gloss_zh: 投标前阶段；投标准备期

teaching_sense.en_definition: The preparatory stage before bids are submitted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式提交投标文件之前，用于了解要求、澄清问题和准备投标的阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fażi preparatorja qabel ma jitressqu l-offerti, meta jiġu studjati r-rekwiżiti u jitħejjew id-dokumenti meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投标前的准备活动或准备阶段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tħejjija li ssir qabel ma jitressqu l-offerti fi proċess ta' sejħa għall-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pre-bidding is the preparation that takes place before participants submit their bids.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投标程序中正式提交投标文件之前的阶段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-istadju fi proċess ta' sejħa għall-offerti li jiġi qabel is-sottomissjoni tal-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The pre-bidding phase is the stage during which participants prepare before submitting their bids.

formal.mt: Matul il-fażi ta' qabel l-offerti, il-parteċipanti jistgħu jitolbu kjarifiki dwar ir-rekwiżiti.
formal.en: During the pre-bidding phase, participants may request clarification of the requirements.
formal.zh: 在投标前阶段，参与者可以要求澄清相关要求。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għadna fil-fażi ta' qabel l-offerti? Pawlu: Iva, issa qed nippreparaw id-dokumenti.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are we still in the pre-bidding phase? Pawlu: Yes, we are preparing the documents now.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们还处于投标前阶段吗？保罗：对，我们现在正在准备文件。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna fil-fażi ta' qabel l-offerti?
messages.mt_standard: Għadna fil-fażi ta' qabel l-offerti?
messages.zh: 我们还处于投标前阶段吗？
messages.en: Are we still in the pre-bidding phase?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa qed nippreparaw id-dokumenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa qed nippreparaw id-dokumenti.
messages.zh: 对，我们现在正在准备文件。
messages.en: Yes, we are preparing the documents now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象投标文件还放在桌上准备、尚未提交的画面，把整个短语记为“投标之前的准备阶段”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To push yourself off the ground or another surface and move through the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用身体发力离开地面或其他支撑面，向上或向前跃起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jimbotta b'saqajh biex jitlaq mill-art jew minn wiċċ ieħor u jiċċaqlaq fl-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跳；使身体离开支撑面而跃起。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitlaq mill-art jew minn wiċċ ieħor billi jimbotta b'saqajh u jogħla jew jimxi 'l quddiem fl-arja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you jump, you push yourself off a surface and move briefly through the air.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, l-atleta qabeż minn fuq ostaklu baxx u niżel fuq saqajh.
formal.en: During the exercise, the athlete jumped over a low obstacle and landed on his feet.
formal.zh: 训练时，运动员跳过一个低矮障碍物，双脚落地。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajtu lil Mark jaqbeż? Ben: Iva, qabeż għoli ħafna!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see Mark jump? Ben: Yes, he jumped really high!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看见马克跳了吗？本：看见了，他跳得可高了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu lil Mark jaqbeż?
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu lil Mark jaqbeż?
messages.zh: 你看见马克跳了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Mark jump?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qabeż għoli ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qabeż għoli ħafna!
messages.zh: 看见了，他跳得可高了！
messages.en: Yes, he jumped really high!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“屈膝、蹬地、腾空、落地”四幅连续画面记住“跳”的动作；例句中的 qabeż 和 jaqbeż 都围绕这个动作理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: People employed to perform domestic work or provide personal service in a household.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受雇在家庭中料理家务或服侍他人的人，表示复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuni impjegati biex jagħmlu xogħol tad-dar jew jaqdu lill-membri ta' familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仆人；佣人，指受雇料理家务或提供个人服侍的多个人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nies li jkunu impjegati f'dar biex jagħmlu xogħol domestiku jew jipprovdu servizz personali lil min jgħix fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Servants are people employed in a household to do domestic work or attend to its members.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-qaddejja tal-palazz ħejjew is-sala qabel ma waslu l-mistednin.
formal.en: In the story, the palace servants prepared the hall before the guests arrived.
formal.zh: 故事中，宫中的仆人们在宾客到达之前布置好了大厅。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min huma dawk in-nies fl-istampa? Toni: Huma l-qaddejja tal-palazz; qed iħejju l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who are those people in the picture? Toni: They are the palace servants; they are preparing the food.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：图里的那些人是谁？托尼：他们是宫中的仆人，正在准备食物。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min huma dawk in-nies fl-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Min huma dawk in-nies fl-istampa?
messages.zh: 图里的那些人是谁？
messages.en: Who are those people in the picture?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma l-qaddejja tal-palazz; qed iħejju l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Huma l-qaddejja tal-palazz; qed iħejju l-ikel.
messages.zh: 他们是宫中的仆人，正在准备食物。
messages.en: They are the palace servants; they are preparing the food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事里几位佣人一起布置大厅，重点记住“一群人”的复数意义；搭配和例句使用 qaddejja 这一拼写。

gloss_zh: 动词条目；所给标签为“现在时和过去时”，具体词义未提供

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb entry supplied with a present-and-past-tense label, without a specified lexical meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原包归为动词的条目，仅提供“现在时和过去时”这一语法标签，未说明具体动作或状态的含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata kklassifikata bħala verb li għandha tikketta dwar iż-żmien preżent u l-passat, iżda li t-tifsira lessikali tagħha mhijiex speċifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 现在时和过去时；这是原包提供的语法标签，未给出该动词的具体词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tikketta grammatikali li ssemmi ż-żmien preżent u l-passat, mingħajr ma tagħti t-tifsira tal-verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This label refers to present and past tense but does not specify what the verb means.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'qaghad' hija kklassifikata bħala verb, iżda t-tikketta mogħtija ssemmi biss iż-żmien preżent u l-passat u ma tispeċifikax it-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The entry 'qaghad' is classified as a verb, but its supplied label mentions only present and past tense and does not specify its meaning.
formal.zh: “qaghad”词条被归为动词，但所给标签只提到现在时和过去时，并未说明其具体含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'qaghad' f'din il-lista? Mark: Il-lista ssemmi biss il-preżent u l-passat; ma tagħtix it-tifsira tal-verb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'qaghad' mean in this list? Mark: The list only mentions present and past tense; it does not give the verb's meaning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张表里的“qaghad”是什么意思？马克：表里只提到现在时和过去时，没有给出这个动词的词义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'qaghad' f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'qaghad' f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这张表里的“qaghad”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'qaghad' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lista ssemmi biss il-preżent u l-passat; ma tagħtix it-tifsira tal-verb.
messages.mt_standard: Il-lista ssemmi biss il-preżent u l-passat; ma tagħtix it-tifsira tal-verb.
messages.zh: 表里只提到现在时和过去时，没有给出这个动词的词义。
messages.en: The list only mentions present and past tense; it does not give the verb's meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这张学习卡分成“词义”和“时态标签”两栏：目前只填有“现在／过去”的标签，词义留待核实，避免把语法标签当成动作含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wait in a line of people until it is your turn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加入等候的队伍，等待轮到自己。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jistenna f'ringiela ta' nies sakemm jasal imissu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排队，按先后次序等候。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed joqgħod f'ringiela ma' nies oħra u jistenna sakemm jasal imissu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone queues, they wait in a line of people until it is their turn.

formal.mt: Kull viżitatur qagħad fil-kju quddiem id-daħla u stenna sakemm wasal imissu.
formal.en: Each visitor queued at the entrance and waited until it was their turn.
formal.zh: 每位访客都在入口处排队，等待轮到自己。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn hu Pawlu? Luqa: Qagħad fil-kju biex jixtri l-biljetti. Marta: Mela nistennewh hawn.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where is Pawlu? Luqa: He joined the queue to buy the tickets. Marta: Then let's wait for him here.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗在哪里？卢卡：他去排队买票了。玛尔塔：那我们就在这里等他吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu Pawlu?
messages.zh: 保罗在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qagħad fil-kju biex jixtri l-biljetti.
messages.mt_standard: Qagħad fil-kju biex jixtri l-biljetti.
messages.zh: 他去排队买票了。
messages.en: He joined the queue to buy the tickets.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nistennewh hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nistennewh hawn.
messages.zh: 那我们就在这里等他吧。
messages.en: Then let's wait for him here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上售票口前排队的画面：人在队伍里等，意思就是排队等候。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To depend on a person or thing for help, support, or a desired result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依靠某人或某事，指望其提供帮助、支持或所需的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jistrieħ fuq persuna jew ħaġa biex jikseb għajnuna, appoġġ jew riżultat mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依赖，信赖并指望某人或某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed jafda f'persuna jew ħaġa u jistrieħ fuqha għall-għajnuna jew għall-appoġġ li jkollu bżonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you rely on someone or something, you depend on them to provide what you need.

formal.mt: Il-maniġer qagħad fuq l-esperjenza tat-tim biex isolvi l-problema fil-ħin.
formal.en: The manager relied on the team's experience to solve the problem in time.
formal.zh: 经理依靠团队的经验及时解决了问题。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu qagħad fuqek biex tlesti x-xogħol? David: Iva, u lestejtu fil-ħin. Marija: Tajjeb, issa jista' jibgħatu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did Pawlu rely on you to finish the work? David: Yes, and I finished it on time. Marija: Good, now he can send it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗指望你完成这项工作吗？戴维：是的，而且我按时完成了。玛丽娅：好，那他现在可以把它发出去了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu qagħad fuqek biex tlesti x-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu qagħad fuqek biex tlesti x-xogħol?
messages.zh: 保罗指望你完成这项工作吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu rely on you to finish the work?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u lestejtu fil-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u lestejtu fil-ħin.
messages.zh: 是的，而且我按时完成了。
messages.en: Yes, and I finished it on time.

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, issa jista' jibgħatu.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, issa jista' jibgħatu.
messages.zh: 好，那他现在可以把它发出去了。
messages.en: Good, now he can send it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把任务的重量交给可靠的人承担，用这个画面记住整个短语表示依靠、指望。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lower the body close to the ground by bending the knees.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 弯曲双膝，将身体降低到接近地面的位置，呈蹲下或蹲伏姿势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jinżel qrib l-art billi jgħawweġ irkopptejh u jbaxxi ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蹲伏，屈膝压低身体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed jgħawweġ irkopptejh u jbaxxi ġismu qrib l-art biex jieħu pożizzjoni baxxa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone crouches, they bend their knees and lower their body close to the ground.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蹲下，双膝弯曲、臀部接近脚跟而身体由双脚支撑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed jinżel b'irkopptejh milwijin u bil-warrani qrib l-għarqbejn, waqt li jżomm il-piż ta' ġismu fuq saqajh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone squats, they bend their knees deeply and lower their bottom towards their heels.

collocations.en: squatted down to pick up the keys

formal.mt: L-għalliem qagħad kokka ħdejn it-tifel biex jurih kif iħawwel iż-żerriegħa.
formal.en: The teacher squatted beside the boy to show him how to plant the seed.
formal.zh: 老师蹲在男孩身旁，向他示范如何播下种子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark qagħad kokka ħdejn il-mejda? Nina: Biex jiġbor iċ-ċwievet li waqgħu. Sara: Ara, hemm waħda taħt is-siġġu wkoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark crouch beside the table? Nina: To pick up the keys that fell. Sara: Look, there's one under the chair too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么蹲在桌子旁边？妮娜：为了捡起掉下来的钥匙。萨拉：看，椅子下面也有一把。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark qagħad kokka ħdejn il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark qagħad kokka ħdejn il-mejda?
messages.zh: 马克为什么蹲在桌子旁边？
messages.en: Why did Mark crouch beside the table?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jiġbor iċ-ċwievet li waqgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jiġbor iċ-ċwievet li waqgħu.
messages.zh: 为了捡起掉下来的钥匙。
messages.en: To pick up the keys that fell.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, hemm waħda taħt is-siġġu wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Ara, hemm waħda taħt is-siġġu wkoll.
messages.zh: 看，椅子下面也有一把。
messages.en: Look, there's one under the chair too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 边念短语边想象屈膝蹲下捡钥匙：身体变低，双膝弯曲，帮助区分蹲下与站立。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ring-shaped doughnuts with a hole in the middle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用面团制成、中央有孔的环形甜点；本词条按环形甜甜圈学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħelu magħmul mill-għaġina u msajjar f'għamla ta' ċrieki b'toqba fin-nofs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 环形甜甜圈，即中央有孔、外形呈圆环的面团甜点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħelu tal-għaġina msajjar f'għamla ta' ċirku b'toqba fin-nofs.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ring-shaped doughnut is a sweet food made from dough in a circular shape with a hole in the centre.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa ġew offruti qagħaq friski flimkien mat-te u l-kafè.
formal.en: Fresh ring-shaped doughnuts were offered with tea and coffee during the meeting.
formal.zh: 会议期间提供了新鲜的环形甜甜圈，以及茶和咖啡。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom qagħaq friski llum? Rita: Iva, trid tnejn biz-zokkor? Mark: Iva, grazzi, ħa nieħuhom miegħi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have fresh ring-shaped doughnuts today? Rita: Yes, would you like two with sugar? Mark: Yes, thank you, I'll take them with me.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们今天有新鲜的环形甜甜圈吗？丽塔：有，要两个加糖的吗？马克：要，谢谢，我带走。

messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom qagħaq friski llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom qagħaq friski llum?
messages.zh: 你们今天有新鲜的环形甜甜圈吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh ring-shaped doughnuts today?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, trid tnejn biz-zokkor?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, trid tnejn biz-zokkor?
messages.zh: 有，要两个加糖的吗？
messages.en: Yes, would you like two with sugar?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi, ħa nieħuhom miegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi, ħa nieħuhom miegħi.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢，我带走。
messages.en: Yes, thank you, I'll take them with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画出中央有洞的圆环甜点，把 qagħaq 和这个形状一起记，再用点心店买两个的场景复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express the meaning of a word or text in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把词语或文本的意思用英语表达出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tesprimi bl-Ingliż it-tifsira ta' kelma jew ta' test miktub b'lingwa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将词语或文本翻译成英语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tittraduċi kelma jew test minn lingwa oħra għall-Ingliż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you translate something into English, you express its meaning using English words.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-verb 'qriegh' jirreferi għall-azzjoni li tittraduċi kelma jew test għall-Ingliż.
formal.en: In this exercise, the verb 'qriegh' refers to the action of translating a word or text into English.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，动词 qriegh 指把词语或文本译成英语的行为。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser 'qriegh' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Ifisser li tittraduċi għall-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'qriegh' mean in this exercise? Pawlu: It means to translate into English.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这道练习里的 qriegh 是什么意思？保罗：意思是译成英语。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser 'qriegh' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser 'qriegh' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这道练习里的 qriegh 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'qriegh' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tittraduċi għall-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tittraduċi għall-Ingliż.
messages.zh: 意思是译成英语。
messages.en: It means to translate into English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qriegh 与“译成英语”整组配对记忆，想象把一句中文改用英语表达，重点记住翻译的目标语言。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of passing across a border between countries or territories.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一个国家或地区越过边界进入另一个国家或地区的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jgħaddi minn pajjiż jew territorju għal ieħor billi jaqsam il-fruntiera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跨越国家或地区边境的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-passaġġ minn naħa għal oħra ta' fruntiera bejn pajjiżi jew territorji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Border crossing is the act of passing from one country or territory into another across their shared boundary.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跨越国界或地区边界的行为或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li wieħed jgħaddi minn naħa għal oħra tal-fruntieri bejn pajjiżi jew territorji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The crossing of borders involves moving across boundaries that separate different countries or territories.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 越过国界或领土边界的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-passaġġ minn pajjiż jew territorju għal ieħor billi wieħed jgħaddi minn naħa għal oħra tal-fruntieri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The crossing of frontiers occurs when people or goods pass across boundaries between countries or territories.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċeduri għall-qsim tal-fruntieri u d-dokumenti meħtieġa għall-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The report describes the procedures for crossing borders and the documents required for the journey.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了跨越边境的手续以及旅程所需的文件。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandek id-dokumenti għall-qsim tal-fruntieri? David: Iva, qegħdin fil-basket tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you have the documents for crossing borders? David: Yes, they're in my bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你带了过境所需的文件吗？戴维：带了，都在我的包里。

messages.speaker: Marta (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek id-dokumenti għall-qsim tal-fruntieri?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek id-dokumenti għall-qsim tal-fruntieri?
messages.zh: 你带了过境所需的文件吗？
messages.en: Do you have the documents for crossing borders?

messages.speaker: David (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qegħdin fil-basket tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qegħdin fil-basket tiegħi.
messages.zh: 带了，都在我的包里。
messages.en: Yes, they're in my bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上“拿着证件跨过地图边界线”的画面，记住它表示跨越边境这一行为。

gloss_zh: 负担分担；共同承担责任或费用

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sharing of responsibilities, costs, or other burdens among several people or groups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由多个人或团体共同分担责任、费用或其他负担。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tqassim tar-responsabbiltajiet, tal-ispejjeż jew ta' piżijiet oħra bejn diversi persuni jew gruppi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在多个人、团体或机构之间分担责任、费用或其他负担。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament li bih diversi persuni, gruppi jew istituzzjonijiet jaqsmu bejniethom ir-responsabbiltajiet, l-ispejjeż jew piżijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Burden sharing is an arrangement in which several people or groups each take responsibility for part of a difficult task or cost.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jistabbilixxi qsim ġust tal-piżijiet bejn l-organizzazzjonijiet li qed jieħdu sehem fil-proġett.
formal.en: The agreement establishes fair burden sharing among the organizations participating in the project.
formal.zh: 该协议规定，由参与项目的各组织公平分担负担。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif se nagħmlu l-qsim tal-piżijiet għal din l-attività? Mark: Jien nieħu ħsieb ix-xiri, u int tieħu ħsieb it-trasport.
colloquial.en: Nina: How are we going to share the burdens for this activity? Mark: I'll handle the shopping, and you can handle the transport.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这次活动的负担怎么分担？马克：我负责采购，你负责交通安排。

messages.speaker: Nina (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nagħmlu l-qsim tal-piżijiet għal din l-attività?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nagħmlu l-qsim tal-piżijiet għal din l-attività?
messages.zh: 这次活动的负担怎么分担？
messages.en: How are we going to share the burdens for this activity?

messages.speaker: Mark (共同组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien nieħu ħsieb ix-xiri, u int tieħu ħsieb it-trasport.
messages.mt_standard: Jien nieħu ħsieb ix-xiri, u int tieħu ħsieb it-trasport.
messages.zh: 我负责采购，你负责交通安排。
messages.en: I'll handle the shopping, and you can handle the transport.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个人把一份沉重任务分成几份，各自承担一部分；用这个画面记住整个短语表示“分担负担”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A liquid preparation put into the eyes in small drops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以小液滴形式滴入眼睛使用的液体制剂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Preparazzjoni likwida li titqiegħed fl-għajnejn fi qtar żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供滴入眼睛使用的液体制剂，即滴眼液或眼药水。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Preparazzjoni likwida maħsuba biex titqiegħed fl-għajnejn fi qtar żgħar, għal kura jew biex iżżommhom niedja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Eye drops are a liquid preparation that you put into your eyes in small amounts to treat or moisten them.

formal.mt: L-istruzzjonijiet għall-użu tal-qtar għall-għajnejn jinsabu fuq it-tikketta tal-flixkun.
formal.en: The instructions for using the eye drops are on the bottle's label.
formal.zh: 滴眼液的使用说明写在瓶身标签上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn poġġejt il-qtar għall-għajnejn? Luqa: Fil-kexxun ħdejn is-sodda, fil-kaxxa tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you put the eye drops? Luqa: In the drawer beside the bed, in their box.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你把眼药水放哪儿了？卢卡：床边的抽屉里，装在原来的盒子里。

messages.speaker: Sara (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġejt il-qtar għall-għajnejn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġejt il-qtar għall-għajnejn?
messages.zh: 你把眼药水放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the eye drops?

messages.speaker: Luqa (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ħdejn is-sodda, fil-kaxxa tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ħdejn is-sodda, fil-kaxxa tagħhom.
messages.zh: 床边的抽屉里，装在原来的盒子里。
messages.en: In the drawer beside the bed, in their box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和一只标有眼睛图案的小滴瓶联系起来，想象一滴液体滴向眼睛，记住“滴眼液”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of despair in which someone loses hope.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因失去希望而产生的绝望或灰心情绪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' dwejjaq kbar li fih persuna titlef it-tama.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失去希望时的绝望或灰心。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat emozzjonali li fih persuna tħoss dwejjaq kbar u ma tibqax tara tama.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone feels despair, they feel deeply unhappy because they have lost hope.

formal.mt: Wara diversi tentattivi li fallew, hija ħasset qtigħ ta' qalb, iżda bl-appoġġ tal-familja reġgħet sabet it-tama.
formal.en: After several failed attempts, she felt despair, but with her family's support she found hope again.
formal.zh: 多次尝试失败后，她感到绝望，但在家人的支持下重新找到了希望。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Wara dan ir-riżultat, qed inħoss qtigħ ta' qalb. Pawlu: Nifhmek. Ejja nitkellmu u naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Marta: After this result, I'm feeling despair. Pawlu: I understand. Let's talk and see what we can do.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：看到这个结果，我感到很绝望。保罗：我理解。我们聊聊，看看能做些什么。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dan ir-riżultat, qed inħoss qtigħ ta' qalb.
messages.mt_standard: Wara dan ir-riżultat, qed inħoss qtigħ ta' qalb.
messages.zh: 看到这个结果，我感到很绝望。
messages.en: After this result, I'm feeling despair.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhmek. Ejja nitkellmu u naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhmek. Ejja nitkellmu u naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu.
messages.zh: 我理解。我们聊聊，看看能做些什么。
messages.en: I understand. Let's talk and see what we can do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成“希望落空后心灰意冷”的画面，整体记作绝望；搭配 tħoss 一起练习。

gloss_zh: 词义未明；所给材料未提供释义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form whose meaning and part of speech are not identified in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料中词义和词性均未确定的形式，暂不赋予具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li l-materjal mogħti ma jidentifikax it-tifsira tagħha jew il-parti tad-diskors tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未知；所给材料未说明此形式的含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' din il-forma mhix speċifikata fil-materjal mogħti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry does not establish what this form means or how it functions grammatically.

formal.mt: Il-materjal mogħti jinkludi l-forma 'qualb', iżda ma jispeċifikax it-tifsira tagħha jew il-parti tad-diskors tagħha.
formal.en: The supplied material includes the form 'qualb', but does not specify its meaning or part of speech.
formal.zh: 所给材料收录了“qualb”这一形式，但未说明其含义或词性。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser 'qualb' hawn? Mark: Il-materjal ma jgħidx. Għalissa nħallu t-tifsira mhux magħrufa.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'qualb' mean here? Mark: The material doesn't say. For now, we'll leave the meaning unidentified.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：“qualb”在这里是什么意思？马克：材料没有说明。我们暂时把词义标为未知。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'qualb' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'qualb' hawn?
messages.zh: “qualb”在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'qualb' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-materjal ma jgħidx. Għalissa nħallu t-tifsira mhux magħrufa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-materjal ma jgħidx. Għalissa nħallu t-tifsira mhux magħrufa.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of the arm between the elbow and the wrist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手臂中位于肘部与手腕之间的部分，即前臂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tad-driegħ li tinsab bejn il-minkeb u l-polz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 前臂，即从肘部到手腕的这一段手臂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti tad-driegħ li testendi mill-minkeb sal-polz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your forearm is the part of your arm that extends from your elbow to your wrist.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-ħaddiem weġġa' l-qudriegh tal-lemin waqt li kien qed jerfa' kaxxa.
formal.en: The report indicates that the worker injured his right forearm while lifting a box.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该工人在搬起一个箱子时伤到了右前臂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn weġġajt? Toni: Fil-qudriegh, bejn il-minkeb u l-polz.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you hurt yourself? Toni: In my forearm, between my elbow and wrist.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你伤到哪里了？托尼：前臂，就是肘部和手腕之间。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn weġġajt?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn weġġajt?
messages.zh: 你伤到哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you hurt yourself?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-qudriegh, bejn il-minkeb u l-polz.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-qudriegh, bejn il-minkeb u l-polz.
messages.zh: 前臂，就是肘部和手腕之间。
messages.en: In my forearm, between my elbow and wrist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 伸出手臂，用另一只手从肘部指到手腕，把这一整段与 qudriegh 和“前臂”对应记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small edible seeds that are cooked and served as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 藜麦，种子可煮熟食用的一种食材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żrieragħ żgħar li jissajru u jittieklu bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 藜麦；可煮食，也可加入沙拉等菜肴的种子类食材。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żrieragħ żgħar ta' pjanta li jintużaw bħala ikel u jistgħu jissajru jew jiżdiedu mal-insalati wara li jissajru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Quinoa consists of small edible seeds that you cook and serve in dishes such as salads.

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, il-menu joffri insalata bil-quinoa, bit-tadam u bil-ħjar.
formal.en: For lunch, the menu offers a salad with quinoa, tomatoes, and cucumber.
formal.zh: 午餐菜单提供一道搭配藜麦、番茄和黄瓜的沙拉。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'se nagħmlu għall-ikel illum? Ġużeppi: Ejja nsajru l-quinoa u nżiduha mal-insalata.
colloquial.en: Marija: What shall we make to eat today? Ġużeppi: Let's cook some quinoa and add it to the salad.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：今天我们做什么吃？朱塞佩：我们煮些藜麦，加到沙拉里吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nagħmlu għall-ikel illum?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nagħmlu għall-ikel illum?
messages.zh: 今天我们做什么吃？
messages.en: What shall we make to eat today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nsajru l-quinoa u nżiduha mal-insalata.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nsajru l-quinoa u nżiduha mal-insalata.
messages.zh: 我们煮些藜麦，加到沙拉里吧。
messages.en: Let's cook some quinoa and add it to the salad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一勺煮熟的藜麦拌进沙拉，同时记住 quinoa 与 insalata bil-quinoa，建立食材和菜名的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The religious text of Islam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伊斯兰教的宗教经典《古兰经》。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-test reliġjuż tal-Iżlam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗教经典；本词指《古兰经》。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Test li għandu importanza reliġjuża; hawnhekk jirreferi għall-Quran, it-test reliġjuż tal-Iżlam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The Quran is the religious text of Islam.

formal.mt: L-istudenti qraw silta mill-Quran u ddiskutew it-tifsira tagħha fil-klassi.
formal.en: The students read a passage from the Quran and discussed its meaning in class.
formal.zh: 学生们阅读了《古兰经》中的一段文字，并在课堂上讨论了它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema ktieb qed taqra? Omar: Qed naqra traduzzjoni tal-Quran.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which book are you reading? Omar: I'm reading a translation of the Quran.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在读哪本书？奥马尔：我在读《古兰经》的译本。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema ktieb qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: Liema ktieb qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你在读哪本书？
messages.en: Which book are you reading?

messages.speaker: Omar (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naqra traduzzjoni tal-Quran.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naqra traduzzjoni tal-Quran.
messages.zh: 我在读《古兰经》的译本。
messages.en: I'm reading a translation of the Quran.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把Quran与书名《古兰经》配对记忆，再用“阅读经典”和“一节经文”两个场景巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The skin covering the top of the head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖头顶、通常生长头发的皮肤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġilda li tgħatti l-parti ta' fuq tar-ras u li normalment jikber ix-xagħar fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头皮，即覆盖头顶、通常生长头发的皮肤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ġilda tal-parti ta' fuq tar-ras, fejn normalment jikber ix-xagħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your scalp is the skin on the top of your head where hair normally grows.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头皮，指头部上方被头发覆盖或原本可生长头发的皮肤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ġilda fuq in-naħa ta' fuq tar-ras, kemm jekk tkun miksija bix-xagħar kif ukoll jekk le.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The scalp is the skin covering the upper part of a person's head.

formal.mt: Fil-kwestjonarju, il-parteċipanti indikaw jekk kellhomx ħakk jew nixfa fil-qurriegħa.
formal.en: In the questionnaire, participants indicated whether they had an itchy or dry scalp.
formal.zh: 参与者在问卷中注明了自己是否有头皮发痒或干燥的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tobrox rasek? Pawlu: Għandi ħakk fil-qurriegħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you scratching your head? Pawlu: My scalp is itchy.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么在挠头？保罗：我的头皮发痒。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tobrox rasek?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tobrox rasek?
messages.zh: 你为什么在挠头？
messages.en: Why are you scratching your head?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħakk fil-qurriegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħakk fil-qurriegħa.
messages.zh: 我的头皮发痒。
messages.en: My scalp is itchy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指拨开头发后碰到的那层皮肤，把qurriegħa与“头皮发痒”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar term for the penis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指阴茎的粗俗说法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma vulgari li tirreferi għall-pene, organu ġenitali maskili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴茎的粗俗称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma vulgari għall-pene, jiġifieri organu ġenitali maskili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This is a vulgar word used to refer to the penis.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, il-kelma 'qzieqez' tingħata bit-tifsira ta' 'żobb', kelma vulgari għall-pene.
formal.en: In this vocabulary exercise, 'qzieqez' is given the meaning of 'żobb', a vulgar word for the penis.
formal.zh: 在这项词汇练习中，“qzieqez”按“żobb”这一义项解释，即阴茎的粗俗称呼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'qzieqez' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Hawn tfisser 'żobb'; hija kelma vulgari għall-pene.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'qzieqez' mean in this exercise? Mark: Here it means 'żobb'; it's a vulgar word for the penis.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习里的“qzieqez”是什么意思？马克：这里指“żobb”，是阴茎的粗俗称呼。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'qzieqez' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'qzieqez' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这道练习里的“qzieqez”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'qzieqez' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser 'żobb'; hija kelma vulgari għall-pene.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser 'żobb'; hija kelma vulgari għall-pene.
messages.zh: 这里指“żobb”，是阴茎的粗俗称呼。
messages.en: Here it means 'żobb'; it's a vulgar word for the penis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条给定义项，把qzieqez与“阴茎”和“粗俗语体”两张记忆标签一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To achieve victory in a competition or obtain a prize through success.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在比赛或竞争中获胜，或因胜出而获得奖项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikseb ir-rebħa f'logħba jew kompetizzjoni, jew tikseb premju bis-suċċess tiegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赢，获胜；赢得比赛或奖项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Toħroġ rebbieħ f'logħba jew kompetizzjoni, jew tikseb premju bħala riżultat tas-suċċess tiegħek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you win, you achieve victory in a contest or receive a prize for succeeding.

formal.mt: It-tim tal-iskola rebaħ il-kompetizzjoni wara xhur ta' taħriġ.
formal.en: The school team won the competition after months of training.
formal.zh: 经过数月训练，校队赢得了比赛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min rebaħ il-logħba lbieraħ? David: Rebaħ it-tim tagħna!
colloquial.en: Sara: Who won the game yesterday? David: Our team won!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：昨天谁赢了比赛？戴维：我们队赢了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min rebaħ il-logħba lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Min rebaħ il-logħba lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 昨天谁赢了比赛？
messages.en: Who won the game yesterday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rebaħ it-tim tagħna!
messages.mt_standard: Rebaħ it-tim tagħna!
messages.zh: 我们队赢了！
messages.en: Our team won!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“比赛结束举起奖杯”的画面记住获胜义，再把“赢比赛”和“赢奖项”配成一组练习。

gloss_zh: 词义未明；所给义项标记为 r_ch_l

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun supplied with the unresolved sense marker 'r_ch_l'; its meaning cannot be established from the packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料中标为名词，但仅提供未解释的义项标记 r_ch_l，无法据此确定具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li fil-pakkett għandu biss il-kodiċi mhux spjegat 'r_ch_l', mingħajr tagħrif biżżejjed biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 义项未能确定：所给 r_ch_l 是未解释的标记，不能据此给出可靠的具体释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhijiex stabbilita, għax il-pakkett jagħti biss il-kodiċi mhux spjegat 'r_ch_l'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The noun is associated with an unexplained marker, so its meaning cannot be determined from the supplied information.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'rachelle' hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda l-kodiċi 'r_ch_l' ma jipprovdix tifsira ċara.
formal.en: In the exercise, the word 'rachelle' is marked as a noun, but the code 'r_ch_l' does not provide a clear meaning.
formal.zh: 在练习中，“rachelle”被标为名词，但代码“r_ch_l”并未提供明确的词义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'rachelle' hawn? Mark: Il-pakkett jagħti biss 'r_ch_l'; minn hekk ma nistgħux inkunu nafu t-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word 'rachelle' mean here? Mark: The packet only gives 'r_ch_l'; we cannot determine the meaning from that.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的“rachelle”是什么意思？Mark：资料只给了“r_ch_l”；我们无法据此确定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving fundamental or far-reaching change, or supporting changes that depart greatly from existing arrangements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及根本、彻底或影响深远的改变的；也指主张大幅改变现有制度或做法的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi bidla fundamentali jew estensiva, jew li jappoġġa tibdil li jitbiegħed ħafna mill-arranġamenti jew mill-prattiċi eżistenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 根本的、彻底的；在思想或主张上要求大幅改变现状的，激进的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jbiddel xi ħaġa mill-bażi tagħha jew li jitlob tibdil kbir fil-mod kif l-affarijiet huma organizzati jew isiru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A radical change affects the basic nature of something, while a radical proposal calls for major changes to existing arrangements.

collocations.zh: 一项主张大幅变革的提议

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi bidla radikali fil-mod kif jiġu organizzati s-servizzi, sabiex dawn isiru aktar aċċessibbli għar-residenti.
formal.en: The report proposes a radical change in how services are organized so that they become more accessible to residents.
formal.zh: 报告提议从根本上改变服务的组织方式，使居民能够更方便地使用这些服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tibdel il-pjan kollu? David: Iva, qed nipproponi bidla radikali, għax il-pjan ta' bħalissa ma jaħdimx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to change the whole plan? David: Yes, I'm proposing a radical change because the current plan isn't working.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你想把整个计划都改掉吗？David：对，我提议作出根本性的改变，因为现在的计划行不通。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tibdel il-pjan kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tibdel il-pjan kollu?
messages.zh: 你想把整个计划都改掉吗？
messages.en: Do you want to change the whole plan?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nipproponi bidla radikali, għax il-pjan ta' bħalissa ma jaħdimx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nipproponi bidla radikali, għax il-pjan ta' bħalissa ma jaħdimx.
messages.zh: 对，我提议作出根本性的改变，因为现在的计划行不通。
messages.en: Yes, I'm proposing a radical change because the current plan isn't working.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 bidla radikali 联想“整个方案从基础上重做”，记住它形容改变的彻底程度，也能形容激进主张。

gloss_zh: 激进主义；主张根本变革的思想

teaching_sense.en_definition: The belief in or advocacy of fundamental changes to existing political, social, or other arrangements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主张对现有政治、社会或其他制度安排作根本性改变的思想或立场，即激进主义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twemmin jew pożizzjoni li tappoġġa tibdil fundamentali fl-arranġamenti politiċi, soċjali jew oħrajn li jkunu jeżistu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激进主义：认为现有制度或社会安排需要根本变革，并支持这种变革的思想或立场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Twemmin li l-istituzzjonijiet jew l-arranġamenti eżistenti jeħtieġu jinbidlu mill-bażi tagħhom, flimkien mal-appoġġ għal dan it-tibdil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Radicalism is the belief that existing political or social arrangements should undergo fundamental change.

collocations.zh: 该运动的激进主义立场

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza r-radikaliżmu tal-moviment billi jeżamina t-talbiet tiegħu għal tibdil fundamentali fl-istituzzjonijiet politiċi.
formal.en: The study analyzes the movement's radicalism by examining its demands for fundamental changes to political institutions.
formal.zh: 这项研究通过考察该运动对政治制度进行根本变革的诉求，分析其激进主义立场。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed nitkellmu dwar ir-radikaliżmu ta' dan il-grupp? Ġorġ: Għax irid ibiddel is-sistema mill-bażi tagħha, u dan huwa ċentrali għall-ideat tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are we talking about this group's radicalism? Ġorġ: Because it wants to change the system fundamentally, and that is central to its ideas.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们为什么在讨论这个团体的激进主义立场？Ġorġ：因为它想从根本上改变制度，而这正是它思想的核心。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nitkellmu dwar ir-radikaliżmu ta' dan il-grupp?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nitkellmu dwar ir-radikaliżmu ta' dan il-grupp?
messages.zh: 我们为什么在讨论这个团体的激进主义立场？
messages.en: Why are we talking about this group's radicalism?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irid ibiddel is-sistema mill-bażi tagħha, u dan huwa ċentrali għall-ideat tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irid ibiddel is-sistema mill-bażi tagħha, u dan huwa ċentrali għall-ideat tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为它想从根本上改变制度，而这正是它思想的核心。
messages.en: Because it wants to change the system fundamentally, and that is central to its ideas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 radikaliżmu 记成一张写着“主张根本变革”的思想标签：这里谈的是主义或立场，而非某一次改变。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that transfers heat, used to warm a room or help cool a vehicle's engine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过传递热量来给房间供暖或帮助车辆发动机散热的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Radjatur huwa apparat li jittrasferixxi s-sħana biex isaħħan kamra jew jgħin biex titkessaħ il-magna ta' vettura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 散热器，指用于房间供暖或车辆发动机冷却的热量交换装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Radjatur huwa apparat li jagħti s-sħana lil kamra jew jgħin biex titneħħa s-sħana mill-magna ta' vettura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A radiator is a device that transfers heat to warm a room or to help cool a vehicle's engine.

formal.mt: It-tekniku spezzjona r-radjatur tal-karozza biex jara jekk kienx qed inixxi.
formal.en: The technician inspected the car's radiator to see whether it was leaking.
formal.zh: 技术人员检查了汽车散热器，查看是否存在泄漏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kamra għadha kiesħa? Mark: Ir-radjatur għadu mitfi. Se nixegħlu issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the room still cold? Mark: The radiator is still off. I'll turn it on now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：房间怎么还这么冷？Mark：暖气片还没开。我现在就打开。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kamra għadha kiesħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kamra għadha kiesħa?
messages.zh: 房间怎么还这么冷？
messages.en: Why is the room still cold?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-radjatur għadu mitfi. Se nixegħlu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-radjatur għadu mitfi. Se nixegħlu issa.
messages.zh: 暖气片还没开。我现在就打开。
messages.en: The radiator is still off. I'll turn it on now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 radjatur 与“热量传出去”的画面绑定：房间里是暖气片，汽车里是发动机散热器，同一个词联系两个场景。

gloss_zh: 放射性的；具有放射性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Emitting radiation as a result of changes in unstable atomic nuclei.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不稳定原子核发生变化而释放辐射的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal radjuattiv huwa materjal li joħroġ radjazzjoni minħabba bidliet fin-nuklei instabbli tal-atomi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有放射性的，指物质因其不稳定原子核发生变化而释放辐射。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun radjuattiva meta toħroġ radjazzjoni minħabba bidliet fin-nuklei instabbli tal-atomi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substance that is radioactive gives off radiation because its unstable atomic nuclei undergo changes.

formal.mt: Il-materjal radjuattiv jinżamm f'kontenituri apposta, u l-aċċess għaż-żona huwa kkontrollat.
formal.en: The radioactive material is kept in specially designed containers, and access to the area is controlled.
formal.zh: 放射性物质存放在专用容器中，该区域实行出入管制。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan is-sinjal ifisser li hawn materjal radjuattiv? Pawlu: Iva, għalhekk m'għandniex nidħlu mingħajr permess.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this sign mean there is radioactive material here? Pawlu: Yes, so we mustn't go in without permission.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个标志是不是表示这里有放射性物质？Pawlu：是的，所以我们不能未经许可就进去。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-sinjal ifisser li hawn materjal radjuattiv?
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-sinjal ifisser li hawn materjal radjuattiv?
messages.zh: 这个标志是不是表示这里有放射性物质？
messages.en: Does this sign mean there is radioactive material here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalhekk m'għandniex nidħlu mingħajr permess.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalhekk m'għandniex nidħlu mingħajr permess.
messages.zh: 是的，所以我们不能未经许可就进去。
messages.en: Yes, so we mustn't go in without permission.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 radjuattiv 放进 materjal radjuattiv“放射性物质”这个词组来记，联想容器上的辐射标志，记住它描述的是物质的性质。

gloss_zh: 刚开始破土而出的植物或杂草

teaching_sense.en_definition: Plants or weeds at the stage when they first begin to emerge through the soil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刚开始从土壤中冒出来的植物或杂草，强调初次破土的生长阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rafgħan huwa l-pjanti jew il-ħaxix ħażin fl-istadju meta jkunu għadhom qed jibdew joħorġu mill-ħamrija.

sense_translations.en_definition: plants or weeds beginning to break through the soil
sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始破土而出的植物或杂草，指刚从土壤中冒头的新生植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma rafgħan tirreferi għall-pjanti jew għall-ħaxix ħażin li jkunu għadhom kemm bdew joħorġu minn ġol-ħamrija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rafgħan refers to plants or weeds as they first begin to push up through the soil.

collocations.zh: 初生植物开始破土可见

formal.mt: Wara l-ewwel xita, deher ir-rafgħan fl-għalqa, hekk kif il-pjanti bdew joħorġu mill-ħamrija.
formal.en: After the first rain, new plant growth appeared in the field as the plants began to emerge through the soil.
formal.zh: 第一场雨过后，田里的植物开始破土，初生的新苗显现出来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara, beda jidher ir-rafgħan! Toni: Iva, il-pjanti żgħar qed joħorġu mill-ħamrija.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look, the plants are starting to come through! Toni: Yes, the little plants are emerging from the soil.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看，植物开始破土冒头了！Toni：是啊，小苗正从土里长出来。

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, beda jidher ir-rafgħan!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, beda jidher ir-rafgħan!
messages.zh: 看，植物开始破土冒头了！
messages.en: Look, the plants are starting to come through!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-pjanti żgħar qed joħorġu mill-ħamrija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-pjanti żgħar qed joħorġu mill-ħamrija.
messages.zh: 是啊，小苗正从土里长出来。
messages.en: Yes, the little plants are emerging from the soil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 rafgħan 时想象雨后土面刚被嫩芽顶开的瞬间，把词义锁定在“植物或杂草刚刚破土”，避免泛记成所有植物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The loud rumbling or crashing sound in the sky associated with lightning during a storm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雷暴中伴随闪电产生的隆隆声或轰鸣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ragħda hija l-ħoss qawwi li jinstema' fis-sema waqt maltempata u li jkun marbut mas-sajjetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雷声，指雷暴中由闪电引起、从天空传来的轰鸣声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ragħda hija l-ħoss li jiġi mis-sajjetti waqt maltempata u li jista' jinstema' bħala ħoss qasir u qawwi jew bħala ħoss twil u baxx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Thunder is the loud sound produced by lightning, often heard as a crash or a prolonged rumble.

formal.mt: Matul il-maltempata, instemgħet ragħda qawwija u x-xita kompliet nieżla għal diversi sigħat.
formal.en: During the storm, loud thunder was heard and the rain continued to fall for several hours.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，雷声轰鸣，大雨持续下了数个小时。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt dik ir-ragħda? Ben: Iva, kienet qawwija ħafna! Ejja nidħlu ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear that thunder? Ben: Yes, it was really loud! Let's go inside.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你听到刚才那声雷了吗？Ben：听到了，特别响！我们进屋吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt dik ir-ragħda?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt dik ir-ragħda?
messages.zh: 你听到刚才那声雷了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that thunder?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet qawwija ħafna! Ejja nidħlu ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet qawwija ħafna! Ejja nidħlu ġewwa.
messages.zh: 听到了，特别响！我们进屋吧。
messages.en: Yes, it was really loud! Let's go inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ragħda 与“耳朵听见轰隆雷声”的画面绑定，再用 ragħda qawwija“响亮的雷声”整组记忆，抓住声音这一核心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The craft or activity of decorating cloth by making stitches with thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用针线在布料上绣出装饰图案的活动或工艺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol jew is-sengħa li biha drapp jiġi mżejjen b'disinji magħmula bil-labra u l-ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺绣；用针线在织物上制作装饰图案的工艺。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sengħa li tinvolvi t-tiżjin tad-drapp b'punti u disinji magħmula bil-labra u l-ħajt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Embroidery is the craft of decorating fabric with patterns or pictures stitched in thread.

formal.mt: Il-kors tar-rakkmar jgħallem lill-parteċipanti kif jagħmlu disinji sempliċi bil-labra u l-ħajt.
formal.en: The embroidery course teaches participants how to make simple designs with a needle and thread.
formal.zh: 这门刺绣课程教参与者如何用针线绣出简单的图案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi se titgħallem fil-kors il-ġdid? Nina: Ir-rakkmar. Nixtieq inżejjen il-boroż tad-drapp tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you going to learn on the new course? Nina: Embroidery. I would like to decorate my cloth bags.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在新课程里要学什么？妮娜：刺绣。我想装饰自己的布袋。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi se titgħallem fil-kors il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Xi se titgħallem fil-kors il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 你在新课程里要学什么？
messages.en: What are you going to learn on the new course?

messages.speaker: Nina (刺绣初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rakkmar. Nixtieq inżejjen il-boroż tad-drapp tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rakkmar. Nixtieq inżejjen il-boroż tad-drapp tiegħi.
messages.zh: 刺绣。我想装饰自己的布袋。
messages.en: Embroidery. I would like to decorate my cloth bags.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rakkmar 放进“报名学刺绣”的场景：桌上摆着针、线和布，学习者一针一针绣图案，帮助记住这门手艺。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Decorative stitching on fabric, made with a needle and thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用针线绣在织物上的装饰性针脚或图案。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiżjin fuq drapp magħmul b'punti tal-ħajt permezz ta' labra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺绣；以针线在布料上绣成的装饰图案。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Disinji jew tiżjin fuq drapp magħmulin bil-labra u l-ħajt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Embroidery consists of decorative patterns or pictures that are sewn onto fabric using thread.

formal.mt: Il-libsa għandha rakkmu fin madwar l-għonq u fuq il-kmiem.
formal.en: The dress has fine embroidery around the neckline and on the sleeves.
formal.zh: 这条连衣裙的领口周围和袖子上有精细的刺绣。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt ir-rakkmu fuq din il-borża? Marija: Iva, il-fjuri huma sbieħ ħafna. Għamiltu int?
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you seen the embroidery on this bag? Marija: Yes, the flowers are very beautiful. Did you do it yourself?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到这个包上的刺绣了吗？玛丽亚：看到了，花朵非常漂亮。是你自己绣的吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (手作爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt ir-rakkmu fuq din il-borża?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt ir-rakkmu fuq din il-borża?
messages.zh: 你看到这个包上的刺绣了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the embroidery on this bag?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fjuri huma sbieħ ħafna. Għamiltu int?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fjuri huma sbieħ ħafna. Għamiltu int?
messages.zh: 看到了，花朵非常漂亮。是你自己绣的吗？
messages.en: Yes, the flowers are very beautiful. Did you do it yourself?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 rakkmu 时，想象手指沿着袖口上凸起的绣花移动；把这个词和布面上看得见、摸得到的刺绣图案联系起来。

gloss_zh: 表达“他没有看见你”的词项

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression conveying the idea that he does not see you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达“他没有看见你”这一否定视觉感知意思的词项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li twassal l-idea li hu ma jarakx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表达“他没有看见你”这一意思的词项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li persuna msemmija bħala 'hu' ma tarax lill-persuna li tkun qed tiġi indirizzata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This expression conveys the idea that he does not see the person being addressed.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudent għandu jqabbel 'rakx' mal-idea li hu ma jarakx.
formal.en: In this exercise, the student should match 'rakx' with the idea that he does not see you.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生应把“rakx”与“他没有看见你”这一意思相匹配。

colloquial.mt: Lin: Ma' liema idea nqabbel 'rakx' f'din il-lista? Rita: Mal-idea li hu ma jarakx. Immaġina li qiegħed wara purtiera.
colloquial.en: Lin: Which idea should I match 'rakx' with in this list? Rita: With the idea that he does not see you. Imagine that you are behind a curtain.
colloquial.zh: 林：这张词表里的“rakx”应该对应哪个意思？丽塔：对应“他没有看见你”。想象你站在窗帘后面。

messages.speaker: Lin (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' liema idea nqabbel 'rakx' f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' liema idea nqabbel 'rakx' f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这张词表里的“rakx”应该对应哪个意思？
messages.en: Which idea should I match 'rakx' with in this list?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Mal-idea li hu ma jarakx. Immaġina li qiegħed wara purtiera.
messages.mt_standard: Mal-idea li hu ma jarakx. Immaġina li qiegħed wara purtiera.
messages.zh: 对应“他没有看见你”。想象你站在窗帘后面。
messages.en: With the idea that he does not see you. Imagine that you are behind a curtain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rakx 写在记忆卡上，配一幅“你躲在窗帘后，他没有看见你”的画面，用完整情境记住否定看见的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Acts of attacking people or things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人或物实施攻击、袭击的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attakki fuq persuni jew affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对人或物的攻击、袭击行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Atti li fihom xi ħadd jattakka persuni jew affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Attacks are acts in which someone tries to hurt people or damage things.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-rambaġġ u l-ħsara li kkawża.
formal.en: The report describes the attacks and the damage they caused.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这些袭击及其造成的损害。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt bir-rambaġġ tal-bieraħ? Mark: Iva, nispera li l-vittmi qed jirċievu l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear about yesterday's attacks? Mark: Yes, I hope the victims are getting help.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听说昨天的袭击了吗？Mark：听说了，希望受害者正在得到帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt bir-rambaġġ tal-bieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt bir-rambaġġ tal-bieraħ?
messages.zh: 你听说昨天的袭击了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear about yesterday's attacks?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nispera li l-vittmi qed jirċievu l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nispera li l-vittmi qed jirċievu l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 听说了，希望受害者正在得到帮助。
messages.en: Yes, I hope the victims are getting help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rambaġġ 放进“报告记录袭击”的画面中，再连读 rambaġġ vjolenti，记住它在这里表示攻击或袭击行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A position in an ordered hierarchy, or a degree on a scale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有序层级中的地位或级别，也可指某一尺度上的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pożizzjoni f'ġerarkija, jew grad fuq skala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 层级体系中的等级、级别或地位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pożizzjoni li persuna jew ħaġa għandha f'ġerarkija mqassma f'livelli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's rank is the position they hold within an ordered hierarchy.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某种性质或状态在尺度上所达到的程度或等级。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grad jew livell li juri sa fejn tasal kwalità jew kundizzjoni fuq skala.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A degree is a particular level of a quality or condition on a scale.

formal.mt: Id-dokument jelenka l-uffiċjali skont ir-rank tagħhom.
formal.en: The document lists the officers according to their rank.
formal.zh: 文件按照级别列出了这些官员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'rank għandu fl-organizzazzjoni? Mark: Għandu rank għoli, imma xorta jkellem lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: What rank does he hold in the organisation? Mark: He holds a high rank, but he still talks to everyone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他在组织里是什么级别？Mark：他的级别很高，不过他仍然会和每个人交谈。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'rank għandu fl-organizzazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: X'rank għandu fl-organizzazzjoni?
messages.zh: 他在组织里是什么级别？
messages.en: What rank does he hold in the organisation?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu rank għoli, imma xorta jkellem lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu rank għoli, imma xorta jkellem lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 他的级别很高，不过他仍然会和每个人交谈。
messages.en: He holds a high rank, but he still talks to everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rank 想成刻有层级的梯子：人的位置对应“级别”，性质在刻度上的位置对应“程度”，用同一幅图分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A daffodil, a flowering plant with a trumpet-shaped centre to its flower.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黄水仙，即花朵中央具有喇叭状结构的一种水仙花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li tagħmel fjura b'parti fin-nofs li tixbah tromba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄水仙，一种花朵中央具有喇叭状副花冠的水仙花。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-fjuri li l-fjura tagħha għandha parti fin-nofs forma ta' tromba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A daffodil is a flowering plant whose flower has a distinctive trumpet-shaped centre.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-fjura tar-ranġis u pinġew il-parti fin-nofs li tixbah tromba.
formal.en: The students observed the daffodil flower and drew its trumpet-shaped centre.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了水仙花，并画出了花朵中央的喇叭状结构。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi din il-fjura? Nina: Din fjura tar-ranġis. Ara l-parti fin-nofs, qisha tromba żgħira!
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this flower? Nina: It's a daffodil flower. Look at the centre; it's like a little trumpet!
colloquial.zh: Lara：这是什么花？Nina：这是水仙花。看中间的部分，像个小喇叭！

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din il-fjura?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din il-fjura?
messages.zh: 这是什么花？
messages.en: What is this flower?

messages.speaker: Nina (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din fjura tar-ranġis. Ara l-parti fin-nofs, qisha tromba żgħira!
messages.mt_standard: Din fjura tar-ranġis. Ara l-parti fin-nofs, qisha tromba żgħira!
messages.zh: 这是水仙花。看中间的部分，像个小喇叭！
messages.en: It's a daffodil flower. Look at the centre; it's like a little trumpet!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ranġis 配一张中央像小喇叭的水仙花图，并把“花朵”和“鳞茎”两个搭配一起记，建立具体的植物形象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening or being done at a high speed or in a short time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生、进行或完成得很快的，所需时间很短的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġri jew isir b'veloċità għolja jew fi żmien qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迅速的，指发生或进行的速度很高。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jseħħ jew jimxi b'veloċità għolja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is rapid happens or progresses at a high speed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 快速的，指行动及时或完成所需时间很短。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jsir minnufih jew jitlesta fi żmien qasir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is quick is done promptly or takes little time.

formal.mt: Ir-rispons rapidu tat-tim għen biex il-problema tissolva fi żmien qasir.
formal.en: The team's quick response helped resolve the problem in a short time.
formal.zh: 团队的迅速回应帮助问题在短时间内得到了解决。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Diġà weġbuk? Toni: Iva, ir-rispons kien rapidu ħafna. Stennejt biss ftit minuti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have they replied already? Toni: Yes, the response was very quick. I only waited a few minutes.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他们已经回复你了吗？Toni：是啊，回复非常快。我只等了几分钟。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà weġbuk?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà weġbuk?
messages.zh: 他们已经回复你了吗？
messages.en: Have they replied already?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ir-rispons kien rapidu ħafna. Stennejt biss ftit minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ir-rispons kien rapidu ħafna. Stennejt biss ftit minuti.
messages.zh: 是啊，回复非常快。我只等了几分钟。
messages.en: Yes, the response was very quick. I only waited a few minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rapidu 与英语 rapid 并排做词卡，再想象消息几分钟就收到回复，用 rispons rapidu 记住“迅速、耗时短”的共同意思。

gloss_zh: 咨询报告；顾问建议报告

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written report that presents a consultant's assessment and recommendations on a particular matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由顾问就某一事项作出评估并提出专业建议的书面报告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument miktub li fih konsulent jippreżenta l-analiżi tiegħu ta' kwistjoni u jagħti rakkomandazzjonijiet dwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对某一问题提供分析、专业意见及建议的咨询报告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rapport li jipprovdi analiżi u pariri professjonali dwar kwistjoni partikolari biex jgħin fit-teħid ta' deċiżjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An advisory report is a written document that examines a particular issue and offers professional recommendations to help someone make decisions.

collocations.en: the recommendations in the advisory report

formal.mt: Il-kumitat eżamina r-rapport ta' konsulenza qabel ma ddeċieda li jibdel il-proċeduri interni.
formal.en: The committee examined the advisory report before deciding to change the internal procedures.
formal.zh: 委员会在决定修改内部程序之前，审阅了咨询报告。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Wasal ir-rapport ta' konsulenza? Pawlu: Iva, wasal dalgħodu. Fih xi suġġerimenti tajbin biex intejbu s-servizz.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the advisory report arrived? Pawlu: Yes, it arrived this morning. It has some good suggestions for improving the service.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：咨询报告到了吗？保罗：到了，今天早上到的。里面有一些改善服务的好建议。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Wasal ir-rapport ta' konsulenza?
messages.mt_standard: Wasal ir-rapport ta' konsulenza?
messages.zh: 咨询报告到了吗？
messages.en: Has the advisory report arrived?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wasal dalgħodu. Fih xi suġġerimenti tajbin biex intejbu s-servizz.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wasal dalgħodu. Fih xi suġġerimenti tajbin biex intejbu s-servizz.
messages.zh: 到了，今天早上到的。里面有一些改善服务的好建议。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning. It has some good suggestions for improving the service.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词想成“顾问交来的一份报告”：先写问题分析，再列改进建议，借这个场景记住“咨询报告”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person chosen or authorized to speak or act for another person, a group, or an organization, including someone sent on a particular mission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受选派或授权，代表他人、团体或机构发言或办事的人，也可指受派执行特定任务的使者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna magħżula jew awtorizzata biex titkellem jew taġixxi f'isem persuna oħra, grupp jew organizzazzjoni, inkluża persuna mibgħuta fuq missjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代表他人、团体或机构表达意见或处理事务的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem jew taġixxi f'isem persuna oħra, grupp jew organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A representative is someone who speaks or acts on behalf of another person, a group, or an organization.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由政府、组织或其他主体派出，负责传达信息或执行特定任务的使者或特使。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna mibgħuta minn gvern, organizzazzjoni jew awtorità oħra biex twassal messaġġ jew twettaq missjoni partikolari f'isimhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An envoy is someone sent by a government or organization to deliver a message or carry out a particular mission.

collocations.en: send an envoy on a mission

formal.mt: Il-gvern bagħat rappreżentant biex iwassal messaġġ uffiċjali lill-awtoritajiet tal-pajjiż ġar.
formal.en: The government sent an envoy to deliver an official message to the authorities of the neighbouring country.
formal.zh: 政府派遣了一名使者，向邻国当局传达正式信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jkellem lill-maniġer dwar il-ħinijiet il-ġodda? Mark: Ir-rappreżentant tal-ħaddiema. Diġà tajnieh il-kummenti tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will speak to the manager about the new working hours? Mark: The workers' representative. We've already given him our comments.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁会去跟经理谈新的工作时间？马克：工人代表。我们已经把意见交给他了。

messages.speaker: Lara (员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkellem lill-maniġer dwar il-ħinijiet il-ġodda?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkellem lill-maniġer dwar il-ħinijiet il-ġodda?
messages.zh: 谁会去跟经理谈新的工作时间？
messages.en: Who will speak to the manager about the new working hours?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rappreżentant tal-ħaddiema. Diġà tajnieh il-kummenti tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rappreżentant tal-ħaddiema. Diġà tajnieh il-kummenti tagħna.
messages.zh: 工人代表。我们已经把意见交给他了。
messages.en: The workers' representative. We've already given him our comments.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人替一群人站出来发言，就是“代表”；再想象他受派出门传递正式信息，就是“使者”。用两个场景记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 海关事务代理人；报关代理人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person authorized to handle customs formalities on behalf of another person or business.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受他人或企业授权，代为办理报关等海关手续的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna awtorizzata biex twettaq formalitajiet doganali f'isem persuna oħra jew negozju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代表委托人向海关办理货物申报及相关手续的代理人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taġixxi f'isem klijent biex tippreżenta dikjarazzjonijiet doganali u tieħu ħsieb proċeduri oħra relatati mad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs representative is someone authorized to submit customs declarations and deal with related formalities for another person or business.

collocations.en: a customs representative submits the declaration
collocations.zh: 报关代理人提交申报单

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija awtorizzat rappreżentant doganali biex jippreżenta d-dikjarazzjoni u jieħu ħsieb il-formalitajiet relatati mal-importazzjoni.
formal.en: The company authorized a customs representative to submit the declaration and handle the formalities relating to the import.
formal.zh: 公司授权一名海关事务代理人提交申报单，并办理有关进口手续。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jieħu ħsieb id-dokumenti għad-dwana? David: Ir-rappreżentant doganali tagħna. Se nibgħatlu l-fattura llum.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who will take care of the customs documents? David: Our customs representative. I'll send him the invoice today.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁来处理海关所需的文件？戴维：我们的报关代理人。我今天会把发票发给他。

messages.speaker: Nina (物流同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb id-dokumenti għad-dwana?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb id-dokumenti għad-dwana?
messages.zh: 谁来处理海关所需的文件？
messages.en: Who will take care of the customs documents?

messages.speaker: David (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rappreżentant doganali tagħna. Se nibgħatlu l-fattura llum.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rappreżentant doganali tagħna. Se nibgħatlu l-fattura llum.
messages.zh: 我们的报关代理人。我今天会把发票发给他。
messages.en: Our customs representative. I'll send him the invoice today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货物到港后，有人拿着你的授权和发票替你办理海关手续；把这个“替你报关的人”与整组词对应起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or service of acting on someone's behalf in legal matters or court proceedings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在法律事务或法院诉讼中，代表他人处理事务、提出意见或维护其权益的行为或服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil jew is-servizz ta' min jaġixxi f'isem persuna oħra fi kwistjonijiet legali jew fi proċeduri quddiem il-qorti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法律代理，即由代理人代表某人处理法律事务或维护其法律权益。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizz li bih persuna taġixxi f'isem ħaddieħor fi kwistjonijiet legali u tħares l-interessi tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Legal representation is the service of acting on someone's behalf in matters involving the law.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诉讼代理，即在法院审理过程中代表某人出庭、陈述或维护其权益。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' min jidher u jitkellem f'isem persuna oħra quddiem il-qorti biex iħares l-interessi tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Representation in court occurs when someone presents a person's case and protects their interests during court proceedings.

formal.mt: Il-klijent talab rappreżentanza legali għall-proċeduri quddiem il-qorti.
formal.en: The client requested legal representation for the court proceedings.
formal.zh: 该客户请求在法院诉讼中获得法律代理。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi bżonn rappreżentanza legali għal din il-kawża. Pawlu: Nista' nagħtik in-numru ta' avukat.
colloquial.en: Marija: I need legal representation for this court case. Pawlu: I can give you a lawyer's number.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这场官司我需要法律代理。Pawlu：我可以给你一位律师的电话号码。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn rappreżentanza legali għal din il-kawża.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn rappreżentanza legali għal din il-kawża.
messages.zh: 这场官司我需要法律代理。
messages.en: I need legal representation for this court case.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nagħtik in-numru ta' avukat.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nagħtik in-numru ta' avukat.
messages.zh: 我可以给你一位律师的电话号码。
messages.en: I can give you a lawyer's number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词放进“请人代表我处理法律事务”的画面中记忆；看到 quddiem il-qorti（在法院面前），就进一步联想到诉讼代理。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or arrangement of having someone, usually a lawyer, act on a person's behalf in judicial proceedings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由他人，通常为律师，在司法程序中代表当事人行事的行为或安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew l-arranġament li bih persuna, normalment avukat, taġixxi f'isem persuna oħra fi proċeduri ġudizzjarji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在司法程序中由律师等代理人代表当事人处理诉讼事务的法律代理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizz jew arranġament li permezz tiegħu avukat jew rappreżentant ieħor jaġixxi f'isem parti fi proċeduri ġudizzjarji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Legal representation is an arrangement in which a lawyer or another authorized representative acts for someone in judicial proceedings.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在法庭上代表当事人出庭、陈述立场并处理相关诉讼事项的代理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jidher u jaġixxi fil-qorti f'isem parti, jippreżenta l-pożizzjoni tagħha u jieħu ħsieb kwistjonijiet relatati mal-kawża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Representation in court occurs when someone appears and acts on a party's behalf during court proceedings.

formal.mt: Il-klijent qabbad avukat biex jipprovdilu rappreżentanza ġudizzjarja matul il-proċeduri quddiem il-qorti.
formal.en: The client engaged a lawyer to provide legal representation throughout the proceedings before the court.
formal.zh: 委托人聘请了一名律师，在法庭诉讼程序期间为其提供代理。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Diġà rranġajt ir-rappreżentanza ġudizzjarja għall-kawża? Anna: Iva, qbadt avukat. Għandi appuntament miegħu għada.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Have you arranged legal representation for the case yet? Anna: Yes, I've hired a lawyer. I have an appointment with him tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你已经为这宗案子安排好诉讼代理了吗？安娜：安排好了，我聘请了一名律师。我明天约了跟他见面。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà rranġajt ir-rappreżentanza ġudizzjarja għall-kawża?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà rranġajt ir-rappreżentanza ġudizzjarja għall-kawża?
messages.zh: 你已经为这宗案子安排好诉讼代理了吗？
messages.en: Have you arranged legal representation for the case yet?

messages.speaker: Anna (当事人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qbadt avukat. Għandi appuntament miegħu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qbadt avukat. Għandi appuntament miegħu għada.
messages.zh: 安排好了，我聘请了一名律师。我明天约了跟他见面。
messages.en: Yes, I've hired a lawyer. I have an appointment with him tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象律师在法庭上代表当事人陈述立场：这里记的是“代理这项服务或安排”，可联系“聘请律师”和“代理费用”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 被代表的；有代表出席的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having someone act or speak on one's behalf, or having a representative present.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由他人代为行动或发言的，或有代表出席某个组织、会议等场合的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lil xi ħadd jaġixxi jew jitkellem f'ismu, jew li għandu rappreżentant preżenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被代表的，指有他人代为行动、发言或出席的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu persuna oħra taġixxi, titkellem jew tkun preżenti f'ismu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or group that is represented has someone present to speak or act on their behalf.

formal.mt: Kull dipartiment huwa rappreżentat fil-kumitat minn membru wieħed.
formal.en: Each department is represented on the committee by one member.
formal.zh: 每个部门在委员会中都有一名成员作为代表。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-grupp tagħna se jkun rappreżentat fil-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, se mmur jien f'isem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: Will our group be represented at the meeting? Mark: Yes, I'll go on everyone's behalf.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们小组会有代表出席会议吗？Mark：会，我会代表大家去。

messages.speaker: Lara (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-grupp tagħna se jkun rappreżentat fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Il-grupp tagħna se jkun rappreżentat fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 我们小组会有代表出席会议吗？
messages.en: Will our group be represented at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se mmur jien f'isem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se mmur jien f'isem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 会，我会代表大家去。
messages.en: Yes, I'll go on everyone's behalf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议桌上有人替你的小组发言，用“有代表在场”的状态记住 rappreżentat；搭配 minn 时留意后面说明由谁代表。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or service of carrying out customs formalities on behalf of another person or business.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代表他人或企业办理货物申报等海关手续的行为或服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil jew is-servizz ta' min iwettaq formalitajiet doganali f'isem persuna jew negozju ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关代理，即代表他人或企业与海关交涉并办理相关申报及手续。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizz li bih persuna taġixxi f'isem persuna jew negozju ieħor biex tittratta mad-dwana u twettaq il-formalitajiet meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs representation is a service in which someone handles customs declarations and related formalities on another party's behalf.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tqabbad aġent biex jipprovdi rappreżentazzjoni doganali għall-merkanzija importata.
formal.en: The company appoints an agent to provide customs representation for the imported goods.
formal.zh: 该公司委托一名代理人为进口货物提供海关代理服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Toffru rappreżentazzjoni doganali għal din il-konsenja? David: Iva, nistgħu nieħdu ħsieb il-formalitajiet mad-dwana għalik.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you offer customs representation for this shipment? David: Yes, we can handle the customs formalities for you.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你们为这批货提供海关代理服务吗？David：提供，我们可以替你办理海关手续。

messages.speaker: Sara (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Toffru rappreżentazzjoni doganali għal din il-konsenja?
messages.mt_standard: Toffru rappreżentazzjoni doganali għal din il-konsenja?
messages.zh: 你们为这批货提供海关代理服务吗？
messages.en: Do you offer customs representation for this shipment?

messages.speaker: David (代理公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nieħdu ħsieb il-formalitajiet mad-dwana għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nieħdu ħsieb il-formalitajiet mad-dwana għalik.
messages.zh: 提供，我们可以替你办理海关手续。
messages.en: Yes, we can handle the customs formalities for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“货物到海关，代理替我办手续”的场景记住整组词；将 doganali 与海关场景绑定，再把整组词对应到海关代理服务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To repair a hole or damaged area by attaching a piece of material over it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在破洞或损坏处加上一块材料，以修补衣物等物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sewwa toqba jew parti mqattgħa billi waħħal biċċa materjal fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打补丁，用一块材料覆盖并修补破洞或损坏处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sewwa ħaġa mtaqqba jew imqattgħa billi żied u waħħal biċċa materjal fuq il-parti bil-ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone patches an item, they repair a hole or damaged area by attaching a piece of material over it.

collocations.en: patched the hole in the trousers

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat raqqa l-qmis b'biċċa drapp tal-istess kulur.
formal.en: The tailor patched the shirt with a piece of fabric of the same colour.
formal.zh: 裁缝用一块同色布料给衬衫打了补丁。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min raqqa t-toqba fil-qliezet tiegħi? Omm: Jien, u użajt drapp blu biex jaqbel magħhom.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who patched the hole in my trousers? Mum: I did, and I used blue fabric to match them.
colloquial.zh: Nina：谁补好了我裤子上的破洞？妈妈：我补的，还用了蓝布来配裤子的颜色。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Min raqqa t-toqba fil-qliezet tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Min raqqa t-toqba fil-qliezet tiegħi?
messages.zh: 谁补好了我裤子上的破洞？
messages.en: Who patched the hole in my trousers?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, u użajt drapp blu biex jaqbel magħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, u użajt drapp blu biex jaqbel magħhom.
messages.zh: 我补的，还用了蓝布来配裤子的颜色。
messages.en: I did, and I used blue fabric to match them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一小块布盖在裤子的破洞上并缝牢，用这个具体动作记住 raqqa；它在这里表示打补丁这一动作，而不是补丁这件东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A message or notification that gives someone information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人传递信息的消息或通知。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Messaġġ jew avviż li jagħti informazzjoni lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 传达信息的消息，或告知某事的通知。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Messaġġ jew avviż li jwassal informazzjoni jew jgħarraf lil xi ħadd b'xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rasla is a message or notification that informs someone about something.

collocations.en: to receive a message or notification

formal.mt: L-istudenti rċevew rasla li tgħarrafhom bil-ħin tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The students received a notification informing them of the meeting time.
formal.zh: 学生们收到了一则通知，告知他们会议的时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irċevejt rasla mill-iskola? Mark: Iva, il-laqgħa se tkun għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you receive a notification from the school? Mark: Yes, the meeting will be tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你收到学校的通知了吗？马克：收到了，会议在明天上午。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Irċevejt rasla mill-iskola?
messages.mt_standard: Irċevejt rasla mill-iskola?
messages.zh: 你收到学校的通知了吗？
messages.en: Did you receive a notification from the school?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-laqgħa se tkun għada filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-laqgħa se tkun għada filgħodu.
messages.zh: 收到了，会议在明天上午。
messages.en: Yes, the meeting will be tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rasla 放进“收到学校通知”的画面中，连着 tirċievi rasla 一起记，突出“信息传到你这里”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to describe a male person who is unwilling to change his opinion or decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容男性固执、倔强，不愿改变自己的意见或决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tiddeskrivi raġel jew tifel li ma jkunx irid ibiddel fehmtu jew id-deċiżjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 固执的；即使别人劝说，也不愿改变意见或做法的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għal raġel jew tifel li jibqa' jinsisti fuq fehmtu jew fuq dak li jrid jagħmel, minkejja l-pariri ta' ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is rasu iebsa, he refuses to change his opinion or intended action despite other people's advice.

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni huwa raġel rasu iebsa li jirrifjuta li jbiddel id-deċiżjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The main character is a stubborn man who refuses to change his decision.
formal.zh: 主人公是一个固执的男人，拒绝改变自己的决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jipprova triq oħra? Mark: Għax rasu iebsa; irid jgħaddi minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why won't Pawlu try another route? Mark: Because he's stubborn; he wants to go this way.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么不愿意试试另一条路？马克：因为他很固执，非要从这里走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jipprova triq oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jipprova triq oħra?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不愿意试试另一条路？
messages.en: Why won't Pawlu try another route?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax rasu iebsa; irid jgħaddi minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax rasu iebsa; irid jgħaddi minn hawn.
messages.zh: 因为他很固执，非要从这里走。
messages.en: Because he's stubborn; he wants to go this way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rasu iebsa 整体记成“他就是不改主意”，想象一个坚持原路走的男孩；本条形式用于描述男性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A measure of an amount, frequency, or change in relation to another quantity or a period of time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某个数量、发生频次或变化量与另一数量或一段时间相比所得的率或比率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura ta' ammont, frekwenza jew bidla mqabbla ma' kwantità oħra jew ma' perjodu ta' żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 率；比率；表示某数量相对于另一数量或单位时间的大小。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura li turi kemm jiġri, jinbidel jew jammonta xi ħaġa b'relazzjoni ma' kwantità oħra jew ma' perjodu ta' żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rate measures how much something occurs, changes, or amounts to in relation to another quantity or a period of time.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel ir-rata ta' tkabbir tal-popolazzjoni f'żewġ reġjuni.
formal.en: The report compares the population growth rate in two regions.
formal.zh: 该报告比较了两个地区的人口增长率。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi r-rata ta' imgħax fuq dan il-kont? Mark: Tnejn fil-mija fis-sena.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the interest rate on this account? Mark: Two percent per year.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个账户的利率是多少？马克：年利率百分之二。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi r-rata ta' imgħax fuq dan il-kont?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi r-rata ta' imgħax fuq dan il-kont?
messages.zh: 这个账户的利率是多少？
messages.en: What is the interest rate on this account?

messages.speaker: Mark (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tnejn fil-mija fis-sena.
messages.mt_standard: Tnejn fil-mija fis-sena.
messages.zh: 年利率百分之二。
messages.en: Two percent per year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 rata 就想到“每多少之中有多少”：利率按本金比较，增长率按原数量比较，用“率”的共同概念串起来记。

gloss_zh: 自给程度；自给率；自给自足率

teaching_sense.en_definition: A measure of how much of a person's, group's, or country's needs can be met through its own production or resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 衡量个人、群体或国家依靠自身生产或资源满足需求的程度或比例。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura li turi kemm persuna, grupp jew pajjiż jista' jissodisfa l-ħtiġijiet tiegħu bil-produzzjoni jew bir-riżorsi tiegħu stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自给自足程度；依靠自身生产或资源满足需求的程度。
