sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-livell sa fejn persuna, grupp jew pajjiż jista' jissodisfa l-ħtiġijiet tiegħu bir-riżorsi jew bil-produzzjoni tiegħu stess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The degree of self-sufficiency indicates how far a person or community can meet its needs using its own resources.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自行供给程度；所需物资由自身生产或供应满足的程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-livell sa fejn persuna, organizzazzjoni jew pajjiż jipprovdi għalih innifsu l-oġġetti jew il-provvisti li jeħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The degree of self-supply indicates how far an individual or organization provides the goods or supplies it needs for itself.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自给自足比率；总需求中可由自身生产或资源满足的比例。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proporzjon tal-ħtiġijiet totali li persuna, grupp jew pajjiż jista' jissodisfa bil-produzzjoni jew bir-riżorsi tiegħu stess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The rate of self-sufficiency expresses the proportion of total needs that can be met through one's own production or resources.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自行供给比率；所需总供应量中由自身提供的比例。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proporzjon tal-provvisti totali meħtieġa li persuna, organizzazzjoni jew pajjiż jipprovdi għalih innifsu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The rate of self-supply measures the share of required supplies that an individual or organization provides for itself.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自给率；自身生产或资源能够满足总需求的比例。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura tal-parti mill-ħtiġijiet totali li tiġi ssodisfata bil-produzzjoni jew bir-riżorsi proprji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A self-sufficiency rate shows what proportion of total needs is covered by a person's or community's own production or resources.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自供率；全部所需物资中由自身供应的份额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura tal-parti mill-provvisti kollha meħtieġa li persuna, organizzazzjoni jew pajjiż jipprovdi għalih innifsu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A self-supply rate shows the proportion of all required supplies that a person, organization, or country provides for itself.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif il-produzzjoni lokali tista' żżid ir-rata ta' awtosuffiċjenza fl-ikel.
formal.en: The study examines how local production can increase the food self-sufficiency rate.
formal.zh: 该研究考察本地生产如何提高食物自给率。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jekk inkabbru aktar ħaxix aħna stess, ir-rata ta' awtosuffiċjenza tagħna fl-ikel tiżdied? Mark: Iva, għax inkunu qed nipproduċu parti akbar mill-ikel li nieklu.
colloquial.en: Maja: If we grow more vegetables ourselves, will our food self-sufficiency rate increase? Mark: Yes, because we will be producing a larger share of the food we eat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：如果我们自己多种些蔬菜，食物自给率会提高吗？马克：会，因为我们吃的食物中，自己生产的部分会占更大比例。

messages.speaker: Maja (社区菜园成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk inkabbru aktar ħaxix aħna stess, ir-rata ta' awtosuffiċjenza tagħna fl-ikel tiżdied?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk inkabbru aktar ħaxix aħna stess, ir-rata ta' awtosuffiċjenza tagħna fl-ikel tiżdied?
messages.zh: 如果我们自己多种些蔬菜，食物自给率会提高吗？
messages.en: If we grow more vegetables ourselves, will our food self-sufficiency rate increase?

messages.speaker: Mark (社区菜园成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax inkunu qed nipproduċu parti akbar mill-ikel li nieklu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax inkunu qed nipproduċu parti akbar mill-ikel li nieklu.
messages.zh: 会，因为我们吃的食物中，自己生产的部分会占更大比例。
messages.en: Yes, because we will be producing a larger share of the food we eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条短语配上一张餐盘图：盘中食物有多少由自己生产，就用多大的自给比例来理解；程度看“能自给多少”，比率看“自给部分占多少”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rate at which a controlled quantity increases or decreases progressively over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受控数值在一段时间内逐步增加或减少的速率，例如每分钟的温度变化量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kejl ta' kemm tiżdied jew tonqos gradwalment kwantità kkontrollata f'unità ta' ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爬坡速率；受控数值每单位时间逐步上升或下降的变化量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rata li biha valur ikkontrollat, bħat-temperatura jew il-qawwa, jiżdied jew jonqos gradwalment maż-żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ramp rate is the amount by which a controlled value progressively increases or decreases per unit of time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 渐变速率；设备或过程逐步调整某个数值时的变化速度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-veloċità li biha apparat jew proċess ibiddel gradwalment valur minn livell għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The ramping rate describes how quickly a device or process progressively changes a value from one level to another.

formal.mt: Matul it-test, ir-rata ta' kalar tat-temperatura ġiet stabbilita għal żewġ gradi Celsius kull minuta.
formal.en: During the test, the temperature ramp rate was set to two degrees Celsius per minute.
formal.zh: 测试期间，温度的渐变速率被设定为每分钟两摄氏度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi r-rata ta' kalar bħalissa? Mark: Żewġ gradi fil-minuta. Tridni nnaqqasha?
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the ramp rate at the moment? Mark: Two degrees per minute. Would you like me to reduce it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：现在的渐变速率是多少？Mark：每分钟两度。要我调低一点吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (实验员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi r-rata ta' kalar bħalissa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi r-rata ta' kalar bħalissa?
messages.zh: 现在的渐变速率是多少？
messages.en: What is the ramp rate at the moment?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewġ gradi fil-minuta. Tridni nnaqqasha?
messages.mt_standard: Żewġ gradi fil-minuta. Tridni nnaqqasha?
messages.zh: 每分钟两度。要我调低一点吗？
messages.en: Two degrees per minute. Would you like me to reduce it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它联想成温控器旁的斜坡图：关注的是每分钟变化多少，而不是最终温度；用“每分钟两度”记住渐变速率。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The income or gain produced by an investment, expressed as a proportion of its value or cost over a stated period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 投资在规定期间内产生的收益相对于其价值或成本的比率，通常以百分比表示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proporzjon bejn id-dħul jew il-qligħ minn investiment u l-valur jew l-ispiża tiegħu matul perjodu speċifikat, normalment espress bħala perċentwal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收益率；投资所得收益与所采用的投资价值或成本基数之间的比率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rata li turi kemm dħul jew qligħ jipproduċi investiment meta mqabbel mal-valur jew mal-ispiża tiegħu għal perjodu partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rate of yield expresses the income or gain from an investment as a proportion of its value or cost over a specified period.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju sempliċi, dħul annwali ta' ħamsin ewro minn investiment ta' elf ewro jagħti rata ta' rendiment ta' ħamsa fil-mija, qabel l-ispejjeż u t-taxxi.
formal.en: In this simple example, annual income of fifty euros from an investment of one thousand euros gives a rate of yield of five percent, before costs and taxes.
formal.zh: 在这个简单例子中，一千欧元的投资每年产生五十欧元收入，扣除费用和税款前的收益率为百分之五。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nikkalkula r-rata ta' rendiment f'dan l-eżempju? Mark: Aqsam il-ħamsin ewro bl-elf ewro u mmultiplika b'mija. Jiġu ħamsa fil-mija.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I calculate the rate of yield in this example? Mark: Divide the fifty euros by the thousand euros and multiply by one hundred. That gives five percent.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个例子里的收益率怎么算？Mark：用五十欧元除以一千欧元，再乘以一百，结果就是百分之五。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nikkalkula r-rata ta' rendiment f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nikkalkula r-rata ta' rendiment f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.zh: 这个例子里的收益率怎么算？
messages.en: How do I calculate the rate of yield in this example?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqsam il-ħamsin ewro bl-elf ewro u mmultiplika b'mija. Jiġu ħamsa fil-mija.
messages.mt_standard: Aqsam il-ħamsin ewro bl-elf ewro u mmultiplika b'mija. Jiġu ħamsa fil-mija.
messages.zh: 用五十欧元除以一千欧元，再乘以一百，结果就是百分之五。
messages.en: Divide the fifty euros by the thousand euros and multiply by one hundred. That gives five percent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“投入一千，收益五十，收益率百分之五”的小账本记整句；看到它就想到收益除以投资基数，并核对计算期间。

gloss_zh: 有功功率变化率；有功功率爬坡速率

teaching_sense.en_definition: The amount by which active power increases or decreases per unit of time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 单位时间内有功功率增加或减少的量，常用于描述发电设备调整功率的速度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bidla fil-potenza attiva għal kull unità ta' ħin, li turi kemm din tiżdied jew tonqos malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有功功率的爬坡速率，即单位时间内有功功率增加或减少的量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidla fil-potenza attiva għal kull unità ta' ħin waqt li l-potenza tiżdied jew tonqos.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The ramp rate is the amount by which active power increases or decreases in a given unit of time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有功功率升降过程中的变化速率，即功率随时间增加或减少的快慢。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rata li biha l-potenza attiva tiżdied jew tonqos waqt proċess ta' aġġustament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The ramping rate describes how quickly active power changes while equipment adjusts its output.

collocations.mt: rata massima ta' varjazzjoni tal-potenza attiva
collocations.zh: 最大有功功率爬坡速率

collocations.mt: limitu fuq ir-rata ta' varjazzjoni tal-potenza attiva
collocations.en: limit on the active power ramp rate

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li r-rata ta' varjazzjoni tal-potenza attiva ma għandhiex taqbeż il-5 MW kull minuta.
formal.en: The report states that the active power ramp rate must not exceed 5 MW per minute.
formal.zh: 报告指出，有功功率变化率不得超过每分钟5兆瓦。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhi r-rata ta' varjazzjoni tal-potenza attiva f'dan l-eżempju? Pawlu: Hija 2 MW kull minuta; il-potenza qed tiżdied b'dak l-ammont kull minuta.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is the active power ramp rate in this example? Pawlu: It is 2 MW per minute; the power is increasing by that amount every minute.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这个例子中的有功功率变化率是多少？Pawlu：每分钟2兆瓦，也就是功率每分钟增加这么多。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi r-rata ta' varjazzjoni tal-potenza attiva f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi r-rata ta' varjazzjoni tal-potenza attiva f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.zh: 这个例子中的有功功率变化率是多少？
messages.en: What is the active power ramp rate in this example?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija 2 MW kull minuta; il-potenza qed tiżdied b'dak l-ammont kull minuta.
messages.mt_standard: Hija 2 MW kull minuta; il-potenza qed tiżdied b'dak l-ammont kull minuta.
messages.zh: 每分钟2兆瓦，也就是功率每分钟增加这么多。
messages.en: It is 2 MW per minute; the power is increasing by that amount every minute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整词组和功率曲线的斜率一起记：关注每分钟变化多少兆瓦，而不是当前共有多少兆瓦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The percentage charged for borrowing money or paid for saving money over a specified period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在规定期间内，借款所支付或存款所获得的利息占本金的百分比。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-perċentwal tal-kapital li jitħallas bħala mgħax fuq self jew li jinkiseb bħala mgħax fuq tfaddil matul perjodu speċifikat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利率；一定期间内借款利息或存款利息相对于本金的百分比。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rata, espressa bħala perċentwal, li tiddetermina kemm jitħallas mgħax fuq flus mislufa jew kemm jinkiseb mgħax fuq flus imfaddla f'perjodu partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An interest rate is the percentage of a sum of money charged for borrowing it or paid for keeping it in savings over a stated period.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jispeċifika rata tal-imgħax annwali fissa ta' tlieta fil-mija għall-ewwel sentejn tas-self.
formal.en: The contract specifies a fixed annual interest rate of three percent for the first two years of the loan.
formal.zh: 合同规定，贷款前两年的固定年利率为百分之三。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-rata tal-imgħax fuq dan is-self hija fissa? Mark: Iva, tibqa' l-istess għall-ewwel sentejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the interest rate on this loan fixed? Mark: Yes, it stays the same for the first two years.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这笔贷款的利率是固定的吗？Mark：是的，前两年保持不变。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rata tal-imgħax fuq dan is-self hija fissa?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rata tal-imgħax fuq dan is-self hija fissa?
messages.zh: 这笔贷款的利率是固定的吗？
messages.en: Is the interest rate on this loan fixed?

messages.speaker: Mark (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tibqa' l-istess għall-ewwel sentejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tibqa' l-istess għall-ewwel sentejn.
messages.zh: 是的，前两年保持不变。
messages.en: Yes, it stays the same for the first two years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本金画成一百枚硬币，再圈出作为利息的几枚；这几枚占本金的百分比就是利率，并记得同时看清计息期间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The value of one currency expressed in units of another currency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种货币以另一种货币表示的兑换价格，即一单位货币可兑换多少另一种货币。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-valur ta' munita waħda espress f'munita oħra, li juri kemm wieħed jista' jikseb minn munita waħda għal unità tal-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汇率；两种货币之间的兑换比率，表示一单位某种货币相当于多少另一种货币。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rata li biha munita tiġi skambjata ma' munita oħra, espressa bħala l-ammont ta' munita li jingħata għal unità tal-munita l-oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An exchange rate tells you how much of one currency you can obtain for a unit of another currency.

formal.mt: Għall-finijiet ta' dan l-eżempju, tintuża rata tal-kambju ta' tmien wan Ċiniżi għal kull ewro.
formal.en: For the purposes of this example, an exchange rate of eight Chinese yuan per euro is used.
formal.zh: 本例采用一欧元兑换八元人民币的汇率。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Iċċekkjajt ir-rata tal-kambju qabel bdilt il-flus? Mark: Iva, u staqsejt ukoll jekk hemmx xi kummissjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you check the exchange rate before changing the money? Mark: Yes, and I also asked whether there was any commission.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你换钱之前查过汇率了吗？Mark：查过了，我还问了是否收手续费。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċċekkjajt ir-rata tal-kambju qabel bdilt il-flus?
messages.mt_standard: Iċċekkjajt ir-rata tal-kambju qabel bdilt il-flus?
messages.zh: 你换钱之前查过汇率了吗？
messages.en: Did you check the exchange rate before changing the money?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u staqsejt ukoll jekk hemmx xi kummissjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u staqsejt ukoll jekk hemmx xi kummissjoni.
messages.zh: 查过了，我还问了是否收手续费。
messages.en: Yes, and I also asked whether there was any commission.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象兑换窗口两边摆着不同货币，中间写着“一单位换多少”；整句对应汇率，记忆时把兑换方向一起读出来。

gloss_zh: 已正式批准的；已获批准的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Formally approved or confirmed by the authority responsible for giving official consent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经由有权机关正式批准或确认的，常用于条约或协议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie approvat jew ikkonfermat formalment mill-awtorità kompetenti, speċjalment fil-każ ta' trattat jew ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经有权机关正式批准或确认的，尤指条约或协议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ingħata approvazzjoni jew konferma formali mill-awtorità li għandha s-setgħa tagħmel dan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ratified treaty or agreement has received formal approval from the authority responsible for confirming it.

formal.mt: It-trattat ratifikat jistabbilixxi regoli komuni għall-kooperazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ pajjiżi.
formal.en: The ratified treaty establishes common rules for cooperation between the two countries.
formal.zh: 已获正式批准的条约为两国合作确立了共同规则。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-ftehim diġà ġie ratifikat? David: Iva, issa għandna ftehim ratifikat u nistgħu nippjanaw il-passi li jmiss.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the agreement already been ratified? David: Yes, we now have a ratified agreement and can plan the next steps.
colloquial.zh: Marija：协议已经正式获批了吗？David：是的，现在协议已经获批，我们可以规划接下来的步骤了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ftehim diġà ġie ratifikat?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ftehim diġà ġie ratifikat?
messages.zh: 协议已经正式获批了吗？
messages.en: Has the agreement already been ratified?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandna ftehim ratifikat u nistgħu nippjanaw il-passi li jmiss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandna ftehim ratifikat u nistgħu nippjanaw il-passi li jmiss.
messages.zh: 是的，现在协议已经获批，我们可以规划接下来的步骤了。
messages.en: Yes, we now have a ratified agreement and can plan the next steps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象协议封面盖上正式批准章，把 ratifikat 与已经完成批准这一状态一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vegetable with a small edible root, often eaten raw, that has a crisp texture and a slightly peppery taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种根部可食用的小萝卜，口感脆，略带辛辣味，常生吃或用于沙拉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa b'għerq żgħir li jittiekel, għandu tessut tqarmeċ u togħma kemxejn taħraq, u spiss jittiekel nej fl-insalata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小萝卜，根部通常较小、脆嫩且略带辛辣味，常用于生食或拌沙拉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaxixa mkabbra għall-għerq tagħha li jittiekel u li ġeneralment ikun żgħir, tqarmeċ u kemxejn jaħraq fit-togħma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A radish is a vegetable whose crisp, slightly peppery root is often eaten raw in salads.

formal.mt: Għal din l-insalata, aħsel ir-ravanella sew u qattagħha fi flieli rqaq qabel iżżidha mal-ħass.
formal.en: For this salad, wash the radish thoroughly and cut it into thin slices before adding it to the lettuce.
formal.zh: 制作这道沙拉时，将小萝卜彻底洗净并切成薄片，再加入生菜中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid inżid ravanella mal-insalata? Toni: Iva, imma qattagħha rqiqa għax it-togħma tagħha taħraq ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like me to add a radish to the salad? Toni: Yes, but slice it thinly because it tastes a little peppery.
colloquial.zh: Lara：要我往沙拉里加一个小萝卜吗？Toni：要，不过切薄一点，因为它有点辛辣。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid inżid ravanella mal-insalata?
messages.mt_standard: Trid inżid ravanella mal-insalata?
messages.zh: 要我往沙拉里加一个小萝卜吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to add a radish to the salad?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma qattagħha rqiqa għax it-togħma tagħha taħraq ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma qattagħha rqiqa għax it-togħma tagħha taħraq ftit.
messages.zh: 要，不过切薄一点，因为它有点辛辣。
messages.en: Yes, but slice it thinly because it tastes a little peppery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ravanella 配上沙拉里脆脆的小萝卜薄片，用清脆口感和微辣味共同帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One stage or period of play in a game or competition that is divided into several such stages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 游戏或比赛中划分出来的一个阶段，称为一轮或一个回合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fażi jew taqsima waħda minn logħba jew kompetizzjoni li tkun maqsuma f'diversi fażijiet jew taqsimiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 游戏或比赛中的一轮、一个回合，指整个过程中的一个独立阶段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqsima waħda ta' logħba jew kompetizzjoni, li tintlagħab qabel jew wara taqsimiet oħra tal-istess attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A round is one stage of a game or competition that consists of several separate stages.

collocations.en: to advance to the next round

formal.mt: It-tim li jirbaħ dan ir-rawnd jgħaddi għar-rawnd li jmiss tal-kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: The team that wins this round advances to the next round of the competition.
formal.zh: 赢得本轮比赛的队伍将晋级下一轮。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nilagħbu rawnd ieħor? Mark: Iva, imma dan ikun l-aħħar rawnd għax dalwaqt irrid nitlaq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we play another round? Mark: Yes, but this will be the last round because I have to leave soon.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们再玩一轮吗？Mark：好，不过这是最后一轮，因为我很快就得走了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nilagħbu rawnd ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Nilagħbu rawnd ieħor?
messages.zh: 我们再玩一轮吗？
messages.en: Shall we play another round?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma dan ikun l-aħħar rawnd għax dalwaqt irrid nitlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma dan ikun l-aħħar rawnd għax dalwaqt irrid nitlaq.
messages.zh: 好，不过这是最后一轮，因为我很快就得走了。
messages.en: Yes, but this will be the last round because I have to leave soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象游戏记分板每完成一轮就更新一次，把 rawnd 和再玩一轮的具体场景绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fixed amount of food or other supplies allocated to a person for a particular period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在一定时期内分配给一个人的定量食物或其他物资。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont fiss ta' ikel jew provvisti oħra mogħti lil persuna għal perjodu speċifiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按规定分配给个人、供一定时期使用的食物或物资份额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwantità stabbilita ta' ikel jew provvisti oħra li tingħata lil persuna biex tużaha matul żmien determinat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ration is a fixed amount of food or other supplies that someone is allowed or given for a particular period.

collocations.en: to distribute a ration to each person
collocations.zh: 向每个人发放一份配给物资

formal.mt: Matul l-emerġenza, kull persuna rċeviet razzjon ta' ikel biżżejjed għal ġurnata.
formal.en: During the emergency, each person received a ration of food sufficient for one day.
formal.zh: 紧急情况期间，每个人都领到了一份足够一天食用的定量口粮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-razzjon għal-lum biss? Toni: Iva, għada jagħtuna ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this ration just for today? Toni: Yes, they'll give us another one tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份口粮只够今天用吗？托尼：对，明天他们会再给我们一份。

messages.speaker: Maja (领取物资的居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-razzjon għal-lum biss?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-razzjon għal-lum biss?
messages.zh: 这份口粮只够今天用吗？
messages.en: Is this ration just for today?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行的邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għada jagħtuna ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għada jagħtuna ieħor.
messages.zh: 对，明天他们会再给我们一份。
messages.en: Yes, they'll give us another one tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 razzjon 和救援站发放的每日口粮联系起来：每人领到固定一份，重点记住“按量分配”，而不只是普通的一餐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The philosophical view that reason is a primary source of knowledge and a basis for judging what is true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为理性是知识的主要来源，并以理性作为判断真理基础的哲学观点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fehma filosofika li tqis ir-raġuni bħala sors ewlieni tal-għarfien u bħala bażi biex jiġi ġġudikat x'inhu veru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理性主义，强调通过理性思考和推理获得知识、判断真理的哲学立场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pożizzjoni filosofika li tagħti importanza ċentrali lir-raġuni u lir-raġunament fil-kisba tal-għarfien u fid-determinazzjoni tal-verità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rationalism is the philosophical belief that reason provides a primary basis for knowledge and for deciding what is true.

formal.mt: Dan l-esej jeżamina r-razzjonaliżmu bħala fehma li tagħti lir-raġuni rwol ewlieni fil-kisba tal-għarfien.
formal.en: This essay examines rationalism as a view that gives reason a central role in acquiring knowledge.
formal.zh: 本文探讨理性主义这一观点，即理性在获取知识的过程中发挥核心作用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu r-razzjonaliżmu, fi kliem sempliċi? Mark: Huwa l-idea li r-raġuni għandha rwol ewlieni biex naslu għall-għarfien.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is rationalism, in simple terms? Mark: It's the idea that reason has a central role in how we acquire knowledge.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：简单来说，什么是理性主义？马克：就是认为理性在我们获取知识的过程中发挥核心作用。

messages.speaker: Lara (复习哲学的学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu r-razzjonaliżmu, fi kliem sempliċi?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu r-razzjonaliżmu, fi kliem sempliċi?
messages.zh: 简单来说，什么是理性主义？
messages.en: What is rationalism, in simple terms?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起复习的同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-idea li r-raġuni għandha rwol ewlieni biex naslu għall-għarfien.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-idea li r-raġuni għandha rwol ewlieni biex naslu għall-għarfien.
messages.zh: 就是认为理性在我们获取知识的过程中发挥核心作用。
messages.en: It's the idea that reason has a central role in how we acquire knowledge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 razzjonaliżmu 放进哲学课堂的画面：面对一个观点，先问“能否通过理性推导？”用这个提问记住“理性主义”的核心。

gloss_zh: 垃圾；无用之物；待丢弃的旧衣杂物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rubbish or unwanted objects, including old clothing, considered worthless or ready to be thrown away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被认为没有价值或不再需要、可以丢弃的垃圾、旧衣服及其他杂物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żibel jew oġġetti li ma għadhomx meħtieġa, fosthom ħwejjeġ qodma, u li jitqiesu bla valur jew tajbin biex jintremew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 垃圾；需要清理或丢弃的废弃物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal jew affarijiet li ma għadhomx meħtieġa u li għandhom jintremew bħala żibel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rubbish consists of unwanted waste or discarded things that need to be cleared away.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毫无价值或没有用处的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li titqies bla valur jew li ma taqdi ebda skop utli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is described this way, it is considered to have no value or practical use.

sense_translations.en_definition: unused clothing or other objects fit for throwing away
sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经不用、适合丢弃的衣服或其他物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħwejjeġ jew oġġetti oħra li ma għadhomx jintużaw u li huma tajbin biex jintremew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: These are clothes or other belongings that are no longer used and are considered ready to be thrown away.

collocations.en: a pile of rubbish or unwanted junk
to get rid of unwanted junk

formal.mt: Qabel it-tindif tal-maħżen, il-ħaddiema għandhom jifirdu l-oġġetti li għadhom jistgħu jintużaw mir-raċanċ li għandu jintrema.
formal.en: Before cleaning the storeroom, workers should separate objects that can still be used from the junk that should be thrown away.
formal.zh: 清理储藏室之前，工作人员应将仍可使用的物品与应当丢弃的杂物分开。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Se nżommu dan il-munzell kollu? Pawlu: Le, ħafna minnu raċanċ; ejja nżommu biss dak li għadu tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are we keeping this whole pile? Pawlu: No, much of it is junk; let's keep only what is still usable.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这一整堆我们都要留着吗？Pawlu：不，里面很多都是无用杂物；我们只留下还能用的东西吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nżommu dan il-munzell kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Se nżommu dan il-munzell kollu?
messages.zh: 这一整堆我们都要留着吗？
messages.en: Are we keeping this whole pile?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħafna minnu raċanċ; ejja nżommu biss dak li għadu tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħafna minnu raċanċ; ejja nżommu biss dak li għadu tajjeb.
messages.zh: 不，里面很多都是无用杂物；我们只留下还能用的东西吧。
messages.en: No, much of it is junk; let's keep only what is still usable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清理储藏室，把无用垃圾和准备丢弃的旧衣杂物放成一堆，用 raċanċ 给这一堆贴标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: People who live in villages or the countryside, including people who work the land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 居住在村庄或乡间的人，包括以耕作为生的农民。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nies li jgħixu fl-irħula jew fil-kampanja, fosthom dawk li jaħdmu l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 村庄或乡间的居民；乡下人；从事耕作的农民。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nies li joqogħdu fl-irħula jew fil-kampanja, jew bdiewa li jaħdmu l-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Villagers and country people are people who live in rural communities, sometimes earning their living by farming.

formal.mt: Ir-raħħala ħadmu flimkien biex isewwu t-triq li twassal għall-għelieqi tagħhom.
formal.en: The villagers worked together to repair the road leading to their fields.
formal.zh: 村民们一起修缮了通往他们田地的道路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jgħin fit-tindif tal-pjazza? Pawlu: Ir-raħħala se jiġu jgħinu nhar is-Sibt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to help clean the square? Pawlu: The villagers are coming to help on Saturday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁会来帮忙打扫广场？保罗：村民们星期六会来帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jgħin fit-tindif tal-pjazza?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jgħin fit-tindif tal-pjazza?
messages.zh: 谁会来帮忙打扫广场？
messages.en: Who is going to help clean the square?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-raħħala se jiġu jgħinu nhar is-Sibt.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-raħħala se jiġu jgħinu nhar is-Sibt.
messages.zh: 村民们星期六会来帮忙。
messages.en: The villagers are coming to help on Saturday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 raħħala 联想成村庄广场上一群居民共同劳动的画面，记住它表示复数的村民、乡间居民或农民。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Animals and other living organisms that live in a natural environment without being domesticated or cultivated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生活在自然环境中、未经人类驯养或栽培的动物及其他生物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimali u organiżmi ħajjin oħra li jgħixu fl-ambjent naturali tagħhom mingħajr ma jkunu domestikati jew ikkultivati mill-bniedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 野生生物，指在自然环境中自行生长和生活、未经人类驯养或栽培的生物，尤指野生动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-annimali u organiżmi oħra li jgħixu fis-selvaġġ fl-ambjent naturali tagħhom, speċjalment dawk li mhumiex domestikati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Wildlife consists of animals and other organisms that live freely in their natural surroundings.

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' konservazzjoni għandu l-għan li jħares ir-rbenesseri u l-ħabitats naturali taż-żona.
formal.en: The conservation plan aims to protect the area's wildlife and natural habitats.
formal.zh: 该保护计划旨在保护这一地区的野生生物及其自然栖息地。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Taħseb li naraw xi rbenesseri waqt il-mixja? Pawlu: Jista' jkun. Ejja nimxu bil-kwiet biex ma nbeżżgħux l-annimali.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you think we'll see any wildlife on the walk? Pawlu: We might. Let's walk quietly so we don't frighten the animals.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你觉得我们散步时会看到野生生物吗？保罗：有可能。我们轻声走吧，免得吓到动物。

messages.speaker: Nina (参加自然步行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li naraw xi rbenesseri waqt il-mixja?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li naraw xi rbenesseri waqt il-mixja?
messages.zh: 你觉得我们散步时会看到野生生物吗？
messages.en: Do you think we'll see any wildlife on the walk?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun. Ejja nimxu bil-kwiet biex ma nbeżżgħux l-annimali.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun. Ejja nimxu bil-kwiet biex ma nbeżżgħux l-annimali.
messages.zh: 有可能。我们轻声走吧，免得吓到动物。
messages.en: We might. Let's walk quietly so we don't frighten the animals.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rbenesseri 配上一幅自然保护区的画面：鸟在飞，野生动物自由活动。用“自然环境中的野生生命”这一整体场景记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A son of one's husband or wife from another relationship, rather than one's own biological son.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 丈夫或妻子与他人在另一段关系中所生的儿子，即自己的继子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iben ir-raġel jew il-mara tiegħek minn relazzjoni oħra, li mhuwiex ibnek bijoloġiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 继子，指配偶与他人所生、并非自己亲生的儿子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifel jew raġel li huwa iben il-konjuġi tiegħek minn relazzjoni oħra u li mhuwiex ibnek bijoloġiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your stepson is the son of your husband or wife from another relationship.

collocations.en: a good relationship with one's stepson

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha lill-iskola, Elena spjegat li r-rbib tagħha kien se jibda jattendi l-lezzjonijiet it-Tnejn.
formal.en: In her letter to the school, Elena explained that her stepson would begin attending lessons on Monday.
formal.zh: 埃莱娜在写给学校的信中说明，她的继子将于星期一开始上课。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu t-tifel ħdejk fir-ritratt? Elena: Dak ir-rbib tiegħi, Adam. Huwa iben ir-raġel tiegħi minn relazzjoni oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the boy next to you in the photo? Elena: That's my stepson, Adam. He's my husband's son from another relationship.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：照片里你旁边的男孩是谁？埃莱娜：那是我的继子亚当，是我丈夫与另一段关系中的伴侣所生的儿子。

messages.speaker: Sara (看照片的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu t-tifel ħdejk fir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu t-tifel ħdejk fir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 照片里你旁边的男孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is the boy next to you in the photo?

messages.speaker: Elena (介绍继子的继母)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-rbib tiegħi, Adam. Huwa iben ir-raġel tiegħi minn relazzjoni oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-rbib tiegħi, Adam. Huwa iben ir-raġel tiegħi minn relazzjoni oħra.
messages.zh: 那是我的继子亚当，是我丈夫与另一段关系中的伴侣所生的儿子。
messages.en: That's my stepson, Adam. He's my husband's son from another relationship.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个小家庭关系图：自己连到配偶，配偶再连到与前伴侣所生的儿子；从自己的角度，这个男孩就是 rbib，即继子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that is real actually exists or happens and is not merely imagined.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 真实存在或实际发生的，而非想象出来的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeżisti jew iseħħ tassew u mhux biss fl-immaġinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 真实的；确实存在或实际发生的，而非想象的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jeżisti jew jiġri tassew, u mhux xi ħaġa immaġinata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is real, it actually exists or happens rather than being imagined.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li n-nuqqas ta' ilma huwa problema reali għar-residenti.
formal.en: The report shows that the water shortage is a real problem for residents.
formal.zh: 报告表明，缺水是居民面临的一个实际问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-post huwa reali jew jeżisti biss fil-film? Mark: Huwa reali! Mort hemm is-sena l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this place real, or does it only exist in the film? Mark: It's real! I went there last year.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个地方真实存在，还是只存在于电影里？马克：真实存在！我去年去过那里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-post huwa reali jew jeżisti biss fil-film?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-post huwa reali jew jeżisti biss fil-film?
messages.zh: 这个地方真实存在，还是只存在于电影里？
messages.en: Is this place real, or does it only exist in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa reali! Mort hemm is-sena l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa reali! Mort hemm is-sena l-oħra.
messages.zh: 真实存在！我去年去过那里。
messages.en: It's real! I went there last year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reali 和“确实存在”绑定记忆：看到照片时问地方是否真实存在，就想到 reali；它强调真假与实际存在。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something realistic fits the facts and practical limits of a situation or represents things as they appear in real life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 符合事实和实际条件的；也可指描绘事物时接近真实生活、显得逼真的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqis il-fatti u dak li jista' jsir fil-prattika, jew li juri l-affarijiet kif jidhru fil-ħajja vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切合实际的，考虑现实条件和可行性的；也指表现得逼真、贴近真实生活的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaqbel mal-fatti u mal-possibbiltajiet prattiċi, jew li jirrappreżenta l-affarijiet b'mod li jixbah il-ħajja vera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is realistic, it reflects practical possibilities or presents things as they appear in real life.

formal.mt: Il-proġett jeħtieġ pjan realistiku li jqis iż-żmien u r-riżorsi disponibbli.
formal.en: The project requires a realistic plan that takes account of the time and resources available.
formal.zh: 该项目需要一个切合实际的计划，充分考虑可用的时间和资源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li nistgħu npinġu l-kamra kollha f'siegħa? Mark: Ejja nagħmlu pjan realistiku: illum inpinġu ħajt wieħed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think we can paint the whole room in an hour? Mark: Let's make a realistic plan: today we'll paint one wall.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得我们能在一小时内刷完整个房间吗？马克：我们定个切合实际的计划吧：今天刷一面墙。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li nistgħu npinġu l-kamra kollha f'siegħa?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li nistgħu npinġu l-kamra kollha f'siegħa?
messages.zh: 你觉得我们能在一小时内刷完整个房间吗？
messages.en: Do you think we can paint the whole room in an hour?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nagħmlu pjan realistiku: illum inpinġu ħajt wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nagħmlu pjan realistiku: illum inpinġu ħajt wieħed.
messages.zh: 我们定个切合实际的计划吧：今天刷一面墙。
messages.en: Let's make a realistic plan: today we'll paint one wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 realistiku：安排任务时“做得到”，观看肖像时“画得像”；分别对应切合实际和逼真。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Reality is the way things actually are, rather than how someone imagines or wishes them to be.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物实际存在的状态或实际情况，而非人们的想象或愿望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda tal-affarijiet kif tassew huma, aktar milli kif wieħed jimmaġinahom jew jixtieqhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 现实；事物真实存在的状态或实际发生的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dak li tassew jeżisti jew jiġri, u l-qagħda vera tal-affarijiet minflok dik immaġinata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Reality is the actual state of things, rather than what people imagine or hope for.

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel l-aspettattivi tal-istudenti mar-realtà tal-ħajja fl-università.
formal.en: The study compares students' expectations with the reality of university life.
formal.zh: 该研究将学生的预期与大学生活的实际情况进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħsibt li x-xogħol kien se jkun faċli. Mark: U fir-realtà? Maja: Huwa interessanti, imma jeħtieġ ħafna paċenzja.
colloquial.en: Maja: I thought the job would be easy. Mark: And in reality? Maja: It's interesting, but it takes a lot of patience.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我原以为这份工作会很轻松。马克：那实际情况呢？玛雅：挺有意思的，不过需要很大的耐心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħsibt li x-xogħol kien se jkun faċli.
messages.mt_standard: Ħsibt li x-xogħol kien se jkun faċli.
messages.zh: 我原以为这份工作会很轻松。
messages.en: I thought the job would be easy.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: U fir-realtà?
messages.mt_standard: U fir-realtà?
messages.zh: 那实际情况呢？
messages.en: And in reality?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa interessanti, imma jeħtieġ ħafna paċenzja.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa interessanti, imma jeħtieġ ħafna paċenzja.
messages.zh: 挺有意思的，不过需要很大的耐心。
messages.en: It's interesting, but it takes a lot of patience.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 realtà 放进“预想与现实”的对照框：预想工作轻松，实际却很忙；再整块记住 fir-realtà 表示“实际上”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs offence is an act that breaks a law governing goods brought into or taken out of a country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 违反有关货物进出境及海关管理法律规定的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att li jikser il-liġi doganali dwar merkanzija li tidħol f'pajjiż jew toħroġ minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关违法行为；违反货物进出境或其他海关管理法律规定的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ksur tal-liġi doganali li tirregola d-dħul jew il-ħruġ tal-merkanzija minn pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs offence is an illegal act involving the rules that govern goods crossing a country's borders.

collocations.en: an investigation into a customs offence
collocations.zh: 对海关违法行为的调查

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi investigazzjoni dwar reat doganali marbut mal-importazzjoni ta' merkanzija.
formal.en: The report describes an investigation into a customs offence connected with the importation of goods.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了对一起与货物进口有关的海关违法行为的调查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fl-artiklu hemm il-kliem 'reat doganali'. Xi jfisser? Mark: Ifisser att li jikser il-liġi doganali, bħal meta xi ħadd idaħħal merkanzija bil-moħbi biex jevita d-dazju.
colloquial.en: Maja: The article contains the words 'customs offence'. What does that mean? Mark: It means an act that breaks customs law, such as secretly bringing in goods to evade customs duty.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：文章里有“海关违法行为”这个说法。是什么意思？马克：就是违反海关法律的行为，例如为了逃避关税而偷偷把货物带入境内。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-artiklu hemm il-kliem 'reat doganali'. Xi jfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Fl-artiklu hemm il-kliem 'reat doganali'. Xi jfisser?
messages.zh: 文章里有“海关违法行为”这个说法。是什么意思？
messages.en: The article contains the words 'customs offence'. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser att li jikser il-liġi doganali, bħal meta xi ħadd idaħħal merkanzija bil-moħbi biex jevita d-dazju.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser att li jikser il-liġi doganali, bħal meta xi ħadd idaħħal merkanzija bil-moħbi biex jevita d-dazju.
messages.zh: 就是违反海关法律的行为，例如为了逃避关税而偷偷把货物带入境内。
messages.en: It means an act that breaks customs law, such as secretly bringing in goods to evade customs duty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reat doganali 整块放进“货物过海关却违法”的场景中记忆，再搭配 twettaq 练习表达“实施海关违法行为”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An excessive desire to obtain more money, possessions, or advantages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对金钱、财物或利益产生过度追求、总想获得更多的欲望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa eċċessiva li wieħed jikseb aktar flus, ġid jew vantaġġi milli jeħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪婪；对金钱、财物或利益无止境或过度的欲望。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija u eċċessiva għall-flus, għall-ġid jew għal vantaġġi personali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Greed is a strong desire to have more money, possessions, or advantages than you need.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif ir-rebgha għall-flus tista' twassal għal deċiżjonijiet li jagħmlu ħsara lill-komunità.
formal.en: The report explains how greed for money can lead to decisions that harm the community.
formal.zh: 报告说明了对金钱的贪欲如何导致损害社区利益的决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħa l-biċċiet kollha tal-kejk? Mark: Minħabba r-rebgha! Ma ħalla xejn għalina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he take all the pieces of cake? Mark: Because of greed! He left nothing for us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么把所有蛋糕都拿走了？马克：因为贪心呀！一点都没给我们留。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħa l-biċċiet kollha tal-kejk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħa l-biċċiet kollha tal-kejk?
messages.zh: 他为什么把所有蛋糕都拿走了？
messages.en: Why did he take all the pieces of cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba r-rebgha! Ma ħalla xejn għalina.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba r-rebgha! Ma ħalla xejn għalina.
messages.zh: 因为贪心呀！一点都没给我们留。
messages.en: Because of greed! He left nothing for us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“蛋糕全拿走，还嫌不够”的画面联系起来，记住它表示过度索取的贪婪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To think again about a decision, opinion, or proposal in order to decide whether it should change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 再次思考某项决定、意见或提议，以判断是否需要改变。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħseb mill-ġdid dwar deċiżjoni, opinjoni jew proposta biex tqis jekk għandhiex tinbidel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重新考虑；再次审视决定、看法或提议，判断是否应作调整。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terġa' teżamina deċiżjoni, fehma jew proposta u tqis ir-raġunijiet favur u kontra tagħha qabel tiddeċiedi jekk tibdilhiex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you reconsider a decision or opinion, you think about it again to decide whether you should change it.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tagħti t-tweġiba finali, reconcedi l-proposta fid-dawl tal-informazzjoni l-ġdida.
formal.en: Before giving your final answer, reconsider the proposal in light of the new information.
formal.zh: 在给出最终答复之前，请根据新信息重新考虑这项提议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma naħsibx li se niġi għall-vjaġġ. Toni: Reconcedi d-deċiżjoni, jekk jogħġbok. Nistgħu mmorru nhar il-Ħadd jekk is-Sibt ma tistax.
colloquial.en: Lara: I don't think I'll come on the trip. Toni: Please reconsider your decision. We can go on Sunday if you can't make Saturday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我想我不会参加这次出游了。托尼：请再考虑一下这个决定。如果你星期六没空，我们可以星期日去。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naħsibx li se niġi għall-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naħsibx li se niġi għall-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 我想我不会参加这次出游了。
messages.en: I don't think I'll come on the trip.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Reconcedi d-deċiżjoni, jekk jogħġbok. Nistgħu mmorru nhar il-Ħadd jekk is-Sibt ma tistax.
messages.mt_standard: Reconcedi d-deċiżjoni, jekk jogħġbok. Nistgħu mmorru nhar il-Ħadd jekk is-Sibt ma tistax.
messages.zh: 请再考虑一下这个决定。如果你星期六没空，我们可以星期日去。
messages.en: Please reconsider your decision. We can go on Sunday if you can't make Saturday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把已经作出的决定重新放回桌面，补看新信息后再判断；用 reconcedi d-deċiżjoni 整体记住重新考虑决定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sound or moving images that have been captured and stored so they can be played again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将声音或活动影像记录并保存后形成的内容，可供再次播放。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss jew stampi li jiċċaqalqu li jkunu nqabdu u nħażnu biex ikunu jistgħu jerġgħu jinstemgħu jew jintwerew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 录音或录像；以设备记录并保存、能够再次播放的声音或影像。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħoss jew filmat maħżun fuq mezz li jippermetti li terġa' tisimgħu jew tarah aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A recording is sound or moving images that have been stored so that people can listen to or watch them again.

formal.mt: Ir-recording tal-lezzjoni se jkun disponibbli għall-istudenti biex ikunu jistgħu jirrevedu l-ispjegazzjoni qabel l-eżami.
formal.en: The recording of the lesson will be available to students so that they can review the explanation before the examination.
formal.zh: 这节课的录制内容将向学生开放，供他们在考试前复习讲解内容。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek recording tal-kanzunetta li kantajna lbieraħ? Ben: Iva, għamilt recording bit-telefon. Nibgħathulek issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a recording of the song we sang yesterday? Ben: Yes, I made a recording on my phone. I'll send it to you now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有我们昨天唱那首歌的录音吗？本：有，我用手机录了音。我现在发给你。

messages.speaker: Nina (合唱团团员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek recording tal-kanzunetta li kantajna lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek recording tal-kanzunetta li kantajna lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 你有我们昨天唱那首歌的录音吗？
messages.en: Do you have a recording of the song we sang yesterday?

messages.speaker: Ben (合唱团团员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għamilt recording bit-telefon. Nibgħathulek issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għamilt recording bit-telefon. Nibgħathulek issa.
messages.zh: 有，我用手机录了音。我现在发给你。
messages.en: Yes, I made a recording on my phone. I'll send it to you now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手机先按录制键，再按播放键：保存下来、以后还能重听或重看的内容就是 recording，可连同 tisma' recording 一起记。

gloss_zh: 正在从成瘾中康复的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is recovering from addiction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 曾受成瘾问题困扰、目前正在康复过程中的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li kellha problema ta' dipendenza u li bħalissa tinsab fi proċess ta' rkupru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在经历成瘾康复过程的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li qed tirkupra minn problema ta' dipendenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A recovering addict is someone who is in the process of recovering from addiction.

collocations.mt: appoġġ għal persuna li qed tirkupra minn dipendenza
collocations.zh: 为正在从成瘾中康复的人提供的支持

collocations.mt: l-esperjenza ta' persuna li qed tirkupra minn dipendenza
collocations.en: the experience of a recovering addict
collocations.zh: 正在从成瘾中康复的人的经历

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-esperjenza ta' persuna li qed tirkupra minn dipendenza u l-appoġġ li tirċievi mill-familja tagħha.
formal.en: The report describes the experience of a recovering addict and the support they receive from their family.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一位正在从成瘾中康复的人的经历，以及其家人给予的支持。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sejjer l-irkupru tiegħek? Pawlu: Qed nirkupra mid-dipendenza, u l-appoġġ ta' sħabi jgħinni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is your recovery going? Pawlu: I'm recovering from addiction, and my friends' support helps me a lot.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的康复进展怎么样？保罗：我正在从成瘾中康复，朋友们的支持对我帮助很大。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer l-irkupru tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer l-irkupru tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的康复进展怎么样？
messages.en: How is your recovery going?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (正在康复的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nirkupra mid-dipendenza, u l-appoġġ ta' sħabi jgħinni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nirkupra mid-dipendenza, u l-appoġġ ta' sħabi jgħinni ħafna.
messages.zh: 我正在从成瘾中康复，朋友们的支持对我帮助很大。
messages.en: I'm recovering from addiction, and my friends' support helps me a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 recovering 想成“正在康复”，整组记作“走在成瘾康复路上的人”，不要误记成已经完全康复。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A redeemer who saves or delivers others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 救赎他人、使他人获得解救者；在宗教语境中可称为救赎主。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tifdi jew issalva lil oħrajn; f'kuntest reliġjuż, dak li jagħti l-fidwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 救赎者；在宗教语境中指施行救赎的救赎主。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dak li jifdi jew isalva lil oħrajn u jagħtihom il-fidwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Redeemer is someone who saves others or brings them deliverance.

formal.mt: F'dan it-test reliġjuż, ir-redentur huwa ppreżentat bħala dak li jġib il-fidwa lill-bnedmin.
formal.en: In this religious text, the redeemer is presented as the one who brings redemption to humankind.
formal.zh: 在这篇宗教文本中，救赎主被描绘为给人类带来救赎者。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi tfisser 'redentur' f'din is-silta? Ġużeppi: Tfisser dak li jifdi jew isalva lil oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does 'redentur' mean in this passage? Ġużeppi: It means someone who redeems or saves others.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这段文字里的 redentur 是什么意思？朱塞佩：意思是救赎或拯救他人的人。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'redentur' f'din is-silta?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'redentur' f'din is-silta?
messages.zh: 这段文字里的 redentur 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'redentur' mean in this passage?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser dak li jifdi jew isalva lil oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser dak li jifdi jew isalva lil oħrajn.
messages.zh: 意思是救赎或拯救他人的人。
messages.en: It means someone who redeems or saves others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“救赎者带来救赎”的人物画面记住 redentur；遇到宗教文本时，可对应中文的“救赎主”。

gloss_zh: 引离某处的转向指示（所给释义不完整）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An indication described as taking you from a place, with the destination left unspecified in the incomplete gloss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指引人从某处转开的指示；所给释义不完整，无法据此确定目的地或更具体的含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Indikazzjoni li tieħdok minn post; il-glossa mhix kompluta u ma tispeċifikax b'mod sħiħ id-destinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引导你从某处转去的指示；原释义在说明目的地时中断，具体去向不明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Indikazzjoni li tieħdok minn post, iżda l-glossa mogħtija tieqaf qabel ma tiddeskrivi b'mod sħiħ fejn tieħdok.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry concerns being directed from a place, although the incomplete gloss does not fully identify the destination.

formal.mt: L-avviż bit-tikketta 'redirected' ma jagħtix biżżejjed informazzjoni dwar fejn għandu jmur il-qarrej.
formal.en: The notice labelled 'redirected' does not provide enough information about where the reader should go.
formal.zh: 这则标有 redirected 的通知没有充分说明读者应该去哪里。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hawn miktub 'redirected'. Fejn għandi mmur? Mark: Mhux ċar minn dan il-messaġġ; ejja nitolbu aktar tagħrif.
colloquial.en: Nina: It says 'redirected' here. Where should I go? Mark: It isn't clear from this message; let's ask for more information.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里写着 redirected。我该去哪里？马克：这条消息没说清楚，我们再问问具体情况吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'redirected'. Fejn għandi mmur?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'redirected'. Fejn għandi mmur?
messages.zh: 这里写着 redirected。我该去哪里？
messages.en: It says 'redirected' here. Where should I go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux ċar minn dan il-messaġġ; ejja nitolbu aktar tagħrif.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux ċar minn dan il-messaġġ; ejja nitolbu aktar tagħrif.
messages.zh: 这条消息没说清楚，我们再问问具体情况吧。
messages.en: It isn't clear from this message; let's ask for more information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 暂用“指示你从原处转开”的画面辅助记忆；本条释义末尾残缺，学习时不要自行补成确定的目的地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: He shrugged by raising his shoulders.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 他抬起肩膀做出耸肩动作，可用来表示不知道、不确定或不在意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għolla spallejh b'ġest li jista' juri li ma jafx, li mhux ċert jew li ma jimpurtahx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耸肩；本词组的形式具体表示“他耸了耸肩”，可表达不知情、不确定或不在意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għolla spallejh biex jesprimi, pereżempju, li ma jafx it-tweġiba jew li ma jimpurtahx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone shrugs, they raise their shoulders to express uncertainty, lack of knowledge, or indifference.

formal.mt: Meta ġie mistoqsi dwar ir-raġuni tad-dewmien, ir-raġel refa' spallejh bla ma ta tweġiba.
formal.en: When asked about the reason for the delay, the man shrugged without giving an answer.
formal.zh: 当被问及延误的原因时，那名男子耸了耸肩，没有作答。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qallek Tom meta staqsejtu fejn kienu ċ-ċwievet? Ben: Ma qal xejn; refa' spallejh u baqa' jfittex.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did Tom say when you asked him where the keys were? Ben: He didn't say anything; he shrugged and kept looking.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你问汤姆钥匙在哪里时，他怎么说？本：他什么也没说，耸了耸肩，继续找。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qallek Tom meta staqsejtu fejn kienu ċ-ċwievet?
messages.mt_standard: X'qallek Tom meta staqsejtu fejn kienu ċ-ċwievet?
messages.zh: 你问汤姆钥匙在哪里时，他怎么说？
messages.en: What did Tom say when you asked him where the keys were?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma qal xejn; refa' spallejh u baqa' jfittex.
messages.mt_standard: Ma qal xejn; refa' spallejh u baqa' jfittex.
messages.zh: 他什么也没说，耸了耸肩，继续找。
messages.en: He didn't say anything; he shrugged and kept looking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象别人问钥匙在哪，他双肩一抬表示不知道；把 refa' spallejh 连同“他耸了耸肩”的动作整组记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mention of someone or something, or a citation identifying a source of information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事的提及，也指用于标明信息来源的文献引注。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aċċenn għal persuna jew ħaġa, jew indikazzjoni tas-sors minn fejn ittieħdet informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在言语或文字中对某人或某事的提及。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aċċenn għal persuna jew ħaġa f'diskors jew f'kitba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reference to someone or something is a mention of that person or thing in speech or writing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 列明书籍、文章等资料出处，供读者查找的文献引注。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Indikazzjoni tad-dettalji ta' ktieb, artiklu jew sors ieħor li tippermetti lill-qarrej isib minn fejn ittieħdet l-informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reference is a citation that gives readers the details needed to identify and locate a source.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport hemm referenza għall-istudju, iżda r-referenza biblijografika ma tinkludix is-sena tal-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: The report contains a reference to the study, but the bibliographic citation does not include the year of publication.
formal.zh: 报告中提到了这项研究，但文献引注没有列出出版年份。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din ir-referenza għal min hi? Mark: Għall-għalliema tagħna; kont qed nitkellem dwar il-parir tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who does this reference refer to? Mark: Our teacher; I was talking about her advice.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里提到的是谁？Mark：我们的老师；我当时在说她给的建议。

messages.mt_spoken: Din ir-referenza għal min hi?
messages.mt_standard: Din ir-referenza għal min hi?

messages.zh: 我们的老师；我当时在说她给的建议。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The people who carry a coffin at a funeral.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在葬礼中共同抬运棺材的人，词义为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-persuni li jġorru tebut waqt funeral.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 葬礼中负责抬运棺材的人员，指多名抬棺者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-persuni li jerfgħu u jġorru tebut waqt funeral.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The bearers are the people who carry a coffin during a funeral.

formal.mt: Waqt il-funeral, ir-reffiegħa ġarrew it-tebut mill-knisja sal-karozza tal-mejtin.
formal.en: During the funeral, the bearers carried the coffin from the church to the hearse.
formal.zh: 葬礼期间，抬棺者将棺材从教堂抬到灵车上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-reffiegħa waslu? Mark: Iva, qegħdin ħdejn il-bieb tal-knisja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have the coffin bearers arrived? Mark: Yes, they are by the church door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：抬棺的人到了吗？Mark：到了，他们在教堂门口旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (家属)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-reffiegħa waslu?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-reffiegħa waslu?
messages.zh: 抬棺的人到了吗？
messages.en: Have the coffin bearers arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (葬礼工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qegħdin ħdejn il-bieb tal-knisja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qegħdin ħdejn il-bieb tal-knisja.
messages.zh: 到了，他们在教堂门口旁边。
messages.en: Yes, they are by the church door.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place that provides safety or shelter from danger or difficult conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人免受危险或恶劣环境影响、获得安全与遮蔽的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn wieħed jista' jsib kenn u protezzjoni minn periklu jew kundizzjonijiet diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为躲避危险或恶劣处境而寻求的庇护，或提供这种保护的避难处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kenn jew post ta' protezzjoni fejn wieħed imur biex jevita periklu jew isib sigurtà f'ċirkostanzi diffiċli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A refuge is a place or source of protection where people can find safety from danger or hardship.

collocations.zh: 躲避恶劣天气的庇护处

formal.mt: Matul il-maltemp, il-bini serva bħala refuġju għall-persuni li ma setgħux jaslu lura d-dar.
formal.en: During the storm, the building served as a refuge for people who could not get home.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，这座建筑为无法回家的人提供了避难之所。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sibtu refuġju mill-maltemp? Mark: F'dar ta' ħabib; bqajna hemm sakemm waqfet ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you find refuge from the storm? Mark: At a friend's house; we stayed there until the rain stopped.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们在哪里躲过了暴风雨？Mark：在一个朋友家；我们一直待到雨停。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn sibtu refuġju mill-maltemp?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn sibtu refuġju mill-maltemp?
messages.zh: 你们在哪里躲过了暴风雨？
messages.en: Where did you find refuge from the storm?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dar ta' ħabib; bqajna hemm sakemm waqfet ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: F'dar ta' ħabib; bqajna hemm sakemm waqfet ix-xita.
messages.zh: 在一个朋友家；我们一直待到雨停。
messages.en: At a friend's house; we stayed there until the rain stopped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 refuġju 配上“风雨中走进安全屋”的画面：屋外有危险，屋内得庇护；再用 fittex refuġju 记住“寻求庇护”。

gloss_zh: 原释义为 balalalu，具体含义未说明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun supplied with the gloss 'balalalu', whose specific meaning is not explained in the packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料中标为名词、释义写作“balalalu”的词；现有资料没有说明其具体所指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom mogħti bit-tifsira 'balalalu', iżda l-materjal ipprovdut ma jispjegax x'jindika eżatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原资料仅给出“balalalu”这一释义，无法据此确定具体中文含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal jagħti biss 'balalalu' bħala tifsira ta' dan in-nom, mingħajr ma jiċċara x'jindika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss for this noun is 'balalalu', but the packet does not explain what it denotes.

formal.mt: Il-materjal jagħti 'balalalu' bħala t-tifsira ta' 'refġħet', iżda ma jipprovdix spjegazzjoni biżżejjed biex tiġi stabbilita traduzzjoni preċiża.
formal.en: The material gives 'balalalu' as the meaning of 'refġħet', but does not provide enough explanation to establish a precise translation.
formal.zh: 资料将“refġħet”的含义列为“balalalu”，但没有提供足够说明来确定准确译法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'refġħet'? Mark: Hawn miktub biss 'balalalu'; minn din l-informazzjoni ma nistax ngħid eżatt xi tfisser.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'refġħet' mean? Mark: It only says 'balalalu' here; I cannot tell exactly what it means from this information.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“refġħet”这个词是什么意思？Mark：这里只写了“balalalu”；凭这些信息，我无法确定它的具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that you give to someone as a present.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赠送给他人以表达心意或庆祝某个场合的物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li tagħti lil xi ħadd biex turi affezzjoni jew biex tiċċelebra okkażjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 送给他人以表达心意或祝贺的礼物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaġa li tingħata lil persuna oħra bħala turija ta' affezzjoni jew biex tiġi ċċelebrata okkażjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gift is something you give to another person to express affection or celebrate an occasion.

formal.mt: Bħala turija ta' gratitudni, il-grupp ta regal lill-għalliema fi tmiem il-kors.
formal.en: As a token of gratitude, the group gave the teacher a gift at the end of the course.
formal.zh: 课程结束时，全组送给老师一份礼物，以表谢意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-regal għalik. Lara: Grazzi! Nista' niftħu issa?
colloquial.en: Maja: This gift is for you. Lara: Thank you! Can I open it now?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份礼物是送给你的。拉拉：谢谢！我现在可以打开吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-regal għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-regal għalik.
messages.zh: 这份礼物是送给你的。
messages.en: This gift is for you.

messages.mt_standard: Grazzi! Nista' niftħu issa?

messages.en: Thank you! Can I open it now?

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某一种工作的名称；所给义项未进一步说明具体工作内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għal tip ta' xogħol li l-kontenut speċifiku tiegħu mhuwiex indikat fit-tifsira mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种工作类型，具体工作内容未在所给义项中说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' xogħol li n-natura speċifika tiegħu mhijiex spjegata fit-tifsira mogħtija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The term refers to a type of work whose specific activities are not described in the supplied sense.

collocations.zh: 作为一种工作类型的 regattier

collocations.en: a description of the type of work called regattier
collocations.zh: 对 regattier 这种工作的描述

formal.mt: Il-glossarju jelenka regattier bħala tip ta' xogħol, iżda ma jagħtix deskrizzjoni tal-attivitajiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The glossary lists regattier as a type of work but does not describe the activities it involves.
formal.zh: 术语表将 regattier 列为一种工作，但未描述其具体活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser regattier hawn? Mark: Tip ta' xogħol, imma m'hemmx aktar dettalji fil-lista.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop that sells vintage items from an earlier period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售具有往日年代特色的旧物或复古物品的商店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut li jbigħ oġġetti minn żmien imgħoddi li għandhom l-istil jew il-karattru ta' dak iż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经营具有旧时代风格或年代特色物品的商店。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħanut li fih jinbiegħu oġġetti minn epoki ta' qabel, apprezzati għall-istil jew il-karattru tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vintage store is a shop where you can buy items from earlier periods with a distinctive period style.

collocations.zh: 一家小型复古物品商店

collocations.en: to buy from a vintage store

formal.mt: Il-gwida ssemmi reggettier fiċ-ċentru tal-belt fejn jinbiegħu oġġetti minn żmien imgħoddi.
formal.en: The guide mentions a vintage store in the town centre where items from earlier periods are sold.
formal.zh: 指南介绍了市中心一家出售往昔年代物品的复古商店。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn xtrajt din il-borża? Maja: Minn reggettier ħdejn il-pjazza. Għandu affarijiet sbieħ ħafna!
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you buy this bag? Maja: From a vintage store near the square. It has some really lovely things!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个包你在哪里买的？玛雅：在广场附近一家复古商店买的。那里的东西可漂亮了！

teaching_sense.en_definition: An excessive desire for wealth, possessions, or personal advantage. The supplied adjective label is retained, but no adjectival use is established by the packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对财富、财物或个人利益的过度欲望。保留材料所给的形容词标签，但材料没有确立其形容词用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa eċċessiva għall-ġid, għall-affarijiet materjali jew għall-vantaġġ personali. It-tikketta ta' aġġettiv mogħtija fil-materjal tinżamm, iżda l-materjal ma jistabbilixxix użu aġġettivali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪欲；对财物或利益过度追求的欲望。原材料标注为形容词，但没有提供相应的形容词用例。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xewqa eċċessiva li persuna tikseb aktar ġid, affarijiet materjali jew vantaġġi għaliha nnifisha. Il-materjal jagħti t-tikketta ta' aġġettiv, iżda ma jipprovdix eżempju ta' dan l-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Greed is an excessive desire to acquire wealth, possessions, or advantages for oneself.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'Reghba' tingħata bit-tifsira Ingliża 'Greed'. Għalkemm hija mmarkata bħala aġġettiv, il-materjal ma jinkludix eżempju li juri dan l-użu.
formal.en: The entry 'Reghba' is given the English meaning 'Greed'. Although it is marked as an adjective, the material includes no example demonstrating that use.
formal.zh: 词条“Reghba”所给的英语释义为“Greed”。虽然它被标为形容词，但材料没有提供展示这种用法的例句。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tifsira tagħti l-lista għal 'Reghba'? Lara: Tagħti 'Greed', jiġifieri xewqa eċċessiva għall-ġid jew għall-vantaġġ personali. Maja: U nista' nużaha bħala aġġettiv? Lara: Il-lista timmarkaha hekk, iżda ma tagħtix eżempju ta' dak l-użu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What meaning does the list give for 'Reghba'? Lara: It gives 'Greed', meaning an excessive desire for wealth or personal advantage. Maja: And can I use it as an adjective? Lara: The list labels it that way, but gives no example of that use.
colloquial.zh: Maja：词表给“Reghba”的释义是什么？Lara：是“Greed”，也就是对财富或个人利益的过度欲望。Maja：那我能把它当形容词用吗？Lara：词表是这样标的，但没有提供这种用法的例句。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom li t-tifsira Ingliża mogħtija għaliha tirrepeti biss 'Reghex', mingħajr ma tispjega xi tfisser.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 材料只重复“Reghex”这一形式，未提供可确定具体指称或词义的解释。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal jirrepeti biss il-forma 'Reghex' u ma jagħtix spjegazzjoni li tippermetti li tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira jew ir-referenza tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss repeats the entry itself, so its intended meaning cannot be determined from this material.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'Reghex' hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira mogħtija tirrepeti biss l-istess kelma. Għalhekk, dan il-materjal ma jippermettix traduzzjoni semantika preċiża.
