gloss_zh: 充分披露规则；全面披露原则

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rule requiring all relevant information to be disclosed fully, without concealing material facts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求完整披露所有相关信息、不隐瞒重要事实的规则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regola li titlob li tingħata l-informazzjoni rilevanti kollha b'mod sħiħ, mingħajr ma jinħbew fatti importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 充分披露；完整提供所有相关信息，不隐瞒可能影响理解或判断的重要事实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti tal-informazzjoni rilevanti kollha b'mod sħiħ, mingħajr ma jinħbew fatti importanti li jistgħu jinfluwenzaw il-fehim jew il-ġudizzju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Full disclosure means providing all relevant information so that important facts are not concealed from the people concerned.

collocations.en: the application of the full disclosure rule

formal.mt: Skont ir-regola ta' divulgazzjoni totali, ir-rapport għandu jinkludi l-informazzjoni rilevanti kollha, inklużi l-limitazzjonijiet li jistgħu jinfluwenzaw il-fehim tar-riżultati.
formal.en: Under the full disclosure rule, the report should include all relevant information, including limitations that may affect how the results are understood.
formal.zh: 根据充分披露规则，报告应包括所有相关信息，其中也包括可能影响读者理解结果的局限。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna nsemmu wkoll il-limitazzjonijiet fir-rapport? Mark: Iva, ir-regola ta' divulgazzjoni totali titlob l-informazzjoni rilevanti kollha. Sara: Anki jekk jagħmlu r-riżultati jidhru inqas tajbin? Mark: Iva, il-qarrejja jridu jkunu jistgħu jifhmu l-istampa kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Should we mention the limitations in the report too? Mark: Yes, the full disclosure rule calls for all relevant information. Sara: Even if they make the results look less impressive? Mark: Yes, readers need to be able to understand the whole picture.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们也应该在报告里写出局限吗？Mark：应该，充分披露规则要求提供所有相关信息。Sara：即使这些局限会让结果显得没那么好？Mark：对，读者需要能够了解全貌。

messages.speaker: Sara (报告撰写人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna nsemmu wkoll il-limitazzjonijiet fir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna nsemmu wkoll il-limitazzjonijiet fir-rapport?
messages.zh: 我们也应该在报告里写出局限吗？
messages.en: Should we mention the limitations in the report too?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ir-regola ta' divulgazzjoni totali titlob l-informazzjoni rilevanti kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ir-regola ta' divulgazzjoni totali titlob l-informazzjoni rilevanti kollha.
messages.zh: 应该，充分披露规则要求提供所有相关信息。
messages.en: Yes, the full disclosure rule calls for all relevant information.

messages.speaker: Sara (报告撰写人)
messages.mt_spoken: Anki jekk jagħmlu r-riżultati jidhru inqas tajbin?
messages.mt_standard: Anki jekk jagħmlu r-riżultati jidhru inqas tajbin?
messages.zh: 即使这些局限会让结果显得没那么好？
messages.en: Even if they make the results look less impressive?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-qarrejja jridu jkunu jistgħu jifhmu l-istampa kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-qarrejja jridu jkunu jistgħu jifhmu l-istampa kollha.
messages.zh: 对，读者需要能够了解全貌。
messages.en: Yes, readers need to be able to understand the whole picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 divulgazzjoni 记作披露信息，totali 记作完整全面；想象把相关资料全部摊开给读者看，好处与局限都不藏起来。

gloss_zh: 较低税额规则；较低反倾销税规则

teaching_sense.en_definition: An anti-dumping rule under which a duty below the dumping margin is applied when that lower duty is sufficient to remove the injury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反倾销措施中的一项规则：如果低于倾销幅度的税额已足以消除损害，则采用该较低税额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regola fil-miżuri kontra d-dumping li tipprevedi dazju aktar baxx mill-marġni tad-dumping meta dak id-dazju jkun biżżejjed biex ineħħi l-ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 较低税额规则：在反倾销措施中，如果较低税额足以消除损害，就采用低于倾销幅度的税额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Regola dwar id-dazji kontra d-dumping li tippermetti l-applikazzjoni ta' dazju aktar baxx mill-marġni tad-dumping jekk dan ikun biżżejjed biex ineħħi l-ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The lesser duty rule allows an anti-dumping duty below the dumping margin when the lower amount is sufficient to remove the injury.

collocations.en: the application of the lesser duty rule

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina jekk ir-regola tad-dazju inferjuri tippermettix dazju aktar baxx mill-marġni tad-dumping li jkun biżżejjed biex ineħħi l-ħsara.
formal.en: The report examines whether the lesser duty rule permits a duty below the dumping margin that would be sufficient to remove the injury.
formal.zh: 报告考察能否根据较低税额规则，采用低于倾销幅度且足以消除损害的税额。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tagħmel ir-regola tad-dazju inferjuri? Pawlu: Tippermetti dazju aktar baxx mill-marġni tad-dumping jekk ikun biżżejjed biex ineħħi l-ħsara. Maja: Jiġifieri l-ammont aktar baxx irid xorta jkun biżżejjed? Pawlu: Iva, dik hija l-kundizzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the lesser duty rule do? Pawlu: It allows a duty below the dumping margin if it is sufficient to remove the injury. Maja: So the lower amount still has to be enough? Pawlu: Yes, that is the condition.
colloquial.zh: Maja：较低税额规则有什么作用？Pawlu：如果较低税额足以消除损害，就允许采用低于倾销幅度的税额。Maja：也就是说，较低金额仍然必须足够？Pawlu：对，这就是条件。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tagħmel ir-regola tad-dazju inferjuri?
messages.mt_standard: X'tagħmel ir-regola tad-dazju inferjuri?
messages.zh: 较低税额规则有什么作用？
messages.en: What does the lesser duty rule do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tippermetti dazju aktar baxx mill-marġni tad-dumping jekk ikun biżżejjed biex ineħħi l-ħsara.
messages.mt_standard: Tippermetti dazju aktar baxx mill-marġni tad-dumping jekk ikun biżżejjed biex ineħħi l-ħsara.
messages.zh: 如果较低税额足以消除损害，就允许采用低于倾销幅度的税额。
messages.en: It allows a duty below the dumping margin if it is sufficient to remove the injury.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri l-ammont aktar baxx irid xorta jkun biżżejjed?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri l-ammont aktar baxx irid xorta jkun biżżejjed?
messages.zh: 也就是说，较低金额仍然必须足够？
messages.en: So the lower amount still has to be enough?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik hija l-kundizzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik hija l-kundizzjoni.
messages.zh: 对，这就是条件。
messages.en: Yes, that is the condition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词组记：regola 是规则，dazju 是税，inferjuri 提示较低；脑中保留“税额较低，但仍足以消除损害”的条件画面。

gloss_zh: 从价百分比规则；按增值比例判定的原产地规则

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rule that uses a percentage of a product's value, including a specified value-added share, to assess whether a requirement is met.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以产品价值的一定百分比作为判断标准的规则；在原产地判定中，可依据规定的增值比例判断产品是否符合要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regola li tuża perċentwal tal-valur ta' prodott, fosthom sehem speċifikat ta' valur miżjud, biex jiġi ddeterminat jekk ikunx issodisfat rekwiżit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 要求产品增值部分达到规定的 X% 比例的规则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Regola li teħtieġ li l-valur miżjud ta' prodott jilħaq il-perċentwal speċifikat bħala X%.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An X% value added rule requires the value added to a product to meet a specified percentage threshold.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以产品货币价值的一定百分比为计算或判定依据的从价规则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Regola li tibbaża kalkolu jew deċiżjoni fuq perċentwal tal-valur monetarju ta' prodott.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ad valorem percentage rule uses a proportion of a product's monetary value as its assessment criterion.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依据产品增值部分所占百分比来判断是否符合条件的规则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Regola li tuża l-perċentwal tal-valur miżjud ta' prodott biex jiġi ddeterminat jekk il-prodott jissodisfax kundizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A percentage value added rule assesses compliance by expressing the value added to a product as a percentage.

sense_translations.en_definition: percentage value added rule of origin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 依据产品增值比例来确定其是否符合特定原产地资格的规则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Regola tal-oriġini li tuża l-perċentwal tal-valur miżjud biex jiġi ddeterminat jekk prodott jikkwalifikax bħala li joriġina f'pajjiż jew territorju partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This rule of origin uses a product's value-added percentage to determine whether it qualifies as originating in a particular country or territory.

collocations.en: the application of the ad valorem percentage rule
collocations.zh: 从价百分比规则的适用

collocations.en: compliance with the ad valorem percentage rule

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif għandha tiġi applikata r-regola tal-perċentwal ad valorem biex jiġi vverifikat jekk il-prodott jissodisfax ir-rekwiżit tal-valur miżjud.
formal.en: The report explains how the ad valorem percentage rule should be applied to verify whether the product meets the value-added requirement.
formal.zh: 报告说明了应如何运用从价百分比规则，核实产品是否满足增值要求。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif inkunu nafu jekk il-prodott jissodisfax ir-regola tal-perċentwal ad valorem? Pawlu: L-ewwel niċċekkjaw kif ir-regola tiddefinixxi l-valur miżjud, imbagħad nikkalkulaw il-perċentwal.
colloquial.en: Marta: How do we know whether the product meets the ad valorem percentage rule? Pawlu: First we check how the rule defines value added, then we calculate the percentage.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们怎么知道产品是否符合从价百分比规则？保罗：先查看规则如何界定增值，再计算百分比。

messages.speaker: Marta (出口业务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inkunu nafu jekk il-prodott jissodisfax ir-regola tal-perċentwal ad valorem?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inkunu nafu jekk il-prodott jissodisfax ir-regola tal-perċentwal ad valorem?
messages.zh: 我们怎么知道产品是否符合从价百分比规则？
messages.en: How do we know whether the product meets the ad valorem percentage rule?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel niċċekkjaw kif ir-regola tiddefinixxi l-valur miżjud, imbagħad nikkalkulaw il-perċentwal.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel niċċekkjaw kif ir-regola tiddefinixxi l-valur miżjud, imbagħad nikkalkulaw il-perċentwal.
messages.zh: 先查看规则如何界定增值，再计算百分比。
messages.en: First we check how the rule defines value added, then we calculate the percentage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个长词组想成“规则＋百分比＋按价值”：学习时画一个价格圆饼，用其中的增值份额联想百分比门槛；具体门槛须看所用规则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that automatically adjusts voltage to keep it close to a desired level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自动调节电压，使其保持在接近设定水平的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jaġġusta l-voltaġġ awtomatikament biex iżommu qrib il-livell mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够自动调节电压，使电压接近设定值的调节装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jirregola l-voltaġġ mingħajr aġġustament manwali kontinwu sabiex iżommu qrib valur stabbilit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An automatic voltage regulator adjusts voltage without continuous manual intervention so that it remains close to a set level.

collocations.en: the installation of an automatic voltage regulator
collocations.zh: 自动电压调节器的安装

collocations.en: the settings of the automatic voltage regulator
collocations.zh: 自动电压调节器的设置

formal.mt: Matul it-test, ir-regolatur awtomatiku tal-voltaġġ żamm il-voltaġġ qrib il-valur stabbilit minkejja l-bidliet fit-tagħbija.
formal.en: During the test, the automatic voltage regulator kept the voltage close to the set value despite changes in the load.
formal.zh: 测试期间，尽管负载发生变化，自动电压调节器仍使电压保持在接近设定值的水平。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-voltaġġ baqa' stabbli meta nbidlet it-tagħbija? Mark: Ir-regolatur awtomatiku tal-voltaġġ aġġustah waħdu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did the voltage stay stable when the load changed? Mark: The automatic voltage regulator adjusted it by itself.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：负载变化时，电压为什么还能保持稳定？马克：自动电压调节器自行调节了电压。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-voltaġġ baqa' stabbli meta nbidlet it-tagħbija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-voltaġġ baqa' stabbli meta nbidlet it-tagħbija?
messages.zh: 负载变化时，电压为什么还能保持稳定？
messages.en: Why did the voltage stay stable when the load changed?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-regolatur awtomatiku tal-voltaġġ aġġustah waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-regolatur awtomatiku tal-voltaġġ aġġustah waħdu.
messages.zh: 自动电压调节器自行调节了电压。
messages.en: The automatic voltage regulator adjusted it by itself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“调节器＋自动＋电压”三个意义块记忆，想象电压表指针偏离目标后，装置自动把它调回目标附近。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A regulator that uses feedback from a system's output to adjust its operation towards a desired value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用系统输出的反馈信息进行调节，使输出趋近目标值的调节器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regolatur li juża informazzjoni dwar l-output tas-sistema bħala feedback biex jaġġusta t-tħaddim tagħha u jqarreb l-output lejn il-valur mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将测得的系统输出反馈回来，与目标值比较并据此修正系统运行的调节器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Regolatur li jqabbel l-output imkejjel ta' sistema mal-valur mixtieq u juża d-differenza biex jaġġusta t-tħaddim tas-sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A closed-loop regulator uses measured output as feedback and adjusts the system to reduce the difference from the desired value.

collocations.mt: l-aġġustament ta' regolatur ta' ċirku magħluq
collocations.en: the adjustment of a closed-loop regulator

collocations.mt: ir-rispons ta' regolatur ta' ċirku magħluq
collocations.en: the response of a closed-loop regulator

formal.mt: Ir-regolatur ta' ċirku magħluq iqabbel it-temperatura mkejla mal-valur mixtieq u jaġġusta t-tisħin skont id-differenza.
formal.en: The closed-loop regulator compares the measured temperature with the desired value and adjusts the heating according to the difference.
formal.zh: 闭环调节器将测得的温度与目标值比较，并根据两者的差值调节加热。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif jaf l-apparat meta għandu jnaqqas it-tisħin? Toni: Ir-regolatur ta' ċirku magħluq juża t-temperatura li jkejjel is-sensur.
colloquial.en: Sara: How does the device know when to reduce the heating? Toni: The closed-loop regulator uses the temperature measured by the sensor.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：装置怎么知道什么时候该减小加热？托尼：闭环调节器会利用传感器测得的温度。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jaf l-apparat meta għandu jnaqqas it-tisħin?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jaf l-apparat meta għandu jnaqqas it-tisħin?
messages.zh: 装置怎么知道什么时候该减小加热？
messages.en: How does the device know when to reduce the heating?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-regolatur ta' ċirku magħluq juża t-temperatura li jkejjel is-sensur.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-regolatur ta' ċirku magħluq juża t-temperatura li jkejjel is-sensur.
messages.zh: 闭环调节器会利用传感器测得的温度。
messages.en: The closed-loop regulator uses the temperature measured by the sensor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“闭环”画成一圈箭头：调节、产生输出、测量、反馈、再调节；沿着这圈箭头记住整个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rules that specify when compensation is provided and how it is determined or administered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定何种情况下给予补偿或赔偿，以及如何确定或办理补偿或赔偿的规则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regoli li jistabbilixxu meta jingħata kumpens u kif jiġi ddeterminat jew amministrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关于补偿或赔偿的适用条件、确定方式或办理程序的规则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' regoli li jiddefinixxu l-kundizzjonijiet, il-metodu ta' kalkolu jew il-proċedura għall-għoti ta' kumpens għal telf, ħsara jew inkonvenjent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Compensation rules set out the conditions and procedures for providing compensation and may specify how its amount is calculated.

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega r-regoli ta' kumpens, inklużi l-kundizzjonijiet għall-għoti tal-kumpens u l-metodu użat biex jiġi kkalkulat l-ammont.
formal.en: The document explains the compensation rules, including the conditions for awarding compensation and the method used to calculate the amount.
formal.zh: 文件说明了补偿规则，包括给予补偿的条件以及计算补偿金额的方法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn nista' nsib ir-regoli ta' kumpens? David: Fid-dokument tal-iskema; hemm spjegat min jista' jitlob kumpens u kif japplika.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I find the compensation rules? David: In the scheme document; it explains who can claim compensation and how to apply.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我在哪里能找到补偿规则？戴维：在这项计划的文件里，里面说明了谁可以申请补偿以及如何申请。

messages.speaker: Lara (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nsib ir-regoli ta' kumpens?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nsib ir-regoli ta' kumpens?
messages.zh: 我在哪里能找到补偿规则？
messages.en: Where can I find the compensation rules?

messages.speaker: David (服务人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fid-dokument tal-iskema; hemm spjegat min jista' jitlob kumpens u kif japplika.
messages.mt_standard: Fid-dokument tal-iskema; hemm spjegat min jista' jitlob kumpens u kif japplika.
messages.zh: 在这项计划的文件里，里面说明了谁可以申请补偿以及如何申请。
messages.en: In the scheme document; it explains who can claim compensation and how to apply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组与一张补偿说明表联系起来：谁能领取、金额怎么算、手续怎么办；三个问题帮助记住“补偿规则”的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rules governing how public bodies purchase goods and services and award contracts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规范公共机构购买货物、采购服务及授予合同的规则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regoli li jirregolaw kif il-korpi pubbliċi jixtru oġġetti u servizzi u jagħtu kuntratti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共机构采购货物、服务或工程以及授予相关合同时必须遵守的规则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Regoli li l-korpi pubbliċi għandhom isegwu meta jixtru oġġetti, jiksbu servizzi jew jagħtu kuntratti għal xogħlijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Public procurement rules are the requirements that public bodies must follow when purchasing goods or services or awarding contracts.

collocations.en: a breach of public procurement rules
collocations.zh: 违反公共采购规则的行为

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għandu jiżgura li l-proċess kollu jikkonforma mar-regoli tal-akkwist pubbliku.
formal.en: The committee must ensure that the entire process complies with public procurement rules.
formal.zh: 委员会必须确保整个流程符合公共采购规则。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Nistgħu nixtru l-kompjuters illum? Pawlu: L-ewwel irridu niċċekkjaw ir-regoli tal-akkwist pubbliku.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can we buy the computers today? Pawlu: First we need to check the public procurement rules.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们今天可以买这些电脑吗？保罗：我们得先核查公共采购规则。

messages.speaker: Marta (行政同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nixtru l-kompjuters illum?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nixtru l-kompjuters illum?
messages.zh: 我们今天可以买这些电脑吗？
messages.en: Can we buy the computers today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irridu niċċekkjaw ir-regoli tal-akkwist pubbliku.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irridu niċċekkjaw ir-regoli tal-akkwist pubbliku.
messages.zh: 我们得先核查公共采购规则。
messages.en: First we need to check the public procurement rules.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进“公共机构买电脑前先查规则”的场景中记忆：regoli 是规则，akkwist 是采购，pubbliku 表示公共的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outer coat worn to protect your clothes and body from rain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 下雨时穿在外面，用来防止身体和衣物被淋湿的外套。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kowt li jintlibes fuq il-ħwejjeġ biex jipproteġi lill-persuna mix-xita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于挡雨、防止身体和衣物被淋湿的外套；雨衣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilbies ta' barra magħmul biex iżomm ix-xita milli xxarrab lill-persuna u l-ħwejjeġ tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A raincoat is a coat that you wear over your clothes to keep yourself dry when it rains.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom iġibu rejnkowt għax iż-żjara se ssir barra anki jekk tagħmel ix-xita.
formal.en: Participants should bring a raincoat because the visit will take place outdoors even if it rains.
formal.zh: 参加者应携带雨衣，因为即使下雨，参观活动也将在户外进行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tagħmel ix-xita. Għandek rejnkowt? Mark: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket. Se nilbsu issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: It's raining. Do you have a raincoat? Mark: Yes, it's in my bag. I'll put it on now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：下雨了。你带雨衣了吗？马克：带了，在我的包里。我现在就穿上。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tagħmel ix-xita. Għandek rejnkowt?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tagħmel ix-xita. Għandek rejnkowt?
messages.zh: 下雨了。你带雨衣了吗？
messages.en: It's raining. Do you have a raincoat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket. Se nilbsu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket. Se nilbsu issa.
messages.zh: 带了，在我的包里。我现在就穿上。
messages.en: Yes, it's in my bag. I'll put it on now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用声音联想辅助记忆：rejnkowt 听起来近似英语 raincoat；脑中配上“下雨时从包里拿出雨衣穿上”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used for shaving, or the sharp blade used in that tool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于剃除胡须或体毛的刀具，也可指该刀具使用的锋利刀片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex titqaxxar il-leħja jew jitneħħa x-xagħar tal-ġisem, jew ix-xafra li tintuża f'din l-għodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于剃除胡须或体毛的剃刀、剃须刀。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda b'xafra li tintuża biex titqaxxar il-leħja jew jitneħħa x-xagħar tal-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A razor is a tool that you use to shave hair from your face or body.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安装在剃刀或剃须刀内、用于剃毛的薄而锋利的刀片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xafra rqiqa b'tarf jaqta' li titwaħħal f'għodda tal-leħja biex taqta' x-xagħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A razor blade is a thin, sharp piece of metal fitted into a razor for shaving.

formal.mt: Għal raġunijiet ta' iġjene, kull persuna għandha tuża r-rejżer tagħha stess.
formal.en: For reasons of hygiene, each person should use their own razor.
formal.zh: 出于卫生考虑，每个人都应使用自己的剃须刀。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek rejżer ġdid? Dan m'għadux jaqta' sew. Lara: Iva, hemm wieħed fil-kexxun ħdejn il-mera.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a new razor? This one doesn't cut well anymore. Lara: Yes, there's one in the drawer next to the mirror.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有新的剃须刀吗？这把已经不太锋利了。拉拉：有，镜子旁边的抽屉里有一把。

messages.speaker: Mark (伴侣)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek rejżer ġdid? Dan m'għadux jaqta' sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek rejżer ġdid? Dan m'għadux jaqta' sew.
messages.zh: 你有新的剃须刀吗？这把已经不太锋利了。
messages.en: Do you have a new razor? This one doesn't cut well anymore.

messages.speaker: Lara (伴侣)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wieħed fil-kexxun ħdejn il-mera.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wieħed fil-kexxun ħdejn il-mera.
messages.zh: 有，镜子旁边的抽屉里有一把。
messages.en: Yes, there's one in the drawer next to the mirror.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rejżer 与英语 razor 的声音联系起来，再想象镜子前的一把剃须刀；记住本词也可指其中的刀片，要结合上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A promotional message, or the activity of promoting products, services, or events to the public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向公众介绍并推广产品、服务或活动的广告信息，也指进行这类宣传的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Messaġġ li jippromwovi prodott, servizz jew avveniment lill-pubbliku, jew l-attività li biha ssir din il-promozzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为推广产品、服务或活动而向公众发布的广告信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Messaġġ jew avviż maħsub biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni tal-pubbliku lejn prodott, servizz jew avveniment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An advertisement is a message intended to attract public attention to a product, service, or event.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过制作和发布广告来推广产品、服务或活动的宣传活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li biha jiġu promossi prodotti, servizzi jew avvenimenti permezz ta' messaġġi u avviżi lill-pubbliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Advertising is the activity of creating and sharing promotional messages to encourage public interest in products, services, or events.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija allokat baġit għar-reklamar tas-servizz il-ġdid fuq l-internet.
formal.en: The company allocated a budget to advertise the new service online.
formal.zh: 公司拨出了预算，用于在网上宣传新服务。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif se ngħarrfu lin-nies bil-ħanut il-ġdid? Toni: Nistgħu nibdew b'xi reklamar fuq l-internet.
colloquial.en: Nina: How are we going to let people know about the new shop? Toni: We can start with some online advertising.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们怎么让大家知道这家新店？托尼：我们可以先做一些网络广告。

messages.speaker: Nina (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se ngħarrfu lin-nies bil-ħanut il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se ngħarrfu lin-nies bil-ħanut il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 我们怎么让大家知道这家新店？
messages.en: How are we going to let people know about the new shop?

messages.speaker: Toni (合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nibdew b'xi reklamar fuq l-internet.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nibdew b'xi reklamar fuq l-internet.
messages.zh: 我们可以先做一些网络广告。
messages.en: We can start with some online advertising.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新店开张后在网上发布广告：看到的宣传信息和开展宣传的活动，都可用 reklamar 表达；分别对应“广告”和“广告宣传”。

gloss_zh: 行为广告；行为定向投放

teaching_sense.en_definition: Advertising that uses information about people's behaviour to select relevant advertisements or audiences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用人们的浏览、点击或其他行为信息来选择广告内容或投放对象的广告方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reklamar li juża informazzjoni dwar l-imġiba tan-nies, bħall-paġni li jżuru jew ir-rabtiet li jagħfsu, biex jagħżel ir-reklami jew l-udjenza tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为广告：根据用户的浏览、点击等行为信息选择并展示广告的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reklamar li fih ir-reklami jintgħażlu u jintwerew skont informazzjoni dwar l-attivitajiet u l-interessi li juru l-utenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Behavioural advertising is advertising in which the advertisements shown to people are selected using information about their activities and apparent interests.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为定向：利用用户行为信息识别目标受众，并决定向哪些人投放哪些广告的做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prattika li tintuża informazzjoni dwar l-imġiba tal-utenti biex jintgħażlu l-persuni li għandhom jaraw ċerti reklami.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Behavioural targeting is the practice of using information about people's activities to decide which people should receive particular advertisements.

collocations.mt: l-użu ta' reklamar li jagħraf l-imġiba
kampanja ta' reklamar li jagħraf l-imġiba

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif ir-reklamar li jagħraf l-imġiba juża informazzjoni dwar l-attivitajiet tal-utenti biex jagħżel ir-reklami li jintwerewlhom.
formal.en: The report explains how behavioural advertising uses information about users' activities to select the advertisements shown to them.
formal.zh: 报告说明了行为广告如何利用用户的活动信息，选择向他们展示的广告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed nara tant reklami taż-żraben wara li fittixt żraben ilbieraħ? Mark: Jista' jkun minħabba reklamar li jagħraf l-imġiba; ir-reklami jistgħu jintgħażlu skont dak li tkun fittixt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why am I seeing so many shoe ads after searching for shoes yesterday? Mark: It could be because of behavioural advertising; ads can be selected based on what you have searched for.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么我昨天搜了鞋子，今天就看到这么多鞋子的广告？Mark：可能是行为广告；广告可以根据你搜索过的内容来选择。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nara tant reklami taż-żraben wara li fittixt żraben ilbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nara tant reklami taż-żraben wara li fittixt żraben ilbieraħ?
messages.zh: 为什么我昨天搜了鞋子，今天就看到这么多鞋子的广告？
messages.en: Why am I seeing so many shoe ads after searching for shoes yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun minħabba reklamar li jagħraf l-imġiba; ir-reklami jistgħu jintgħażlu skont dak li tkun fittixt.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun minħabba reklamar li jagħraf l-imġiba; ir-reklami jistgħu jintgħażlu skont dak li tkun fittixt.
messages.zh: 可能是行为广告；广告可以根据你搜索过的内容来选择。
messages.en: It could be because of behavioural advertising; ads can be selected based on what you have searched for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语想成“会识别行为的广告”：先看你浏览和点击什么，再决定广告给谁看、展示什么；两个义项分别侧重广告方式与定向过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Advertising that gives people a false or inaccurate impression of a product, service, or offer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人对商品、服务或优惠条件产生错误或不准确印象的广告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reklamar li jagħti impressjoni falza jew mhux preċiża dwar prodott, servizz jew offerta u b'hekk jista' jqarraq bil-konsumaturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 误导性广告：通过不准确的陈述、呈现方式或重要信息的遗漏，使受众对商品、服务或优惠产生错误认识的广告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reklamar li jista' jwassal lin-nies biex jifhmu ħażin prodott, servizz jew offerta minħabba informazzjoni mhux preċiża, il-mod kif tiġi ppreżentata jew in-nuqqas ta' dettalji importanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Misleading advertising is advertising that causes people to form an inaccurate impression through its claims, presentation, or omission of important information.

collocations.zh: 关于误导性广告的投诉

formal.mt: Il-materjal tat-taħriġ jippreżenta eżempju ta' reklamar qarrieqi li jwiegħed prezz baxx iżda ma jsemmix l-ispejjeż obbligatorji addizzjonali.
formal.en: The training material presents an example of misleading advertising that promises a low price but does not mention additional compulsory charges.
formal.zh: 培训材料展示了一个误导性广告案例：广告承诺低价，却没有提及必须另付的费用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fir-reklam qalulna li l-kunsinna kienet b'xejn, imma issa qed jitolbu ħames ewro. Pawlu: Dan jidher li hu reklamar qarrieqi. Ejja niċċekkjaw x'kien miktub fl-offerta.
colloquial.en: Nina: The ad told us delivery was free, but now they are asking for five euros. Pawlu: This looks like misleading advertising. Let's check what the offer said.
colloquial.zh: Nina：广告说免运费，可现在他们又要收五欧元。Pawlu：这看起来像误导性广告。我们看看优惠说明里原来写了什么。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-reklam qalulna li l-kunsinna kienet b'xejn, imma issa qed jitolbu ħames ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Fir-reklam qalulna li l-kunsinna kienet b'xejn, imma issa qed jitolbu ħames ewro.
messages.zh: 广告说免运费，可现在他们又要收五欧元。
messages.en: The ad told us delivery was free, but now they are asking for five euros.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan jidher li hu reklamar qarrieqi. Ejja niċċekkjaw x'kien miktub fl-offerta.
messages.mt_standard: Dan jidher li hu reklamar qarrieqi. Ejja niċċekkjaw x'kien miktub fl-offerta.
messages.zh: 这看起来像误导性广告。我们看看优惠说明里原来写了什么。
messages.en: This looks like misleading advertising. Let's check what the offer said.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“广告说免费，结账却收费”的画面记住整个短语：重点是广告让人形成错误印象，而不只是广告令人不喜欢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enrol someone as a member of a group or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 招收某人，使其成为团体或组织的成员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddaħħal persuna bħala membru ta' grupp jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招收或吸纳某人加入团体、组织，使其正式成为成员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tirreġistra jew taċċetta persuna biex issir membru ta' grupp jew organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you enrol someone, you arrange for that person to become a member of a group or organization.

formal.mt: Il-klabb se jirrekluta membri ġodda matul ix-xahar ta' Settembru u se jorganizza laqgħa ta' tagħrif għal dawk interessati.
formal.en: The club will enrol new members during September and will organize an information meeting for those interested.
formal.zh: 俱乐部将在九月招收新成员，并为有意加入的人举办说明会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-grupp tagħna se jirrekluta aktar voluntiera din il-ġimgħa. Trid tingħaqad magħna? Toni: Iva, nixtieq. Għidli kif nista' nirreġistra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Our group will recruit more volunteers this week. Would you like to join us? Toni: Yes, I'd like to. Tell me how I can sign up.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们小组这周要再招一些志愿者。你想加入吗？Toni：想啊。告诉我怎么报名吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-grupp tagħna se jirrekluta aktar voluntiera din il-ġimgħa. Trid tingħaqad magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Il-grupp tagħna se jirrekluta aktar voluntiera din il-ġimgħa. Trid tingħaqad magħna?
messages.zh: 我们小组这周要再招一些志愿者。你想加入吗？
messages.en: Our group will recruit more volunteers this week. Would you like to join us?

messages.speaker: Toni (有意报名者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq. Għidli kif nista' nirreġistra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq. Għidli kif nista' nirreġistra.
messages.zh: 想啊。告诉我怎么报名吧。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to. Tell me how I can sign up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rekluta 放进“俱乐部招收新成员”的动作场景来记：组织把人招进来。搭配里的 jirrekluta 是句中动词形式，可整块记为“招收成员”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of enrolling people as members of a group or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 招收人员加入团体或组织、使其成为成员的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuni jiġu rreġistrati jew aċċettati bħala membri ta' grupp jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招收、吸纳人员加入团体或组织的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess tad-dħul ta' persuni ġodda bħala membri fi grupp jew f'organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Enrolment is the process through which people are registered or accepted as members of a group or organization.

formal.mt: Ir-reklutaġġ ta' membri ġodda se jibda f'Settembru, u l-assoċjazzjoni se tippubblika d-dettalji dwar il-proċess fuq is-sit tagħha.
formal.en: The enrolment of new members will begin in September, and the association will publish details of the process on its website.
formal.zh: 新成员招收工作将于九月开始，协会将在其网站上公布流程详情。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta jibda r-reklutaġġ tal-voluntiera għall-festival? David: Nhar it-Tnejn. Tista' timla l-formola fuq is-sit tal-festival.
colloquial.en: Sara: When does volunteer recruitment for the festival begin? David: On Monday. You can fill in the form on the festival website.
colloquial.zh: Sara：节庆活动的志愿者招募什么时候开始？David：周一。你可以到活动网站上填写表格。

messages.speaker: Sara (有意报名者)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta jibda r-reklutaġġ tal-voluntiera għall-festival?
messages.mt_standard: Meta jibda r-reklutaġġ tal-voluntiera għall-festival?
messages.zh: 节庆活动的志愿者招募什么时候开始？
messages.en: When does volunteer recruitment for the festival begin?

messages.speaker: David (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nhar it-Tnejn. Tista' timla l-formola fuq is-sit tal-festival.
messages.mt_standard: Nhar it-Tnejn. Tista' timla l-formola fuq is-sit tal-festival.
messages.zh: 周一。你可以到活动网站上填写表格。
messages.en: On Monday. You can fill in the form on the festival website.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“招募工作周一开始”记住 reklutaġġ 的名词身份：它指整个招收过程。与动词 rekluta 对照，分别记作“招募这件事”和“招募这个动作”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sound or images stored so that they can be played back later.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保存下来、可以在之后重新播放的声音或影像内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss jew stampi li jkunu nżammu biex ikunu jistgħu jerġgħu jinstemgħu jew jintwerew aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过录制保存、可以再次播放的声音或影像。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħoss jew stampi miżmuma f'forma li tippermetti li jerġgħu jinstemgħu jew jintwerew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A recording is sound or moving images that have been stored so that people can play them again.

formal.mt: L-istudenti jistgħu jisimgħu r-rekordju tal-lezzjoni biex jirrevedu l-punti ewlenin.
formal.en: Students can listen to the recording of the lesson to review the main points.
formal.zh: 学生可以听课堂录音，复习主要内容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tibgħatli r-rekordju tal-lezzjoni? Pawlu: Iva, nibgħathulek issa biex tkun tista' tisimgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you send me the recording of the lesson? Pawlu: Yes, I'll send it to you now so you can listen to it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能把课堂录音发给我吗？保罗：可以，我现在发给你，你就能听了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tibgħatli r-rekordju tal-lezzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tibgħatli r-rekordju tal-lezzjoni?
messages.zh: 你能把课堂录音发给我吗？
messages.en: Can you send me the recording of the lesson?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nibgħathulek issa biex tkun tista' tisimgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nibgħathulek issa biex tkun tista' tisimgħu.
messages.zh: 可以，我现在发给你，你就能听了。
messages.en: Yes, I'll send it to you now so you can listen to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rekordju 和“课堂结束后按播放键重听”的画面绑定，记住它指保存下来供回放的录制内容。

gloss_zh: 标签要求；标签须满足的条件

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition that a label must meet concerning its content or presentation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 标签在所载信息或呈现方式方面必须满足的一项条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li tikketta trid tissodisfa dwar l-informazzjoni li jkun fiha jew il-mod kif tkun ippreżentata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对标签内容或呈现方式规定的必备条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni speċifikata dwar dak li għandu jidher fuq tikketta jew kif għandu jkun ippreżentat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A label requirement is a condition specifying what a label must include or how it must present information.

formal.mt: Skont l-istruzzjonijiet tal-eżerċizzju, ir-rekwiżit tat-tikketta huwa li l-isem tal-prodott jidher b'mod ċar.
formal.en: According to the exercise instructions, the label requirement is that the product name must appear clearly.
formal.zh: 根据练习说明，标签要求是清楚显示产品名称。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu r-rekwiżit tat-tikketta għal dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Trid turi l-isem tal-prodott b'mod ċar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the label requirement for this exercise? Mark: It needs to show the product name clearly.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这个练习的标签要求是什么？马克：标签需要清楚显示产品名称。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu r-rekwiżit tat-tikketta għal dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu r-rekwiżit tat-tikketta għal dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这个练习的标签要求是什么？
messages.en: What is the label requirement for this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid turi l-isem tal-prodott b'mod ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Trid turi l-isem tal-prodott b'mod ċar.
messages.zh: 标签需要清楚显示产品名称。
messages.en: It needs to show the product name clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给标签逐项打勾：名称是否清楚、信息是否齐全。把整个词组记作“标签必须满足的条件”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with a particular subject, thing, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某个主题、事物或情况存在联系的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu rabta ma' suġġett, ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与另一事物或某个主题有联系的；相关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu konnessjoni jew rabta ma' xi ħaġa oħra jew ma' suġġett partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is related to a subject or situation, it has a connection with that subject or situation.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi kapitlu relatat mal-użu tal-ilma fl-iskejjel.
formal.en: The report includes a chapter related to water use in schools.
formal.zh: 报告包含一章与学校用水相关的内容。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-kapitlu hu relatat mal-lezzjoni tal-bieraħ? David: Iva, jispjega f'aktar dettall dak li tgħallimna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this chapter related to yesterday's lesson? David: Yes, it explains what we learned in more detail.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这一章和昨天的课有关吗？戴维：有，它更详细地解释了我们学过的内容。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kapitlu hu relatat mal-lezzjoni tal-bieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kapitlu hu relatat mal-lezzjoni tal-bieraħ?
messages.zh: 这一章和昨天的课有关吗？
messages.en: Is this chapter related to yesterday's lesson?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jispjega f'aktar dettall dak li tgħallimna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jispjega f'aktar dettall dak li tgħallimna.
messages.zh: 有，它更详细地解释了我们学过的内容。
messages.en: Yes, it explains what we learned in more detail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在两个主题之间画一条连接线，在线上写 relatat；再连同 relatat ma' 一起记成“与……相关”。

gloss_zh: 相对论的；涉及相对论效应的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the theory of relativity or taking its effects into account.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与相对论有关的，或在描述和计算中考虑相对论效应的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-teorija tar-relattività jew li jqis l-effetti tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及相对论，或依据相对论考虑相关物理效应的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda t-teorija tar-relattività jew juża din it-teorija biex jiddeskrivi fenomeni fiżiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A relativistic description or calculation uses the theory of relativity to account for the physical effects being considered.

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jitlob kalkolu relativistiku biex jiddeskrivi l-moviment ta' partiċella b'veloċità qrib dik tad-dawl.
formal.en: The exercise calls for a relativistic calculation to describe the motion of a particle at a speed close to that of light.
formal.zh: 这道练习要求运用相对论计算，描述粒子以接近光速运动的情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed nużaw kalkolu relativistiku hawn? Ġużeppi: Għax il-partiċella qed timxi b'veloċità qrib dik tad-dawl.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are we using a relativistic calculation here? Ġużeppi: Because the particle is moving at a speed close to that of light.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里为什么要用相对论计算？朱塞佩：因为这个粒子的运动速度接近光速。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nużaw kalkolu relativistiku hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nużaw kalkolu relativistiku hawn?
messages.zh: 这里为什么要用相对论计算？
messages.en: Why are we using a relativistic calculation here?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (物理老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-partiċella qed timxi b'veloċità qrib dik tad-dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-partiċella qed timxi b'veloċità qrib dik tad-dawl.
messages.zh: 因为这个粒子的运动速度接近光速。
messages.en: Because the particle is moving at a speed close to that of light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象物理题中的粒子接近光速，在计算旁标上 relativistiku，把这个形容词与“需要考虑相对论效应”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 相对的；取决于比较标准或具体情况的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dependent on a comparison, a particular standard, or the circumstances, rather than absolute.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要依据比较对象、特定标准或具体情况来判断的，而非绝对成立的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddependi minn paragun, minn kriterju partikolari jew miċ-ċirkostanzi, u mhux assolut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相对的；其意义或程度须根据比较对象、判断标准或具体情况确定的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa hi relattiva meta t-tifsira jew il-grad tagħha jiddependu minn dak li titqabbel miegħu jew miċ-ċirkostanzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something is relative when its meaning or degree depends on what it is compared with or on the circumstances.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-riżultat bħala suċċess relattiv, għax il-bejgħ żdied meta mqabbel mas-sena li għaddiet iżda baqa' taħt il-mira.
formal.en: The report describes the result as a relative success because sales increased compared with last year but remained below the target.
formal.zh: 报告将这一结果称为相对而言的成功，因为销售额较去年增长，但仍未达到目标。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li l-proġett kien suċċess? Mark: Kien suċċess relattiv: għamilna aħjar mill-aħħar darba, imma għad għandna x'nirranġaw.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think the project was a success? Mark: It was a relative success: we did better than last time, but we still have things to fix.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你觉得这个项目成功了吗？Mark：算是相对成功吧，我们比上次做得好，但还有需要改进的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li l-proġett kien suċċess?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li l-proġett kien suċċess?
messages.zh: 你觉得这个项目成功了吗？
messages.en: Do you think the project was a success?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien suċċess relattiv: għamilna aħjar mill-aħħar darba, imma għad għandna x'nirranġaw.
messages.mt_standard: Kien suċċess relattiv: għamilna aħjar mill-aħħar darba, imma għad għandna x'nirranġaw.
messages.zh: 算是相对成功吧，我们比上次做得好，但还有需要改进的地方。
messages.en: It was a relative success: we did better than last time, but we still have things to fix.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 relattiv 和一把需要选定参照物的尺子联系起来：说“相对成功”时，先问“跟什么相比”。

gloss_zh: 相对地；比较而言；有些；在一定程度上

teaching_sense.en_definition: In comparison with something else, or to a moderate extent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示与其他事物相比的程度，或表示有一定程度但不十分强烈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri paragun ma' xi ħaġa oħra, jew sa ċertu punt mingħajr ma l-grad ikun qawwi ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相对地；比较而言；以其他事物或某一标准为参照。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta jsir paragun ma' xi ħaġa oħra jew ma' kriterju partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use relatively to describe something by comparing it with other things or with a particular standard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有些；颇为；在一定程度上，用于缓和所表达的程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sa ċertu punt jew fi grad moderat, mingħajr ma jkun hemm enfasi fuq grad għoli ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this word to indicate that something is true to a limited or moderate degree.

formal.mt: Il-metodu l-ġdid huwa relattivament faċli biex jintuża meta mqabbel ma' dak ta' qabel, iżda xorta jeħtieġ taħriġ inizjali.
formal.en: The new method is relatively easy to use compared with the previous one, but it still requires initial training.
formal.zh: 与旧方法相比，新方法使用起来相对容易，但仍需要初步培训。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif mort fl-eżami? Pawlu: Mar tajjeb. Kien relattivament faċli, imma l-aħħar mistoqsija ħaditli ħafna ħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did your exam go? Pawlu: It went well. It was relatively easy, but the last question took me a long time.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你考试考得怎么样？Pawlu：挺好的。还算容易，不过最后一道题花了我很长时间。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mort fl-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mort fl-eżami?
messages.zh: 你考试考得怎么样？
messages.en: How did your exam go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mar tajjeb. Kien relattivament faċli, imma l-aħħar mistoqsija ħaditli ħafna ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Mar tajjeb. Kien relattivament faċli, imma l-aħħar mistoqsija ħaditli ħafna ħin.
messages.zh: 挺好的。还算容易，不过最后一道题花了我很长时间。
messages.en: It went well. It was relatively easy, but the last question took me a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个提示词：“相比”和“还算”。relattivament faċli 可以强调“相比更容易”，也可以缓和语气说“还算容易”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The view that truth, knowledge, or values depend on a particular context or framework rather than on universally fixed standards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为真理、知识或价值取决于特定背景或判断框架，而非普遍固定标准的观点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fehma li l-verità, l-għarfien jew il-valuri jiddependu minn kuntest jew qafas partikolari aktar milli minn standards fissi u universali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相对主义；主张真理、知识或价值判断依赖特定背景、文化或判断框架的观点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fehma li tqis il-verità, l-għarfien jew il-ġudizzji dwar il-valuri bħala dipendenti fuq kuntest, kultura jew qafas ta' ħsieb partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Relativism is the view that truth, knowledge, or values must be understood in relation to a particular context or framework.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina r-relattiviżmu morali u jistaqsi jekk il-ġudizzji dwar it-tajjeb u l-ħażin jiddependux mill-kultura li fiha jsiru.
formal.en: The study examines moral relativism and asks whether judgments about right and wrong depend on the culture in which they are made.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察道德相对主义，并探讨关于对错的判断是否取决于作出判断时所处的文化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu r-relattiviżmu morali? David: Huwa l-fehma li dak li jitqies tajjeb jew ħażin jiddependi mill-kultura jew mill-qafas morali.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is moral relativism? David: It is the view that what is considered right or wrong depends on the culture or moral framework.
colloquial.zh: Lara：什么是道德相对主义？David：就是认为何为对错取决于文化或道德判断框架的观点。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu r-relattiviżmu morali?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu r-relattiviżmu morali?
messages.zh: 什么是道德相对主义？
messages.en: What is moral relativism?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-fehma li dak li jitqies tajjeb jew ħażin jiddependi mill-kultura jew mill-qafas morali.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-fehma li dak li jitqies tajjeb jew ħażin jiddependi mill-kultura jew mill-qafas morali.
messages.zh: 就是认为何为对错取决于文化或道德判断框架的观点。
messages.en: It is the view that what is considered right or wrong depends on the culture or moral framework.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 relattiviżmu 记成一副“先看判断框架”的眼镜：讨论真理或价值时，先辨认所依据的背景，再理解其相对主义观点。

gloss_zh: 降级；被降级；被置于较次要位置

teaching_sense.en_definition: The moving of a team to a lower division, or of someone or something to a lower or less important position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将球队降入较低级别联赛，或将人或事物置于较低等级、较次要位置的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tniżżil ta' tim għal diviżjoni aktar baxxa, jew ta' persuna jew ħaġa għal livell jew pożizzjoni ta' inqas importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 降级；将球队降入较低级别联赛，或将人或事物降至较低等级或较次要位置的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għemil li bih tim jitniżżel għal diviżjoni aktar baxxa, jew persuna jew ħaġa titqiegħed f'pożizzjoni aktar baxxa jew ta' inqas importanza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Relegation is the process of moving a team to a lower division or assigning someone or something a less important position.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被降级；球队被降入较低级别联赛，或人或事物被置于较低等级或较次要位置这一事件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li tim jiġi mniżżel għal diviżjoni aktar baxxa, jew li persuna jew ħaġa titqiegħed f'pożizzjoni aktar baxxa jew ta' inqas importanza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A team or person undergoes relegation when they are moved to a lower level or a less important position.

formal.mt: Wara t-telfa fl-aħħar partita tal-istaġun, ġiet ikkonfermata r-relegazzjoni tat-tim għal diviżjoni aktar baxxa, fejn se jilgħab fl-istaġun li jmiss.
formal.en: After the defeat in the final match of the season, the team's relegation to a lower division was confirmed, and it will play there next season.
formal.zh: 球队在赛季最后一场比赛失利后，降入较低级别联赛的结果得到确认，下赛季将在该级别参赛。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għad nistgħu nevitaw ir-relegazzjoni? Nina: Iva, imma rridu nirbħu l-aħħar żewġ partiti u nistennew ir-riżultati tat-timijiet l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can we still avoid relegation? Nina: Yes, but we need to win the last two matches and wait for the other teams' results.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们还有机会避免降级吗？Nina：有，不过我们必须赢下最后两场比赛，还得看其他球队的赛果。

messages.mt_standard: Għad nistgħu nevitaw ir-relegazzjoni?

messages.en: Can we still avoid relegation?

messages.speaker: Nina (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rridu nirbħu l-aħħar żewġ partiti u nistennew ir-riżultati tat-timijiet l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rridu nirbħu l-aħħar żewġ partiti u nistennew ir-riżultati tat-timijiet l-oħra.
messages.zh: 有，不过我们必须赢下最后两场比赛，还得看其他球队的赛果。
messages.en: Yes, but we need to win the last two matches and wait for the other teams' results.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象球队从联赛阶梯向下走一级，把这个画面和 relegazzjoni 联系起来；再用“避免降级”这一搭配巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 相关的；切合当前话题的；涉及某事的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with the subject being discussed or useful in the situation being considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与正在讨论的主题或正在考虑的情况有关，并能帮助理解或处理它的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-suġġett li jkun qed jiġi diskuss jew li jkun utli għas-sitwazzjoni li tkun qed tiġi kkunsidrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与当前讨论、问题或任务有直接关系的；切题的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu rabta diretta mal-kwistjoni, mad-diskussjoni jew mal-ħidma li tkun qed issir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is relevant has a direct connection with the subject or problem you are considering.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与当前受关注的话题或时事有关的；具有现实话题性的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jittratta suġġett jew ġrajja li bħalissa qed jiġbdu l-interess tan-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is topical concerns a subject or event that people are currently discussing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及某事物的；与某个特定事项有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jikkonċerna ħaġa jew kwistjoni partikolari u għandu x'jaqsam magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something pertaining to a particular matter relates to or concerns that matter.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jinkludi l-informazzjoni kollha relevanti għall-evalwazzjoni tal-proġett.
formal.en: The report should include all information relevant to the evaluation of the project.
formal.zh: 报告应包括与项目评估有关的全部信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ninkludi dan l-artiklu fil-preżentazzjoni? Mark: Iva, huwa relevanti għas-suġġett li se niddiskutu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Should I include this article in the presentation? Mark: Yes, it is relevant to the subject we are going to discuss.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我要把这篇文章放进演示里吗？Mark：要，它与我们将要讨论的主题有关。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ninkludi dan l-artiklu fil-preżentazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Ninkludi dan l-artiklu fil-preżentazzjoni?
messages.zh: 我要把这篇文章放进演示里吗？
messages.en: Should I include this article in the presentation?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa relevanti għas-suġġett li se niddiskutu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa relevanti għas-suġġett li se niddiskutu.
messages.zh: 要，它与我们将要讨论的主题有关。
messages.en: Yes, it is relevant to the subject we are going to discuss.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 relevanti 放进“这条信息与题目有关吗”的课堂提问中记忆；有关系、切题，就可以用它描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object surviving from the past, especially one valued for its historical or religious associations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从过去保存下来的物品，尤其指因历史或宗教关联而受到珍视的遗物或圣物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li baqa' minn żmien imgħoddi u li jitqies ta' valur, speċjalment minħabba r-rabta tiegħu mal-istorja jew mar-reliġjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过去遗留下来的、有历史或宗教价值的物品；遗物；圣物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett jew fdal li jkun inżamm minn żmien imgħoddi u jkun apprezzat minħabba r-rabta tiegħu ma' persuna, ġrajja jew tradizzjoni reliġjuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A relic is an object preserved from the past, often because of its historical or religious importance.

collocations.en: a relic kept in the museum
collocations.zh: 保存在博物馆中的遗物

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi relikwa antika u jispjega l-importanza tagħha għall-istorja lokali.
formal.en: The catalogue describes an ancient relic and explains its importance to local history.
formal.zh: 目录介绍了一件古老遗物，并解释了它对当地历史的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm f'dik il-kaxxa tal-ħġieġ? Pawlu: Hemm relikwa antika; ejja naqraw it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is in that glass case? Pawlu: There is an ancient relic; let's read the label.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那个玻璃展柜里是什么？Pawlu：是一件古老遗物；我们读读说明牌吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'hemm f'dik il-kaxxa tal-ħġieġ?
messages.mt_standard: X'hemm f'dik il-kaxxa tal-ħġieġ?
messages.zh: 那个玻璃展柜里是什么？
messages.en: What is in that glass case?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm relikwa antika; ejja naqraw it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm relikwa antika; ejja naqraw it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 是一件古老遗物；我们读读说明牌吧。
messages.en: There is an ancient relic; let's read the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象博物馆玻璃柜里的一件旧物，旁边写着 relikwa；用“保存至今的遗物”这一画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object or physical remnant preserved from the past and valued for its historical or religious significance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从过去留存并得到保存的物品或实物遗存，因其历史或宗教意义而受到重视。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett jew fdal materjali li baqa' mill-imgħoddi u li jinżamm minħabba s-siwi storiku jew reliġjuż tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从过去保存下来的遗物或实物遗存，尤指具有历史意义或宗教意义的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett jew fdal minn żmien imgħoddi li jitħares minħabba l-importanza tiegħu għall-istorja, għall-memorja ta' persuna jew għar-reliġjon.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A relic is a surviving object or physical remnant that people preserve for its connection with the past or religion.

formal.mt: Il-mużew poġġa r-relikwja f'vetrina apposta biex jipproteġiha u jippermetti lill-pubbliku jaraha.
formal.en: The museum placed the relic in a special display case to protect it and allow the public to see it.
formal.zh: 博物馆把这件遗物放入专用展柜，以保护它并供公众观看。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nista' nieħu ritratt ta' din ir-relikwja? David: Iva, imma mingħajr flash, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: May I take a photograph of this relic? David: Yes, but without flash, please.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我可以给这件遗物拍照吗？David：可以，但请不要使用闪光灯。

messages.speaker: Anna (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nieħu ritratt ta' din ir-relikwja?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nieħu ritratt ta' din ir-relikwja?
messages.zh: 我可以给这件遗物拍照吗？
messages.en: May I take a photograph of this relic?

messages.speaker: David (博物馆工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma mingħajr flash, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma mingħajr flash, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 可以，但请不要使用闪光灯。
messages.en: Yes, but without flash, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 relikwja 写在“值得保存的旧物”图片下，再联想历史展柜或宗教陈列中的遗物；用场景记忆，不猜词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose or cast off a natural outer covering, such as old skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脱去或蜕去原有的天然外层，例如动物蜕去旧皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa jew ħalla jaqa' minn fuqu kisi naturali, bħall-ġilda l-qadima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱去、蜕去或使自身的天然覆盖物脱落，如蜕去旧皮。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħalla jaqa' jew neħħa minn fuqu parti mill-kisi naturali tiegħu, bħalma jagħmel serp meta jibdel il-ġilda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When an animal sheds an outer covering, it loses or casts off that covering as part of a natural process.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti nnutaw li s-serp kien rema' l-ġilda l-qadima tiegħu.
formal.en: During the observation, the students noticed that the snake had shed its old skin.
formal.zh: 观察期间，学生们注意到那条蛇已经蜕去了旧皮。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'inhi din ħdejn is-serp? Noel: Dik hi l-ġilda l-qadima tiegħu; rema' l-ġilda u ħalliha hemm.
colloquial.en: Rita: What is this next to the snake? Noel: That is its old skin; it shed its skin and left it there.
colloquial.zh: Rita：蛇旁边的这是什么？Noel：那是它的旧皮；它蜕了皮，把旧皮留在那里了。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din ħdejn is-serp?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din ħdejn is-serp?
messages.zh: 蛇旁边的这是什么？
messages.en: What is this next to the snake?

messages.speaker: Noel (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi l-ġilda l-qadima tiegħu; rema' l-ġilda u ħalliha hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi l-ġilda l-qadima tiegħu; rema' l-ġilda u ħalliha hemm.
messages.zh: 那是它的旧皮；它蜕了皮，把旧皮留在那里了。
messages.en: That is its old skin; it shed its skin and left it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蛇爬走后留下一层旧皮，把 rema' l-ġilda 与“蜕去了皮”整组记忆；重点记住外层脱离身体的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A memory of a past experience, or an account of such a memory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对过去某段经历的回忆，也可指讲述这段回忆的内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifkira ta' esperjenza mill-imgħoddi, jew rakkont ta' dik it-tifkira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对往事的回想，或对过去经历的追述。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifkira ta' ġrajja jew esperjenza tal-imgħoddi, jew rakkont li fih persuna terġa' ġġib dik l-esperjenza f'moħħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reminiscence is a memory of something that happened in the past, or a spoken or written account of that memory.

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tiftaħ il-kapitlu b'reminixxenza tat-tfulija tagħha fir-raħal.
formal.en: The author opens the chapter with a reminiscence of her childhood in the village.
formal.zh: 作者以一段在村庄度过童年的回忆作为本章的开篇。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tikteb? Lara: Reminixxenza ħelwa dwar il-vaganzi man-nanna. Maja: Aqrahieli meta tlesti!
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you writing? Lara: A fond reminiscence about holidays with my grandmother. Maja: Read it to me when you finish!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在写什么？拉拉：一段和奶奶一起度假的温馨回忆。玛雅：写完读给我听吧！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tikteb?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tikteb?
messages.zh: 你在写什么？
messages.en: What are you writing?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Reminixxenza ħelwa dwar il-vaganzi man-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Reminixxenza ħelwa dwar il-vaganzi man-nanna.
messages.zh: 一段和奶奶一起度假的温馨回忆。
messages.en: A fond reminiscence about holidays with my grandmother.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqrahieli meta tlesti!
messages.mt_standard: Aqrahieli meta tlesti!
messages.zh: 写完读给我听吧！
messages.en: Read it to me when you finish!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“翻开童年相册，讲起一段往事”的画面来记；重点是回忆及其讲述，不只是记住某个事实。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction or disappearance of signs of an illness, or a reduction or cancellation of a duty payable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疾病症状或体征减轻、消失的缓解状态；也指应缴关税的部分减免或全部免除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis jew għajbien tas-sinjali ta' marda, jew tnaqqis jew tneħħija ta' dazju li għandu jitħallas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疾病症状或体征减轻或消失的状态；缓解本身不等于已经治愈。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat li fih is-sinjali jew is-sintomi ta' marda jonqsu jew jgħibu, mingħajr ma dan bilfors ifisser li l-marda fieqet għalkollox.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an illness is in remission, its signs or symptoms have become less severe or have disappeared, although this does not necessarily mean it has been cured.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对应缴关税作出的部分减免或全部免除。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tnaqqis jew tneħħija ta' dazju li persuna jew negozju jkollhom iħallsu fuq merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A remission of duty is a reduction or cancellation of the customs duty that would otherwise have to be paid.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jindika li l-marda tinsab f'remissjoni, iżda l-pazjent għadu jeħtieġ monitoraġġ regolari.
formal.en: The medical report indicates that the illness is in remission, but the patient still requires regular monitoring.
formal.zh: 医疗报告显示疾病处于缓解期，但患者仍需接受定期监测。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'qallek it-tabib? Anna: Qalli li l-marda tinsab f'remissjoni. Mark: U se tibqa' tmur għall-kontrolli? Anna: Iva, għad għandi bżonn kontrolli regolari.
colloquial.en: Mark: What did the doctor tell you? Anna: He told me the illness is in remission. Mark: And will you keep going for check-ups? Anna: Yes, I still need regular check-ups.
colloquial.zh: 马克：医生怎么跟你说？安娜：他说病情已经缓解了。马克：那你还会继续复查吗？安娜：会，我仍然需要定期复查。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qallek it-tabib?
messages.mt_standard: X'qallek it-tabib?
messages.zh: 医生怎么跟你说？
messages.en: What did the doctor tell you?

messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li l-marda tinsab f'remissjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li l-marda tinsab f'remissjoni.
messages.zh: 他说病情已经缓解了。
messages.en: He told me the illness is in remission.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: U se tibqa' tmur għall-kontrolli?
messages.mt_standard: U se tibqa' tmur għall-kontrolli?
messages.zh: 那你还会继续复查吗？
messages.en: And will you keep going for check-ups?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għad għandi bżonn kontrolli regolari.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għad għandi bżonn kontrolli regolari.
messages.zh: 会，我仍然需要定期复查。
messages.en: Yes, I still need regular check-ups.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分开记：病历上写“症状缓解”，税单上写“关税减免”；共同联想是负担减轻，具体词义由语境决定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction or cancellation of customs duty that would otherwise be payable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对应缴关税给予部分减免或全部免除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis jew tneħħija ta' dazju li altrimenti jkollu jitħallas fuq merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减免；在这个词组中，特指对应缴关税的减免。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tnaqqis jew tneħħija ta' ħlas dovut; f'din l-espressjoni, il-ħlas ikun dazju fuq merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Remission is the reduction or cancellation of an amount owed, and in this expression it concerns customs duty.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应缴关税的部分减免或全部免除。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tnaqqis jew tneħħija tal-obbligu li jitħallas dazju fuq merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A remission of duty allows some or all of an otherwise payable customs charge to be waived.

collocations.en: an application for remission of duty

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ressqet applikazzjoni għal remissjoni tad-dazju fuq il-merkanzija importata.
formal.en: The company submitted an application for remission of duty on the imported goods.
formal.zh: 该公司提交了进口货物的关税减免申请。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Waslet risposta għall-applikazzjoni tagħna? Pawlu: Iva, tawna remissjoni tad-dazju. Sara: Fuq l-ammont kollu? Pawlu: Le, fuq parti minnu biss.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has a reply to our application arrived? Pawlu: Yes, we were granted remission of duty. Sara: On the whole amount? Pawlu: No, only on part of it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们的申请收到回复了吗？保罗：收到了，我们获准减免关税了。萨拉：全部金额都免了吗？保罗：没有，只减免了一部分。

messages.speaker: Sara (进口公司职员)

messages.mt_standard: Waslet risposta għall-applikazzjoni tagħna?
messages.zh: 我们的申请收到回复了吗？
messages.en: Has a reply to our application arrived?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tawna remissjoni tad-dazju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tawna remissjoni tad-dazju.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组贴在一张进口关税单上，想象应缴金额被划去一部分或全部；整组记作“关税减免”，避免套用疾病缓解义。

gloss_zh: 便利收益；持有实物商品的便利收益

teaching_sense.en_definition: The benefit of having a physical commodity available for immediate use rather than only holding a contract for future delivery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持有实物商品、能够随时使用或供应该商品所带来的收益或便利，相对于仅持有未来交货合约而言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-benefiċċju li ġġib magħha ż-żamma ta' komodità fiżika disponibbli għall-użu immedjat, meta mqabbla maż-żamma ta' kuntratt biss għal konsenja futura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因实际持有商品库存、能够及时使用或供应而获得的便利收益，例如维持生产和应对临时需求的好处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-benefiċċju li jinkiseb meta komodità tinżamm fiżikament u tkun disponibbli minnufih, pereżempju biex il-produzzjoni tibqa' għaddejja jew biex tintlaqa' domanda mhux mistennija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Convenience yield is the benefit of holding a physical commodity that can be used or supplied immediately, rather than relying solely on a contract for future delivery.

collocations.en: an estimate of the convenience yield

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tal-ħażniet, il-kumpanija qieset ir-rendiment ta' konvenjenza tal-qamħ li kellha disponibbli għall-produzzjoni immedjata.
formal.en: In its inventory analysis, the company considered the convenience yield of the wheat it had available for immediate production.
formal.zh: 在库存分析中，公司考虑了手头可立即投入生产的小麦所带来的便利收益。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex inżommu qamħ fil-maħżen? Lara: Biex inkunu nistgħu nużawh minnufih jekk il-konsenja li jmiss tittardja. Mark: Dan hu r-rendiment ta' konvenjenza? Lara: Iva, il-benefiċċju li jkollna l-qamħ hawn meta jkollna bżonnu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why do we keep wheat in the warehouse? Lara: So we can use it immediately if the next delivery is delayed. Mark: Is that the convenience yield? Lara: Yes, the benefit of having the wheat here when we need it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们为什么要在仓库里存小麦？拉拉：这样下一批货延迟时，我们就能立即用上。马克：这就是便利收益吗？拉拉：对，就是需要小麦时手头有货的好处。

messages.speaker: Mark (面包厂新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex inżommu qamħ fil-maħżen?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex inżommu qamħ fil-maħżen?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要在仓库里存小麦？
messages.en: Why do we keep wheat in the warehouse?

messages.speaker: Lara (库存主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inkunu nistgħu nużawh minnufih jekk il-konsenja li jmiss tittardja.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inkunu nistgħu nużawh minnufih jekk il-konsenja li jmiss tittardja.
messages.zh: 这样下一批货延迟时，我们就能立即用上。
messages.en: So we can use it immediately if the next delivery is delayed.

messages.speaker: Mark (面包厂新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu r-rendiment ta' konvenjenza?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu r-rendiment ta' konvenjenza?
messages.zh: 这就是便利收益吗？
messages.en: Is that the convenience yield?

messages.speaker: Lara (库存主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-benefiċċju li jkollna l-qamħ hawn meta jkollna bżonnu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-benefiċċju li jkollna l-qamħ hawn meta jkollna bżonnu.
messages.zh: 对，就是需要小麦时手头有货的好处。
messages.en: Yes, the benefit of having the wheat here when we need it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包厂急需小麦：仓库里的现货马上能用，未来交货合约却不能立刻投料；把“手头有货的便利”记作便利收益。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money received as rent, income, or revenue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以租金、收入或收益形式收到的钱款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus li jidħlu bħala ħlas għall-kiri, dħul jew introjtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 租金；为使用房屋、土地或其他租赁物而支付的钱款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas li jsir biex wieħed juża dar, art jew proprjetà oħra mikrija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rent is money paid for the use of property belonging to someone else.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收入；个人或机构从工作、财产或其他来源获得的钱款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Flus li persuna jew organizzazzjoni tirċievi mix-xogħol, mill-proprjetà jew minn sorsi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Income is money that a person or organization receives from work, property, or other sources.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收益；企业或机构从经营活动或其他来源取得的收入款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-flus li negozju jew istituzzjoni ddaħħal mill-attivitajiet tagħha jew minn sorsi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Revenue is the money that a business or institution receives through its activities or other sources.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri r-renta annwali li l-istituzzjoni tirċievi mill-proprjetà tagħha.
formal.en: The report shows the annual income that the institution receives from its property.
formal.zh: 报告列出了该机构从其房产获得的年收入。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hi r-renta tad-dar fix-xahar? Toni: Hi sitt mitt ewro, u nħallasha fil-bidu ta' kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much is the rent for the house each month? Toni: It's six hundred euros, and I pay it at the beginning of each month.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这套房子每月租金多少？托尼：六百欧元，我每月月初支付。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi r-renta tad-dar fix-xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi r-renta tad-dar fix-xahar?
messages.zh: 这套房子每月租金多少？
messages.en: How much is the rent for the house each month?

messages.speaker: Toni (租客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hi sitt mitt ewro, u nħallasha fil-bidu ta' kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Hi sitt mitt ewro, u nħallasha fil-bidu ta' kull xahar.
messages.zh: 六百欧元，我每月月初支付。
messages.en: It's six hundred euros, and I pay it at the beginning of each month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 renta 放进“房屋收租”的画面记忆：租客付的是租金，房东收到的是收入；看到机构或经营语境时，再理解为收益。

gloss_zh: 替代；用某人或某物代替另一人或物

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of one person or thing in place of another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用一个人或一件事物代替另一个人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' persuna jew ħaġa minflok persuna jew ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 替代；以一人或一物取代另一人或物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-użu ta' persuna jew ħaġa fil-post ta' persuna jew ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Replacing involves using one person or thing in the place of another.

collocations.en: in place of the old version
we use one instead of the other
collocations.zh: 我们用其中一个代替另一个

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, 'replacing' jindika l-użu ta' dokument ġdid minflok dak qadim.
formal.en: In this example, 'replacing' refers to the use of a new document in place of the old one.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，replacing 指用新文件替代旧文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nispjega 'replacing' f'dan l-eżempju? Pawlu: Qed nużaw ktieb ġdid minflok il-ktieb il-qadim.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I explain 'replacing' in this example? Pawlu: We're using a new book in place of the old book.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个例子里的 replacing 怎么解释？保罗：我们用一本新书代替那本旧书。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nispjega 'replacing' f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nispjega 'replacing' f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.zh: 这个例子里的 replacing 怎么解释？
messages.en: How do I explain 'replacing' in this example?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nużaw ktieb ġdid minflok il-ktieb il-qadim.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nużaw ktieb ġdid minflok il-ktieb il-qadim.
messages.zh: 我们用一本新书代替那本旧书。
messages.en: We're using a new book in place of the old book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把旧书拿走，再把新书放在同一位置：这个“替代”概念对应 replacing，马耳他语表达可抓住 minflok。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A repetition of something that has already been said or done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对已经说过的话或已经做过的事情再次重复。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ripetizzjoni ta' xi ħaġa li tkun diġà ntqalet jew saret.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重复；再次说出、做出或呈现先前已有的内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għemil, il-kliem jew il-preżentazzjoni mill-ġdid ta' xi ħaġa li tkun diġà saret, intqalet jew ġiet ippreżentata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A repetition occurs when something already said or done is said or done again.

formal.mt: Ir-replika tal-eżerċizzju tagħti lill-istudenti opportunità oħra biex jipprattikaw il-pronunzja.
formal.en: The repetition of the exercise gives students another opportunity to practise pronunciation.
formal.zh: 再次进行这项练习，能让学生多一次练习发音的机会。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tagħmel replika tas-sentenza? Ma fhimtx l-aħħar kelma. Mark: Iva, nerġa' ngħidha bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you repeat the sentence? I didn't understand the last word. Mark: Yes, I'll say it again slowly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你能把句子再说一遍吗？我没听懂最后一个词。马克：可以，我再慢慢说一遍。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħmel replika tas-sentenza? Ma fhimtx l-aħħar kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħmel replika tas-sentenza? Ma fhimtx l-aħħar kelma.
messages.zh: 你能把句子再说一遍吗？我没听懂最后一个词。
messages.en: Can you repeat the sentence? I didn't understand the last word.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nerġa' ngħidha bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nerġa' ngħidha bil-mod.
messages.zh: 可以，我再慢慢说一遍。
messages.en: Yes, I'll say it again slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 replika 与课堂上的“再来一遍”联系起来：一句话说完后再说一次，一项练习做完后再做一次，都是这里的重复义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place or collection in which things are stored and kept.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于集中存放、保存物品或资料的地方或集合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew ġabra fejn jinħażnu u jinżammu oġġetti jew materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储存库；集中存放和保存物品、文件或其他资料的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn jinġabru, jinħażnu u jinżammu oġġetti, dokumenti jew materjal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A repository is a place where objects, documents, or other materials are stored and kept.

formal.mt: Il-librerija żżomm kopji tad-dokumenti f'repożitorju diġitali biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jaċċessawhom.
formal.en: The library keeps copies of the documents in a digital repository so that students can access them.
formal.zh: 图书馆将这些文件的副本保存在数字资料库中，方便学生查阅。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nista' nsib il-kopja tar-rapport? David: Fir-repożitorju tad-dokumenti; fittex it-titlu tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can I find a copy of the report? David: In the document repository; search for its title.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我在哪里能找到报告的副本？戴维：在文件资料库里，搜索报告标题就行。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nsib il-kopja tar-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nsib il-kopja tar-rapport?
messages.zh: 我在哪里能找到报告的副本？
messages.en: Where can I find a copy of the report?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-repożitorju tad-dokumenti; fittex it-titlu tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Fir-repożitorju tad-dokumenti; fittex it-titlu tiegħu.
messages.zh: 在文件资料库里，搜索报告标题就行。
messages.en: In the document repository; search for its title.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个把文件集中保存、需要时可以查找的资料柜：英语 repository 对应马耳他语 repożitorju，记住共同的“储存库”画面。

gloss_zh: 共和的；共和政体的；支持共和制的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a republic or supporting a republican system of government.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与共和国或共和政体有关的，或支持共和制度的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' repubblika jew li jappoġġa sistema ta' gvern repubblikana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共和国的；共和政体的；拥护共和制的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda repubblika, il-mod kif titmexxa, jew l-appoġġ għal sistema politika repubblikana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is republican relates to a republic or expresses support for a republican form of government.

formal.mt: L-awtur jispjega l-ideal repubblikan u jqabblu mal-idea ta' monarkija.
formal.en: The author explains the republican ideal and compares it with the idea of monarchy.
formal.zh: 作者阐释共和理念，并将其与君主制的理念作比较。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'ifisser 'repubblikan' f'dan it-test? Mark: Hawnhekk jiddeskrivi gvern ta' repubblika.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'republican' mean in this text? Mark: Here it describes the government of a republic.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这篇文章里的“repubblikan”是什么意思？马克：这里用它来描述共和国的政府。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser 'repubblikan' f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser 'repubblikan' f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“repubblikan”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'republican' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk jiddeskrivi gvern ta' repubblika.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk jiddeskrivi gvern ta' repubblika.
messages.zh: 这里用它来描述共和国的政府。
messages.en: Here it describes the government of a republic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“共和政府、共和理念”两个词组一起记；看到它就联想“与共和制度有关的”这一形容词含义。

gloss_zh: 接近；趋近于；逼近某种状态或界限

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come close to reaching a particular condition, outcome, or limit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接近某种状态、结果或界限，尚未明确表示已经达到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wasal qrib qagħda, riżultat jew limitu partikolari, mingħajr ma dan bilfors ifisser li laħqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 趋近于某种状态；接近某个结果或界限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Resaq tant qrib qagħda, riżultat jew limitu li kien kważi wasal għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something verges on a condition or limit, they come very close to reaching it.

formal.mt: Minħabba n-nuqqas ta' fondi, il-proġett resaq lejn il-falliment.
formal.en: Because of a lack of funding, the project verged on failure.
formal.zh: 由于资金不足，该项目濒临失败。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tim rebaħ il-logħba? Pawlu: Le, imma resaq lejn ir-rebħa; l-avversarji ġabu d-draw fl-aħħar minuta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the team win the match? Pawlu: No, but it came close to victory; the opponents equalized in the last minute.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：球队赢了比赛吗？保罗：没有，不过差点就赢了；对手在最后一分钟扳平了比分。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tim rebaħ il-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: It-tim rebaħ il-logħba?
messages.zh: 球队赢了比赛吗？
messages.en: Did the team win the match?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma resaq lejn ir-rebħa; l-avversarji ġabu d-draw fl-aħħar minuta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma resaq lejn ir-rebħa; l-avversarji ġabu d-draw fl-aħħar minuta.
messages.zh: 没有，不过差点就赢了；对手在最后一分钟扳平了比分。
messages.en: No, but it came close to victory; the opponents equalized in the last minute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进度条已经逼近终点，却还差一点；用这个画面记住整组“接近某个结果”的意思，例句中的 resaq 表示已经发生的接近。

gloss_zh: 责任；职责；承担后果的义务

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duty to take care of something or to answer for an action and its consequences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 照管某事、履行某项任务，或对行为及其后果负责的义务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dmir li tieħu ħsieb xi ħaġa jew li twieġeb għal azzjoni u għall-konsegwenzi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应当履行的职责，或对某件事及其结果负责的义务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Obbligu li twettaq dmir, tieħu ħsieb xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew taċċetta l-konsegwenzi tal-għemil tiegħek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have responsibility for something, you have a duty to deal with it and answer for what happens.

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur għandu r-responsabbiltà li jiżgura li kull parteċipant jirċievi l-informazzjoni meħtieġa.
formal.en: The coordinator has responsibility for ensuring that every participant receives the necessary information.
formal.zh: 协调员有责任确保每位参与者都收到所需的信息。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jieħu ħsieb iċ-ċwievet? Ġanni: Jien se nieħu r-responsabbiltà; inżommhom fil-borża tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is going to look after the keys? Ġanni: I'll take responsibility; I'll keep them in my bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：谁来保管钥匙？詹尼：我来负责；我会把它们放在我的包里。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb iċ-ċwievet?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb iċ-ċwievet?
messages.zh: 谁来保管钥匙？
messages.en: Who is going to look after the keys?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien se nieħu r-responsabbiltà; inżommhom fil-borża tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Jien se nieħu r-responsabbiltà; inżommhom fil-borża tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我来负责；我会把它们放在我的包里。
messages.en: I'll take responsibility; I'll keep them in my bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把钥匙交给你，你回答“我来负责”；把这个场景与 tieħu r-responsabbiltà 一起记，连接“职责”和“承担责任”。

gloss_zh: 各项责任；职责；应尽的义务

teaching_sense.en_definition: Duties or obligations that someone is expected to fulfil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人应当履行的各项职责、责任或义务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dmirijiet u l-obbligi li persuna tkun mistennija twettaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某人需要承担和履行的各项责任、职责或义务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kompiti, id-dmirijiet u l-obbligi li persuna għandha tieħu ħsieb u twettaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your responsibilities are the duties and obligations that you are expected to fulfil.

formal.mt: Id-dokument jelenka r-responsabbiltajiet ta' kull membru tat-tim sabiex kulħadd ikun jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
formal.en: The document lists each team member's responsibilities so that everyone knows what they need to do.
formal.zh: 文件列出了每位团队成员的职责，以便每个人都清楚自己需要做什么。
