colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se naqsmu r-responsabbiltajiet għall-festa? Mark: Jien nieħu ħsieb l-ikel, u int tieħu ħsieb il-mużika.
colloquial.en: Maja: How shall we share the responsibilities for the party? Mark: I'll take care of the food, and you take care of the music.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：聚会的各项工作我们怎么分担？马克：我负责食物，你负责音乐。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se naqsmu r-responsabbiltajiet għall-festa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se naqsmu r-responsabbiltajiet għall-festa?
messages.zh: 聚会的各项工作我们怎么分担？
messages.en: How shall we share the responsibilities for the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien nieħu ħsieb l-ikel, u int tieħu ħsieb il-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: Jien nieħu ħsieb l-ikel, u int tieħu ħsieb il-mużika.
messages.zh: 我负责食物，你负责音乐。
messages.en: I'll take care of the food, and you take care of the music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着做饭、采购、整理的职责清单：responsabbiltajiet 指清单上的“各项责任”。把它与“分担职责”和“履行职责”两个动作一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 产品责任；对产品造成的损害承担的法律责任

teaching_sense.en_definition: Legal responsibility for harm or damage caused by a defective product.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因有缺陷的产品造成人身伤害或财产损害而产生的法律责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Responsabbiltà legali għal korriment jew ħsara kkawżati minn prodott difettuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产品责任，即对有缺陷的产品造成的伤害或损失所承担的法律责任。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Obbligu legali li wieħed iwieġeb għal dannu kkawżat minn prodott difettuż, bħal korriment lil persuna jew ħsara lill-proprjetà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Product liability is the legal responsibility for injuries or damage caused by a defective product.

collocations.mt: assigurazzjoni kontra r-responsabbiltà għal dannu minn prodotti
talba għal kumpens dwar responsabbiltà għal dannu minn prodotti

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddiskuti r-responsabbiltà għal dannu minn prodotti permezz ta' eżempju ta' apparat difettuż li kkawża ħsara lill-proprjetà.
formal.en: The report discusses product liability through an example of a defective appliance that caused property damage.
formal.zh: 报告以一台有缺陷的电器造成财产损害为例，讨论产品责任。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'responsabbiltà għal dannu minn prodotti'? David: Hija r-responsabbiltà legali għal ħsara jew korriment ikkawżati minn prodott difettuż.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'product liability' mean? David: It means legal responsibility for damage or injury caused by a defective product.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：“产品责任”是什么意思？戴维：就是对有缺陷的产品造成的损害或伤害承担的法律责任。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'responsabbiltà għal dannu minn prodotti'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'responsabbiltà għal dannu minn prodotti'?
messages.zh: “产品责任”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'product liability' mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija r-responsabbiltà legali għal ħsara jew korriment ikkawżati minn prodott difettuż.
messages.mt_standard: Hija r-responsabbiltà legali għal ħsara jew korriment ikkawżati minn prodott difettuż.
messages.zh: 就是对有缺陷的产品造成的损害或伤害承担的法律责任。
messages.en: It means legal responsibility for damage or injury caused by a defective product.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“责任—针对损害—来自产品”三个意义块记忆：responsabbiltà / għal dannu / minn prodotti，再联想“缺陷电器造成损害”的场景。

gloss_zh: 缺陷产品责任；产品责任

teaching_sense.en_definition: Legal responsibility for harm caused by defective products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因缺陷产品造成损害而承担的法律责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-responsabbiltà legali għal ħsara kkawżata minn prodotti difettużi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对缺陷产品所造成损害承担的法律责任。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-obbligu legali li wieħed iwieġeb għal ħsara kkawżata minn prodotti difettużi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Liability for defective products is legal responsibility for harm that faulty products cause.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产品责任，即因产品存在缺陷并造成损害而产生的法律责任。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-responsabbiltà legali marbuta mal-ħsara li jikkawża prodott minħabba difett fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Product liability refers to legal responsibility arising when a defective product causes harm.

collocations.mt: talba għal kumpens marbuta mar-responsabbiltà għall-prodotti difettużi
collocations.en: a compensation claim relating to product liability
collocations.zh: 与缺陷产品责任有关的赔偿请求

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-kunċett ta' responsabbiltà għall-prodotti difettużi u jagħti eżempji ta' ħsara kkawżata minn dawn il-prodotti.
formal.en: The report explains the concept of product liability and gives examples of harm caused by defective products.
formal.zh: 该报告解释了缺陷产品责任这一概念，并举例说明此类产品造成的损害。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser responsabbiltà għall-prodotti difettużi? Mark: Tfisser responsabbiltà legali għal ħsara li jikkawża prodott difettuż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does product liability mean? Mark: It means legal responsibility for harm caused by a defective product.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：缺陷产品责任是什么意思？马克：就是对缺陷产品造成的损害承担法律责任。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser responsabbiltà għall-prodotti difettużi?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser responsabbiltà għall-prodotti difettużi?
messages.zh: 缺陷产品责任是什么意思？
messages.en: What does product liability mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser responsabbiltà legali għal ħsara li jikkawża prodott difettuż.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser responsabbiltà legali għal ħsara li jikkawża prodott difettuż.
messages.zh: 就是对缺陷产品造成的损害承担法律责任。
messages.en: It means legal responsibility for harm caused by a defective product.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词放进“产品有缺陷、造成损害、涉及法律责任”的情境中记忆；看到 prodotti difettużi，就联想“缺陷产品”，再把前面的 responsabbiltà 连成“缺陷产品责任”。

gloss_zh: 负责的；负有责任的；有责任心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a duty to take care of something or answer for it, or showing care in fulfilling duties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有职责照管某事或须为其负责的；也可形容履行职责时认真可靠、有责任心的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dmir jieħu ħsieb xi ħaġa jew iwieġeb għaliha, jew li jwettaq dmirijietu b'għaqal u b'attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事负有职责或责任的；形容人时也可表示认真履行职责、有责任心的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu r-responsabbiltà għal xi ħaġa jew għall-konsegwenzi ta' għemilu, jew li jaġixxi b'għaqal u jwettaq dmirijietu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are responsible for something, you have a duty to look after it or answer for it; a responsible person also acts carefully and fulfils their duties.

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur huwa responsabbli mill-proġett u għandu jiżgura li x-xogħol jitlesta fil-ħin.
formal.en: The coordinator is responsible for the project and must ensure that the work is completed on time.
formal.zh: 协调员负责该项目，必须确保工作按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu responsabbli miċ-ċwievet illum? Mark: Jien. Qegħdin fil-borża tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is responsible for the keys today? Mark: I am. They're in my bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天谁负责保管钥匙？马克：我。钥匙在我的包里。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu responsabbli miċ-ċwievet illum?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu responsabbli miċ-ċwievet illum?
messages.zh: 今天谁负责保管钥匙？
messages.en: Who is responsible for the keys today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Qegħdin fil-borża tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Qegħdin fil-borża tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我。钥匙在我的包里。
messages.en: I am. They're in my bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“钥匙交给谁，谁就负责”来记 responsabbli；再联想一个认真保管钥匙的人，就能同时记住“负有责任的”和“有责任心的”两种用法。

gloss_zh: 已修复的；经修复而恢复原貌的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Repaired or treated so that it returns to a former good condition or appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过修理或修复处理，恢复到原先良好状态或外观的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie msewwi jew trattat sabiex jerġa' jikseb il-kundizzjoni tajba jew id-dehra li kellu qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过修复，已恢复原有良好状态或外观的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li saritlu ħidma ta' tiswija jew konservazzjoni biex jerġa' jkun f'kundizzjoni tajba jew jidher kif kien qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is restored has been repaired or treated to bring back its former condition or appearance.

formal.mt: Il-kwadru restawrat reġa' tqiegħed fis-sala ewlenija tal-mużew wara li tlesta x-xogħol ta' konservazzjoni.
formal.en: The restored painting was placed back in the museum's main hall after the conservation work was completed.
formal.zh: 保护修复工作完成后，修复好的画作重新陈列在博物馆的主展厅里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan is-siġġu huwa ġdid? Mark: Le, huwa restawrat. Kien tan-nannu tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this chair new? Mark: No, it's restored. It belonged to my grandfather.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这把椅子是新的吗？马克：不是，是修复过的。以前是我爷爷的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-siġġu huwa ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-siġġu huwa ġdid?
messages.zh: 这把椅子是新的吗？
messages.en: Is this chair new?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa restawrat. Kien tan-nannu tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa restawrat. Kien tan-nannu tiegħi.
messages.zh: 不是，是修复过的。以前是我爷爷的。
messages.en: No, it's restored. It belonged to my grandfather.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象爷爷的旧椅子经过修理，又恢复了往日模样：这种“已经修复好”的状态就是 restawrat。搭配 siġġu 记 restawrat，搭配 għamara 记 restawrata。

gloss_zh: 分配约束；资源配置限制

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition that limits how available resources may be assigned to different uses or recipients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对可用资源如何分配给不同用途或接收方所施加的限制条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li tillimita kif ir-riżorsi disponibbli jistgħu jitqassmu bejn użi jew benefiċjarji differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 限制资源分配方式、数量或对象的条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li tistabbilixxi limiti fuq il-mod kif jitqassmu r-riżorsi, il-kwantitajiet tagħhom jew min jista' jirċevihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An allocation constraint is a condition that restricts how resources can be distributed among different purposes or recipients.

formal.mt: Il-pjan għandu jirrispetta r-restrizzjoni tal-allokazzjoni li tillimita s-sehem ta' kull dipartiment għal għoxrin fil-mija tal-baġit.
formal.en: The plan must comply with the allocation constraint that limits each department's share to twenty per cent of the budget.
formal.zh: 该计划必须遵守分配约束，即每个部门所得份额不得超过预算的百分之二十。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nagħtu aktar flus lil dan it-tim? Mark: Le, ir-restrizzjoni tal-allokazzjoni tippermetti biss mitejn ewro għal kull tim.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we give this team more money? Mark: No, the allocation constraint allows only two hundred euros per team.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们能给这个团队多分一点钱吗？马克：不行，分配约束规定每个团队只能分到两百欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nagħtu aktar flus lil dan it-tim?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nagħtu aktar flus lil dan it-tim?
messages.zh: 我们能给这个团队多分一点钱吗？
messages.en: Can we give this team more money?

messages.speaker: Mark (预算负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ir-restrizzjoni tal-allokazzjoni tippermetti biss mitejn ewro għal kull tim.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ir-restrizzjoni tal-allokazzjoni tippermetti biss mitejn ewro għal kull tim.
messages.zh: 不行，分配约束规定每个团队只能分到两百欧元。
messages.en: No, the allocation constraint allows only two hundred euros per team.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“分预算”的场景记忆：钱要分给各团队，但每队有上限；整个短语就是约束分配的条件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition that limits the transmission of data or signals, including its amount, speed, or availability.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 限制数据或信号传输的条件，可涉及传输量、速度或是否能够传输。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li tillimita t-trażmissjoni ta' data jew sinjali, inklużi l-kwantità, il-veloċità jew il-possibbiltà li jintbagħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对数据或信号传送所施加的限制条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li tistabbilixxi limitu fuq kif, kemm jew meta jistgħu jintbagħtu data jew sinjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A transmission constraint is a condition that restricts how much data or how many signals can be sent, or how they are transmitted.

formal.mt: Minħabba r-restrizzjoni tat-trażmissjoni, is-sistema tista' tibgħat biss ammont limitat ta' data kull sekonda.
formal.en: Because of the transmission constraint, the system can send only a limited amount of data per second.
formal.zh: 由于传输约束，该系统每秒只能发送有限数量的数据。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma nistax nibgħat il-fajls kollha f'daqqa? Pawlu: Hemm restrizzjoni tat-trażmissjoni; ipprova ibgħathom wieħed wieħed.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why can't I send all the files at once? Pawlu: There's a transmission constraint; try sending them one at a time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么我不能一次发送所有文件？保罗：有传输限制；试着一个一个地发送。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nibgħat il-fajls kollha f'daqqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nibgħat il-fajls kollha f'daqqa?
messages.zh: 为什么我不能一次发送所有文件？
messages.en: Why can't I send all the files at once?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (技术支持人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm restrizzjoni tat-trażmissjoni; ipprova ibgħathom wieħed wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm restrizzjoni tat-trażmissjoni; ipprova ibgħathom wieħed wieħed.
messages.zh: 有传输限制；试着一个一个地发送。
messages.en: There's a transmission constraint; try sending them one at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象发送文件时通道有容量上限：每秒只能通过一部分数据，用这个画面记住“传输约束”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat shape with four straight sides and four right angles, called rettanglu or rettangolu in Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由四条直边围成、四个角都是直角的平面图形；马耳他语可称为 rettanglu 或 rettangolu。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Figura ċatta b'erba' naħat dritti u erba' angoli retti, li tissejjaħ rettanglu jew rettangolu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有四条直边且四个角均为直角的四边形。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Figura ġeometrika ċatta b'erba' naħat dritti u erba' angoli retti, li n-naħat opposti tagħha huma paralleli u ndaqs.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rectangle is a flat four-sided shape in which every angle is a right angle and opposite sides are equal.

formal.mt: Biex tikkalkula l-erja ta' rettanglu, immultiplika t-tul bil-wisa'.
formal.en: To calculate the area of a rectangle, multiply its length by its width.
formal.zh: 计算矩形的面积时，将长乘以宽。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi npinġi rettanglu hawn? Ben: Iva, pinġi rettangolu twil u dejjaq, bħal dan il-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Should I draw a rectangle here? Ben: Yes, draw a long, narrow rectangle, like this book.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我应该在这里画一个矩形吗？本：对，画一个长而窄的矩形，像这本书一样。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi npinġi rettanglu hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi npinġi rettanglu hawn?
messages.zh: 我应该在这里画一个矩形吗？
messages.en: Should I draw a rectangle here?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, pinġi rettangolu twil u dejjaq, bħal dan il-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, pinġi rettangolu twil u dejjaq, bħal dan il-ktieb.
messages.zh: 对，画一个长而窄的矩形，像这本书一样。
messages.en: Yes, draw a long, narrow rectangle, like this book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个四角都是直角的书本封面，同时读 rettanglu 和 rettangolu；中间的 jew 表示“或”，连接同一图形的两种名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An animal such as a snake, lizard, or crocodile, with scaly skin and a body temperature strongly affected by its surroundings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蛇、蜥蜴、鳄等具有鳞片状皮肤、体温主要受外界环境影响的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal, bħal serp, gremxula jew kukkudrill, li għandu ġilda bil-qxur u temperatura tal-ġisem li tiddependi ħafna mill-ambjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爬行动物，如蛇、蜥蜴或鳄，通常有鳞片状皮肤，体温主要受环境影响。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal tal-grupp li jinkludi s-sriep, il-gremxul u l-kukkudrilli, b'ġilda bil-qxur u b'temperatura tal-ġisem li tinbidel skont l-ambjent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reptile is an animal such as a snake or lizard that has scaly skin and relies largely on external heat to regulate its body temperature.

formal.mt: Is-sriep u l-gremxul huma rettili, u l-ħarsien tal-ħabitat tagħhom huwa importanti għall-konservazzjoni tagħhom.
formal.en: Snakes and lizards are reptiles, and protecting their habitat is important for their conservation.
formal.zh: 蛇和蜥蜴属于爬行动物，保护它们的栖息地对其保育十分重要。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-gremxul huma rettili? Adam: Iva, bħas-sriep. Ara dik il-gremxula fuq il-ħajt!
colloquial.en: Nina: Are lizards reptiles? Adam: Yes, like snakes. Look at that lizard on the wall!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：蜥蜴是爬行动物吗？亚当：是的，和蛇一样。看墙上的那只蜥蜴！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-gremxul huma rettili?
messages.mt_standard: Il-gremxul huma rettili?
messages.zh: 蜥蜴是爬行动物吗？
messages.en: Are lizards reptiles?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bħas-sriep. Ara dik il-gremxula fuq il-ħajt!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bħas-sriep. Ara dik il-gremxula fuq il-ħajt!
messages.zh: 是的，和蛇一样。看墙上的那只蜥蜴！
messages.en: Yes, like snakes. Look at that lizard on the wall!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rettili 与墙上晒太阳的蜥蜴、地上游动的蛇一起记忆；观察鳞片和借助环境热量调节体温这两个特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An animal with a backbone and scaly skin, such as a snake or lizard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有脊椎、皮肤覆盖鳞片的一类动物，如蛇或蜥蜴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal vertebrat b'ġilda miksija bl-iskali, bħas-serp jew il-gremxula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爬行动物，如蛇、蜥蜴或龟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal li jagħmel parti mill-grupp tas-sriep, tal-gremxul u tal-fkieren, u li għandu sinsla tad-dahar u ġilda bl-iskali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reptile is an animal such as a snake, lizard, or turtle that has a backbone and scaly skin.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, l-istudenta ddeskriviet rettilu li jgħix f'ambjent niexef.
formal.en: In her report, the student described a reptile that lives in a dry environment.
formal.zh: 这名女学生在报告中描述了一种生活在干燥环境中的爬行动物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik il-gremxula fuq il-ħajt! Toni: Dik ukoll hija rettilu, bħas-serp.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that lizard on the wall! Toni: That is a reptile too, like a snake.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看墙上那只蜥蜴！托尼：它也是爬行动物，和蛇一样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik il-gremxula fuq il-ħajt!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik il-gremxula fuq il-ħajt!
messages.zh: 看墙上那只蜥蜴！
messages.en: Look at that lizard on the wall!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ukoll hija rettilu, bħas-serp.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ukoll hija rettilu, bħas-serp.
messages.zh: 它也是爬行动物，和蛇一样。
messages.en: That is a reptile too, like a snake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rettilu 和英语 reptile 配成词卡，卡背画一条蛇和一只蜥蜴，记住它表示动物类别“爬行动物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The person who leads a university or certain other educational institutions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主持大学或某些其他教育机构事务的负责人，通常译为校长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi università jew ċerti istituzzjonijiet edukattivi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大学或某些教育、宗教机构的负责人；校长或院长，具体译名依机构而定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha t-tmexxija ta' università jew ta' ċerti istituzzjonijiet edukattivi jew reliġjużi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rector is the person in charge of a university or certain other educational or religious institutions.

formal.mt: Ir-rettur tal-università laqa' lill-istudenti l-ġodda waqt iċ-ċerimonja tal-ftuħ tas-sena akkademika.
formal.en: The rector of the university welcomed the new students during the ceremony marking the start of the academic year.
formal.zh: 大学校长在新学年开幕典礼上欢迎了新生。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jitkellem fiċ-ċerimonja għada? Mark: Ir-rettur. Se jilqa' lill-istudenti l-ġodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is speaking at the ceremony tomorrow? Mark: The rector. He will welcome the new students.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：明天的典礼上谁来讲话？马克：校长。他会欢迎新生。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jitkellem fiċ-ċerimonja għada?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jitkellem fiċ-ċerimonja għada?
messages.zh: 明天的典礼上谁来讲话？
messages.en: Who is speaking at the ceremony tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rettur. Se jilqa' lill-istudenti l-ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rettur. Se jilqa' lill-istudenti l-ġodda.
messages.zh: 校长。他会欢迎新生。
messages.en: The rector. He will welcome the new students.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大学开学典礼上致辞的人，把 ir-rettur tal-università 整块记成“大学校长”，并与英语 rector 对照复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be officially cancelled or withdrawn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以通过正式决定予以取消、撤销或撤回的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi rtirat jew imħassar permezz ta' deċiżjoni uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可撤销的；指许可、授权或决定等可以被正式撤回或取消。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi rtirat jew imħassar uffiċjalment, bħal permess, awtorizzazzjoni jew deċiżjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a permission, authorization, or decision is revocable, it can be officially withdrawn or cancelled.

formal.mt: L-ittra tispeċifika li l-permess għall-użu tas-sala huwa revokabbli jekk ma jiġux rispettati l-kundizzjonijiet.
formal.en: The letter specifies that permission to use the hall is revocable if the conditions are not respected.
formal.zh: 信中明确说明，如不遵守相关条件，使用礼堂的许可可以被撤销。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-permess jibqa' jgħodd jiġri x'jiġri? Pawlu: Le, huwa revokabbli. Jistgħu jirtirawh jekk ma nimxux mal-kundizzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this permit remain valid no matter what happens? Pawlu: No, it is revocable. They can withdraw it if we do not follow the conditions.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个许可无论发生什么都一直有效吗？保罗：不是，它可以被撤销。如果我们不遵守条件，他们可以撤回许可。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-permess jibqa' jgħodd jiġri x'jiġri?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-permess jibqa' jgħodd jiġri x'jiġri?
messages.zh: 这个许可无论发生什么都一直有效吗？
messages.en: Does this permit remain valid no matter what happens?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa revokabbli. Jistgħu jirtirawh jekk ma nimxux mal-kundizzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa revokabbli. Jistgħu jirtirawh jekk ma nimxux mal-kundizzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 不是，它可以被撤销。如果我们不遵守条件，他们可以撤回许可。
messages.en: No, it is revocable. They can withdraw it if we do not follow the conditions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上给“许可”画一个可撤回的箭头，再写 permess revokabbli，用“许可可以收回”的画面记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A general term for conditions involving pain or stiffness in joints, muscles, or surrounding tissues.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及关节、肌肉或周围组织疼痛、僵硬的一类病症的统称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ġenerali għal kundizzjonijiet li jinvolvu wġigħ jew ebusija fil-ġogi, fil-muskoli jew fit-tessuti ta' madwarhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 风湿；泛指引起关节、肌肉或其周围组织疼痛、僵硬等症状的病症，并非某一种具体疾病的名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terminu ġenerali għal diversi kundizzjonijiet li jikkawżaw uġigħ jew ebusija fil-ġogi, fil-muskoli jew fit-tessuti ta' madwarhom, aktar milli isem ta' marda waħda speċifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rheumatism is a general term for conditions that cause pain or stiffness in joints, muscles, or nearby tissues.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega li r-rewmatiżmu huwa terminu ġenerali li jista' jirreferi għal diversi kundizzjonijiet tal-ġogi u tal-muskoli.
formal.en: The leaflet explains that rheumatism is a general term that can refer to various conditions affecting joints and muscles.
formal.zh: 小册子说明，风湿是一个统称，可以指多种影响关节和肌肉的病症。

colloquial.mt: Anna: In-nannu kif inhu llum? Luqa: Qal li għandu uġigħ minħabba r-rewmatiżmu, imma xorta ġie joqgħod magħna fil-kċina.
colloquial.en: Anna: How is Grandpa today? Luqa: He said he has pain due to rheumatism, but he still came to sit with us in the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：爷爷今天怎么样？卢卡：他说风湿让他有些疼，不过他还是来厨房和我们一起坐了。

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu kif inhu llum?
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu kif inhu llum?
messages.zh: 爷爷今天怎么样？
messages.en: How is Grandpa today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li għandu uġigħ minħabba r-rewmatiżmu, imma xorta ġie joqgħod magħna fil-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li għandu uġigħ minħabba r-rewmatiżmu, imma xorta ġie joqgħod magħna fil-kċina.
messages.zh: 他说风湿让他有些疼，不过他还是来厨房和我们一起坐了。
messages.en: He said he has pain due to rheumatism, but he still came to sit with us in the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rewmatiżmu 与英语 rheumatism 对照记忆，旁边画关节和肌肉，标注“疼痛、僵硬的统称”，避免把它只记成一种具体关节病。

gloss_zh: 叛乱；起义；反抗统治的暴动

teaching_sense.en_definition: An uprising in which a group openly opposes or fights against those in authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一群人公开反抗或以武力对抗统治者、政府或其他权威的行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni li fiha grupp ta' nies iqum kontra dawk li għandhom l-awtorità, xi drabi billi juża l-forza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公开反抗既有统治或权威的叛乱或起义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni kollettiva kontra l-ħakma jew l-awtorità eżistenti, li tista' tinvolvi ġlied.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rebellion is an action in which people openly oppose or fight against an established authority.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人们因不满统治或待遇而发动的反抗、暴动或起义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qawmien ta' nies li jirrifjutaw ħakma jew trattament li jqisuh inġust u jaġixxu kontrih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A revolt occurs when people rise against those controlling them, often because they consider their treatment unjust.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif in-nuqqas ta' ikel wassal għal rewwixta kontra l-ħakkiema.
formal.en: The report explains how a shortage of food led to a revolt against the rulers.
formal.zh: 这份报告解释了粮食短缺如何引发了一场反抗统治者的起义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex bdiet ir-rewwixta fl-istorja li qrajna? Mark: In-nies kienu rrabjati mal-ħakkiema u qamu kontrihom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the revolt start in the story we read? Mark: The people were angry with the rulers and rose against them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们读的故事里，起义为什么会爆发？马克：人们对统治者很愤怒，就起来反抗他们了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex bdiet ir-rewwixta fl-istorja li qrajna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex bdiet ir-rewwixta fl-istorja li qrajna?
messages.zh: 我们读的故事里，起义为什么会爆发？
messages.en: Why did the revolt start in the story we read?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nies kienu rrabjati mal-ħakkiema u qamu kontrihom.
messages.mt_standard: In-nies kienu rrabjati mal-ħakkiema u qamu kontrihom.
messages.zh: 人们对统治者很愤怒，就起来反抗他们了。
messages.en: The people were angry with the rulers and rose against them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rewwixta 配上“一群人起来反抗统治者”的画面记忆；重点是集体反抗权威，不只是个人生气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written or spoken assessment that describes and evaluates a work, product, or performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对作品、产品或演出进行介绍、分析和评价的书面或口头评论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kitba jew kumment bil-fomm li jiddeskrivi u jevalwa ktieb, film, prodott jew wirja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 评介；对书籍、电影、产品或演出等所作的介绍和评价。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kitba jew diskussjoni li tippreżenta u tevalwa l-kwalitajiet ta' xogħol, prodott jew wirja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A review is a written or spoken assessment that describes something and gives an opinion about its quality.

formal.mt: Ir-reċensjoni tal-ktieb tanalizza l-istil tal-awtur u tispjega għaliex l-istorja hija effettiva.
formal.en: The book review analyses the author's style and explains why the story is effective.
formal.zh: 这篇书评分析了作者的风格，并解释了故事为何具有感染力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt ir-reċensjoni ta' dak il-film? Mark: Iva, imma nixtieq narah u niddeċiedi jien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you read the review of that film? Mark: Yes, but I'd like to watch it and decide for myself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你读过那部电影的影评吗？马克：读过，不过我想自己看一看，再作判断。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt ir-reċensjoni ta' dak il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt ir-reċensjoni ta' dak il-film?
messages.zh: 你读过那部电影的影评吗？
messages.en: Have you read the review of that film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nixtieq narah u niddeċiedi jien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nixtieq narah u niddeċiedi jien.
messages.zh: 读过，不过我想自己看一看，再作判断。
messages.en: Yes, but I'd like to watch it and decide for myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读完一本书后写下“讲了什么、好在哪里”，把这份有评价的文字记作 reċensjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a time not long before the present.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某件事发生在距离现在不久的时间，用于说明动作或事件发生的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi żmien mhux 'il bogħod minn issa, biex tindika meta seħħet azzjoni jew ġrajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最近；不久前，表示动作或事件发生于距今不久的时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftit taż-żmien ilu, jiġifieri fi żmien qrib il-preżent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happened recently, it happened only a short time before now.

formal.mt: L-istudju li ġie ppubblikat reċentement janalizza kif l-istudenti jitgħallmu kliem ġdid.
formal.en: The study that was published recently analyses how students learn new words.
formal.zh: 最近发表的这项研究分析了学生如何学习新词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Iltqajt ma' Sara reċentement? Mark: Iva, rajtha lbieraħ fil-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen Sara recently? Mark: Yes, I saw her yesterday at the shop.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你最近见过萨拉吗？马克：见过，昨天我在商店里看到她了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iltqajt ma' Sara reċentement?
messages.mt_standard: Iltqajt ma' Sara reċentement?
messages.zh: 你最近见过萨拉吗？
messages.en: Have you seen Sara recently?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rajtha lbieraħ fil-ħanut.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rajtha lbieraħ fil-ħanut.
messages.zh: 见过，昨天我在商店里看到她了。
messages.en: Yes, I saw her yesterday at the shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“什么时候发生？”来提示自己：reċentement 回答“最近发生”，在句中给动作标上时间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having happened, appeared, or been made only a short time ago.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述不久前发生、出现或制作的事物，表示其时间距离现在很近。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li seħħ, deher jew sar ftit taż-żmien ilu, qrib il-preżent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最近的；新近发生、出现或完成的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għal żmien qrib il-preżent jew li seħħ ftit taż-żmien ilu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is recent happened, appeared, or was made only a short time ago.

formal.mt: Studju reċenti juri li l-qari regolari jgħin lill-istudenti jkabbru l-vokabularju tagħhom.
formal.en: A recent study shows that regular reading helps students expand their vocabulary.
formal.zh: 最近的一项研究表明，经常阅读有助于学生扩大词汇量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-ritratt huwa reċenti? Mark: Iva, ħadnieh il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this photo recent? Mark: Yes, we took it last week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张照片是最近拍的吗？马克：是的，我们上周拍的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-ritratt huwa reċenti?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-ritratt huwa reċenti?
messages.zh: 这张照片是最近拍的吗？
messages.en: Is this photo recent?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħadnieh il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħadnieh il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.zh: 是的，我们上周拍的。
messages.en: Yes, we took it last week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reċenti 贴在“照片、研究、变化”等名词旁，记成“最近的”；与表示“最近发生”的副词 reċentement 配对区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period when economic activity declines and businesses generally produce or sell less.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经济活动持续减弱、企业生产或销售普遍下降的一段时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu li fih tonqos l-attività ekonomika u n-negozji ġeneralment jipproduċu jew ibigħu inqas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经济活动持续下降的时期；经济衰退。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċessjoni hija perjodu ta' tnaqqis fl-attività ekonomika, li jista' jkun akkumpanjat minn inqas produzzjoni, bejgħ u impjiegi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A recession is a period when economic activity declines, often leading to lower production and fewer jobs.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif ir-reċessjoni wasslet għal tnaqqis fil-bejgħ u fl-investiment.
formal.en: The report explains how the recession led to a decline in sales and investment.
formal.zh: 报告说明了经济衰退如何导致销售和投资下降。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ħwienet qed ibigħu inqas? Pawlu: Minħabba r-reċessjoni, ħafna nies qed joqogħdu aktar attenti kif jonfqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are shops selling less? Pawlu: Because of the recession, many people are being more careful about how they spend.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么商店的销量下降了？保罗：因为经济衰退，很多人花钱更谨慎了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħwienet qed ibigħu inqas?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħwienet qed ibigħu inqas?
messages.zh: 为什么商店的销量下降了？
messages.en: Why are shops selling less?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba r-reċessjoni, ħafna nies qed joqogħdu aktar attenti kif jonfqu.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba r-reċessjoni, ħafna nies qed joqogħdu aktar attenti kif jonfqu.
messages.zh: 因为经济衰退，很多人花钱更谨慎了。
messages.en: Because of the recession, many people are being more careful about how they spend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reċessjoni 配上销售曲线向下的画面，联想“销量少、投资减、花钱谨慎”的经济衰退情景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used to hold liquids or other substances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来盛放液体或其他物质的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jintuża biex jinżammu fih likwidi jew sustanzi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于盛放液体或其他物质的容器、盛器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent huwa oġġett li fih jistgħu jitqiegħdu jew jinżammu likwidi jew sustanzi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vessel is a container in which liquids or other substances can be held.

formal.mt: Poġġi l-kampjun f'reċipjent nadif u agħlaq l-għatu sew.
formal.en: Place the sample in a clean container and close the lid securely.
formal.zh: 将样品放入干净的容器中，并盖紧盖子。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn inpoġġi s-soppa li fadal? Toni: Poġġiha f'dan ir-reċipjent u agħlaq l-għatu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where should I put the leftover soup? Toni: Put it in this container and close the lid.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：剩下的汤放在哪里？托尼：放进这个容器里，再把盖子盖上。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi s-soppa li fadal?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi s-soppa li fadal?
messages.zh: 剩下的汤放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the leftover soup?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha f'dan ir-reċipjent u agħlaq l-għatu.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha f'dan ir-reċipjent u agħlaq l-għatu.
messages.zh: 放进这个容器里，再把盖子盖上。
messages.en: Put it in this container and close the lid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 reċipjent，就想象一个可以装汤、装水或装样品的容器，用“里面能盛东西”的共同功能记忆。

gloss_zh: 倾倒用容器；用于倒出液体的容器

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used to hold liquid and pour it out where it is needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放液体，并将液体倾倒到所需位置的容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex jinżamm fih likwidu u jitferra' fil-post mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于将所盛液体倾倒到其他物体上或所需位置的容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent biex tferra' huwa kontenitur li minnu jitferra' likwidu fuq xi ħaġa jew fil-post fejn ikun meħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pour-on container holds liquid so that it can be poured onto something or into a chosen place.

formal.mt: Uża reċipjent biex tferra' l-likwidu bil-mod fil-flixkun.
formal.en: Use a pouring container to pour the liquid slowly into the bottle.
formal.zh: 使用倾倒用容器，将液体缓缓倒入瓶中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek reċipjent biex tferra' l-ilma fil-vażun? Mark: Iva, ħu dan u ferra' bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a container for pouring water into the vase? Mark: Yes, take this one and pour slowly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有能往花瓶里倒水的容器吗？马克：有，拿这个，慢慢倒。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek reċipjent biex tferra' l-ilma fil-vażun?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek reċipjent biex tferra' l-ilma fil-vażun?
messages.zh: 你有能往花瓶里倒水的容器吗？
messages.en: Do you have a container for pouring water into the vase?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu dan u ferra' bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu dan u ferra' bil-mod.
messages.zh: 有，拿这个，慢慢倒。
messages.en: Yes, take this one and pour slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成“拿起容器，倾斜，倒出液体”的连续动作；用倒水进花瓶的画面记住它的用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used to collect material removed during dredging.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清淤作业中用于收集所清除物料的容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex jinġabar fih il-materjal imneħħi waqt it-tindif tal-qiegħ ta' passaġġ jew medda ta' ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疏浚、清淤时用于收集从水底清除的泥沙等物料的容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent għat-tindif huwa kontenitur li jintuża biex jinġabru fih tajn, ramel jew materjal ieħor imneħħi mill-qiegħ waqt xogħol ta' tindif fl-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dredging container collects mud, sand, or other material removed from the bottom of a body of water.

collocations.en: a dredging container full of mud

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif tal-qiegħ tal-kanal, il-materjal imneħħi nġabar f'reċipjent għat-tindif.
formal.en: During dredging of the canal bed, the removed material was collected in a dredging container.
formal.zh: 运河河底清淤期间，清除的物料被收集到清淤容器中。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ir-reċipjent għat-tindif diġà mtela bit-tajn? Ġużeppi: Iva, irridu nbattluh qabel inkomplu x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the dredging container already full of mud? Ġużeppi: Yes, we need to empty it before continuing the work.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：清淤容器已经装满淤泥了吗？朱塞佩：是的，我们得先清空它，再继续干活。

messages.speaker: Rita (作业同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-reċipjent għat-tindif diġà mtela bit-tajn?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-reċipjent għat-tindif diġà mtela bit-tajn?
messages.zh: 清淤容器已经装满淤泥了吗？
messages.en: Is the dredging container already full of mud?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (作业同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irridu nbattluh qabel inkomplu x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irridu nbattluh qabel inkomplu x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 是的，我们得先清空它，再继续干活。
messages.en: Yes, we need to empty it before continuing the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 结合本条给定的清淤义，想象河底泥沙被清起后装进容器；把“清除泥沙、容器收集”的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes a feeling, action, or relationship that involves both sides giving or doing something similar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容双方彼此具有同类感情、采取相应行动或承担相应关系的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi sentiment, azzjoni jew relazzjoni li fiha ż-żewġ naħat iħossu jew jagħmlu xi ħaġa simili lejn xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相互的；双方彼此给予、感受或作出相应回应的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jeżisti jew iseħħ bejn żewġ naħat, b'kull naħa tagħti jew tagħmel xi ħaġa simili lill-oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reciprocal feeling or action is shared or returned by the other person or group involved.

formal.mt: Il-kooperazzjoni bejn iż-żewġ organizzazzjonijiet hija bbażata fuq rispett reċiproku u skambju regolari ta' informazzjoni.
formal.en: Cooperation between the two organizations is based on mutual respect and the regular exchange of information.
formal.zh: 这两个组织之间的合作建立在相互尊重和定期交流信息的基础上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Grazzi talli għentni lbieraħ. Mark: Int ukoll dejjem tgħinni. L-appoġġ tagħna huwa reċiproku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Thanks for helping me yesterday. Mark: You always help me too. We support each other.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谢谢你昨天帮我。马克：你也总是帮我。我们的支持是相互的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli għentni lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli għentni lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 谢谢你昨天帮我。
messages.en: Thanks for helping me yesterday.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int ukoll dejjem tgħinni. L-appoġġ tagħna huwa reċiproku.
messages.mt_standard: Int ukoll dejjem tgħinni. L-appoġġ tagħna huwa reċiproku.
messages.zh: 你也总是帮我。我们的支持是相互的。
messages.en: You always help me too. We support each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出两个人之间来回的双向箭头，并联想固定搭配 rispett reċiproku：尊重从双方发出，意思就是相互的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dramatic work or performance in which actors present a story through dialogue and action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由演员通过对白和动作呈现故事的戏剧作品或演出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol teatrali jew rappreżentazzjoni tiegħu li fiha l-atturi jippreżentaw storja permezz tad-djalogu u l-azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戏剧；由演员扮演角色、通过对白和动作展开故事的作品或演出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Storja miktuba biex tiġi rrappreżentata minn atturi, jew il-preżentazzjoni tagħha quddiem udjenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A play is a dramatic work in which actors perform a story, usually in front of an audience.

collocations.en: to take part in a play

formal.mt: L-istudenti se jippreżentaw reċta dwar il-ħbiberija fis-sala tal-iskola nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The students will present a play about friendship in the school hall on Friday.
formal.zh: 学生们将于星期五在学校礼堂演出一部关于友谊的戏剧。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tiġi tara r-reċta tal-iskola għada? Pawlu: Iva! Oħti għandha parti fiha, u nixtieq naraha fuq il-palk.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to come and watch the school play tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes! My sister has a part in it, and I'd like to see her on stage.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你明天想来看学校的戏剧演出吗？保罗：想！我姐姐在里面演一个角色，我想看看她登台的样子。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi tara r-reċta tal-iskola għada?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi tara r-reċta tal-iskola għada?
messages.zh: 你明天想来看学校的戏剧演出吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come and watch the school play tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Oħti għandha parti fiha, u nixtieq naraha fuq il-palk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Oħti għandha parti fiha, u nixtieq naraha fuq il-palk.
messages.zh: 想！我姐姐在里面演一个角色，我想看看她登台的样子。
messages.en: Yes! My sister has a part in it, and I'd like to see her on stage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reċta 放进学校礼堂的画面：舞台上有人物、对白和情节。用 tara reċta 记住这里的 play 指戏剧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come or go back to a place where one was before.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 回到先前所在或曾经去过的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jmur jew jiġi f'post fejn kien qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 返回；回到原来或先前所在的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jerġa' jasal f'post li jkun telaq minnu jew fejn ikun kien qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone returns, they come or go back to a place where they were before.

formal.mt: Wara li temm l-istudji tiegħu barra minn Malta, Daniel reġa' lura biex jaħdem bħala għalliem.
formal.en: After completing his studies outside Malta, Daniel returned to work as a teacher.
formal.zh: 在马耳他以外完成学业后，丹尼尔回来当了教师。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk għadu barra? Luqa: Le, reġa' lura lbieraħ filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your brother still abroad? Luqa: No, he returned yesterday evening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥还在国外吗？卢卡：没有，他昨晚回来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk għadu barra?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk għadu barra?
messages.zh: 你哥哥还在国外吗？
messages.en: Is your brother still abroad?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, reġa' lura lbieraħ filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Le, reġa' lura lbieraħ filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 没有，他昨晚回来了。
messages.en: No, he returned yesterday evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语放进“离开家，再回家”的画面中记忆：reġa' lura d-dar 就是“他回到了家”；用完整场景记住返回的方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To find again something that was lost or could not be located.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重新找到先前遗失或一时找不到的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jsib xi ħaġa li kienet intilfet jew li ma setax isib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 找回；重新找到先前遗失或无法找到的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jerġa' jsib xi ħaġa li kien tilef jew li għal xi żmien ma kienx jaf fejn kienet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone retrieves a lost item, they find it again and are able to recover it.

formal.mt: Wara tfittxija fl-arkivju, l-impjegat reġa' sab id-dokument mitluf u poġġieh fil-fajl korrett.
formal.en: After searching the archive, the employee retrieved the lost document and placed it in the correct file.
formal.zh: 在档案库中查找后，那名职员找回了遗失的文件，并将它放入正确的档案夹。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark reġa' sab il-kartiera tiegħu? Nina: Iva, kienet taħt is-sufan!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark find his wallet again? Nina: Yes, it was under the sofa!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克找回钱包了吗？妮娜：找回了，就在沙发下面！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark reġa' sab il-kartiera tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Mark reġa' sab il-kartiera tiegħu?
messages.zh: 马克找回钱包了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark find his wallet again?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet taħt is-sufan!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet taħt is-sufan!
messages.zh: 找回了，就在沙发下面！
messages.en: Yes, it was under the sofa!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钱包先丢失、后来在沙发下重新出现，把 reġa' sab 连同“找回钱包”的情节一起记；重点是重新找到。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized military unit whose soldiers serve together under a command.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由士兵组成、在统一指挥下服役的军事编制单位，通常指团。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità militari organizzata magħmula minn suldati li jaqdu dmirijiethom taħt kmand wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 团；军队中由若干下属分队组成的军事编制单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unità organizzata fl-armata li tinkludi għadd ta' taqsimiet iżgħar taħt kmand wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A regiment is an organized military unit consisting of soldiers who serve together under a particular command.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 军团；作为有组织整体执行任务的军事部队或兵团。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Korp militari magħmul minn suldati organizzati biex jaqdu dmirijiet jew iwettqu ħidmiet flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A corps is an organized military body whose members serve together or carry out related duties.

formal.mt: Ir-reġiment ħa sehem f'eżerċizzju militari biex itejjeb il-koordinazzjoni bejn it-taqsimiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The regiment took part in a military exercise to improve coordination between its units.
formal.zh: 该团参加了一次军事演习，以改善下属各分队之间的协调。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk f'liema reġiment qiegħed? Pawlu: Qiegħed fl-istess reġiment bħall-kuġin tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which regiment is your brother in? Pawlu: He is in the same regiment as my cousin.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥在哪个团？保罗：他和我表哥在同一个团。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk f'liema reġiment qiegħed?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk f'liema reġiment qiegħed?
messages.zh: 你哥哥在哪个团？
messages.en: Which regiment is your brother in?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed fl-istess reġiment bħall-kuġin tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed fl-istess reġiment bħall-kuġin tiegħi.
messages.zh: 他和我表哥在同一个团。
messages.en: He is in the same regiment as my cousin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reġiment 与英语 regiment 对照记忆，再想象一面团旗下一队士兵；这个画面帮助记住它表示有组织的军事单位。

gloss_zh: 已登记的；已记录的；已订阅的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Officially entered on a register, recorded in a log, or signed up for a service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已列入登记册、已记入记录，或已登记订阅某项服务的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ddaħħal f'reġistru jew f'lista ta' rekords, jew li nkiteb biex jirċievi servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已登记的；姓名或相关资料已正式列入登记册的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ismu jew id-dettalji tiegħu ddaħħlu uffiċjalment f'reġistru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is registered has been officially entered on a list or register.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已记录的；事件、活动或资料已记入日志或记录系统的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ddaħħal bħala rekord f'ġurnal jew f'sistema li żżomm informazzjoni dwar avvenimenti jew attivitajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An event or activity that is logged has been entered in a written or electronic record.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已订阅的；已登记以接收某项服务、刊物或定期信息的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li nkiteb biex jirċievi servizz, pubblikazzjoni jew informazzjoni fuq bażi regolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person who is subscribed has signed up to receive a service, publication, or regular updates.

collocations.en: a payment logged in the system
a user subscribed to receive updates
collocations.zh: 已订阅更新信息的用户

formal.mt: Kull student reġistrat fil-kors għandu jirċievi konferma bil-miktub qabel l-ewwel lezzjoni.
formal.en: Every student registered for the course should receive written confirmation before the first lesson.
formal.zh: 每位已注册该课程的学生都应在第一堂课前收到书面确认。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Int reġistrat biex tirċievi l-aġġornamenti bl-email? Mark: Iva, u diġà wasal l-ewwel messaġġ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you subscribed to receive updates by email? Mark: Yes, and the first message has already arrived.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你订阅电子邮件更新了吗？马克：订阅了，第一封邮件已经收到了。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Int reġistrat biex tirċievi l-aġġornamenti bl-email?
messages.mt_standard: Int reġistrat biex tirċievi l-aġġornamenti bl-email?
messages.zh: 你订阅电子邮件更新了吗？
messages.en: Are you subscribed to receive updates by email?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u diġà wasal l-ewwel messaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u diġà wasal l-ewwel messaġġ.
messages.zh: 订阅了，第一封邮件已经收到了。
messages.en: Yes, and the first message has already arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张清单记住 reġistrat：学生名单对应“已登记”，系统日志对应“已记录”，邮件接收名单对应“已订阅”；根据所在清单判断意思。

gloss_zh: 登记；订阅登记；日志记录

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of officially entering details, signing up for a subscription, or recording events in a log.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式录入资料、办理订阅，或将事件写入日志的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jiddaħħlu dettalji uffiċjalment, isir abbonament, jew jitniżżlu avvenimenti f'reġistru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将个人、机构或事项的资料正式录入名册或系统的登记手续或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih id-dettalji ta' persuna, għaqda jew ħaġa jiddaħħlu uffiċjalment f'lista jew f'sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Registration is the process of officially entering someone's or something's details in a list or system.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 登记订阅某项刊物或服务，以便持续或定期获取其内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament li bih persuna tinkiteb biex tirċievi pubblikazzjoni jew servizz regolarment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A subscription is an arrangement to receive a publication or service regularly.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将事件、活动或系统操作按发生情况持续写入日志的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih avvenimenti, attivitajiet jew operazzjonijiet ta' sistema jitniżżlu b'mod regolari f'reġistru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Logging is the systematic recording of events, activities, or system operations for later reference.

formal.mt: Biex jipparteċipaw fil-kors, l-istudenti għandhom jimlew il-formola ta' reġistrazzjoni u jibagħtuha lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: To participate in the course, students must complete the registration form and send it to the office.
formal.zh: 学生须填写登记表并将其交给办公室，方可参加课程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għamilt ir-reġistrazzjoni għall-kors? Luka: Għadni le. Tista' tibgħatli l-link? Maja: Iva, nibgħathielek issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you registered for the course? Luka: Not yet. Can you send me the link? Maja: Yes, I'll send it to you now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你办好课程报名了吗？卢卡：还没有。你能把链接发给我吗？玛雅：可以，我现在发给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt ir-reġistrazzjoni għall-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt ir-reġistrazzjoni għall-kors?
messages.zh: 你办好课程报名了吗？
messages.en: Have you registered for the course?

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Tista' tibgħatli l-link?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Tista' tibgħatli l-link?
messages.zh: 还没有。你能把链接发给我吗？
messages.en: Not yet. Can you send me the link?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nibgħathielek issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nibgħathielek issa.
messages.zh: 可以，我现在发给你。
messages.en: Yes, I'll send it to you now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它联想成“把信息录进去”的动作：报名录入姓名，订阅录入需求，日志录入事件；再按语境区分三种意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A book, list, or document used to keep organized records of details, events, or attendance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于有条理地记录资料、事件或出勤情况的册簿、名单或表格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb, lista jew dokument li fih jinżammu b'mod organizzat dettalji, avvenimenti jew informazzjoni dwar l-attendenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按一定次序记载人员、事项或相关资料的登记册或名册。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktieb jew lista li fihom jitniżżlu b'ordni ismijiet, affarijiet jew dettalji oħra għal referenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A register is an organized record containing names, details, or other information for reference.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按时间顺序记录活动、事件或操作情况的日志簿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktieb li fih jitniżżlu attivitajiet, avvenimenti jew operazzjonijiet skont meta jkunu seħħew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A logbook is a book in which events or activities are recorded in chronological order.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于记录学生、员工或活动参加者是否到场的考勤表或出勤记录表。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Folja jew lista li fuqha jiġi mmarkat min hu preżenti u min hu assenti f'lezzjoni, fuq ix-xogħol jew f'attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An attendance sheet is a list used to record who is present or absent.

formal.mt: L-għalliem għandu jimmarka l-preżenza tal-istudenti fir-reġistru tal-attendenza fil-bidu ta' kull lezzjoni.
formal.en: The teacher must mark students' presence on the attendance sheet at the beginning of each lesson.
formal.zh: 教师须在每节课开始时，在考勤表上记录学生的出勤情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu r-reġistru tal-attendenza? Mark: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-pinna. Sara: Tajjeb, se nimmarka min ġie.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where's the attendance sheet? Mark: On the table, beside the pen. Sara: Great, I'll mark who's here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：考勤表在哪里？马克：在桌上，笔的旁边。萨拉：好，我来记一下谁到了。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu r-reġistru tal-attendenza?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu r-reġistru tal-attendenza?
messages.zh: 考勤表在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the attendance sheet?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-pinna.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-pinna.
messages.zh: 在桌上，笔的旁边。
messages.en: On the table, beside the pen.

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se nimmarka min ġie.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se nimmarka min ġie.
messages.zh: 好，我来记一下谁到了。
messages.en: Great, I'll mark who's here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中摆一本记录册：写会员姓名是名册，按时间记事情是日志簿，给到场者打勾就是考勤表；共同点都是承载记录的东西。

gloss_zh: 共享订单簿；共用订单登记册

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shared record in which orders are entered and consulted by several users.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供多名使用者共同登记和查阅订单的记录簿或登记表。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reġistru li jintuża minn diversi persuni biex fih jitniżżlu u jiġu kkonsultati l-ordnijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由多名使用者共用、用于集中登记和查阅订单的订单簿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktieb jew reġistru elettroniku komuni li fih diversi utenti jistgħu jniżżlu u jikkonsultaw l-ordnijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shared order book is a common record that several users use to enter and consult orders.

collocations.en: access to the shared order book
collocations.zh: 共享订单簿的访问权限

collocations.en: enter an order in the shared order book
collocations.zh: 在共享订单簿中录入订单

formal.mt: Kull ordni ġdida għandha tiddaħħal fir-reġistru komuni tal-ordnijiet sabiex il-membri kollha tat-tim ikunu jistgħu jaraw l-istess informazzjoni.
formal.en: Every new order must be entered in the shared order book so that all team members can see the same information.
formal.zh: 每笔新订单都须录入共享订单簿，以便所有团队成员查看同一份信息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Daħħalt l-ordni l-ġdida fir-reġistru komuni tal-ordnijiet? Pawlu: Iva, u żidt id-data tal-kunsinna wkoll. Nina: Tajjeb, se niċċekkja d-dettalji.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you entered the new order in the shared order book? Pawlu: Yes, and I added the delivery date too. Nina: Great, I'll check the details.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你把新订单录入共享订单簿了吗？保罗：录入了，也加上了交货日期。妮娜：好，我来核对一下详情。

messages.speaker: Nina (订单协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Daħħalt l-ordni l-ġdida fir-reġistru komuni tal-ordnijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Daħħalt l-ordni l-ġdida fir-reġistru komuni tal-ordnijiet?
messages.zh: 你把新订单录入共享订单簿了吗？
messages.en: Have you entered the new order in the shared order book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (销售同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u żidt id-data tal-kunsinna wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u żidt id-data tal-kunsinna wkoll.
messages.zh: 录入了，也加上了交货日期。
messages.en: Yes, and I added the delivery date too.

messages.speaker: Nina (订单协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se niċċekkja d-dettalji.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se niċċekkja d-dettalji.
messages.zh: 好，我来核对一下详情。
messages.en: Great, I'll check the details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记：reġistru 是记录册，komuni 提醒大家共用，tal-ordnijiet 指订单；想象同事围着同一本订单簿查单。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A defined region for which capacity calculations are carried out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为进行容量计算而划定、作为计算范围的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona definita li għaliha jsiru kalkoli tal-kapaċità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为容量计算范围的特定区域，其范围用于界定计算所涉及的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reġjun definit li jintuża bħala l-ambitu ġeografiku għall-kalkolu tal-kapaċità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A capacity calculation region is a defined area used as the scope for calculating capacity.

collocations.en: the boundaries of the capacity calculation region
the definition of the capacity calculation region
data for the capacity calculation region
collocations.zh: 用于容量计算区域的数据

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddefinixxi l-konfini tar-reġjun bil-kapaċità kalkolata u jelenka d-data użata fil-kalkolu.
formal.en: The report defines the boundaries of the capacity calculation region and lists the data used in the calculation.
formal.zh: 报告界定了容量计算区域的边界，并列出了计算所用的数据。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema żona hi r-reġjun bil-kapaċità kalkolata fuq din il-mappa? David: Dik immarkata bil-blu. Lara: Tajjeb, se nuża d-data għal dik iż-żona.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which area is the capacity calculation region on this map? David: The one marked in blue. Lara: Okay, I'll use the data for that area.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张地图上哪一块是容量计算区域？戴维：标成蓝色的那一块。拉拉：好，我会使用那个区域的数据。

messages.speaker: Lara (规划分析员)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema żona hi r-reġjun bil-kapaċità kalkolata fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Liema żona hi r-reġjun bil-kapaċità kalkolata fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 这张地图上哪一块是容量计算区域？
messages.en: Which area is the capacity calculation region on this map?

messages.speaker: David (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik immarkata bil-blu.
messages.mt_standard: Dik immarkata bil-blu.
messages.zh: 标成蓝色的那一块。
messages.en: The one marked in blue.

messages.speaker: Lara (规划分析员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se nuża d-data għal dik iż-żona.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se nuża d-data għal dik iż-żona.
messages.zh: 好，我会使用那个区域的数据。
messages.en: Okay, I'll use the data for that area.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用地图画面记整条术语：先圈出 reġjun 所指的区域，再在圈内写上“容量计算”；把区域、容量、计算三个概念连成一幅图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A region within which outages are coordinated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为协调设施或服务的停运安排而划定的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reġjun li fih jiġu kkoordinati l-perjodi meta faċilitajiet jew servizzi ma jkunux disponibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于协调设施或服务停运安排的区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona li fiha jiġu kkoordinati l-perjodi ta' indisponibilità ta' faċilitajiet jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An outage coordination region is an area within which arrangements for outages are coordinated.

collocations.en: the boundaries of the outage coordination region
a plan for the outage coordination region

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-konfini tar-reġjun ta' koordinazzjoni tal-indisponibilità u l-arranġamenti għall-koordinazzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes the boundaries of the outage coordination region and the coordination arrangements.
formal.zh: 报告说明了停运协调区域的边界以及协调安排。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din iż-żona tinsab fir-reġjun ta' koordinazzjoni tal-indisponibilità? Pawlu: Iva, ara l-konfini fuq din il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is this area within the outage coordination region? Pawlu: Yes, look at the boundaries on this map.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这一带属于停运协调区域吗？保罗：是的，看这张地图上的边界。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din iż-żona tinsab fir-reġjun ta' koordinazzjoni tal-indisponibilità?
messages.mt_standard: Din iż-żona tinsab fir-reġjun ta' koordinazzjoni tal-indisponibilità?
messages.zh: 这一带属于停运协调区域吗？
messages.en: Is this area within the outage coordination region?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara l-konfini fuq din il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara l-konfini fuq din il-mappa.
messages.zh: 是的，看这张地图上的边界。
messages.en: Yes, look at the boundaries on this map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条短语分成“区域—协调—不可用状态”三块，想象地图上划出一片需要统一协调停运的区域。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Opposition to something, or the ability of a person, material, or system to withstand an influence or force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事物的抵抗或反对，也指人、材料或系统承受外来影响或阻碍其作用的能力；在电学中指电阻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oppożizzjoni għal xi ħaġa, jew il-ħila ta' persuna, materjal jew sistema li tiflaħ għal forza jew influwenza; fl-elettriku, l-oppożizzjoni għall-mogħdija tal-kurrent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抵抗、反对或抵制；也指承受外力或阻碍某种作用的能力，以及电流通过时遇到的电阻。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oppożizzjoni għal azzjoni jew bidla, jew il-kapaċità li wieħed jiflaħ għal forza jew influwenza; tista' wkoll tkun l-oppożizzjoni li materjal joffri għall-mogħdija tal-kurrent elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Resistance is opposition to something or the capacity to withstand its effects, including the opposition a material offers to electric current.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li kien hemm reżistenza għall-bidla fost xi impjegati.
formal.en: The report shows that there was resistance to change among some employees.
formal.zh: 报告显示，部分员工对这项改变存在抵触。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm daqshekk reżistenza għall-bidla fl-iskeda? Mark: Għax ħafna nies diġà għamlu l-pjanijiet tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there so much resistance to the change in the schedule? Mark: Because many people have already made their plans.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么大家这么抵触调整时间表？马克：因为很多人已经安排好自己的计划了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk reżistenza għall-bidla fl-iskeda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk reżistenza għall-bidla fl-iskeda?
messages.zh: 为什么大家这么抵触调整时间表？
messages.en: Why is there so much resistance to the change in the schedule?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħafna nies diġà għamlu l-pjanijiet tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħafna nies diġà għamlu l-pjanijiet tagħhom.
messages.zh: 因为很多人已经安排好自己的计划了。
messages.en: Because many people have already made their plans.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“挡住外来作用”串起 reżistenza：人会抵制改变，材料会抵抗外力，电路中则有电阻。

gloss_zh: 精炼；提纯；改进；使更精细

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove impurities from a substance or improve something by making careful, precise changes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去除物质中的杂质，使其更纯；也指通过细致调整，使方法、文字或其他事物更精确、更完善。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-impuritajiet minn sustanza biex jagħmilha aktar pura, jew tejjeb xi ħaġa b'bidliet bir-reqqa biex jagħmilha aktar preċiża jew aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精炼或提纯某种物质；也指对事物作细致改进，使其更加精确或完善。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għamel sustanza aktar pura billi neħħa l-impuritajiet, jew tejjeb xogħol, metodu jew idea permezz ta' aġġustamenti bir-reqqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you refine something, you remove its impurities or improve its quality by making careful adjustments.

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur rfina l-metodu wara li analizza r-riżultati tal-ewwel prova.
formal.en: The researcher refined the method after analysing the results of the first trial.
formal.zh: 研究人员分析第一次试验的结果后，对方法作了细致改进。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark rfina t-test qabel bagħtu? Sara: Iva, biddel ftit kliem u għamlu aktar ċar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark refine the text before sending it? Sara: Yes, he changed a few words and made it clearer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克发出那段文字前润色过了吗？萨拉：润色过，他改了几个词，让意思更清楚了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark rfina t-test qabel bagħtu?
messages.mt_standard: Mark rfina t-test qabel bagħtu?
messages.zh: 马克发出那段文字前润色过了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark refine the text before sending it?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biddel ftit kliem u għamlu aktar ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biddel ftit kliem u għamlu aktar ċar.
messages.zh: 润色过，他改了几个词，让意思更清楚了。
messages.en: Yes, he changed a few words and made it clearer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 rfina 时想象两幅图：把油中的杂质除掉，把文章中的表达磨细；共同点都是经过加工变得更精。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wanting more food, money, or possessions than one needs or deserves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人总想获得超过自身需要或应得份额的食物、金钱或财物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jrid aktar ikel, flus jew ġid milli għandu bżonn jew milli jistħoqqlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪婪的，指过分渴望占有食物、金钱或财物的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu xewqa eċċessiva għall-ikel, għall-flus jew għall-ġid u dejjem irid aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is greedy wants more food, money, or possessions than they need or deserve.

formal.mt: Il-karattru rgħab fir-rakkont jipprova jieħu l-ġid kollu għalih.
formal.en: The greedy character in the story tries to take all the wealth for himself.
formal.zh: 故事中那个贪婪的人物试图将所有财富据为己有。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tgħid li Pawlu rgħab? Mark: Għax irid il-kejk kollu għalih u ma jrid jaqsam ma' ħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you saying that Pawlu is greedy? Mark: Because he wants the whole cake for himself and does not want to share it with anyone.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么说保罗贪心？马克：因为他想独占整个蛋糕，不愿意分给任何人。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li Pawlu rgħab?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li Pawlu rgħab?
messages.zh: 你为什么说保罗贪心？
messages.en: Why are you saying that Pawlu is greedy?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irid il-kejk kollu għalih u ma jrid jaqsam ma' ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irid il-kejk kollu għalih u ma jrid jaqsam ma' ħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他想独占整个蛋糕，不愿意分给任何人。
messages.en: Because he wants the whole cake for himself and does not want to share it with anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rgħab 和独占整个蛋糕的画面联系起来：已经够吃还想全部拿走，就是贪婪。

gloss_zh: 康复；恢复正常生活或活动能力的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of helping someone recover abilities and return to everyday life after illness, injury, or other difficulties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过治疗、训练或支持，帮助一个人在疾病、受伤或其他困难之后恢复能力、重新适应日常生活的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' għajnuna lil persuna biex terġa' tikseb il-kapaċitajiet tagħha u terġa' tadatta għall-ħajja ta' kuljum wara marda, korriment jew diffikultajiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 康复或复健，指通过治疗、训练和支持恢复能力、重新适应日常生活的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess ta' kura, taħriġ u appoġġ li jgħin lil persuna tirkupra l-kapaċitajiet tagħha u terġa' tieħu sehem fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rehabilitation is the process of helping someone regain abilities and resume everyday life after illness, injury, or other difficulties.

formal.mt: Il-programm ta' riabilitazzjoni jinkludi eżerċizzji biex il-pazjent jerġa' jikseb is-saħħa u l-ħila li jimxi.
formal.en: The rehabilitation programme includes exercises to help the patient regain strength and the ability to walk.
formal.zh: 这项康复计划包含帮助患者恢复力量和行走能力的练习。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejra r-riabilitazzjoni tiegħek? Toni: Sejra tajjeb. Issa nista' nimxi ftit aktar kuljum.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is your rehabilitation going? Toni: It is going well. I can now walk a little farther each day.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的康复进展怎么样？托尼：进展不错。我现在每天都能多走一点路。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejra r-riabilitazzjoni tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejra r-riabilitazzjoni tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的康复进展怎么样？
messages.en: How is your rehabilitation going?

messages.speaker: Toni (康复中的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejra tajjeb. Issa nista' nimxi ftit aktar kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Sejra tajjeb. Issa nista' nimxi ftit aktar kuljum.
messages.zh: 进展不错。我现在每天都能多走一点路。
messages.en: It is going well. I can now walk a little farther each day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riabilitazzjoni 放进“康复计划”的情境记忆：每天练习一点，逐渐恢复能力和日常生活。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese rice dish cooked in an oven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在烤箱中烤制的马耳他米饭菜肴，可称为烤饭或焗饭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Platt Malti tar-ross li jissajjar fil-forn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的；在此用于说明这道烤箱焗饭的菜肴归属。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Malta; hawnhekk jiddeskrivi l-platt tar-ross imsajjar fil-forn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Maltese describes something associated with Malta, here the rice dish cooked in an oven.

formal.mt: Fil-menu, il-platt imsejjaħ bl-Ingliż 'Rice in the oven' huwa deskritt bħala ross fil-forn Malti.
formal.en: On the menu, the dish called 'Rice in the oven' in English is described as Maltese oven-baked rice.
formal.zh: 菜单上，英文名为“Rice in the oven”的菜肴被描述为马耳他烤饭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nieklu llum? Pawlu: Ross fil-forn. Fuq il-menu bl-Ingliż hemm miktub 'Rice in the oven'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are we eating today? Paul: Oven-baked rice. The English menu calls it 'Rice in the oven'.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们今天吃什么？保罗：烤饭。英文菜单上写的是“Rice in the oven”。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nieklu llum?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nieklu llum?
messages.zh: 我们今天吃什么？
messages.en: What are we eating today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ross fil-forn. Fuq il-menu bl-Ingliż hemm miktub 'Rice in the oven'.
messages.mt_standard: Ross fil-forn. Fuq il-menu bl-Ingliż hemm miktub 'Rice in the oven'.
messages.zh: 烤饭。英文菜单上写的是“Rice in the oven”。
messages.en: Oven-baked rice. The English menu calls it 'Rice in the oven'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“米饭放进烤箱”的画面记住英文名称，再配对马耳他语 ross fil-forn，整体记成“烤饭”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something ridiculous is so unreasonable or silly that it seems absurd or laughable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容事物极不合理或十分愚蠢，以至于显得荒谬、可笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa tant bla sens jew iblah li jidher assurd jew iqanqal id-daħk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荒谬的；因不合理、愚蠢或不合情理而显得可笑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher assurd jew tad-daħk minħabba li huwa bla sens jew iblah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe something as ridiculous, you mean that it is very silly or unreasonable.

formal.mt: L-awtur iqis dan l-argument bħala ridikolu għax jinjora l-fatti ewlenin.
formal.en: The author considers this argument ridiculous because it ignores the main facts.
formal.zh: 作者认为这一论点荒谬，因为它忽略了主要事实。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaxar ewro għal flixkun ilma? Dan prezz ridikolu! Nina: Ejja nixtru minn ħanut ieħor.
colloquial.en: Mark: Ten euros for a bottle of water? That's a ridiculous price! Nina: Let's buy it from another shop.
colloquial.zh: 马克：一瓶水要十欧元？这个价格太离谱了！妮娜：我们去另一家店买吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxar ewro għal flixkun ilma? Dan prezz ridikolu!
messages.mt_standard: Għaxar ewro għal flixkun ilma? Dan prezz ridikolu!
messages.zh: 一瓶水要十欧元？这个价格太离谱了！
messages.en: Ten euros for a bottle of water? That's a ridiculous price!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nixtru minn ħanut ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nixtru minn ħanut ieħor.
messages.zh: 我们去另一家店买吧。
messages.en: Let's buy it from another shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ridikolu 与英语 ridiculous 并排联想，再想象一瓶水标出离谱高价，记住 prezz ridikolu。

gloss_zh: 缩减的；减少的（名词用法所指未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term conveying that something has been made smaller or less, with its specific noun referent left unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达某物已经缩小或减少的词；其具体名词用法所指的事物尚未明确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terminu li jesprimi li xi ħaġa saret iżgħar jew inqas, mingħajr ma jkun speċifikat għal xiex jirreferi bħala nom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已缩减的；已减少的。此处保留名词标注，但具体所指未明确。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li sar iżgħar jew inqas minn qabel; it-tifsira speċifika tiegħu bħala nom mhijiex ċara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is reduced, it has been made smaller in size, amount, or degree.

collocations.en: the use of 'ridot' as a noun

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'ridot' tesprimi l-idea li xi ħaġa saret iżgħar jew inqas, iżda l-użu tagħha bħala nom jeħtieġ kuntest aktar ċar.
formal.en: The word 'ridot' conveys the idea that something has become smaller or less, but its use as a noun requires clearer context.
formal.zh: “ridot”表达某物已经缩小或减少的意思，但它作为名词的用法需要更明确的语境。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'ridot'? Marija: Aħseb f'xi ħaġa li saret iżgħar jew inqas. Biex tifhem l-użu bħala nom, trid aktar kuntest.
colloquial.en: Lina: How can I remember the meaning of 'ridot'? Maria: Think of something that has become smaller or less. To understand its use as a noun, you need more context.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我怎样记住“ridot”的意思？玛丽亚：想一想某样东西变小或减少了。要理解它作为名词的用法，还需要更多语境。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'ridot'?
messages.mt_standard: Kif niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'ridot'?
messages.zh: 我怎样记住“ridot”的意思？
messages.en: How can I remember the meaning of 'ridot'?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb f'xi ħaġa li saret iżgħar jew inqas. Biex tifhem l-użu bħala nom, trid aktar kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb f'xi ħaġa li saret iżgħar jew inqas. Biex tifhem l-użu bħala nom, trid aktar kuntest.
messages.zh: 想一想某样东西变小或减少了。要理解它作为名词的用法，还需要更多语境。
messages.en: Think of something that has become smaller or less. To understand its use as a noun, you need more context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ridot 暂时配上“数量条变短”的画面，记住“缩减、减少”的核心意思；具体名词所指需结合语境确认。

gloss_zh: 战时防御据点；设防瞭望哨

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fortified wartime position used for observation and defence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 战时用于观察周围情况并进行防御的小型设防据点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post żgħir imsaħħaħ li jintuża fi żmien il-gwerra biex jiġu osservati l-inħawi u ssir id-difiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 战时用于瞭望和防御的小型设防据点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post żgħir imsaħħaħ fejn is-suldati jistgħu josservaw l-inħawi u jiddefendu ruħhom fi żmien il-gwerra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A redoubt is a small fortified position where soldiers can watch the surrounding area and defend themselves during wartime.

collocations.zh: 山丘上的设防瞭望据点

formal.mt: Fi żmien il-gwerra, is-suldati kienu josservaw il-kosta minn dan ir-ridott.
formal.en: During the war, soldiers watched the coast from this redoubt.
formal.zh: 战争期间，士兵从这个设防瞭望据点观察海岸。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-bini żgħir fuq l-għolja? Pawlu: Dak ridott; fi żmien il-gwerra, is-suldati kienu josservaw il-kosta minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that little building on the hill? Pawlu: That's a redoubt; during the war, soldiers watched the coast from there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：山丘上那座小建筑是什么？保罗：那是设防瞭望据点；战争期间，士兵从那里观察海岸。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-bini żgħir fuq l-għolja?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-bini żgħir fuq l-għolja?
messages.zh: 山丘上那座小建筑是什么？
messages.en: What's that little building on the hill?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ridott; fi żmien il-gwerra, is-suldati kienu josservaw il-kosta minn hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ridott; fi żmien il-gwerra, is-suldati kienu josservaw il-kosta minn hemm.
messages.zh: 那是设防瞭望据点；战争期间，士兵从那里观察海岸。
messages.en: That's a redoubt; during the war, soldiers watched the coast from there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ridott 放进山丘上的小堡垒画面：士兵既能瞭望海岸，也能据守防御，借此记住它的战时用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The export of goods that were previously imported into a country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把先前进口到某个国家的货物再次出口的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih oġġetti li jkunu ġew importati f'pajjiż jintbagħtu mill-ġdid lejn pajjiż ieħor għall-esportazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将已经进口的货物再次出口的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li jiġu esportati mill-ġdid oġġetti li qabel kienu ġew importati fil-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Re-export is the act of sending goods out of a country after they have previously been imported into it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对先前进口货物进行再出口的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess tal-esportazzjoni mill-ġdid ta' merkanzija li tkun daħlet fil-pajjiż permezz tal-importazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Re-exportation is the process by which previously imported goods are exported from the country again.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-riesportazzjoni ta' merkanzija li kienet ġiet importata aktar kmieni fl-istess sena.
formal.en: The report describes the re-export of goods that had been imported earlier in the same year.
formal.zh: 该报告介绍了对同年早些时候进口的货物进行再出口的情况。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dawn il-kaxxi se jinbiegħu hawn? Rita: Le, huma għar-riesportazzjoni; waslu minn barra u se nibagħtuhom lejn pajjiż ieħor.
colloquial.en: Mark: Will these boxes be sold here? Rita: No, they're for re-export; they arrived from abroad and we'll send them to another country.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些箱子里的货会在这里出售吗？丽塔：不会，这是要再出口的；货从国外运来，我们会把它们发往另一个国家。

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-kaxxi se jinbiegħu hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-kaxxi se jinbiegħu hawn?
messages.zh: 这些箱子里的货会在这里出售吗？
messages.en: Will these boxes be sold here?

messages.speaker: Rita (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huma għar-riesportazzjoni; waslu minn barra u se nibagħtuhom lejn pajjiż ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huma għar-riesportazzjoni; waslu minn barra u se nibagħtuhom lejn pajjiż ieħor.
messages.zh: 不会，这是要再出口的；货从国外运来，我们会把它们发往另一个国家。
messages.en: No, they're for re-export; they arrived from abroad and we'll send them to another country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用货物流向记 riesportazzjoni：先进口进入本国，再出口离开本国；把两个连续箭头连起来，就能记住再出口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A quality of something that you notice through your nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过鼻子闻到的气味，可以令人愉快，也可以令人不快。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li tħoss bl-imnieħer meta xxomm xi ħaġa, u li jista' jkun pjaċevoli jew spjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某种东西散发出来、能够被鼻子闻到的气味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni li tinħass bl-imnieħer meta wieħed ixomm xi ħaġa, bħal ikel, fjuri jew duħħan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The smell of something is the quality that you notice when you breathe its scent in through your nose.

formal.mt: Fil-kċina nħasset rieħa qawwija ta' ħobż frisk.
formal.en: There was a strong smell of fresh bread in the kitchen.
formal.zh: 厨房里弥漫着浓郁的新鲜面包香味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'rieħa tajba! Qed taħmi xi ħaġa? Nina: Iva, għadni kemm ħriġt il-ħobż mill-forn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What a lovely smell! Are you baking something? Nina: Yes, I've just taken the bread out of the oven.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：好香啊！你在烤什么吗？妮娜：是啊，我刚把面包从烤箱里拿出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'rieħa tajba! Qed taħmi xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: X'rieħa tajba! Qed taħmi xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: 好香啊！你在烤什么吗？
messages.en: What a lovely smell! Are you baking something?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kemm ħriġt il-ħobż mill-forn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kemm ħriġt il-ħobż mill-forn.
messages.zh: 是啊，我刚把面包从烤箱里拿出来。
messages.en: Yes, I've just taken the bread out of the oven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 rieħa 时想象先闻到面包香、再看到面包：鼻子先发现的就是气味；这个词也能指难闻的味道。

gloss_zh: 被转介的；被提交处理的；被提及的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone or something directed to another person or body for attention, or mentioned in a particular context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或事项已被转交给他人或机构处理，也可形容在某个语境中已被提及的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna jew każ li jkun intbagħat għand persuna jew entità oħra biex jingħata attenzjoni, jew xi ħaġa li tkun issemmiet f'kuntest partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被转介给某人、提交给某机构处理的；或在某个语境中被提及的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun intbagħat għand persuna jew entità oħra għall-attenzjoni jew għall-eżami, jew li jkun issemma f'diskors jew f'kitba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something described as referred has been directed elsewhere for attention or has been mentioned in a particular context.

collocations.en: a patient referred to a specialist
collocations.zh: 被转介给专科医生的患者

collocations.en: a case referred to the committee
collocations.zh: 提交委员会处理的个案

formal.mt: Il-każ riferut lill-kumitat se jiġi eżaminat fil-laqgħa li jmiss.
formal.en: The case referred to the committee will be examined at the next meeting.
formal.zh: 提交委员会处理的个案将在下次会议上审议。

colloquial.mt: Daniel: Jien il-pazjent riferut għand it-tabib Borg. Fejn għandi nistenna? Sara: Oqgħod bilqiegħda hawn, jekk jogħġbok. It-tabib se jsejjaħlek.
