colloquial.en: Daniel: I'm the patient referred to Dr Borg. Where should I wait? Sara: Please take a seat here. The doctor will call you.
colloquial.zh: 丹尼尔：我是被转介给博格医生的患者。我应该在哪里等？萨拉：请在这里坐。医生会叫您的。

messages.speaker: Daniel (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien il-pazjent riferut għand it-tabib Borg. Fejn għandi nistenna?
messages.mt_standard: Jien il-pazjent riferut għand it-tabib Borg. Fejn għandi nistenna?
messages.zh: 我是被转介给博格医生的患者。我应该在哪里等？
messages.en: I'm the patient referred to Dr Borg. Where should I wait?

messages.speaker: Sara (诊所接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod bilqiegħda hawn, jekk jogħġbok. It-tabib se jsejjaħlek.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod bilqiegħda hawn, jekk jogħġbok. It-tabib se jsejjaħlek.
messages.zh: 请在这里坐。医生会叫您的。
messages.en: Please take a seat here. The doctor will call you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riferut 想成名词旁的状态标签：患者已被转介、个案已被提交；遇到文章语境时，再联想其中被提及的对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not accepted or approved after being considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过考虑后未被接受或批准的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx ġie aċċettat jew approvat wara li jkun ġie kkunsidrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遭到拒绝的；未获接受或批准的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie miċħud u ma jkunx ġie aċċettat jew approvat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is refused has not been accepted or approved by the person considering it.

formal.mt: L-appell ġie rifjutat għax id-dokumenti meħtieġa ma ġewx ippreżentati fil-ħin.
formal.en: The appeal was rejected because the required documents were not submitted on time.
formal.zh: 由于未按时提交所需文件，该申诉被驳回。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-permess tiegħi ġie rifjutat. Lara: Qalulek għaliex? Mark: Iva, kien hemm dokument nieqes.
colloquial.en: Mark: My permit was refused. Lara: Did they tell you why? Mark: Yes, a document was missing.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我的许可申请被拒绝了。Lara：他们告诉你原因了吗？Mark：说了，缺了一份文件。

messages.speaker: Mark (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-permess tiegħi ġie rifjutat.
messages.mt_standard: Il-permess tiegħi ġie rifjutat.
messages.zh: 我的许可申请被拒绝了。
messages.en: My permit was refused.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalulek għaliex?
messages.mt_standard: Qalulek għaliex?
messages.zh: 他们告诉你原因了吗？
messages.en: Did they tell you why?

messages.speaker: Mark (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien hemm dokument nieqes.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien hemm dokument nieqes.
messages.zh: 说了，缺了一份文件。
messages.en: Yes, a document was missing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rifjutat 和申请表上“未获批准”的印章一起记，看到它就想到事情遭到拒绝的结果。

gloss_zh: 映像；反射动作；被反射的

teaching_sense.en_definition: An image seen in a mirror, water, or another reflecting surface, or an automatic bodily response to a stimulus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 镜子、水面等反射表面中显现的映像；也指身体受到刺激时自动产生的反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xbieha li tidher f'mera, fl-ilma jew fuq wiċċ ieħor li jirrifletti, jew reazzjoni awtomatika tal-ġisem għal stimolu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由镜子、水面等表面反射而形成的映像。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xbieha ta' persuna jew oġġett li tidher f'mera, fl-ilma jew fuq wiċċ ieħor li jirrifletti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reflection is an image of a person or object that you see in a mirror or another reflecting surface.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体受到刺激后不经有意识决定而产生的自动反应；反射动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reazzjoni awtomatika tal-ġisem għal stimolu, mingħajr deċiżjoni konxja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reflex is an automatic physical response that occurs without a conscious decision.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被表面反射回来的，尤指光。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie mibgħut lura jew f'direzzjoni oħra minn wiċċ, speċjalment meta jirreferi għad-dawl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Reflected light has struck a surface and been sent back or in another direction.

formal.mt: Ir-rifless tas-siġar kien jidher ċar fuq wiċċ il-lag meta l-ilma kien kalm.
formal.en: The reflection of the trees was clearly visible on the surface of the lake when the water was calm.
formal.zh: 湖水平静时，树木的倒影清晰地映在湖面上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara r-rifless tiegħek fl-ilma! Pawlu: Iva, jidher ċar ħafna. Maja: Ħa nieħu ritratt qabel jiċċaqlaq l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at your reflection in the water! Pawlu: Yes, it looks very clear. Maja: Let me take a photo before the water moves.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看你在水里的倒影！Pawlu：是啊，看得特别清楚。Maja：趁水面还没动，我拍张照片。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara r-rifless tiegħek fl-ilma!
messages.mt_standard: Ara r-rifless tiegħek fl-ilma!
messages.zh: 看你在水里的倒影！
messages.en: Look at your reflection in the water!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidher ċar ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidher ċar ħafna.
messages.zh: 是啊，看得特别清楚。
messages.en: Yes, it looks very clear.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa nieħu ritratt qabel jiċċaqlaq l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Ħa nieħu ritratt qabel jiċċaqlaq l-ilma.
messages.zh: 趁水面还没动，我拍张照片。
messages.en: Let me take a photo before the water moves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅画记 rifless：镜中出现映像、身体自动反应、光线碰到表面后反射；分别对应两个名词义和一个形容词义。

gloss_zh: 反身动词：动作作用于主语自身的动词

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb expressing an action that the subject performs on itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示主语对自身实施某种动作的动词，即反身动词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li jesprimi azzjoni li s-suġġett jagħmel fuqu nnifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反身动词，表示动作的实施者同时也是该动作的承受者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Verb li fih min jagħmel l-azzjoni jkun ukoll min jirċeviha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reflexive verb describes an action whose subject and recipient are the same person or thing.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, identifika l-verb riflessiv u spjega kif l-azzjoni tirreferi lura għas-suġġett.
formal.en: In this exercise, identify the reflexive verb and explain how the action refers back to the subject.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，找出反身动词，并解释该动作如何回指主语自身。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser verb riflessiv? Mark: Ifisser li s-suġġett jagħmel l-azzjoni fuqu nnifsu. Sara: Mela min jagħmel l-azzjoni jkun ukoll min jirċeviha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does a reflexive verb mean? Mark: It means that the subject performs the action on itself. Sara: So the person doing the action also receives it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：反身动词是什么意思？Mark：意思是主语把动作施加在自己身上。Sara：也就是说，做这个动作的人同时也是承受动作的人。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser verb riflessiv?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser verb riflessiv?
messages.zh: 反身动词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a reflexive verb mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li s-suġġett jagħmel l-azzjoni fuqu nnifsu.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li s-suġġett jagħmel l-azzjoni fuqu nnifsu.
messages.zh: 意思是主语把动作施加在自己身上。
messages.en: It means that the subject performs the action on itself.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela min jagħmel l-azzjoni jkun ukoll min jirċeviha.
messages.mt_standard: Mela min jagħmel l-azzjoni jkun ukoll min jirċeviha.
messages.zh: 也就是说，做这个动作的人同时也是承受动作的人。
messages.en: So the person doing the action also receives it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 verb riflessiv 时画一支从主语出发又指回主语的箭头，记住动作由自己发出，也落在自己身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful thought about an experience, idea, or decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某段经历、某个想法或某项决定进行的认真思考或反思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsieb bir-reqqa dwar esperjenza, idea jew deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对事情、经历或想法进行的审慎思考，尤指为加深理解或作出决定而进行的反思。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess ta' ħsieb bir-reqqa dwar xi ħaġa, speċjalment biex wieħed jifhimha aħjar jew jasal għal deċiżjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Reflection is careful thought about something, especially when you are trying to understand an experience or make a decision.

formal.mt: Wara riflessjoni bir-reqqa dwar ir-riżultati, il-kumitat iddeċieda li jirrevedi l-pjan.
formal.en: After careful reflection on the results, the committee decided to revise the plan.
formal.zh: 经过对结果的审慎思考，委员会决定修改计划。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se taċċetta l-offerta? Pawlu: Għandi bżonn ftit ħin għal riflessjoni qabel inwieġeb. Lara: Sewwa, aħseb sew qabel tiddeċiedi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you going to accept the offer? Pawlu: I need a little time for reflection before I reply. Lara: All right, think it through before you decide.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你会接受这个提议吗？Pawlu：回复之前，我需要一点时间想一想。Lara：好，决定之前仔细考虑一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se taċċetta l-offerta?
messages.mt_standard: Se taċċetta l-offerta?
messages.zh: 你会接受这个提议吗？
messages.en: Are you going to accept the offer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn ftit ħin għal riflessjoni qabel inwieġeb.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn ftit ħin għal riflessjoni qabel inwieġeb.
messages.zh: 回复之前，我需要一点时间想一想。
messages.en: I need a little time for reflection before I reply.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, aħseb sew qabel tiddeċiedi.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, aħseb sew qabel tiddeċiedi.
messages.zh: 好，决定之前仔细考虑一下。
messages.en: All right, think it through before you decide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riflessjoni 放进“先停一下，再认真想”的场景中记忆：回顾经历、权衡选择，都需要一段反思时间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change or set of changes intended to improve a system, institution, or practice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为改善制度、机构或做事方式而进行的一项或一系列改变。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla jew sensiela ta' bidliet maħsuba biex itejbu sistema, istituzzjoni jew mod ta' kif isiru l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旨在改善现有制度、机构或做法的改革。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bidla f'sistema, istituzzjoni jew prattika li ssir bil-għan li titjieb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reform is a change introduced to improve an existing system, institution, or practice.

formal.mt: Ir-riforma tas-sistema edukattiva għandha l-għan li ttejjeb l-aċċess għat-tagħlim.
formal.en: The reform of the education system aims to improve access to learning.
formal.zh: 教育制度改革旨在改善人们接受教育的机会。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed ibiddlu s-sistema tal-eżamijiet? Pawlu: Qed jagħmlu riforma biex l-eżamijiet ikunu aktar ġusti.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are they changing the examination system? Pawlu: They are introducing a reform to make the examinations fairer.
colloquial.zh: Marija：他们为什么要改变考试制度？Pawlu：他们正在进行改革，让考试更加公平。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed ibiddlu s-sistema tal-eżamijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed ibiddlu s-sistema tal-eżamijiet?
messages.zh: 他们为什么要改变考试制度？
messages.en: Why are they changing the examination system?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jagħmlu riforma biex l-eżamijiet ikunu aktar ġusti.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jagħmlu riforma biex l-eżamijiet ikunu aktar ġusti.
messages.zh: 他们正在进行改革，让考试更加公平。
messages.en: They are introducing a reform to make the examinations fairer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riforma 放进“改革考试制度，让规则更公平”的场景中记忆，重点联想有目的的制度改善。

gloss_zh: 茶点；供人享用的饮料和小食

teaching_sense.en_definition: Drinks and small amounts of food offered during a meeting, event, or break.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在会议、活动或休息期间供应的饮料和少量食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xorb u ikel ħafif li jiġu offruti waqt laqgħa, attività jew pawża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供与会者、来宾等享用的饮料和小食；茶点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xorb u ikel ħafif li jiġu servuti lill-parteċipanti jew lill-mistednin waqt attività jew pawża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Refreshments are drinks and small amounts of food provided for people during an event or break.

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, se jiġu offruti rifreskamenti lill-parteċipanti fis-sala ta' ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: After the meeting, refreshments will be offered to participants in the hall beside the entrance.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，将在入口旁的大厅向与会者供应茶点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm xi ħaġa x'nieklu waqt il-pawża? Mark: Iva, hemm rifreskamenti fuq il-mejda: ilma, meraq u gallettini.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there anything to eat during the break? Mark: Yes, there are refreshments on the table: water, juice, and biscuits.
colloquial.zh: Sara：休息的时候有什么可以吃的吗？Mark：有，桌上有茶点：水、果汁和饼干。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi ħaġa x'nieklu waqt il-pawża?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi ħaġa x'nieklu waqt il-pawża?
messages.zh: 休息的时候有什么可以吃的吗？
messages.en: Is there anything to eat during the break?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm rifreskamenti fuq il-mejda: ilma, meraq u gallettini.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm rifreskamenti fuq il-mejda: ilma, meraq u gallettini.
messages.zh: 有，桌上有茶点：水、果汁和饼干。
messages.en: Yes, there are refreshments on the table: water, juice, and biscuits.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 rifreskamenti，就想象会议休息时桌上的水、果汁和饼干，把它作为“茶点”的整体场景来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A remark or action that insults someone or shows a serious lack of respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 侮辱他人或表现出严重不尊重的言语或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma jew azzjoni li toffendi lil xi ħadd jew turi nuqqas serju ta' rispett lejh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人感到受辱或受到严重不尊重的言语或行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kumment jew għemil offensiv li juri nuqqas ta' rispett lejn persuna jew lejn id-dinjità tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An affront is a remark or action that someone regards as insulting or seriously disrespectful.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat qies il-kumment bħala rifront għad-dinjità tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The committee regarded the comment as an affront to the participants' dignity.
formal.zh: 委员会认为这番评论冒犯了参与者的尊严。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ħadtha daqshekk bi kbira? Toni: Għax dak li qal kien rifront personali, u weġġagħni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you take it so badly? Toni: Because what he said was a personal affront, and it hurt me.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么这么介意？Toni：因为他说的话是在侮辱我，让我很受伤。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħadtha daqshekk bi kbira?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħadtha daqshekk bi kbira?
messages.zh: 你为什么这么介意？
messages.en: Why did you take it so badly?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dak li qal kien rifront personali, u weġġagħni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dak li qal kien rifront personali, u weġġagħni.
messages.zh: 因为他说的话是在侮辱我，让我很受伤。
messages.en: Because what he said was a personal affront, and it hurt me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“那句话伤了我的尊严”来记 rifront；它强调令人受辱的冒犯，可以指言语，也可以指行为。

gloss_zh: 出口退款；与出口有关的退还款项

teaching_sense.en_definition: A repayment of money connected with the export of goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与货物出口有关的一笔退还款项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas lura ta' flus marbut mal-esportazzjoni ta' oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因货物出口而涉及的退款或退还款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus li titħallas lura b'rabta mal-esportazzjoni ta' oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An export refund is an amount of money paid back in connection with goods being exported.

collocations.en: an application for an export refund

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija inkludiet kopja tat-talba għal rifużjoni għall-esportazzjoni fir-rapport tagħha.
formal.en: The company included a copy of the application for an export refund in its report.
formal.zh: 公司在报告中附上了一份出口退款申请的副本。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Waslu l-flus tar-rifużjoni għall-esportazzjoni? David: Għadhom ma waslux; se niċċekkja l-kont illum wara nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has the money from the export refund arrived? David: It hasn't arrived yet; I'll check the account this afternoon.
colloquial.zh: Anna：出口退款到账了吗？David：还没有；我今天下午会查看账户。

messages.speaker: Anna (出口业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslu l-flus tar-rifużjoni għall-esportazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Waslu l-flus tar-rifużjoni għall-esportazzjoni?
messages.zh: 出口退款到账了吗？
messages.en: Has the money from the export refund arrived?

messages.speaker: David (财务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadhom ma waslux; se niċċekkja l-kont illum wara nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Għadhom ma waslux; se niċċekkja l-kont illum wara nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 还没有；我今天下午会查看账户。
messages.en: It hasn't arrived yet; I'll check the account this afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rifużjoni għall-esportazzjoni 整体放进“出口业务完成后查看退款是否到账”的场景，记住它指与出口相关的退还款项。

gloss_zh: 出口退款；出口退还款项

teaching_sense.en_definition: Payments made to return money in connection with the export of goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与货物出口有关、按适用安排退还给出口方的款项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlasijiet li jingħataw lura lill-esportaturi b'rabta mal-esportazzjoni ta' prodotti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出口退款，即因出口货物而按相关安排获得退还的款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somom ta' flus li jitħallsu lura lill-esportaturi skont l-arranġamenti applikabbli għall-esportazzjoni ta' prodotti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Export refunds are payments through which exporters receive money back under arrangements relating to exported goods.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ppreżentat id-dokumenti meħtieġa biex titlob rifużjonijiet fuq l-esportazzjoni.
formal.en: The company submitted the required documents to claim export refunds.
formal.zh: 该公司提交了所需文件，以申请出口退款。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Waslu r-rifużjonijiet fuq l-esportazzjoni? Pawlu: Għadhom le; se niċċekkja mal-uffiċċju llum.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have the export refunds come through? Pawlu: Not yet; I'll check with the office today.
colloquial.zh: Marija：出口退款到账了吗？Pawlu：还没有；我今天会向办事处查询。

messages.speaker: Marija (出口业务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslu r-rifużjonijiet fuq l-esportazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Waslu r-rifużjonijiet fuq l-esportazzjoni?
messages.zh: 出口退款到账了吗？
messages.en: Have the export refunds come through?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (财务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadhom le; se niċċekkja mal-uffiċċju llum.
messages.mt_standard: Għadhom le; se niċċekkja mal-uffiċċju llum.
messages.zh: 还没有；我今天会向办事处查询。
messages.en: Not yet; I'll check with the office today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组连着“货物出口后收到退款”的画面记忆；练习时搭配“申请”和“支付”，并注意这里说的是复数款项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Firm and demanding in manner or in requiring rules and standards to be followed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人的态度严厉，或对遵守规则、达到标准要求严格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri severità fl-imġiba jew jitlob li r-regoli u l-istandards jiġu segwiti bir-reqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严厉的，形容人的态度或表现认真而有威严，不轻易宽容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri attitudni serja u severa lejn l-oħrajn u ma jkunx lest jaċċetta mġiba ħażina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is stern behaves in a serious and firm way that shows disapproval or demands obedience.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严格的，形容认真执行规则或坚持标准，不轻易允许例外。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsisti li r-regoli jew l-istandards jiġu osservati u ma jippermettix eċċezzjonijiet faċilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is strict expects rules and standards to be followed and allows few exceptions.

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju japplika kontroll rigoruż fuq il-kwalità tal-materjali u jirreġistra kull riżultat.
formal.en: The laboratory applies strict control over the quality of the materials and records every result.
formal.zh: 实验室严格管控材料质量，并记录每一项结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: L-għalliem il-ġdid jidher rigoruż. Ben: Iva, irid li kulħadd jasal fil-ħin u jlesti x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: The new teacher seems stern. Ben: Yes, he wants everyone to arrive on time and finish their work.
colloquial.zh: Sara：新老师看起来很严厉。Ben：是啊，他要求大家准时到，并完成作业。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem il-ġdid jidher rigoruż.
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem il-ġdid jidher rigoruż.
messages.zh: 新老师看起来很严厉。
messages.en: The new teacher seems stern.

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irid li kulħadd jasal fil-ħin u jlesti x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irid li kulħadd jasal fil-ħin u jlesti x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 是啊，他要求大家准时到，并完成作业。
messages.en: Yes, he wants everyone to arrive on time and finish their work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分词义：老师神情严厉对应 stern，执行规则一丝不苟对应 strict；两者都可用 rigoruż 表达。

gloss_zh: 后悔；感到遗憾（按所给词包的动词释义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the supplied packet, this verb expresses feeling sorry about a past action or an unwelcome situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在所给词包中，此词作为动词，表示对过去的行为或令人不快的情况感到后悔、遗憾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dan il-pakkett, dan il-verb ifisser li wieħed iħoss dispjaċir għal xi ħaġa li għamel jew għal sitwazzjoni li seħħet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对自己做过的事或已经发生的情况感到后悔、遗憾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħoss dispjaċir għal xi ħaġa li għamilt jew għal xi ħaġa li ġrat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you regret something, you feel sorry about having done it or about its having happened.

collocations.zh: 为“rigress”提供的释义（词条讨论用语）

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jelenka 'rigress' bħala verb u jagħtih it-tifsira Ingliża 'Regret'; din l-ispjegazzjoni ssegwi dik it-tifsira.
formal.en: The packet lists 'rigress' as a verb and gives it the English meaning 'Regret'; this explanation follows that meaning.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied packet labels this entry as a proper noun and glosses it as 'your mom', referring to the mother of the person being addressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词包将此词列为专名，释义为“你的妈妈”，指说话对象的母亲；这里保留该词包的词性与释义配对。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pakkett jelenka din il-kelma bħala isem proprju u jagħtiha t-tifsira 'your mom', jiġifieri omm il-persuna li tkun qed tkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你的妈妈，即说话对象的母亲；此义项在所给词包中标为专名。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Omm il-persuna li tkun qed tkellem; dan is-sens huwa elenkat bħala isem proprju fil-pakkett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss refers to the mother of the person you are speaking to.

gloss_zh: 比较广告；对比式广告宣传

teaching_sense.en_definition: Advertising that promotes a product or service by comparing it with another product or service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过将某种产品或服务与另一种产品或服务进行比较来开展的广告宣传。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reklamar li jippromwovi prodott jew servizz billi jqabblu ma' prodott jew servizz ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比较广告，即通过比较不同产品或服务的特点来进行的广告宣传。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma ta' reklamar li tqabbel il-karatteristiċi ta' prodott jew servizz ma' dawk ta' prodott jew servizz ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Comparative advertising promotes a product or service by showing how it compares with an alternative.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza kampanja ta' riklamar komparattiv li tqabbel il-prezz u l-karatteristiċi ta' żewġ prodotti.
formal.en: The report analyses a comparative advertising campaign that compares the price and features of two products.
formal.zh: 该报告分析了一项比较广告活动，该活动对两种产品的价格和特点进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex dan ir-reklam juri żewġ prodotti ħdejn xulxin? David: Juża riklamar komparattiv biex jurik kif il-prezzijiet u l-karatteristiċi tagħhom ivarjaw.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does this advertisement show two products side by side? David: It uses comparative advertising to show you how their prices and features differ.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个广告为什么把两种产品并排展示？戴维：它采用比较广告的方式，让你看到两者在价格和特点上的差异。

messages.zh: 这个广告为什么把两种产品并排展示？

messages.en: It uses comparative advertising to show you how their prices and features differ.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广告画面左右摆着两种产品，中间列出价格和功能对照表；把“并排比较来宣传”的画面与整个短语一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling or showing appreciation for help, kindness, or something beneficial.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因得到帮助、善意或有益的事物而心怀感激或表现出谢意的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss jew juri gratitudni għal għajnuna, ġid jew qalb tajba li jkun irċieva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因他人的帮助、善意或给予而感激的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħoss jew juri gratitudni lejn xi ħadd għall-għajnuna jew il-ġid li jkun irċieva mingħandu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are grateful, you feel appreciation for someone's kindness or help.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因获得帮助、得到好结果或处境改善而心怀谢意的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħoss gratitudni għax ikun irċieva għajnuna, kiseb riżultat tajjeb jew għadda minn bidla għall-aħjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are thankful, you feel pleased and appreciative because something helpful or welcome has happened.

formal.mt: Jiena rikonoxxenti lejn il-kollegi kollha għall-appoġġ tagħhom matul dan il-proġett.
formal.en: I am grateful to all my colleagues for their support throughout this project.
formal.zh: 我感谢所有同事在整个项目期间给予的支持。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien rikonoxxenti ħafna lejk talli għentni lbieraħ. Maja: Ta' xejn! Meta jkollok bżonn, għidli.
colloquial.en: Mark: I am really grateful to you for helping me yesterday. Maja: You're welcome! Whenever you need help, let me know.
colloquial.zh: Mark：真的很感谢你昨天帮了我。Maja：不客气！需要帮忙时就告诉我。

messages.mt_spoken: Jien rikonoxxenti ħafna lejk talli għentni lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Jien rikonoxxenti ħafna lejk talli għentni lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 真的很感谢你昨天帮了我。
messages.en: I am really grateful to you for helping me yesterday.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta' xejn! Meta jkollok bżonn, għidli.
messages.mt_standard: Ta' xejn! Meta jkollok bżonn, għidli.
messages.zh: 不客气！需要帮忙时就告诉我。
messages.en: You're welcome! Whenever you need help, let me know.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进感谢场景：朋友伸手帮助，你心里暖暖地说谢谢；它描述心怀感激的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Accepted or recognized as valid, true, important, or deserving of credit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 其有效性、真实性、重要性或应得的功劳得到承认或认可的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie aċċettat bħala validu, veru jew importanti, jew li jkun ingħata l-kreditu li jistħoqqlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 其事实、地位、价值或贡献已被承认或认可的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li l-eżistenza, l-istatus, il-valur jew il-kontribut tiegħu jkun ġie aċċettat jew iddikjarat b'mod ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is acknowledged, people accept its existence, validity, or importance, or give it the credit it deserves.

formal.mt: Il-kontribut tiegħu għar-riċerka huwa rikonoxxut fir-rapport finali.
formal.en: His contribution to the research is acknowledged in the final report.
formal.zh: 最终报告肯定了他对这项研究的贡献。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ix-xogħol ta' Lara hu rikonoxxut mit-tim kollu. Mark: Iva, kulħadd jaf kemm għenet biex il-proġett jirnexxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Lara's work is acknowledged by the whole team. Mark: Yes, everyone knows how much she helped make the project succeed.
colloquial.zh: Maja：整个团队都认可Lara的工作。Mark：是的，大家都知道她为项目成功提供了多大的帮助。

messages.mt_standard: Ix-xogħol ta' Lara hu rikonoxxut mit-tim kollu.

messages.en: Lara's work is acknowledged by the whole team.

messages.zh: 是的，大家都知道她为项目成功提供了多大的帮助。

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份报告明确写出某人的贡献，大家点头认可；用这个画面记住已经得到承认的状态。

gloss_zh: 重新托运人；货物再托运人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that consigns goods again for onward shipment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将货物再次交付托运、安排继续运送的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li terġa' tagħti merkanzija għat-trasport sabiex tintbagħat lejn destinatarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将货物再次交运的重新托运人或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li terġa' tikkonsenja merkanzija għat-trasport lejn destinatarju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reconsignor is a person or organization that consigns goods again for further transport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 办理货物再次托运的个人或机构，即货物再托运人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tagħti merkanzija mill-ġdid lil trasportatur biex iwassalha lil destinatarju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reconsignor of goods arranges for those goods to be consigned again and sent onward to a recipient.

collocations.zh: 该批货物的重新托运人
重新托运人的详细资料

formal.mt: L-isem u l-indirizz tar-rikonsenjant għandhom jitniżżlu fid-dokument tat-trasport qabel ma l-merkanzija terġa' tintbagħat.
formal.en: The reconsignor's name and address must be entered in the transport document before the goods are dispatched again.
formal.zh: 货物再次发运前，必须在运输单据中填写重新托运人的姓名或名称及地址。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu r-rikonsenjant ta' dawn il-kaxxi? Mark: Jien. Se nerġa' nibgħathom lil ħanut ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the reconsignor of these boxes? Mark: I am. I am going to send them onward to another shop.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这些箱子的重新托运人是谁？Mark：是我。我准备把它们再发往另一家商店。

messages.mt_spoken: Min hu r-rikonsenjant ta' dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu r-rikonsenjant ta' dawn il-kaxxi?

messages.mt_standard: Jien. Se nerġa' nibgħathom lil ħanut ieħor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货箱需要再次发运，负责重新填写托运资料并交运的人，就是这里要记住的重新托运人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of arranging for goods already consigned to be sent onward again, including to a different recipient or destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对已托运的货物重新安排运输，包括改送其他收货人或目的地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-arranġament biex merkanzija diġà kkonsenjata terġa' tintbagħat, inkluż lil destinatarju ieħor jew lejn destinazzjoni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重新托运；对已托运货物重新安排运送，尤其指变更收货人或目的地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih merkanzija diġà kkonsenjata terġa' tintbagħat jew tingħata destinazzjoni jew destinatarju ġdid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Reconsignment is the arrangement of a further or revised shipment of goods that have already been consigned.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija talbet ir-rikonsenjar tal-merkanzija lejn il-maħżen il-ġdid.
formal.en: The company requested reconsignment of the goods to the new warehouse.
formal.zh: 公司申请将货物改运至新仓库。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-merkanzija diġà ntbagħtet, imma rridha tmur f'maħżen ieħor. Rita: Nista' nirranġa r-rikonsenjar. Agħtini l-indirizz il-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Mark: The goods have already been sent, but I need them to go to another warehouse. Rita: I can arrange reconsignment. Give me the new address.
colloquial.zh: Mark：货物已经发出了，但我需要把它们送到另一个仓库。Rita：我可以安排改运。把新地址给我。

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-merkanzija diġà ntbagħtet, imma rridha tmur f'maħżen ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Il-merkanzija diġà ntbagħtet, imma rridha tmur f'maħżen ieħor.
messages.zh: 货物已经发出了，但我需要把它们送到另一个仓库。
messages.en: The goods have already been sent, but I need them to go to another warehouse.

messages.speaker: Rita (货运职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nirranġa r-rikonsenjar. Agħtini l-indirizz il-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nirranġa r-rikonsenjar. Agħtini l-indirizz il-ġdid.
messages.zh: 我可以安排改运。把新地址给我。
messages.en: I can arrange reconsignment. Give me the new address.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货箱已经贴好运输单，又换上一张新地址标签；把这个“重新安排托运”的画面与 rikonsenjar 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of matching records or figures to check that they agree and identify differences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将记录或数字相互匹配、核对，以确认是否一致并找出差异的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' tqabbil ta' rekords jew ċifri biex jiġi vverifikat li jaqblu u jiġu identifikati d-differenzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对记录、项目或数字进行匹配核对，确认其对应关系或一致性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tqabbil ta' rekords, elementi jew ċifri biex jiġi stabbilit jekk jikkorrispondux jew jaqblux ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Matching is the process of comparing corresponding records or figures to establish whether they agree.

formal.mt: Ir-rikonċiljazzjoni tal-kontijiet għandha titlesta qabel ma jiġi approvat ir-rapport finanzjarju.
formal.en: The reconciliation of accounts must be completed before the financial report is approved.
formal.zh: 财务报告获批之前，必须完成账目核对。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lestejt ir-rikonċiljazzjoni tal-kontijiet? Mark: Kważi. Għad hemm żewġ ħlasijiet li ma jaqblux mar-rekords tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you finished reconciling the accounts? Mark: Almost. There are still two payments that do not match our records.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你完成账目核对了吗？Mark：差不多了。还有两笔付款与我们的记录不一致。

messages.speaker: Maja (财务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt ir-rikonċiljazzjoni tal-kontijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt ir-rikonċiljazzjoni tal-kontijiet?
messages.zh: 你完成账目核对了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished reconciling the accounts?

messages.speaker: Mark (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Għad hemm żewġ ħlasijiet li ma jaqblux mar-rekords tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Għad hemm żewġ ħlasijiet li ma jaqblux mar-rekords tagħna.
messages.zh: 差不多了。还有两笔付款与我们的记录不一致。
messages.en: Almost. There are still two payments that do not match our records.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把两张账单并排放好，逐笔连线核对；用这个画面记住它表示匹配核验的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object kept or bought to remind you of a place, person, or experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为纪念某个地方、某个人或某次经历而购买或保存的物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li tixtri jew iżżomm biex ifakkrek f'post, f'persuna jew f'esperjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纪念品；用来唤起对某个地方、人物或经历的回忆的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett mixtri jew miżmum bħala tifkira ta' post, ta' persuna jew ta' esperjenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A souvenir is an object you keep or buy because it reminds you of a particular place, person, or experience.

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant ingħata rikordju żgħir biex ifakkru fiż-żjara.
formal.en: Each participant was given a small souvenir to remind them of the visit.
formal.zh: 每位参与者都获赠了一件小纪念品，作为此次参观的留念。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xtrajt xi rikordju minn Għawdex? Lara: Iva, xtrajt kalamita żgħira għall-friġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you buy a souvenir from Gozo? Lara: Yes, I bought a little fridge magnet.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你从戈佐岛买纪念品了吗？Lara：买了，我买了一块小冰箱贴。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xtrajt xi rikordju minn Għawdex?
messages.mt_standard: Xtrajt xi rikordju minn Għawdex?
messages.zh: 你从戈佐岛买纪念品了吗？
messages.en: Did you buy a souvenir from Gozo?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xtrajt kalamita żgħira għall-friġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xtrajt kalamita żgħira għall-friġġ.
messages.zh: 买了，我买了一块小冰箱贴。
messages.en: Yes, I bought a little fridge magnet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rikordju 想成旅行后贴在冰箱上的小磁贴：看见这件实物，就想起那次旅行，从而记住“纪念品”。

gloss_zh: 反复出现的；经常发生的；递归的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening repeatedly or regularly; in technical contexts, involving a rule or procedure applied within itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复或经常发生的；在技术语境中，也指在自身内部再次应用同一规则或过程的，即递归的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġri jew jidher ripetutament jew ta' spiss; f'kuntest tekniku, li jinvolvi regola jew proċedura li terġa' tiġi applikata fi ħdanha stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复出现的；发生后又再次发生的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jerġa' jiġri jew jidher wara li jkun diġà seħħ qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is recurrent happens again after it has happened before.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to occur frequently or habitually
sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常发生的；倾向于频繁或惯常出现的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jiġri ta' spiss jew bħala parti minn drawwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described this way tends to happen often or as a regular habit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 递归的；在某个结构或过程内部再次应用同一规则或过程的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi l-applikazzjoni mill-ġdid tal-istess regola jew proċedura fi ħdan l-istruttura jew il-proċedura nnifisha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A recursive rule or procedure applies itself again within its own operation or structure.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika dewmien rikorrenti fil-proċess tal-kunsinna u jipproponi miżuri biex jitnaqqas.
formal.en: The report identifies recurrent delays in the delivery process and proposes measures to reduce them.
formal.zh: 报告指出配送流程中反复发生的延误，并提出减少延误的措施。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-problema reġgħet ġrat dalgħodu. Mark: Mela hija problema rikorrenti. Ejja naraw x'qed jikkawżaha.
colloquial.en: Lara: This problem happened again this morning. Mark: So it is a recurrent problem. Let's see what is causing it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今天早上这个问题又出现了。Mark：那这是个反复出现的问题。我们看看是什么原因造成的。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-problema reġgħet ġrat dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-problema reġgħet ġrat dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 今天早上这个问题又出现了。
messages.en: This problem happened again this morning.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hija problema rikorrenti. Ejja naraw x'qed jikkawżaha.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hija problema rikorrenti. Ejja naraw x'qed jikkawżaha.
messages.zh: 那这是个反复出现的问题。我们看看是什么原因造成的。
messages.en: So it is a recurrent problem. Let's see what is causing it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分义项：日历上同一问题反复出现，对应“反复、经常”；一个步骤内部再次调用自己，对应“递归”。这只是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal request to a court or other authority to review or change a decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向法院或其他主管机关正式提出、要求复查或改变某项决定的申诉或上诉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba formali lil qorti jew lil awtorità oħra biex teżamina mill-ġdid jew tibdel deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 申诉；上诉；请求法院或有关机关重新审查某项决定的正式申请。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Talba formali magħmula lil qorti jew lil awtorità kompetenti biex deċiżjoni tiġi eżaminata mill-ġdid jew mibdula.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An appeal is a formal request for a court or authority to reconsider a decision.

collocations.zh: 针对该决定提出的申诉或上诉

formal.mt: Il-kumitat eżamina r-rikors kontra d-deċiżjoni u talab aktar dokumenti qabel ma ta t-tweġiba tiegħu.
formal.en: The committee examined the appeal against the decision and requested further documents before giving its response.
formal.zh: 委员会审查了针对该决定提出的申诉，并在作出答复前要求补充文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma naqbilx mad-deċiżjoni tal-kumitat. Mark: Tista' tippreżenta rikors u tispjega għaliex trid li jerġgħu jeżaminawha.
colloquial.en: Maja: I disagree with the committee's decision. Mark: You can lodge an appeal and explain why you want them to review it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我不同意委员会的决定。Mark：你可以提出申诉，说明为什么希望他们重新审查这个决定。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naqbilx mad-deċiżjoni tal-kumitat.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naqbilx mad-deċiżjoni tal-kumitat.
messages.zh: 我不同意委员会的决定。
messages.en: I disagree with the committee's decision.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tippreżenta rikors u tispjega għaliex trid li jerġgħu jeżaminawha.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tippreżenta rikors u tispjega għaliex trid li jerġgħu jeżaminawha.
messages.zh: 你可以提出申诉，说明为什么希望他们重新审查这个决定。
messages.en: You can lodge an appeal and explain why you want them to review it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把写着“请重新审查决定”的正式文件递交给委员会；将这个动作连同 tippreżenta rikors 一起记，掌握“提出申诉”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Activities people do for enjoyment and relaxation during their free time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们在空闲时间为了获得乐趣、放松身心而进行的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attivitajiet li n-nies jagħmlu fil-ħin liberu biex jieħdu gost u jistrieħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 娱乐；消遣；为享受闲暇和放松身心而进行的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attivitajiet ta' divertiment u mistrieħ li persuna tagħmel fil-ħin liberu tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Recreation consists of activities that you do for pleasure and relaxation when you are not working.

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi attivitajiet ta' rikreazzjoni għat-tfal wara l-ħin tal-iskola.
formal.en: The programme includes recreational activities for children after school.
formal.zh: 该计划包括供儿童放学后参加的休闲娱乐活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tagħmel għar-rikreazzjoni wara x-xogħol? Pawlu: Immur nimxi jew nilgħab il-futbol mal-ħbieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you do for recreation after work? Pawlu: I go for a walk or play football with friends.
colloquial.zh: Maja：下班后你做些什么休闲活动？Pawlu：我去散步，或者和朋友踢足球。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tagħmel għar-rikreazzjoni wara x-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: X'tagħmel għar-rikreazzjoni wara x-xogħol?
messages.zh: 下班后你做些什么休闲活动？
messages.en: What do you do for recreation after work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Immur nimxi jew nilgħab il-futbol mal-ħbieb.
messages.mt_standard: Immur nimxi jew nilgħab il-futbol mal-ħbieb.
messages.zh: 我去散步，或者和朋友踢足球。
messages.en: I go for a walk or play football with friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rikreazzjoni 放进“下班后散步、踢球”的画面中，记住它指休闲娱乐活动；搭配 attivitajiet 一起记更容易。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Making someone feel calmer and less tense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到更平静，减轻紧张或压力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu aktar kalm u b'inqas tensjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人放松；让人缓解紧张、恢复平静。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jgħin lil persuna tnaqqas it-tensjoni u tħossha aktar kalma u mistrieħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is relaxing helps you feel calmer and less worried or tense.

formal.mt: Matul il-pawża, il-parteċipanti semgħu mużika rilassanti qabel komplew bl-attivitajiet.
formal.en: During the break, the participants listened to relaxing music before continuing with the activities.
formal.zh: 休息期间，参与者听了令人放松的音乐，然后继续进行活动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kienet il-mixja ħdejn il-baħar? Mark: Kienet rilassanti ħafna; issa nħossni aktar kalm.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was your walk by the sea? Mark: It was very relaxing; I feel calmer now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：在海边散步感觉怎么样？Mark：非常放松，我现在平静多了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kienet il-mixja ħdejn il-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kienet il-mixja ħdejn il-baħar?
messages.zh: 在海边散步感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How was your walk by the sea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet rilassanti ħafna; issa nħossni aktar kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet rilassanti ħafna; issa nħossni aktar kalm.
messages.zh: 非常放松，我现在平静多了。
messages.en: It was very relaxing; I feel calmer now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听着轻音乐，紧绷的肩膀慢慢松下来；用 mużika rilassanti 把这个词和“令人放松”的效果联系起来。

gloss_zh: 放行供境内使用或消费；投放市场

teaching_sense.en_definition: The clearance or release of goods for domestic use, consumption, or placement on the market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准许货物供境内使用、消费，或将货物投放市场的放行行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-permess jew il-proċess li bih merkanzija titħalla tintuża jew tiġi kkunsmata fil-pajjiż, jew titqiegħed fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放行供境内使用；准许货物进入境内使用的通关放行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-approvazzjoni doganali li tippermetti li merkanzija tidħol għall-użu fil-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Clearance for home use is customs approval that allows goods to enter domestic use.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放行供消费；准许货物进入消费环节。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' permess biex merkanzija tkun tista' tidħol għall-konsum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Release for consumption is the authorization that allows goods to enter consumption.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放行供境内使用；准许货物在进口国境内使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rilaxx ta' merkanzija biex tkun tista' tintuża fil-pajjiż fejn tkun ġiet importata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Release for home use allows imported goods to be used within the importing country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投放市场；准许或安排产品进入市场销售。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih prodott jitqiegħed fis-suq u jsir disponibbli għall-bejgħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Release to the market is the process of making a product available for sale.

collocations.en: authorization for release to the market
the release of the product to the market

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispeċifika d-data prevista għar-rilaxx fis-suq tal-prodott il-ġdid.
formal.en: The document specifies the planned date for the release of the new product to the market.
formal.zh: 文件注明了新产品计划投放市场的日期。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta hu ppjanat ir-rilaxx fis-suq tal-prodott il-ġdid? Toni: Għax-xahar id-dieħel; it-tim għadu qed iħejji kollox.
colloquial.en: Sara: When is the new product's release to the market planned? Toni: For next month; the team is still getting everything ready.
colloquial.zh: Sara：新产品计划什么时候投放市场？Toni：下个月，团队还在做各项准备。

messages.speaker: Sara (销售同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta hu ppjanat ir-rilaxx fis-suq tal-prodott il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Meta hu ppjanat ir-rilaxx fis-suq tal-prodott il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 新产品计划什么时候投放市场？
messages.en: When is the new product's release to the market planned?

messages.speaker: Toni (产品同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax-xahar id-dieħel; it-tim għadu qed iħejji kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Għax-xahar id-dieħel; it-tim għadu qed iħejji kollox.
messages.zh: 下个月，团队还在做各项准备。
messages.en: For next month; the team is still getting everything ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“货物获准进入境内使用，或产品进入市场销售”的连续画面记整组短语；这里的 home use 指境内使用，不只是家庭自用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The release of goods so that they may enter free circulation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准许货物进入自由流通状态的放行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien ta' merkanzija sabiex tkun tista' tidħol f'ċirkolazzjoni libera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准许货物进入自由流通状态的放行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien ta' merkanzija biex tkun tista' tidħol f'ċirkolazzjoni libera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Release for free circulation is the authorization that allows goods to enter free circulation.

collocations.mt: talba għal rilaxx għal ċirkolazzjoni libera
collocations.en: a request for release for free circulation
documents for release for free circulation
collocations.zh: 自由流通放行所需文件

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jindika d-data tar-rilaxx għal ċirkolazzjoni libera tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: The report should indicate the date of the goods' release for free circulation.
formal.zh: 报告应注明货物获准进入自由流通的放行日期。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Waslet il-konferma tar-rilaxx għal ċirkolazzjoni libera? Pawlu: Iva, waslet dalgħodu. Se nibgħathielek issa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has the confirmation of release for free circulation arrived? Pawlu: Yes, it arrived this morning. I'll send it to you now.
colloquial.zh: Marta：自由流通放行的确认收到了吗？Pawlu：收到了，今天早上到的。我现在发给你。

messages.speaker: Marta (进口业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslet il-konferma tar-rilaxx għal ċirkolazzjoni libera?
messages.mt_standard: Waslet il-konferma tar-rilaxx għal ċirkolazzjoni libera?
messages.zh: 自由流通放行的确认收到了吗？
messages.en: Has the confirmation of release for free circulation arrived?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (物流同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waslet dalgħodu. Se nibgħathielek issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waslet dalgħodu. Se nibgħathielek issa.
messages.zh: 收到了，今天早上到的。我现在发给你。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning. I'll send it to you now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整词想成货物通过一道写着“自由流通”的闸门：rilaxx记“放行”，ċirkolazzjoni libera记“自由流通”，合起来就是自由流通放行。

gloss_zh: 国内消费放行；本国使用清关；市场投放放行

teaching_sense.en_definition: The clearance or release of goods for domestic use, consumption, or entry onto the market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准许货物供本国使用、消费或投放市场的清关或放行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iżdoganar jew il-ħelsien ta' merkanzija sabiex tkun tista' tintuża jew tiġi kkunsmata fil-pajjiż, jew titqiegħed fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准许货物供本国使用的清关；此处不专指家庭使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-iżdoganar ta' merkanzija sabiex tkun tista' tintuża fil-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Clearance for home use is customs clearance allowing goods to be used within the country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准许货物供消费的放行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien ta' merkanzija sabiex tkun tista' tiġi kkunsmata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Release for consumption is the authorization that allows goods to be made available for consumption.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准许货物供本国使用的放行；此处不专指家庭使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien ta' merkanzija sabiex tkun tista' tintuża fil-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Release for home use is the authorization that allows goods to be used within the country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准许货物投放市场的放行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien ta' merkanzija sabiex tkun tista' titqiegħed fis-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Release to the market is the authorization that allows goods to be placed on the market.

collocations.en: a request for release for consumption

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġobkom, ehmżu l-konferma tar-rilaxx għall-konsum mad-dokumenti tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: Please attach the confirmation of release for consumption to the delivery documents.
formal.zh: 请将消费放行确认附在交货文件中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna l-konferma tar-rilaxx għall-konsum? Toni: Għadha ma waslitx. Se nistaqsi lill-aġent.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we have the confirmation of release for consumption? Toni: It hasn't arrived yet. I'll ask the agent.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们拿到消费放行确认了吗？Toni：还没收到。我去问问代理。

messages.speaker: Lara (进口业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna l-konferma tar-rilaxx għall-konsum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna l-konferma tar-rilaxx għall-konsum?
messages.zh: 我们拿到消费放行确认了吗？
messages.en: Do we have the confirmation of release for consumption?

messages.speaker: Toni (物流同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadha ma waslitx. Se nistaqsi lill-aġent.
messages.mt_standard: Għadha ma waslitx. Se nistaqsi lill-aġent.
messages.zh: 还没收到。我去问问代理。
messages.en: It hasn't arrived yet. I'll ask the agent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“放行后供消费”的画面记忆：rilaxx对应放行，konsum对应消费。再把本国使用和投放市场串进同一场景；这里的消费不限于吃喝。

gloss_zh: 本国使用放行；本国使用清关；消费或市场投放放行

teaching_sense.en_definition: The clearance or release of goods for use within the country, also expressed as release for consumption or to the market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准许货物在本国使用的清关或放行，也可表示供消费或投放市场的放行；此处的本国使用不局限于家庭用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iżdoganar jew il-ħelsien ta' merkanzija għall-użu fil-pajjiż, għall-konsum jew għat-tqegħid fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准许货物供本国使用的清关；这里的本国使用不等于仅供家庭使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-iżdoganar ta' merkanzija sabiex tkun tista' tintuża fil-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Clearance for home use is customs clearance permitting goods to be used in the country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准许货物供消费的放行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien ta' merkanzija sabiex tkun disponibbli għall-konsum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Release for consumption is the authorization permitting goods to become available for consumption.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准许货物供本国使用的放行；这里的本国使用不等于仅供家庭使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien ta' merkanzija sabiex tkun disponibbli għall-użu fil-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Release for home use is the authorization permitting goods to become available for use within the country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准许货物投放市场的放行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien ta' merkanzija sabiex tkun disponibbli fis-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Release to the market is the authorization permitting goods to become available on the market.

collocations.en: documents for release for home use
collocations.zh: 本国使用放行所需文件

collocations.en: the date of release for home use

formal.mt: Il-formola titlob id-data tar-rilaxx għall-użu domestiku u referenza għad-dokument ta' konferma.
formal.en: The form asks for the date of release for home use and a reference to the confirmation document.
formal.zh: 该表格要求填写本国使用放行日期及确认文件的编号。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser rilaxx għall-użu domestiku hawn? David: Ifisser li l-merkanzija tinħeles għall-użu fil-pajjiż. Mhux biss għall-użu fid-dar.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does release for home use mean here? David: It means that the goods are released for use within the country. It isn't limited to use in the home.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这里的本国使用放行是什么意思？David：意思是货物获准放行，供本国使用。用途不限于家庭。

messages.speaker: Nina (新入职同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser rilaxx għall-użu domestiku hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser rilaxx għall-użu domestiku hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的本国使用放行是什么意思？
messages.en: What does release for home use mean here?

messages.speaker: David (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-merkanzija tinħeles għall-użu fil-pajjiż. Mhux biss għall-użu fid-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-merkanzija tinħeles għall-użu fil-pajjiż. Mhux biss għall-użu fid-dar.
messages.zh: 意思是货物获准放行，供本国使用。用途不限于家庭。
messages.en: It means that the goods are released for use within the country. It isn't limited to use in the home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成“放行→在本国使用”：rilaxx抓住放行，użu抓住使用。在这个贸易词组里，把domestiku联想到本国范围，避免只想到家里的用品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of allowing goods to leave a place where they have been held or to proceed to their next destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准许货物离开被留置或保管地点，或继续运往下一地点的放行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' permess biex il-merkanzija titlaq mill-post fejn tkun qed tinżamm jew tkompli lejn id-destinazzjoni li jmiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准许货物离开留置或保管地点，或继续运输的放行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħelsien tal-merkanzija sabiex tkun tista' titlaq mill-post fejn tkun qed tinżamm jew tkompli fi triqitha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The release of goods is the act of allowing goods to leave where they are held or continue to another destination.

collocations.en: a request for the release of goods
a delay in the release of goods

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega r-raġuni għad-dewmien fir-rilaxx tal-merkanzija u jagħti d-data mistennija tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The report explains the reason for the delay in the release of goods and gives the expected delivery date.
formal.zh: 报告说明了货物放行延误的原因，并给出了预计交货日期。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm xi aħbar dwar ir-rilaxx tal-merkanzija? Mark: Iva, għadhom kemm ikkonfermawh. Se nċempel lix-xufier.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there any news about the release of the goods? Mark: Yes, they've just confirmed it. I'll call the driver.
colloquial.zh: Sara：货物放行有消息了吗？Mark：有了，他们刚刚确认。我来给司机打电话。

messages.speaker: Sara (仓库同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi aħbar dwar ir-rilaxx tal-merkanzija?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi aħbar dwar ir-rilaxx tal-merkanzija?
messages.zh: 货物放行有消息了吗？
messages.en: Is there any news about the release of the goods?

messages.speaker: Mark (运输协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadhom kemm ikkonfermawh. Se nċempel lix-xufier.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadhom kemm ikkonfermawh. Se nċempel lix-xufier.
messages.zh: 有了，他们刚刚确认。我来给司机打电话。
messages.en: Yes, they've just confirmed it. I'll call the driver.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仓库门打开，货物获准继续走：rilaxx记“放行”，tal-merkanzija记“货物的”，合起来就是货物放行；这个词组本身不指定放行后的用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: No longer held in prison or another form of custody.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经从监狱或其他拘押状态中被释放、恢复自由的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun inħeles mill-ħabs jew minn forma oħra ta' kustodja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被释放的；获释的，例如从监狱中获释。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx għadu miżmum il-ħabs jew taħt kustodja wara li jkun tħalla joħroġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is released is allowed to leave prison or another place where they have been held.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-appoġġ mogħti lil priġunier rilaxxat biex jerġa' jibda ħajtu fil-komunità.
formal.en: The report describes the support given to a released prisoner to help him rebuild his life in the community.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了为一名获释囚犯提供的支持，以帮助他在社区中重新开始生活。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħuk għadu l-ħabs? David: Le, issa hu rilaxxat u jinsab id-dar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is your brother still in prison? David: No, he has been released and is at home now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你哥哥还在监狱里吗？David：不，他已经获释，现在在家。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk għadu l-ħabs?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk għadu l-ħabs?
messages.zh: 你哥哥还在监狱里吗？
messages.en: Is your brother still in prison?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa hu rilaxxat u jinsab id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa hu rilaxxat u jinsab id-dar.
messages.zh: 不，他已经获释，现在在家。
messages.en: No, he has been released and is at home now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rilaxxat 和“牢门打开，人已回家”的画面绑定，记成“已经获释的状态”；配合 mill-ħabs 一起复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A similarity of sound between the endings of words, especially in poetry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个或多个词的结尾具有相同或相近的声音，尤指诗歌中的押韵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qbil fil-ħoss bejn it-truf ta' żewġ kelmiet jew aktar, speċjalment fil-poeżija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词尾声音的相同或相近，尤其用于诗歌中的押韵。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rima hija qbil fil-ħoss fit-tmiem ta' kelmiet, li spiss jintuża fil-poeżiji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rhyme is the use of similar sounds at the ends of words, especially in poetry.

formal.mt: Il-poeta juża r-rima fit-tmiem tal-versi biex joħloq effett mużikali.
formal.en: The poet uses rhyme at the ends of the lines to create a musical effect.
formal.zh: 诗人在诗行末尾运用押韵，营造音乐般的效果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelmiet 'dar' u 'nhar' jagħmlu rima? Luqa: Iva, it-tnejn jispiċċaw bl-istess ħoss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do the words 'dar' and 'nhar' rhyme? Luqa: Yes, they both end with the same sound.
colloquial.zh: Maja：'dar'和'nhar'这两个词押韵吗？Luqa：是的，它们的结尾声音相同。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelmiet 'dar' u 'nhar' jagħmlu rima?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelmiet 'dar' u 'nhar' jagħmlu rima?
messages.zh: 'dar'和'nhar'这两个词押韵吗？
messages.en: Do the words 'dar' and 'nhar' rhyme?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tnejn jispiċċaw bl-istess ħoss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tnejn jispiċċaw bl-istess ħoss.
messages.zh: 是的，它们的结尾声音相同。
messages.en: Yes, they both end with the same sound.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把rima和诗行末尾的声音联系起来：读到结尾，听听是否押韵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money returned to someone after they have paid for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将已支付的钱退还给付款人，或指退还的款项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas lura ta' flus li persuna tkun diġà ħallset għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对已经支付的费用所作的退款，或退还给付款人的钱款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rimbors huwa flus li jingħataw lura lil min ikun ħallashom, pereżempju meta jirritorna prodott jew meta servizz jitħassar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A refund is money that is returned to you after you have paid for a product or service.

formal.mt: Il-klijent talab rimbors sħiħ wara li l-kumpanija ħassret is-servizz.
formal.en: The customer requested a full refund after the company cancelled the service.
formal.zh: 公司取消服务后，顾客要求全额退款。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-prodott ma jaħdimx. Nista' nieħu rimbors? Sara: Iva, ġib l-irċevuta u nagħtuk flusek lura.
colloquial.en: Mark: This product doesn't work. Can I get a refund? Sara: Yes, bring the receipt and we'll give you your money back.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个产品不能用。我可以退款吗？Sara：可以，带上收据，我们会把钱退给你。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-prodott ma jaħdimx. Nista' nieħu rimbors?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-prodott ma jaħdimx. Nista' nieħu rimbors?
messages.zh: 这个产品不能用。我可以退款吗？
messages.en: This product doesn't work. Can I get a refund?

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġib l-irċevuta u nagħtuk flusek lura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġib l-irċevuta u nagħtuk flusek lura.
messages.zh: 可以，带上收据，我们会把钱退给你。
messages.en: Yes, bring the receipt and we'll give you your money back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住rimbors的退款场景：钱已经付出去，退货后又回到自己手中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something used to treat an illness or to correct a problem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于治疗疾病、缓解不适或纠正问题的方法或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tintuża biex tittratta marda, ittaffi sintomu jew issolvi problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 治疗疾病或缓解症状的疗法，也指解决问题或弥补不良情况的办法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rimedju huwa mezz jew trattament li jgħin biex tittaffa marda jew biex tissewwa sitwazzjoni ħażina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A remedy is something that helps treat an illness or put a problem right.

collocations.en: to find a remedy for a problem

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi rimedju għall-problema tad-dewmien fit-tqassim tal-ittri.
formal.en: The report proposes a remedy for the problem of delays in letter delivery.
formal.zh: 报告针对信件投递延误的问题提出了补救办法。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kull darba li nsaqqi l-pjanta, l-ilma jaqa' mal-art. Hemm xi rimedju? Pawlu: Iva, poġġi platt taħt il-borma.
colloquial.en: Anna: Every time I water the plant, water falls onto the floor. Is there a remedy? Pawlu: Yes, put a saucer under the pot.
colloquial.zh: Anna：每次给植物浇水，水都会流到地上。有什么解决办法吗？Pawlu：有，在花盆下面放个托盘。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kull darba li nsaqqi l-pjanta, l-ilma jaqa' mal-art. Hemm xi rimedju?
messages.mt_standard: Kull darba li nsaqqi l-pjanta, l-ilma jaqa' mal-art. Hemm xi rimedju?
messages.zh: 每次给植物浇水，水都会流到地上。有什么解决办法吗？
messages.en: Every time I water the plant, water falls onto the floor. Is there a remedy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, poġġi platt taħt il-borma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, poġġi platt taħt il-borma.
messages.zh: 有，在花盆下面放个托盘。
messages.en: Yes, put a saucer under the pot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把rimedju想成解决麻烦的工具箱：身体不适用疗法，事情出错用补救办法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money sent to another person or place, usually through a bank or money transfer service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过银行或汇款服务等渠道汇寄给其他人或其他地方的款项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mibgħuta lil persuna jew f'post ieħor, normalment permezz ta' bank jew servizz ta' trasferiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汇寄给他人或汇往其他地方的钱款，通常通过银行或汇款服务转交。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rimessa hija somma ta' flus li tintbagħat lil xi ħadd, pereżempju biex jitħallas kont jew biex tingħata għajnuna lill-familja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A remittance is a sum of money sent to someone, often through a bank or transfer service.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija kkonfermat li rċeviet ir-rimessa bankarja għall-ħlas tal-fattura.
formal.en: The company confirmed that it had received the bank remittance to pay the invoice.
formal.zh: 公司确认已收到用于支付发票款项的银行汇款。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Waslet ir-rimessa li bgħattlek ilbieraħ? Marija: Iva, il-flus daħlu fil-kont dalgħodu. Grazzi!
colloquial.en: Rita: Has the remittance I sent you yesterday arrived? Marija: Yes, the money reached the account this morning. Thanks!
colloquial.zh: Rita：我昨天给你寄的汇款到账了吗？Marija：到了，钱今天早上进了账户。谢谢！

messages.speaker: Rita (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslet ir-rimessa li bgħattlek ilbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Waslet ir-rimessa li bgħattlek ilbieraħ?
messages.zh: 我昨天给你寄的汇款到账了吗？
messages.en: Has the remittance I sent you yesterday arrived?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-flus daħlu fil-kont dalgħodu. Grazzi!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-flus daħlu fil-kont dalgħodu. Grazzi!
messages.zh: 到了，钱今天早上进了账户。谢谢！
messages.en: Yes, the money reached the account this morning. Thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住rimessa的汇款画面：一笔钱从汇款人的账户出发，到达收款人的账户。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An amount of money sent to another person or place as a payment or financial support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 汇给另一人或另一地点的一笔钱，通常用于付款或提供经济支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mibgħuta lil persuna oħra jew lejn post ieħor bħala ħlas jew għajnuna finanzjarja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为付款或资助而汇出或收到的一笔现金款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus li tintbagħat lil xi ħadd bħala ħlas jew bħala appoġġ finanzjarju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cash remittance is a sum of money that someone sends to another person, often as payment or financial support.

formal.mt: Il-familja rċeviet rimessa fi flus mingħand qarib li jgħix barra mill-pajjiż biex tkopri l-ispejjeż tal-iskola.
formal.en: The family received a cash remittance from a relative living abroad to cover school expenses.
formal.zh: 这家人收到了一位旅居国外的亲属汇来的款项，用于支付上学的费用。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Waslet ir-rimessa fi flus li bagħat ħuk? Pawlu: Iva, waslet illum. Se nużawha biex inħallsu l-kera.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the cash remittance your brother sent arrived? Pawlu: Yes, it arrived today. We'll use it to pay the rent.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你哥哥寄来的汇款到了吗？Pawlu：到了，今天收到的。我们会用它来付房租。

messages.speaker: Marija (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslet ir-rimessa fi flus li bagħat ħuk?
messages.mt_standard: Waslet ir-rimessa fi flus li bagħat ħuk?
messages.zh: 你哥哥寄来的汇款到了吗？
messages.en: Has the cash remittance your brother sent arrived?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waslet illum. Se nużawha biex inħallsu l-kera.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waslet illum. Se nużawha biex inħallsu l-kera.
messages.zh: 到了，今天收到的。我们会用它来付房租。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived today. We'll use it to pay the rent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“亲属汇钱、家人收款”的画面一起记：重点是送达他人的一笔钱，可配对记忆“汇出”和“收到”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A collection of miscellaneous small objects, often including things that are unwanted or of little use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一堆种类不一的零碎物件，常包括不需要或没有多少用处的杂物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' oġġetti żgħar u differenti, li spiss tinkludi affarijiet mhux mixtieqa jew ta' ftit użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种类杂乱的零碎物件，不一定没有用处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' affarijiet żgħar u differenti li ma jiffurmawx sett wieħed u li jistgħu jkunu għadhom utli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Odds and ends are various small things collected together, some of which may still be useful.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不再需要、用处很小或被视为废物的一堆杂物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' affarijiet qodma, mhux mixtieqa jew ta' ftit użu li jitqiesu bħala skart.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Junk consists of things that people no longer want or consider useful enough to keep.

collocations.en: a box full of odds and ends

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif tal-maħżen, il-ħaddiema sseparaw ir-rimiżolja mill-għodod li kienu għadhom jintużaw.
formal.en: While cleaning the storeroom, the workers separated the junk from the tools that were still in use.
formal.zh: 清理储藏室时，工人把废旧杂物与仍在使用的工具分开放置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm f'din il-kaxxa? Mark: Rimiżolja: buttuni, ċwievet qodma u biċċiet ta' spag. Forsi xi ħaġa għadha utli.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's in this box? Mark: Odds and ends: buttons, old keys and bits of string. Perhaps something is still useful.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个箱子里有什么？Mark：一些零碎杂物：纽扣、旧钥匙和几段绳子。也许还有能用的东西。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'hemm f'din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: X'hemm f'din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 这个箱子里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this box?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rimiżolja: buttuni, ċwievet qodma u biċċiet ta' spag. Forsi xi ħaġa għadha utli.
messages.mt_standard: Rimiżolja: buttuni, ċwievet qodma u biċċiet ta' spag. Forsi xi ħaġa għadha utli.
messages.zh: 一些零碎杂物：纽扣、旧钥匙和几段绳子。也许还有能用的东西。
messages.en: Odds and ends: buttons, old keys and bits of string. Perhaps something is still useful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个装着纽扣、旧钥匙和绳头的杂物箱：强调东西零散时记“零碎杂物”，强调不再有用时记“废旧杂物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of guilt and regret about something wrong that you have done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自己做了错事而产生的强烈内疚和悔恨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens qawwi ta' ħtija u dispjaċir għal xi ħaġa ħażina li tkun għamilt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对自己做过的错事感到的深切悔恨与良心上的不安。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tbatija fil-kuxjenza u dispjaċir profond minħabba xi ħaġa ħażina li persuna tkun għamlet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Remorse is a deep feeling of guilt and regret that you experience because you have done something wrong.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra ta' apoloġija tiegħu, l-istudent wera rimors talli kien xerred informazzjoni falza dwar sieħbu.
formal.en: In his letter of apology, the student showed remorse for having spread false information about his classmate.
formal.zh: 这名学生在道歉信中，对自己散布有关同学的虚假信息表现出悔意。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex int daqshekk imdejjaq? Luqa: Qed inħoss rimors talli għajjart lil ħija. Se nitolbu skuża.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you so upset? Luqa: I feel remorse for insulting my brother. I'm going to apologize to him.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么这么难过？Luqa：我骂了我弟弟，心里很内疚。我打算向他道歉。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex int daqshekk imdejjaq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex int daqshekk imdejjaq?
messages.zh: 你为什么这么难过？
messages.en: Why are you so upset?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss rimors talli għajjart lil ħija. Se nitolbu skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss rimors talli għajjart lil ħija. Se nitolbu skuża.
messages.zh: 我骂了我弟弟，心里很内疚。我打算向他道歉。
messages.en: I feel remorse for insulting my brother. I'm going to apologize to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“做错事后心里难受，想去道歉”的情境记住 rimors；它强调自己的过错引起的内疚，不只是一般的难过。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A line of people or things arranged next to one another or one behind another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或物按一定次序并排或前后排列形成的一排、一行或一列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Linja ta' nies jew oġġetti mqiegħda ħdejn xulxin jew wieħed wara l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由人或物依次排列形成的一排、一行或一列。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għadd ta' nies jew affarijiet irranġati f'linja, ħdejn xulxin jew wieħed wara l-ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A row is a line of people or things arranged beside one another or one behind another.

formal.mt: L-ewwel ringiela tas-siġġijiet fis-sala kienet riservata għall-kelliema tal-konferenza.
formal.en: The first row of chairs in the hall was reserved for the conference speakers.
formal.zh: 大厅里的第一排椅子预留给了会议发言人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: F'liema ringiela se noqogħdu? Ben: Fit-tielet ringiela. Minn hemm naraw il-palk sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which row are we going to sit in? Ben: In the third row. We'll have a good view of the stage from there.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们坐第几排？Ben：第三排。从那里能清楚地看到舞台。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'liema ringiela se noqogħdu?
messages.mt_standard: F'liema ringiela se noqogħdu?
messages.zh: 我们坐第几排？
messages.en: Which row are we going to sit in?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-tielet ringiela. Minn hemm naraw il-palk sew.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-tielet ringiela. Minn hemm naraw il-palk sew.
messages.zh: 第三排。从那里能清楚地看到舞台。
messages.en: In the third row. We'll have a good view of the stage from there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ringiela 和剧场选座联系起来：眼前一排排椅子，先找第一排，再数到第三排，借排列画面记住“一排、一行”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Well known and admired for a particular quality, achievement, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某种特质、成就或所从事的活动而广为人知并受到赞赏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħruf u stmat minn ħafna nies minħabba xi kwalità, kisba jew attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 著名的；因某方面的优点或成就而享有盛誉的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna, post jew ħaġa rinomata tkun magħrufa u stmata minn ħafna nies għal xi kwalità jew kisba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something renowned is widely known and admired for a particular quality or achievement.

formal.mt: Il-festival stieden kittieb rinomat biex jitkellem dwar il-letteratura għaż-żgħażagħ.
formal.en: The festival invited a renowned writer to speak about literature for young people.
formal.zh: 该文化节邀请了一位著名作家，讲述面向青少年的文学。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex trid tiekol f'dak ir-ristorant? Pawlu: Għax hu rinomat għall-ħut frisk tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you want to eat at that restaurant? Pawlu: Because it is renowned for its fresh fish.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么想去那家餐厅吃饭？保罗：因为它的鲜鱼菜很有名。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid tiekol f'dak ir-ristorant?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid tiekol f'dak ir-ristorant?
messages.zh: 你为什么想去那家餐厅吃饭？
messages.en: Why do you want to eat at that restaurant?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu rinomat għall-ħut frisk tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu rinomat għall-ħut frisk tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为它的鲜鱼菜很有名。
messages.en: Because it is renowned for its fresh fish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rinomat 放在获奖作家或口碑餐厅的图片旁，记成“大家都知道，而且很赞赏”；再用 rinomat għal 练习说明因什么出名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large, heavy mammal with thick skin and one or two horns on its nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种体形庞大、皮肤厚实、鼻部有一只或两只角的哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu kbir u tqil, b'ġilda ħoxna u b'qarn wieħed jew żewġt iqrun fuq imnieħru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犀牛，一种皮厚、鼻部有一只或两只角的大型哺乳动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-rinoċeronte huwa mammiferu kbir b'ġilda ħoxna u b'qarn wieħed jew żewġt iqrun fuq imnieħru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rhinoceros is a large mammal with thick skin and one or two horns on its nose.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw ir-rinoċeronte u kitbu deskrizzjoni tal-ġilda ħoxna tiegħu.
formal.en: The students observed the rhinoceros and wrote a description of its thick skin.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了犀牛，并写下了对其厚实皮肤的描述。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak ir-rinoċeronte ħdejn is-siġra! Mark: Rajtu! Kemm għandu ġilda ħoxna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that rhinoceros beside the tree! Mark: I see it! What thick skin it has!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树旁边那头犀牛！马克：看到了！它的皮可真厚啊！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak ir-rinoċeronte ħdejn is-siġra!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak ir-rinoċeronte ħdejn is-siġra!
messages.zh: 看树旁边那头犀牛！
messages.en: Look at that rhinoceros beside the tree!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu! Kemm għandu ġilda ħoxna!
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu! Kemm għandu ġilda ħoxna!
messages.zh: 看到了！它的皮可真厚啊！
messages.en: I see it! What thick skin it has!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rinoċeronte 配上一张鼻上长角、身披厚皮的犀牛图，再朗读短语 rinoċeronte adult，用形象和短语一起记住。

gloss_zh: 遣返；送返本国；回国安置

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of returning someone to their own country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将身在国外的人送返其本国的过程，可依具体情境译为遣返或协助回国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna li tinsab barra minn pajjiżha tintbagħat jew tittieħed lura lejn pajjiżha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将人送返其本国的过程；具体可指遣返或安排回国，本词本身不限定是否出于自愿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-ripatrijazzjoni hija l-proċess li bih persuna terġa' titwassal lejn pajjiżha wara li tkun tinsab f'pajjiż ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Repatriation is the process of sending or bringing someone back to their own country.

formal.mt: L-ambaxxata għenet fl-organizzazzjoni tar-ripatrijazzjoni taċ-ċittadini li talbu li jirritornaw lejn pajjiżhom.
formal.en: The embassy helped organize the repatriation of citizens who had asked to return to their country.
formal.zh: 大使馆协助安排了提出回国请求的公民返回本国。

colloquial.mt: Anna: L-ambaxxata se tgħinna mmorru lura d-dar? David: Iva, qed torganizza r-ripatrijazzjoni tagħna u se tibgħatilna d-dettalji.
colloquial.en: Anna: Will the embassy help us get back home? David: Yes, it is organizing our repatriation and will send us the details.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：大使馆会帮助我们回国吗？戴维：会，他们正在安排我们回国，会把具体信息发给我们。

messages.speaker: Anna (身在国外的旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ambaxxata se tgħinna mmorru lura d-dar?
messages.mt_standard: L-ambaxxata se tgħinna mmorru lura d-dar?
messages.zh: 大使馆会帮助我们回国吗？
messages.en: Will the embassy help us get back home?

messages.speaker: David (同行旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed torganizza r-ripatrijazzjoni tagħna u se tibgħatilna d-dettalji.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed torganizza r-ripatrijazzjoni tagħna u se tibgħatilna d-dettalji.
messages.zh: 会，他们正在安排我们回国，会把具体信息发给我们。
messages.en: Yes, it is organizing our repatriation and will send us the details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上一支箭头从国外指回本国，把整个返国安排标成 ripatrijazzjoni；搭配 volontarja 时记作“自愿回国”。

gloss_zh: 未使用的结转额；未动用的结转部分

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unused amount or allocation carried forward from an earlier period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从前一期间结转而来、尚未使用的金额或配额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont jew kwota li jkunu ġew trasferiti minn perjodu preċedenti għal perjodu sussegwenti u li jkunu għadhom ma ntużawx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从先前期间转入后续期间、仍未动用的结转金额或配额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riport mhux użat huwa ammont jew kwota miġjuba minn perjodu preċedenti li jkunu għadhom disponibbli għax ma ntużawx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Unused carry-overs are amounts or allocations transferred from an earlier period that have not been used.

collocations.en: the balance of the unused carry-over
the use of the unused carry-over
collocations.zh: 对未动用结转额的使用

formal.mt: Ir-rapport finanzjarju juri riport mhux użat ta' mitejn ewro mis-sena ta' qabel.
formal.en: The financial report shows an unused carry-over of two hundred euros from the previous year.
formal.zh: 财务报告显示，上年度结转的金额中有两百欧元尚未使用。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għad fadal xi flus mis-sena l-oħra? Toni: Iva, għandna riport mhux użat ta' mitejn ewro.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is there any money left from last year? Toni: Yes, we have an unused carry-over of two hundred euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：去年还有钱结余下来吗？托尼：有，我们有两百欧元的结转额还没用。

messages.speaker: Marija (社团负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal xi flus mis-sena l-oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal xi flus mis-sena l-oħra?
messages.zh: 去年还有钱结余下来吗？
messages.en: Is there any money left from last year?

messages.speaker: Toni (社团财务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna riport mhux użat ta' mitejn ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna riport mhux użat ta' mitejn ewro.
messages.zh: 有，我们有两百欧元的结转额还没用。
messages.en: Yes, we have an unused carry-over of two hundred euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出“上期余额移到本期”的箭头，再给余额贴上“尚未使用”的标签；把整个画面对应到 riport mhux użat，记牢结转与未用两层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of rest during which someone pauses work or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂时停止工作或活动、让身心得到休息的一段时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' mistrieħ li fih persuna tieqaf mix-xogħol jew minn attività biex tistrieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 休息；通过暂停工作或活动来恢复精力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mistrieħ li persuna tieħu billi twaqqaf ix-xogħol jew attività għal xi żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ripozizzjoni is rest taken when someone stops working or being active for a while.

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi ħin ta' ripozizzjoni bejn attività u oħra.
formal.en: The programme includes time for rest between activities.
formal.zh: 该日程在各项活动之间安排了休息时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għajjiena wara dak il-mixi kollu? Rita: Iva, għandi bżonn ftit ripozizzjoni qabel inkompli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you tired after all that walking? Rita: Yes, I need a little rest before I carry on.
colloquial.zh: Maja：走了那么多路，你累了吗？Rita：是的，我需要稍微休息一下再继续。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għajjiena wara dak il-mixi kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Għajjiena wara dak il-mixi kollu?
messages.zh: 走了那么多路，你累了吗？
messages.en: Are you tired after all that walking?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi bżonn ftit ripozizzjoni qabel inkompli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi bżonn ftit ripozizzjoni qabel inkompli.
messages.zh: 是的，我需要稍微休息一下再继续。
messages.en: Yes, I need a little rest before I carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“走累后坐下休息”的画面中记忆，并搭配 ħin ta' ripozizzjoni，记住它在本条中表示休息。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small wave moving across the surface of water or another liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在水或其他液体表面传播的小波浪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mewġa żgħira li timxi fuq wiċċ l-ilma jew ta' likwidu ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 波纹；液体表面起伏传播的小波浪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mewġa żgħira fuq wiċċ likwidu, bħall-ilma f'għadira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ripple is a small wave that travels across the surface of a liquid.

formal.mt: Meta l-qatra waqgħet fl-ilma, deher ripple fuq il-wiċċ.
formal.en: When the drop fell into the water, a ripple appeared on the surface.
formal.zh: 水滴落入水中时，水面上出现了一道波纹。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Rajt dak ir-ripple fuq l-ilma? Maja: Iva, deher meta waqgħet werqa fl-għadira.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you see that ripple on the water? Maja: Yes, it appeared when a leaf fell into the pond.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你看到水面上那道波纹了吗？Maja：看到了，是一片叶子落进池塘时出现的。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt dak ir-ripple fuq l-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt dak ir-ripple fuq l-ilma?
messages.zh: 你看到水面上那道波纹了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that ripple on the water?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, deher meta waqgħet werqa fl-għadira.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, deher meta waqgħet werqa fl-għadira.
messages.zh: 看到了，是一片叶子落进池塘时出现的。
messages.en: Yes, it appeared when a leaf fell into the pond.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象叶子落进池塘后水面荡开一圈涟漪，把 ripple 与“水面上的小波纹”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made again as a copy or representation of an original.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过复制或再现原件而制成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmul mill-ġdid bħala kopja jew rappreżentazzjoni ta' oriġinal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被复制或再现的；由原件制作出来的。
