sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie kkupjat jew maħluq mill-ġdid biex jirrappreżenta l-oriġinal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as riprodott has been made again as a copy or representation of an original.

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt oriġinali ġie riprodott fil-katalgu biex il-qarrejja jkunu jistgħu jaraw id-dettalji tiegħu.
formal.en: The original photograph was reproduced in the catalogue so that readers could see its details.
formal.zh: 原始照片被复制刊载在目录中，以便读者查看其细节。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan hu r-ritratt oriġinali? Mark: Le, dan hu ritratt riprodott; l-oriġinal qiegħed fl-album.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is this the original photograph? Mark: No, this is a reproduced photograph; the original is in the album.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这是原始照片吗？Mark：不是，这是复制的照片；原件在相册里。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu r-ritratt oriġinali?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu r-ritratt oriġinali?
messages.zh: 这是原始照片吗？
messages.en: Is this the original photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan hu ritratt riprodott; l-oriġinal qiegħed fl-album.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan hu ritratt riprodott; l-oriġinal qiegħed fl-album.
messages.zh: 不是，这是复制的照片；原件在相册里。
messages.en: No, this is a reproduced photograph; the original is in the album.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象相册里的原照旁边放着一张复制照片，用 ritratt riprodott 把“照片”和“复制的”连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Reserve power capacity activated automatically to restore the frequency of an electricity system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过自动激活来恢复电力系统频率的备用功率容量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kapaċità ta' riżerva tal-enerġija elettrika li tiġi attivata awtomatikament biex il-frekwenza tas-sistema terġa' lura għall-valur mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自动频率恢复备用；自动激活以恢复电力系统频率的备用容量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riżerva ta' kapaċità elettrika li tiġi attivata awtomatikament biex tgħin terġa' tiġi stabbilita l-frekwenza mixtieqa tas-sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Automatic FRR is reserve power capacity that is activated automatically to help restore an electricity system's frequency.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自动频率恢复备用；用于通过自动调节功率使电力系统频率恢复至目标值的备用容量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kapaċità elettrika miżmuma f'riżerva biex, permezz ta' aġġustament awtomatiku tal-potenza, tgħin il-frekwenza tas-sistema terġa' tilħaq il-valur mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An automatic frequency restoration reserve provides power capacity that can be adjusted automatically to bring system frequency back towards its target.

collocations.en: activation of the automatic frequency restoration reserve
collocations.zh: 自动频率恢复备用的激活

collocations.mt: kapaċità disponibbli għar-riserva tar-restawr tal-frekwenza awtomatika
collocations.en: capacity available for automatic frequency restoration reserve
collocations.zh: 可用于自动频率恢复备用的容量

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif ir-riserva tar-restawr tal-frekwenza awtomatika tiġi attivata biex tgħin il-frekwenza tas-sistema terġa' lura għall-valur mixtieq.
formal.en: The report describes how the automatic frequency restoration reserve is activated to help system frequency return to its target value.
formal.zh: 报告说明了如何激活自动频率恢复备用，帮助系统频率恢复至目标值。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tagħmel ir-riserva tar-restawr tal-frekwenza awtomatika? Mark: Taġġusta l-potenza awtomatikament biex tgħin il-frekwenza terġa' lura għall-valur mixtieq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the automatic frequency restoration reserve do? Mark: It adjusts power automatically to help frequency return to its target value.
colloquial.zh: Maja：自动频率恢复备用有什么作用？Mark：它会自动调节功率，帮助频率恢复至目标值。

messages.speaker: Maja (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tagħmel ir-riserva tar-restawr tal-frekwenza awtomatika?
messages.mt_standard: X'tagħmel ir-riserva tar-restawr tal-frekwenza awtomatika?
messages.zh: 自动频率恢复备用有什么作用？
messages.en: What does the automatic frequency restoration reserve do?

messages.speaker: Mark (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Taġġusta l-potenza awtomatikament biex tgħin il-frekwenza terġa' lura għall-valur mixtieq.
messages.mt_standard: Taġġusta l-potenza awtomatikament biex tgħin il-frekwenza terġa' lura għall-valur mixtieq.
messages.zh: 它会自动调节功率，帮助频率恢复至目标值。
messages.en: It adjusts power automatically to help frequency return to its target value.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“预留容量—自动调功率—频率回目标”这幅流程图记住整个术语，再将完整马耳他语词组与中文“自动频率恢复备用”配对朗读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Reserve power activated manually to help restore the frequency of an electricity system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过人工启动、用于帮助电力系统恢复频率的备用功率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riżerva ta' potenza li tiġi attivata manwalment biex tgħin terġa' ġġib il-frekwenza tas-sistema tal-elettriku għal-livell meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手动频率恢复备用，即通过人工启动来帮助恢复电力系统频率的备用功率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riżerva ta' potenza attivata manwalment biex tgħin fir-restawr tal-frekwenza tas-sistema tal-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Manual FRR is reserve power that is activated manually to help restore the frequency of an electricity system.

collocations.zh: 手动频率恢复备用的启动
手动频率恢复备用的可用性

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċedura għall-attivazzjoni tar-riserva tar-restawr tal-frekwenza manwali.
formal.en: The report describes the procedure for activating manual FRR.
formal.zh: 该报告说明了启动手动频率恢复备用的程序。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhi r-riserva tar-restawr tal-frekwenza manwali? Pawlu: Hija riżerva ta' potenza li tiġi attivata manwalment biex tgħin terġa' ġġib il-frekwenza għal-livell meħtieġ.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is manual FRR? Pawlu: It is reserve power that is activated manually to help bring the frequency back to the required level.
colloquial.zh: Marta：什么是手动频率恢复备用？Pawlu：它是通过人工启动的备用功率，用来帮助频率恢复到所需水平。

messages.speaker: Marta (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi r-riserva tar-restawr tal-frekwenza manwali?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi r-riserva tar-restawr tal-frekwenza manwali?
messages.zh: 什么是手动频率恢复备用？
messages.en: What is manual FRR?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (培训师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija riżerva ta' potenza li tiġi attivata manwalment biex tgħin terġa' ġġib il-frekwenza għal-livell meħtieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Hija riżerva ta' potenza li tiġi attivata manwalment biex tgħin terġa' ġġib il-frekwenza għal-livell meħtieġ.
messages.zh: 它是通过人工启动的备用功率，用来帮助频率恢复到所需水平。
messages.en: It is reserve power that is activated manually to help bring the frequency back to the required level.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条术语记成“备用功率—恢复频率—人工启动”三步画面，想象操作员启动备用来帮助频率恢复；这是意义联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capacity kept available to support a system when additional resources are needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为系统保留、在需要额外资源时可投入使用的备用容量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kapaċità li tinżamm disponibbli biex tappoġġa sistema meta jkun hemm bżonn ta' riżorsi addizzjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系统备用，即为满足系统额外需要而保留的可用容量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kapaċità ta' riżerva miżmuma disponibbli għall-ħtiġijiet addizzjonali ta' sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A system reserve is capacity kept available for use when a system needs additional resources.

collocations.en: the level of the system reserve
the increase in the system reserve

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri l-livell tar-riserva tas-sistema u jispjega jekk hemmx bżonn ta' kapaċità addizzjonali.
formal.en: The report shows the level of the system reserve and explains whether additional capacity is needed.
formal.zh: 该报告列出系统备用水平，并说明是否需要额外容量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed niċċekkjaw ir-riserva tas-sistema? Mark: Biex inkunu nafu kemm hemm kapaċità disponibbli jekk ikollna bżonn aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are we checking the system reserve? Mark: So we know how much capacity is available if we need more.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们为什么要检查系统备用？Mark：这样就能知道，需要更多容量时有多少可以使用。

messages.speaker: Lara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed niċċekkjaw ir-riserva tas-sistema?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed niċċekkjaw ir-riserva tas-sistema?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要检查系统备用？
messages.en: Why are we checking the system reserve?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inkunu nafu kemm hemm kapaċità disponibbli jekk ikollna bżonn aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inkunu nafu kemm hemm kapaċità disponibbli jekk ikollna bżonn aktar.
messages.zh: 这样就能知道，需要更多容量时有多少可以使用。
messages.en: So we know how much capacity is available if we need more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象系统旁边留着一格“备用容量”，需要时就能取用；把整个短语与“给系统留余量”的画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of a telephone that you hold to your ear to hear the person speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打电话时放在耳边、用来听对方说话的听筒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tat-telefon li żżomm ma' widintek biex tisma' lill-persuna li tkun qed tkellmek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话听筒，即通话时放在耳边以听取对方声音的部件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti tat-telefon li titqiegħed ma' widintek sabiex tkun tista' tisma' leħen il-persuna fuq in-naħa l-oħra tal-linja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A telephone receiver is the part of a telephone that you hold to your ear to hear the other person.

collocations.en: to pick up the telephone receiver
to put down the telephone receiver

formal.mt: L-impjegata refgħet ir-risiver u wieġbet it-telefon b'mod edukat.
formal.en: The employee picked up the receiver and answered the telephone politely.
formal.zh: 这名员工拿起听筒，礼貌地接听了电话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-telefon qed idoqq. Tista' terfa' r-risiver? Toni: Iva, se nwieġeb jien.
colloquial.en: Maja: The phone is ringing. Can you pick up the receiver? Toni: Yes, I'll answer it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电话响了。你能拿起听筒吗？Toni：可以，我来接。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-telefon qed idoqq. Tista' terfa' r-risiver?
messages.mt_standard: It-telefon qed idoqq. Tista' terfa' r-risiver?
messages.zh: 电话响了。你能拿起听筒吗？
messages.en: The phone is ringing. Can you pick up the receiver?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nwieġeb jien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nwieġeb jien.
messages.zh: 可以，我来接。
messages.en: Yes, I'll answer it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上电话响起，你拿起听筒贴到耳边，把 risiver 与这个动作绑定；再配对记住“拿起听筒”和“放下听筒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change in active power output in response to a change in the frequency of an electricity system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电力系统频率发生变化时，有功功率输出随之作出的调整。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla fil-potenza attiva prodotta bħala reazzjoni għal bidla fil-frekwenza tas-sistema tal-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有功功率频率响应，即有功功率输出针对电力系统频率变化作出的调整。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-reazzjoni tal-potenza attiva prodotta għal tibdil fil-frekwenza tas-sistema tal-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Active power frequency response is the adjustment of active power output in response to changes in an electricity system's frequency.

collocations.en: the measurement of active power frequency response
collocations.zh: 有功功率频率响应的测量

collocations.en: the assessment of active power frequency response
collocations.zh: 有功功率频率响应的评估

formal.mt: Matul it-test, ġie mkejjel ir-rispons tal-frekwenza tal-potenza attiva billi ġew irreġistrati l-bidliet fil-frekwenza u fil-potenza attiva prodotta.
formal.en: During the test, active power frequency response was measured by recording changes in frequency and active power output.
formal.zh: 测试期间，通过记录频率和有功功率输出的变化，测量了有功功率频率响应。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qed nuru b'din il-graff? David: Ir-rispons tal-frekwenza tal-potenza attiva, jiġifieri kif tinbidel il-potenza attiva prodotta meta tinbidel il-frekwenza.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are we showing with this graph? David: Active power frequency response, meaning how active power output changes when the frequency changes.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这张图展示的是什么？David：有功功率频率响应，也就是频率变化时，有功功率输出如何随之变化。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed nuru b'din il-graff?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed nuru b'din il-graff?
messages.zh: 这张图展示的是什么？
messages.en: What are we showing with this graph?

messages.speaker: David (培训师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rispons tal-frekwenza tal-potenza attiva, jiġifieri kif tinbidel il-potenza attiva prodotta meta tinbidel il-frekwenza.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rispons tal-frekwenza tal-potenza attiva, jiġifieri kif tinbidel il-potenza attiva prodotta meta tinbidel il-frekwenza.
messages.zh: 有功功率频率响应，也就是频率变化时，有功功率输出如何随之变化。
messages.en: Active power frequency response, meaning how active power output changes when the frequency changes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个相连的框：“频率变化”指向“有功功率调整”。用这条因果箭头记住整个术语，并把“有功功率”作为一个完整概念记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where people pay to eat meals prepared and served there.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为顾客烹制并供应餐食、由顾客付费用餐的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jitħejja u jiġi servut l-ikel lil klijenti li jħallsu biex jieklu hemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向顾客提供餐食并收取费用的餐馆或餐厅。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ristorant huwa post fejn il-klijenti jħallsu biex jieklu ikliet imħejjija u servuti hemmhekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A restaurant is a place where you can buy and eat a meal.

collocations.en: to book a table at a restaurant

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti se jieklu f'ristorant qrib is-sala tal-konferenza.
formal.en: The participants will eat at a restaurant near the conference hall.
formal.zh: 与会者将在会议厅附近的一家餐馆用餐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid nieklu f'ristorant illejla? Mark: Iva, imma ejja nibbukkjaw mejda qabel immorru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we eat at a restaurant tonight? Mark: Yes, but let's book a table before we go.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚我们去餐馆吃饭好吗？Mark：好，不过出发前先订张桌子吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nieklu f'ristorant illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid nieklu f'ristorant illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚我们去餐馆吃饭好吗？
messages.en: Shall we eat at a restaurant tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja nibbukkjaw mejda qabel immorru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja nibbukkjaw mejda qabel immorru.
messages.zh: 好，不过出发前先订张桌子吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's book a table before we go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ristorant 放进“订桌、点餐、结账”的场景中记忆；想到付费用餐的地方，就联想到这个词。

gloss_zh: 受限制的；限于特定范围的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Limited by rules or conditions, especially regarding who may enter or use something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到规则或条件限制的，尤指进入或使用的资格受到限制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun limitat b'regoli jew kundizzjonijiet, speċjalment dwar min jista' jidħol jew juża xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受规则、条件或许可范围约束的；并非人人都可进入或使用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun ristretta meta regoli jew kundizzjonijiet jillimitaw min jista' jużaha jew ikollu aċċess għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If access or use is restricted, rules limit who is allowed to enter or use something.

collocations.zh: 受限制的访问或进入权限

formal.mt: L-aċċess għal dan l-arkivju huwa ristrett għall-persunal awtorizzat.
formal.en: Access to this archive is restricted to authorized staff.
formal.zh: 该档案库仅限获授权的工作人员进入。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu nidħlu hawn? Pawlu: Le, l-aċċess huwa ristrett għall-ħaddiema.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we go in here? Pawlu: No, access is restricted to employees.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们能进去这里吗？Pawlu：不能，这里只允许员工进入。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nidħlu hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nidħlu hawn?
messages.zh: 我们能进去这里吗？
messages.en: Can we go in here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-aċċess huwa ristrett għall-ħaddiema.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-aċċess huwa ristrett għall-ħaddiema.
messages.zh: 不能，这里只允许员工进入。
messages.en: No, access is restricted to employees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到“仅限员工”的门牌，就联想 aċċess ristrett；用一道门和一条准入规则记住“受限制的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ceremony or set of ceremonial actions performed according to religious or traditional rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照宗教或传统规定举行的仪式，或其中一套固定的礼仪行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċerimonja jew sensiela ta' għemejjel ċerimonjali li jsiru skont regoli reliġjużi jew tradizzjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依照宗教或传统惯例进行的仪式或礼仪程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rit huwa ċerimonja, jew parti minn ċerimonja, li ssir b'mod stabbilit skont reliġjon jew tradizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rite is a ceremony performed according to the customs of a religion or community.

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi rit tradizzjonali li jsir kull sena fil-komunità.
formal.en: The study describes a traditional rite performed annually in the community.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了该社群每年举行的一项传统仪式。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex kulħadd qed jixgħel xemgħa? Rita: Dan jagħmel parti mir-rit li qed isir illum.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is everyone lighting a candle? Rita: This is part of the rite being performed today.
colloquial.zh: Nina：为什么大家都在点蜡烛？Rita：这是今天举行的仪式的一部分。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd qed jixgħel xemgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd qed jixgħel xemgħa?
messages.zh: 为什么大家都在点蜡烛？
messages.en: Why is everyone lighting a candle?

messages.speaker: Rita (向导)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan jagħmel parti mir-rit li qed isir illum.
messages.mt_standard: Dan jagħmel parti mir-rit li qed isir illum.
messages.zh: 这是今天举行的仪式的一部分。
messages.en: This is part of the rite being performed today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rit 想成一张仪式流程卡：按固定次序完成礼仪动作；用“依照传统举行仪式”的画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a clear, regular pattern of beats, sounds, or movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 节拍、声音或动作具有清晰而有规律的重复形式的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu taħbit, ħsejjes jew movimenti li jirrepetu ruħhom b'ritmu ċar u regolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声音或动作具有规律节拍或韵律的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħoss jew moviment ikun ritmiku meta jsegwi sekwenza regolari ta' taħbit jew movimenti ripetuti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rhythmic sound or movement follows a regular pattern that you can hear or feel.

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jinkludi moviment ritmiku tad-dirgħajn flimkien ma' mużika bil-mod.
formal.en: The exercise includes rhythmic arm movement accompanied by slow music.
formal.zh: 这项练习包括配合舒缓音乐进行的有节奏的手臂动作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tisma' dak it-taħbit ritmiku? Mark: Iva, ejja nċapċpu miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear that rhythmic beat? Mark: Yes, let's clap along with it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听到那有规律的节拍了吗？Mark：听到了，我们跟着拍手吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tisma' dak it-taħbit ritmiku?
messages.mt_standard: Tisma' dak it-taħbit ritmiku?
messages.zh: 你听到那有规律的节拍了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that rhythmic beat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nċapċpu miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nċapċpu miegħu.
messages.zh: 听到了，我们跟着拍手吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's clap along with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 一边均匀拍手，一边说 taħbit ritmiku；把反复出现的稳定节拍与“有节奏的”直接联系起来。

gloss_zh: 支付退单；交易款项撤回

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reversal of a payment through which money is returned to the payer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过撤销原支付交易，将交易款项退回付款人的处理过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess li bih ħlas jiġi mreġġa' lura u l-flus jingħataw lura lil min ikun ħallas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 支付退单，即撤销先前的支付交易并将款项退回付款人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Treġġigħ lura ta' ħlas li jkun sar, sabiex il-flus jingħataw lura lil min ikun ħallas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A charge back occurs when a payment is reversed and the money is returned to the person who paid.

formal.mt: Il-klijent ressaq talba għal ritrasferiment wara li nnota ħlas li ma kienx awtorizza.
formal.en: The customer submitted a chargeback request after noticing a payment that he had not authorized.
formal.zh: 客户发现一笔未经其授权的支付后，提交了退单申请。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hemm ħlas li ma għamiltx jien. Nista' nitlob ritrasferiment? Lara: Iva, nistgħu nirreġistraw it-talba u niċċekkjaw il-ħlas.
colloquial.en: Mark: There is a payment I did not make. Can I request a chargeback? Lara: Yes, we can register your request and check the payment.
colloquial.zh: 马克：有一笔支付不是我操作的。我可以申请退单吗？拉拉：可以，我们可以登记你的申请并核查这笔支付。

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħlas li ma għamiltx jien. Nista' nitlob ritrasferiment?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħlas li ma għamiltx jien. Nista' nitlob ritrasferiment?
messages.zh: 有一笔支付不是我操作的。我可以申请退单吗？
messages.en: There is a payment I did not make. Can I request a chargeback?

messages.speaker: Lara (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nirreġistraw it-talba u niċċekkjaw il-ħlas.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nirreġistraw it-talba u niċċekkjaw il-ħlas.
messages.zh: 可以，我们可以登记你的申请并核查这笔支付。
messages.en: Yes, we can register your request and check the payment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用付款箭头倒转的画面记忆：钱原本付出去，退单后沿反方向回到付款人账户。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of coming or going back to a place where someone has been before.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 回到先前所在地点的行为或过程；此处作为名词使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jerġa' jiġi jew imur f'post fejn kien qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 返回或归来，即回到先前所在的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li persuna terġa' tasal f'post li kienet telqet minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's return is their arrival back at a place where they were previously.

formal.mt: Skont il-programm, ir-rittorna tal-grupp lejn Malta huwa ppjanat għall-Ħadd filgħaxija.
formal.en: According to the programme, the group's return to Malta is planned for Sunday evening.
formal.zh: 根据行程安排，团队计划于星期日晚上返回马耳他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta hu r-rittorna tagħkom lejn Malta? Pawlu: Il-Ħadd filgħaxija. Nixtiequ narawk it-Tnejn!
colloquial.en: Maja: When is your return to Malta? Pawlu: Sunday evening. We would like to see you on Monday!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们什么时候返回马耳他？保罗：星期日晚上。我们想星期一见你！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta hu r-rittorna tagħkom lejn Malta?
messages.mt_standard: Meta hu r-rittorna tagħkom lejn Malta?
messages.zh: 你们什么时候返回马耳他？
messages.en: When is your return to Malta?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅行中的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-Ħadd filgħaxija. Nixtiequ narawk it-Tnejn!
messages.mt_standard: Il-Ħadd filgħaxija. Nixtiequ narawk it-Tnejn!
messages.zh: 星期日晚上。我们想星期一见你！
messages.en: Sunday evening. We would like to see you on Monday!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把行程画成去程和回程两支箭头，本条用名词记住其中的返回这一程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A relationship in which people or groups compete with one another for success or an advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或群体为了成功、优势或同一目标而相互竞争的关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Relazzjoni ta' kompetizzjoni bejn persuni jew gruppi li jippruvaw jiksbu suċċess jew vantaġġ fuq xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对手之间争取成功、优势或同一目标的竞争关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni bejn żewġ persuni jew gruppi, jew aktar, li kull wieħed minnhom irid ikun aħjar jew jikseb aktar mill-oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rivalry is a situation in which people or groups compete because they want the same success or advantage.

collocations.zh: 两支球队之间的竞争关系

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-rivalità bejn iż-żewġ klabbs u l-effett tagħha fuq l-attendenza għal-logħob.
formal.en: The report describes the rivalry between the two clubs and its effect on attendance at matches.
formal.zh: 报告描述了两家俱乐部之间的竞争关系，以及这种关系对比赛上座人数的影响。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm rivalità qawwija bejn it-tim tiegħek u tiegħi! Mark: Veru, imma wara l-logħba xorta nieħdu kafè flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: There is intense rivalry between your team and mine! Mark: True, but we still have coffee together after the match.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你支持的球队和我支持的球队竞争可激烈了！马克：确实，不过比赛结束后我们照样一起喝咖啡。

messages.speaker: Sara (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm rivalità qawwija bejn it-tim tiegħek u tiegħi!
messages.mt_standard: Hemm rivalità qawwija bejn it-tim tiegħek u tiegħi!
messages.zh: 你支持的球队和我支持的球队竞争可激烈了！
messages.en: There is intense rivalry between your team and mine!

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, imma wara l-logħba xorta nieħdu kafè flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, imma wara l-logħba xorta nieħdu kafè flimkien.
messages.zh: 确实，不过比赛结束后我们照样一起喝咖啡。
messages.en: True, but we still have coffee together after the match.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两支球队同时伸手争夺一座奖杯，用共同目标与彼此较劲记住竞争关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Changed after being examined in order to correct, improve, or update it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过检查后，为纠错、完善或更新内容而作了修改的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie eżaminat u mibdul sabiex jiġu kkoreġuti żbalji, jitjieb il-kontenut jew tiġi aġġornata l-informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修订过的；经检查后作了纠正、改进或更新的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun sarulu tibdiliet wara eżami, bil-għan li jkun aktar korrett, aħjar jew aġġornat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A revised document or plan has been changed after examination to correct, improve, or update it.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva l-pjan rivedut wara li ġew ikkoreġuti l-iżbalji fid-dati.
formal.en: The committee approved the revised plan after the errors in the dates had been corrected.
formal.zh: 日期错误得到纠正后，委员会批准了修订后的计划。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan hu r-rapport rivedut? Pawlu: Iva, ikkoreġejt iċ-ċifri u żidt l-aħħar informazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this the revised report? Pawlu: Yes, I corrected the figures and added the latest information.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是修订后的报告吗？保罗：是的，我纠正了数字，也补充了最新信息。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu r-rapport rivedut?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu r-rapport rivedut?
messages.zh: 这是修订后的报告吗？
messages.en: Is this the revised report?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (报告撰写人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ikkoreġejt iċ-ċifri u żidt l-aħħar informazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ikkoreġejt iċ-ċifri u żidt l-aħħar informazzjoni.
messages.zh: 是的，我纠正了数字，也补充了最新信息。
messages.en: Yes, I corrected the figures and added the latest information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报告上的红笔修改已经落实，手中的新版本就是修订后的报告；可连读记忆 rapport rivedut。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The disclosure of something previously unknown, especially something surprising or important.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将原先不为人知的事情揭示出来，尤指令人惊讶或具有重要意义的真相。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kxif ta' xi ħaġa li qabel ma kinitx magħrufa, speċjalment jekk tkun sorprendenti jew importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原先未知的事实或秘密的揭示；被揭示出来的惊人真相。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kxif ta' fatt jew sigriet li qabel ma kienx magħruf, jew l-informazzjoni sorprendenti li tinkixef.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A revelation is information that becomes known and surprises people because it was previously hidden or unknown.

formal.mt: Ir-rivelazzjoni ta' dawn il-fatti wasslet lill-kumitat biex jerġa' jeżamina l-każ.
formal.en: The revelation of these facts led the committee to re-examine the case.
formal.zh: 这些事实的披露促使委员会重新审查该案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kont taf li Lara kitbet dak il-ktieb? Pawlu: Le! Din kienet rivelazzjoni għalija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you know that Lara wrote that book? Pawlu: No! That was a revelation to me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你知道那本书是Lara写的吗？Pawlu：不知道！这对我来说可是个意外的新发现。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont taf li Lara kitbet dak il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Kont taf li Lara kitbet dak il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 你知道那本书是Lara写的吗？
messages.en: Did you know that Lara wrote that book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le! Din kienet rivelazzjoni għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Le! Din kienet rivelazzjoni għalija.
messages.zh: 不知道！这对我来说可是个意外的新发现。
messages.en: No! That was a revelation to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象揭开遮布后突然看见真相，把 rivelazzjoni 与“原来如此”的惊讶场景联系起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or business that buys products in order to sell them again to customers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 购入商品后再出售给顾客的个人或商家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew negozju li jixtri prodotti biex imbagħad ibigħhom mill-ġdid lill-klijenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从其他供应方购入商品，再将商品出售给顾客的个人或企业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tixtri prodotti mingħand fornitur u terġa' tbigħhom lill-klijenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reseller is a person or business that buys goods from another supplier and sells them again to customers.

formal.mt: Il-klijenti jistgħu jixtru l-prodott mingħand rivenditur awtorizzat u jitolbu rċevuta tax-xiri.
formal.en: Customers can purchase the product from an authorized reseller and request a receipt.
formal.zh: 顾客可以向授权经销商购买该产品，并索取购物收据。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ħanut jagħmel il-kompjuters hu? Sara: Le, huwa rivenditur. Jixtrihom mingħand il-manifattur u jerġa' jbigħhom.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this shop make the computers itself? Sara: No, it is a reseller. It buys them from the manufacturer and sells them again.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这家店自己生产电脑吗？Sara：不，它是经销商。它从制造商那里购入电脑，再出售出去。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħanut jagħmel il-kompjuters hu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħanut jagħmel il-kompjuters hu?
messages.zh: 这家店自己生产电脑吗？
messages.en: Does this shop make the computers itself?

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa rivenditur. Jixtrihom mingħand il-manifattur u jerġa' jbigħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa rivenditur. Jixtrihom mingħand il-manifattur u jerġa' jbigħhom.
messages.zh: 不，它是经销商。它从制造商那里购入电脑，再出售出去。
messages.en: No, it is a reseller. It buys them from the manufacturer and sells them again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出“供应商→店家→顾客”的商品流向，把中间负责购入再出售的店家标成 rivenditur。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A publication issued regularly, containing articles and often pictures on general or specialized subjects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 定期发行、刊载综合性或专业性文章且常附有图片的出版物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pubblikazzjoni li toħroġ regolarment u tinkludi artikli, u spiss stampi, dwar suġġetti ġenerali jew speċjalizzati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂志，通常定期出版，刊载面向特定读者或围绕特定主题的文章和图片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pubblikazzjoni li toħroġ regolarment u fiha artikli u stampi għal qarrejja b'interessi partikolari jew dwar diversi suġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A magazine is a publication containing articles and often photographs, usually produced regularly for readers with particular interests.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 期刊，按一定周期连续发行的出版物，强调其定期出版的性质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pubblikazzjoni li toħroġ f'ħarġiet suċċessivi f'intervalli regolari, bħal kull xahar jew kull tliet xhur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A periodical is a publication that appears in successive issues at regular intervals.

formal.mt: Il-librerija tirċievi kull ħarġa ta' din ir-rivista xjentifika u żżommha disponibbli għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The library receives every issue of this scientific periodical and keeps it available to students.
formal.zh: 图书馆接收这本科学期刊的每一期，并将其保存供学生查阅。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek xi ħaġa x'naqra fuq il-ferrovija? Luqa: Iva, ħu din ir-rivista. Fiha artiklu sabiħ dwar l-ivvjaġġar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you got something I can read on the train? Luqa: Yes, take this magazine. It has a nice article about travel.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你有可以让我在火车上读的东西吗？Luqa：有，拿这本杂志吧。里面有篇很不错的旅行文章。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xi ħaġa x'naqra fuq il-ferrovija?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xi ħaġa x'naqra fuq il-ferrovija?
messages.zh: 你有可以让我在火车上读的东西吗？
messages.en: Have you got something I can read on the train?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din ir-rivista. Fiha artiklu sabiħ dwar l-ivvjaġġar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din ir-rivista. Fiha artiklu sabiħ dwar l-ivvjaġġar.
messages.zh: 有，拿这本杂志吧。里面有篇很不错的旅行文章。
messages.en: Yes, take this magazine. It has a nice article about travel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象书架上按月份排列的一排杂志，用 rivista 同时联想“翻阅文章”和“定期出新一期”。

gloss_zh: 革命的；带来根本变革的（复数形容词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with a revolution, or introducing a major and fundamental change; used with plural nouns.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与革命有关的，或引入重大而根本性改变的；用于修饰复数名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandhom x'jaqsmu ma' rivoluzzjoni jew li jġibu bidla kbira u fundamentali; din il-forma tintuża ma' nomi fil-plural.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 革命的、与革命有关的；也指具有突破性并能带来根本改变的，此处为复数形容词形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huma marbuta ma' rivoluzzjoni jew li jibdlu b'mod radikali l-ideat jew il-metodi eżistenti; forma tal-aġġettiv fil-plural.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ideas, movements, or methods described as revolutionary are connected with a revolution or bring about fundamental changes.

formal.mt: L-istudju jipproponi metodi rivoluzzjonarji li jistgħu jbiddlu b'mod fundamentali l-mod kif jiġi ttrattat l-ilma.
formal.en: The study proposes revolutionary methods that could fundamentally change how water is treated.
formal.zh: 该研究提出了可能从根本上改变水处理方式的突破性方法。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed issejħilhom metodi rivoluzzjonarji? David: Għax ibiddlu kompletament il-mod kif naħdmu, u mhux biss jiffrankaw ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you calling them revolutionary methods? David: Because they completely change how we work, and do more than just save a little time.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你为什么把它们称为带来根本变革的方法？David：因为它们彻底改变了我们的工作方式，作用远不止节省一点时间。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed issejħilhom metodi rivoluzzjonarji?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed issejħilhom metodi rivoluzzjonarji?
messages.zh: 你为什么把它们称为带来根本变革的方法？
messages.en: Why are you calling them revolutionary methods?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ibiddlu kompletament il-mod kif naħdmu, u mhux biss jiffrankaw ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ibiddlu kompletament il-mod kif naħdmu, u mhux biss jiffrankaw ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 因为它们彻底改变了我们的工作方式，作用远不止节省一点时间。
messages.en: Because they completely change how we work, and do more than just save a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把多种彻底改变旧做法的方法画在一起，标注 metodi rivoluzzjonarji，同时记住“根本变革”和复数搭配。

gloss_zh: 革命；政治剧变；旋转一周

teaching_sense.en_definition: A revolution is a fundamental change in a political or social system; the word can also mean one complete turn around an axis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指政治或社会制度发生的根本变革，也可指物体绕轴完整旋转一周。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rivoluzzjoni hija bidla fundamentali fis-sistema politika jew soċjali; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll dawra sħiħa ta' oġġett madwar assi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 革命；使现有政治或社会制度发生根本改变的变革。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rivoluzzjoni hija bidla fundamentali li tittrasforma s-sistema politika jew soċjali eżistenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A revolution is a fundamental change that transforms an existing political or social system.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 政治剧变；使既有政治秩序受到严重冲击的动荡或突变。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rivoluzzjoni hija taqliba politika kbira li ġġib magħha instabbiltà u bidliet fl-ordni eżistenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A political upheaval is a major disturbance that disrupts the existing political order.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完整旋转一周，即绕轴转过三百六十度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rivoluzzjoni hija dawra sħiħa ta' oġġett madwar assi, li tikkorrispondi għal 360 grad.
sense_translations.en_explanation: One revolution is a complete turn of an object through 360 degrees around an axis.

collocations.en: one complete revolution around the axis

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza kif ir-rivoluzzjoni bidlet l-istituzzjonijiet politiċi u r-relazzjonijiet soċjali.
formal.en: The study analyses how the revolution changed political institutions and social relations.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了革命如何改变政治制度与社会关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-rota għamlet rivoluzzjoni sħiħa? Pawlu: Iva, il-marka reġgħet waslet fl-istess post.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the wheel made one complete revolution? Pawlu: Yes, the mark has come back to the same place.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：轮子已经完整转了一圈吗？保罗：是的，标记又回到了原来的位置。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rota għamlet rivoluzzjoni sħiħa?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rota għamlet rivoluzzjoni sħiħa?
messages.zh: 轮子已经完整转了一圈吗？
messages.en: Has the wheel made one complete revolution?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-marka reġgħet waslet fl-istess post.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-marka reġgħet waslet fl-istess post.
messages.zh: 是的，标记又回到了原来的位置。
messages.en: Yes, the mark has come back to the same place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义分成两幅画：政治制度发生根本变革是“革命”，轮上的标记绕轴回到原点是“旋转一周”；遇到政治动荡语境时，再判断是否强调“政治剧变”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A revolver is a handgun with a rotating cylinder containing several chambers for cartridges.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 左轮手枪，指装有旋转弹巢、弹巢内有多个弹膛的短枪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rivolver huwa pistola b'tanbur li jdur u li fih diversi kmamar għall-iskrataċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 左轮手枪；以带有多个弹膛的旋转弹巢为特征的手枪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rivolver huwa tip ta' pistola li għandha tanbur li jdur b'diversi kmamar għall-iskrataċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A revolver is a type of handgun that holds cartridges in separate chambers within a rotating cylinder.

collocations.en: a revolver in the museum display case
collocations.zh: 博物馆展柜中的左轮手枪

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jiddeskrivi r-rivolver espost fil-vetrina u jispjega l-funzjoni tat-tanbur tiegħu.
formal.en: The museum catalogue describes the revolver in the display case and explains the function of its cylinder.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录介绍了展柜中的左轮手枪，并解释其弹巢的功能。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dik fil-vetrina hija pistola? Mark: Iva, hija rivolver; tara t-tanbur tagħha?
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that a handgun in the display case? Mark: Yes, it is a revolver; can you see its cylinder?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：展柜里的那是一把手枪吗？马克：是的，是左轮手枪；你看到它的弹巢了吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik fil-vetrina hija pistola?
messages.mt_standard: Dik fil-vetrina hija pistola?
messages.zh: 展柜里的那是一把手枪吗？
messages.en: Is that a handgun in the display case?

messages.speaker: Mark (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija rivolver; tara t-tanbur tagħha?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija rivolver; tara t-tanbur tagħha?
messages.zh: 是的，是左轮手枪；你看到它的弹巢了吗？
messages.en: Yes, it is a revolver; can you see its cylinder?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rivolver 与博物馆里带圆形旋转弹巢的手枪图像配对，记住“左轮手枪”这一具体物件，避免只记成泛指的“手枪”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful, systematic study carried out to discover information or develop understanding of a subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为发现信息或加深对某一主题的理解而开展的细致、有系统的研究。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Studju bir-reqqa u b'mod sistematiku biex tinkiseb informazzjoni ġdida jew biex suġġett jinftiehem aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 研究，指为获取新信息、解答问题或增进理解而进行的系统性探究。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħidma sistematika ta' studju u ġbir ta' informazzjoni biex jinstabu tweġibiet għal mistoqsijiet jew jinkiseb għarfien ġdid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Research is careful and systematic study undertaken to discover information or improve understanding of a particular subject.

formal.mt: It-tim qed jagħmel riċerka dwar l-effett tat-traffiku fuq il-kwalità tal-arja.
formal.en: The team is conducting research into the effect of traffic on air quality.
formal.zh: 该团队正在研究交通对空气质量的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex qed tagħmel ir-riċerka tiegħek? Luqa: Fuq kif l-istudenti jużaw il-librerija. Illum se nitkellem ma' xi wħud minnhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you doing your research on? Luqa: On how students use the library. Today I am going to speak to some of them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在研究什么？卢卡：研究学生如何使用图书馆。我今天要和其中一些学生聊聊。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex qed tagħmel ir-riċerka tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex qed tagħmel ir-riċerka tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你在研究什么？
messages.en: What are you doing your research on?

messages.speaker: Luqa (学生研究者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq kif l-istudenti jużaw il-librerija. Illum se nitkellem ma' xi wħud minnhom.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq kif l-istudenti jużaw il-librerija. Illum se nitkellem ma' xi wħud minnhom.
messages.zh: 研究学生如何使用图书馆。我今天要和其中一些学生聊聊。
messages.en: On how students use the library. Today I am going to speak to some of them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 riċerka 时串起三个动作：提出问题、收集资料、分析结果；这一整套过程就是研究。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money owed to a business that has not yet been paid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 企业有权收取但尚未收到的款项，尤其是客户购买商品或服务后尚未支付的账款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammonti ta' flus dovuti lil negozju li għadhom ma tħallsux, speċjalment minn klijenti li xtraw prodotti jew servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应收账款，指企业因向客户销售商品或提供服务而应收取、但尚未收到的款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammonti dovuti minn klijenti lil negozju għal prodotti jew servizzi li jkunu ngħataw iżda li għadhom ma tħallsux.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A business's accounts receivable are the amounts its customers still owe for goods or services already supplied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应收款项，指企业或机构有权向他人收取、但尚未收到的各项金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somom li negozju jew istituzzjoni għandhom dritt jirċievu mingħand ħaddieħor iżda li għadhom ma nġabrux.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Receivables are sums of money that a business or institution is entitled to collect from others.

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tax-xahar, ir-riċevibbli tal-kumpanija ammontaw għal għaxart elef ewro.
formal.en: At the end of the month, the company's receivables amounted to ten thousand euros.
formal.zh: 月底时，公司的应收款项总额为一万欧元。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-klijenti kollha ħallsu? Pawlu: Le, għad għandna xi riċevibbli. Marija: Mela ejja naraw min għad irid iħallas.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have all the customers paid? Pawlu: No, we still have some receivables. Marija: Then let's see who still needs to pay.
colloquial.zh: Marija：客户都付款了吗？Pawlu：没有，我们还有一些应收款项。Marija：那我们看看还有谁没付。

messages.speaker: Marija (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-klijenti kollha ħallsu?
messages.mt_standard: Il-klijenti kollha ħallsu?
messages.zh: 客户都付款了吗？
messages.en: Have all the customers paid?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għad għandna xi riċevibbli.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għad għandna xi riċevibbli.
messages.zh: 没有，我们还有一些应收款项。
messages.en: No, we still have some receivables.

messages.speaker: Marija (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja naraw min għad irid iħallas.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja naraw min għad irid iħallas.
messages.zh: 那我们看看还有谁没付。
messages.en: Then let's see who still needs to pay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riċevibbli 放进“客户欠款清单”的画面里记：商品已交付，钱还没到账，账上留下的就是应收款项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized gathering at which guests are welcomed, often to celebrate a special occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为迎接宾客而安排的聚会，常用于庆祝婚礼或其他特殊场合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqgħa organizzata li fiha jintlaqgħu l-mistednin, ħafna drabi biex tiġi ċċelebrata okkażjoni speċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接待会；为迎接和招待宾客而举行的正式聚会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Laqgħa formali organizzata biex jintlaqgħu u jiġu milqugħa l-mistednin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reception is a formal gathering at which guests are welcomed and entertained.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 庆祝招待会；为庆祝婚礼等喜庆场合而举行的社交聚会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Laqgħa soċjali li ssir biex in-nies jiċċelebraw flimkien okkażjoni bħal tieġ jew anniversarju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A celebratory reception brings people together socially to mark a wedding or another special occasion.

formal.mt: Wara ċ-ċerimonja, il-mistednin huma mistiedna għal riċeviment fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: After the ceremony, guests are invited to a reception in the main hall.
formal.zh: 仪式结束后，敬请宾客前往主厅参加招待会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se jsir ir-riċeviment? Mark: Fis-sala ħdejn il-baħar. Lara: Tajjeb, niltaqgħu hemm wara ċ-ċerimonja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where will the reception be held? Mark: In the hall by the sea. Lara: Great, let's meet there after the ceremony.
colloquial.zh: Lara：招待会在哪里举行？Mark：在海边的宴会厅。Lara：好，仪式结束后我们在那里见。

messages.speaker: Lara (婚礼宾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se jsir ir-riċeviment?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se jsir ir-riċeviment?
messages.zh: 招待会在哪里举行？
messages.en: Where will the reception be held?

messages.speaker: Mark (新郎的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-sala ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Fis-sala ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 在海边的宴会厅。
messages.en: In the hall by the sea.

messages.speaker: Lara (婚礼宾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, niltaqgħu hemm wara ċ-ċerimonja.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, niltaqgħu hemm wara ċ-ċerimonja.
messages.zh: 好，仪式结束后我们在那里见。
messages.en: Great, let's meet there after the ceremony.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riċeviment 和婚礼后的宴会画面绑定：仪式结束，宾客进入大厅，主人迎接大家，一起庆祝。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A document showing that money has been paid for goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 证明已经为商品或服务付款的凭证，通常列有金额和购买项目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li juri li sar ħlas għal prodotti jew servizzi, u li normalment jinkludi l-ammont imħallas u dak li nxtara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收据；确认收到付款、可用来证明交易或付款已经完成的凭证。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jikkonferma li ġie riċevut ħlas u li jservi bħala prova li persuna ħallset għal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A receipt is a document you receive as proof that you have paid for something.

formal.mt: Il-klijent għandu jżomm ir-riċevuta bħala prova tal-ħlas.
formal.en: The customer should keep the receipt as proof of payment.
formal.zh: 客户应保留收据作为付款证明。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tagħtini riċevuta, jekk jogħġbok? Ġorġ: Iva, hawn hi. Nina: Grazzi, se nżommha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Could you give me a receipt, please? Ġorġ: Yes, here it is. Nina: Thank you, I'll keep it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：请给我一张收据，好吗？Ġorġ：好的，给你。Nina：谢谢，我会留着。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini riċevuta, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini riċevuta, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请给我一张收据，好吗？
messages.en: Could you give me a receipt, please?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (收银员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn hi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn hi.
messages.zh: 好的，给你。
messages.en: Yes, here it is.

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, se nżommha.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, se nżommha.
messages.zh: 谢谢，我会留着。
messages.en: Thank you, I'll keep it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住购物动作链：付款、拿到 riċevuta、放进钱包。把这个词与“已经付过钱的证明”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 回收再利用；废物再生处理

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of treating waste materials so that they can be used again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对废弃材料进行处理，使其能够再次作为材料使用的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih materjali mormija jiġu pproċessati sabiex ikunu jistgħu jerġgħu jintużaw bħala materja prima jew fi prodotti ġodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 回收再利用；将废纸、废玻璃等废弃材料加工处理，使其重新成为可用材料的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ġbir u l-ipproċessar ta' materjali mormija, bħall-karta u l-ħġieġ, biex minnhom jinkisbu materjali li jistgħu jerġgħu jintużaw.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Recycling is the process of collecting and treating waste materials so that they can be used again.

formal.mt: L-iskola tħeġġeġ ir-riċiklaġġ tal-karta billi tqiegħed kontenituri apposta f'kull klassi.
formal.en: The school encourages paper recycling by placing designated containers in every classroom.
formal.zh: 学校在每间教室设置专用收集容器，以鼓励废纸回收再利用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn il-gazzetti narmihom mal-iskart l-ieħor? Luqa: Le, żommhom għar-riċiklaġġ. Sara: Tajjeb, inpoġġihom fil-kontenitur tal-karta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall I throw these newspapers away with the other rubbish? Luqa: No, keep them for recycling. Sara: All right, I'll put them in the paper container.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这些报纸要和其他垃圾一起扔掉吗？Luqa：别，留着回收再利用。Sara：好，我把它们放进废纸收集容器。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-gazzetti narmihom mal-iskart l-ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-gazzetti narmihom mal-iskart l-ieħor?
messages.zh: 这些报纸要和其他垃圾一起扔掉吗？
messages.en: Shall I throw these newspapers away with the other rubbish?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, żommhom għar-riċiklaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, żommhom għar-riċiklaġġ.
messages.zh: 别，留着回收再利用。
messages.en: No, keep them for recycling.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, inpoġġihom fil-kontenitur tal-karta.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, inpoġġihom fil-kontenitur tal-karta.
messages.zh: 好，我把它们放进废纸收集容器。
messages.en: All right, I'll put them in the paper container.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用循环箭头帮助记忆 riċiklaġġ：旧报纸进入回收容器，经过处理，又成为可用的纸张。重点记住“处理后再次利用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bra is an item of underwear worn to support or cover the breasts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于承托或遮盖乳房的内衣，即胸罩或文胸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies ta' taħt li jintlibes biex iżomm jew jgħatti s-sider.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胸罩；穿在外衣里面、用于承托或遮盖乳房的内衣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilbies ta' taħt li jintlibes taħt il-ħwejjeġ biex iżomm jew jgħatti s-sider.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bra is a piece of underwear that supports or covers the breasts.

formal.mt: Meta tagħżel riċipettu, huwa importanti li tiċċekkja d-daqs u l-kumdità.
formal.en: When choosing a bra, it is important to check the size and comfort.
formal.zh: 挑选胸罩时，检查尺码和穿着舒适度很重要。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed infittex riċipettu komdu għal kuljum. Rita: Trid tipprova dan? Għandna diversi daqsijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'm looking for a comfortable bra for everyday wear. Rita: Would you like to try this one? We have several sizes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我想找一件适合日常穿着的舒适胸罩。丽塔：你想试试这件吗？我们有好几个尺码。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed infittex riċipettu komdu għal kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Qed infittex riċipettu komdu għal kuljum.
messages.zh: 我想找一件适合日常穿着的舒适胸罩。
messages.en: I'm looking for a comfortable bra for everyday wear.

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tipprova dan? Għandna diversi daqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Trid tipprova dan? Għandna diversi daqsijiet.
messages.zh: 你想试试这件吗？我们有好几个尺码。
messages.en: Would you like to try this one? We have several sizes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riċipettu 和挑选文胸的画面绑定，连读 riċipettu komdu，记住“舒适的胸罩”这一实用搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A straight instrument used for measuring lengths and drawing straight lines.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于测量长度或画直线的直条形工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda dritta li tintuża biex jitkejlu t-tulijiet u jinġibdu linji dritti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直尺，用于测量长度或画直线的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda dritta, ġeneralment b'marki tal-kejl, li tintuża biex jitkejlu t-tulijiet jew jinġibdu linji dritti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ruler is a straight tool that you use to measure lengths or draw straight lines.

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu juża riġa biex jiġbed linja dritta twila għaxar ċentimetri.
formal.en: The student should use a ruler to draw a straight line ten centimetres long.
formal.zh: 学生应使用直尺画一条十厘米长的直线。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' ssellifni r-riġa tiegħek? Mark: Iva, hawn hi. Agħtihieli lura meta tlesti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you lend me your ruler? Mark: Yes, here it is. Give it back when you finish.
colloquial.zh: Lara：能把你的直尺借给我吗？Mark：可以，给你。用完还给我。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' ssellifni r-riġa tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' ssellifni r-riġa tiegħek?
messages.zh: 能把你的直尺借给我吗？
messages.en: Can you lend me your ruler?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn hi. Agħtihieli lura meta tlesti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn hi. Agħtihieli lura meta tlesti.
messages.zh: 可以，给你。用完还给我。
messages.en: Yes, here it is. Give it back when you finish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文具盒里一把画直线的尺子，把 riġa 与“量长度、画直线”两个动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The feet belonging to the person who is speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话者自己的双脚，词中已经包含“我的”这一所属意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-saqajn tal-persuna li qed titkellem, jiġifieri s-saqajn tiegħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我的双脚，指说话者自己的脚。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-saqajn tiegħi, jiġifieri ż-żewġ partijiet ta' ġismi li fuqhom noqgħod bilwieqfa u li nuża biex nimxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use my feet to refer to your own feet when speaking about yourself.

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, ħsilt riġlejja u ħallejthom jistrieħu.
formal.en: After the long walk, I washed my feet and let them rest.
formal.zh: 长途步行后，我洗了双脚，让它们休息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Riġlejja qed juġgħuni wara dik il-mixja kollha. David: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda hawn u nistrieħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: My feet hurt after all that walking. David: Let's sit here and rest for a bit.
colloquial.zh: Nina：走了那么多路，我的双脚都疼了。David：我们坐在这里休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Riġlejja qed juġgħuni wara dik il-mixja kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Riġlejja qed juġgħuni wara dik il-mixja kollha.
messages.zh: 走了那么多路，我的双脚都疼了。
messages.en: My feet hurt after all that walking.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda hawn u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda hawn u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.zh: 我们坐在这里休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's sit here and rest for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 低头看着自己的双脚说 riġlejja，把整个词记成“我的双脚”；“我的”已经包含在词里，无需另外补上。

gloss_zh: 非旋转备用；补充备用资源

teaching_sense.en_definition: A supplemental reserve is an additional resource held available to meet extra needs; in electricity supply, it can refer to reserve capacity that is not currently running in synchronism with the grid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为满足额外需求而保留的补充备用资源；在电力供应语境中，也指当前未与电网同步运行、可在需要时投入的非旋转备用容量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riżerva supplimentari hija riżorsa addizzjonali miżmuma biex tintuża meta jkun hemm bżonn; fil-provvista tal-elettriku, tista' tkun kapaċità ta' riżerva li bħalissa mhix qed taħdem b'mod sinkronizzat man-netwerk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非旋转备用；当前未与电网同步运行、可在需要时启动并投入供电的备用容量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riżerva supplimentari hija kapaċità ta' riżerva għall-provvista tal-elettriku li mhix qed taħdem b'mod sinkronizzat man-netwerk, iżda li tista' tinbeda u titqiegħed fis-servizz meta jkun hemm bżonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Non-spinning reserves are backup electricity supply resources that are not currently operating in synchronism with the grid but can be brought into service when needed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 补充备用资源；在现有供应或储备之外保留、用于满足额外需求的资源。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riżerva supplimentari hija riżorsa addizzjonali miżmuma biex issaħħaħ il-provvista jew ir-riżerva eżistenti meta jiżdied il-bżonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supplemental reserve is an additional resource kept available to support existing supplies when extra demand arises.

collocations.en: the need for a supplemental reserve
collocations.zh: 对补充备用资源的需求

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar il-provvista tal-elettriku jiddistingwi bejn kapaċità li diġà qed taħdem b'mod sinkronizzat man-netwerk u riżerva supplimentari li tista' titqiegħed fis-servizz meta jkun hemm bżonn.
formal.en: The electricity supply report distinguishes between capacity already operating in synchronism with the grid and non-spinning reserve capacity that can be brought into service when needed.
formal.zh: 这份电力供应报告区分了已经与电网同步运行的容量，以及可在需要时投入使用的非旋转备用容量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna biżżejjed ilma għall-attività? Toni: Iva, u żammejna riżerva supplimentari jekk jiġu aktar nies.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we have enough water for the event? Toni: Yes, and we have kept a supplemental reserve in case more people come.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：活动用水够吗？托尼：够，而且我们留了额外的备用水，以防来的人更多。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna biżżejjed ilma għall-attività?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna biżżejjed ilma għall-attività?
messages.zh: 活动用水够吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough water for the event?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u żammejna riżerva supplimentari jekk jiġu aktar nies.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u żammejna riżerva supplimentari jekk jiġu aktar nies.
messages.zh: 够，而且我们留了额外的备用水，以防来的人更多。
messages.en: Yes, and we have kept a supplemental reserve in case more people come.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想“正常供应之外再留一份备用”：日常物资中理解为“补充备用资源”，电力语境中则联想到尚未同步运行、需要时投入的“非旋转备用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mineral and energy reserves are known quantities of mineral resources and energy resources that are available for extraction and use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 矿产及能源储量，指已知可供开采和利用的矿产资源与能源资源的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-riżervi minerali u tal-enerġija huma kwantitajiet magħrufa ta' riżorsi minerali u ta' riżorsi tal-enerġija li jistgħu jiġu estratti u użati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 矿产及能源储量；已知可供开采利用的矿产资源和能源资源的数量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-riżervi minerali u tal-enerġija huma l-kwantitajiet magħrufa ta' materjali minerali u ta' riżorsi tal-enerġija li huma disponibbli għall-estrazzjoni u għall-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mineral and energy reserves are known amounts of mineral materials and energy resources that can be extracted for use.

collocations.en: an estimate of mineral and energy reserves
the assessment of mineral and energy reserves

collocations.mt: data dwar ir-riżervi minerali u tal-enerġija
collocations.en: data on mineral and energy reserves
collocations.zh: 有关矿产及能源储量的数据

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta stima tar-riżervi minerali u tal-enerġija fir-reġjun u jispjega l-metodu użat biex ġew ikkalkulati dawn il-kwantitajiet.
formal.en: The report presents an estimate of the region's mineral and energy reserves and explains the method used to calculate these quantities.
formal.zh: 报告提供了该地区矿产及能源储量的估算，并说明了这些数量的计算方法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qed turi din it-tabella? David: Qed turi r-riżervi minerali u tal-enerġija tar-reġjun, jiġifieri kemm hemm riżorsi magħrufa li jistgħu jiġu estratti u użati.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does this table show? David: It shows the region's mineral and energy reserves, meaning how much of its known resources can be extracted and used.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张表显示的是什么？戴维：它显示该地区的矿产及能源储量，也就是已知可供开采利用的资源有多少。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed turi din it-tabella?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed turi din it-tabella?
messages.zh: 这张表显示的是什么？
messages.en: What does this table show?

messages.speaker: David (地理教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed turi r-riżervi minerali u tal-enerġija tar-reġjun, jiġifieri kemm hemm riżorsi magħrufa li jistgħu jiġu estratti u użati.
messages.mt_standard: Qed turi r-riżervi minerali u tal-enerġija tar-reġjun, jiġifieri kemm hemm riżorsi magħrufa li jistgħu jiġu estratti u użati.
messages.zh: 它显示该地区的矿产及能源储量，也就是已知可供开采利用的资源有多少。
messages.en: It shows the region's mineral and energy reserves, meaning how much of its known resources can be extracted and used.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成资源统计表的标题：左栏是矿产，右栏是能源，两栏记录的都是可供开采利用的“储量”，合起来记作“矿产及能源储量”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Additional or different supplies kept available for future use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 除已经提及的储备以外，留待日后使用的其他物资或存量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Provvisti oħra, minbarra dawk diġà msemmija, li jinżammu biex jintużaw meta jkun hemm bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已提及或已使用的储备之外的其他备用存量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Provvisti jew ħażniet oħra li jinżammu għal użu fil-futur, minbarra dawk diġà msemmija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Other reserves are supplies kept available in addition to those already mentioned.

formal.mt: Jekk il-provvista ewlenija tal-ilma tonqos, ir-raħal jista' juża riżervi oħra.
formal.en: If the main water supply runs low, the village can use other reserves.
formal.zh: 如果主要供水不足，村庄可以使用其他储备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandna ilma fit-tank? Mark: Ftit biss, imma għandna riżervi oħra fil-garaxx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we still have water in the tank? Mark: Only a little, but we have other reserves in the garage.
colloquial.zh: Maja：水箱里还有水吗？Mark：只剩一点，不过我们在车库里还有其他储备。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandna ilma fit-tank?
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandna ilma fit-tank?
messages.zh: 水箱里还有水吗？
messages.en: Do we still have water in the tank?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit biss, imma għandna riżervi oħra fil-garaxx.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit biss, imma għandna riżervi oħra fil-garaxx.
messages.zh: 只剩一点，不过我们在车库里还有其他储备。
messages.en: Only a little, but we have other reserves in the garage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主要水箱旁边还有几桶备用水：riżervi 是储备，oħra 提醒你这些是“其他的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name used here to refer to Skialv.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 此处用于指称 Skialv 的名称，书写形式为 Riżna。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem Riżna, li hawn jintuża biex jirreferi għal Skialv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Skialv；此处对应的名称写作 Riżna。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Riżna huwa l-isem li hawn jirreferi għal Skialv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The name Riżna is used here to identify Skialv.

collocations.en: the spelling of the name Riżna

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-isem Riżna jirreferi għal Skialv.
formal.en: In this exercise, the name Riżna refers to Skialv.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，Riżna 这个名称指的是 Skialv。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nikteb l-isem Riżna? Mark: R, i, ż, n, a. Tinsiex it-tikka fuq iż-ż.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I spell the name Riżna? Mark: R, i, ż, n, a. Remember the dot above the ż.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Riżna 这个名称怎么拼？Mark：R、i、ż、n、a。别忘了 ż 上面的点。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nikteb l-isem Riżna?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nikteb l-isem Riżna?
messages.zh: Riżna 这个名称怎么拼？
messages.en: How do I spell the name Riżna?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: R, i, ż, n, a. Tinsiex it-tikka fuq iż-ż.
messages.mt_standard: R, i, ż, n, a. Tinsiex it-tikka fuq iż-ż.
messages.zh: R、i、ż、n、a。别忘了 ż 上面的点。
messages.en: R, i, ż, n, a. Remember the dot above the ż.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Riżna 与 Skialv 写在同一张名称卡的两面，成对记忆，并特别留意 ż 上面的小点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something available that can be used to meet a need or achieve a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可供利用、能够满足某种需要或帮助实现某个目的的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa disponibbli li tista' tintuża biex tissodisfa ħtieġa jew tgħin biex jintlaħaq għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够用于满足需要、解决问题或实现目标的资源。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mezz jew ħaġa li tkun disponibbli u li tista' tintuża biex issir xi ħaġa jew tintlaħaq mira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A resource is something available that you can use to meet a need or achieve a goal.

formal.mt: Il-librerija tal-iskola hija riżors importanti għall-istudenti li qed jagħmlu riċerka.
formal.en: The school library is an important resource for students conducting research.
formal.zh: 学校图书馆是学生开展研究的重要资源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma nafx fejn insib it-tifsira ta' din il-kelma. Mark: Uża dan id-dizzjunarju; huwa riżors utli ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: I don't know where to find the meaning of this word. Mark: Use this dictionary; it's a very useful resource.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我不知道去哪里查这个词的意思。Mark：用这本词典吧，它是很有用的资源。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx fejn insib it-tifsira ta' din il-kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx fejn insib it-tifsira ta' din il-kelma.
messages.zh: 我不知道去哪里查这个词的意思。
messages.en: I don't know where to find the meaning of this word.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża dan id-dizzjunarju; huwa riżors utli ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Uża dan id-dizzjunarju; huwa riżors utli ħafna.
messages.zh: 用这本词典吧，它是很有用的资源。
messages.en: Use this dictionary; it's a very useful resource.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词典、图书馆和水源画进一个“可利用的东西”工具箱，每件都能叫 riżors，帮助记住“资源”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Good fortune that allows something favourable to happen by chance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人碰巧遇到有利情况或获得好结果的运气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xorti tajba li biha jiġri xi ħaġa favorevoli jew jinkiseb riżultat tajjeb b'kumbinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好运；偶然遇上有利事情或取得好结果的运气。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xorti favorevoli li tgħin lil xi ħadd jiltaqa' ma' ġrajja tajba jew jikseb suċċess b'kumbinazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have good luck, chance brings you a favourable event or result.

formal.mt: Ir-riżq għenu jirbaħ il-premju fit-tlugħ bix-xorti.
formal.en: Good luck helped him win the prize in the draw.
formal.zh: 好运让他在抽奖中赢得了奖品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irbaħt premju fit-tlugħ bix-xorti! Mark: X'riżq! Prosit!
colloquial.en: Maja: I won a prize in the draw! Mark: What good luck! Congratulations!
colloquial.zh: Maja：我抽奖中奖了！Mark：真走运！恭喜！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irbaħt premju fit-tlugħ bix-xorti!
messages.mt_standard: Irbaħt premju fit-tlugħ bix-xorti!
messages.zh: 我抽奖中奖了！
messages.en: I won a prize in the draw!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'riżq! Prosit!
messages.mt_standard: X'riżq! Prosit!
messages.zh: 真走运！恭喜！
messages.en: What good luck! Congratulations!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友抽奖中奖，你脱口而出 X'riżq!，把这句感叹和中文“真走运”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that follows from an action or process, including a concrete output produced by work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项行动或过程产生的结果，也可指工作形成的具体成果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li joħroġ minn azzjoni jew proċess, inkluż prodott konkret li jitħejja permezz tax-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行动、计算、考试或其他过程产生的结果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dak li jinkiseb jew jirriżulta minn azzjoni, kalkolu, eżami jew proċess ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A result is something obtained or produced by an action, calculation, test, or other process.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事件、活动或一连串行动最终形成的结局或成效。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda jew l-effett finali li joħroġ minn avveniment, attività jew sensiela ta' azzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The outcome of an event or activity is the final situation or effect that it produces.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 项目或任务要求完成并交付的具体成果，如报告或成品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott jew xogħol konkret, bħal rapport jew oġġett lest, li jrid jitlesta u jitwassal bħala parti minn proġett jew kompitu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A deliverable is a specific piece of work or product that a project requires someone to complete and provide.

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat ewlieni tal-proġett huwa rapport li għandu jitwassal lill-klijent sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The main deliverable of the project is a report that must be provided to the client by the end of the month.
formal.zh: 该项目的主要交付成果是一份须于月底前交给客户的报告。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif kien ir-riżultat tal-eżami? Pawlu: Għaddejt! Ir-riżultat kien aħjar milli stennejt.
colloquial.en: Marta: How was your examination result? Pawlu: I passed! The result was better than I expected.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：考试结果怎么样？保罗：我通过了！结果比我预期的好。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien ir-riżultat tal-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien ir-riżultat tal-eżami?
messages.zh: 考试结果怎么样？
messages.en: How was your examination result?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (考生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddejt! Ir-riżultat kien aħjar milli stennejt.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddejt! Ir-riżultat kien aħjar milli stennejt.
messages.zh: 我通过了！结果比我预期的好。
messages.en: I passed! The result was better than I expected.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放在“行动之后看结果”的画面里记：考试看分数，事情看结局，项目看交付成果；三种用法都关注最后得到什么。

gloss_zh: 升价拍卖；升价时钟拍卖；递增出价拍卖

teaching_sense.en_definition: An auction in which the price rises through announced increases or progressively higher bids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 价格通过组织者逐步公布更高价格或竞买人不断提高出价而上升的拍卖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rkant li fih il-prezz jiżdied permezz ta' żidiet imħabbra mill-organizzatur jew permezz ta' offerti dejjem ogħla mill-parteċipanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由拍卖方逐轮提高公布价格，竞买人在各轮表明是否继续参与或申报需求的升价拍卖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rkant li fih l-organizzatur jgħolli l-prezz imħabbar minn rawnd għal ieħor, u l-parteċipanti jindikaw jekk jibqgħux jieħdu sehem jew kemm jixtiequ jixtru b'dak il-prezz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ascending clock auction raises an announced price in successive rounds while bidders indicate their continued participation or demand.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 竞买人通过提出越来越高的出价相互竞争的拍卖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rkant li fih il-parteċipanti jikkompetu billi jagħmlu offerti ogħla minn dawk li jkunu diġà saru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ascending-bid auction allows bidders to compete by making offers higher than the bids already submitted.

collocations.mt: ir-regoli ta' rkant bi prezz axxendenti
collocations.en: the rules of an ascending-price auction

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rkant bi prezz axxendenti, l-organizzatur iħabbar prezz ogħla f'kull rawnd, u l-parteċipanti jindikaw jekk jixtiqux jibqgħu jieħdu sehem.
formal.en: In this ascending clock auction, the organizer announces a higher price in each round, and participants indicate whether they wish to remain involved.
formal.zh: 在这场升价时钟拍卖中，组织者每轮公布一个更高的价格，参与者则表明是否愿意继续参与。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif jaħdem dan ir-rkant bi prezz axxendenti? Mark: Hawnhekk noffru prezzijiet dejjem ogħla, imma jien nieqaf jekk il-prezz jaqbeż il-mitt ewro.
colloquial.en: Sara: How does this ascending-bid auction work? Mark: Here we make progressively higher bids, but I will stop if the price goes over one hundred euros.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这场递增出价拍卖是怎么进行的？马克：我们在这里不断加价，不过价格超过一百欧元我就不再出价了。

messages.speaker: Sara (首次参加拍卖的顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jaħdem dan ir-rkant bi prezz axxendenti?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jaħdem dan ir-rkant bi prezz axxendenti?
messages.zh: 这场递增出价拍卖是怎么进行的？
messages.en: How does this ascending-bid auction work?

messages.speaker: Mark (竞买人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk noffru prezzijiet dejjem ogħla, imma jien nieqaf jekk il-prezz jaqbeż il-mitt ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk noffru prezzijiet dejjem ogħla, imma jien nieqaf jekk il-prezz jaqbeż il-mitt ewro.
messages.zh: 我们在这里不断加价，不过价格超过一百欧元我就不再出价了。
messages.en: Here we make progressively higher bids, but I will stop if the price goes over one hundred euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用价格阶梯向上的画面记忆：每一级都比前一级贵。再区分两种操作：组织者逐轮报高价，或竞买人轮流加价。

gloss_zh: 统一价格拍卖；出清价格拍卖；单一费率拍卖；荷兰式拍卖

teaching_sense.en_definition: An auction in which all successful bidders pay the same price per unit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所有中标者按同一单位价格支付的拍卖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rkant li fih il-parteċipanti kollha li jirbħu jħallsu l-istess prezz għal kull unità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荷兰式拍卖；常见机制是从高价开始逐步降价，直到有买家接受；这一机制本身并不等同于所有中标者支付统一价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' rkant li, fit-tifsira komuni tiegħu, jibda bi prezz għoli li jitnaqqas sakemm xerrej jaċċettah; dan il-mekkaniżmu fih innifsu ma jfissirx li r-rebbieħa kollha jħallsu prezz wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Dutch auction commonly starts at a high price and lowers it until a buyer accepts, so the name alone does not establish uniform pricing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按使可售数量与获接受需求相匹配的出清价格进行分配和定价的拍卖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rkant li fih l-allokazzjoni u l-ħlas jiġu stabbiliti skont prezz li jqabbel il-kwantità disponibbli mad-domanda aċċettata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clearing price auction allocates the available supply at a price that brings it into balance with accepted demand.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所有获接受的投标均采用同一成交费率或利率的拍卖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rkant li fih tiġi applikata l-istess rata finali, bħal rata ta' imgħax, għall-offerti kollha li jiġu aċċettati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A single rate auction applies one final rate, such as an interest rate, to all bids that are accepted.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所有中标者无论各自投标价格如何，均按同一最终单位价格支付的拍卖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rkant li fih kull parteċipant li jirbaħ iħallas l-istess prezz finali għal kull unità, anki jekk l-offerti oriġinali kienu bi prezzijiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A uniform-price auction charges every successful bidder the same final price per unit even when their original bids differ.

collocations.mt: il-prezz finali f'rkant bi prezz uniformi
collocations.en: the final price in a uniform-price auction
collocations.zh: 统一价格拍卖的最终成交价

formal.mt: Skont ir-regoli ta' dan ir-rkant bi prezz uniformi, kull parteċipant li jirbaħ iħallas l-istess prezz għal kull unità, irrispettivament mill-prezz tal-offerta tiegħu.
formal.en: Under the rules of this uniform-price auction, every successful bidder pays the same price per unit, regardless of the price in their bid.
formal.zh: 根据这场统一价格拍卖的规则，每位中标者均按相同的单位价格付款，无论其投标价格是多少。

colloquial.mt: Nina: F'dan ir-rkant bi prezz uniformi, jekk noffri aktar minnek, inħallas aktar għal kull unità? David: Le, jekk nirbħu t-tnejn, inħallsu l-istess prezz finali għal kull unità.
colloquial.en: Nina: In this uniform-price auction, if I bid more than you, do I pay more per unit? David: No, if we both win, we pay the same final price per unit.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：在这场统一价格拍卖中，如果我的出价比你高，我每单位付的钱也更多吗？戴维：不会，如果我们都中标，每单位就支付相同的最终价格。

messages.speaker: Nina (首次投标的参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan ir-rkant bi prezz uniformi, jekk noffri aktar minnek, inħallas aktar għal kull unità?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan ir-rkant bi prezz uniformi, jekk noffri aktar minnek, inħallas aktar għal kull unità?
messages.zh: 在这场统一价格拍卖中，如果我的出价比你高，我每单位付的钱也更多吗？
messages.en: In this uniform-price auction, if I bid more than you, do I pay more per unit?

messages.speaker: David (有经验的竞买人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jekk nirbħu t-tnejn, inħallsu l-istess prezz finali għal kull unità.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jekk nirbħu t-tnejn, inħallsu l-istess prezz finali għal kull unità.
messages.zh: 不会，如果我们都中标，每单位就支付相同的最终价格。
messages.en: No, if we both win, we pay the same final price per unit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象不同竞买人的账单上都印着同一个单位价格，记住“统一”看的是成交单价。遇到荷兰式拍卖这一名称时，另外辨认降价过程与统一结算规则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An auction conducted through an electronic system that allows participants to submit bids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子系统进行、允许参与者提交出价的拍卖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rkant li jsir permezz ta' sistema elettronika li tippermetti lill-parteċipanti jibagħtu l-offerti tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用电子平台接收和处理竞买人出价的拍卖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rkant li juża pjattaforma elettronika biex jirċievi u jipproċessa l-offerti tal-parteċipanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electronic auction uses an electronic platform to receive and process bids from the people taking part.

collocations.en: place a bid in an electronic auction

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jibagħtu l-offerti tagħhom permezz tal-pjattaforma qabel jagħlaq ir-rkant elettroniku fil-ħamsa ta' waranofsinhar.
formal.en: Participants must submit their bids through the platform before the electronic auction closes at five in the afternoon.
formal.zh: 参与者须在电子拍卖于下午五点结束前，通过平台提交出价。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Diġà għamilt offerta fir-rkant elettroniku? Toni: Għadni le. Se nidħol fil-pjattaforma issa u niċċekkja l-prezz.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you already placed a bid in the electronic auction? Toni: Not yet. I will log in to the platform now and check the price.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你已经在电子拍卖中出价了吗？托尼：还没有。我现在就登录平台，看看价格。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà għamilt offerta fir-rkant elettroniku?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà għamilt offerta fir-rkant elettroniku?
messages.zh: 你已经在电子拍卖中出价了吗？
messages.en: Have you already placed a bid in the electronic auction?

messages.speaker: Toni (竞买人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Se nidħol fil-pjattaforma issa u niċċekkja l-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Se nidħol fil-pjattaforma issa u niċċekkja l-prezz.
messages.zh: 还没有。我现在就登录平台，看看价格。
messages.en: Not yet. I will log in to the platform now and check the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把电脑屏幕上的“提交出价”按钮当作记忆画面：rkant 对应拍卖，elettroniku 提示电子方式，合起来就是通过电子平台参加的拍卖。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An auction held in advance to allocate capacity for the following day.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提前举行、通过竞价分配次日可用容量的拍卖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rkant li jsir minn qabel biex tiġi allokata l-kapaċità disponibbli għall-jum ta' wara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过提前竞价分配次日可用容量的日前拍卖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rkant li fih il-parteċipanti jagħmlu offerti minn qabel għall-kapaċità li tkun disponibbli fil-jum ta' wara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A day-ahead capacity auction is an auction in which participants bid in advance for capacity available on the following day.

collocations.mt: torganizza rkant tal-kapaċità ta' jum bil-quddiem
tipparteċipa fir-rkant tal-kapaċità ta' jum bil-quddiem
collocations.en: participate in the day-ahead capacity auction

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se tipparteċipa fir-rkant tal-kapaċità ta' jum bil-quddiem biex tikseb il-kapaċità meħtieġa għall-jum ta' wara.
formal.en: The company will participate in the day-ahead capacity auction to obtain the capacity required for the following day.
formal.zh: 公司将参与日前容量拍卖，以获得次日所需的容量。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Se nieħdu sehem fir-rkant tal-kapaċità ta' jum bil-quddiem? Pawlu: Iva, irridu nħejju l-offerta għall-kapaċità li għandna bżonn għada.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are we taking part in the day-ahead capacity auction? Pawlu: Yes, we need to prepare our bid for the capacity we need tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我们要参加日前容量拍卖吗？Pawlu：要，我们得为明天所需的容量准备报价。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nieħdu sehem fir-rkant tal-kapaċità ta' jum bil-quddiem?
messages.mt_standard: Se nieħdu sehem fir-rkant tal-kapaċità ta' jum bil-quddiem?
messages.zh: 我们要参加日前容量拍卖吗？
messages.en: Are we taking part in the day-ahead capacity auction?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irridu nħejju l-offerta għall-kapaċità li għandna bżonn għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irridu nħejju l-offerta għall-kapaċità li għandna bżonn għada.
messages.zh: 要，我们得为明天所需的容量准备报价。
messages.en: Yes, we need to prepare our bid for the capacity we need tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分块记忆：rkant 是拍卖，tal-kapaċità 表示容量的，ta' jum bil-quddiem 提示提前一天；联想“今天竞价，分配明天容量”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The two joints where a person's legs bend between the thighs and lower legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人的两条腿上连接大腿与小腿、使腿能够弯曲的两个关节，即双膝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żewġ ġogi bejn il-koxox u l-partijiet t'isfel tas-saqajn, fejn is-saqajn jitgħawġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两个膝盖，指双腿上连接大腿与小腿的两个关节。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żewġ irkopptejn ta' persuna, jiġifieri l-ġogi fejn kull sieq titgħawweġ bejn il-koxxa u l-parti t'isfel tas-sieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your two knees are the joints in your legs that allow them to bend between the thighs and lower legs.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, il-parteċipanti għandhom jgħawġu r-rkopptejn bil-mod u jżommu daharhom dritt.
formal.en: During the exercise, participants should bend their knees slowly and keep their backs straight.
formal.zh: 练习时，参与者应缓慢弯曲双膝，并保持背部挺直。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mod? Mark: Għandi uġigħ fiż-żewġ rkopptejn wara l-mixja tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you walking slowly? Mark: Both my knees hurt after yesterday's walk.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么走得这么慢？Mark：昨天走完路以后，我两个膝盖都疼。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mod?
messages.zh: 你怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi uġigħ fiż-żewġ rkopptejn wara l-mixja tal-bieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi uġigħ fiż-żewġ rkopptejn wara l-mixja tal-bieraħ.
messages.zh: 昨天走完路以后，我两个膝盖都疼。
messages.en: Both my knees hurt after yesterday's walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记这个词时同时轻点左右两个膝盖，把 rkopptejn 与“双膝”这个成对画面绑定，避免只想到一个膝盖。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to robots, or resembling a robot in movement or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与机器人有关的，或在动作、行为上像机器人一样机械的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mar-robots, jew li jixbah robot fil-moviment jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与机器人有关的；也可形容动作或行为像机器人一样机械的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa marbut mar-robots jew mat-tħaddim tagħhom, jew li għandu movimenti jew imġiba mekkaniċi bħal ta' robot.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is robotic is connected with robots or resembles the mechanical movements or behaviour of a robot.
