formal.mt: Il-laboratorju juża driegħ robotiku biex iqiegħed il-kampjuni fl-istess pożizzjoni kull darba.
formal.en: The laboratory uses a robotic arm to place the samples in the same position each time.
formal.zh: 实验室使用机械臂，每次都将样本放在同一位置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-moviment jidher robotiku wisq. David: Għandek raġun, se nipprova niżfen b'mod aktar naturali.
colloquial.en: Nina: That movement looks too robotic. David: You're right, I'll try to dance more naturally.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个动作看起来太机械了。David：你说得对，我会试着跳得更自然些。

messages.speaker: Nina (舞伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-moviment jidher robotiku wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-moviment jidher robotiku wisq.
messages.zh: 这个动作看起来太机械了。
messages.en: That movement looks too robotic.

messages.speaker: David (舞伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, se nipprova niżfen b'mod aktar naturali.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, se nipprova niżfen b'mod aktar naturali.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我会试着跳得更自然些。
messages.en: You're right, I'll try to dance more naturally.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 robotiku，先想象机器臂，再想象人跳舞时僵硬的动作：一个画面记“与机器人有关”，另一个记“像机器人一样机械”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vehicle or device propelled by gases expelled from its engine, often used for travel into space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依靠发动机向后喷出气体产生推力的飞行器或装置，常用于进入太空。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura jew apparat li jitmexxa bil-forza tal-gassijiet li joħorġu mill-magna tiegħu, u li spiss jintuża biex jasal fl-ispazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过喷出气体获得推力的火箭，可用于把载荷送入太空。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vettura jew apparat li javvanza permezz tal-gassijiet li joħorġu b'forza mill-magna tiegħu, u li jista' jintuża biex iġorr tagħbija fl-ispazju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rocket is a vehicle or device driven forward by gases expelled from its engine, often carrying a payload into space.

formal.mt: Ir-rokit ġarr satellita fl-ispazju wara tnedija li rnexxiet.
formal.en: The rocket carried a satellite into space after a successful launch.
formal.zh: 火箭成功发射后，将一颗卫星送入太空。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt it-tnedija tar-rokit dalgħodu? Luqa: Iva, rajtu jitla' fis-sema fuq it-televixin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see the rocket launch this morning? Luqa: Yes, I watched it rise into the sky on television.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看到今天早上的火箭发射了吗？Luqa：看到了，我在电视上看着它升上天空。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt it-tnedija tar-rokit dalgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt it-tnedija tar-rokit dalgħodu?
messages.zh: 你看到今天早上的火箭发射了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the rocket launch this morning?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rajtu jitla' fis-sema fuq it-televixin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rajtu jitla' fis-sema fuq it-televixin.
messages.zh: 看到了，我在电视上看着它升上天空。
messages.en: Yes, I watched it rise into the sky on television.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rokit 配上一幅“尾部喷气、箭头向上”的火箭图，再连读 tnedija ta' rokit，连同“火箭发射”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A length of flexible material wound around itself or a central support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将纸、胶片等柔软材料绕自身或中心轴卷成的一卷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tul ta' materjal flessibbli, bħal karta jew film, imdawwar fuqu nnifsu jew madwar qalba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷；由纸、胶片等材料卷绕而成的一卷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Roll huwa tul ta' materjal, bħal karta jew film, imdawwar fuqu nnifsu jew madwar qalba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A roll is a length of paper, film, or similar material that has been wound around itself or a central support.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弹筒；把弹壳、发射药及弹丸等组合成一个整体的枪弹。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Roll huwa skartoċċ li jiġbor f'unità waħda l-qoxra, il-porvli u l-projettili jew iċ-ċomb għal tir minn arma tan-nar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cartridge is a complete unit of ammunition containing the components needed for a single shot from a firearm.

formal.mt: Għall-attività tal-klassi, kull grupp għandu bżonn roll tal-karta biex jagħmel poster twil.
formal.en: For the classroom activity, each group needs a roll of paper to make a long poster.
formal.zh: 在这项课堂活动中，每组都需要一卷纸来制作一张长海报。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandek roll tal-karta ieħor? Pawlu: Iva, hemm wieħed fl-armarju. Marija: Tajjeb, ħa nġibu biex inlestu l-poster.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you have another roll of paper? Pawlu: Yes, there's one in the cupboard. Marija: Great, I'll get it so we can finish the poster.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你还有一卷纸吗？Pawlu：有，柜子里有一卷。Marija：好，我去拿来，这样我们就能完成海报了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek roll tal-karta ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek roll tal-karta ieħor?
messages.zh: 你还有一卷纸吗？
messages.en: Do you have another roll of paper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wieħed fl-armarju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wieħed fl-armarju.
messages.zh: 有，柜子里有一卷。
messages.en: Yes, there's one in the cupboard.

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, ħa nġibu biex inlestu l-poster.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, ħa nġibu biex inlestu l-poster.
messages.zh: 好，我去拿来，这样我们就能完成海报了。
messages.en: Great, I'll get it so we can finish the poster.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 roll 配成两张学习卡：tal-karta 对应卷起来的纸，tas-senter 对应枪弹；靠后面的搭配区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fairground ride in which connected cars travel quickly along a track with steep climbs, drops, and bends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 游乐场中车辆沿轨道快速行驶、经过陡坡和弯道的过山车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attrazzjoni f'park tad-divertiment fejn vaguni magħqudin jimxu b'veloċità fuq binarju b'telgħat, niżliet u dawriet qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过山车；沿起伏、转弯的轨道快速运行的游乐设施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rollercoaster huwa attrazzjoni ta' divertiment li ġġorr il-passiġġieri f'vaguni fuq binarju b'telgħat, niżliet u dawriet li jagħtu sensazzjoni ta' eċċitament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rollercoaster is a fairground ride that carries passengers rapidly around a track with steep slopes and sharp bends.

formal.mt: Il-mappa tal-park turi fejn jinsab ir-rollercoaster u minn fejn jidħlu l-passiġġieri.
formal.en: The park map shows where the rollercoaster is and where passengers enter.
formal.zh: 园区地图标出了过山车的位置以及乘客入口。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid titla' fuq ir-rollercoaster miegħi? Luqa: Iva, imma nippreferi noqgħod fin-nofs. Sara: Tajjeb, noqogħdu ħdejn xulxin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to go on the rollercoaster with me? Luqa: Yes, but I'd prefer to sit in the middle. Sara: Okay, we'll sit next to each other.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你想和我一起坐过山车吗？Luqa：想，不过我比较想坐中间。Sara：好，我们坐在一起。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid titla' fuq ir-rollercoaster miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Trid titla' fuq ir-rollercoaster miegħi?
messages.zh: 你想和我一起坐过山车吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go on the rollercoaster with me?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nippreferi noqgħod fin-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nippreferi noqgħod fin-nofs.

messages.en: Yes, but I'd prefer to sit in the middle.

messages.zh: 好，我们坐在一起。
messages.en: Okay, we'll sit next to each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象过山车沿轨道上坡、俯冲、转弯，边画路线边读 rollercoaster，把整个单词和游乐设施联系起来。

gloss_zh: 所给词条仅标注“用马耳他语”，具体词义未说明

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression supplied with the label 'bil-Malti', meaning 'in Maltese', but without a specific lexical definition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个仅附有“用马耳他语”这一语言标注的表达；所给材料没有说明其具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li fl-entrata għandha biss l-indikazzjoni 'bil-Malti', mingħajr definizzjoni tat-tifsira speċifika tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用马耳他语；此处是语言标注，未提供该表达的具体释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Indikazzjoni li xi ħaġa tingħad jew tinkiteb bil-lingwa Maltija; hawnhekk ma tingħatax tifsira speċifika tal-espressjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied label indicates the Maltese language, while leaving the expression's specific meaning unspecified.

formal.mt: L-entrata għal 'Roman uncia' tinkludi biss l-indikazzjoni 'bil-Malti' u ma tagħtix definizzjoni speċifika.
formal.en: The entry for 'Roman uncia' includes only the label 'in Maltese' and provides no specific definition.
formal.zh: “Roman uncia”词条仅包含“用马耳他语”的标注，没有提供具体释义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'Roman uncia' hawn? Mark: Hawn miktub biss 'bil-Malti'; ma hemmx definizzjoni speċifika.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Roman uncia' mean here? Mark: It only says 'in Maltese' here; there is no specific definition.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的“Roman uncia”是什么意思？Mark：这里只写了“用马耳他语”，没有具体释义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)

messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'Roman uncia' hawn?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这条做成“释义待补”的学习卡：bil-Malti只提示所用语言，不能代替Roman uncia的具体词义。

gloss_zh: 浪漫的；富于幻想的；浪漫主义的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with love, or expressing tender feelings and affection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与爱情有关，或表达温柔情感和爱意的；浪漫的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-imħabba jew li jesprimi sentimenti teneri u affezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浪漫的；与爱情、温柔情感或理想化想象有关的；也可指具有浪漫主义特点的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Romantiku jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa marbuta mal-imħabba u mas-sentimenti teneri, jew persuna jew ħsieb li jagħti spazju lill-ideali u lill-immaġinazzjoni; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa marbuta mar-romantiċiżmu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something romantic expresses love or tender feelings, reflects an idealized view of life, or has qualities associated with romanticism.

formal.mt: Fil-film, l-ittra miktuba bl-idejn hija ġest romantiku li jesprimi l-imħabba tal-protagonist.
formal.en: In the film, the handwritten letter is a romantic gesture that expresses the protagonist's love.
formal.zh: 在这部电影中，那封手写信是表达主人公爱意的浪漫举动。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'taħseb dwar piknik ħdejn il-baħar għal għeluq sninha? David: Jidhirli ġest romantiku ħafna. Elena: Mela nieħu wkoll l-ikel favorit tagħha.
colloquial.en: Elena: What do you think about a picnic by the sea for her birthday? David: I think it's a very romantic gesture. Elena: Then I'll bring her favourite food too.
colloquial.zh: Elena：她生日时去海边野餐，你觉得怎么样？David：我觉得这是个很浪漫的举动。Elena：那我也带上她最喜欢的食物。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'taħseb dwar piknik ħdejn il-baħar għal għeluq sninha?
messages.mt_standard: X'taħseb dwar piknik ħdejn il-baħar għal għeluq sninha?
messages.zh: 她生日时去海边野餐，你觉得怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think about a picnic by the sea for her birthday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidhirli ġest romantiku ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Jidhirli ġest romantiku ħafna.
messages.zh: 我觉得这是个很浪漫的举动。
messages.en: I think it's a very romantic gesture.

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nieħu wkoll l-ikel favorit tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nieħu wkoll l-ikel favorit tagħha.
messages.zh: 那我也带上她最喜欢的食物。
messages.en: Then I'll bring her favourite food too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“手写情书是 ġest romantiku”记住形容词的用法：romantiku 描述举动或事物的特点，romantiċiżmu 则命名一种思想或倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An approach to art, literature, or life that places particular importance on emotion, imagination, and individual experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在艺术、文学或生活态度中，特别重视情感、想象和个人体验的浪漫主义或浪漫倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment jew tendenza fl-arti, fil-letteratura jew fil-ħajja li tagħti importanza speċjali lis-sentimenti, lill-immaġinazzjoni u lill-esperjenza personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浪漫主义；强调情感、想象及个人体验的文艺思想或看待生活的倾向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ir-romantiċiżmu huwa moviment jew mod ta' ħsieb li jenfasizza s-sentimenti, l-immaġinazzjoni u l-esperjenza tal-individwu fl-arti, fil-letteratura jew fil-mod kif wieħed iħares lejn il-ħajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Romanticism is an approach to art, literature, or life that gives special importance to emotion, imagination, and individual experience.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-influwenza tar-romantiċiżmu fil-poeżija, b'attenzjoni għas-sentimenti personali u għall-immaġinazzjoni.
formal.en: The study examines the influence of romanticism in poetry, focusing on personal feelings and imagination.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察浪漫主义对诗歌的影响，重点关注个人情感和想象。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu r-romantiċiżmu f'din il-poeżija? Mark: Ara kemm il-poeta jagħti spazju lis-sentimenti u lill-immaġinazzjoni. Nina: Issa nifhem aħjar għaliex jiddeskrivi kollox b'daqshekk emozzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does romanticism mean in this poem? Mark: Look at how much space the poet gives to feelings and imagination. Nina: Now I understand better why he describes everything with so much emotion.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这首诗里的浪漫主义指什么？Mark：你看，诗人给了情感和想象多大的发挥空间。Nina：现在我更明白他为什么带着这么强烈的感情描写一切了。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu r-romantiċiżmu f'din il-poeżija?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu r-romantiċiżmu f'din il-poeżija?
messages.zh: 这首诗里的浪漫主义指什么？
messages.en: What does romanticism mean in this poem?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm il-poeta jagħti spazju lis-sentimenti u lill-immaġinazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm il-poeta jagħti spazju lis-sentimenti u lill-immaġinazzjoni.
messages.zh: 你看，诗人给了情感和想象多大的发挥空间。
messages.en: Look at how much space the poet gives to feelings and imagination.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem aħjar għaliex jiddeskrivi kollox b'daqshekk emozzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem aħjar għaliex jiddeskrivi kollox b'daqshekk emozzjoni.
messages.zh: 现在我更明白他为什么带着这么强烈的感情描写一切了。
messages.en: Now I understand better why he describes everything with so much emotion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 romantiċiżmu 放进“情感、想象、个人体验”三格笔记中，记成一种思想或倾向；不要只联想到情侣约会。

gloss_zh: 配送、派发、路线安排及货物运送相关用法

teaching_sense.en_definition: Routes used to organize deliveries, dispatch goods, and direct shipments to their destinations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于安排配送、派发货物并引导货运到达目的地的路线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toroq jew itinerarji ppjanati biex jitwasslu l-oġġetti, jintbagħtu l-kunsinni u jiġu organizzati l-vjaġġi lejn id-destinazzjonijiet tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配送；将货物送交收件人或送达指定地点的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih l-oġġetti jitwasslu għand ir-riċevitur jew fil-post indikat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Delivery is the process of taking goods to the person or place for which they are intended.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发运；安排并发出货物，使其开始前往目的地的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess tal-organizzazzjoni u t-tluq tal-oġġetti biex jintbagħtu lejn id-destinazzjoni tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dispatching is the process of organizing goods and sending them towards their intended destinations.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 路线安排；确定人员、车辆或货物应当沿哪些路线行进。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għażla u l-ippjanar tat-toroq li għandhom isegwu n-nies, il-vetturi jew il-kunsinni biex jaslu fid-destinazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Routing is the process of deciding which paths people, vehicles, or goods should follow.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物运送，或作为一批发出的货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-trasport ta' oġġetti lejn destinazzjoni, jew grupp ta' oġġetti li jintbagħtu flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shipment is a quantity of goods sent together, or the act of transporting those goods.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija rrevediet ir-rotot tal-kunsinna biex tnaqqas id-dewmien u twassal l-oġġetti fil-ħin.
formal.en: The company reviewed its delivery routes to reduce delays and deliver goods on time.
formal.zh: 公司重新审查了配送路线，以减少延误并按时送达货物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema rotot se nużaw għall-kunsinni llum? Mark: Nibdew b'dawk qrib il-maħżen, imbagħad immorru lejn il-belt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which routes are we using for deliveries today? Mark: We'll start with those near the warehouse, then head towards the city.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天配送走哪些路线？Mark：先走仓库附近的那些，再往城里去。

messages.speaker: Maja (配送协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema rotot se nużaw għall-kunsinni llum?
messages.mt_standard: Liema rotot se nużaw għall-kunsinni llum?
messages.zh: 今天配送走哪些路线？
messages.en: Which routes are we using for deliveries today?

messages.speaker: Mark (配送司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibdew b'dawk qrib il-maħżen, imbagħad immorru lejn il-belt.
messages.mt_standard: Nibdew b'dawk qrib il-maħżen, imbagħad immorru lejn il-belt.
messages.zh: 先走仓库附近的那些，再往城里去。
messages.en: We'll start with those near the warehouse, then head towards the city.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象配送地图上的几条彩色线路，把rotot与“货从哪里出发、沿哪条路送到”连起来记，再区分配送、发运、路线安排和货运四种语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rough in texture or lacking politeness in manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容质地粗糙，或形容人的言行粗鲁、缺乏礼貌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu wiċċ jew tessut mhux fin, jew li juri nuqqas ta' edukazzjoni u rispett fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗糙的；质地不细腻或表面不光滑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu tessut mhux fin jew wiċċ mhux lixx meta jintmess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is coarse has a rough texture rather than a fine or smooth surface.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无礼的；言行缺乏应有的礼貌或尊重的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jurix il-kortesija jew ir-rispett li wieħed għandu juri lejn ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is discourteous behaves without the politeness or respect expected towards other people.

formal.mt: Il-kampjun tad-drapp kien rozz wisq biex jintuża għal ħwejjeġ li jmissu direttament mal-ġilda.
formal.en: The fabric sample was too coarse to be used for clothing worn directly against the skin.
formal.zh: 这块布料样品过于粗糙，不适合制作直接贴着皮肤穿的衣物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn il-bank? Mark: Il-bejjiegħ kien rozz miegħi, u ma ridtx nibqa' nitkellem miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave the counter? Mark: The seller was rude to me, and I didn't want to keep talking to him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么离开柜台了？Mark：卖东西的人对我很无礼，我不想再跟他说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn il-bank?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn il-bank?
messages.zh: 你为什么离开柜台了？
messages.en: Why did you leave the counter?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bejjiegħ kien rozz miegħi, u ma ridtx nibqa' nitkellem miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bejjiegħ kien rozz miegħi, u ma ridtx nibqa' nitkellem miegħu.
messages.zh: 卖东西的人对我很无礼，我不想再跟他说话。
messages.en: The seller was rude to me, and I didn't want to keep talking to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“摸着粗、听着冲”记住rozz：布料让手感到粗糙，言语让人感到无礼；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 遮蔽；庇护；避风雨的地方

teaching_sense.en_definition: Protection from bad weather or danger, or a place that provides such protection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 免受恶劣天气或危险侵袭的遮蔽与庇护，也可指提供这种保护的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Protezzjoni mix-xita, mir-riħ jew mill-periklu, jew post li jagħti din il-protezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遮蔽或庇护；使人免受风雨或危险影响的保护，或提供这种保护的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-protezzjoni li żżomm lil xi ħadd 'il bogħod mix-xita, mir-riħ jew mill-periklu, jew il-post fejn tingħata din il-protezzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Shelter is protection from bad weather or danger, or a place where you can find that protection.

formal.mt: Meta bdiet il-maltempata, il-mixi waqaf u l-parteċipanti fittxew rpar f'bini fil-qrib.
formal.en: When the storm began, the walk stopped and the participants sought shelter in a nearby building.
formal.zh: 暴风雨开始时，步行活动停止了，参与者到附近的一栋建筑里寻找庇护。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ix-xita qed tiżdied; fejn nistgħu nsibu rpar? Mark: Ejja taħt dak is-saqaf sakemm tgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Maja: The rain is getting heavier; where can we find shelter? Mark: Let's get under that roof until it passes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：雨越下越大了，我们去哪儿避一避？Mark：我们到那个屋顶下面，等雨过去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (步行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xita qed tiżdied; fejn nistgħu nsibu rpar?
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xita qed tiżdied; fejn nistgħu nsibu rpar?
messages.zh: 雨越下越大了，我们去哪儿避一避？
messages.en: The rain is getting heavier; where can we find shelter?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja taħt dak is-saqaf sakemm tgħaddi.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja taħt dak is-saqaf sakemm tgħaddi.
messages.zh: 我们到那个屋顶下面，等雨过去吧。
messages.en: Let's get under that roof until it passes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把rpar配上一幅“人走进屋檐下避雨”的画面：既记住获得的庇护，也记住提供庇护的地方，再用“寻找遮蔽处”整组复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thin objects have little thickness, while thin strands have a small diameter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物体厚度小，或线、丝等的直径小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti rqieq għandhom ftit ħxuna, filwaqt li ħjut rqieq għandhom dijametru żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 薄的；形容线、丝等时指细的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta oġġetti jkunu rqieq, ikollhom ftit ħxuna jew dijametru żgħir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Objects that are thin have only a small distance between their opposite surfaces.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, il-ħobż għandu jinqata' fi flieli rqieq.
formal.en: For this recipe, the bread should be cut into thin slices.
formal.zh: 制作这道食谱时，应将面包切成薄片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid flieli rqieq jew ħoxnin? Mark: Rqieq, jekk jogħġbok, biex ikun aktar faċli niekolhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want thin or thick slices? Mark: Thin ones, please, so they are easier for me to eat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要薄片还是厚片？马克：薄片，谢谢，这样我吃起来更方便。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid flieli rqieq jew ħoxnin?
messages.mt_standard: Trid flieli rqieq jew ħoxnin?
messages.zh: 你要薄片还是厚片？
messages.en: Do you want thin or thick slices?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rqieq, jekk jogħġbok, biex ikun aktar faċli niekolhom.
messages.mt_standard: Rqieq, jekk jogħġbok, biex ikun aktar faċli niekolhom.
