teaching_sense.en_definition: Something arranged is organized or prepared, while something fixed has been repaired.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示事情已经安排妥当，或物品已经修理好；具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa rranġata tkun organizzata jew imħejjija, jew tkun issewwiet wara ħsara, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已安排好的；已组织或准备妥当的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa rranġata tkun ġiet organizzata jew imħejjija sabiex tkun lesta għall-użu jew għall-attività maħsuba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is arranged, the necessary preparations or organizational decisions have already been made.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修好的；经过修理而恢复正常使用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett irranġat ikun ġie msewwi wara ħsara u jkun jista' jerġa' jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a damaged object is fixed, it has been repaired so that it can be used again.

formal.mt: Kollox huwa rranġat għal-laqgħa, u l-kompjuter li kien bil-ħsara issa huwa rranġat ukoll.
formal.en: Everything is arranged for the meeting, and the computer that was faulty is now repaired as well.
formal.zh: 会议的一切事宜都已安排妥当，先前出故障的电脑现在也已修好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kollox irranġat għall-festa? Mark: Iva, u l-kompjuter ukoll irranġat, allura nistgħu ndoqqu l-mużika.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is everything arranged for the party? Mark: Yes, and the computer is fixed too, so we can play the music.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：聚会的一切都安排好了吗？马克：好了，电脑也修好了，所以我们可以放音乐了。

messages.speaker: Maja (聚会组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kollox irranġat għall-festa?
messages.mt_standard: Kollox irranġat għall-festa?
messages.zh: 聚会的一切都安排好了吗？
messages.en: Is everything arranged for the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-kompjuter ukoll irranġat, allura nistgħu ndoqqu l-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-kompjuter ukoll irranġat, allura nistgħu ndoqqu l-mużika.
messages.zh: 好了，电脑也修好了，所以我们可以放音乐了。
messages.en: Yes, and the computer is fixed too, so we can play the music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个完成画面记住 rranġat：会议事项打好勾是“安排好的”，故障电脑重新开机是“修好的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To report something is to give information about an event, situation, or problem to another person or an authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事件、情况或问题的信息告知他人或有关负责人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti informazzjoni lil persuna oħra jew lil awtorità dwar ġrajja, sitwazzjoni jew problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 报告；向他人或有关负责人说明事件、情况或问题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Twassal informazzjoni dwar dak li ġara jew dwar problema lil xi ħadd li għandu jkun jaf biha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you report an event or problem, you tell someone about it and provide relevant information.

formal.mt: L-impjegat rraporta l-inċident lill-maniġer u ta deskrizzjoni ċara ta' dak li ġara.
formal.en: The employee reported the incident to the manager and gave a clear description of what happened.
formal.zh: 该员工向经理报告了这起事件，并清楚描述了经过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi ħadd rraporta l-problema tal-internet? Mark: Iva, Pawlu rraporta l-problema dalgħodu, u t-tekniku ġej wara nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has anyone reported the internet problem? Mark: Yes, Pawlu reported the problem this morning, and the technician is coming this afternoon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有人报告网络问题了吗？马克：有，保罗今天早上已经报告了，技术员下午会来。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd rraporta l-problema tal-internet?
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd rraporta l-problema tal-internet?
messages.zh: 有人报告网络问题了吗？
messages.en: Has anyone reported the internet problem?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu rraporta l-problema dalgħodu, u t-tekniku ġej wara nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu rraporta l-problema dalgħodu, u t-tekniku ġej wara nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 有，保罗今天早上已经报告了，技术员下午会来。
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu reported the problem this morning, and the technician is coming this afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rraporta 放进“发现问题→告知负责人”的场景里记忆：重点是传递情况，例句里的动作已经发生，可译作“报告了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say or do something again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将已经说过的话再说一次，或将已经做过的事再做一次。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terġa' tgħid xi ħaġa li tkun għedt jew terġa' tagħmel xi ħaġa li tkun għamilt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重复；再次说出同样的话或再次做同样的事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terġa' tgħid l-istess kliem jew terġa' tagħmel l-istess azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you repeat something, you say or do it again, often to make it clearer or to practise it.

formal.mt: L-għalliem rrepeta l-istruzzjonijiet biex l-istudenti kollha jifhmu x'kellhom jagħmlu.
formal.en: The teacher repeated the instructions so that all the students would understand what they had to do.
formal.zh: 老师重复了操作说明，以便所有学生都明白自己需要做什么。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qal Pawlu? Ma smajtx sew. Ben: Qal li l-laqgħa fl-erbgħa, u mbagħad rrepeta l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did Paul say? I didn't hear properly. Ben: He said the meeting is at four, and then he repeated the time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗说了什么？我没听清。贝恩：他说会议四点开始，随后又重复了一遍时间。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qal Pawlu? Ma smajtx sew.
messages.mt_standard: X'qal Pawlu? Ma smajtx sew.
messages.zh: 保罗说了什么？我没听清。
messages.en: What did Paul say? I didn't hear properly.

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li l-laqgħa fl-erbgħa, u mbagħad rrepeta l-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li l-laqgħa fl-erbgħa, u mbagħad rrepeta l-ħin.
messages.zh: 他说会议四点开始，随后又重复了一遍时间。
messages.en: He said the meeting is at four, and then he repeated the time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用课堂动作记忆：老师说一句，你再说一句；练习做一遍，再做一遍。把 rrepeta 和“再来一次”的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To roleplay or pretend is to act as a character or behave as though an imagined situation were real.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过言语和动作扮演某个角色，或表现得仿佛某种虚构情况是真实的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieħu r-rwol ta' persuna jew karattru u titkellem jew taġixxi bħalu, jew tagħmel bħallikieku sitwazzjoni immaġinata kienet vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扮演角色；假装自己是某人，或假装处于某种情境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taġixxi fir-rwol ta' persuna oħra jew tagħmel bħallikieku xi ħaġa li mhijiex vera kienet qed isseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you roleplay or pretend, you act as someone else or behave as if an imagined situation were real.

collocations.en: played the part of a customer

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju fil-klassi, Mark rreċta r-rwol ta' tabib u staqsa lill-pazjent dwar is-sintomi tiegħu.
formal.en: During the classroom exercise, Mark roleplayed a doctor and asked the patient about his symptoms.
formal.zh: 在课堂练习中，马克扮演医生，询问病人有哪些症状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Mark fil-logħba? Pawlu: Rreċta r-rwol ta' tabib, u jien għamilt ta' pazjent.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Mark do in the game? Pawlu: He roleplayed a doctor, and I played the patient.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在游戏里做了什么？保罗：他扮演医生，我扮演病人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel Mark fil-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel Mark fil-logħba?
messages.zh: 马克在游戏里做了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark do in the game?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rreċta r-rwol ta' tabib, u jien għamilt ta' pazjent.
messages.mt_standard: Rreċta r-rwol ta' tabib, u jien għamilt ta' pazjent.
messages.zh: 他扮演医生，我扮演病人。
messages.en: He roleplayed a doctor, and I played the patient.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课堂角色卡写着“医生”和“病人”：拿到卡后按角色说话、做动作，就把 rreċta 与“扮演、假装”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 登记；办理入住手续；登记申领失业救济

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter someone's name or other details in an official record.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某人的姓名或其他资料录入正式名册或记录。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tniżżel isem persuna jew dettalji oħra f'reġistru uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 登记；将姓名或资料录入正式记录。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tniżżel ismek jew informazzjoni oħra f'reġistru uffiċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you register, you provide your name or other details so that they can be entered in an official record.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 办理入住或报到手续，登记自己已经到达。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti d-dettalji tiegħek mal-wasla f'lukanda jew post ieħor biex tiġi rreġistrata l-wasla tiegħek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you check in, you give your details on arrival so that a hotel or another organization can record your presence.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 登记申请领取失业救济。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tirreġistra mal-awtorità responsabbli biex tapplika għal benefiċċji tal-qgħad.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you register for unemployment benefits, you formally apply for financial support because you are unemployed.

collocations.zh: 在酒店办理了入住手续

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal rreġistra l-ismijiet tal-parteċipanti qabel il-bidu tal-kors.
formal.en: The official registered the participants' names before the course began.
formal.zh: 工作人员在课程开始前登记了参加者的姓名。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark diġà rreġistra fil-lukanda? Nina: Iva, u ċ-ċavetta tal-kamra diġà għandu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has Mark checked in at the hotel yet? Nina: Yes, and he already has the room key.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克已经在酒店办好入住了吗？妮娜：对，他已经拿到房间钥匙了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark diġà rreġistra fil-lukanda?
messages.mt_standard: Mark diġà rreġistra fil-lukanda?
messages.zh: 马克已经在酒店办好入住了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark checked in at the hotel yet?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ċ-ċavetta tal-kamra diġà għandu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ċ-ċavetta tal-kamra diġà għandu.
messages.zh: 对，他已经拿到房间钥匙了。
messages.en: Yes, and he already has the room key.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个场景串起来记：课程报名登记姓名，酒店入住登记到达，失业时登记申领救济；核心画面都是把资料正式记下来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To identify someone or something because you have seen, heard, or known them before.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 凭以前见过、听过或了解过的经验，认出某人或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħraf min hi persuna jew x'inhi xi ħaġa għax tkun rajtha, smajtha jew kont tafha qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 认出；根据已有的认识或记忆辨明某人或某物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħraf persuna jew ħaġa minn xi dehra, leħen jew karatteristika li tkun taf minn qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you recognise someone or something, you identify them because you have encountered them before.

collocations.zh: 认出了一张熟悉的面孔

formal.mt: Ix-xhud rrikonoxxa lir-raġel fir-ritratt u kkonferma li kien rah ħdejn l-istazzjon.
formal.en: The witness recognised the man in the photograph and confirmed that he had seen him near the station.
formal.zh: 证人认出了照片中的男子，并确认曾在车站附近见过他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien jaf li kont jien fuq it-telefon? Lara: Rrikonoxxa l-vuċi tiegħek mill-ewwel!
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he know it was me on the phone? Lara: He recognised your voice straight away!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他怎么知道电话里是我？拉拉：他一下就认出了你的声音！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien jaf li kont jien fuq it-telefon?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien jaf li kont jien fuq it-telefon?
messages.zh: 他怎么知道电话里是我？
messages.en: How did he know it was me on the phone?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rrikonoxxa l-vuċi tiegħek mill-ewwel!
messages.mt_standard: Rrikonoxxa l-vuċi tiegħek mill-ewwel!
messages.zh: 他一下就认出了你的声音！
messages.en: He recognised your voice straight away!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象接到电话还没听到姓名，就凭熟悉的声音认出朋友；用“已有记忆对上眼前线索”来记 rrikonoxxa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give back money that someone has paid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人已经支付的款项退还给对方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti lura flus li persuna tkun ħallset għal prodott jew servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退还已收取的款项；向付款者退款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħallas lura lil persuna l-flus li tkun ħallset, pereżempju meta tirritorna prodott jew jitħassar servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a business refunds your money, it gives back money you paid for a product or service.

collocations.en: refunded the money to the customer

formal.mt: Wara li l-avveniment tħassar, l-organizzatur rrimborsa l-prezz sħiħ tal-biljetti lill-klijenti.
formal.en: After the event was cancelled, the organiser refunded the full ticket price to the customers.
formal.zh: 活动取消后，主办方向顾客退还了全部票款。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-ħanut rrimborsa l-flus għaż-żarbun? Mark: Iva, tawni lura l-ammont kollu meta rritornajtu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did the shop refund the money for the shoes? Mark: Yes, they gave me the full amount back when I returned them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：店里退了那双鞋的钱吗？马克：退了，我把鞋退回去时，他们把钱全退给我了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħanut rrimborsa l-flus għaż-żarbun?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħanut rrimborsa l-flus għaż-żarbun?
messages.zh: 店里退了那双鞋的钱吗？
messages.en: Did the shop refund the money for the shoes?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tawni lura l-ammont kollu meta rritornajtu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tawni lura l-ammont kollu meta rritornajtu.
messages.zh: 退了，我把鞋退回去时，他们把钱全退给我了。
messages.en: Yes, they gave me the full amount back when I returned them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象购物时钱从你手里交给商家，退货时钱沿原路回到你手里；把 rrimborsa 记成“已付款项退回来”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fix something damaged or make reparations for harm caused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 修好损坏的东西；或对造成的伤害、损失作出赔偿或补救。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isewwi xi ħaġa bil-ħsara jew jagħmel tajjeb għall-ħsara jew għat-telf li jkun ikkawża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修理损坏或不能正常运作的东西，使其恢复正常。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isewwi xi ħaġa li tkun inkisret jew li ma tkunx qed taħdem sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone repairs something, they restore it to a usable or working condition.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对自己造成的伤害或损失作出赔偿或补救。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel tajjeb għall-ħsara jew għat-telf li jkun ikkawża, permezz ta' kumpens jew ta' azzjoni li tirranġa s-sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone makes reparations, they compensate for harm or loss they have caused.

collocations.en: made reparations for the damage he caused
collocations.zh: 对自己造成的损害作出了赔偿

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur rripara għall-ħsara li kkawża billi ħallas l-ispejjeż kollha tat-tiswija.
formal.en: The contractor made reparations for the damage he caused by paying all the repair costs.
formal.zh: 承包商支付了全部维修费用，以赔偿自己造成的损害。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tekniku rripara l-magna tal-ħasil? Mark: Iva, issa taħdem sew u nistgħu naħslu l-ħwejjeġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the technician repair the washing machine? Mark: Yes, it works properly now, and we can wash the clothes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：维修师傅把洗衣机修好了吗？马克：修好了，现在运作正常，我们可以洗衣服了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tekniku rripara l-magna tal-ħasil?
messages.mt_standard: It-tekniku rripara l-magna tal-ħasil?
messages.zh: 维修师傅把洗衣机修好了吗？
messages.en: Did the technician repair the washing machine?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa taħdem sew u nistgħu naħslu l-ħwejjeġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa taħdem sew u nistgħu naħslu l-ħwejjeġ.
messages.zh: 修好了，现在运作正常，我们可以洗衣服了。
messages.en: Yes, it works properly now, and we can wash the clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rripara 配成两幅学习画面：修好坏机器，以及赔偿造成的损失；共同记住“把损坏补好”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange for something to be kept available for a particular person or purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事先安排保留座位、房间或其他资源，供特定的人或用途使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibbukkja jew iżomm xi ħaġa disponibbli għal persuna partikolari jew għal skop speċifiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预订或预留某物，使其可供指定的人或用途使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel arranġament minn qabel biex post, kamra jew xi ħaġa oħra tinżamm għal persuna jew għal skop partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you reserve something, you arrange for it to be kept available for you or a particular purpose.

collocations.en: reserved a room at the hotel

formal.mt: L-organizzatur rriserva sala għal-laqgħa u bagħat id-dettalji lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The organiser reserved a hall for the meeting and sent the details to the participants.
formal.zh: 组织者为会议预订了一间大厅，并向参加者发送了详细信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min rriserva l-mejda għal-lejla? Pawlu: Jien, għal tnejn fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who reserved the table for tonight? Pawlu: I did, for two people at eight.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今晚的桌位是谁订的？保罗：我订的，八点，两个人。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min rriserva l-mejda għal-lejla?
messages.mt_standard: Min rriserva l-mejda għal-lejla?
messages.zh: 今晚的桌位是谁订的？
messages.en: Who reserved the table for tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, għal tnejn fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, għal tnejn fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 我订的，八点，两个人。
messages.en: I did, for two people at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 rriserva，就想象餐桌上放着写有姓名的预订牌：东西先留好，到了约定时间再使用。

gloss_zh: 我们曾努力；我们曾奋力争取

teaching_sense.en_definition: We made a determined effort to achieve something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示我们曾为实现某个目标付出坚定的努力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamilna sforz qawwi u determinat biex nilħqu għan jew niksbu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我们曾努力奋斗，力求实现某个目标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħdimna b'determinazzjoni u għamilna sforz kbir biex nilħqu għan partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When we say we strived, we mean that we made a determined effort to achieve something.

collocations.en: we strived to improve the service
we strived to achieve our goal

formal.mt: Matul is-sena, rsistejna biex intejbu s-servizz u nnaqqsu l-ħin ta' stennija.
formal.en: Throughout the year, we strived to improve the service and reduce waiting times.
formal.zh: 这一年里，我们努力改善服务并缩短等候时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kien diffiċli tlestu l-proġett fil-ħin? Toni: Iva, imma rsistejna biex inlestuh, u fl-aħħar irnexxielna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was it difficult to finish the project on time? Toni: Yes, but we strived to finish it, and in the end we succeeded.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：按时完成项目很难吗？托尼：是啊，不过我们努力把它做完，最后成功了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien diffiċli tlestu l-proġett fil-ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Kien diffiċli tlestu l-proġett fil-ħin?
messages.zh: 按时完成项目很难吗？
messages.en: Was it difficult to finish the project on time?

messages.speaker: Toni (项目组同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rsistejna biex inlestuh, u fl-aħħar irnexxielna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rsistejna biex inlestuh, u fl-aħħar irnexxielna.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过我们努力把它做完，最后成功了。
messages.en: Yes, but we strived to finish it, and in the end we succeeded.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rsistejna 整体记成“我们当时努力过”，想象团队一起赶项目；它强调努力，成功与否要看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: No longer working after retirement, or removed from consideration or participation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指已经退休、不再从事原来职业的；也指已从审议、参与或使用中撤回的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li waqfet taħdem għax ħarġet bil-pensjoni, jew xi ħaġa li tneħħiet mill-kunsiderazzjoni jew mill-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已退休的，即已经结束职业工作生活的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li temmet il-ħajja tax-xogħol tagħha u ħarġet bil-pensjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is retired has ended their working life and no longer follows their former occupation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已撤回或撤出的，不再供考虑、参与或使用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li ġiet irtirata u m'għadhiex titressaq għall-kunsiderazzjoni, għall-parteċipazzjoni jew għall-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is withdrawn has been taken back and is no longer offered for consideration or use.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport irtirat mhux se jiġi diskuss fil-laqgħa li jmiss.
formal.en: The withdrawn report will not be discussed at the next meeting.
formal.zh: 这份已撤回的报告将不会在下次会议上讨论。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Missierek għadu jgħallem? David: Le, issa rtirat, imma għadu jgħinni fil-matematika.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does your father still teach? David: No, he is retired now, but he still helps me with mathematics.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你爸爸还在教书吗？戴维：没有，他现在退休了，不过还会帮我学数学。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missierek għadu jgħallem?
messages.mt_standard: Missierek għadu jgħallem?
messages.zh: 你爸爸还在教书吗？
messages.en: Does your father still teach?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa rtirat, imma għadu jgħinni fil-matematika.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa rtirat, imma għadu jgħinni fil-matematika.
messages.zh: 没有，他现在退休了，不过还会帮我学数学。
messages.en: No, he is retired now, but he still helps me with mathematics.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片记 rtirat：人物卡写“退休”，文件卡写“撤回”。搭配对象帮助你选对中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who serves others by carrying out errands or small tasks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为别人服务，受托跑腿或办理琐碎事务的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqdi lil ħaddieħor billi twassal affarijiet jew tagħmel qadjiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 替别人跑腿、传送物品或办理杂事的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel qadjiet għal ħaddieħor, bħal twassil ta' affarijiet jew xogħol żgħir ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ruffjan is someone who serves another person by running errands or carrying out small tasks.

collocations.en: an errand runner who delivers letters
to send the errand runner on an errand

formal.mt: Ir-ruffjan għandu jwassal l-ittri fl-uffiċċju qabel nofsinhar.
formal.en: The errand runner must deliver the letters to the office before noon.
formal.zh: 跑腿人员必须在中午以前把信送到办公室。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min se jwassal dawn l-ittri? Pawlu: Ir-ruffjan se jeħodhom miegħu meta joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who is going to deliver these letters? Pawlu: The errand runner will take them with him when he goes out.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁去送这些信？保罗：跑腿的人出门时会把它们带上。

messages.speaker: Marta (办公室职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jwassal dawn l-ittri?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jwassal dawn l-ittri?
messages.zh: 谁去送这些信？
messages.en: Who is going to deliver these letters?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-ruffjan se jeħodhom miegħu meta joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-ruffjan se jeħodhom miegħu meta joħroġ.
messages.zh: 跑腿的人出门时会把它们带上。
messages.en: The errand runner will take them with him when he goes out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ruffjan和送信、跑腿、办杂事的画面连在一起；本条专记所给的跑腿人员义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of the city of Rome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城市“罗马”的专有名称，马耳他语写作Ruma。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju tal-belt ta' Ruma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罗马，城市的专有名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jirreferi għall-belt ta' Ruma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ruma is the Maltese name used to refer to the city of Rome.

formal.mt: Il-grupp se jqatta' tlett ijiem f'Ruma u jżur diversi mużewijiet.
formal.en: The group will spend three days in Rome and visit several museums.
formal.zh: 这个团体将在罗马停留三天，并参观几家博物馆。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejra għall-vaganza? Anna: Se mmur Ruma u noqgħod hemm tlett ijiem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going on holiday? Anna: I am going to Rome and staying there for three days.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你打算去哪里度假？安娜：我要去罗马，在那里住三天。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn sejra għall-vaganza?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn sejra għall-vaganza?
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur Ruma u noqgħod hemm tlett ijiem.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur Ruma u noqgħod hemm tlett ijiem.
messages.zh: 我要去罗马，在那里住三天。
messages.en: I am going to Rome and staying there for three days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把Ruma写在罗马的旅行地图上：它是城市名称，首字母大写；f'Ruma可连着记为“在罗马”。

gloss_zh: 罗马的；与罗马人有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Rome, its people, or their culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与罗马、罗马人或其文化有关的，用来修饰名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Ruma, mar-Rumani jew mal-kultura tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罗马的；属于罗马人或与其文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-belt ta' Ruma, in-nies tagħha jew il-kultura tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Roman is connected with Rome, its people, or their culture.

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu jiddeskrivi l-istil Ruman tad-disinn u jispjega l-karatteristiċi tiegħu.
formal.en: The student should describe the design's Roman style and explain its features.
formal.zh: 学生应描述这一设计的罗马风格，并解释其特点。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Liema disinn għażilt għall-proġett? David: Għażilt disinn Ruman għax jogħġobni dan l-istil.
colloquial.en: Marija: Which design did you choose for the project? David: I chose a Roman design because I like this style.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为这个项目选了哪种设计？戴维：我选了罗马式设计，因为我喜欢这种风格。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema disinn għażilt għall-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Liema disinn għażilt għall-proġett?
messages.zh: 你为这个项目选了哪种设计？
messages.en: Which design did you choose for the project?

messages.speaker: David (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għażilt disinn Ruman għax jogħġobni dan l-istil.
messages.mt_standard: Għażilt disinn Ruman għax jogħġobni dan l-istil.
messages.zh: 我选了罗马式设计，因为我喜欢这种风格。
messages.en: I chose a Roman design because I like this style.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用短语对照记忆：Ruma是“罗马”这座城，stil Ruman是“罗马风格”；在本条中把Ruman当作修饰名词的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long fictional prose work that develops characters and events through a connected story.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以散文形式叙述虚构故事，并较充分地展开人物与情节的长篇文学作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rumanz huwa xogħol letterarju twil miktub bil-proża, li jirrakkonta storja fittizja u jiżviluppa l-karattri u l-ġrajjiet tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长篇小说；以较长篇幅展开人物、事件及其发展的虚构散文作品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rumanz huwa kitba letterarja twila bil-proża li tippreżenta storja fittizja b'karattri u ġrajjiet żviluppati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A novel is a long work of fiction in prose that tells a developed story about its characters.

formal.mt: Għall-proġett tal-letteratura, kull student għandu jagħżel rumanz u janalizza l-iżvilupp tal-karattru ewlieni.
formal.en: For the literature project, each student must choose a novel and analyse the development of its main character.
formal.zh: 在文学专题作业中，每位学生须选择一部长篇小说，分析其主要人物的发展。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Pawlu: Qed naqra rumanz dwar familja li tmur tgħix Għawdex. Maja: Meta tispiċċah, tista' ssellifhuli?
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Pawlu: I'm reading a novel about a family that moves to Gozo. Maja: When you finish it, can you lend it to me?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在读什么？保罗：我在读一本讲述一家人搬到戈佐岛生活的长篇小说。玛雅：读完后可以借给我吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naqra rumanz dwar familja li tmur tgħix Għawdex.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naqra rumanz dwar familja li tmur tgħix Għawdex.
messages.zh: 我在读一本讲述一家人搬到戈佐岛生活的长篇小说。
messages.en: I'm reading a novel about a family that moves to Gozo.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tispiċċah, tista' ssellifhuli?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tispiċċah, tista' ssellifhuli?
messages.zh: 读完后可以借给我吗？
messages.en: When you finish it, can you lend it to me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rumanz 和一本厚厚的故事书联系起来：人物多、情节长，读长篇小说就练习说 naqra rumanz。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A round fruit with a tough skin and many seeds surrounded by juicy pulp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种外皮较坚韧、内部含许多带多汁果肉的籽粒的圆形水果，即石榴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rummiena hija frotta tonda b'qoxra iebsa u b'ħafna żrieragħ imdawrin b'polpa mmerqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石榴；外皮较坚韧，内部有许多包着多汁果肉的籽粒的水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rummiena hija frotta b'qoxra iebsa li fiha ħafna żrieragħ, kull waħda mdawra b'polpa mmerqa li tittiekel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pomegranate is a round fruit with a tough outer skin and many seeds surrounded by edible, juicy pulp.

formal.mt: Biex tipprepara l-insalata, aqsam rummiena, oħroġ iż-żrieragħ u żidhom mal-ħaxix.
formal.en: To prepare the salad, cut open a pomegranate, remove the seeds and add them to the vegetables.
formal.zh: 准备这道沙拉时，先切开一个石榴，取出石榴籽，再加入蔬菜中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid ftit żrieragħ tar-rummiena? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Din ir-rummiena ħelwa? Sara: Iva, doq ftit!
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like some pomegranate seeds? Mark: Yes, thanks. Is this pomegranate sweet? Sara: Yes, try some!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：要吃点石榴籽吗？马克：好啊，谢谢。这个石榴甜吗？萨拉：甜，尝一点吧！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit żrieragħ tar-rummiena?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit żrieragħ tar-rummiena?
messages.zh: 要吃点石榴籽吗？
messages.en: Would you like some pomegranate seeds?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Din ir-rummiena ħelwa?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Din ir-rummiena ħelwa?
messages.zh: 好啊，谢谢。这个石榴甜吗？
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Is this pomegranate sweet?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, doq ftit!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, doq ftit!
messages.zh: 甜，尝一点吧！
messages.en: Yes, try some!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 rummiena 时想象切开石榴后露出满满籽粒，再把整个水果 rummiena 与石榴籽 żrieragħ 配对练习。

gloss_zh: 一次猛泼出的大量水；常用于戈佐岛用语 bir-ruppat，表示大量一下子泼下或倾泻而下

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large quantity of water thrown all at once, used in Gozo, especially in the expression bir-ruppat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戈佐岛用语，指一次猛泼出的大量水；常见于 bir-ruppat，也可用来形容雨水猛烈倾泻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ruppat huwa ammont kbir ta' ilma mitfugħ f'daqqa. Din il-kelma tintuża f'Għawdex, speċjalment fl-espressjoni bir-ruppat, anki biex tiddeskrivi xita qawwija.

sense_translations.en_definition: large quantity of water thrown all at once e.g niezla xita bir-ruppat; itfa' barmil ilma bir-ruppat. Used in Gozo.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次猛泼出的大量水。用于戈佐岛，常以 bir-ruppat 表示把水一下子大量泼出，也可形容大雨倾泻而下。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ruppat huwa kwantità kbira ta' ilma li tintefa' kollha f'daqqa. F'Għawdex tintuża l-espressjoni bir-ruppat meta wieħed jitfa' ħafna ilma f'daqqa jew meta tkun nieżla xita qawwija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In Gozo, a ruppat is a large quantity of water thrown all at once, and the expression bir-ruppat also describes rain pouring down heavily.

collocations.en: to throw a bucketful of water all at once
collocations.zh: 把一桶水一下子猛泼出去

formal.mt: F'eżerċizzju dwar il-vokabularju ta' Għawdex, l-istudenti qraw is-sentenza: "Il-ħaddiem tefa' barmil ilma bir-ruppat biex jaħsel il-bitħa."
formal.en: In an exercise on Gozo vocabulary, the students read the sentence: "The worker threw a bucketful of water all at once to wash the yard."
formal.zh: 在一项关于戈佐岛词汇的练习中，学生读到了这个句子：“工人把一桶水一下子泼出去，用来冲洗院子。”

colloquial.mt: Marija: Se toħroġ issa? Ġużeppi: Le, nieżla xita bir-ruppat! Marija: Mela nistennew ftit sakemm tonqos.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you going out now? Ġużeppi: No, it's pouring down! Marija: Then let's wait a little until it eases.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你现在要出去吗？朱塞佩：不出去，雨正下得像泼水一样！玛丽亚：那我们等一会儿，等雨小一点吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se toħroġ issa?
messages.mt_standard: Se toħroġ issa?
messages.zh: 你现在要出去吗？
messages.en: Are you going out now?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nieżla xita bir-ruppat!
messages.mt_standard: Le, nieżla xita bir-ruppat!
messages.zh: 不出去，雨正下得像泼水一样！
messages.en: No, it's pouring down!

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nistennew ftit sakemm tonqos.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nistennew ftit sakemm tonqos.
messages.zh: 那我们等一会儿，等雨小一点吧。
messages.en: Then let's wait a little until it eases.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ruppat 想成一整桶水瞬间泼出的画面，重点记住“大量、一下子”；连同戈佐岛表达 bir-ruppat 一起学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A measuring tool consisting of a flexible strip marked with units of length that can be rolled up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种带有长度刻度、可以卷起收纳的柔性尺带测量工具，即卷尺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rutella hija għodda għall-kejl tat-tul, magħmula minn tejp flessibbli mmarkat b'unitajiet tal-kejl li jista' jitkebbeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷尺；用可卷起的带刻度尺带测量长度的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rutella hija strument li jintuża biex jitkejjel it-tul permezz ta' tejp flessibbli b'marki tal-kejl, li jitkebbeb meta ma jkunx qed jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tape measure is a tool with a flexible marked strip that you extend to measure lengths and roll up for storage.

collocations.en: to measure with a tape measure

formal.mt: Qabel tordna l-purtieri, uża rutella biex tkejjel il-wisa' u l-għoli tat-tieqa, u niżżel il-qisien f'ċentimetri.
formal.en: Before ordering the curtains, use a tape measure to measure the width and height of the window, and record the measurements in centimetres.
formal.zh: 订购窗帘前，先用卷尺测量窗户的宽度和高度，并以厘米为单位记录尺寸。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek rutella biex inkejjel il-mejda? David: Iva, hawn hi. Trid inżommlek tarf wieħed? Lara: Iva, grazzi, hekk inkejjel aktar faċli.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a tape measure so I can measure the table? David: Yes, here it is. Shall I hold one end for you? Lara: Yes, thanks, that will make measuring easier.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有卷尺吗？我想量一下桌子。戴维：有，给你。要我帮你抓住一端吗？拉拉：好，谢谢，这样量起来更方便。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek rutella biex inkejjel il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek rutella biex inkejjel il-mejda?
messages.zh: 你有卷尺吗？我想量一下桌子。
messages.en: Do you have a tape measure so I can measure the table?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn hi. Trid inżommlek tarf wieħed?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn hi. Trid inżommlek tarf wieħed?
messages.zh: 有，给你。要我帮你抓住一端吗？
messages.en: Yes, here it is. Shall I hold one end for you?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi, hekk inkejjel aktar faċli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi, hekk inkejjel aktar faċli.
messages.zh: 好，谢谢，这样量起来更方便。
messages.en: Yes, thanks, that will make measuring easier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 rutella 就想象把带刻度的尺带拉出、量好桌子再卷回去；把单词与“拉出、测量、卷起”三个动作绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A regular sequence of activities that someone follows in everyday life or work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在日常生活或工作中经常遵循的一套固定活动或做事程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' attivitajiet li persuna tagħmel regolarment fil-ħajja ta' kuljum jew fix-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日常反复遵循的惯例、活动安排或固定程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod regolari ta' kif isiru ċerti affarijiet, jew sensiela ta' attivitajiet li jiġu ripetuti ta' spiss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A routine is a sequence of activities that you regularly follow, often at the same time or in the same order.

collocations.zh: 我改变自己的日常安排

formal.mt: L-istudenti ġew imħeġġa jistabbilixxu rutina ta' studju regolari qabel l-eżamijiet.
formal.en: The students were encouraged to establish a regular study routine before the examinations.
formal.zh: 学生们受到鼓励，在考试前建立规律的学习安排。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tagħmel kull filgħodu? Pawlu: Għandi rutina sempliċi: nieħu kolazzjon u mbagħad noħroġ nimxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you do every morning? Pawlu: I have a simple routine: I have breakfast and then go out for a walk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你每天早上做什么？保罗：我的日常安排很简单：吃早饭，然后出去散步。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tagħmel kull filgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: X'tagħmel kull filgħodu?
messages.zh: 你每天早上做什么？
messages.en: What do you do every morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi rutina sempliċi: nieħu kolazzjon u mbagħad noħroġ nimxi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi rutina sempliċi: nieħu kolazzjon u mbagħad noħroġ nimxi.
messages.zh: 我的日常安排很简单：吃早饭，然后出去散步。
messages.en: I have a simple routine: I have breakfast and then go out for a walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把每天按顺序进行的起床、早餐、散步想成一条固定路线，用这幅生活画面记住 rutina 表示日常惯例。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large quantity of something, such as many objects or a great deal of work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量很大的一批事物，也可指大量工作等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità kbira ta' xi ħaġa, bħal ħafna oġġetti jew ħafna xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量；一大批，指事物的数量很多。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għadd jew ammont kbir ta' affarijiet, li jista' jirreferi wkoll għal ħafna xogħol jew materjal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have a ruxxmata of something, you have a large quantity of it.

formal.mt: Matul it-tindif tal-arkivju, instabet ruxxmata dokumenti li kellhom jiġu kklassifikati.
formal.en: During the cleaning of the archive, a large quantity of documents was found that needed to be classified.
formal.zh: 清理档案室时，发现了一大批需要分类的文件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek ma spiċċajtx? Mark: Le, għandi ruxxmata xogħol illum. Niltaqgħu aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Sara: Haven't you finished yet? Mark: No, I've got loads of work today. Let's meet later.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你还没做完吗？马克：还没有，我今天有一大堆工作。我们晚点见吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek ma spiċċajtx?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek ma spiċċajtx?
messages.zh: 你还没做完吗？
messages.en: Haven't you finished yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandi ruxxmata xogħol illum. Niltaqgħu aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandi ruxxmata xogħol illum. Niltaqgħu aktar tard.
messages.zh: 还没有，我今天有一大堆工作。我们晚点见吧。
messages.en: No, I've got loads of work today. Let's meet later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上堆满纸张、待办工作多得做不完；把这个“大量、一大堆”的画面与 ruxxmata 联系起来。

gloss_zh: 词义未注明（所给释义为idk）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not specified in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料标为名词，但没有提供可确认的具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma mmarkata bħala nom li t-tifsira tagħha mhix speċifikata fil-materjal mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给释义仅为表示“不知道”的idk，未说明这个名词的实际含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal jagħti biss l-indikazzjoni "idk" u ma jispeċifikax x'tfisser din il-kelma bħala nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry marks this word as a noun but does not establish what it means.

formal.mt: Il-kelma "ruġġjata" hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda l-materjal mogħti ma jispjegax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The word "ruġġjata" is marked as a noun, but the supplied material does not explain its meaning.
formal.zh: “ruġġjata”被标为名词，但所给材料没有解释它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser "ruġġjata"? Mark: Hawn miktub biss "idk"; minn dan il-materjal ma nistgħux inkunu nafu t-tifsira tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does "ruġġjata" mean? Mark: It only says "idk" here; we cannot determine its meaning from this material.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“ruġġjata”是什么意思？马克：这里仅写着“idk”；我们无法根据这份材料确定它的意思。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser "ruġġjata"?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser "ruġġjata"?
messages.zh: “ruġġjata”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does "ruġġjata" mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub biss "idk"; minn dan il-materjal ma nistgħux inkunu nafu t-tifsira tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub biss "idk"; minn dan il-materjal ma nistgħux inkunu nafu t-tifsira tagħha.
messages.zh: 这里仅写着“idk”；我们无法根据这份材料确定它的意思。
messages.en: It only says "idk" here; we cannot determine its meaning from this material.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记ruġġjata的拼写和名词标签，旁注“词义待确认”；不要把idk当作该词本身的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sequence of Catholic prayers, or the string of beads used to count those prayers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天主教的一套祈祷经文，即玫瑰经；也指诵念时用来计数的念珠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' talb Kattoliku, jew il-katina taż-żibeġ li tintuża biex jingħadd dan it-talb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玫瑰经，天主教按一定次序诵念的一套祷文；也指辅助诵念和计数的玫瑰经念珠。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Talba Kattolika magħmula minn sensiela ta' talbiet ripetuti waqt meditazzjoni fuq misteri tal-fidi, jew il-katina taż-żibeġ użata biex jingħaddu dawn it-talbiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rosary is a sequence of Catholic prayers, or a string of beads used to keep count while saying them.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa ta' talb, il-parteċipanti qalu r-rużarju flimkien.
formal.en: During the prayer meeting, the participants said the rosary together.
formal.zh: 在祈祷聚会上，参与者一同诵念了玫瑰经。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nanna, fejn poġġejt ir-rużarju tiegħek? Marija: Fil-kexxun ħdejn is-sodda. Tista' ġġibhuli, jekk jogħġbok?
colloquial.en: Anna: Grandma, where did you put your rosary? Marija: In the drawer beside the bed. Could you bring it to me, please?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：奶奶，你把念珠放在哪里了？玛丽亚：在床边的抽屉里。请帮我拿过来，好吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Nanna, fejn poġġejt ir-rużarju tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Nanna, fejn poġġejt ir-rużarju tiegħek?
messages.zh: 奶奶，你把念珠放在哪里了？
messages.en: Grandma, where did you put your rosary?

messages.speaker: Marija (祖母)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ħdejn is-sodda. Tista' ġġibhuli, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ħdejn is-sodda. Tista' ġġibhuli, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 在床边的抽屉里。请帮我拿过来，好吗？
messages.en: In the drawer beside the bed. Could you bring it to me, please?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指逐颗拨动念珠、口中依次诵念祷文；用“念珠加祷文”的画面同时记住 rużarju 的两种指向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bird known for its beautiful song, which can also be heard at night.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种以优美鸣声著称的小鸟，夜间也会鸣唱，即夜莺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir magħruf għall-għana sabiħ tiegħu, li jista' jinstema' wkoll bil-lejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夜莺，一种以清亮悦耳的鸣唱著称、夜间也会鸣叫的小型鸟类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir b'rix kannella li huwa magħruf għall-għana melodjuż tiegħu u li jista' jgħanni wkoll matul il-lejl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A nightingale is a small brown bird famous for its beautiful song, which can be heard during the night as well as the day.

collocations.zh: 我听见一只夜莺在鸣唱

formal.mt: Fir-rapport dwar l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, ġie nnutat li nstema' rużinjol jgħanni wara nżul ix-xemx.
formal.en: The birdwatching report noted that a nightingale was heard singing after sunset.
formal.zh: 观鸟报告记录到，日落后听见了一只夜莺鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tisma' dak l-għasfur? Ġużeppi: Iva, dak rużinjol. Kemm jgħanni sabiħ!
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear that bird? Ġużeppi: Yes, that's a nightingale. What a beautiful song!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听见那只鸟的叫声了吗？朱塞佩：听见了，那是夜莺。它唱得真好听！

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' dak l-għasfur?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' dak l-għasfur?
messages.zh: 你听见那只鸟的叫声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that bird?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak rużinjol. Kemm jgħanni sabiħ!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak rużinjol. Kemm jgħanni sabiħ!
messages.zh: 听见了，那是夜莺。它唱得真好听！
messages.en: Yes, that's a nightingale. What a beautiful song!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rużinjol 配上一幅月下小鸟歌唱的画面，用“夜里传来优美鸟鸣”这个场景记住夜莺。

gloss_zh: 毁坏；破损货物；毁坏行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of serious damage in which something has lost its usefulness or original condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物严重受损，失去原有状态或使用价值的毁坏状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' ħsara kbira li fih xi ħaġa titlef il-qagħda oriġinali jew l-użu tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物或其他事物遭到严重破坏后的毁坏、破败状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' bini jew ta' xi ħaġa oħra wara li tkun ġarrbet ħsara kbira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Ruin is the state of something that has been badly damaged and has lost its former condition.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经破损，因而影响使用或出售的货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti jew merkanzija li ġarrbu ħsara u li għalhekk ma jistgħux jintużaw jew jinbiegħu bħas-soltu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Damaged goods are items whose condition has been spoiled, reducing their usefulness or saleability.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物遭到严重破坏或变得无法使用的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha xi ħadd jagħmel ħsara kbira lil xi ħaġa jew jagħmilha ma tistax tintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This sense refers to the act of damaging something so severely that it can no longer function properly.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-rvina tal-bini wara n-nar u l-ħsara lill-merkanzija li kienet ġewwa.
formal.en: The report describes the ruin of the building after the fire and the damage to the goods inside.
formal.zh: 报告描述了火灾后建筑物的毁坏情况，以及内部货物的损坏情况。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Rajt il-maħżen wara n-nar? Pawlu: Iva, rvina sħiħa! Anki l-kaxxi kollha nħarqu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you see the warehouse after the fire? Pawlu: Yes, complete ruin! Even all the boxes burned.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你看到火灾后的仓库了吗？保罗：看到了，彻底毁了！连所有箱子都烧掉了。

messages.speaker: Marta (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-maħżen wara n-nar?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-maħżen wara n-nar?
messages.zh: 你看到火灾后的仓库了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the warehouse after the fire?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rvina sħiħa! Anki l-kaxxi kollha nħarqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rvina sħiħa! Anki l-kaxxi kollha nħarqu.
messages.zh: 看到了，彻底毁了！连所有箱子都烧掉了。
messages.en: Yes, complete ruin! Even all the boxes burned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rvina 配上一张火灾后仓库的图：建筑毁坏、货物破损，再联想到造成这种结果的毁坏行为，分清三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Instructions or agreed standards that say what people may, must, or must not do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定人们可以、必须或不得做什么的规则或共同准则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struzzjonijiet jew prinċipji miftiehma li jgħidu x'jistgħu jagħmlu n-nies, x'għandhom jagħmlu u x'ma jistgħux jagħmlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约束行为或规定活动进行方式的各项规则。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' struzzjonijiet jew prinċipji li jirregolaw l-imġiba tan-nies jew il-mod kif issir attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rules are instructions or accepted principles that govern how people behave or how an activity is carried out.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jaqraw ir-rwiegel tal-kompetizzjoni qabel ma jibdew l-ewwel prova.
formal.en: Participants must read the competition rules before starting the first round.
formal.zh: 参赛者必须在开始第一轮比赛前阅读竞赛规则。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Taf ir-rwiegel tal-logħba? Mark: Għadni le. Tista' tispjegahomli qabel nibdew?
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you know the rules of the game? Mark: Not yet. Can you explain them to me before we start?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你知道游戏规则吗？马克：还不知道。开始前你能给我讲讲吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf ir-rwiegel tal-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Taf ir-rwiegel tal-logħba?
messages.zh: 你知道游戏规则吗？
messages.en: Do you know the rules of the game?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Tista' tispjegahomli qabel nibdew?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Tista' tispjegahomli qabel nibdew?
messages.zh: 还不知道。开始前你能给我讲讲吗？
messages.en: Not yet. Can you explain them to me before we start?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rwiegel 写在游戏说明卡上，下面列出几条允许和禁止的行为，用整套游戏规则的画面记住它。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The inner, nonphysical part of a person, or the shared feeling that gives a group its character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人的内在精神或心灵，也可指赋予群体共同特点的精神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' ġewwa ta' persuna li mhijiex fiżika, jew is-sentiment komuni li jagħti karattru lil grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人的非物质内在精神，或一个群体所体现的共同精神。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-aspett mhux materjali ta' persuna, jew is-sentiment u l-karattru komuni li jidhru f'komunità jew fi grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spirit is the nonphysical aspect of a person, or the shared feeling that characterizes a group.

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu jsaħħaħ ir-rwħ ta' għaqda fil-komunità permezz ta' attivitajiet komuni.
formal.en: The project aims to strengthen the spirit of unity in the community through shared activities.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在通过共同参与的活动，加强社区的团结精神。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għoġbitek l-attività tal-bieraħ? David: Iva, kien hemm rwħ ta' għaqda u kulħadd għen.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you enjoy yesterday's activity? David: Yes, there was a spirit of unity and everyone helped.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你喜欢昨天的活动吗？戴维：喜欢，大家很有团结精神，每个人都帮了忙。

messages.speaker: Lara (社区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġbitek l-attività tal-bieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għoġbitek l-attività tal-bieraħ?
messages.zh: 你喜欢昨天的活动吗？
messages.en: Did you enjoy yesterday's activity?

messages.speaker: David (社区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien hemm rwħ ta' għaqda u kulħadd għen.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien hemm rwħ ta' għaqda u kulħadd għen.
messages.zh: 喜欢，大家很有团结精神，每个人都帮了忙。
messages.en: Yes, there was a spirit of unity and everyone helped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 rwħ 时想象大家一起出力的场景：看得见的是行动，看不见却能感受到的是共同的精神。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Light rain consisting of very small drops of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由很细小的水滴组成、雨势轻微的毛毛雨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xita ħafifa magħmula minn qtar żgħir ħafna ta' ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以细小雨滴轻轻落下的毛毛雨。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xita ħafifa li tinżel fi qtar fin ħafna u li xxarrab l-affarijiet bil-mod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Drizzle is very light rain that falls in tiny drops and gradually makes surfaces wet.

formal.mt: Matul il-mixja niżel rxiex ħafif, u l-parteċipanti waqfu għal ftit taħt is-siġar.
formal.en: Light drizzle fell during the walk, and the participants stopped briefly under the trees.
formal.zh: 步行途中下起了轻微的毛毛雨，参加者在树下短暂停留。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Barra nieżel ir-rxiex? Ġanni: Iva, ħu ġakketta ħafifa biex ma tixxarrabx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is it drizzling outside? Ġanni: Yes, take a light jacket so you don't get wet.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：外面在下毛毛雨吗？詹尼：是啊，带件薄外套，免得淋湿。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Barra nieżel ir-rxiex?
messages.mt_standard: Barra nieżel ir-rxiex?
messages.zh: 外面在下毛毛雨吗？
messages.en: Is it drizzling outside?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu ġakketta ħafifa biex ma tixxarrabx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu ġakketta ħafifa biex ma tixxarrabx.
messages.zh: 是啊，带件薄外套，免得淋湿。
messages.en: Yes, take a light jacket so you don't get wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 rxiex 时想象外套上慢慢出现细小水点：雨滴很细、雨势很轻，这就是毛毛雨的典型画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cereal plant whose grain is used to make flour and bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种谷类作物，其籽粒可磨成面粉，用来制作黑麦面包等食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-segala hija pjanta taċ-ċereali li ż-żerriegħa tagħha tintuża biex isir id-dqiq u l-ħobż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑麦；其籽粒可用于磨粉和制作面包的谷类作物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-segala hija pjanta taċ-ċereali li titkabbar għaż-żerriegħa tagħha, li tista' tintuża biex isir id-dqiq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rye is a cereal crop whose grain is used for making flour and bread.

formal.mt: Il-kelma Ingliża 'rye' fuq it-tikketta tindika s-segala, li tintuża fil-produzzjoni ta' dan il-ħobż.
formal.en: The English word 'rye' on the label refers to the cereal used in producing this bread.
formal.zh: 标签上的英语单词 rye 指的是制作这种面包所用的黑麦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'rye' fuq dan il-pakkett? Mark: Tfisser segala. Dan hu ħobż tas-segala.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'rye' mean on this packet? Mark: It means segala in Maltese. This is rye bread.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个包装上的 rye 是什么意思？Mark：意思是黑麦，马耳他语叫 segala。这是黑麦面包。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'rye' fuq dan il-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'rye' fuq dan il-pakkett?
messages.zh: 这个包装上的 rye 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'rye' mean on this packet?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser segala. Dan hu ħobż tas-segala.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser segala. Dan hu ħobż tas-segala.
messages.zh: 意思是黑麦，马耳他语叫 segala。这是黑麦面包。
messages.en: It means segala in Maltese. This is rye bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包包装上写着 rye，再把它与马耳他语 segala 和中文“黑麦”连起来；用“黑麦面包、黑麦面粉”两个食品搭配帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 有男子气概的；有男性活力的；雄健的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having qualities conventionally associated with masculinity, such as strength, confidence, or physical vitality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有传统观念中与男性相关的力量、自信或身体活力等特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kwalitajiet tradizzjonalment marbuta mal-maskulinità, bħas-saħħa, il-kunfidenza jew il-vitalità fiżika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有男子气概的；具有传统上被视为男性特征的力量、勇气或自信的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri kwalitajiet tradizzjonalment meqjusa bħala maskili, bħas-saħħa, il-kuraġġ jew il-kunfidenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described as manly has qualities that are conventionally associated with men, such as strength or courage.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有旺盛男性活力的；雄健的，尤指身体力量或性活力充沛的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri saħħa u vitalità maskili qawwija, speċjalment fil-ġisem jew fil-ħajja sesswali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A man described as virile is considered physically strong and full of masculine energy, sometimes especially sexual energy.

collocations.zh: 雄健而有男性活力的男子

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist huwa deskritt bħala raġel rġuli, mimli saħħa u vitalità.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist is described as a virile man, full of strength and vitality.
formal.zh: 小说将主人公描写成一名雄健的男子，充满力量与活力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jidher l-attur f'dan ir-rwol? Mark: Għandu dehra rġuli u jidher kunfidenti ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How does the actor look in this role? Mark: He has a manly appearance and looks very confident.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这位演员在这个角色里的形象怎么样？马克：他看起来很有男子气概，也显得非常自信。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jidher l-attur f'dan ir-rwol?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jidher l-attur f'dan ir-rwol?
messages.zh: 这位演员在这个角色里的形象怎么样？
messages.en: How does the actor look in this role?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu dehra rġuli u jidher kunfidenti ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu dehra rġuli u jidher kunfidenti ħafna.
messages.zh: 他看起来很有男子气概，也显得非常自信。
messages.en: He has a manly appearance and looks very confident.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rġuli 放进“角色外形雄健、充满男性活力”的画面：manly 偏气概，virile 更强调身体或性活力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very small village or a small group of homes in the countryside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规模很小的村庄，或乡间由少量住宅组成的聚落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raħal żgħir ħafna jew grupp żgħir ta' djar fil-kampanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小村落，指由少量住宅组成的乡间聚落。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp żgħir ta' djar fil-kampanja li jifforma komunità żgħira ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hamlet is a very small settlement consisting of only a few homes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小村庄，指规模较小、住户不多的村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Raħal ta' daqs żgħir fejn jgħixu ftit nies u hemm għadd żgħir ta' djar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A small village is a rural community with relatively few homes and inhabitants.

collocations.en: a small village in the countryside

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi l-ħajja ta' kuljum f'rħajjel fejn jgħixu għoxrin familja.
formal.en: The study describes daily life in a hamlet where twenty families live.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了一个住着二十户人家的小村落的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn mort ilbieraħ? David: Żort rħajjel fil-kampanja. Kien hemm ftit djar u kien kwiet ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did you go yesterday? David: I visited a small village in the countryside. There were only a few houses, and it was very quiet.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你昨天去哪儿了？戴维：我去了一个乡间小村庄。那里只有几栋房子，非常安静。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mort ilbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mort ilbieraħ?
messages.zh: 你昨天去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you go yesterday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żort rħajjel fil-kampanja. Kien hemm ftit djar u kien kwiet ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Żort rħajjel fil-kampanja. Kien hemm ftit djar u kien kwiet ħafna.
messages.zh: 我去了一个乡间小村庄。那里只有几栋房子，非常安静。
messages.en: I visited a small village in the countryside. There were only a few houses, and it was very quiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 rħajjel 时想象田野里聚着几户人家，用“小而宁静的村落”这一画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Up to the time when a specified event happens or a condition is met.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某种状态或行为持续到指定事件发生或某个条件满足的时候。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika li azzjoni jew sitwazzjoni tibqa' għaddejja sal-ħin li fih iseħħ avveniment jew tintlaħaq kundizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直到；表示行为或状态持续至某个时间点或事件发生时。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li azzjoni jew stat ikompli sal-mument li fih jiġri xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something continues until an event happens, it continues up to the time of that event.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直到；表示持续到所说的时间或事件发生之时。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex turi li xi ħaġa tibqa' għaddejja sal-ħin jew sal-avveniment imsemmi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you wait till something happens, you keep waiting up to the moment when it happens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直至……之时；表示某种安排或状态持续到特定条件满足的时候。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li arranġament jew sitwazzjoni jibqa' fis-seħħ sal-mument li fih tintlaħaq kundizzjoni speċifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an arrangement applies until such time as a condition is met, it remains in effect until that happens.

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju se jibqa' magħluq sa meta jitlesta x-xogħol.
formal.en: The office will remain closed until the work is completed.
formal.zh: 办公室将保持关闭，直至工程完工。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadni fit-triq. Tista' tistennieni? Lara: Iva, nibqa' hawn sa meta tasal.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm still on my way. Can you wait for me? Lara: Yes, I'll stay here until you arrive.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我还在路上。你能等我吗？拉拉：可以，我会在这里待到你来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni fit-triq. Tista' tistennieni?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni fit-triq. Tista' tistennieni?
messages.zh: 我还在路上。你能等我吗？
messages.en: I'm still on my way. Can you wait for me?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nibqa' hawn sa meta tasal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nibqa' hawn sa meta tasal.
messages.zh: 可以，我会在这里待到你来。
messages.en: Yes, I'll stay here until you arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sa meta 想成时间线上的终点标记：前面的事情一直持续，直到后面的事件发生。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the movable parts at the end of the hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手部末端可以弯曲和活动的指状部分，用于触摸、指示或抓握。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saba' huwa waħda mill-partijiet twal u mobbli fit-tarf tal-id, li nużaw biex immissu, nippuntaw jew naqbdu l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手指；位于手部末端、可弯曲活动并用于触摸或抓握的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saba' huwa waħda mill-partijiet mobbli fit-tarf tal-id li jgħinuna mmissu u naqbdu l-affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A finger is one of the movable parts of your hand that you use to touch and hold things.

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu jipponta b'saba' wieħed lejn il-kelma li jkun qed jaqra.
formal.en: The student should point with one finger to the word they are reading.
formal.zh: 学生应当用一根手指指着自己正在读的单词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi saba' maħmuġ bil-linka. Mark: Aħsel idek bis-sapun.
colloquial.en: Maja: I've got ink on one finger. Mark: Wash your hand with soap.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我有一根手指沾上墨水了。Mark：用肥皂洗洗手吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi saba' maħmuġ bil-linka.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi saba' maħmuġ bil-linka.
messages.zh: 我有一根手指沾上墨水了。
messages.en: I've got ink on one finger.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħsel idek bis-sapun.
messages.mt_standard: Aħsel idek bis-sapun.
messages.zh: 用肥皂洗洗手吧。
messages.en: Wash your hand with soap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 saba' 就伸出一根手指，做“指向单词”的动作；把词形、手指形象和动作一起记住，并留意词尾的撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The short, thick digit on the side of the hand that helps you grip things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于手的一侧、较短而粗的手指，可以与其他手指配合抓握物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-saba' l-kbir huwa s-saba' qasir u oħxon fil-ġenb tal-id li jgħinna naqbdu l-affarijiet flimkien mas-swaba' l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拇指；位于手侧、较短而粗，并能与其他手指配合抓握的手指。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-saba' l-kbir huwa s-saba' fil-ġenb tal-id li jista' jmiss is-swaba' l-oħra u jgħin biex naqbdu l-oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your thumb is the short, thick digit at the side of your hand that helps you grip objects.

formal.mt: Biex tiftaħ il-kaxxa, agħfas il-buttuna bis-saba' l-kbir u erfa' l-għatu.
formal.en: To open the box, press the button with your thumb and lift the lid.
formal.zh: 打开盒子时，请用拇指按下按钮，再掀起盖子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: B'liema saba' nagħfas din il-buttuna? Mark: Bis-saba' l-kbir. Hekk tkun aktar faċli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which finger should I use to press this button? Mark: Your thumb. That makes it easier.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我该用哪根手指按这个按钮？Mark：用拇指。这样更容易。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: B'liema saba' nagħfas din il-buttuna?
messages.mt_standard: B'liema saba' nagħfas din il-buttuna?
messages.zh: 我该用哪根手指按这个按钮？
messages.en: Which finger should I use to press this button?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bis-saba' l-kbir. Hekk tkun aktar faċli.
messages.mt_standard: Bis-saba' l-kbir. Hekk tkun aktar faċli.
messages.zh: 用拇指。这样更容易。
messages.en: Your thumb. That makes it easier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 saba' l-kbir 整体配上“拇指按按钮”的画面：每读一次就用拇指轻按桌面，借助具体动作记住整个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the small movable parts at the front of the foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脚前端可以活动的趾状部分，在站立和行走时帮助支撑与保持平衡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saba' tas-sieq huwa waħda mill-partijiet żgħar u mobbli fit-tarf ta' quddiem tas-sieq li jgħinuna nżommu l-bilanċ meta noqogħdu bilwieqfa jew nimxu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脚趾；脚前端的小型可活动部分，参与支撑身体和保持平衡。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saba' tas-sieq huwa waħda mill-partijiet mobbli fit-tarf ta' quddiem tas-sieq li jgħinuna nimxu u nżommu l-bilanċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A toe is one of the small movable parts at the front of your foot.

collocations.en: stub a toe against the table

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, il-parteċipant għandu jċaqlaq kull saba' tas-sieq bil-mod.
formal.en: During the exercise, the participant should move each toe slowly.
formal.zh: 练习时，参与者应缓慢活动每一根脚趾。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħabbatt saba' tas-sieq mal-mejda! Mark: Oqgħod bilqiegħda ftit. Għadek tista' ċċaqilqu?
colloquial.en: Maja: I stubbed my toe against the table! Mark: Sit down for a moment. Can you still move it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的脚趾撞到桌子了！Mark：先坐一会儿。你还能动那根脚趾吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħabbatt saba' tas-sieq mal-mejda!
messages.mt_standard: Ħabbatt saba' tas-sieq mal-mejda!
messages.zh: 我的脚趾撞到桌子了！
messages.en: I stubbed my toe against the table!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod bilqiegħda ftit. Għadek tista' ċċaqilqu?
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod bilqiegħda ftit. Għadek tista' ċċaqilqu?
messages.zh: 先坐一会儿。你还能动那根脚趾吗？
messages.en: Sit down for a moment. Can you still move it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 saba' tas-sieq 和鞋子前端里的脚趾联系起来；读词组时轻动脚趾，再与伸出手指说 saba' 的动作对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word expressing that someone or something is pleasant to look at.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示人或事物外观漂亮、令人赏心悦目的词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tesprimi li persuna jew ħaġa għandha dehra li togħġob lill-għajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漂亮的；好看的；形容外观令人赏心悦目。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tiddeskrivi persuna jew ħaġa li għandha dehra sabiħa u li togħġob lill-għajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is pretty, they have an appearance that is pleasant to look at.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ġnien sabiħ b'ħafna fjuri u siġar.
formal.en: The report describes a beautiful garden with many flowers and trees.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一座美丽的花园，里面有许多花草树木。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dan ir-ritratt! Kemm hu sabiħ! Mark: Iva, ħadtu fil-ġnien ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at this photograph! It's so beautiful! Mark: Yes, I took it in the garden yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看这张照片！真漂亮！Mark：是啊，我昨天在花园里拍的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dan ir-ritratt! Kemm hu sabiħ!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dan ir-ritratt! Kemm hu sabiħ!
messages.zh: 看这张照片！真漂亮！
messages.en: Look at this photograph! It's so beautiful!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħadtu fil-ġnien ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħadtu fil-ġnien ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 是啊，我昨天在花园里拍的。
messages.en: Yes, I took it in the garden yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sabiħ 和一张漂亮照片一起记：ritratt sabiħ。看到照片便练说 Kemm hu sabiħ!（真漂亮！），用画面和赞叹句帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word introducing the purpose of an action or the result someone intends to achieve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出某个行动的目的或希望达到的结果，意思是“为了”或“以便”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintroduċi l-għan ta' azzjoni jew ir-riżultat li xi ħadd ikun irid jikseb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了；用来引出采取某项行动的目的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex turi għal liema għan issir azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to introduce the purpose for which someone does something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了；以便；引出行动所要达到的目的或预期结果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex torbot azzjoni mal-għan tagħha jew ma' riżultat mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to explain what an action is intended to achieve or make possible.

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat laqgħa sabiex il-ġenituri jkunu jistgħu jistaqsu dwar il-programm il-ġdid.
formal.en: The school organised a meeting so that parents could ask questions about the new programme.
formal.zh: 学校组织了一次会议，以便家长就新课程方案提出问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex se titlaq kmieni? Mark: Sabiex nasal fil-ħin għal-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you leaving early? Mark: So that I arrive in time for the lesson.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么要提早出发？Mark：为了能准时到达课堂。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex se titlaq kmieni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex se titlaq kmieni?
messages.zh: 你为什么要提早出发？
messages.en: Why are you leaving early?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sabiex nasal fil-ħin għal-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Sabiex nasal fil-ħin għal-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 为了能准时到达课堂。
messages.en: So that I arrive in time for the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sabiex 记成连接“行动”和“目的”的桥：提早出发 → sabiex → 准时到达。每次遇到它，都追问一句“为了什么？”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An urban railway system whose trains run underground for all or part of their route.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城市公共轨道交通系统，其列车在全部或部分线路上于地下运行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' ferroviji għat-trasport pubbliku f'belt, li jgħaddu minn taħt l-art tul ir-rotta kollha jew parti minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地铁；在城市地下全部或部分运行的公共铁路系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' trasport pubbliku bil-ferroviji f'belt, li jivvjaġġaw taħt l-art tul ir-rotta kollha jew parti minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A subway is an urban railway system that carries passengers underground for all or part of their journey.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi jistgħu jużaw is-sabwej biex jaslu fiċ-ċentru tal-belt.
formal.en: Visitors can use the subway to reach the city centre.
formal.zh: 游客可以乘地铁前往市中心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se naslu fil-mużew? Mark: Ejja nieħdu s-sabwej. Hemm stazzjon ħdejn il-lukanda.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are we going to get to the museum? Mark: Let's take the subway. There's a station near the hotel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们怎么去博物馆？马克：坐地铁吧。酒店附近有个站。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se naslu fil-mużew?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se naslu fil-mużew?
messages.zh: 我们怎么去博物馆？
messages.en: How are we going to get to the museum?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieħdu s-sabwej. Hemm stazzjon ħdejn il-lukanda.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieħdu s-sabwej. Hemm stazzjon ħdejn il-lukanda.
messages.zh: 坐地铁吧。酒店附近有个站。
messages.en: Let's take the subway. There's a station near the hotel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sabwej 放进“买票、进站、乘地铁”的出行画面，连记 biljett tas-sabwej 和 stazzjon tas-sabwej，让词义与实际动作一起留下印象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A religious term used to refer to a priest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于指称司铎或神父的宗教称谓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terminu reliġjuż li jintuża biex jirreferi għal qassis.

sense_translations.en_definition: A term related to a religious. A priest who will become a “sacerdot”
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与宗教有关的称谓，所指涉及神父或司铎；原释义描述的是将成为“sacerdot”的神父。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terminu marbut mar-reliġjon li, skont id-deskrizzjoni mogħtija, jirreferi għal qassis li se jsir sacerdot.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In the supplied description, this religious term refers to a priest who is to become a sacerdot.

formal.mt: Is-sacerdot tal-parroċċa laqa' lill-viżitaturi fid-daħla tal-knisja.
formal.en: The priest of the parish welcomed the visitors at the entrance to the church.
formal.zh: 堂区的神父在教堂入口处迎接了来访者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ħdejn il-bieb tal-knisja? Mark: Dak is-sacerdot tal-parroċċa. Ejja nsellmulu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that by the church door? Mark: That's the priest of the parish. Let's go and say hello to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：教堂门口那位是谁？马克：那是堂区的神父。我们过去打个招呼吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (来访者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ħdejn il-bieb tal-knisja?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ħdejn il-bieb tal-knisja?
messages.zh: 教堂门口那位是谁？
messages.en: Who is that by the church door?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak is-sacerdot tal-parroċċa. Ejja nsellmulu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak is-sacerdot tal-parroċċa. Ejja nsellmulu.
messages.zh: 那是堂区的神父。我们过去打个招呼吧。
messages.en: That's the priest of the parish. Let's go and say hello to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sacerdot 与“教堂门口迎接来访者的神父”这一画面绑定，再用 sacerdot tal-parroċċa 记住人物身份与堂区场景；这是情境记忆法，不作词源拆解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Meanwhile; during the time when another action or situation is continuing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示另一件事情正在进行时，某个动作或情况也在同一期间发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li turi li azzjoni jew sitwazzjoni sseħħ waqt li tkun għaddejja xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与此同时；在另一件事情进行的这段时间里。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Matul iż-żmien li fih tkun qed isseħħ xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use sadanittant to introduce something happening while another activity or situation continues.

collocations.zh: 与此同时，我们准备食物

formal.mt: It-tim qed jiġbor l-informazzjoni; sadanittant, il-kumitat qed iħejji r-rapport.
formal.en: The team is collecting the information; meanwhile, the committee is preparing the report.
formal.zh: 团队正在收集资料；与此同时，委员会正在起草报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-ikel għadu mhux lest. Mark: Tajjeb, sadanittant inħejji l-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: The food isn't ready yet. Mark: All right, I'll set the table in the meantime.
colloquial.zh: Maja：饭还没做好。Mark：好，那我趁这会儿摆好餐桌。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ikel għadu mhux lest.
messages.mt_standard: L-ikel għadu mhux lest.
messages.zh: 饭还没做好。
messages.en: The food isn't ready yet.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, sadanittant inħejji l-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, sadanittant inħejji l-mejda.
messages.zh: 好，那我趁这会儿摆好餐桌。
messages.en: All right, I'll set the table in the meantime.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两件同时进行的事画成两条平行线，在中间写上 sadanittant，记住它连接“与此同时”的情景。

gloss_zh: 《圣经》中提及的某类人（所给释义未具体指明）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A category of people associated with the Bible, not identified more precisely in the supplied gloss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指与《圣经》有关的某类人；所给释义未进一步说明具体是哪一群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kategorija ta' nies marbuta mal-Bibbja, li t-tifsira mogħtija ma tidentifikax b'mod aktar preċiż.

sense_translations.en_definition: these are types of people, see bible.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 这些是某些类别的人，需参看《圣经》；原释义未明确具体群体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dawn huma tipi ta' nies li għalihom għandha tiġi kkonsultata l-Bibbja, mingħajr identifikazzjoni aktar preċiża fit-tifsira mogħtija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss describes sadducej as a category of people and directs the reader to the Bible without identifying the group precisely.

formal.mt: It-tifsira mogħtija għall-kelma 'sadducej' tirreferi għal tipi ta' nies u tindika li għandu jsir riferiment għall-Bibbja.
formal.en: The supplied meaning of 'sadducej' refers to types of people and indicates that the Bible should be consulted.
formal.zh: sadducej 的所给释义提到某些类别的人，并提示应参看《圣经》。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tifsira ta' 'sadducej' tgħid eżatt liema nies huma? Ġanni: Le, issemmi tipi ta' nies u tgħid biex inħarsu fil-Bibbja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does the meaning of 'sadducej' say exactly which people they are? Ġanni: No, it mentions types of people and tells us to look in the Bible.
colloquial.zh: Nina：sadducej 的释义明确说了是哪些人吗？Ġanni：没有，只提到某些类别的人，并让我们参看《圣经》。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tifsira ta' 'sadducej' tgħid eżatt liema nies huma?
messages.mt_standard: It-tifsira ta' 'sadducej' tgħid eżatt liema nies huma?
messages.zh: sadducej 的释义明确说了是哪些人吗？
messages.en: Does the meaning of 'sadducej' say exactly which people they are?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issemmi tipi ta' nies u tgħid biex inħarsu fil-Bibbja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issemmi tipi ta' nies u tgħid biex inħarsu fil-Bibbja.
messages.zh: 没有，只提到某些类别的人，并让我们参看《圣经》。
messages.en: No, it mentions types of people and tells us to look in the Bible.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sadducej 写在书签上，旁边标注“某类人，参看圣经”；先记材料明确提供的线索，具体群体留待核实。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The people known as Sadducees, referred to collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 撒都该人；用来统称这一群体成员的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-persuni magħrufa bħala s-Sadduċej, imsemmija bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撒都该人，指这一群体的成员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-membri tal-grupp magħruf bħala s-Sadduċej.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The noun sadduċej refers collectively to people known as Sadducees.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jittraduċu l-kelma 'sadduċej' bħala 'Sadducees' bl-Ingliż.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should translate the word 'sadduċej' into English as 'Sadducees'.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生应把 sadduċej 译成英语 Sadducees，即“撒都该人”。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ngħid 'sadduċej' bl-Ingliż? Pawlu: Ngħidu 'Sadducees'; qed nirreferu għal grupp ta' nies.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do I say 'sadduċej' in English? Pawlu: We say 'Sadducees'; we're referring to a group of people.
colloquial.zh: Lara：sadduċej 用英语怎么说？Pawlu：说 Sadducees，指的是一群人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ngħid 'sadduċej' bl-Ingliż?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ngħid 'sadduċej' bl-Ingliż?
messages.zh: sadduċej 用英语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say 'sadduċej' in English?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħidu 'Sadducees'; qed nirreferu għal grupp ta' nies.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħidu 'Sadducees'; qed nirreferu għal grupp ta' nies.
messages.zh: 说 Sadducees，指的是一群人。
messages.en: We say 'Sadducees'; we're referring to a group of people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡上把 sadduċej、Sadducees 和“撒都该人”并排写好，再画一组人物，帮助记住它指群体成员。

gloss_zh: 释义未提供（原释义为问号）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not specified in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料将此词标为名词，但未提供可确定其具体含义的释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex speċifikata fil-materjal mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义仅为问号，无法据此确定该名词的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mogħtija hija biss marka ta' mistoqsija, għalhekk ma tispjegax xi jfisser dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry marks sagristan as a noun but gives no usable definition of its meaning.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'sagristan' hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira tagħha mhijiex mogħtija f'din l-entrata.
formal.en: The word 'sagristan' is marked as a noun, but its meaning is not provided in this entry.
formal.zh: sagristan 这个词被标为名词，但本词条未提供其含义。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'sagristan' f'din il-lista? David: Hawn hemm biss marka ta' mistoqsija; irridu niċċekkjaw it-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does the word 'sagristan' mean in this list? David: There's only a question mark here; we need to check the meaning.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这张表里的 sagristan 是什么意思？David：这里只有一个问号，我们得核实一下词义。

messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'sagristan' f'din il-lista?
