teaching_sense.en_definition: A room in a church where vestments and sacred objects are kept and clergy prepare for services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 教堂内存放祭衣、圣器等礼仪用品，并供神职人员准备礼仪的房间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra fil-knisja fejn jinżammu l-ilbies u l-oġġetti sagri u fejn is-saċerdoti jippreparaw għaċ-ċelebrazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教堂的祭衣室或圣器室，用于存放礼仪用品并准备宗教礼仪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sagristija hija kamra fil-knisja fejn jinżammu l-ilbies u l-oġġetti sagri u fejn is-saċerdoti jippreparaw għaċ-ċelebrazzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sacristy is a room in a church where vestments and sacred objects are stored and clergy prepare for services.

formal.mt: L-ilbies liturġiku jinżamm fis-sagristija, fejn is-saċerdot jipprepara qabel il-quddiesa.
formal.en: The liturgical vestments are kept in the sacristy, where the priest prepares before Mass.
formal.zh: 礼仪祭衣存放在祭衣室内，神父在弥撒前会在那里做准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-qassis? Pawlu: Fis-sagristija, ħdejn l-artal. Maja: Tajjeb, nistennih hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the priest? Pawlu: In the sacristy, beside the altar. Maja: All right, I'll wait for him here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：神父在哪里？Pawlu：在祭衣室里，就在祭坛旁边。Maja：好，我在这里等他。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-qassis?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-qassis?
messages.zh: 神父在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the priest?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教堂工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-sagristija, ħdejn l-artal.
messages.mt_standard: Fis-sagristija, ħdejn l-artal.
messages.zh: 在祭衣室里，就在祭坛旁边。
messages.en: In the sacristy, beside the altar.

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, nistennih hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nistennih hawn.
messages.zh: 好，我在这里等他。
messages.en: All right, I'll wait for him here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sagristija 配上一幅画：神父在教堂的小房间里取祭衣、准备圣器，用这个场景记住“祭衣室”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A low cupboard, usually in a dining room, used for storing dishes, cutlery, and other dining items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常放在餐厅里的低柜，用于存放碗盘、刀叉等餐具，也可在柜面放置物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamara baxxa b'armarji jew kxaxen, ġeneralment fil-kamra tal-ikel, fejn jinżammu platti, pożati u oġġetti oħra tal-mejda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 餐厅内用于存放餐具、桌布等用品的餐边柜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sajbord huwa biċċa għamara baxxa, ġeneralment fil-kamra tal-ikel, b'armarji jew kxaxen għall-platti, il-pożati u oġġetti oħra tal-mejda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sideboard is a low piece of furniture in a dining room in which you keep dishes, cutlery, and other items used at meals.

formal.mt: Fil-kamra tal-ikel tqiegħed sajbord tal-injam biex fih jinżammu l-platti u l-pożati.
formal.en: A wooden sideboard was placed in the dining room to store the dishes and cutlery.
formal.zh: 餐厅里放置了一个木制餐边柜，用来存放碗盘和刀叉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn poġġejt il-frieket? Mark: Fl-ewwel kexxun tas-sajbord. Lara: Sibthom, grazzi!
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you put the forks? Mark: In the first drawer of the sideboard. Lara: I've found them, thanks!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你把叉子放在哪里了？Mark：在餐边柜的第一个抽屉里。Lara：找到了，谢谢！

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġejt il-frieket?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġejt il-frieket?
messages.zh: 你把叉子放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the forks?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-ewwel kexxun tas-sajbord.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-ewwel kexxun tas-sajbord.
messages.zh: 在餐边柜的第一个抽屉里。
messages.en: In the first drawer of the sideboard.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibthom, grazzi!
messages.mt_standard: Sibthom, grazzi!
messages.zh: 找到了，谢谢！
messages.en: I've found them, thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sajbord 与英语 sideboard 对照记忆，再想象餐桌旁装着碗盘和刀叉的低柜，固定“餐边柜”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Up to the present day or the time when someone is speaking or writing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从过去某个时间一直延续或累计到今天或说话、写作的当前时点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sa llum jew sal-mument preżenti li fih persuna tkun qed titkellem jew tikteb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直到现在；表示某种情况从过去持续到当前，或某事截至当前仍未发生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sa llum jew sa dan il-mument, biex turi li sitwazzjoni kompliet minn qabel jew li xi ħaġa għadha ma seħħitx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something has continued until now, it has continued up to the present time.

collocations.en: is still used to this day

collocations.mt: sal-ġurnata tal-lum ma waslet ebda tweġiba
collocations.en: no reply has arrived to date
collocations.zh: 截至目前尚未收到任何回复

collocations.en: from the beginning up to the present day

formal.mt: Sal-ġurnata tal-lum, l-uffiċċju ma rċieva ebda talba għal aktar informazzjoni.
formal.en: To date, the office has received no requests for further information.
formal.zh: 截至目前，该办公室尚未收到任何索取更多信息的请求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadhom jużaw dik il-mejda l-qadima? Pawlu: Iva, sal-ġurnata tal-lum għadhom jieklu fuqha kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do they still use that old table? Pawlu: Yes, to this day they still eat at it every day.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他们还在用那张旧桌子吗？Pawlu：是啊，直到今天，他们仍然每天在那张桌子旁吃饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadhom jużaw dik il-mejda l-qadima?
messages.mt_standard: Għadhom jużaw dik il-mejda l-qadima?
messages.zh: 他们还在用那张旧桌子吗？
messages.en: Do they still use that old table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sal-ġurnata tal-lum għadhom jieklu fuqha kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sal-ġurnata tal-lum għadhom jieklu fuqha kuljum.
messages.zh: 是啊，直到今天，他们仍然每天在那张桌子旁吃饭。
messages.en: Yes, to this day they still eat at it every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一条从过去延伸到今天的时间线，把 sal-ġurnata tal-lum 放在今天这个端点，记住“截至现在”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room or section of a hospital where patients stay and receive care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 医院内供住院患者入住并接受护理的房间或区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra jew sezzjoni fi sptar fejn joqogħdu l-pazjenti waqt li jirċievu l-kura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 医院中供患者住院并接受治疗、护理的病房或病区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sala fi sptar hija kamra jew sezzjoni fejn il-pazjenti joqogħdu u jirċievu kura mingħand it-tobba u l-infermiera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ward is a room or section of a hospital where patients stay while receiving treatment and nursing care.

formal.mt: Wara l-operazzjoni, il-pazjent ġie trasferit għal sala fi sptar biex ikompli jirċievi l-kura.
formal.en: After the operation, the patient was transferred to a hospital ward to continue receiving care.
formal.zh: 手术后，患者被转入医院病房，继续接受护理。

colloquial.mt: Nina: F'liema sala qiegħed ħija? Rita: Fis-sala tal-kirurġija, fit-tieni sular. Nina: Grazzi, se nitla' narah.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which ward is my brother in? Rita: In the surgical ward, on the second floor. Nina: Thank you, I'll go up to see him.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我哥哥在哪个病房？Rita：在二楼的外科病房。Nina：谢谢，我上去看看他。

messages.speaker: Nina (患者家属)
messages.mt_spoken: F'liema sala qiegħed ħija?
messages.mt_standard: F'liema sala qiegħed ħija?
messages.zh: 我哥哥在哪个病房？
messages.en: Which ward is my brother in?

messages.speaker: Rita (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-sala tal-kirurġija, fit-tieni sular.
messages.mt_standard: Fis-sala tal-kirurġija, fit-tieni sular.
messages.zh: 在二楼的外科病房。
messages.en: In the surgical ward, on the second floor.

messages.speaker: Nina (患者家属)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, se nitla' narah.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, se nitla' narah.
messages.zh: 谢谢，我上去看看他。
messages.en: Thank you, I'll go up to see him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sala fi sptar 整组配上“医院里一排病床”的画面；看到完整短语，就联想到供患者住院护理的病房。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A room or hall in a home or other building where people sit down to eat meals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 住宅或其他建筑中供人坐下来吃饭的房间或大厅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra jew sala f'dar jew f'bini ieħor fejn in-nies joqogħdu bilqiegħda biex jieklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 住宅、旅馆等建筑内专门供人用餐的房间或大厅。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kamra jew sala f'dar, f'lukanda jew f'bini ieħor li tintuża biex in-nies jieklu fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dining room is a room in a house or another building where people sit down to eat their meals.

collocations.en: the table in the dining room
the entrance to the dining room

formal.mt: Il-mistednin huma mitluba jidħlu fis-sala tal-pranzu fis-sebgħa ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: Guests are asked to enter the dining room at seven in the evening.
formal.zh: 请宾客于晚上七点进入餐厅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se nieklu llejla? Pawlu: Fis-sala tal-pranzu. Diġà ħejjejt il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we eating tonight? Pawlu: In the dining room. I've already set the table.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚我们在哪里吃饭？Pawlu：在用餐室。我已经摆好餐桌了。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se nieklu llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se nieklu llejla?
messages.zh: 今晚我们在哪里吃饭？
messages.en: Where are we eating tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-sala tal-pranzu. Diġà ħejjejt il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Fis-sala tal-pranzu. Diġà ħejjejt il-mejda.
messages.zh: 在用餐室。我已经摆好餐桌了。
messages.en: In the dining room. I've already set the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和摆好餐桌的房间一起记忆：走进 sala tal-pranzu，就是走进用餐的地方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fish with silvery skin and usually pink or orange flesh, or its flesh eaten as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种表皮银亮、鱼肉通常呈粉红色或橙色的鱼，也指作为食物的这种鱼肉，常称三文鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta b'ġilda lewn il-fidda u laħam ġeneralment roża jew oranġjo, jew il-laħam tagħha li jittiekel bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲑鱼，也指供食用的鲑鱼肉，通常称为三文鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-salamun huwa ħuta b'ġilda lewn il-fidda u laħam ġeneralment roża jew oranġjo; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal-laħam tagħha bħala ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Salmon is a fish with silvery skin and usually pink or orange flesh, and the word also refers to its flesh when eaten as food.

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi flett tas-salamun moħmi, servut bil-ħaxix u r-ross.
formal.en: The menu includes a baked salmon fillet served with vegetables and rice.
formal.zh: 菜单上有烤三文鱼鱼柳，配蔬菜和米饭。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom salamun illum? Lara: Iva, moħmi jew affumikat. Mark: Nieħu s-salamun moħmi, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have salmon today? Lara: Yes, baked or smoked. Mark: I'll have the baked salmon, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：今天有三文鱼吗？Lara：有，有烤的和烟熏的。Mark：请给我烤三文鱼。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom salamun illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom salamun illum?
messages.zh: 今天有三文鱼吗？
messages.en: Do you have salmon today?

messages.speaker: Lara (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, moħmi jew affumikat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, moħmi jew affumikat.
messages.zh: 有，有烤的和烟熏的。
messages.en: Yes, baked or smoked.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nieħu s-salamun moħmi, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nieħu s-salamun moħmi, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我烤三文鱼。
messages.en: I'll have the baked salmon, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salamun 与英语 salmon 并排看，再想象一片橙粉色三文鱼；用颜色和餐盘场景一起记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A regular payment received for work, or a fixed allowance provided to support a person's activities or training.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因工作而定期领取的报酬，也可指为支持某人的活动或培训而发放的固定津贴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas regolari li persuna tirċievi għax-xogħol tagħha, jew somma fissa mogħtija biex tappoġġa l-attivitajiet jew it-taħriġ tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雇员因工作而定期领取的固定薪酬。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas fiss li impjegat jirċievi regolarment mingħand min iħaddmu għax-xogħol li jagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your salary is the fixed amount of money that your employer pays you regularly for your work.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为支持学习、培训或履行特定职责而定期发放的固定津贴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma fissa li tingħata regolarment lil persuna biex tgħinha waqt l-istudju, it-taħriġ jew it-twettiq ta' dmirijiet partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stipend is a fixed payment that someone receives regularly to support their studies, training, or particular duties.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jispeċifika s-salarju fix-xahar u d-data tal-ħlas.
formal.en: The contract specifies the monthly salary and the payment date.
formal.zh: 合同明确规定了月薪和发薪日期。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta jidħol is-salarju tiegħek? Mark: Fl-aħħar tax-xahar, u din id-darba se jkolli żieda żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: When do you get your salary? Mark: At the end of the month, and this time I'll get a small increase.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你什么时候领工资？Mark：月底，而且这次会涨一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta jidħol is-salarju tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Meta jidħol is-salarju tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你什么时候领工资？
messages.en: When do you get your salary?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-aħħar tax-xahar, u din id-darba se jkolli żieda żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-aħħar tax-xahar, u din id-darba se jkolli żieda żgħira.
messages.zh: 月底，而且这次会涨一点。
messages.en: At the end of the month, and this time I'll get a small increase.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salarju 配上每月到账的工资单来记；看到培训或学习语境时，再联想到定期发放的津贴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The settlement of a difference between amounts that are out of balance, through payment or adjustment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过付款或调整，对彼此不平衡的金额之间的差额进行结算。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħlas jew l-aġġustament li jsir biex tiġi rregolata differenza bejn ammonti li mhumiex f'bilanċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对金额不平衡所产生的差额，通过支付或调整完成的结算。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li fih differenza bejn ammonti li mhumiex f'bilanċ tiġi rregolata permezz ta' ħlas jew aġġustament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An imbalance settlement is a payment or adjustment made to resolve a difference between amounts that are out of balance.

collocations.en: the calculation of the imbalance settlement
collocations.zh: 不平衡差额结算的计算
不平衡差额结算款的支付

collocations.en: the date of the imbalance settlement
collocations.zh: 不平衡差额的结算日期

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jistabbilixxi l-ammont u d-data tas-saldu tal-iżbilanċ.
formal.en: The agreement specifies the amount and date of the imbalance settlement.
formal.zh: 协议规定了不平衡差额结算的金额和日期。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex għad hemm ammont x'nħallas? Rita: Dan huwa s-saldu tal-iżbilanċ bejn l-ammont dovut u dak li diġà ħallast.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is there still an amount for me to pay? Rita: This is the imbalance settlement for the difference between the amount due and what you've already paid.
colloquial.zh: Mark：为什么我还需要付一笔钱？Rita：这是应付金额与你已付金额之间不平衡差额的结算款。

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għad hemm ammont x'nħallas?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għad hemm ammont x'nħallas?
messages.zh: 为什么我还需要付一笔钱？
messages.en: Why is there still an amount for me to pay?

messages.speaker: Rita (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa s-saldu tal-iżbilanċ bejn l-ammont dovut u dak li diġà ħallast.
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa s-saldu tal-iżbilanċ bejn l-ammont dovut u dak li diġà ħallast.
messages.zh: 这是应付金额与你已付金额之间不平衡差额的结算款。
messages.en: This is the imbalance settlement for the difference between the amount due and what you've already paid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账面两边金额不相等，再用付款或调整补齐差额；把整个短语记成“把不平衡差额结算清楚”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Salt pans are shallow pools where salty water evaporates so that salt can be collected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供盐水蒸发、使盐结晶后收集的浅池或盐田；本词为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-salini huma għadajjar baxxi fejn l-ilma mielaħ jitħalla jevapora sabiex jinġabar il-melħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过蒸发盐水来获取盐的浅池或盐田。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-salini huma għadajjar baxxi li jintużaw biex jinġabar il-melħ wara li l-ilma mielaħ jevapora.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Salt pans are shallow pools in which salty water evaporates, leaving salt that can be collected.

collocations.en: a visit to the salt pans

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara edukattiva, l-istudenti osservaw kif jinġabar il-melħ mis-salini.
formal.en: During the educational visit, the students observed how salt is collected from the salt pans.
formal.zh: 在教学参观期间，学生们观察了如何从盐田收集盐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi tara s-salini miegħi għada? Luqa: Iva, nixtieq nara kif jinġabar il-melħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come and see the salt pans with me tomorrow? Luqa: Yes, I'd like to see how the salt is collected.
colloquial.zh: Maja：明天想和我一起去看盐田吗？Luqa：想，我想看看盐是怎么收集的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi tara s-salini miegħi għada?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi tara s-salini miegħi għada?
messages.zh: 明天想和我一起去看盐田吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come and see the salt pans with me tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nara kif jinġabar il-melħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nara kif jinġabar il-melħ.
messages.zh: 想，我想看看盐是怎么收集的。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to see how the salt is collected.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salini 配上一排浅浅的晒盐池来记：水蒸发后留下盐；整排盐池的画面也提醒你这是复数形式。

gloss_zh: 圣咏；《诗篇》中的一篇诗歌

teaching_sense.en_definition: A psalm is a sacred song or poem, especially one from the biblical Book of Psalms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于祈祷或赞颂上帝的宗教诗歌，尤指《圣经·诗篇》中的一篇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Salm huwa għanja jew poeżija reliġjuża ta' talb jew tifħir lil Alla, speċjalment waħda mill-Ktieb tas-Salmi fil-Bibbja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣咏，尤指《圣经·诗篇》中用于祈祷或赞颂上帝的诗歌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Salm huwa test poetiku reliġjuż li jintuża fit-talb jew fil-kant, b'mod partikolari wieħed mill-Ktieb tas-Salmi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A psalm is a religious song or poem used in worship, especially one from the biblical Book of Psalms.

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliema qrat salm u spjegat it-tema ewlenija tiegħu.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher read a psalm and explained its main theme.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师读了一篇圣咏，并解释了它的主要主题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema salm se taqra llum? Pawlu: Għadni ma għażiltx wieħed. Tgħinni nagħżel?
colloquial.en: Sara: Which psalm are you going to read today? Pawlu: I haven't chosen one yet. Will you help me choose?
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天准备读哪一篇圣咏？Pawlu：我还没选好。你能帮我选吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema salm se taqra llum?
messages.mt_standard: Liema salm se taqra llum?
messages.zh: 你今天准备读哪一篇圣咏？
messages.en: Which psalm are you going to read today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma għażiltx wieħed. Tgħinni nagħżel?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma għażiltx wieħed. Tgħinni nagħżel?
messages.zh: 我还没选好。你能帮我选吗？
messages.en: I haven't chosen one yet. Will you help me choose?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salm 放进翻开诗篇、轻声诵读的画面中，记住它是一篇可读也可唱的圣咏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Brine is water containing a large amount of dissolved salt, often used to preserve food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 溶有较多盐的水，常用于腌渍或保存食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-salmura hija ilma li fih jinħall ħafna melħ u li spiss jintuża biex jiġi ppreservat l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含盐量较高的水溶液，常用作腌渍或保存食物的盐水。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-salmura hija taħlita ta' ilma u ħafna melħ maħlul, li tintuża fost affarijiet oħra biex jiġi ppreservat l-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Brine is water with a high concentration of dissolved salt, often used for preserving or preparing food.

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika li ż-żebbuġ jinżamm fis-salmura.
formal.en: The label states that the olives are kept in brine.
formal.zh: 标签注明，这些橄榄保存在盐水中。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan iż-żebbuġ qiegħed fis-salmura? Rita: Iva, trid ftit biex idduqu?
colloquial.en: Mark: Are these olives in brine? Rita: Yes, would you like some to taste?
colloquial.zh: Mark：这些橄榄是泡在盐水里的吗？Rita：是的，要尝一点吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan iż-żebbuġ qiegħed fis-salmura?
messages.mt_standard: Dan iż-żebbuġ qiegħed fis-salmura?
messages.zh: 这些橄榄是泡在盐水里的吗？
messages.en: Are these olives in brine?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, trid ftit biex idduqu?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, trid ftit biex idduqu?
messages.zh: 是的，要尝一点吗？
messages.en: Yes, would you like some to taste?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 salmura 时想象一罐泡在咸水里的橄榄，把词和罐中的盐水对应，再连读 żebbuġ fis-salmura。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A living room is a room in a home where people relax, spend time together, or receive visitors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 住宅中供人休息、相聚或接待客人的房间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Salott huwa kamra fid-dar fejn in-nies jistrieħu, iqattgħu l-ħin flimkien jew jilqgħu lill-mistednin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 客厅或起居室，即家中用于休息、相聚和接待客人的房间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Salott huwa kamra ta' dar li tintuża għar-rilassament, biex il-familja tqatta' l-ħin flimkien u biex jintlaqgħu l-mistednin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A living room is a room in a home where people sit together, relax, and welcome visitors.

collocations.en: to sit in the living room

formal.mt: L-appartament għandu salott spazjuż b'żewġ twieqi kbar.
formal.en: The apartment has a spacious living room with two large windows.
formal.zh: 这套公寓有一间宽敞的客厅，配有两扇大窗户。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inpoġġi l-borża? Marija: Poġġiha fis-salott, ħdejn is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where shall I put the bag? Marija: Put it in the living room, next to the sofa.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我把包放在哪里？Marija：放在客厅里，沙发旁边吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (来访朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi l-borża?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi l-borża?
messages.zh: 我把包放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the bag?

messages.speaker: Marija (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha fis-salott, ħdejn is-sufan.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha fis-salott, ħdejn is-sufan.
messages.zh: 放在客厅里，沙发旁边吧。
messages.en: Put it in the living room, next to the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salott 和家里摆着沙发、招待朋友的房间连起来记；想说“在客厅里”时，整块记住 fis-salott。

gloss_zh: 大量；突然的一跳或一动

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large amount of something, or a sudden bodily movement caused by surprise or fright.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指数量很多的一批事物，也可指人在惊讶或受惊时身体突然的一跳或一动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità kbira ta' xi ħaġa, jew ċaqliqa għal għarrieda tal-ġisem minħabba sorpriża jew biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量；一大批；一大堆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammont kbir ta' xi ħaġa jew għadd kbir ta' persuni jew oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A salt of something is a large amount or number of it.

sense_translations.en_definition: a sudden movement (e.g. in the case of a fright)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体突然的一跳或一动，例如受惊时的猛然一颤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċaqliqa f'daqqa tal-ġisem, bħal meta persuna titwerwer b'ħoss jew b'xi ħaġa mhux mistennija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A salt is a sudden bodily movement, such as a jump caused by fright.

formal.mt: Wara l-maltemp, il-ħaddiema kellhom salt xogħol biex inaddfu t-toroq.
formal.en: After the storm, the workers had a lot of work to do to clean the streets.
formal.zh: 暴风雨过后，工人们有大量清理街道的工作要做。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex għamilt salt? Pawlu: Smajt ħoss qawwi warajja u bżajt.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you jump like that? Pawlu: I heard a loud noise behind me and got scared.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你怎么突然跳了一下？保罗：我听到身后有一声巨响，吓了一跳。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għamilt salt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għamilt salt?
messages.zh: 你怎么突然跳了一下？
messages.en: Why did you jump like that?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt ħoss qawwi warajja u bżajt.
messages.mt_standard: Smajt ħoss qawwi warajja u bżajt.
messages.zh: 我听到身后有一声巨响，吓了一跳。
messages.en: I heard a loud noise behind me and got scared.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个画面并排记：桌上一大堆工作是 salt xogħol，听到巨响突然一跳是 għamel salt。注意这里的 salt 不是英语的“盐”。

gloss_zh: 熟食店；冷切肉类及奶酪食品店

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop that sells foods such as cold meats, cheeses, and prepared items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售冷切肉类、奶酪及部分即食食品的熟食店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut li jbigħ ikel bħal laħam kiesaħ, ġobon u prodotti oħra lesti għall-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熟食店，主要出售冷切肉类、奶酪等可直接食用的食品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħanut fejn jinbiegħu laħam kiesaħ, ġobon u ikel ieħor li jista' jittiekel mingħajr aktar tisjir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A salumerija is a shop where you can buy cold meats, cheeses, and other ready-to-eat foods.

formal.mt: Is-salumerija tal-lokal toffri għażla ta' ġobon u laħam kiesaħ għall-preparazzjoni ta' ikliet ħfief.
formal.en: The local delicatessen offers a selection of cheeses and cold meats for preparing light meals.
formal.zh: 本地熟食店提供多种奶酪和冷切肉类，供人们准备简餐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se nieqaf fis-salumerija. Trid xi ħaġa? Mark: Iva, ġibli ftit ġobon u mitt gramma perżut, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'm stopping at the delicatessen. Would you like anything? Mark: Yes, please get me some cheese and a hundred grams of ham.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我要顺路去一下熟食店。你要买什么吗？马克：要，请帮我买点奶酪和一百克火腿。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nieqaf fis-salumerija. Trid xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Se nieqaf fis-salumerija. Trid xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: 我要顺路去一下熟食店。你要买什么吗？
messages.en: I'm stopping at the delicatessen. Would you like anything?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġibli ftit ġobon u mitt gramma perżut, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġibli ftit ġobon u mitt gramma perżut, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 要，请帮我买点奶酪和一百克火腿。
messages.en: Yes, please get me some cheese and a hundred grams of ham.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象走进一家柜台摆着奶酪、火腿和冷切肉的店，把整幅购物画面与 salumerija 绑定，就能记住它是“熟食店”。

gloss_zh: 获救的；被救下的；被保全的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rescued from danger or protected from being lost or destroyed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已被从危险中救出，或已受到保护而免于丢失、毁坏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie meħlus minn periklu jew imħares milli jintilef jew jinqered.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获救的；被救下的；被保全而免于丢失或毁坏的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie meħlus minn sitwazzjoni perikoluża jew miżmum milli jintilef jew jinqered.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is salvat has been rescued from danger or protected from loss or destruction.

formal.mt: Ir-raġel salvat mill-għarqa ngħata l-ewwel għajnuna fuq il-bajja.
formal.en: The man saved from drowning received first aid on the beach.
formal.zh: 那名被救起、免于溺亡的男子在海滩上接受了急救。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan hu l-kelb salvat li rajna fir-ritratt? David: Iva, issa qiegħed magħna u jinsab tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this the rescued dog we saw in the photo? David: Yes, he's with us now and is doing well.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这就是我们在照片里看到的那只获救的狗吗？戴维：是啊，它现在和我们住在一起，状况很好。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu l-kelb salvat li rajna fir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu l-kelb salvat li rajna fir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 这就是我们在照片里看到的那只获救的狗吗？
messages.en: Is this the rescued dog we saw in the photo?

messages.speaker: David (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa qiegħed magħna u jinsab tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa qiegħed magħna u jinsab tajjeb.
messages.zh: 是啊，它现在和我们住在一起，状况很好。
messages.en: Yes, he's with us now and is doing well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“危险已经过去，救援已经完成”的画面：kelb salvat 是已经获救的狗。salvat 在这里描述获救后的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aromatic herb whose leaves are used to flavour food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种叶片具有香气、可用于给食物调味的草本植物，即鼠尾草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta aromatika li l-weraq tagħha jintuża biex jagħti togħma lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼠尾草，一种叶片带有香气、常用于烹饪调味的草本植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaxixa aromatika b'weraq li għandu riħa qawwija u li jintuża fit-tisjir biex jagħti togħma lill-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Salvja is an aromatic herb whose leaves are used in cooking to add flavour to food.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, żid ftit weraq tas-salvja mal-butir u saħħan fuq nar baxx.
formal.en: For this recipe, add a few sage leaves to the butter and heat over a low flame.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，在黄油中加入几片鼠尾草叶，用小火加热。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna salvja friska għall-għaġin? Luka: Iva, hemm ftit weraq fil-friġġ. Ġibhom u naħsilhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we have fresh sage for the pasta? Luka: Yes, there are a few leaves in the fridge. Bring them over and I'll wash them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们有做意面用的新鲜鼠尾草吗？卢卡：有，冰箱里有几片叶子。拿过来，我来洗。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna salvja friska għall-għaġin?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna salvja friska għall-għaġin?
messages.zh: 我们有做意面用的新鲜鼠尾草吗？
messages.en: Do we have fresh sage for the pasta?

messages.speaker: Luka (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ftit weraq fil-friġġ. Ġibhom u naħsilhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ftit weraq fil-friġġ. Ġibhom u naħsilhom.
messages.zh: 有，冰箱里有几片叶子。拿过来，我来洗。
messages.en: Yes, there are a few leaves in the fridge. Bring them over and I'll wash them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 salvja 和厨房里的香叶画面一起记：几片鼠尾草叶放进黄油，为意面添香。这里的英语 sage 指香草植物。

gloss_zh: 拱石；构成拱券的楔形石块

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wedge-shaped stone that forms one of the segments of an arch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于砌筑拱券的楔形石块，是组成拱形结构的一块构件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebla f'għamla ta' feles li tifforma waħda mill-partijiet ta' ħnejja.

sense_translations.en_definition: a voussoir (a wedge-shaped stone segment used to build an arch)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拱石；用于砌筑拱券的楔形石块。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġebla maqtugħa f'għamla ta' feles li titqiegħed ma' ġebel ieħor biex tinbena ħnejja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A voussoir is one of the wedge-shaped stones fitted together to form an arch.

collocations.en: to set a voussoir in place

formal.mt: Waqt ir-restawr tal-ħnejja, il-bennej neħħa samrott bil-ħsara u qiegħed ieħor f'postu.
formal.en: During the restoration of the arch, the builder removed a damaged voussoir and put another in its place.
formal.zh: 修复拱券时，工匠移除了一块受损的拱石，并换上了另一块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha dik il-ġebla fil-ħnejja? Pawlu: Dik samrott. Għandha għamla ta' feles.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that stone in the arch called? Pawlu: That's a voussoir. It's wedge-shaped.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：拱券里的那块石头叫什么？保罗：那是拱石，形状像楔子。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jisimha dik il-ġebla fil-ħnejja?
messages.mt_standard: X'jisimha dik il-ġebla fil-ħnejja?
messages.zh: 拱券里的那块石头叫什么？
messages.en: What is that stone in the arch called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (石匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik samrott. Għandha għamla ta' feles.
messages.mt_standard: Dik samrott. Għandha għamla ta' feles.
messages.zh: 那是拱石，形状像楔子。
messages.en: That's a voussoir. It's wedge-shaped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 samrott 时画一个石拱，再圈出其中一块楔形石；整座拱中的这一块就是拱石。

gloss_zh: 圣布拉斯；戈佐岛上的一个村庄

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a village in Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣布拉斯，戈佐岛上一个村庄的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' raħal f'Għawdex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣布拉斯，位于戈佐岛的一个村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: San Blas huwa raħal li jinsab f'Għawdex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: San Blas is the name of a village in Gozo.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi żjara fir-raħal ta' San Blas f'Għawdex.
formal.en: The travel itinerary includes a visit to the village of San Blas in Gozo.
formal.zh: 旅行行程包括游览戈佐岛上的圣布拉斯村。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejra għada? Lara: Se mmur San Blas f'Għawdex. Tiġi miegħi?
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going tomorrow? Lara: I'm going to San Blas in Gozo. Will you come with me?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天去哪里？拉拉：我要去戈佐岛的圣布拉斯。你和我一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn sejra għada?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn sejra għada?
messages.zh: 你明天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur San Blas f'Għawdex. Tiġi miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur San Blas f'Għawdex. Tiġi miegħi?
messages.zh: 我要去戈佐岛的圣布拉斯。你和我一起去吗？
messages.en: I'm going to San Blas in Gozo. Will you come with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 San Blas 当作地图上的村名标签，与 Għawdex（戈佐岛）配对记忆，并注意地名首字母大写。

gloss_zh: 圣劳伦茨（戈佐岛的村庄）

teaching_sense.en_definition: San Lawrenz is the name of a village in Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣劳伦茨，戈佐岛上一个村庄的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: San Lawrenz huwa l-isem ta' raħal f'Għawdex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣劳伦茨，位于戈佐岛的一个村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: San Lawrenz huwa raħal li jinsab f'Għawdex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: San Lawrenz is a village located in Gozo.

collocations.zh: 到圣劳伦茨的一次参观

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi żjara f'San Lawrenz, raħal f'Għawdex.
formal.en: The programme includes a visit to San Lawrenz, a village in Gozo.
formal.zh: 行程安排包括参观戈佐岛上的圣劳伦茨村。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tmur San Lawrenz għada? Mark: Iva, nixtieq indur ftit fir-raħal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to go to San Lawrenz tomorrow? Mark: Yes, I'd like to walk around the village a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天想去圣劳伦茨吗？马克：想，我想在村里逛一逛。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tmur San Lawrenz għada?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tmur San Lawrenz għada?
messages.zh: 你明天想去圣劳伦茨吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go to San Lawrenz tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq indur ftit fir-raħal.

messages.en: Yes, I'd like to walk around the village a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 San Lawrenz 整体记作地图上的“圣劳伦茨村”，再用“戈佐岛上的村庄”这张地点卡片巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: San Marino is a geographical proper name, used to identify a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣马力诺，用于指称特定地点的专有名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: San Marino huwa isem proprju li jintuża biex jidentifika post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣马力诺这一地名。
sense_translations.mt_definition: San Marino huwa l-isem proprju ta' post.
sense_translations.en_explanation: San Marino is a proper name used to identify a geographical place.

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-vjaġġ jinkludi waqfa f'San Marino.
formal.en: The travel plan includes a stop in San Marino.
formal.zh: 旅行计划包括在圣马力诺停留。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek mappa ta' San Marino? Mark: Iva, nistgħu nħarsu lejha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a map of San Marino? Mark: Yes, we can look at it together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有圣马力诺的地图吗？马克：有，我们可以一起看看。

messages.mt_spoken: Għandek mappa ta' San Marino?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek mappa ta' San Marino?

messages.en: Do you have a map of San Marino?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nħarsu lejha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nħarsu lejha flimkien.
messages.zh: 有，我们可以一起看看。
messages.en: Yes, we can look at it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 San Marino 与中文“圣马力诺”并排写在地图卡片上，再用“前往圣马力诺”和“圣马力诺地图”两个搭配练习。

gloss_zh: 圣保罗湾（马耳他北部城镇）

teaching_sense.en_definition: San Pawl il-Baħar is the Maltese name for St Paul's Bay, a town in northern Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣保罗湾，马耳他北部的一座城镇，其马耳他语名称为 San Pawl il-Baħar。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: San Pawl il-Baħar huwa l-isem ta' belt fit-Tramuntana ta' Malta, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala St Paul's Bay.

sense_translations.en_definition: St Paul's Bay, a town in the north of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣保罗湾，位于马耳他北部的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: San Pawl il-Baħar huwa belt li tinsab fit-Tramuntana ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: San Pawl il-Baħar is a town in northern Malta known in English as St Paul's Bay.

collocations.en: a visit to St Paul's Bay
collocations.zh: 到圣保罗湾的一次参观

collocations.en: the centre of St Paul's Bay

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'San Pawl il-Baħar, belt fit-Tramuntana ta' Malta.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in St Paul's Bay, a town in northern Malta.
formal.zh: 会议将在马耳他北部的圣保罗湾镇举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu f'San Pawl il-Baħar? Mark: Nistgħu niltaqgħu fiċ-ċentru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet in St Paul's Bay? Mark: We can meet in the centre.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在圣保罗湾哪里见面？马克：我们可以在镇中心见面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu f'San Pawl il-Baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu f'San Pawl il-Baħar?
messages.zh: 我们在圣保罗湾哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet in St Paul's Bay?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu niltaqgħu fiċ-ċentru.

messages.zh: 我们可以在镇中心见面。
messages.en: We can meet in the centre.

gloss_zh: 圣保罗塔塔尔贾，位于纳沙尔与莫斯塔周边的地区

teaching_sense.en_definition: San Pawl tat-Tarġa is the name of an area in the environs of Naxxar and Mosta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣保罗塔塔尔贾，马耳他语地名，指纳沙尔与莫斯塔周边的一个地区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: San Pawl tat-Tarġa huwa l-isem ta' żona fl-inħawi tan-Naxxar u tal-Mosta.

sense_translations.en_definition: San Pawl tat-Tarġa, an area in the environs of Naxxar and Mosta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣保罗塔塔尔贾，纳沙尔与莫斯塔周边的一个地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: San Pawl tat-Tarġa huwa isem ta' post li jirreferi għal żona fl-inħawi tan-Naxxar u tal-Mosta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: San Pawl tat-Tarġa is an area situated in the environs of Naxxar and Mosta.

collocations.en: in the vicinity of San Pawl tat-Tarġa
collocations.zh: 在圣保罗塔塔尔贾附近

teaching_sense.en_definition: San Pietruburgu is the Maltese name for the city known in English as St Petersburg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣彼得堡的马耳他语名称，对应英语地名 St Petersburg。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: San Pietruburgu huwa l-isem Malti tal-belt magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala St Petersburg.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣彼得堡，城市名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: San Pietruburgu huwa isem ta' belt li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ St Petersburg.
sense_translations.en_explanation: San Pietruburgu is the Maltese name used to refer to St Petersburg.

collocations.zh: 到圣彼得堡的一次访问

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ż-żjara tad-delegazzjoni f'San Pietruburgu.
formal.en: The report describes the delegation's visit to St Petersburg.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了代表团访问圣彼得堡的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn tixtieq tmur għall-vaganza? Daniel: Nixtieq inżur San Pietruburgu. Lara: Jien ukoll! Nistgħu nippjanaw il-vjaġġ flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where would you like to go on holiday? Daniel: I'd like to visit St Petersburg. Lara: Me too! We can plan the trip together.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想去哪里度假？Daniel：我想去圣彼得堡。Lara：我也想去！我们可以一起规划行程。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn tixtieq tmur għall-vaganza?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn tixtieq tmur għall-vaganza?

messages.en: Where would you like to go on holiday?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq inżur San Pietruburgu.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq inżur San Pietruburgu.
messages.zh: 我想去圣彼得堡。
messages.en: I'd like to visit St Petersburg.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll! Nistgħu nippjanaw il-vjaġġ flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll! Nistgħu nippjanaw il-vjaġġ flimkien.
messages.zh: 我也想去！我们可以一起规划行程。
messages.en: Me too! We can plan the trip together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“San Pietruburgu—St Petersburg—圣彼得堡”制作三语地名卡片；朗读时可把 Pietru 和 burgu 当作拼写记忆段，实际书写仍连成 Pietruburgu。

gloss_zh: 圣朱利安（马耳他中部地区的城镇）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a town in the central region of Malta, known in English as St Julians.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他中部地区一座城镇的名称，英语称 St Julians，中文通常译为圣朱利安。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' lokalità fir-reġjun ċentrali ta' Malta, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala St Julians.

sense_translations.en_definition: St Julians, a town in the central region of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣朱利安，位于马耳他中部地区的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: San Ġiljan huwa lokalità fir-reġjun ċentrali ta' Malta li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ St Julians.
sense_translations.en_explanation: San Ġiljan is the Maltese name for St Julians, a town in the central region of Malta.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'San Ġiljan nhar it-Tnejn filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in St Julians on Monday morning.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期一上午在圣朱利安举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu għada? Daniel: F'San Ġiljan, ħdejn il-waqfa tal-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet tomorrow? Daniel: In St Julians, near the bus stop.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们明天在哪里见面？Daniel：在圣朱利安，公交车站附近。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu għada?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu għada?
messages.zh: 我们明天在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'San Ġiljan, ħdejn il-waqfa tal-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: F'San Ġiljan, ħdejn il-waqfa tal-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 在圣朱利安，公交车站附近。
messages.en: In St Julians, near the bus stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 San Ġiljan、St Julians 和“圣朱利安”写在同一张地名卡上，再用 f'San Ġiljan 记住“在圣朱利安”。

gloss_zh: 圣格旺（马耳他中部地区的城镇）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a town in the central region of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他中部地区一座城镇的名称，中文译作圣格旺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' lokalità li tinsab fir-reġjun ċentrali ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: San Ġwann, a town in the central region of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣格旺，位于马耳他中部地区的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: San Ġwann huwa lokalità li tinsab fir-reġjun ċentrali ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: San Ġwann is a town situated in the central region of Malta.

formal.mt: Il-kors se jsir f'San Ġwann kull nhar ta' Erbgħa.
formal.en: The course will take place in San Ġwann every Wednesday.
formal.zh: 课程将于每星期三在圣格旺举行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int fejn toqgħod? Pawlu: Noqgħod f'San Ġwann. U int?
colloquial.en: Sara: Where do you live? Pawlu: I live in San Ġwann. And you?
colloquial.zh: Sara：你住在哪里？Pawlu：我住在圣格旺。你呢？

messages.speaker: Sara (新同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Int fejn toqgħod?
messages.mt_standard: Int fejn toqgħod?
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Noqgħod f'San Ġwann. U int?
messages.mt_standard: Noqgħod f'San Ġwann. U int?
messages.zh: 我住在圣格旺。你呢？
messages.en: I live in San Ġwann. And you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 San Ġwann 单独做成“圣格旺”地名卡，重点辨认 Ġwann，再反复说 Noqgħod f'San Ġwann，记住“我住在圣格旺”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Open shoes with soles held to the feet by straps; sandli is a plural form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鞋面敞开、通过带子固定在脚上的鞋；sandli 是复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żraben miftuħa li għandhom qiegħ marbut mas-sieq permezz ta' ċineg; sandli hija forma fil-plural.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凉鞋，指鞋面敞开、用带子固定在脚上的鞋；本词形 sandli 为复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' żarbun miftuħ b'qiegħ li jinżamm mas-sieq permezz ta' ċineg; il-kelma sandli tintuża fil-plural.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sandal is an open shoe held on the foot by straps, and sandli refers to such shoes in the plural.

formal.mt: Għall-vjaġġ tas-sajf, huwa għażel par sandli komdi tal-ġilda.
formal.en: For the summer trip, he chose a comfortable pair of leather sandals.
formal.zh: 为了夏季旅行，他挑选了一双舒适的皮凉鞋。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom sandli bin-numru erbgħin? Rita: Iva, għandna dan il-par. Trid tippruvah?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have sandals in size forty? Rita: Yes, we have this pair. Would you like to try them on?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有四十码的凉鞋吗？丽塔：有，我们有这一双。你想试穿吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom sandli bin-numru erbgħin?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom sandli bin-numru erbgħin?
messages.zh: 你们有四十码的凉鞋吗？
messages.en: Do you have sandals in size forty?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna dan il-par. Trid tippruvah?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna dan il-par. Trid tippruvah?
messages.zh: 有，我们有这一双。你想试穿吗？
messages.en: Yes, we have this pair. Would you like to try them on?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sandli 和一双露出脚趾的凉鞋联系起来，再连读 par sandli，记住这个词形表示复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A food made by putting a filling, such as cheese or meat, between slices of bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在面包片之间夹入奶酪、肉类等馅料制成的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul minn flieli tal-ħobż b'mili bejniethom, bħal ġobon jew laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 三明治；由面包片夹住馅料制成的食物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul minn flieli tal-ħobż li jkollhom mili bejniethom, bħal ġobon, laħam jew ħaxix.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sandwich is a food consisting of a filling placed between slices of bread.

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant se jingħata sandwiċ bil-ġobon waqt il-pawża.
formal.en: Each participant will be given a cheese sandwich during the break.
formal.zh: 休息期间，每位参与者都会领到一个奶酪三明治。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid sandwiċ bil-ġobon? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Għandi l-ġuħ!
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like a cheese sandwich? Mark: Yes, thanks. I'm hungry!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想要一个奶酪三明治吗？Mark：好啊，谢谢。我饿了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid sandwiċ bil-ġobon?
messages.mt_standard: Trid sandwiċ bil-ġobon?
messages.zh: 你想要一个奶酪三明治吗？
messages.en: Would you like a cheese sandwich?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Għandi l-ġuħ!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Għandi l-ġuħ!
messages.zh: 好啊，谢谢。我饿了！
messages.en: Yes, thanks. I'm hungry!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sandwiċ 和“两片面包夹馅”的画面一起记，再用 sandwiċ bil-ġobon 练习说“奶酪三明治”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small wormlike animal that can attach itself to another animal and feed on its blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种身体像蠕虫的小动物，可附着在其他动物身上吸食血液，称为水蛭或蚂蟥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir b'ġisem bħal dudu li jista' jeħel ma' annimal ieħor u jerdagħlu demmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水蛭，俗称蚂蟥；一种可附着在其他动物身上吸血的蠕虫状动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal b'ġisem artab u tawwali, bħal dudu, li jista' jeħel ma' annimal ieħor biex jerdagħlu demmu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A leech is a small wormlike animal that can attach itself to another animal and suck its blood.

collocations.en: a leech attached to the skin

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti raw sangisuga mwaħħla mal-ġilda ta' annimal.
formal.en: During the observation, the students saw a leech attached to an animal's skin.
formal.zh: 观察期间，学生们看到一只水蛭附着在一只动物的皮肤上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak l-annimal żgħir fl-ilma? Marija: Dik sangisuga. Tista' teħel mal-ġilda u terda' d-demm.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that little animal in the water? Marija: That's a leech. It can attach itself to the skin and suck blood.
colloquial.zh: Nina：水里那个小动物是什么？Marija：那是水蛭。它能附着在皮肤上吸血。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak l-annimal żgħir fl-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak l-annimal żgħir fl-ilma?
messages.zh: 水里那个小动物是什么？
messages.en: What's that little animal in the water?

messages.speaker: Marija (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik sangisuga. Tista' teħel mal-ġilda u terda' d-demm.
messages.mt_standard: Dik sangisuga. Tista' teħel mal-ġilda u terda' d-demm.
messages.zh: 那是水蛭。它能附着在皮肤上吸血。
messages.en: That's a leech. It can attach itself to the skin and suck blood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sangisuga 与“细长身体贴在皮肤上吸血”的画面配对，再用 sangisuga terda' d-demm 记住“水蛭吸血”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sannat is the name of a village in Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 萨纳特，戈佐岛上一个村庄的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sannat huwa l-isem ta' raħal f'Għawdex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萨纳特，位于戈佐岛的一个村庄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sannat huwa raħal li jinsab f'Għawdex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sannat is a village located in Gozo.

formal.mt: Id-dokument jinkludi informazzjoni dwar Sannat, raħal f'Għawdex.

messages.mt_standard: Din it-triq twassal għal Sannat?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Sannat 作为一个完整地名记住，想象路牌上写着“萨纳特”，旁边的小卡片注明“戈佐岛村庄”。

gloss_zh: 桑塔卢奇亚，马耳他南部的一座城镇

teaching_sense.en_definition: Santa Luċija is the name of a town in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 桑塔卢奇亚，位于马耳他南部的一座城镇的名称。

sense_translations.en_definition: Santa Luċija, a town in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 桑塔卢奇亚，马耳他南部的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Santa Luċija huwa isem ta' post li jirreferi għal belt li tinsab fin-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.

gloss_zh: 桑塔玛格丽塔，莫斯塔周边的一处地方

teaching_sense.en_definition: Santa Margerita is the name of a location in the environs of Mosta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 桑塔玛格丽塔，指莫斯塔周边的一处地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Santa Margerita huwa l-isem ta' post fl-inħawi tal-Mosta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Santa Margherita, a location in the environs of Mosta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 桑塔玛格丽塔，莫斯塔周边的一处地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Santa Margerita huwa isem ta' post li jinsab fl-inħawi tal-Mosta.

桑塔玛格丽塔的一个地址

gloss_zh: 圣韦内拉，马耳他中部的一座城镇

teaching_sense.en_definition: Santa Venera is a town in the central region of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣韦内拉，位于马耳他中部地区的一座城镇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Santa Venera hija belt fir-reġjun ċentrali ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: St Venera, a town in the central region of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣韦内拉，马耳他中部地区的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Santa Venera hija belt li tinsab fir-reġjun ċentrali ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Santa Venera is a town situated in the central region of Malta.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi informazzjoni dwar Santa Venera, belt fir-reġjun ċentrali ta' Malta.
formal.en: The report includes information about Santa Venera, a town in the central region of Malta.
formal.zh: 该报告包含有关圣韦内拉的信息；这是一座位于马耳他中部地区的城镇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A saint is a person recognized in a religious tradition for exceptional holiness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣人或圣徒，指在宗教传统中因卓越的圣德而受到认可和尊崇的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Santu qaddis huwa persuna magħrufa u meqjuma fi tradizzjoni reliġjuża għall-qdusija kbira tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣人；圣徒，指因圣德而在宗教中受到认可和尊崇的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Santu qaddis huwa persuna li titqies bħala eżempju ta' qdusija u li tingħata ġieħ fi tradizzjoni reliġjuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A saint is someone who is recognized and honoured within a religious tradition for exceptional holiness.

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jirrakkonta l-ħajja ta' santu qaddis u jiddeskrivi l-għajnuna li ta lill-foqra.
formal.en: The book recounts the life of a saint and describes the help he gave to the poor.
formal.zh: 这本书讲述了一位圣人的生平，并描述了他对穷人的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din l-istatwa ta' min hi? Pawlu: Hija statwa ta' santu qaddis. Lara: Taf x'jismu?
colloquial.en: Lara: Who does this statue represent? Pawlu: It's a statue of a saint. Lara: Do you know his name?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这尊雕像雕的是谁？保罗：这是一位圣人的雕像。拉拉：你知道他叫什么名字吗？

messages.mt_standard: Din l-istatwa ta' min hi?

messages.mt_standard: Taf x'jismu?

gloss_zh: 神龛；供奉圣所；宗教圣所

teaching_sense.en_definition: A santwarju is a sacred place used for religious devotion, such as a shrine or sanctuary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供宗教敬礼或礼拜使用的神圣场所，可指供奉圣所，也可指宗教圣所或圣殿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Santwarju huwa post sagru fejn in-nies imorru biex jitolbu, iqimu jew jesprimu d-devozzjoni reliġjuża tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神龛或供奉圣所，指供人向神圣人物或圣物表达敬意和祈祷的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Santwarju huwa post ta' devozzjoni marbut ma' persuna qaddisa jew ma' oġġett sagru, fejn in-nies imorru jitolbu u jagħtu ġieħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shrine is a place associated with a holy person or sacred object where people go to pray or show devotion.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗教圣所；圣殿，指被视为神圣并用于礼拜或祈祷的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Santwarju huwa post meqjus bħala sagru u ddedikat għat-talb u għall-qima reliġjuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A religious sanctuary is a sacred place set apart for worship, prayer, or other acts of religious devotion.

collocations.en: a shrine dedicated to a saint

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi huma mitluba jżommu s-skiet fis-santwarju biex ma jfixklux lil dawk li jkunu qed jitolbu.
formal.en: Visitors are asked to remain quiet in the sanctuary so that they do not disturb those who are praying.
formal.zh: 请参观者在圣所内保持安静，以免打扰正在祈祷的人。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid tidħol fis-santwarju? Ġanni: Iva, nixtieq nitlob ftit. Marija: Tajjeb, nistenna hawn barra.
colloquial.en: Marija: Would you like to go into the sanctuary? Ġanni: Yes, I'd like to pray for a little while. Marija: All right, I'll wait out here.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你想进圣所吗？詹尼：想，我想祈祷一会儿。玛丽亚：好，我在外面等。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“进入圣所，安静祈祷”的画面记 santwarju；看到 shrine 联想供奉对象，看到 sanctuary 联想神圣礼拜空间。

gloss_zh: 受到制裁的；受到处罚的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone or something that is sanctioned is subject to an official penalty or restrictive measure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到有关机构正式处罚、制裁或限制措施的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità sanzjonata tkun ġiet suġġetta għal piena jew għal miżura restrittiva minn awtorità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受制裁的；受处罚的，指被有关机构正式施加惩罚或限制措施的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sanzjonat jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa li awtorità tkun imponiet fuqhom piena jew restrizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a person or organization is sanctioned, an authority has imposed a penalty or restriction on them.

collocations.zh: 因违反规则而受到处罚的

formal.mt: L-operatur sanzjonat għandu jikkonforma mal-miżuri imposti mill-awtorità.
formal.en: The sanctioned operator must comply with the measures imposed by the authority.
formal.zh: 受到处罚的经营者必须遵守有关机构施加的措施。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark ma jistax jilgħab illum? Luqa: Huwa sanzjonat għal ksur tar-regoli. Sara: Issa nifhem għaliex qed jara l-logħba biss.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why can't Mark play today? Luqa: He's sanctioned for breaking the rules. Sara: Now I understand why he's only watching the match.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克今天为什么不能上场？卢卡：他因违反规则受到了处罚。萨拉：现在我明白他为什么只能看比赛了。

messages.mt_standard: Huwa sanzjonat għal ksur tar-regoli.

messages.en: He's sanctioned for breaking the rules.

messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem għaliex qed jara l-logħba biss.
messages.zh: 现在我明白他为什么只能看比赛了。
messages.en: Now I understand why he's only watching the match.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象球员违规后只能坐着看比赛，把 sanzjonat 与“已经受到正式处罚的状态”联系起来记忆。

gloss_zh: 因他人的才智或知识而受吸引的；智性恋的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who is attracted to other people because of their intelligence or knowledge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人因他人的才智或知识而对其产生吸引感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan l-aġġettiv jiddeskrivi persuna li tħoss attrazzjoni lejn persuna oħra minħabba l-intelliġenza jew l-għarfien tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: a person who is attracted to another person because of their intelligence or knowledge
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容因另一人的才智或知识而对其产生吸引感的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan l-aġġettiv jiddeskrivi persuna li tħoss attrazzjoni lejn ħaddieħor minħabba l-intelliġenza jew l-għarfien ta' dik il-persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is sapiosexual, they are attracted to another person because of that person's intelligence or knowledge.

collocations.zh: 她认同自己是智性恋者

formal.mt: Fl-intervista, il-parteċipant iddeskriva lilu nnifsu bħala sapjosesswali u spjega li l-intelliġenza ta' persuna tqanqal fih attrazzjoni.
formal.en: In the interview, the participant described himself as sapiosexual and explained that a person's intelligence makes him feel attracted to them.
formal.zh: 访谈中，这位参与者形容自己是智性恋者，并解释说，一个人的才智会使他对其产生吸引感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li int sapjosesswali? Lara: Li nħoss attrazzjoni lejn xi ħadd minħabba l-intelliġenza jew l-għarfien tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you mean when you say you are sapiosexual? Lara: That I feel attracted to someone because of their intelligence or knowledge.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你说自己是智性恋者，是什么意思？Lara：就是说，我会因为一个人的才智或知识而对其产生吸引感。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li int sapjosesswali?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li int sapjosesswali?
messages.zh: 你说自己是智性恋者，是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean when you say you are sapiosexual?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Li nħoss attrazzjoni lejn xi ħadd minħabba l-intelliġenza jew l-għarfien tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Li nħoss attrazzjoni lejn xi ħadd minħabba l-intelliġenza jew l-għarfien tiegħu.
messages.zh: 就是说，我会因为一个人的才智或知识而对其产生吸引感。
messages.en: That I feel attracted to someone because of their intelligence or knowledge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两人交谈时，一方因对方的见识而心动，把这个词与“才智引发吸引”这一画面联系起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or an instance of watering, expressed as a noun related to jsaqqi.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与 jsaqqi 对应的动作名词，表示浇水这一行为或一次浇灌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan in-nom marbut mal-verb jsaqqi jirreferi għall-għoti tal-ilma lill-pjanti jew lill-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由 jsaqqi 对应而来的名词，表示浇水或浇灌的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa nom mill-verb jsaqqi u jfisser l-att li jingħata l-ilma lill-pjanti jew lill-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun refers to the act of watering, or to an occasion when plants or land receive water.

formal.mt: Wara s-saqa tal-pjanti, il-ħaddiema ċċekkjaw li l-ilma kien wasal sal-għeruq.
formal.en: After watering the plants, the workers checked that the water had reached the roots.
formal.zh: 给植物浇水后，工作人员检查水是否已到达根部。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-pjanti għandhom bżonn saqa? Rita: Iva, il-ħamrija niexfa. Nagħtihom ftit ilma issa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do the plants need watering? Rita: Yes, the soil is dry. I'll give them some water now.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这些植物需要浇水吗？Rita：需要，土已经干了。我现在给它们浇点水。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pjanti għandhom bżonn saqa?
messages.mt_standard: Il-pjanti għandhom bżonn saqa?
messages.zh: 这些植物需要浇水吗？
messages.en: Do the plants need watering?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħamrija niexfa. Nagħtihom ftit ilma issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħamrija niexfa. Nagħtihom ftit ilma issa.
messages.zh: 需要，土已经干了。我现在给它们浇点水。
messages.en: Yes, the soil is dry. I'll give them some water now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把浇水动作想成日程表上的“一次浇灌”，用这个具体事件记住 saqa 的名词用法，并与所给动词 jsaqqi 配对。

gloss_zh: 他们的屋顶；他们的栖身之所

teaching_sense.en_definition: Their roof, or the shelter that provides them with protection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 他们的屋顶，也可指为他们遮风挡雨的栖身之所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din il-kelma tirreferi għas-saqaf tagħhom jew għall-kenn li jipproteġihom mix-xemx u mix-xita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们的屋顶，或供他们遮蔽、栖身的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din il-kelma tfisser is-saqaf tagħhom jew post li jagħtihom kenn u protezzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Their roof or shelter is the covering or place that protects them from the weather.

formal.mt: Wara l-maltempata, il-familji talbu għajnuna biex isewwu saqafhom u jipproteġu djarhom mix-xita.
formal.en: After the storm, the families requested assistance to repair their roofs and protect their homes from the rain.
formal.zh: 暴风雨过后，这些家庭请求援助，以修理各自的屋顶，保护房屋免受雨水侵袭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm il-ħaddiema għand il-ġirien? Mark: Qed isewwu saqafhom għax beda jidħol l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there workers at the neighbours' house? Mark: They are repairing their roof because water started coming in.
colloquial.zh: Maja：邻居家怎么有工人？Mark：工人在修他们的屋顶，因为屋里开始漏水了。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm il-ħaddiema għand il-ġirien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm il-ħaddiema għand il-ġirien?
messages.zh: 邻居家怎么有工人？
messages.en: Why are there workers at the neighbours' house?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed isewwu saqafhom għax beda jidħol l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Qed isewwu saqafhom għax beda jidħol l-ilma.
messages.zh: 工人在修他们的屋顶，因为屋里开始漏水了。
messages.en: They are repairing their roof because water started coming in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一家人站在自家屋檐下避雨，把 saqafhom 整体连到“他们的屋顶”，再由遮雨画面联想到“他们的栖身之所”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Our feet, the parts of our bodies on which we stand and walk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我们的双脚，即我们站立和行走时支撑身体的部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-saqajn tagħna huma l-partijiet ta' ġisimna li fuqhom nieqfu u li nużaw biex nimxu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我们的双脚，指我们用来站立、行走并支撑身体的部位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan is-sens jirreferi għas-saqajn tagħna, jiġifieri l-partijiet ta' ġisimna li jmissu mal-art meta nieqfu jew nimxu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Our feet are the parts of our bodies that support us when we stand and walk.

collocations.en: we take care of our feet

formal.mt: Waqt mixja twila, għandna nieħdu pawżi u niċċekkjaw is-saqajn tagħna għal sinjali ta' għeja jew korriment.
formal.en: During a long walk, we should take breaks and check our feet for signs of fatigue or injury.
formal.zh: 长途步行时，我们应适时休息，并检查双脚是否出现疲劳或受伤的迹象。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Wara din il-mixja, is-saqajn tagħna għandhom bżonn mistrieħ! Maja: Veru! Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda għal ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: After this walk, our feet need a rest! Maja: They really do! Let's sit down for a while.
colloquial.zh: Lara：走完这一程，我们的双脚得歇歇了！Maja：确实！我们坐一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara din il-mixja, is-saqajn tagħna għandhom bżonn mistrieħ!
messages.mt_standard: Wara din il-mixja, is-saqajn tagħna għandhom bżonn mistrieħ!
messages.zh: 走完这一程，我们的双脚得歇歇了！
messages.en: After this walk, our feet need a rest!

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru! Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda għal ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Veru! Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda għal ftit.
messages.zh: 确实！我们坐一会儿吧。
messages.en: They really do! Let's sit down for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按所给义项，想象同行的两个人一起低头看脚，说“我们的双脚都走累了”，用共同走路的画面记住所属关系和身体部位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The roof of my house or of another building that belongs to me.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我家的屋顶，或属于我的某座建筑物的屋顶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-saqaf tad-dar tiegħi jew ta' bini ieħor li huwa tiegħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我的屋顶；我家的屋顶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-saqaf li huwa tiegħi, bħal dak li jgħatti d-dar tiegħi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When I refer to my roof, I mean the roof of my home or another building belonging to me.

formal.mt: Nixtieq nitlob spezzjoni għax saqfi ġarrab ħsara waqt il-maltemp.
formal.en: I would like to request an inspection because my roof was damaged during the storm.
formal.zh: 我想申请检查，因为我的屋顶在暴风雨中受损了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Saqfi qed iqattar. Tista' tgħinni? Mark: Iva, ġib barmil u ċempel lil xi ħadd biex isewwih.
colloquial.en: Lara: My roof is leaking. Can you help me? Mark: Yes, get a bucket and call someone to repair it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我的屋顶漏水了。你能帮帮我吗？马克：能，拿个桶来，再打电话请人修。

messages.speaker: Lara (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Saqfi qed iqattar. Tista' tgħinni?
messages.mt_standard: Saqfi qed iqattar. Tista' tgħinni?
messages.zh: 我的屋顶漏水了。你能帮帮我吗？
messages.en: My roof is leaking. Can you help me?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġib barmil u ċempel lil xi ħadd biex isewwih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġib barmil u ċempel lil xi ħadd biex isewwih.
messages.zh: 能，拿个桶来，再打电话请人修。
messages.en: Yes, get a bucket and call someone to repair it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你指着自家漏水的屋顶说 saqfi，把整个词记成“我的屋顶”，别漏掉“我的”这一层意思。

gloss_zh: 暂释：żaqq 的旋律管，具体对应尚不确定

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tentatively, the chanter of a żaqq; the supplied meaning is marked as uncertain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂指 żaqq 上称为 chanter 的旋律管；所给词义带有疑问标记，因此这一对应尚不确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod provviżorju, il-parti taż-żaqq imsejħa chanter; it-tifsira mogħtija hija mmarkata bħala inċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未确定；括号中的提示暂将其对应为 żaqq 的旋律管。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira mhijiex ċerta; in-nota fil-parentesi tindika b'mod provviżorju l-parti taż-żaqq imsejħa chanter.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss tentatively identifies this as the chanter of a żaqq, but leaves the meaning uncertain.

collocations.en: the chanter of the żaqq, following the tentative gloss
collocations.zh: żaqq 的旋律管，按暂定词义理解

collocations.en: the identification of the part tentatively called saqqafa
collocations.zh: 对暂称 saqqafa 的部件的辨认

formal.mt: F'din in-nota, il-kelma 'Saqqafa' tintuża b'mod provviżorju għall-parti taż-żaqq imsejħa chanter, iżda l-identifikazzjoni għadha mhijiex ċerta.
formal.en: In this note, the word 'Saqqafa' is used provisionally for the part of the żaqq called the chanter, but the identification remains uncertain.
formal.zh: 本注释暂用“Saqqafa”指 żaqq 上称为 chanter 的旋律管，但这一对应仍不确定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser 'Saqqafa' hawn? Pawlu: In-nota tindika l-chanter taż-żaqq, imma t-tifsira għadha mhijiex ċerta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Saqqafa' mean here? Pawlu: The note points to the chanter of the żaqq, but the meaning is still uncertain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的“Saqqafa”是什么意思？保罗：注释指向 żaqq 的旋律管，不过词义还不确定。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tfisser 'Saqqafa' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: X'tfisser 'Saqqafa' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的“Saqqafa”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Saqqafa' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nota tindika l-chanter taż-żaqq, imma t-tifsira għadha mhijiex ċerta.
messages.mt_standard: In-nota tindika l-chanter taż-żaqq, imma t-tifsira għadha mhijiex ċerta.
messages.zh: 注释指向 żaqq 的旋律管，不过词义还不确定。
messages.en: The note points to the chanter of the żaqq, but the meaning is still uncertain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Saqqafa 与“żaqq 的旋律管？”写在同一张记忆卡上，保留问号，提醒自己这只是暂定对应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A way of speaking that mocks or criticizes someone, often by saying the opposite of what is meant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用带有嘲弄意味的话挖苦或批评别人，常通过说反话来表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mod ta' kif wieħed jitkellem biex iwaqqa' lil xi ħadd għaċ-ċajt jew jikkritikah, spiss billi jgħid il-kuntrarju ta' dak li jkun irid ifisser.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讥讽；挖苦，尤其指通过反话表达嘲弄或批评。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kliem li jesprimi tmaqdir jew twaqqigħ għaċ-ċajt, ħafna drabi billi jgħid il-kuntrarju ta' dak li verament ikun maħsub.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sarcasm is speech that mocks or criticizes someone, often by expressing the opposite of the speaker's real meaning.

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-djalogu, it-ton ta' sarcsam juri li l-kliem ta' tifħir fil-fatt jesprimi kritika.
formal.en: In the analysis of the dialogue, the sarcastic tone shows that the words of praise actually express criticism.
formal.zh: 在这段对话的分析中，讥讽的语气表明，那些赞美的话实际表达的是批评。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta għedt 'Prosit, erġajt wasalt tard!', kont qed infaħħrek? Mark: Le, dak kien sarcsam. Skużani li wasalt tard.
colloquial.en: Nina: When I said 'Well done, you're late again!', was I praising you? Mark: No, that was sarcasm. Sorry I'm late.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我说“真棒，你又迟到了！”的时候，是在夸你吗？马克：不是，那是在挖苦我。抱歉，我迟到了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta għedt 'Prosit, erġajt wasalt tard!', kont qed infaħħrek?
messages.mt_standard: Meta għedt 'Prosit, erġajt wasalt tard!', kont qed infaħħrek?
messages.zh: 我说“真棒，你又迟到了！”的时候，是在夸你吗？
messages.en: When I said 'Well done, you're late again!', was I praising you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak kien sarcsam. Skużani li wasalt tard.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak kien sarcsam. Skużani li wasalt tard.
messages.zh: 不是，那是在挖苦我。抱歉，我迟到了。
messages.en: No, that was sarcasm. Sorry I'm late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“真棒，你又迟到了！”记住 sarcsam：字面像表扬，结合语气和情境却是在挖苦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small sea fish that is eaten fresh or preserved in a tin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种体形较小的海鱼，可鲜食，也常制成罐头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta żgħira tal-baħar li tittiekel friska jew ippreservata f'landa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙丁鱼，一种可鲜食或制成罐头的小型海鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħuta żgħira tal-baħar li tintuża bħala ikel u tinbiegħ friska jew f'landa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sardine is a small sea fish that people eat fresh or buy preserved in tins.

formal.mt: Għall-ewwel platt, kull mistieden jingħata sardina mixwija bil-lumi u t-tursin.
formal.en: For the first course, each guest is served a grilled sardine with lemon and parsley.
formal.zh: 第一道菜为每位宾客各上一条配柠檬和欧芹的烤沙丁鱼。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid sardina oħra mal-ħobż? David: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Għaddi l-lumi wkoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like another sardine with your bread? David: Yes, please. Pass the lemon too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：要不要再来一条沙丁鱼配面包？戴维：好，谢谢。也把柠檬递给我吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友兼主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid sardina oħra mal-ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: Trid sardina oħra mal-ħobż?
messages.zh: 要不要再来一条沙丁鱼配面包？
messages.en: Would you like another sardine with your bread?

messages.speaker: David (朋友兼客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Għaddi l-lumi wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Għaddi l-lumi wkoll.
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。也把柠檬递给我吧。
messages.en: Yes, please. Pass the lemon too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sardina 的开头与中文“沙丁”联系起来，再想象盘子里的一条小海鱼，记住它表示“沙丁鱼”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A geranium is an ornamental plant grown for its flowers, often in a pot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天竺葵，一种供观赏的开花植物，常种在花盆中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta ornamentali li titkabbar għall-fjuri tagħha, spiss f'qasrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天竺葵，常作盆栽观赏的开花植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta bil-fjuri li titkabbar bħala tiżjin fil-qsari jew fil-ġonna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A geranium is a flowering plant that people grow in pots or gardens for decoration.

formal.mt: L-istudenti poġġew sardinella f'qasrija ħdejn it-tieqa tal-klassi.
formal.en: The students placed a geranium in a pot beside the classroom window.
formal.zh: 学生们把一盆天竺葵放在教室窗边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'pjanta hi din? Rita: Din sardinella. Trid tpoġġiha ħdejn it-tieqa?
colloquial.en: Maja: What plant is this? Rita: It's a geranium. Do you want to put it beside the window?
colloquial.zh: Maja：这是什么植物？Rita：这是天竺葵。你想把它放在窗边吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'pjanta hi din?
messages.mt_standard: X'pjanta hi din?
messages.zh: 这是什么植物？
messages.en: What plant is this?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din sardinella. Trid tpoġġiha ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Din sardinella. Trid tpoġġiha ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 这是天竺葵。你想把它放在窗边吗？
messages.en: It's a geranium. Do you want to put it beside the window?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sardinella 和窗边一盆盛开的天竺葵一起记忆，再用“盆中的天竺葵”这个搭配巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bream is a fish that lives in salt water and can be eaten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生活在海水中的鲷鱼，可供食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta li tgħix fil-baħar u li tittiekel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海鲷，生活在海水中的一种鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' ħuta tal-baħar li tista' tissajjar u tittiekel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bream is a saltwater fish that is also caught for food.

formal.mt: Ir-ristorant joffri sargu mixwi bil-ħaxix bħala platt prinċipali.
formal.en: The restaurant offers grilled bream with vegetables as a main course.
formal.zh: 这家餐厅供应配蔬菜的烤海鲷作为主菜。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek sargu frisk illum? Pawlu: Iva, għandi. Kemm trid?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have fresh bream today? Pawlu: Yes, I do. How much would you like?
colloquial.zh: Mark：今天有新鲜海鲷吗？Pawlu：有。你想要多少？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek sargu frisk illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek sargu frisk illum?
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜海鲷吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh bream today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (鱼贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi. Kemm trid?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi. Kemm trid?
messages.zh: 有。你想要多少？
messages.en: Yes, I do. How much would you like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sargu 放进鱼摊买海鲷的场景：先问有没有新鲜的，再想象餐桌上的烤海鲷。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sarcasm is a way of speaking that mocks or criticizes, often by saying the opposite of what is meant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来嘲讽或批评的表达方式，常通过说反话来传达真实意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mod ta' espressjoni li jwaqqa' lil xi ħadd għaċ-ċajt jew jikkritikah, spiss billi jgħid il-kontra ta' dak li jkun ifisser.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讽刺、挖苦的表达方式，常用与本意相反的话来嘲弄或批评。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kliem maħsub biex iweġġa', iwaqqa' għaċ-ċajt jew jikkritika, li spiss jesprimi l-kontra tal-ħsieb veru ta' min jgħidu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sarcasm is speech used to mock or criticize someone, often by expressing the opposite of the speaker's real meaning.

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test, l-istudenti spjegaw kif l-awtur juża s-sarkażmu biex jikkritika l-imġiba tal-karattru.
formal.en: In their analysis of the text, the students explained how the author uses sarcasm to criticize the character's behaviour.
formal.zh: 在文本分析中，学生们解释了作者如何用讽刺来批评人物的行为。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kont qed tuża s-sarkażmu meta għedt 'Prosit' lil min wasal tard? David: Iva, ridt nuri li ma kontx kuntent bid-dewmien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Were you using sarcasm when you said 'Well done' to the person who arrived late? David: Yes, I wanted to show that I was unhappy about the delay.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你对迟到的人说“真棒”的时候，是在挖苦他吗？David：是的，我想表达对耽搁的不满。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont qed tuża s-sarkażmu meta għedt 'Prosit' lil min wasal tard?
messages.mt_standard: Kont qed tuża s-sarkażmu meta għedt 'Prosit' lil min wasal tard?
messages.zh: 你对迟到的人说“真棒”的时候，是在挖苦他吗？
messages.en: Were you using sarcasm when you said 'Well done' to the person who arrived late?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ridt nuri li ma kontx kuntent bid-dewmien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ridt nuri li ma kontx kuntent bid-dewmien.
messages.zh: 是的，我想表达对耽搁的不满。
messages.en: Yes, I wanted to show that I was unhappy about the delay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住迟到却被说“真准时”的场景：字面像夸奖，语气却在挖苦，这就是 sarkażmu 的常见用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A napkin is a piece of cloth or paper used during a meal to wipe your mouth or protect your clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用餐时擦嘴或保护衣物的布巾或纸巾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp jew karta li tintuża waqt l-ikel biex wieħed jimsaħ ħalqu jew jipproteġi ħwejġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 餐巾或餐巾纸，用餐时用来擦嘴、擦手或防止食物弄脏衣服。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa karta jew drapp li tintuża mal-ikel biex jitnaddfu l-ħalq jew l-idejn, jew biex il-ħwejjeġ ma jitħammġux.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A napkin is a piece of paper or cloth that you use at meals to wipe your mouth or keep your clothes clean.

formal.mt: Qabel beda jiekol, poġġa s-sarvetta fuq ħoġru.
formal.en: Before he began eating, he placed the napkin on his lap.
formal.zh: 开始用餐前，他把餐巾铺在膝上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tista' tgħaddili sarvetta, jekk jogħġbok? Marija: Hawn waħda. Għandek bżonn oħra?
colloquial.en: Anna: Could you pass me a napkin, please? Marija: Here's one. Do you need another?
colloquial.zh: Anna：请递给我一张餐巾纸，好吗？Marija：给你一张。还需要一张吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (食客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħaddili sarvetta, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħaddili sarvetta, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请递给我一张餐巾纸，好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me a napkin, please?

messages.speaker: Marija (同桌朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn waħda. Għandek bżonn oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn waħda. Għandek bżonn oħra?
messages.zh: 给你一张。还需要一张吗？
messages.en: Here's one. Do you need another?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sarvetta 想成餐盘旁折好的餐巾：纸做的可擦嘴，布做的可铺在膝上，用餐场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container with a handle, used for carrying water or other liquids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有提手、用来盛装和搬运水或其他液体的桶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent b'manku li jintuża biex jinġarr l-ilma jew likwidi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有提手的桶，通常用于盛装和提运水或其他液体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent b'manku li fih jinżamm u jinġarr l-ilma jew likwidu ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pail is a container with a handle that you use to carry water or other liquids.

formal.mt: Qabel ma beda t-tindif, il-ħaddiem mela sassla bl-ilma.
formal.en: Before starting the cleaning, the worker filled a pail with water.
formal.zh: 开始清洁之前，工人往提桶里装满了水。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hi s-sassla? Pawlu: Ħdejn il-bieb. Imlieha bl-ilma biex naħslu l-art.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the pail? Pawlu: By the door. Fill it with water so we can wash the floor.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：提桶在哪里？保罗：在门旁边。装满水，我们好洗地板。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi s-sassla?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi s-sassla?
messages.zh: 提桶在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the pail?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb. Imlieha bl-ilma biex naħslu l-art.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb. Imlieha bl-ilma biex naħslu l-art.
messages.zh: 在门旁边。装满水，我们好洗地板。
messages.en: By the door. Fill it with water so we can wash the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sassla 和“提手、水、洗地板”的画面一起记：看到提桶，就想起提水清洁的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The evil spiritual being known as Satan, who opposes God in Christian belief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 撒旦，基督教信仰中与上帝对抗、代表邪恶的灵体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ispirtu ħażin magħruf bħala Satana, li fit-twemmin Nisrani jopponi lil Alla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撒旦，基督教信仰中与上帝对抗的魔鬼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xitan magħruf bħala Satana, li fit-twemmin Nisrani huwa għadu ta' Alla u jirrappreżenta l-ħażen.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Satan is the evil spiritual being who opposes God in Christian belief.

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza l-figura ta' Satana u r-rwol tagħha fit-test reliġjuż.
formal.en: The study analyses the figure of Satan and its role in the religious text.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了撒旦这一形象及其在宗教文本中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu Satana f'din l-istorja? Mark: Hu x-xitan li jipprova jħajjar lill-karattru jagħmel il-ħażen.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is Satan in this story? Mark: He is the devil who tries to tempt the character into doing evil.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里的撒旦是谁？马克：就是那个试图引诱故事人物作恶的魔鬼。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu Satana f'din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu Satana f'din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的撒旦是谁？
messages.en: Who is Satan in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu x-xitan li jipprova jħajjar lill-karattru jagħmel il-ħażen.
messages.mt_standard: Hu x-xitan li jipprova jħajjar lill-karattru jagħmel il-ħażen.
messages.zh: 就是那个试图引诱故事人物作恶的魔鬼。
messages.en: He is the devil who tries to tempt the character into doing evil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 satana 与中文“撒旦”和英文 Satan 并排记忆，再用故事中“引诱作恶”的角色画面巩固含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A natural object or human-made device that moves around a planet or another body in space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕行星或其他天体运行的天然天体或人造装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett naturali jew magħmul mill-bniedem li jdur madwar pjaneta jew korp ieħor fl-ispazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卫星，绕行星或其他天体运行的天然天体或人造装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Korp naturali jew apparat magħmul mill-bniedem li jiċċaqlaq f'orbita madwar pjaneta jew korp ieħor fl-ispazju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A satellite is a natural object or an artificial device that travels around a planet or another body in space.

formal.mt: It-trażmissjoni tas-sinjal permezz tas-satellita tippermetti komunikazzjoni ma' żoni remoti.
formal.en: Signal transmission via satellite enables communication with remote areas.
formal.zh: 通过卫星传输信号，可以与偏远地区进行通信。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif jasal is-sinjal tat-televiżjoni hawn? David: Permezz tas-satellita, anki jekk ngħixu 'l bogħod mill-belt.
colloquial.en: Nina: How does the television signal reach us here? David: Via satellite, even though we live far from the city.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：电视信号是怎么传到我们这里的？戴维：通过卫星，虽然我们住得离城市很远。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jasal is-sinjal tat-televiżjoni hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jasal is-sinjal tat-televiżjoni hawn?

messages.zh: 通过卫星，虽然我们住得离城市很远。
messages.en: Via satellite, even though we live far from the city.
