gloss_zh: 讽刺的；具有讽刺意味的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using humour, irony, or ridicule to criticise people, behaviour, or society.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运用幽默、反讽或嘲弄来批评人物、行为或社会现象的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża l-umoriżmu, l-ironija jew iż-żuffjett biex jikkritika nies, imġiba jew aspetti tas-soċjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讽刺性的，借助幽默、反讽或嘲弄来揭示和批评问题的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jesprimi kritika permezz tal-umoriżmu, l-ironija jew iż-żuffjett, spiss billi jikxef difetti fin-nies jew fis-soċjetà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is satirical uses humour, irony, or ridicule to expose and criticise faults in people or society.

collocations.zh: 一句带有讽刺意味的评论

formal.mt: L-awtur juża ton satiriku biex jikxef il-kontradizzjonijiet fid-diskors tal-politiċi.
formal.en: The author uses a satirical tone to expose contradictions in politicians' statements.
formal.zh: 作者以讽刺的语气揭示政治人物言论中的矛盾。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan l-artiklu jfaħħar il-kjuwijiet twal? Toni: Għax hu satiriku! Qed juża l-ironija biex jikkritika s-servizz bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does this article praise long queues? Toni: Because it is satirical! It is using irony to criticise the slow service.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章为什么赞美排长队？托尼：因为它是讽刺文章呀！它是在用反讽批评服务缓慢。

messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan l-artiklu jfaħħar il-kjuwijiet twal?
messages.zh: 这篇文章为什么赞美排长队？
messages.en: Why does this article praise long queues?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu satiriku! Qed juża l-ironija biex jikkritika s-servizz bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu satiriku! Qed juża l-ironija biex jikkritika s-servizz bil-mod.
messages.zh: 因为它是讽刺文章呀！它是在用反讽批评服务缓慢。
messages.en: Because it is satirical! It is using irony to criticise the slow service.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 satiriku 的阅读线索：表面夸奖排队真长，实际批评服务太慢；让人发笑的话语中藏着批评。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sea fish called mackerel, eaten as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鲭鱼，一种可供食用的海鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-baħar li tittiekel u li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ mackerel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲭鱼，一种食用海鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-baħar li tintuża bħala ikel u li bl-Ingliż hija magħrufa bħala mackerel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mackerel is a sea fish that people prepare and eat as food.

formal.mt: Il-menu tal-lum jinkludi sawrell mixwi bil-lumi u l-ħaxix.
formal.en: Today's menu includes grilled mackerel with lemon and vegetables.
formal.zh: 今日菜单包括配柠檬和蔬菜的烤鲭鱼。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek sawrell frisk illum? Rita: Iva, kemm trid? Mark: Tnejn, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have fresh mackerel today? Rita: Yes, how many would you like? Mark: Two, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你今天有新鲜鲭鱼吗？Rita：有，你要几条？Mark：请给我两条。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hit a person or animal with a whip.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用鞭子抽打人或动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqat persuna jew annimal bi frosta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用鞭子抽打或鞭打人、动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Laqat lil xi ħadd jew lil xi annimal permezz ta' frosta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone whips a person or animal, they hit them with a whip.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport tax-xhud, ir-raġel sawwat liż-żiemel bil-frosta.
formal.en: According to the witness's report, the man whipped the horse.
formal.zh: 根据证人的报告，那名男子用鞭子抽打了那匹马。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex kont imdejqa? Nina: Rajt raġel li sawwat liż-żiemel bil-frosta. Lara: Miskin iż-żiemel!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why were you upset? Nina: I saw a man who whipped the horse. Lara: Poor horse!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你刚才为什么难过？Nina：我看见一个男人用鞭子抽打那匹马。Lara：那匹马真可怜！

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very surprised by something unexpected or impressive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因出乎意料或令人赞叹的事情而十分惊讶的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss sorpriża kbira minħabba xi ħaġa mhux mistennija jew impressjonanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十分惊讶的；因意外或令人赞叹的事物而惊呆的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mimli sorpriża jew stagħġib kbir quddiem xi ħaġa li ma kienx jistenna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are amazed, you feel very surprised by something unexpected or impressive.

collocations.en: amazed by the beauty of the place
collocations.zh: 惊叹于这个地方的美丽

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur baqa' sbalordit bir-riżultat mhux mistenni tal-esperiment.
formal.en: The researcher was amazed by the experiment's unexpected result.
formal.zh: 研究人员对实验中出乎意料的结果感到十分惊讶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok l-ispettaklu? Mark: Iva, bqajt sbalordit! Ma stennejtx daqshekk talent. Maja: Jien ukoll!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you enjoy the show? Mark: Yes, I was amazed! I didn't expect so much talent. Maja: Me too!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢这场演出吗？Mark：喜欢，我都惊呆了！没想到表演者这么有才华。Maja：我也是！

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medicine used to calm a person or help them sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于使人平静下来或帮助入睡的药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mediċina li tintuża biex tikkalma persuna jew tgħinha torqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镇静剂；具有使人平静或产生睡意作用的药物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mediċina li għandha effett ta' kalma jew li tista' ġġib in-ngħas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sedative is a medicine that calms a person or makes them feel sleepy.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-effett tas-sedattiv fuq il-pazjent.
formal.en: The report describes the effect of the sedative on the patient.
formal.zh: 报告描述了镇静剂对患者的作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser 'sedattiv'? Mark: Hija mediċina li tikkalma persuna jew tgħinha torqod.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'sedattiv' mean? Mark: It is a medicine that calms a person or helps them sleep.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：sedattiv 是什么意思？马克：是一种使人平静或帮助入睡的药物。

formal.zh: Sefghet 这一形式可能表示“变成了”，但所给信息并未确认这一解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a toothed blade used for cutting materials such as wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有齿状刀刃、用于切割木材等材料的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'xafra bis-snien li tintuża biex taqta' materjali bħall-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锯子；用带齿锯片切割木材等材料的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda li taqta' l-injam jew materjali oħra permezz ta' xafra bis-snien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A saw is a tool whose toothed blade is used to cut wood or other materials.

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża sega tal-idejn biex jaqta' l-biċċa injam skont il-qisien meħtieġa.
formal.en: The carpenter used a hand saw to cut the piece of wood to the required dimensions.
formal.zh: 木匠用手锯把那块木料锯成所需尺寸。

colloquial.zh: 妮娜：锯子在哪里？托尼：在桌上，锤子旁边。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The office or staff responsible for an organization's administrative and secretarial work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责组织的行政事务、文书处理和秘书工作的办事机构或工作人员整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju jew grupp ta' ħaddiema responsabbli mix-xogħol amministrattiv u segretarjali ta' organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秘书处；承担某个组织的文书、联络和日常行政事务的机构或工作人员整体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju jew grupp ta' persuni li jieħdu ħsieb il-korrispondenza, id-dokumenti u l-amministrazzjoni ta' organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A secretariat is the office or group of staff that handles an organization's administrative and secretarial work.

formal.mt: Is-segretarjat tal-kumitat se jibgħat l-aġenda lill-membri qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The committee's secretariat will send the agenda to the members before the meeting.
formal.zh: 委员会秘书处将在会议前向各成员发送议程。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Lil min nibgħat il-formola? David: Ibgħatha lis-segretarjat; huma jieħdu ħsieb ir-reġistrazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who should I send the form to? David: Send it to the secretariat; they handle registration.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我该把表格发给谁？戴维：发给秘书处，他们负责登记。

messages.speaker: Marija (活动参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nibgħat il-formola?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nibgħat il-formola?
messages.zh: 我该把表格发给谁？
messages.en: Who should I send the form to?

messages.speaker: David (活动工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibgħatha lis-segretarjat; huma jieħdu ħsieb ir-reġistrazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ibgħatha lis-segretarjat; huma jieħdu ħsieb ir-reġistrazzjoni.
messages.zh: 发给秘书处，他们负责登记。
messages.en: Send it to the secretariat; they handle registration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 segretarjat 与英语 secretariat 并排记忆，想象负责收表格、发议程的一间办公室，记住它指“秘书处”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who handles correspondence, keeps records, and organizes administrative work for another person or an organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为个人或机构处理往来函件、保存记录并安排日常行政事务的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu ħsieb il-korrispondenza, iżżomm ir-rekords u torganizza x-xogħol amministrattiv għal persuna oħra jew għal organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秘书；负责文书、记录、日程安排等行政事务的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li twettaq xogħol amministrattiv, bħal tikteb ittri, iżżomm ir-rekords u torganizza appuntamenti jew laqgħat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A secretary is someone whose work includes handling correspondence, keeping records, and arranging appointments or meetings.

formal.mt: Is-segretarju tal-kumitat bagħat l-aġenda lill-membri qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The committee secretary sent the agenda to the members before the meeting.
formal.zh: 委员会秘书在开会前向成员发送了议程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lil min għandi nċempel biex nagħmel appuntament? Mark: Ċempel lis-segretarju; hu jieħu ħsieb l-appuntamenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who should I call to make an appointment? Mark: Call the secretary; he handles appointments.
colloquial.zh: Maja：预约应该打电话给谁？Mark：打给秘书吧，预约由他负责。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min għandi nċempel biex nagħmel appuntament?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min għandi nċempel biex nagħmel appuntament?
messages.zh: 预约应该打电话给谁？
messages.en: Who should I call to make an appointment?

messages.speaker: Mark (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempel lis-segretarju; hu jieħu ħsieb l-appuntamenti.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempel lis-segretarju; hu jieħu ħsieb l-appuntamenti.
messages.zh: 打给秘书吧，预约由他负责。
messages.en: Call the secretary; he handles appointments.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把秘书桌上的三样东西连起来记：信件、会议记录、预约表；负责这些事务的人就是 segretarju。

gloss_zh: 隐秘行动；守口如瓶、秘而不宣的作风

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of acting without attracting notice or keeping information about oneself or one's activities hidden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行动时避免引人注意的隐秘方式，或不愿透露个人情况和活动信息的作风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed jaġixxi mingħajr ma jiġbed l-attenzjoni, jew iżomm moħbija informazzjoni dwaru nnifsu jew dwar dak li jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐秘行动；为避免被人注意或发现而采取的悄然行事方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod ta' kif wieħed jimxi jew jaġixxi bil-moħbi biex ħadd ma jinduna bih jew b'dak li jkun qed jagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Stealth is a way of moving or acting carefully so that other people do not notice you or discover your activity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 守口如瓶、秘而不宣的作风；不愿向他人透露自己的情况、想法或活动的倾向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tendenza ta' persuna li ma tiżvelax lil ħaddieħor informazzjoni dwarha nnifisha, il-ħsibijiet tagħha jew l-attivitajiet tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Secretiveness is the tendency to hide personal information, thoughts, or activities and avoid telling other people about them.

collocations.zh: 对自己的计划秘而不宣

formal.mt: L-operazzjoni twettqet b'segretezza sabiex ma tiġbed l-attenzjoni ta' ħadd.
formal.en: The operation was carried out with stealth so that it would attract nobody's attention.
formal.zh: 这次行动以隐秘方式进行，以免引起任何人的注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex din is-segretezza kollha dwar il-vjaġġ? Mark: Għax irrid nagħmel sorpriża lil oħti!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why all this secretiveness about the trip? Mark: Because I want to surprise my sister!
colloquial.zh: Maja：这趟旅行为什么这么神神秘秘的？Mark：因为我想给妹妹一个惊喜！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din is-segretezza kollha dwar il-vjaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din is-segretezza kollha dwar il-vjaġġ?
messages.zh: 这趟旅行为什么这么神神秘秘的？
messages.en: Why all this secretiveness about the trip?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irrid nagħmel sorpriża lil oħti!
messages.mt_standard: Għax irrid nagħmel sorpriża lil oħti!
messages.zh: 因为我想给妹妹一个惊喜！
messages.en: Because I want to surprise my sister!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分：踮脚行动、避免被发现，记“隐秘行动”；被问计划却不透露，记“秘而不宣”。两者都可联系 segretezza。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports a leader, movement, or set of ideas and follows its guidance or principles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持某位领袖、某个运动或某套思想，并遵循其指引或原则的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġa mexxej, moviment jew sett ta' ideat u timxi fuq il-gwida jew il-prinċipji tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 追随者；认同并支持某个人、运动或思想的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ssegwi u tappoġġa persuna oħra, moviment jew tagħlim għax temmen fihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A follower is someone who supports another person, a movement, or a set of ideas and accepts its guidance.

formal.mt: Il-mexxej ħeġġeġ lis-segwaċi tiegħu biex jiddiskutu l-proposti b'rispett.
formal.en: The leader encouraged his followers to discuss the proposals respectfully.
formal.zh: 这位领袖鼓励自己的追随者以尊重他人的态度讨论这些提议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int segwaċi ta' dan il-moviment? Mark: Iva, nemmen fl-għanijiet tiegħu u nieħu sehem fl-attivitajiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you a follower of this movement? Mark: Yes, I believe in its aims and take part in its activities.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你是这个运动的拥护者吗？Mark：是的，我认同它的目标，也参加它的活动。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int segwaċi ta' dan il-moviment?
messages.mt_standard: Int segwaċi ta' dan il-moviment?
messages.zh: 你是这个运动的拥护者吗？
messages.en: Are you a follower of this movement?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nemmen fl-għanijiet tiegħu u nieħu sehem fl-attivitajiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nemmen fl-għanijiet tiegħu u nieħu sehem fl-attivitajiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，我认同它的目标，也参加它的活动。
messages.en: Yes, I believe in its aims and take part in its activities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人举着支持的标语，跟随自己认同的领袖或思想；把“认同、支持、跟随”一起对应 segwaċi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming or happening after something else in time or order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在时间或顺序上处于另一件事之后的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi jew iseħħ wara xi ħaġa oħra fiż-żmien jew fl-ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 随后的；在所提到的时间、事件或步骤之后出现或发生的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġi jew iseħħ wara ż-żmien, il-ġrajja jew il-pass li jkun issemma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something subsequent happens or comes after the time, event, or stage that has already been mentioned.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat eżamina l-proposta fl-ewwel laqgħa u approvaha fil-laqgħa segwenti.
formal.en: The committee examined the proposal at the first meeting and approved it at the subsequent meeting.
formal.zh: 委员会在第一次会议上审议了该提案，并在随后的会议上批准了它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lestejna l-ewwel parti. X'inhu l-pass segwenti? Mark: Issa niċċekkjaw it-tweġibiet flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: We've finished the first part. What's the next step? Mark: Now we check the answers together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们完成第一部分了。下一步是什么？Mark：现在我们一起核对答案。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejna l-ewwel parti. X'inhu l-pass segwenti?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejna l-ewwel parti. X'inhu l-pass segwenti?
messages.zh: 我们完成第一部分了。下一步是什么？
messages.en: We've finished the first part. What's the next step?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa niċċekkjaw it-tweġibiet flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Issa niċċekkjaw it-tweġibiet flimkien.
messages.zh: 现在我们一起核对答案。
messages.en: Now we check the answers together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画“第一步→下一步”，把箭头后面的步骤标为 il-pass segwenti；记住它描述时间或顺序上随后的事物。

gloss_zh: 被跟随的；随后有……的；有追随者或受众的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Followed by someone or something, or having people who regularly follow or watch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示有人跟随、后面接着某事，或拥有持续关注的追随者或受众。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħadd jimxi warajh, li warajh tiġi xi ħaġa oħra, jew li għandu nies li jsegwuh regolarment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被人跟随的；后面接着另一事物的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li xi ħadd jimxi warajh jew li warajh tiġi xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is followed, another person or thing comes after them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥有一批持续关注的追随者、观众或支持者的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu grupp ta' nies li jsegwuh jew juru interess fih regolarment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something with a following has people who regularly show interest or support.

collocations.en: a programme with a large following

formal.mt: Id-diskors tal-president kien segwit minn diskussjoni qasira.
formal.en: The president's speech was followed by a short discussion.
formal.zh: 主席发言后进行了一场简短讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-programm għadu segwit ħafna? Mark: Iva, ħafna ħbieb tiegħi jarawh kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this programme still have a large following? Mark: Yes, many of my friends watch it every week.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个节目现在还有很多人追看吗？Mark：有啊，我很多朋友每周都看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-programm għadu segwit ħafna?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-programm għadu segwit ħafna?
messages.zh: 这个节目现在还有很多人追看吗？
messages.en: Does this programme still have a large following?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħafna ħbieb tiegħi jarawh kull ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħafna ħbieb tiegħi jarawh kull ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 有啊，我很多朋友每周都看。
messages.en: Yes, many of my friends watch it every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项画成两幅图：一人身后有人跟随，一个节目身后有固定观众；共同抓住“后面有人或有事接着”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used with a plural subject to describe going somewhere or an intended journey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于复数主语，表示正在前往某处，或打算、即将去某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li tintuża ma' suġġett fil-plural biex turi li persuni qegħdin imorru jew biħsiebhom imorru xi mkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在去、前往；用于复数主语时，也可表示计划或即将前往。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tgħid li grupp ta' persuni qiegħed fi triqtu lejn xi post jew għandu l-ħsieb li jmur hemm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When people are going somewhere, they are travelling there or intend to travel there.

formal.mt: L-istudenti sejrin il-mużew għada bħala parti mill-programm edukattiv tal-iskola.
formal.en: The students are going to the museum tomorrow as part of the school's educational programme.
formal.zh: 作为学校教学活动的一部分，学生们明天将前往博物馆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejrin wara l-ikel? Mark: Sejrin il-baħar. Trid tiġi magħna?
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going after lunch? Mark: We're going to the seaside. Do you want to come with us?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们午饭后要去哪里？马克：我们要去海边。你想跟我们一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn sejrin wara l-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn sejrin wara l-ikel?
messages.zh: 你们午饭后要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going after lunch?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejrin il-baħar. Trid tiġi magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Sejrin il-baħar. Trid tiġi magħna?
messages.zh: 我们要去海边。你想跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: We're going to the seaside. Do you want to come with us?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sejrin 和“一群人一起往前走”的画面绑定，再整句记住 Fejn sejrin?（你们要去哪里？），同时记住复数和前往的意思。

gloss_zh: 竞争征集公告；招标公告

teaching_sense.en_definition: An announcement inviting participation in a competitive process, including the submission of tenders.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 邀请有关人员或机构参加竞争程序的公告，也可指邀请提交投标的招标公告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avviż li jistieden persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet jieħdu sehem fi proċess kompetittiv, inkluż billi jippreżentaw offerti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邀请有关人员或机构参加竞争程序的公开征集公告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avviż li jistieden lill-persuni jew lill-organizzazzjonijiet interessati jieħdu sehem fi proċess kompetittiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A call for competition is an announcement inviting interested parties to take part in a competitive process.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邀请供应商或承包商提交投标的招标公告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avviż li jistieden fornituri jew kuntratturi jippreżentaw offerti għal xogħol, prodotti jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A call for tender invites suppliers or contractors to submit offers for specified work, goods, or services.

collocations.en: respond to a call for competition

formal.mt: L-awtorità ppubblikat sejħa għall-kompetizzjoni biex tagħżel fornitur ġdid għas-servizzi tat-tindif.
formal.en: The authority published a call for competition to select a new provider of cleaning services.
formal.zh: 主管机构发布了招标公告，以选定新的清洁服务供应商。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt is-sejħa għall-kompetizzjoni għas-servizzi tat-tindif? Pawlu: Iva, se naqra l-kundizzjonijiet illum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you seen the call for competition for cleaning services? Pawlu: Yes, I'll read the conditions today.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看到清洁服务的招标公告了吗？Pawlu：看到了，我今天会读一下条件。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt is-sejħa għall-kompetizzjoni għas-servizzi tat-tindif?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt is-sejħa għall-kompetizzjoni għas-servizzi tat-tindif?
messages.zh: 你看到清洁服务的招标公告了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the call for competition for cleaning services?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se naqra l-kundizzjonijiet illum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se naqra l-kundizzjonijiet illum.
messages.zh: 看到了，我今天会读一下条件。
messages.en: Yes, I'll read the conditions today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句想成一张“邀请大家来竞争”的公告；一般语境记竞争征集，采购语境记招标，靠公告目的区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An announcement or request inviting suppliers or contractors to submit tenders.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 邀请供应商或承包商针对指定项目、货物或服务提交投标的公告或正式请求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avviż jew talba li jistieden fornituri jew kuntratturi jippreżentaw offerti għal xogħol, prodotti jew servizzi speċifikati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邀请供应商或承包商提交投标的招标公告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avviż li jistieden fornituri jew kuntratturi jippreżentaw offerti għal xogħol, prodotti jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A call for tenders is an announcement inviting suppliers or contractors to submit formal offers.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 要求有关供应商或承包商按指定条件提交投标的正式邀请或请求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Talba formali biex fornituri jew kuntratturi jippreżentaw offerti skont kundizzjonijiet speċifikati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A request for tenders formally asks potential suppliers to submit offers according to specified requirements.

collocations.en: the conditions of the call for tenders

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ħareġ sejħa għall-offerti għax-xiri ta' għamara ġdida għall-uffiċċji tiegħu.
formal.en: The council issued a call for tenders for the purchase of new furniture for its offices.
formal.zh: 议会发布了招标公告，为其办公室采购新家具。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qrajt is-sejħa għall-offerti għall-għamara? Lara: Iva, imma rridu niċċekkjaw id-data tal-għeluq qabel nibagħtu l-offerta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you read the call for tenders for the furniture? Lara: Yes, but we need to check the closing date before sending our tender.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你读过家具采购的招标公告了吗？Lara：读过了，不过提交投标前，我们得核对一下截止日期。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt is-sejħa għall-offerti għall-għamara?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt is-sejħa għall-offerti għall-għamara?
messages.zh: 你读过家具采购的招标公告了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the call for tenders for the furniture?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rridu niċċekkjaw id-data tal-għeluq qabel nibagħtu l-offerta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rridu niċċekkjaw id-data tal-għeluq qabel nibagħtu l-offerta.
messages.zh: 读过了，不过提交投标前，我们得核对一下截止日期。
messages.en: Yes, but we need to check the closing date before sending our tender.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想采购办公室发出公告，供应商递交投标的完整场景；整组记成“招标公告／投标邀请”，再连着记截止日期和提交投标。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official request for a product to be returned, especially because a problem has been found.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因发现产品存在问题，要求将其退回的正式召回行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba uffiċjali biex prodott jintbagħat lura, speċjalment wara li tinstab xi problema fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产品召回，尤指因安全或质量问题要求退回已售产品的行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni li fiha manifattur jew awtorità jitlob li prodott mibjugħ jintbagħat lura minħabba problema ta' sigurtà jew kwalità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A product recall is an official action asking customers to return a product because a problem has been discovered.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 召回，即要求已经离开或发出的人员、物品等返回。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Talba jew ordni biex persuna jew xi ħaġa li tkun telqet jew intbagħtet xi mkien terġa' lura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A recall is a request or order for someone or something to return after leaving or being sent somewhere.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħabbret sejħa lura tal-prodott wara li nstab difett li seta' jipperikola lill-utenti.
formal.en: The company announced a product recall after a defect was found that could endanger users.
formal.zh: 发现一项可能危及使用者的缺陷后，公司宣布召回该产品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt l-avviż ta' sejħa lura għal din il-lampa? Mark: Iva, se neħodha lura fil-ħanut illum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the recall notice for this lamp? Mark: Yes, I'm taking it back to the shop today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到这款灯的召回通知了吗？马克：看到了，我今天就把它拿回店里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt l-avviż ta' sejħa lura għal din il-lampa?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt l-avviż ta' sejħa lura għal din il-lampa?
messages.zh: 你看到这款灯的召回通知了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the recall notice for this lamp?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se neħodha lura fil-ħanut illum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se neħodha lura fil-ħanut illum.
messages.zh: 看到了，我今天就把它拿回店里。
messages.en: Yes, I'm taking it back to the shop today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上“通知消费者把商品送回来”的画面记忆；看到 lura，就联想这里的“返回”，从而记住“召回”。

gloss_zh: 从市场召回产品；产品市场召回

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official action to withdraw a product from the market and request the return of affected items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某种产品从市场撤回，并要求退回相关产品的正式召回行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni uffiċjali biex prodott jitneħħa mis-suq u jintalab li l-oġġetti affettwati jintbagħtu lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产品召回，即将存在问题的产品从市场撤回，并要求退回相关产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni li permezz tagħha prodott li jkun fih problema jitneħħa mis-suq u jintalab li jintbagħat lura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A product recall occurs when a company or authority withdraws a product from sale and asks for affected items to be returned.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 召回；在本短语中，特指将产品从市场撤回并要求退回的行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Talba jew ordni biex xi ħaġa tintbagħat lura; f'din l-espressjoni, tirreferi għal prodott li jitneħħa mis-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A recall is an action requiring something to be returned, and this expression specifically concerns a product on the market.

collocations.mt: tħabbar sejħa lura ta' prodott mis-suq
avviż dwar sejħa lura ta' prodott mis-suq
collocations.en: a notice about a product recall
collocations.zh: 关于产品市场召回的通知

collocations.mt: proċedura għal sejħa lura ta' prodott mis-suq
collocations.en: a procedure for recalling a product from the market
collocations.zh: 从市场召回产品的程序

formal.mt: F'każ ta' sejħa lura ta' prodott mis-suq, il-konsumaturi għandhom jaqraw l-avviż u jsegwu l-istruzzjonijiet għar-ritorn.
formal.en: In the event of a product recall, consumers should read the notice and follow the return instructions.
formal.zh: 产品从市场召回时，消费者应阅读通知，并按照指示退回产品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'sejħa lura ta' prodott mis-suq' f'dan l-avviż? Pawlu: Qed jitolbu lin-nies jibagħtu l-prodott lura għax instabet problema fih.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'product recall' mean in this notice? Pawlu: They're asking people to send the product back because a problem was found with it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份通知里的“从市场召回产品”是什么意思？保罗：就是发现产品有问题，要求大家把它寄回去。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'sejħa lura ta' prodott mis-suq' f'dan l-avviż?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'sejħa lura ta' prodott mis-suq' f'dan l-avviż?
messages.zh: 这份通知里的“从市场召回产品”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'product recall' mean in this notice?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jitolbu lin-nies jibagħtu l-prodott lura għax instabet problema fih.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jitolbu lin-nies jibagħtu l-prodott lura għax instabet problema fih.
messages.zh: 就是发现产品有问题，要求大家把它寄回去。
messages.en: They're asking people to send the product back because a problem was found with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三段记：sejħa lura 是“召回”，ta' prodott 说明“产品”，mis-suq 补充“从市场”；把三段串成一张产品召回通知。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Previously owned or used by someone else before being acquired by another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品在由另一人购入或取得之前，已经被别人拥有或使用过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi oġġett li jkun diġà kien għand persuna oħra jew intuża minnha qabel ma jinxtra jew jinkiseb minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二手的，指先前已由他人拥有或使用过的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għal oġġett li ma jkunx ġdid u li jkun diġà kien proprjetà ta' xi ħadd ieħor jew intuża minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is second-hand has already been owned or used by another person before you obtain it.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tixtri karozza sekondaman, huwa rakkomandat li mekkanik jivverifika l-kundizzjoni tagħha.
formal.en: Before buying a second-hand car, it is recommended that a mechanic check its condition.
formal.zh: 购买二手汽车之前，建议请机械师检查车况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-mejda xtrajtu ġdid? Pawlu: Le, xtrajtu sekondaman, imma għadu f'kundizzjoni tajba ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you buy this table new? Pawlu: No, I bought it second-hand, but it's still in very good condition.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张桌子是买的新的吗？保罗：不是，买的是二手的，不过它的状况仍然很好。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-mejda xtrajtu ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-mejda xtrajtu ġdid?
messages.zh: 这张桌子是买的新的吗？
messages.en: Did you buy this table new?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, xtrajtu sekondaman, imma għadu f'kundizzjoni tajba ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, xtrajtu sekondaman, imma għadu f'kundizzjoni tajba ħafna.
messages.zh: 不是，买的是二手的，不过它的状况仍然很好。
messages.en: No, I bought it second-hand, but it's still in very good condition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一件物品从前任主人手里交到你手里，并给它贴上 sekondaman 标签；用“二手汽车、二手家具、二手书”三个场景反复记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fertiliser that supplies iron to plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为植物提供铁元素的肥料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fertilizzant li jipprovdi l-ħadid lill-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于给植物补充铁元素的肥料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fertilizzant li jintuża biex jagħti lill-pjanti l-ħadid li jeħtieġu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An iron fertiliser is a substance used to supply plants with iron.

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar irreġistra l-applikazzjoni ta' sekwestrin u l-kwantità użata fir-rapport tal-ġnien.
formal.en: The gardener recorded the application of iron fertiliser and the quantity used in the garden report.
formal.zh: 园丁在花园管理报告中记录了铁肥的施用情况及用量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek sekwestrin għall-pjanti? Pawlu: Iva, hemm fuq l-ixkaffa. Aqra l-istruzzjonijiet qabel tużah.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have iron fertiliser for plants? Pawlu: Yes, it is there on the shelf. Read the instructions before using it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你这里有给植物用的铁肥吗？Pawlu：有，就在架子上。使用前先阅读说明。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek sekwestrin għall-pjanti?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek sekwestrin għall-pjanti?
messages.zh: 你这里有给植物用的铁肥吗？
messages.en: Do you have iron fertiliser for plants?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm fuq l-ixkaffa. Aqra l-istruzzjonijiet qabel tużah.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm fuq l-ixkaffa. Aqra l-istruzzjonijiet qabel tużah.
messages.zh: 有，就在架子上。使用前先阅读说明。
messages.en: Yes, it is there on the shelf. Read the instructions before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sekwestrin 写在一袋标有“给植物补铁”的肥料旁，用“植物—铁元素—肥料”的画面记住词义。

gloss_zh: 消费信贷；消费者贷款；向消费者放贷

teaching_sense.en_definition: Credit or a loan provided to a consumer for personal purchases or expenses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向消费者提供、用于个人消费或支出的信贷或贷款，也可指提供这类贷款的业务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kreditu jew flus mislufa lil konsumatur għal xiri jew spejjeż personali; l-espressjoni tista' tirreferi wkoll għall-attività li jingħata dan is-self.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向消费者提供、允许其先取得商品、服务或资金而后付款或还款的消费信贷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faċilità finanzjarja li tippermetti lil konsumatur jixtri oġġetti jew servizzi, jew jikseb flus, u jħallas jew irodd il-flus aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer credit is credit that allows individuals to obtain goods, services, or money and pay for them later.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向消费者提供个人消费用途贷款的活动或业务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li biha istituzzjoni jew sellief jipprovdi flus mislufa lil konsumaturi għal xiri jew spejjeż personali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer lending is the activity of providing loans to individuals for their personal purchases or expenses.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向消费者发放、用于个人消费或支出并须偿还的一笔贷款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mislufa lil konsumatur għal xiri jew spejjeż personali, li trid titħallas lura skont il-kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consumer loan is a sum of money lent to an individual to cover personal purchases or expenses.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett dwar is-self lill-konsumatur jispjega l-ispiża totali tas-self u l-iskeda tal-ħlasijiet.
formal.en: The leaflet on consumer credit explains the total cost of borrowing and the payment schedule.
formal.zh: 这份消费信贷说明册介绍了借款总成本和还款安排。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed naħseb li napplika għal self lill-konsumatur biex nixtri friġġ ġdid. Karl: Taf kemm se tħallas b'kollox?
colloquial.en: Nina: I'm thinking of applying for a consumer loan to buy a new fridge. Karl: Do you know how much you'll pay in total?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我在考虑申请消费贷款，买一台新冰箱。卡尔：你知道总共要付多少钱吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naħseb li napplika għal self lill-konsumatur biex nixtri friġġ ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naħseb li napplika għal self lill-konsumatur biex nixtri friġġ ġdid.
messages.zh: 我在考虑申请消费贷款，买一台新冰箱。
messages.en: I'm thinking of applying for a consumer loan to buy a new fridge.

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf kemm se tħallas b'kollox?
messages.mt_standard: Taf kemm se tħallas b'kollox?
messages.zh: 你知道总共要付多少钱吗？
messages.en: Do you know how much you'll pay in total?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用买冰箱的情景区分三义：可先买后付的安排是消费信贷，机构提供贷款的活动是放贷业务，实际借到的那笔钱是消费贷款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loan used to finance the purchase of an aeroplane.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于支付购买飞机费用的贷款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mislufa biex jinxtara ajruplan, li trid titħallas lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于购买飞机的贷款；英语释义采用英式拼写 aeroplane。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Selfa li tintuża biex jiġi ffinanzjat ix-xiri ta' ajruplan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aeroplane loan is money borrowed to pay for the purchase of an aeroplane.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于购买飞机的贷款；英语释义采用美式拼写 airplane。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus li persuna jew organizzazzjoni tissellef biex tixtri ajruplan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An airplane loan allows a borrower to purchase an airplane using money that must be repaid.

collocations.en: an application for an aeroplane loan

collocations.mt: ħlasijiet lura ta' selfa għal ajruplan

formal.mt: Il-klabb tat-titjir ressaq applikazzjoni għal selfa għal ajruplan biex jixtri ajruplan għat-taħriġ.
formal.en: The flying club submitted an application for an aeroplane loan to purchase a training aircraft.
formal.zh: 飞行俱乐部提交了飞机贷款申请，以购买一架教练机。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif se tħallas għall-ajruplan? Rita: Se napplika għal selfa għal ajruplan, imma l-ewwel irrid inkun naf kemm se nħallas kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Mark: How are you going to pay for the aeroplane? Rita: I am going to apply for an aeroplane loan, but first I want to know how much I will pay each month.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你打算怎么支付买飞机的钱？Rita：我打算申请飞机贷款，不过我想先了解每个月要还多少钱。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se tħallas għall-ajruplan?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se tħallas għall-ajruplan?
messages.zh: 你打算怎么支付买飞机的钱？
messages.en: How are you going to pay for the aeroplane?

messages.speaker: Rita (购机者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se napplika għal selfa għal ajruplan, imma l-ewwel irrid inkun naf kemm se nħallas kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Se napplika għal selfa għal ajruplan, imma l-ewwel irrid inkun naf kemm se nħallas kull xahar.
messages.zh: 我打算申请飞机贷款，不过我想先了解每个月要还多少钱。
messages.en: I am going to apply for an aeroplane loan, but first I want to know how much I will pay each month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记：selfa 是“贷款”，għal 表示用途，ajruplan 是“飞机”；想象贷款申请表旁停着一架飞机。

gloss_zh: 预制住宅贷款；移动式住宅贷款

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loan used to finance the purchase of a manufactured home.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于购买在工厂制造的预制住宅的贷款，此处对应移动式住宅的购房融资。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mislufa biex tinxtara dar mobbli manifatturata f'fabbrika, li trid titħallas lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为购买工厂制造的预制住宅而提供的贷款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Selfa maħsuba biex jiġi ffinanzjat ix-xiri ta' dar mobbli li tkun ġiet manifatturata f'fabbrika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A manufactured housing loan is money borrowed to finance the purchase of a home manufactured in a factory.

collocations.mt: applikazzjoni għal selfa għal dar mobbli
collocations.en: an application for a manufactured housing loan

collocations.mt: ħlasijiet lura ta' selfa għal dar mobbli
collocations.en: repayments on a manufactured housing loan

formal.mt: Il-koppja ressqet applikazzjoni għal selfa għal dar mobbli biex tiffinanzja x-xiri ta' dar manifatturata f'fabbrika.
formal.en: The couple submitted an application for a manufactured housing loan to finance the purchase of a factory-built home.
formal.zh: 这对夫妇提交了预制住宅贷款申请，以支付购买工厂制造住宅的费用。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif se tħallsu għad-dar il-ġdida? David: Qed nistaqsu dwar selfa għal dar mobbli. Irridu nkunu nafu kemm se nħallsu kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Anna: How are you going to pay for the new home? David: We are asking about a manufactured housing loan. We want to know how much we will pay each month.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你们打算怎么支付新房的费用？David：我们正在咨询预制住宅贷款。我们想了解每个月要还多少钱。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se tħallsu għad-dar il-ġdida?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se tħallsu għad-dar il-ġdida?
messages.zh: 你们打算怎么支付新房的费用？
messages.en: How are you going to pay for the new home?

messages.speaker: David (购房者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistaqsu dwar selfa għal dar mobbli. Irridu nkunu nafu kemm se nħallsu kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistaqsu dwar selfa għal dar mobbli. Irridu nkunu nafu kemm se nħallsu kull xahar.
messages.zh: 我们正在咨询预制住宅贷款。我们想了解每个月要还多少钱。
messages.en: We are asking about a manufactured housing loan. We want to know how much we will pay each month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 selfa għal 记作“用于……的贷款”，再把 dar mobbli 配上移动式预制住宅的图片，整句联想为“购买这种住宅的贷款”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loan used to finance the purchase of a boat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于支付购买船艇费用的贷款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mislufa biex tinxtara dgħajsa, li trid titħallas lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为购买船艇而借入、需要偿还的款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Selfa li persuna jew organizzazzjoni tieħu biex tiffinanzja x-xiri ta' dgħajsa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A boat loan is money borrowed to purchase a boat and repaid under an agreed arrangement.

collocations.en: an application for a boat loan

collocations.mt: ħlasijiet lura ta' selfa għal dgħajsa

formal.mt: Is-sajjied ressaq applikazzjoni għal selfa għal dgħajsa biex jixtri dgħajsa għax-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: The fisherman submitted an application for a boat loan to purchase a boat for his work.
formal.zh: 这名渔民提交了购船贷款申请，以购买一艘工作用船。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Se tixtri d-dgħajsa dan ix-xahar? Ġużeppi: Forsi. L-ewwel irrid nara jekk nistax nieħu selfa għal dgħajsa u kemm se nħallas kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you going to buy the boat this month? Ġużeppi: Maybe. First I want to see whether I can get a boat loan and how much I will pay each month.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你打算这个月买那艘船吗？Ġużeppi：也许吧。我想先看看能不能申请到购船贷款，以及每个月要还多少钱。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tixtri d-dgħajsa dan ix-xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Se tixtri d-dgħajsa dan ix-xahar?
messages.zh: 你打算这个月买那艘船吗？
messages.en: Are you going to buy the boat this month?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (购船者)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi. L-ewwel irrid nara jekk nistax nieħu selfa għal dgħajsa u kemm se nħallas kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi. L-ewwel irrid nara jekk nistax nieħu selfa għal dgħajsa u kemm se nħallas kull xahar.
messages.zh: 也许吧。我想先看看能不能申请到购船贷款，以及每个月要还多少钱。
messages.en: Maybe. First I want to see whether I can get a boat loan and how much I will pay each month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“贷款单上画着一艘船”的画面记忆：selfa 是贷款，għal 引出用途，dgħajsa 是船，合起来就是购船贷款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money lent to finance the production of a film, which must be repaid under agreed terms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为资助电影制作而提供、须按约定条件偿还的贷款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mislufa biex tiffinanzja l-produzzjoni ta' film, li trid titħallas lura skont il-kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于资助电影制作的贷款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Selfa li tingħata biex tkopri spejjeż marbuta mal-produzzjoni ta' film.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A film loan is money borrowed to cover the costs of making a film.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tal-produzzjoni applikat għal selfa għal film biex tkopri l-ispejjeż tal-ġbid.
formal.en: The production company applied for a film loan to cover the costs of filming.
formal.zh: 这家制片公司申请了电影融资贷款，以支付拍摄费用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se tħallsu għall-ġbid tal-film? Mark: Se napplikaw għal selfa għal film. Maja: U meta se tħallsuha lura? Mark: Dan jiddependi mill-ftehim mal-bank.
colloquial.en: Maja: How will you pay for filming? Mark: We are going to apply for a film loan. Maja: And when will you repay it? Mark: That depends on the agreement with the bank.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们打算怎么支付电影拍摄费用？Mark：我们打算申请电影融资贷款。Maja：那什么时候偿还呢？Mark：这要看与银行的协议。

messages.mt_standard: Se napplikaw għal selfa għal film.

messages.mt_standard: U meta se tħallsuha lura?

messages.en: And when will you repay it?

messages.speaker: Mark (制片人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan jiddependi mill-ftehim mal-bank.
messages.mt_standard: Dan jiddependi mill-ftehim mal-bank.
messages.zh: 这要看与银行的协议。
messages.en: That depends on the agreement with the bank.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语按用途分块记：selfa 是贷款，għal 表示用于，film 是电影；想象制片人借钱支付拍摄费用，就能联想到电影融资贷款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money lent to someone to buy a car, which is repaid under agreed terms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为购买汽车而借入、须按约定条件偿还的贷款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mislufa lil persuna biex tixtri karozza, li titħallas lura skont il-kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为购买汽车而提供的贷款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Selfa li persuna tieħu biex tiffinanzja x-xiri ta' karozza u li trid tħallas lura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An auto loan is money that you borrow to pay for a car.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于购买汽车、须按约定偿还的贷款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mislufa għax-xiri ta' karozza, bl-obbligu li titħallas lura skont ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An automobile loan allows a buyer to borrow money for the purchase of a car.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 购车贷款，即为支付汽车购置款而借入的资金。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Selfa maħsuba biex tgħin lil xi ħadd iħallas għall-karozza li jkun qed jixtri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A car loan is a sum of money lent to someone who wants to buy a car.

collocations.mt: il-ħlas ta' kull xahar tas-selfa għal karozza
collocations.en: the monthly payment on a car loan

formal.mt: L-applikant talab selfa għal karozza u ppreżenta d-dokumenti dwar id-dħul tiegħu.
formal.en: The applicant requested a car loan and submitted documents showing his income.
formal.zh: 申请人申请了购车贷款，并提交了收入证明文件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Diġà xtrajt il-karozza? Pawlu: Għadni le. Qed nistenna li tiġi approvata s-selfa għal karozza. Lara: Taf kemm se tħallas fix-xahar? Pawlu: Iva, il-bank tani l-iskeda tal-ħlasijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you bought the car yet? Pawlu: Not yet. I am waiting for the car loan to be approved. Lara: Do you know how much you will pay each month? Pawlu: Yes, the bank gave me the payment schedule.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你已经买车了吗？Pawlu：还没有。我在等购车贷款获批。Lara：你知道每个月要还多少吗？Pawlu：知道，银行给了我还款计划表。

messages.mt_spoken: Diġà xtrajt il-karozza?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà xtrajt il-karozza?
messages.zh: 你已经买车了吗？
messages.en: Have you bought the car yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (购车者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Qed nistenna li tiġi approvata s-selfa għal karozza.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Qed nistenna li tiġi approvata s-selfa għal karozza.

messages.en: Not yet. I am waiting for the car loan to be approved.

messages.mt_spoken: Taf kemm se tħallas fix-xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Taf kemm se tħallas fix-xahar?
messages.zh: 你知道每个月要还多少吗？
messages.en: Do you know how much you will pay each month?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (购车者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-bank tani l-iskeda tal-ħlasijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-bank tani l-iskeda tal-ħlasijiet.
messages.zh: 知道，银行给了我还款计划表。
messages.en: Yes, the bank gave me the payment schedule.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用购车场景记忆：selfa 是贷款，għal karozza 表示用于汽车。看到车钥匙就联想购车贷款，并把 auto loan、automobile loan、car loan 作为同义表达一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Credit or a loan provided to an individual to pay for personal goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向个人提供、用于支付个人消费商品或服务费用的信贷或贷款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kreditu jew self mogħti lil individwu biex iħallas għal oġġetti jew servizzi għall-użu personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费信贷，即让个人先取得消费商品或服务、再按约定付款的信用安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' kreditu li jippermetti lil individwu jixtri oġġetti jew servizzi għall-użu personali u jħallas għalihom aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer credit allows individuals to obtain goods or services and pay for them at a later date.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费贷款业务，即向个人发放用于消费支出的贷款的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha istituzzjoni jew sellief jagħti self lil individwi biex ikopru spejjeż ta' konsum personali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer lending is the activity of providing loans to individuals for their personal spending.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费贷款，即个人为支付消费商品或服务费用而借入、须偿还的一笔资金。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mislufa lil individwu biex iħallas għal oġġetti jew servizzi għall-użu personali, li trid titħallas lura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consumer loan is money borrowed by an individual to pay for personal goods or services.

collocations.en: the terms of a consumer loan

formal.mt: Il-klijenta talbet informazzjoni dwar selfa għal konsum biex tixtri għamara għad-dar.
formal.en: The customer requested information about a consumer loan to buy furniture for her home.
formal.zh: 这位顾客咨询了消费贷款的相关信息，打算用来购买家用家具。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se tħallas għall-għamara l-ġdida? Nina: Qed naħseb li nieħu selfa għal konsum. Sara: Diġà taf kemm se tħallas lura b'kollox? Nina: Għadni le. Se nitlob id-dettalji lill-bank.
colloquial.en: Sara: How will you pay for the new furniture? Nina: I am thinking of taking out a consumer loan. Sara: Do you already know how much you will repay in total? Nina: Not yet. I will ask the bank for the details.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你打算怎么支付新家具的钱？Nina：我在考虑申请一笔消费贷款。Sara：你已经知道总共要还多少钱了吗？Nina：还不知道。我会向银行询问具体情况。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se tħallas għall-għamara l-ġdida?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se tħallas għall-għamara l-ġdida?
messages.zh: 你打算怎么支付新家具的钱？
messages.en: How will you pay for the new furniture?

messages.speaker: Nina (家具购买者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naħseb li nieħu selfa għal konsum.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naħseb li nieħu selfa għal konsum.
messages.zh: 我在考虑申请一笔消费贷款。
messages.en: I am thinking of taking out a consumer loan.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà taf kemm se tħallas lura b'kollox?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà taf kemm se tħallas lura b'kollox?
messages.zh: 你已经知道总共要还多少钱了吗？
messages.en: Do you already know how much you will repay in total?

messages.speaker: Nina (家具购买者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Se nitlob id-dettalji lill-bank.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Se nitlob id-dettalji lill-bank.
messages.zh: 还不知道。我会向银行询问具体情况。
messages.en: Not yet. I will ask the bank for the details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买家具时使用贷款：selfa 对应贷款，konsum 对应消费。再区分三个英语角度：credit 看信贷安排，lending 看放贷活动，loan 看具体的一笔贷款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money lent to finance the purchase or improvement of property used as offices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为购买或改善办公用途的物业而提供的贷款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mislufa biex tiffinanzja x-xiri jew it-titjib ta' proprjetà li tintuża bħala uffiċċji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 办公物业贷款，即用于购置或改善办公用途房地产的贷款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Selfa maħsuba biex tkopri x-xiri jew it-titjib ta' proprjetà għall-użu bħala uffiċċji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An office property loan provides borrowed money to finance property that is used as offices.

collocations.mt: tapplika għal selfa għal proprjetà ta' uffiċċji
collocations.en: apply for an office property loan

collocations.mt: l-approvazzjoni ta' selfa għal proprjetà ta' uffiċċji
collocations.en: the approval of an office property loan

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija applikat għal selfa għal proprjetà ta' uffiċċji biex tixtri bini għall-persunal tagħha.
formal.en: The company applied for an office property loan to purchase a building for its staff.
formal.zh: 这家公司申请了办公物业贷款，以购买一栋供员工办公的楼宇。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Se tixtru l-uffiċċji fejn taħdmu? David: Iva, applikajna għal selfa għal proprjetà ta' uffiċċji. Rita: Il-bank diġà approvaha? David: Għadu le. Qed jistenna l-valutazzjoni tal-bini.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you going to buy the offices where you work? David: Yes, we have applied for an office property loan. Rita: Has the bank approved it yet? David: Not yet. It is waiting for the building valuation.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你们打算买下现在办公的地方吗？David：是的，我们已经申请了办公物业贷款。Rita：银行已经批准了吗？David：还没有。银行正在等楼宇估值结果。

messages.mt_standard: Il-bank diġà approvaha?

messages.en: Has the bank approved it yet?

messages.mt_standard: Għadu le. Qed jistenna l-valutazzjoni tal-bini.
messages.zh: 还没有。银行正在等楼宇估值结果。
messages.en: Not yet. It is waiting for the building valuation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长短语分成三块：selfa 是贷款，għal proprjetà 是用于物业，ta' uffiċċji 说明办公用途。脑中画出公司贷款买办公楼的场景，依次串起这三块。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loan intended to cover the cost of a utility service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于支付水、电等公用事业服务费用的贷款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Selfa maħsuba biex tkopri l-ispejjeż ta' servizz essenzjali, bħall-provvista tal-ilma jew tal-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于支付水、电等公用事业服务费用的贷款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma ta' flus mislufa biex jitħallsu spejjeż marbuta ma' servizz essenzjali, bħall-ilma jew l-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A utility loan is money borrowed to pay expenses associated with a utility service.

collocations.zh: 申请公用事业费用贷款
偿还公用事业费用贷款

formal.mt: Qabel ma japplika għal selfa għal utilità, l-applikant għandu jaqra l-kundizzjonijiet tal-ħlas lura.
formal.en: Before applying for a utility loan, the applicant should read the repayment terms.
formal.zh: 申请人在申请公用事业费用贷款之前，应阅读还款条款。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Qed naħseb li napplika għal selfa għal utilità biex inħallas il-kont tad-dawl. Pawlu: L-ewwel ara kemm ikollok tħallas lura kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Marta: I'm thinking of applying for a utility loan to pay the electricity bill. Pawlu: First check how much you'll have to repay each month.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我在考虑申请公用事业费用贷款来付电费。保罗：先看看每个月要还多少钱。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naħseb li napplika għal selfa għal utilità biex inħallas il-kont tad-dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naħseb li napplika għal selfa għal utilità biex inħallas il-kont tad-dawl.
messages.zh: 我在考虑申请公用事业费用贷款来付电费。
messages.en: I'm thinking of applying for a utility loan to pay the electricity bill.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel ara kemm ikollok tħallas lura kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel ara kemm ikollok tħallas lura kull xahar.
messages.zh: 先看看每个月要还多少钱。
messages.en: First check how much you'll have to repay each month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“水电账单旁的一份贷款申请”配成画面，记住这里的贷款用途是支付公用事业费用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of putting other people's needs before your own interests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 优先考虑他人的需要，而不以自身利益为先的品质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min iqiegħed il-ħtiġijiet tal-oħrajn qabel l-interessi tiegħu stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了他人的需要或利益而放下自身利益的无私品质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attitudni li biha persuna twarrab l-interessi personali tagħha biex tgħin lil ħaddieħor jew tagħti prijorità lill-ħtiġijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Selflessness is the quality you show when you put other people's needs before your own interests.

formal.mt: Il-voluntiera wrew awtoabnegazzjoni billi taw il-ħin liberu tagħhom biex jgħinu lill-familji fil-bżonn.
formal.en: The volunteers showed selflessness by giving their free time to help families in need.
formal.zh: 志愿者们奉献自己的空闲时间，帮助有需要的家庭，体现了无私精神。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rita qattgħet il-jum liberu tagħha tgħin lill-ġara. Mark: Dak eżempju sabiħ ta' awtoabnegazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Rita spent her day off helping her neighbour. Mark: That's a lovely example of selflessness.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：丽塔休息那天一直在帮助邻居。马克：这真是无私助人的好例子。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rita qattgħet il-jum liberu tagħha tgħin lill-ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Rita qattgħet il-jum liberu tagħha tgħin lill-ġara.
messages.zh: 丽塔休息那天一直在帮助邻居。
messages.en: Rita spent her day off helping her neighbour.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak eżempju sabiħ ta' awtoabnegazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Dak eżempju sabiħ ta' awtoabnegazzjoni.
messages.zh: 这真是无私助人的好例子。
messages.en: That's a lovely example of selflessness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语词头 selflessness 与马耳他语对应词 awtoabnegazzjoni 成对记忆：想象一个人把自己的休息时间让给需要帮助的邻居。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A road signal with coloured lights that tells traffic when to stop or go.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过不同颜色的灯光指示车辆何时停车或通行的道路交通信号装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat fit-triq b'dwal ta' kuluri differenti li juri lit-traffiku meta għandu jieqaf u meta jista' jgħaddi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设置在道路上、用不同颜色灯光控制车辆停止或通行的交通信号灯。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sinjal tat-traffiku li juża dwal ta' kuluri differenti biex jirregola l-moviment tal-vetturi u jurihom meta jieqfu jew jgħaddu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A traffic light is a set of coloured lights beside or above a road that tells drivers when to stop or proceed.

formal.mt: Meta s-semaforu jkun aħmar, is-sewwieqa għandhom jieqfu qabel il-linja tal-waqfien.
formal.en: When the traffic light is red, drivers should stop before the stop line.
formal.zh: 交通信号灯亮红灯时，驾驶员应在停止线前停车。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex waqaft hawn? David: Is-semaforu aħmar. Nitilqu meta jsir aħdar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you stop here? David: The traffic light is red. We'll go when it turns green.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么在这里停下了？戴维：红灯亮着。等变成绿灯我们再走。

messages.speaker: Anna (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex waqaft hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex waqaft hawn?
messages.zh: 你为什么在这里停下了？
messages.en: Why did you stop here?

messages.speaker: David (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-semaforu aħmar. Nitilqu meta jsir aħdar.
messages.mt_standard: Is-semaforu aħmar. Nitilqu meta jsir aħdar.
messages.zh: 红灯亮着。等变成绿灯我们再走。
messages.en: The traffic light is red. We'll go when it turns green.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 semaforu 写在路口红绿灯的图旁，再配对 aħmar“红色”和 aħdar“绿色”，用停车与通行的画面记住词义。

gloss_zh: 半决赛选手；晋级半决赛者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A competitor or team that has reached the semifinal stage of a competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经晋级某项比赛半决赛的选手或队伍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parteċipant jew tim li jkun wasal sas-semifinali ta' kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进入比赛半决赛的选手或队伍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parteċipant jew tim li jkun ikkwalifika biex jieħu sehem fis-semifinali ta' kompetizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A semifinalist is a person or team that has qualified to compete in the semifinals of a competition.

collocations.zh: 该锦标赛的半决赛选手

formal.mt: Kull semifinalist għandu jikkonferma l-parteċipazzjoni tiegħu sal-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: Every semifinalist must confirm their participation by Friday.
formal.zh: 每位半决赛选手必须在星期五之前确认参赛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar ħuk fit-turnew? Mark: Rebaħ illum u issa huwa semifinalist!
colloquial.en: Lara: How did your brother do in the tournament? Mark: He won today and now he's a semifinalist!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你哥哥在锦标赛中表现怎么样？Mark：他今天赢了，现在已经晋级半决赛了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar ħuk fit-turnew?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar ħuk fit-turnew?
messages.zh: 你哥哥在锦标赛中表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did your brother do in the tournament?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rebaħ illum u issa huwa semifinalist!
messages.mt_standard: Rebaħ illum u issa huwa semifinalist!
messages.zh: 他今天赢了，现在已经晋级半决赛了！
messages.en: He won today and now he's a semifinalist!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 semifinalist 贴在赛事四强名单旁：它指已经进入半决赛的参赛者，并不表示已经进入决赛。

gloss_zh: 闪米特语族的；闪米特人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Semitic family of languages or the peoples associated with those languages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与闪米特语族或使用这些语言的民族有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-familja tal-lingwi semitiċi jew mal-popli marbuta ma' dawn il-lingwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪米特语族的，或与该语族相关民族有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-lingwi tal-familja semitika jew il-popli assoċjati ma' dawn il-lingwi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Semitic relates to the Semitic family of languages or to the peoples associated with those languages.

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel l-istruttura ta' lsien semitiku ma' dik ta' lsien minn familja oħra.
formal.en: The study compares the structure of a Semitic language with that of a language from another family.
formal.zh: 这项研究比较了一种闪米特语族语言与另一语族语言的结构。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'semitiku' hawn? Mark: Hawn qed jiddeskrivi lsien li jagħmel parti mill-familja tal-lingwi semitiċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'Semitic' mean here? Mark: Here it describes a language that belongs to the Semitic language family.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的“semitiku”是什么意思？Mark：这里用它来描述一种属于闪米特语族的语言。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'semitiku' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'semitiku' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的“semitiku”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Semitic' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn qed jiddeskrivi lsien li jagħmel parti mill-familja tal-lingwi semitiċi.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn qed jiddeskrivi lsien li jagħmel parti mill-familja tal-lingwi semitiċi.
messages.zh: 这里用它来描述一种属于闪米特语族的语言。
messages.en: Here it describes a language that belongs to the Semitic language family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 semitiku 想成语言分类图上的形容词标签，旁边写“闪米特语族的”；再搭配“民族”练习另一种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a simple or uncomplicated way, or merely without anything additional.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以简单、不复杂的方式；也可表示仅仅如此，没有更多内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod sempliċi u mingħajr kumplikazzjonijiet, jew biss, mingħajr xejn iżjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简单地，不复杂地；或仅仅、只是，用于限定所说内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod ċar u sempliċi, jew biex turi li xi ħaġa hija biss hekk u ma tinvolvix aktar minn hekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you do something simply, you do it without complication; you can also use simply to mean only or merely.

formal.mt: L-awtur jispjega l-proċess sempliċiment, b'eżempji li l-qarrej jista' jifhem faċilment.
formal.en: The author explains the process simply, using examples that the reader can easily understand.
formal.zh: 作者用读者容易理解的例子，简单明了地解释了这个过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ċempiltli? Mark: Sempliċiment ridt inkun naf kif int.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you call me? Mark: I simply wanted to know how you are.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么打电话给我？Mark：我只是想知道你最近怎么样。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ċempiltli?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ċempiltli?
messages.zh: 你为什么打电话给我？
messages.en: Why did you call me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sempliċiment ridt inkun naf kif int.
messages.mt_standard: Sempliċiment ridt inkun naf kif int.
messages.zh: 我只是想知道你最近怎么样。
messages.en: I simply wanted to know how you are.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sempliċiment 配两幅画：把复杂说明讲简单，记“简单地”；把多余目的划掉，记“仅仅、只是”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A year that is beginning or has just begun, especially as an occasion for celebration and good wishes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 即将开始或刚刚开始的一年，尤其用于新年庆祝、祝福和计划。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sena li tkun se tibda jew li tkun għadha kif bdiet, speċjalment bħala żmien ta' ċelebrazzjoni u awguri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 新开始的一年；也指作为庆祝和祝福时节的新年。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidu ta' sena oħra jew is-sena li tkun għadha kif bdiet, meta n-nies spiss jiċċelebraw u jagħtu l-awguri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The new year is the year that is beginning or has just begun, often marked by celebrations and good wishes.

collocations.en: wish someone a happy new year

formal.mt: Fl-ewwel laqgħa tas-sena l-ġdida, il-kumitat se jiddiskuti l-pjan ta' ħidma.
formal.en: At the first meeting of the new year, the committee will discuss the work plan.
formal.zh: 委员会将在新年的第一次会议上讨论工作计划。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sena ġdida tajba, Mark! Mark: Grazzi, lilek ukoll! X'se tagħmel illum?
colloquial.en: Lara: Happy New Year, Mark! Mark: Thanks, you too! What are you going to do today?
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark，新年快乐！Mark：谢谢，你也一样！你今天打算做什么？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sena ġdida tajba, Mark!
messages.mt_standard: Sena ġdida tajba, Mark!
messages.zh: Mark，新年快乐！
messages.en: Happy New Year, Mark!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, lilek ukoll! X'se tagħmel illum?
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, lilek ukoll! X'se tagħmel illum?
messages.zh: 谢谢，你也一样！你今天打算做什么？
messages.en: Thanks, you too! What are you going to do today?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把日历翻到新一年的画面配上 sena ġdida，整组记成“新的一年”；再加 tajba，练习新年祝福。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sharpen the cutting edge of a knife or another blade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 磨削刀具或其他刀刃，使其锋利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel it-tarf ta' sikkina jew ta' xafra oħra aktar jaqta' billi tħokku ma' ġebla jew għodda apposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨快，磨利刀刃。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel xafra aktar taqta' billi tħokkha ma' ġebla jew għodda magħmula għal dan il-għan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you whet a blade, you sharpen its edge by rubbing it against a suitable surface.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem senn is-sikkina b'ġebla apposta qabel beda jaqta' l-materjal.
formal.en: The worker sharpened the knife with a suitable stone before beginning to cut the material.
formal.zh: 工人在开始切割材料之前，用专门的磨刀石磨快了刀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din is-sikkina ma taqtax sew. Pawlu: Sennha ftit qabel tużaha.
colloquial.en: Maja: This knife doesn't cut well. Pawlu: Sharpen it a little before you use it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这把刀不太锋利。Pawlu：用之前先磨一磨。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-sikkina ma taqtax sew.
messages.mt_standard: Din is-sikkina ma taqtax sew.
messages.zh: 这把刀不太锋利。
messages.en: This knife doesn't cut well.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sennha ftit qabel tużaha.
messages.mt_standard: Sennha ftit qabel tużaha.
messages.zh: 用之前先磨一磨。
messages.en: Sharpen it a little before you use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 senn 和磨刀的动作一起记：刀刃来回磨，切东西更利落；看到 senn is-sikkina 就联想“磨快刀”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The meaning of something, or one of the bodily abilities used to perceive the world.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物所表达的意义，或人通过视觉、嗅觉、触觉、味觉、听觉感知外界的能力之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa, jew waħda mill-ħames kapaċitajiet li bihom naraw, inxommu, inħossu, induqu u nisimgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意义；话语、文字或事物所表达的意思。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira li għandha kelma, frażi, stqarrija jew xi ħaġa oħra f'kuntest partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The sense of a word or statement is the meaning it expresses in a particular context.

sense_translations.en_definition: sense (one of the five senses of sight, smell, touch, taste and hearing)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 感官感觉；视觉、嗅觉、触觉、味觉、听觉五种感知能力中的一种。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waħda mill-ħames kapaċitajiet tal-ġisem li bihom persuna tara, ixxomm, tħoss bil-mess, idduq jew tisma'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sense is one of the five bodily abilities through which you see, smell, touch, taste, or hear.

formal.mt: F'din is-sentenza, il-kelma 'sens' tirreferi għall-kapaċità tax-xamm.
formal.en: In this sentence, the word 'sens' refers to the ability to smell.
formal.zh: 在这个句子中，sens 一词指嗅觉这种感知能力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu s-sens ta' din il-kelma hawn? Mark: Hawn tfisser waħda mill-ħames kapaċitajiet tal-ġisem, bħas-smigħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does this word mean here? Mark: Here it means one of the body's five sensory abilities, such as hearing.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个词在这里是什么意思？Mark：这里指身体五种感知能力中的一种，比如听觉。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu s-sens ta' din il-kelma hawn?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu s-sens ta' din il-kelma hawn?
messages.zh: 这个词在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this word mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser waħda mill-ħames kapaċitajiet tal-ġisem, bħas-smigħ.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser waħda mill-ħames kapaċitajiet tal-ġisem, bħas-smigħ.
messages.zh: 这里指身体五种感知能力中的一种，比如听觉。
messages.en: Here it means one of the body's five sensory abilities, such as hearing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个问题区分 sens：问“这句话什么意思”记意义；问“靠什么感知外界”记感官。把词义和五感分成两张记忆卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who arranges transactions between other people, usually for a fee.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为交易双方牵线、协助安排交易，并通常收取佣金或服务费的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tlaqqa' lil min irid jixtri ma' min irid ibigħ u tgħin biex isir ftehim, normalment bi ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经纪人；受托为买卖双方安排交易、通常收取佣金的中介。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taġixxi bħala intermedjarju bejn partijiet fi tranżazzjoni u tgħinhom jilħqu ftehim, normalment bi ħlas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A broker is a person who arranges transactions between buyers and sellers, usually in return for a fee.

formal.mt: Is-sensal għen lix-xerrej u lill-bejjiegħ jilħqu ftehim dwar il-prezz tal-proprjetà.
formal.en: The broker helped the buyer and seller reach an agreement on the price of the property.
formal.zh: 经纪人帮助买方和卖方就房产价格达成了协议。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif sibt lil min jixtri d-dar? Ġorġ: Sensal laqqagħni ma' xerrej interessat.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did you find someone to buy the house? Ġorġ: A broker put me in touch with an interested buyer.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你是怎么找到买房的人的？Ġorġ：一位经纪人帮我联系上了有意购买的人。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sibt lil min jixtri d-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sibt lil min jixtri d-dar?
messages.zh: 你是怎么找到买房的人的？
messages.en: How did you find someone to buy the house?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (卖房者)
messages.mt_spoken: Sensal laqqagħni ma' xerrej interessat.
messages.mt_standard: Sensal laqqagħni ma' xerrej interessat.
messages.zh: 一位经纪人帮我联系上了有意购买的人。
messages.en: A broker put me in touch with an interested buyer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sensal 放在买家和卖家之间想象：他牵线、谈交易、收服务费。用“买家—经纪人—卖家”的画面记住这个职业。

gloss_zh: 煽情主义；以夸张刺激吸引关注的报道手法

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of exaggerated or shocking material to attract attention, especially in news reporting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尤其在新闻报道中，利用夸张、耸动或刺激性的内容吸引公众注意的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li fatti jew stejjer jiġu ppreżentati b'mod esaġerat jew xokkanti biex jiġbdu l-attenzjoni, speċjalment fl-aħbarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煽情主义；在报道或呈现信息时突出耸动、刺激或夸张内容，以吸引注意的倾向或手法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tendenza li wieħed jenfasizza dettalji xokkanti jew jippreżenta stejjer b'mod esaġerat sabiex jiġbed l-interess tal-pubbliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sensationalism is the practice of presenting information in an exaggerated or shocking way in order to attract public attention.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta l-fatti b'mod ċar u jevita s-sensazzjonaliżmu li jista' jqarraq bil-qarrejja.
formal.en: The report presents the facts clearly and avoids sensationalism that could mislead readers.
formal.zh: 这份报告清楚地呈现事实，并避免使用可能误导读者的煽情手法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan it-titlu jagħmel l-istorja tidher ħafna agħar milli hi. David: Iva, dan sensazzjonaliżmu biex jiġbdu l-attenzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: This headline makes the story seem much worse than it is. David: Yes, that's sensationalism to attract attention.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个标题把事情说得比实际严重多了。David：对，这是为了吸引注意而故意夸张煽情。

messages.speaker: Nina (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-titlu jagħmel l-istorja tidher ħafna agħar milli hi.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-titlu jagħmel l-istorja tidher ħafna agħar milli hi.
messages.zh: 这个标题把事情说得比实际严重多了。
messages.en: This headline makes the story seem much worse than it is.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan sensazzjonaliżmu biex jiġbdu l-attenzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan sensazzjonaliżmu biex jiġbdu l-attenzjoni.
messages.zh: 对，这是为了吸引注意而故意夸张煽情。
messages.en: Yes, that's sensationalism to attract attention.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个把小事写成惊天大事的新闻标题：夸张、刺激、抢眼球。把这一整套吸引注意的做法记作 sensazzjonaliżmu。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing good judgment and making practical, reasonable choices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能作出合理判断，并采取切合实际、明智的做法的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ġudizzju tajjeb u jagħmel għażliet raġonevoli u prattiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明智的；能根据实际情况作出合理判断的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaħseb b'mod raġonevoli u jagħżel dak li jkun xieraq għaċ-ċirkostanzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is sensible uses good judgment and makes practical decisions.

formal.mt: L-għażla ta' post qrib l-istazzjon kienet deċiżjoni sensibbli, għax naqqset il-ħin tal-ivvjaġġar.
formal.en: Choosing a location near the station was a sensible decision because it reduced travel time.
formal.zh: 选择靠近车站的地点是个明智的决定，因为这样缩短了出行时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Naħseb li għandna nitilqu kmieni biex nevitaw it-traffiku. Mark: Dak parir sensibbli. Nitilqu fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Maja: I think we should leave early to avoid the traffic. Mark: That's sensible advice. Let's leave at eight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我觉得我们应该早点出发，避开堵车。马克：这个建议很合理。我们八点出发吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li għandna nitilqu kmieni biex nevitaw it-traffiku.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li għandna nitilqu kmieni biex nevitaw it-traffiku.
messages.zh: 我觉得我们应该早点出发，避开堵车。
messages.en: I think we should leave early to avoid the traffic.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak parir sensibbli. Nitilqu fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Dak parir sensibbli. Nitilqu fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 这个建议很合理。我们八点出发吧。
messages.en: That's sensible advice. Let's leave at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sensibbli 和“早点出门避堵车”的决定一起记：强调判断明智、做法合理；再用“明智的决定、合理的建议”两个搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: My faculties of perception or awareness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我感知周围事物的能力，也可指我的清醒意识。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kapaċitajiet tiegħi li nara, nisma' u nħoss, jew l-għarfien tiegħi ta' dak li jkun qed jiġri madwari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我的感官知觉；在失去或恢复知觉的语境中，指我的意识。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kapaċitajiet tiegħi li nħoss u ninduna b'dak li hemm madwari, jew l-istat tiegħi ta' għarfien ta' dak li jkun qed jiġri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: My senses are my faculties of perception, and the expression can also refer to my conscious awareness.

formal.mt: Wara li tlift sensijja għal ftit ħin, erġajt ġejt f'sensijja u stajt inwieġeb il-mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: After briefly losing consciousness, I regained consciousness and was able to answer the questions.
formal.zh: 短暂失去知觉后，我恢复了意识，能够回答问题了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara meta waqajt? Pawlu: Tlift sensijja għal ftit, imma meta erġajt ġejt f'sensijja, rajt lil ħija ħdejja.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened when you fell? Pawlu: I lost consciousness briefly, but when I came round, I saw my brother beside me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你摔倒时发生了什么？保罗：我短暂失去了知觉，不过醒来后，我看见哥哥就在身边。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara meta waqajt?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara meta waqajt?
messages.zh: 你摔倒时发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened when you fell?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlift sensijja għal ftit, imma meta erġajt ġejt f'sensijja, rajt lil ħija ħdejja.
messages.mt_standard: Tlift sensijja għal ftit, imma meta erġajt ġejt f'sensijja, rajt lil ħija ħdejja.
messages.zh: 我短暂失去了知觉，不过醒来后，我看见哥哥就在身边。
messages.en: I lost consciousness briefly, but when I came round, I saw my brother beside me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sensijja 放进“我失去知觉、我恢复知觉”的成对场景记忆，并始终保留“我的”这一视角，避免只记成泛指的感官。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Easily affected by feelings, treatment, or changes in surrounding conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易受到情绪、他人对待方式或周围条件变化影响的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintlaqat malajr minn sentimenti, minn kif jittrattawh in-nies jew minn bidliet fil-kundizzjonijiet ta' madwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敏感的；对情绪、刺激或环境变化容易产生反应的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirreaġixxi faċilment għal sentimenti, għal dak li jiġri madwaru jew għal stimoli bħad-dawl u l-ħoss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is sensitive reacts readily to emotions, treatment, or changes in surrounding conditions.

formal.mt: L-istudent huwa sensittiv għall-kritika, għalhekk l-għalliem jagħtih kummenti ċari u rispettużi dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: The student is sensitive to criticism, so the teacher gives him clear and respectful feedback on his work.
formal.zh: 这名学生对批评很敏感，因此老师就他的作业给予清楚而尊重的反馈。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għalaqt il-purtieri? David: Għax jien sensittiv għad-dawl qawwi. Hekk inħossni aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you close the curtains? David: Because I'm sensitive to bright light. I feel better this way.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把窗帘拉上了？戴维：因为我对强光敏感。这样我舒服一些。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għalaqt il-purtieri?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għalaqt il-purtieri?
messages.zh: 你为什么把窗帘拉上了？
messages.en: Why did you close the curtains?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jien sensittiv għad-dawl qawwi. Hekk inħossni aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jien sensittiv għad-dawl qawwi. Hekk inħossni aħjar.
messages.zh: 因为我对强光敏感。这样我舒服一些。
messages.en: Because I'm sensitive to bright light. I feel better this way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“听到批评心里有反应、遇到强光身体有反应”两幅画面记 sensittiv：共同点都是容易受到影响、反应敏感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dismissal from employment, including dismissal because a job is no longer required.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雇主终止雇佣关系，包括因岗位不再需要而进行的裁员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkeċċija ta' persuna mill-impjieg, inkluż meta l-post tax-xogħol tagħha ma jibqax meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解雇；由雇主解除某人的雇佣关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tmiem tal-impjieg ta' persuna fuq deċiżjoni ta' min iħaddimha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A discharge is the ending of someone's employment by their employer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裁员；因岗位或相关工作不再需要而终止雇佣关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tmiem tal-impjieg ta' ħaddiem minħabba li l-post tiegħu jew ix-xogħol li jagħmel ma jibqax meħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Redundancy occurs when an employer ends someone's employment because their job is no longer needed.

formal.mt: Minħabba t-tnaqqis fix-xogħol, il-kumpanija tat is-sensja lil għaxar ħaddiema li l-postijiet tagħhom ma baqgħux meħtieġa.
formal.en: Because of a reduction in work, the company made ten workers redundant as their positions were no longer needed.
formal.zh: 由于业务量减少，公司裁撤了十名员工，他们的岗位已不再需要。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadek taħdem fl-istess fabbrika? Toni: Le, tawni s-sensja għax għalqu d-dipartiment tagħna. Issa qed infittex xogħol ieħor.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you still working at the same factory? Toni: No, they made me redundant because they closed our department. I'm looking for another job now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你还在原来那家工厂上班吗？托尼：没有了，他们关闭了我们部门，我被裁员了。现在我正在找别的工作。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek taħdem fl-istess fabbrika?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek taħdem fl-istess fabbrika?
messages.zh: 你还在原来那家工厂上班吗？
messages.en: Are you still working at the same factory?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tawni s-sensja għax għalqu d-dipartiment tagħna. Issa qed infittex xogħol ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tawni s-sensja għax għalqu d-dipartiment tagħna. Issa qed infittex xogħol ieħor.
messages.zh: 没有了，他们关闭了我们部门，我被裁员了。现在我正在找别的工作。
messages.en: No, they made me redundant because they closed our department. I'm looking for another job now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sensja 联想到收到解雇通知的场景：泛指雇佣结束时记“解雇”，明确因为岗位取消时记“裁员”，用结束的原因区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling, emotion, or personal attitude towards someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人、某事产生的情感、情绪或带有感情色彩的看法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment huwa emozzjoni jew atteġġjament personali li wieħed iħoss lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人、某事持有的、带有感情色彩的看法或态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sentiment huwa fehma jew atteġġjament lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li jkollu fih element ta' emozzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sentiment is an opinion or attitude that reflects how someone feels about a person, event, or situation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内心体验到的情绪或感情，如喜悦、悲伤或恐惧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sentiment huwa esperjenza emozzjonali li persuna tħoss fiha nfisha, bħall-ferħ, id-dwejjaq jew il-biża'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An emotion is a feeling you experience, such as happiness, sadness, or fear, often in response to something.

collocations.en: to express a feeling or sentiment

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, l-awtriċi esprimiet sentiment ta' gratitudni lejn dawk li għenuha.
formal.en: In her letter, the author expressed a feeling of gratitude towards those who had helped her.
formal.zh: 作者在信中向帮助过她的人表达了感激之情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ħassejt meta rajt ir-ritratt? Lara: Ħassejt sentiment ta' ferħ għax ftakart fil-vaganza tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you feel when you saw the photo? Lara: I felt happy because it reminded me of our holiday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看到照片时，你有什么感受？Lara：我感到很开心，因为它让我想起了我们的假期。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ħassejt meta rajt ir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: X'ħassejt meta rajt ir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 看到照片时，你有什么感受？
