messages.en: How did you feel when you saw the photo?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt sentiment ta' ferħ għax ftakart fil-vaganza tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt sentiment ta' ferħ għax ftakart fil-vaganza tagħna.
messages.zh: 我感到很开心，因为它让我想起了我们的假期。
messages.en: I felt happy because it reminded me of our holiday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sentiment 放在“看到旧照片时的感受”这个场景中记忆：它既能指心中的情绪，也能指带着感情的看法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Existing, kept, or considered apart from another person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他人或事物分开存在、存放或考虑的；单独的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa separata tkun waħedha jew tinżamm jew titqies għaliha, mhux flimkien ma' ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与其他对象分开的、不合在一起的；独立处理或设置的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun separata meta ma tkunx magħquda jew imħallta ma' ħaġa oħra, jew meta tiġi ttrattata għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is separate, it is kept apart from other things or is dealt with on its own.

formal.mt: Kull applikazzjoni għandha tinżamm f'fajl separat sabiex id-dokumenti ma jitħalltux.
formal.en: Each application should be kept in a separate file so that the documents do not get mixed up.
formal.zh: 每份申请应存放在单独的文件中，以免文件材料混在一起。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' jkolli kont separat, jekk jogħġbok? Rita: Żgur. X'ordnajt inti?
colloquial.en: Mark: Could I have a separate bill, please? Rita: Of course. What did you order?
colloquial.zh: Mark：请给我单独结账，可以吗？Rita：当然。您点了些什么？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' jkolli kont separat, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' jkolli kont separat, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请给我单独结账，可以吗？
messages.en: Could I have a separate bill, please?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. X'ordnajt inti?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. X'ordnajt inti?
messages.zh: 当然。您点了些什么？
messages.en: Of course. What did you order?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把两份材料分别放进两个文件夹：每个都是 fajl separat。用“分开放、单独算”记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tomb or burial chamber in which a dead person is laid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安放死者遗体的坟墓或墓室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sepulkru huwa qabar jew kamra tad-dfin fejn jitqiegħed il-ġisem ta' persuna mejta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于安放死者遗体的坟墓、墓穴或墓室。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sepulkru huwa post tad-dfin, bħal qabar jew kamra, li fih jitqiegħed il-ġisem ta' persuna mejta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sepulchre is a tomb or burial chamber where the body of a dead person is placed.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi sepulkru tal-ġebel b'daħla dejqa u kamra waħda ġewwa.
formal.en: The report describes a stone sepulchre with a narrow entrance and a single chamber inside.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一座石砌坟墓，其入口狭窄，内部只有一个墓室。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-bini żgħir tal-ġebel? Pawlu: Dak hu sepulkru. Ejja naqraw it-tabella biex insiru nafu aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that small stone building? Pawlu: That is a sepulchre. Let's read the sign to find out more.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那座小石建筑是什么？Pawlu：那是一座坟墓。我们读读说明牌，了解更多吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-bini żgħir tal-ġebel?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-bini żgħir tal-ġebel?
messages.zh: 那座小石建筑是什么？
messages.en: What is that small stone building?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu sepulkru. Ejja naqraw it-tabella biex insiru nafu aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu sepulkru. Ejja naqraw it-tabella biex insiru nafu aktar.
messages.zh: 那是一座坟墓。我们读读说明牌，了解更多吧。
messages.en: That is a sepulchre. Let's read the sign to find out more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“石砌墓室与狭窄入口”的画面记住 sepulkru；把它和安放遗体的具体场所联系起来，而不是泛指死亡。

gloss_zh: 将；将要（表示将来的小品词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particle placed before a verb to indicate that an action or event is in the future.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在动词前，表示某个动作或事件将要发生的小品词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ser hija partiċella li titqiegħed qabel verb biex turi li azzjoni jew ġrajja ser isseħħ fil-futur.

sense_translations.en_definition: particle used to indicate future tense
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于标示将来时的小品词，放在动词前表示“将要”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ser hija partiċella li tintuża qabel verb biex tindika li l-azzjoni jew il-ġrajja msemmija għadha trid isseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use ser before a verb to indicate that an action or event will take place in the future.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa ser tibda fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu, u l-parteċipanti ser jirċievu l-aġenda qabel.
formal.en: The meeting will begin at nine in the morning, and the participants will receive the agenda beforehand.
formal.zh: 会议将于上午九点开始，与会者将提前收到议程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ser tagħmel għada? Mark: Ser immur il-baħar ma' ħija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to do tomorrow? Mark: I'm going to the seaside with my brother.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你明天打算做什么？Mark：我要和兄弟一起去海边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ser tagħmel għada?
messages.mt_standard: X'ser tagħmel għada?
messages.zh: 你明天打算做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to do tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ser immur il-baħar ma' ħija.
messages.mt_standard: Ser immur il-baħar ma' ħija.
messages.zh: 我要和兄弟一起去海边。
messages.en: I'm going to the seaside with my brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ser 想成动词前的“未来提示牌”：immur 是动作，ser immur 提示“我将去”；连同 għada“明天”一起练习更容易记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A night or evening, or a performance held during the evening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指夜晚或晚间时段，也可指在晚间举行的演出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin ta' filgħaxija jew tal-lejl, jew spettaklu li jsir filgħaxija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夜晚；一天中入夜后的时段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħin tal-lejl, meta jkun dalam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A serata is a night considered as a period of time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晚间演出；在晚上举行的表演。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spettaklu jew wirja artistika li ssir filgħaxija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A serata is a performance that takes place during the evening.

formal.mt: Is-serata mużikali se ssir fit-teatru nhar il-Ġimgħa fit-tmienja ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The evening musical performance will take place at the theatre on Friday at eight in the evening.
formal.zh: 晚间音乐演出将于星期五晚上八点在剧院举行。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ħadt gost bis-serata tal-bieraħ? Pawlu: Iva, il-mużika kienet sabiħa ħafna!
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you enjoy yesterday's evening performance? Pawlu: Yes, the music was really lovely!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你喜欢昨晚的演出吗？保罗：喜欢，音乐真的很美！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadt gost bis-serata tal-bieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Ħadt gost bis-serata tal-bieraħ?
messages.zh: 你喜欢昨晚的演出吗？
messages.en: Did you enjoy yesterday's evening performance?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-mużika kienet sabiħa ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-mużika kienet sabiħa ħafna!
messages.zh: 喜欢，音乐真的很美！
messages.en: Yes, the music was really lovely!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serata 放进“晚上去看演出”的画面：先记夜晚这个时段，再记晚间演出这个活动。

gloss_zh: 释义未明；所给材料未提供可确认的词义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word listed as a noun whose meaning is not established by the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料将该词标为名词，但未提供可确认的实际词义；学习时应暂记为待查词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma mniżżla bħala nom li t-tifsira tagħha mhijiex stabbilita fil-materjal mogħti.

sense_translations.en_definition: I don't know but I'd to find out! :)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义表达的是“不知道，但想弄清楚”，并未说明该词本身的含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-deskrizzjoni mogħtija tgħid li t-tifsira mhijiex magħrufa u li hemm xewqa li tinstab; ma tagħtix tifsira tal-kelma nnifisha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied description expresses uncertainty and does not establish what this noun means.

formal.mt: Il-materjal mogħti jelenka 'seratizz' bħala nom, iżda ma jagħtix tifsira ċara tal-kelma.
formal.en: The supplied material lists 'seratizz' as a noun but does not give a clear meaning for the word.
formal.zh: 所给材料将“seratizz”列为名词，但没有给出该词的明确含义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taf xi tfisser 'seratizz'? Mark: Le, hawn ma nsibx tifsira ċara. Ejja nħalluha bħala kelma li rridu niċċekkjaw.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you know what 'seratizz' means? Mark: No, I can't find a clear meaning here. Let's leave it as a word we need to check.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你知道“seratizz”是什么意思吗？马克：不知道，这里找不到明确的释义。我们先把它记作待查词吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf xi tfisser 'seratizz'?
messages.mt_standard: Taf xi tfisser 'seratizz'?
messages.zh: 你知道“seratizz”是什么意思吗？
messages.en: Do you know what 'seratizz' means?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn ma nsibx tifsira ċara. Ejja nħalluha bħala kelma li rridu niċċekkjaw.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn ma nsibx tifsira ċara. Ejja nħalluha bħala kelma li rridu niċċekkjaw.
messages.zh: 不知道，这里找不到明确的释义。我们先把它记作待查词吧。
messages.en: No, I can't find a clear meaning here. Let's leave it as a word we need to check.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 seratizz 的词卡画一个问号，旁边写“名词，含义待查”；不要把原释义中的“不知道”误当成这个词的词义。

gloss_zh: 塞尔维亚的；塞尔维亚人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Serbia, its people, or their culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与塞尔维亚、塞尔维亚人或其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-Serbja, mal-poplu tagħha jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞尔维亚的；塞尔维亚人的；与其民族或文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għas-Serbja jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-poplu Serb u l-kultura tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as Serb is connected with Serbia, its people, or their culture.

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Serb se jitkellem dwar il-letteratura waqt il-laqgħa tal-lum.
formal.en: The Serbian writer will speak about literature during today's meeting.
formal.zh: 这位塞尔维亚作家将在今天的会议上谈论文学。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan it-tim minn fejn hu? Adam: Hu tim Serb. Nina: Mela ejja narawh jilgħab!
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is this team from? Adam: It's a Serbian team. Nina: Then let's watch them play!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这支球队来自哪里？亚当：是支塞尔维亚球队。妮娜：那我们看看他们的比赛吧！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tim minn fejn hu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tim minn fejn hu?
messages.zh: 这支球队来自哪里？
messages.en: Where is this team from?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu tim Serb.
messages.mt_standard: Hu tim Serb.
messages.zh: 是支塞尔维亚球队。
messages.en: It's a Serbian team.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja narawh jilgħab!
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja narawh jilgħab!
messages.zh: 那我们看看他们的比赛吧！
messages.en: Then let's watch them play!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 tim Serb“塞尔维亚球队”记忆：把 Serb 当成贴在球队名词后面的国别标签，帮助记住这里是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A board that a person stands or lies on to ride waves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 冲浪时供人站立或俯卧、借海浪滑行的板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bord li persuna toqgħod fuqu bilwieqfa jew mimduda biex tirkeb il-mewġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冲浪板；供冲浪者站立或俯卧并随浪滑行的板。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bord użat għas-surfing, li fuqu persuna tirkeb il-mewġ bilwieqfa jew mimduda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A surfboard is a board used to ride waves while standing or lying on it.

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant jista' jikri serfbord għal-lezzjoni tas-surfing.
formal.en: Each participant can rent a surfboard for the surfing lesson.
formal.zh: 每位参加者都可以为冲浪课租用一块冲浪板。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn ħallejt is-serfbord? Ben: Ħdejn il-karozza. Tgħinni nġorru sal-bajja? Sara: Iva, żgur!
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you leave the surfboard? Ben: By the car. Can you help me carry it to the beach? Sara: Yes, of course!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你把冲浪板放在哪里了？本：车旁边。你能帮我把它搬到海滩吗？萨拉：当然可以！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn ħallejt is-serfbord?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn ħallejt is-serfbord?
messages.zh: 你把冲浪板放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you leave the surfboard?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-karozza. Tgħinni nġorru sal-bajja?
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-karozza. Tgħinni nġorru sal-bajja?
messages.zh: 车旁边。你能帮我把它搬到海滩吗？
messages.en: By the car. Can you help me carry it to the beach?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żgur!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żgur!
messages.zh: 当然可以！
messages.en: Yes, of course!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serfbord 和英语 surfboard 并排写在画有海浪的词卡上，再想象自己抱着冲浪板走向海滩，结合拼写和画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who rides ocean waves on a surfboard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 站在冲浪板上，借助海浪滑行的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tuża bord tas-surf biex tirkeb il-mewġ tal-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用冲浪板在海浪上滑行的人；冲浪者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Serfer huwa persuna li tirkeb il-mewġ fuq bord tas-surf, bħala passatemp jew sport.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A surfer is someone who rides waves on a surfboard for enjoyment or sport.

collocations.en: a surfer starts riding a wave
collocations.zh: 一名冲浪者开始踏浪滑行

formal.mt: Is-serfer għandu jiċċekkja l-kundizzjonijiet tal-baħar qabel jidħol fl-ilma.
formal.en: The surfer should check the sea conditions before entering the water.
formal.zh: 冲浪者应在下水前检查海况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak is-serfer! Kemm qed iżomm il-bilanċ tajjeb! Pawlu: Iva, ilu snin jipprattika.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that surfer! He is keeping his balance so well! Pawlu: Yes, he has been practising for years.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那位冲浪者！他的平衡保持得真好！保罗：是啊，他已经练了好多年。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak is-serfer! Kemm qed iżomm il-bilanċ tajjeb!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak is-serfer! Kemm qed iżomm il-bilanċ tajjeb!
messages.zh: 看那位冲浪者！他的平衡保持得真好！
messages.en: Look at that surfer! He is keeping his balance so well!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilu snin jipprattika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilu snin jipprattika.
messages.zh: 是啊，他已经练了好多年。
messages.en: Yes, he has been practising for years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serfer 和英语 surfer 配对记忆，再想象一个人站在冲浪板上踏浪前进，记住它指冲浪的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of comfort or ease when worry, pain, or tension becomes less intense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 担忧、疼痛或紧张减轻时产生的安心、轻松或宽慰感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' kumdità jew kalma li wieħed iħoss meta jonqsu l-inkwiet, l-uġigħ jew it-tensjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 担忧或不适减轻后的宽慰、安心或如释重负的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' serħan li fih persuna tħossha aktar kalma għax ikun naqas jew għadda dak li kien qed jinkwetaha jew iweġġagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Relief is the feeling of comfort you experience when something worrying or painful becomes less severe or ends.

formal.mt: Il-konferma li l-passiġġieri kollha kienu salvati ġabet sens ta' serħan lill-familji tagħhom.
formal.en: Confirmation that all the passengers had been rescued brought their families a feeling of relief.
formal.zh: 所有乘客均已获救的确认消息，让他们的家人感到宽慰。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sibt iċ-ċwievet! Kienu fil-but tal-ġakketta. Mark: X'serħan! Kont qed naħseb li tlifniehom.
colloquial.en: Lara: I found the keys! They were in the jacket pocket. Mark: What a relief! I thought we had lost them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我找到钥匙了！就在夹克口袋里。马克：总算松了口气！我还以为我们把钥匙弄丢了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt iċ-ċwievet! Kienu fil-but tal-ġakketta.
messages.mt_standard: Sibt iċ-ċwievet! Kienu fil-but tal-ġakketta.
messages.zh: 我找到钥匙了！就在夹克口袋里。
messages.en: I found the keys! They were in the jacket pocket.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'serħan! Kont qed naħseb li tlifniehom.
messages.mt_standard: X'serħan! Kont qed naħseb li tlifniehom.
messages.zh: 总算松了口气！我还以为我们把钥匙弄丢了。
messages.en: What a relief! I thought we had lost them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象丢失的钥匙终于找到，肩膀放松、长舒一口气；用这个画面记住条目所表达的宽慰感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of related things or events, or a television story presented in several episodes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彼此相关的一组事物或连续发生的事件，也可指分成多集播出的电视连续剧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' affarijiet jew ġrajjiet marbuta ma' xulxin, jew storja televiżiva li tinqasam f'diversi episodji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系列；由相互关联的事物、活动或事件构成的一组。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Serje hija għadd ta' affarijiet, attivitajiet jew ġrajjiet li huma marbuta ma' xulxin jew isegwu waħda wara l-oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A series is a group of related things or events that belong together or occur one after another.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电视连续剧；以多集形式逐步展开同一故事的电视节目。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Serje televiżiva hija programm li jirrakkonta storja fuq diversi episodji, bl-istorja tkompli minn episodju għall-ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A television serial is a programme whose story continues across several episodes shown on television.

formal.mt: Il-librerija se torganizza serje ta' laqgħat mal-awturi matul ix-xahar ta' Novembru.
formal.en: The library will organise a series of meetings with authors during November.
formal.zh: 图书馆将在十一月举办一系列作家见面会。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed issegwi dik is-serje l-ġdida fuq it-televiżjoni? Luqa: Iva! L-aħħar episodju spiċċa f'mument eċċitanti, u rrid inkun naf x'se jiġri wara.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you following that new television serial? Luqa: Yes! The latest episode ended at an exciting moment, and I want to know what happens next.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在追电视上那部新连续剧吗？卢卡：在追！最新一集停在了精彩的地方，我很想知道接下来会发生什么。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed issegwi dik is-serje l-ġdida fuq it-televiżjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Qed issegwi dik is-serje l-ġdida fuq it-televiżjoni?
messages.zh: 你在追电视上那部新连续剧吗？
messages.en: Are you following that new television serial?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! L-aħħar episodju spiċċa f'mument eċċitanti, u rrid inkun naf x'se jiġri wara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! L-aħħar episodju spiċċa f'mument eċċitanti, u rrid inkun naf x'se jiġri wara.
messages.zh: 在追！最新一集停在了精彩的地方，我很想知道接下来会发生什么。
messages.en: Yes! The latest episode ended at an exciting moment, and I want to know what happens next.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serje 想成一串彼此相连的珠子：会议一场接一场是系列，故事一集接一集就是连续剧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of treating a matter as important and giving it careful attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认真、严肃地对待事情的态度或特质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min jittratta kwistjoni bħala importanti u jagħtiha l-attenzjoni meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 认真或严肃的态度、性质或程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-grad ta' kemm persuna, imġiba jew sitwazzjoni tkun serja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Seriousness is the quality of being serious in your attitude, behaviour, or treatment of something.

formal.mt: Kull ilment għandu jiġi ttrattat bis-serjetà u jingħata tweġiba ċara.
formal.en: Every complaint should be treated seriously and given a clear response.
formal.zh: 每一项投诉都应得到认真处理和明确答复。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tieħu dan l-eżami bis-serjetà? Mark: Iva, qed nistudja kuljum u nagħmel l-eżerċizzji kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you taking this exam seriously? Mark: Yes, I'm studying every day and doing all the exercises.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有认真准备这次考试吗？马克：有，我每天都学习，还把所有练习都做了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tieħu dan l-eżami bis-serjetà?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tieħu dan l-eżami bis-serjetà?
messages.zh: 你有认真准备这次考试吗？
messages.en: Are you taking this exam seriously?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nistudja kuljum u nagħmel l-eżerċizzji kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nistudja kuljum u nagħmel l-eżerċizzji kollha.
messages.zh: 有，我每天都学习，还把所有练习都做了。
messages.en: Yes, I'm studying every day and doing all the exercises.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serjetà 和“认真态度”一起记，再整块记住 bis-serjetà 表示“认真地”，联想每天认真备考的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Treating something as important, or describing a matter that requires careful attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人态度认真、严肃，或事情重要、严重而需要认真对待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jittratta l-affarijiet b'attenzjoni u responsabbiltà, jew li jeħtieġ attenzjoni minħabba l-importanza jew il-gravità tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 认真的、严肃的；也指情况严重、需要重视的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jiħux l-affarijiet biċ-ċajt, jew li jkun importanti jew gravi u jkun jeħtieġ attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is serious treats things thoughtfully, while a serious matter requires careful attention because of its importance or severity.

collocations.zh: 严重的个案；需要重视的情况

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ serju li jeħtieġ investigazzjoni bir-reqqa.
formal.en: The report describes a serious case that requires a thorough investigation.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起需要深入调查的严重个案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int serju jew qed tiċċajta? Pawlu: Jien serju. Irrid nibda nistudja l-Malti kuljum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you serious or are you joking? Pawlu: I'm serious. I want to start studying Maltese every day.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你是认真的，还是在开玩笑？保罗：我是认真的。我想开始每天学习马耳他语。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int serju jew qed tiċċajta?
messages.mt_standard: Int serju jew qed tiċċajta?
messages.zh: 你是认真的，还是在开玩笑？
messages.en: Are you serious or are you joking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien serju. Irrid nibda nistudja l-Malti kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Jien serju. Irrid nibda nistudja l-Malti kuljum.
messages.zh: 我是认真的。我想开始每天学习马耳他语。
messages.en: I'm serious. I want to start studying Maltese every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 Int serju? 这句“你是认真的吗？”，再用“人认真、事情严重”两幅画面串起 serju 的常见用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kind of rock fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种岩礁鱼的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' ħuta tal-blat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种岩礁鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħuta ta' tip magħruf bħala ħut tal-blat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A serran is a kind of fish described as a rock fish.

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliem wera stampa ta' serran u kiteb ismu fuq il-bord.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher showed a picture of a rock fish and wrote its name on the board.
formal.zh: 上课时，老师展示了一张岩礁鱼的图片，并把它的名称写在黑板上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jismu dan il-ħut? Rita: Dan serran. Mark: Tista' tagħtini wieħed, jekk jogħġbok?
colloquial.en: Mark: What is this fish called? Rita: This is a serran, a kind of rock fish. Mark: Could you give me one, please?
colloquial.zh: 马克：这种鱼叫什么？丽塔：这是 serran，一种岩礁鱼。马克：请给我一条，好吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jismu dan il-ħut?
messages.mt_standard: X'jismu dan il-ħut?
messages.zh: 这种鱼叫什么？
messages.en: What is this fish called?

messages.speaker: Rita (鱼贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan serran.
messages.mt_standard: Dan serran.
messages.zh: 这是 serran，一种岩礁鱼。
messages.en: This is a serran, a kind of rock fish.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini wieħed, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini wieħed, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请给我一条，好吗？
messages.en: Could you give me one, please?

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张岩礁鱼词卡，把 serran 写在鱼旁边，再配上“鱼摊问名称”的对话，帮助记住这是鱼名。

gloss_zh: 梁状支撑构件；搁板支撑件

teaching_sense.en_definition: A beam-like structural support, including a support used for a shelf.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 起支撑作用的梁状结构构件，也可指用于支撑搁板的构件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element strutturali li jixbah travu u jservi ta' appoġġ, fost l-oħrajn biex isostni raff.

sense_translations.en_definition: beam-like structural element acting as a support
sense_translations.zh_definition: 起支撑作用的梁状结构构件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Element ta' struttura li jixbah travu u li jintuża biex isostni parti oħra tal-istruttura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A serratizz is a structural element resembling a beam that supports another part of a structure.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于支撑搁板的构件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ta' appoġġ li tintuża biex iżżomm jew issostni raff.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A serratizz can be a support used to hold a shelf in place.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jitqiegħdu l-kotba fuq ir-raff, għandu jiġi ċċekkjat li s-serratizz ikun imwaħħal sew.
formal.en: Before books are placed on the shelf, the support should be checked to ensure that it is firmly attached.
formal.zh: 将书放到搁板上之前，应检查支撑件是否安装牢固。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ir-raff qed jiċċaqlaq. Tista' tiċċekkjah? Toni: Iva, is-serratizz taħtu mhux imwaħħal sew. Sara: Mela nneħħi l-kotba qabel tibda.
colloquial.en: Sara: This shelf is moving. Can you check it? Toni: Yes, the support underneath it isn't firmly attached. Sara: Then I'll take the books off before you start.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这块搁板在晃，你能检查一下吗？托尼：可以，它下面的支撑件没固定好。萨拉：那我在你开始之前先把书拿下来。

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-raff qed jiċċaqlaq. Tista' tiċċekkjah?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-raff qed jiċċaqlaq. Tista' tiċċekkjah?
messages.zh: 这块搁板在晃，你能检查一下吗？
messages.en: This shelf is moving. Can you check it?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, is-serratizz taħtu mhux imwaħħal sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, is-serratizz taħtu mhux imwaħħal sew.
messages.zh: 可以，它下面的支撑件没固定好。
messages.en: Yes, the support underneath it isn't firmly attached.

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nneħħi l-kotba qabel tibda.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nneħħi l-kotba qabel tibda.
messages.zh: 那我在你开始之前先把书拿下来。
messages.en: Then I'll take the books off before you start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象搁板下有一根梁状构件托住书本，把 serratizz 标在支撑件上，用“托住、撑稳”的动作记忆词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A systematic investigation that collects information about a group, topic, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了解某一群体、主题或情况而有系统地收集资料的调查。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stħarriġ li jiġbor informazzjoni b'mod sistematiku dwar grupp ta' nies, suġġett jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过提问、观察或其他资料收集方式了解某一群体或情况的调查。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stħarriġ li jsir permezz ta' mistoqsijiet, osservazzjoni jew ġbir ieħor ta' informazzjoni biex tinftiehem sitwazzjoni jew il-fehma ta' grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A survey is an investigation in which information is collected to understand people's views or a particular situation.

formal.mt: L-iskola wettqet servej fost il-ġenituri biex tiġbor il-fehmiet tagħhom dwar il-ħinijiet tal-lezzjonijiet.
formal.en: The school conducted a survey among parents to gather their views on lesson times.
formal.zh: 学校在家长中开展了一项调查，以收集他们对上课时间的意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Imlejt is-servej dwar il-karozzi tal-linja? Toni: Iva, u ktibt li hemm bżonn aktar vjaġġi filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you fill in the survey about the buses? Toni: Yes, and I wrote that we need more evening services.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你填了那份关于公交车的调查问卷吗？托尼：填了，我还写了晚上需要增加班次。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Imlejt is-servej dwar il-karozzi tal-linja?
messages.mt_standard: Imlejt is-servej dwar il-karozzi tal-linja?
messages.zh: 你填了那份关于公交车的调查问卷吗？
messages.en: Did you fill in the survey about the buses?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ktibt li hemm bżonn aktar vjaġġi filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ktibt li hemm bżonn aktar vjaġġi filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 填了，我还写了晚上需要增加班次。
messages.en: Yes, and I wrote that we need more evening services.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 servej 联想成一次完整的调查活动：先收集回答，再整理结果；连记 twettaq servej（开展调查）更容易掌握用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of giving services a greater role in economic activity or in what a business offers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使服务在经济活动或企业所提供的产品与方案中发挥更大作用的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih is-servizzi jingħataw rwol akbar fl-attività ekonomika jew f'dak li toffri negozju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务化：服务投入、服务活动或服务产出在经济活动中的作用增强的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih l-użu, il-provvista jew il-produzzjoni tas-servizzi jsiru parti aktar importanti mill-attività ekonomika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Servicification is the process by which services become more important as inputs, activities, or outputs in economic activity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产品服务化：企业在产品业务中增加或整合维护、支援等服务，形成结合产品与服务的供给方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih negozju jżid jew jintegra servizzi, bħall-manutenzjoni u l-appoġġ, ma' prodotti li joffri lill-klijenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Servitization is a process in which a business develops its product offering by adding or integrating services for customers.

formal.mt: Bħala parti mill-istrateġija ta' servitizzazzjoni tagħha, il-kumpanija bdiet toffri pakkett li jinkludi l-magna, il-manutenzjoni u t-taħriġ għall-utenti.
formal.en: As part of its servitization strategy, the company began offering a package that includes the machine, maintenance, and user training.
formal.zh: 作为产品服务化战略的一部分，公司开始提供包含机器、维护和用户培训的套餐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tifhem b'servitizzazzjoni fil-każ tal-ħanut tagħna? Mark: Li mal-apparat noffru wkoll l-installazzjoni u l-manutenzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you mean by servitization in our shop's case? Mark: Offering installation and maintenance along with the equipment.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：对我们店来说，你说的产品服务化是什么意思？马克：就是除了设备，我们还提供安装和维护。

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tifhem b'servitizzazzjoni fil-każ tal-ħanut tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: X'tifhem b'servitizzazzjoni fil-każ tal-ħanut tagħna?
messages.zh: 对我们店来说，你说的产品服务化是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by servitization in our shop's case?

messages.speaker: Mark (店长)
messages.mt_spoken: Li mal-apparat noffru wkoll l-installazzjoni u l-manutenzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Li mal-apparat noffru wkoll l-installazzjoni u l-manutenzjoni.
messages.zh: 就是除了设备，我们还提供安装和维护。
messages.en: Offering installation and maintenance along with the equipment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景区分记忆：经济活动中服务的作用增加，对应 servicification；卖机器时加入维护与培训，对应 servitization。

gloss_zh: 未经请求而提供的服务

teaching_sense.en_definition: A service offered or provided without the recipient having requested it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在接受者没有提出请求的情况下，被主动提出或提供的服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Servizz offrut jew mogħti lil persuna mingħajr ma dik il-persuna tkun talbitu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接受者未曾请求，却被主动提出或提供的服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizz li jiġi offrut jew ipprovdut lil xi ħadd għalkemm ma jkunx talab għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An unsolicited service is offered or provided to someone who has not asked for it.

collocations.zh: 接受未经请求而提供的服务
拒绝未经请求而提供的服务

formal.mt: Fl-ilment tagħha, il-klijenta spjegat li l-ħlas kien għal servizz mhux mitlub.
formal.en: In her complaint, the customer explained that the charge was for an unsolicited service.
formal.zh: 这位客户在投诉中说明，该笔费用对应的是一项她未曾请求的服务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fuq il-kont hemm ħlas għal servizz li qatt ma tlabt. Pawlu: Ċempel lill-kumpanija u għidilhom li dan huwa servizz mhux mitlub. Lara: Iva, se nitlobhom jispjegaw il-ħlas.
colloquial.en: Lara: There's a charge on the bill for a service I never requested. Pawlu: Call the company and tell them this is an unsolicited service. Lara: Yes, I'll ask them to explain the charge.
colloquial.zh: Lara：账单上有一项服务费，可我从没要求过那项服务。Pawlu：打电话给公司，告诉他们这是未经请求而提供的服务。Lara：对，我会请他们解释这笔收费。

messages.speaker: Lara (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-kont hemm ħlas għal servizz li qatt ma tlabt.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-kont hemm ħlas għal servizz li qatt ma tlabt.
messages.zh: 账单上有一项服务费，可我从没要求过那项服务。
messages.en: There's a charge on the bill for a service I never requested.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempel lill-kumpanija u għidilhom li dan huwa servizz mhux mitlub.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempel lill-kumpanija u għidilhom li dan huwa servizz mhux mitlub.
messages.zh: 打电话给公司，告诉他们这是未经请求而提供的服务。
messages.en: Call the company and tell them this is an unsolicited service.

messages.speaker: Lara (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nitlobhom jispjegaw il-ħlas.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nitlobhom jispjegaw il-ħlas.
messages.zh: 对，我会请他们解释这笔收费。
messages.en: Yes, I'll ask them to explain the charge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语配上“我没要求，服务却来了”的画面；重点记住没有提出请求，不要误记成免费服务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A service that people access or use through the internet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们通过互联网访问或使用的服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Servizz li n-nies jaċċessaw jew jużaw permezz tal-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过互联网向用户提供、供用户访问或使用的服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizz disponibbli fuq l-internet li jippermetti lill-utenti jiksbu għajnuna jew jagħmlu xi ħaġa permezz ta' sit jew applikazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An online service allows people to obtain help or carry out tasks through the internet.

collocations.zh: 在线服务的访问权限或使用途径

formal.mt: L-utenti jistgħu jużaw is-servizz online biex jibagħtu l-applikazzjoni u jsegwu l-progress tagħha.
formal.en: Users can use the online service to submit their application and track its progress.
formal.zh: 用户可以通过在线服务提交申请，并跟踪申请的办理进度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irrid immur l-uffiċċju biex inġedded l-abbonament? Ben: Le, tista' tuża s-servizz online minn darek. Maja: Mela se nagħmel hekk illejla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do I have to go to the office to renew the subscription? Ben: No, you can use the online service from home. Maja: Then I'll do that this evening.
colloquial.zh: Maja：续订一定要去办公室吗？Ben：不用，你在家就能使用在线服务。Maja：那我今晚就这样办。

messages.speaker: Maja (订阅用户)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid immur l-uffiċċju biex inġedded l-abbonament?
messages.mt_standard: Irrid immur l-uffiċċju biex inġedded l-abbonament?
messages.zh: 续订一定要去办公室吗？
messages.en: Do I have to go to the office to renew the subscription?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tista' tuża s-servizz online minn darek.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tista' tuża s-servizz online minn darek.
messages.zh: 不用，你在家就能使用在线服务。
messages.en: No, you can use the online service from home.

messages.speaker: Maja (订阅用户)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela se nagħmel hekk illejla.
messages.mt_standard: Mela se nagħmel hekk illejla.
messages.zh: 那我今晚就这样办。
messages.en: Then I'll do that this evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把服务窗口搬到电脑屏幕上：看到 servizz online，就联想到通过互联网办理或使用服务。

gloss_zh: 定期海上运输服务；定期航运服务

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sea transport service that operates repeatedly according to an established schedule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照既定班期反复运营、通过海路运送货物或乘客的服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Servizz ta' trasport bil-baħar li jġorr merkanzija jew passiġġieri u jopera ripetutament skont skeda stabbilita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按照固定或既定班期运营的海上运输服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizz li jittrasporta merkanzija jew passiġġieri bil-baħar bejn portijiet skont skeda regolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A regular shipping service carries goods or passengers by sea on a recurring, established schedule.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se topera servizz regolari tat-trasport marittimu bejn iż-żewġ portijiet, bi tliet vjaġġi fil-ġimgħa.
formal.en: The company will operate a regular shipping service between the two ports, with three sailings a week.
formal.zh: 该公司将运营连接这两个港口的定期航运服务，每周安排三个航次。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hemm servizz regolari tat-trasport marittimu għal dawn il-kaxxi? Rita: Iva, il-vapur jitlaq kull nhar ta' Tlieta. Mark: Sewwa, allura nippreparahom sa nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is there a regular shipping service for these boxes? Rita: Yes, the ship leaves every Tuesday. Mark: Good, then I'll have them ready by Monday.
colloquial.zh: Mark：有可以运这些箱子的定期航运服务吗？Rita：有，船每周二出发。Mark：好的，那我会在周一之前把箱子准备好。

messages.speaker: Mark (发货客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm servizz regolari tat-trasport marittimu għal dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm servizz regolari tat-trasport marittimu għal dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 有可以运这些箱子的定期航运服务吗？
messages.en: Is there a regular shipping service for these boxes?

messages.speaker: Rita (航运公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-vapur jitlaq kull nhar ta' Tlieta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-vapur jitlaq kull nhar ta' Tlieta.
messages.zh: 有，船每周二出发。
messages.en: Yes, the ship leaves every Tuesday.

messages.speaker: Mark (发货客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, allura nippreparahom sa nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, allura nippreparahom sa nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.zh: 好的，那我会在周一之前把箱子准备好。
messages.en: Good, then I'll have them ready by Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“服务＋定期＋海上运输”分块记忆，再想象日历上每周固定出现一艘船，把整个短语对应到定期航运。

gloss_zh: 平衡服务；平衡调整服务

teaching_sense.en_definition: A service that checks or adjusts something to achieve or maintain balance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过检查或调整，使某个对象或系统达到或保持平衡的服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Servizz li jiċċekkja jew jaġġusta xi ħaġa sabiex jintlaħaq jew jinżamm bilanċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旨在使某个对象或系统达到或维持平衡的检查与调整服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizz li jipprovdi l-kontrolli jew l-aġġustamenti meħtieġa biex xi ħaġa tilħaq jew iżżomm bilanċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A balancing service provides checks or adjustments that help something achieve or maintain balance.

collocations.en: a provider of a balancing service

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija talbet servizz ta' bbilanċjar biex jinżamm bilanċ bejn il-partijiet tas-sistema.
formal.en: The company requested a balancing service to maintain balance between the parts of the system.
formal.zh: 公司申请了平衡调整服务，以维持系统各部分之间的平衡。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom servizz ta' bbilanċjar? Rita: Iva, nistgħu niċċekkjaw is-sistema u nagħmlu l-aġġustamenti meħtieġa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you offer a balancing service? Rita: Yes, we can check the system and make the necessary adjustments.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们提供平衡调整服务吗？丽塔：提供，我们可以检查系统并进行必要的调整。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom servizz ta' bbilanċjar?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom servizz ta' bbilanċjar?
messages.zh: 你们提供平衡调整服务吗？
messages.en: Do you offer a balancing service?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu niċċekkjaw is-sistema u nagħmlu l-aġġustamenti meħtieġa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu niċċekkjaw is-sistema u nagħmlu l-aġġustamenti meħtieġa.
messages.zh: 提供，我们可以检查系统并进行必要的调整。
messages.en: Yes, we can check the system and make the necessary adjustments.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成一张服务单：工作人员先检查，再调整，让原本失衡的对象恢复平衡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A service that allows people to take part in gambling over the internet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过互联网让用户参与赌博活动的服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Servizz li jippermetti lin-nies jieħdu sehem fil-logħob tal-azzard permezz tal-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过互联网提供赌博活动参与渠道的服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizz offrut fuq l-internet li permezz tiegħu l-utenti jistgħu jieħdu sehem fil-logħob tal-azzard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An online gambling service enables people to participate in gambling activities through the internet.

collocations.mt: fornitur ta' servizz tal-logħob tal-azzard onlajn
collocations.en: a provider of an online gambling service

collocations.mt: aċċess għal servizz tal-logħob tal-azzard onlajn
collocations.en: access to an online gambling service
collocations.zh: 在线赌博服务的访问权限

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif jaħdem is-servizz tal-logħob tal-azzard onlajn u liema informazzjoni tingħata lill-utenti.
formal.en: The report describes how the online gambling service works and what information is provided to users.
formal.zh: 报告说明了该在线赌博服务的运作方式，以及向用户提供哪些信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan is-sit ibigħ il-logħob tal-kompjuter? Pawlu: Le, joffri servizz tal-logħob tal-azzard onlajn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this website sell computer games? Pawlu: No, it offers an online gambling service.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个网站卖电脑游戏吗？保罗：不，它提供在线赌博服务。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-sit ibigħ il-logħob tal-kompjuter?
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-sit ibigħ il-logħob tal-kompjuter?
messages.zh: 这个网站卖电脑游戏吗？
messages.en: Does this website sell computer games?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, joffri servizz tal-logħob tal-azzard onlajn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, joffri servizz tal-logħob tal-azzard onlajn.
messages.zh: 不，它提供在线赌博服务。
messages.en: No, it offers an online gambling service.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意思分块记成“服务＋赌博活动＋在线”；联想浏览器里的赌博平台，避免误记成普通电子游戏服务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Services provided by people with specialized professional knowledge, skills, or training.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由具备专门职业知识、技能或训练的人提供的服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Servizzi mogħtija minn persuni li għandhom għarfien, ħiliet jew taħriġ speċjalizzat f'qasam professjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 运用专门职业知识和技能提供的服务，例如会计、法律咨询或工程咨询服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizzi li jużaw għarfien u ħiliet speċjalizzati, bħall-kontabbiltà, il-pariri legali jew il-konsulenza fl-inġinerija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Professional services are services supplied by people who use specialized knowledge and skills, such as accountants, lawyers, or engineering consultants.

formal.mt: Id-ditta tipprovdi servizzi professjonali fil-kontabbiltà u tgħin lin-negozji jħejju r-rapporti finanzjarji tagħhom.
formal.en: The firm provides professional accounting services and helps businesses prepare their financial reports.
formal.zh: 该公司提供专业会计服务，帮助企业编制财务报告。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tirrakkomandali ditta li toffri servizzi professjonali fil-kontabbiltà? Pawlu: Iva, nagħtik in-numru tal-accountant tagħna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you recommend a firm that offers professional accounting services? Pawlu: Yes, I'll give you our accountant's number.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你能推荐一家提供专业会计服务的公司吗？保罗：可以，我把我们会计师的电话号码给你。

messages.speaker: Nina (小企业主)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tirrakkomandali ditta li toffri servizzi professjonali fil-kontabbiltà?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tirrakkomandali ditta li toffri servizzi professjonali fil-kontabbiltà?
messages.zh: 你能推荐一家提供专业会计服务的公司吗？
messages.en: Can you recommend a firm that offers professional accounting services?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nagħtik in-numru tal-accountant tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nagħtik in-numru tal-accountant tagħna.
messages.zh: 可以，我把我们会计师的电话号码给你。
messages.en: Yes, I'll give you our accountant's number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把账目交给会计师、把合同交给律师：靠专门知识提供的这些服务，就是 servizi professjonali，整组记作“专业服务”。

gloss_zh: 一般经济利益服务；具有普遍经济利益的服务

teaching_sense.en_definition: Economic services that public authorities regard as serving the general interest and subject to specific public service obligations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公共机关认定为服务于公众整体利益，并对其规定特定公共服务义务的经济性服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Servizzi ta' natura ekonomika li l-awtoritajiet pubbliċi jqisu li jaqdu l-interess ġenerali u li għalihom jistabbilixxu obbligi speċifiċi ta' servizz pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有经济性质、被公共机关认定为符合公众整体利益，并承担特定公共服务义务的服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizzi ekonomiċi li l-awtoritajiet pubbliċi jidentifikaw bħala importanti għall-interess ġenerali u li jkunu suġġetti għal obbligi speċifiċi ta' servizz pubbliku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Services of general economic interest are economic services that public authorities identify as serving the public interest and make subject to specific public service obligations.

collocations.mt: il-provvista ta' servizzi ta' interess ekonomiku ġenerali
collocations.en: the provision of services of general economic interest
collocations.zh: 一般经济利益服务的提供

collocations.mt: il-finanzjament tas-servizzi ta' interess ekonomiku ġenerali
collocations.en: the funding of services of general economic interest
collocations.zh: 一般经济利益服务的资金支持

collocations.mt: il-kwalità tas-servizzi ta' interess ekonomiku ġenerali
collocations.en: the quality of services of general economic interest
collocations.zh: 一般经济利益服务的质量

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-provvista ta' servizzi ta' interess ekonomiku ġenerali u l-obbligi ta' servizz pubbliku marbuta magħhom.
formal.en: The report examines the provision of services of general economic interest and the public service obligations associated with them.
formal.zh: 报告研究了一般经济利益服务的提供情况，以及与这些服务相关的公共服务义务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser 'servizzi ta' interess ekonomiku ġenerali' f'dan ir-rapport? David: Huma servizzi ekonomiċi li l-awtoritajiet iqisu importanti għall-pubbliku u li għalihom jistabbilixxu obbligi speċifiċi ta' servizz pubbliku.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'services of general economic interest' mean in this report? David: They are economic services that the authorities consider important for the public and for which they set specific public service obligations.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这份报告里的“一般经济利益服务”是什么意思？戴维：就是当局认为对公众很重要，并为其规定特定公共服务义务的经济性服务。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'servizzi ta' interess ekonomiku ġenerali' f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'servizzi ta' interess ekonomiku ġenerali' f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 这份报告里的“一般经济利益服务”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'services of general economic interest' mean in this report?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma servizzi ekonomiċi li l-awtoritajiet iqisu importanti għall-pubbliku u li għalihom jistabbilixxu obbligi speċifiċi ta' servizz pubbliku.
messages.mt_standard: Huma servizzi ekonomiċi li l-awtoritajiet iqisu importanti għall-pubbliku u li għalihom jistabbilixxu obbligi speċifiċi ta' servizz pubbliku.
messages.zh: 就是当局认为对公众很重要，并为其规定特定公共服务义务的经济性服务。
messages.en: They are economic services that the authorities consider important for the public and for which they set specific public service obligations.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分块记忆：servizzi 是服务，ta' 表示关联，interess ekonomiku ġenerali 是整体经济利益；再用“服务公众、承担公共服务义务”把概念串起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Services provided by an intermediary who helps parties arrange a transaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由中间人提供的服务，帮助交易双方建立联系并安排交易。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Servizzi mogħtija minn intermedjarju li jgħin lill-partijiet jagħmlu kuntatt u jorganizzaw tranżazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 帮助交易双方建立联系并促成交易的经纪或居间服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizzi li fihom intermedjarju jlaqqa' lill-partijiet interessati u jgħinhom jaslu għal ftehim dwar tranżazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Brokering services involve helping people or organizations find suitable parties and arrange transactions with them.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija toffri servizzi ta' senserija biex tgħin lill-klijenti jsibu xerrejja għall-proprjetà tagħhom.
formal.en: The company offers brokering services to help clients find buyers for their property.
formal.zh: 该公司提供经纪服务，帮助客户为其房产寻找买家。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed infittex lil xi ħadd li jgħinni nbiegħ l-appartament. Intom toffru servizzi ta' senserija? Rita: Iva, nistgħu ngħinuk issib xerrej. Mark: Tajjeb. Kemm tiswa s-senserija?
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm looking for someone to help me sell the apartment. Do you offer brokering services? Rita: Yes, we can help you find a buyer. Mark: Good. How much does the brokerage cost?
colloquial.zh: Mark：我想找人帮我卖公寓。你们提供经纪服务吗？Rita：提供，我们可以帮你找买家。Mark：好的。经纪服务要多少钱？

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed infittex lil xi ħadd li jgħinni nbiegħ l-appartament. Intom toffru servizzi ta' senserija?
messages.mt_standard: Qed infittex lil xi ħadd li jgħinni nbiegħ l-appartament. Intom toffru servizzi ta' senserija?
messages.zh: 我想找人帮我卖公寓。你们提供经纪服务吗？
messages.en: I'm looking for someone to help me sell the apartment. Do you offer brokering services?

messages.speaker: Rita (经纪人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu ngħinuk issib xerrej.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu ngħinuk issib xerrej.
messages.zh: 提供，我们可以帮你找买家。
messages.en: Yes, we can help you find a buyer.

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb. Kemm tiswa s-senserija?
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb. Kemm tiswa s-senserija?
messages.zh: 好的。经纪服务要多少钱？
messages.en: Good. How much does the brokerage cost?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买卖双方之间站着一位牵线人：把整组词与“帮助双方成交的经纪服务”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of stopping work or activity in order to relax and recover energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂时停止工作或活动，以放松身心、恢复精力的一段时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu li fih wieħed jieqaf mix-xogħol jew minn attività biex jirrilassa u jerġa' jikseb l-enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 休息；为放松或恢复体力而暂停活动的一段时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Serħa hija waqfa mix-xogħol jew minn attività li tagħti lil persuna ċans tirrilassa u tirkupra s-saħħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rest is a period when you stop working or being active so that you can relax and regain energy.

formal.mt: Wara sagħtejn ta' mixi, il-grupp waqaf għal serħa qasira qabel kompla tul il-mogħdija.
formal.en: After two hours of walking, the group stopped for a short rest before continuing along the path.
formal.zh: 步行两小时后，一行人停下来稍作休息，然后继续沿小路前进。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għajjejt. Nieħdu serħa hawn? David: Iva, noqogħdu fuq dan il-bank għal ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: I am tired. Shall we take a rest here? David: Yes, let's sit on this bench for a while.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我累了。我们在这里歇一下好吗？戴维：好，我们在这张长椅上坐一会儿。

messages.speaker: Nina (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għajjejt. Nieħdu serħa hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għajjejt. Nieħdu serħa hawn?
messages.zh: 我累了。我们在这里歇一下好吗？
messages.en: I am tired. Shall we take a rest here?

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, noqogħdu fuq dan il-bank għal ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, noqogħdu fuq dan il-bank għal ftit.
messages.zh: 好，我们在这张长椅上坐一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, let's sit on this bench for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serħa 记成徒步途中坐上长椅的那段休息时间，并整块记住 nieħu serħa，表示我歇一会儿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A round in a bidding process during which participants submit their bids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 竞价或投标过程中，供参与者提交报价的一轮活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fażi fi proċess ta' offerti li matulha l-parteċipanti jippreżentaw l-offerti tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 竞价或投标程序中，参与者提交报价的一个轮次。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sessjoni fi proċess ta' kompetizzjoni bejn offerenti, li matulha jiġu ppreżentati l-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bidding round is a stage in a bidding process during which participants submit their offers.

collocations.en: to participate in a bidding round

formal.mt: Is-sessjoni ta' offerti tibda fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu, u l-parteċipanti għandhom jippreżentaw l-offerti tagħhom qabel nofsinhar.
formal.en: The bidding round begins at ten in the morning, and participants must submit their bids before noon.
formal.zh: 本轮竞价于上午十点开始，参与者须在中午之前提交报价。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta tibda s-sessjoni ta' offerti? Mark: Fl-għaxra. Għad għandna ħin niċċekkjaw l-offerta tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: When does the bidding round start? Mark: At ten. We still have time to check our bid.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这轮竞价什么时候开始？马克：十点。我们还有时间检查一下我们的报价。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tibda s-sessjoni ta' offerti?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tibda s-sessjoni ta' offerti?
messages.zh: 这轮竞价什么时候开始？
messages.en: When does the bidding round start?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-għaxra. Għad għandna ħin niċċekkjaw l-offerta tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-għaxra. Għad għandna ħin niċċekkjaw l-offerta tagħna.
messages.zh: 十点。我们还有时间检查一下我们的报价。
messages.en: At ten. We still have time to check our bid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象竞价按轮次进行：每到一轮，大家各交一份报价；把整个短语与“一轮提交报价”一起记。

gloss_zh: “与……对照；与……对立”这一英语表达

teaching_sense.en_definition: The English expression 'set against', referring to contrast or opposition between things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 此处作为词条名称收录的英语表达，表示把事物置于对照或对立关系中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-espressjoni Ingliża 'set against', meħuda hawn bħala isem ta' espressjoni, tindika kuntrast jew oppożizzjoni bejn affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英语表达“set against”的名称，涉及将事物相互对照或置于对立关系中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem tal-espressjoni Ingliża 'set against', li tintuża biex tindika li ħaġa titqiegħed f'kuntrast ma' oħra jew f'oppożizzjoni għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The expression 'set against' describes a relationship in which one thing is contrasted with or opposed to another.

collocations.en: an example of the use of 'set against'

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tal-espressjoni Ingliża 'set against', l-istudenti għandhom jidentifikaw iż-żewġ elementi li jitqiegħdu f'kuntrast jew f'oppożizzjoni.
formal.en: When analysing the English expression 'set against', students should identify the two elements placed in contrast or opposition.
formal.zh: 分析英语表达“set against”时，学生应找出被置于对照或对立关系中的两个要素。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'set against' hawn? Pawlu: Hawn tindika kuntrast bejn iż-żewġ ideat.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'set against' mean here? Pawlu: Here it indicates a contrast between the two ideas.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“set against”在这里是什么意思？保罗：这里表示两个想法之间的对照。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'set against' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'set against' hawn?
messages.zh: “set against”在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'set against' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tindika kuntrast bejn iż-żewġ ideat.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tindika kuntrast bejn iż-żewġ ideat.
messages.zh: 这里表示两个想法之间的对照。
messages.en: Here it indicates a contrast between the two ideas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个观点想成并排摆放的卡片，观察它们的差异或冲突；本条按表达名称记忆，保留所给名词标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A line of verse consisting of seven syllables.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由七个音节构成的一个诗行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vers magħmul minn seba' sillabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由七个音节组成的诗行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Settenarju huwa vers li jkun fih seba' sillabi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A settenarju is a line of poetry that contains seven syllables.

collocations.en: write a seven-syllable line of verse
count the syllables in a seven-syllable line
collocations.zh: 数一个七音节诗行中的音节

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jiktbu settenarju u jindikaw is-seba' sillabi tiegħu.
formal.en: In this exercise, students must write a seven-syllable line of verse and identify its seven syllables.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生须写一个七音节诗行，并标出其中的七个音节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-vers huwa settenarju? Pawlu: Ejja ngħoddu s-sillabi. Jekk għandu sebgħa, iva.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a seven-syllable line? Pawlu: Let's count the syllables. If it has seven, yes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一行是七音节诗行吗？保罗：我们数数音节。如果有七个，那就是。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-vers huwa settenarju?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-vers huwa settenarju?
messages.zh: 这一行是七音节诗行吗？
messages.en: Is this a seven-syllable line?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja ngħoddu s-sillabi. Jekk għandu sebgħa, iva.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja ngħoddu s-sillabi. Jekk għandu sebgħa, iva.
messages.zh: 我们数数音节。如果有七个，那就是。
messages.en: Let's count the syllables. If it has seven, yes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一行诗下面画着七个音节小格：settenarju 记的是七个音节，不是七个单词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The industry concerned with selling goods directly to consumers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以直接向消费者销售商品为主要活动的行业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-settur ekonomiku li fih jinbiegħu prodotti direttament lill-konsumaturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直接向消费者销售商品的零售行业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-settur tal-bejgħ bl-imnut huwa l-qasam tal-ekonomija li jinvolvi l-bejgħ ta' prodotti direttament lill-konsumaturi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The retail industry consists of businesses that sell goods directly to consumers.

collocations.en: the growth of the retail industry

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-impjiegi fis-settur tal-bejgħ bl-imnut u l-ħtiġijiet tat-taħriġ tal-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The report examines employment in the retail industry and workers' training needs.
formal.zh: 该报告考察零售行业的就业情况及从业人员的培训需求。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F'liema settur taħdem? Mark: Naħdem fis-settur tal-bejgħ bl-imnut, f'ħanut tal-ħwejjeġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which industry do you work in? Mark: I work in retail, in a clothes shop.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在哪个行业工作？马克：我在零售业工作，在一家服装店。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'liema settur taħdem?
messages.mt_standard: F'liema settur taħdem?
messages.zh: 你在哪个行业工作？
messages.en: Which industry do you work in?

messages.speaker: Mark (零售从业者)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħdem fis-settur tal-bejgħ bl-imnut, f'ħanut tal-ħwejjeġ.
messages.mt_standard: Naħdem fis-settur tal-bejgħ bl-imnut, f'ħanut tal-ħwejjeġ.
messages.zh: 我在零售业工作，在一家服装店。
messages.en: I work in retail, in a clothes shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上服装店收银台的画面：顾客直接买走商品，由这个场景记住“零售行业”。

gloss_zh: 严格的；不灵活的；严苛的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strict in enforcing rules, inflexible in approach, or demanding in requirements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指执行规则严格、处理方式不灵活，或所设要求严苛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitlob osservanza stretta tar-regoli, ma jurix flessibbiltà fl-approċċ tiegħu, jew jimponi rekwiżiti diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严格的；要求他人认真遵守规则或标准的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsisti li r-regoli u l-istandards jiġu osservati bir-reqqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is strict expects people to obey rules and meet established standards.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不灵活的；在规则、做法或立场上不易通融的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jurix flessibbiltà u ma jaċċettax faċilment tibdil jew eċċezzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rigid approach allows little flexibility or adjustment to different circumstances.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严苛的；规定或要求严格而难以满足的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jimponi kundizzjonijiet jew rekwiżiti stretti li diffiċli jiġu ssodisfati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Stringent requirements impose demanding conditions that must be satisfied carefully.

collocations.zh: 一种不灵活的处理方式

formal.mt: Il-kumitat jirrakkomanda kontroll sever tal-kwalità qabel ma l-prodotti jitqiegħdu għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: The committee recommends stringent quality control before the products are put on sale.
formal.zh: 委员会建议在产品上市销售前实施严格的质量管控。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-għalliem il-ġdid huwa sever? Ben: Iva, irid li kulħadd jasal fil-ħin u jagħmel ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the new teacher strict? Ben: Yes, he wants everyone to arrive on time and do the work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新老师严格吗？本：严格，他要求每个人准时到，并完成作业。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem il-ġdid huwa sever?
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem il-ġdid huwa sever?
messages.zh: 新老师严格吗？
messages.en: Is the new teacher strict?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irid li kulħadd jasal fil-ħin u jagħmel ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irid li kulħadd jasal fil-ħin u jagħmel ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 严格，他要求每个人准时到，并完成作业。
messages.en: Yes, he wants everyone to arrive on time and do the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景区分 sever：老师要求守规矩是“严格”，做法不通融是“不灵活”，审核条件难满足是“严苛”。

gloss_zh: 对应 Suxrobbek 的形容词；具体含义未注明

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective supplied with the equivalent Suxrobbek, whose specific meaning is not stated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给对应项为 Suxrobbek 的形容词；材料未说明其具体描述含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li fil-materjal mogħti għandu l-ekwivalenti Suxrobbek, iżda t-tifsira speċifika tiegħu mhijiex spjegata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Suxrobbek（所给形容词对应项；具体语义未注明）。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sevganmsanu huwa aġġettiv mogħti bl-ekwivalenti Suxrobbek, mingħajr spjegazzjoni tat-tifsira speċifika tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sevganmsanu is supplied as an adjective corresponding to Suxrobbek, but its specific meaning is not explained.

formal.mt: Fil-materjal mogħti, l-aġġettiv Sevganmsanu għandu l-ekwivalenti Suxrobbek, iżda ma tingħatax definizzjoni li tiċċara t-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: In the supplied material, the adjective Sevganmsanu has the equivalent Suxrobbek, but no definition is provided to clarify its meaning.
formal.zh: 在所给材料中，形容词 Sevganmsanu 的对应项为 Suxrobbek，但材料未提供可说明其含义的定义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser Sevganmsanu? Pawlu: Hawn insibu biss Suxrobbek bħala ekwivalenti. It-tifsira mhijiex spjegata.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does Sevganmsanu mean? Pawlu: Here we only have Suxrobbek as an equivalent. The meaning is not explained.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：Sevganmsanu 是什么意思？保罗：这里仅给出对应项 Suxrobbek，没有解释具体含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser Sevganmsanu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser Sevganmsanu?
messages.zh: Sevganmsanu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Sevganmsanu mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who becomes angry easily and may react without thinking calmly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易动怒、可能因一时冲动而作出反应的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirrabja malajr u li tista' tirreaġixxi bla ma taħseb bil-kalma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易因愤怒而冲动行事的人；脾气火爆的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tisħon malajr u taġixxi b'għaġla minħabba r-rabja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you call someone a hothead, you mean that they become angry quickly and may act impulsively.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 很容易被激怒的人；动不动就生气的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tirrabja faċilment, anki minħabba affarijiet żgħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person described this way becomes angry easily, sometimes over relatively minor things.

collocations.mt: sfiċċus li jirrabja għal kull ħaġa
collocations.en: a hothead who gets angry at everything
collocations.zh: 什么事都能惹他生气的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru ewlieni huwa sfiċċus li jirrabja malajr u spiss jitkellem qabel jaħseb.
formal.en: In the story, the main character is a hothead who becomes angry quickly and often speaks before thinking.
formal.zh: 故事中的主人公脾气火爆，很容易发怒，而且经常不加思考就开口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex beda jgħajjat Mark? Pawlu: Hu sfiċċus; biżżejjed xi ħaġa żgħira biex jirrabja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark start shouting? Pawlu: He's a hothead; even a small thing can make him angry.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么喊起来了？保罗：他脾气火爆，一点小事就能让他生气。

messages.zh: 他脾气火爆，一点小事就能让他生气。
messages.en: He's a hothead; even a small thing can make him angry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sfiċċus 联想成一点就着的火爆人物；这是指人的名词，记住“容易发怒的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate that an event or situation is unfortunate or disappointing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某件事令人遗憾或不如人意，相当于“不幸的是”或“遗憾的是”；所给资料未指定词性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex turi li ġrajja jew sitwazzjoni hija ta' sfortuna jew ta' diżappunt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不幸的是；遗憾的是；用于引出令人失望或不如意的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tintuża meta wieħed irid jgħid li xi ħaġa ġrat b'mod li jġib sfortuna jew diżappunt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this word to introduce a situation that you regard as unfortunate or disappointing.

formal.mt: Sfortunament, il-laqgħa ġiet posposta minħabba problema teknika.
formal.en: Unfortunately, the meeting was postponed because of a technical problem.
formal.zh: 遗憾的是，会议因技术问题而延期了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tiġi magħna llejla? Pawlu: Sfortunament ma nistax; għandi x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you coming with us tonight? Pawlu: Unfortunately, I can't; I have to work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今晚和我们一起去吗？保罗：遗憾的是，我去不了，得工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tiġi magħna llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Se tiġi magħna llejla?

messages.en: Are you coming with us tonight?

messages.en: Unfortunately, I can't; I have to work.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to express regret about an unfortunate or disappointing fact or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于对不幸或令人失望的事实、事件表示遗憾的副词，相当于“不幸的是”或“可惜”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avverbju li jintuża biex jesprimi dispjaċir dwar fatt jew ġrajja ta' sfortuna jew ta' diżappunt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不幸的是；遗憾的是；可惜；用于表达对某种不如意情况的遗憾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avverbju li bih wieħed juri li jqis fatt jew sitwazzjoni bħala ħaġa ta' sfortuna jew ta' diżappunt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this adverb to express regret when reporting an unfortunate fact or a disappointing event.

collocations.en: unfortunately, there is no time left
collocations.zh: 遗憾的是，已经没有时间了
遗憾的是，我们不得不取消

formal.mt: Sfortunatament, ma baqax ħin biżżejjed biex il-kumitat jiddiskuti l-proposti kollha.
formal.en: Unfortunately, there is not enough time left for the committee to discuss all the proposals.
formal.zh: 遗憾的是，剩余时间不足以让委员会讨论所有提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sibt xi biljetti għall-kunċert? Pawlu: Sfortunatament le; inbiegħu kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you get any tickets for the concert? Pawlu: Unfortunately, no; they all sold out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你买到音乐会的票了吗？保罗：可惜没有，全卖完了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun presented in this entry as referring to balls, or round objects used in games.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条中指球或游戏中使用的圆形物体的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li f'din l-entrata jirreferi għal blalen, jiġifieri oġġetti tondi li jintużaw fil-logħob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 球；用于游戏等活动的圆形物体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti tondi li jistgħu jintużaw f'logħob jew f'attivitajiet sportivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this entry, the word refers to round objects that people use in games.

formal.mt: F'din l-entrata, il-kelma 'sfortutunatament' hija ppreżentata bħala nom bit-tifsira ta' blalen.
formal.en: In this entry, the word 'sfortutunatament' is presented as a noun meaning balls.
formal.zh: 在本词条中，“sfortutunatament”被列为名词，意思是球。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Uncontrolled or unrestricted, especially when describing a strong desire, emotion, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容欲望、情绪或活动不受约束、缺乏节制的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma tkunx ikkontrollata jew imrażżna, speċjalment meta tirreferi għal xewqa, emozzjoni jew attività qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不受控制或约束的；肆意发展的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li titħalla tiżviluppa jew tiġi espressa mingħajr kontroll jew trażżin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a desire, emotion, or activity is unbridled, it is allowed to develop without restraint.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iwissi li l-kompetizzjoni sfrenata tista' twassal biex il-kumpaniji jittraskuraw il-kwalità.
formal.en: The report warns that unbridled competition can lead companies to neglect quality.
formal.zh: 报告警告，无节制的竞争可能导致企业忽视质量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex irid jirbaħ kull darba? Lara: Għandu ambizzjoni sfrenata; anki logħba bejn il-ħbieb jeħodha bis-serjetà.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does he want to win every time? Lara: He has unbridled ambition; he takes even a game among friends seriously.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他为什么每次都想赢？Lara：他的好胜心毫无节制，连朋友之间的游戏都很认真。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex irid jirbaħ kull darba?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex irid jirbaħ kull darba?
messages.zh: 他为什么每次都想赢？
messages.en: Why does he want to win every time?

messages.mt_standard: Għandu ambizzjoni sfrenata; anki logħba bejn il-ħbieb jeħodha bis-serjetà.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to obtain a benefit, especially when a person is treated unfairly for someone else's advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容被用于获取利益的；用于人时，尤其指为了他人的利益而受到不公平利用或剥削的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex jinkiseb vantaġġ, speċjalment meta persuna tiġi ttrattata b'mod inġust għall-benefiċċju ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被利用以获取利益的；涉及人时可指受到剥削的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun intuża biex jinkiseb xi benefiċċju, jew li jkun ġie ttrattat b'mod inġust biex ħaddieħor jiggwadanja minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is exploited is used for another person's advantage, often in an unfair way.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-każ ta' ħaddiem sfruttat li kien jaħdem sigħat twal għal paga baxxa ħafna.
formal.en: The report describes the case of an exploited worker who worked long hours for very low pay.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一名受剥削工人的情况：他工作时间很长，工资却非常低。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dejjem jagħtuni aktar xogħol, iżda l-paga tibqa' l-istess. Lara: Qed tħossok sfruttat? Mark: Iva, irrid nitkellem mal-maniġer.
colloquial.en: Mark: They keep giving me more work, but my pay stays the same. Lara: Are you feeling exploited? Mark: Yes, I want to speak to the manager.
colloquial.zh: Mark：他们总给我加工作，工资却一直不变。Lara：你觉得自己被剥削了吗？Mark：是的，我想跟经理谈谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not sharply focused, so that the details of an image or object appear blurred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容未准确对焦，因而影像或物体的细节显得模糊不清的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx iffokat sew, b'tali mod li d-dettalji ta' xbieha jew ta' oġġett jidhru mċajpra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因对焦不准而模糊的；影像细节不清晰的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher imċajpar għax il-fokus ma jkunx issettjat sew u d-dettalji ma jkunux ċari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An image that is out of focus looks blurred because its details are not sharply defined.

collocations.zh: 一张因失焦而模糊的脸

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt sfukat ma jippermettix li jinqraw id-dettalji tad-dokument.
formal.en: The out-of-focus photograph does not allow the details of the document to be read.
formal.zh: 这张照片没有对准焦点，导致文件上的细节无法辨读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-ritratt sfukat; wiċċek ma jidhirx ċar. Mark: Ejja nieħdu ieħor u niffokaw fuq il-wiċċ.
colloquial.en: Maja: This photo is out of focus; your face isn't clear. Mark: Let's take another one and focus on the face.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张照片失焦了，你的脸看不清。Mark：我们再拍一张，把焦点对准脸。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-ritratt sfukat; wiċċek ma jidhirx ċar.
messages.zh: 这张照片失焦了，你的脸看不清。
messages.en: This photo is out of focus; your face isn't clear.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieħdu ieħor u niffokaw fuq il-wiċċ.
messages.zh: 我们再拍一张，把焦点对准脸。
messages.en: Let's take another one and focus on the face.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular tint or slight variation of a colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种颜色的特定色调，或同一颜色内部的细微差别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ton partikolari ta' kulur jew differenza żgħira bejn kuluri qrib ħafna ta' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某种颜色的特定色调，尤指与相近颜色略有不同的颜色。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ton ta' kulur li jkun kemxejn differenti minn ton ieħor tal-istess kulur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tint is a particular shade of a colour that differs slightly from other shades.

formal.mt: Għall-ħitan tal-klassi ntgħażlet sfumatura ċara ta' blu biex l-ambjent jidher aktar kalm.
formal.en: A light tint of blue was chosen for the classroom walls to make the surroundings feel calmer.
formal.zh: 教室墙壁选用了浅蓝色调，使环境显得更加宁静。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema sfumatura ta' blu tippreferi għall-kamra? Lara: Dik l-aktar ċara; naħseb li taqbel mal-purtieri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which tint of blue do you prefer for the room? Lara: The lightest one; I think it matches the curtains.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：房间用哪一种蓝色色调比较合你心意？拉拉：最浅的那种；我觉得它和窗帘很搭。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema sfumatura ta' blu tippreferi għall-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Liema sfumatura ta' blu tippreferi għall-kamra?
messages.zh: 房间用哪一种蓝色色调比较合你心意？
messages.en: Which tint of blue do you prefer for the room?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik l-aktar ċara; naħseb li taqbel mal-purtieri.
messages.mt_standard: Dik l-aktar ċara; naħseb li taqbel mal-purtieri.
messages.zh: 最浅的那种；我觉得它和窗帘很搭。
messages.en: The lightest one; I think it matches the curtains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张蓝色油漆色卡：每一格略有不同的蓝，都可以是一种 sfumatura，把它与细微色调联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of using considerable effort or putting something under excessive physical pressure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使出很大力气，或让身体部位、声音等承受过度负荷的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' forza jew sforz kbir li jista' jqiegħed pressjoni żejda fuq il-ġisem, il-vuċi jew xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使劲用力，尤指让肌肉、声音等承受过大负荷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed juża sforz qawwi jew iżżejjed, speċjalment b'mod li jgħabbi l-muskoli jew il-vuċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Straining is the act of making a strong effort that puts pressure on your body or voice.

collocations.zh: 不费力地；不过度用力地

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ tal-kant, l-għalliema spjegat kif wieħed jista' jkanta b'mod ċar mingħajr sfurzar tal-vuċi.
formal.en: During singing practice, the teacher explained how to sing clearly without straining the voice.
formal.zh: 在歌唱训练中，老师讲解了如何在不过度用嗓的情况下清晰地演唱。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tridni nkanta aktar għoli? Rita: Le, ipprova kanta mingħajr sfurzar tal-vuċi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you want me to sing louder? Rita: No, try to sing without straining your voice.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你想让我唱得更响吗？丽塔：不用，试着唱得自然些，别过度用嗓。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tridni nkanta aktar għoli?
messages.mt_standard: Tridni nkanta aktar għoli?
messages.zh: 你想让我唱得更响吗？
messages.en: Do you want me to sing louder?

messages.speaker: Rita (声乐老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ipprova kanta mingħajr sfurzar tal-vuċi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ipprova kanta mingħajr sfurzar tal-vuċi.
messages.zh: 不用，试着唱得自然些，别过度用嗓。
messages.en: No, try to sing without straining your voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象唱歌时越唱越费劲、喉咙绷紧的动作，用这幅画面记住 sfurzar 表示使劲或过度用力。

gloss_zh: 紧绷而不自然的；勉强的；被迫的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing tension or unnatural effort, or done because of pressure rather than free choice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因紧张或刻意用力而显得不自然的；也指受到压力而被迫做出的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri tensjoni jew sforz mhux naturali, jew li jsir minħabba pressjoni u mhux b'għażla ħielsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声音、表情等因紧张或费力而显得紧绷、不自然的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher jew jinstema' mimli tensjoni jew sforz, u għalhekk ma jkunx naturali jew rilassat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a voice or expression is strained, it shows tension or effort and does not seem relaxed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到外界压力或强迫而做出的，并非出于自由意愿的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jsir minħabba pressjoni jew għax xi ħadd iġiegħel lil persuna tagħmlu, u mhux minn rajha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An action is forced when someone performs it because of pressure rather than their own free choice.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru wieġeb b'leħen sfurzat, u dan wera t-tensjoni li kien qed iħoss.
formal.en: In the story, the character replied in a strained voice, revealing the tension he was feeling.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物用紧绷而不自然的声音回答，显露出他内心的紧张。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed titbissem hekk? Mark: It-tbissima tidher sfurzata? Għadni nervuż dwar il-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you smiling like that? Mark: Does my smile look strained? I'm still nervous about the meeting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么笑得这样？马克：我的笑容看起来很勉强吗？我还在为那场会议紧张。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed titbissem hekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed titbissem hekk?
messages.zh: 你怎么笑得这样？
messages.en: Why are you smiling like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tbissima tidher sfurzata? Għadni nervuż dwar il-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: It-tbissima tidher sfurzata? Għadni nervuż dwar il-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 我的笑容看起来很勉强吗？我还在为那场会议紧张。
messages.en: Does my smile look strained? I'm still nervous about the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分词义：硬挤出的笑容是紧绷勉强，被要求做的事情是被迫；sfurzat 都带有不自然或不情愿的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aromatic herb whose small leaves are used to flavour food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种具有香气的草本植物，其小叶常用来给食物调味，即百里香。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta aromatika b'weraq żgħir li jintuża biex jagħti t-togħma lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 百里香，一种叶片细小、带有芳香、可用作烹饪香草的植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaxixa aromatika b'weraq żgħir li jista' jintuża frisk jew imnixxef biex jagħti togħma lill-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Thyme is an aromatic herb with small leaves that people use fresh or dried to flavour food.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tissuġġerixxi li jiżdied ftit sagħtar frisk mal-patata qabel ma tiddaħħal fil-forn.
formal.en: The recipe suggests adding a little fresh thyme to the potatoes before putting them in the oven.
formal.zh: 这份食谱建议在把土豆放入烤箱前，加入少许新鲜百里香。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna sagħtar frisk għall-patata? Pawlu: Le, imma għandna sagħtar imnixxef fil-vażett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have fresh thyme for the potatoes? Pawlu: No, but we have dried thyme in the jar.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们有给土豆调味的新鲜百里香吗？保罗：没有，不过罐子里有干百里香。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna sagħtar frisk għall-patata?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna sagħtar frisk għall-patata?
messages.zh: 我们有给土豆调味的新鲜百里香吗？
messages.en: Do we have fresh thyme for the potatoes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma għandna sagħtar imnixxef fil-vażett.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma għandna sagħtar imnixxef fil-vażett.
messages.zh: 没有，不过罐子里有干百里香。
messages.en: No, but we have dried thyme in the jar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往烤土豆上撒细小香草叶的画面，把例句中的 sagħtar 与百里香的叶片、香气和调味用途一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A personal name used to identify someone called Shane.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人名，指名叫谢恩的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' persuna li jintuża biex jidentifika lil xi ħadd jismu Shane.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谢恩，用于称呼或指认某个人的人名。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem personali li bih tissejjaħ jew tiġi identifikata persuna jisimha Shane.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Shane is a personal name by which someone may be addressed or identified.

formal.mt: Shane bagħat it-talba tiegħu bil-miktub u stenna tweġiba.
formal.en: Shane submitted his request in writing and waited for a reply.
formal.zh: 谢恩以书面形式提交了申请，并等待答复。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf fejn hu Shane? Lara: Iva, qed jistenniena ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know where Shane is? Lara: Yes, he is waiting for us by the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你知道谢恩在哪里吗？拉拉：知道，他在门边等我们。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf fejn hu Shane?
messages.mt_standard: Taf fejn hu Shane?
messages.zh: 你知道谢恩在哪里吗？
messages.en: Do you know where Shane is?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jistenniena ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jistenniena ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 知道，他在门边等我们。
messages.en: Yes, he is waiting for us by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Shane 和朋友谢恩的姓名牌联系起来，看到首字母大写就联想到具体的人名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression stating that a female person shed tears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某位女性哭了的表达，对应马耳他语 bkiet。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tgħid li persuna femminili bkiet, jiġifieri ħarġilha d-dmugħ minn għajnejha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 她哭了，表示某位女性流下了眼泪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li persuna femminili ħarġilha d-dmugħ minn għajnejha, pereżempju minħabba dwejjaq jew ferħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you say that she cried, you mean that she shed tears.

collocations.en: she cried when she heard the news

formal.mt: L-istudenta bkiet bil-ferħ meta saret taf li għaddiet mill-eżami.
formal.en: The female student cried with joy when she learned that she had passed the exam.
formal.zh: 这名女学生得知自己通过考试时，喜极而泣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex bkiet Sara? Lara: Bkiet bil-ferħ meta rat lil ommha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Sara cry? Lara: She cried with joy when she saw her mother.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：萨拉为什么哭了？拉拉：她看到妈妈时，高兴得哭了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex bkiet Sara?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex bkiet Sara?
messages.zh: 萨拉为什么哭了？
messages.en: Why did Sara cry?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bkiet bil-ferħ meta rat lil ommha.
messages.mt_standard: Bkiet bil-ferħ meta rat lil ommha.
messages.zh: 她看到妈妈时，高兴得哭了。
messages.en: She cried with joy when she saw her mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bkiet 配上一幅她流泪的画面，再用 bil-ferħ 提醒自己：哭也可能是因为高兴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proper name identifying the place called Sheffield.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地名，指名为谢菲尔德的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jidentifika l-post imsejjaħ Sheffield.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谢菲尔德，用于指认特定地方的专有名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem ta' post partikolari li jintuża biex wieħed jirreferi għal Sheffield.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sheffield is a place name used to identify a particular location.
