formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'Sheffield, u l-parteċipanti se jirċievu l-indirizz bil-posta elettronika.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Sheffield, and participants will receive the address by email.
formal.zh: 会议将在谢菲尔德举行，与会者将通过电子邮件收到地址。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tgħix issa? Mark: Ngħix f'Sheffield. Ejja żurni xi darba!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where do you live now? Mark: I live in Sheffield. Come and visit me sometime!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你现在住在哪里？马克：我住在谢菲尔德。有空来找我玩！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn tgħix issa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn tgħix issa?
messages.zh: 你现在住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħix f'Sheffield. Ejja żurni xi darba!
messages.mt_standard: Ngħix f'Sheffield. Ejja żurni xi darba!
messages.zh: 我住在谢菲尔德。有空来找我玩！
messages.en: I live in Sheffield. Come and visit me sometime!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Sheffield 写在旅行地图的地点标记旁，再连读 f'Sheffield，记住在谢菲尔德这一表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing people or things as being with one another or acting as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述人或事物在一起，或作为一个群体共同活动的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkunu ma' xulxin jew li jagħmlu xi ħaġa flimkien bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在一起的，或共同参与某项活动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkunu flimkien fl-istess post jew jieħdu sehem fl-istess attività ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People who are together are with one another or are taking part in an activity as a group.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti ħadmu flimkien biex ilestu l-proġett fil-ħin.
formal.en: The participants worked together to complete the project on time.
formal.zh: 参与者共同合作，按时完成了项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tistudja miegħi llum? Lara: Iva, nistgħu nistudjaw flimkien fil-librerija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to study with me today? Lara: Yes, we can study together at the library.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天想和我一起学习吗？拉拉：想，我们可以一起在图书馆学习。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tistudja miegħi llum?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tistudja miegħi llum?
messages.zh: 你今天想和我一起学习吗？
messages.en: Do you want to study with me today?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nistudjaw flimkien fil-librerija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nistudjaw flimkien fil-librerija.
messages.zh: 想，我们可以一起在图书馆学习。
messages.en: Yes, we can study together at the library.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条给定的 Together 义项，想象同学围桌一起学习，再用 flimkien 的例句巩固共同参与的意思。

gloss_zh: Shingles（原包标为动词，具体词义未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form supplied as a verb whose specific meaning is not established by the packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原包列为动词的形式，但所给释义仅重复词形，未明确其具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma mogħtija bħala verb, iżda t-tagħrif ipprovdut ma jagħtix tifsira ċara tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Shingles；所给内容仅重复词形，未提供可确定的动词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-forma 'Shingles' tingħata bħala verb, iżda t-tifsira speċifika tagħha mhijiex spjegata fit-tagħrif ipprovdut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry labels 'Shingles' as a verb but does not explain what it means.

formal.mt: Il-forma 'Shingles' hija mniżżla bħala verb, iżda jeħtieġ tagħrif ieħor biex tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The form 'Shingles' is listed as a verb, but further information is needed to establish its meaning.
formal.zh: “Shingles”被列为动词，但需要更多信息才能确定其含义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'Shingles' hawn? Paul: Hija mniżżla bħala verb, imma t-tifsira mhix spjegata.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'Shingles' mean here? Paul: It is listed as a verb, but its meaning is not explained.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的“Shingles”是什么意思？Paul：它被列为动词，但没有解释具体含义。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'Shingles' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'Shingles' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的“Shingles”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Shingles' mean here?

messages.speaker: Paul (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija mniżżla bħala verb, imma t-tifsira mhix spjegata.
messages.mt_standard: Hija mniżżla bħala verb, imma t-tifsira mhix spjegata.
messages.zh: 它被列为动词，但没有解释具体含义。
messages.en: It is listed as a verb, but its meaning is not explained.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“词义待核对”的学习卡片：先保留原包的动词标签，不凭词形猜测含义；例句只练习如何询问词义。

gloss_zh: 我们给她找到了它（所给例子中的物品是戒指）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A supplied form explained by the example 'we found the ring for her'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给形式以“我们给她找到了戒指”为例说明，表达我们替她找到了某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li fit-tagħrif ipprovdut hija spjegata bl-eżempju 'sibna ċ-ċurkett lilha', jiġifieri sibna ċ-ċurkett għaliha.

sense_translations.en_definition: sibna ċ-ċurkett lilha pereżempju-Karl Scicluna nikteb il-Malti Tajjeb paġna 91
sense_translations.zh_definition: 例如“我们给她找到了戒指”；原释义附有 Karl Scicluna、《nikteb il-Malti Tajjeb》第91页的说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skont l-eżempju mogħti, il-forma tfisser li sibna ċ-ċurkett għal dik il-persuna femminili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In the supplied example, this form means that we found the ring for her.

collocations.en: 'sibnihulha' in the example about the ring

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-forma 'sibnihulha' hija spjegata bil-frażi 'sibna ċ-ċurkett lilha'.
formal.en: In this example, the form 'sibnihulha' is explained by the phrase 'we found the ring for her'.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，“sibnihulha”这一形式用“我们给她找到了戒指”来解释。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'sibnihulha' f'dan l-eżempju? Mark: Tfisser li sibna ċ-ċurkett għaliha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'sibnihulha' mean in this example? Mark: It means that we found the ring for her.
colloquial.zh: Nina：“sibnihulha”在这个例子里是什么意思？Mark：意思是我们给她找到了戒指。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'sibnihulha' f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'sibnihulha' f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.zh: “sibnihulha”在这个例子里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sibnihulha' mean in this example?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li sibna ċ-ċurkett għaliha.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li sibna ċ-ċurkett għaliha.
messages.zh: 意思是我们给她找到了戒指。
messages.en: It means that we found the ring for her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“我们找到戒指，再交给她”的连续画面记整词，并抓住“我们、找到、物品、给她”四个意义位置；不据此自行拆分词形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit used to measure an area of land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于计量土地面积的单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura li tintuża biex titkejjel l-erja ta' biċċa art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 土地面积的计量单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura li biha tiġi espressa l-erja tal-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Siegh is a unit used to express the area of a piece of land.

collocations.zh: 以 Siegh 计量面积的土地

collocations.en: the use of Siegh in measuring land
collocations.zh: Siegh 在土地面积计量中的使用

formal.mt: F'dan id-dokument, il-kelma 'Siegh' tintuża bħala miżura tal-art.
formal.en: In this document, the word 'Siegh' is used as a land measure.
formal.zh: 在这份文件中，Siegh 一词用作土地面积计量单位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser 'Siegh' hawn? Pawlu: Hija miżura tal-art; tintuża biex titkejjel l-erja.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Siegh' mean here? Pawlu: It is a land measure; it is used to measure area.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 Siegh 是什么意思？保罗：它是土地面积计量单位，用来计量面积。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tfisser 'Siegh' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: X'tfisser 'Siegh' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的 Siegh 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Siegh' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija miżura tal-art; tintuża biex titkejjel l-erja.
messages.mt_standard: Hija miżura tal-art; tintuża biex titkejjel l-erja.
messages.zh: 它是土地面积计量单位，用来计量面积。
messages.en: It is a land measure; it is used to measure area.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Siegh 写在一幅田地示意图旁，联想“这块地有多大”，记住它表示土地面积单位。

gloss_zh: 有用的；有价值的；所需的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Useful, valuable, or needed for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能提供帮助、具有实际价值，或为某种目的所需要的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti għajnuna jew benefiċċju, jew li jkun meħtieġ għal xi għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有益的、必要的、需要的或有用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ta' għajnuna jew ta' benefiċċju, jew li jkun hemm bżonnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is siewi helps you achieve a purpose or provides something you need.

formal.mt: Dan ir-rapport fih tagħrif siewi għall-għalliema li qed iħejju l-lezzjonijiet.
formal.en: This report contains useful information for teachers who are preparing lessons.
formal.zh: 这份报告包含对正在备课的教师有用的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kien siewi l-parir ta' Pawlu? Lara: Iva, għenni nifhem x'għandi nagħmel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Pawlu's advice useful? Lara: Yes, it helped me understand what I should do.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗的建议有用吗？拉拉：有用，它帮我弄清楚了该怎么做。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien siewi l-parir ta' Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Kien siewi l-parir ta' Pawlu?
messages.zh: 保罗的建议有用吗？
messages.en: Was Pawlu's advice useful?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għenni nifhem x'għandi nagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għenni nifhem x'għandi nagħmel.
messages.zh: 有用，它帮我弄清楚了该怎么做。
messages.en: Yes, it helped me understand what I should do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 siewi 和 parir 连着记成“有价值的建议”，想象一句建议帮你解决问题，就能记住“有用、有益”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bacterial infection that can be transmitted through sexual contact.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种可通过性接触传播的细菌感染，即梅毒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Infezzjoni kkawżata minn batterju li tista' tgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra waqt kuntatt sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梅毒，一种可经性接触传播的细菌感染。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marda infettiva kkawżata minn batterju li tista' tiġi trażmessa permezz ta' kuntatt sesswali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Syphilis is a bacterial infection that can pass from one person to another through sexual contact.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jagħti informazzjoni dwar is-sifilide u jispjega kif tista' tiġi trażmessa.
formal.en: The leaflet provides information about syphilis and explains how it can be transmitted.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册提供有关梅毒的信息，并解释其传播方式。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhi s-sifilide? Rita: Hija infezzjoni li tista' tgħaddi waqt kuntatt sesswali.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is syphilis? Rita: It is an infection that can be transmitted through sexual contact.
colloquial.zh: 马克：梅毒是什么？丽塔：它是一种可通过性接触传播的感染。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi s-sifilide?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi s-sifilide?
messages.zh: 梅毒是什么？
messages.en: What is syphilis?

messages.speaker: Rita (健康教育老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija infezzjoni li tista' tgħaddi waqt kuntatt sesswali.
messages.mt_standard: Hija infezzjoni li tista' tgħaddi waqt kuntatt sesswali.
messages.zh: 它是一种可通过性接触传播的感染。
messages.en: It is an infection that can be transmitted through sexual contact.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sifilide 与英语 syphilis 并排制成词卡，再配上“梅毒检测”的场景，帮助记住医学词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A measure used to express the area of land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于表示土地面积的一种计量单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura li tintuża biex titkejjel u tiġi espressa l-erja ta' biċċa art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 土地面积计量单位；用于衡量一块土地面积的度量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura tal-art li biha tiġi indikata l-erja ta' għalqa jew ta' biċċa art oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sighan is a measure used to express the area of a piece of land.

collocations.zh: sighan 这一土地计量单位
用 sighan 计量土地面积

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika l-erja tal-għalqa bl-użu tal-miżura sighan.
formal.en: The report states the area of the field using the land measure sighan.
formal.zh: 报告使用 sighan 这一土地计量单位表示该田地的面积。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'sighan' f'dan id-dokument? Mark: Hija miżura tal-art. Hawnhekk tintuża biex tindika l-erja tal-għalqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'sighan' mean in this document? Mark: It is a land measure. Here it is used to indicate the area of the field.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这份文件里的 sighan 是什么意思？Mark：它是一种土地计量单位，这里用来表示田地的面积。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'sighan' f'dan id-dokument?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'sighan' f'dan id-dokument?
messages.zh: 这份文件里的 sighan 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sighan' mean in this document?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija miżura tal-art. Hawnhekk tintuża biex tindika l-erja tal-għalqa.
messages.mt_standard: Hija miżura tal-art. Hawnhekk tintuża biex tindika l-erja tal-għalqa.
messages.zh: 它是一种土地计量单位，这里用来表示田地的面积。
messages.en: It is a land measure. Here it is used to indicate the area of the field.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张田地平面图，旁边用 sighan 标注面积；把这个词与“土地面积计量”一起记忆，不给它编造具体换算数值。

gloss_zh: （形容词）在群体中居于主导地位的；（动词）表示某事物很好

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes someone regarded as the dominant leader of a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人在群体中居于主导地位，是其他成员追随的领头者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna meqjusa bħala l-mexxej dominanti ta' grupp, li l-membri l-oħra jimxu warajha.

sense_translations.en_definition: Someone who is the alpha of the pack
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容在群体中居于主导地位、带领其他成员的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li għandha l-pożizzjoni dominanti fi grupp u li tmexxi lill-membri l-oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is described as sigma in this sense, they are regarded as the dominant leader of their group.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表达某事物很好，表示肯定或赞赏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jintuża biex wieħed jesprimi li xi ħaġa hija tajba jew li jistħoqqilha tifħir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone uses sigma in this verbal sense, they express the opinion that something is good.

collocations.zh: 在群体中居于主导地位的领头者

collocations.en: a person regarded as the dominant member of a group
collocations.zh: 被视为群体主导者的人

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-kelma 'sigma' tiddeskrivi lill-persuna li għandha r-rwol dominanti fil-grupp u li l-oħrajn jimxu warajha.
formal.en: In this example, the word 'sigma' describes the person who has the dominant role in the group and whom the others follow.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，sigma 描述的是在群体中占据主导地位、受到其他成员追随的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu sigma? Mark: Għax hu l-mexxej tal-grupp u l-oħrajn jimxu warajh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you calling him sigma? Mark: Because he is the leader of the group and the others follow him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么称他为 sigma？Mark：因为他是这个群体的领头者，其他人都跟着他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu sigma?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu sigma?
messages.zh: 你为什么称他为 sigma？
messages.en: Why are you calling him sigma?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu l-mexxej tal-grupp u l-oħrajn jimxu warajh.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu l-mexxej tal-grupp u l-oħrajn jimxu warajh.
messages.zh: 因为他是这个群体的领头者，其他人都跟着他。
messages.en: Because he is the leader of the group and the others follow him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分开记：形容词对应“大家跟着谁走”的领头者画面；动词对应“这东西很好”的赞赏表达。按词性区分这两个给定义项，不把它们混成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Information about a business that is kept confidential rather than shared publicly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 企业或经营者保密、不向公众公开的经营相关信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Informazzjoni dwar negozju jew l-attivitajiet tiegħu li tinżamm kunfidenzjali u ma tingħatax lill-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业或经营者不对外公开的经营相关秘密信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sigriet kummerċjali huwa tagħrif dwar negozju, bħalma hija riċetta jew metodu ta' produzzjoni, li jinżamm kunfidenzjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A business secret is information about a business or its activities that the business keeps confidential.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tqis il-formula tal-prodott bħala sigriet kummerċjali u ma taqsamhiex mal-pubbliku.
formal.en: The company regards the product formula as a business secret and does not share it with the public.
formal.zh: 公司将产品配方视为商业秘密，不向公众公开。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tgħidli x'hemm f'din it-taħlita? Rita: Jiddispjaċini, ir-riċetta hija sigriet kummerċjali.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you tell me what is in this mixture? Rita: Sorry, the recipe is a business secret.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你能告诉我这个混合物里有什么吗？Rita：抱歉，配方是商业秘密。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħidli x'hemm f'din it-taħlita?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħidli x'hemm f'din it-taħlita?
messages.zh: 你能告诉我这个混合物里有什么吗？
messages.en: Can you tell me what is in this mixture?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiddispjaċini, ir-riċetta hija sigriet kummerċjali.
messages.mt_standard: Jiddispjaċini, ir-riċetta hija sigriet kummerċjali.
messages.zh: 抱歉，配方是商业秘密。
messages.en: Sorry, the recipe is a business secret.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sigriet 记作“秘密”，把 kummerċjali 记作“商业的”；想象店员把配方收进抽屉，说“这是商业秘密”，将整个词组和保密场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Confidential information about a business that is kept from competitors and the public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 企业不向竞争对手或公众公开的经营、技术或其他保密信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Informazzjoni kunfidenzjali dwar negozju li tinżamm mistura mill-kompetituri u mill-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业保密、不向外界公开的商业信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sigriet tan-negozju huwa tagħrif dwar l-attività ta' negozju li ma jingħatax lill-pubbliku jew lill-kompetituri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A business secret is information about a company's activities or methods that the company keeps confidential.

formal.mt: Il-metodu tal-produzzjoni huwa sigriet tan-negozju u d-dettalji tiegħu għandhom jinżammu kunfidenzjali.
formal.en: The production method is a business secret, and its details must be kept confidential.
formal.zh: 该生产方法属于商业秘密，其细节必须保密。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tgħidli kif tagħmlu din iz-zalza? Mark: Le, dik ir-riċetta hija sigriet tan-negozju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you tell me how you make this sauce? Mark: No, that recipe is a business secret.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能告诉我你们怎么做这种酱汁吗？Mark：不行，那个配方是商业秘密。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħidli kif tagħmlu din iz-zalza?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħidli kif tagħmlu din iz-zalza?
messages.zh: 你能告诉我你们怎么做这种酱汁吗？
messages.en: Can you tell me how you make this sauce?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dik ir-riċetta hija sigriet tan-negozju.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dik ir-riċetta hija sigriet tan-negozju.
messages.zh: 不行，那个配方是商业秘密。
messages.en: No, that recipe is a business secret.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组短语记成“做生意时不能公开的秘密”，联想店主保密的酱汁配方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The safety of products for the people who use or handle them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产品在使用或接触过程中不会对人造成伤害的安全性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li l-prodotti jkunu sikuri u ma jikkawżawx ħsara lin-nies meta jużawhom jew jimmaniġġjawhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产品对使用者及接触者的安全性，涉及防止产品造成伤害。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sigurtà tal-prodotti tirrigwarda kemm il-prodotti jkunu sikuri għan-nies li jużawhom jew jiġu f'kuntatt magħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Product safety concerns whether products can be used or handled without causing harm to people.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija twettaq testijiet regolari biex tivverifika s-sigurtà tal-prodotti qabel ma tqegħedhom għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: The company carries out regular tests to verify product safety before offering the products for sale.
formal.zh: 该公司定期进行测试，在产品上市销售前核实其安全性。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed tiċċekkja dawn il-ġugarelli? David: Qed niċċekkja s-sigurtà tal-prodotti. Din il-biċċa żgħira tista' tinqala'.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you checking these toys? David: I am checking product safety. This small part could come off.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么在检查这些玩具？David：我在检查产品安全性。这个小零件可能会脱落。

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tiċċekkja dawn il-ġugarelli?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tiċċekkja dawn il-ġugarelli?
messages.zh: 你为什么在检查这些玩具？
messages.en: Why are you checking these toys?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed niċċekkja s-sigurtà tal-prodotti. Din il-biċċa żgħira tista' tinqala'.
messages.mt_standard: Qed niċċekkja s-sigurtà tal-prodotti. Din il-biċċa żgħira tista' tinqala'.
messages.zh: 我在检查产品安全性。这个小零件可能会脱落。
messages.en: I am checking product safety. This small part could come off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语和“检查玩具零件会不会脱落”的画面绑定，记住它说的是产品是否安全。

gloss_zh: 产品一般安全性；产品总体安全

teaching_sense.en_definition: The overall safety of products, considered through general requirements and risks to users.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一般安全要求及使用者面临的风险出发，对产品整体安全性的概括。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sigurtà tal-prodotti meqjusa b'mod ġenerali, fid-dawl tar-rekwiżiti komuni u tar-riskji għall-utenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产品的一般安全性，着重于产品整体适用的安全要求和使用风险。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sigurtà ġenerali tal-prodotti hija l-kundizzjoni li l-prodotti jkunu sikuri għall-utenti, meta jitqiesu r-rekwiżiti ġenerali u r-riskji tal-użu tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: General product safety concerns the overall safety of products and the general requirements intended to protect people who use them.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina s-sigurtà ġenerali tal-prodotti u jidentifika riskji komuni għall-konsumaturi.
formal.en: The report examines general product safety and identifies common risks to consumers.
formal.zh: 该报告审视产品的总体安全性，并识别消费者面临的常见风险。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fuq xiex inhu l-kors li se tagħmel? Pawlu: Fuq is-sigurtà ġenerali tal-prodotti, biex nifhem aħjar ir-riskji komuni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the course you are going to take about? Pawlu: General product safety, so I can better understand common risks.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你准备上的课程讲什么？Pawlu：讲产品总体安全，帮助我更好地了解常见风险。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex inhu l-kors li se tagħmel?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex inhu l-kors li se tagħmel?
messages.zh: 你准备上的课程讲什么？
messages.en: What is the course you are going to take about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq is-sigurtà ġenerali tal-prodotti, biex nifhem aħjar ir-riskji komuni.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq is-sigurtà ġenerali tal-prodotti, biex nifhem aħjar ir-riskji komuni.
messages.zh: 讲产品总体安全，帮助我更好地了解常见风险。
messages.en: General product safety, so I can better understand common risks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ġenerali 就提醒自己“从总体看安全”，联想一份检查各类产品共同风险的总清单。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Making no sound or very little sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不发出声音或声音很小的，用于描述人、物或环境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jagħmilx ħoss jew li jagħmel ftit li xejn ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无声的或十分安静的；形容人时也可表示不说话的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li ma titkellimx, jew oġġett jew post li ma jagħmilx ħoss jew jagħmel ftit li xejn ħoss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is silent makes no sound or very little sound.

formal.mt: Il-mutur il-ġdid huwa silenzjuż u ma jfixkilx lill-ħaddiema waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The new motor is quiet and does not disturb employees while they work.
formal.zh: 新马达运转安静，不会打扰员工工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex int daqshekk silenzjuż illum? Luqa: Għajjien biss. Kelli ġurnata twila.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you so quiet today? Luqa: I am just tired. I have had a long day.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天怎么这么安静？Luqa：只是累了。今天忙了一整天。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex int daqshekk silenzjuż illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex int daqshekk silenzjuż illum?
messages.zh: 你今天怎么这么安静？
messages.en: Why are you so quiet today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għajjien biss. Kelli ġurnata twila.
messages.mt_standard: Għajjien biss. Kelli ġurnata twila.
messages.zh: 只是累了。今天忙了一整天。
messages.en: I am just tired. I have had a long day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 可用英语 silent 作联想提示，再记住 silenzjuż 的完整拼写；想象安静运转的马达或沉默的朋友。

gloss_zh: 西里西亚的；与西里西亚有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Silesia, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与西里西亚地区、当地居民或当地文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mar-reġjun tas-Sileżja, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西里西亚的；属于西里西亚地区或与其居民、文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għas-Sileżja jew li għandu x'jaqsam mar-reġjun, mal-abitanti tiegħu jew mal-kultura tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Silesian comes from Silesia or is connected with its people or culture.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-wirja jinkludi taqsima dwar l-artiġjanat sileżjan.
formal.en: The exhibition catalogue includes a section on Silesian craftsmanship.
formal.zh: 展览目录收录了一个介绍西里西亚手工艺的章节。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'sileżjan' hawn? Pawlu: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mas-Sileżja. Lara: Allura dan il-ktieb hu dwar il-wirt sileżjan.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'sileżjan' mean here? Pawlu: It means that something is connected with Silesia. Lara: So this book is about Silesian heritage.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 'sileżjan' 是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是与西里西亚有关。Lara：那么这本书讲的是西里西亚文化遗产。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'sileżjan' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'sileżjan' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的 'sileżjan' 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sileżjan' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mas-Sileżja.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mas-Sileżja.
messages.zh: 意思是与西里西亚有关。
messages.en: It means that something is connected with Silesia.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura dan il-ktieb hu dwar il-wirt sileżjan.
messages.mt_standard: Allura dan il-ktieb hu dwar il-wirt sileżjan.
messages.zh: 那么这本书讲的是西里西亚文化遗产。
messages.en: So this book is about Silesian heritage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sileżjan 与“西里西亚的”配对记忆：想象一张标有西里西亚的地图，旁边放着介绍当地文化遗产的书；这个词用来说明事物与该地区有关。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A document setting out the subjects and content to be covered in a course.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 列明一门课程将教授哪些主题和内容的文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li jiddeskrivi s-suġġetti u l-kontenut li se jiġu mgħallma f'kors.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 课程或教学大纲，列出课程涵盖的主题与学习内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jagħti ħarsa ġenerali lejn is-suġġetti, il-kontenut u l-miri tat-tagħlim ta' kors.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A syllabus is a document that tells students what subjects and material a course will cover.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jaqraw is-sillabu tal-kors qabel l-ewwel lezzjoni biex ikunu jafu liema suġġetti se jiġu diskussi.
formal.en: Students should read the course syllabus before the first lesson so that they know which topics will be discussed.
formal.zh: 学生应在第一堂课之前阅读课程大纲，以了解将要讨论哪些主题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' nsib is-sillabu tal-kors? Mark: Fuq il-paġna tal-kors, taħt it-titlu. Maja: Tajjeb, se naqrah qabel il-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I find the course syllabus? Mark: On the course page, under the title. Maja: Great, I'll read it before the lesson.
colloquial.zh: Maja：在哪里可以找到课程大纲？Mark：在课程页面上，标题下面。Maja：好的，我会在上课前读一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nsib is-sillabu tal-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nsib is-sillabu tal-kors?
messages.zh: 在哪里可以找到课程大纲？
messages.en: Where can I find the course syllabus?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-paġna tal-kors, taħt it-titlu.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-paġna tal-kors, taħt it-titlu.
messages.zh: 在课程页面上，标题下面。
messages.en: On the course page, under the title.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se naqrah qabel il-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se naqrah qabel il-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 好的，我会在上课前读一遍。
messages.en: Great, I'll read it before the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sillabu 想成开课前拿到的“学习路线图”：上面列着这门课要学哪些主题。用“先看大纲，再去上课”的画面记住它。

gloss_zh: 家具软包工；家具包覆工

teaching_sense.en_definition: A craftsperson who fits or repairs the padding and coverings of furniture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为家具安装或修补软垫及布料、皮革等包覆材料的工匠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna tas-sengħa li twaħħal jew issewwi l-ikkuttunar u l-kisi tad-drapp jew tal-ġilda fuq l-għamara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家具软包工，负责为椅子、沙发等家具安装、更换或修补软垫和表面包覆材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaddiem tas-sengħa li jiksi siġġijiet, sufani u għamara oħra b'ikkuttunar, drapp jew ġilda, u jsewwi jew jibdel dan il-kisi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An upholsterer is someone whose job is to fit or repair the padding and coverings on furniture.

collocations.zh: 手艺熟练的家具软包工

collocations.en: to take a sofa to the upholsterer
collocations.zh: 把沙发送到家具软包工那里

formal.mt: Is-sillar se jibdel id-drapp u l-ikkuttunar tas-siġġijiet qabel ma jerġgħu jitqiegħdu fis-sala.
formal.en: The upholsterer will replace the fabric and padding of the chairs before they are returned to the hall.
formal.zh: 家具软包工会先更换椅子的布面和软垫，再将椅子放回大厅。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Id-drapp tas-sufan tqatta'. Lil min nistgħu nċemplu? Toni: Nafu sillar tajjeb; jista' jibdel id-drapp. Nina: Mela ċempillu u staqsih kemm jiswa.
colloquial.en: Nina: The sofa fabric has torn. Who can we call? Toni: We know a good upholsterer; he can replace the fabric. Nina: Then call him and ask how much it costs.
colloquial.zh: Nina：沙发的布面破了，我们可以找谁？Toni：我们认识一位不错的家具软包工，他能更换布面。Nina：那就打电话问问他要多少钱。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-drapp tas-sufan tqatta'. Lil min nistgħu nċemplu?
messages.mt_standard: Id-drapp tas-sufan tqatta'. Lil min nistgħu nċemplu?
messages.zh: 沙发的布面破了，我们可以找谁？
messages.en: The sofa fabric has torn. Who can we call?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nafu sillar tajjeb; jista' jibdel id-drapp.
messages.mt_standard: Nafu sillar tajjeb; jista' jibdel id-drapp.
messages.zh: 我们认识一位不错的家具软包工，他能更换布面。
messages.en: We know a good upholsterer; he can replace the fabric.

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ċempillu u staqsih kemm jiswa.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ċempillu u staqsih kemm jiswa.
messages.zh: 那就打电话问问他要多少钱。
messages.en: Then call him and ask how much it costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 sillar 时，想象一位给旧沙发“换外衣、添软垫”的师傅；把人物和这两项工作连在一起，就能记牢“家具软包工”。

gloss_zh: 牛排；一块供煎烤的牛肉

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cut of beef prepared for cooking as a steak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切成适合煎、烤等方式烹调的块状牛肉，即牛排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa laħam taċ-ċanga maqtugħa biex tissajjar bħala steak, pereżempju fil-qali jew fuq il-gradilja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肉排；本词组具体指切成适合煎烤的牛排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa laħam maqtugħa fi ħxuna adattata biex tinqela jew tissajjar fuq il-gradilja; f'din l-espressjoni l-laħam ikun taċ-ċanga.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A steak is a thick slice of meat usually cooked by frying or grilling; this expression refers specifically to beef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牛排，即从牛肉上切下、通常用于煎烤的一块厚肉片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ħoxna ta' laħam taċ-ċanga li normalment tissajjar fil-qali jew fuq il-gradilja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A beefsteak is a thick slice of beef that is usually fried or grilled and served as an individual portion.

formal.mt: Għall-platt ewlieni, il-kok ipprepara silta ċanga fuq il-gradilja u servieha ma' patata u ħaxix.
formal.en: For the main course, the chef prepared a grilled beefsteak and served it with potatoes and vegetables.
formal.zh: 主菜是厨师制作的一块烤牛排，配以土豆和蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nixtieq silta ċanga, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Kif tixtieqha msajra? Lara: Imsajra sew, u bil-patata.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'd like a beefsteak, please. Mark: How would you like it cooked? Lara: Well done, and with potatoes.
colloquial.zh: Lara：请给我一份牛排。Mark：您想要几分熟？Lara：全熟，配土豆。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq silta ċanga, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq silta ċanga, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我一份牛排。
messages.en: I'd like a beefsteak, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tixtieqha msajra?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tixtieqha msajra?
messages.zh: 您想要几分熟？
messages.en: How would you like it cooked?

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Imsajra sew, u bil-patata.
messages.mt_standard: Imsajra sew, u bil-patata.
messages.zh: 全熟，配土豆。
messages.en: Well done, and with potatoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 silta ċanga 整体贴在“一盘牛排配土豆”的画面上，再练习点餐句 Nixtieq silta ċanga，让词组与真实用餐动作一起进入记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a close association between organisms of different species.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与不同物种的生物之间密切共同生活的关系有关的；共生的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda relazzjoni mill-qrib bejn organiżmi ta' speċi differenti li jgħixu f'assoċjazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共生的；涉及不同物种的生物之间密切共同生活的关系的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' assoċjazzjoni mill-qrib bejn organiżmi ta' speċi differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A symbiotic relationship involves organisms of different species living in close association with one another.

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza rapport simbjotiku bejn żewġ speċi u jeżamina kif din l-assoċjazzjoni taffettwa lil kull waħda.
formal.en: The study analyses a symbiotic relationship between two species and examines how this association affects each one.
formal.zh: 该研究分析两个物种之间的共生关系，并考察这种联系如何影响其中每个物种。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn iż-żewġ organiżmi jgħinu lil xulxin? Mark: Iva, f'dan il-każ għandhom rapport simbjotiku u t-tnejn jibbenefikaw.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do these two organisms help each other? Mark: Yes, in this case they have a symbiotic relationship and both benefit.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这两种生物会互相帮助吗？Mark：会，在这个例子中，它们形成共生关系，而且双方都受益。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żewġ organiżmi jgħinu lil xulxin?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żewġ organiżmi jgħinu lil xulxin?
messages.zh: 这两种生物会互相帮助吗？
messages.en: Do these two organisms help each other?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'dan il-każ għandhom rapport simbjotiku u t-tnejn jibbenefikaw.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'dan il-każ għandhom rapport simbjotiku u t-tnejn jibbenefikaw.
messages.zh: 会，在这个例子中，它们形成共生关系，而且双方都受益。
messages.en: Yes, in this case they have a symbiotic relationship and both benefit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 simbjotiku 放进 rapport simbjotiku“共生关系”一起记，脑中画出两种生物紧密相伴生活的图像；双方受益只是这里的具体例子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having corresponding parts that match in shape and position across a line or around a point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各部分在线的两侧或围绕某一点，在形状和位置上相互对应的；对称的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandhom partijiet li jaqblu fil-forma u fil-pożizzjoni fuq naħat opposti ta' linja jew madwar punt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对称的；各部分相对于某条线或某个点，在形状与位置上相互对应的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandhom partijiet korrispondenti mqassma b'mod li jaqblu fuq iż-żewġ naħat ta' linja jew madwar punt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Shapes are symmetrical when their parts correspond in shape and position across a line or around a point.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti jridu jidentifikaw il-forom simettriċi u jimmarkaw l-assi ta' simetrija tagħhom.
formal.en: In the exercise, students must identify the symmetrical shapes and mark their axes of symmetry.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生需要找出对称的形状，并标出它们的对称轴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn iż-żewġ forom huma simettriċi? Rita: Iva, jekk titwihom tul il-linja mmarkata, iż-żewġ naħat jaqblu eżatt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these two shapes symmetrical? Rita: Yes, if you fold them along the marked line, the two sides match exactly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这两个形状都是对称的吗？Rita：是的，沿着标出的线折叠，两边就会完全重合。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żewġ forom huma simettriċi?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żewġ forom huma simettriċi?
messages.zh: 这两个形状都是对称的吗？
messages.en: Are these two shapes symmetrical?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk titwihom tul il-linja mmarkata, iż-żewġ naħat jaqblu eżatt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk titwihom tul il-linja mmarkata, iż-żewġ naħat jaqblu eżatt.
messages.zh: 是的，沿着标出的线折叠，两边就会完全重合。
messages.en: Yes, if you fold them along the marked line, the two sides match exactly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 forom simettriċi“对称的形状”，想象把纸上的爱心沿中线对折，两边重合，用这个画面记住“对称”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of sharing characteristics, or a particular feature that two or more things have in common.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个或多个事物具有共同特征的性质，也可指它们之间某个具体的相似之处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li żewġ affarijiet jew aktar għandhom karatteristiċi komuni, jew karatteristika partikolari li għandhom komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相似性；两个或多个事物共有特征的性质或具体的相似之处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li affarijiet ikunu jixxiebhu f'ċerti aspetti, jew aspett komuni li jagħmilhom jixxiebhu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A similarity is a shared feature between things, while similarity also refers to the general quality of being alike.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika similarità qawwija bejn iż-żewġ metodi, għalkemm ir-riżultati tagħhom mhumiex identiċi.
formal.en: The report indicates a strong similarity between the two methods, although their results are not identical.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这两种方法具有很强的相似性，尽管它们的结果并不完全相同。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara xi similarità bejn dawn iż-żewġ ritratti? Mark: Iva, it-tnejn juru triq dejqa b'djar ikkuluriti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see any similarity between these two photographs? Mark: Yes, both show a narrow street with colourful houses.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看得出这两张照片有什么相似之处吗？Mark：看得出，两张都拍了一条有彩色房屋的狭窄街道。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara xi similarità bejn dawn iż-żewġ ritratti?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara xi similarità bejn dawn iż-żewġ ritratti?
messages.zh: 你看得出这两张照片有什么相似之处吗？
messages.en: Can you see any similarity between these two photographs?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tnejn juru triq dejqa b'djar ikkuluriti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tnejn juru triq dejqa b'djar ikkuluriti.
messages.zh: 看得出，两张都拍了一条有彩色房屋的狭窄街道。
messages.en: Yes, both show a narrow street with colourful houses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 similarità 当作可以指出来的“相似之处”：比较两张照片，圈出共同的街道和房屋，再用 similarità 给这些共同点命名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having characteristics in common with another person or thing without necessarily being identical.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个人或事物具有共同特征、但不一定完全相同的；相似的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu karatteristiċi komuni ma' persuna jew ħaġa oħra, mingħajr ma jkun neċessarjament identiku għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相似的；在某些特征或方面与另一个人或事物相近的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jixbah lil persuna jew ħaġa oħra f'aspett wieħed jew aktar, iżda mhux bilfors ikun eżatt bħalha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If two things are similar, they share noticeable characteristics but may still differ in other ways.

formal.mt: Ir-riżultati tat-tieni esperiment huma simili għal dawk tal-ewwel, iżda hemm differenza żgħira fil-kejl finali.
formal.en: The results of the second experiment are similar to those of the first, but there is a small difference in the final measurement.
formal.zh: 第二次实验的结果与第一次的相似，但最终测量值存在细微差异。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-flokk huwa simili għal tiegħek, hux? Mark: Iva, il-kulur huwa kważi l-istess, imma tiegħi għandu bwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: This shirt is similar to yours, isn't it? Mark: Yes, the colour is almost the same, but mine has pockets.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这件衬衫和你的很像，对吧？Mark：对，颜色几乎一样，不过我的有口袋。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-flokk huwa simili għal tiegħek, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-flokk huwa simili għal tiegħek, hux?
messages.zh: 这件衬衫和你的很像，对吧？
messages.en: This shirt is similar to yours, isn't it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kulur huwa kważi l-istess, imma tiegħi għandu bwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kulur huwa kważi l-istess, imma tiegħi għandu bwiet.
messages.zh: 对，颜色几乎一样，不过我的有口袋。
messages.en: Yes, the colour is almost the same, but mine has pockets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 simili għal“与……相似”整块记忆：想象两件颜色相近、口袋不同的衬衫，用 simili 描述它们很像但不完全一样。

gloss_zh: 简化的；经过简化处理的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made easier to understand or use by reducing complexity or removing unnecessary detail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过降低复杂程度或删去不必要细节，使内容更容易理解或使用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmul aktar faċli biex jinftiehem jew jintuża billi titnaqqas il-kumplessità jew jitneħħew dettalji mhux meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过简化而更容易理解、操作或使用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li sar aktar sempliċi u aktar faċli biex jinftiehem jew jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is simplified has been made less complicated so that people can understand or use it more easily.

formal.mt: L-għalliema ħejjiet test simplifikat biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jifhmu aħjar l-ideat ewlenin.
formal.en: The teacher prepared a simplified text so that the students could understand the main ideas better.
formal.zh: 老师准备了一篇简化后的文本，让学生能够更好地理解主要观点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-test għadu diffiċli għalija. Pawlu: Għandi test simplifikat tal-istess storja. Trid taqrah?
colloquial.en: Maja: This text is still difficult for me. Pawlu: I have a simplified text of the same story. Would you like to read it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章对我来说还是很难。Pawlu：我有同一个故事的简化文本。你想读读吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-test għadu diffiċli għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-test għadu diffiċli għalija.
messages.zh: 这篇文章对我来说还是很难。
messages.en: This text is still difficult for me.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi test simplifikat tal-istess storja. Trid taqrah?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi test simplifikat tal-istess storja. Trid taqrah?
messages.zh: 我有同一个故事的简化文本。你想读读吗？
messages.en: I have a simplified text of the same story. Would you like to read it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把复杂文章删去枝节，留下容易读懂的版本：simplifikat 强调已经简化后的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or result of making something less complicated and easier to understand or carry out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物不那么复杂、更容易理解或执行的过程，或这一过程产生的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir inqas kumplessa u aktar faċli biex tinftiehem jew titwettaq, jew ir-riżultat ta' dan il-proċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关手续或程序的简化，使相关申报和办理过程更便捷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tnaqqis tal-kumplessità tal-proċeduri doganali biex id-dikjarazzjonijiet u l-formalitajiet ikunu aktar faċli biex jitwettqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs simplification is the process of making customs procedures less complicated and easier for people or businesses to complete.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简化；降低内容、方法或程序复杂程度的过程或结果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat li xi ħaġa ssir aktar sempliċi billi titnaqqas il-kumplessità tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Simplification is the process of making something easier to understand or do by reducing its complexity.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi s-simplifikazzjoni tal-proċeduri biex jitnaqqas iż-żmien meħtieġ għall-ipproċessar tal-applikazzjonijiet.
formal.en: The report proposes the simplification of procedures to reduce the time needed to process applications.
formal.zh: 报告建议简化程序，以缩短处理申请所需的时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-formola fiha wisq mistoqsijiet. Mark: Naqbel. Hemm bżonn ta' simplifikazzjoni biex tkun aktar faċli biex timtela.
colloquial.en: Sara: This form has too many questions. Mark: I agree. It needs simplification to make it easier to fill in.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这张表格的问题太多了。Mark：我同意。需要简化一下，让它更容易填写。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-formola fiha wisq mistoqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-formola fiha wisq mistoqsijiet.
messages.zh: 这张表格的问题太多了。
messages.en: This form has too many questions.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel. Hemm bżonn ta' simplifikazzjoni biex tkun aktar faċli biex timtela.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel. Hemm bżonn ta' simplifikazzjoni biex tkun aktar faċli biex timtela.
messages.zh: 我同意。需要简化一下，让它更容易填写。
messages.en: I agree. It needs simplification to make it easier to fill in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把十步流程画成三步流程，整个化繁为简的过程就是 simplifikazzjoni；海关语境中可指手续简化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making customs procedures and formalities less complicated and easier to complete.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 降低海关程序和手续的复杂程度，使相关申报及办理过程更便捷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-proċeduri u l-formalitajiet doganali jsiru inqas kumplessi u aktar faċli biex jitwettqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关手续简化；使海关申报及相关程序更简便的过程或安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-arranġamenti li jagħmlu d-dikjarazzjonijiet u l-proċeduri doganali aktar sempliċi biex jitwettqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs simplification involves making customs declarations and related procedures easier for traders or other users to complete.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简化，即降低事物复杂程度的过程或结果；本词组将这一概念限定在海关事务中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat li xi ħaġa ssir inqas kumplessa; f'din il-frażi, dan jirreferi għall-qasam doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Simplification means making something less complicated; in this phrase, it concerns customs procedures and formalities.

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi miżuri ta' simplifikazzjoni doganali maħsuba biex inaqqsu x-xogħol amministrattiv għall-importaturi.
formal.en: The document describes customs simplification measures intended to reduce administrative work for importers.
formal.zh: 该文件介绍了旨在减少进口商行政事务负担的海关手续简化措施。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi s-simplifikazzjoni doganali? Toni: Tfisser li l-proċeduri tad-dwana jsiru inqas ikkumplikati, pereżempju billi titnaqqas l-informazzjoni li tintalab darbtejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is customs simplification? Toni: It means making customs procedures less complicated, for example by reducing the information requested twice.
colloquial.zh: Lara：什么是海关手续简化？Toni：就是让海关程序更简便，例如减少重复索取的信息。

messages.speaker: Lara (进口公司新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi s-simplifikazzjoni doganali?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi s-simplifikazzjoni doganali?
messages.zh: 什么是海关手续简化？
messages.en: What is customs simplification?

messages.speaker: Toni (进口公司同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-proċeduri tad-dwana jsiru inqas ikkumplikati, pereżempju billi titnaqqas l-informazzjoni li tintalab darbtejn.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-proċeduri tad-dwana jsiru inqas ikkumplikati, pereżempju billi titnaqqas l-informazzjoni li tintalab darbtejn.
messages.zh: 就是让海关程序更简便，例如减少重复索取的信息。
messages.en: It means making customs procedures less complicated, for example by reducing the information requested twice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组分成意义上的两块来记：simplifikazzjoni 是简化，doganali 限定海关事务，合起来就是海关手续简化。

gloss_zh: 过于简单化的；把问题看得过于简单的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Treating a complicated subject as much simpler than it really is and ignoring important details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把复杂问题看得过于简单，因而忽略重要细节或因素的，通常含批评意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jittratta suġġett kumpless bħallikieku kien ħafna aktar sempliċi milli hu, u jinjora dettalji jew fatturi importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过于简单化的；因忽视复杂性或重要因素而显得片面的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jippreżenta jew jinterpreta xi ħaġa b'mod sempliċi żżejjed u ma jqisx il-kumplessità jew il-fatturi importanti tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe an explanation or approach as simplistic, you mean that it ignores important details and makes a complicated matter seem too simple.

collocations.zh: 过于简单化的处理方式

formal.mt: L-awtur iwissi li approċċ simplistiku għall-problema jista' jinjora d-differenzi importanti bejn il-każijiet.
formal.en: The author warns that a simplistic approach to the problem may ignore important differences between cases.
formal.zh: 作者提醒，过于简单化地处理这一问题，可能会忽略各个案例之间的重要差异。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jekk nistudja aktar sigħat, żgur nieħu marka aħjar. Sara: Dak hu ħsieb simplistiku. Jgħodd ukoll kif tistudja u kemm tistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: If I study for more hours, I will definitely get a better mark. Sara: That is simplistic thinking. How you study and how much you rest matter too.
colloquial.zh: Mark：只要多学几个小时，我肯定就能考得更好。Sara：这个想法太简单化了。学习方法和休息时间也很重要。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk nistudja aktar sigħat, żgur nieħu marka aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk nistudja aktar sigħat, żgur nieħu marka aħjar.
messages.zh: 只要多学几个小时，我肯定就能考得更好。
messages.en: If I study for more hours, I will definitely get a better mark.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu ħsieb simplistiku. Jgħodd ukoll kif tistudja u kemm tistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu ħsieb simplistiku. Jgħodd ukoll kif tistudja u kemm tistrieħ.
messages.zh: 这个想法太简单化了。学习方法和休息时间也很重要。
messages.en: That is simplistic thinking. How you study and how much you rest matter too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住批评语气：把复杂问题硬说成一句话就能解决，是 simplistiku；理解时要抓住过于简单、遗漏关键因素。

gloss_zh: 专题研讨会；学术研讨会

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal meeting at which participants present and discuss ideas about a particular subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕某一专题举行的正式会议，参与者在会上发表见解并进行讨论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqgħa formali li fiha l-parteċipanti jippreżentaw u jiddiskutu ideat dwar suġġett partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就某一特定主题进行报告、交流和讨论的正式研讨会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Laqgħa formali ddedikata għal suġġett partikolari, li fiha jsiru preżentazzjonijiet u diskussjonijiet bejn il-parteċipanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A symposium is a formal meeting where people present and discuss ideas about a particular subject.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat organizza simpożjum biex ir-riċerkaturi jiddiskutu r-riżultati tal-istudji tagħhom.
formal.en: The committee organized a symposium so that researchers could discuss the results of their studies.
formal.zh: 委员会组织了一场专题研讨会，供研究人员讨论各自的研究成果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tmur għas-simpożjum għada? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nisma' l-preżentazzjonijiet u nieħu sehem fid-diskussjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to the symposium tomorrow? Mark: Yes, I'd like to hear the presentations and take part in the discussion.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你明天去参加专题研讨会吗？Mark：去，我想听听报告，也参与讨论。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tmur għas-simpożjum għada?
messages.mt_standard: Se tmur għas-simpożjum għada?
messages.zh: 你明天去参加专题研讨会吗？
messages.en: Are you going to the symposium tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nisma' l-preżentazzjonijiet u nieħu sehem fid-diskussjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nisma' l-preżentazzjonijiet u nieħu sehem fid-diskussjoni.
messages.zh: 去，我想听听报告，也参与讨论。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to hear the presentations and take part in the discussion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“同一专题、多人报告、共同讨论”的会议画面绑定，记住它表示专题研讨会。

gloss_zh: 合规模拟；合规情境演练

teaching_sense.en_definition: A simulated exercise used to examine how rules or requirements are followed in a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过模拟某种情境，演练或检查如何遵守规则及相关要求的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżerċizzju li jissimula sitwazzjoni partikolari biex jiġi eżaminat kif jiġu segwiti regoli jew rekwiżiti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 模拟实际情境，以演练或检验遵守规定和要求的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżerċizzju f'sitwazzjoni simulata li jintuża biex jiġi pprattikat jew eżaminat il-ħarsien ta' regoli u rekwiżiti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A compliance simulation is an exercise that models a situation to examine how people or processes follow relevant rules and requirements.

collocations.en: the results of the compliance simulation

formal.mt: It-tim wettaq simulazzjoni ta' konformità biex jeżamina jekk il-proċeduri proposti jissodisfawx ir-rekwiżiti kollha.
formal.en: The team carried out a compliance simulation to examine whether the proposed procedures met all the requirements.
formal.zh: 团队开展了一次合规模拟，以检查拟议的程序是否满足全部要求。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se nagħmlu fit-taħriġ illum? Pawlu: Se nagħmlu simulazzjoni ta' konformità u naraw jekk insegwux ir-regoli kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are we doing in today's training? Pawlu: We're doing a compliance simulation to see whether we follow all the rules.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天的培训要做什么？Pawlu：我们要做一次合规模拟，看看是否遵守了所有规则。

messages.speaker: Sara (参训员工)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nagħmlu fit-taħriġ illum?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nagħmlu fit-taħriġ illum?
messages.zh: 今天的培训要做什么？
messages.en: What are we doing in today's training?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (培训师)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nagħmlu simulazzjoni ta' konformità u naraw jekk insegwux ir-regoli kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Se nagħmlu simulazzjoni ta' konformità u naraw jekk insegwux ir-regoli kollha.
messages.zh: 我们要做一次合规模拟，看看是否遵守了所有规则。
messages.en: We're doing a compliance simulation to see whether we follow all the rules.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先模拟情境，再逐条核对规定”的画面记忆整个短语，把它理解为一次合规演练。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building where Jewish people gather for prayer, religious study, and community activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 犹太人聚集祈祷、学习宗教知识并开展社群活动的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini fejn il-Lhud jinġabru għat-talb, għall-istudju reliġjuż u għal attivitajiet tal-komunità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供犹太人集体祈祷、进行宗教学习及社群活动的会堂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post ta' qima Lhudi fejn il-membri tal-komunità jinġabru biex jitolbu, jistudjaw u jieħdu sehem f'attivitajiet komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A synagogue is a building where Jewish people meet for worship, religious study, and community activities.

formal.mt: Il-membri tal-komunità nġabru fis-sinagoga għat-talb.
formal.en: The members of the community gathered in the synagogue for prayer.
formal.zh: 社群成员聚集在犹太会堂祈祷。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn sejjer dalgħodu? David: Se mmur fis-sinagoga biex nitlob mal-komunità.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where are you going this morning? David: I'm going to the synagogue to pray with the community.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你今天早上去哪里？David：我要去犹太会堂，和社群成员一起祈祷。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn sejjer dalgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn sejjer dalgħodu?
messages.zh: 你今天早上去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going this morning?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur fis-sinagoga biex nitlob mal-komunità.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur fis-sinagoga biex nitlob mal-komunità.
messages.zh: 我要去犹太会堂，和社群成员一起祈祷。
messages.en: I'm going to the synagogue to pray with the community.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时配上“犹太社群在会堂共同祈祷”的画面，并把 sinagoga 与中文“犹太会堂”成对复习。

gloss_zh: 爱管闲事的；爱打听别人私事的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Too interested in other people's private affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容过分关注、打听或干涉别人私事的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jistaqsi dwar il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor jew jindaħal fiha bla bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱窥探别人隐私、打听或干涉别人私事的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri kurżità żejda dwar l-affarijiet personali ta' ħaddieħor u jfittex li jkun jaf dak li ma jikkonċernahx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is sindicariou takes an excessive interest in other people's private affairs.

collocations.zh: 一个爱打听别人私事的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar huwa deskritt bħala bniedem sindicariou li jistaqsi dwar il-ħajja privata ta' kulħadd.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour is described as a nosy person who asks about everyone's private life.
formal.zh: 故事把这位邻居描写成一个爱打听别人私事的人，谁的私生活他都要问。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ġar dejjem jistaqsi min jiġi għandna? Toni: Huwa sindicariou; irid ikun jaf kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the neighbour always ask who comes to our place? Toni: He's nosy; he wants to know everything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：邻居为什么总问谁来我们家？托尼：他爱打听别人的事，什么都想知道。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ġar dejjem jistaqsi min jiġi għandna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ġar dejjem jistaqsi min jiġi għandna?
messages.zh: 邻居为什么总问谁来我们家？
messages.en: Why does the neighbour always ask who comes to our place?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa sindicariou; irid ikun jaf kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa sindicariou; irid ikun jaf kollox.
messages.zh: 他爱打听别人的事，什么都想知道。
messages.en: He's nosy; he wants to know everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sindicariou 放进“邻居总问谁来你家”的画面，记住它形容爱打听私事的人。

gloss_zh: 辛迪加；为共同利益组成的联合组织

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized group of people or businesses working together for a shared purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由个人或企业为共同目标、利益或项目而组成的联合组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda organizzata ta' persuni jew negozji li jaħdmu flimkien għal għan jew interess komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为共同经营、投资或维护共同利益而组成的个人或企业联合组织，亦称辛迪加。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp organizzat ta' persuni jew kumpaniji li jingħaqdu biex imexxu attività, jiffinanzjaw proġett jew iħarsu interess komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A syndicate is an organized group of people or businesses that cooperate in a shared activity or venture.

formal.mt: Sindikat ta' investituri se jiffinanzja l-proġett, u kull membru se jikkontribwixxi parti mill-kapital.
formal.en: A syndicate of investors will finance the project, with each member contributing part of the capital.
formal.zh: 一个投资者联合组织将为该项目提供资金，每位成员都会投入一部分资本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jħallas għal dan il-proġett? Mark: Sindikat ta' investituri; se jaqsmu l-ispejjeż bejniethom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who's going to pay for this project? Mark: A syndicate of investors; they'll share the costs.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个项目由谁出钱？马克：一个投资者联合组织，他们会分担费用。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jħallas għal dan il-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jħallas għal dan il-proġett?
messages.zh: 这个项目由谁出钱？
messages.en: Who's going to pay for this project?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sindikat ta' investituri; se jaqsmu l-ispejjeż bejniethom.
messages.mt_standard: Sindikat ta' investituri; se jaqsmu l-ispejjeż bejniethom.
messages.zh: 一个投资者联合组织，他们会分担费用。
messages.en: A syndicate of investors; they'll share the costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sindikat 想成几位投资者围桌合资的画面，抓住“多人联合、共同办事”的核心。

gloss_zh: 市长；镇长；地方议会首长

teaching_sense.en_definition: The head of a local council in a town, city, or village.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城镇或村庄地方议会的首长，通常对应市长或镇长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-persuna li tmexxi l-kunsill lokali ta' belt jew raħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市长或镇长，即主持地方议会并代表当地社区的首长。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kap tal-kunsill lokali li jmexxi l-ħidma tiegħu u jirrappreżenta l-belt jew ir-raħal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mayor is the head of a local council who represents a town, city, or village.

formal.mt: Is-sindku fetaħ il-laqgħa tal-kunsill lokali u ppreżenta l-pjan għat-titjib tal-pjazza.
formal.en: The mayor opened the local council meeting and presented the plan to improve the square.
formal.zh: 市长宣布地方议会会议开始，并介绍了广场改善计划。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Lil min nistgħu nkellmu dwar id-dawl fit-triq? Pawlu: Nistgħu nitkellmu mas-sindku fil-laqgħa ta' għada.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who can we speak to about the street lighting? Pawlu: We can speak to the mayor at tomorrow's meeting.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：街道照明的问题可以找谁谈？保罗：我们可以在明天的会议上找市长谈。

messages.speaker: Nina (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nistgħu nkellmu dwar id-dawl fit-triq?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nistgħu nkellmu dwar id-dawl fit-triq?
messages.zh: 街道照明的问题可以找谁谈？
messages.en: Who can we speak to about the street lighting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nitkellmu mas-sindku fil-laqgħa ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nitkellmu mas-sindku fil-laqgħa ta' għada.
messages.zh: 我们可以在明天的会议上找市长谈。
messages.en: We can speak to the mayor at tomorrow's meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 sindku 时想象主持地方议会、听居民反映路灯问题的市长，把人物与公共事务联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of barren land where little or nothing grows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 草木稀少或几乎没有植物生长的一片贫瘠土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda art għerja u fqira fejn ftit li xejn jikbru pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一片贫瘠、植被稀少或不长植物的荒地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda art bla veġetazzjoni jew bi ftit pjanti biss, minħabba li l-art hija fqira u ma tantx tipproduċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stretch of barren land is an area where little or no vegetation grows.

collocations.en: a stretch of barren land without trees
to cross the stretch of barren land

formal.mt: Bejn ir-raħal u l-għoljiet hemm sined fejn ftit li xejn jikbru pjanti.
formal.en: Between the village and the hills lies a stretch of barren land where very few plants grow.
formal.zh: 村庄与山丘之间有一片荒地，那里几乎没有植物生长。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm xi dell jekk naqsmu minn hemm? Ġanni: Le, irridu naqsmu sined bla siġar; aħjar nieħdu l-ilma magħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there any shade if we go that way? Ġanni: No, we have to cross a stretch of barren land without trees; we'd better take water with us.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：走那边有地方遮阴吗？詹尼：没有，我们得穿过一片没有树的荒地，最好带上水。

messages.speaker: Sara (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi dell jekk naqsmu minn hemm?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi dell jekk naqsmu minn hemm?
messages.zh: 走那边有地方遮阴吗？
messages.en: Is there any shade if we go that way?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irridu naqsmu sined bla siġar; aħjar nieħdu l-ilma magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irridu naqsmu sined bla siġar; aħjar nieħdu l-ilma magħna.
messages.zh: 没有，我们得穿过一片没有树的荒地，最好带上水。
messages.en: No, we have to cross a stretch of barren land without trees; we'd better take water with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sined 对应到徒步时经过的一整片贫瘠荒地，重点记住“土地成片、草木稀少”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substantial musical composition for an orchestra, usually divided into several movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为管弦乐队创作、通常分为若干乐章的大型器乐作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompożizzjoni mużikali kbira għal orkestra, ġeneralment maqsuma f'diversi movimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交响曲，通常由管弦乐队演奏、包含若干乐章的大型音乐作品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol mużikali għal orkestra li ġeneralment ikun magħmul minn diversi movimenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A symphony is a substantial piece of orchestral music that usually consists of several movements.

formal.mt: Fil-kunċert ta' nhar il-Ġimgħa, l-orkestra se ddoqq sinfonija magħmula minn erba' movimenti.
formal.en: At Friday's concert, the orchestra will play a symphony consisting of four movements.
formal.zh: 在星期五的音乐会上，管弦乐队将演奏一部由四个乐章组成的交响曲。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se ddoqq l-orkestra llejla? Mark: Sinfonija. Trid tiġi tismagħha miegħi? Lara: Iva, nixtieq nismagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What will the orchestra play tonight? Mark: A symphony. Would you like to come and listen to it with me? Lara: Yes, I'd like to hear it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：管弦乐队今晚会演奏什么？马克：一部交响曲。你想和我一起去听吗？拉拉：想，我很想听听。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se ddoqq l-orkestra llejla?
messages.mt_standard: X'se ddoqq l-orkestra llejla?
messages.zh: 管弦乐队今晚会演奏什么？
messages.en: What will the orchestra play tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sinfonija. Trid tiġi tismagħha miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Sinfonija. Trid tiġi tismagħha miegħi?
messages.zh: 一部交响曲。你想和我一起去听吗？
messages.en: A symphony. Would you like to come and listen to it with me?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nismagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nismagħha.
messages.zh: 想，我很想听听。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to hear it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sinfonija 和音乐厅里的整支管弦乐队联系起来，再想象节目单上的几个乐章，记住它指一部交响曲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The grammatical number used for a word or form referring to one person, thing, or instance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示一个人、一件事物或一个实例的语法数，与复数相对。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd grammatikali li jintuża meta kelma jew forma tirreferi għal persuna waħda, ħaġa waħda jew każ wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 单数，指词或词形表示一个人、一件事物等时所用的语法数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għadd grammatikali li jindika persuna waħda jew ħaġa waħda, b'differenza mill-plural.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The singular is the grammatical form used when referring to one person or thing.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jibdlu kull nom mis-singular għall-plural.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should change each noun from singular to plural.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应将每个名词从单数改为复数。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelma 'ktieb' hija fis-singular? Rita: Iva, għax qed nitkellmu dwar ktieb wieħed. Maja: U 'kotba' hija fil-plural, hux?
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the word 'ktieb' in the singular? Rita: Yes, because we're talking about one book. Maja: And 'kotba' is in the plural, right?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：ktieb 这个词是单数吗？丽塔：是的，因为我们说的是一本书。玛雅：那么 kotba 就是复数，对吧？

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelma 'ktieb' hija fis-singular?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelma 'ktieb' hija fis-singular?
messages.zh: ktieb 这个词是单数吗？
messages.en: Is the word 'ktieb' in the singular?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax qed nitkellmu dwar ktieb wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax qed nitkellmu dwar ktieb wieħed.
messages.zh: 是的，因为我们说的是一本书。
messages.en: Yes, because we're talking about one book.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: U 'kotba' hija fil-plural, hux?
messages.mt_standard: U 'kotba' hija fil-plural, hux?
messages.zh: 那么 kotba 就是复数，对吧？
messages.en: And 'kotba' is in the plural, right?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 singular 就在脑中放一本书，再用 ktieb 对照 kotba：前者表示一本，帮助你记住语法上的单数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The importance or meaningful value of something in a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物在特定情境中具有的重要性、价值或深层意义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-importanza jew il-valur li jkollha xi ħaġa f'sitwazzjoni jew f'kuntest partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重要性；某件事、某个行为或某种现象在特定背景下具有的意义和价值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-importanza li jkollha xi ħaġa minħabba dak li tirrappreżenta jew l-effett tagħha f'kuntest partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The significance of something is its importance or the meaningful value it has in a particular context.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega s-sinjifikat storiku tal-bini u r-rabta tiegħu mal-ħajja tal-komunità.
formal.en: The report explains the historical significance of the building and its connection with the life of the community.
formal.zh: 报告阐述了这座建筑的历史意义，以及它与社区生活的联系。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex din il-ġurnata għandha tant sinjifikat għalik? Pawlu: Għax dakinhar iltqajt ma' marti. Nina: Issa nifhem għaliex tiftakarha kull sena.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does this day have so much significance for you? Pawlu: Because that's the day I met my wife. Nina: Now I understand why you remember it every year.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么这一天对你这么有意义？保罗：因为那天我认识了我妻子。妮娜：现在我明白你为什么每年都记着这一天了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din il-ġurnata għandha tant sinjifikat għalik?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din il-ġurnata għandha tant sinjifikat għalik?
messages.zh: 为什么这一天对你这么有意义？
messages.en: Why does this day have so much significance for you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dakinhar iltqajt ma' marti.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dakinhar iltqajt ma' marti.
messages.zh: 因为那天我认识了我妻子。
messages.en: Because that's the day I met my wife.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem għaliex tiftakarha kull sena.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem għaliex tiftakarha kull sena.
messages.zh: 现在我明白你为什么每年都记着这一天了。
messages.en: Now I understand why you remember it every year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sinjifikat 放进纪念日的场景：日历上只是一天，对当事人却很重要；由此记住它表示重要性或重要意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Important enough to deserve attention, or expressing a meaning that can be understood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重要到值得注意的，或能够表达某种可理解意义的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu importanza biżżejjed biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni, jew li jesprimi tifsira li tista' tinftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重要的；影响或程度足以引起注意的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu importanza jew effett biżżejjed biex jistħoqqlu l-attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is significant is important enough to deserve attention or to make a noticeable difference.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有意义的；带有可理解的含义或传达某种信息的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu tifsira jew iwassal messaġġ li jista' jinftiehem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is significant in this sense carries a meaning or communicates an understandable message.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri progress sinjifikattiv fil-kwalità tas-servizz minn meta beda l-programm ta' taħriġ.
formal.en: The report shows significant progress in service quality since the training programme began.
formal.zh: 报告显示，自培训计划开始以来，服务质量有了显著提升。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħallejtlu nota biex nirringrazzjah tal-għajnuna. David: Dak ġest sinjifikattiv; juri li tapprezza dak li għamel. Sara: Iva, ridt nurih li l-għajnuna tiegħu kienet importanti għalija.
colloquial.en: Sara: I left him a note to thank him for his help. David: That's a meaningful gesture; it shows that you appreciate what he did. Sara: Yes, I wanted to show him that his help mattered to me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我给他留了张便条，感谢他的帮助。戴维：这个举动很有意义，能让他知道你感激他所做的事。萨拉：是的，我想让他知道，他的帮助对我很重要。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejtlu nota biex nirringrazzjah tal-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejtlu nota biex nirringrazzjah tal-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 我给他留了张便条，感谢他的帮助。
messages.en: I left him a note to thank him for his help.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ġest sinjifikattiv; juri li tapprezza dak li għamel.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ġest sinjifikattiv; juri li tapprezza dak li għamel.
messages.zh: 这个举动很有意义，能让他知道你感激他所做的事。
messages.en: That's a meaningful gesture; it shows that you appreciate what he did.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ridt nurih li l-għajnuna tiegħu kienet importanti għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ridt nurih li l-għajnuna tiegħu kienet importanti għalija.
messages.zh: 是的，我想让他知道，他的帮助对我很重要。
messages.en: Yes, I wanted to show him that his help mattered to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记住 sinjifikattiv：明显改善的成绩表示“重要、显著”，表达谢意的小举动表示“有意义、传达心意”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman who teaches children at a school.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在学校里教导儿童的女教师。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li tgħallem lit-tfal fi skola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学校里的女教师，尤指教导儿童的教师。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għalliema li taħdem fi skola u tgħallem lit-tfal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A schoolmistress is a woman whose job is to teach children at a school.

formal.mt: Is-sinjora tal-iskola ħejjiet lezzjoni ġdida biex tgħin lit-tfal jitgħallmu jaqraw.
formal.en: The schoolmistress prepared a new lesson to help the children learn to read.
formal.zh: 学校的女教师准备了一节新课，帮助孩子们学习阅读。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min għallmek taqra? Pawlu: Is-sinjora tal-iskola. Kienet tgħinni kuljum.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who taught you to read? Pawlu: The schoolmistress. She used to help me every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁教你读书认字的？保罗：学校的女教师。她以前每天都会帮助我。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għallmek taqra?
messages.mt_standard: Min għallmek taqra?
messages.zh: 谁教你读书认字的？
messages.en: Who taught you to read?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sinjora tal-iskola. Kienet tgħinni kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sinjora tal-iskola. Kienet tgħinni kuljum.
messages.zh: 学校的女教师。她以前每天都会帮助我。
messages.en: The schoolmistress. She used to help me every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sinjora 放进女教师教孩子阅读的课堂画面中记忆；本词条记作“女教师”，并留意它与 sinjura 的拼写区别。

gloss_zh: 小姐（对年轻或未婚女子的称呼）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A title or polite form of address for a young or unmarried woman.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于称呼年轻女子或未婚女子的称谓，相当于“小姐”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlu jew kelma ta' indirizz għal mara żagħżugħa jew mhux miżżewġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小姐；用在年轻女子或未婚女子姓氏之前，或直接称呼对方的称谓。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titlu li jintuża qabel kunjom mara żagħżugħa jew mhux miżżewġa, jew bħala kelma biex tindirizzaha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Miss is a title used before the surname of a young or unmarried woman, or when addressing her directly.

formal.mt: Is-Sinjorina Borg se tippreżenta l-proġett waqt il-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Miss Borg will present the project at tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: 博尔格小姐将在明天的会议上介绍这个项目。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Skużani, sinjorina, dan is-siġġu ħieles? Lara: Iva, tista' toqgħod hawn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Excuse me, miss, is this seat free? Lara: Yes, you can sit here.
colloquial.zh: 马克：打扰一下，小姐，这个座位有人吗？拉拉：没有，你可以坐这里。

messages.speaker: Mark (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, sinjorina, dan is-siġġu ħieles?
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, sinjorina, dan is-siġġu ħieles?
messages.zh: 打扰一下，小姐，这个座位有人吗？
messages.en: Excuse me, miss, is this seat free?

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' toqgħod hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' toqgħod hawn.
messages.zh: 没有，你可以坐这里。
messages.en: Yes, you can sit here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“Sinjorina Borg＝博尔格小姐”整组记忆，再练习 skużani, sinjorina，建立姓名前称谓与当面称呼两种用法的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lady, or a polite title used to address or refer to a woman, especially a married woman.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指女士，也可作为称呼或提及女性、尤其是已婚女性时使用的“夫人、太太”等称谓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara, jew titlu ta' rispett li jintuża biex tindirizza jew issemmi mara, speċjalment waħda miżżewġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夫人；太太；放在已婚女性姓氏之前的称谓。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titlu ta' rispett li jitqiegħed qabel il-kunjom ta' mara miżżewġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mrs is a title used before the surname of a married woman.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 太太；口语中对某人妻子的称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża f'taħdit familjari biex tirreferi għall-mara ta' xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's missus is their wife, referred to in informal conversation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女士；对成年女性的礼貌称呼或指称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mara adulta li tissemma jew tiġi indirizzata b'mod edukat u b'rispett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lady is a woman referred to or addressed in a polite and respectful way.

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Borg bagħtet it-talba tagħha bil-miktub lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: Mrs Borg sent her request to the office in writing.
formal.zh: 博尔格太太向办公室提交了书面申请。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Is-sinjura tiegħek ġejja magħna? Mark: Iva, is-sinjura tiegħi tasal fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Is your missus coming with us? Mark: Yes, my missus will arrive at eight.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你太太跟我们一起去吗？马克：是的，我太太八点到。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sinjura tiegħek ġejja magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Is-sinjura tiegħek ġejja magħna?
messages.zh: 你太太跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Is your missus coming with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, is-sinjura tiegħi tasal fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, is-sinjura tiegħi tasal fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 是的，我太太八点到。
messages.en: Yes, my missus will arrive at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景串记 sinjura：姓氏前是“某某太太”，is-sinjura tiegħi 是“我太太”，礼貌指称女性时是“女士”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the teeth on a toothed wheel that engages with another part to transmit motion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 齿轮上的一个凸齿，通过与其他部件啮合来传递运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda mis-snien ta' rota bis-snien li tidħol bejn is-snien ta' parti oħra biex tittrasmetti l-moviment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轮齿；齿轮边缘用于与另一部件啮合、传递运动的单个凸齿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sinna fuq it-tarf ta' rota li taqbad mas-snien ta' parti oħra sabiex il-moviment jgħaddi minn parti għal oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cog is one of the teeth on a wheel that engages with another part to transmit motion.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, it-tekniku sab sinna ta' rota miksura fil-mekkaniżmu.
formal.en: During the inspection, the technician found a broken cog in the mechanism.
formal.zh: 检查过程中，技术员发现机构内有一个断裂的轮齿。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ir-rota ma ddurx sew? Toni: Hemm sinna ta' rota miksura. Trid tissewwa qabel nerġgħu nużaw il-magna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why isn't the wheel turning properly? Toni: There's a broken cog. It needs to be repaired before we use the machine again.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个轮子为什么转得不顺？托尼：有一个轮齿断了。我们再次使用机器之前得把它修好。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ir-rota ma ddurx sew?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ir-rota ma ddurx sew?
messages.zh: 这个轮子为什么转得不顺？
messages.en: Why isn't the wheel turning properly?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm sinna ta' rota miksura. Trid tissewwa qabel nerġgħu nużaw il-magna.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm sinna ta' rota miksura. Trid tissewwa qabel nerġgħu nużaw il-magna.
messages.zh: 有一个轮齿断了。我们再次使用机器之前得把它修好。
messages.en: There's a broken cog. It needs to be repaired before we use the machine again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象齿轮边缘缺了一颗齿，用 sinna ta' rota 指着那一颗来记忆；把注意力放在单个轮齿上，帮助掌握这个短语的具体所指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the individual segments that make up a bulb of garlic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 组成一头大蒜的单独一瓣，常作为烹饪配料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda mill-partijiet separati li jiffurmaw ras tewm u li jintużaw fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒜瓣；一头大蒜中可以单独剥开的一瓣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sinna tewm hija parti waħda minn ras tewm, li tista' titqaxxar u tintuża biex tagħti t-togħma lill-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clove of garlic is one of the small separate segments inside a garlic bulb.

formal.mt: Żid sinna tewm mgħaffġa maż-żejt u sajjar għal minuta fuq nar baxx.
formal.en: Add a crushed clove of garlic to the oil and cook for one minute over low heat.
formal.zh: 在油中加入一瓣压碎的大蒜，用小火烹煮一分钟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm tewm għandi nżid maz-zalza? Mark: Żid sinna tewm waħda, u mbagħad doqha.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much garlic should I add to the sauce? Mark: Add one clove of garlic, then taste it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：酱汁里该加多少大蒜？Mark：先加一瓣，然后尝尝味道。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm tewm għandi nżid maz-zalza?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm tewm għandi nżid maz-zalza?
messages.zh: 酱汁里该加多少大蒜？
messages.en: How much garlic should I add to the sauce?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid sinna tewm waħda, u mbagħad doqha.
messages.mt_standard: Żid sinna tewm waħda, u mbagħad doqha.
messages.zh: 先加一瓣，然后尝尝味道。
messages.en: Add one clove of garlic, then taste it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一头蒜掰开，取出其中一瓣：sinna tewm 对应“一瓣大蒜”，记住计量单位是瓣。

gloss_zh: 教会会议；教会代表大会

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal assembly of church representatives that discusses religious or church matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由教会代表参加、讨论信仰或教会事务的正式会议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Assemblea formali ta' rappreżentanti tal-Knisja li jiltaqgħu biex jiddiskutu kwistjonijiet reliġjużi jew affarijiet tal-Knisja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教会会议；由主教或其他教会代表组成、商议教会事务的正式集会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sinodu huwa laqgħa formali ta' isqfijiet jew rappreżentanti oħra tal-Knisja biex jiddiskutu kwistjonijiet li jolqtu l-ħajja u l-ħidma tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A synod is a formal meeting of church representatives to discuss matters concerning their church.

formal.mt: Matul is-sinodu, ir-rappreżentanti tal-Knisja tkellmu dwar il-ħtiġijiet tal-komunitajiet lokali.
formal.en: During the synod, the church representatives spoke about the needs of local communities.
formal.zh: 在教会会议期间，教会代表讨论了当地各社区的需要。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se jsir is-sinodu? Pawlu: Fis-sala tal-Knisja; ir-rappreżentanti se jiltaqgħu hemm għada.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where will the synod take place? Pawlu: In the church hall; the representatives will meet there tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Anna：教会会议在哪里举行？Pawlu：在教会礼堂，代表们明天会在那里开会。

messages.speaker: Anna (教区志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se jsir is-sinodu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se jsir is-sinodu?
messages.zh: 教会会议在哪里举行？
messages.en: Where will the synod take place?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教区工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-sala tal-Knisja; ir-rappreżentanti se jiltaqgħu hemm għada.
