messages.mt_standard: Fis-sala tal-Knisja; ir-rappreżentanti se jiltaqgħu hemm għada.
messages.zh: 在教会礼堂，代表们明天会在那里开会。
messages.en: In the church hall; the representatives will meet there tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sinodu 和“教会代表围桌议事”的画面绑定，看到这个词就想到讨论教会事务的正式会议。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Words that have the same or nearly the same meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意义相同或非常接近的词，能否互换取决于具体语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li għandu l-istess tifsira jew tifsira simili ħafna, għalkemm mhux dejjem jista' jintuża minflok xulxin f'kull kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同义词或近义词，指意义相同或十分相近的一组词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sinonimi huma kliem li għandu l-istess tifsira jew tifsira qrib ħafna, iżda li jista' jvarja fl-użu skont il-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Synonyms are words with the same or very similar meanings, although their uses may differ.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom isibu żewġ sinonimi għal kull kelma u jużawhom f'sentenzi.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should find two synonyms for each word and use them in sentences.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应为每个词找出两个同义词，并用它们造句。

colloquial.mt: Lara: 'Ferħan' u 'kuntent' huma sinonimi? David: Iva, f'ħafna kuntesti għandhom tifsira simili, imma ara kif jintużaw fis-sentenza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are 'ferħan' and 'kuntent' synonyms? David: Yes, they have similar meanings in many contexts, but check how they are used in the sentence.
colloquial.zh: Lara：“ferħan”和“kuntent”是同义词吗？David：是的，它们在许多语境中意思相近，不过要看看它们在句子里怎么用。

messages.speaker: Lara (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Ferħan' u 'kuntent' huma sinonimi?
messages.mt_standard: 'Ferħan' u 'kuntent' huma sinonimi?
messages.zh: “ferħan”和“kuntent”是同义词吗？
messages.en: Are 'ferħan' and 'kuntent' synonyms?

messages.speaker: David (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'ħafna kuntesti għandhom tifsira simili, imma ara kif jintużaw fis-sentenza.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'ħafna kuntesti għandhom tifsira simili, imma ara kif jintużaw fis-sentenza.
messages.zh: 是的，它们在许多语境中意思相近，不过要看看它们在句子里怎么用。
messages.en: Yes, they have similar meanings in many contexts, but check how they are used in the sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sinonimi 记成词汇本里“意思相近的一组词”，每组配例句，帮助记住同义也要看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Presenting the main information about a subject together in a concise overview.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某一主题的主要信息集中呈现、便于整体查看和比较的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġbor u jippreżenta l-informazzjoni ewlenija dwar suġġett fil-qosor, b'mod li jagħti ħarsa ġenerali ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 概览性的；把主要内容汇集起来，以简明形式呈现整体情况的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa sinottika tippreżenta l-punti ewlenin ta' suġġett flimkien u fil-qosor, biex ikun aktar faċli tara l-istampa ġenerali u tqabbel l-informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A synoptic presentation brings the main facts together so that you can see a subject as a whole.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi qafas sinottiku li jiġbor l-għanijiet, l-attivitajiet u r-riżultati tal-proġett f'paġna waħda.
formal.en: The report includes a synoptic outline that brings together the project's objectives, activities, and results on one page.
formal.zh: 报告包含一份概览性提纲，将项目的目标、活动和成果汇集在一页中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek xi ħaġa li tiġbor il-kapitlu kollu fil-qosor? Luqa: Iva, għamilt qafas sinottiku; il-punti ewlenin qegħdin kollha f'paġna waħda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have something that summarizes the whole chapter? Luqa: Yes, I made a synoptic outline; all the main points are on one page.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你有概括整章内容的材料吗？Luqa：有，我做了一份概览性提纲，所有要点都在一页上。

messages.speaker: Sara (一起复习的同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xi ħaġa li tiġbor il-kapitlu kollu fil-qosor?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xi ħaġa li tiġbor il-kapitlu kollu fil-qosor?
messages.zh: 你有概括整章内容的材料吗？
messages.en: Do you have something that summarizes the whole chapter?

messages.speaker: Luqa (一起复习的同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għamilt qafas sinottiku; il-punti ewlenin qegħdin kollha f'paġna waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għamilt qafas sinottiku; il-punti ewlenin qegħdin kollha f'paġna waħda.
messages.zh: 有，我做了一份概览性提纲，所有要点都在一页上。
messages.en: Yes, I made a synoptic outline; all the main points are on one page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把整章要点放进一张总览表，用 sinottiku 描述这种集中呈现全貌的方式；搭配 tabella 时记作 sinottika。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to present something as obvious, expected, or readily agreed to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事显而易见、理所当然，或表示毫不犹豫地同意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex turi li xi ħaġa hija ovvja jew mistennija, jew biex tesprimi qbil bla tlaqliq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 当然；显然；自然如此，用于强调某事理所当然或表示爽快同意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li biha wieħed juri li xi ħaġa hija ovvja jew naturali, jew li jaqbel ma' dak li ntqal jew intalab.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You say sintendi when something seems obvious or when you readily agree to a request.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipazzjoni hija, sintendi, miftuħa għall-istudenti kollha.
formal.en: Participation is, of course, open to all students.
formal.zh: 当然，所有学生都可以参加。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' niġi magħkom għada? Lara: Sintendi! Niltaqgħu quddiem l-iskola fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I come with you tomorrow? Lara: Of course! We'll meet outside the school at nine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我明天可以跟你们一起去吗？拉拉：当然！我们九点在学校门口见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' niġi magħkom għada?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' niġi magħkom għada?
messages.zh: 我明天可以跟你们一起去吗？
messages.en: Can I come with you tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sintendi! Niltaqgħu quddiem l-iskola fid-disgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Sintendi! Niltaqgħu quddiem l-iskola fid-disgħa.
messages.zh: 当然！我们九点在学校门口见。
messages.en: Of course! We'll meet outside the school at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sintendi 和点头答应的画面一起记：朋友问能否同行，你爽快回答“当然！”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of mess or disorder in which things are confused or badly arranged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品凌乱或事情混乱、缺乏条理的一团糟状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' taħwid jew diżordni fejn l-affarijiet ma jkunux irranġati sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂乱无章、一团糟的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni ta' taħwid u nuqqas ta' ordni, fejn l-affarijiet ikunu mqiegħda jew organizzati ħażin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sintina is a mess in which things are untidy, confused, or poorly organized.

formal.mt: Wara ċ-ċaqliq tal-għamara, l-uffiċċju kien sintina sħiħa u kellu bżonn jiġi rranġat.
formal.en: After the furniture was moved, the office was a complete mess and needed to be tidied.
formal.zh: 搬动家具后，办公室一片狼藉，需要整理。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Għaliex ħallejt din is-sintina kollha fil-kċina? Pawlu: Kont qed nagħmel kejk. Issa nnaddaf kollox.
colloquial.en: Mother: Why did you leave this whole mess in the kitchen? Pawlu: I was making a cake. I'll clean everything up now.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：你怎么把厨房弄得这么乱？保罗：我刚才在做蛋糕，现在就把所有东西收拾干净。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallejt din is-sintina kollha fil-kċina?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallejt din is-sintina kollha fil-kċina?
messages.zh: 你怎么把厨房弄得这么乱？
messages.en: Why did you leave this whole mess in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont qed nagħmel kejk. Issa nnaddaf kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Kont qed nagħmel kejk. Issa nnaddaf kollox.
messages.zh: 我刚才在做蛋糕，现在就把所有东西收拾干净。
messages.en: I was making a cake. I'll clean everything up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 sintina 时想象做完蛋糕的厨房：面粉、碗盘到处都是，眼前就是“一团糟”。

gloss_zh: 症状的；表明某种问题的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to symptoms or serving as a sign of a condition or underlying problem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与症状有关的，或作为某种状况、潜在问题之征兆的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sintomi jew li jindika l-eżistenza ta' kundizzjoni jew problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与症状有关的；显示某种病况或潜在问题存在的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa marbut mas-sintomi jew li jservi bħala sinjal ta' kundizzjoni jew ta' problema li hemm warajh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is sintomatiku relates to symptoms or indicates that a particular condition or problem exists.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi d-dewmien ripetut bħala sintomatiku ta' nuqqas ta' koordinazzjoni bejn id-dipartimenti.
formal.en: The report describes the repeated delays as symptomatic of a lack of coordination between departments.
formal.zh: 报告指出，反复延误表明各部门之间缺乏协调。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jintilfu tant ordnijiet? Mark: Naħseb li dan it-taħwid hu sintomatiku ta' problema fis-sistema.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are so many orders getting lost? Mark: I think this confusion is symptomatic of a problem in the system.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么这么多订单都找不到了？马克：我觉得这种混乱表明系统存在问题。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jintilfu tant ordnijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jintilfu tant ordnijiet?
messages.zh: 为什么这么多订单都找不到了？
messages.en: Why are so many orders getting lost?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li dan it-taħwid hu sintomatiku ta' problema fis-sistema.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li dan it-taħwid hu sintomatiku ta' problema fis-sistema.
messages.zh: 我觉得这种混乱表明系统存在问题。
messages.en: I think this confusion is symptomatic of a problem in the system.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sintomatiku 放进“某现象表明某问题”的句框：反复延误是表象，协调不足是背后的问题。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A physical or mental change associated with an illness, or a sign of an underlying problem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与疾病有关的身体或心理变化，也可指反映潜在问题的征兆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla fil-ġisem jew fl-istat mentali marbuta ma' marda, jew sinjal li juri problema li hemm warajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 症状，即与疾病有关的身体或心理表现；也可指某种问题的征兆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Manifestazzjoni fiżika jew mentali marbuta ma' marda, jew sinjal li jindika l-eżistenza ta' problema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sintomu is a change associated with an illness, or a sign that an underlying problem exists.

formal.mt: Il-pazjent qal li l-ewwel sintomu kien uġigħ fil-griżmejn u li s-sogħla bdiet l-għada.
formal.en: The patient said that the first symptom was a sore throat and that the cough began the following day.
formal.zh: 患者表示，最初的症状是喉咙痛，第二天开始咳嗽。

colloquial.mt: Tabiba Rita: X'inhuma s-sintomi li għandek bħalissa? Pawlu: L-uniku sintomu li għandi bħalissa hu sogħla ħafifa.
colloquial.en: Dr Rita: What symptoms do you have at the moment? Pawlu: The only symptom I have at the moment is a mild cough.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔医生：你现在有哪些症状？保罗：我现在唯一的症状就是轻微咳嗽。

messages.speaker: Rita (医生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhuma s-sintomi li għandek bħalissa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhuma s-sintomi li għandek bħalissa?
messages.zh: 你现在有哪些症状？
messages.en: What symptoms do you have at the moment?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: L-uniku sintomu li għandi bħalissa hu sogħla ħafifa.
messages.mt_standard: L-uniku sintomu li għandi bħalissa hu sogħla ħafifa.
messages.zh: 我现在唯一的症状就是轻微咳嗽。
messages.en: The only symptom I have at the moment is a mild cough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用问诊画面记 sintomu：医生问身体有什么表现，你说出咳嗽或喉咙痛，这些就是“症状”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Genuine in feelings or intentions, or open and honest when expressing what one thinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感情或意图真实诚恳的；也指表达想法时坦率、不隐瞒的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu sentimenti jew intenzjonijiet ġenwini, jew li jesprimi dak li jaħseb b'mod miftuħ u onest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 真诚的；所表达的感情、信念或意图确实出自内心的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jesprimi sentimenti, twemmin jew intenzjonijiet ġenwini u li ma jippretendix li jħoss jew jemmen xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is sincere truly feels or believes what they express and does not pretend.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坦率的；愿意直接、诚实地表达真实想法而不加隐瞒的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jgħid dak li jaħseb b'mod dirett u onest, mingħajr ma jaħbi l-opinjoni vera tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is candid expresses their real opinions openly and honestly, including things that may be difficult to hear.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-evalwatur kien sinċier dwar in-nuqqasijiet tal-proġett u spjega kif setgħu jiġu indirizzati.
formal.en: In his report, the evaluator was candid about the project's shortcomings and explained how they could be addressed.
formal.zh: 评估人员在报告中坦率指出了项目的不足，并说明了可以如何解决这些问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kun sinċier miegħi: għoġbok id-diskors tiegħi? Mark: Iva, imma tkellimt ftit malajr. Il-messaġġ tiegħek kien ċar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Be honest with me: did you like my speech? Mark: Yes, but you spoke a little quickly. Your message was clear.
colloquial.zh: Maja：跟我说实话：你喜欢我的演讲吗？Mark：喜欢，不过你说得有点快。你要表达的意思很清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kun sinċier miegħi: għoġbok id-diskors tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Kun sinċier miegħi: għoġbok id-diskors tiegħi?
messages.zh: 跟我说实话：你喜欢我的演讲吗？
messages.en: Be honest with me: did you like my speech?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma tkellimt ftit malajr. Il-messaġġ tiegħek kien ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma tkellimt ftit malajr. Il-messaġġ tiegħek kien ċar.
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过你说得有点快。你要表达的意思很清楚。
messages.en: Yes, but you spoke a little quickly. Your message was clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景区分义项：朋友的关心出自内心是“真诚”，朋友直说演讲问题是“坦率”；两者都可用 sinċier。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large curtain in a theatre that opens or closes to reveal or conceal the stage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剧院中用于露出或遮住舞台的大幅幕布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Purtiera kbira fit-teatru li tinfetaħ jew tingħalaq biex turi jew taħbi l-palk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剧院舞台前用于遮挡舞台、在演出或场景开始和结束时开合的大幕。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Purtiera kbira quddiem il-palk ta' teatru li tinfetaħ jew tingħalaq fil-bidu jew fit-tmiem ta' rappreżentazzjoni jew xena.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A theatre curtain is a large curtain that opens to reveal the stage and closes to hide it.

formal.mt: Meta nfetaħ is-siparju, l-udjenza rat palk imżejjen bħala ġnien.
formal.en: When the theatre curtain opened, the audience saw a stage decorated as a garden.
formal.zh: 舞台大幕拉开时，观众看到了布置成花园的舞台。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex is-siparju għadu magħluq? Pawlu: Għax l-atturi għadhom qed iħejju l-palk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the curtain still closed? Pawlu: Because the actors are still preparing the stage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大幕怎么还没拉开？保罗：因为演员们还在准备舞台。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex is-siparju għadu magħluq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex is-siparju għadu magħluq?
messages.zh: 大幕怎么还没拉开？
messages.en: Why is the curtain still closed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-atturi għadhom qed iħejju l-palk.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-atturi għadhom qed iħejju l-palk.
messages.zh: 因为演员们还在准备舞台。
messages.en: Because the actors are still preparing the stage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 siparju 与剧院开场时拉开的大幕画面绑定，再用“幕前看戏、幕后候场”帮助记住它指舞台幕布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An imaginary sea creature with a woman's upper body and a fish's tail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 传说中上半身为女性、下半身为鱼尾的海中生物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejqa immaġinarja tal-baħar li għandha l-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem ta' mara u denb ta' ħuta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美人鱼，故事或传说中具有女性上半身和鱼尾的海中生物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlejqa tal-baħar fil-ħrejjef u l-leġġendi, bil-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem ta' mara u b'denb ta' ħuta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mermaid is an imaginary sea creature whose upper body is a woman's and whose lower body is a fish's tail.

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, is-sirena tgħix fil-baħar u tgħin lil baħri jsib it-triq lejn id-dar.
formal.en: In the story, the mermaid lives in the sea and helps a sailor find his way home.
formal.zh: 故事中，美人鱼生活在海里，并帮助一名水手找到回家的路。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tpinġi? Nina: Sirena b'denb aħdar. Lara: Ħa nżidilha ħuta żgħira ħdejha!
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you drawing? Nina: A mermaid with a green tail. Lara: Let me add a little fish beside her!
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你在画什么？妮娜：一条长着绿色尾巴的美人鱼。劳拉：让我在她旁边添一条小鱼吧！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tpinġi?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tpinġi?
messages.zh: 你在画什么？
messages.en: What are you drawing?

messages.speaker: Nina (画画的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sirena b'denb aħdar.
messages.mt_standard: Sirena b'denb aħdar.
messages.zh: 一条长着绿色尾巴的美人鱼。
messages.en: A mermaid with a green tail.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa nżidilha ħuta żgħira ħdejha!
messages.mt_standard: Ħa nżidilha ħuta żgħira ħdejha!
messages.zh: 让我在她旁边添一条小鱼吧！
messages.en: Let me add a little fish beside her!

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习本义时，把 sirena 配上一幅“女性上身加鱼尾”的童话图，再用 denb ta' sirena 复习美人鱼的尾巴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device with a barrel and a plunger used to inject a liquid into the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有筒体和活塞、用于将液体注入体内的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument b'ċilindru u pistun li jintuża biex jiddaħħal likwidu fil-ġisem permezz ta' injezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于向体内注入药液等液体的注射器，通常具有筒体和可推动的活塞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument li jintuża biex jingħata likwidu fil-ġisem b'injezzjoni, u li għandu ċilindru u pistun li jiċċaqlaq fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An injection syringe is a device with a barrel and plunger that is used to inject liquid into the body.

collocations.en: the plunger of the injection syringe

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni, l-għalliema wriet siringa għall-injezzjoni u spjegat il-funzjoni taċ-ċilindru u tal-pistun.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher showed an injection syringe and explained the function of the barrel and the plunger.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师展示了一支注射用注射器，并解释了筒体和活塞的作用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din siringa għall-injezzjoni? Rita: Iva, u din il-parti li tiċċaqlaq tissejjaħ il-pistun.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this an injection syringe? Rita: Yes, and this moving part is called the plunger.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这是注射用的注射器吗？丽塔：是的，这个能移动的部件叫活塞。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din siringa għall-injezzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Din siringa għall-injezzjoni?
messages.zh: 这是注射用的注射器吗？
messages.en: Is this an injection syringe?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u din il-parti li tiċċaqlaq tissejjaħ il-pistun.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u din il-parti li tiċċaqlaq tissejjaħ il-pistun.
messages.zh: 是的，这个能移动的部件叫活塞。
messages.en: Yes, and this moving part is called the plunger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“器具加用途”记整个短语：siringa 是注射器，għall-injezzjoni 表示用于注射；联想筒体与活塞的课堂示意图。

gloss_zh: 乳房内给药注射器；乳腺内给药注射器

teaching_sense.en_definition: A veterinary syringe designed to deliver a preparation into an animal's mammary gland through the teat canal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 兽医使用的专用注射器，用于经乳头管将制剂送入动物乳腺内。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siringa għall-użu veterinarju maħsuba biex iddaħħal preparazzjoni fil-glandola mammarja ta' annimal mill-kanal tal-beżżula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乳腺内给药用的兽医专用注射器，经动物乳头管将药物制剂送入乳腺内。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Siringa veterinarja maħsuba biex tagħti preparazzjoni mediċinali direttament fil-glandola mammarja ta' annimal permezz tal-kanal tal-beżżula.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intramammary syringe is a veterinary device used to deliver a medicinal preparation into an animal's mammary gland through the teat canal.

collocations.en: an intramammary syringe for veterinary use
collocations.zh: 兽医用乳腺内给药注射器

collocations.en: the tip of the intramammary syringe
collocations.zh: 乳腺内给药注射器的尖端

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ veterinarju, l-għalliema wriet siringa intramammarja u spjegat li tintuża biex tingħata preparazzjoni fil-glandola mammarja mill-kanal tal-beżżula.
formal.en: During veterinary training, the teacher showed an intramammary syringe and explained that it is used to deliver a preparation into the mammary gland through the teat canal.
formal.zh: 兽医培训中，老师展示了一支乳腺内给药注射器，并解释说，它用于经乳头管将制剂送入乳腺内。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi din is-siringa? Pawlu: Din siringa intramammarja, għall-użu veterinarju. Lara: Jiġifieri tintuża għall-glandola mammarja? Pawlu: Iva, biex tingħata preparazzjoni mill-kanal tal-beżżula.
colloquial.en: Lara: What kind of syringe is this? Pawlu: This is an intramammary syringe, for veterinary use. Lara: So it is used for the mammary gland? Pawlu: Yes, to deliver a preparation through the teat canal.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这是什么注射器？保罗：这是兽医用的乳腺内给药注射器。劳拉：也就是说，它用于乳腺？保罗：对，用来经乳头管送入制剂。

messages.speaker: Lara (兽医专业学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din is-siringa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din is-siringa?
messages.zh: 这是什么注射器？
messages.en: What kind of syringe is this?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (兽医教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din siringa intramammarja, għall-użu veterinarju.
messages.mt_standard: Din siringa intramammarja, għall-użu veterinarju.
messages.zh: 这是兽医用的乳腺内给药注射器。
messages.en: This is an intramammary syringe, for veterinary use.

messages.speaker: Lara (兽医专业学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri tintuża għall-glandola mammarja?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri tintuża għall-glandola mammarja?
messages.zh: 也就是说，它用于乳腺？
messages.en: So it is used for the mammary gland?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (兽医教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biex tingħata preparazzjoni mill-kanal tal-beżżula.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biex tingħata preparazzjoni mill-kanal tal-beżżula.
messages.zh: 对，用来经乳头管送入制剂。
messages.en: Yes, to deliver a preparation through the teat canal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 siringa intramammarja 整体标在兽医乳腺示意图旁，记住“注射器加乳腺内给药用途”，并联想乳头管通向乳腺的路径。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A syringe supplied already filled with medicine and prepared for use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供应时已预先装入药液、备妥待用的注射器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siringa li tiġi fornuta diġà mimlija bil-mediċina u mħejjija għall-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预先装有药液、备妥待用的注射器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Siringa fornuta bil-mediċina diġà fiha, sabiex ma jkunx hemm bżonn timtela qabel l-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pre-filled syringe is a syringe supplied with medicine already inside it.

collocations.en: the packaging of a pre-filled syringe
a pre-filled syringe ready for use
collocations.zh: 备妥待用的预充式注射器

formal.mt: Il-lista tat-tagħmir tinkludi siringa mimlija lesta fl-imballaġġ oriġinali tagħha.
formal.en: The equipment list includes a pre-filled syringe in its original packaging.
formal.zh: 器材清单包括一支保留原包装的预充式注射器。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din is-siringa diġà mimlija? Pawlu: Iva, hija siringa mimlija lesta. Marta: Mela nifhem għaliex tissejjaħ hekk.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is this syringe already filled? Pawlu: Yes, it is a pre-filled syringe. Marta: Then I understand why it is called that.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这支注射器已经装好药液了吗？保罗：是的，这是一支预充式注射器。玛尔塔：那我明白为什么这样叫了。

messages.speaker: Marta (护理学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-siringa diġà mimlija?
messages.mt_standard: Din is-siringa diġà mimlija?
messages.zh: 这支注射器已经装好药液了吗？
messages.en: Is this syringe already filled?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (护理教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija siringa mimlija lesta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija siringa mimlija lesta.
messages.zh: 是的，这是一支预充式注射器。
messages.en: Yes, it is a pre-filled syringe.

messages.speaker: Marta (护理学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nifhem għaliex tissejjaħ hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nifhem għaliex tissejjaħ hekk.
messages.zh: 那我明白为什么这样叫了。
messages.en: Then I understand why it is called that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组想成一幅图：siringa 是注射器，mimlija 表示已装满，lesta 表示已备妥；连起来记作“药液预先装好、备妥待用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A syringe used to measure liquid medicine and administer it through the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于量取液体药物并经口给药的注射器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siringa li tintuża biex jitkejjel ammont ta' mediċina likwida u tingħata mill-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于量取并经口给予液体药物的口服给药注射器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Siringa maħsuba biex tkejjel mediċina likwida u twassalha fil-ħalq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An oral syringe is a device used to measure liquid medicine and give it through the mouth.

collocations.en: to measure medicine with an oral syringe
collocations.zh: 用口服给药注射器量取药液

collocations.en: the measurement markings on an oral syringe
collocations.zh: 口服给药注射器上的计量刻度

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega kif jinqraw il-marki tal-kejl fuq is-siringa tal-ħalq.
formal.en: The leaflet explains how to read the measurement markings on the oral syringe.
formal.zh: 说明单解释了如何读取口服给药注射器上的计量刻度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din x'tip ta' siringa hi? Marija: Hija siringa tal-ħalq, għall-mediċina likwida. Lara: U dawn il-marki juru l-volum? Marija: Iva, huma marki tal-kejl.
colloquial.en: Lara: What type of syringe is this? Marija: It is an oral syringe, for liquid medicine. Lara: And do these markings show the volume? Marija: Yes, they are measurement markings.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是什么类型的注射器？玛丽亚：这是口服给药注射器，用于液体药物。拉拉：这些刻度表示体积吗？玛丽亚：是的，这些是计量刻度。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din x'tip ta' siringa hi?
messages.mt_standard: Din x'tip ta' siringa hi?
messages.zh: 这是什么类型的注射器？
messages.en: What type of syringe is this?

messages.speaker: Marija (药剂师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija siringa tal-ħalq, għall-mediċina likwida.
messages.mt_standard: Hija siringa tal-ħalq, għall-mediċina likwida.
messages.zh: 这是口服给药注射器，用于液体药物。
messages.en: It is an oral syringe, for liquid medicine.

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: U dawn il-marki juru l-volum?
messages.mt_standard: U dawn il-marki juru l-volum?
messages.zh: 这些刻度表示体积吗？
messages.en: And do these markings show the volume?

messages.speaker: Marija (药剂师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma marki tal-kejl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma marki tal-kejl.
messages.zh: 是的，这些是计量刻度。
messages.en: Yes, they are measurement markings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用用途画面记忆：siringa 是注射器，ħalq 是嘴；看到 tal-ħalq，就联想到把量好的药液送入口中的口服给药工具。

gloss_zh: 消费税（针对特定商品征收）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tax charged on particular types of goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对特定类别商品征收的消费税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taxxa imposta fuq ċerti tipi ta' oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对特定类别商品征收的消费税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taxxa li titħallas fuq kategoriji speċifiċi ta' oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Excise duty is a tax charged on particular categories of goods.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri l-ammont tas-sisa separatament mill-prezz tal-prodott.
formal.en: The report shows the amount of excise duty separately from the product price.
formal.zh: 报告将消费税金额与商品价格分开列示。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhi din is-sisa fuq il-kont? Rita: Hija taxxa fuq dan it-tip ta' prodott. Mark: Diġà inkluża fit-total? Rita: Iva, inkluża fit-total li tara hawn.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is this excise duty on the bill? Rita: It is a tax on this type of product. Mark: Is it already included in the total? Rita: Yes, it is included in the total you see here.
colloquial.zh: 马克：账单上的这项消费税是什么？丽塔：这是对这类商品征收的税。马克：已经包含在总额里了吗？丽塔：是的，已经包含在你看到的这个总额里。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din is-sisa fuq il-kont?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din is-sisa fuq il-kont?
messages.zh: 账单上的这项消费税是什么？
messages.en: What is this excise duty on the bill?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija taxxa fuq dan it-tip ta' prodott.
messages.mt_standard: Hija taxxa fuq dan it-tip ta' prodott.
messages.zh: 这是对这类商品征收的税。
messages.en: It is a tax on this type of product.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà inkluża fit-total?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà inkluża fit-total?
messages.zh: 已经包含在总额里了吗？
messages.en: Is it already included in the total?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inkluża fit-total li tara hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inkluża fit-total li tara hawn.
messages.zh: 是的，已经包含在你看到的这个总额里。
messages.en: Yes, it is included in the total you see here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sisa 写在想象中的商品账单税额栏里，旁边标注“特定商品消费税”；再搭配“税率”和“缴纳”两个场景反复记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A digital system used to submit, process and manage customs information and procedures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于提交、处理和管理海关信息及办理海关手续的电子系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema diġitali li tintuża biex tiġi sottomessa, ipproċessata u ġestita informazzjoni doganali u biex jitwettqu proċeduri doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子海关，即通过电子系统办理海关业务的方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod kif jitwettqu servizzi u proċeduri doganali permezz ta' sistemi elettroniċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: eCustoms refers to the use of electronic systems to carry out customs activities.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子化海关业务，即以电子方式提交和处理报关等海关事务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-twettiq ta' attivitajiet doganali, bħas-sottomissjoni u l-ipproċessar ta' dikjarazzjonijiet, b'mezzi elettroniċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electronic customs involves handling customs information and procedures through electronic means.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子海关系统，用于接收、处理和管理海关资料及相关手续的数字化系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema diġitali li tirċievi, tipproċessa u tamministra data u dokumenti relatati mal-proċeduri doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electronic customs system is a digital platform used to manage customs data and procedures.

collocations.mt: tissottometti dikjarazzjoni permezz ta' sistema doganali elettronika
collocations.en: submit a declaration through an electronic customs system
collocations.zh: 通过电子海关系统提交申报

collocations.en: access to the electronic customs system
collocations.zh: 电子海关系统的访问权限

formal.mt: L-importatur issottometta d-dikjarazzjoni u d-dokumenti meħtieġa permezz tas-sistema doganali elettronika.
formal.en: The importer submitted the declaration and the required documents through the electronic customs system.
formal.zh: 进口商通过电子海关系统提交了申报及所需文件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Diġà bgħatt id-dikjarazzjoni? Rita: Iva, bgħattha permezz tas-sistema doganali elettronika. Mark: Tajjeb, allura nista' niċċekkja l-istatus tagħha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you sent the declaration yet? Rita: Yes, I sent it through the electronic customs system. Mark: Good, then I can check its status.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你已经发送申报了吗？Rita：是的，我通过电子海关系统发送了。Mark：好，那我可以查看申报状态了。

messages.speaker: Mark (进口业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà bgħatt id-dikjarazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà bgħatt id-dikjarazzjoni?
messages.zh: 你已经发送申报了吗？
messages.en: Have you sent the declaration yet?

messages.speaker: Rita (报关业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bgħattha permezz tas-sistema doganali elettronika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bgħattha permezz tas-sistema doganali elettronika.
messages.zh: 是的，我通过电子海关系统发送了。
messages.en: Yes, I sent it through the electronic customs system.

messages.speaker: Mark (进口业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, allura nista' niċċekkja l-istatus tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, allura nista' niċċekkja l-istatus tagħha.
messages.zh: 好，那我可以查看申报状态了。
messages.en: Good, then I can check its status.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组联系到“在电脑上向海关提交申报”的画面，按“系统—海关的—电子的”三个意义块记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system whose components are connected so that they can communicate or work together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各组成部分相互连接，能够交换信息或协同运行的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema li l-partijiet tagħha huma konnessi ma' xulxin sabiex ikunu jistgħu jikkomunikaw jew jaħdmu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 互联系统，指各部分相互连接、能够交换信息或共同运作的系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema magħmula minn partijiet li huma marbuta ma' xulxin u li jistgħu jaqsmu informazzjoni jew jaħdmu flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An interconnected system has parts that are linked together and can communicate or operate jointly.

collocations.mt: taqsam id-data permezz ta' sistema interkonnessa
collocations.en: share data through an interconnected system
collocations.zh: 通过互联系统共享数据

formal.mt: L-uffiċċji jużaw sistema interkonnessa biex jaqsmu l-informazzjoni u jikkoordinaw ix-xogħol tagħhom.
formal.en: The offices use an interconnected system to share information and coordinate their work.
formal.zh: 各办公室使用互联系统共享信息并协调工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi ndaħħal l-istess data f'kull uffiċċju? Pawlu: Le, għandna sistema interkonnessa u d-data tinqasam bejn l-uffiċċji. Maja: Tajjeb, hekk niffranka l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do I have to enter the same data in every office? Pawlu: No, we have an interconnected system, and the data is shared between the offices. Maja: Good, that saves me time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我得在每个办公室都录入同样的数据吗？Pawlu：不用，我们有互联系统，数据会在各办公室之间共享。Maja：好，这样我就省时间了。

messages.speaker: Maja (新入职员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ndaħħal l-istess data f'kull uffiċċju?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ndaħħal l-istess data f'kull uffiċċju?
messages.zh: 我得在每个办公室都录入同样的数据吗？
messages.en: Do I have to enter the same data in every office?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (办公室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandna sistema interkonnessa u d-data tinqasam bejn l-uffiċċji.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandna sistema interkonnessa u d-data tinqasam bejn l-uffiċċji.
messages.zh: 不用，我们有互联系统，数据会在各办公室之间共享。
messages.en: No, we have an interconnected system, and the data is shared between the offices.

messages.speaker: Maja (新入职员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, hekk niffranka l-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, hekk niffranka l-ħin.
messages.zh: 好，这样我就省时间了。
messages.en: Good, that saves me time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几间办公室之间都有连线，录入一次就能共享；用“系统里的各部分互相连通”记住整个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A framework of shared rules and arrangements governing trade among multiple countries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由多个国家共同参与，以共同规则和安排规范彼此贸易关系的体制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qafas ta' regoli u arranġamenti komuni li jirregola l-kummerċ bejn diversi pajjiżi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多边贸易体制，指多个国家通过共同规则与安排开展和规范贸易的制度框架。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qafas li fih diversi pajjiżi jmexxu r-relazzjonijiet kummerċjali tagħhom skont regoli u arranġamenti komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A multilateral trading system provides shared rules and arrangements for trade among several countries.

collocations.en: the rules of the multilateral trading system

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif sistema kummerċjali multilaterali tista' tgħin lill-pajjiżi jikkoordinaw ir-regoli dwar il-kummerċ.
formal.en: The report explains how a multilateral trading system can help countries coordinate trade rules.
formal.zh: 报告说明了多边贸易体制如何帮助各国协调贸易规则。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi sistema kummerċjali multilaterali? David: Hija qafas ta' regoli għall-kummerċ bejn diversi pajjiżi. Sara: Mela ħafna pajjiżi jużaw regoli komuni.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is a multilateral trading system? David: It is a framework of rules for trade among several countries. Sara: So many countries use shared rules.
colloquial.zh: Sara：什么是多边贸易体制？David：它是多个国家之间开展贸易所用的规则框架。Sara：也就是说，许多国家使用共同规则。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi sistema kummerċjali multilaterali?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi sistema kummerċjali multilaterali?
messages.zh: 什么是多边贸易体制？
messages.en: What is a multilateral trading system?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija qafas ta' regoli għall-kummerċ bejn diversi pajjiżi.
messages.mt_standard: Hija qafas ta' regoli għall-kummerċ bejn diversi pajjiżi.
messages.zh: 它是多个国家之间开展贸易所用的规则框架。
messages.en: It is a framework of rules for trade among several countries.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ħafna pajjiżi jużaw regoli komuni.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ħafna pajjiżi jużaw regoli komuni.
messages.zh: 也就是说，许多国家使用共同规则。
messages.en: So many countries use shared rules.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象许多国家围桌商定贸易规则，按“体制—贸易的—多边的”理解词组，把“多国共同规则”作为记忆中心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A digital system used to manage purchasing activities, including orders and supplier information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子方式管理采购活动的系统，可用于处理订单、供应商信息及相关采购流程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema diġitali li tintuża biex tmexxi l-proċess tax-xiri, inklużi l-ordnijiet u l-informazzjoni dwar il-fornituri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用电子平台办理采购业务的系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li tippermetti lil organizzazzjoni twettaq u ssegwi x-xiri tagħha permezz ta' pjattaforma elettronika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An e-purchasing system allows an organization to conduct and track its purchasing activities electronically.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以电子方式处理采购申请、订单及供应商资料的采购管理系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema elettronika li tintuża biex jiġu pproċessati t-talbiet għax-xiri, l-ordnijiet u d-dettalji tal-fornituri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electronic purchasing system processes purchasing requests, orders, and supplier details through digital tools.

collocations.mt: tissottometti ordni permezz tas-sistema ta' akkwist elettroniku
collocations.en: submit an order through the electronic purchasing system
collocations.zh: 通过电子采购系统提交订单

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni se tintroduċi sistema ta' akkwist elettroniku biex kull dipartiment ikun jista' jissottometti t-talbiet għax-xiri u jsegwi l-istat tagħhom.
formal.en: The organization will introduce an electronic purchasing system so that each department can submit purchasing requests and track their status.
formal.zh: 该机构将引入电子采购系统，使各部门能够提交采购申请并跟踪其处理状态。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif nordna l-karti għall-uffiċċju? Pawlu: Uża s-sistema ta' akkwist elettroniku; hemmhekk tista' tagħżel il-kwantità u tibgħat it-talba.
colloquial.en: Marta: How do I order paper for the office? Pawlu: Use the electronic purchasing system; you can choose the quantity and send the request there.
colloquial.zh: Marta：办公室用纸要怎么订？Pawlu：用电子采购系统，在里面选择数量，再提交申请。

messages.speaker: Marta (行政助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nordna l-karti għall-uffiċċju?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nordna l-karti għall-uffiċċju?
messages.zh: 办公室用纸要怎么订？
messages.en: How do I order paper for the office?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża s-sistema ta' akkwist elettroniku; hemmhekk tista' tagħżel il-kwantità u tibgħat it-talba.
messages.mt_standard: Uża s-sistema ta' akkwist elettroniku; hemmhekk tista' tagħżel il-kwantità u tibgħat it-talba.
messages.zh: 用电子采购系统，在里面选择数量，再提交申请。
messages.en: Use the electronic purchasing system; you can choose the quantity and send the request there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组联想成办公室的网上采购页面：选用品、填数量、交申请，用这个流程记住“电子采购系统”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A digital system used to request, order and manage purchases of goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于以电子方式提出采购需求、订购并管理商品或服务采购的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema diġitali li tintuża biex isiru talbiet għax-xiri, jintbagħtu ordnijiet u jiġi ġestit ix-xiri ta' oġġetti jew servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子采购系统，用于在线提出采购申请、下单及管理采购流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li tippermetti li talbiet għax-xiri, ordnijiet u passi oħra tal-proċess tax-xiri jsiru u jiġu ġestiti b'mod elettroniku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An e-purchasing system allows people or organizations to arrange and manage purchases electronically.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子化采购系统，通过数字化工具办理和管理商品或服务的采购。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li tuża għodod diġitali biex jitwettqu u jiġu amministrati proċessi ta' xiri ta' oġġetti jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electronic purchasing system uses digital tools to handle the purchase of goods or services.

collocations.mt: tagħmel ordni permezz ta' sistema ta' akkwist-e
collocations.en: place an order through an e-purchasing system
collocations.zh: 通过电子采购系统下单

formal.mt: Id-dipartiment juża sistema ta' akkwist-e biex jirreġistra t-talbiet għax-xiri u jsegwi l-ordnijiet.
formal.en: The department uses an e-purchasing system to record purchase requests and track orders.
formal.zh: 该部门使用电子采购系统登记采购申请并跟踪订单。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif nordna l-karti għall-uffiċċju? Karl: Uża s-sistema ta' akkwist-e u agħżel il-kwantità li għandek bżonn. Nina: Tajjeb, se nagħmel l-ordni issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do I order paper for the office? Karl: Use the e-purchasing system and select the quantity you need. Nina: Good, I'll place the order now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我怎么给办公室订纸张？Karl：使用电子采购系统，选择你需要的数量。Nina：好，我现在就下单。

messages.speaker: Nina (行政助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nordna l-karti għall-uffiċċju?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nordna l-karti għall-uffiċċju?
messages.zh: 我怎么给办公室订纸张？
messages.en: How do I order paper for the office?

messages.speaker: Karl (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża s-sistema ta' akkwist-e u agħżel il-kwantità li għandek bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Uża s-sistema ta' akkwist-e u agħżel il-kwantità li għandek bżonn.
messages.zh: 使用电子采购系统，选择你需要的数量。
messages.en: Use the e-purchasing system and select the quantity you need.

messages.speaker: Nina (行政助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se nagħmel l-ordni issa.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se nagħmel l-ordni issa.
messages.zh: 好，我现在就下单。
messages.en: Good, I'll place the order now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组和“在采购页面选物品、填数量、提交订单”的动作连起来，记作“办理电子采购的一套系统”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system in which participants organize their own dispatch or assignments rather than having each one allocated centrally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由参与者自行安排出动或任务分配，而非由中心逐项派遣的调度系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema li fiha l-parteċipanti jorganizzaw huma stess it-tluq tagħhom jew jagħżlu l-kompiti tagħhom, minflok ma jirċievu kull assenjazzjoni minn ċentru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 允许参与者自行安排出动或选择任务的自主调度系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li tippermetti lill-parteċipanti jiddeċiedu huma stess liema kompiti jieħdu jew meta jitilqu biex iwettquhom, mingħajr assenjazzjoni ċentrali għal kull każ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A self dispatch system lets participants arrange their own dispatch or select their assignments without a central dispatcher allocating each task.

collocations.mt: tagħżel kompitu permezz tas-sistema ta' awtodispaċċ
collocations.en: select a task through the self dispatch system
collocations.zh: 通过自主调度系统选择任务

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tat-trasport introduċiet sistema ta' awtodispaċċ li tippermetti lis-sewwieqa jagħżlu vjaġġi disponibbli skont il-ħin u l-kapaċità tagħhom.
formal.en: The transport company introduced a self dispatch system that allows drivers to select available trips according to their time and capacity.
formal.zh: 这家运输公司引入了自主调度系统，允许司机根据自己的时间和运力选择可接的运输任务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Irrid nistenna lil xi ħadd jagħtini vjaġġ? Toni: Le, bis-sistema ta' awtodispaċċ tista' tagħżel int vjaġġ mil-lista.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do I have to wait for someone to assign me a trip? Toni: No, with the self dispatch system you can choose a trip yourself from the list.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我要等别人给我派运输任务吗？Toni：不用，有了自主调度系统，你可以自己从列表里选任务。

messages.speaker: Lara (新入职司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nistenna lil xi ħadd jagħtini vjaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nistenna lil xi ħadd jagħtini vjaġġ?
messages.zh: 我要等别人给我派运输任务吗？
messages.en: Do I have to wait for someone to assign me a trip?

messages.speaker: Toni (司机同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bis-sistema ta' awtodispaċċ tista' tagħżel int vjaġġ mil-lista.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bis-sistema ta' awtodispaċċ tista' tagħżel int vjaġġ mil-lista.
messages.zh: 不用，有了自主调度系统，你可以自己从列表里选任务。
messages.en: No, with the self dispatch system you can choose a trip yourself from the list.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象司机打开任务列表，自己选单并安排出发；用“自己选择、自己安排”的画面记住“自主调度系统”。

gloss_zh: 尽职调查制度；尽职调查系统

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized set of procedures for gathering information, checking relevant facts, and assessing risks before a decision or transaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在作出决定或进行交易前，有组织地收集信息、核实相关事实并评估风险的一套程序或制度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett organizzat ta' proċeduri biex tinġabar l-informazzjoni, jiġu vverifikati l-fatti rilevanti u jiġu evalwati r-riskji qabel deċiżjoni jew tranżazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于在决策或交易前开展资料收集、事实核查与风险评估的尽职调查制度或系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' proċeduri li tintuża biex jiġu eżaminati l-informazzjoni u r-riskji marbuta ma' persuna, organizzazzjoni jew attività qabel ma tittieħed deċiżjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A due diligence system provides procedures for checking relevant information and assessing risks before proceeding with a decision or transaction.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tagħżel fornitur ġdid, l-organizzazzjoni tapplika s-sistema ta' diliġenza dovuta tagħha biex tivverifika d-dokumenti tiegħu u tevalwa r-riskji.
formal.en: Before selecting a new supplier, the organization applies its due diligence system to verify the supplier's documents and assess the risks.
formal.zh: 在选择新供应商之前，该机构会按照其尽职调查制度核实供应商的文件并评估风险。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nistgħu nibdew naħdmu ma' dan il-fornitur illum? David: L-ewwel irridu nagħmlu l-verifiki previsti fis-sistema ta' diliġenza dovuta tagħna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can we start working with this supplier today? David: First we need to carry out the checks required by our due diligence system.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们今天就能开始和这家供应商合作吗？David：得先完成我们尽职调查制度规定的核查。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nibdew naħdmu ma' dan il-fornitur illum?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nibdew naħdmu ma' dan il-fornitur illum?
messages.zh: 我们今天就能开始和这家供应商合作吗？
messages.en: Can we start working with this supplier today?

messages.speaker: David (审核同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irridu nagħmlu l-verifiki previsti fis-sistema ta' diliġenza dovuta tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irridu nagħmlu l-verifiki previsti fis-sistema ta' diliġenza dovuta tagħna.
messages.zh: 得先完成我们尽职调查制度规定的核查。
messages.en: First we need to carry out the checks required by our due diligence system.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词组记成签约前的三步清单：收集资料、核实事实、评估风险；清单背后的整套程序就是“尽职调查制度”。

gloss_zh: 分配系统；分销网络；配电网

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement of connections, facilities, or procedures that delivers goods, electricity, or other resources to their destinations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过相互连接的设施、网络或程序，将货物、电力或其他资源输送到各个目的地的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' konnessjonijiet, faċilitajiet jew proċeduri li twassal prodotti, elettriku jew riżorsi oħra lejn id-destinazzjonijiet tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将电力输送并分配给各用电地点的配电网。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Netwerk ta' linji u tagħmir li jqassam l-elettriku lejn id-djar, in-negozji u postijiet oħra fejn jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distribution grid is a connected set of lines and equipment that carries electricity to homes, businesses, and other users.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由相互连接的地点、渠道或设施构成，将产品或资源送达接收者的分销或配送网络。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Netwerk ta' postijiet, kanali jew faċilitajiet marbuta ma' xulxin li permezz tagħhom il-prodotti jew ir-riżorsi jaslu għand min jirċevihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distribution network consists of connected locations, channels, or facilities through which products or resources reach their recipients.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于组织和完成产品或资源分配、输送及交付的整套设施与程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett organizzat ta' faċilitajiet u proċeduri li jintuża biex prodotti jew riżorsi jitqassmu u jitwasslu lejn id-destinazzjonijiet tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distribution system combines the facilities and procedures used to allocate and deliver products or resources to their destinations.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se ttejjeb is-sistema ta' distribuzzjoni tagħha billi tgħaqqad il-maħżen il-ġdid mar-rotot li jservu l-ħwienet.
formal.en: The company will improve its distribution system by connecting the new warehouse to the routes serving the shops.
formal.zh: 公司将把新仓库接入为各门店供货的运输路线，以改进其配送系统。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif jaslu l-prodotti mill-maħżen sal-ħwienet? Mark: Għandna sistema ta' distribuzzjoni; il-vannijiet jieħdu l-ordnijiet fuq rotot differenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do the products get from the warehouse to the shops? Mark: We have a distribution system; the vans take the orders along different routes.
colloquial.zh: Sara：产品是怎么从仓库送到门店的？Mark：我们有配送系统，货车沿不同路线运送各批订单。

messages.speaker: Sara (新入职店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jaslu l-prodotti mill-maħżen sal-ħwienet?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jaslu l-prodotti mill-maħżen sal-ħwienet?
messages.zh: 产品是怎么从仓库送到门店的？
messages.en: How do the products get from the warehouse to the shops?

messages.speaker: Mark (物流同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna sistema ta' distribuzzjoni; il-vannijiet jieħdu l-ordnijiet fuq rotot differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna sistema ta' distribuzzjoni; il-vannijiet jieħdu l-ordnijiet fuq rotot differenti.
messages.zh: 我们有配送系统，货车沿不同路线运送各批订单。
messages.en: We have a distribution system; the vans take the orders along different routes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个中心向多个终点连出线路：送货时联想配送网络，送电时联想配电网；共同画面是“把资源分送到各处”。

gloss_zh: 封闭式分配网络；封闭式分配系统

teaching_sense.en_definition: A distribution system that serves a defined group of users within a restricted network.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在限定网络内为特定用户群提供分配服务的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema li tqassam riżorsi lil grupp definit ta' utenti fi ħdan netwerk b'aċċess limitat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 封闭式分配网络，指连接特定用户、接入范围受到限制的分配网络。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni li jgħaqqad grupp definit ta' utenti u li l-aċċess għalih huwa limitat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A closed distribution network connects a defined group of users through distribution links with restricted access.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 封闭式分配系统，指为特定用户群组织和管理资源分配的完整系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li torganizza u tmexxi t-tqassim ta' riżorsi lil grupp definit ta' utenti b'aċċess limitat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A closed distribution system organizes and manages distribution for a defined group of users within restricted boundaries.

collocations.mt: it-tħaddim ta' sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa
collocations.en: the operation of a closed distribution system
collocations.zh: 封闭式分配系统的运行

collocations.mt: l-aċċess għal sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa
collocations.en: access to a closed distribution system
collocations.zh: 封闭式分配系统的接入

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif taħdem is-sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa u liema utenti jistgħu jaċċessawha.
formal.en: The report describes how the closed distribution system works and which users can access it.
formal.zh: 报告说明了封闭式分配系统的运作方式，以及哪些用户可以接入该系统。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kulħadd jista' juża din is-sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa? Pawlu: Le, hija għall-utenti rreġistrati biss.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can anyone use this closed distribution system? Pawlu: No, it is only for registered users.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：任何人都能使用这个封闭式分配系统吗？保罗：不能，它只供已注册的用户使用。

messages.speaker: Marta (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulħadd jista' juża din is-sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa?
messages.mt_standard: Kulħadd jista' juża din is-sistema ta' distribuzzjoni magħluqa?
messages.zh: 任何人都能使用这个封闭式分配系统吗？
messages.en: Can anyone use this closed distribution system?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija għall-utenti rreġistrati biss.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija għall-utenti rreġistrati biss.
messages.zh: 不能，它只供已注册的用户使用。
messages.en: No, it is only for registered users.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整词想成一张有门禁的分配网络图：sistema 是系统，distribuzzjoni 是分配，magħluqa 提醒你范围封闭、接入受限。

gloss_zh: 红旗标记系统；风险警示标记系统

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system that marks potential problems or risks with red flags so that they receive attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过红旗标记提示潜在问题或风险、使其受到关注的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema li timmarka problemi jew riskji possibbli b'bandieri ħomor biex tiġbed l-attenzjoni lejhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红旗警示标记系统，用于标出需要关注的潜在问题或风险。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li tuża bandieri ħomor biex tindika każijiet li jistgħu jinvolvu problema jew riskju u li jeħtieġu attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A red-flagging system marks possible problems or risks so that people can identify and investigate them.

collocations.mt: l-introduzzjoni ta' sistema ta' ffleggjar aħmar
collocations.en: the introduction of a red-flagging system
collocations.zh: 红旗警示标记系统的引入

collocations.mt: każijiet identifikati mis-sistema ta' ffleggjar aħmar
collocations.en: cases identified by the red-flagging system
collocations.zh: 红旗警示标记系统识别出的个案

formal.mt: Is-sistema ta' ffleggjar aħmar tindika l-każijiet li jeħtieġu eżami aktar bir-reqqa qabel tittieħed deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The red-flagging system identifies cases that require closer examination before a decision is made.
formal.zh: 红旗警示标记系统会标出需要在作出决定前进行更仔细审查的个案。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex is-sistema ta' ffleggjar aħmar immarkat dan il-każ? Mark: Hemm xi informazzjoni nieqsa; ejja niċċekkjawha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did the red-flagging system flag this case? Mark: Some information is missing; let's check it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：红旗警示标记系统为什么标记了这个个案？马克：有些信息缺失了，我们核查一下吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex is-sistema ta' ffleggjar aħmar immarkat dan il-każ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex is-sistema ta' ffleggjar aħmar immarkat dan il-każ?
messages.zh: 红旗警示标记系统为什么标记了这个个案？
messages.en: Why did the red-flagging system flag this case?

messages.speaker: Mark (审核员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi informazzjoni nieqsa; ejja niċċekkjawha.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi informazzjoni nieqsa; ejja niċċekkjawha.
messages.zh: 有些信息缺失了，我们核查一下吧。
messages.en: Some information is missing; let's check it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象审核表旁插着一面红旗：aħmar 表示红色，把 ffleggjar 与标旗动作一起记，就能联想到系统在提醒你检查潜在问题。

exact_key: sistema ta' inċentivi tat-taxxa favur il-privattivi
gloss_zh: 专利盒制度；专利相关所得税收优惠制度

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tax incentive scheme that gives preferential tax treatment to qualifying income from patents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对符合条件的专利所得给予优惠税收待遇的激励制度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' inċentivi tat-taxxa li tagħti trattament fiskali preferenzjali lil dħul minn privattivi li jissodisfa l-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专利盒制度，即对符合规定条件的专利所得给予优惠税收待遇的制度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema fiskali li tipprovdi trattament tat-taxxa preferenzjali għal dħul minn privattivi meta jiġu ssodisfati l-kundizzjonijiet stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A patent box is a tax scheme under which qualifying income from patents receives preferential tax treatment.

collocations.mt: il-kundizzjonijiet tas-sistema ta' inċentivi tat-taxxa favur il-privattivi
collocations.en: the conditions of the patent box scheme
collocations.zh: 专利盒制度的适用条件

collocations.mt: il-benefiċċji tas-sistema ta' inċentivi tat-taxxa favur il-privattivi
collocations.en: the benefits of the patent box scheme
collocations.zh: 专利盒制度提供的优惠

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega l-kundizzjonijiet li jridu jiġu ssodisfati biex dħul minn privattivi jibbenefika mis-sistema ta' inċentivi tat-taxxa favur il-privattivi.
formal.en: The document explains the conditions that must be met for income from patents to benefit from the patent box scheme.
formal.zh: 该文件说明了专利所得享受专利盒制度优惠所必须满足的条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din is-sistema ta' inċentivi tat-taxxa favur il-privattivi tapplika għal kull dħul tagħna? David: Ejja naraw il-kundizzjonijiet; irridu nifhmu liema dħul jikkwalifika.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this patent box scheme apply to all our income? David: Let's look at the conditions; we need to understand which income qualifies.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个专利盒制度适用于我们所有的收入吗？戴维：我们看看适用条件吧，需要弄清哪些收入符合资格。

messages.speaker: Lara (企业负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-sistema ta' inċentivi tat-taxxa favur il-privattivi tapplika għal kull dħul tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Din is-sistema ta' inċentivi tat-taxxa favur il-privattivi tapplika għal kull dħul tagħna?
messages.zh: 这个专利盒制度适用于我们所有的收入吗？
messages.en: Does this patent box scheme apply to all our income?

messages.speaker: David (会计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naraw il-kundizzjonijiet; irridu nifhmu liema dħul jikkwalifika.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naraw il-kundizzjonijiet; irridu nifhmu liema dħul jikkwalifika.
messages.zh: 我们看看适用条件吧，需要弄清哪些收入符合资格。
messages.en: Let's look at the conditions; we need to understand which income qualifies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分段记：sistema 是制度，inċentivi tat-taxxa 是税收激励，favur il-privattivi 是有利于专利；再用“专利收入放进优惠盒”联想英语 patent box。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system of equipment and connections that links offshore electrical installations to an electricity grid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由设备和连接设施组成、将海上电力设施接入电网的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' tagħmir u konnessjonijiet li tgħaqqad installazzjonijiet elettriċi fil-baħar mal-grilja tal-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海上电网连接系统，指用于将海上电力设施与电网连接起来的设备和连接设施系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li tinkludi t-tagħmir u l-konnessjonijiet meħtieġa biex installazzjonijiet elettriċi fil-baħar ikunu konnessi mal-grilja tal-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An offshore grid connection system provides the equipment and connections needed to link offshore electrical installations to an electricity grid.

collocations.mt: l-installazzjoni ta' sistema ta' konnessjoni tal-grilja fil-baħar
collocations.en: the installation of an offshore grid connection system
collocations.zh: 海上电网连接系统的安装

collocations.mt: il-manutenzjoni tas-sistema ta' konnessjoni tal-grilja fil-baħar
collocations.en: maintenance of the offshore grid connection system
collocations.zh: 海上电网连接系统的维护

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-proġett jinkludi l-installazzjoni u l-ittestjar tas-sistema ta' konnessjoni tal-grilja fil-baħar qabel tibda topera.
formal.en: The project plan includes the installation and testing of the offshore grid connection system before it begins operating.
formal.zh: 项目计划包括在海上电网连接系统投入运行前完成其安装和测试。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Is-sistema ta' konnessjoni tal-grilja fil-baħar lesta? Ġorġ: L-installazzjoni lesta, imma għad irridu nagħmlu t-testijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the offshore grid connection system ready? Ġorġ: The installation is complete, but we still need to carry out the tests.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：海上电网连接系统准备好了吗？乔治：安装已经完成，但我们还需要进行测试。

messages.speaker: Sara (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sistema ta' konnessjoni tal-grilja fil-baħar lesta?
messages.mt_standard: Is-sistema ta' konnessjoni tal-grilja fil-baħar lesta?
messages.zh: 海上电网连接系统准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the offshore grid connection system ready?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-installazzjoni lesta, imma għad irridu nagħmlu t-testijiet.
messages.mt_standard: L-installazzjoni lesta, imma għad irridu nagħmlu t-testijiet.
messages.zh: 安装已经完成，但我们还需要进行测试。
messages.en: The installation is complete, but we still need to carry out the tests.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条把海上电力设施接到电网的线：konnessjoni 记连接，grilja 记电网，fil-baħar 记在海上，再用 sistema 把整套设施串起来。

exact_key: sistema ta' kurrent dirett b'voltaġġ għoli

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electricity transmission system that uses direct current at high voltage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 采用高电压直流电传输电能的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema li tittrażmetti l-enerġija elettrika permezz ta' kurrent dirett b'voltaġġ għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高压直流输电系统，英文简称为 HVDC。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema għat-trażmissjoni tal-enerġija elettrika li tuża kurrent dirett b'voltaġġ għoli u li hija magħrufa bl-abbrevjazzjoni Ingliża HVDC.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An HVDC system is a system that transmits electrical energy using direct current at high voltage.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用高电压直流电传输电能的输电系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema għat-trażmissjoni tal-enerġija elettrika li fiha jintuża kurrent dirett b'voltaġġ għoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A high-voltage direct current system is an electricity transmission system in which direct current is used at high voltage.

collocations.mt: l-installazzjoni ta' sistema ta' kurrent dirett b'voltaġġ għoli
collocations.en: the installation of a high-voltage direct current system
collocations.zh: 高压直流输电系统的安装

collocations.mt: il-manutenzjoni ta' sistema ta' kurrent dirett b'voltaġġ għoli
collocations.en: the maintenance of a high-voltage direct current system
collocations.zh: 高压直流输电系统的维护

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tekniku jiddeskrivi sistema ta' kurrent dirett b'voltaġġ għoli għat-trażmissjoni tal-enerġija elettrika bejn żewġ stazzjonijiet.
formal.en: The technical report describes a high-voltage direct current system for transmitting electrical energy between two stations.
formal.zh: 技术报告介绍了一套用于在两个站点之间传输电能的高压直流输电系统。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi sistema ta' kurrent dirett b'voltaġġ għoli? Mark: Hija sistema li tittrażmetti l-elettriku b'kurrent dirett u b'voltaġġ għoli.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is a high-voltage direct current system? Mark: It is a system that transmits electricity using direct current at high voltage.
colloquial.zh: Maja：什么是高压直流输电系统？Mark：就是用高电压直流电来传输电能的系统。

messages.mt_standard: X'inhi sistema ta' kurrent dirett b'voltaġġ għoli?

messages.en: What is a high-voltage direct current system?

cognitive_memory_aid: 分块记忆：sistema 是系统，kurrent dirett 是直流电，voltaġġ għoli 是高电压；把三块拼成“高压直流输电系统”。

gloss_zh: 资格认定制度；资格评定体系

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized set of rules and procedures for determining whether someone or something meets the requirements for a qualification or participation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过一套规则和程序，判断个人或实体是否符合取得某种资格或参与某项活动所需条件的制度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett organizzat ta' regoli u proċeduri biex jiġi stabbilit jekk persuna jew entità tissodisfax il-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa biex tikseb kwalifika jew tipparteċipa f'attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于规定资格条件并评定个人或实体是否符合这些条件的制度或体系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li tistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet għal kwalifika u l-proċeduri biex jiġi vverifikat jekk persuna jew entità tissodisfax dawk il-kundizzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A qualification system is a set of rules and procedures used to determine whether people or entities meet specified requirements.

collocations.en: the criteria of the qualification system
collocations.zh: 资格认定制度的评定标准

collocations.en: the application of the qualification system

formal.mt: Is-sistema ta' kwalifika tistabbilixxi l-kriterji li l-applikanti jridu jissodisfaw biex ikunu eliġibbli għall-programm.
formal.en: The qualification system sets out the criteria that applicants must meet to be eligible for the programme.
formal.zh: 资格认定制度规定了申请人获得该项目参与资格所必须满足的标准。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nista' nkun naf jekk nikkwalifikax għall-programm? Mark: Ara l-kriterji tas-sistema ta' kwalifika; hemm issib ir-rekwiżiti.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I find out whether I qualify for the programme? Mark: Check the criteria of the qualification system; you will find the requirements there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我怎么知道自己是否有资格参加这个项目？Mark：看看资格认定制度的评定标准，那里列出了要求。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)

messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nkun naf jekk nikkwalifikax għall-programm?
messages.zh: 我怎么知道自己是否有资格参加这个项目？
messages.en: How can I find out whether I qualify for the programme?
