messages.mt_spoken: Ara l-kriterji tas-sistema ta' kwalifika; hemm issib ir-rekwiżiti.
messages.mt_standard: Ara l-kriterji tas-sistema ta' kwalifika; hemm issib ir-rekwiżiti.
messages.zh: 看看资格认定制度的评定标准，那里列出了要求。
messages.en: Check the criteria of the qualification system; you will find the requirements there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sistema ta' kwalifika 想成一张“是否符合资格”的检查表：sistema 提醒你是整套制度，kwalifika 提醒你关注资格条件。

exact_key: sistema ta' negozjar b'irkanti kontinwi permezz ta' ktieb tal-ordnijiet
gloss_zh: 订单簿式连续竞价交易系统

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trading system that records buy and sell orders in an order book and continuously matches compatible orders under its trading rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将买卖订单记录在订单簿中，并按照交易规则持续撮合符合成交条件的订单的交易系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' negozjar li tirreġistra ordnijiet ta' xiri u bejgħ fi ktieb tal-ordnijiet u tqabbel kontinwament ordnijiet kompatibbli skont ir-regoli tan-negozjar.

sense_translations.en_definition: continuous auction order book trading system
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以订单簿记录买卖委托，并通过连续竞价持续撮合符合成交条件的委托的交易系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li fiha l-ordnijiet ta' xiri u bejgħ jinżammu fi ktieb tal-ordnijiet u jitqabblu kontinwament permezz ta' rkant kontinwu skont ir-regoli tas-sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A continuous auction order book trading system is a trading arrangement in which buy and sell orders are recorded in an order book and compatible orders are matched continuously.

collocations.mt: ir-regoli tas-sistema ta' negozjar b'irkanti kontinwi permezz ta' ktieb tal-ordnijiet
collocations.en: the rules of the continuous auction order book trading system
collocations.zh: 订单簿式连续竞价交易系统的规则

collocations.mt: l-użu ta' sistema ta' negozjar b'irkanti kontinwi permezz ta' ktieb tal-ordnijiet
collocations.en: the use of a continuous auction order book trading system
collocations.zh: 订单簿式连续竞价交易系统的使用

formal.mt: F'sistema ta' negozjar b'irkanti kontinwi permezz ta' ktieb tal-ordnijiet, l-ordnijiet ta' xiri u bejgħ jitqabblu kontinwament skont ir-regoli tas-sistema.
formal.en: In a continuous auction order book trading system, buy and sell orders are matched continuously according to the system's rules.
formal.zh: 在订单簿式连续竞价交易系统中，买卖订单按照系统规则持续进行撮合。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif taħdem sistema ta' negozjar b'irkanti kontinwi permezz ta' ktieb tal-ordnijiet? Mark: L-ordnijiet jidħlu fil-ktieb tal-ordnijiet, u s-sistema tqabbel dawk li jistgħu jiġu eżegwiti flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: How does a continuous auction order book trading system work? Mark: Orders enter the order book, and the system matches those that can be executed together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：订单簿式连续竞价交易系统是怎么运作的？Mark：订单先进入订单簿，系统再撮合其中能够相互成交的订单。

messages.speaker: Maja (金融课程学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif taħdem sistema ta' negozjar b'irkanti kontinwi permezz ta' ktieb tal-ordnijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Kif taħdem sistema ta' negozjar b'irkanti kontinwi permezz ta' ktieb tal-ordnijiet?
messages.zh: 订单簿式连续竞价交易系统是怎么运作的？
messages.en: How does a continuous auction order book trading system work?

messages.speaker: Mark (金融课程教师)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ordnijiet jidħlu fil-ktieb tal-ordnijiet, u s-sistema tqabbel dawk li jistgħu jiġu eżegwiti flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: L-ordnijiet jidħlu fil-ktieb tal-ordnijiet, u s-sistema tqabbel dawk li jistgħu jiġu eżegwiti flimkien.
messages.zh: 订单先进入订单簿，系统再撮合其中能够相互成交的订单。
messages.en: Orders enter the order book, and the system matches those that can be executed together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按交易流程记长词组：negozjar 是交易，irkanti kontinwi 是连续竞价，permezz ta' 表示通过，ktieb tal-ordnijiet 是订单簿；联想“订单入簿，连续撮合”。

gloss_zh: 资格预审制度；资格预审系统

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system for checking whether applicants meet specified requirements before they proceed to a later selection or tendering stage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在后续遴选或投标阶段开始前，预先审查申请人是否满足规定条件的制度或系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema li tivverifika jekk l-applikanti jissodisfawx rekwiżiti speċifiċi qabel ma jgħaddu għal stadju sussegwenti ta' għażla jew ta' offerti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在正式遴选或投标的后续阶段之前，依据既定标准预先审查参与者资格的制度或系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' verifika minn qabel biex jiġi stabbilit jekk applikanti jissodisfawx il-kriterji meħtieġa biex jgħaddu għal stadju sussegwenti ta' għażla jew jipparteċipaw fi proċess ta' offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prequalification system is a procedure for checking applicants against specified requirements before allowing them to proceed to a later selection or tendering stage.

collocations.en: the criteria of the prequalification system
collocations.zh: 资格预审制度的审查标准
在资格预审系统中注册

formal.mt: L-awtorità tuża sistema ta' prekwalifikazzjoni biex tivverifika l-kapaċità teknika tal-fornituri qabel tistedinhom jippreżentaw offerta.
formal.en: The authority uses a prequalification system to check suppliers' technical capacity before inviting them to submit a tender.
formal.zh: 主管机构使用资格预审制度，在邀请供应商提交投标文件前核查其技术能力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nibagħtu l-offerta issa? Mark: L-ewwel irridu ngħaddu mill-verifika fis-sistema ta' prekwalifikazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we submit the tender now? Mark: First we need to pass the check in the prequalification system.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们现在可以提交投标文件了吗？Mark：我们得先通过资格预审系统的审查。

messages.speaker: Maja (供应商业务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nibagħtu l-offerta issa?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nibagħtu l-offerta issa?
messages.zh: 我们现在可以提交投标文件了吗？
messages.en: Can we submit the tender now?

messages.speaker: Mark (供应商投标负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irridu ngħaddu mill-verifika fis-sistema ta' prekwalifikazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irridu ngħaddu mill-verifika fis-sistema ta' prekwalifikazzjoni.
messages.zh: 我们得先通过资格预审系统的审查。
messages.en: First we need to pass the check in the prequalification system.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先过资格检查，再进下一阶段”的画面记忆 sistema ta' prekwalifikazzjoni；重点记住“预审”发生在后续遴选或投标之前。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized arrangement in which exchanges follow established standard rules and procedures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依照既定标准规则和程序进行交换的一套制度或系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema li fiha l-iskambji jsiru skont regoli u proċeduri standard stabbiliti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按照统一标准和规定程序运作的交换系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema organizzata li tuża regoli u proċeduri standard biex jitwettqu l-iskambji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A standard exchange system is an arrangement that enables exchanges to take place according to established rules and procedures.

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni adottat sistema ta' skambju standard biex kull skambju jsir skont l-istess proċeduri.
formal.en: The organization adopted a standard exchange system so that every exchange would follow the same procedures.
formal.zh: 该组织采用了标准交换系统，使每次交换都遵循相同程序。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex irridu nimlew l-istess formola kull darba? Mark: Għax issa nużaw sistema ta' skambju standard, u kull skambju jrid isegwi l-istess passi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do we have to fill in the same form every time? Mark: Because we now use a standard exchange system, and every exchange has to follow the same steps.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么我们每次都要填同样的表格？Mark：因为我们现在使用标准交换系统，每次交换都必须遵循相同的步骤。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex irridu nimlew l-istess formola kull darba?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex irridu nimlew l-istess formola kull darba?
messages.zh: 为什么我们每次都要填同样的表格？
messages.en: Why do we have to fill in the same form every time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax issa nużaw sistema ta' skambju standard, u kull skambju jrid isegwi l-istess passi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax issa nużaw sistema ta' skambju standard, u kull skambju jrid isegwi l-istess passi.
messages.zh: 因为我们现在使用标准交换系统，每次交换都必须遵循相同的步骤。
messages.en: Because we now use a standard exchange system, and every exchange has to follow the same steps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语分成 sistema「系统」、ta' skambju「用于交换」和 standard「标准」三块，想象每次交换都沿着同一套标准步骤进行。

gloss_zh: 争端解决制度；纠纷解决系统

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized set of procedures for addressing disagreements and reaching a resolution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于处理争议并达成解决结果的一套有组织的程序或制度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett organizzat ta' proċeduri li jintużaw biex jiġu indirizzati u solvuti t-tilwimiet bejn il-partijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过既定程序处理并解决各方争端的一套制度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' proċeduri li tipprovdi mod organizzat kif il-partijiet jistgħu jfittxu soluzzjoni għal tilwima.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dispute resolution system provides established procedures through which parties can address a disagreement and seek a settlement.

collocations.mt: tirrikorri għal sistema ta' soluzzjoni tat-tilwim
collocations.en: have recourse to a dispute resolution system

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jipprevedi sistema ta' soluzzjoni tat-tilwim li tistabbilixxi l-passi li għandhom isegwu l-partijiet meta jinqala' nuqqas ta' qbil.
formal.en: The agreement provides for a dispute resolution system that sets out the steps the parties should follow when a disagreement arises.
formal.zh: 该协议规定了一套争端解决制度，列明各方发生分歧时应遵循的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadna ma qbilniex dwar il-ħlas. X'nistgħu nagħmlu? Pawlu: Fil-ftehim hemm sistema ta' soluzzjoni tat-tilwim. Ejja naraw x'pass għandna nieħdu l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: We still haven't agreed about the payment. What can we do? Pawlu: The agreement includes a dispute resolution system. Let's see which step we should take first.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们对付款问题还是没有达成一致。能怎么办？Pawlu：协议里有争端解决制度。我们看看首先应该采取哪个步骤。

messages.speaker: Lara (合作方代表)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna ma qbilniex dwar il-ħlas. X'nistgħu nagħmlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għadna ma qbilniex dwar il-ħlas. X'nistgħu nagħmlu?
messages.zh: 我们对付款问题还是没有达成一致。能怎么办？
messages.en: We still haven't agreed about the payment. What can we do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-ftehim hemm sistema ta' soluzzjoni tat-tilwim. Ejja naraw x'pass għandna nieħdu l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-ftehim hemm sistema ta' soluzzjoni tat-tilwim. Ejja naraw x'pass għandna nieħdu l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 协议里有争端解决制度。我们看看首先应该采取哪个步骤。
messages.en: The agreement includes a dispute resolution system. Let's see which step we should take first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用「系统—解决—争端」三个意义块记忆：sistema 是系统，soluzzjoni 是解决，tilwim 是争端；把整个短语想成处理分歧的程序图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system intended to reduce fluctuations in earnings received from exports.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在减轻出口所得收入波动、使其保持较为稳定的一套制度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema maħsuba biex tnaqqas il-varjazzjonijiet fid-dħul li jinkiseb mill-esportazzjoni u tgħin biex dan id-dħul jibqa' aktar stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Stabex，即以稳定出口收入为目的的制度名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stabex huwa l-isem ta' sistema maħsuba biex tgħin fl-istabbilizzazzjoni tad-dħul mill-esportazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Stabex is the name of a system intended to help stabilize earnings from exports.

sense_translations.en_definition: system for the stabilization of export earnings
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于减少出口收入波动并促进其稳定的一套制度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li għandha l-għan li tillimita l-varjazzjonijiet fid-dħul mill-esportazzjoni u tagħmlu aktar stabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A system for the stabilization of export earnings aims to reduce fluctuations in the income received from selling goods abroad.

collocations.mt: tistabbilixxi sistema ta' stabbilizzazzjoni tad-dħul mill-esportazzjoni
collocations.en: establish a system for the stabilization of export earnings
collocations.zh: 建立出口收入稳定制度

collocations.mt: l-effettività tas-sistema ta' stabbilizzazzjoni tad-dħul mill-esportazzjoni
collocations.en: the effectiveness of the system for the stabilization of export earnings
collocations.zh: 出口收入稳定制度的有效性

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina kif sistema ta' stabbilizzazzjoni tad-dħul mill-esportazzjoni tista' tnaqqas l-effetti tal-varjazzjonijiet fid-dħul.
formal.en: The report examines how a system for the stabilization of export earnings can reduce the effects of fluctuations in income.
formal.zh: 该报告考察出口收入稳定制度如何减轻收入波动带来的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tipprova tagħmel sistema ta' stabbilizzazzjoni tad-dħul mill-esportazzjoni? Mark: Tipprova żżomm id-dħul mill-esportazzjoni aktar stabbli meta dan jitla' u jinżel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does a system for the stabilization of export earnings try to do? Mark: It tries to keep export earnings more stable when they rise and fall.
colloquial.zh: Maja：出口收入稳定制度想要达到什么目的？Mark：它力求在出口收入上下波动时，让收入保持更稳定。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tipprova tagħmel sistema ta' stabbilizzazzjoni tad-dħul mill-esportazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: X'tipprova tagħmel sistema ta' stabbilizzazzjoni tad-dħul mill-esportazzjoni?
messages.zh: 出口收入稳定制度想要达到什么目的？
messages.en: What does a system for the stabilization of export earnings try to do?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tipprova żżomm id-dħul mill-esportazzjoni aktar stabbli meta dan jitla' u jinżel.
messages.mt_standard: Tipprova żżomm id-dħul mill-esportazzjoni aktar stabbli meta dan jitla' u jinżel.
messages.zh: 它力求在出口收入上下波动时，让收入保持更稳定。
messages.en: It tries to keep export earnings more stable when they rise and fall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按「系统—稳定—收入—来自出口」分块朗读，抓住 stabbilizzazzjoni「稳定」、dħul「收入」、esportazzjoni「出口」，想象把出口收入的波浪线压平。

gloss_zh: 追踪与追溯系统；追踪与追溯技术

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system or technology used to monitor an item's movement and trace its recorded history.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于跟踪物品流转情况，并依据记录追溯其来源或经过的系统或技术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema jew teknoloġija li tintuża biex jiġi segwit il-moviment ta' oġġett u biex jiġu identifikati l-oriġini tiegħu jew l-istadji li għadda minnhom permezz tar-rekords.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 记录并跟踪物品流转、同时支持追溯其来源和流转经过的系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li żżomm rekords tal-moviment ta' oġġett sabiex ikun jista' jiġi segwit u jkun jista' jiġi stabbilit minn fejn ġie jew minn liema stadji għadda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A track and trace system records an item's progress so that its movement and earlier stages can be checked.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于跟踪物品流转并追溯其来源和流转记录的技术。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Teknoloġija li tippermetti li jinġabru u jiġu ċċekkjati rekords biex jiġi segwit il-moviment ta' oġġett u jiġu identifikati l-oriġini tiegħu jew l-istadji li għadda minnhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Track and trace technology enables users to follow an item's movement and retrieve records of its previous stages.

collocations.mt: timplimenta sistema ta' traċċar u rintraċċar
collocations.en: implement a track and trace system

collocations.mt: tuża sistema ta' traċċar u rintraċċar għall-pakketti
collocations.en: use a track and trace system for parcels
collocations.zh: 使用包裹追踪与追溯系统

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tuża sistema ta' traċċar u rintraċċar biex tirreġistra l-moviment tal-pakketti u tivverifika l-istadji li jkunu għaddew minnhom.
formal.en: The company uses a track and trace system to record parcel movements and verify the stages they have passed through.
formal.zh: 该公司使用追踪与追溯系统记录包裹的流转情况，并核查包裹经过的各个环节。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nara fejn wasal il-pakkett tiegħi? Pawlu: Iva, daħħal in-numru tiegħu fis-sistema ta' traċċar u rintraċċar. Tara l-aħħar aġġornament u l-istadji ta' qabel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I see how far my parcel has got? Pawlu: Yes, enter its number in the track and trace system. You'll see the latest update and the earlier stages.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我能查看我的包裹到哪儿了吗？Pawlu：可以，把包裹号码输入追踪与追溯系统。你就能看到最新状态和之前经过的环节。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nara fejn wasal il-pakkett tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nara fejn wasal il-pakkett tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我能查看我的包裹到哪儿了吗？
messages.en: Can I see how far my parcel has got?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, daħħal in-numru tiegħu fis-sistema ta' traċċar u rintraċċar. Tara l-aħħar aġġornament u l-istadji ta' qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, daħħal in-numru tiegħu fis-sistema ta' traċċar u rintraċċar. Tara l-aħħar aġġornament u l-istadji ta' qabel.
messages.zh: 可以，把包裹号码输入追踪与追溯系统。你就能看到最新状态和之前经过的环节。
messages.en: Yes, enter its number in the track and trace system. You'll see the latest update and the earlier stages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 traċċar u rintraċċar 成对记成「跟踪并追溯」：想象包裹页面既显示现在走到哪里，也能回看之前经过哪里；u 表示「和」。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system that coordinates the assignment and sending of personnel or vehicles from a central point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一个中心统一协调人员或车辆的任务分配与派遣的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema li tikkoordina minn ċentru wieħed l-assenjazzjoni tal-kompiti u d-dispaċċ ta' persunal jew vetturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由中心统一安排任务并派遣人员或车辆的调度系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema li permezz tagħha ċentru wieħed iqassam il-kompiti u jibgħat il-persunal jew il-vetturi fejn ikun hemm bżonnhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A central dispatch system coordinates where personnel or vehicles are sent from a single central point.

collocations.en: to operate a central dispatch system

collocations.mt: tirċievi kompitu permezz tas-sistema ċentrali tad-dispaċċ
collocations.en: to receive an assignment through the central dispatch system
collocations.zh: 通过中央调度系统接收任务

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tuża sistema ċentrali tad-dispaċċ biex tqassam il-kompiti bejn is-sewwieqa.
formal.en: The company uses a central dispatch system to distribute assignments among drivers.
formal.zh: 公司使用中央调度系统向司机分配任务。

colloquial.mt: Daniel: Minn fejn nirċievi l-kompitu li jmiss? Sara: Mis-sistema ċentrali tad-dispaċċ. Daniel: Mela nistenna l-assenjazzjoni hemm? Sara: Iva, hemm tara fejn trid tmur.
colloquial.en: Daniel: Where do I receive my next assignment? Sara: From the central dispatch system. Daniel: So I wait for the assignment there? Sara: Yes, that is where you will see where you need to go.
colloquial.zh: 丹尼尔：我从哪里接收下一个任务？萨拉：从中央调度系统接收。丹尼尔：那我就在系统里等任务分配？萨拉：是的，你会在那里看到需要去哪里。

messages.speaker: Daniel (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn nirċievi l-kompitu li jmiss?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn nirċievi l-kompitu li jmiss?
messages.zh: 我从哪里接收下一个任务？
messages.en: Where do I receive my next assignment?

messages.speaker: Sara (调度员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mis-sistema ċentrali tad-dispaċċ.
messages.mt_standard: Mis-sistema ċentrali tad-dispaċċ.
messages.zh: 从中央调度系统接收。
messages.en: From the central dispatch system.

messages.speaker: Daniel (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nistenna l-assenjazzjoni hemm?
messages.mt_standard: Mela nistenna l-assenjazzjoni hemm?
messages.zh: 那我就在系统里等任务分配？
messages.en: So I wait for the assignment there?

messages.speaker: Sara (调度员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm tara fejn trid tmur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm tara fejn trid tmur.
messages.zh: 是的，你会在那里看到需要去哪里。
messages.en: Yes, that is where you will see where you need to go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张中心向外发出任务箭头的图：sistema 对应系统，ċentrali 对应中央，tad-dispaċċ 对应调度；整组记成“中央统一派任务”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place used for a particular activity, or a website containing related pages on the internet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于某项活动的场地或地点，也指由相关网页组成的互联网网站。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn issir attività partikolari, jew ġabra ta' paġni relatati fuq l-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某项活动、工程或建筑所在的地点或场地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post jew biċċa art fejn issir attività, jitwettaq proġett jew ikun hemm bini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A site is a place where a particular activity takes place or where something is built.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由个人或机构维护、可通过互联网访问的一组相关网页，即网站。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' paġni relatati fuq l-internet, miżmuma minn persuna jew organizzazzjoni u aċċessibbli permezz ta' indirizz elettroniku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A site is a collection of related pages that you can visit on the internet.

formal.mt: L-indirizz tas-sit ta' kostruzzjoni jinsab fuq is-sit elettroniku tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: The address of the construction site is available on the company's website.
formal.zh: 建筑工地的地址可在公司网站上查到。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq liema sit nista' nsib il-ħinijiet tal-mużew? Mark: Fuq is-sit uffiċjali tiegħu; hemm issib ukoll il-prezzijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which website can I find the museum's opening hours on? Mark: On its official website; you'll also find the prices there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在哪个网站能查到博物馆的开放时间？马克：它的官方网站，那里也有票价。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq liema sit nista' nsib il-ħinijiet tal-mużew?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq liema sit nista' nsib il-ħinijiet tal-mużew?
messages.zh: 我在哪个网站能查到博物馆的开放时间？
messages.en: Which website can I find the museum's opening hours on?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq is-sit uffiċjali tiegħu; hemm issib ukoll il-prezzijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq is-sit uffiċjali tiegħu; hemm issib ukoll il-prezzijiet.
messages.zh: 它的官方网站，那里也有票价。
messages.en: On its official website; you'll also find the prices there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sit 记成两张配对图片：现实中的施工地点和屏幕上的网站。看到 kostruzzjoni 想到工地，看到 elettroniku 想到网站。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A safety belt worn by someone sitting in a vehicle to help keep them in their seat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乘坐交通工具时系在身上的安全带，用来帮助乘员固定在座位上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċinturin tas-sigurtà li persuna tilbes meta tkun bilqiegħda f'vettura biex iżommha f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交通工具座位上供乘员系用、用于固定身体的安全带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċinturin imwaħħal ma' sedil f'vettura li jintrabat madwar il-persuna biex iżommha f'postha waqt il-vjaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A seatbelt is a safety belt that holds you in your seat while you are travelling in a vehicle.

formal.mt: Kull passiġġier għandu jorbot is-sitbelt qabel ma tibda timxi l-vettura.
formal.en: Every passenger should fasten their seatbelt before the vehicle starts moving.
formal.zh: 每位乘客都应在车辆开动前系好安全带。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Rbatt is-sitbelt, Pawlu? Pawlu: Iva, issa lest. Nistgħu nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you fastened your seatbelt, Pawlu? Pawlu: Yes, I'm ready now. We can go.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：保罗，你系好安全带了吗？保罗：系好了，现在准备好了。我们可以出发了。

messages.speaker: Rita (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Rbatt is-sitbelt, Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Rbatt is-sitbelt, Pawlu?
messages.zh: 保罗，你系好安全带了吗？
messages.en: Have you fastened your seatbelt, Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa lest. Nistgħu nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa lest. Nistgħu nitilqu.
messages.zh: 系好了，现在准备好了。我们可以出发了。
messages.en: Yes, I'm ready now. We can go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用乘车动作记 sitbelt：坐稳、拉带、扣好。再把 orbot 和 ħoll 配成一组，分别练习系上与解开安全带。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sea animal called a cuttlefish, with arms around its mouth and the ability to release ink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为乌贼或墨鱼的海洋动物，口部周围有腕，能够释放墨汁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal tal-baħar li għandu dirgħajn madwar ħalqu u jista' joħroġ linka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌贼，亦称墨鱼，一种口部周围有腕并能释放墨汁的海洋动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal tal-baħar b'dirgħajn madwar ħalqu, li jista' joħroġ linka u jintuża wkoll bħala ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cuttlefish is a sea animal with arms around its mouth that can release ink.

formal.mt: Is-siċċa hija annimal tal-baħar li jista' joħroġ linka meta jkun fil-periklu.
formal.en: The cuttlefish is a sea animal that can release ink when it is in danger.
formal.zh: 乌贼是一种海洋动物，遇到危险时能够释放墨汁。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din is-siċċa friska? Toni: Iva, waslet dalgħodu. Trid waħda?
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this cuttlefish fresh? Toni: Yes, it arrived this morning. Would you like one?
colloquial.zh: Anna：这墨鱼新鲜吗？Toni：新鲜，今天早上刚到。你要一只吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-siċċa friska?
messages.mt_standard: Din is-siċċa friska?
messages.zh: 这墨鱼新鲜吗？
messages.en: Is this cuttlefish fresh?

messages.speaker: Toni (鱼贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waslet dalgħodu. Trid waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waslet dalgħodu. Trid waħda?
messages.zh: 新鲜，今天早上刚到。你要一只吗？
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning. Would you like one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 siċċa，就联想海里的墨鱼喷出一团墨汁；再用“新鲜墨鱼”和“酿馅墨鱼”两个食物画面巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To close or secure something by applying a seal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过施加封印或封口，使物品封闭或固定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għalaq jew assigura xi ħaġa billi waħħal siġill magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 封上；通过加封使物品保持封闭。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waħħal siġill ma' xi ħaġa biex iżommha magħluqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone seals something, they apply a seal to keep it closed or secure.

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal siġel l-ittra qabel bagħatha lir-riċevitur.
formal.en: The official sealed the letter before sending it to the recipient.
formal.zh: 工作人员在把信寄给收件人之前，将信件封好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu siġel il-pakkett? Mark: Iva, issa lest biex jintbagħat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu seal the package? Mark: Yes, it is now ready to be sent.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗把包裹封好了吗？马克：封好了，现在可以寄出了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu siġel il-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu siġel il-pakkett?
messages.zh: 保罗把包裹封好了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu seal the package?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa lest biex jintbagħat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa lest biex jintbagħat.
messages.zh: 封好了，现在可以寄出了。
messages.en: Yes, it is now ready to be sent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象寄信前给封口加上封印的动作，把 siġel 与“封好信件”连在一起，记住这里表达动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chair with wheels that helps a person move around when walking is difficult or impossible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装有轮子、供行走困难或无法行走的人移动使用的椅子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġġu bir-roti li jgħin lil persuna tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor meta jkollha diffikultà biex timxi jew ma tkunx tista' timxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轮椅；供行走困难或无法行走的人乘坐并移动的带轮椅子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Siġġu mgħammar bir-roti li jintuża minn persuna li jkollha diffikultà biex timxi jew li ma tkunx tista' timxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wheelchair is a chair fitted with wheels that enables someone who has difficulty walking to move from place to place.

formal.mt: Id-daħla tal-bini għandha rampa sabiex persuna li tuża siġġu tar-roti tkun tista' tidħol faċilment.
formal.en: The entrance to the building has a ramp so that a person who uses a wheelchair can enter easily.
formal.zh: 大楼入口设有坡道，方便使用轮椅的人进入。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tridni nimbotta s-siġġu tar-roti? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Sa ħdejn il-mejda, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like me to push the wheelchair? Pawlu: Yes, please. Just over to the table, thanks.
colloquial.zh: Maja：要我帮你推轮椅吗？Pawlu：好的，麻烦你。推到桌子旁边就行，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tridni nimbotta s-siġġu tar-roti?
messages.mt_standard: Tridni nimbotta s-siġġu tar-roti?
messages.zh: 要我帮你推轮椅吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to push the wheelchair?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Sa ħdejn il-mejda, grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Sa ħdejn il-mejda, grazzi.
messages.zh: 好的，麻烦你。推到桌子旁边就行，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, please. Just over to the table, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 siġġu tar-roti 整体配上一幅“坐在带轮子的椅子上移动”的画面，再搭配“使用轮椅”和“推轮椅”两个动作记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small plate used for serving a small amount of food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来盛放少量食物的小盘子或小碟子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Platt żgħir li jintuża biex jitqiegħed jew jiġi servut ammont żgħir ta' ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尺寸较小、可用于盛放点心等少量食物的盘子或碟子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Platt ta' daqs żgħir li fuqu jitqiegħed ftit ikel, bħal biċċa kejk jew xi gallettini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A small plate is a dish used to hold or serve a small portion of food.

collocations.en: a small plate with biscuits on it
collocations.zh: 一个盛着饼干的小盘子

collocations.en: put the cake on the small plate

formal.mt: Għal kull mistieden tħejja sjett tal-porċellana b'biċċa kejk.
formal.en: A small porcelain plate with a slice of cake was prepared for each guest.
formal.zh: 为每位来宾准备了一个瓷制小盘子，盘中放着一块蛋糕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tgħaddili sjett, jekk jogħġbok? Rita: Hawn, ħudu. Trid biċċa kejk ukoll?
colloquial.en: Maja: Could you pass me a small plate, please? Rita: Here, take it. Would you like a slice of cake too?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：请递给我一个小盘子，好吗？丽塔：给，拿着。你也要一块蛋糕吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħaddili sjett, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tgħaddili sjett, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请递给我一个小盘子，好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me a small plate, please?

messages.speaker: Rita (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, ħudu. Trid biċċa kejk ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, ħudu. Trid biċċa kejk ukoll?
messages.zh: 给，拿着。你也要一块蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Here, take it. Would you like a slice of cake too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sjett 与下午茶画面绑定：一块蛋糕放在小盘子上，旁边摆着茶杯。每次想起这只小盘，就练一句 għaddili sjett。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The right or state of owning something, or the authority exercised by a lord.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有某物的权利或状态，也可指领主所拥有的权威或统辖权。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dritt jew l-istat li xi ħaġa tkun ta' xi ħadd, jew is-setgħa li jkollu sid jew ħakkiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 领主所拥有的权威或统辖权；对某物的所有权或拥有状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-setgħa jew l-awtorità ta' sid jew ħakkiem fuq art jew nies; ukoll id-dritt jew l-istat li persuna tkun sid ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Lordship is the authority held by a lord, while ownership is the right or state of possessing something as its owner.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-trasferiment tas-sjieda tal-bini mill-kumpanija lill-kunsill lokali.
formal.en: The report describes the transfer of ownership of the building from the company to the local council.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该建筑的所有权从公司转移至地方议会的情况。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din ir-rota tiegħek? Maja: Iva, u għandi l-irċevuta bħala prova tas-sjieda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this bicycle yours? Maja: Yes, and I have the receipt as proof of ownership.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这辆自行车是你的吗？玛雅：是的，我还留着收据作为所有权证明。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din ir-rota tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Din ir-rota tiegħek?
messages.zh: 这辆自行车是你的吗？
messages.en: Is this bicycle yours?

messages.speaker: Maja (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandi l-irċevuta bħala prova tas-sjieda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandi l-irċevuta bħala prova tas-sjieda.
messages.zh: 是的，我还留着收据作为所有权证明。
messages.en: Yes, and I have the receipt as proof of ownership.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这是谁的？”引出 sjieda：自行车属于谁，就是所有权问题；读到领主语境时，再联想到其统辖权。用场景区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A skin disease caused by tiny mites and associated with intense itching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种由疥螨引起、常伴有明显瘙痒的皮肤病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda tal-ġilda kkawżata minn dud żgħir ħafna, li ġġib ħakk qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疥疮，一种由疥螨引起并伴有瘙痒的皮肤病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marda tal-ġilda kkawżata minn dud żgħir ħafna u kkaratterizzata minn ħakk qawwi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Scabies is a skin disease in which tiny mites cause intense itching.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi każ ta' skabbja u t-trattament mogħti lill-pazjent.
formal.en: The medical report describes a case of scabies and the treatment given to the patient.
formal.zh: 医疗报告描述了一例疥疮病例及患者接受的治疗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qallek it-tabib dwar il-ħakk? Lara: Qalli li għandi l-iskabbja u spjegali t-trattament.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the doctor tell you about the itching? Lara: He told me I have scabies and explained the treatment.
colloquial.zh: Maja：医生怎么说你身上发痒的事？Lara：他说我得了疥疮，还给我讲解了治疗方法。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qallek it-tabib dwar il-ħakk?
messages.mt_standard: X'qallek it-tabib dwar il-ħakk?
messages.zh: 医生怎么说你身上发痒的事？
messages.en: What did the doctor tell you about the itching?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li għandi l-iskabbja u spjegali t-trattament.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li għandi l-iskabbja u spjegali t-trattament.
messages.zh: 他说我得了疥疮，还给我讲解了治疗方法。
messages.en: He told me I have scabies and explained the treatment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skabbja 与“疥疮、皮肤瘙痒”的画面配对记忆，再用 każ ta' skabbja“疥疮病例”巩固名词用法；这是情境记忆，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reach the end of a period of validity or an allowed period of time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指证件、合同等达到有效期终点，或规定的期限已经结束。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jasal fi tmiem il-perjodu li fih dokument jew ftehim ikun validu, jew jintemm iż-żmien permess għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 到期；有效期届满；规定期限结束。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jasal fit-tmiem tal-validità tiegħu jew jintemm iż-żmien stabbilit għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a document or agreement expires, its period of validity comes to an end.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt skada fil-31 ta' Ottubru, u l-kumpanija qed tħejji ftehim ġdid.
formal.en: The contract expired on 31 October, and the company is preparing a new agreement.
formal.zh: 合同已于10月31日到期，公司正在准备一份新协议。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed iġġedded il-passaport? Lara: Għax skada x-xahar li għadda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you renewing your passport? Lara: Because it expired last month.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你为什么要换发护照？Lara：因为它上个月已经过期了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iġġedded il-passaport?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iġġedded il-passaport?
messages.zh: 你为什么要换发护照？
messages.en: Why are you renewing your passport?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax skada x-xahar li għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Għax skada x-xahar li għadda.
messages.zh: 因为它上个月已经过期了。
messages.en: Because it expired last month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象护照上的有效日期已经过去，用 il-passaport skada“护照过期了”整句记忆。这里的 skada 表示“它已经到期”，把动作与时间终点联系起来。

gloss_zh: 长期安排的确定性截止时点

teaching_sense.en_definition: The deadline after which long term arrangements are treated as firm under the applicable rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照适用规则，长期安排从此被视为确定安排的截止时点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin limitu li warajh l-arranġamenti għal terminu twil jitqiesu bħala stabbiliti skont ir-regoli applikabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长期确定性截止时点，即按适用规则，长期安排此后被视为确定安排的时间界限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-punt ta' żmien li warajh l-arranġamenti għal perjodu twil jitqiesu bħala stabbiliti skont ir-regoli applikabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The long term firmness deadline is the time after which long term arrangements are treated as firm under the applicable rules.

collocations.mt: tiddetermina l-iskadenza għaċ-ċertezza ta' terminu twil
collocations.en: to determine the long term firmness deadline
collocations.zh: 确定长期确定性截止时点

collocations.mt: wara l-iskadenza għaċ-ċertezza ta' terminu twil
collocations.en: after the long term firmness deadline
collocations.zh: 在长期确定性截止时点之后

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, id-dokument jistabbilixxi l-iskadenza għaċ-ċertezza ta' terminu twil għat-30 ta' Novembru f'nofsinhar, meta l-arranġamenti għal terminu twil jitqiesu bħala stabbiliti.
formal.en: In this example, the document sets the long term firmness deadline at noon on 30 November, when the long term arrangements are treated as firm.
formal.zh: 在本例中，文件将长期确定性截止时点设为11月30日中午；届时，长期安排被视为已经确定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta hi l-iskadenza għaċ-ċertezza ta' terminu twil f'dan l-eżempju? Pawlu: Fit-30 ta' Novembru f'nofsinhar; minn dak il-ħin, l-arranġamenti għal terminu twil jitqiesu bħala stabbiliti.
colloquial.en: Maja: When is the long term firmness deadline in this example? Pawlu: At noon on 30 November; from that time, the long term arrangements are treated as firm.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个例子中的长期确定性截止时点是什么时候？Pawlu：11月30日中午；从那时起，长期安排就被视为已经确定。

messages.speaker: Maja (培训学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta hi l-iskadenza għaċ-ċertezza ta' terminu twil f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: Meta hi l-iskadenza għaċ-ċertezza ta' terminu twil f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.zh: 这个例子中的长期确定性截止时点是什么时候？
messages.en: When is the long term firmness deadline in this example?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (培训讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-30 ta' Novembru f'nofsinhar; minn dak il-ħin, l-arranġamenti għal terminu twil jitqiesu bħala stabbiliti.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-30 ta' Novembru f'nofsinhar; minn dak il-ħin, l-arranġamenti għal terminu twil jitqiesu bħala stabbiliti.
messages.zh: 11月30日中午；从那时起，长期安排就被视为已经确定。
messages.en: At noon on 30 November; from that time, the long term arrangements are treated as firm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张长期计划表，在某个日期画一道线，线后安排被视为确定。把 skadenza 记作“截止时点”、ċertezza 记作“确定性”、terminu twil 记作“长期”；例句日期只是教学设定。

gloss_zh: 日前安排的确定性截止时点

teaching_sense.en_definition: The deadline after which arrangements made a day ahead are treated as firm under the applicable rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照适用规则，提前一天作出的安排从此被视为确定安排的截止时点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin limitu li warajh l-arranġamenti magħmula ġurnata bil-quddiem jitqiesu bħala stabbiliti skont ir-regoli applikabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日前确定性截止时点，即按适用规则，提前一天作出的安排此后被视为确定安排的时间界限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-punt ta' żmien li warajh l-arranġamenti għall-ġurnata ta' wara jitqiesu bħala stabbiliti skont ir-regoli applikabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The day ahead firmness deadline is the time after which arrangements for the following day are treated as firm under the applicable rules.

collocations.en: to set the day ahead firmness deadline
collocations.zh: 设定日前确定性截止时点

collocations.en: before the day ahead firmness deadline
collocations.zh: 在日前确定性截止时点之前

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-proċedura tistabbilixxi l-iskadenza għaċ-ċertezza tal-ġurnata bil-quddiem għas-14:00, meta l-arranġamenti għall-ġurnata ta' wara jitqiesu bħala stabbiliti.
formal.en: In this example, the procedure sets the day ahead firmness deadline at 14:00, when arrangements for the following day are treated as firm.
formal.zh: 在本例中，程序将日前确定性截止时点设为14:00；届时，次日的安排被视为已经确定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ħin hi l-iskadenza għaċ-ċertezza tal-ġurnata bil-quddiem f'dan l-eżempju? Mark: Fis-sagħtejn ta' waranofsinhar; minn dak il-ħin, l-arranġamenti għal għada jitqiesu bħala stabbiliti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What time is the day ahead firmness deadline in this example? Mark: At two in the afternoon; from that time, tomorrow's arrangements are treated as firm.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个例子中的日前确定性截止时点是几点？Mark：下午两点；从那时起，明天的安排就被视为已经确定。

messages.speaker: Lara (培训学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ħin hi l-iskadenza għaċ-ċertezza tal-ġurnata bil-quddiem f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: X'ħin hi l-iskadenza għaċ-ċertezza tal-ġurnata bil-quddiem f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.zh: 这个例子中的日前确定性截止时点是几点？
messages.en: What time is the day ahead firmness deadline in this example?

messages.speaker: Mark (培训讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-sagħtejn ta' waranofsinhar; minn dak il-ħin, l-arranġamenti għal għada jitqiesu bħala stabbiliti.
messages.mt_standard: Fis-sagħtejn ta' waranofsinhar; minn dak il-ħin, l-arranġamenti għal għada jitqiesu bħala stabbiliti.
messages.zh: 下午两点；从那时起，明天的安排就被视为已经确定。
messages.en: At two in the afternoon; from that time, tomorrow's arrangements are treated as firm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“今天划定时点，明天安排确定”的时间轴记忆：skadenza 提醒你找截止时点，ċertezza 提醒你关注确定性，ġurnata bil-quddiem 提醒你是提前一天。例句中的两点只是教学设定。

gloss_zh: 过时的；陈旧而不再适用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: No longer current or suitable because information, methods, or circumstances have changed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因信息、方法或情况已经改变而显得陈旧、不再适用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li m'għadux jaqbel mal-ħtiġijiet jew mal-għarfien tal-lum minħabba tibdil li seħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过时的；因未跟上变化而不再适合当前需要的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li kien jintuża jew jitqies adattat qabel, iżda m'għadux jaqbel mas-sitwazzjoni tal-lum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is outdated is no longer suitable for present use because circumstances or knowledge have changed.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport fih tagħrif skadut u għandu jiġi aġġornat qabel ma jiġi ppubblikat.
formal.en: The report contains outdated information and should be updated before publication.
formal.zh: 这份报告包含过时的信息，应在发表前更新。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-metodu għadu tajjeb? Mark: Le, huwa skadut. Ejja nippruvaw il-metodu l-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this method still any good? Mark: No, it is outdated. Let's try the new method.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个方法还好用吗？马克：不好用了，已经过时了。我们试试新方法吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-metodu għadu tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-metodu għadu tajjeb?
messages.zh: 这个方法还好用吗？
messages.en: Is this method still any good?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa skadut. Ejja nippruvaw il-metodu l-ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa skadut. Ejja nippruvaw il-metodu l-ġdid.
messages.zh: 不好用了，已经过时了。我们试试新方法吧。
messages.en: No, it is outdated. Let's try the new method.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skadut 和“旧方法跟不上新情况”的画面绑定：看到旧资料需要更新，就回想 tagħrif skadut，记住重点是“过时、不再适用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very tall building with many floors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 楼层很多、高度很高的建筑物，即摩天大楼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini għoli ħafna b'ħafna sulari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摩天大楼；具有很多楼层的高耸建筑物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bini li għandu ħafna sulari u li jilħaq għoli kbir ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A skyscraper is a very tall building that has many floors.

formal.mt: Il-pjan jinkludi skajskrejper b'ħamsin sular u spazju pubbliku madwaru.
formal.en: The plan includes a fifty-storey skyscraper with public space around it.
formal.zh: 该规划包括一座五十层的摩天大楼及其周围的公共空间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara dak l-iskajskrejper? Pawlu: Iva! Kemm għandu sulari?
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see that skyscraper? Pawlu: Yes! How many floors does it have?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到那座摩天大楼了吗？保罗：看到了！它有多少层？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dak l-iskajskrejper?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dak l-iskajskrejper?
messages.zh: 你看到那座摩天大楼了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that skyscraper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Kemm għandu sulari?
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Kemm għandu sulari?
messages.zh: 看到了！它有多少层？
messages.en: Yes! How many floors does it have?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skajskrejper 写在一幅高楼图旁，从楼底向上数很多层，再读整个词，用“高到仰头看”的画面记住“摩天大楼”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name Skalambja, retained in its supplied form without a specified referent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名称 Skalambja；所给资料未说明其具体指称，学习时保留原文。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem Skalambja, li fit-tagħrif mogħti ma ġiex speċifikat għal xiex jirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Skalambja；保留原文的名称，具体所指未在所给资料中说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem mogħti bħala Skalambja, mingħajr tagħrif li jidentifika b'mod aktar preċiż għal xiex jirreferi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Skalambja is presented as a name, but the supplied information does not identify its referent.

collocations.en: the spelling of the name Skalambja
the pronunciation of the name Skalambja

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, ikteb l-isem Skalambja b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu.
formal.en: In this exercise, write the name Skalambja with an initial capital letter.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，书写名称 Skalambja 时首字母要大写。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'isem għandi nikteb hawn? Marija: Ikteb Skalambja, kif jidher fl-eżempju.
colloquial.en: Anna: What name should I write here? Marija: Write Skalambja, as it appears in the example.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这里我该写什么名称？玛丽亚：写 Skalambja，照例子里的写法。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'isem għandi nikteb hawn?
messages.mt_standard: X'isem għandi nikteb hawn?
messages.zh: 这里我该写什么名称？
messages.en: What name should I write here?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb Skalambja, kif jidher fl-eżempju.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb Skalambja, kif jidher fl-eżempju.
messages.zh: 写 Skalambja，照例子里的写法。
messages.en: Write Skalambja, as it appears in the example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Skalambja 当作一张名称卡片来记：正面抄写完整拼写并圈出大写 S，背面写“具体所指待语境确认”，避免凭空联想成人名或地名。

gloss_zh: 尖细碎片；通常指木刺或木头碎片

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small sharp fragment, usually a thin piece of wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 细小而尖锐的碎片，通常指从木头上裂出的木刺或细木片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira u bil-ponta, ġeneralment tal-injam, li tkun inqalgħet minn biċċa akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尖细的小碎片，通常为木刺或木头碎片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira u bil-ponta, ħafna drabi tal-injam, li tinqala' minn biċċa akbar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A skalda is a small sharp fragment, typically a thin piece that has broken away from wood.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木刺；从木头等材料上裂出的细小尖片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa rqiqa u bil-ponta li tinqala' minn injama jew minn materjal ieħor u li tista' tidħol fil-ġilda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A splinter is a small thin fragment of wood or another material that can pierce the skin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尖锐的碎片，通常是木头碎片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Framment b'ponta jew b'tarf li jaqta', ġeneralment magħmul mill-injam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This sense refers to a fragment with a sharp point or edge, usually broken from a piece of wood.

collocations.zh: 一根木刺；一片尖细木屑

formal.mt: Waqt li kien qed iċaqlaq it-tavla, il-ħaddiem induna li skalda tal-injam kienet daħlet f'subgħajh.
formal.en: While moving the plank, the worker noticed that a wood splinter had entered his finger.
formal.zh: 工人在搬动木板时，发现一根木刺扎进了手指。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Ajma, daħlitli skalda f'subgħajja! Rita: Ejja ħdejn id-dawl biex narawha aħjar.
colloquial.en: Ben: Ow, I've got a splinter in my finger! Rita: Come over to the light so we can see it better.
colloquial.zh: 本：哎哟，我手指扎进一根刺了！丽塔：到亮一点的地方来，我们好看清楚。

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ajma, daħlitli skalda f'subgħajja!
messages.mt_standard: Ajma, daħlitli skalda f'subgħajja!
messages.zh: 哎哟，我手指扎进一根刺了！
messages.en: Ow, I've got a splinter in my finger!

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)

teaching_sense.en_definition: Canary seed is seed used as food for canaries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作金丝雀饲料的籽实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żerriegħa li tintuża bħala ikel għall-kanarini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供金丝雀食用的籽实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żerriegħa li tingħata lill-kanarini bħala ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Canary seed is seed that people give to canaries as food.

formal.mt: Il-ħanut ibigħ skalora f'boroż żgħar għall-għalf tal-kanarini.
formal.en: The shop sells canary seed in small bags for feeding canaries.
formal.zh: 这家商店出售小袋装的金丝雀食用籽，用于喂养金丝雀。

gloss_zh: 按预定时间进行的交换

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scheduled exchange is an exchange arranged to take place at a specified time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事先安排在指定时间进行的交换。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skambju li jkun ippjanat li jsir f'ħin stabbilit minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已安排在预定时间进行的交换。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skambju bejn partijiet li jkun ġie arranġat għal ħin speċifiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A scheduled exchange is one that the participants have arranged to carry out at a particular time.

collocations.zh: 安排在明天进行的交换

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju kkonferma li l-iskambju skedat ta' dokumenti se jsir għada fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The office confirmed that the scheduled exchange of documents will take place tomorrow at ten in the morning.
formal.zh: 办公室确认，预定的文件交换将于明天上午十点进行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad għandna l-iskambju skedat ta' kotba għada? Mark: Iva, niltaqgħu fil-ħamsa quddiem il-librerija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is our scheduled book exchange still on for tomorrow? Mark: Yes, let's meet at five in front of the library.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们预定的换书活动明天还照常进行吗？Mark：是的，我们五点在图书馆门前见吧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The exchange of resources held in reserve for use when needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 交换预先保留、可在需要时使用的备用资源；在电力语境中指备用资源的交换。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iskambju ta' riżorsi miżmuma bħala riżerva biex jintużaw meta jkun hemm bżonn; fil-kuntest tal-elettriku, dawn jgħinu biex jinżamm il-bilanċ tas-sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预留以备需要时使用的资源的交换；在电力语境中指备用资源交换。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa l-iskambju ta' riżorsi li jinżammu lesti għal użu aktar tard jekk jinqala' l-bżonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When reserves are exchanged, resources kept available for future needs are transferred or made available to another party.

collocations.en: an agreement on the exchange of reserves
collocations.zh: 关于备用资源交换的协议

collocations.en: coordination of the exchange of reserves

formal.mt: Fil-kuntest tas-sistema tal-elettriku, il-pjan jiddeskrivi kif l-iskambju ta' riservi jista' jgħin meta jkun hemm bżonn ta' riżorsi addizzjonali.
formal.en: In the context of the electricity system, the plan describes how the exchange of reserves can help when additional resources are needed.
formal.zh: 在电力系统语境下，该计划说明了备用资源交换如何在需要额外资源时发挥作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għandna bżonn skambju ta' riservi? David: Biex inkunu nistgħu nużaw riżorsi miżmuma lesti meta jkollna bżonnhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do we need an exchange of reserves? David: So that we can use resources kept ready when we need them.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们为什么需要交换备用资源？David：这样在有需要时，我们就能使用预先准备好的资源。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)

messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandna bżonn skambju ta' riservi?
messages.zh: 我们为什么需要交换备用资源？
messages.en: Why do we need an exchange of reserves?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inkunu nistgħu nużaw riżorsi miżmuma lesti meta jkollna bżonnhom.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inkunu nistgħu nużaw riżorsi miżmuma lesti meta jkollna bżonnhom.
messages.zh: 这样在有需要时，我们就能使用预先准备好的资源。
messages.en: So that we can use resources kept ready when we need them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 riservi 想成标有“备用”的资源箱：资源先留好，需要时再使用；skambju ta' riservi 就记作“备用资源交换”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The exchange of services that help maintain the balance between electricity supply and demand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 交换帮助维持电力供需平衡的服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iskambju ta' servizzi li jgħinu biex jinżamm il-bilanċ bejn il-provvista u d-domanda għall-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于维持电力供需平衡的服务的交换。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa l-iskambju ta' servizzi li jintużaw biex il-provvista tal-elettriku u l-konsum tiegħu jibqgħu bbilanċjati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When balancing services are exchanged, one party provides another with services that help keep electricity supply and demand in balance.

collocations.mt: ftehim dwar l-iskambju ta' servizzi ta' bbilanċjar

collocations.zh: 关于平衡服务交换的协议

collocations.mt: il-koordinazzjoni tal-iskambju ta' servizzi ta' bbilanċjar
collocations.en: coordination of the exchange of balancing services

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi l-iskambju ta' servizzi ta' bbilanċjar bejn il-partijiet u jispjega kif dawn is-servizzi jgħinu biex jinżamm il-bilanċ tas-sistema tal-elettriku.
formal.en: The document describes the exchange of balancing services between the parties and explains how these services help maintain the balance of the electricity system.
formal.zh: 该文件介绍了各方之间的平衡服务交换，并说明这些服务如何帮助维持电力系统的平衡。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'jinkludi l-iskambju ta' servizzi ta' bbilanċjar? Ġanni: Servizzi li jgħinu biex il-provvista tal-elettriku taqbel mal-konsum.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does the exchange of balancing services involve? Ġanni: Services that help electricity supply match consumption.
colloquial.zh: Marija：平衡服务交换涉及什么？Ġanni：涉及帮助供电量与用电量相匹配的服务。

messages.en: What does the exchange of balancing services involve?

messages.zh: 涉及帮助供电量与用电量相匹配的服务。
messages.en: Services that help electricity supply match consumption.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三块记忆：skambju 是交换，servizzi 是服务，ta' bbilanċjar 表示用于平衡；连起来就是“交换帮助电力供需平衡的服务”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The exchange of electrical energy used to balance electricity supply and demand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 交换用于平衡电力供需的电能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iskambju ta' enerġija elettrika li tintuża biex jinżamm bilanċ bejn il-provvista u d-domanda għall-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于维持电力供需平衡的电能的交换。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa l-iskambju ta' enerġija elettrika użata biex tiġi bbilanċjata l-provvista mal-konsum tal-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When balancing energy is exchanged, electrical energy is transferred to help match electricity supply with demand.

collocations.mt: ftehim dwar l-iskambju tal-enerġija ta' bbilanċjar
collocations.en: an agreement on the exchange of balancing energy
collocations.zh: 关于平衡电能交换的协议

collocations.en: the volume of balancing energy exchanged

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza l-iskambju tal-enerġija ta' bbilanċjar u r-rwol tiegħu fiż-żamma tal-bilanċ bejn il-provvista u d-domanda għall-elettriku.
formal.en: The report analyses the exchange of balancing energy and its role in maintaining the balance between electricity supply and demand.
formal.zh: 报告分析了平衡电能交换及其在维持电力供需平衡方面的作用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri skambju tal-enerġija ta' bbilanċjar? Pawlu: Jiġifieri skambju ta' enerġija elettrika biex il-provvista taqbel mad-domanda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does exchange of balancing energy mean? Pawlu: It means exchanging electrical energy so that supply matches demand.
colloquial.zh: Lara：平衡电能交换是什么意思？Pawlu：就是交换电能，使供电量与需求量相匹配。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)

messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri skambju ta' enerġija elettrika biex il-provvista taqbel mad-domanda.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri skambju ta' enerġija elettrika biex il-provvista taqbel mad-domanda.
messages.zh: 就是交换电能，使供电量与需求量相匹配。
messages.en: It means exchanging electrical energy so that supply matches demand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把电力供需想成天平：enerġija 提醒你关注用于调平的电能，skambju 提醒你关注交换；合起来记作“平衡电能交换”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The exchange of capacity made available to help balance electricity supply and demand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 交换为平衡电力供需而准备的可用调节容量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iskambju ta' kapaċità disponibbli biex tintuża meta jkun hemm bżonn jiġi bbilanċjat il-forniment tal-elettriku mal-konsum tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于电力供需平衡的可用调节容量的交换。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa l-iskambju ta' kapaċità miżmuma disponibbli sabiex tkun tista' tgħin fiż-żamma tal-bilanċ bejn il-provvista u d-domanda għall-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When balancing capacity is exchanged, capacity available for adjusting electricity supply or consumption is made available to another party.

collocations.mt: ftehim dwar l-iskambju tal-kapaċità ta' bbilanċjar
collocations.en: an agreement on the exchange of balancing capacity
collocations.zh: 关于平衡容量交换的协议

collocations.en: the conditions for the exchange of balancing capacity

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet għall-iskambju tal-kapaċità ta' bbilanċjar u jispeċifika kemm għandha tkun disponibbli kapaċità.
formal.en: The agreement sets out the conditions for the exchange of balancing capacity and specifies how much capacity must be available.
formal.zh: 协议规定了平衡容量交换的条件，并明确必须提供多少可用容量。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fl-iskambju tal-kapaċità ta' bbilanċjar, qed nitkellmu fuq elettriku li diġà ntuża? Mark: Le, fuq kapaċità disponibbli biex tgħin fil-bilanċ meta jkun hemm bżonn.

teaching_sense.en_definition: An event involving wrongdoing that causes public shock or anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及不当行为并引起公众震惊、愤怒或谴责的事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja li tinvolvi mġiba ħażina u tqajjem xokk, rabja jew kundanna fost il-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因不当行为曝光而引起公众震惊或谴责的丑闻。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skandlu huwa każ ta' mġiba ħażina li jsir magħruf u jqajjem għadab jew kundanna pubblika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A scandal is an event involving wrongdoing that shocks people and attracts public criticism.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab investigazzjoni indipendenti dwar l-iskandlu finanzjarju.
formal.en: The committee requested an independent investigation into the financial scandal.
formal.zh: 委员会要求对这起金融丑闻展开独立调查。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Smajt bl-iskandlu li semmew fl-aħbarijiet? Pawlu: Iva, imma għadni ma nafx id-dettalji kollha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you hear about the scandal they mentioned on the news? Pawlu: Yes, but I still don't know all the details.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你听说新闻里提到的那起丑闻了吗？Pawlu：听说了，不过我还不知道全部细节。
