messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'skibidi' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'skibidi' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的 skibidi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'skibidi' mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna bżonn il-kuntest. Din il-lista tagħti l-kelma u l-kategorija, iżda ma tispjegax it-tifsira speċifika.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna bżonn il-kuntest. Din il-lista tagħti l-kelma u l-kategorija, iżda ma tispjegax it-tifsira speċifika.
messages.zh: 我们需要上下文。这份词表给出了词形和类别，但没有解释具体含义。
messages.en: We need the context. This list gives the word and its category, but it doesn't explain the specific meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skibidi 做成一张分格词卡，分别标注形容词、副词、名词；另格记录 skibidi toilet 的 punct 标签，提醒自己先看语境再确定含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move over snow using skis attached to your feet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脚上穿着滑雪板，在雪面上滑行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiżżerżaq fuq il-borra permezz ta' ski li jintlibsu fuq is-saqajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿着滑雪板在雪上滑行；滑雪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiżżerżaq fuq il-borra bi ski mwaħħlin mas-saqajn, bħala sport jew għall-gost.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone skis, they travel over snow on skis attached to their feet.

formal.mt: Matul il-kors tax-xitwa, Mark skija fuq mogħdija faċli taħt is-superviżjoni tal-għalliem.
formal.en: During the winter course, Mark skied on an easy trail under the instructor's supervision.
formal.zh: 在冬季课程期间，马克在教练的指导下沿着一条简单的雪道滑雪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark skija għall-ewwel darba lbieraħ. Nina: Iva, u qal li ħa gost ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark skied for the first time yesterday. Nina: Yes, and he said he really enjoyed it!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克昨天第一次滑雪。妮娜：是啊，他还说玩得特别开心！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark skija għall-ewwel darba lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Mark skija għall-ewwel darba lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 马克昨天第一次滑雪。
messages.en: Mark skied for the first time yesterday.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u qal li ħa gost ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u qal li ħa gost ħafna!
messages.zh: 是啊，他还说玩得特别开心！
messages.en: Yes, and he said he really enjoyed it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skija 配上“双脚踩板滑过白雪”的动作画面，连同 fuq il-borra 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Brisk and concise in expression, or quick in movement or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容表达简短利落，或动作、行动迅速。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun qasir u pront fil-kliem, jew mgħaġġel fil-moviment jew fl-azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容回答或表达简短、明快、干脆利落的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun qasir, ċar u pront, speċjalment meta jingħad dwar tweġiba jew espressjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A snappy reply or expression is short, brisk, and gets its point across immediately.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迅速的；动作敏捷或用时很短的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jsir malajr jew li juri ħeffa fil-moviment jew fl-azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A quick movement or action happens rapidly and takes very little time.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, id-direttur ta tweġiba skjetta u mbagħad għadda għall-punt li jmiss.
formal.en: During the meeting, the director gave a snappy reply and then moved on to the next point.
formal.zh: 会议期间，主管作了一个干脆利落的回答，随后转入下一个议题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Agħtini tweġiba skjetta: ġej magħna? Mark: Iva, ġej! Niltaqgħu fis-sebgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Give me a snappy answer: are you coming with us? Mark: Yes, I am! Let's meet at seven.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：干脆点回答我：你跟我们一起去吗？马克：去！我们七点见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħtini tweġiba skjetta: ġej magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Agħtini tweġiba skjetta: ġej magħna?
messages.zh: 干脆点回答我：你跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Give me a snappy answer: are you coming with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej! Niltaqgħu fis-sebgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej! Niltaqgħu fis-sebgħa.
messages.zh: 去！我们七点见。
messages.en: Yes, I am! Let's meet at seven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“回答利落、迈步迅速”两个画面记 skjett；搭配阴性名词 tweġiba 时，留意形式 skjetta。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small mammal with a bushy tail that often climbs trees and eats nuts and seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种尾巴蓬松、常在树上攀爬并以坚果和种子等为食的小型哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir li jredda', b'denb folt, li spiss jitla' mas-siġar u jiekol ġewż u żrieragħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松鼠，一种尾巴蓬松、善于攀爬的小型啮齿动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Gerriem żgħir b'denb folt li spiss jgħix fis-siġar u jiekol ġewż, żrieragħ u ikel ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A squirrel is a small rodent with a bushy tail that often climbs trees and feeds on nuts and seeds.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-foresta, l-istudenti raw skojjatlu jiġbor iż-żrieragħ taħt siġra.
formal.en: During their observation in the forest, the students saw a squirrel gathering seeds under a tree.
formal.zh: 在森林观察活动中，学生们看到一只松鼠在树下收集种子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-iskojjatlu fuq il-fergħa! Mark: Rajtu! X'denb folt għandu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that squirrel on the branch! Mark: I see it! What a bushy tail it has!
colloquial.zh: Maja：看树枝上那只松鼠！Mark：看到了！它的尾巴真蓬松！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-iskojjatlu fuq il-fergħa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-iskojjatlu fuq il-fergħa!
messages.zh: 看树枝上那只松鼠！
messages.en: Look at that squirrel on the branch!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu! X'denb folt għandu!
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu! X'denb folt għandu!
messages.zh: 看到了！它的尾巴真蓬松！
messages.en: I see it! What a bushy tail it has!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skojjatlu 和“蓬松尾巴、树上攀爬、抱着坚果”的松鼠画面一起记，再用 skojjatlu aħmar 练习说“红松鼠”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A school where young children receive care and early education before starting primary school.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为尚未进入小学的幼儿提供照护、游戏和早期教育的学校。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skola fejn tfal żgħar jirċievu kura u edukazzjoni bikrija permezz tal-logħob u ta' attivitajiet oħra qabel jibdew l-iskola primarja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幼儿园，为入小学前的幼儿提供照护及早期教育的机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Istituzzjoni edukattiva għal tfal żgħar li għadhom ma bdewx l-iskola primarja, fejn jitgħallmu u jiżviluppaw permezz tal-logħob u ta' attivitajiet adattati għall-età tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A nursery school is a school where young children learn through play and other activities before beginning primary education.

formal.mt: L-iskola tan-nuna toffri attivitajiet ta' logħob u tagħlim li jgħinu lit-tfal jiżviluppaw il-lingwa u l-ħiliet soċjali tagħhom.
formal.en: The nursery school offers play and learning activities that help children develop their language and social skills.
formal.zh: 这所幼儿园提供游戏和学习活动，帮助幼儿发展语言能力与社交技能。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għoġbitek l-iskola tan-nuna llum? Nina: Iva! Lgħabt ma' sħabi u pinġejt qattus.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you enjoy nursery school today? Nina: Yes! I played with my friends and drew a cat.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今天在幼儿园玩得开心吗？Nina：开心！我和朋友们一起玩，还画了一只猫。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġbitek l-iskola tan-nuna llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għoġbitek l-iskola tan-nuna llum?
messages.zh: 今天在幼儿园玩得开心吗？
messages.en: Did you enjoy nursery school today?

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Lgħabt ma' sħabi u pinġejt qattus.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Lgħabt ma' sħabi u pinġejt qattus.
messages.zh: 开心！我和朋友们一起玩，还画了一只猫。
messages.en: Yes! I played with my friends and drew a cat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skola tan-nuna 整体记成“幼儿园”，配上小朋友画画、唱歌和一起游戏的画面，再练习说 jattendi skola tan-nuna。

gloss_zh: 学业的；学校教育的；经院哲学或神学的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to school learning or education, or to Scholastic philosophy or theology.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与学校学习或教育有关的；也可指属于经院哲学或经院神学的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-tagħlim fl-iskola jew mal-edukazzjoni, jew li jappartjeni għall-filosofija jew it-teoloġija skolastika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学业的，涉及学校中的学习、学术活动或学习表现的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-istudju, mat-tagħlim jew mal-kisbiet tal-istudenti fl-iskola.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Scholastic activities or achievements concern studying and learning at school.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学校的；教育的，涉及学校事务、教学安排或教育活动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-iskejjel, l-organizzazzjoni tagħhom jew l-attivitajiet edukattivi li jsiru fihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described this way relates to schools or the organization and provision of education.

sense_translations.en_definition: belonging to the Scholastic school of philosophy or theology
sense_translations.zh_definition: 经院哲学或经院神学的，属于这一哲学或神学学派及其思想方法的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għall-iskola skolastika tal-filosofija jew tat-teoloġija u għall-metodi ta' ħsieb tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Scholastic thought belongs to a school of philosophy or theology that uses systematic reasoning to examine questions of knowledge and faith.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-progress skolastiku tal-istudenti u jipproponi miżuri biex jitjieb it-tagħlim.
formal.en: The report examines the students' scholastic progress and proposes measures to improve learning.
formal.zh: 该报告考察学生的学业进展，并提出改善学习的措施。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejjer ix-xogħol skolastiku tiegħek? Pawlu: Tajjeb, imma għandi ħafna x'nistudja din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is your schoolwork going? Pawlu: Well, but I have a lot to study this week.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你的功课做得怎么样？Pawlu：挺好，不过这周有很多东西要学。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer ix-xogħol skolastiku tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer ix-xogħol skolastiku tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的功课做得怎么样？
messages.en: How is your schoolwork going?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, imma għandi ħafna x'nistudja din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, imma għandi ħafna x'nistudja din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 挺好，不过这周有很多东西要学。
messages.en: Well, but I have a lot to study this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用搭配区分词义：suċċess skolastiku 联想学业成绩，sena skolastika 联想学年，ħsieb skolastiku 联想经院思想；看到具体名词再选中文义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ridge or mass of rock or coral lying at or near the surface of the sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于海面附近或水面以下，由岩石或珊瑚形成的礁体或礁脉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda jew massa ta' blat jew qroll fil-baħar li tinsab qrib wiċċ l-ilma jew eżatt taħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 礁，由岩石或珊瑚形成、位于海面附近或水下较浅处的隆起地形。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Formazzjoni ta' blat jew qroll li titla' minn qiegħ il-baħar sa qrib wiċċ l-ilma u tista' tkun mgħottija bl-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reef is a ridge or mass of rock or coral that lies close to the surface of the sea.

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi skoll qrib id-daħla tal-bajja, u d-dgħajjes għandhom iżommu distanza minnu.
formal.en: The map shows a reef near the entrance to the bay, and boats should keep their distance from it.
formal.zh: 地图标示海湾入口附近有一处礁体，船只应与其保持距离。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'hemm hemmhekk, taħt l-ilma? Rita: Dak skoll. Ejja nduru madwaru bid-dgħajsa.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's over there, under the water? Rita: That's a reef. Let's take the boat around it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：那边水下是什么？Rita：那是一处礁。我们开船绕过去吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'hemm hemmhekk, taħt l-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: X'hemm hemmhekk, taħt l-ilma?
messages.zh: 那边水下是什么？
messages.en: What's over there, under the water?

messages.speaker: Rita (船长)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak skoll. Ejja nduru madwaru bid-dgħajsa.
messages.mt_standard: Dak skoll. Ejja nduru madwaru bid-dgħajsa.
messages.zh: 那是一处礁。我们开船绕过去吧。
messages.en: That's a reef. Let's take the boat around it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 skoll 时想象海面下浅浅的一道礁，船只需要绕行；再用 skoll tal-qroll 把“礁”和“珊瑚礁”的搭配一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show that someone is not guilty or responsible for an alleged wrongdoing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过证据或解释表明某人没有犯下被指控的过错，或不应为该过错负责。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Turi, permezz ta' provi jew spjegazzjoni, li persuna mhix ħatja jew responsabbli għal xi ħaġa ħażina li ġiet akkużata biha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 证明某人没有被指控的罪责；洗清某人的过错或责任。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Turi li persuna mhix ħatja ta' dak li ġiet akkużata bih jew li ma għandhiex tinżamm responsabbli għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If evidence or an explanation exculpates someone, it shows that they are not guilty of the wrongdoing attributed to them.

collocations.en: evidence that may exculpate the accused
collocations.zh: 可能证明被告无罪的证据

collocations.en: to clear his companion of blame

formal.mt: Ir-reġistrazzjoni tista' tiskolpa lill-akkużat, għax turi li kien f'post ieħor meta seħħ l-inċident.
formal.en: The recording may exculpate the accused because it shows that he was elsewhere when the incident occurred.
formal.zh: 这段录像可能证明被告无罪，因为它显示事发时他在别处。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Qed jgħidu li Pawlu kisser it-tieqa. David: Imma dan il-filmat jista' jiskolpa lil Pawlu; kien magħna l-ħin kollu.
colloquial.en: Marta: They're saying that Pawlu broke the window. David: But this video can clear Pawlu of blame; he was with us the whole time.
colloquial.zh: Marta：他们说是保罗打破了窗户。David：可这段视频能洗清保罗的责任；他一直和我们在一起。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jgħidu li Pawlu kisser it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jgħidu li Pawlu kisser it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 他们说是保罗打破了窗户。
messages.en: They're saying that Pawlu broke the window.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Imma dan il-filmat jista' jiskolpa lil Pawlu; kien magħna l-ħin kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Imma dan il-filmat jista' jiskolpa lil Pawlu; kien magħna l-ħin kollu.
messages.zh: 可这段视频能洗清保罗的责任；他一直和我们在一起。
messages.en: But this video can clear Pawlu of blame; he was with us the whole time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skolpa 放进“录像证明朋友不在现场”的画面中，记住它表示用证据洗清罪责，而不是简单地请求原谅。

gloss_zh: 不舒适的；不自在的；心神不安的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physically uncomfortable or mentally uneasy in a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容身体感到不舒适，或在某种处境中感到不自在、局促或不安。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx komdu fiżikament, jew li jħossu mħasseb jew mhux f'postu f'ċerta sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体感觉不舒服的；使人难以舒适地坐着、躺着或活动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jagħtix kumdità jew li jġiegħel lil persuna tħoss nuqqas ta' kumdità fiżika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are uncomfortable, your body does not feel relaxed or at ease, often because of your position or surroundings.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因担忧、局促或对处境缺乏把握而感到不安或不自在的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħossu mħasseb, imbarazzat jew mhux għalkollox kalm minħabba s-sitwazzjoni li jinsab fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you feel uneasy, you are worried or not fully relaxed about a situation or something that might happen.

collocations.en: to feel uneasy in front of people

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant ħassu skomdu meta ntalab jiddiskuti kwistjonijiet personali quddiem il-grupp.
formal.en: The participant felt uneasy when he was asked to discuss personal matters in front of the group.
formal.zh: 当被要求在小组面前谈论私人问题时，这位参与者感到不自在。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tibdel il-pożizzjoni l-ħin kollu? Mark: Dan is-siġġu skomdu ħafna; se nġib ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you keep shifting your position? Mark: This chair is very uncomfortable; I'll get another one.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么老是换姿势？Mark：这把椅子坐着太不舒服了，我去拿另一把。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tibdel il-pożizzjoni l-ħin kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tibdel il-pożizzjoni l-ħin kollu?
messages.zh: 你怎么老是换姿势？
messages.en: Why do you keep shifting your position?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-siġġu skomdu ħafna; se nġib ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-siġġu skomdu ħafna; se nġib ieħor.
messages.zh: 这把椅子坐着太不舒服了，我去拿另一把。
messages.en: This chair is very uncomfortable; I'll get another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 skomdu：硬椅子让身体不舒服，当众谈私事让心里不自在；这个形容词可以描述这两类感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of physical discomfort or a lack of ease in a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体不舒服的感觉，也可指在某种处境中缺乏自在、安适的感受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' nuqqas ta' kumdità fil-ġisem jew ta' nuqqas ta' serħan f'ċerta sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体上的不适感，或因处境令人不自在而产生的不舒服感受。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni mhux pjaċevoli li tinħass meta l-ġisem ma jkunx komdu jew meta sitwazzjoni ġġiegħel lil persuna tħossha mhux f'postha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Discomfort is an unpleasant feeling that you experience when your body is not comfortable or a situation makes you feel ill at ease.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, il-parteċipant semma sens ta' skomfort wara li qatta' sagħtejn bilqiegħda fuq siġġu iebes.
formal.en: In his report, the participant mentioned a feeling of discomfort after spending two hours sitting on a hard chair.
formal.zh: 这位参与者在报告中提到，在硬椅子上坐了两个小时后，他感到不适。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid tieqaf ftit mill-mixi? Pawlu: Iva, qed inħoss ftit skomfort f'saqajja; ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you want to take a short break from walking? Pawlu: Yes, I'm feeling some discomfort in my feet; let's sit down.
colloquial.zh: Nina：要不要停下来歇一会儿？Pawlu：好，我的脚有点不舒服；我们坐一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tieqaf ftit mill-mixi?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tieqaf ftit mill-mixi?
messages.zh: 要不要停下来歇一会儿？
messages.en: Do you want to take a short break from walking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed inħoss ftit skomfort f'saqajja; ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed inħoss ftit skomfort f'saqajja; ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 好，我的脚有点不舒服；我们坐一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, I'm feeling some discomfort in my feet; let's sit down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skomfort 记作可以被“感到”或“引起”的不适感：inħoss skomfort 是感到不适，jikkawża skomfort 是引起不适。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A separate section within a larger space, vehicle, bag, or container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 较大空间、车辆、包袋或容器内部划分出来的独立部分，如隔间、隔层或分格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti separata ġewwa spazju akbar, vettura, borża jew kontenitur, maħsuba biex iżżomm nies jew oġġetti apparti minn oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由隔板、边界等划分出来的内部空间；车辆的隔间或容器、包袋的隔层。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sezzjoni ta' spazju, vettura jew kontenitur li tkun mifruda mill-bqija permezz ta' ħitan, diviżorji jew xi forma oħra ta' separazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A compartment is one of the separate sections into which a larger enclosed space or container is divided.

formal.mt: Il-bagalja għandha skompartiment separat għad-dokumenti, sabiex dawn jinżammu organizzati waqt il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The suitcase has a separate compartment for documents so that they can be kept organized during the journey.
formal.zh: 这只行李箱设有独立的文件隔层，方便在旅途中有序存放文件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn poġġejt il-passaport? Toni: Fl-iskompartiment ta' quddiem tal-borża; hemm ħdejn il-biljett.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you put the passport? Toni: In the front compartment of the bag; it's there beside the ticket.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你把护照放哪儿了？Toni：在包的前面隔层里，就在票旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġejt il-passaport?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġejt il-passaport?
messages.zh: 你把护照放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the passport?

messages.speaker: Toni (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-iskompartiment ta' quddiem tal-borża; hemm ħdejn il-biljett.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-iskompartiment ta' quddiem tal-borża; hemm ħdejn il-biljett.
messages.zh: 在包的前面隔层里，就在票旁边。
messages.en: In the front compartment of the bag; it's there beside the ticket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开旅行包，护照和衣物分别放在不同隔层；每个被分开的内部空间都可以帮助你记住 skompartiment。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally exclude someone from the communion of a church.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由教会正式对某人施以绝罚，将其排除在教会共融之外。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tneħħi uffiċjalment lil xi ħadd mill-komunjoni tal-Knisja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由教会正式对某人施以绝罚，将其排除在教会共融之外。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tneħħi uffiċjalment lil xi ħadd mill-komunjoni tal-Knisja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a church excommunicates someone, it formally excludes that person from its religious communion.

collocations.en: excommunicated a member of the Church
collocations.zh: 将一名教会成员逐出教会

formal.mt: Id-dokument jgħid li l-isqof skomunika lil membru tal-Knisja.
formal.en: The document states that the bishop excommunicated a member of the Church.
formal.zh: 文件记载，主教将一名教会成员逐出了教会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'skomunika' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Ifisser li neħħa lil xi ħadd mill-komunjoni tal-Knisja.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'skomunika' mean in this sentence? Mark: It means that he excluded someone from the communion of the Church.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这句话里的 skomunika 是什么意思？Mark：意思是他把某人排除在教会共融之外。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'skomunika' f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'skomunika' f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这句话里的 skomunika 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'skomunika' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li neħħa lil xi ħadd mill-komunjoni tal-Knisja.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li neħħa lil xi ħadd mill-komunjoni tal-Knisja.
messages.zh: 意思是他把某人排除在教会共融之外。
messages.en: It means that he excluded someone from the communion of the Church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“主教宣布绝罚”的场景来记，并连同 lil xi ħadd（某人）一起练习，突出动作针对一个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break or remove a connection between things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使原本连接的事物分离，或中断设备、线路等之间的连接。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqta' jew tneħħi l-konnessjoni bejn ħaġa u oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 断开事物之间的连接；使设备、线路等不再相连。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tneħħi l-konnessjoni li tgħaqqad apparat jew ħaġa ma' apparat jew ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you disconnect something, you break or remove the connection linking it to something else.

collocations.en: disconnected the device from the electricity supply
collocations.zh: 断开设备与电源的连接

collocations.en: disconnected the computer from the network
collocations.zh: 断开电脑与网络的连接

formal.mt: Qabel beda x-xogħol ta' manutenzjoni, it-tekniku skonnettja l-apparat mill-elettriku.
formal.en: Before beginning the maintenance work, the technician disconnected the device from the electricity supply.
formal.zh: 开始维护工作之前，技术人员断开了设备与电源的连接。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-kompjuter m'għadux fuq in-netwerk? Mark: It-tekniku skonnettja l-kompjuter min-netwerk biex jagħmel xi testijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the computer no longer on the network? Mark: The technician disconnected the computer from the network to run some tests.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电脑怎么不再连着网络了？Mark：技术人员断开了电脑与网络的连接，要做一些测试。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kompjuter m'għadux fuq in-netwerk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kompjuter m'għadux fuq in-netwerk?
messages.zh: 电脑怎么不再连着网络了？
messages.en: Why is the computer no longer on the network?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tekniku skonnettja l-kompjuter min-netwerk biex jagħmel xi testijiet.
messages.mt_standard: It-tekniku skonnettja l-kompjuter min-netwerk biex jagħmel xi testijiet.
messages.zh: 技术人员断开了电脑与网络的连接，要做一些测试。
messages.en: The technician disconnected the computer from the network to run some tests.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把连接电脑的网线拔下，画面就是“断开连接”；连读 skonnettja l-kompjuter min-netwerk，把动作、设备和断开的对象一起记住。

gloss_zh: 递延折扣；延后兑现的折扣

teaching_sense.en_definition: A price reduction that is applied at a later agreed time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照约定在之后的时间才实际给予或抵扣的价格优惠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-prezz li jiġi applikat aktar tard, skont il-kundizzjonijiet miftiehma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 递延折扣，即按约定延后给予或抵扣的价格优惠。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skont li ma jiġix applikat minnufih iżda jingħata f'ħin aktar tard skont ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A deferred discount is a price reduction that is applied at a later agreed time.

collocations.mt: japplika skont differit fuq il-fattura li jmiss
collocations.en: apply a deferred discount to the next invoice
collocations.zh: 在下一张发票上抵扣递延折扣

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jipprovdi għal skont differit li jiġi applikat fuq il-fattura tax-xahar li jmiss.
formal.en: The agreement provides for a deferred discount to be applied to next month's invoice.
formal.zh: 协议规定给予递延折扣，并在下个月的发票上抵扣。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex l-iskont ma jidhirx fuq din il-fattura? Rita: Għax huwa skont differit; jiġi applikat max-xiri li jmiss.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why isn't the discount shown on this invoice? Rita: Because it's a deferred discount; it will be applied to your next purchase.
colloquial.zh: 马克：为什么这张发票上没有显示折扣？丽塔：因为这是递延折扣，会在你下次购物时抵扣。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-iskont ma jidhirx fuq din il-fattura?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-iskont ma jidhirx fuq din il-fattura?
messages.zh: 为什么这张发票上没有显示折扣？
messages.en: Why isn't the discount shown on this invoice?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa skont differit; jiġi applikat max-xiri li jmiss.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa skont differit; jiġi applikat max-xiri li jmiss.
messages.zh: 因为这是递延折扣，会在你下次购物时抵扣。
messages.en: Because it's a deferred discount; it will be applied to your next purchase.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词记成“优惠先约好，之后再抵扣”，用下次购物才兑现的折扣画面帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 扣除；给予折扣；度过某段时间（尤指服刑）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deduct an amount, give a discount, or undergo a period of time, especially in confinement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从金额中扣除一部分、给予价格折扣，或度过某段时间，尤其指在拘禁中服刑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqas ammont minn somma, tagħti skont fuq prezz, jew tgħaddi perjodu ta' żmien, speċjalment fil-ħabs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从总数或总金额中减去、扣除某个数额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tnaqqas ammont minn total jew minn somma ta' flus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you deduct an amount, you subtract it from a larger total.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予折扣，将商品或服务的价格降低。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti skont billi tnaqqas il-prezz ta' prodott jew servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you provide a discount, you reduce the price that a customer has to pay.

sense_translations.en_definition: to undergo (used for periods of time, especially of confinement, e.g. in a correctional facility)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 度过或经受某段时间，尤指在监狱等拘禁场所服刑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħaddi perjodu ta' żmien f'ċerta kundizzjoni, speċjalment meta tkun qed tiskonta sentenza ta' ħabs.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone undergoes a period of confinement, they spend that time in custody, such as while serving a prison sentence.

collocations.en: deducted the expenses from the total
discounted the price by ten percent
collocations.zh: 将价格降低了百分之十

formal.mt: Il-kontabilist skonta l-ispejjeż mit-total qabel ħejja r-rapport finanzjarju.
formal.en: The accountant deducted the expenses from the total before preparing the financial report.
formal.zh: 会计在编制财务报告之前，从总额中扣除了费用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħallast inqas għall-mejda? Mark: Il-bejjiegħ skonta l-prezz b'għaxra fil-mija għax kienet l-aħħar waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you pay less for the table? Mark: The seller discounted the price by ten percent because it was the last one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你买这张桌子怎么付得少了？Mark：因为这是最后一张，卖家给了百分之十的折扣。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallast inqas għall-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallast inqas għall-mejda?
messages.zh: 你买这张桌子怎么付得少了？
messages.en: Why did you pay less for the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bejjiegħ skonta l-prezz b'għaxra fil-mija għax kienet l-aħħar waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bejjiegħ skonta l-prezz b'għaxra fil-mija għax kienet l-aħħar waħda.
messages.zh: 因为这是最后一张，卖家给了百分之十的折扣。
messages.en: The seller discounted the price by ten percent because it was the last one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张场景卡分别记忆：账单扣费用、商店给折扣、囚犯服刑期。看到金额、价格或刑期宾语时，再判断 skonta 对应哪一个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb whose meaning is not established by the supplied packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给资料将此词列为动词，但未提供可确定其具体含义的信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan huwa verb li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex speċifikata fil-pakkett mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未明；所给资料仅标明其词性为动词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pakkett jidentifika din il-kelma bħala verb, iżda ma jagħtix it-tifsira tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied packet identifies this word as a verb but does not establish its meaning.

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jelenka 'skonġra' bħala verb, iżda ma jispeċifikax it-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The packet lists 'skonġra' as a verb but does not specify its meaning.
formal.zh: 该资料将 skonġra 列为动词，但没有说明其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser il-verb 'skonġra'? Mark: Il-pakkett ma jagħtix it-tifsira tiegħu, allura ma nistgħux niddeterminawha minn din l-informazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the verb 'skonġra' mean? Mark: The packet does not give its meaning, so we cannot determine it from this information.
colloquial.zh: Maja：动词 skonġra 是什么意思？Mark：资料没有给出它的含义，所以我们无法根据这些信息确定词义。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser il-verb 'skonġra'?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser il-verb 'skonġra'?
messages.zh: 动词 skonġra 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the verb 'skonġra' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pakkett ma jagħtix it-tifsira tiegħu, allura ma nistgħux niddeterminawha minn din l-informazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pakkett ma jagħtix it-tifsira tiegħu, allura ma nistgħux niddeterminawha minn din l-informazzjoni.
messages.zh: 资料没有给出它的含义，所以我们无法根据这些信息确定词义。
messages.en: The packet does not give its meaning, so we cannot determine it from this information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 skonġra 记在“词义待确认”的动词卡片上，保留 ġ 上的小点；本条搭配和对话只练习讨论词语，不据此猜测实际词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Found or made known after previously being unknown or unnoticed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 先前未知或未被注意，后来被找到或获知的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li nstab jew sar magħruf wara li qabel ma kienx magħruf jew ma kienx ġie nnutat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被发现的，指原先未知或未被注意而后来被找到或获知的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie misjub jew magħruf wara tfittxija, osservazzjoni jew b'kumbinazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is discovered has been found or become known after previously being unknown or unnoticed.

collocations.zh: 挖掘过程中发现的遗址

formal.mt: L-oġġett skopert waqt l-iskavi ġie rreġistrat u fotografat.
formal.en: The object discovered during the excavations was recorded and photographed.
formal.zh: 挖掘过程中发现的物件已被登记并拍照。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt ir-ritratti tal-post skopert ilbieraħ? Pawlu: Iva, jidher sabiħ! Immorru narawh?
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen the photos of the place discovered yesterday? Pawlu: Yes, it looks beautiful! Shall we go and see it?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看过昨天发现的那个地方的照片吗？保罗：看过，那里看起来很美！我们去看看吧？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt ir-ritratti tal-post skopert ilbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt ir-ritratti tal-post skopert ilbieraħ?
messages.zh: 你看过昨天发现的那个地方的照片吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the photos of the place discovered yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidher sabiħ! Immorru narawh?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidher sabiħ! Immorru narawh?
messages.zh: 看过，那里看起来很美！我们去看看吧？
messages.en: Yes, it looks beautiful! Shall we go and see it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给刚找到的物件贴上“已发现”标签；skopert 描述物件被发现后的状态。

gloss_zh: 发现；发现之事或发现成果

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of finding or learning about something previously unknown, or the thing found.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 找到或获知先前未知事物的行为，也指由此发现的事物或成果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ssib jew issir taf b'xi ħaġa li qabel ma kinitx magħrufa, jew il-ħaġa li tinstab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发现，指找到或认识先前未知事物的过程，也可指发现的事物或成果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sejba ta' xi ħaġa li qabel ma kinitx magħrufa, jew il-ħaġa ġdida li tkun instabet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A discovery is the act of finding or learning about something previously unknown, or the thing that is found.

formal.mt: Din l-iskoperta xjentifika għenet lir-riċerkaturi jifhmu aħjar kif tikber il-pjanta.
formal.en: This scientific discovery helped the researchers better understand how the plant grows.
formal.zh: 这项科学发现帮助研究人员更好地理解这种植物如何生长。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sibt kafetterija żgħira ħdejn il-pjazza. Toni: X'skoperta sabiħa! Immorru nieħdu kafè hemm għada?
colloquial.en: Lara: I found a little café near the square. Toni: What a lovely discovery! Shall we have coffee there tomorrow?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我在广场附近发现了一家小咖啡馆。托尼：这个发现真不错！我们明天去那里喝咖啡吧？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt kafetterija żgħira ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Sibt kafetterija żgħira ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 我在广场附近发现了一家小咖啡馆。
messages.en: I found a little café near the square.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'skoperta sabiħa! Immorru nieħdu kafè hemm għada?
messages.mt_standard: X'skoperta sabiħa! Immorru nieħdu kafè hemm għada?
messages.zh: 这个发现真不错！我们明天去那里喝咖啡吧？
messages.en: What a lovely discovery! Shall we have coffee there tomorrow?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skoperta 放进“一个重要发现”的名词格子里：既能说发现这件事，也能说发现的成果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To notice the presence of something or find something previously unknown.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 察觉或检测到某事物的存在，或找到、获知先前未知的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinduna bil-preżenza ta' xi ħaġa jew isib xi ħaġa li qabel ma kinitx magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 察觉或检测到某事物的存在，尤其指不容易直接注意到的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jinduna bil-preżenza ta' xi ħaġa, speċjalment meta ma tkunx tidher jew tinħass faċilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you detect something, you notice or identify its presence, especially when it is not immediately obvious.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发现，指找到某事物或首次获知先前不知道的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isib xi ħaġa jew isir jaf b'xi ħaġa li qabel ma kienx jaf biha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you discover something, you find it or learn about it for the first time.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, it-tekniku skopra tnixxija żgħira fil-pajp.
formal.en: During the inspection, the technician detected a small leak in the pipe.
formal.zh: 检查过程中，技术员发现管道有一处轻微泄漏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Skoprejt ħanut tal-kotba qrib id-dar! David: Kif sirt taf bih? Sara: Għaddejt minn triq differenti u rajtu.
colloquial.en: Sara: I discovered a bookshop near home! David: How did you find out about it? Sara: I took a different street and saw it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我发现家附近有一家书店！戴维：你怎么发现的？萨拉：我走了另一条街，就看到了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skoprejt ħanut tal-kotba qrib id-dar!
messages.mt_standard: Skoprejt ħanut tal-kotba qrib id-dar!
messages.zh: 我发现家附近有一家书店！
messages.en: I discovered a bookshop near home!

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sirt taf bih?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sirt taf bih?
messages.zh: 你怎么发现的？
messages.en: How did you find out about it?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddejt minn triq differenti u rajtu.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddejt minn triq differenti u rajtu.
messages.zh: 我走了另一条街，就看到了。
messages.en: I took a different street and saw it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记住动作：检查时发现漏水对应 detect，散步时发现书店对应 discover。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number of points or goals achieved by a player or team, or the figures showing the result of a game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 选手或球队在比赛中获得的分数、进球数，或表示双方比赛结果的比分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għadd ta' punti jew gowls li jikseb plejer jew tim, jew iċ-ċifri li juru r-riżultat ta' logħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比赛中的得分，或显示双方得分情况的比分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għadd ta' punti jew gowls miksuba f'logħba, jew iċ-ċifri li juru kemm kisbet kull naħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The score in a game is the number of points or goals that each player or team has achieved.

formal.mt: L-iskor finali tal-partita kien tnejn b'wieħed favur it-tim tad-dar.
formal.en: The final score of the match was two to one in favour of the home team.
formal.zh: 比赛最终比分为二比一，主队获胜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu l-iskor? Mark: Wieħed b'wieħed, u għad fadal għaxar minuti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the score? Mark: One all, and there are still ten minutes left.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：现在比分是多少？马克：一比一，还剩十分钟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu l-iskor?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu l-iskor?
messages.zh: 现在比分是多少？
messages.en: What's the score?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wieħed b'wieħed, u għad fadal għaxar minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Wieħed b'wieħed, u għad fadal għaxar minuti.
messages.zh: 一比一，还剩十分钟。
messages.en: One all, and there are still ten minutes left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skor 放在球场记分牌的画面中记忆：牌上显示的是“比分”；连记 l-iskor finali，就是“最终比分”。

gloss_zh: 使气馁；使打消做某事的念头

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reduce someone's confidence or enthusiasm, or make them less willing to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 削弱某人的信心或热情，使其气馁，或使其不再愿意做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqas il-kuraġġ jew il-ħeġġa ta' xi ħadd, jew iġġiegħlu ma jibqax irid jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人失去信心、勇气或热情；使气馁。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlef il-kuraġġ, il-fiduċja fih innifsu jew il-ħeġġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something discourages you, it makes you feel less confident or less enthusiastic about what you are doing.

sense_translations.en_definition: to put sb. off doing sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人不愿意做某事，或打消其原本打算做某事的念头。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd ma jkunx irid jagħmel xi ħaġa li kien qed jaħseb jew jippjana li jagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something puts you off doing something, it makes you less willing to do it or leads you to abandon the idea.

collocations.mt: jiskoraġġixxi lil xi ħadd milli japplika
collocations.zh: 使某人打消申请的念头

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' appoġġ skoraġġixxa lil diversi studenti milli japplikaw għall-programm.
formal.en: The lack of support discouraged several students from applying for the programme.
formal.zh: 缺乏支持使几名学生打消了申请该项目的念头。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-prezz skoraġġik milli tmur għall-kors? Luqa: Iva, imma se nfittex kors irħas.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the price put you off taking the course? Luqa: Yes, but I'll look for a cheaper course.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：价格让你打消了去上这门课的念头吗？卢卡：是的，不过我会找一门更便宜的课。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)

messages.zh: 价格让你打消了去上这门课的念头吗？
messages.en: Did the price put you off taking the course?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma se nfittex kors irħas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个连续画面记忆：先是信心下降的“气馁”，再是收起报名表的“打消念头”；搭配 milli 时留意后面不愿再做的事情。

gloss_zh: 得分；进球（尤指体育比赛中）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To win a point or points, or get a goal, especially in a sporting game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在比赛中获得分数或攻入进球，尤用于体育比赛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikseb punt jew punti, jew tagħmel gowl, speċjalment f'logħba sportiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在比赛中得分或进球，尤指体育比赛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tikseb punti jew tagħmel gowl waqt logħba, speċjalment f'kompetizzjoni sportiva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a player or team scores, they gain a point or points, for example by getting a goal.

formal.mt: L-attakkant skorja l-gowl tar-rebħa fl-aħħar minuta tal-partita.
formal.en: The striker scored the winning goal in the final minute of the match.
formal.zh: 前锋在比赛最后一分钟攻入了制胜球。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min skorja t-tieni gowl? Pawlu: Mark! Kien xutt mill-isbaħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who scored the second goal? Pawlu: Mark! It was a brilliant shot.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：第二个球是谁进的？保罗：马克！那一脚射门太精彩了。

messages.speaker: Nina (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min skorja t-tieni gowl?
messages.mt_standard: Min skorja t-tieni gowl?
messages.zh: 第二个球是谁进的？
messages.en: Who scored the second goal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark! Kien xutt mill-isbaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Mark! Kien xutt mill-isbaħ.
messages.zh: 马克！那一脚射门太精彩了。
messages.en: Mark! It was a brilliant shot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skorja 配上球飞进球门的动作来记：“进球、得分”是动作；再与名词 skor“比分”对照，区分进球动作和记分结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go beyond a limit or amount, or to move past someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 超过某个限度或数量，或在移动中越过某人或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqbeż limitu jew ammont, jew tgħaddi lil hinn minn persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在数量、程度等方面超过规定的限度或某个数值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkun akbar minn ammont jew ogħla minn limitu stabbilit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something exceeds a limit or amount, it is greater than that limit or amount.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从某人或某物旁边通过，移动到其前方或另一侧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħaddi minn ħdejn persuna jew ħaġa u tasal quddiemha jew fuq in-naħa l-oħra tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you get past someone or something, you move beyond their position and continue on your way.

formal.mt: Il-kont finali skorra l-limitu tal-baġit b'mitt ewro.
formal.en: The final bill exceeded the budget limit by one hundred euros.
formal.zh: 最终账单超出预算限额一百欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt kif Mark skorra lill-avversarju tiegħu? Luqa: Iva, għadda minn ħdejh eżatt qabel it-tmiem!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see how Mark got past his opponent? Luqa: Yes, he went past him just before the finish!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到马克是怎么超过对手的吗？卢卡：看到了，他就在终点前超过了对方！

messages.speaker: Maja (观赛朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kif Mark skorra lill-avversarju tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kif Mark skorra lill-avversarju tiegħu?
messages.zh: 你看到马克是怎么超过对手的吗？
messages.en: Did you see how Mark got past his opponent?

messages.speaker: Luqa (观赛朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadda minn ħdejh eżatt qabel it-tmiem!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadda minn ħdejh eżatt qabel it-tmiem!
messages.zh: 看到了，他就在终点前超过了对方！
messages.en: Yes, he went past him just before the finish!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“越过一条线”串联两义：数字越过预算线是“超出”，跑者越过对手的位置是“超过”；这是帮助理解的场景联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or group that accompanies someone to provide protection or assistance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 陪同他人以提供保护或协助的人或队伍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew grupp ta' nies li jakkumpanjaw lil xi ħadd biex jipproteġuh jew jgħinuh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为提供保护或协助而陪同他人的人或队伍；护送人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew grupp ta' nies li jakkumpanjaw lil xi ħadd biex jipprovdu protezzjoni jew għajnuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An escort is a person or group accompanying someone to provide protection or assistance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陪同或护送某人，通常为了提供保护、协助或引路。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Takkumpanja lil xi ħadd biex tipproteġih, tgħinu jew turih it-triq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you escort someone, you accompany them to provide protection, assistance, or guidance.

formal.mt: Id-delegazzjoni waslet fil-bini taħt skorta tal-pulizija.
formal.en: The delegation arrived at the building under police escort.
formal.zh: 代表团在警方护送下抵达大楼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm il-pulizija ħdejn il-karozza? Mark: Qed jipprovdu skorta lill-mistieden.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there police officers beside the car? Mark: They are providing an escort for the guest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么汽车旁边有警察？马克：他们正在为来宾提供护送。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm il-pulizija ħdejn il-karozza?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm il-pulizija ħdejn il-karozza?
messages.zh: 为什么汽车旁边有警察？
messages.en: Why are there police officers beside the car?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jipprovdu skorta lill-mistieden.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jipprovdu skorta lill-mistieden.
messages.zh: 他们正在为来宾提供护送。
messages.en: They are providing an escort for the guest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skorta 和警察陪着来宾前行的画面一起记：名词指护送人员，动词指护送这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden sharp movement or shaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然发生的一下猛烈震动或颠簸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment jew theżżiża qawwija li sseħħ f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然的一下震动、猛晃或颠簸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Theżżiża jew ċaqliq qawwi u għal għarrieda, bħal meta vettura tgħaddi minn fuq ħofra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A jolt is a sudden sharp movement that shakes someone or something.

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri ħassew skoss qawwi meta l-karozza tal-linja għaddiet minn fuq ħofra.
formal.en: The passengers felt a strong jolt when the bus went over a pothole.
formal.zh: 公交车驶过路面的坑洞时，乘客们感到一下猛烈的颠簸。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħassejt dak l-iskoss? Pawlu: Iva, il-karozza għaddiet minn fuq ħofra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you feel that jolt? Pawlu: Yes, the car went over a pothole.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你感觉到刚才那一下颠簸了吗？保罗：感觉到了，车子驶过了一个坑。

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt dak l-iskoss?
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt dak l-iskoss?
messages.zh: 你感觉到刚才那一下颠簸了吗？
messages.en: Did you feel that jolt?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-karozza għaddiet minn fuq ħofra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-karozza għaddiet minn fuq ħofra.
messages.zh: 感觉到了，车子驶过了一个坑。
messages.en: Yes, the car went over a pothole.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 skoss 时想象车轮突然过坑、身体猛地一颠；把它记成可数的“一下震动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move something sharply back and forth or up and down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物来回或上下晃动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċċaqlaq xi ħaġa bis-saħħa 'l quddiem u lura jew 'il fuq u 'l isfel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇动或抖动某物，使其来回或上下移动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċċaqlaq xi ħaġa ripetutament u bis-saħħa 'l quddiem u lura jew 'il fuq u 'l isfel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you shake something, you move it sharply back and forth or up and down.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem skossja l-flixkun biex iħallat il-likwidu qabel l-użu.
formal.en: The worker shook the bottle to mix the liquid before use.
formal.zh: 工作人员在使用前摇动瓶子，使液体混合均匀。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu skossja t-tapit barra? Maja: Biex ineħħi t-trab qabel idaħħlu lura.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu shake the rug outside? Maja: To remove the dust before bringing it back in.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗为什么在外面抖地毯？玛雅：为了先把灰尘抖掉，再拿回屋里。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu skossja t-tapit barra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu skossja t-tapit barra?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么在外面抖地毯？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu shake the rug outside?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ineħħi t-trab qabel idaħħlu lura.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ineħħi t-trab qabel idaħħlu lura.
messages.zh: 为了先把灰尘抖掉，再拿回屋里。
messages.en: To remove the dust before bringing it back in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作记 skossja：双手拿瓶子来回摇，再拿地毯上下抖；两个场景都突出“使物体晃动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who comes from Scotland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自苏格兰的人；苏格兰人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġejja mill-Iskozja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苏格兰人；来自苏格兰的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ġejja mill-Iskozja jew li għandha identità nazzjonali Skoċċiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Scottish person is someone who comes from Scotland or identifies with its people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苏格兰的；与苏格兰、苏格兰人或其文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Iskozja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something Scottish comes from Scotland or is connected with its people or culture.

collocations.zh: 来自爱丁堡的苏格兰人

formal.mt: Il-mistieden huwa Skoċċiż li ġie mistieden jitkellem dwar il-wirt kulturali Skoċċiż.
formal.en: The guest is a Scottish person who was invited to speak about Scottish cultural heritage.
formal.zh: 这位嘉宾是一名苏格兰人，受邀介绍苏格兰文化遗产。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int Skoċċiż? Iain: Iva, jien minn Edinburgh, imma issa noqgħod Malta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you Scottish? Iain: Yes, I'm from Edinburgh, but I live in Malta now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是苏格兰人吗？伊恩：是的，我来自爱丁堡，不过现在住在马耳他。

messages.speaker: Maja (新朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int Skoċċiż?
messages.mt_standard: Int Skoċċiż?
messages.zh: 你是苏格兰人吗？
messages.en: Are you Scottish?

messages.speaker: Iain (苏格兰来客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien minn Edinburgh, imma issa noqgħod Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien minn Edinburgh, imma issa noqgħod Malta.
messages.zh: 是的，我来自爱丁堡，不过现在住在马耳他。
messages.en: Yes, I'm from Edinburgh, but I live in Malta now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Skoċċiż 放进两张记忆卡：人物卡写“苏格兰人”，作家卡写 kittieb Skoċċiż，区分名词与形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surface on which images, text, or video are displayed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于显示图像、文字或视频的屏幕或银幕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiċċ li fuqu jintwerew stampi, kliem jew filmati, bħal dak ta' kompjuter jew televixin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显示文字、图像或视频的屏幕；放映影像的银幕。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wiċċ ta' apparat elettroniku jew wiċċ għall-projezzjoni li fuqu jintwerew kliem, stampi jew filmati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A screen is a surface on which you can see text, pictures, or moving images.

formal.mt: Matul il-preżentazzjoni, ir-riżultati ntwerew fuq skrin kbir biex kulħadd seta' jaqrahom.
formal.en: During the presentation, the results were displayed on a large screen so that everyone could read them.
formal.zh: 演示期间，结果显示在大屏幕上，以便所有人都能阅读。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tara r-ritratt fuq l-iskrin? Sara: Iva, imma tista' tkabbru ftit?
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you see the photo on the screen? Sara: Yes, but can you make it a little bigger?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你能看到屏幕上的照片吗？萨拉：能，不过你可以把它放大一点吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tara r-ritratt fuq l-iskrin?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tara r-ritratt fuq l-iskrin?
messages.zh: 你能看到屏幕上的照片吗？
messages.en: Can you see the photo on the screen?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma tista' tkabbru ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma tista' tkabbru ftit?
messages.zh: 能，不过你可以把它放大一点吗？
messages.en: Yes, but can you make it a little bigger?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skrin 贴在脑中的电脑屏幕上，再连记 fuq l-iskrin，意思是“在屏幕上”，用位置短语巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Writing regarded as sacred within a religious tradition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某一宗教传统中被视为神圣的文字或经典。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kitba li titqies qaddisa fi ħdan tradizzjoni reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某一宗教所尊奉的经文或神圣经典。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kitba jew ġabra ta' kitbiet li r-reliġjon tqis bħala qaddisa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Scripture is writing that followers of a religion regard as sacred.

formal.mt: L-istudenti qraw silta mill-Iskrittura Mqaddsa u ddiskutew it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The students read a passage from Holy Scripture and discussed its meaning.
formal.zh: 学生们阅读了一段圣经经文，并讨论了它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Liema silta mill-Iskrittura se naqraw illum? Pawlu: Se naqraw din is-silta qasira u nitkellmu dwarha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Which passage from Scripture are we going to read today? Pawlu: We are going to read this short passage and talk about it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：今天我们要读哪一段经文？保罗：我们要读这段短经文，然后聊聊它。

messages.speaker: Marija (学习小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema silta mill-Iskrittura se naqraw illum?
messages.mt_standard: Liema silta mill-Iskrittura se naqraw illum?
messages.zh: 今天我们要读哪一段经文？
messages.en: Which passage from Scripture are we going to read today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学习小组带领者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se naqraw din is-silta qasira u nitkellmu dwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Se naqraw din is-silta qasira u nitkellmu dwarha.
messages.zh: 我们要读这段短经文，然后聊聊它。
messages.en: We are going to read this short passage and talk about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skrittura 与翻开圣典、诵读经文的画面相连；连记 silta mill-Iskrittura，意思是“一段经文”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job involves handling documents, records, and routine office tasks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责处理文件、登记资料及日常办公室事务的工作人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tieħu ħsieb dokumenti, iżżomm rekords u tagħmel xogħol amministrattiv ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在办公室或办事机构中处理文件、记录等事务的文员或办事员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Impjegat li jieħu ħsieb dokumenti, rekords u ħidmiet amministrattivi f'uffiċċju jew istituzzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clerk is someone employed to handle records, documents, and routine administrative work.

formal.mt: L-iskrivan irreġistra l-applikazzjoni u ta kopja tagħha lill-applikant.
formal.en: The clerk registered the application and gave the applicant a copy.
formal.zh: 办事员登记了申请，并向申请人提供了一份副本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lil min nagħti din il-formola? Mark: Agħtiha lill-iskrivan ħdejn il-bieb; hu jieħu ħsieb l-applikazzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who should I give this form to? Mark: Give it to the clerk by the door; he handles applications.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张表格该交给谁？马克：交给门边的那位办事员；他负责处理申请。

messages.speaker: Lara (办事群众)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nagħti din il-formola?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nagħti din il-formola?
messages.zh: 这张表格该交给谁？
messages.en: Who should I give this form to?

messages.speaker: Mark (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħtiha lill-iskrivan ħdejn il-bieb; hu jieħu ħsieb l-applikazzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Agħtiha lill-iskrivan ħdejn il-bieb; hu jieħu ħsieb l-applikazzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 交给门边的那位办事员；他负责处理申请。
messages.en: Give it to the clerk by the door; he handles applications.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 skrivan，就想象一位正在登记表格、整理文件的文员；用 jaħdem bħala skrivan“担任文员”整句记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of furniture used for writing, studying, or office work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供书写、学习或办公使用的桌子，也可指带抽屉或储物格的写字台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamara b'wiċċ ċatt għall-kitba, għall-istudju jew għax-xogħol tal-uffiċċju, li jista' jkollha kxaxen jew kompartimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供书写、学习或办公使用的书桌或办公桌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mejda maħsuba għall-kitba, għall-istudju jew għax-xogħol tal-uffiċċju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A desk is a piece of furniture at which you write, study, or work.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常带有抽屉或储物格、供书写使用的写字台。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għamara għall-kitba li ġeneralment ikollha kxaxen jew kompartimenti fejn jinżammu karti u oġġetti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bureau is a writing desk that usually includes drawers or compartments for storage.

formal.mt: Kull student għandu skrivanija b'kexxun fejn jista' jżomm il-materjal tal-istudju.
formal.en: Each student has a desk with a drawer in which to keep study materials.
formal.zh: 每名学生都有一张带抽屉的书桌，可以在抽屉里存放学习用品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn ħallejt il-pinna tiegħi? Luka: Fuq l-iskrivanija, ħdejn il-kompjuter. Nina: Sibtha, grazzi!
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did I leave my pen? Luka: On the desk, next to the computer. Nina: Found it, thanks!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我把笔放在哪儿了？卢卡：在书桌上，电脑旁边。妮娜：找到了，谢谢！

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn ħallejt il-pinna tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn ħallejt il-pinna tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我把笔放在哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did I leave my pen?

messages.speaker: Luka (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-iskrivanija, ħdejn il-kompjuter.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-iskrivanija, ħdejn il-kompjuter.
messages.zh: 在书桌上，电脑旁边。
messages.en: On the desk, next to the computer.

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibtha, grazzi!
messages.mt_standard: Sibtha, grazzi!
messages.zh: 找到了，谢谢！
messages.en: Found it, thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skrivanija 贴在想象中的书桌上：桌面放电脑，抽屉放文具；用 fuq l-iskrivanija“在书桌上”固定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Words written or engraved on an object or monument, including commemorative words on a grave.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写在或刻在物件、纪念物上的文字，也可指墓碑上纪念逝者的文字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem miktub jew imnaqqax fuq oġġett jew monument, inkluż kliem fuq qabar b'tifkira ta' persuna mejta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 写在或刻在石碑、建筑物、器物等表面的文字；铭文或碑文。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kliem miktub jew imnaqqax fuq il-wiċċ ta' oġġett, bini jew monument.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inscription is a set of words written or engraved on an object or monument.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刻写在墓碑上、用于纪念或描述逝者的文字；墓志铭。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kliem miktub jew imnaqqax fuq qabar li jfakkar jew jiddeskrivi l-persuna midfuna fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An epitaph is wording on a grave that commemorates the person buried there.

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur qara l-iskrizzjoni fuq il-monument u rreġistra l-ismijiet u d-data li kien fiha.
formal.en: The researcher read the inscription on the monument and recorded the names and date it contained.
formal.zh: 研究人员阅读了纪念碑上的铭文，并记录了其中的人名和日期。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tista' taqra l-iskrizzjoni fuq dan il-qabar? David: Iva, tgħid li kien missier maħbub u ħabib ta' kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you read the epitaph on this grave? David: Yes, it says he was a beloved father and a friend to everyone.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你能读清这座墓碑上的墓志铭吗？戴维：能，上面说他是一位深受爱戴的父亲，也是大家的朋友。

messages.speaker: Anna (墓园访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' taqra l-iskrizzjoni fuq dan il-qabar?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' taqra l-iskrizzjoni fuq dan il-qabar?
messages.zh: 你能读清这座墓碑上的墓志铭吗？
messages.en: Can you read the epitaph on this grave?

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tgħid li kien missier maħbub u ħabib ta' kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tgħid li kien missier maħbub u ħabib ta' kulħadd.
messages.zh: 能，上面说他是一位深受爱戴的父亲，也是大家的朋友。
messages.en: Yes, it says he was a beloved father and a friend to everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skrizzjoni 想成石头上可读的文字：纪念碑上的叫铭文，墓碑上纪念逝者的叫墓志铭；借助所在位置区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device with rotating blades that moves a boat or aircraft through water or air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过叶片旋转推动水或空气，使船只或飞机前进的装置；螺旋桨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat bi xfafar li jduru u jimbuttaw l-ilma jew l-arja biex imexxu dgħajsa jew ajruplan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 螺旋桨；通过旋转叶片产生推力、推动船只或飞机的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat bi xfafar li jduru fl-ilma jew fl-arja biex joħolqu l-forza li tmexxi dgħajsa jew ajruplan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A propellor is a device whose blades rotate to push a boat or aircraft through water or air.

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, it-tekniku ċċekkja li l-iskrun tad-dgħajsa kien imwaħħal sew.
formal.en: Before departure, the technician checked that the boat's propeller was securely attached.
formal.zh: 出发前，技术人员检查了船的螺旋桨是否安装牢固。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex id-dgħajsa mhix miexja? Mark: L-iskrun ma jdurx. Irridu niċċekkjawh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't the boat moving? Mark: The propeller isn't turning. We need to check it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：船为什么不动？Mark：螺旋桨不转了。我们得检查一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex id-dgħajsa mhix miexja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex id-dgħajsa mhix miexja?
messages.zh: 船为什么不动？
messages.en: Why isn't the boat moving?

messages.speaker: Mark (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-iskrun ma jdurx. Irridu niċċekkjawh.
messages.mt_standard: L-iskrun ma jdurx. Irridu niċċekkjawh.
messages.zh: 螺旋桨不转了。我们得检查一下。
messages.en: The propeller isn't turning. We need to check it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skrun 和船尾旋转的叶片一起记：叶片转动推水，船便向前，想到这个画面就想到“螺旋桨”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of doubt or uneasiness about an action, especially because it may be morally wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种行为产生的不安或疑虑，尤其指担心该行为违背道德而产生的良心顾忌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dubju jew tħassib dwar azzjoni, speċjalment minħabba l-biża' li din tkun ħażina minn naħa morali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某件事或某种行为感到的不安、疑虑或犹豫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sens ta' tħassib jew dubju dwar xi ħaġa li jista' jġiegħel lil persuna toqgħod lura milli taġixxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A qualm is a feeling of doubt or uneasiness that makes you hesitate about doing something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 道德上的顾忌；因担心做错事而产生的良心不安。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dubju tal-kuxjenza dwar jekk azzjoni tkunx tajba jew ħażina, li jġiegħel lil persuna taħsibha qabel tagħmilha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A scruple is a moral doubt that makes you reluctant to do something you believe may be wrong.

collocations.zh: 毫无顾忌地；毫无良心不安地

formal.mt: Il-membru tal-kumitat esprima skruplu morali dwar l-aċċettazzjoni tar-rigal mingħand il-fornitur.
formal.en: The committee member expressed a moral scruple about accepting the gift from the supplier.
formal.zh: 该委员会成员表示，接受供应商的礼物令他在道德上有所顾忌。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi skruplu dwar dan ir-rigal. Naħseb li jrid xi ħaġa lura. Pawlu: Mela aħjar ma taċċettahx.
colloquial.en: Lara: I have a qualm about this gift. I think he wants something in return. Pawlu: Then you'd better not accept it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这份礼物让我有点不安。我觉得他想要回报。Pawlu：那你最好别收。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi skruplu dwar dan ir-rigal. Naħseb li jrid xi ħaġa lura.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi skruplu dwar dan ir-rigal. Naħseb li jrid xi ħaġa lura.
messages.zh: 这份礼物让我有点不安。我觉得他想要回报。
messages.en: I have a qualm about this gift. I think he wants something in return.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela aħjar ma taċċettahx.
messages.mt_standard: Mela aħjar ma taċċettahx.
messages.zh: 那你最好别收。
messages.en: Then you'd better not accept it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skruplu 记成收礼前心里亮起的小警灯：一般的不安对应 qualm，涉及对错和良心时对应 scruple。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful and detailed examination of something in order to assess it or discover problems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了评估情况、核实内容或发现问题而进行的仔细、深入的检查或审查。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami bir-reqqa u fid-dettall ta' xi ħaġa biex tiġi evalwata, jiġu vverifikati l-fatti jew jinstabu problemi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仔细审查；对某事物进行严密、细致的检查或考察。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżami attent u dettaljat ta' xi ħaġa, bil-għan li wieħed jifhimha sew jew jinduna b'xi żball jew problema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Scrutiny is the careful examination of something, especially when people want to assess its quality or find problems.

collocations.zh: 受到公众的审视和监督

formal.mt: Il-kumitat issuġġetta l-proposta għal skrutinju bir-reqqa qabel ma approvaha.
formal.en: The committee subjected the proposal to close scrutiny before approving it.
formal.zh: 委员会在批准该提案前，对其进行了仔细审查。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadek ma bgħattx ir-rapport? David: Le, għadu taħt skrutinju. Qed jiċċekkjaw iċ-ċifri kollha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Haven't you sent the report yet? David: No, it's still under scrutiny. They're checking all the figures.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你还没把报告发出去吗？David：还没有，还在仔细审查。他们正在核对所有数字。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek ma bgħattx ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek ma bgħattx ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 你还没把报告发出去吗？
messages.en: Haven't you sent the report yet?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu taħt skrutinju. Qed jiċċekkjaw iċ-ċifri kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu taħt skrutinju. Qed jiċċekkjaw iċ-ċifri kollha.
messages.zh: 还没有，还在仔细审查。他们正在核对所有数字。
messages.en: No, it's still under scrutiny. They're checking all the figures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 skrutinju 就想象拿着放大镜逐项核对报告：重点是仔细检查每个细节，把它与“严密审查”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plate fitted around a keyhole to protect or decorate the surrounding surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安装在钥匙孔周围、用来保护或装饰孔口周边表面的小片状配件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanċa mwaħħla madwar it-toqba taċ-ċavetta biex tipproteġi jew iżżejjen il-wiċċ ta' madwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钥匙孔护片或饰片；固定在钥匙孔周围、保护或装饰孔口的小片状配件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanċa li titwaħħal madwar it-toqba fejn tidħol iċ-ċavetta, biex tipproteġi l-wiċċ ta' madwar it-toqba jew isservi ta' tiżjin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A key-hole plate is a small fitting placed around a keyhole to protect or decorate the surrounding surface.

formal.mt: Waqt ir-restawr tal-bieb, il-ħaddiem waħħal skudett tar-ram madwar it-toqba taċ-ċavetta.
formal.en: During the restoration of the door, the worker fitted a brass keyhole plate around the keyhole.
formal.zh: 修复门扇时，工人在钥匙孔周围安装了一块黄铜护片。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Din il-pjanċa żgħira madwar it-toqba taċ-ċavetta x'jisimha? Toni: Skudett. Trid wieħed bħalu għall-bieb tiegħek?
colloquial.en: Rita: What's this little plate around the keyhole called? Toni: A keyhole plate. Do you want one like it for your door?
colloquial.zh: Rita：钥匙孔周围这块小片叫什么？Toni：钥匙孔护片。你想给自家的门装一块这样的护片吗？

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-pjanċa żgħira madwar it-toqba taċ-ċavetta x'jisimha?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-pjanċa żgħira madwar it-toqba taċ-ċavetta x'jisimha?
messages.zh: 钥匙孔周围这块小片叫什么？
messages.en: What's this little plate around the keyhole called?

messages.speaker: Toni (五金店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Skudett. Trid wieħed bħalu għall-bieb tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Skudett. Trid wieħed bħalu għall-bieb tiegħek?
messages.zh: 钥匙孔护片。你想给自家的门装一块这样的护片吗？
messages.en: A keyhole plate. Do you want one like it for your door?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skudett 想成钥匙孔周围的一圈小护甲：看门时先找到钥匙孔，再看包围它的护片，用位置帮助记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who studies a subject deeply and has extensive knowledge of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 深入研究某一学科或领域，并具有丰富相关知识的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistudja suġġett fil-fond u jkollha għarfien estensiv tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学者；对某一学科有深入研究和丰富知识的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel studju serju u fil-fond ta' suġġett u jkollha għarfien wiesa' f'dak il-qasam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A scholar is someone who studies a particular subject deeply and develops extensive knowledge of it.

formal.mt: Il-mużew stieden skular tal-istorja biex jispjega l-importanza tad-dokumenti lill-pubbliku.
formal.en: The museum invited a scholar of history to explain the importance of the documents to the public.
formal.zh: 博物馆邀请了一位历史学者，向公众讲解这些文献的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel li qed jitkellem dwar il-kotba l-qodma? Mark: Hu skular magħruf li jistudja l-istorja ta' Malta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man talking about the old books? Mark: He's a well-known scholar who studies the history of Malta.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个正在讲古书的人是谁？马克：他是一位研究马耳他历史的知名学者。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel li qed jitkellem dwar il-kotba l-qodma?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel li qed jitkellem dwar il-kotba l-qodma?
messages.zh: 那个正在讲古书的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man talking about the old books?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu skular magħruf li jistudja l-istorja ta' Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Hu skular magħruf li jistudja l-istorja ta' Malta.
messages.zh: 他是一位研究马耳他历史的知名学者。
messages.en: He's a well-known scholar who studies the history of Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skular 与书桌前研究古书的学者画面联系起来，再用 skular tal-istorja 记住“历史学者”；这是场景记忆法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An artist who creates three-dimensional works by carving, modelling, or shaping materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过雕刻、塑形等方式制作立体艺术作品的艺术家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artist li joħloq xogħlijiet tal-arti fi tliet dimensjonijiet billi jnaqqax, jimmudella jew jagħti forma lil materjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雕塑家；以雕刻或塑形等方式创作立体艺术作品的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Artist li jaħdem materjali bħall-ġebel, it-tafal jew il-metall biex joħloq statwi u xogħlijiet oħra fi tliet dimensjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sculptor is an artist who shapes materials into statues or other three-dimensional works of art.

collocations.en: a sculptor who works in marble
collocations.zh: 以大理石为创作材料的雕塑家

formal.mt: L-iskultur ħadem fl-irħam biex joħloq statwa għall-ġnien pubbliku.
formal.en: The sculptor worked in marble to create a statue for the public garden.
formal.zh: 这位雕塑家用大理石为公共花园创作了一尊雕像。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min għamel din l-istatwa? Pawlu: Skultur mill-belt tagħna. Rajtu jaħdem fuqha fil-ħanut tax-xogħol tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who made this statue? Pawlu: A sculptor from our town. I saw him working on it in his workshop.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这尊雕像是谁做的？保罗：我们镇上的一位雕塑家。我在他的工作室见过他制作这尊雕像。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għamel din l-istatwa?
messages.mt_standard: Min għamel din l-istatwa?
messages.zh: 这尊雕像是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this statue?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skultur mill-belt tagħna. Rajtu jaħdem fuqha fil-ħanut tax-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Skultur mill-belt tagħna. Rajtu jaħdem fuqha fil-ħanut tax-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我们镇上的一位雕塑家。我在他的工作室见过他制作这尊雕像。
messages.en: A sculptor from our town. I saw him working on it in his workshop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 成对记忆 skultur“雕塑家”和 skultura“雕塑”：看到 skultur，就想象拿着工具制作雕像的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A three-dimensional work of art, or the art of creating such works by shaping materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过雕刻、塑形等方式制作的立体艺术作品，也指创作这类作品的艺术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol tal-arti fi tliet dimensjonijiet magħmul billi materjal jingħata forma, jew l-arti li jinħolqu xogħlijiet bħal dawn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雕塑作品；也指通过处理材料来创作立体作品的雕塑艺术。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol artistiku fi tliet dimensjonijiet maħluq minn materjal bħall-ġebel, it-tafal jew il-metall, jew l-arti li tipproduċi xogħlijiet bħal dawn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sculpture is the art of shaping materials into three-dimensional forms, or a work created in this way.

formal.mt: Il-gallerija xtrat skultura tal-bronż u poġġietha fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: The gallery bought a bronze sculpture and placed it in the main hall.
formal.zh: 画廊购入了一件青铜雕塑，并将它放在主展厅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Togħġbok din l-iskultura? David: Iva, speċjalment il-forma tagħha. Minn hawn tidher qisha għasfur.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you like this sculpture? David: Yes, especially its shape. From here it looks like a bird.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你喜欢这件雕塑吗？戴维：喜欢，尤其是它的造型。从这里看，它像一只鸟。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Togħġbok din l-iskultura?
messages.mt_standard: Togħġbok din l-iskultura?
messages.zh: 你喜欢这件雕塑吗？
messages.en: Do you like this sculpture?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment il-forma tagħha. Minn hawn tidher qisha għasfur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment il-forma tagħha. Minn hawn tidher qisha għasfur.
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其是它的造型。从这里看，它像一只鸟。
messages.en: Yes, especially its shape. From here it looks like a bird.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skultura 放进美术馆场景：绕着作品走一圈，观察它的立体造型；再配对记住 skultur 是创作者，skultura 是雕塑。

gloss_zh: 使不安；使困窘；使不知所措

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel upset, confused, or unsure how to react.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到不安、困惑，或一时不知道该如何反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mħasseb, konfuż jew ma jkunx jaf kif għandu jirreaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人心烦或不安，扰乱其平静的情绪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mdejjaq jew inkwetat u jtelliflu l-kalma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something upsets a person, it makes them feel unhappy, worried, or emotionally disturbed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人因意外或尴尬的情况而困惑、失去镇定或不知如何应对。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlef il-kalma jew iħossu konfuż u ma jkunx jaf kif jirreaġixxi għal sitwazzjoni mhux mistennija jew imbarazzanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something disconcerts someone, it unsettles them and leaves them unsure how to respond.

collocations.zh: 使所有人不安或不知所措

formal.mt: It-tħabbir tal-għeluq tal-iskola skunċerta lill-ġenituri, li talbu aktar informazzjoni dwar il-passi li kien imiss.
formal.en: The announcement of the school's closure upset the parents, who requested more information about the next steps.
formal.zh: 学校宣布关闭的消息令家长们感到不安，他们要求进一步了解后续安排。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex waqaft titkellem waqt il-laqgħa? Tom: Dik il-mistoqsija skunċertatni. Ma kontx naf kif inwieġeb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you stop talking during the meeting? Tom: That question threw me off. I didn't know how to answer.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你开会时为什么突然不说话了？汤姆：那个问题让我不知所措。我不知道该怎么回答。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex waqaft titkellem waqt il-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex waqaft titkellem waqt il-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 你开会时为什么突然不说话了？
messages.en: Why did you stop talking during the meeting?

messages.speaker: Tom (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik il-mistoqsija skunċertatni. Ma kontx naf kif inwieġeb.
messages.mt_standard: Dik il-mistoqsija skunċertatni. Ma kontx naf kif inwieġeb.
messages.zh: 那个问题让我不知所措。我不知道该怎么回答。
messages.en: That question threw me off. I didn't know how to answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象被一个突如其来的问题问住：先心里不安，再一时答不上来。用这个场景串联 skunċerta 的“使不安”和“使不知所措”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Emotionally disturbed or unsure how to react after something unexpected or troubling happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因意外或令人不安的事情而心烦、慌乱，或不知道如何反应的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun imħawwad jew imdejjaq minħabba xi ħaġa mhux mistennija jew li tinkwetah, u ma jkunx jaf kif jirreaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某件事而感到难过、烦恼或情绪不安的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun imdejjaq jew inkwetat minħabba xi ħaġa li tkun ġrat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is upset, they feel unhappy or emotionally troubled because of something that has happened.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因出乎意料的情况而慌乱、困惑或不知所措的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun imħawwad b'dak li ġara jew intqal u ma jkunx jaf minnufih kif għandu jġib ruħu jew iwieġeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is disconcerted, something unexpected makes them feel confused or unsure how to react.

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant deher skunċertat meta sar jaf li l-laqgħa kienet tħassret mingħajr avviż.
formal.en: The representative looked disconcerted when he learned that the meeting had been cancelled without notice.
formal.zh: 代表得知会议未经通知就被取消时，显得不知所措。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tidher daqshekk skunċertat? Mark: Għadni kemm sirt naf li l-vjaġġ tħassar. Maja: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look so upset? Mark: I've just found out that the trip has been cancelled. Maja: Let's sit down and see what we can do.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么显得这么心烦？马克：我刚得知旅行取消了。玛雅：我们坐下来，看看能怎么办。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tidher daqshekk skunċertat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tidher daqshekk skunċertat?
messages.zh: 你怎么显得这么心烦？
messages.en: Why do you look so upset?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni kemm sirt naf li l-vjaġġ tħassar.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni kemm sirt naf li l-vjaġġ tħassar.
messages.zh: 我刚得知旅行取消了。
messages.en: I've just found out that the trip has been cancelled.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu.
messages.zh: 我们坐下来，看看能怎么办。
messages.en: Let's sit down and see what we can do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skunċertat 配上“突然听到取消消息，心烦又愣住”的画面，同时记住情绪不安和不知所措两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Successfully obtained and recorded as a point or goal in a game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在比赛中已经取得并计入成绩的，用于描述得分或进球。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun inkiseb u ngħadd bħala punt jew gowl f'logħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在比赛中已经取得并记入成绩的，如已攻入的进球。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun inkiseb waqt logħba u jkun ingħadd fir-riżultat bħala punt jew gowl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A scored point or goal is one that a player has successfully obtained during a game.

formal.mt: Il-gowl skurjat fl-aħħar minuta ta r-rebħa lit-tim tad-dar.
formal.en: The goal scored in the final minute gave the home team victory.
formal.zh: 最后一分钟攻入的进球使主队获胜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt il-gowl skurjat fl-aħħar minuta? Pawlu: Iva, kien gowl sabiħ ħafna! Lara: U bih irbaħna l-logħba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the goal scored in the last minute? Pawlu: Yes, it was a brilliant goal! Lara: And we won the game with it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到最后一分钟攻入的那球了吗？保罗：看到了，那球太漂亮了！拉拉：而且我们靠它赢了比赛。

messages.speaker: Lara (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-gowl skurjat fl-aħħar minuta?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-gowl skurjat fl-aħħar minuta?
messages.zh: 你看到最后一分钟攻入的那球了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the goal scored in the last minute?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien gowl sabiħ ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien gowl sabiħ ħafna!
messages.zh: 看到了，那球太漂亮了！
messages.en: Yes, it was a brilliant goal!

messages.speaker: Lara (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: U bih irbaħna l-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: U bih irbaħna l-logħba.
messages.zh: 而且我们靠它赢了比赛。
messages.en: And we won the game with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skurjat 放进 gowl skurjat 整组记忆：球已入网，比分已增加，强调得分已经取得。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A round, open container with deep sides, used for holding, serving, or mixing food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种圆形、敞口且有一定深度的容器，用于盛放、端上或混合食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent tond u fond, miftuħ minn fuq, li jintuża biex jinżamm, jitħallat jew jiġi servut l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 碗；用于盛放、食用或混合食物的圆形敞口深容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent tond b'ġnub għoljin u fetħa fil-parti ta' fuq, li jintuża biex jitpoġġa fih l-ikel jew jitħalltu l-ingredjenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bowl is a round container with deep sides that you use for serving food or mixing ingredients.

formal.mt: Poġġi d-dqiq fi skutella kbira u żid l-ilma ftit ftit waqt li tħallat.
formal.en: Put the flour in a large bowl and add the water gradually while mixing.
formal.zh: 把面粉放进大碗里，边搅拌边逐渐加水。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tgħaddili skutella, jekk jogħġbok? Adam: Trid il-kbira jew iż-żgħira? Nina: Il-kbira, għax se nħallat l-insalata.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you pass me a bowl, please? Adam: Do you want the large one or the small one? Nina: The large one, because I'm going to mix the salad.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：请递给我一个碗，好吗？亚当：你要大的还是小的？妮娜：大的，因为我要拌沙拉。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħaddili skutella, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħaddili skutella, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请递给我一个碗，好吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me a bowl, please?

messages.speaker: Adam (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid il-kbira jew iż-żgħira?
messages.mt_standard: Trid il-kbira jew iż-żgħira?
messages.zh: 你要大的还是小的？
messages.en: Do you want the large one or the small one?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kbira, għax se nħallat l-insalata.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kbira, għax se nħallat l-insalata.
messages.zh: 大的，因为我要拌沙拉。
messages.en: The large one, because I'm going to mix the salad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手捧着一碗热汤，连读 skutella soppa；用“碗里盛汤”的具体画面记住 skutella。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small motor vehicle with two wheels, handlebars, a seat, and a platform for the rider's feet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种有两个车轮、车把、座位和脚踏平台的小型机动车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura żgħira b'mutur, żewġ roti, manubriju, sedil u pjattaforma fejn is-sewwieq iqiegħed saqajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小型踏板摩托车；有座位和脚踏平台的两轮机动车。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vettura żgħira b'żewġ roti u mutur, li s-sewwieq isuq bilqiegħda b'saqajh fuq pjattaforma quddiemu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A scooter is a small motorcycle with a seat and a platform on which the rider rests their feet.

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq ipparkja l-iskuter fil-post magħżul u daħal fl-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The rider parked the scooter in the designated space and entered the office.
formal.zh: 骑车人把踏板摩托车停在指定位置，然后走进办公室。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se tmur ix-xogħol illum? David: Bl-iskuter, għax it-temp sabiħ. Sara: Tinsiex l-elmu!
colloquial.en: Sara: How are you getting to work today? David: By scooter, because the weather is nice. Sara: Don't forget your helmet!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天怎么去上班？戴维：骑踏板摩托车，因为天气很好。萨拉：别忘了头盔！
