messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se tmur ix-xogħol illum?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se tmur ix-xogħol illum?
messages.zh: 你今天怎么去上班？
messages.en: How are you getting to work today?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bl-iskuter, għax it-temp sabiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Bl-iskuter, għax it-temp sabiħ.
messages.zh: 骑踏板摩托车，因为天气很好。
messages.en: By scooter, because the weather is nice.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tinsiex l-elmu!
messages.mt_standard: Tinsiex l-elmu!
messages.zh: 别忘了头盔！
messages.en: Don't forget your helmet!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 skuter 与英语 scooter 对照记忆，再想象戴上头盔、坐好并把双脚放上踏板的骑车画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people who work, train, or compete together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为共同任务而工作、训练或参赛的一组人，可指小队、团队或球队。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies li jaħdmu, jitħarrġu jew jikkompetu flimkien għal għan komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 执行特定任务或共同训练的小队。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp ta' persuni organizzati biex iwettqu xogħol jew missjoni partikolari flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A squad is an organized group of people assigned to a particular task or activity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共同工作或参加比赛的团队，尤指运动队。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies li jaħdmu flimkien jew jilagħbu flimkien kontra grupp ieħor f'kompetizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A team is a group whose members work together or compete together in a sport.

formal.mt: L-iskwadra ta' salvataġġ waslet fil-post u bdiet tfittex lill-persuni neqsin.
formal.en: The rescue squad arrived at the scene and began searching for the missing people.
formal.zh: 救援小队到达现场，开始搜寻失踪人员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma' liema skwadra tilgħab? Mark: Nilgħab mal-iskwadra tal-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which team do you play for? Mark: I play for the school team.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在哪支球队踢球？Mark：我在校队踢球。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' liema skwadra tilgħab?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' liema skwadra tilgħab?
messages.zh: 你在哪支球队踢球？
messages.en: Which team do you play for?

messages.speaker: Mark (校队队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nilgħab mal-iskwadra tal-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Nilgħab mal-iskwadra tal-iskola.
messages.zh: 我在校队踢球。
messages.en: I play for the school team.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一群人穿同样队服、一起完成任务的画面与 skwadra 绑定：救援时是小队，踢球时是球队。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small animal with a long, bushy tail that climbs trees and eats nuts and seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种尾巴长而蓬松、善于爬树，常吃坚果和种子的小动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir b'denb twil u folt li jitla' mas-siġar u jiekol ġewż u żrieragħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松鼠，一种善于爬树、尾巴蓬松的小型啮齿动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir mill-grupp tal-gerriema, b'denb folt, li jitla' mas-siġar u jiekol fost l-oħrajn ġewż u żrieragħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A squirrel is a small rodent with a bushy tail that often climbs trees and feeds on nuts and seeds.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-park, l-istudenti raw skwirill jiġbor iż-żrieragħ ħdejn siġra.
formal.en: During their observation in the park, the students saw a squirrel collecting seeds near a tree.
formal.zh: 在公园进行观察时，学生们看到一只松鼠在树旁收集种子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak l-iskwirill fuq is-siġra! Pawlu: Qed narah! Għandu denb folt ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that squirrel in the tree! Pawlu: I can see it! It has a very bushy tail.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看树上那只松鼠！Pawlu：我看见了！它的尾巴真蓬松。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-iskwirill fuq is-siġra!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-iskwirill fuq is-siġra!
messages.zh: 看树上那只松鼠！
messages.en: Look at that squirrel in the tree!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed narah! Għandu denb folt ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Qed narah! Għandu denb folt ħafna.
messages.zh: 我看见了！它的尾巴真蓬松。
messages.en: I can see it! It has a very bushy tail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 skwirill 时想象一只抱着坚果、拖着蓬松大尾巴爬树的松鼠，把词音与整幅画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of equipment that you sit on to slide over a surface, especially snow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人坐在上面沿地面滑行的器具，尤指在雪地上使用的雪橇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmir li wieħed joqgħod bilqiegħda fuqu biex jiżżerżaq fuq wiċċ, speċjalment fuq il-borra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人坐在上面滑行的器具，如雪地上使用的雪橇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett magħmul biex persuna toqgħod fuqu u tiżżerżaq bih, pereżempju fuq il-borra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sledge is an object that you sit on to slide along, particularly over snow.

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività fuq il-borra, kull tifel u tifla qagħdu bilqiegħda fuq sledge u niżlu l-għolja taħt is-superviżjoni ta' għalliem.
formal.en: During the snow activity, each child sat on a sledge and went down the hill under a teacher's supervision.
formal.zh: 在雪地活动中，每个孩子都坐上雪橇，在老师的监督下滑下山坡。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nuża s-sledge tiegħek? Adam: Iva, oqgħod bilqiegħda fuqu u jien niġbdek.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I use your sledge? Adam: Yes, sit on it and I'll pull you.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我能用一下你的雪橇吗？Adam：可以，你坐上去，我来拉你。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża s-sledge tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża s-sledge tiegħek?
messages.zh: 我能用一下你的雪橇吗？
messages.en: Can I use your sledge?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, oqgħod bilqiegħda fuqu u jien niġbdek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, oqgħod bilqiegħda fuqu u jien niġbdek.
messages.zh: 可以，你坐上去，我来拉你。
messages.en: Yes, sit on it and I'll pull you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sledge 记成脚下那件可以坐着滑下雪坡的器具；词指雪橇本身，搭配动作再表达滑行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Footwear used for sport or, in another sense, slippers worn indoors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指跑步、训练等活动穿的运动鞋，也可指卧室或家中穿的拖鞋，具体含义由语境确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żarbun li jintlibes għall-ġiri jew għall-isport, jew, f'tifsira oħra, papoċċ li jintlibes ġewwa d-dar.

sense_translations.en_definition: running shoes, trainers or sports shoes
sense_translations.zh_definition: 跑鞋、训练鞋或其他运动鞋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żarbun maħsub biex jintlibes waqt il-ġiri, it-taħriġ fiżiku jew attivitajiet sportivi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In a sporting context, sliper refers to footwear worn for running, training, or other physical activities.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在卧室或家中穿的拖鞋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Papoċċ komdu maħsub biex jintlibes fil-kamra tas-sodda jew f'partijiet oħra tad-dar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In a household context, sliper refers to comfortable slippers worn in the bedroom or elsewhere indoors.

collocations.en: a pair of trainers or slippers, depending on context
collocations.zh: 一双运动鞋或拖鞋，具体依语境而定

formal.mt: Għal-lezzjoni tal-edukazzjoni fiżika, l-istudenti għandhom jilbsu sliper adattati għall-isport.
formal.en: For the physical education lesson, students should wear suitable sports shoes.
formal.zh: 上体育课时，学生应穿适合运动的鞋。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dħalt id-dar bis-sliper tal-ġiri? Ben: Iva, issa se nneħħihom u nilbes is-sliper tad-dar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you come into the house wearing your running shoes? Ben: Yes, I'll take them off now and put on my house slippers.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你穿着跑鞋进屋了吗？Ben：是的，我现在就脱下来，换上家居拖鞋。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dħalt id-dar bis-sliper tal-ġiri?
messages.mt_standard: Dħalt id-dar bis-sliper tal-ġiri?
messages.zh: 你穿着跑鞋进屋了吗？
messages.en: Did you come into the house wearing your running shoes?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa se nneħħihom u nilbes is-sliper tad-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa se nneħħihom u nilbes is-sliper tad-dar.
messages.zh: 是的，我现在就脱下来，换上家居拖鞋。
messages.en: Yes, I'll take them off now and put on my house slippers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sliper 配两幅场景：操场上穿运动鞋，卧室里穿拖鞋；看到 ġiri 联想跑步，看到 dar 联想家中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Light, comfortable footwear worn indoors and easily slipped on and off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在室内穿着、方便穿脱的轻便舒适的鞋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-slipper huma żraben ħfief u komdi li jintlibsu ġewwa d-dar u li faċli tilbishom u tneħħihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖鞋，通常指在家中穿着、容易穿脱的便鞋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-slipper huma żraben komdi għall-użu ġewwa d-dar, li tista' tilbes u tneħħi malajr.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Slippers are comfortable shoes that you wear inside your home and can put on and take off easily.

formal.mt: Il-mistednin huma mitluba jneħħu ż-żraben u jilbsu s-slipper ipprovduti fid-daħla.
formal.en: Guests are asked to remove their shoes and wear the slippers provided at the entrance.
formal.zh: 请客人脱下鞋子，换上入口处提供的拖鞋。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn ħallejt is-slipper tiegħi? Omm: Ħdejn is-sodda. Ilbishom, għax l-art kiesħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did I leave my slippers? Mum: Beside the bed. Put them on, because the floor is cold.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我把拖鞋放哪儿了？妈妈：床边。穿上吧，地板很凉。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn ħallejt is-slipper tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn ħallejt is-slipper tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我把拖鞋放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did I leave my slippers?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn is-sodda. Ilbishom, għax l-art kiesħa.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn is-sodda. Ilbishom, għax l-art kiesħa.
messages.zh: 床边。穿上吧，地板很凉。
messages.en: Beside the bed. Put them on, because the floor is cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 slipper 和“回家换拖鞋”的画面绑定，再连读 par slipper，记住“一双拖鞋”的常用搭配。

gloss_zh: 深棕发女子；头发深棕色的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman or girl with dark brown hair, or a description of such a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指头发呈深棕色的女子，也可用于描述女子具有深棕色头发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Smajra tiddeskrivi mara jew tfajla b'xagħar kannella skur, u tista' tirreferi wkoll għal mara jew tfajla b'dan il-kulur ta' xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深棕色头发的女子；形容女子的头发为深棕色。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Smajra hija mara jew tfajla li għandha xagħar kannella skur; il-kelma tintuża wkoll biex tiddeskriviha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A brunette is a woman or girl whose hair is dark brown.

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-karattru prinċipali huwa mara smajra li taħdem bħala għalliema f'raħal żgħir.
formal.en: In the story, the main character is a brunette woman who works as a teacher in a small village.
formal.zh: 故事的主角是一位深棕发女子，在一个小村庄里当教师。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema waħda hi oħtok? Rita: Dik it-tfajla smajra ħdejn il-bieb, bil-ġakketta ħadra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which one is your sister? Rita: That brunette girl by the door, wearing the green jacket.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：哪一位是你姐妹？丽塔：门边那个穿绿夹克的深棕发女孩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema waħda hi oħtok?
messages.mt_standard: Liema waħda hi oħtok?
messages.zh: 哪一位是你姐妹？
messages.en: Which one is your sister?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik it-tfajla smajra ħdejn il-bieb, bil-ġakketta ħadra.
messages.mt_standard: Dik it-tfajla smajra ħdejn il-bieb, bil-ġakketta ħadra.
messages.zh: 门边那个穿绿夹克的深棕发女孩。
messages.en: That brunette girl by the door, wearing the green jacket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给人物画像涂上深棕色头发，旁边写 tfajla smajra，用“人物加发色”的画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mobile phone that can connect to the internet and run applications.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够连接互联网并运行应用程序的移动电话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Smartfown huwa mowbajl li jista' jaqbad mal-internet u jħaddem applikazzjonijiet għal diversi attivitajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 智能手机，具备上网、运行应用程序等功能的移动电话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Smartfown huwa telefon ċellulari li, minbarra t-telefonati u l-messaġġi, jippermettilek tuża l-internet u tħaddem applikazzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A smartphone is a mobile phone that lets you use the internet and run applications as well as make calls.

collocations.zh: 智能手机上的应用程序

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti jistgħu jużaw smartfown biex jiskennjaw il-kodiċi u jimlew il-kwestjonarju.
formal.en: Participants can use a smartphone to scan the code and complete the questionnaire.
formal.zh: 参与者可以使用智能手机扫描代码并填写问卷。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek ċarġer għas-smartfown tiegħi? Anna: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda ħdejn is-sokit.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a charger for my smartphone? Anna: Yes, it is on the table beside the socket.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有适合我这部智能手机的充电器吗？安娜：有，在插座旁边的桌子上。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ċarġer għas-smartfown tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ċarġer għas-smartfown tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你有适合我这部智能手机的充电器吗？
messages.en: Do you have a charger for my smartphone?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda ħdejn is-sokit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda ħdejn is-sokit.
messages.zh: 有，在插座旁边的桌子上。
messages.en: Yes, it is on the table beside the socket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 smartfown 和“手机上网、打开应用”的动作连在一起，再用“给智能手机充电”的整句巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very thin aluminium sheeting used especially for wrapping or covering food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 压制得非常薄的铝片材料，尤其用于包裹或覆盖食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-smontra hija materjal magħmul minn aluminju rqiq ħafna li jintuża speċjalment biex jitgeżwer jew jitgħatta l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铝箔，常用于厨房中包裹食物或覆盖容器的极薄铝片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-smontra hija folja rqiqa ħafna tal-aluminju li tintuża fil-kċina biex tgeżwer l-ikel jew tgħatti reċipjenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Aluminum foil is a very thin sheet of aluminum that you use to wrap food or cover containers.

collocations.en: to cover food with aluminum foil

formal.mt: Għatti t-trej bis-smontra u poġġih fil-forn għal għoxrin minuta.
formal.en: Cover the tray with aluminum foil and place it in the oven for twenty minutes.
formal.zh: 用铝箔盖住烤盘，放入烤箱烤二十分钟。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn qiegħda s-smontra? Irrid ngħatti t-trej. Pawlu: Fil-kexxun taħt il-forn. Hemm romblu ġdid.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the aluminum foil? I want to cover the tray. Pawlu: In the drawer under the oven. There is a new roll.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：铝箔在哪儿？我想把烤盘盖起来。保罗：在烤箱下面的抽屉里，那里有一卷新的。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn qiegħda s-smontra? Irrid ngħatti t-trej.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn qiegħda s-smontra? Irrid ngħatti t-trej.
messages.zh: 铝箔在哪儿？我想把烤盘盖起来。
messages.en: Where is the aluminum foil? I want to cover the tray.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun taħt il-forn. Hemm romblu ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun taħt il-forn. Hemm romblu ġdid.
messages.zh: 在烤箱下面的抽屉里，那里有一卷新的。
messages.en: In the drawer under the oven. There is a new roll.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从厨房抽屉取出一卷银亮铝箔，边展开边说 romblu smontra，再用它盖住烤盘，建立动作记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person trained to shoot accurately at targets from a distance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受过专门训练、能够从远距离准确射击目标的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mħarrġa biex tispara b'mod preċiż lejn miri minn distanza twila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狙击手；受过远距离精准射击训练的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna mħarrġa fl-isparar preċiż lejn miri li jkunu 'l bogħod minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sniper is someone trained to shoot accurately at targets from a considerable distance.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, is-snajper jiddeskrivi kif l-esperjenzi tal-gwerra bidlulu ħajtu.
formal.en: In the novel, the sniper describes how his wartime experiences changed his life.
formal.zh: 在小说中，这名狙击手描述了战争经历如何改变了他的生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'irwol għandu dak l-attur fil-film? Mark: Jagħmel il-parti ta' snajper. Maja: Mela l-istorja hija dwar il-gwerra?
colloquial.en: Maja: What role does that actor have in the film? Mark: He plays a sniper. Maja: So is the story about war?
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个演员在电影里演什么角色？Mark：他演一名狙击手。Maja：那么故事是关于战争的吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'irwol għandu dak l-attur fil-film?
messages.mt_standard: X'irwol għandu dak l-attur fil-film?
messages.zh: 那个演员在电影里演什么角色？
messages.en: What role does that actor have in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jagħmel il-parti ta' snajper.
messages.mt_standard: Jagħmel il-parti ta' snajper.
messages.zh: 他演一名狙击手。
messages.en: He plays a sniper.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela l-istorja hija dwar il-gwerra?
messages.mt_standard: Mela l-istorja hija dwar il-gwerra?
messages.zh: 那么故事是关于战争的吗？
messages.en: So is the story about war?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 snajper 放进电影角色卡来记：卡片正面写单词，背面画远处的人物并写“狙击手”，用人物身份帮助回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not natural or normal, or difficult to believe because it seems too unlikely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示不自然、不合常态；也可表示某种解释或说法过于牵强，令人难以相信。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li mhijiex naturali jew normali, jew spjegazzjoni li diffiċli temminha għax tidher improbabbli wisq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不自然的；不符合自然状态或通常表现的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li ma tidhirx naturali jew li ma taqbilx ma' dak li normalment wieħed jistenna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is unnatural, it does not seem natural or consistent with what normally happens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牵强的；因过于离奇或可能性太低而难以令人信服的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi idea jew spjegazzjoni li diffiċli taċċettaha għax tidher improbabbli jew maħluqa bi sforz żejjed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an explanation is far-fetched, it seems too unlikely or strained for people to believe.

formal.mt: Ir-reċensjoni tiddeskrivi l-imġiba tal-karattri bħala snaturali u l-ispjegazzjoni finali bħala diffiċli biex titwemmen.
formal.en: The review describes the characters' behaviour as unnatural and the final explanation as difficult to believe.
formal.zh: 这篇评论认为人物的行为不自然，而最后的解释令人难以相信。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għoġbok it-tmiem tal-film? Pawlu: Le, l-ispjegazzjoni kienet snaturali wisq. Lara: Naqbel, diffiċli nemmen li kollox ġara b'kumbinazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you like the film's ending? Pawlu: No, the explanation was too far-fetched. Lara: I agree; I find it hard to believe that everything happened by coincidence.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你喜欢电影的结尾吗？Pawlu：不喜欢，那个解释太牵强了。Lara：我同意，很难相信一切都是巧合。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġbok it-tmiem tal-film?
messages.mt_standard: Għoġbok it-tmiem tal-film?
messages.zh: 你喜欢电影的结尾吗？
messages.en: Did you like the film's ending?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-ispjegazzjoni kienet snaturali wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-ispjegazzjoni kienet snaturali wisq.
messages.zh: 不喜欢，那个解释太牵强了。
messages.en: No, the explanation was too far-fetched.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel, diffiċli nemmen li kollox ġara b'kumbinazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel, diffiċli nemmen li kollox ġara b'kumbinazzjoni.
messages.zh: 我同意，很难相信一切都是巧合。
messages.en: I agree; I find it hard to believe that everything happened by coincidence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 snaturali 配两幅学习画面：僵硬的表演对应“不自然”，硬凑的剧情解释对应“牵强”；通过被描述的对象区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to ask how many years old someone is.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问某人年龄的表达，意思是“几岁”或“多少岁”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tistaqsi kemm għandha snin persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 几岁；多少岁，用于询问某人的年龄。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li biha wieħed jistaqsi x'inhi l-età ta' persuna f'snin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you use this expression, you are asking how old someone is in years.

collocations.en: the word 'snina' in a question about age

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, l-espressjoni 'snina' hija marbuta mal-mistoqsija dwar kemm għandha snin persuna.
formal.en: In this lesson, the expression 'snina' is linked to asking how many years old a person is.
formal.zh: 在本课中，表达“snina”与询问某人多少岁有关。

colloquial.mt: Mei: Xi tfisser 'snina' hawn? Rita: Hawn tfisser 'kemm għandha snin persuna'. Mei: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar l-età.
colloquial.en: Mei: What does 'snina' mean here? Rita: Here it means 'how many years old a person is'. Mei: So we are talking about age.
colloquial.zh: Mei：“snina”在这里是什么意思？Rita：这里的意思是“某人多少岁”。Mei：那么我们说的是年龄。

messages.speaker: Mei (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'snina' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'snina' hawn?
messages.zh: “snina”在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'snina' mean here?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser 'kemm għandha snin persuna'.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser 'kemm għandha snin persuna'.
messages.zh: 这里的意思是“某人多少岁”。
messages.en: Here it means 'how many years old a person is'.

messages.speaker: Mei (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar l-età.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar l-età.
messages.zh: 那么我们说的是年龄。
messages.en: So we are talking about age.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 snina 写在生日蛋糕旁，再画一个问号，联想“今年几岁”；记住它对应年龄提问，而不是某个具体年龄数字。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A type of scarf worn around the neck to provide warmth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围在颈部用于保暖的一种围巾或围脖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' xalpa li tintlibes madwar l-għonq biex iżżommu sħun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种围巾，通常围在颈部保暖，可称为围脖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' xalpa li wieħed jilbes madwar għonqu biex jipproteġih mill-kesħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A snood is a type of scarf that you wear around your neck to keep warm.

formal.mt: Għall-mixja fix-xitwa, il-parteċipanti jistgħu jilbsu snood tas-suf biex iżommu għonqhom sħun.
formal.en: For the winter walk, participants can wear a woollen snood to keep their necks warm.
formal.zh: 参加冬季步行活动的人可以戴羊毛围脖，让颈部保持温暖。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandi għonqi kiesaħ. Ben: Trid is-snood tiegħi? Anna: Iva, grazzi. Jidher sħun ħafna.
colloquial.en: Anna: My neck is cold. Ben: Would you like my snood? Anna: Yes, thanks. It looks very warm.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我的脖子很冷。Ben：你要戴我的围脖吗？Anna：要，谢谢。看起来很暖和。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi għonqi kiesaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi għonqi kiesaħ.
messages.zh: 我的脖子很冷。
messages.en: My neck is cold.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid is-snood tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Trid is-snood tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你要戴我的围脖吗？
messages.en: Would you like my snood?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Jidher sħun ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Jidher sħun ħafna.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。看起来很暖和。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. It looks very warm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象冬天出门前给脖子套上暖和的围脖，并在衣物标签上写 snood；把单词与颈部保暖的动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bed designed to provide sleeping space for two people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设计供两个人同睡的一张床。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sodda maħsuba biex ikunu jistgħu jorqdu fiha żewġ persuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双人床；供两个人使用的一张床。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sodda waħda li hija kbira biżżejjed u maħsuba għall-irqad ta' żewġ persuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A double bed is a single bed unit that is designed for two people to sleep in.

collocations.en: a room with a double bed
collocations.zh: 配有一张双人床的房间

formal.mt: Nixtieq nibbukkja kamra b'sodda doppja għal żewġ iljieli, jekk jogħġobkom.
formal.en: I would like to book a room with a double bed for two nights, please.
formal.zh: 我想预订一间配有双人床的客房，住两晚，谢谢。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-kamra għandha sodda doppja jew żewġ sodod separati? Rita: Għandha sodda doppja, u hemm ukoll sufan żgħir.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does the room have a double bed or two separate beds? Rita: It has a double bed, and there is also a small sofa.
colloquial.zh: 马克：房间里是一张双人床，还是两张分开的床？丽塔：有一张双人床，另外还有一张小沙发。

messages.speaker: Mark (住客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kamra għandha sodda doppja jew żewġ sodod separati?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kamra għandha sodda doppja jew żewġ sodod separati?
messages.zh: 房间里是一张双人床，还是两张分开的床？
messages.en: Does the room have a double bed or two separate beds?

messages.speaker: Rita (民宿房东)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha sodda doppja, u hemm ukoll sufan żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha sodda doppja, u hemm ukoll sufan żgħir.
messages.zh: 有一张双人床，另外还有一张小沙发。
messages.en: It has a double bed, and there is also a small sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词和“一张床、两个枕头”的画面绑定：sodda doppja 表示一张双人床，订房时整组使用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bed belonging to or used by the people being referred to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于所指的他们或她们，或由这些人使用的床。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sodda li tappartjeni lill-persuni li qed jissemmew jew li tintuża minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他们的床或她们的床；表示床属于或供所指的那些人使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sodda tal-persuni li wieħed ikun qed jitkellem dwarhom, kemm jekk tkun tagħhom kif ukoll jekk ikunu jużawha għall-irqad.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Their bed is the bed that belongs to or is used by the people being discussed.

formal.mt: Il-mistednin talbu li l-bagalji jitqiegħdu ħdejn soddithom qabel il-wasla tagħhom.
formal.en: The guests requested that the suitcases be placed beside their bed before their arrival.
formal.zh: 客人要求在他们抵达前，将行李箱放在他们的床旁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġew il-bagalja Lara u Nina? Mark: Taħt soddithom, biex ma tieħux spazju fil-kamra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Lara and Nina put the suitcase? Mark: Under their bed, so it would not take up space in the room.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：拉拉和妮娜把行李箱放哪儿了？马克：放在她们的床底下，这样就不占房间里的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġew il-bagalja Lara u Nina?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġew il-bagalja Lara u Nina?
messages.zh: 拉拉和妮娜把行李箱放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Lara and Nina put the suitcase?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħt soddithom, biex ma tieħux spazju fil-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Taħt soddithom, biex ma tieħux spazju fil-kamra.
messages.zh: 放在她们的床底下，这样就不占房间里的地方。
messages.en: Under their bed, so it would not take up space in the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 soddithom 当作“他们的床”整词记忆，想象两位住客指着同一张床；换成两位女性时也可译为“她们的床”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bed belonging to or used by us.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于我们或供我们睡觉使用的床。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sodda li hija tagħna jew li nużaw aħna biex norqdu fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我们的床，即属于我们或由我们使用的床。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sodda li tappartjeni lilna jew li norqdu fiha aħna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When we refer to our bed, we mean the bed that belongs to us or that we sleep in.

formal.mt: Poġġejna sodditna ħdejn it-tieqa biex ikollna aktar spazju fil-kamra.
formal.en: We placed our bed beside the window to have more space in the room.
formal.zh: 我们把床放在窗边，让房间里有更多空间。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn se npoġġu sodditna? Pawlu: Ħdejn it-tieqa; hemm biżżejjed spazju.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where shall we put our bed? Pawlu: Beside the window; there is enough space there.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们的床放在哪里？保罗：窗边吧，那里有足够的空间。

messages.speaker: Marta (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se npoġġu sodditna?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se npoġġu sodditna?
messages.zh: 我们的床放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put our bed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn it-tieqa; hemm biżżejjed spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn it-tieqa; hemm biżżejjed spazju.
messages.zh: 窗边吧，那里有足够的空间。
messages.en: Beside the window; there is enough space there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人一起铺床，一边指着床说 sodditna，把整个词与“我们的床”这一共同生活画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling content with one's situation or pleased because something meets one's needs or expectations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对自身处境感到知足，或因某事符合需要、达到预期而感到满意的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħossu kuntent bil-qagħda tiegħu jew b'xi ħaġa li tilħaq il-ħtiġijiet jew l-aspettattivi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对目前拥有的事物或所处的生活状态感到知足、安心的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħossu kuntent b'dak li għandu jew bil-mod kif qed jgħix, mingħajr ma jħoss il-ħtieġa li jkollu aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are content, you feel happy with what you have and do not feel a strong need for more.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因结果、服务或表现符合自己的要求或预期而感到满意的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħossu kuntent għax riżultat, servizz jew xogħol ikun laħaq dak li kien jistenna jew jeħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are satisfied with something, you are pleased because it meets your needs or expectations.

collocations.zh: 对自己拥有的一切感到知足

formal.mt: Il-klijent iddikjara li kien sodisfatt bis-servizz u bil-kwalità tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The client stated that he was satisfied with the service and the quality of the work.
formal.zh: 客户表示，他对服务及工作质量感到满意。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int sodisfatt bil-kamra l-ġdida? Mark: Iva, għandha dak kollu li għandi bżonn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you satisfied with the new room? Mark: Yes, it has everything I need.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你对新房间满意吗？马克：满意，里面有我需要的一切。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int sodisfatt bil-kamra l-ġdida?
messages.mt_standard: Int sodisfatt bil-kamra l-ġdida?
messages.zh: 你对新房间满意吗？
messages.en: Are you satisfied with the new room?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha dak kollu li għandi bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha dak kollu li għandi bżonn.
messages.zh: 满意，里面有我需要的一切。
messages.en: Yes, it has everything I need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sodisfatt 配上点头微笑的画面：谈生活时是“知足”，谈结果时是“满意”，都表示心里的需要得到满足。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The experience of enduring pain, hardship, or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承受身体疼痛、生活苦难或精神痛苦的经历。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-esperjenza li wieħed jgħaddi minn uġigħ, tbatija jew dwejjaq u jkollu jissaportihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忍受痛苦、承受苦难这一经历。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-esperjenza ta' min iġarrab it-tbatija u jkollu jissaporti l-uġigħ jew id-diffikultajiet li ġġib magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Enduring suffering involves living through pain or hardship and bearing the distress that it causes.

collocations.en: the suffering endured by the family
collocations.zh: 这个家庭所承受的苦难

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jagħti xhieda tas-soffert tal-familja matul il-gwerra.
formal.en: The account bears witness to the suffering endured by the family during the war.
formal.zh: 这篇记述见证了这个家庭在战争期间所承受的苦难。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed nibagħtulhom il-fjuri? Toni: Wara s-soffert, irridu nuruhom li aħna magħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are we sending them flowers? Toni: After all the suffering they have endured, we want to show them that we stand by them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们为什么要给他们送花？托尼：他们经历了那些苦难，我们想让他们知道，我们支持他们。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nibagħtulhom il-fjuri?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nibagħtulhom il-fjuri?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要给他们送花？
messages.en: Why are we sending them flowers?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara s-soffert, irridu nuruhom li aħna magħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Wara s-soffert, irridu nuruhom li aħna magħhom.
messages.zh: 他们经历了那些苦难，我们想让他们知道，我们支持他们。
messages.en: After all the suffering they have endured, we want to show them that we stand by them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 soffert 放进“经历苦难后收到朋友的花”这一画面，记住所指的是承受痛苦的经历，而不只是某一次疼痛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To experience pain or distress, or to undergo an event or condition, especially an unpleasant one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感受身体或精神上的痛苦，或经历某种事件、处境，尤其是不愉快的经历。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed iġarrab uġigħ jew dwejjaq, jew jgħaddi minn ġrajja jew qagħda, speċjalment waħda diffiċli jew mhux pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遭受身体疼痛或精神折磨；受苦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed iħoss uġigħ fil-ġisem jew tbatija u dwejjaq f'qalbu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone suffers, they experience physical pain or mental distress because of something that affects them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经历或经受某种事件、过程或变化，尤其是困难或不利的经历。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed jgħaddi minn esperjenza, proċess jew bidla, speċjalment meta dawn ikunu diffiċli jew mhux mixtieqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something undergoes an event or change, they experience it or are affected by it.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddokumenta l-ħsarat li sofra l-bini waqt il-maltempata.
formal.en: The report documents the damage that the building sustained during the storm.
formal.zh: 报告记录了这座建筑在暴风雨期间遭受的损坏。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif inhu missierek illum? Luqa: Aħjar. Ilbieraħ sofra ħafna bl-uġigħ fid-dahar, imma llum seta' joħroġ jimxi.
colloquial.en: Nina: How is your father today? Luqa: Better. Yesterday he suffered a lot with back pain, but today he was able to go out for a walk.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你爸爸今天怎么样？卢卡：好些了。他昨天背痛得很难受，不过今天已经能出门散步了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu missierek illum?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu missierek illum?
messages.zh: 你爸爸今天怎么样？
messages.en: How is your father today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar. Ilbieraħ sofra ħafna bl-uġigħ fid-dahar, imma llum seta' joħroġ jimxi.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar. Ilbieraħ sofra ħafna bl-uġigħ fid-dahar, imma llum seta' joħroġ jimxi.
messages.zh: 好些了。他昨天背痛得很难受，不过今天已经能出门散步了。
messages.en: Better. Yesterday he suffered a lot with back pain, but today he was able to go out for a walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 sofra：人捂着背，表示“受苦”；建筑被风暴损坏，表示“遭受”。共同点是亲身经历不利影响。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose intended meaning remains unclear and requires clarification.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具体含义尚不明确、需要进一步核实才能可靠解释和使用的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu għadha mhijiex ċara u teħtieġ kjarifika qabel ma jkun jista' jintuża b'mod affidabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未明；无法确定具体所指的名词义项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sens ta' nom li ma jistax jiġi definit b'mod ċar mingħajr aktar informazzjoni dwar it-tifsira maħsuba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun requires further clarification before its intended meaning can be reliably explained.

formal.mt: Qabel ma nużaw il-kelma 'soggettiv' fit-test, jeħtieġ li niċċaraw it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: Before using the word 'soggettiv' in the text, we need to clarify its meaning.
formal.zh: 在文章中使用“soggettiv”一词之前，我们需要先明确它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser 'soggettiv' hawn? Mark: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja niċċaraw it-tifsira qabel nużawha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'soggettiv' mean here? Mark: I don't know yet. Let's clarify the meaning before using it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：“soggettiv”在这里是什么意思？马克：我还不知道。我们先弄清意思再用吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'soggettiv' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'soggettiv' hawn?
messages.zh: “soggettiv”在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'soggettiv' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja niċċaraw it-tifsira qabel nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja niċċaraw it-tifsira qabel nużawha.
messages.zh: 我还不知道。我们先弄清意思再用吧。
messages.en: I don't know yet. Let's clarify the meaning before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 soggettiv 的词卡画一个问号：本条按名词记录，具体词义待明确，先记拼写，不凭词形猜义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving danger or a risk of harm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有危险性，可能造成伤害或损害的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi periklu jew riskju ta' ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 危险的；可能带来伤害或损害的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jista' jikkawża ħsara jew jesponi lil xi ħadd għall-periklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is hazardous involves danger and may cause injury or other harm.

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġ sar sogru minħabba r-riħ qawwi u l-viżibbiltà baxxa.
formal.en: The journey became hazardous because of strong winds and poor visibility.
formal.zh: 由于风势强劲、能见度低，这段旅程变得危险。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Naqsmu minn dan il-passaġġ? Mark: Le, huwa sogru wisq wara x-xita. Ejja ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we go through this passage? Mark: No, it's too hazardous after the rain. Let's take another route.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们从这条通道过去吗？马克：不，雨后这里太危险了。我们换条路吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqsmu minn dan il-passaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Naqsmu minn dan il-passaġġ?
messages.zh: 我们从这条通道过去吗？
messages.en: Shall we go through this passage?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa sogru wisq wara x-xita. Ejja ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa sogru wisq wara x-xita. Ejja ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.zh: 不，雨后这里太危险了。我们换条路吧。
messages.en: No, it's too hazardous after the rain. Let's take another route.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sogru 写在湿滑山路的警示牌上，联想“走过去可能受伤”，记住它表示有危险的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes a female person coughing in the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示女性在过去咳嗽了，既包含过去时间，也指明主语为“她”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tal-verb li tindika li persuna femminili kellha sogħla f'ħin li għadda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 她咳嗽了；表示女性主语在过去发生的咳嗽动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li hi ħarġet arja minn griżmejha f'daqqa bil-ħoss tas-sogħla f'ħin li għadda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If she coughed, she suddenly forced air from her throat with the sound of a cough.

formal.mt: Waqt il-preżentazzjoni, Marija sogħlot darbtejn u waqfet għal ftit biex tixrob l-ilma.
formal.en: During the presentation, Marija coughed twice and paused briefly to drink some water.
formal.zh: 作报告时，玛丽亚咳嗽了两次，随后暂停片刻喝了些水。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqfet titkellem Marija? Mark: Sogħlot darbtejn u xorbot ftit ilma. Issa qed terġa' titkellem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Marija stop talking? Mark: She coughed twice and drank some water. Now she's talking again.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：玛丽亚为什么停下来不说话了？马克：她咳嗽了两次，喝了点水。现在又开始说话了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex waqfet titkellem Marija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex waqfet titkellem Marija?
messages.zh: 玛丽亚为什么停下来不说话了？
messages.en: Why did Marija stop talking?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sogħlot darbtejn u xorbot ftit ilma. Issa qed terġa' titkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Sogħlot darbtejn u xorbot ftit ilma. Issa qed terġa' titkellem.
messages.zh: 她咳嗽了两次，喝了点水。现在又开始说话了。
messages.en: She coughed twice and drank some water. Now she's talking again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象玛丽亚刚才咳了两声：把 sogħlot 整体记成“她咳嗽了”，同时记住女性主语和过去动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel sorry about something one did or failed to do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自己做过或没有做某事而感到后悔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss dispjaċir għal xi ħaġa li għamel jew naqas milli jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对过去的行为、决定或疏漏感到后悔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iħoss dispjaċir dwar azzjoni, deċiżjoni jew nuqqas tiegħu fil-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone regrets something, they feel sorry about what they did or failed to do.

collocations.en: he regretted not listening to the advice

formal.mt: Wara li qara r-rapport, sogħobbih li kien ħa d-deċiżjoni mingħajr ma kkonsulta lit-tim.
formal.en: After reading the report, he regretted having made the decision without consulting the team.
formal.zh: 读完报告后，他后悔当初没有征询团队意见就作出了决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sogħobbih li telaq kmieni? Mark: Iva, tilef l-aħjar parti tas-serata.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did he regret leaving early? Mark: Yes, he missed the best part of the evening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他后悔早走了吗？马克：是啊，他错过了那晚最精彩的部分。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sogħobbih li telaq kmieni?
messages.mt_standard: Sogħobbih li telaq kmieni?
messages.zh: 他后悔早走了吗？
messages.en: Did he regret leaving early?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tilef l-aħjar parti tas-serata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tilef l-aħjar parti tas-serata.
messages.zh: 是啊，他错过了那晚最精彩的部分。
messages.en: Yes, he missed the best part of the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sogħobbih li… 连着记成“他后悔……”，想象早走后错过精彩节目的懊悔表情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fitting into which an electrical plug is inserted to make a connection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供电源插头插入并接通电路的插座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li fih jiddaħħal plagg biex issir konnessjoni mal-provvista tal-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供插头或配套部件插入并连接的插座或插口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti ta' apparat li fiha jiddaħħal plagg jew komponent adattat biex issir konnessjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A socket is a fitting into which a plug or another matching part is inserted.

collocations.en: insert the plug into the socket

formal.mt: Qabel ma tqabbad l-apparat, iċċekkja li s-sokit ikun f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: Before connecting the appliance, check that the socket is in good condition.
formal.zh: 连接电器之前，请检查插座是否完好。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hemm sokit biex niċċarġja l-mowbajl? Ben: Hemm wieħed ħdejn il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is there a socket so I can charge my phone? Ben: There is one next to the table.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：哪里有插座？我想给手机充电。本：桌子旁边有一个。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hemm sokit biex niċċarġja l-mowbajl?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hemm sokit biex niċċarġja l-mowbajl?
messages.zh: 哪里有插座？我想给手机充电。
messages.en: Where is there a socket so I can charge my phone?

messages.speaker: Ben (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm wieħed ħdejn il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm wieħed ħdejn il-mejda.
messages.zh: 桌子旁边有一个。
messages.en: There is one next to the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 socket 联想 sokit，再配上“插头进入墙上插座”的画面，记住它指接纳插头的接口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the sun or using energy from the sun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与太阳有关的，或利用太阳能的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam max-xemx jew li juża l-enerġija tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 属于太阳或与太阳有关的；利用太阳能的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda x-xemx, jiġi minnha jew juża l-enerġija tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as solar relates to the sun or uses energy that comes from it.

formal.mt: Il-bini għandu sistema ta' tisħin solar li tuża l-enerġija tax-xemx biex issaħħan l-ilma.
formal.en: The building has a solar heating system that uses energy from the sun to heat water.
formal.zh: 这座建筑配有太阳能供热系统，利用太阳的能量加热水。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm pannell solar fuq il-bejt? Tom: Biex nużaw l-enerġija tax-xemx id-dar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is there a solar panel on the roof? Tom: So we can use energy from the sun at home.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：屋顶上为什么有一块太阳能板？汤姆：这样我们在家就能利用太阳能。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm pannell solar fuq il-bejt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm pannell solar fuq il-bejt?
messages.zh: 屋顶上为什么有一块太阳能板？
messages.en: Why is there a solar panel on the roof?

messages.speaker: Tom (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nużaw l-enerġija tax-xemx id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nużaw l-enerġija tax-xemx id-dar.
messages.zh: 这样我们在家就能利用太阳能。
messages.en: So we can use energy from the sun at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 solar 与英语 solar 对照，再把 pannell solar 想成屋顶晒太阳的板子，记住“太阳的、太阳能的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with the sun or with energy obtained from sunlight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与太阳有关的，或与从阳光获取的能量有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam max-xemx jew mal-enerġija miksuba mid-dawl tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 太阳的；与太阳有关的；利用太阳能的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għax-xemx jew għal xi ħaġa li taħdem bl-enerġija tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Solar things are connected with the sun, including devices that obtain their energy from sunlight.

formal.mt: L-enerġija solari tista' tintuża biex tiġġenera l-elettriku u ssaħħan l-ilma.
formal.en: Solar energy can be used to generate electricity and heat water.
formal.zh: 太阳能可用于发电和加热水。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Id-Dinja tagħmel parti mis-sistema solari? Leo: Iva, hija waħda mill-pjaneti li jduru max-Xemx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is Earth part of the solar system? Leo: Yes, it is one of the planets that orbit the Sun.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：地球是太阳系的一部分吗？利奥：是的，它是绕太阳运行的行星之一。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-Dinja tagħmel parti mis-sistema solari?
messages.mt_standard: Id-Dinja tagħmel parti mis-sistema solari?
messages.zh: 地球是太阳系的一部分吗？
messages.en: Is Earth part of the solar system?

messages.speaker: Leo (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija waħda mill-pjaneti li jduru max-Xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija waħda mill-pjaneti li jduru max-Xemx.
messages.zh: 是的，它是绕太阳运行的行星之一。
messages.en: Yes, it is one of the planets that orbit the Sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 solari 放进两个词组一起记：enerġija solari 是太阳能，sistema solari 是太阳系，核心画面都是太阳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A penny, or money that someone earns through work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一便士；也泛指一个人通过工作挣来的钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Munita ta' valur żgħir, jiġifieri penny; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għall-flus li persuna taqla' bix-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一便士，指一种小面额硬币或相应的货币金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Munita żgħira msejħa penny, jew is-somma ta' flus li tirrappreżenta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sold is a penny, considered as a coin or a small amount of money.

sense_translations.en_definition: a generic term for money earned
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挣来的钱，泛指劳动或工作所得的收入。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma ġenerali għall-flus li wieħed jaqla' permezz tax-xogħol tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's sold is the money they earn through their work.

formal.mt: L-istudent jaħdem fi tmiem il-ġimgħa biex jaqla' sold u jħallas għall-kotba tiegħu.
formal.en: The student works at weekends to earn some money and pay for his books.
formal.zh: 这名学生在周末工作，挣些钱来支付自己的书本费。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed taħdem is-Sibt ukoll? Toni: Biex naqla' sold u nfaddal għal rota.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you working on Saturday as well? Toni: To earn some money and save up for a bicycle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么连星期六也工作？托尼：为了挣些钱，攒钱买辆自行车。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed taħdem is-Sibt ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed taħdem is-Sibt ukoll?
messages.zh: 你为什么连星期六也工作？
messages.en: Why are you working on Saturday as well?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex naqla' sold u nfaddal għal rota.
messages.mt_standard: Biex naqla' sold u nfaddal għal rota.
messages.zh: 为了挣些钱，攒钱买辆自行车。
messages.en: To earn some money and save up for a bicycle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sold 配上两个画面：手里的一便士和工作后挣的钱；用 jaqla' sold 联想“挣些钱”，区分硬币义与收入义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unity and mutual support among people who share a concern, aim, or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们因共同的关切、目标或困境而表现出的团结与相互支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda u appoġġ reċiproku bejn nies li għandhom interess, għan jew diffikultà komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 团结与声援，指对他人的处境或共同事业表示支持，并愿意彼此扶持。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sens ta' għaqda li bih in-nies jappoġġjaw lil xulxin jew lil min jinsab f'diffikultà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Solidarity is the support people give one another because they share concerns or recognize a common difficulty.

formal.mt: L-għaqda esprimiet solidarjetà mal-familji milquta mill-għargħar u organizzat ġbir ta' ikel.
formal.en: The association expressed solidarity with the families affected by the flooding and organized a food collection.
formal.zh: 该协会向遭受洪灾的家庭表示声援，并组织了食品募集活动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tiġbru l-ikel? Mark: Biex nuru solidarjetà mal-familji li għandhom bżonn l-għajnuna. Lara: Se nġib xi ħaġa jien ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you collecting food? Mark: To show solidarity with families who need help. Lara: I'll bring something too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们为什么在募集食品？马克：为了向需要帮助的家庭表示支持。拉拉：我也会带些东西来。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tiġbru l-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tiġbru l-ikel?
messages.zh: 你们为什么在募集食品？
messages.en: Why are you collecting food?

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nuru solidarjetà mal-familji li għandhom bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nuru solidarjetà mal-familji li għandhom bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 为了向需要帮助的家庭表示支持。
messages.en: To show solidarity with families who need help.

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nġib xi ħaġa jien ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Se nġib xi ħaġa jien ukoll.
messages.zh: 我也会带些东西来。
messages.en: I'll bring something too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象邻居们一起募集食品：共同站出来、互相扶持，就是 solidarjetà；把“团结”与具体的声援行动一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a firm structure and a definite shape, rather than being liquid or gas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有坚实结构和确定形状的，处于固态而非液态或气态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu struttura soda u forma definita, u li mhuwiex likwidu jew gass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 固体的；具有确定形状、结构坚实而非液态或气态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab fi stat b'forma u volum definiti, bħall-ġebel jew is-silġ, u mhux fi stat likwidu jew ta' gass.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substance that is solid has a definite shape and volume, unlike a liquid or a gas.

formal.mt: F'dan l-esperiment, l-ilma jitkessaħ sakemm jinbidel fi stat solidu.
formal.en: In this experiment, water is cooled until it changes into a solid state.
formal.zh: 在这个实验中，水被冷却，直到转变为固态。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Is-silġ huwa likwidu? Pawlu: Le, huwa solidu. Meta jdub, isir ilma likwidu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is ice a liquid? Pawlu: No, it is solid. When it melts, it becomes liquid water.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：冰是液体吗？保罗：不是，它是固体。融化后，它就变成液态的水。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-silġ huwa likwidu?
messages.mt_standard: Is-silġ huwa likwidu?
messages.zh: 冰是液体吗？
messages.en: Is ice a liquid?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa solidu. Meta jdub, isir ilma likwidu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa solidu. Meta jdub, isir ilma likwidu.
messages.zh: 不是，它是固体。融化后，它就变成液态的水。
messages.en: No, it is solid. When it melts, it becomes liquid water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用冰块记 solidu：冰块有固定形状，拿在手里是固体；再把 stat solidu 整体记作“固态”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Either of the two annual occasions when the Sun reaches its greatest angular distance north or south of the celestial equator.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 太阳每年在天球上到达天赤道以北或以南最大角距离的两个时刻之一，分别对应夏至和冬至。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed miż-żewġ mumenti tas-sena meta x-Xemx tilħaq l-akbar distanza angolari tagħha lejn it-tramuntana jew lejn in-nofsinhar tal-ekwatur ċelesti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 至日，即夏至或冬至；对应一个半球一年中白昼最长或最短的时期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wieħed miż-żewġ mumenti annwali marbuta mal-itwal jew mal-iqsar jum tas-sena f'emisferu partikolari, magħruf bħala s-solistizju tas-sajf jew tax-xitwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A solstice is either of the two annual occasions associated with the longest or shortest period of daylight in a hemisphere.

formal.mt: F'Malta, is-solistizju tas-sajf huwa marbut mal-itwal perjodu ta' dawl tax-xemx tas-sena.
formal.en: In Malta, the summer solstice is associated with the longest period of daylight of the year.
formal.zh: 在马耳他，夏至对应一年中白昼最长的时期。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex illum idum daqshekk ma jidlam? Ben: Qegħdin qrib is-solistizju tas-sajf, meta l-ġranet ikunu l-itwal.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is it taking so long to get dark today? Ben: We're close to the summer solstice, when the days are longest.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天怎么这么晚才天黑？本：快到夏至了，这时候白昼最长。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex illum idum daqshekk ma jidlam?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex illum idum daqshekk ma jidlam?
messages.zh: 今天怎么这么晚才天黑？
messages.en: Why is it taking so long to get dark today?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qegħdin qrib is-solistizju tas-sajf, meta l-ġranet ikunu l-itwal.
messages.mt_standard: Qegħdin qrib is-solistizju tas-sajf, meta l-ġranet ikunu l-itwal.
messages.zh: 快到夏至了，这时候白昼最长。
messages.en: We're close to the summer solstice, when the days are longest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两条白昼长度线，一条最长、一条最短，分别标上夏至和冬至；把 solistizju 记成这两个“至日”的共同名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes someone who spends much time alone or prefers being alone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容经常独自生活、活动，或偏好独处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jqatta' ħafna ħin waħdu jew li jippreferi jkun waħdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 独自生活或活动的；偏好独处而较少与人交往的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tgħix jew tqatta' ħafna ħin waħedha, jew li tippreferi ma tkunx fil-kumpanija ta' oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is solitary spends much of their time alone, sometimes because they prefer their own company.

formal.mt: Il-protagonist tar-rumanz huwa raġel solitarju li jqatta' ħafna mill-ħin tiegħu jaqra u jimxi waħdu.
formal.en: The protagonist of the novel is a solitary man who spends much of his time reading and walking alone.
formal.zh: 这部小说的主人公是个独来独往的男人，大部分时间都在读书或独自散步。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu hu pjuttost solitarju, hux? Mark: Iva, jippreferi jimxi waħdu, imma jieħu pjaċir jitkellem magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu is quite solitary, isn't he? Mark: Yes, he prefers walking alone, but he enjoys talking to us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗挺喜欢独处的，对吧？马克：是啊，他喜欢一个人散步，不过也很乐意跟我们聊天。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu hu pjuttost solitarju, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu hu pjuttost solitarju, hux?
messages.zh: 保罗挺喜欢独处的，对吧？
messages.en: Pawlu is quite solitary, isn't he?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jippreferi jimxi waħdu, imma jieħu pjaċir jitkellem magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jippreferi jimxi waħdu, imma jieħu pjaċir jitkellem magħna.
messages.zh: 是啊，他喜欢一个人散步，不过也很乐意跟我们聊天。
messages.en: Yes, he prefers walking alone, but he enjoys talking to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说里总是独自散步的人，用 solitarju 描述他独来独往的状态；独处不一定表示内心难过。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The unhappy feeling of lacking companionship or meaningful contact with other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于缺少陪伴或与他人的亲近联系而产生的孤独、寂寞感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sentiment ta' dwejjaq li persuna tħoss meta tkun nieqsa mill-kumpanija jew minn relazzjonijiet mill-qrib ma' nies oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缺少陪伴、交流或亲近关系时感到的孤独与寂寞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' dwejjaq jew vojt li tinħass meta persuna ma jkollhiex il-kumpanija jew ir-rabtiet ma' oħrajn li tixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Loneliness is the sadness you feel when you lack the companionship or personal connections you want.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru jorganizza laqgħat kull ġimgħa biex inaqqas is-solitudni fost l-anzjani li jgħixu waħedhom.
formal.en: The centre organises weekly gatherings to reduce loneliness among older people who live alone.
formal.zh: 该中心每周组织聚会，以减轻独居老年人的孤独感。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn meta mort noqgħod waħdi, qed inħoss ħafna solitudni filgħaxija. Maja: Trid niġi nieħu te miegħek illejla?
colloquial.en: Lara: Since I started living alone, I've been feeling very lonely in the evenings. Maja: Would you like me to come over for tea tonight?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：自从开始一个人住，我晚上总觉得很寂寞。玛雅：要不要我今晚过来陪你喝杯茶？

messages.speaker: Lara (独居的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn meta mort noqgħod waħdi, qed inħoss ħafna solitudni filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Minn meta mort noqgħod waħdi, qed inħoss ħafna solitudni filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 自从开始一个人住，我晚上总觉得很寂寞。
messages.en: Since I started living alone, I've been feeling very lonely in the evenings.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid niġi nieħu te miegħek illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid niġi nieħu te miegħek illejla?
messages.zh: 要不要我今晚过来陪你喝杯茶？
messages.en: Would you like me to come over for tea tonight?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 solitudni 记成空房间里想找人说话的那份寂寞：重点是心里的孤独感，而不只是身边没人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction in pain, worry, or difficulty, or a temporary break from something unpleasant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疼痛、忧虑或困难的减轻，也指暂时摆脱不适或压力而获得的喘息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fl-uġigħ, fit-tħassib jew fid-diffikultà, jew waqfa temporanja minn xi ħaġa li tikkawża tbatija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疼痛、压力或忧虑减轻时获得的舒缓或宽慰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Serħan li persuna tħoss meta jonqos jew jgħaddi l-uġigħ, it-tħassib jew xi piż ieħor li tkun qed iġġorr.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Relief is the comfort you feel when pain, worry, or another source of distress becomes less severe or ends.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从持续的困难、压力或不适中获得的短暂休息或喘息机会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Perjodu qasir li fih persuna tkun ħielsa minn diffikultà, pressjoni jew tbatija li tkun ilha tesperjenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A respite is a short period during which an unpleasant or difficult situation stops affecting you.

formal.mt: Il-waqfa qasira offriet soljev temporanju lill-ħaddiema wara diversi sigħat ta' xogħol fi sħana qawwija.
formal.en: The short break offered the workers temporary respite after several hours of work in intense heat.
formal.zh: 工人在酷热中工作数小时后，这次短暂休息给了他们片刻喘息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Waslet l-aħbar: ommi tista' toħroġ mill-isptar illum. Mark: Xi soljev! Naf kemm kont inkwetata.
colloquial.en: Sara: The news has come through: my mother can leave hospital today. Mark: What a relief! I know how worried you were.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：消息来了，我妈妈今天可以出院了。马克：这下可松口气了！我知道你之前有多担心。

messages.speaker: Sara (病人的女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslet l-aħbar: ommi tista' toħroġ mill-isptar illum.
messages.mt_standard: Waslet l-aħbar: ommi tista' toħroġ mill-isptar illum.
messages.zh: 消息来了，我妈妈今天可以出院了。
messages.en: The news has come through: my mother can leave hospital today.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi soljev! Naf kemm kont inkwetata.
messages.mt_standard: Xi soljev! Naf kemm kont inkwetata.
messages.zh: 这下可松口气了！我知道你之前有多担心。
messages.en: What a relief! I know how worried you were.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 soljev 联想到终于松开紧绷的肩膀：疼痛或担忧减轻是宽慰，忙碌中短暂停下也是获得喘息。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The level at which a contingent circumstance begins to influence an outcome or decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 偶发情况开始对结果或决定产生影响时所达到的临界水平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-livell li fih ċirkostanza kontinġenti tibda tinfluwenza riżultat jew deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偶发情况开始对结果或决定产生影响的临界水平。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-livell li fih il-kontinġenza tibda tħalli effett fuq riżultat jew deċiżjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contingency influence threshold is the level at which a contingent circumstance begins to affect an outcome or decision.

collocations.mt: jiġi stabbilit is-soll ta' influwenza tal-kontinġenza
collocations.en: the contingency influence threshold is established
collocations.zh: 确定偶发因素影响阈值

collocations.en: the contingency influence threshold is reached
collocations.zh: 达到偶发因素影响阈值

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif ġie stabbilit is-soll ta' influwenza tal-kontinġenza u għaliex dan huwa rilevanti għall-analiżi.
formal.en: The report explains how the contingency influence threshold was established and why it is relevant to the analysis.
formal.zh: 报告解释了偶发因素影响阈值的确定方式，以及它为何与本项分析有关。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser hawn 'soll ta' influwenza tal-kontinġenza'? Pawlu: Huwa l-punt li fih ċirkostanza kontinġenti tibda taffettwa r-riżultat.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'contingency influence threshold' mean here? Pawlu: It is the point at which a contingent circumstance begins to affect the outcome.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的“偶发因素影响阈值”是什么意思？保罗：就是某种偶发情况开始影响结果的那个临界点。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser hawn 'soll ta' influwenza tal-kontinġenza'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser hawn 'soll ta' influwenza tal-kontinġenza'?
messages.zh: 这里的“偶发因素影响阈值”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'contingency influence threshold' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-punt li fih ċirkostanza kontinġenti tibda taffettwa r-riżultat.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-punt li fih ċirkostanza kontinġenti tibda taffettwa r-riżultat.
messages.zh: 就是某种偶发情况开始影响结果的那个临界点。
messages.en: It is the point at which a contingent circumstance begins to affect the outcome.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组短语想成一道刻度线：偶发情况的影响达到这条线，就开始改变结果；用“情况—影响—临界点”三个画面串联记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The serious and respectful quality of an occasion, action, or manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 场合、行为或举止所体现的庄重、严肃而恭敬的特质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' okkażjoni, għemil jew imġiba li turi serjetà kbira u rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仪式、气氛或举止中严肃、庄重且充满敬意的性质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-serjetà u d-dinjità ta' ċerimonja, atmosfera jew imġiba li titlob jew tesprimi rispett profond.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Solemnity is the serious and respectful quality of an occasion or of the way someone behaves.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti osservaw minuta silenzju b'sollenità kbira biex ifakkru lill-vittmi.
formal.en: The participants observed a minute's silence with great solemnity to commemorate the victims.
formal.zh: 参与者以极其庄重的态度默哀一分钟，悼念遇难者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd qed jitkellem bil-mod? Pawlu: Biex inżommu s-sollenità tal-okkażjoni; dalwaqt tibda t-tifkira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is everyone speaking quietly? Pawlu: To preserve the solemnity of the occasion; the commemoration is about to begin.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么大家说话都轻声细语的？保罗：为了保持这个场合的庄重，纪念活动马上就要开始了。

messages.speaker: Maja (参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd qed jitkellem bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd qed jitkellem bil-mod?
messages.zh: 为什么大家说话都轻声细语的？
messages.en: Why is everyone speaking quietly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inżommu s-sollenità tal-okkażjoni; dalwaqt tibda t-tifkira.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inżommu s-sollenità tal-okkażjoni; dalwaqt tibda t-tifkira.
messages.zh: 为了保持这个场合的庄重，纪念活动马上就要开始了。
messages.en: To preserve the solemnity of the occasion; the commemoration is about to begin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到纪念仪式开始时众人安静站立、神情恭敬的画面，把这种庄严肃穆的气氛记作 sollenità。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling unhappy because one lacks companionship or close contact with other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因缺少陪伴或与他人的亲近联系而感到孤独、寂寞的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss dwejjaq minħabba nuqqas ta' kumpanija jew ta' kuntatt mill-qrib ma' nies oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因缺少陪伴或亲近的人际联系而感到孤独的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħossu waħdu u mdejjaq għax jonqsu l-kumpanija jew ir-relazzjonijiet mill-qrib ma' ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you feel lonely, you are unhappy because you lack companionship or close contact with other people.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-istudent kiteb: 'Minkejja li ngħix ma' studenti oħra, kultant inħossni soltiduni.'
formal.en: In his letter, the student wrote: 'Although I live with other students, I sometimes feel lonely.'
formal.zh: 这名学生在信中写道：“虽然我与其他学生同住，但有时仍感到孤独。”

colloquial.mt: Mark: Illum qed inħossni soltiduni. Sara: Trid toħroġ timxi miegħi? Nistgħu nitkellmu ftit.
colloquial.en: Mark: I am feeling lonely today. Sara: Would you like to go for a walk with me? We can talk for a while.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我今天觉得很孤独。萨拉：想和我出去散散步吗？我们可以聊一会儿。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum qed inħossni soltiduni.
messages.mt_standard: Illum qed inħossni soltiduni.
messages.zh: 我今天觉得很孤独。
messages.en: I am feeling lonely today.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid toħroġ timxi miegħi? Nistgħu nitkellmu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Trid toħroġ timxi miegħi? Nistgħu nitkellmu ftit.
messages.zh: 想和我出去散散步吗？我们可以聊一会儿。
messages.en: Would you like to go for a walk with me? We can talk for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚会里有人身边很热闹，心里却盼着有人陪伴；把 soltiduni 与“心里孤单”的感受绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having been successfully dealt with so that the problem or difficulty no longer remains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 问题或困难已经得到妥善处理、获得解决的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie ttrattat b'suċċess u għalhekk ma jibqax joħloq problema jew diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经处理妥当、获得解决的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tkun instabet soluzzjoni għalih u li ma jkunx għadu pendenti bħala problema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a problem is resolved, a satisfactory solution has been found and the difficulty has been dealt with.

formal.mt: Il-każ issa huwa solvut, u l-partijiet kollha ġew infurmati bir-riżultat.
formal.en: The case is now resolved, and all parties have been informed of the outcome.
formal.zh: 该个案现已解决，所有相关方均已获知结果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-każ tal-ħlas għadu pendenti? David: Le, issa solvut. Il-flus daħlu fil-kont dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the payment issue still pending? David: No, it is resolved now. The money reached the account this morning.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：付款的事还没解决吗？戴维：已经解决了。钱今天早上到账了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-każ tal-ħlas għadu pendenti?
messages.mt_standard: Il-każ tal-ħlas għadu pendenti?
messages.zh: 付款的事还没解决吗？
messages.en: Is the payment issue still pending?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa solvut. Il-flus daħlu fil-kont dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa solvut. Il-flus daħlu fil-kont dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 已经解决了。钱今天早上到账了。
messages.en: No, it is resolved now. The money reached the account this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 solvut 放在办结清单的绿色对勾旁，连读“każ solvut，个案已解决”，记住它描述处理完成后的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medication used to help a person fall asleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于帮助人入睡的药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mediċina li tintuża biex tgħin lil persuna torqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够促进入睡的药物，即安眠药或催眠药。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mediċina maħsuba biex iġġib in-ngħas u tgħin lil min jeħodha jorqod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sleep-inducing medication is a medicine intended to help someone become sleepy and fall asleep.

formal.mt: Fir-rekord mediku ġie nnutat li t-tabib kien ippreskriva sonniferu lill-pazjent.
formal.en: The medical record noted that the doctor had prescribed a sleeping medication for the patient.
formal.zh: 病历记载，医生曾为该患者开具安眠药处方。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi jfisser 'sonniferu' fuq din il-kaxxa? Ġużeppi: Ifisser mediċina li tgħin lil persuna torqod.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does 'sonniferu' mean on this box? Ġużeppi: It means a medication that helps a person fall asleep.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这个盒子上的“sonniferu”是什么意思？朱塞佩：意思是帮助人入睡的药物。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'sonniferu' fuq din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'sonniferu' fuq din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 这个盒子上的“sonniferu”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sonniferu' mean on this box?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (药剂师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser mediċina li tgħin lil persuna torqod.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser mediċina li tgħin lil persuna torqod.
messages.zh: 意思是帮助人入睡的药物。
messages.en: It means a medication that helps a person fall asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一只贴着 sonniferu 标签的药盒，旁边画月亮与闭上的眼睛，用“药物帮助入睡”的画面记住词义。

gloss_zh: 超自然现象；超自然领域

teaching_sense.en_definition: Phenomena or forces believed to exist beyond the natural world and its ordinary laws.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被认为超出自然世界及其通常规律的现象或力量，也指这些现象所属的领域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jitqies li jeżisti lil hinn mid-dinja naturali u mil-liġijiet ordinarji tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 超出自然规律、被认为不能用通常的自然原因解释的现象或力量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fenomeni jew il-forzi li jitqiesu li jmorru lil hinn mil-liġijiet tan-natura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supernatural consists of phenomena or forces that people believe exist beyond the ordinary laws of nature.

formal.mt: Dan l-istudju jeżamina r-rwol tas-sopranaturali fil-letteratura.
formal.en: This study examines the role of the supernatural in literature.
formal.zh: 本研究考察超自然现象在文学中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Temmen fis-sopranaturali? Luqa: Ma nafx, imma nħobb naqra stejjer dwaru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you believe in the supernatural? Luqa: I don't know, but I enjoy reading stories about it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你相信超自然现象吗？卢卡：我不知道，不过我喜欢读这方面的故事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Temmen fis-sopranaturali?
messages.mt_standard: Temmen fis-sopranaturali?
messages.zh: 你相信超自然现象吗？
messages.en: Do you believe in the supernatural?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx, imma nħobb naqra stejjer dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx, imma nħobb naqra stejjer dwaru.
messages.zh: 我不知道，不过我喜欢读这方面的故事。
messages.en: I don't know, but I enjoy reading stories about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本讨论幽灵传说的书，用“超自然领域”记住这个名词；把 temmen fis-sopranaturali 整组记成“相信超自然现象”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or process of remaining alive or continuing to exist despite danger or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在危险或困难条件下继续活着或继续存在的状态或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt jew il-proċess li wieħed jibqa' ħaj, jew li xi ħaġa tibqa' teżisti, minkejja periklu jew diffikultajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在危险、困境或不利条件下存活下来；也指事物继续存在。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna jew ħlejqa tibqa' ħajja, jew li xi ħaġa tibqa' teżisti, minkejja kundizzjonijiet diffiċli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Survival is the act or state of staying alive or continuing to exist despite danger or difficult conditions.

formal.mt: L-aċċess għal ilma nadif huwa essenzjali għas-sopravvivenza tal-bniedem.
formal.en: Access to clean water is essential for human survival.
formal.zh: 能够获得洁净的水对人类生存至关重要。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tgħallimt fil-kors ta' sopravvivenza? Mark: Tgħallimt kif nibni kenn u nsib ilma tajjeb għax-xorb.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did you learn on the survival course? Mark: I learned how to build a shelter and find safe drinking water.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在生存课程上学了什么？马克：我学会了怎样搭建庇护所和寻找安全的饮用水。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tgħallimt fil-kors ta' sopravvivenza?
messages.mt_standard: X'tgħallimt fil-kors ta' sopravvivenza?
messages.zh: 你在生存课程上学了什么？
messages.en: What did you learn on the survival course?

messages.speaker: Mark (课程学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħallimt kif nibni kenn u nsib ilma tajjeb għax-xorb.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħallimt kif nibni kenn u nsib ilma tajjeb għax-xorb.
messages.zh: 我学会了怎样搭建庇护所和寻找安全的饮用水。
messages.en: I learned how to build a shelter and find safe drinking water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“水、食物、庇护所”三个生存必需品联想 sopravvivenza，再把 ħiliet ta' sopravvivenza 记成“生存技能”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unexpected event or thing, or the feeling caused by something unexpected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出乎意料的事情或东西，也指遇到意外情况时产生的惊讶感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja jew ħaġa mhux mistennija, jew is-sentiment li wieħed iħoss meta jiġri xi ħaġa li ma jkunx qed jistenna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意外发生的事、意外得到的东西，或由此产生的惊讶；令人高兴时可译为“惊喜”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tiġri jew tasal bla ma tkun mistennija, jew is-sentiment li tqanqal f'min jesperjenzaha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A surprise is something unexpected that happens, or the feeling you have when something unexpected occurs.

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat tal-kompetizzjoni kien sorpriża kbira għall-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The result of the competition was a great surprise to the participants.
formal.zh: 比赛结果令参赛者大感意外。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi sorpriża għalik! Pawlu: X'inhi? Nina: Ġibtlek il-ktieb li ridt.
colloquial.en: Nina: I've got a surprise for you! Pawlu: What is it? Nina: I got you the book you wanted.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我有个惊喜给你！保罗：是什么？妮娜：我给你买到了你想要的那本书。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi sorpriża għalik!
messages.mt_standard: Għandi sorpriża għalik!
messages.zh: 我有个惊喜给你！
messages.en: I've got a surprise for you!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi?
messages.zh: 是什么？
messages.en: What is it?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġibtlek il-ktieb li ridt.
messages.mt_standard: Ġibtlek il-ktieb li ridt.
messages.zh: 我给你买到了你想要的那本书。
messages.en: I got you the book you wanted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象突然收到礼物时脱口而出的“惊喜！”；记住 sorpriża 的核心是“出乎意料”，并不保证每次都是好事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person, place, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物产生、传出或可被获取的人、地点或事物，即其来源或源头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-persuna, il-post jew il-ħaġa li minnha tiġi jew tista' tinkiseb xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事物的来源或源头；也可指提供消息、资料或其他资源的人或事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna, post jew ħaġa li minnha joriġina jew jinkiseb xi ħaġa, bħal informazzjoni, ilma jew enerġija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The source of something is the person, place, or thing that it comes from or is obtained from.

formal.mt: L-awtur għandu jindika s-sors ta' kull statistika użata fir-rapport.
formal.en: The author should indicate the source of every statistic used in the report.
formal.zh: 作者应注明报告中使用的每项统计数据的来源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġibt din l-informazzjoni? Luqa: Minn artiklu fuq l-internet. Maja: Is-sors huwa affidabbli?
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you get this information? Luqa: From an article online. Maja: Is the source reliable?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你从哪里得到这个信息的？卢卡：从网上的一篇文章里。玛雅：这个来源可靠吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġibt din l-informazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġibt din l-informazzjoni?
messages.zh: 你从哪里得到这个信息的？
messages.en: Where did you get this information?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn artiklu fuq l-internet.
messages.mt_standard: Minn artiklu fuq l-internet.
messages.zh: 从网上的一篇文章里。
messages.en: From an article online.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sors huwa affidabbli?
messages.mt_standard: Is-sors huwa affidabbli?
messages.zh: 这个来源可靠吗？
messages.en: Is the source reliable?

cognitive_memory_aid: 每次看到 sors，就在心里追问“从哪里来？”；消息从人或文章来，能量从能源来，都可以用“来源”串起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of watching people, places, or events carefully to obtain information or maintain security.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获取信息或维护安全而对人员、地点或活动进行持续观察和监控。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha persuni, postijiet jew avvenimenti jiġu osservati bir-reqqa biex tinġabar informazzjoni jew tinżamm is-sigurtà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为收集信息、发现异常或维护安全而进行的监视或监控。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-osservazzjoni bir-reqqa ta' persuni, postijiet jew attivitajiet biex tinġabar informazzjoni, jinstabu irregolaritajiet jew tinżamm is-sigurtà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Surveillance is the careful observation of people, places, or activities in order to gather information or maintain security.

formal.mt: Il-mużew juża kameras ta' sorveljanza biex jipproteġi l-oġġetti esposti.
formal.en: The museum uses surveillance cameras to protect the objects on display.
formal.zh: 博物馆使用监控摄像头保护展品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm kamera ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Hija kamera ta' sorveljanza biex iżżomm id-daħla taħt osservazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there a camera next to the door? Mark: It is a surveillance camera for monitoring the entrance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门旁边为什么有摄像头？马克：那是监控摄像头，用来监控入口。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm kamera ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm kamera ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门旁边为什么有摄像头？
messages.en: Why is there a camera next to the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (保安)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija kamera ta' sorveljanza biex iżżomm id-daħla taħt osservazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Hija kamera ta' sorveljanza biex iżżomm id-daħla taħt osservazzjoni.
messages.zh: 那是监控摄像头，用来监控入口。
messages.en: It is a surveillance camera for monitoring the entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sorveljanza 与入口处持续工作的摄像头画面联系起来，记住它表示持续监视或监控这一活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The systematic observation of sea areas, vessels, and maritime activities to obtain information or maintain safety and security.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获取信息或维护安全而对海域、船舶及海上活动进行的系统监视。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-osservazzjoni sistematika ta' żoni tal-baħar, bastimenti u attivitajiet marittimi biex tinġabar informazzjoni jew tinżamm is-sigurtà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对海域、船舶及海事活动开展的监视与监控。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-osservazzjoni ta' żoni tal-baħar, bastimenti u attivitajiet marittimi biex tinġabar informazzjoni u jiġu identifikati problemi jew perikli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Maritime surveillance is the monitoring of sea areas, vessels, and maritime activities to gather information and identify possible problems.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对海面、海域及其活动进行的持续观察和监控。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-osservazzjoni kontinwa tal-baħar u tal-attivitajiet li jsiru fih biex jiġu nnutati movimenti, problemi jew perikli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sea surveillance involves watching areas of the sea to detect movements, unusual activities, or possible dangers.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif is-sistema ta' sorveljanza marittima tintuża biex jiġu osservati l-movimenti tal-bastimenti qrib il-kosta.
formal.en: The report describes how the maritime surveillance system is used to monitor vessel movements near the coast.
formal.zh: 报告说明了如何使用海上监控系统观察沿岸船舶的动向。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għal xiex jintuża dak ir-radar? Pawlu: Jintuża għas-sorveljanza marittima biex inkunu nafu fejn jinsabu l-bastimenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that radar used for? Pawlu: It is used for maritime surveillance so that we know where the vessels are.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个雷达是做什么用的？保罗：用于海上监控，让我们知道船舶在哪里。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex jintuża dak ir-radar?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex jintuża dak ir-radar?
messages.zh: 那个雷达是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is that radar used for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (港口工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jintuża għas-sorveljanza marittima biex inkunu nafu fejn jinsabu l-bastimenti.
messages.mt_standard: Jintuża għas-sorveljanza marittima biex inkunu nafu fejn jinsabu l-bastimenti.
messages.zh: 用于海上监控，让我们知道船舶在哪里。
messages.en: It is used for maritime surveillance so that we know where the vessels are.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与雷达屏幕上的船舶位置联系起来：sorveljanza 表示监控，marittima 提示海事范围，合起来记作海上监控。

gloss_zh: 海关监管；由海关当局实施的监督

teaching_sense.en_definition: The monitoring and control of goods or related activities by customs authorities to ensure compliance with customs requirements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海关当局为确保遵守海关要求而对货物或相关活动实施的监督和管理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-osservazzjoni u l-kontroll tal-merkanzija jew ta' attivitajiet relatati mill-awtoritajiet doganali biex jiġi żgurat li r-rekwiżiti doganali jiġu rispettati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关对货物及相关活动实施的监管，以确保符合海关要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kontroll li jagħmlu l-awtoritajiet doganali fuq il-merkanzija u l-attivitajiet relatati magħha biex jiġi żgurat li jiġu rispettati r-rekwiżiti doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs supervision is the monitoring and control of goods or related activities to ensure that customs requirements are met.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由海关当局负责实施的监督或监管。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sorveljanza li jwettqu l-awtoritajiet doganali fuq merkanzija jew attivitajiet li jaqgħu taħt ir-responsabbiltà tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Supervision by the customs authorities means that customs officials are responsible for overseeing the goods or activities concerned.

collocations.zh: 处于海关监管之下的货物

collocations.en: subject to supervision by the customs authorities
collocations.zh: 须接受海关当局监管的

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-merkanzija baqgħet taħt sorveljanza mill-awtoritajiet doganali waqt il-verifika tad-dokumenti.
formal.en: According to the report, the goods remained under customs supervision while the documents were being checked.
formal.zh: 根据报告，在核查文件期间，这批货物一直处于海关监管之下。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-merkanzija għadha taħt sorveljanza mill-awtoritajiet doganali? Rita: Iva, għadhom qed jiċċekkjaw id-dokumenti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are the goods still under customs supervision? Rita: Yes, they are still checking the documents.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这批货物还在海关监管之下吗？丽塔：是的，他们还在核查文件。

messages.speaker: Mark (货主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-merkanzija għadha taħt sorveljanza mill-awtoritajiet doganali?
messages.mt_standard: Il-merkanzija għadha taħt sorveljanza mill-awtoritajiet doganali?
messages.zh: 这批货物还在海关监管之下吗？
messages.en: Are the goods still under customs supervision?

messages.speaker: Rita (货运代理)
