messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadhom qed jiċċekkjaw id-dokumenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadhom qed jiċċekkjaw id-dokumenti.
messages.zh: 是的，他们还在核查文件。
messages.en: Yes, they are still checking the documents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分块记忆：sorveljanza 是监管，mill-awtoritajiet doganali 回答由谁监管；想象海关人员核查货物文件的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The observation and monitoring of the sea and activities at sea to gather information or detect possible dangers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为收集信息或发现潜在危险而对海域及海上活动进行的观察和监控。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-osservazzjoni u l-monitoraġġ tal-baħar u tal-attivitajiet li jsiru fih biex tinġabar informazzjoni jew jinstabu perikli possibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对海域、船舶及海上活动进行的海事监视与监控。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-osservazzjoni ta' żoni tal-baħar, bastimenti u attivitajiet fuq il-baħar biex tinġabar informazzjoni u jiġu identifikati problemi jew perikli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Maritime surveillance involves monitoring the sea, vessels, and activities at sea to obtain information and identify potential dangers.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对海域及海上动向进行的持续观察和监控。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-osservazzjoni kontinwa tal-baħar u tal-movimenti li jsiru fih biex jiġu nnutati attivitajiet mhux tas-soltu jew perikli possibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sea surveillance is the continuing observation of sea areas to detect movements, unusual activities, or possible threats.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru għas-sorveljanza tal-baħar jiġbor informazzjoni dwar il-movimenti tal-bastimenti fiż-żona.
formal.en: The sea surveillance centre gathers information about vessel movements in the area.
formal.zh: 海上监控中心收集有关该海域船舶动向的信息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'juru dawn l-iskrins? David: Juru l-pożizzjonijiet tal-bastimenti u jgħinuna fis-sorveljanza tal-baħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: What do these screens show? David: They show the positions of vessels and help us with sea surveillance.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些屏幕显示什么？戴维：显示船舶的位置，帮助我们开展海上监控。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'juru dawn l-iskrins?
messages.mt_standard: X'juru dawn l-iskrins?
messages.zh: 这些屏幕显示什么？
messages.en: What do these screens show?

messages.speaker: David (监控中心工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Juru l-pożizzjonijiet tal-bastimenti u jgħinuna fis-sorveljanza tal-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Juru l-pożizzjonijiet tal-bastimenti u jgħinuna fis-sorveljanza tal-baħar.
messages.zh: 显示船舶的位置，帮助我们开展海上监控。
messages.en: They show the positions of vessels and help us with sea surveillance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用监控中心的大屏幕作记忆画面：sorveljanza 表示监视，tal-baħar 把监视对象限定为海域，整组记成海上监控。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The monitoring of products and commercial activity in a market to check compliance with applicable requirements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对市场上的产品及商业活动进行监测和检查，以核实是否符合适用要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-monitoraġġ u l-kontroll tal-prodotti u tal-attivitajiet kummerċjali fis-suq biex jiġi vverifikat jekk humiex konformi mar-rekwiżiti applikabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对市场中的产品或商业活动进行持续监测和检查，以监督其合规情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sorveljanza tas-suq hija l-attività ta' monitoraġġ u kontroll tal-prodotti jew tal-attivitajiet kummerċjali biex tiġi vverifikata l-konformità mar-rekwiżiti applikabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Market surveillance is the process of monitoring products or commercial activities to check that applicable requirements are being met.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda li tissaħħaħ is-sorveljanza tas-suq permezz ta' aktar kontrolli fuq il-prodotti offruti għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: The report recommends strengthening market surveillance through additional checks on products offered for sale.
formal.zh: 该报告建议增加对在售产品的检查，以加强市场监管。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jiċċekkjaw dawn il-ġugarelli fil-ħwienet? Mark: Dan jagħmel parti mis-sorveljanza tas-suq; qed jaraw jekk il-prodotti jissodisfawx ir-rekwiżiti tas-sigurtà.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are they checking these toys in the shops? Mark: This is part of market surveillance; they are checking whether the products meet safety requirements.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么在商店里检查这些玩具？马克：这是市场监管的一部分；他们在检查产品是否符合安全要求。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jiċċekkjaw dawn il-ġugarelli fil-ħwienet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jiċċekkjaw dawn il-ġugarelli fil-ħwienet?
messages.zh: 他们为什么在商店里检查这些玩具？
messages.en: Why are they checking these toys in the shops?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan jagħmel parti mis-sorveljanza tas-suq; qed jaraw jekk il-prodotti jissodisfawx ir-rekwiżiti tas-sigurtà.
messages.mt_standard: Dan jagħmel parti mis-sorveljanza tas-suq; qed jaraw jekk il-prodotti jissodisfawx ir-rekwiżiti tas-sigurtà.
messages.zh: 这是市场监管的一部分；他们在检查产品是否符合安全要求。
messages.en: This is part of market surveillance; they are checking whether the products meet safety requirements.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“检查商店货架上的产品”这一画面联系起来：关注市场中的合规检查，就能记住“市场监管”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of tense uncertainty while waiting to discover what will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不知道接下来会发生什么，而在等待结果时产生的紧张和期待感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' tensjoni u stennija li tinħoloq meta wieħed ikun għadu ma jafx x'se jiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对尚未揭晓的情节或结果感到紧张、好奇和期待的心理状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sospensjoni hija l-istat ta' tensjoni u kurżità li wieħed iħoss waqt li jkun qed jistenna li jsir jaf kif se tiżviluppa jew tispiċċa sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Suspense is the tense feeling you experience while waiting to find out what will happen in an uncertain situation.

formal.mt: L-awtur iżomm lill-qarrej f'sospensjoni billi jiżvela l-identità tal-ħati biss fl-aħħar kapitlu.
formal.en: The author keeps the reader in suspense by revealing the culprit's identity only in the final chapter.
formal.zh: 作者直到最后一章才揭晓罪犯的身份，使读者始终处于紧张的期待之中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hemm wara l-bieb? Għidli! Noel: Stenna ftit; dik is-sospensjoni hija l-aħjar parti tal-film.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is behind the door? Tell me! Noel: Wait a moment; that suspense is the best part of the film.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：门后面是谁？快告诉我！诺埃尔：再等一下；这种悬念正是这部电影最精彩的地方。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hemm wara l-bieb? Għidli!
messages.mt_standard: Min hemm wara l-bieb? Għidli!
messages.zh: 门后面是谁？快告诉我！
messages.en: Who is behind the door? Tell me!

messages.speaker: Noel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; dik is-sospensjoni hija l-aħjar parti tal-film.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; dik is-sospensjoni hija l-aħjar parti tal-film.
messages.zh: 再等一下；这种悬念正是这部电影最精彩的地方。
messages.en: Wait a moment; that suspense is the best part of the film.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影中的门即将打开，你紧张地等着看门后是谁；把这种“结果未揭晓、心一直悬着”的感觉与本词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The temporary withholding of the performance of an obligation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂时不履行某项义务，或暂停继续履行该义务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-waqfien temporanju mit-twettiq ta' obbligu jew id-deċiżjoni li dak l-obbligu ma jitwettaqx għal xi żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暂时搁置某项义务的履行，即在一段时间内不开始或不继续履行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sospensjoni tal-eżekuzzjoni hija s-sitwazzjoni li fiha t-twettiq ta' obbligu jinżamm lura jew jitwaqqaf temporanjament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Withholding performance means temporarily refraining from carrying out an obligation or from continuing to fulfil it.

formal.mt: Il-partijiet qablu dwar sospensjoni tal-eżekuzzjoni tal-obbligi speċifikati fil-ftehim sakemm jiġu ċċarati d-dettalji tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The parties agreed to withhold performance of the obligations specified in the agreement until the delivery details were clarified.
formal.zh: 双方同意暂缓履行协议中列明的义务，直至交付细节得到澄清。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tfisser hawn sospensjoni tal-eżekuzzjoni? David: Li għalissa ma nwettqux l-obbligu msemmi fil-ftehim; irridu niċċaraw id-dettalji l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does withholding performance mean here? David: It means that for now we do not carry out the obligation mentioned in the agreement; we need to clarify the details first.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的“暂缓履行”是什么意思？戴维：就是说我们暂时不履行协议里提到的那项义务；我们得先把细节弄清楚。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tfisser hawn sospensjoni tal-eżekuzzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: X'tfisser hawn sospensjoni tal-eżekuzzjoni?
messages.zh: 这里的“暂缓履行”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does withholding performance mean here?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Li għalissa ma nwettqux l-obbligu msemmi fil-ftehim; irridu niċċaraw id-dettalji l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Li għalissa ma nwettqux l-obbligu msemmi fil-ftehim; irridu niċċaraw id-dettalji l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 就是说我们暂时不履行协议里提到的那项义务；我们得先把细节弄清楚。
messages.en: It means that for now we do not carry out the obligation mentioned in the agreement; we need to clarify the details first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语记成“给履行义务按暂停键”：义务的履行暂时停住，待相关情况明确后再处理。

gloss_zh: 自主关税暂停；自主暂停征收关税

teaching_sense.en_definition: A temporary suspension of an import duty decided independently by the authority applying the tariff.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由实施关税的主管方自主决定，在一定时期内暂停征收某项进口关税的措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura li biha l-awtorità li tapplika t-tariffa tiddeċiedi b'mod indipendenti li twaqqaf temporanjament il-ġbir ta' dazju fuq l-importazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关税实施方自主决定的临时措施，对特定进口货物暂停征收有关关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sospensjoni tariffarja awtonoma hija miżura deċiża b'mod indipendenti mill-awtorità responsabbli mit-tariffa, li twaqqaf temporanjament il-ġbir tad-dazju kkonċernat fuq oġġetti importati speċifiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An autonomous tariff suspension is a temporary measure independently adopted by a tariff authority to suspend an import duty on specified goods.

collocations.en: a request for an autonomous tariff suspension
collocations.zh: 自主暂停征收关税的申请

collocations.en: the application of an autonomous tariff suspension
collocations.zh: 自主关税暂停措施的适用

collocations.mt: il-perjodu ta' validità tas-sospensjoni tariffarja awtonoma
collocations.en: the period of validity of the autonomous tariff suspension
collocations.zh: 自主关税暂停措施的有效期

formal.mt: Qabel tikkalkula d-dazju dovut, il-kumpanija għandha tivverifika jekk tapplikax sospensjoni tariffarja awtonoma għall-prodott importat.
formal.en: Before calculating the duty payable, the company should verify whether an autonomous tariff suspension applies to the imported product.
formal.zh: 公司在计算应缴关税之前，应核实该进口产品是否适用自主关税暂停措施。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma inkludejtx dan id-dazju fil-kalkolu? Pawlu: Għax għal dan il-prodott tapplika sospensjoni tariffarja awtonoma, u ċċekkjajt li għadha valida.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you leave this duty out of the calculation? Pawlu: Because an autonomous tariff suspension applies to this product, and I checked that it is still valid.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么没有把这项关税算进去？保罗：因为这个产品适用自主关税暂停措施，而且我核实过，该措施仍在有效期内。

messages.speaker: Nina (进口业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma inkludejtx dan id-dazju fil-kalkolu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma inkludejtx dan id-dazju fil-kalkolu?
messages.zh: 你为什么没有把这项关税算进去？
messages.en: Why did you leave this duty out of the calculation?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (进口业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għal dan il-prodott tapplika sospensjoni tariffarja awtonoma, u ċċekkjajt li għadha valida.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għal dan il-prodott tapplika sospensjoni tariffarja awtonoma, u ċċekkjajt li għadha valida.
messages.zh: 因为这个产品适用自主关税暂停措施，而且我核实过，该措施仍在有效期内。
messages.en: Because an autonomous tariff suspension applies to this product, and I checked that it is still valid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“自主决定、关税暂停”两步记忆整个术语：先想到主管方自行决定，再想到特定进口关税在一定期间暂停征收。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Temporarily stopped or prevented from continuing, or held hanging without support from below.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指活动、服务或资格暂时停止或失效的，也可指物体悬挂着、下方没有支撑的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li twaqqaf għal żmien jew ma tħalliex ikompli, jew li jinsab imdendel mingħajr appoġġ minn taħt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被暂时停止的；被暂停资格或职务的；悬挂着的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li twaqqaf temporanjament, li tneħħa għal żmien minn kariga jew minn attività, jew li jinsab imdendel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is suspended, it is temporarily stopped or held hanging above the ground.

formal.mt: Is-servizz tal-laneċ se jibqa' sospiż sakemm il-kundizzjonijiet tat-temp jitjiebu.
formal.en: The ferry service will remain suspended until weather conditions improve.
formal.zh: 渡轮服务将继续暂停，直至天气状况改善。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Is-servizz tal-laneċ għadu sospiż? Pawlu: Iva, minħabba r-riħ qawwi. Immorru bil-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the ferry service still suspended? Pawlu: Yes, because of the strong wind. Let's go by bus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：渡轮服务还暂停着吗？保罗：是啊，因为风很大。我们坐公共汽车去吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-servizz tal-laneċ għadu sospiż?
messages.mt_standard: Is-servizz tal-laneċ għadu sospiż?
messages.zh: 渡轮服务还暂停着吗？
messages.en: Is the ferry service still suspended?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minħabba r-riħ qawwi. Immorru bil-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minħabba r-riħ qawwi. Immorru bil-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 是啊，因为风很大。我们坐公共汽车去吧。
messages.en: Yes, because of the strong wind. Let's go by bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sospiż 配上两个画面记忆：渡轮服务按下暂停键，吊灯悬在天花板下；分别对应“暂停的”和“悬挂的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Large or important enough in amount, extent, or effect to make a noticeable difference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指数量、程度或影响相当大，足以产生明显变化或具有实际重要性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa kbir jew importanti fl-ammont, fil-firxa jew fl-effett tiegħu, biżżejjed biex jagħmel differenza ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 数量或程度相当大的；具有实际重要性或明显成效的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa ta' ammont jew daqs konsiderevoli, jew li għandu importanza jew effett ċar u sinifikanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is substantial is large in amount or important enough to have a noticeable effect.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri tnaqqis sostanzjali fil-konsum tal-enerġija wara t-titjib fil-bini.
formal.en: The report shows a substantial reduction in energy consumption following the improvements to the building.
formal.zh: 报告显示，建筑物完成改造后，能源消耗大幅下降。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irnexxielek tiffranka xi ħaġa din is-sena? Daniel: Iva, ammont sostanzjali. Issa għandi biżżejjed biex nixtri karozza użata.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you manage to save any money this year? Daniel: Yes, a substantial amount. Now I have enough to buy a used car.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今年存下钱了吗？丹尼尔：存了，数目还相当可观。现在我有足够的钱买辆二手车了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irnexxielek tiffranka xi ħaġa din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: Irnexxielek tiffranka xi ħaġa din is-sena?
messages.zh: 你今年存下钱了吗？
messages.en: Did you manage to save any money this year?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ammont sostanzjali. Issa għandi biżżejjed biex nixtri karozza użata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ammont sostanzjali. Issa għandi biżżejjed biex nixtri karozza użata.
messages.zh: 存了，数目还相当可观。现在我有足够的钱买辆二手车了。
messages.en: Yes, a substantial amount. Now I have enough to buy a used car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 sostanzjali 时想象存款从几枚硬币变成足够买车的一笔钱：强调数量可观，搭配进展时则强调成效明显。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ability of a borrower to keep meeting debt payments over time without requiring debt restructuring or an unrealistic financial adjustment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 借款人在一段时期内持续履行债务偿付义务，而无需重组债务或进行不切实际的财务调整的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kapaċità ta' min għandu dejn li jkompli jħallas l-imgħax u l-kapital dovuti maż-żmien, mingħajr ma jkollu jirristruttura d-dejn jew jagħmel aġġustamenti finanzjarji mhux realistiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 债务可持续性，即债务人能够持续偿还到期本金和利息，而无需债务重组或不切实际的财务调整的状态或能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda li fiha debitur ikun jista' jkompli jħallas il-kapital u l-imgħax dovuti fuq id-dejn tiegħu maż-żmien, mingħajr ristrutturar tad-dejn jew aġġustamenti finanzjarji mhux realistiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Debt sustainability is a borrower's ability to continue meeting debt obligations without restructuring the debt or making unrealistic financial adjustments.

collocations.zh: 影响债务可持续性的风险

formal.mt: L-analiżi tas-sostenibbiltà tad-dejn tqis it-tkabbir ekonomiku, ir-rati tal-imgħax u l-ħtiġijiet futuri ta' finanzjament.
formal.en: The debt sustainability analysis considers economic growth, interest rates, and future financing needs.
formal.zh: 债务可持续性分析会考虑经济增长、利率和未来融资需求。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta jgħidu sostenibbiltà tad-dejn, xi jfissru? Mark: Jekk min għandu d-dejn jistax jibqa' jħallas dak dovut maż-żmien mingħajr ma jkollu jinnegozja mill-ġdid il-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: When they say debt sustainability, what do they mean? Mark: Whether the borrower can keep paying what is due over time without having to renegotiate the terms of the debt.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他们说的债务可持续性是什么意思？马克：就是借款人能否持续偿还到期款项，而不必重新协商债务条件。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta jgħidu sostenibbiltà tad-dejn, xi jfissru?
messages.mt_standard: Meta jgħidu sostenibbiltà tad-dejn, xi jfissru?
messages.zh: 他们说的债务可持续性是什么意思？
messages.en: When they say debt sustainability, what do they mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk min għandu d-dejn jistax jibqa' jħallas dak dovut maż-żmien mingħajr ma jkollu jinnegozja mill-ġdid il-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk min għandu d-dejn jistax jibqa' jħallas dak dovut maż-żmien mingħajr ma jkollu jinnegozja mill-ġdid il-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 就是借款人能否持续偿还到期款项，而不必重新协商债务条件。
messages.en: Whether the borrower can keep paying what is due over time without having to renegotiate the terms of the debt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sostenibbiltà tad-dejn 放在长期还款日历旁记忆：每期本金和利息都能持续支付，帮助理解“债务可持续性”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Assistance or backing provided within a country or from within a group or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在一国国内提供的援助或支持，也可指来自某个团体或组织内部的支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajnuna jew appoġġ li jingħata fil-pajjiż stess, jew li jiġi minn ġewwa grupp jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国内支持，指在本国范围内提供的援助或扶持，尤可用于本国生产者获得的政策或经济支持。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għajnuna jew appoġġ mogħti fil-pajjiż stess, b'mod partikolari permezz ta' miżuri li jgħinu lill-produtturi lokali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Domestic support is assistance provided within a country, especially through measures that help its own producers.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内部支持，指来自某个团体、组织或机构自身内部成员的帮助或赞同。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għajnuna jew qbil li jiġi mill-membri ta' grupp, organizzazzjoni jew istituzzjoni stess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Internal support is help or approval that comes from people within the same group or organization.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-miżuri ta' sostenn domestiku għall-bdiewa u l-effett tagħhom fuq il-produzzjoni lokali.
formal.en: The report examines domestic support measures for farmers and their effect on local production.
formal.zh: 报告考察了对农民的国内支持措施及其对本地生产的影响。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hawnhekk, sostenn domestiku jfisser għajnuna mill-gvern? David: Le, f'dan it-test ifisser sostenn minn ġewwa l-organizzazzjoni, jiġifieri mill-membri tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does domestic support mean government assistance here? David: No, in this text it means support from within the organization, that is, from its members.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里的 sostenn domestiku 是指政府援助吗？戴维：不是，在这篇文章里，它指组织内部的支持，也就是来自组织成员的支持。

messages.speaker: Nina (学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, sostenn domestiku jfisser għajnuna mill-gvern?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, sostenn domestiku jfisser għajnuna mill-gvern?
messages.zh: 这里的 sostenn domestiku 是指政府援助吗？
messages.en: Does domestic support mean government assistance here?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'dan it-test ifisser sostenn minn ġewwa l-organizzazzjoni, jiġifieri mill-membri tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'dan it-test ifisser sostenn minn ġewwa l-organizzazzjoni, jiġifieri mill-membri tagħha.
messages.zh: 不是，在这篇文章里，它指组织内部的支持，也就是来自组织成员的支持。
messages.en: No, in this text it means support from within the organization, that is, from its members.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 sostenn domestiku 画两个圈：国家这个大圈对应“国内支持”，组织这个小圈对应“内部支持”；阅读时用上下文判断圈的范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing used in place of another person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代替另一个人承担职责，或代替另一物品发挥作用的人或物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li tieħu post persuna jew ħaġa oħra biex taqdi l-istess funzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来代替另一个人或另一事物的人或物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sostitut huwa persuna jew ħaġa li tintuża minflok persuna jew ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substitute is someone or something that takes the place of another person or thing.

formal.mt: L-iskola ħatret sostitut temporanju biex jgħallem il-klassi waqt l-assenza tal-għalliem.
formal.en: The school appointed a temporary substitute to teach the class during the teacher's absence.
formal.zh: 学校安排了一名临时代课教师，在原任教师缺席期间给该班上课。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Spiċċalna z-zokkor. X'nistgħu nużaw? Mark: Għandna sostitut għaz-zokkor fl-armarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: We've run out of sugar. What can we use? Mark: We have a sugar substitute in the cupboard.
colloquial.zh: Maja：糖用完了，我们能用什么代替？Mark：橱柜里有糖的替代品。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Spiċċalna z-zokkor. X'nistgħu nużaw?
messages.mt_standard: Spiċċalna z-zokkor. X'nistgħu nużaw?
messages.zh: 糖用完了，我们能用什么代替？
messages.en: We've run out of sugar. What can we use?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna sostitut għaz-zokkor fl-armarju.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna sostitut għaz-zokkor fl-armarju.
messages.zh: 橱柜里有糖的替代品。
messages.en: We have a sugar substitute in the cupboard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sostitut 和“有人缺席时有人顶上、材料用完时换一种”这两个画面相连，同时记住它既能指人，也能指物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An incomplete replacement of a debtor in which the original debtor is not wholly released from the obligation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 债务人发生替换，但原债务人并未完全解除相关债务义务的情形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla fid-debitur li fiha debitur ieħor jieħu post id-debitur oriġinali mingħajr ma dan jinħeles għalkollox mill-obbligu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 债务人的不完全替换，即原债务人未因替换而完全解除债务义务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sostituzzjoni mhux sħiħa tad-debitur hija bidla li biha debitur ieħor jidħol minflok id-debitur oriġinali, iżda d-debitur oriġinali jibqa' marbut b'xi obbligu relatat mad-dejn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An incomplete substitution of debtor occurs when another debtor takes the original debtor's place without fully releasing the original debtor from the obligation.

collocations.mt: ftehim dwar sostituzzjoni mhux sħiħa tad-debitur
collocations.en: an agreement concerning incomplete substitution of debtor
collocations.zh: 关于债务人不完全替换的协议

collocations.mt: każ ta' sostituzzjoni mhux sħiħa tad-debitur
collocations.en: a case of incomplete substitution of debtor
collocations.zh: 债务人不完全替换的情形

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju deskritt fir-rapport, is-sostituzzjoni mhux sħiħa tad-debitur tħalli lid-debitur oriġinali marbut b'parti mill-obbligu.
formal.en: In the example described in the report, the incomplete substitution of debtor leaves the original debtor bound by part of the obligation.
formal.zh: 在报告描述的例子中，债务人的不完全替换使原债务人仍须承担部分债务义务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser sostituzzjoni mhux sħiħa tad-debitur f'dan l-eżempju? Pawlu: Daħal debitur ieħor, imma dak oriġinali għadu marbut b'parti mill-obbligu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does incomplete substitution of debtor mean in this example? Pawlu: Another debtor has stepped in, but the original debtor is still bound by part of the obligation.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个例子中的债务人不完全替换是什么意思？Pawlu：另一个债务人接替了进来，但原债务人仍须承担部分义务。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser sostituzzjoni mhux sħiħa tad-debitur f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser sostituzzjoni mhux sħiħa tad-debitur f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.zh: 这个例子中的债务人不完全替换是什么意思？
messages.en: What does incomplete substitution of debtor mean in this example?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Daħal debitur ieħor, imma dak oriġinali għadu marbut b'parti mill-obbligu.
messages.mt_standard: Daħal debitur ieħor, imma dak oriġinali għadu marbut b'parti mill-obbligu.
messages.zh: 另一个债务人接替了进来，但原债务人仍须承担部分义务。
messages.en: Another debtor has stepped in, but the original debtor is still bound by part of the obligation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记忆：sostituzzjoni 是替换，mhux sħiħa 是不完全，tad-debitur 指债务人的。想象交接后原债务人手中仍留着一部分责任。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A complete replacement of a debtor in which a new debtor takes over the obligation and the original debtor is released from it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由新债务人完全接替原债务人承担相关债务义务，原债务人因此解除该义务的情形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla li fiha debitur ġdid jieħu kompletament post id-debitur oriġinali fl-obbligu, u d-debitur oriġinali jinħeles minn dak l-obbligu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 债务人的完全替换，即新债务人承接相关债务义务，原债务人完全解除该义务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sostituzzjoni sħiħa tad-debitur hija bidla li biha debitur ġdid jieħu l-obbligu kollu minflok id-debitur oriġinali, li jinħeles minn dak l-obbligu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A complete substitution of debtor occurs when a new debtor fully replaces the original debtor, who is released from the obligation concerned.

collocations.en: an agreement concerning complete substitution of debtor
collocations.zh: 关于债务人完全替换的协议

collocations.en: a case of complete substitution of debtor
collocations.zh: 债务人完全替换的情形

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-manwal, is-sostituzzjoni sħiħa tad-debitur tfisser li d-debitur ġdid jieħu l-obbligu kollu u d-debitur oriġinali jinħeles minnu.
formal.en: In the textbook example, complete substitution of debtor means that the new debtor takes over the entire obligation and the original debtor is released from it.
formal.zh: 在教材的例子中，债务人的完全替换意味着新债务人承接全部相关债务义务，原债务人解除该义务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F'dan l-eżempju, min irid iħallas wara s-sostituzzjoni sħiħa tad-debitur? Pawlu: Id-debitur ġdid. Dak oriġinali nħeles minn dan l-obbligu.
colloquial.en: Lara: In this example, who has to pay after the complete substitution of debtor? Pawlu: The new debtor. The original debtor has been released from this obligation.
colloquial.zh: Lara：在这个例子中，债务人完全替换后由谁付款？Pawlu：由新债务人付款。原债务人已解除这项义务。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan l-eżempju, min irid iħallas wara s-sostituzzjoni sħiħa tad-debitur?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan l-eżempju, min irid iħallas wara s-sostituzzjoni sħiħa tad-debitur?
messages.zh: 在这个例子中，债务人完全替换后由谁付款？
messages.en: In this example, who has to pay after the complete substitution of debtor?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-debitur ġdid. Dak oriġinali nħeles minn dan l-obbligu.
messages.mt_standard: Id-debitur ġdid. Dak oriġinali nħeles minn dan l-obbligu.
messages.zh: 由新债务人付款。原债务人已解除这项义务。
messages.en: The new debtor. The original debtor has been released from this obligation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sħiħa 记作“完整的”，想象相关债务责任整包交给新债务人，原债务人完成交接；与含有 mhux 的不完全替换对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The replacement of an existing debtor by another debtor in relation to an obligation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 就某项债务义务，由另一债务人接替原债务人的变更。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla li biha debitur ieħor jieħu post id-debitur oriġinali fir-rigward ta' obbligu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 债务人的替换，指另一债务人就相关债务义务接替原债务人；该短语本身未说明替换是否完全。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sostituzzjoni tad-debitur hija bidla li fiha debitur ieħor jidħol minflok id-debitur oriġinali fir-rigward ta' dejn, mingħajr ma t-terminu waħdu jispeċifika jekk il-bidla hijiex sħiħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Substitution of debtor is a change in which another debtor takes the original debtor's place in relation to a debt.

collocations.en: an agreement concerning substitution of debtor
collocations.zh: 关于债务人替换的协议

collocations.en: the conditions for substitution of debtor

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi s-sostituzzjoni tad-debitur u jidentifika d-debitur oriġinali u d-debitur li jieħu postu.
formal.en: The report describes the substitution of debtor and identifies the original debtor and the debtor who replaces them.
formal.zh: 报告说明了债务人的替换，并明确指出原债务人及接替其地位的债务人。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi tfisser sostituzzjoni tad-debitur? Toni: Tfisser li debitur ieħor jieħu post dak oriġinali. Marta: U l-kelma waħedha tgħid jekk is-sostituzzjoni hijiex sħiħa? Toni: Le, trid tħares lejn id-dettalji tal-każ.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does substitution of debtor mean? Toni: It means that another debtor takes the original debtor's place. Marta: And does the term alone tell us whether the substitution is complete? Toni: No, you need to look at the details of the case.
colloquial.zh: Marta：债务人替换是什么意思？Toni：意思是另一个债务人接替原债务人。Marta：仅凭这个术语能知道替换是否完全吗？Toni：不能，要看具体情况。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser sostituzzjoni tad-debitur?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser sostituzzjoni tad-debitur?
messages.zh: 债务人替换是什么意思？
messages.en: What does substitution of debtor mean?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li debitur ieħor jieħu post dak oriġinali.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li debitur ieħor jieħu post dak oriġinali.
messages.zh: 意思是另一个债务人接替原债务人。
messages.en: It means that another debtor takes the original debtor's place.

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: U l-kelma waħedha tgħid jekk is-sostituzzjoni hijiex sħiħa?
messages.mt_standard: U l-kelma waħedha tgħid jekk is-sostituzzjoni hijiex sħiħa?
messages.zh: 仅凭这个术语能知道替换是否完全吗？
messages.en: And does the term alone tell us whether the substitution is complete?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, trid tħares lejn id-dettalji tal-każ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, trid tħares lejn id-dettalji tal-każ.
messages.zh: 不能，要看具体情况。
messages.en: No, you need to look at the details of the case.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住“替换＋债务人”两个意义块，想象债务人姓名栏换成另一个人；短语没有 sħiħa 或 mhux sħiħa 时，不自行补上完全或不完全。

gloss_zh: 被替换的；已由其他人或物取代的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Replaced by another person or thing serving the same purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已由另一个承担相同作用的人或物取代的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun inbidel ma' persuna jew ħaġa oħra biex din taqdi l-istess funzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被另一个人或物替换的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li persuna jew ħaġa oħra tkun ħadet postu biex taqdi l-istess funzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is substituted, another person or thing takes their place.

collocations.en: a player who has been replaced
a component that has been replaced

formal.mt: Il-komponent sostitwit għandu jinżamm għall-ispezzjoni sabiex tkun tista' tiġi stabbilita l-kawża tal-ħsara.
formal.en: The component that has been replaced must be retained for inspection so that the cause of the fault can be established.
formal.zh: 已被更换的部件须保留以供检查，从而确定故障原因。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex dak il-plejer qiegħed fuq il-bank? Lara: Ġie sostitwit għax weġġa' siequ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is that player on the bench? Lara: He was replaced because he hurt his foot.
colloquial.zh: 马克：那个球员为什么坐在替补席上？拉拉：他脚受伤了，所以被换下了。

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dak il-plejer qiegħed fuq il-bank?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dak il-plejer qiegħed fuq il-bank?
messages.zh: 那个球员为什么坐在替补席上？
messages.en: Why is that player on the bench?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġie sostitwit għax weġġa' siequ.
messages.mt_standard: Ġie sostitwit għax weġġa' siequ.
messages.zh: 他脚受伤了，所以被换下了。
messages.en: He was replaced because he hurt his foot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sostitwit 和球员被换下的画面一起记：原来的球员坐到场边，另一人接替他的位置，突出“已经被替换”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A space or area situated beneath the surface of the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于地面以下的空间或区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju jew post li jinsab taħt wiċċ l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地下；位于地面以下的空间或区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti jew l-ispazju li jinsab taħt wiċċ l-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The underground is the space or area beneath the surface of the ground.

collocations.en: the entrance to the underground space

collocations.zh: 进入地下空间的通道或权限

formal.mt: L-aċċess għas-sotterran huwa permess biss meta jkun hemm membru tal-persunal preżenti.
formal.en: Access to the underground space is permitted only when a member of staff is present.
formal.zh: 仅在有工作人员在场时，才允许进入地下空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi d-daħla tas-sotterran? Pawlu: Wara dak il-bieb; imbagħad inżlu t-taraġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the entrance to the underground space? Pawlu: Behind that door; then go down the stairs.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：地下空间的入口在哪里？保罗：在那扇门后面，然后沿楼梯下去。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi d-daħla tas-sotterran?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi d-daħla tas-sotterran?
messages.zh: 地下空间的入口在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the entrance to the underground space?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dak il-bieb; imbagħad inżlu t-taraġ.
messages.mt_standard: Wara dak il-bieb; imbagħad inżlu t-taraġ.
messages.zh: 在那扇门后面，然后沿楼梯下去。
messages.en: Behind that door; then go down the stairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sotterran 配上一张地面剖面图：先看地面，再沿楼梯往下走，把地面以下的整片空间圈起来记作“地下空间”。

gloss_zh: 微妙的；不易察觉的；含蓄而细腻的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small, delicate, or indirect in a way that requires careful attention to notice or understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 细微、含蓄或细腻，需要仔细留意才能察觉或理解的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jidhirx jew ma jinftiehemx mill-ewwel għax ikun fin, żgħir jew espress b'mod indirett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微妙而不明显的；表达含蓄、需要细心体会的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun diffiċli tinduna bih jew tifhmu mill-ewwel minħabba li jkun fin jew mhux espress direttament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something subtle is not immediately obvious and requires careful attention to notice or understand.

formal.mt: Hemm differenza sottili bejn iż-żewġ espressjonijiet, u l-kuntest jgħin lill-qarrej jifhem it-tifsira preċiża.
formal.en: There is a subtle difference between the two expressions, and the context helps the reader understand the precise meaning.
formal.zh: 这两个表达之间存在微妙的差别，语境有助于读者理解其确切含义。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn iż-żewġ kuluri jidhru l-istess għalija. Nina: Hemm differenza sottili; dan hu ftit iktar skur.
colloquial.en: Sara: These two colours look the same to me. Nina: There is a subtle difference; this one is slightly darker.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我看这两种颜色是一样的。妮娜：有一点细微差别，这个稍微深一些。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żewġ kuluri jidhru l-istess għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żewġ kuluri jidhru l-istess għalija.
messages.zh: 我看这两种颜色是一样的。
messages.en: These two colours look the same to me.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm differenza sottili; dan hu ftit iktar skur.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm differenza sottili; dan hu ftit iktar skur.
messages.zh: 有一点细微差别，这个稍微深一些。
messages.en: There is a subtle difference; this one is slightly darker.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两张几乎同色的色卡，必须靠近细看才发现差异；用这个画面记住 sottili 所表达的“微妙、不易察觉”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being delicate, indirect, or difficult to notice, or a fine distinction requiring careful understanding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 细腻、含蓄或不易察觉的性质，也指需要仔细理解的细微差别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa fina jew indiretta li mhix faċli tinduna biha, jew differenza żgħira li teħtieġ attenzjoni biex tinftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微妙、含蓄或细腻的特质；需要细心体会的细微之处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li xi ħaġa tkun fina, indiretta jew diffiċli biex tinduna biha, jew dettall fin li jeħtieġ ħsieb biex jinftiehem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Subtlety is the quality of expressing or distinguishing something in a delicate way that requires careful attention.

formal.mt: Is-sottiljezza tal-argument tidher fid-distinzjoni bejn dak li l-awtur jgħid direttament u dak li jħalli lill-qarrej jifhem.
formal.en: The subtlety of the argument emerges in the distinction between what the author states directly and what the reader is left to infer.
formal.zh: 论证的精细微妙之处，体现在作者直接陈述的内容与留待读者推断的内容之间的区别上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għoġbitek dik iċ-ċajta? Mark: Għas-sottiljezza tagħha; ma tgħidx kollox direttament.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you like that joke? Mark: For its subtlety; it does not say everything directly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么喜欢那个笑话？马克：因为它很含蓄，没有把什么都直接说出来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għoġbitek dik iċ-ċajta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għoġbitek dik iċ-ċajta?
messages.zh: 你为什么喜欢那个笑话？
messages.en: Why did you like that joke?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għas-sottiljezza tagħha; ma tgħidx kollox direttament.
messages.mt_standard: Għas-sottiljezza tagħha; ma tgħidx kollox direttament.
messages.zh: 因为它很含蓄，没有把什么都直接说出来。
messages.en: For its subtlety; it does not say everything directly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“听完笑话后想一想才会心一笑”的场景记 sottiljezza：它指那份值得细细体会的含蓄、细腻和微妙之处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A smaller division within a larger division, organization, or classification.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 较大的部门、组织或分类内部进一步划分出的较小单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqsima iżgħar fi ħdan diviżjoni, organizzazzjoni jew sistema ta' klassifikazzjoni akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 较大部门、整体或类别内部进一步划分出的分部或细分类别。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqsima iżgħar li tifforma parti minn diviżjoni jew kategorija akbar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A subdivision is a smaller unit or category within a larger division or group.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-funzjonijiet ta' kull sottodiviżjoni fi ħdan id-dipartiment.
formal.en: The report describes the functions of each subdivision within the department.
formal.zh: 报告说明了该部门内部各分部的职能。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din is-sottodiviżjoni tieħu ħsieb il-pagamenti? Pawlu: Iva, u s-sottodiviżjoni l-oħra tieħu ħsieb l-applikazzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this subdivision handle payments? Pawlu: Yes, and the other subdivision handles applications.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个分部负责付款吗？保罗：对，另一个分部负责申请。

messages.speaker: Lara (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-sottodiviżjoni tieħu ħsieb il-pagamenti?
messages.mt_standard: Din is-sottodiviżjoni tieħu ħsieb il-pagamenti?
messages.zh: 这个分部负责付款吗？
messages.en: Does this subdivision handle payments?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u s-sottodiviżjoni l-oħra tieħu ħsieb l-applikazzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u s-sottodiviżjoni l-oħra tieħu ħsieb l-applikazzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 对，另一个分部负责申请。
messages.en: Yes, and the other subdivision handles applications.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象组织图中的大方框下面再画小方框，把小方框标为 sottodiviżjoni，记住它是整体内部的进一步细分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A disadvantaged social group with very low economic and social standing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经济和社会地位很低、处于不利处境的社会群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp soċjali fi żvantaġġ li għandu pożizzjoni ekonomika u soċjali baxxa ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于社会经济结构底层、生活条件和发展机会受到明显限制的弱势阶级。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp fil-qiegħ tas-soċjetà li jgħix f'kundizzjonijiet diffiċli u għandu opportunitajiet ekonomiċi u soċjali limitati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An underclass is a social group whose members face severe economic disadvantage and limited opportunities.

collocations.en: the living conditions of the underclass
collocations.zh: 社会底层阶级的生活条件

collocations.en: the social exclusion of the underclass
collocations.zh: 社会底层阶级所遭受的社会排斥

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif in-nuqqas ta' impjiegi stabbli jillimita l-opportunitajiet tas-sottoklassi.
formal.en: The study examines how the lack of stable employment limits opportunities for the underclass.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察缺乏稳定就业如何限制社会底层阶级的发展机会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser sottoklassi f'dan l-artiklu? Nina: Tfisser grupp fil-qiegħ tas-soċjetà, b'riżorsi u opportunitajiet limitati.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does underclass mean in this article? Nina: It means a group at the bottom of society, with limited resources and opportunities.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章里的“社会底层阶级”是什么意思？妮娜：指处于社会底层、资源和机会都有限的群体。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser sottoklassi f'dan l-artiklu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser sottoklassi f'dan l-artiklu?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“社会底层阶级”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does underclass mean in this article?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser grupp fil-qiegħ tas-soċjetà, b'riżorsi u opportunitajiet limitati.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser grupp fil-qiegħ tas-soċjetà, b'riżorsi u opportunitajiet limitati.
messages.zh: 指处于社会底层、资源和机会都有限的群体。
messages.en: It means a group at the bottom of society, with limited resources and opportunities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把社会结构想象成一座阶梯，在资源与机会最少的一层写下 sottoklassi，借位置记住“社会底层阶级”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of hiring another person or company to perform part of contracted work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承包方将自己承接的部分工作交由另一人或公司承担的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li kuntrattur iqabbad persuna jew kumpanija oħra biex twettaq parti mix-xogħol li jkun intrabat li jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承包方通过另行订立合同，将所承接工作的部分任务交由其他个人或企业完成的业务安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament li bih kuntrattur jagħti parti mix-xogħol tiegħu lil persuna jew kumpanija oħra taħt kuntratt separat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Subcontracting is the practice of arranging for another person or business to carry out part of your contracted work.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jippermetti s-sottokuntrattar ta' xogħol speċjalizzat, iżda jeħtieġ l-approvazzjoni bil-miktub tal-klijent.
formal.en: The contract permits the subcontracting of specialized work but requires the client's written approval.
formal.zh: 合同允许将专业工作分包，但要求取得客户的书面批准。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed nikkunsidraw is-sottokuntrattar? Rita: Għax għandna bżonn kumpanija oħra biex tagħmel parti mix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are we considering subcontracting? Rita: Because we need another company to do part of the work.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们为什么在考虑分包？丽塔：因为我们需要另一家公司来完成部分工作。

messages.speaker: Mark (项目助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nikkunsidraw is-sottokuntrattar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nikkunsidraw is-sottokuntrattar?
messages.zh: 我们为什么在考虑分包？
messages.en: Why are we considering subcontracting?

messages.speaker: Rita (项目经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandna bżonn kumpanija oħra biex tagħmel parti mix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandna bżonn kumpanija oħra biex tagħmel parti mix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 因为我们需要另一家公司来完成部分工作。
messages.en: Because we need another company to do part of the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张任务单，把其中一部分沿箭头交给另一家公司，在箭头上写 sottokuntrattar，记住它表示“分包这件事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company hired by a contractor to carry out part of the contractor's work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由承包方聘用、负责完成其所承接工作中一部分的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija mqabbda minn kuntrattur biex twettaq parti mix-xogħol li dak il-kuntrattur ikun intrabat li jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受承包方委托，按照分包合同完成部分工作的个人或企业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tidħol fi ftehim ma' kuntrattur biex tagħmel parti mix-xogħol tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sub-contractor is a person or business hired by a contractor to complete an agreed part of a job.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与承包方订立分包协议，承担原承包工作中部分任务的个人或公司。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li, taħt kuntratt ma' kuntrattur ieħor, twettaq parti minn xogħol akbar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A subcontractor carries out part of a larger job under an agreement with the contractor responsible for that job.

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur ewlieni qabbad sottokuntrattur speċjalizzat biex jinstalla s-sistema elettrika tal-bini.
formal.en: The main contractor hired a specialist subcontractor to install the building's electrical system.
formal.zh: 总承包商聘请了一家专业分包商安装大楼的电气系统。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jinstalla d-dwal il-ġodda? Toni: Is-sottokuntrattur li qabbad il-kuntrattur ewlieni. Se jiġi għada.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who will install the new lights? Toni: The subcontractor hired by the main contractor. He will come tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁来安装新灯？托尼：总承包商聘请的分包承包人。他明天来。

messages.speaker: Anna (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jinstalla d-dwal il-ġodda?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jinstalla d-dwal il-ġodda?
messages.zh: 谁来安装新灯？
messages.en: Who will install the new lights?

messages.speaker: Toni (施工协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sottokuntrattur li qabbad il-kuntrattur ewlieni. Se jiġi għada.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sottokuntrattur li qabbad il-kuntrattur ewlieni. Se jiġi għada.
messages.zh: 总承包商聘请的分包承包人。他明天来。
messages.en: The subcontractor hired by the main contractor. He will come tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把项目中接下一部分工作的个人或公司圈起来，标上 sottokuntrattur；与表示分包活动的 sottokuntrattar 配对，区分承担者与活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vessel designed to travel and operate underwater.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设计用于在水下航行和执行任务的船艇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastiment iddisinjat biex jivvjaġġa u jaħdem taħt wiċċ l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够在水下航行和作业的潜艇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bastiment li jista' jinżel taħt wiċċ l-ilma u jkompli jivvjaġġa jew iwettaq xogħol hemmhekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A submarine is a vessel that can travel and operate beneath the surface of the water.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif is-sottomarin baqa' taħt l-ilma matul il-missjoni.
formal.en: The report describes how the submarine remained underwater during the mission.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这艘潜艇在执行任务期间如何一直保持在水下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak li jidher fir-ritratt huwa sottomarin? Mark: Iva, u jista' jivvjaġġa taħt l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that thing in the photo a submarine? Mark: Yes, and it can travel underwater.
colloquial.zh: Maja：照片里的那个是潜艇吗？Mark：是啊，它能在水下航行。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li jidher fir-ritratt huwa sottomarin?
messages.mt_standard: Dak li jidher fir-ritratt huwa sottomarin?
messages.zh: 照片里的那个是潜艇吗？
messages.en: Is that thing in the photo a submarine?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jista' jivvjaġġa taħt l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jista' jivvjaġġa taħt l-ilma.
messages.zh: 是啊，它能在水下航行。
messages.en: Yes, and it can travel underwater.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sottomarin 配上一幅船艇潜入海面下的画面，再连读 sottomarin taħt l-ilma（水下的潜艇），用画面与短语一起记住“潜艇”。

gloss_zh: 投标文件的电子递交；电子投标提交

teaching_sense.en_definition: The submission of bids or tenders through an electronic system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子系统递交报价或投标文件的行为或程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jiġu ppreżentati offerti permezz ta' sistema elettronika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子递交；本词组具体指通过电子系统提交报价或投标文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-preżentazzjoni ta' dokumenti permezz ta' sistema elettronika, f'dan il-każ dokumenti ta' offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An e-submission is the delivery of documents through an electronic system, here specifically bids or tenders.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子提交；在此指以电子方式递交报价或投标文件的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' preżentazzjoni ta' informazzjoni jew dokumenti b'mezz elettroniku, hawnhekk għall-preżentazzjoni ta' offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electronic submission is the process of sending information or documents electronically, in this context for submitting bids or tenders.

collocations.en: a system for the electronic submission of tenders
collocations.zh: 投标文件电子递交系统

collocations.en: the procedure for the electronic submission of tenders
collocations.zh: 投标文件电子递交程序

collocations.en: the portal for the electronic submission of tenders
collocations.zh: 投标文件电子递交门户

formal.mt: Il-gwida tispjega l-proċedura għas-sottomissjoni elettronika ta' offerti u d-dokumenti meħtieġa.
formal.en: The guide explains the procedure for the electronic submission of tenders and the documents required.
formal.zh: 该指南说明了投标文件电子递交的程序以及所需文件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taf kif taħdem is-sottomissjoni elettronika ta' offerti? Pawlu: Iva, tidħol fil-portal, ittella' d-dokumenti u tibgħat l-offerta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you know how electronic tender submission works? Pawlu: Yes, you log into the portal, upload the documents and submit the tender.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你知道怎样在线递交投标文件吗？Pawlu：知道，登录门户，上传文件，再提交投标。

messages.speaker: Sara (采购助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf kif taħdem is-sottomissjoni elettronika ta' offerti?
messages.mt_standard: Taf kif taħdem is-sottomissjoni elettronika ta' offerti?
messages.zh: 你知道怎样在线递交投标文件吗？
messages.en: Do you know how electronic tender submission works?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tidħol fil-portal, ittella' d-dokumenti u tibgħat l-offerta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tidħol fil-portal, ittella' d-dokumenti u tibgħat l-offerta.
messages.zh: 知道，登录门户，上传文件，再提交投标。
messages.en: Yes, you log into the portal, upload the documents and submit the tender.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义把长词组分成三段记：sottomissjoni（递交）＋ elettronika（电子的）＋ ta' offerti（报价或投标的），再想象登录平台上传投标文件的动作。

gloss_zh: 声音部门；影视制作中的录音与声音制作团队

teaching_sense.en_definition: The department in a film production responsible for recording or working on sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电影制作中负责录制或处理声音的部门或团队。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dipartiment fi produzzjoni ta' film li jkun responsabbli għar-reġistrazzjoni jew l-ipproċessar tal-ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电影行业用语：指电影制作中负责录音或声音处理的部门。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-qasam tal-industrija tal-films, dan huwa d-dipartiment li jieħu ħsieb ir-reġistrazzjoni jew l-ipproċessar tal-ħoss tal-produzzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In the film industry, the sound department is the team responsible for recording or working on a production's sound.

collocations.en: the head of the sound department
to work with the sound department

formal.mt: Il-kap tas-sound department talab li l-istorbju fl-istudjo jitnaqqas qabel ir-reġistrazzjoni tad-djalogu.
formal.en: The head of the sound department requested that noise in the studio be reduced before the dialogue was recorded.
formal.zh: 声音部门负责人要求在录制对白前降低摄影棚内的噪声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed nistennew biex nibdew ix-xena? Ben: It-tim tas-sound department għadu qed jiċċekkja l-mikrofoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are we waiting to start the scene? Ben: The sound department team is still checking the microphones.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们为什么还在等，不能开始拍这场戏吗？Ben：声音部门的团队还在检查麦克风。

messages.speaker: Lara (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nistennew biex nibdew ix-xena?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nistennew biex nibdew ix-xena?
messages.zh: 我们为什么还在等，不能开始拍这场戏吗？
messages.en: Why are we waiting to start the scene?

messages.speaker: Ben (剧组助理)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tim tas-sound department għadu qed jiċċekkja l-mikrofoni.
messages.mt_standard: It-tim tas-sound department għadu qed jiċċekkja l-mikrofoni.
messages.zh: 声音部门的团队还在检查麦克风。
messages.en: The sound department team is still checking the microphones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sound department 和片场里戴耳机、检查麦克风的团队联系起来；sound 对应声音，department 对应部门，整组记成“影视声音部门”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supervision and oversight of work, an activity, or an organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对工作、活动或机构进行监督、指导和管理的职责或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma jew ir-responsabbiltà li tissorvelja u tmexxi xogħol, attività jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 监督管理；对某项工作、活动或机构承担总体督导和监管责任。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sorveljanza ġenerali ta' xogħol, attività jew organizzazzjoni biex jiġi żgurat li kollox jitmexxa kif suppost.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Superintendence is the responsibility or activity of overseeing work or an organization and ensuring that it is managed properly.

collocations.en: under the supervision of an expert

formal.mt: Ix-xogħlijiet ta' restawr saru taħt is-sovraintendenza ta' espert biex tiġi żgurata l-kwalità tagħhom.
formal.en: The restoration work was carried out under an expert's supervision to ensure its quality.
formal.zh: 修复工作在专家的监督指导下开展，以确保质量。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jieħu ħsieb is-sovraintendenza tax-xogħlijiet? Toni: Il-perit; se jiġi kuljum biex jara kif sejrin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who will be responsible for supervising the works? Toni: The architect; he will come every day to see how things are going.
colloquial.zh: Nina：谁来负责监督这些工程？Toni：建筑师，他每天都会来看看进展。

messages.speaker: Nina (业主)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb is-sovraintendenza tax-xogħlijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb is-sovraintendenza tax-xogħlijiet?
messages.zh: 谁来负责监督这些工程？
messages.en: Who will be responsible for supervising the works?

messages.speaker: Toni (工程协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-perit; se jiġi kuljum biex jara kif sejrin.
messages.mt_standard: Il-perit; se jiġi kuljum biex jara kif sejrin.
messages.zh: 建筑师，他每天都会来看看进展。
messages.en: The architect; he will come every day to see how things are going.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住固定搭配 taħt is-sovraintendenza ta'（在某人的监督下），想象负责人每天检查进度与质量，用这个场景记住“监督管理”这一抽象名词。

gloss_zh: 拥有主权的；具有最高统治权的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having supreme authority or the independent power to govern.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有最高统治权，或具有独立自主治理权的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ogħla setgħa li jmexxi jew id-dritt li jiggverna b'mod indipendenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥有主权、能够独立行使最高治理权的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu setgħa suprema jew jista' jiggverna lilu nnifsu mingħajr ma jkun taħt l-awtorità ta' stat ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sovereign state or authority has the highest power to govern and make its own decisions.

formal.mt: Bħala stat sovran, il-pajjiż għandu d-dritt li jfassal il-politika tiegħu stess.
formal.en: As a sovereign state, the country has the right to formulate its own policies.
formal.zh: 作为主权国家，该国有权制定自己的政策。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri li pajjiż hu sovran? Mark: Jiġifieri li għandu s-setgħa li jiggverna lilu nnifsu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean for a country to be sovereign? Mark: It means that it has the power to govern itself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：一个国家拥有主权是什么意思？马克：意思是它有权自主治理。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri li pajjiż hu sovran?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri li pajjiż hu sovran?
messages.zh: 一个国家拥有主权是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean for a country to be sovereign?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li għandu s-setgħa li jiggverna lilu nnifsu.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li għandu s-setgħa li jiggverna lilu nnifsu.
messages.zh: 意思是它有权自主治理。
messages.en: It means that it has the power to govern itself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sovran 和“国家自己作主”这一画面绑定，再用 stat sovran 整组记住“主权国家”。

gloss_zh: 粮食主权；人民自主决定粮食与农业体系的权利

teaching_sense.en_definition: The right of peoples to shape their own food and agricultural systems, including how food is produced and distributed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各国人民或社区自主决定本地粮食与农业体系，包括粮食如何生产、分配和消费的权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dritt tal-popli u tal-komunitajiet li jiddeċiedu kif jiġi prodott, imqassam u kkunsmat l-ikel tagħhom u kif titmexxa l-agrikoltura tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粮食主权，即人民和社区自主决定自身粮食及农业政策与体系的权利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dritt tal-popli li jfasslu s-sistemi u l-politiki tagħhom dwar l-ikel u l-agrikoltura skont il-ħtiġijiet u l-għażliet tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Food sovereignty is the right of people and communities to determine their own food and agricultural systems.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza li s-sovranità tal-ikel titlob li l-bdiewa u l-komunitajiet ikollhom sehem fid-deċiżjonijiet dwar is-sistema tal-ikel.
formal.en: The report stresses that food sovereignty requires farmers and communities to have a say in decisions about the food system.
formal.zh: 报告强调，粮食主权要求农民和社区能够参与粮食体系的相关决策。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi s-sovranità tal-ikel? Pawlu: Hi li n-nies ikollhom vuċi f'kif jitkabbar u jitqassam l-ikel tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is food sovereignty? Pawlu: It means people having a say in how their food is grown and distributed.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：什么是粮食主权？保罗：就是人们对自己的粮食如何种植和分配有发言权。

messages.speaker: Sara (社区居民)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi s-sovranità tal-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi s-sovranità tal-ikel?
messages.zh: 什么是粮食主权？
messages.en: What is food sovereignty?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Hi li n-nies ikollhom vuċi f'kif jitkabbar u jitqassam l-ikel tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Hi li n-nies ikollhom vuċi f'kif jitkabbar u jitqassam l-ikel tagħhom.
messages.zh: 就是人们对自己的粮食如何种植和分配有发言权。
messages.en: It means people having a say in how their food is grown and distributed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“餐桌上的食物，由社区参与作主”记住整个短语；重点是粮食体系的自主决定权。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Placed over another image, surface, or element so that the two occupy the same area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放置或显示在另一图像、表面或元素之上，与其占据同一区域的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imqiegħed jew muri fuq stampa, wiċċ jew element ieħor fl-istess spazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叠置或叠加在另一物体、图像或表面之上的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imqiegħed fuq xi ħaġa oħra b'mod li t-tnejn jidhru jew jinsabu fl-istess żona.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is superimposed is placed over another image or object so that they overlap.

collocations.en: a layer superimposed on a map

formal.mt: It-test sovrapost fuq ir-ritratt għandu jkun ċar u jinqara faċilment.
formal.en: The text superimposed on the photograph should be clear and easy to read.
formal.zh: 叠加在照片上的文字应清晰易读。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma nistax nara wiċċ it-tifel sew? David: Għax it-titlu hu sovrapost fuq ir-ritratt u jgħatti parti minn wiċċu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't I see the boy's face clearly? David: Because the title is superimposed on the photograph and covers part of his face.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么我看不清男孩的脸？戴维：因为标题叠加在照片上，遮住了他的一部分脸。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nara wiċċ it-tifel sew?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nara wiċċ it-tifel sew?
messages.zh: 为什么我看不清男孩的脸？
messages.en: Why can't I see the boy's face clearly?

messages.speaker: David (海报制作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax it-titlu hu sovrapost fuq ir-ritratt u jgħatti parti minn wiċċu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax it-titlu hu sovrapost fuq ir-ritratt u jgħatti parti minn wiċċu.
messages.zh: 因为标题叠加在照片上，遮住了他的一部分脸。
messages.en: Because the title is superimposed on the photograph and covers part of his face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把透明文字片盖在照片上，用这个“上层叠着下层”的画面记住 sovrapost。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money provided by a government or organization to support an activity, project, or cost, usually without repayment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 政府或机构为支持某项活动、项目或支付相关费用而提供的、通常无需偿还的款项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajnuna finanzjarja mogħtija minn gvern jew organizzazzjoni biex tappoġġa attività jew proġett, jew tkopri spejjeż, normalment mingħajr obbligu ta' ħlas lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由政府或机构拨给个人或组织、用于特定目的且通常无需偿还的补助金。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma flus li gvern jew organizzazzjoni jagħtu lil persuna jew għaqda għal skop speċifiku, normalment mingħajr ma jkollha titħallas lura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A grant is an amount of money given by a government or organization for a particular purpose.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以拨款形式提供、通常无需偿还的财政援助或资助。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għajnuna finanzjarja mogħtija bħala fondi għal proġett jew ħtieġa partikolari, normalment mingħajr obbligu li titħallas lura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Grant aid is financial assistance provided through grants to support a project, organization, or particular need.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 政府或其他机构为降低成本、维持价格或支持某项经济活动而提供的补贴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għajnuna finanzjarja li gvern jew istituzzjoni jagħtu biex inaqqsu l-ispejjeż, iżommu l-prezzijiet aktar baxxi jew isostnu attività ekonomika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A subsidy is money paid by a government or other body to reduce costs or support an activity.

collocations.en: to receive a grant or subsidy

formal.mt: L-għaqda rċeviet sovvenzjoni biex tkopri parti mill-ispejjeż tal-proġett edukattiv.
formal.en: The association received a grant to cover part of the costs of the educational project.
formal.zh: 该协会获得了一笔补助金，用于支付教育项目的部分费用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif se nħallsu għat-tagħmir il-ġdid tal-klabb? Toni: Nistgħu napplikaw għal sovvenzjoni biex tkopri parti mill-ispiża.
colloquial.en: Nina: How are we going to pay for the club's new equipment? Toni: We can apply for a grant to cover part of the cost.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：俱乐部的新设备要怎么付钱？托尼：我们可以申请补助金，支付一部分费用。

messages.speaker: Nina (俱乐部成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nħallsu għat-tagħmir il-ġdid tal-klabb?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nħallsu għat-tagħmir il-ġdid tal-klabb?
messages.zh: 俱乐部的新设备要怎么付钱？
messages.en: How are we going to pay for the club's new equipment?

messages.speaker: Toni (俱乐部负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu napplikaw għal sovvenzjoni biex tkopri parti mill-ispiża.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu napplikaw għal sovvenzjoni biex tkopri parti mill-ispiża.
messages.zh: 我们可以申请补助金，支付一部分费用。
messages.en: We can apply for a grant to cover part of the cost.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sovvenzjoni 想成项目账单旁的一笔援助款：用于项目是补助金，用于降低成本是补贴。

gloss_zh: 社会主义者；社会主义的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports socialism and its ideas about social and economic organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持社会主义及其社会、经济组织理念的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġja s-soċjaliżmu u l-ideat tiegħu dwar kif għandhom jiġu organizzati s-soċjetà u l-ekonomija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 社会主义者；支持社会主义理念的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li temmen fis-soċjaliżmu u tappoġġja l-prinċipji tiegħu fil-politika, fis-soċjetà jew fl-ekonomija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A socialist is someone who supports socialism as a way of organizing society and the economy.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 社会主义的；与社会主义理念、政策或运动有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-soċjaliżmu jew li huwa bbażat fuq il-prinċipji tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A socialist policy, organization, or movement is based on or associated with the principles of socialism.

formal.mt: Fl-artiklu tiegħu, l-awtur jiddeskrivi lilu nnifsu bħala soċjalist u jispjega l-fehmiet tiegħu dwar l-ugwaljanza soċjali.
formal.en: In his article, the author describes himself as a socialist and explains his views on social equality.
formal.zh: 作者在文章中自称社会主义者，并阐述了自己对社会平等的看法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int tqis lilek innifsek bħala soċjalist? Mark: Iva, imma nixtieq nispjega x'nifhem b'dik il-kelma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you consider yourself a socialist? Mark: Yes, but I would like to explain what I mean by that word.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你认为自己是社会主义者吗？马克：是的，不过我想解释一下我用这个词表达的意思。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int tqis lilek innifsek bħala soċjalist?
messages.mt_standard: Int tqis lilek innifsek bħala soċjalist?
messages.zh: 你认为自己是社会主义者吗？
messages.en: Do you consider yourself a socialist?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nixtieq nispjega x'nifhem b'dik il-kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nixtieq nispjega x'nifhem b'dik il-kelma.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我想解释一下我用这个词表达的意思。
messages.en: Yes, but I would like to explain what I mean by that word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个句框记词性：表示一个人时记“社会主义者”，放在 moviment 后修饰运动时记“社会主义的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of how language use relates to society, social groups, and social situations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究语言使用与社会、社会群体及社会情境之间关系的学科。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qasam ta' studju li jeżamina r-relazzjoni bejn l-użu tal-lingwa u s-soċjetà, il-gruppi soċjali u s-sitwazzjonijiet soċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 社会语言学；研究语言与社会的关系，包括不同群体和情境中的语言使用及变异。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qasam tal-lingwistika li jistudja kif l-użu u l-varjazzjoni tal-lingwa huma marbuta mas-soċjetà, mal-gruppi soċjali u mal-kuntest tal-komunikazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sociolinguistics is the study of how language varies and is used within different social groups and situations.

formal.mt: Dan l-istudju fis-soċjolingwistika jeżamina kif l-istudenti jagħżlu bejn il-Malti u l-Ingliż f'sitwazzjonijiet differenti.
formal.en: This study in sociolinguistics examines how students choose between Maltese and English in different situations.
formal.zh: 这项社会语言学研究考察学生在不同情境中如何选择使用马耳他语或英语。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tistudja dan is-semestru? Nina: Is-soċjolingwistika. Qed nitgħallmu kif in-nies ibiddlu l-mod kif jitkellmu skont ma' min ikunu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you studying this semester? Nina: Sociolinguistics. We are learning how people change the way they speak depending on who they are with.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你这学期在学什么？妮娜：社会语言学。我们正在学习人们如何根据交谈对象调整说话方式。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tistudja dan is-semestru?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tistudja dan is-semestru?
messages.zh: 你这学期在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying this semester?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-soċjolingwistika. Qed nitgħallmu kif in-nies ibiddlu l-mod kif jitkellmu skont ma' min ikunu.
messages.mt_standard: Is-soċjolingwistika. Qed nitgħallmu kif in-nies ibiddlu l-mod kif jitkellmu skont ma' min ikunu.
messages.zh: 社会语言学。我们正在学习人们如何根据交谈对象调整说话方式。
messages.en: Sociolinguistics. We are learning how people change the way they speak depending on who they are with.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人对老师和朋友采用不同说法，把“社会情境影响语言使用”的画面与这个学科名称一起记住。

gloss_zh: 逗留；旅居；度假期间的住宿

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period spent staying in a place, for example during a holiday.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某地暂时居住或停留的一段时间，例如度假期间的住宿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' żmien li persuna tqatta' toqgħod f'post, pereżempju waqt vaganza.

sense_translations.en_definition: stay (in a place, e.g. on holiday)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某地的一段逗留或暂住，尤指度假期间的住宿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żmien li persuna tqatta' toqgħod f'post partikolari, bħal f'lukanda jew f'pajjiż ieħor waqt vaganza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stay is a period during which you live temporarily in a particular place, often while on holiday.

formal.mt: Matul is-soġġorn tagħhom f'Għawdex, l-istudenti żaru diversi postijiet ta' interess storiku.
formal.en: During their stay in Gozo, the students visited several places of historical interest.
formal.zh: 学生们在戈佐岛逗留期间，参观了几处具有历史意义的地方。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien is-soġġorn tiegħek f'Malta? Mark: Kien sabiħ ħafna, imma qasir wisq!
colloquial.en: Sara: How was your stay in Malta? Mark: It was lovely, but much too short!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在马耳他住得怎么样？马克：非常愉快，就是时间太短了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien is-soġġorn tiegħek f'Malta?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien is-soġġorn tiegħek f'Malta?
messages.zh: 你在马耳他住得怎么样？
messages.en: How was your stay in Malta?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien sabiħ ħafna, imma qasir wisq!
messages.mt_standard: Kien sabiħ ħafna, imma qasir wisq!
messages.zh: 非常愉快，就是时间太短了！
messages.en: It was lovely, but much too short!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旅行日历上圈出抵达与离开的日期：两者之间整段暂住时间，就是 soġġorn。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thin cord used for tying, fastening, or hanging things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来捆绑、固定或悬挂物品的细绳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spag huwa ħajt oħxon jew korda rqiqa li tintuża biex torbot, twaħħal jew iddendel l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于捆绑、固定或悬挂物品的细绳。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spag huwa ħajt oħxon jew korda rqiqa li tintuża biex torbot jew iddendel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: String is thin cord that you use to tie, fasten, or hang things.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由多股纤维或线捻成、主要用于捆扎的细绳。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spag huwa korda magħmula minn diversi ħjut mibrumin flimkien, li tintuża l-aktar biex torbot pakketti jew affarijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Twine is cord made from strands twisted together and used especially for tying things.

formal.mt: Il-pakkett għandu jintrabat bi spag biex jibqa' magħluq waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The parcel should be tied with string to keep it closed during transport.
formal.zh: 包裹应当用细绳捆好，以便在运输过程中保持封闭。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek biċċa spag biex norbot din il-kaxxa? Pawlu: Iva, hemm romblu spag fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a piece of string so I can tie this box? Pawlu: Yes, there's a roll of string in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有一段细绳吗？我想把这个盒子捆起来。保罗：有，抽屉里有一卷细绳。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek biċċa spag biex norbot din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek biċċa spag biex norbot din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 你有一段细绳吗？我想把这个盒子捆起来。
messages.en: Do you have a piece of string so I can tie this box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm romblu spag fil-kexxun.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm romblu spag fil-kexxun.
messages.zh: 有，抽屉里有一卷细绳。
messages.en: Yes, there's a roll of string in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spag 和“捆包裹”画面绑定：需要一段就说 biċċa spag，需要一卷就说 romblu spag。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin cord or length of cord used for tying or fastening things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于捆绑或固定物品的一根细绳或一段绳子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spaga hija ħajta ħoxna jew korda rqiqa li tintuża biex torbot jew iżżomm xi ħaġa f'postha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于捆绑、连接或固定物品的细绳。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spaga hija ħajta ħoxna jew korda rqiqa li biha tista' torbot, tgħaqqad jew iżżomm xi ħaġa f'postha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A string is a thin cord that you use to tie or fasten something.

formal.mt: It-tikketta għandha titwaħħal mal-borża permezz ta' spaga rqiqa.
formal.en: The label should be attached to the bag using a thin string.
formal.zh: 标签应使用一根细绳系在袋子上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din l-ispaga twila biżżejjed biex norbot ir-rigal? Mark: Iva, u tista' tagħmel pruwa biha wkoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this string long enough for me to tie the gift? Mark: Yes, and you can make a bow with it too.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这根细绳够长吗？我想用它捆礼物。马克：够长，你还可以用它打个蝴蝶结。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-ispaga twila biżżejjed biex norbot ir-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-ispaga twila biżżejjed biex norbot ir-rigal?
messages.zh: 这根细绳够长吗？我想用它捆礼物。
messages.en: Is this string long enough for me to tie the gift?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u tista' tagħmel pruwa biha wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u tista' tagħmel pruwa biha wkoll.
messages.zh: 够长，你还可以用它打个蝴蝶结。
messages.en: Yes, and you can make a bow with it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里拿着一根细绳，把 spaga 与 spaga twila“长细绳”一起记，靠完整搭配巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The two shoulders, where the arms join the upper part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人体上部左右两侧、与手臂相连的两个肩膀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ispallejn huma ż-żewġ partijiet ta' fuq tal-ġisem fejn id-dirgħajn jingħaqdu mat-tronk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一双肩膀，即人体左右两侧的两个肩部。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ispallejn huma ż-żewġ partijiet tal-ġisem, waħda fuq kull naħa taħt l-għonq, fejn id-dirgħajn jingħaqdu mat-tronk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your shoulders are the two parts of your body where your arms join your upper body.

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju, il-parteċipanti għandhom iżommu l-ispallejn rilassati.
formal.en: During the exercise, participants should keep their shoulders relaxed.
formal.zh: 练习过程中，参与者应保持双肩放松。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi uġigħ fl-ispallejn wara li ġarrejt dawk il-basktijiet. Anna: Poġġi ftit u strieħ; jien inġorr il-bqija.
colloquial.en: Marija: My shoulders hurt after carrying those bags. Anna: Sit down and rest for a bit; I'll carry the rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：提完那些袋子后，我的双肩都疼了。安娜：坐下来休息一会儿，剩下的我来提。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi uġigħ fl-ispallejn wara li ġarrejt dawk il-basktijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi uġigħ fl-ispallejn wara li ġarrejt dawk il-basktijiet.
messages.zh: 提完那些袋子后，我的双肩都疼了。
messages.en: My shoulders hurt after carrying those bags.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġi ftit u strieħ; jien inġorr il-bqija.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġi ftit u strieħ; jien inġorr il-bqija.
messages.zh: 坐下来休息一会儿，剩下的我来提。
messages.en: Sit down and rest for a bit; I'll carry the rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 spallejn 时同时轻点左右肩，把这个词固定记成“双肩”；再配合“抬肩、放松肩膀”两个动作练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fire a gun or another weapon that sends out a projectile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发射枪械或其他能够射出弹射物的武器；开枪射击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tispara jfisser li tuża arma biex minnha toħroġ balla jew projettili ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用枪械等武器发射子弹或其他弹射物；射击。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tispara jfisser li tuża pistola, xkubetta jew arma oħra biex tisħaq projettili minnha lejn xi ħaġa jew f'direzzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone shoots, they fire a gun or another weapon, often aiming at a particular target.

formal.mt: Matul il-kompetizzjoni, il-parteċipant spara tliet darbiet lejn il-mira.
formal.en: During the competition, the participant fired three times at the target.
formal.zh: 比赛期间，参赛者朝靶子射击了三次。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar Mark fil-kompetizzjoni? Pawlu: Mar tajjeb! Spara tliet darbiet u laqat il-mira kull darba.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Mark do in the competition? Pawlu: He did well! He fired three times and hit the target every time.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克比赛表现怎么样？保罗：表现很好！他射击了三次，每次都命中靶子。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar Mark fil-kompetizzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar Mark fil-kompetizzjoni?
messages.zh: 马克比赛表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark do in the competition?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mar tajjeb! Spara tliet darbiet u laqat il-mira kull darba.
messages.mt_standard: Mar tajjeb! Spara tliet darbiet u laqat il-mira kull darba.
messages.zh: 表现很好！他射击了三次，每次都命中靶子。
messages.en: He did well! He fired three times and hit the target every time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用射击比赛的画面记 spara：先对准 il-mira“靶子”，再记短句 spara lejn il-mira“他朝靶子射击了”。

gloss_zh: 他们开了枪；他们射击了

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fire a gun or another weapon; sparaw expresses that they performed this action in the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指开枪或发射其他武器；sparaw 表示“他们射击了”，用于叙述过去发生的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisparaw b'arma tan-nar jew b'arma oħra; il-forma sparaw tindika li huma għamlu din l-azzjoni fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开枪；射击；用武器发射子弹或其他射出物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tispara b'arma tan-nar jew b'arma oħra biex toħroġ minnha balla jew projettili ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone shoots, they fire a gun or another weapon.

formal.mt: Matul il-kompetizzjoni, il-parteċipanti sparaw lejn il-miri u l-ġudikanti rreġistraw il-punteġġi tagħhom.
formal.en: During the competition, the participants shot at the targets, and the judges recorded their scores.
formal.zh: 比赛期间，参赛者向靶子射击，裁判记录了他们的得分。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Diġà sparaw lejn il-mira? Pawlu: Iva, u issa qed jistennew ir-riżultat.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have they already shot at the target? Pawlu: Yes, and now they are waiting for the result.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：他们已经朝靶子射击了吗？保罗：是的，现在他们正在等结果。

messages.speaker: Marija (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà sparaw lejn il-mira?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà sparaw lejn il-mira?
messages.zh: 他们已经朝靶子射击了吗？
messages.en: Have they already shot at the target?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u issa qed jistennew ir-riżultat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u issa qed jistennew ir-riżultat.
messages.zh: 是的，现在他们正在等结果。
messages.en: Yes, and now they are waiting for the result.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sparaw 配上“一组人刚完成靶场射击”的画面，整句记住 sparaw lejn il-mira，提醒自己这里说的是“他们射击了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To disappear or vanish from sight or from a place; sparixxa expresses this happening to a masculine singular subject in the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指从视线中或某处消失、不见；sparixxa 用于阳性单数主语，表示过去发生了这一变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jibqax jidher jew ma jibqax jinstab f'post; il-forma sparixxa tindika li dan ġara fil-passat lil persuna jew ħaġa fil-maskil singular.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消失；不再能被看见，或不再能在原来的地方找到。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ma tibqax tidher jew ma tibqax tinstab fil-post fejn kont qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something disappears, they can no longer be seen or found.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消失得无影无踪；强调突然或完全地不见。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħib għal kollox minn quddiem l-għajnejn jew minn post, spiss f'daqqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear completely, often very suddenly.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li d-dokument sparixxa mill-arkivju wara l-aħħar spezzjoni.
formal.en: The report indicates that the document disappeared from the archive after the last inspection.
formal.zh: 报告指出，那份文件在上次检查后从档案库中不见了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-qattus? Sparixxa f'daqqa! Mark: Qiegħed taħt is-sodda. Għadu kemm daħal hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the cat? He suddenly disappeared! Mark: He is under the bed. He has just gone in there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：猫在哪里？它突然不见了！马克：它在床底下，刚刚钻进去。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-qattus? Sparixxa f'daqqa!
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-qattus? Sparixxa f'daqqa!
messages.zh: 猫在哪里？它突然不见了！
messages.en: Where is the cat? He suddenly disappeared!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed taħt is-sodda. Għadu kemm daħal hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed taħt is-sodda. Għadu kemm daħal hemm.
messages.zh: 它在床底下，刚刚钻进去。
messages.en: He is under the bed. He has just gone in there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象猫刚才还在眼前，转眼就躲进床底：对着空位置说 sparixxa，把这个词和“刚刚不见了”的完整情景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A utensil with a broad, flat blade used to scrape, spread, lift, or turn food or other material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有宽而扁平工作面的工具，可用于刮取、涂抹、托起或翻动食物及其他材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'parti wiesgħa u ċatta li tintuża biex tobrox, tidlek, terfa' jew taqleb ikel jew materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮刀、抹刀或锅铲，指用于刮取、涂抹或翻动材料的扁平工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda ċatta b'manku, użata biex tobrox materjal minn reċipjent, tifrex taħlita fuq wiċċ jew taqleb l-ikel waqt it-tisjir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spatula is a flat utensil used for scraping, spreading, or turning food and other materials.

collocations.en: turn the egg with a spatula

formal.mt: Uża spatula tas-silikon biex tiġbor it-taħlita minn mal-ġnub tal-iskutella u tittrasferiha fil-landa tal-ħami.
formal.en: Use a silicone spatula to scrape the mixture from the sides of the bowl and transfer it to the baking tin.
formal.zh: 用硅胶刮刀刮下碗壁上的混合物，并将其转移到烤模中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tgħaddili l-ispatula, jekk jogħġbok? Ben: Din tas-silikon? Nina: Iva, biex niġbor it-taħlita mill-iskutella.
colloquial.en: Nina: Could you pass me the spatula, please? Ben: This silicone one? Nina: Yes, so I can scrape the mixture out of the bowl.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：请把刮刀递给我好吗？本：这把硅胶的吗？妮娜：对，我要把碗里的混合物刮出来。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħaddili l-ispatula, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tgħaddili l-ispatula, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请把刮刀递给我好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the spatula, please?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din tas-silikon?
messages.mt_standard: Din tas-silikon?
messages.zh: 这把硅胶的吗？
messages.en: This silicone one?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
