messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biex niġbor it-taħlita mill-iskutella.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biex niġbor it-taħlita mill-iskutella.
messages.zh: 对，我要把碗里的混合物刮出来。
messages.en: Yes, so I can scrape the mixture out of the bowl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spatula 写在厨房刮刀旁，边看扁平刀面边想“刮碗壁、抹奶油、翻食物”，用三种动作记住工具的用途。

gloss_zh: 自由活动区域；可自由移动的空间

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area in which people or things can move freely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人或物自由移动、活动而不受阻碍的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona fejn persuni jew affarijiet jistgħu jiċċaqilqu liberament mingħajr ostakli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 允许人或物自由移动的区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona li tippermetti lill-persuni jew lill-affarijiet jiċċaqilqu liberament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An area of free movement is a space where people or things can move without obstruction.

collocations.en: an area where children can move freely
collocations.zh: 供儿童自由活动的区域

collocations.en: to leave room for free movement

formal.mt: L-għamara għandha titqiegħed b'mod li tħalli spazju ta' moviment liberu fiċ-ċentru tal-kamra.
formal.en: The furniture should be arranged so that an area for free movement remains in the centre of the room.
formal.zh: 家具应合理摆放，使房间中央留有自由活动的空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inressqu l-mejda mal-ħajt? Mark: Iva, hekk inħallu spazju ta' moviment liberu għat-tfal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we move the table against the wall? Mark: Yes, that will leave an area where the children can move freely.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们把桌子移到墙边好吗？马克：好，这样就能给孩子们留出自由活动的空间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inressqu l-mejda mal-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Inressqu l-mejda mal-ħajt?
messages.zh: 我们把桌子移到墙边好吗？
messages.en: Shall we move the table against the wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk inħallu spazju ta' moviment liberu għat-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk inħallu spazju ta' moviment liberu għat-tfal.
messages.zh: 好，这样就能给孩子们留出自由活动的空间。
messages.en: Yes, that will leave an area where the children can move freely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把桌椅推到墙边，中央空出来让人自由走动；把整个短语作为“自由活动区域”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having plenty of room, especially inside a room or building; the feminine singular form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容房间、建筑等内部空间充足、宽敞；此处为阴性单数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandha ħafna spazju ġewwa fiha; din hija l-forma femminili singulari tal-aġġettiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宽敞的；内部有充足空间的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandha biżżejjed spazju biex wieħed joqgħod jew jiċċaqlaq bil-kumdità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spacious room or building has plenty of space for people to use comfortably.

formal.mt: Il-librerija għandha sala spazjuża fejn l-istudenti jistgħu jaqraw u jistudjaw bil-kumdità.
formal.en: The library has a spacious hall where students can read and study comfortably.
formal.zh: 图书馆设有宽敞的大厅，学生可以在那里舒适地阅读和学习。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhi l-kċina fid-dar il-ġdida? Nina: Spazjuża ħafna! Nistgħu nsajru flimkien bla ma ndejqu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's the kitchen like in the new house? Nina: Very spacious! We can cook together without getting in each other's way.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：新家的厨房怎么样？妮娜：特别宽敞！我们可以一起做饭，不会互相碍事。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhi l-kċina fid-dar il-ġdida?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhi l-kċina fid-dar il-ġdida?
messages.zh: 新家的厨房怎么样？
messages.en: What's the kitchen like in the new house?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Spazjuża ħafna! Nistgħu nsajru flimkien bla ma ndejqu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Spazjuża ħafna! Nistgħu nsajru flimkien bla ma ndejqu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 特别宽敞！我们可以一起做饭，不会互相碍事。
messages.en: Very spacious! We can cook together without getting in each other's way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kamra spazjuża 想成能轻松摆下桌椅的宽敞房间；连同阴性名词 kamra 一起记住这个形式。

gloss_zh: 空间的；与空间有关的（按所给形容词标签理解）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Associated with space, following the adjective label supplied for this entry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按本条提供的形容词标签，理解为与空间有关的、空间方面的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ispazju, skont il-klassifikazzjoni bħala aġġettiv mogħtija f'din l-entrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空间的；与空间有关的（依本条给定的形容词词性解释）。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għall-ispazju jew għandu x'jaqsam miegħu, skont it-tikketta grammatikali mogħtija għal din l-entrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Under the supplied adjective label, this entry describes something associated with space.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista ta' vokabularju, il-kelma 'Spazzju' hija mmarkata bħala aġġettiv u tingħata t-tifsira Ingliża 'Space'.
formal.en: In this vocabulary list, the word 'Spazzju' is labelled as an adjective and is given the English meaning 'Space'.
formal.zh: 在这份词汇表中，“Spazzju”被标为形容词，所给英文释义为“Space”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nifhem 'Spazzju' f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Hawn immarkat bħala aġġettiv; f'din l-entrata nifhmuh bħala xi ħaġa marbuta mal-ispazju.
colloquial.en: Maja: How should I understand 'Spazzju' in this list? Pawlu: It's labelled as an adjective here; in this entry, we understand it as something associated with space.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份表里的“Spazzju”该怎么理解？保罗：这里把它标为形容词；在这个词条中，我们把它理解为与空间有关。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nifhem 'Spazzju' f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nifhem 'Spazzju' f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这份表里的“Spazzju”该怎么理解？
messages.en: How should I understand 'Spazzju' in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn immarkat bħala aġġettiv; f'din l-entrata nifhmuh bħala xi ħaġa marbuta mal-ispazju.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn immarkat bħala aġġettiv; f'din l-entrata nifhmuh bħala xi ħaġa marbuta mal-ispazju.
messages.zh: 这里把它标为形容词；在这个词条中，我们把它理解为与空间有关。
messages.en: It's labelled as an adjective here; in this entry, we understand it as something associated with space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本条的形容词标签与英文 Space 成对记忆；例句采用词语讲解形式，避免仅凭这个短释义猜测实际搭配。

gloss_zh: 痉挛；肌肉突然不自主收缩

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden, involuntary tightening of a muscle or group of muscles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块肌肉或一组肌肉突然发生的不受意志控制的收缩，即痉挛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontrazzjoni f'daqqa u mhux volontarja ta' muskolu jew ta' grupp ta' muskoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 痉挛，指肌肉突然发生的不自主收缩，有时伴有疼痛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontrazzjoni f'daqqa ta' muskolu jew ta' grupp ta' muskoli li sseħħ mingħajr kontroll volontarju u li xi drabi tkun akkumpanjata minn uġigħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spasm is a sudden tightening of a muscle that you cannot control.

formal.mt: Il-pazjent irrapporta spażmu qawwi fil-muskolu tar-riġel li dam ftit sekondi.
formal.en: The patient reported a strong spasm in a leg muscle that lasted a few seconds.
formal.zh: 患者报告腿部肌肉发生了一次持续数秒的剧烈痉挛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqaft timxi? David: Għadni kemm ħassejt spażmu fil-muskolu tar-riġel. Sara: Għadu qed juġgħek? David: Le, issa għadda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you stop walking? David: I have just felt a spasm in a leg muscle. Sara: Does it still hurt? David: No, it has passed now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么停下来不走了？戴维：我刚才腿部肌肉痉挛了一下。萨拉：现在还疼吗？戴维：不疼了，已经过去了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex waqaft timxi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex waqaft timxi?
messages.zh: 你为什么停下来不走了？
messages.en: Why did you stop walking?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni kemm ħassejt spażmu fil-muskolu tar-riġel.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni kemm ħassejt spażmu fil-muskolu tar-riġel.
messages.zh: 我刚才腿部肌肉痉挛了一下。
messages.en: I have just felt a spasm in a leg muscle.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu qed juġgħek?
messages.mt_standard: Għadu qed juġgħek?
messages.zh: 现在还疼吗？
messages.en: Does it still hurt?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa għadda.
messages.zh: 不疼了，已经过去了。
messages.en: No, it has passed now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spażmu 和“肌肉突然自己绷紧一下”的画面配对，再读 spażmu fil-muskolu，抓住“突然、不自主收缩”这三个记忆点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company that sends a letter, parcel, or shipment of goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寄出信件、包裹或货物的人或公司；根据语境可指寄件人、发货人或托运人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tibgħat ittra, pakkett jew merkanzija lil persuna jew kumpanija oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 托运人；将货物交付运输、安排发往收货人的个人或公司。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tgħaddi merkanzija lil trasportatur biex din tintbagħat lil riċevitur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consignor is a person or company that hands goods over to a carrier for delivery to a recipient.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寄件人；发送信件、包裹或其他物品的人或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tibgħat ittra, pakkett jew oġġett ieħor lil xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The sender is the person or organization that sends a letter, parcel, or other item to someone.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发货人；安排将货物通过运输服务发出的个人或公司。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tirranġa biex merkanzija tintbagħat minn post għal ieħor permezz ta' servizz ta' trasport.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shipper is a person or company that arranges for goods to be transported from one place to another.

formal.mt: L-isem u l-indirizz tal-speditur għandhom jidhru b'mod ċar fuq id-dokument tat-trasport.
formal.en: The consignor's name and address must appear clearly on the transport document.
formal.zh: 托运人的姓名或名称及地址必须清楚地列在运输单据上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-pakkett għadu ma wasalx. Lil min għandi nkellem? Mark: Ikkuntattja lill-speditur u staqsih għan-numru tat-traċċar.
colloquial.en: Lara: The parcel still hasn't arrived. Who should I speak to? Mark: Contact the sender and ask them for the tracking number.
colloquial.zh: Lara：包裹还没到。我该找谁？Mark：联系寄件人，向对方要一下物流追踪号码。

messages.speaker: Lara (收件人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pakkett għadu ma wasalx. Lil min għandi nkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Il-pakkett għadu ma wasalx. Lil min għandi nkellem?
messages.zh: 包裹还没到。我该找谁？
messages.en: The parcel still hasn't arrived. Who should I speak to?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikkuntattja lill-speditur u staqsih għan-numru tat-traċċar.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkuntattja lill-speditur u staqsih għan-numru tat-traċċar.
messages.zh: 联系寄件人，向对方要一下物流追踪号码。
messages.en: Contact the sender and ask them for the tracking number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把包裹想成一条从甲到乙的箭头：speditur 站在寄出的一端。信件中记“寄件人”，货运中记“发货人、托运人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Business costs that remain unchanged over a given period within a relevant range of activity, regardless of output or sales.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在一定期间和一定经营活动范围内，不随产量或销售量变化而改变的成本，例如按固定金额支付的租金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spejjeż ta' negozju li jibqgħu l-istess matul perjodu partikolari u fi ħdan ċertu livell ta' attività, anki jekk tinbidel il-kwantità prodotta jew mibjugħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 固定成本；在特定期间和相关经营范围内，总额不因产量或销售量增减而变化的成本。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spejjeż li t-total tagħhom ma jinbidilx skont il-kwantità prodotta jew mibjugħa matul perjodu partikolari u fi ħdan ċertu firxa ta' attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fixed costs are expenses whose total remains the same over a particular period within a relevant range of activity, even when production or sales change.

formal.mt: Il-kera tal-ħanut hija inkluża fl-ispejjeż fissi, għax l-ammont ta' kull xahar jibqa' l-istess irrispettivament min-numru ta' prodotti mibjugħa.
formal.en: The shop's rent is included in its fixed costs because the monthly amount remains the same regardless of the number of products sold.
formal.zh: 店铺租金计入固定成本，因为无论卖出多少件商品，每月租金都保持不变。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan ix-xahar begħna inqas. Se jonqsu l-ispejjeż kollha? Ġorġ: Le, l-ispejjeż fissi, bħall-kera, jibqgħu l-istess.
colloquial.en: Nina: We sold less this month. Will all our costs go down? Ġorġ: No, fixed costs, such as rent, stay the same.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个月我们卖得少了。所有成本都会下降吗？Ġorġ：不会，像租金这样的固定成本还是一样。

messages.speaker: Nina (店铺合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ix-xahar begħna inqas. Se jonqsu l-ispejjeż kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ix-xahar begħna inqas. Se jonqsu l-ispejjeż kollha?
messages.zh: 这个月我们卖得少了。所有成本都会下降吗？
messages.en: We sold less this month. Will all our costs go down?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (店铺合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-ispejjeż fissi, bħall-kera, jibqgħu l-istess.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-ispejjeż fissi, bħall-kera, jibqgħu l-istess.
messages.zh: 不会，像租金这样的固定成本还是一样。
messages.en: No, fixed costs, such as rent, stay the same.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象店里本月少卖十件商品，租金账单上的数字仍不动；用这张“不动的账单”记住 spejjeż fissi，但固定只针对一定期间和经营范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The costs of keeping goods or materials in storage, including charges for storage space and related services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为存放货物或材料而产生的费用，包括仓储空间及相关服务的费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spejjeż marbuta maż-żamma ta' merkanzija jew materjali f'post għall-ħżin, inklużi l-ħlas għall-ispazju u s-servizzi relatati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仓储成本；因将货物或材料存放在仓库等场所而产生的空间占用及相关保管服务费用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spejjeż li jirriżultaw miż-żamma ta' merkanzija jew materjali f'maħżen jew f'post ieħor adattat, bħall-ħlas għall-ispazju u għall-kura tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Storage costs are the expenses involved in keeping goods or materials in a warehouse or another suitable place.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tordna kwantità akbar ta' merkanzija, il-kumpanija għandha tikkalkula l-ispejjeż tal-ħżin għall-perjodu kollu.
formal.en: Before ordering a larger quantity of goods, the company should calculate the storage costs for the entire period.
formal.zh: 在订购更多货物之前，公司应计算整个存放期间的仓储费用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Inħallu l-kaxxi fil-maħżen għal xahar ieħor? David: Ejja niċċekkjaw l-ispejjeż tal-ħżin l-ewwel, għax jista' jkun aħjar li niġbruhom din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we leave the boxes in the warehouse for another month? David: Let's check the storage costs first, because it might be better to collect them this week.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们把这些箱子再放在仓库里一个月吗？David：先查一下仓储费用吧，也许这周就取回来更合适。

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Inħallu l-kaxxi fil-maħżen għal xahar ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Inħallu l-kaxxi fil-maħżen għal xahar ieħor?
messages.zh: 我们把这些箱子再放在仓库里一个月吗？
messages.en: Shall we leave the boxes in the warehouse for another month?

messages.speaker: David (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw l-ispejjeż tal-ħżin l-ewwel, għax jista' jkun aħjar li niġbruhom din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw l-ispejjeż tal-ħżin l-ewwel, għax jista' jkun aħjar li niġbruhom din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 先查一下仓储费用吧，也许这周就取回来更合适。
messages.en: Let's check the storage costs first, because it might be better to collect them this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象箱子住进仓库也要付“住宿费”：把 spejjeż tal-ħżin 和货物占用空间、接受保管的画面连起来，就能记住“仓储费用”。

gloss_zh: 白色短罩衣（套在长袍外的礼仪服）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loose white vestment worn over a cassock during Christian religious services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教礼拜中套在长袍外穿着的一种宽松白色礼仪罩衣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Libsa bajda u wiesgħa li tintlibes fuq is-suttana waqt ċerimonji reliġjużi Nsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白色短罩衣，基督教礼仪中套在长袍外穿的宽松罩衣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilbies abjad u wiesa' li jintlibes fuq is-suttana waqt servizzi reliġjużi Nsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A surplice is a loose white garment worn over a cassock during Christian religious services.

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, il-qassis libes spellizza bajda fuq is-suttana sewda.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the priest wore a white surplice over his black cassock.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，神父在黑色长袍外穿了一件白色短罩衣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik il-libsa bajda fuq is-suttana x'jgħidulha? Pawlu: Dik spellizza. Il-qassis jilbisha waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you call that white garment over the cassock? Pawlu: That's a surplice. The priest wears it during the ceremony.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：长袍外面那件白衣服叫什么？保罗：那叫白色短罩衣。神父举行仪式时会穿。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik il-libsa bajda fuq is-suttana x'jgħidulha?
messages.mt_standard: Dik il-libsa bajda fuq is-suttana x'jgħidulha?
messages.zh: 长袍外面那件白衣服叫什么？
messages.en: What do you call that white garment over the cassock?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik spellizza. Il-qassis jilbisha waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
messages.mt_standard: Dik spellizza. Il-qassis jilbisha waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
messages.zh: 那叫白色短罩衣。神父举行仪式时会穿。
messages.en: That's a surplice. The priest wears it during the ceremony.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spellizza 和“黑长袍外罩一层白衣”的画面绑定，记住它是特定的礼仪罩衣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An impressive sight, or an organized performance presented to an audience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人印象深刻的景象，或为观众安排的演出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dehra li tqanqal l-ammirazzjoni jew il-meravilja, jew wirja organizzata biex tiddeverti lill-udjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奇观；引人注目、令人惊叹的景象或场面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dehra jew xena impressjonanti li tiġbed l-attenzjoni u tqanqal il-meravilja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spectacle is an impressive or unusual sight that attracts people's attention.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 演出；面向观众安排的文娱表演。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wirja organizzata quddiem udjenza, li tista' tinkludi reċtar, kant, żfin jew divertiment ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A show is an organized performance presented to an audience for entertainment.

formal.mt: Il-festival fetaħ bi spettaklu taż-żfin fil-pjazza ewlenija, filwaqt li nżul ix-xemx offra spettaklu naturali mill-isbaħ.
formal.en: The festival opened with a dance show in the main square, while the sunset provided a magnificent natural spectacle.
formal.zh: 节庆以主广场上的舞蹈演出开幕，而落日则呈现出壮丽的自然奇观。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tiġi tara l-ispettaklu taż-żfin illejla? Mark: Iva! X'ħin jibda? Lara: Fit-tmienja, fil-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to come and see the dance show tonight? Mark: Yes! What time does it start? Lara: At eight, in the square.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今晚你想一起来看舞蹈演出吗？马克：想！几点开始？拉拉：八点，在广场上。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi tara l-ispettaklu taż-żfin illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi tara l-ispettaklu taż-żfin illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚你想一起来看舞蹈演出吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come and see the dance show tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! X'ħin jibda?
messages.mt_standard: Iva! X'ħin jibda?
messages.zh: 想！几点开始？
messages.en: Yes! What time does it start?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-tmienja, fil-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-tmienja, fil-pjazza.
messages.zh: 八点，在广场上。
messages.en: At eight, in the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个观看场景记 spettaklu：看落日是“奇观”，看舞台是“演出”；依据上下文选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who watches an event or performance without taking part in it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 观看赛事、演出或其他活动而不直接参与的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tara avveniment, logħba jew wirja mingħajr ma tieħu sehem fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 观众，观看比赛、演出或其他活动而不参与其中的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun qed tara logħba, wirja jew avveniment ieħor mingħajr ma tkun parteċipant.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spectator is someone who watches an event or performance without participating in it.

formal.mt: Kull spettatur għandu jżomm il-biljett tiegħu sakemm tintemm il-logħba.
formal.en: Every spectator must keep their ticket until the match ends.
formal.zh: 每位观众都必须保留门票，直到比赛结束。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Illum se tilgħab mat-tim? Pawlu: Le, illum se nkun spettatur biss. Nina: Mela ejja oqgħod ħdejja!
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you playing with the team today? Pawlu: No, today I'll just be a spectator. Nina: Then come and sit next to me!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你今天要跟球队一起上场吗？保罗：不了，今天我只当观众。妮娜：那就过来坐我旁边吧！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum se tilgħab mat-tim?
messages.mt_standard: Illum se tilgħab mat-tim?
messages.zh: 你今天要跟球队一起上场吗？
messages.en: Are you playing with the team today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum se nkun spettatur biss.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum se nkun spettatur biss.
messages.zh: 不了，今天我只当观众。
messages.en: No, today I'll just be a spectator.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja oqgħod ħdejja!
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja oqgħod ħdejja!
messages.zh: 那就过来坐我旁边吧！
messages.en: Then come and sit next to me!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spettatur 放在看台座位上记忆：他看比赛但不上场，因此是“观众”；可与表示演出的 spettaklu 配对记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A range of colours, frequencies, or other related things arranged across a scale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按一定尺度排列的颜色或频率所形成的谱，也可指相关事物构成的广泛范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Firxa ta' kuluri, frekwenzi jew elementi oħra relatati, mifruxa fuq skala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谱，包括光谱、频谱；也可指观点等相关事物构成的连续范围。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Firxa ordnata ta' kuluri jew frekwenzi, jew, f'sens usa', firxa ta' opinjonijiet jew affarijiet relatati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spectrum is a range of colours, frequencies, or related things extending across a scale.

formal.mt: Fl-esperiment, il-priżma qasmet id-dawl abjad fil-kuluri differenti tal-ispettru viżibbli.
formal.en: In the experiment, the prism separated white light into the different colours of the visible spectrum.
formal.zh: 实验中，棱镜将白光分解为可见光谱中的不同颜色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed naraw daqshekk kuluri wara l-priżma? Lara: Il-priżma tifred id-dawl abjad fil-kuluri tiegħu. Dik il-firxa ta' kuluri tissejjaħ spettru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we seeing so many colours after the prism? Lara: The prism separates white light into its colours. That range of colours is called a spectrum.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么光穿过棱镜后，我们会看到这么多颜色？拉拉：棱镜把白光分解成它所包含的各种颜色。这一系列颜色就叫光谱。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed naraw daqshekk kuluri wara l-priżma?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed naraw daqshekk kuluri wara l-priżma?
messages.zh: 为什么光穿过棱镜后，我们会看到这么多颜色？
messages.en: Why are we seeing so many colours after the prism?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-priżma tifred id-dawl abjad fil-kuluri tiegħu. Dik il-firxa ta' kuluri tissejjaħ spettru.
messages.mt_standard: Il-priżma tifred id-dawl abjad fil-kuluri tiegħu. Dik il-firxa ta' kuluri tissejjaħ spettru.
messages.zh: 棱镜把白光分解成它所包含的各种颜色。这一系列颜色就叫光谱。
messages.en: The prism separates white light into its colours. That range of colours is called a spectrum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象棱镜后展开的一条彩色光带来记 spettru：先记“光谱”，再用同一条连续刻度联想频率或观点的范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official whose work is to examine places, activities, or records and check whether requirements are being met.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责检查场所、活动或记录，确认是否符合规定的人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal li xogħlu hu li jeżamina postijiet, attivitajiet jew dokumenti biex jiċċekkja jekk humiex qed jitħarsu r-regoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 检查员；负责检查并监督规定落实情况的人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha r-responsabbiltà li teżamina xogħol, postijiet jew dokumenti u tiċċekkja jekk humiex skont ir-regoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inspector is an official who examines something to make sure that the relevant rules and standards are being followed.

formal.mt: L-ispettur tas-saħħa eżamina l-kċina u ħejja rapport dwar l-iġjene.
formal.en: The health inspector examined the kitchen and prepared a report on hygiene.
formal.zh: 卫生检查员检查了厨房，并编写了卫生情况报告。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min ġie jiċċekkja l-kċina? Rita: Ġie l-ispettur tas-saħħa. Mark: Kollox kien sew? Rita: Iva, qal li l-kċina kienet nadifa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who came to check the kitchen? Rita: The health inspector came. Mark: Was everything all right? Rita: Yes, he said the kitchen was clean.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁来检查厨房了？丽塔：卫生检查员来了。马克：一切都没问题吗？丽塔：是的，他说厨房很干净。

messages.speaker: Mark (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ġie jiċċekkja l-kċina?
messages.mt_standard: Min ġie jiċċekkja l-kċina?
messages.zh: 谁来检查厨房了？
messages.en: Who came to check the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Rita (餐厅经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġie l-ispettur tas-saħħa.
messages.mt_standard: Ġie l-ispettur tas-saħħa.
messages.zh: 卫生检查员来了。
messages.en: The health inspector came.

messages.speaker: Mark (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Kollox kien sew?
messages.mt_standard: Kollox kien sew?
messages.zh: 一切都没问题吗？
messages.en: Was everything all right?

messages.speaker: Rita (餐厅经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qal li l-kċina kienet nadifa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qal li l-kċina kienet nadifa.
messages.zh: 是的，他说厨房很干净。
messages.en: Yes, he said the kitchen was clean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spettur 和拿着检查表巡视厨房的人联系起来：这个词指负责检查的人员。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A careful examination of a place, object, or activity to assess its condition or check whether requirements are being met.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为评估状况或确认是否符合要求，对场所、物品或活动进行的仔细检查或查勘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżami bir-reqqa ta' post, oġġett jew attività biex tiġi evalwata l-kundizzjoni tiegħu jew jiġi ċċekkjat jekk humiex qed jitħarsu r-rekwiżiti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 检查；为确认状况或是否符合规定而进行的仔细检验。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżami bir-reqqa li jsir biex tiġi ċċekkjata l-kundizzjoni ta' xi ħaġa jew jekk din tissodisfax ir-regoli u r-rekwiżiti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inspection is a careful examination carried out to check the condition of something or whether it meets the required standards.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 查勘；对建筑物或场地等进行实地查看，以评估其状况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżami ta' bini, art jew sit biex tinġabar informazzjoni dwar il-kundizzjoni tiegħu u jiġu identifikati problemi jew ħtiġijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A survey is an examination of a building or site that provides information about its condition and any problems requiring attention.

formal.mt: Qabel ix-xiri, saret spezzjoni tal-bini biex jiġu identifikati problemi fl-istruttura.
formal.en: Before the purchase, a building survey was carried out to identify structural problems.
formal.zh: 购买前对建筑物进行了查勘，以查明结构方面的问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għadna ma nistgħux nidħlu? Pawlu: Għax għadha għaddejja l-ispezzjoni tas-sigurtà. Lara: Meta tispiċċa? Pawlu: Qalu li tispiċċa f'nofs siegħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't we go in yet? Pawlu: Because the safety inspection is still going on. Lara: When will it finish? Pawlu: They said it would finish in half an hour.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么我们还不能进去？保罗：因为安全检查还在进行。拉拉：什么时候结束？保罗：他们说半小时后结束。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadna ma nistgħux nidħlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadna ma nistgħux nidħlu?
messages.zh: 为什么我们还不能进去？
messages.en: Why can't we go in yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għadha għaddejja l-ispezzjoni tas-sigurtà.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għadha għaddejja l-ispezzjoni tas-sigurtà.
messages.zh: 因为安全检查还在进行。
messages.en: Because the safety inspection is still going on.

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tispiċċa?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tispiċċa?
messages.zh: 什么时候结束？
messages.en: When will it finish?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalu li tispiċċa f'nofs siegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Qalu li tispiċċa f'nofs siegħa.
messages.zh: 他们说半小时后结束。
messages.en: They said it would finish in half an hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张建筑检查表记 spezzjoni：逐项查看的过程叫检查，实地评估建筑状况时可译为查勘。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A biological group of similar organisms whose members can normally reproduce with one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生物分类中的物种，指成员通常能够相互繁殖的一类相似生物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' organiżmi simili li l-membri tiegħu normalment jistgħu jirriproduċu bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物种；生物分类中由通常能够相互繁殖的相似生物构成的类别。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kategorija bijoloġika ta' organiżmi b'karatteristiċi simili li normalment jistgħu jirriproduċu bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A species is a group of similar living organisms whose members can normally reproduce with one another.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi speċi ta' pjanti li jeħtieġu protezzjoni minħabba t-telf tal-ambjent naturali tagħhom.
formal.en: The report describes plant species that need protection because of the loss of their natural habitat.
formal.zh: 报告描述了因自然栖息地丧失而需要保护的植物物种。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn iż-żewġ għasafar huma tal-istess speċi? Toni: Ma nafx. Ejja nfittxu fil-ktieb tal-għasafar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are these two birds the same species? Toni: I don't know. Let's look in the bird book.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这两只鸟属于同一个物种吗？托尼：我不知道。我们查查鸟类图鉴吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żewġ għasafar huma tal-istess speċi?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żewġ għasafar huma tal-istess speċi?
messages.zh: 这两只鸟属于同一个物种吗？
messages.en: Are these two birds the same species?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. Ejja nfittxu fil-ktieb tal-għasafar.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. Ejja nfittxu fil-ktieb tal-għasafar.
messages.zh: 我不知道。我们查查鸟类图鉴吧。
messages.en: I don't know. Let's look in the bird book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鸟类图鉴把外形相似的鸟分成不同物种；用“同一物种 tal-istess speċi”整组记忆。

gloss_zh: 明确指定的；具体说明的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clearly stated or identified, especially in instructions or requirements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在说明、要求或文件中已经明确指出或具体列明的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie indikat jew deskritt b'mod ċar, speċjalment f'istruzzjonijiet jew rekwiżiti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已明确指定或具体说明的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie msemmi, indikat jew deskritt b'mod preċiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is specified has been clearly stated or identified so that people know exactly what is required.

collocations.zh: 明确列出的金额或数量

formal.mt: Il-ħlas għandu jsir qabel it-terminu speċifikat fil-kuntratt.
formal.en: Payment must be made before the deadline specified in the contract.
formal.zh: 必须在合同规定的截止期限之前付款。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema ħin irridu nkunu hemm? Mark: Fit-tmienja; dak hu l-ħin speċifikat fl-email.
colloquial.en: Maja: What time do we need to be there? Mark: At eight; that's the time specified in the email.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们几点必须到那里？马克：八点，邮件里指定的就是这个时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: F'liema ħin irridu nkunu hemm?
messages.mt_standard: F'liema ħin irridu nkunu hemm?
messages.zh: 我们几点必须到那里？
messages.en: What time do we need to be there?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-tmienja; dak hu l-ħin speċifikat fl-email.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-tmienja; dak hu l-ħin speċifikat fl-email.
messages.zh: 八点，邮件里指定的就是这个时间。
messages.en: At eight; that's the time specified in the email.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 speċifikat 和邮件中圈出的具体时间一起记：时间已经写明，所以是“明确指定的”。

gloss_zh: 规格；技术要求；招标规格要求

teaching_sense.en_definition: Detailed requirements describing the features, standards, or work expected of a product, service, or tender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 详细列明产品、服务或工程应具备的特征、标准及工作要求的规格说明，也可指招标中的具体要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rekwiżiti dettaljati li jiddeskrivu l-karatteristiċi, l-istandards jew ix-xogħol meħtieġ għal prodott, servizz jew sejħa għall-offerti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 详细规定产品、服务或工程的特征、性能、尺寸或标准的规格要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rekwiżiti dettaljati dwar il-karatteristiċi, il-prestazzjoni, id-daqs jew l-istandards ta' prodott, servizz jew xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Specifications are detailed descriptions of the features and standards that a product, service, or piece of work must meet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招标文件中列明的、投标所涉货物、服务或工程必须满足的具体规格与要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rekwiżiti dettaljati fid-dokumenti ta' sejħa għall-offerti li jistabbilixxu x'għandhom jissodisfaw il-prodotti, is-servizzi jew ix-xogħlijiet offruti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tender specifications set out the detailed requirements for the goods, services, or work covered by an invitation to submit bids.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于招投标的详细规格与要求，供投标者据以准备符合要求的方案。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rekwiżiti dettaljati użati fi proċess ta' sejħa għall-offerti biex dawk li jitfgħu offerta jkunu jafu x'għandhom jipproponu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tendering specifications describe the detailed requirements that bidders use when preparing proposals for a contract.

formal.mt: Il-prodotti offruti għandhom jissodisfaw l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet kollha elenkati fid-dokumenti tas-sejħa għall-offerti.
formal.en: The products offered must meet all the specifications listed in the tender documents.
formal.zh: 所提供的产品必须符合招标文件中列明的全部规格要求。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-kompjuter tajjeb għax-xogħol tiegħek? Pawlu: Irrid niċċekkja l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet; għandi bżonn ħafna memorja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this computer suitable for your work? Pawlu: I need to check the specifications; I need a lot of memory.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这台电脑适合你的工作吗？保罗：我得看看规格，我需要很大的内存。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kompjuter tajjeb għax-xogħol tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kompjuter tajjeb għax-xogħol tiegħek?
messages.zh: 这台电脑适合你的工作吗？
messages.en: Is this computer suitable for your work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid niċċekkja l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet; għandi bżonn ħafna memorja.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid niċċekkja l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet; għandi bżonn ħafna memorja.
messages.zh: 我得看看规格，我需要很大的内存。
messages.en: I need to check the specifications; I need a lot of memory.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 speċifikazzjonijiet 想成电脑参数清单：内存、尺寸、性能逐项列出；放进招标文件就是投标须满足的规格要求。

gloss_zh: 特别条件；特殊规格要求

teaching_sense.en_definition: Conditions or detailed requirements set specifically for a particular contract, project, or purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对某一合同、项目或特定用途另行规定的特别条件或具体规格要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjonijiet jew rekwiżiti dettaljati stabbiliti apposta għal kuntratt, proġett jew għan partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对某一具体合同或项目特别订明的适用条件或条款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjonijiet jew klawżoli stabbiliti apposta biex japplikaw għal kuntratt jew proġett partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Special conditions are terms established for a particular contract or project to address its specific circumstances.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为特定项目、产品或用途专门制定的详细规格与要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rekwiżiti dettaljati mfassla apposta għal proġett, prodott jew użu partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Special specifications are detailed requirements drawn up to meet the particular needs of a project, product, or intended use.

collocations.en: the special conditions or specifications of the contract
collocations.zh: 合同的特别条件或特殊规格要求

collocations.en: in accordance with the special specifications

formal.mt: L-ispeċifikazzjonijiet speċjali tal-proġett jeħtieġu materjali li jifilħu temperaturi għoljin.
formal.en: The project's special specifications require materials that can withstand high temperatures.
formal.zh: 该项目的特殊规格要求使用耐高温材料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu nużaw iż-żebgħa tas-soltu? Ġanni: Ejja niċċekkjaw l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet speċjali; għal din il-kamra jista' jkun hemm rekwiżiti oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we use the usual paint? Ġanni: Let's check the special specifications; there may be other requirements for this room.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我们能用平常那种油漆吗？詹尼：看看特殊规格要求吧，这个房间可能还有其他要求。

messages.speaker: Lara (装修工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nużaw iż-żebgħa tas-soltu?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nużaw iż-żebgħa tas-soltu?
messages.zh: 我们能用平常那种油漆吗？
messages.en: Can we use the usual paint?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (工长)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet speċjali; għal din il-kamra jista' jkun hemm rekwiżiti oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet speċjali; għal din il-kamra jista' jkun hemm rekwiżiti oħra.
messages.zh: 看看特殊规格要求吧，这个房间可能还有其他要求。
messages.en: Let's check the special specifications; there may be other requirements for this room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语记成贴着“本项目专用”标签的要求清单：合同语境可指特别条件，材料和性能语境可指特殊规格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Different from what is usual, or intended for a particular person, purpose, or occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不同于一般情况的，或专为某个人、用途或场合而安排的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun differenti mis-soltu, jew maħsub apposta għal persuna, għan jew okkażjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因不同寻常、具有特别意义，或用于特定对象与用途而显得特别的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun differenti minn dak tas-soltu, ikollu tifsira partikolari, jew ikun maħsub għal persuna jew għan partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is special is different from ordinary things, has particular importance, or is intended for a specific person or purpose.

formal.mt: Biex jidħlu fil-laboratorju barra l-ħinijiet normali, il-viżitaturi jeħtieġu permess speċjali.
formal.en: Visitors need special permission to enter the laboratory outside normal hours.
formal.zh: 访客在正常开放时间以外进入实验室，需要获得特别许可。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex xtrajt kejk? Adam: Illum għeluq snin ommi; irrid nagħmel xi ħaġa speċjali għaliha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you buy a cake? Adam: It's my mother's birthday today; I want to do something special for her.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么买了蛋糕？亚当：今天是我妈妈的生日，我想为她做点特别的事。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex xtrajt kejk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex xtrajt kejk?
messages.zh: 你为什么买了蛋糕？
messages.en: Why did you buy a cake?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum għeluq snin ommi; irrid nagħmel xi ħaġa speċjali għaliha.
messages.mt_standard: Illum għeluq snin ommi; irrid nagħmel xi ħaġa speċjali għaliha.
messages.zh: 今天是我妈妈的生日，我想为她做点特别的事。
messages.en: It's my mother's birthday today; I want to do something special for her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用生日蛋糕联想 speċjali：今天有特别意义，所以要做点特别的事；再用“特别许可”记住它也能表示专门安排。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person with detailed knowledge or advanced skills in a particular field, including a doctor trained in a specific branch of medicine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个领域拥有深入知识或高级技能的人；也指专门诊治某类疾病的专科医生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna b'għarfien fil-fond jew b'ħiliet avvanzati f'qasam partikolari, inkluż tabib imħarreġ f'fergħa speċifika tal-mediċina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某一领域具有专门知识或技能的专家；医学语境中指专科医生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha għarfien jew ħila speċjali f'qasam partikolari; fil-mediċina, tabib li jispeċjalizza f'fergħa partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A specialist is someone who has particular knowledge or skills in one area, especially a doctor trained in a specific branch of medicine.

collocations.zh: 咨询专家；向专科医生求诊

formal.mt: It-tabib irrakkomanda li l-pazjent jikkonsulta speċjalista fil-kardjoloġija għal aktar eżamijiet.
formal.en: The doctor recommended that the patient consult a specialist in cardiology for further examinations.
formal.zh: 医生建议患者向心脏病学专科医生求诊，接受进一步检查。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għada għandi appuntament għand speċjalista. Pawlu: Għand min se tmur? Marta: Għand speċjalista tal-għajnejn.
colloquial.en: Marta: I have an appointment with a specialist tomorrow. Pawlu: Who are you going to see? Marta: An eye specialist.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我明天约了专科医生。保罗：你要去看哪一位？玛尔塔：一位眼科专科医生。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada għandi appuntament għand speċjalista.
messages.mt_standard: Għada għandi appuntament għand speċjalista.
messages.zh: 我明天约了专科医生。
messages.en: I have an appointment with a specialist tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għand min se tmur?
messages.mt_standard: Għand min se tmur?
messages.zh: 你要去看哪一位？
messages.en: Who are you going to see?

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għand speċjalista tal-għajnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għand speċjalista tal-għajnejn.
messages.zh: 一位眼科专科医生。
messages.en: An eye specialist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 speċjalista 和“某领域的专家本人”绑定记忆：想象门牌上写着他的专长，再用 speċjalista fil-kardjoloġija 记住“心脏病学专家”。

gloss_zh: 专长领域；特色菜；特产（复数）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fields in which someone has particular expertise, or distinctive foods and products associated with a person or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人具有专门知识或技能的领域，或某个人、地方具有代表性的特色食品和产品；此词形为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oqsma li fihom persuna għandha għarfien jew ħiliet speċjali, jew ikel u prodotti li għalihom persuna jew post huma magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专门擅长的领域；某个人或地方著名的特色食品或特产。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qasam li fih persuna għandha għarfien jew ħila speċjali, jew ikel jew prodott li għalih persuna jew post huma magħrufa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A specialty is a subject or activity that someone knows particularly well, or a distinctive food or product for which a person or place is known.

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi diversi speċjalitajiet lokali, fosthom platti tradizzjonali magħmula b'ingredjenti tal-istaġun.
formal.en: The menu includes several local specialties, including traditional dishes made with seasonal ingredients.
formal.zh: 菜单包含多种当地特色菜，其中有使用时令食材制作的传统菜肴。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhuma l-ispeċjalitajiet tagħkom? Mark: Għandna stuffat tal-fenek u soppa tal-armla. Lara: Nieħu s-soppa, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are your specialties? Mark: We have rabbit stew and widow's soup. Lara: I'll have the soup, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们有什么特色菜？马克：我们有炖兔肉和寡妇汤。拉拉：请给我来一份汤。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhuma l-ispeċjalitajiet tagħkom?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhuma l-ispeċjalitajiet tagħkom?
messages.zh: 你们有什么特色菜？
messages.en: What are your specialties?

messages.speaker: Mark (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna stuffat tal-fenek u soppa tal-armla.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna stuffat tal-fenek u soppa tal-armla.
messages.zh: 我们有炖兔肉和寡妇汤。
messages.en: We have rabbit stew and widow's soup.

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nieħu s-soppa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nieħu s-soppa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我来一份汤。
messages.en: I'll have the soup, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 speċjalitajiet 想成菜单上列出的“一道道特色菜”，记住这里表示多个特色项目；换到医院语境，speċjalitajiet mediċi 就是多个医学专科。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To concentrate one's study or work on a particular subject or activity and develop expertise in it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把学习或工作的重点放在某个特定学科或活动上，并在其中发展专门知识或技能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiffoka l-istudju jew ix-xogħol tiegħu fuq suġġett jew attività partikolari u jiżviluppa għarfien jew ħiliet speċjali fihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专攻某个领域，或专门从事某类工作，以形成专长。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddedika l-istudju jew ix-xogħol tiegħu għal qasam partikolari sabiex jikseb għarfien fil-fond jew ħila speċjali fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone specialises in a subject or activity, they concentrate on it and develop particular knowledge or skills in that area.

formal.mt: Wara li temm l-istudji tiegħu fil-mediċina, it-tabib speċjalizza fil-kirurġija.
formal.en: After completing his medical studies, the doctor specialised in surgery.
formal.zh: 完成医学学业后，这位医生专攻了外科。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħuk fiex speċjalizza? David: Speċjalizza fit-traduzzjoni legali. Nina: Mela jista' jgħinni nifhem dan il-kuntratt.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did your brother specialise in? David: He specialised in legal translation. Nina: Then he can help me understand this contract.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你哥哥专攻什么？戴维：他专攻法律翻译。妮娜：那他可以帮我看懂这份合同。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk fiex speċjalizza?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk fiex speċjalizza?
messages.zh: 你哥哥专攻什么？
messages.en: What did your brother specialise in?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Speċjalizza fit-traduzzjoni legali.
messages.mt_standard: Speċjalizza fit-traduzzjoni legali.
messages.zh: 他专攻法律翻译。
messages.en: He specialised in legal translation.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela jista' jgħinni nifhem dan il-kuntratt.
messages.mt_standard: Mela jista' jgħinni nifhem dan il-kuntratt.
messages.zh: 那他可以帮我看懂这份合同。
messages.en: Then he can help me understand this contract.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 speċjalizza 记成“把精力集中到一个专业”的动作。用整句 Speċjalizza fil-kirurġija 反复练习，联想“他专攻了外科”，抓住动词的动作感。

gloss_zh: 专业的；专门化的；专用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a narrow professional focus, requiring particular expertise, or designed for a specific purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专注于某个专业领域的，需要专门知识或技能的，或为某种特定用途设计的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiffoka fuq qasam partikolari, jeħtieġ għarfien jew ħiliet speċjali, jew huwa maħsub għal skop speċifiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专门针对某个领域或用途的；具有或需要专门知识、技能的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa marbut ma' qasam jew skop speċifiku, jew li għandu jew jeħtieġ għarfien u ħiliet speċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is specialised is intended for a particular purpose or field and often involves knowledge or skills that most people do not have.

formal.mt: L-użu ta' dan it-tagħmir speċjalizzat jeħtieġ taħriġ speċifiku u għarfien tal-proċeduri tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: Using this specialised equipment requires specific training and knowledge of safety procedures.
formal.zh: 使用这种专用设备需要接受针对性培训，并了解安全操作程序。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nsewwi dan b'għodda ordinarja? Toni: Le, għal din it-tiswija għandek bżonn tagħmir speċjalizzat. Sara: Mela nieħdu għand tekniku.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I fix this with ordinary tools? Toni: No, you need specialised equipment for this repair. Sara: Then I'll take it to a technician.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我能用普通工具修好这个吗？托尼：不能，这项维修需要专用设备。萨拉：那我把它拿去给技术人员修。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nsewwi dan b'għodda ordinarja?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nsewwi dan b'għodda ordinarja?
messages.zh: 我能用普通工具修好这个吗？
messages.en: Can I fix this with ordinary tools?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għal din it-tiswija għandek bżonn tagħmir speċjalizzat.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għal din it-tiswija għandek bżonn tagħmir speċjalizzat.
messages.zh: 不能，这项维修需要专用设备。
messages.en: No, you need specialised equipment for this repair.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nieħdu għand tekniku.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nieħdu għand tekniku.
messages.zh: 那我把它拿去给技术人员修。
messages.en: Then I'll take it to a technician.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 speċjalizzat 贴在一台只能完成特定任务的设备上，记住它描述“专业、专用”的性质；连读 tagħmir speċjalizzat，把“专用设备”作为整体记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Particularly, with greater emphasis on one person, thing, or situation than on others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尤其，特别；用于从一般情况中突出某个人、事物或情形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod partikulari, biex tenfasizza persuna, ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni aktar minn oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尤其；特别；表示所提到的人、事物或情况比其他对象更值得强调。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod partikulari jew aktar minn oħrajn, meta trid tagħti enfasi lil persuna, ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use especially to emphasize one person, thing, or situation more than others.

formal.mt: Il-qari ta' kuljum huwa ta' benefiċċju għall-istudenti kollha, speċjalment għal dawk li qed jitgħallmu lingwa ġdida.
formal.en: Daily reading benefits all students, especially those who are learning a new language.
formal.zh: 每天阅读对所有学生都有益，尤其是正在学习一门新语言的学生。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tħobb tmur ħdejn il-baħar? Pawlu: Iva, speċjalment filgħaxija meta jkun hemm inqas nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like going to the seaside? Pawlu: Yes, especially in the evening when there are fewer people.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢去海边吗？Pawlu：喜欢，尤其是晚上人比较少的时候。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħobb tmur ħdejn il-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Tħobb tmur ħdejn il-baħar?
messages.zh: 你喜欢去海边吗？
messages.en: Do you like going to the seaside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment filgħaxija meta jkun hemm inqas nies.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment filgħaxija meta jkun hemm inqas nies.
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其是晚上人比较少的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially in the evening when there are fewer people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先说一整组事物，再用聚光灯照出其中一个：speċjalment 就是把这个对象标成“尤其、特别”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rate at which something moves, with direction also specified when the word is used in the sense of velocity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体运动的快慢；用于表示物理学中的速度时，还包括运动方向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kemm oġġett jiċċaqlaq malajr; fis-sens ta' veloċità, titqies ukoll id-direzzjoni tal-moviment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 速率；单位时间内经过的距离，表示运动的快慢。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kejl ta' kemm oġġett jiċċaqlaq malajr, espress bħala d-distanza li jgħaddi minnha f'unità ta' ħin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The speed of something is the rate at which it moves, measured by the distance it travels in a given time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 速度；物体位置随时间变化的快慢及其方向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kejl ta' kemm il-pożizzjoni ta' oġġett tinbidel mal-ħin, flimkien mad-direzzjoni ta' dik il-bidla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The velocity of an object describes how quickly its position changes and the direction in which that change occurs.

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, l-ispid tal-vettura ġie mkejjel f'metri kull sekonda, u d-direzzjoni tal-moviment ġiet irreġistrata separatament.
formal.en: During the experiment, the vehicle's speed was measured in metres per second, and its direction of movement was recorded separately.
formal.zh: 实验中以米每秒测量车辆的速率，并另行记录其运动方向。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tnaqqas l-ispid ftit? Mark: Iva, qed insuq malajr wisq? Sara: Hemm kantuniera ftit 'il quddiem. Mark: Sewwa, innaqqas issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you reduce your speed a little? Mark: Yes, am I driving too fast? Sara: There's a bend just ahead. Mark: All right, I'll slow down now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你能稍微减速吗？马克：可以，我开得太快了吗？萨拉：前面不远有个弯。马克：好，我现在减速。

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tnaqqas l-ispid ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tnaqqas l-ispid ftit?
messages.zh: 你能稍微减速吗？
messages.en: Can you reduce your speed a little?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed insuq malajr wisq?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed insuq malajr wisq?
messages.zh: 可以，我开得太快了吗？
messages.en: Yes, am I driving too fast?

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm kantuniera ftit 'il quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm kantuniera ftit 'il quddiem.
messages.zh: 前面不远有个弯。
messages.en: There's a bend just ahead.

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, innaqqas issa.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, innaqqas issa.
messages.zh: 好，我现在减速。
messages.en: All right, I'll slow down now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看汽车仪表盘记 spid：数字表示运动快慢；学习 velocity 这一义项时，再添一支表示方向的箭头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who secretly gathers information about other people, organizations, or countries for someone else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为他人秘密搜集有关个人、组织或国家情报的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġbor bil-moħbi informazzjoni dwar nies, organizzazzjonijiet jew pajjiżi biex tgħaddiha lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 间谍；受人指派，秘密获取并传递情报的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem bil-moħbi biex tikseb informazzjoni sigrieta u tgħaddiha lil min tkun qed taħdem għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spy is someone who secretly obtains information about people, organizations, or countries and passes it to those they work for.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, spija tiġbor informazzjoni sigrieta u tgħaddiha lill-għadu.
formal.en: In the novel, a spy gathers secret information and passes it to the enemy.
formal.zh: 小说中，一名间谍搜集秘密情报，并将其交给敌方。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak ir-raġel fil-film? Luqa: Hu spija li qed jipprova jsib dokument sigriet. Nina: U l-oħrajn jafu min hu? Luqa: Le, jaħsbu li hu turist.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is that man in the film? Luqa: He's a spy trying to find a secret document. Nina: And do the others know who he is? Luqa: No, they think he's a tourist.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：电影里那个男人是谁？卢卡：他是一名间谍，正在设法找到一份秘密文件。妮娜：其他人知道他的身份吗？卢卡：不知道，他们以为他是游客。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel fil-film?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel fil-film?
messages.zh: 电影里那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man in the film?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu spija li qed jipprova jsib dokument sigriet.
messages.mt_standard: Hu spija li qed jipprova jsib dokument sigriet.
messages.zh: 他是一名间谍，正在设法找到一份秘密文件。
messages.en: He's a spy trying to find a secret document.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: U l-oħrajn jafu min hu?
messages.mt_standard: U l-oħrajn jafu min hu?
messages.zh: 其他人知道他的身份吗？
messages.en: And do the others know who he is?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jaħsbu li hu turist.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jaħsbu li hu turist.
messages.zh: 不知道，他们以为他是游客。
messages.en: No, they think he's a tourist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spija 放进谍战电影画面：表面是游客，暗中搜集并传递情报，便能记住“间谍”这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stand out from others or to excel in a particular activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因明显的特点或优异的表现而引人注意，或在某项活动中表现出色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħaraf minn fost l-oħrajn minħabba kwalità ċara jew jagħmel xi ħaġa b'ħila kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显得突出；因与周围的人或事物不同而引人注意。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kien jidher differenti jew aktar ċar minn dak li kien madwaru u għalhekk ġibed l-attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something stood out, they were especially noticeable among the people or things around them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现出色；在某项活动或某个领域中展现很高的水平。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa tajjeb ħafna u juri livell għoli ta' ħila f'attività jew f'qasam partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you excel in an activity, you perform it extremely well and show a high level of ability.

collocations.zh: 在其他人之中显得突出

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-iskola, l-għalliem kiteb li Daniel spikka fil-matematika u wera ħila kbira biex isolvi problemi diffiċli.
formal.en: In the school report, the teacher wrote that Daniel excelled in mathematics and showed great skill in solving difficult problems.
formal.zh: 在学校评语中，老师写道，丹尼尔在数学方面表现出色，并展现了解决难题的高超能力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min spikka fil-wirja tal-bieraħ? Lara: Għalija, spikka t-tifel li kanta waħdu. Kellu vuċi sabiħa ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who stood out in yesterday's show? Lara: For me, the boy who sang on his own stood out. He had a lovely voice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：昨天的演出中谁最突出？拉拉：我觉得是那个独唱的男孩。他的声音特别好听。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min spikka fil-wirja tal-bieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Min spikka fil-wirja tal-bieraħ?
messages.zh: 昨天的演出中谁最突出？
messages.en: Who stood out in yesterday's show?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalija, spikka t-tifel li kanta waħdu. Kellu vuċi sabiħa ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għalija, spikka t-tifel li kanta waħdu. Kellu vuċi sabiħa ħafna.
messages.zh: 我觉得是那个独唱的男孩。他的声音特别好听。
messages.en: For me, the boy who sang on his own stood out. He had a lovely voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象合照中一个人特别显眼，再联想到成绩特别优秀：把“引人注意”和“表现出色”这两个义项一起记住。

gloss_zh: 词义未明（原释义为 idk）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An item labelled as a noun whose meaning is not specified in the supplied packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给资料将此词标为名词，但仅提供“idk”，未给出可确认的具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma mmarkata bħala nom fil-pakkett mogħti, iżda mingħajr tifsira ċara, għax hemm miktub biss 'idk'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 释义未知；所给资料没有说明此名词的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhijiex speċifikata fil-pakkett mogħti, li jagħti biss 'idk' bħala definizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry does not establish a meaning for this item, so a specific noun sense cannot be taught from it.

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jimmarka 'spikkat' bħala nom, iżda jagħti biss 'idk' bħala definizzjoni; għalhekk, it-tifsira tibqa' mhux speċifikata.
formal.en: The packet labels 'spikkat' as a noun but gives only 'idk' as its definition; its meaning therefore remains unspecified.
formal.zh: 资料包将“spikkat”标为名词，但释义只写了“idk”；因此，其具体含义仍未明确。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'spikkat' f'din il-lista? Lara: Ma nafx. Hemm miktub biss 'idk', allura minn din il-lista ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'spikkat' mean in this list? Lara: I don't know. It only says 'idk', so we cannot be sure of the meaning from this list.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份词表里的“spikkat”是什么意思？拉拉：我不知道。这里只写了“idk”，所以凭这份词表还不能确定它的含义。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'spikkat' f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'spikkat' f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这份词表里的“spikkat”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'spikkat' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. Hemm miktub biss 'idk', allura minn din il-lista ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. Hemm miktub biss 'idk', allura minn din il-lista ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti mit-tifsira.
messages.zh: 我不知道。这里只写了“idk”，所以凭这份词表还不能确定它的含义。
messages.en: I don't know. It only says 'idk', so we cannot be sure of the meaning from this list.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这张词卡想成“有词形、缺释义”的待补卡：先记资料标注为名词，不因它与其他词相似就猜测含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Spinach cooked using steam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用蒸汽加热至熟的菠菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spinaċi li jkunu ġew imsajra bis-sħana tal-fwar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒸菠菜；以蒸汽烹熟的菠菜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spinaċi msajra permezz tal-fwar, aktar milli mgħollija direttament fl-ilma jew moqlija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Steamed spinach is spinach that has been cooked using the heat of steam.

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, servi l-ħut bi spinaċi msajra bil-fwar u żid ftit meraq tal-lumi qabel isservi.
formal.en: For lunch, serve the fish with steamed spinach and add a little lemon juice before serving.
formal.zh: 午餐时，将鱼搭配蒸菠菜，并在上桌前加少许柠檬汁。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'hemm mal-ħut illum? Rita: Hemm spinaċi msajra bil-fwar. Trid ftit lumi magħhom?
colloquial.en: Mark: What comes with the fish today? Rita: There is steamed spinach. Would you like some lemon with it?
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天的鱼配什么？丽塔：配蒸菠菜。你要加一点柠檬吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'hemm mal-ħut illum?
messages.mt_standard: X'hemm mal-ħut illum?
messages.zh: 今天的鱼配什么？
messages.en: What comes with the fish today?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm spinaċi msajra bil-fwar. Trid ftit lumi magħhom?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm spinaċi msajra bil-fwar. Trid ftit lumi magħhom?
messages.zh: 配蒸菠菜。你要加一点柠檬吗？
messages.en: There is steamed spinach. Would you like some lemon with it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅厨房画面记整组词：菠菜放在蒸篮里，下面升起蒸汽；把“菠菜”和“用蒸汽烹熟”连成“蒸菠菜”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone ideas, enthusiasm, or a desire to create or act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人产生新的想法、创作灵感或采取行动的热情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem f'xi ħadd ideat ġodda, entużjażmu jew ix-xewqa li joħloq xi ħaġa jew jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 启发；给予某人灵感，或激发其创作、思考和行动的热情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd ideat jew entużjażmu u jqanqlu biex joħloq, jaħseb jew jaġixxi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something inspires you, they give you ideas or enthusiasm that encourage you to create or act.

collocations.zh: 激发了艺术家们的灵感

formal.mt: Il-pajsaġġ tal-gżira spira lill-artisti biex joħolqu sensiela ta' pitturi dwar il-baħar u l-ħajja qrib ix-xatt.
formal.en: The island's landscape inspired the artists to create a series of paintings about the sea and life near the shore.
formal.zh: 岛上的风景激发了艺术家们的灵感，使他们创作了一系列描绘海洋与海滨生活的画作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min spira lilek biex tibda tpinġi? Lara: In-nannu tiegħi. Kont narah ipinġi u ridt nipprova wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who inspired you to start painting? Lara: My grandfather. I used to watch him paint and wanted to try it too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是谁启发你开始画画的？拉拉：我爷爷。我以前常看他画画，也想试一试。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min spira lilek biex tibda tpinġi?
messages.mt_standard: Min spira lilek biex tibda tpinġi?
messages.zh: 是谁启发你开始画画的？
messages.en: Who inspired you to start painting?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu tiegħi. Kont narah ipinġi u ridt nipprova wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu tiegħi. Kont narah ipinġi u ridt nipprova wkoll.
messages.zh: 我爷爷。我以前常看他画画，也想试一试。
messages.en: My grandfather. I used to watch him paint and wanted to try it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看到一幅画后，脑中忽然亮起灵感灯，马上想拿起画笔；用“受到启发后想创作”的画面记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stove used to heat or cook food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于加热或烹煮食物的炉具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex isaħħan jew isajjar l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炉子；用于加热或烹煮食物的炉具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spiritiera hija apparat li fuqu jitqiegħed reċipjent biex jissaħħan jew jissajjar l-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stove is a device on which you heat or cook food.

formal.mt: Qabel tuża l-ispiritiera biex issaħħan l-ikel, aqra sew l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: Before using the stove to heat food, read the instructions carefully.
formal.zh: 使用炉子加热食物前，请仔细阅读说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' nsaħħan is-soppa? Pawlu: Uża l-ispiritiera; qiegħda fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I heat the soup? Pawlu: Use the stove; it's on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以在哪里热汤？保罗：用那个炉子吧，就在桌上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nsaħħan is-soppa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nsaħħan is-soppa?
messages.zh: 我可以在哪里热汤？
messages.en: Where can I heat the soup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-ispiritiera; qiegħda fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-ispiritiera; qiegħda fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 用那个炉子吧，就在桌上。
messages.en: Use the stove; it's on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spiritiera 配上“小锅放在炉子上热汤”的画面，再连读 fuq spiritiera（在炉子上），用具体动作记住这个名词。

gloss_zh: 精神层面的；心灵的；宗教灵性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the inner life, the soul, or religious belief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及人的内心生活、心灵或宗教信仰的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ħajja ta' ġewwa tal-bniedem, mar-ruħ jew mat-twemmin reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精神或心灵层面的；与灵魂、宗教信仰或灵性生活有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa spiritwali għandha x'taqsam mal-ħajja ta' ġewwa, mar-ruħ jew mat-twemmin reliġjuż, aktar milli mal-affarijiet materjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something spiritual relates to people's inner lives, souls, or religious beliefs.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru joffri appoġġ spiritwali lil persuni li jkunu għaddejjin minn żmien diffiċli.
formal.en: The centre offers spiritual support to people going through a difficult time.
formal.zh: 该中心为正在经历困难时期的人提供心灵支持。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tmur għal dawn il-laqgħat? Mark: Jgħinuni fil-ħajja spiritwali tiegħi u jagħtuni ħin biex nirrifletti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you go to these meetings? Mark: They help me in my spiritual life and give me time to reflect.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么参加这些聚会？马克：它们有助于我的心灵生活，也给我时间静心思考。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tmur għal dawn il-laqgħat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tmur għal dawn il-laqgħat?
messages.zh: 你为什么参加这些聚会？
messages.en: Why do you go to these meetings?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħinuni fil-ħajja spiritwali tiegħi u jagħtuni ħin biex nirrifletti.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħinuni fil-ħajja spiritwali tiegħi u jagħtuni ħin biex nirrifletti.
messages.zh: 它们有助于我的心灵生活，也给我时间静心思考。
messages.en: They help me in my spiritual life and give me time to reflect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“照顾心灵生活”的情境记 spiritwali：把 ħajja spiritwali 整组读成“心灵生活”，并提醒自己它是描述性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An amount of money spent or required to obtain something or carry out an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获得某物或开展某项活动而支出或需要支付的金额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont ta' flus li jintefaq jew li jkun meħtieġ biex tinkiseb xi ħaġa jew titwettaq attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开支；支出项目，指为某项需要而花费的钱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spiża hija somma flus li persuna jew organizzazzjoni tonfoq biex tħallas għal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An expense is money that you spend on a particular need or activity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 费用；成本，指购买某物、取得服务或完成某事所需的金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ispiża ta' xi ħaġa hija l-ammont ta' flus meħtieġ biex tinxtara, issir jew tinkiseb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The cost of something is the amount of money needed to buy, obtain, or do it.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika l-ispiża totali tal-proġett u jispjega kull spiża addizzjonali.
formal.en: The report states the total cost of the project and explains each additional expense.
formal.zh: 报告列明了项目总成本，并说明了每一项额外开支。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm se tkun l-ispiża tat-tiswija? Ġużeppi: Ħamsin ewro, u ma jkun hemm ebda spiża addizzjonali.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much will the repair cost? Ġużeppi: Fifty euros, and there won't be any additional expense.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：维修费用是多少？朱塞佩：五十欧元，而且不会再有额外费用。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm se tkun l-ispiża tat-tiswija?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm se tkun l-ispiża tat-tiswija?
messages.zh: 维修费用是多少？
messages.en: How much will the repair cost?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħamsin ewro, u ma jkun hemm ebda spiża addizzjonali.
messages.mt_standard: Ħamsin ewro, u ma jkun hemm ebda spiża addizzjonali.
messages.zh: 五十欧元，而且不会再有额外费用。
messages.en: Fifty euros, and there won't be any additional expense.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账单上的一笔金额：已经花出去时联想“开支”，事先询价时联想“费用或成本”，两种情境都用 spiża 来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something clear by giving information or reasons; Spjegali asks someone to explain it to the speaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过提供信息或理由使事情变得清楚；Spjegali 用于请求或要求对方向自己解释。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li tagħmel xi ħaġa ċara billi tagħti tagħrif jew raġunijiet; il-forma Spjegali titlob lil xi ħadd jagħti din l-ispjegazzjoni lill-kelliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解释；说明，通过提供信息、理由或步骤帮助别人理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel idea, sitwazzjoni jew proċess ċar għal xi ħadd billi tagħti tagħrif, raġunijiet jew dettalji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you explain something, you make it clear by giving information, reasons, or details.

collocations.en: explain to me how it works
collocations.zh: 给我解释它是如何运作的

collocations.en: explain it to me step by step

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, spjegali bil-miktub ir-raġuni għal din il-bidla u kif se taffettwa l-proġett.
formal.en: Please explain to me in writing the reason for this change and how it will affect the project.
formal.zh: 请以书面形式向我说明这次变更的原因，以及它将如何影响项目。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Spjegali kif taħdem din il-magna, jekk jogħġbok. David: Żgur. L-ewwel agħfas din il-buttuna, imbagħad agħżel il-programm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Please explain to me how this machine works. David: Sure. First press this button, then choose the programme.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：请给我讲讲这台机器怎么用。戴维：当然。先按这个按钮，然后选择程序。

messages.speaker: Nina (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Spjegali kif taħdem din il-magna, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Spjegali kif taħdem din il-magna, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我讲讲这台机器怎么用。
messages.en: Please explain to me how this machine works.

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. L-ewwel agħfas din il-buttuna, imbagħad agħżel il-programm.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. L-ewwel agħfas din il-buttuna, imbagħad agħżel il-programm.
messages.zh: 当然。先按这个按钮，然后选择程序。
messages.en: Sure. First press this button, then choose the programme.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Spjegali 当作举手求讲解的整句口令：“给我解释一下。”再接 kif（如何），练成 Spjegali kif taħdem，记住解释是说给“我”听的。

gloss_zh: 已解释的；已阐明的；明显可辨的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Explained or clarified so that its meaning or details can be understood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经得到解释或阐明，因而其含义或细节可以被理解的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ngħatat spjegazzjoni tiegħu sabiex it-tifsira jew id-dettalji tiegħu jkunu jistgħu jinftiehmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已得到解释或说明的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ngħatat spjegazzjoni tiegħu biex jinftiehem aħjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is explained has been described so that people can understand it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被阐明，使其变得显而易见的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li sar ċar u evidenti permezz ta' spjegazzjoni jew turija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is made obvious has been presented in a way that makes it clear.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易看出、辨认或察觉的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jista' jintgħaraf jew jiġi nnutat faċilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is easily discernible can be noticed or recognized without much difficulty.

formal.mt: Il-proċess huwa spjegat fid-dettall fir-rapport sabiex il-qarrej jifhem kull pass.
formal.en: The process is explained in detail in the report so that the reader understands every step.
formal.zh: 报告详细说明了这一过程，以便读者理解每一个步骤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kunċett huwa spjegat tajjeb fil-ktieb? Mark: Iva, hemm ukoll eżempju li jgħinek tifhmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this concept explained well in the book? Mark: Yes, there is also an example to help you understand it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：书里把这个概念解释清楚了吗？Mark：解释清楚了，还有一个例子帮助你理解。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kunċett huwa spjegat tajjeb fil-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kunċett huwa spjegat tajjeb fil-ktieb?
messages.zh: 书里把这个概念解释清楚了吗？
messages.en: Is this concept explained well in the book?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ukoll eżempju li jgħinek tifhmu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ukoll eżempju li jgħinek tifhmu.
messages.zh: 解释清楚了，还有一个例子帮助你理解。
messages.en: Yes, there is also an example to help you understand it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spjegat 配上一页讲解清楚的笔记来记：内容已经解释，意思变得明白；再分别联系“已阐明”和“容易辨认”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who secretly gathers information about people, organizations, or countries for someone else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 秘密搜集个人、组织或国家的情报，并将情报提供给他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġbor bil-moħbi informazzjoni dwar nies, organizzazzjonijiet jew pajjiżi biex tgħaddiha lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受人派遣或为他人秘密搜集情报的间谍、密探。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem bil-moħbi biex tikseb informazzjoni sigrieta u tgħaddiha lil min taħdem għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spy is someone who secretly collects information for another person, organization, or country.

collocations.zh: 从事间谍活动；担任间谍

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, spjun barrani jiġbor informazzjoni sigrieta dwar il-port.
formal.en: In the novel, a foreign spy gathers secret information about the port.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，一名外国间谍秘密搜集有关港口的情报。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel fil-film? Mark: Hu spjun, u ħadd hemmhekk ma jaf għal min jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man in the film? Mark: He is a spy, and nobody there knows who he works for.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影里的那个男人是谁？Mark：他是个间谍，那里没人知道他为谁工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel fil-film?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel fil-film?
messages.zh: 电影里的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu spjun, u ħadd hemmhekk ma jaf għal min jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Hu spjun, u ħadd hemmhekk ma jaf għal min jaħdem.
messages.zh: 他是个间谍，那里没人知道他为谁工作。
messages.en: He is a spy, and nobody there knows who he works for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 spjun 和“藏起身份、秘密搜集情报”的电影人物联系起来；记忆重点是秘密获取信息的人，也就是间谍。

gloss_zh: 词义未注明（所给材料标作“?”）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective whose meaning is not specified in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料标注为形容词，但没有提供可确定的具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex speċifikata fil-materjal mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义待明确；所给材料仅以问号标记，没有提供具体释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan l-aġġettiv mhijiex mogħtija; fil-materjal hemm biss marka ta' mistoqsija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied material identifies this word as an adjective but leaves its meaning unspecified.

collocations.zh: “splengun”这个词（讨论词语本身的表达）

formal.mt: Il-materjal mogħti jelenka l-kelma 'splengun' bħala aġġettiv, iżda ma jagħtix it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The supplied material lists the word 'splengun' as an adjective but does not give its meaning.
formal.zh: 所给材料将“splengun”列为形容词，但没有提供其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'splengun' hawn? Mark: Il-materjal ma jgħidx; hemm biss marka ta' mistoqsija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'splengun' mean here? Mark: The material does not say; there is only a question mark.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的“splengun”是什么意思？Mark：材料没有说明，只标了一个问号。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'splengun' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'splengun' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的“splengun”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'splengun' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-materjal ma jgħidx; hemm biss marka ta' mistoqsija.
messages.mt_standard: Il-materjal ma jgħidx; hemm biss marka ta' mistoqsija.
messages.zh: 材料没有说明，只标了一个问号。
messages.en: The material does not say; there is only a question mark.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 splengun 做一张带问号的词卡：先记拼写和形容词标签，释义栏保留待查；这里的两个搭配只用于讨论这个词本身。

gloss_zh: 已爆炸的；怪异异常的；古怪的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having exploded; also used to describe something freakish or weird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经发生爆炸的；也可形容事物怪异异常或古怪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li sploda; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa stramba ħafna jew mhux tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经发生爆炸的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li sploda u nfaqa' b'mod vjolenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is exploded has burst violently as a result of an explosion.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怪异异常的；明显偏离通常样态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher stramb ħafna u differenti b'mod qawwi minn dak li hu normali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something freakish is extremely unusual and may seem strange or unsettling.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古怪的；让人觉得不寻常或难以理解的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li hu stramb jew mhux tas-soltu u jista' jkun diffiċli biex tifhmu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something weird seems strange, unusual, or difficult to understand.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħsara kkawżata mill-apparat splodut.
formal.en: The report describes the damage caused by the device that exploded.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该装置爆炸造成的损坏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-pjan jidher splodut! Mark: Iva, hu stramb ħafna, imma ejja nisimgħu l-ispjegazzjoni kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: This plan seems weird! Mark: Yes, it is very strange, but let's hear the whole explanation.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个计划看起来真古怪！Mark：是啊，很奇怪，不过我们先听完全部解释吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-pjan jidher splodut!
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-pjan jidher splodut!
messages.zh: 这个计划看起来真古怪！
messages.en: This plan seems weird!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu stramb ħafna, imma ejja nisimgħu l-ispjegazzjoni kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu stramb ħafna, imma ejja nisimgħu l-ispjegazzjoni kollha.
messages.zh: 是啊，很奇怪，不过我们先听完全部解释吧。
messages.en: Yes, it is very strange, but let's hear the whole explanation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 splodut 分成两幅学习画面：一幅是爆炸后的装置，另一幅是令人摸不着头脑的古怪计划；按上下文选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able or likely to explode, or involving an explosion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够或容易发生爆炸的，或与爆炸有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jisplodi jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' splużjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有爆炸性质的；能够或容易爆炸的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jista' jisplodi u joħroġ enerġija f'daqqa, jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' splużjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is explosive can explode or is connected with an explosion.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-materjal splussiv għandu jinżamm f'post sigur.
formal.en: The report indicates that the explosive material must be kept in a secure place.
formal.zh: 报告指出，爆炸性材料必须存放在安全的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm miktub fuq it-tabella? Mark: Tgħid li hawn materjal splussiv. Ejja nibqgħu 'l bogħod.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the sign say? Mark: It says there is explosive material here. Let's keep our distance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：牌子上写着什么？马克：上面说这里有爆炸性材料。我们离远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'hemm miktub fuq it-tabella?
messages.mt_standard: X'hemm miktub fuq it-tabella?
messages.zh: 牌子上写着什么？
messages.en: What does the sign say?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħid li hawn materjal splussiv. Ejja nibqgħu 'l bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħid li hawn materjal splussiv. Ejja nibqgħu 'l bogħod.
messages.zh: 上面说这里有爆炸性材料。我们离远一点吧。
messages.en: It says there is explosive material here. Let's keep our distance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 splussiv 和写着“易爆”的警示牌一起记，再用 materjal splussiv 练习“名词后接形容词”的搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sea fish known as sea bass, often caught or farmed for food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为海鲈鱼的海鱼，常被捕捞或养殖供食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-baħar li tinqabad jew titrabba għall-ikel u għandha ġisem tawwali u lewn fidda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海鲈鱼，一种常供食用、身体细长而呈银色的海鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-baħar b'ġisem tawwali u lewn fidda, li tinqabad jew titrabba għall-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sea bass is a sea fish that is commonly caught or farmed for food.

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi spnotta moħmija bil-lumi, servuta ma' ħaxix frisk.
formal.en: The menu includes sea bass baked with lemon, served with fresh vegetables.
formal.zh: 菜单上有柠檬烤海鲈鱼，配以新鲜蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek spnotta friska llum? Pawlu: Iva, għadha kif waslet. Trid waħda kbira jew żgħira?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have fresh sea bass today? Pawlu: Yes, it has just arrived. Would you like a large one or a small one?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天有新鲜海鲈鱼吗？保罗：有，刚到货。你要大一点的还是小一点的？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek spnotta friska llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek spnotta friska llum?
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜海鲈鱼吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh sea bass today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (鱼贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadha kif waslet. Trid waħda kbira jew żgħira?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadha kif waslet. Trid waħda kbira jew żgħira?
messages.zh: 有，刚到货。你要大一点的还是小一点的？
messages.en: Yes, it has just arrived. Would you like a large one or a small one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鱼摊上一条银色海鲈鱼，把 spnotta friska“新鲜海鲈鱼”和 spnotta moħmija“烤海鲈鱼”成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small songbird called a chaffinch, with a short beak suited to eating seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 苍头燕雀，一种会鸣唱的小型鸟，喙短，适于啄食种子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir li jgħanni u għandu munqar qasir adattat biex jiekol iż-żrieragħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苍头燕雀，一种喙短、常吃种子的小型鸣禽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir li jgħanni, għandu munqar qasir u jiekol iż-żrieragħ kif ukoll insetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chaffinch is a small songbird with a short beak that feeds on seeds and insects.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti raw sponsun fuq fergħa u semgħu l-għana tiegħu.
formal.en: During the birdwatching activity, the students saw a chaffinch on a branch and heard its song.
formal.zh: 在观鸟活动中，学生们看到树枝上有一只苍头燕雀，并听到了它的鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! David: Dak sponsun. Isma' kemm qed jgħanni sabiħ!
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that bird on the branch! David: That's a chaffinch. Listen to how beautifully it's singing!
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：看树枝上的那只鸟！戴维：那是苍头燕雀。听，它唱得多好听！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa!
