messages.zh: 看树枝上的那只鸟！
messages.en: Look at that bird on the branch!

messages.speaker: David (观鸟爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak sponsun. Isma' kemm qed jgħanni sabiħ!
messages.mt_standard: Dak sponsun. Isma' kemm qed jgħanni sabiħ!
messages.zh: 那是苍头燕雀。听，它唱得多好听！
messages.en: That's a chaffinch. Listen to how beautifully it's singing!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“树枝上一只小鸟正在唱歌”的画面记 sponsun，并朗读 sponsun jgħanni，把鸟名和鸣唱动作连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a plant to develop buds, produce new shoots, or grow upwards rapidly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物萌发芽苞、长出新芽，或迅速向上生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta pjanta tibda toħroġ il-blanzuni, jidhru rimjiet ġodda minnha jew tikber malajr 'il fuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萌芽；指植物开始长出芽苞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta pjanta tibda toħroġ il-blanzuni li minnhom jiżviluppaw weraq jew fjuri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a plant buds, it begins to develop buds that will become leaves or flowers.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发芽；出苗；指种子或植物开始长出新芽。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta minn żerriegħa jew minn pjanta jibdew joħorġu rimjiet ġodda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a seed or plant sprouts, it begins to produce new shoots.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迅速长高；指植物在短时间内明显向上生长。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta pjanta tikber malajr 'il fuq u ssir ogħla fi żmien qasir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a plant shoots up, it grows noticeably taller in a short time.

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, il-qamħ beda jisponta, u fi ftit jiem dehru rimjiet ħodor fl-għalqa.
formal.en: After the rain, the wheat began to sprout, and within a few days green shoots appeared in the field.
formal.zh: 雨后，小麦开始出苗，几天之内田里便出现了绿色的嫩芽。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, il-fażola bdiet tisponta! Nanna: Iva, diġà qed jidhru l-ewwel weraq. Ejja nsaqquha ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, the beans have started to sprout! Grandma: Yes, the first leaves are already appearing. Let's give them a little water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，豆子开始发芽了！奶奶：是啊，第一批叶子已经冒出来了。我们给它们浇一点水吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, il-fażola bdiet tisponta!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, il-fażola bdiet tisponta!
messages.zh: 看，豆子开始发芽了！
messages.en: Look, the beans have started to sprout!

messages.speaker: Nanna (奶奶)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà qed jidhru l-ewwel weraq. Ejja nsaqquha ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà qed jidhru l-ewwel weraq. Ejja nsaqquha ftit.
messages.zh: 是啊，第一批叶子已经冒出来了。我们给它们浇一点水吧。
messages.en: Yes, the first leaves are already appearing. Let's give them a little water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sponta 的三个义项串成植物生长画面：枝头冒芽苞、土里出嫩苗、茎秆迅速长高；依次对应 bud、sprout、shoot up。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft, porous material or object that absorbs liquid and is used for washing or cleaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能吸收液体、常用于洗涤或清洁的柔软多孔材料或物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal jew oġġett artab u mimli pori li jassorbi l-likwidu u jintuża għall-ħasil jew għat-tindif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海绵；柔软多孔、能吸水并用于洗涤或清洁的材料或物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sponża hija materjal jew oġġett artab b'ħafna pori li jassorbi l-ilma u jintuża għall-ħasil jew għat-tindif.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sponge is a soft, porous object that absorbs liquid and is often used for washing or cleaning.

formal.mt: Għat-tindif tal-wiċċ, uża sponża ratba u ilma fietel.
formal.en: To clean the surface, use a soft sponge and lukewarm water.
formal.zh: 清洁表面时，请使用柔软的海绵和温水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-isponża? Irrid innaddaf il-mejda. Mark: Ħdejn il-vit. Xarrabha ftit qabel tużaha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the sponge? I want to clean the table. Mark: Next to the tap. Wet it a little before using it.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physical activity involving skill or effort, often practised for enjoyment, exercise, or competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要身体活动、技巧或体力，常以娱乐、锻炼或竞赛为目的的体育运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività fiżika li teħtieġ ħila jew sforz u li ssir għad-divertiment, għall-eżerċizzju jew għall-kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体育；体育运动，包括为锻炼、娱乐或竞赛而进行的身体活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isport huwa attività fiżika li tinvolvi ħila jew sforz u li n-nies jagħmlu għad-divertiment, għall-eżerċizzju jew għall-kompetizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sport is physical activity that people take part in for exercise, enjoyment, or competition, usually involving skill and rules.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-iskola jħeġġeġ lill-istudenti jipprattikaw sport regolarment biex itejbu s-saħħa fiżika tagħhom.
formal.en: The school programme encourages students to practise sport regularly to improve their physical health.
formal.zh: 学校的课程计划鼓励学生经常参加体育运动，以改善身体健康。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema sport jogħġbok l-aktar? Mark: L-għawm. Immur il-pixxina darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which sport do you like best? Mark: Swimming. I go to the pool twice a week.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你最喜欢哪项运动？Mark：游泳。我每周去游泳池两次。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema sport jogħġbok l-aktar?
messages.mt_standard: Liema sport jogħġbok l-aktar?
messages.zh: 你最喜欢哪项运动？
messages.en: Which sport do you like best?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għawm. Immur il-pixxina darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: L-għawm. Immur il-pixxina darbtejn fil-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 游泳。我每周去游泳池两次。
messages.en: Swimming. I go to the pool twice a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sport 与游泳、足球和跑步放在同一张记忆卡上，用多个具体项目记住“体育运动”这个总称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with sport, or showing fairness and respect towards others when taking part in sport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与体育运动有关的；也指在比赛中表现公平、尊重对手、有体育精神的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-isport, jew li juri ġustizzja u rispett lejn l-oħrajn waqt il-kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与体育运动、体育活动或体育事务有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-isport jew ma' attivitajiet u avvenimenti tal-isport.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is sportiv is connected with sports or sporting activities.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在比赛中公平行事、尊重对手并表现出体育精神的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri ġustizzja, rispett lejn l-avversarji u mġiba xierqa waqt il-kompetizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is sportiv behaves fairly and treats opponents with respect during competition.

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru sportiv il-ġdid se joffri spazju għat-taħriġ taż-żgħażagħ.
formal.en: The new sports centre will provide space for young people to train.
formal.zh: 新的体育中心将为年轻人提供训练场地。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tlift, imma mort nifraħ lir-rebbieħ. Lara: Għamilt sew. Dak kien ġest sportiv.
colloquial.en: Mark: I lost, but I went to congratulate the winner. Lara: You did the right thing. That was a sportsmanlike gesture.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我输了，但我还是去祝贺了获胜者。Lara：你做得对。那是体现体育精神的举动。

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlift, imma mort nifraħ lir-rebbieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Tlift, imma mort nifraħ lir-rebbieħ.
messages.zh: 我输了，但我还是去祝贺了获胜者。
messages.en: I lost, but I went to congratulate the winner.

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt sew. Dak kien ġest sportiv.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt sew. Dak kien ġest sportiv.
messages.zh: 你做得对。那是体现体育精神的举动。
messages.en: You did the right thing. That was a sportsmanlike gesture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sportiv 配成两幅画面：体育中心表示“体育的”，赛后握手表示“有体育精神的”。这是语境联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To extend outwards beyond a surrounding surface or edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从周围的表面或边缘向外突出、伸出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jestendi 'l barra lil hinn minn wiċċ jew tarf ta' madwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突出；伸出；超出周围表面或边缘。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa tisporġi, tkun testendi 'l barra lil hinn mill-wiċċ jew mit-tarf ta' madwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something protrudes or juts out, it extends beyond the surface or edge of the things around it.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, il-perit innota li pajp kien jisporġi mill-ħajt għal ġol-passaġġ.
formal.en: During the inspection, the architect noted that a pipe protruded from the wall into the passageway.
formal.zh: 检查时，建筑师注意到一根管子从墙面伸出，占入了通道空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Oqgħod attent għal dak il-fergħa; qed tisporġi għal fuq il-mogħdija. Mark: Rajtha. Se ngħaddi min-naħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Watch out for that branch; it is jutting out over the path. Mark: I saw it. I'll go past on the other side.
colloquial.zh: Maja：小心那根树枝，它伸到小路上方了。Mark：我看见了。我从另一边过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod attent għal dak il-fergħa; qed tisporġi għal fuq il-mogħdija.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod attent għal dak il-fergħa; qed tisporġi għal fuq il-mogħdija.
messages.zh: 小心那根树枝，它伸到小路上方了。
messages.en: Watch out for that branch; it is jutting out over the path.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha. Se ngħaddi min-naħa l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha. Se ngħaddi min-naħa l-oħra.
messages.zh: 我看见了。我从另一边过去。
messages.en: I saw it. I'll go past on the other side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根管子越过墙面的轮廓线，把 sporġa 记成表示“向外伸出”的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extending outwards beyond a surrounding surface or edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 超出周围表面或边缘、向外突出的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jestendi 'l barra lil hinn minn wiċċ jew tarf ta' madwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突出的；伸出的；形容物体的一部分超出周围表面或边缘。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa sporġuta tkun testendi 'l barra lil hinn mill-wiċċ jew mit-tarf ta' madwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is protruding extends outwards beyond the surface or edge of the things around it.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda li jitneħħa l-metall sporġut sabiex jitnaqqas ir-riskju ta' korriment.
formal.en: The report recommends removing the protruding metal to reduce the risk of injury.
formal.zh: 报告建议移除突出的金属，以降低受伤风险。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak id-dwiefer sporġut fis-siġġu! Mark: Tpoġġix hemm. Se nġib martell.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that protruding nail in the chair! Mark: Don't sit there. I'll get a hammer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看椅子上那颗突出来的钉子！Mark：别坐那里。我去拿锤子。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)

messages.zh: 看椅子上那颗突出来的钉子！
messages.en: Look at that protruding nail in the chair!

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tpoġġix hemm. Se nġib martell.

messages.en: Don't sit there. I'll get a hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见露出表面的钉头，就用 sporġut 描述“突出的”状态；用画面记住它的形容词作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of a person or thing away from an original position or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或物离开原来位置或地点的移动；在物理语境中指位置的变化，即位移。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bidla fil-pożizzjoni jew fil-post ta' persuna jew oġġett minn fejn kien qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从原有位置或地点发生的移动、移位或迁移；物理学中指位移。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' persuna jew oġġett minn post jew pożizzjoni għal oħra; fil-fiżika, il-bidla bejn il-pożizzjoni inizjali u dik finali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Displacement is a change in the position or location of a person or thing.

formal.mt: L-esperiment kejjel l-ispostament tal-oġġett mill-pożizzjoni inizjali sal-pożizzjoni finali.
formal.en: The experiment measured the object's displacement from its initial position to its final position.
formal.zh: 实验测量了该物体从初始位置到最终位置的位移。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mexxejt il-kaxxa żewġ metri lejn il-bieb. Pawlu: Mela l-ispostament tagħha kien ta' żewġ metri lejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: I moved the box two metres towards the door. Pawlu: So its displacement was two metres towards the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我把箱子朝门口移动了两米。Pawlu：那么它的位移就是朝门口两米。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mexxejt il-kaxxa żewġ metri lejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Mexxejt il-kaxxa żewġ metri lejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 我把箱子朝门口移动了两米。
messages.en: I moved the box two metres towards the door.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela l-ispostament tagħha kien ta' żewġ metri lejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Mela l-ispostament tagħha kien ta' żewġ metri lejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 那么它的位移就是朝门口两米。
messages.en: So its displacement was two metres towards the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上箱子从起点移到终点，再画一支连接两点的箭头；用这个画面记住 spostament 的“位移、移位”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The noun sprall, whose specific meaning requires clarification before a precise translation can be given.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名词 sprall；其具体含义尚未明确，需先确认词义，才能提供准确翻译。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nom sprall, li t-tifsira speċifika tiegħu trid tiġi ċċarata qabel ma tkun tista' tingħata traduzzjoni preċiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: sprall；此处尚未明确其具体所指，无法确定准确的中文对应词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nom mogħti bħala sprall, li t-tifsira speċifika tiegħu għadha mhix ċara hawnhekk u teħtieġ kjarifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The noun sprall requires further clarification here before its specific meaning can be explained accurately.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tingħata traduzzjoni, jeħtieġ li tiġi ċċarata t-tifsira tal-kelma 'sprall'.
formal.en: Before a translation is provided, the meaning of the word 'sprall' needs to be clarified.
formal.zh: 在提供翻译之前，需要先明确“sprall”一词的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'sprall'? Mark: Għadni ma nafx. Għandna bżonn definizzjoni aktar ċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'sprall' mean? Mark: I don't know yet. We need a clearer definition.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“sprall”这个词是什么意思？Mark：我还不知道。我们需要一个更明确的定义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A liquid released as fine droplets, or a container or device used to release liquid in this way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以细小液滴形式喷出的液体或喷剂，也可指用于这样喷洒液体的容器或装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Likwidu li jinħareġ f'qtar fin, jew kontenitur jew apparat li jintuża biex joħroġ il-likwidu b'dan il-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷成细小液滴的液体或喷雾制剂；也可指喷出这种液体的容器或装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Likwidu mxerred f'qtar fin, jew prodott, kontenitur jew apparat li bih il-likwidu jitferrex b'dan il-mod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spray is a liquid released in very small drops, or a device or product that releases liquid in this form.

formal.mt: L-istruzzjonijiet jindikaw li l-isprej għandu jinżamm wieqaf waqt l-użu.
formal.en: The instructions indicate that the spray container should be kept upright during use.
formal.zh: 说明书指出，使用时应保持喷雾容器直立。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn poġġejt l-isprej għat-tindif? Mark: Taħt is-sink, ħdejn l-isponża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you put the cleaning spray? Mark: Under the sink, next to the sponge.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你把清洁喷剂放在哪里了？Mark：在水槽下面，海绵旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġejt l-isprej għat-tindif?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġejt l-isprej għat-tindif?

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that uses a pump to release liquid as a spray.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过泵的作用，把液体喷成细小液滴的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li juża pompa biex joħroġ likwidu fi qtar żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用泵把液体喷成雾状的喷洒器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat b'pompa li jintuża biex jisprejja likwidu fuq wiċċ jew oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spray pump is a device that uses a pumping action to distribute liquid in small droplets.

collocations.zh: 给植物使用的泵式喷雾器

formal.mt: Uża sprej bil-pompa biex ixxarrab il-weraq b'mod uniformi.
formal.en: Use a pump sprayer to moisten the leaves evenly.
formal.zh: 使用泵式喷雾器，把叶片均匀喷湿。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上“按动泵头，喷出水雾”的画面，记住它指泵式喷雾器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product sprayed onto hair to help keep it in a chosen style.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喷在头发上、帮助固定发型的喷雾产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li jiġi sprejjat fuq ix-xagħar biex jgħin iżomm il-forma tal-hairstyle.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于固定发型的喷雾式发胶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott f'forma ta' sprej li jintuża biex iżomm ix-xagħar fil-forma mixtieqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hairspray is a product that you spray onto your hair to help it stay in the style you have arranged.

formal.mt: Wara li tirranġa x-xagħar, applika ftit sprej għax-xagħar biex iżżomm il-forma mixtieqa.
formal.en: After styling your hair, apply a little hairspray to hold the desired shape.
formal.zh: 整理好头发后，喷少量定型发胶喷雾，以保持想要的造型。

colloquial.zh: Lara：你有定型发胶喷雾吗？Nina：有，在这儿。你要喷一点固定头发吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn hu. Trid ftit biex iżżomm xagħrek f'postu?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn hu. Trid ftit biex iżżomm xagħrek f'postu?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前把发型整理好，再喷一下固定；把这个完整短语与“定型发胶喷雾”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To release liquid in small droplets onto something or into the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把液体以细小液滴的形式喷到物体上或空气中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ likwidu fi qtar żgħir fuq xi ħaġa jew fl-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把液体喷成细小液滴，洒在某物上或喷入空气中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ixerred likwidu fi qtar żgħir permezz ta' sprej fuq wiċċ, fuq oġġett jew fl-arja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you spray a liquid, you release it in small droplets onto a surface or into the air.

formal.mt: Sprejja ftit ilma fuq il-weraq sakemm ikunu niedja.
formal.en: Spray a little water onto the leaves until they are moist.
formal.zh: 往叶片上喷少量水，直到叶片湿润。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif innaddaf dan il-ħġieġ? Mark: Sprejja ftit ilma fuqu u imsaħ b'ċarruta nadifa.
colloquial.en: Anna: How do I clean this glass? Mark: Spray a little water onto it and wipe it with a clean cloth.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这块玻璃怎么清洁？Mark：往上面喷一点水，再用干净的布擦。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif innaddaf dan il-ħġieġ?
messages.mt_standard: Kif innaddaf dan il-ħġieġ?
messages.zh: 这块玻璃怎么清洁？
messages.en: How do I clean this glass?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Sprejja ftit ilma fuqu u imsaħ b'ċarruta nadifa.
messages.mt_standard: Sprejja ftit ilma fuqu u imsaħ b'ċarruta nadifa.
messages.zh: 往上面喷一点水，再用干净的布擦。
messages.en: Spray a little water onto it and wipe it with a clean cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到这个动词，就想象手指按下喷头、水滴散开的动作；用“给植物喷水”整句记住喷洒义。

gloss_zh: 已发芽的；钝的；冒失大胆的；直截了当的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an edge or point that is no longer sharp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容刀刃或尖端已经不锋利、变钝的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x-xifer jew il-ponta mhux aktar jaqtgħu jew ippuntati sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经发出嫩芽的；已萌芽的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li diġà ħareġ rimja jew beda jikber wara l-ġerminazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A seed or plant that has sprouted has begun to produce new growth.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刃口或尖端不锋利的；钝的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu xifer li ma jaqtax sew jew ponta li mhix ippuntata sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An object that is blunt has an edge or point that does not cut or pierce easily.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与人交往时过于大胆、主动而不够拘谨的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu ma' ħaddieħor b'kunfidenza żejda u mingħajr biżżejjed riservatezza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is forward behaves with more confidence or familiarity towards others than a situation normally calls for.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表达或说话直截了当、不绕弯子的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jesprimi dak li jaħseb b'mod ċar u mingħajr tidwir fil-kliem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is direct says what they mean clearly and without avoiding the main point.

collocations.zh: 一个与人交往时过于大胆冒失的男人

formal.mt: Is-sikkina kienet spuntata u ma kinitx taqta' l-ħobż sew.
formal.en: The knife was blunt and did not cut the bread well.
formal.zh: 这把刀已经钝了，切面包不利落。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ma nistax naqta' dan il-ħobż? Luqa: Dik is-sikkina spuntata. Ħu din l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why can't I cut this bread? Luqa: That knife is blunt. Take this other one.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这面包怎么切不动？Luqa：那把刀钝了。用这另一把。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax naqta' dan il-ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax naqta' dan il-ħobż?
messages.zh: 这面包怎么切不动？
messages.en: Why can't I cut this bread?

messages.speaker: Luqa (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik is-sikkina spuntata. Ħu din l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Dik is-sikkina spuntata. Ħu din l-oħra.
messages.zh: 那把刀钝了。用这另一把。
messages.en: That knife is blunt. Take this other one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四张场景卡分开记：麦粒发芽、刀刃变钝、交往过于大胆、回答直截了当；遇到词时先看它形容什么。

gloss_zh: 你给了我喝的东西；你给我水喝了

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone something to drink; this form refers to you giving me a drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某人喝的东西；该形式表示“你给了我喝的东西”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti lil xi ħadd xi ħaġa x'jixrob; din il-forma tindika li inti tajtni xi ħaġa x'nixrob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人饮品或水喝；本词形式表示“你给了我喝的东西”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti lil xi ħadd xi ħaġa x'jixrob, hawnhekk b'referenza għal meta inti tajtni nixrob.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you give someone a drink, you provide them with something to drink.

collocations.en: you gave me a glass of water to drink
you gave me a drink when I was thirsty
collocations.zh: 我口渴时你给了我喝的东西

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, sqejtni tazza ilma u stajt inkompli l-vjaġġ.
formal.en: After the long walk, you gave me a glass of water, and I was able to continue the journey.
formal.zh: 长途步行后，你给了我一杯水，我得以继续行程。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Grazzi talli sqejtni. Kont għatxan ħafna! Rita: Ta' xejn! Trid aktar ilma?
colloquial.en: Mark: Thanks for giving me a drink. I was really thirsty! Rita: You're welcome! Would you like more water?
colloquial.zh: 马克：谢谢你给我水喝。我刚才真渴！丽塔：不客气！还要水吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli sqejtni. Kont għatxan ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli sqejtni. Kont għatxan ħafna!
messages.zh: 谢谢你给我水喝。我刚才真渴！
messages.en: Thanks for giving me a drink. I was really thirsty!

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta' xejn! Trid aktar ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Ta' xejn! Trid aktar ilma?
messages.zh: 不客气！还要水吗？
messages.en: You're welcome! Would you like more water?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整词配上“你递水给我”的画面，再用 sqejtni tazza ilma 反复说“你给了我一杯水喝”，记住动作指向我。

gloss_zh: 你们给了我喝的东西（所给条目标作名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled as a noun that expresses that you all gave me something to drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给资料中标作名词的条目，表达“你们给了我喝的东西”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom fil-materjal mogħti, li tesprimi li intom tajtuni xi ħaġa x'nixrob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给了我喝的东西；该形式表达“你们给了我喝的东西”，所给条目标作名词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-entrata, immarkata bħala nom fil-materjal mogħti, tfisser li intom tajtuni xi ħaġa x'nixrob.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry, labelled as a noun, expresses that you all provided me with something to drink.

collocations.en: you all gave me a glass of water to drink
you all gave me something to drink after the walk
collocations.zh: 步行后你们给了我喝的东西

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħi nixtieq nirringrazzjakom talli sqejtuni u tajtuni post fejn nistrieħ.
formal.en: In my letter, I would like to thank you all for giving me something to drink and a place to rest.
formal.zh: 我想在信中感谢你们给我喝的东西，并给我提供休息的地方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Grazzi talli sqejtuni, ħbieb! Kelli bżonn ftit ilma. Pawlu: Ta' xejn, Lara! Trid xi ħaġa x'tiekol ukoll?
colloquial.en: Lara: Thanks for giving me a drink, everyone! I needed some water. Pawlu: You're welcome, Lara! Would you like something to eat as well?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：朋友们，谢谢你们给我水喝！我正需要喝点水。保罗：不客气，拉拉！还想吃点东西吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (来访的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli sqejtuni, ħbieb! Kelli bżonn ftit ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli sqejtuni, ħbieb! Kelli bżonn ftit ilma.
messages.zh: 朋友们，谢谢你们给我水喝！我正需要喝点水。
messages.en: Thanks for giving me a drink, everyone! I needed some water.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (接待她的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta' xejn, Lara! Trid xi ħaġa x'tiekol ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Ta' xejn, Lara! Trid xi ħaġa x'tiekol ukoll?
messages.zh: 不客气，拉拉！还想吃点东西吗？
messages.en: You're welcome, Lara! Would you like something to eat as well?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己对一群递水的朋友说谢谢，把 sqejtuni 整体记成“你们给我喝的了”；词性栏沿用资料标签，记忆时同时保留这个完整情境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning is not specified in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给资料中标为名词、但未提供具体释义的词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex speċifikata fil-materjal mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给释义仅为“//”，无法据此确定该名词的具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-materjal mogħti juri biss is-simboli // minflok definizzjoni, u għalhekk ma jispeċifikax it-tifsira ta' dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied material does not specify what this noun means.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'srekarju' hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda l-materjal mogħti ma jipprovdix definizzjoni tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'srekarju' is labelled as a noun, but the supplied material does not provide its definition.
formal.zh: “srekarju”被标为名词，但所给资料没有提供它的释义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'srekarju'? Mark: Ma nafx. Hawn għandna biss is-simboli //, mingħajr spjegazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'srekarju' mean? Mark: I don't know. Here we only have the symbols //, without an explanation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“srekarju”这个词是什么意思？马克：我不知道。这里只有“//”符号，没有解释。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'srekarju'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'srekarju'?
messages.zh: “srekarju”这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'srekarju' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. Hawn għandna biss is-simboli //, mingħajr spjegazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. Hawn għandna biss is-simboli //, mingħajr spjegazzjoni.
messages.zh: 我不知道。这里只有“//”符号，没有解释。
messages.en: I don't know. Here we only have the symbols //, without an explanation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 srekarju 做一张“名词，释义待补”的学习卡，先用 il-kelma 'srekarju' 练习提及词语；不要把“//”猜成某种具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive something from someone for temporary use, with the intention of returning it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从别人那里取得某物暂时使用，并打算归还；所给词性标签为 x。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieħu xi ħaġa mingħand xi ħadd biex tużaha għal żmien limitat, bil-ħsieb li troddha lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 借入；暂时借用别人的东西，并打算归还。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieħu xi ħaġa li tkun ta' ħaddieħor biex tużaha għal xi żmien u mbagħad troddha lura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you borrow something, you receive it for temporary use and intend to return it.

formal.mt: Il-ktieb li sselift mil-librerija għandi nroddlu lura sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: I must return the book I borrowed from the library by Friday.
formal.zh: 我必须在星期五之前归还从图书馆借来的书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sselift il-ktieb mingħand Lara? Mark: Iva, u se nroddulha lura għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you borrow the book from Lara? Mark: Yes, and I'll return it to her tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你向拉拉借了那本书吗？马克：是的，我明天会还给她。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sselift il-ktieb mingħand Lara?
messages.mt_standard: Sselift il-ktieb mingħand Lara?
messages.zh: 你向拉拉借了那本书吗？
messages.en: Did you borrow the book from Lara?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u se nroddulha lura għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u se nroddulha lura għada.
messages.zh: 是的，我明天会还给她。
messages.en: Yes, and I'll return it to her tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“接过书，再把书归还”的两格画面记住 sselift ktieb：东西暂时借到自己手里，之后还给主人；资料中的 x 仅按原标签保留。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To close something securely with a seal so that its contents are protected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将物品的开口封牢，使里面的东西受到保护。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħlaq xi ħaġa b'siġill sabiex dak li jkun fiha jibqa' protett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 封住或封牢某物的开口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħlaq fetħa, pakkett jew reċipjent b'siġill sabiex ma jibqax miftuħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you seal something, you close it securely so that its contents remain protected.

formal.mt: L-impjegat ssiġila l-envelop li kien fih id-dokumenti qabel bagħtu bil-posta.
formal.en: The employee sealed the envelope containing the documents before sending it by post.
formal.zh: 工作人员将装有文件的信封封好后，才把它寄出。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min ssiġila l-pakkett? Pawlu: Jien. Issa lest biex jintbagħat.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who sealed the parcel? Pawlu: I did. It is ready to be sent now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：谁把包裹封好了？保罗：我封的。现在可以寄出了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ssiġila l-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Min ssiġila l-pakkett?
messages.zh: 谁把包裹封好了？
messages.en: Who sealed the parcel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Issa lest biex jintbagħat.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Issa lest biex jintbagħat.
messages.zh: 我封的。现在可以寄出了。
messages.en: I did. It is ready to be sent now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象寄包裹前把封口牢牢封住，用这个动作记住 ssiġila 的“封好、密封”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To throw objects towards something, especially repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 朝某处投掷物体，尤其指接连投掷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitfa' oġġetti lejn xi ħaġa, speċjalment wieħed wara l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投掷物体，或朝某个目标接连投掷。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitfa' oġġetti lejn post jew mira, kultant b'mod ripetut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone pelts or throws objects, they send them through the air towards a place or target.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel ssotta ġebel żgħir lejn ħajt vojt.
formal.en: In the story, the boy threw small stones towards a blank wall.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩朝一面空白的墙投掷小石子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel it-tifel fir-rakkont? Mark: Ssotta ġebel żgħir lejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the boy do in the story? Mark: He threw small stones towards the wall.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：故事里的男孩做了什么？马克：他朝墙投掷了小石子。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel it-tifel fir-rakkont?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel it-tifel fir-rakkont?
messages.zh: 故事里的男孩做了什么？
messages.en: What did the boy do in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ssotta ġebel żgħir lejn il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Ssotta ġebel żgħir lejn il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 他朝墙投掷了小石子。
messages.en: He threw small stones towards the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ssotta 和“朝目标接连扔出小物件”的画面一起记，重点记住投掷动作及方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A business that buys and sells goods, often between different countries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事商品买卖的商行或贸易公司，常涉及不同国家之间的贸易。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Negozju li jixtri u jbigħ il-merkanzija, ħafna drabi bejn pajjiżi differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以商品买卖为业务、常从事进出口贸易的商行或贸易公司。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stabbiliment kummerċjali li jixtri u jbigħ il-merkanzija u li jista' jittratta ma' negozji f'pajjiżi differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trading house is a company that buys and sells goods, often through trade between different countries.

collocations.mt: jaħdem fi stabbiliment ta' skambji kummerċjali

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija għażlet stabbiliment ta' skambji kummerċjali biex jixtri l-merkanzija mingħand fornituri barranin.
formal.en: The company selected a trading house to buy goods from foreign suppliers.
formal.zh: 该公司选择了一家商行，负责向国外供应商采购商品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn jaħdem ħuk? David: Fi stabbiliment ta' skambji kummerċjali. Jixtru u jbigħu merkanzija minn pajjiżi differenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where does your brother work? David: At a trading house. They buy and sell goods from different countries.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你兄弟在哪里工作？戴维：在一家商行。他们买卖来自不同国家的商品。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn jaħdem ħuk?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn jaħdem ħuk?
messages.zh: 你兄弟在哪里工作？
messages.en: Where does your brother work?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fi stabbiliment ta' skambji kummerċjali. Jixtru u jbigħu merkanzija minn pajjiżi differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Fi stabbiliment ta' skambji kummerċjali. Jixtru u jbigħu merkanzija minn pajjiżi differenti.
messages.zh: 在一家商行。他们买卖来自不同国家的商品。
messages.en: At a trading house. They buy and sell goods from different countries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条短语对应到“替客户采购和销售商品的商行”这一场景，作为机构名称整体记忆。

gloss_zh: 已确立的；已成立的；已规定的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Already set up, fixed, or accepted as the usual arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经成立、确定，或已被接受为惯常安排的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li diġà twaqqaf, ġie ffissat jew ġie aċċettat bħala l-arranġament tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已成立、已确立或已规定的；具体含义取决于所修饰的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li diġà twaqqaf jew ġie determinat, jew li ilu magħruf u aċċettat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is established has already been set up, fixed, or accepted by the people concerned.

collocations.zh: 一家已有经营基础的企业

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għandu jsegwi l-metodu stabbilit għall-evalwazzjoni tal-applikazzjonijiet.
formal.en: The committee should follow the established method for evaluating applications.
formal.zh: 委员会应按照已确立的方法评估申请。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nistgħu naslu ftit tard? Ġużeppi: Aħjar le. Il-laqgħa tibda fil-ħin stabbilit.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can we arrive a little late? Ġużeppi: Better not. The meeting starts at the set time.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们能稍微晚点到吗？朱塞佩：最好别晚。会议会在规定的时间开始。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu naslu ftit tard?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu naslu ftit tard?
messages.zh: 我们能稍微晚点到吗？
messages.en: Can we arrive a little late?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le. Il-laqgħa tibda fil-ħin stabbilit.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le. Il-laqgħa tibda fil-ħin stabbilit.
messages.zh: 最好别晚。会议会在规定的时间开始。
messages.en: Better not. The meeting starts at the set time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“已经定下来”串联 stabbilit：时间已经确定，方法已经确立，企业已经成立并有基础。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An establishment is a business or institution operating at a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在特定地点开展商业活动或提供服务的企业、机构或营业场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn negozju jew istituzzjoni jopera u jwettaq l-attivitajiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开展经营活动或提供服务的企业、机构或营业场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Negozju jew istituzzjoni li jopera f'post partikolari, jew il-post fejn jitwettqu l-attivitajiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An establishment is a business or institution, or the premises where it carries out its activities.

collocations.zh: 工业企业；工业生产场所

formal.mt: L-istabiliment kummerċjali se jagħlaq għal ġimgħa minħabba xogħlijiet ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The commercial establishment will close for a week because of maintenance work.
formal.zh: 该营业场所将因维护工程关闭一周。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-istabiliment jiftaħ il-Ħadd? Mark: Iva, imma filgħodu biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this establishment open on Sundays? Mark: Yes, but only in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这家店星期天营业吗？马克：营业，不过只开上午。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-istabiliment jiftaħ il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-istabiliment jiftaħ il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 这家店星期天营业吗？
messages.en: Does this establishment open on Sundays?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma filgħodu biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma filgħodu biss.
messages.zh: 营业，不过只开上午。
messages.en: Yes, but only in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和有招牌、入口及营业时间的店面联系起来，记住它指经营或服务的机构场所。

gloss_zh: 转子角稳定性；功角稳定性

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rotor angle stability is the ability of synchronous machines in a power system to remain in synchronism after a disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电力系统中的同步电机在受到扰动后，依靠转子之间的相对角度保持稳定而继续同步运行的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kapaċità tal-magni sinkroniċi f'sistema tal-enerġija elettrika li jibqgħu jaħdmu b'mod sinkronizzat wara disturb, mingħajr ma d-differenzi bejn l-angoli tar-rotors tagħhom jiżdiedu bla kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转子角稳定性，也称功角稳定性，指电力系统中的同步电机在扰动后维持同步运行、使相对转子角不发生失稳发散的能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kapaċità tal-magni sinkroniċi f'sistema elettrika li jżommu s-sinkroniżmu wara disturb, sabiex id-differenzi bejn l-angoli tar-rotors tagħhom ma jkomplux jiżdiedu bla kontroll.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rotor angle stability is the ability of synchronous machines in an electrical power system to maintain synchronism following a disturbance.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta analiżi tal-istabilità tal-angolu tar-rotor wara disturb fis-sistema elettrika.
formal.en: The report presents an analysis of rotor angle stability following a disturbance in the electrical system.
formal.zh: 该报告分析了电力系统受到扰动后的转子角稳定性。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed niċċekkjaw l-istabilità tal-angolu tar-rotor? Pawlu: Biex naraw jekk il-ġeneraturi jibqgħux sinkronizzati wara disturb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are we checking rotor angle stability? Pawlu: To see whether the generators remain synchronized after a disturbance.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们为什么要检查转子角稳定性？保罗：为了看发电机受到扰动后能否继续保持同步。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed niċċekkjaw l-istabilità tal-angolu tar-rotor?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed niċċekkjaw l-istabilità tal-angolu tar-rotor?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要检查转子角稳定性？
messages.en: Why are we checking rotor angle stability?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex naraw jekk il-ġeneraturi jibqgħux sinkronizzati wara disturb.
messages.mt_standard: Biex naraw jekk il-ġeneraturi jibqgħux sinkronizzati wara disturb.
messages.zh: 为了看发电机受到扰动后能否继续保持同步。
messages.en: To see whether the generators remain synchronized after a disturbance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几台发电机的转子像舞者一样同步转动：受到扰动后，相对角度仍能稳住，就是转子角稳定性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To establish something is to create it or put it on a firm basis; to settle something is to decide or agree it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建立组织、制度或安排，使其正式形成；也可指把尚未决定的事项议定或确定下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħloq jew iwaqqaf xi ħaġa, bħal organizzazzjoni jew sistema, jew jiddeċiedi u jiffissa kwistjoni jew arranġament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建立、创立组织或制度，或使某项安排正式确立。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Joħloq jew iwaqqaf organizzazzjoni, sistema jew arranġament u jagħtih bażi soda biex jibda jopera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone establishes an organization or system, they create it and put it into operation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过决定或达成一致，把尚未确定的事项、条件或安排定下来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeċiedi jew jilħaq qbil dwar kwistjoni, kundizzjoni jew arranġament sabiex ma jibqax pendenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone settles a matter or arrangement, they decide it or reach agreement so that it is no longer unresolved.

formal.mt: Id-direttur stabilixxa sistema ġdida għat-taħriġ tal-impjegati.
formal.en: The director established a new system for employee training.
formal.zh: 主管建立了一套新的员工培训制度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark stabilixxa d-dettalji finali tal-vjaġġ? Nina: Iva, tkellem ma' kulħadd u issa kollox deċiż.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has Mark settled the final details of the trip? Nina: Yes, he spoke to everyone, and everything is decided now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克把旅行的最终细节定下来了吗？妮娜：定下来了，他和大家都谈过了，现在一切都决定好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark stabilixxa d-dettalji finali tal-vjaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Mark stabilixxa d-dettalji finali tal-vjaġġ?
messages.zh: 马克把旅行的最终细节定下来了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark settled the final details of the trip?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tkellem ma' kulħadd u issa kollox deċiż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkellem ma' kulħadd u issa kollox deċiż.
messages.zh: 定下来了，他和大家都谈过了，现在一切都决定好了。
messages.en: Yes, he spoke to everyone, and everything is decided now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把事情定下来”串联两个义项：公司制度被建立起来，待议细节被确定下来；再结合宾语区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stadium is a place for sporting events with space for spectators; a stage is a particular part of a process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指供体育比赛并容纳观众的体育场，也可指某个过程或发展中的一个阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn isiru avvenimenti sportivi u fejn hemm spazju għall-ispettaturi, jew fażi partikolari fi proċess jew żvilupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体育场，设有比赛场地及观众观看区域的体育设施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post kbir għal-logħob jew għal avvenimenti sportivi, b'żona għall-kompetizzjoni u spazju għall-ispettaturi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stadium is a large place where sporting events take place and spectators can watch them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阶段，某项过程、工作或发展中可以区分出来的一个时期或步骤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fażi jew parti distinta minn proċess, xogħol jew żvilupp li jkollha postha fis-sekwenza kollha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stage in a process is a particular part or period of its development.

collocations.en: in the first stage of the project

collocations.zh: 后期阶段；进展较深入的阶段

formal.mt: Fl-ewwel stadju tal-proġett, it-tim se jiġbor l-informazzjoni meħtieġa.
formal.en: In the first stage of the project, the team will collect the necessary information.
formal.zh: 在项目的第一阶段，团队将收集所需的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Niltaqgħu ħdejn l-istadju qabel il-logħba? Toni: Iva, nistenniek ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we meet near the stadium before the match? Toni: Yes, I'll wait for you by the main entrance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：比赛前我们在体育场附近碰面好吗？托尼：好，我在主入口旁边等你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Niltaqgħu ħdejn l-istadju qabel il-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Niltaqgħu ħdejn l-istadju qabel il-logħba?
messages.zh: 比赛前我们在体育场附近碰面好吗？
messages.en: Shall we meet near the stadium before the match?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistenniek ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistenniek ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali.
messages.zh: 好，我在主入口旁边等你。
messages.en: Yes, I'll wait for you by the main entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记两幅画面：看比赛时想到“体育场”，看项目进度时想到“阶段”；用上下文选择对应意思。

gloss_zh: 大型车辆的登车踏板；上车踏阶

teaching_sense.en_definition: A step used to climb into a large vehicle, especially a coach.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人踏上并进入大型车辆的踏板或踏阶，尤指长途客车的登车踏阶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tarġa li wieħed juża biex jitla' f'vettura kbira, speċjalment f'kowċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: step (primarily the step leading into a large vehicle, such as a coach)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 踏板；踏阶，主要指供人登上长途客车等大型车辆的踏阶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tarġa fid-daħla ta' vettura kbira, bħal kowċ, li fuqha wieħed iqiegħed siequ biex jitla' ġewwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A staffa is a step that you put your foot on when getting into a large vehicle, such as a coach.

collocations.en: to place his foot on the boarding step

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri għandhom joqogħdu attenti meta jqiegħdu sieqhom fuq l-istaffa tal-kowċ, speċjalment meta tkun imxarrba.
formal.en: Passengers should take care when placing their feet on the coach's boarding step, especially when it is wet.
formal.zh: 乘客踏上长途客车的登车踏阶时应当小心，尤其是在踏阶湿滑的时候。

colloquial.mt: Anna: L-istaffa għolja wisq għalija. Pawlu: Aqbad il-manku u nitla' ngħinek.
colloquial.en: Anna: The boarding step is too high for me. Pawlu: Hold the handle and I'll come up to help you.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这级登车踏阶对我来说太高了。Pawlu：抓住扶手，我上来帮你。

messages.speaker: Anna (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: L-istaffa għolja wisq għalija.
messages.mt_standard: L-istaffa għolja wisq għalija.
messages.zh: 这级登车踏阶对我来说太高了。
messages.en: The boarding step is too high for me.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqbad il-manku u nitla' ngħinek.
messages.mt_standard: Aqbad il-manku u nitla' ngħinek.
messages.zh: 抓住扶手，我上来帮你。
messages.en: Hold the handle and I'll come up to help you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 staffa 和登上大客车前脚踩的那一级踏板连在一起记：先踩踏阶，再进车门。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow, develop, or do well, especially under favourable conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在适宜条件下良好成长、发展或取得成功；兴旺起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikber, jiżviluppa jew imur tajjeb, speċjalment meta l-kundizzjonijiet ikunu favorevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兴旺；茁壮成长；发展良好。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jikber u jiżviluppa tajjeb jew ikollu suċċess f'kundizzjonijiet li jgħinuh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something thrives, it grows or develops successfully because the conditions around it are favourable.

formal.mt: Wara t-titjib fis-servizz, in-negozju stagħan u ġibed aktar klijenti.
formal.en: After improvements to the service, the business thrived and attracted more customers.
formal.zh: 服务改善之后，这家企业蓬勃发展，吸引了更多顾客。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar il-ħanut ta' ħuk din is-sena? Toni: Stagħan! Issa għandu tant xogħol li qed ifittex min jgħinu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did your brother's shop do this year? Toni: It thrived! He now has so much work that he's looking for someone to help him.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你哥哥的店今年经营得怎么样？Toni：生意兴旺！他现在忙得很，正在找人帮忙。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar il-ħanut ta' ħuk din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar il-ħanut ta' ħuk din is-sena?
messages.zh: 你哥哥的店今年经营得怎么样？
messages.en: How did your brother's shop do this year?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stagħan! Issa għandu tant xogħol li qed ifittex min jgħinu.
messages.mt_standard: Stagħan! Issa għandu tant xogħol li qed ifittex min jgħinu.
messages.zh: 生意兴旺！他现在忙得很，正在找人帮忙。
messages.en: It thrived! He now has so much work that he's looking for someone to help him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 stagħan 配一幅小店顾客越来越多的画面，记住它表示发展良好、生意兴旺。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To judge an amount, difficulty, importance, or ability to be lower than it really is.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把数量、难度、重要性或能力估计得低于实际水平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jistma ammont, diffikultà, importanza jew ħila bħala inqas milli jkunu tassew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低估；对某事物的数量、程度、价值或某人的能力作出偏低的估计。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel stima aktar baxxa mir-realtà dwar il-kwantità, il-grad, il-valur jew il-ħila ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone underestimates something, they judge its size, difficulty, importance, or value to be less than it actually is.

formal.mt: It-tim stama anqas il-ħin meħtieġ biex jitlesta l-proġett, u għalhekk kellu jestendi l-iskadenza.
formal.en: The team underestimated the time needed to complete the project and therefore had to extend the deadline.
formal.zh: 团队低估了完成项目所需的时间，因此不得不延后截止日期。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għadkom ma spiċċajtux? Ġużeppi: Mark stama anqas ix-xogħol li kien hemm. Għandna bżonn ġurnata oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why haven't you finished yet? Ġużeppi: Mark underestimated how much work there was. We need another day.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你们怎么还没做完？Ġużeppi：Mark 低估了工作量。我们还需要一天。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadkom ma spiċċajtux?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadkom ma spiċċajtux?
messages.zh: 你们怎么还没做完？
messages.en: Why haven't you finished yet?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark stama anqas ix-xogħol li kien hemm. Għandna bżonn ġurnata oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Mark stama anqas ix-xogħol li kien hemm. Għandna bżonn ġurnata oħra.
messages.zh: Mark 低估了工作量。我们还需要一天。
messages.en: Mark underestimated how much work there was. We need another day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 stama anqas 放进“以为一天能做完，实际需要两天”的情境，记住估得偏少就是低估。

gloss_zh: 人群或兽群受惊后的失控奔逃

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden, uncontrolled rush by a crowd of people or a herd of animals, often caused by fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人群或兽群通常因恐惧而突然集体失控奔跑的情形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġirja f'daqqa u bla kontroll ta' folla nies jew ta' merħla annimali, ħafna drabi minħabba l-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人群或兽群受惊后突然发生的集体失控奔逃。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġirja f'daqqa li fiha ħafna nies jew annimali jiġru flimkien bla kontroll, spiss għax ikunu mbeżżgħin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stampede is a sudden rush in which many people or animals run together without control, usually because they are frightened.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif ħoss qawwi kkawża stampede ta' annimali fl-għalqa.
formal.en: The report describes how a loud noise caused a stampede of animals in the field.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一声巨响如何引发田地里兽群的受惊奔逃。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex bdew jiġru l-annimali kollha? Pawlu: Beżgħu mill-ħoss, u kien hemm stampede lejn il-bieb tal-għalqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did all the animals start running? Pawlu: They were frightened by the noise, and there was a stampede towards the field gate.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么所有动物都跑起来了？保罗：它们被声音吓到了，便失控地朝田地的大门奔去。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex bdew jiġru l-annimali kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex bdew jiġru l-annimali kollha?
messages.zh: 为什么所有动物都跑起来了？
messages.en: Why did all the animals start running?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Beżgħu mill-ħoss, u kien hemm stampede lejn il-bieb tal-għalqa.
messages.mt_standard: Beżgħu mill-ħoss, u kien hemm stampede lejn il-bieb tal-għalqa.
messages.zh: 它们被声音吓到了，便失控地朝田地的大门奔去。
messages.en: They were frightened by the noise, and there was a stampede towards the field gate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一幅画面：巨响之后，整群动物突然失控奔跑；stampede强调群体奔逃，不只是跑得快。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A level of quality or achievement used to judge something or set what is required.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于评价事物或规定要求的质量、表现或成就水准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Livell ta' kwalità jew ta' prestazzjoni li jintuża biex tiġi ġġudikata xi ħaġa jew biex jiġi stabbilit dak li hu meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衡量质量或表现的标准，也可指实际达到的水准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Livell li jservi bħala kejl tal-kwalità jew tal-prestazzjoni, jew il-livell li fil-fatt jintlaħaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A standard is a level of quality or achievement that something is judged against or expected to reach.

formal.mt: Kull prodott għandu jilħaq l-istandard ta' kwalità stabbilit mill-kumpanija.
formal.en: Every product must meet the quality standard set by the company.
formal.zh: 每件产品都必须达到公司制定的质量标准。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibt l-ikel f'dak ir-restorant? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna! L-istandard għadu għoli.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you find the food at that restaurant? Mark: Very good! The standard is still high.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得那家餐馆的饭菜怎么样？马克：非常好！水准还是很高。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sibt l-ikel f'dak ir-restorant?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sibt l-ikel f'dak ir-restorant?
messages.zh: 你觉得那家餐馆的饭菜怎么样？
messages.en: How did you find the food at that restaurant?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! L-istandard għadu għoli.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! L-istandard għadu għoli.
messages.zh: 非常好！水准还是很高。
messages.en: Very good! The standard is still high.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把standard想成一把衡量质量的尺：要求达到的是标准，实际表现出来的是水准。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The level of material comfort people have, including their housing, goods, and access to services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或群体享有的物质生活水平，包括住房、日常用品以及获得服务的条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-livell ta' kumdità materjali li jgawdu n-nies, inklużi l-akkomodazzjoni, l-oġġetti li jkollhom u l-aċċess għas-servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 个人或群体实际达到的物质生活水平。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-livell ta' kundizzjonijiet materjali li persuna jew grupp jgħix fihom, bħall-akkomodazzjoni, l-ikel u s-servizzi disponibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People's level of living is the degree of material comfort they experience in their everyday lives.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以物质条件、消费能力和服务获取情况体现的生活水平。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-livell ta' kumdità materjali ta' persuna jew ta' grupp, kif jidher mill-kundizzjonijiet tal-għajxien u minn dak li jistgħu jaffordjaw.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person's living standard is the level of material comfort supported by their resources and living conditions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 个人、家庭或社会享有的物质生活水平，包括住房、商品和服务等条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-livell ta' benesseri materjali li jgawdu persuna, familja jew soċjetà, inklużi l-akkomodazzjoni, l-oġġetti u s-servizzi li jistgħu jiksbu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your standard of living is the level of material comfort you enjoy, including the housing, goods, and services available to you.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina kif iż-żieda fl-ispejjeż tad-djar taffettwa l-istandard tal-għajxien tal-familji.
formal.en: The report examines how rising housing costs affect families' standard of living.
formal.zh: 报告研究了住房成本上涨如何影响家庭的生活水平。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Bis-salarju l-ġdid, tjieb l-istandard tal-għajxien tagħkom? Pawlu: Iva, issa nistgħu nħallsu l-kera u l-kontijiet aktar faċilment, u nfaddlu ftit ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has your standard of living improved with the new salary? Pawlu: Yes, now we can pay the rent and bills more easily and save a little too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：拿到新工资后，你们的生活水平改善了吗？保罗：是的，现在交房租和付账单都更轻松了，还能存下一点钱。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bis-salarju l-ġdid, tjieb l-istandard tal-għajxien tagħkom?
messages.mt_standard: Bis-salarju l-ġdid, tjieb l-istandard tal-għajxien tagħkom?
messages.zh: 拿到新工资后，你们的生活水平改善了吗？
messages.en: Has your standard of living improved with the new salary?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nistgħu nħallsu l-kera u l-kontijiet aktar faċilment, u nfaddlu ftit ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nistgħu nħallsu l-kera u l-kontijiet aktar faċilment, u nfaddlu ftit ukoll.
messages.zh: 是的，现在交房租和付账单都更轻松了，还能存下一点钱。
messages.en: Yes, now we can pay the rent and bills more easily and save a little too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和住房、食物、账单三幅画面绑定：衡量这些物质生活条件的高低，就是生活水平。

gloss_zh: 标准化的；按统一标准制定的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made or arranged according to a shared standard so that it is consistent and comparable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依照共同标准制定或安排的，使形式、程序或要求保持一致并可供比较。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmul jew organizzat skont standard komuni sabiex ikun konsistenti u jkun jista' jitqabbel ma' oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依照统一标准制定或处理的；标准化的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie magħmul jew adattat skont standard komuni biex jinżammu l-istess regoli jew rekwiżiti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is standardised has been made or organised according to an agreed standard so that it follows consistent requirements.

formal.mt: L-istudenti kollha għamlu test standardizzat bl-istess istruzzjonijiet u bl-istess limitu ta' ħin.
formal.en: All the students took a standardised test with the same instructions and the same time limit.
formal.zh: 所有学生都参加了标准化测试，使用相同的说明和相同的时间限制。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex irridu nużaw l-istess mudell għar-rapport? Mark: Għax il-format hu standardizzat, u hekk ikun aktar faċli nqabblu r-riżultati.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do we have to use the same template for the report? Mark: Because the format is standardised, which makes it easier to compare the results.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么我们写报告要用同一个模板？马克：因为格式已经标准化了，这样更容易比较结果。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex irridu nużaw l-istess mudell għar-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex irridu nużaw l-istess mudell għar-rapport?
messages.zh: 为什么我们写报告要用同一个模板？
messages.en: Why do we have to use the same template for the report?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-format hu standardizzat, u hekk ikun aktar faċli nqabblu r-riżultati.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-format hu standardizzat, u hekk ikun aktar faċli nqabblu r-riżultati.
messages.zh: 因为格式已经标准化了，这样更容易比较结果。
messages.en: Because the format is standardised, which makes it easier to compare the results.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一套试卷配同一份说明和同一时限来记standardizzat：统一要求之后，就具有标准化的特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rigid bar, including one that slides into place to secure a door or gate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坚硬的长杆，也可指滑入固定位置、用来锁住门或大门的门闩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Virga riġida li tista' tintuża wkoll biex iżżomm bieb jew xatba magħluqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 门闩；滑入扣座以锁住门或大门的杆状装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Virga li tiżżerżaq f'postha biex iżżomm bieb jew xatba magħluqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bolt is a bar that slides into a fitting to keep a door or gate closed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杆；条状的坚硬长构件，常用于支撑、阻挡或连接。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa twila u riġida, ħafna drabi tal-metall, li tintuża bħala appoġġ, ostaklu jew parti minn struttura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bar is a long, rigid piece of material used for support or as part of a structure.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jitlaq mill-maħżen, il-ħaddiem għandu jagħlaq il-bieb u jdaħħal l-istanga f'postha.
formal.en: Before leaving the storeroom, the worker must close the door and slide the bolt into place.
formal.zh: 离开储藏室前，工作人员必须关门并插好门闩。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għalaqt il-bieb ta' wara? Pawlu: Iva, u daħħalt l-istanga wkoll.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you close the back door? Pawlu: Yes, and I slid the bolt into place too.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你关后门了吗？保罗：关了，也把门闩插好了。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalaqt il-bieb ta' wara?
messages.mt_standard: Għalaqt il-bieb ta' wara?
messages.zh: 你关后门了吗？
messages.en: Did you close the back door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u daħħalt l-istanga wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u daħħalt l-istanga wkoll.
messages.zh: 关了，也把门闩插好了。
messages.en: Yes, and I slid the bolt into place too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一根铁杆横插在门后的画面记住：单看形状是杆，滑入门扣锁门时就是门闩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pot used for preparing or serving coffee.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于制作或盛放、倒出咖啡的壶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex jitħejja jew jitferra l-kafè.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咖啡壶；用于制作或盛放咖啡并将其倒入杯中的容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent għall-preparazzjoni jew għas-servizz tal-kafè, li minnu jitferra l-kafè fit-tazzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coffee pot is a container used to prepare coffee or pour it into cups.

collocations.en: pour the coffee from the coffee pot

formal.mt: Wara li jservi l-kafè, il-persunal għandu jaħsel l-istanjata u jħalliha tinxef.
formal.en: After serving the coffee, staff should wash the coffee pot and leave it to dry.
formal.zh: 倒完咖啡后，工作人员应清洗咖啡壶，并将其晾干。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hi l-istanjata? Mark: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tazzi. Anna: Tajjeb, se nferra ftit kafè.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the coffee pot? Mark: On the table, beside the cups. Anna: Good, I'll pour some coffee.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：咖啡壶在哪儿？马克：在桌上，杯子旁边。安娜：好，我倒点咖啡。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-istanjata?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-istanjata?
messages.zh: 咖啡壶在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the coffee pot?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tazzi.
messages.zh: 在桌上，杯子旁边。
messages.en: On the table, beside the cups.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se nferra ftit kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se nferra ftit kafè.
messages.zh: 好，我倒点咖啡。
messages.en: Good, I'll pour some coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词贴在脑海中桌上的咖啡壶上，连记“找壶、倒咖啡、洗壶”三个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A metal alloy used to make objects, or a fusible metal material used to join metal parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指制作器物的白镴合金，也可指熔化后用于连接金属部件的焊料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Liga tal-metall li tintuża biex isiru oġġetti, jew materjal tal-metall li jiddewweb biex jgħaqqad biċċiet tal-metall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白镴；以锡为主要成分、用于制作器皿或装饰品的合金。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Liga magħmula l-aktar mill-landa, li tintuża biex isiru reċipjenti u oġġetti dekorattivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pewter is an alloy made mainly of tin and used to make vessels and decorative objects.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 焊料；熔化后用于连接金属表面或部件的金属材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal tal-metall li jiddewweb u jitqiegħed bejn uċuħ jew biċċiet tal-metall biex jgħaqqadhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Solder is a metal material that is melted to join metal surfaces or components together.

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi tazza tal-istann ħdejn reċipjenti oħra tal-metall.
formal.en: The museum displays a pewter cup beside other metal vessels.
formal.zh: 博物馆将一只白镴杯与其他金属器皿并列展出。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek ftit stann biex ngħaqqad dawn iż-żewġ wajers? Toni: Iva, hawn fuq il-bank tax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have some solder so I can join these two wires? Toni: Yes, here on the workbench.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有点焊料吗？我想把这两根导线接起来。托尼：有，就在这张工作台上。

messages.speaker: Sara (维修学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ftit stann biex ngħaqqad dawn iż-żewġ wajers?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ftit stann biex ngħaqqad dawn iż-żewġ wajers?
messages.zh: 你有点焊料吗？我想把这两根导线接起来。
messages.en: Do you have some solder so I can join these two wires?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn fuq il-bank tax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn fuq il-bank tax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 有，就在这张工作台上。
messages.en: Yes, here on the workbench.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景区分义项：展柜里的金属杯提示白镴，工作台上熔化接线的材料提示焊料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join metal parts by melting solder onto the surfaces to be connected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将焊料熔化在待连接的金属表面上，使部件接合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad biċċiet tal-metall billi ddewweb l-istann fuq l-uċuħ li jridu jingħaqdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用熔化的焊料连接金属部件，例如焊接导线或电路接点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad wajers jew biċċiet oħra tal-metall bl-istann imdewweb, li jżommhom magħqudin meta jiksaħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you solder metal parts, you join them using melted solder that holds them together when it cools.

formal.mt: Wara li nqata' l-kurrent, it-tekniku stannja ż-żewġ wajers u ċċekkja l-konnessjoni.
formal.en: After the power was disconnected, the technician soldered the two wires and checked the connection.
formal.zh: 断电后，技术人员焊接了两根导线，并检查了连接处。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min stannja dawn iż-żewġ wajers? Ġorġ: Ħija stannjahom ilbieraħ. Lara: Mela se nistaqsih kif għamel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who soldered these two wires? Ġorġ: My brother soldered them yesterday. Lara: Then I'll ask him how he did it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把这两根导线焊起来的？乔治：我哥哥昨天焊的。拉拉：那我去问问他是怎么做的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min stannja dawn iż-żewġ wajers?
messages.mt_standard: Min stannja dawn iż-żewġ wajers?
messages.zh: 谁把这两根导线焊起来的？
messages.en: Who soldered these two wires?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija stannjahom ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija stannjahom ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 我哥哥昨天焊的。
messages.en: My brother soldered them yesterday.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela se nistaqsih kif għamel.
messages.mt_standard: Mela se nistaqsih kif għamel.
messages.zh: 那我去问问他是怎么做的。
messages.en: Then I'll ask him how he did it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把动作分成“加热焊料、接合导线、冷却固定”三幅图，整组画面对应这个焊接动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ask someone a question or request information; this form gives an instruction to one person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人提出问题或索取信息；此形式用于指示一个人去询问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Agħmel mistoqsija lil xi ħadd jew itlob informazzjoni; din il-forma tintuża biex tingħata ordni jew istruzzjoni lil persuna waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 问；询问，用于指示一个人提出问题或索取信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Agħmel mistoqsija lil xi ħadd biex tikseb tweġiba jew informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you tell someone to ask, you are telling them to put a question to another person.

formal.mt: Jekk teħtieġ aktar informazzjoni, staqsi lill-uffiċjal responsabbli qabel tiffirma d-dokument.
formal.en: If you need more information, ask the officer responsible before signing the document.
formal.zh: 如果需要更多信息，请在签署文件前询问负责的工作人员。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma nafx meta jibda l-kors. Pawlu: Staqsi lil Marija; hi taf.
colloquial.en: Lara: I don't know when the course starts. Pawlu: Ask Marija; she knows.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我不知道课程什么时候开始。保罗：问问玛丽亚，她知道。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx meta jibda l-kors.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx meta jibda l-kors.
messages.zh: 我不知道课程什么时候开始。
messages.en: I don't know when the course starts.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Marija; hi taf.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Marija; hi taf.
messages.zh: 问问玛丽亚，她知道。
messages.en: Ask Marija; she knows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 staqsi 放进“有疑问就问老师”的场景，记作对一个人说“问问吧”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Said of a female person who put a question to someone or requested information in the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示她在过去向某人提出了问题或索取了信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tal-verb li tindika li persuna femminili għamlet mistoqsija jew talbet informazzjoni fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 她问了；她在过去提出了问题或询问了信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li hi għamlet mistoqsija lil xi ħadd jew talbet informazzjoni fil-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If she asked something, she put a question to someone or requested information at an earlier time.

collocations.en: she asked whether there was a place available

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ir-riċerkatriċi staqsiet kif kienet se tinġabar id-data.
formal.en: During the meeting, the female researcher asked how the data would be collected.
formal.zh: 会议期间，这位女研究员询问了将如何收集数据。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'riedet tkun taf Marija? Lara: Staqsiet x'ħin nitilqu għada.
colloquial.en: Mark: What did Marija want to know? Lara: She asked what time we're leaving tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 马克：玛丽亚想知道什么？拉拉：她问我们明天几点出发。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'riedet tkun taf Marija?
messages.mt_standard: X'riedet tkun taf Marija?
messages.zh: 玛丽亚想知道什么？
messages.en: What did Marija want to know?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsiet x'ħin nitilqu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsiet x'ħin nitilqu għada.
messages.zh: 她问我们明天几点出发。
messages.en: She asked what time we're leaving tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 staqsiet 与“她刚才问了什么”一起记，牢牢绑定女性主语和过去发生的询问。

gloss_zh: 黑启动；全停电状态下的自主启动

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of starting a power-generating plant after a complete shutdown without relying on an external electricity supply.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发电设施在完全停运后，不依赖外部电力供应而重新启动的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih impjant tal-ġenerazzjoni tal-elettriku jerġa' jitħaddem wara waqfien totali mingħajr ma jiddependi fuq provvista esterna tal-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑启动，指发电设施完全停运后，在没有外部电源支持的情况下重新启动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidu mill-ġdid ta' impjant tal-ġenerazzjoni tal-elettriku wara waqfien totali, mingħajr l-użu ta' provvista esterna tal-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A black start is a process in which a power-generating plant starts operating again without electricity supplied from outside the plant.

collocations.mt: proċedura ta' startjar minn mitfi totali
kapaċità ta' startjar minn mitfi totali

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' emerġenza jinkludi proċedura ta' startjar minn mitfi totali biex l-impjant jerġa' jitħaddem mingħajr provvista esterna tal-elettriku.
formal.en: The emergency plan includes a black-start procedure to restart the plant without an external electricity supply.
formal.zh: 应急计划包括一套黑启动程序，以便在没有外部电力供应的情况下重新启动发电设施。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif jerġa' jibda jaħdem l-impjant jekk ma jkunx hemm elettriku minn barra? Mark: Jużaw startjar minn mitfi totali biex jerġgħu jqabbduh.
colloquial.en: Sara: How does the plant start working again if there's no electricity from outside? Mark: They use a black start to get it running again.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：如果没有外部电源，发电设施怎么重新运转？马克：他们通过黑启动让它重新运行。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jerġa' jibda jaħdem l-impjant jekk ma jkunx hemm elettriku minn barra?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jerġa' jibda jaħdem l-impjant jekk ma jkunx hemm elettriku minn barra?
messages.zh: 如果没有外部电源，发电设施怎么重新运转？
messages.en: How does the plant start working again if there's no electricity from outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jużaw startjar minn mitfi totali biex jerġgħu jqabbduh.
messages.mt_standard: Jużaw startjar minn mitfi totali biex jerġgħu jqabbduh.
messages.zh: 他们通过黑启动让它重新运行。
messages.en: They use a black start to get it running again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象发电设施全部停下、外部也无电，靠自身条件重新启动；把整组短语记作“黑启动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument used to measure how much a person or an object weighs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于测量人或物体重量的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex jitkejjel il-piż ta' persuna jew ta' oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秤，用于测量人或物体重量的器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jkejjel kemm tiżen persuna jew kemm jiżen oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A weighing scale is a device that shows how much a person or an object weighs.

formal.mt: Il-ħanut juża stasija diġitali biex ikejjel il-piż tal-prodotti qabel ma jikkalkula l-prezz.
formal.en: The shop uses a digital weighing scale to measure the weight of the products before calculating the price.
formal.zh: 商店使用电子秤测量商品重量，然后计算价格。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif se nkejjel mitejn gramma dqiq? Pawlu: Uża stasija tal-kċina; hekk tkun taf il-piż.
colloquial.en: Lara: How am I going to measure two hundred grams of flour? Pawlu: Use a kitchen scale; then you'll know the weight.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我要怎么量出两百克面粉？保罗：用厨房秤，这样就知道重量了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nkejjel mitejn gramma dqiq?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nkejjel mitejn gramma dqiq?
messages.zh: 我要怎么量出两百克面粉？
messages.en: How am I going to measure two hundred grams of flour?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża stasija tal-kċina; hekk tkun taf il-piż.
messages.mt_standard: Uża stasija tal-kċina; hekk tkun taf il-piż.
messages.zh: 用厨房秤，这样就知道重量了。
messages.en: Use a kitchen scale; then you'll know the weight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 stasija 和厨房称面粉的画面绑定：放上面粉、读出克数，眼前这件器具就是秤。

gloss_zh: 无疫病状态；无疾病状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition in which a person, animal, population, or area is free from the disease or diseases under consideration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人、动物、群体或地区不存在所讨论的某种或某些疾病的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha persuna, annimal, popolazzjoni jew żona tkun ħielsa mill-marda jew mill-mard li jkun qed jiġi kkunsidrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无疾病状态；指有关个人、动物、群体或地区没有所讨论的疾病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat li fih persuna, annimal, popolazzjoni jew żona ma jkollhiex il-marda jew il-mard li jkun qed jiġi kkunsidrat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Disease-free status is the condition of a person, animal, population, or area that is free from the disease or diseases being considered.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddokumenta l-istat ta' ħelsien mill-mard fir-razzett abbażi tal-eżamijiet imwettqa.
formal.en: The report documents the farm's disease-free status on the basis of the examinations carried out.
formal.zh: 该报告依据已开展的检查，记录了农场的无疫病状态。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: X'jgħid ir-rapport dwar is-saħħa tal-annimali tagħna? Rita: Jikkonferma l-istat ta' ħelsien mill-mard fir-razzett. Pawlu: Tajjeb, mela nżommu kopja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What does the report say about our animals' health? Rita: It confirms the farm's disease-free status. Pawlu: Good, then let's keep a copy of it.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：报告怎么说我们这些动物的健康状况？Rita：报告确认了农场的无疫病状态。Pawlu：好，那我们留一份副本吧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jgħid ir-rapport dwar is-saħħa tal-annimali tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: X'jgħid ir-rapport dwar is-saħħa tal-annimali tagħna?
messages.zh: 报告怎么说我们这些动物的健康状况？
messages.en: What does the report say about our animals' health?

messages.speaker: Rita (兽医)
messages.mt_spoken: Jikkonferma l-istat ta' ħelsien mill-mard fir-razzett.
messages.mt_standard: Jikkonferma l-istat ta' ħelsien mill-mard fir-razzett.
messages.zh: 报告确认了农场的无疫病状态。
messages.en: It confirms the farm's disease-free status.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, mela nżommu kopja tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, mela nżommu kopja tiegħu.
messages.zh: 好，那我们留一份副本吧。
messages.en: Good, then let's keep a copy of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组短语想成健康报告上的一栏：stat 是“状态”，ħelsien mill-mard 表示“免于疾病”。连起来记作“无疾病状态”，并联系上下文判断具体指哪些疾病。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Remaining still or unchanged, without movement or development.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保持静止或不发生变化的；不呈现运动或发展过程的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' wieqaf jew fl-istess stat, mingħajr moviment jew żvilupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 静止的；保持原状而没有运动、变化或发展的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jiċċaqlaqx jew ma jinbidilx, iżda jibqa' fl-istess pożizzjoni jew kundizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is static remains still or unchanged instead of moving or developing.

formal.mt: Dan il-mudell statiku juri s-sitwazzjoni f'mument wieħed u ma jurix il-bidliet matul iż-żmien.
formal.en: This static model shows the situation at a single moment and does not show changes over time.
formal.zh: 这个静态模型展示某一时刻的情况，不展示随时间发生的变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-karattru fuq l-iskrin jibqa' statiku? Mark: Għax din stampa biss. Agħfas hawn biex tara l-animazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the character on the screen stay still? Mark: Because this is just a picture. Click here to see the animation.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：屏幕上的角色为什么一直静止不动？马克：因为这只是一张图片。点这里就能看动画。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru fuq l-iskrin jibqa' statiku?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru fuq l-iskrin jibqa' statiku?
messages.zh: 屏幕上的角色为什么一直静止不动？
messages.en: Why does the character on the screen stay still?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax din stampa biss. Agħfas hawn biex tara l-animazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax din stampa biss. Agħfas hawn biex tara l-animazzjoni.
messages.zh: 因为这只是一张图片。点这里就能看动画。
messages.en: Because this is just a picture. Click here to see the animation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 statiku 想成按下暂停键后的画面：人物不动、状态不变；再用 mudell statiku 记住“静态模型”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition in which something hangs or bends downwards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物向下垂落或弯垂的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni li fiha xi ħaġa tkun imdendla jew milwija 'l isfel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物体向下垂落或弯垂的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat li fih xi ħaġa tinżel jew titgħawweġ 'l isfel minflok tibqa' wieqfa jew merfugħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A droop is a downward bend or hanging position in something.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, il-ġardinar iddeskriva l-istatiċiżmu tal-weraq u nnota li t-truf kienu jħarsu 'l isfel.
formal.en: In his report, the gardener described the drooping of the leaves and noted that their tips pointed downwards.
formal.zh: 园丁在报告中描述了叶片的下垂状态，并指出叶尖朝下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tifhem bi statiċiżmu tal-weraq? Pawlu: Li l-weraq ikun imdendel 'l isfel, bħal dak ta' din il-pjanta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you mean by drooping of the leaves? Pawlu: That the leaves hang downwards, like those on this plant.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说的叶片下垂是什么意思？保罗：就是叶子向下垂着，像这株植物的叶子。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tifhem bi statiċiżmu tal-weraq?
messages.mt_standard: X'tifhem bi statiċiżmu tal-weraq?
messages.zh: 你说的叶片下垂是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by drooping of the leaves?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Li l-weraq ikun imdendel 'l isfel, bħal dak ta' din il-pjanta.
messages.mt_standard: Li l-weraq ikun imdendel 'l isfel, bħal dak ta' din il-pjanta.
messages.zh: 就是叶子向下垂着，像这株植物的叶子。
messages.en: That the leaves hang downwards, like those on this plant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词与“叶尖朝下”的画面配对，记住它表示下垂状态；可用 statiċiżmu tal-weraq 整组复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The classification or position of goods under customs rules, which determines how customs authorities treat them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物在海关规则下所属的类别或具有的地位，据此确定海关如何处理这些货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-klassifikazzjoni jew il-pożizzjoni tal-merkanzija skont ir-regoli doganali, li tiddetermina kif l-awtoritajiet doganali jittrattawha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关地位；指货物依据海关规则具有的分类或状态，是海关确定其处理方式的依据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pożizzjoni li jkollha l-merkanzija skont ir-regoli doganali u li fuqha jkun ibbażat il-mod kif tiġi ttrattata mill-awtoritajiet doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The customs status of goods is their classification under customs rules, which determines how they are treated by customs authorities.

collocations.en: verify the customs status of the goods

formal.mt: L-importatur talab lill-aġent jivverifika l-istatus doganali tal-merkanzija qabel ma jissottometti d-dokumenti.
formal.en: The importer asked the agent to verify the customs status of the goods before submitting the documents.
formal.zh: 进口商要求代理人在提交文件之前核实货物的海关地位。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Taf x'inhu l-istatus doganali ta' din il-merkanzija? David: Għadni ma ċċekkjajtx. Ħa nara d-dokumenti. Marta: Tajjeb, għidli meta tkun taf.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you know the customs status of these goods? David: I haven't checked yet. Let me look at the documents. Marta: Okay, let me know when you find out.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你知道这批货物的海关地位吗？David：我还没查。我看看文件。Marta：好，查到了告诉我。

messages.speaker: Marta (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf x'inhu l-istatus doganali ta' din il-merkanzija?
messages.mt_standard: Taf x'inhu l-istatus doganali ta' din il-merkanzija?
messages.zh: 你知道这批货物的海关地位吗？
messages.en: Do you know the customs status of these goods?

messages.speaker: David (货运代理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma ċċekkjajtx. Ħa nara d-dokumenti.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma ċċekkjajtx. Ħa nara d-dokumenti.
messages.zh: 我还没查。我看看文件。
messages.en: I haven't checked yet. Let me look at the documents.

messages.speaker: Marta (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, għidli meta tkun taf.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, għidli meta tkun taf.
messages.zh: 好，查到了告诉我。
messages.en: Okay, let me know when you find out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货物文件上有“海关地位”这一栏：status 提醒你看“状态或地位”，doganali 把范围限定在“海关”。整组记忆时，把它与核实货物文件的场景联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The existing state of affairs, especially when it remains unchanged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 目前存在的情况，尤指保持不变的现状，也可指没有进展的停滞状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda eżistenti tal-affarijiet, speċjalment meta tibqa' mingħajr tibdil jew progress.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事情没有继续发展或取得进展的停滞状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qagħda li fiha ma jsir ebda progress u l-affarijiet jibqgħu kif inhuma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When a situation is at a standstill, no further progress or development takes place.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某一时期已经存在的情况或安排，即现状。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda jew l-arranġamenti li jeżistu fi żmien partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The status quo is the existing situation or arrangement before any changes are made.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iddeċieda li jżomm l-istatus quo sakemm jitlestew il-konsultazzjonijiet.
formal.en: The committee decided to maintain the status quo until the consultations were completed.
formal.zh: 委员会决定在咨询工作完成之前维持现状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se nbiddlu l-ħin tal-laqgħa? Mark: Għalissa nżommu l-istatus quo u niltaqgħu fid-disgħa bħas-soltu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we changing the meeting time? Mark: For now, let's keep the status quo and meet at nine as usual.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们要改开会时间吗？马克：暂时维持现状，照常九点见。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nbiddlu l-ħin tal-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Se nbiddlu l-ħin tal-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 我们要改开会时间吗？
messages.en: Are we changing the meeting time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalissa nżommu l-istatus quo u niltaqgħu fid-disgħa bħas-soltu.
messages.mt_standard: Għalissa nżommu l-istatus quo u niltaqgħu fid-disgħa bħas-soltu.
messages.zh: 暂时维持现状，照常九点见。
messages.en: For now, let's keep the status quo and meet at nine as usual.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把会议安排想成一张暂不修改的时间表：保持原样就是维持现状；若事情一直没有推进，则联系停滞状态来记。

gloss_zh: 可用状态；是否可用的状态信息
