teaching_sense.en_definition: Information showing whether someone or something is currently available.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表明某人目前是否有空，或某物目前是否可以使用、取得的状态信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Informazzjoni li turi jekk persuna hijiex ħielsa jew jekk xi ħaġa tistax tintuża jew tinkiseb bħalissa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显示人员是否有空，或物品、资源等是否可供使用或取得的当前状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-istat indikat li juri jekk persuna tkunx ħielsa jew jekk oġġett jew riżorsa jkunux disponibbli għall-użu jew biex jinkisbu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An availability status tells you whether a person or resource is currently available.

formal.mt: Is-sistema turi l-istatus tad-disponibilità ta' kull kamra qabel ma l-utent jikkonferma r-riżervazzjoni.
formal.en: The system displays each room's availability status before the user confirms the booking.
formal.zh: 系统会在用户确认预订之前显示每个房间的可用状态。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inkun naf jekk intix ħieles għal telefonata? Pawlu: Iċċekkja l-istatus tad-disponibilità tiegħi fl-app; naġġornah meta nispiċċa l-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: How can I tell whether you're free for a call? Pawlu: Check my availability status in the app; I'll update it when I finish the meeting.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我怎么知道你有没有空接电话？保罗：看看应用里我的可用状态；开完会我就更新。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inkun naf jekk intix ħieles għal telefonata?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inkun naf jekk intix ħieles għal telefonata?
messages.zh: 我怎么知道你有没有空接电话？
messages.en: How can I tell whether you're free for a call?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċċekkja l-istatus tad-disponibilità tiegħi fl-app; naġġornah meta nispiċċa l-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iċċekkja l-istatus tad-disponibilità tiegħi fl-app; naġġornah meta nispiċċa l-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 看看应用里我的可用状态；开完会我就更新。
messages.en: Check my availability status in the app; I'll update it when I finish the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象预订页面上的房间状态栏：显示可订还是不可订，就是可用状态；用于人时，则看他现在有没有空。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formally written law or set of rules governing an institution or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式制定的成文法律，或规定机构、组织如何运作的正式章程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Liġi miktuba u adottata formalment, jew ġabra ta' regoli uffiċjali li jirregolaw it-tmexxija ta' istituzzjoni jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由有权机关正式制定的成文法律，或约束机构、团体运作的正式章程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Liġi miktuba maħruġa minn awtorità kompetenti, jew sett ta' regoli formali li jistabbilixxu kif għandha titmexxa istituzzjoni jew għaqda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A statute is a formally established written law or a rule governing an institution.

collocations.zh: 通过新的章程或成文法
对章程或成文法的修订

formal.mt: L-istatut tal-għaqda jistabbilixxi d-drittijiet tal-membri u l-proċedura għall-elezzjoni tal-kumitat.
formal.en: The association's statute establishes members' rights and the procedure for electing the committee.
formal.zh: 该协会的章程规定了会员的权利以及委员会的选举程序。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nista' nivvota fil-laqgħa tal-klabb? David: Ejja niċċekkjaw l-istatut; hemm miktub min għandu d-dritt jivvota.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can I vote at the club meeting? David: Let's check the statute; it says who has the right to vote.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我能在俱乐部会议上投票吗？戴维：我们查一下章程，里面写着谁有投票权。

messages.speaker: Anna (俱乐部新会员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nivvota fil-laqgħa tal-klabb?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nivvota fil-laqgħa tal-klabb?
messages.zh: 我能在俱乐部会议上投票吗？
messages.en: Can I vote at the club meeting?

messages.speaker: David (俱乐部秘书)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw l-istatut; hemm miktub min għandu d-dritt jivvota.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw l-istatut; hemm miktub min għandu d-dritt jivvota.
messages.zh: 我们查一下章程，里面写着谁有投票权。
messages.en: Let's check the statute; it says who has the right to vote.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本正式通过的规则册：国家制定的可对应成文法，协会制定的可对应章程，核心都是正式写下的规则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where drivers can buy fuel for their vehicles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供驾驶者为车辆购买和加注燃油的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn is-sewwieqa jistgħu jixtru l-fjuwil u jimlew it-tank tal-vettura tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为机动车供应和加注燃油的加油站。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post b'pompi tal-fjuwil fejn is-sewwieqa jimlew it-tank tal-vettura tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A filling station is a place where you buy fuel and put it into your vehicle.

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq waqaf fi stazzjon tal-petrol biex jimla t-tank qabel kompla l-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The driver stopped at a filling station to fill the tank before continuing the journey.
formal.zh: 驾驶者在加油站停下加满油，然后继续行程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-eqreb stazzjon tal-petrol? Mark: Hemm wieħed wara l-pont. Nistgħu nieqfu hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the nearest filling station? Mark: There is one past the bridge. We can stop there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：最近的加油站在哪里？Mark：过桥后有一家，我们可以在那里停一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-eqreb stazzjon tal-petrol?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-eqreb stazzjon tal-petrol?
messages.zh: 最近的加油站在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the nearest filling station?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm wieħed wara l-pont. Nistgħu nieqfu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm wieħed wara l-pont. Nistgħu nieqfu hemm.
messages.zh: 过桥后有一家，我们可以在那里停一下。
messages.en: There is one past the bridge. We can stop there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和汽车停在油泵旁加油的画面绑定，再用“最近的加油站在哪里”这一问路句反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Remaining in the same position without moving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保持在同一位置而不移动的；静止或固定不动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' fl-istess post jew pożizzjoni mingħajr ma jiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 停留在同一位置而没有移动的；处于静止状态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab fl-istess post u ma jkunx qed jiċċaqlaq minn pożizzjoni għal oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is stationary stays in the same position instead of moving.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 没有动作或位置变化的；保持不动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jiċċaqlaqx u jibqa' mingħajr moviment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is unmoving remains still without making any movement.

formal.mt: Matul il-kejl, l-oġġett għandu jibqa' stazzjonarju sabiex ir-riżultati jkunu preċiżi.
formal.en: During measurement, the object must remain stationary so that the results are accurate.
formal.zh: 测量过程中，物体必须保持静止，以确保结果准确。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għadna ma tlaqniex? Toni: It-trakk ta' quddiemna għadu stazzjonarju; irridu nistennew sakemm jimxi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why haven't we set off yet? Toni: The truck in front of us is still stationary; we have to wait until it moves.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们怎么还没出发？托尼：前面的卡车还停着没动，我们得等它开走。

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadna ma tlaqniex?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadna ma tlaqniex?
messages.zh: 我们怎么还没出发？
messages.en: Why haven't we set off yet?

messages.speaker: Toni (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: It-trakk ta' quddiemna għadu stazzjonarju; irridu nistennew sakemm jimxi.
messages.mt_standard: It-trakk ta' quddiemna għadu stazzjonarju; irridu nistennew sakemm jimxi.
messages.zh: 前面的卡车还停着没动，我们得等它开走。
messages.en: The truck in front of us is still stationary; we have to wait until it moves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给卡车连续拍两张照片：车的位置完全一样，就用这个词记静止不动；也可联想固定在原位的设备。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of the year when fewer people travel or use a particular service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一年中旅游人数或某项服务需求较少的时期，常指旅游淡季。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-perjodu tas-sena meta jkun hemm inqas turisti jew inqas domanda għal servizz partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淡季，尤指游客较少、旅游服务需求较低的季节。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żmien tas-sena meta l-attività turistika jew id-domanda għal ċerti servizzi tkun aktar baxxa mis-soltu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The low season is the period of the year when fewer people visit a place and demand for tourist services is lower.

collocations.en: to travel during the low season

formal.mt: Il-lukanda toffri prezzijiet aktar baxxi matul l-istaġun baxx biex tattira aktar viżitaturi.
formal.en: The hotel offers lower prices during the low season to attract more visitors.
formal.zh: 这家酒店在淡季提供更低的价格，以吸引更多游客。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Immorru btala fl-istaġun baxx? Mark: Iva, forsi nsibu lukanda orħos u inqas nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go on holiday in the low season? Mark: Yes, perhaps we'll find a cheaper hotel and fewer crowds.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们淡季去度假怎么样？Mark：好啊，也许能找到更便宜的酒店，人也少一些。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Immorru btala fl-istaġun baxx?
messages.mt_standard: Immorru btala fl-istaġun baxx?
messages.zh: 我们淡季去度假怎么样？
messages.en: Shall we go on holiday in the low season?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, forsi nsibu lukanda orħos u inqas nies.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, forsi nsibu lukanda orħos u inqas nies.
messages.zh: 好啊，也许能找到更便宜的酒店，人也少一些。
messages.en: Yes, perhaps we'll find a cheaper hotel and fewer crowds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用旅馆空房较多的画面记住 staġun baxx：游客数量低、需求低，就是淡季。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An invitation asking someone to confirm their interest in an opportunity or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求个人或机构确认是否有意参与某项机会或活动的邀请。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stedina li titlob lil persuna jew organizzazzjoni tikkonferma jekk għandhiex interess li tieħu sehem f'opportunità jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 请有关个人或机构确认其参与意向的邀请。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Talba mibgħuta lil persuna jew organizzazzjoni biex tikkonferma l-interess tagħha li tipparteċipa f'attività jew proċess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An invitation to confirm interest asks you to state whether you are interested in taking part.

collocations.en: send an invitation to confirm interest
collocations.zh: 发出确认参与意向的邀请

collocations.mt: twieġeb għal stedina għal konferma tal-interess
collocations.en: respond to an invitation to confirm interest
collocations.zh: 回复确认参与意向的邀请

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni bagħtet stedina għal konferma tal-interess u talbet lill-parteċipanti potenzjali jwieġbu sal-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The organisation sent an invitation to confirm interest and asked potential participants to reply by Friday.
formal.zh: 该机构发出了确认参与意向的邀请，并要求潜在参与者在星期五之前回复。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Waslet stedina għal konferma tal-interess fil-proġett. Noel: Mela nwieġbu llum u ngħidulhom li aħna interessati.
colloquial.en: Lara: An invitation to confirm interest in the project has arrived. Noel: Then let's reply today and tell them we are interested.
colloquial.zh: Lara：确认项目参与意向的邀请到了。Noel：那我们今天就回复，告诉他们我们有兴趣。

messages.speaker: Lara (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslet stedina għal konferma tal-interess fil-proġett.
messages.mt_standard: Waslet stedina għal konferma tal-interess fil-proġett.
messages.zh: 确认项目参与意向的邀请到了。
messages.en: An invitation to confirm interest in the project has arrived.

messages.speaker: Noel (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nwieġbu llum u ngħidulhom li aħna interessati.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nwieġbu llum u ngħidulhom li aħna interessati.
messages.zh: 那我们今天就回复，告诉他们我们有兴趣。
messages.en: Then let's reply today and tell them we are interested.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“收到邀请、确认兴趣、回复意向”三个连续画面记忆整个短语，抓住它要求明确表达参与兴趣的用途。

gloss_zh: 提交投标文件的邀请；招标邀请

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal invitation asking suppliers or contractors to submit offers for specified goods, services, or work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式邀请供应商或承包商就指定货物、服务或工程提交投标文件的通知。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stedina formali lil fornituri jew kuntratturi biex jippreżentaw offerti għal prodotti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet speċifikati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式要求供应商或承包商提交投标文件的邀请。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stedina formali li titlob lil fornitur jew kuntrattur jippreżenta offerta għal prodotti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet deskritti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An invitation to submit a tender formally asks a supplier or contractor to send an offer for specified work, goods, or services.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邀请供应商或承包商参与投标的正式招标通知。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avviż formali li jistieden lil fornituri jew kuntratturi jieħdu sehem fi proċess ta' sejħa għall-offerti billi jippreżentaw l-offerti tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An invitation to tender is a formal notice inviting suppliers or contractors to compete by submitting their offers.

collocations.en: receive an invitation to submit a tender
collocations.zh: 收到提交投标文件的邀请

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ħareġ stedina għall-preżentazzjoni tal-offerti għat-tiswija tas-saqaf u speċifika d-data tal-għeluq.
formal.en: The council issued an invitation to tender for the roof repairs and specified the closing date.
formal.zh: 议会就屋顶维修工程发出了招标邀请，并注明了截止日期。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Irċevejna stedina għall-preżentazzjoni tal-offerti għat-tindif tal-uffiċċji. Pawlu: Tajjeb, ejja naqraw ir-rekwiżiti qabel inħejju l-offerta.
colloquial.en: Sara: We received an invitation to tender for cleaning the offices. Pawlu: Good, let's read the requirements before preparing our tender.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们收到了办公室清洁服务的招标邀请。Pawlu：好，我们先看要求，再准备投标文件。

messages.speaker: Sara (业务经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Irċevejna stedina għall-preżentazzjoni tal-offerti għat-tindif tal-uffiċċji.
messages.mt_standard: Irċevejna stedina għall-preżentazzjoni tal-offerti għat-tindif tal-uffiċċji.
messages.zh: 我们收到了办公室清洁服务的招标邀请。
messages.en: We received an invitation to tender for cleaning the offices.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (投标专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, ejja naqraw ir-rekwiżiti qabel inħejju l-offerta.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, ejja naqraw ir-rekwiżiti qabel inħejju l-offerta.
messages.zh: 好，我们先看要求，再准备投标文件。
messages.en: Good, let's read the requirements before preparing our tender.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长短语放进“收到招标邀请、阅读要求、提交标书”的办事流程中记忆；两个英语释义都可联系这一场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large sports venue with a field or track and areas for spectators.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设有运动场地或跑道，并有观众看台的大型体育场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post kbir għal avvenimenti sportivi, b'grawnd jew korsa u bi spazju għall-ispettaturi madwarhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供举行体育比赛、并设有观众看台的大型场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Faċilità sportiva kbira li tinkludi grawnd jew korsa u tribuni fejn l-ispettaturi jistgħu jsegwu l-kompetizzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stadium is a large venue where people watch sporting events from seats or standing areas around the playing space.

formal.mt: Il-finali se tintlagħab fi stejdjum li jista' jilqa' għaxart elef spettatur.
formal.en: The final will be played in a stadium that can accommodate ten thousand spectators.
formal.zh: 决赛将在一座可容纳一万名观众的体育场举行。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se niltaqgħu qabel il-logħba? David: Ħdejn id-daħla tal-istejdjum, nofs siegħa qabel tibda.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where shall we meet before the match? David: By the stadium entrance, half an hour before it starts.
colloquial.zh: Anna：比赛前我们在哪里碰面？David：在体育场入口旁，开赛前半小时。

messages.speaker: Anna (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu qabel il-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu qabel il-logħba?
messages.zh: 比赛前我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet before the match?

messages.speaker: David (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn id-daħla tal-istejdjum, nofs siegħa qabel tibda.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn id-daħla tal-istejdjum, nofs siegħa qabel tibda.
messages.zh: 在体育场入口旁，开赛前半小时。
messages.en: By the stadium entrance, half an hour before it starts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象绿茵场被一圈观众看台围住，再把 stejdjum 和英语 stadium 配对朗读，记住体育场的整体画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thick slice of meat, especially beef, cooked and served as an individual portion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切成较厚片状、烹调后作为一人份食用的肉排，尤其指牛排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa laħam maqtugħa ħoxna, speċjalment taċ-ċanga, li tissajjar u tiġi servuta bħala porzjon għal persuna waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肉排，尤指切成厚片后煎、烤等烹制的牛排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ħoxna tal-laħam, ġeneralment taċ-ċanga, li tista' tissajjar fit-taġen jew fuq il-gradilja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A steak is a thick slice of meat, usually beef, that is cooked and served as a portion.

formal.mt: Il-menu joffri stejk taċ-ċanga servut bil-patata u l-ħaxix tal-istaġun.
formal.en: The menu offers a beef steak served with potatoes and seasonal vegetables.
formal.zh: 菜单提供牛排，配有土豆和时令蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nixtieq stejk bil-patata, jekk jogħġbok. Rita: Kif tixtiequ msajjar? Mark: Imsajjar sew, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like a steak with potatoes, please. Rita: How would you like it cooked? Mark: Well done, thank you.
colloquial.zh: Mark：请给我一份牛排配土豆。Rita：您想要几分熟？Mark：全熟，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq stejk bil-patata, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq stejk bil-patata, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我一份牛排配土豆。
messages.en: I'd like a steak with potatoes, please.

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tixtiequ msajjar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tixtiequ msajjar?
messages.zh: 您想要几分熟？
messages.en: How would you like it cooked?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Imsajjar sew, grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Imsajjar sew, grazzi.
messages.zh: 全熟，谢谢。
messages.en: Well done, thank you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用餐盘画面记 stejk：一块厚肉排，旁边配土豆。再把“牛排”和“全熟”两个搭配连起来练习点餐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that fastens sheets of paper together using small metal staples.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用小型金属订书钉把多张纸固定在一起的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tgħaqqad folji tal-karta b'qfieli żgħar tal-metall li jgħaddu mill-karta u jitgħawġu minn taħt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 订书机，通过压入并弯折金属订书钉来装订纸张的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda li żżomm folji tal-karta flimkien billi ddaħħal fihom qafla żgħira tal-metall u tgħawweġ it-truf tagħha minn taħt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stapler is a device that joins sheets of paper by pushing small metal staples through them.

formal.mt: Il-folji tar-rapport għandhom jintrabtu flimkien bi stejpler qabel ma jitqiegħdu fil-fajl.
formal.en: The sheets of the report should be fastened together with a stapler before being placed in the file.
formal.zh: 报告的各页应先用订书机订在一起，再放入档案夹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek stejpler? Irrid ngħaqqad dawn il-folji. David: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-iskrivanija. Lara: Grazzi, nużah u nerġa' npoġġih hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a stapler? I need to fasten these sheets together. David: Yes, it's on the desk. Lara: Thanks, I'll use it and put it back there.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你有订书机吗？我得把这些纸订在一起。David：有，在书桌上。Lara：谢谢，我用完就放回那里。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek stejpler? Irrid ngħaqqad dawn il-folji.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek stejpler? Irrid ngħaqqad dawn il-folji.
messages.zh: 你有订书机吗？我得把这些纸订在一起。
messages.en: Do you have a stapler? I need to fasten these sheets together.

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-iskrivanija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-iskrivanija.
messages.zh: 有，在书桌上。
messages.en: Yes, it's on the desk.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, nużah u nerġa' npoġġih hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, nużah u nerġa' npoġġih hemm.
messages.zh: 谢谢，我用完就放回那里。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll use it and put it back there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象书桌上一叠散纸，拿起 stejpler 按一下就订好了。把“订书机”与“按下、装订纸张”的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or business that sells writing materials and other stationery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售纸张、笔、信封等书写及办公用品的人或商家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew negozju li jbigħ materjal għall-kitba u għall-uffiċċju, bħal karti, pinen u envelops.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文具商；出售纸张、笔及其他文具的人或商家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew negozju li jbigħ karti, pinen, pitazzi u oġġetti oħra għall-kitba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stationer is a person or business that sells paper, pens, and other writing materials.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文具用品，尤其指纸张、笔、信封等书写和办公用品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal u oġġetti li jintużaw għall-kitba jew fl-uffiċċju, bħal karti, pinen, pitazzi u envelops.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Stationery consists of paper, pens, envelopes, and similar materials used for writing or office work.

formal.mt: L-istejxiner ipprovda lill-iskola b'pitazzi, pinen u karti għall-eżamijiet.
formal.en: The stationer supplied the school with exercise books, pens, and paper for the examinations.
formal.zh: 文具商向学校提供了练习本、笔和考试用纸。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn xtrajt dawn il-pitazzi? Ben: Mingħand l-istejxiner ħdejn l-iskola. Lara: Għandu pinen ukoll? Ben: Iva, għandu ħafna tipi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you buy these exercise books? Ben: From the stationer near the school. Lara: Does he have pens too? Ben: Yes, he has lots of different kinds.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A platform where people perform, or a designated place where buses stop for passengers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供演员等表演的舞台；也指供乘客上下车的公交车站。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjattaforma fejn isiru wirjiet quddiem udjenza, jew post fejn jieqfu l-karozzi tal-linja biex jitilgħu u jinżlu l-passiġġieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舞台，供演员、歌手等在观众面前表演的平台。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjattaforma fejn atturi, kantanti jew artisti oħra jagħtu wirja quddiem udjenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stage is a platform on which performers appear before an audience.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公交车站，公共汽车按规定停车供乘客上下车的地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post magħżul fejn tieqaf karozza tal-linja biex il-passiġġieri jitilgħu jew jinżlu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bus stop is a designated place where buses stop to let passengers get on or off.

collocations.en: to wait at the bus stop

formal.mt: Waqt il-kunċert, il-kantanti telgħu fuq l-istejġ u sellmu lill-udjenza.
formal.en: During the concert, the singers went onto the stage and greeted the audience.
formal.zh: 音乐会上，歌手们走上舞台，向观众致意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Pawlu: Fl-istejġ ħdejn il-pjazza. Maja: Sewwa, nistenna hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Pawlu: At the bus stop near the square. Maja: All right, I'll wait there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们在哪里见面？Pawlu：广场附近的公交车站。Maja：好，我在那里等。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu?
messages.zh: 我们在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-istejġ ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-istejġ ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 广场附近的公交车站。
messages.en: At the bus stop near the square.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, nistenna hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, nistenna hemm.
messages.zh: 好，我在那里等。
messages.en: All right, I'll wait there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个场景成对记：演员登上舞台，乘客等在车站。看到表演语境想“舞台”，看到公交语境想“车站”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A designated place where a bus stops so that passengers can get on or off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公共汽车按规定停车、供乘客候车和上下车的地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post magħżul fejn il-passiġġieri jistennew il-karozza tal-linja u fejn din tieqaf biex jitilgħu jew jinżlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公交车站，公共汽车停靠并接送乘客的指定地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post magħżul fejn tieqaf il-karozza tal-linja biex tieħu jew tniżżel il-passiġġieri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bus stop is a designated place where passengers wait for buses and get on or off them.

collocations.en: to walk to the bus stop

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jiltaqgħu fl-istejġ tal-karozza quddiem il-mużew fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: Participants should meet at the bus stop in front of the museum at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 参加者应于上午九点在博物馆前的公交车站集合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu l-istejġ tal-karozza? Mark: Quddiem il-mużew, fuq ix-xellug. Sara: Grazzi, sejra hemm issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the bus stop? Mark: In front of the museum, on the left. Sara: Thanks, I'm going there now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：公交车站在哪里？Mark：在博物馆前面，左手边。Sara：谢谢，我现在就过去。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-istejġ tal-karozza?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-istejġ tal-karozza?
messages.zh: 公交车站在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bus stop?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Quddiem il-mużew, fuq ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Quddiem il-mużew, fuq ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 在博物馆前面，左手边。
messages.en: In front of the museum, on the left.

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, sejra hemm issa.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, sejra hemm issa.
messages.zh: 谢谢，我现在就过去。
messages.en: Thanks, I'm going there now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组放进“问路找公交站”的画面里，连同“在哪里”和“走到那里”一起练习，固定记作公交车站。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heraldic design used to represent a family, institution, town, or country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代表家族、机构、城镇或国家的纹章图案，通常以盾形为主要构图。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Disinn araldiku, ġeneralment b'tarka, li jirrappreżenta familja, istituzzjoni, belt jew pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纹章；代表家族、机构或地方等的徽章图案，通常包含盾形。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Emblema araldika li tirrappreżenta familja, istituzzjoni jew post u li ġeneralment tinkludi tarka b'simboli jew kuluri distintivi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coat of arms is a heraldic design that represents a particular family, institution, place, or country.

formal.mt: Fuq il-faċċata tal-bini tidher l-istemma tal-familja, b'tarka u żewġ iljuni.
formal.en: The family coat of arms, featuring a shield and two lions, appears on the building's façade.
formal.zh: 建筑正面可见这个家族的纹章，图案中有一面盾牌和两只狮子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak id-disinn fuq il-bieb? Pawlu: Dik l-istemma tal-familja. Maja: U dak fin-nofs huwa ljun? Pawlu: Iva, jidher fuq it-tarka.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that design on the door? Pawlu: That's the family coat of arms. Maja: And is that a lion in the middle? Pawlu: Yes, it appears on the shield.
colloquial.zh: Maja：门上那个图案是什么？Pawlu：那是家族纹章。Maja：中间那是狮子吗？Pawlu：是，它在盾牌图案上。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak id-disinn fuq il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak id-disinn fuq il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门上那个图案是什么？
messages.en: What's that design on the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik l-istemma tal-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Dik l-istemma tal-familja.
messages.zh: 那是家族纹章。
messages.en: That's the family coat of arms.

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: U dak fin-nofs huwa ljun?
messages.mt_standard: U dak fin-nofs huwa ljun?
messages.zh: 中间那是狮子吗？
messages.en: And is that a lion in the middle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidher fuq it-tarka.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidher fuq it-tarka.
messages.zh: 是，它在盾牌图案上。
messages.en: Yes, it appears on the shield.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象古建筑门上一面带狮子的盾形徽章，用这个完整画面记住 stemma；再把“家族纹章”和“城市纹章”成组练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Free from living microorganisms, or unable to reproduce or support growth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有活微生物的；也可指不能生育、繁殖或支持植物生长的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ħieles minn mikroorganiżmi ħajjin, jew li ma jkunx jista' jirriproduċi jew isostni t-tkabbir tal-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无菌的，即没有活微生物的；也指生物不能生育或繁殖的，或土地贫瘠、不能支持植物生长的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma fihx mikroorganiżmi ħajjin; meta jirreferi għal organiżmu, li ma jistax jirriproduċi, jew, għal art, li ma tistax issostni t-tkabbir tal-pjanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is sterile is free from living microorganisms, while a sterile organism cannot reproduce and sterile land cannot support plant growth.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddistingwi bejn ħamrija sterili, li ma fiha ebda mikroorganiżmu ħaj, u art sterili, li ma ssostnix it-tkabbir tal-pjanti.
formal.en: The report distinguishes between sterile soil containing no living microorganisms and sterile land that cannot support plant growth.
formal.zh: 报告区分了两种情况：不含任何活微生物的无菌土壤，以及不能支持植物生长的贫瘠土地。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser sterili fuq dan il-pakkett? Nina: Tfisser li l-faxxa hija ħielsa minn mikroorganiżmi ħajjin. Sara: Allura mhux sempliċement nadifa? Nina: Eżatt, il-kelma għandha tifsira aktar speċifika.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does sterile mean on this packet? Nina: It means the bandage is free from living microorganisms. Sara: So it doesn't just mean clean? Nina: Exactly, the word has a more specific meaning.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个包装上的 sterili 是什么意思？Nina：意思是绷带不含活微生物。Sara：所以不只是“干净”的意思？Nina：对，这个词的含义更具体。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser sterili fuq dan il-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser sterili fuq dan il-pakkett?
messages.zh: 这个包装上的 sterili 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does sterile mean on this packet?

messages.speaker: Nina (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-faxxa hija ħielsa minn mikroorganiżmi ħajjin.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-faxxa hija ħielsa minn mikroorganiżmi ħajjin.
messages.zh: 意思是绷带不含活微生物。
messages.en: It means the bandage is free from living microorganisms.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura mhux sempliċement nadifa?
messages.mt_standard: Allura mhux sempliċement nadifa?
messages.zh: 所以不只是“干净”的意思？
messages.en: So it doesn't just mean clean?

messages.speaker: Nina (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Eżatt, il-kelma għandha tifsira aktar speċifika.
messages.mt_standard: Eżatt, il-kelma għandha tifsira aktar speċifika.
messages.zh: 对，这个词的含义更具体。
messages.en: Exactly, the word has a more specific meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按被修饰的对象记忆：器械对应“无菌”，生物对应“不育”，土地对应“贫瘠”。先看名词，再选择 sterili 的中文含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit of British currency called the pound sterling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英国货币单位英镑；单数形式用于表示一英镑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità tal-munita Brittanika li tintuża biex jiġu espressi prezzijiet u ammonti ta' flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英镑，英国的货币单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unità monetarja Brittanika li tissejjaħ ukoll lira sterlina u li tinqasam f'mitt penny.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A British pound is a unit of British currency that is divided into one hundred pence.

formal.mt: Skont il-lista tal-prezzijiet, kull kartolina tiswa sterlina waħda u kull ktieb jiswa ħames sterlini.
formal.en: According to the price list, each postcard costs one pound and each book costs five pounds.
formal.zh: 根据价目表，每张明信片售价一英镑，每本书售价五英镑。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa din il-kartolina? Eva: Sterlina waħda. Mark: U żewġ kartolini kemm jiġu? Eva: Żewġ sterlini.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much is this postcard? Eva: One pound. Mark: And how much are two postcards? Eva: Two pounds.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这张明信片多少钱？Eva：一英镑。Mark：那两张多少钱？Eva：两英镑。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm tiswa din il-kartolina?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm tiswa din il-kartolina?
messages.zh: 这张明信片多少钱？
messages.en: How much is this postcard?

messages.speaker: Eva (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Sterlina waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Sterlina waħda.
messages.zh: 一英镑。
messages.en: One pound.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: U żewġ kartolini kemm jiġu?
messages.mt_standard: U żewġ kartolini kemm jiġu?
messages.zh: 那两张明信片多少钱？
messages.en: And how much are two postcards?

messages.speaker: Eva (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewġ sterlini.
messages.mt_standard: Żewġ sterlini.
messages.zh: 两英镑。
messages.en: Two pounds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sterlina 和英镑符号 £ 配对记忆，再朗读 sterlina waħda（一英镑）与 żewġ sterlini（两英镑），同时记住单复数变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take a photograph of yourself, alone or with other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用相机或手机给自己拍照，也可以与别人一起自拍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħa ritratt tiegħu nnifsu, waħdu jew ma' nies oħra, b'kamera jew b'mowbajl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自拍，即用相机或手机拍摄包含自己在内的照片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħa ritratt li fih jidher hu stess, billi uża kamera jew mowbajl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone takes a selfie, they photograph themselves, sometimes together with other people.

collocations.en: take a selfie in front of the sea

formal.mt: Fi tmiem iż-żjara, Mark stessja mal-kollegi quddiem il-mużew.
formal.en: At the end of the visit, Mark took a selfie with his colleagues in front of the museum.
formal.zh: 参观结束时，马克和同事们在博物馆前一起自拍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Stessja magħna qabel titlaq! Mark: Tajjeb, ejjew ħdejja biex nidhru kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Take a selfie with us before you leave! Mark: Okay, come next to me so we can all be in it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：走之前和我们一起自拍吧！马克：好，大家靠到我旁边，这样就都能入镜。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stessja magħna qabel titlaq!
messages.mt_standard: Stessja magħna qabel titlaq!
messages.zh: 走之前和我们一起自拍吧！
messages.en: Take a selfie with us before you leave!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, ejjew ħdejja biex nidhru kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, ejjew ħdejja biex nidhru kollha.
messages.zh: 好，大家靠到我旁边，这样就都能入镜。
messages.en: Okay, come next to me so we can all be in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己举起手机，把自己和朋友一起拍进画面；用“镜头转向自己”的动作记住自拍义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stopped working or being active for a time in order to recover energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂时停止工作或活动，让身体放松并恢复精力，表示已经发生的休息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waqfu mix-xogħol jew mill-attività għal xi ħin biex jirrilassaw u jerġgħu jiksbu s-saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 休息了；曾暂停活动以放松身体或恢复体力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħadu ħin ta' mistrieħ wara xogħol jew attività biex inaqqsu l-għeja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If people rested, they spent some time relaxing or sleeping to recover their energy.

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, il-parteċipanti stieħu għal nofs siegħa qabel komplew bil-programm.
formal.en: After the long walk, the participants rested for half an hour before continuing with the programme.
formal.zh: 长途步行后，参与者休息了半小时，然后继续进行后续活动。

colloquial.mt: Marija: It-tfal għadhom għajjenin? David: Le, stieħu ftit wara l-mixja u issa jridu jilagħbu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are the children still tired? David: No, they rested for a while after the walk, and now they want to play.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：孩子们还累吗？戴维：不累了，他们走完路后休息了一会儿，现在又想玩了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tfal għadhom għajjenin?
messages.mt_standard: It-tfal għadhom għajjenin?
messages.zh: 孩子们还累吗？
messages.en: Are the children still tired?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, stieħu ftit wara l-mixja u issa jridu jilagħbu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, stieħu ftit wara l-mixja u issa jridu jilagħbu.
messages.zh: 不累了，他们走完路后休息了一会儿，现在又想玩了。
messages.en: No, they rested for a while after the walk, and now they want to play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“走累了、坐下了、恢复精神了”的连续画面，并给中文加上“了”，提醒自己这里表示已经休息过。

gloss_zh: 动词，具体动作义未明确

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb whose precise action cannot be determined from the gloss 'stigma' alone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 列为动词，但仅凭“stigma”这一释义无法确定其具体表示的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li t-tifsira preċiża tiegħu ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mill-kelma 'stigma' waħedha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动词；具体动作含义尚不明确，不能据此确定中文动词释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Verb li jeħtieġ aktar kuntest biex ikun jista' jiġi spjegat liema azzjoni jfisser.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry identifies a verb, but its precise action remains unspecified.

collocations.en: the use of the verb 'stigma' in a sentence

formal.mt: Qabel ma nużaw il-verb 'stigma' f'eżempju, irridu niċċaraw it-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: Before using the verb 'stigma' in an example, we must clarify its meaning.
formal.zh: 在例句中使用动词“stigma”之前，我们必须先明确它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser il-verb 'stigma'? Lara: Għadna ma nafux biżżejjed; għandna bżonn aktar kuntest.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the verb 'stigma' mean? Lara: We do not know enough yet; we need more context.
colloquial.zh: Maja：动词“stigma”是什么意思？Lara：我们目前还不能确定，需要更多上下文。

messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser il-verb 'stigma'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser il-verb 'stigma'?
messages.zh: 动词“stigma”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the verb 'stigma' mean?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna ma nafux biżżejjed; għandna bżonn aktar kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna ma nafux biżżejjed; għandna bżonn aktar kuntest.
messages.zh: 我们目前还不能确定，需要更多上下文。
messages.en: We do not know enough yet; we need more context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记本条标为动词，再留空具体动作义；不要仅凭相似拼写猜测中文含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A distinctive way of expressing something, doing something, or designing its appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达、做事或设计外观时所呈现的独特方式，即风格或样式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mod partikolari kif wieħed jesprimi ruħu, jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jagħtiha dehra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某人、作品或事物在表达方式、做法或外观上呈现的风格或样式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod karatteristiku kif persuna tesprimi ruħha jew kif xi ħaġa tkun magħmula jew tidher.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The style of a person or thing is the characteristic way they express themselves, function, or appear.

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tuża stil ċar u dirett biex tispjega ideat kumplessi.
formal.en: The author uses a clear and direct style to explain complex ideas.
formal.zh: 这位女作者采用清晰直接的风格来解释复杂的观点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jogħġbok l-istil ta' din il-kamra? Mark: Iva, huwa sempliċi u komdu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like the style of this room? Mark: Yes, it is simple and comfortable.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢这个房间的风格吗？Mark：喜欢，简洁又舒适。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jogħġbok l-istil ta' din il-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Jogħġbok l-istil ta' din il-kamra?
messages.zh: 你喜欢这个房间的风格吗？
messages.en: Do you like the style of this room?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa sempliċi u komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa sempliċi u komdu.
messages.zh: 喜欢，简洁又舒适。
messages.en: Yes, it is simple and comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把文章、房间和穿着并排想象：它们各有一种风格，这个“风格”就是名词 stil。

gloss_zh: 风格上的；与表现手法有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to style, especially the choices used to express ideas in writing or art.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与风格有关的，尤其指写作或艺术表达中对形式和表现手法的选择。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-istil, speċjalment mal-għażliet ta' espressjoni fil-kitba jew fl-arti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涉及表达风格、形式或表现手法的，尤用于描述语言、文学和艺术。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-mod kif il-lingwa jew il-mezzi artistiċi jintużaw biex jinħoloq stil partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stylistic feature or choice concerns the particular way something is expressed or presented.

collocations.zh: 风格效果；表现手法产生的效果

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-effett stilistiku tar-ripetizzjoni fil-poeżija.
formal.en: The report examines the stylistic effect of repetition in the poem.
formal.zh: 这份报告分析了重复手法在这首诗中产生的风格效果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex l-awtur juża tant sentenzi qosra? Pawlu: Għal effett stilistiku; hekk il-ġrajja timxi aktar malajr.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does the author use so many short sentences? Pawlu: For a stylistic effect; they make the story move faster.
colloquial.zh: Sara：作者为什么用了这么多短句？Pawlu：这是为了产生一种风格效果，让故事节奏更快。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-awtur juża tant sentenzi qosra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-awtur juża tant sentenzi qosra?
messages.zh: 作者为什么用了这么多短句？
messages.en: Why does the author use so many short sentences?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal effett stilistiku; hekk il-ġrajja timxi aktar malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Għal effett stilistiku; hekk il-ġrajja timxi aktar malajr.
messages.zh: 这是为了产生一种风格效果，让故事节奏更快。
messages.en: For a stylistic effect; they make the story move faster.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 stilistiku 就问“这是表达风格上的什么特点？”用它修饰效果、要素或层面。

gloss_zh: 经过风格化处理的；以简化或夸张形式表现的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Represented using simplified or exaggerated forms to create a particular artistic style.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为形成某种艺术风格而对形态进行简化或夸张处理的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun irrappreżentat b'forom simplifikati jew esaġerati biex jinħoloq stil artistiku partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过艺术性的简化、夸张等处理，以特定风格呈现的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun mogħti dehra artistika partikolari permezz ta' simplifikazzjoni jew esaġerazzjoni tal-forom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is stylised uses simplified or exaggerated features to achieve a particular artistic effect.

collocations.zh: 经过风格化处理的肖像

formal.mt: Il-logo juri għasfur stilizzat b'żewġ linji mgħawġa u ċirku żgħir.
formal.en: The logo depicts a stylised bird using two curved lines and a small circle.
formal.zh: 这个标志用两条曲线和一个小圆呈现了一只风格化的鸟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-tpinġija ta' qattus? Mark: Iva, huwa qattus stilizzat; ftit linji biss juru l-forma tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a drawing of a cat? Mark: Yes, it is a stylised cat; just a few lines show its shape.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这画的是一只猫吗？Mark：是的，是一只风格化的猫，只用几条线来表现它的形状。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tpinġija ta' qattus?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tpinġija ta' qattus?
messages.zh: 这画的是一只猫吗？
messages.en: Is this a drawing of a cat?

messages.speaker: Mark (设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa qattus stilizzat; ftit linji biss juru l-forma tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa qattus stilizzat; ftit linji biss juru l-forma tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，是一只风格化的猫，只用几条线来表现它的形状。
messages.en: Yes, it is a stylised cat; just a few lines show its shape.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一只猫画成几条醒目的线：形象经过简化并形成艺术风格，就可以说 stilizzat。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Water in its gaseous form, produced when water is heated or boils.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水受热或沸腾后形成的气态水，日常常指从热水或器具中冒出的蒸汽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fwar tal-ilma li jinħoloq meta l-ilma jissaħħan jew jagħli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒸汽；水受热或沸腾后形成的水蒸气。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fwar li jinħoloq mill-ilma meta dan jissaħħan jew jagħli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Steam is water in its gaseous form, produced when water is heated or boils.

formal.mt: L-istim li joħroġ mill-ilma jagħli jista' jikkawża ħruq.
formal.en: The steam rising from boiling water can cause burns.
formal.zh: 沸水冒出的蒸汽可能造成烫伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistax niftaħ l-għatu issa? Mark: Għax għadu ħiereġ ħafna stim; stenna ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't I open the lid now? Mark: Because a lot of steam is still coming out; wait a moment.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么我现在不能打开盖子？Mark：因为还在冒很多蒸汽；等一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax niftaħ l-għatu issa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax niftaħ l-għatu issa?
messages.zh: 为什么我现在不能打开盖子？
messages.en: Why can't I open the lid now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għadu ħiereġ ħafna stim; stenna ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għadu ħiereġ ħafna stim; stenna ftit.
messages.zh: 因为还在冒很多蒸汽；等一会儿。
messages.en: Because a lot of steam is still coming out; wait a moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 stim 和水壶冒出的蒸汽画面绑定，再用「蒸汽机」magna tal-istim 巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance that increases activity in the body or brain and can make someone feel more alert.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能增强身体或大脑活动、使人更加清醒或兴奋的物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li żżid l-attività tal-ġisem jew tal-moħħ u tista' tagħmel lill-persuna aktar attenta jew imqajma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兴奋剂；能提高身体或大脑活动水平的刺激性物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sustanza li tistimula l-ġisem jew il-moħħ u tista' żżid l-attenzjoni jew iżżomm lill-persuna mqajma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stimulant is a substance that increases activity in your body or brain and can make you feel more alert.

formal.mt: Il-kaffeina hija stimulanti li tista' żżid l-attenzjoni u tagħmilha aktar diffiċli biex wieħed jorqod.
formal.en: Caffeine is a stimulant that can increase alertness and make it harder to fall asleep.
formal.zh: 咖啡因是一种能提高警觉性、也可能使人更难入睡的刺激物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tixrobx kafè filgħaxija? Mark: Għax il-kaffeina hija stimulanti, u wara ma nkunx nista' norqod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you drink coffee in the evening? Mark: Because caffeine is a stimulant, and afterwards I can't sleep.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么晚上不喝咖啡？Mark：因为咖啡因是刺激物，喝了以后我就睡不着。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tixrobx kafè filgħaxija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tixrobx kafè filgħaxija?
messages.zh: 你为什么晚上不喝咖啡？
messages.en: Why don't you drink coffee in the evening?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-kaffeina hija stimulanti, u wara ma nkunx nista' norqod.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-kaffeina hija stimulanti, u wara ma nkunx nista' norqod.
messages.zh: 因为咖啡因是刺激物，喝了以后我就睡不着。
messages.en: Because caffeine is a stimulant, and afterwards I can't sleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象晚上喝咖啡后精神振奋的画面，把 stimulanti 记作「让身体或大脑更活跃的物质」。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unwilling to change an opinion or course of action despite other people's reasons or advice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 即使别人提出理由或劝告，也不愿改变意见或做法的；固执的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' jinsisti fuq l-opinjoni jew id-deċiżjoni tiegħu u ma jkunx irid ibiddilha minkejja r-raġunijiet jew il-pariri ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 固执的；不愿听取他人的理由或建议来改变自己意见或做法的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx irid ibiddel fehmtu jew dak li jkun iddeċieda, anki meta ħaddieħor jipprova jipperswadih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is stubborn refuses to change their opinion or behaviour even when other people give them reasons to do so.

collocations.zh: 仍然固执；坚持不肯改变

formal.mt: Minkejja l-pariri tal-kollegi tiegħu, id-direttur baqa' stinat u rrifjuta li jbiddel il-pjan.
formal.en: Despite his colleagues' advice, the director remained stubborn and refused to change the plan.
formal.zh: 尽管同事们提出了建议，主任仍然很固执，拒绝修改计划。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk aċċetta li jibdel il-pjan? Mark: Le, għadu stinat u jrid jagħmel kollox kif jgħid hu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did your brother agree to change the plan? Mark: No, he's still stubborn and wants everything done his way.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥同意改计划了吗？Mark：没有，他还是很固执，什么都要按他的意思来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk aċċetta li jibdel il-pjan?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk aċċetta li jibdel il-pjan?
messages.zh: 你哥哥同意改计划了吗？
messages.en: Did your brother agree to change the plan?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu stinat u jrid jagħmel kollox kif jgħid hu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu stinat u jrid jagħmel kollox kif jgħid hu.
messages.zh: 没有，他还是很固执，什么都要按他的意思来。
messages.en: No, he's still stubborn and wants everything done his way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个抱着双臂、怎么劝也不改主意的人，用「仍然固执」jibqa' stinat 把词和情境连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a strong and sustained effort to achieve something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为实现某个目标付出很大且持续的努力；奋力争取。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel sforz kbir u kontinwu biex jilħaq għan jew jikseb xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 努力；为达到目标而尽力奋斗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħadem b'ħafna sforz u determinazzjoni biex jilħaq għan jew itejjeb xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you strive to achieve something, you make a strong and determined effort to succeed.

collocations.zh: 非常努力；付出了很大努力

formal.mt: L-istudent stinka matul is-sena kollha biex itejjeb il-kitba tiegħu bil-Malti.
formal.en: The student worked hard throughout the year to improve his writing in Maltese.
formal.zh: 这名学生一整年都在努力提高自己的马耳他语写作水平。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar ħuk fl-eżami? Mark: Mar tajjeb; stinka ħafna biex jipprepara.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did your brother do in the exam? Mark: He did well; he worked very hard to prepare.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥考试考得怎么样？Mark：考得不错；他为备考下了很大功夫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar ħuk fl-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar ħuk fl-eżami?
messages.zh: 你哥哥考试考得怎么样？
messages.en: How did your brother do in the exam?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mar tajjeb; stinka ħafna biex jipprepara.
messages.mt_standard: Mar tajjeb; stinka ħafna biex jipprepara.
messages.zh: 考得不错；他为备考下了很大功夫。
messages.en: He did well; he worked very hard to prepare.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用「努力加目标」来记：stinka ħafna 表示很努力，stinka biex jirnexxi 把努力和成功目标连起来；例句中的 stinka 表示他曾努力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Explicitly specified or agreed upon, especially in a contract, rule, or formal arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在合同、规则或正式安排中明确规定或约定的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie speċifikat jew miftiehem b'mod ċar, speċjalment f'kuntratt, regola jew arranġament formali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明确规定的，尤指在协议或正式文件中写明的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie stabbilit b'mod espliċitu bħala parti minn ftehim, kuntratt jew sett ta' regoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is stipulated is explicitly specified as a requirement or agreed condition.

collocations.en: the amount stipulated in the contract

formal.mt: Il-ħlas għandu jsir fiż-żmien stipulat fil-kuntratt.
formal.en: Payment must be made within the period stipulated in the contract.
formal.zh: 付款必须在合同规定的期限内完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sa xħin irridu naslu? Mark: Il-ħin stipulat huwa d-disgħa, mela nitilqu kmieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What time do we need to arrive by? Mark: The stipulated time is nine, so let's leave early.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们最晚几点要到？马克：规定的时间是九点，所以我们早点出发吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sa xħin irridu naslu?
messages.mt_standard: Sa xħin irridu naslu?
messages.zh: 我们最晚几点要到？
messages.en: What time do we need to arrive by?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħin stipulat huwa d-disgħa, mela nitilqu kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħin stipulat huwa d-disgħa, mela nitilqu kmieni.
messages.zh: 规定的时间是九点，所以我们早点出发吧。
messages.en: The stipulated time is nine, so let's leave early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象合同把时间和金额逐项写明：stipulat 表示已经明确规定或约定的。

gloss_zh: 已装载收妥；已妥善存放

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes material or equipment packed and put away securely for storage or transport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述物资或设备已经装好并妥善收存，以便储放或运输的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi materjal jew tagħmir li jkun ġie ppakkjat u mqiegħed sew f'post apposta għall-ħażna jew għat-trasport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已装载并收妥，指物品已妥善安放在储存或运输的位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tkun tqiegħdet u ġiet irranġata sew f'post għall-ħażna jew għat-trasport.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is stowed away, it has been packed or placed securely in a suitable storage space.

collocations.zh: 装载收妥于货舱内的物资

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, ġie kkonfermat li t-tagħmir kollu kien stivat sew fl-istiva.
formal.en: Before departure, it was confirmed that all the equipment was securely stowed in the hold.
formal.zh: 出发前，已确认全部设备均已在货舱内妥善装载收存。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu t-tagħmir tal-kampeġġ? Pawlu: Kollox stivat fil-vann; nistgħu nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the camping equipment? Pawlu: Everything is stowed in the van; we can leave.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：露营设备在哪里？保罗：都收妥在货车里了；我们可以出发了。

messages.speaker: Lara (露营伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu t-tagħmir tal-kampeġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu t-tagħmir tal-kampeġġ?
messages.zh: 露营设备在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the camping equipment?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (露营伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Kollox stivat fil-vann; nistgħu nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Kollox stivat fil-vann; nistgħu nitilqu.
