cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出发前把设备装进货舱并逐件放稳：stivat 记作已经装好、收妥的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job is to serve passengers or look after people and practical arrangements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责为乘客提供服务，或照料人员及处理现场事务的工作人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li taqdi lill-passiġġieri jew tieħu ħsieb in-nies u l-arranġamenti prattiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责服务和照料他人的工作人员，尤指飞机或船上的乘务员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna inkarigata li taqdi u tgħin lin-nies, speċjalment lill-passiġġieri fuq ajruplan jew vapur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A steward is someone employed to serve passengers or take care of people and practical arrangements.

collocations.en: to ask a steward for help

formal.mt: L-istjuward spjega lill-passiġġieri kif għandhom jużaw iċ-ċinturini tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: The steward explained to the passengers how to use their seat belts.
formal.zh: 乘务员向乘客讲解了安全带的使用方法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Skużani, inti l-istjuward? Nista' nitlob tazza ilma? Mark: Iva, żgur. Inġiblek waħda issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Excuse me, are you the steward? Could I have a glass of water? Mark: Yes, of course. I'll bring you one now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：打扰一下，您是乘务员吗？可以给我一杯水吗？马克：是的，当然可以。我现在就给您拿一杯。

messages.speaker: Nina (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, inti l-istjuward? Nista' nitlob tazza ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, inti l-istjuward? Nista' nitlob tazza ilma?
messages.zh: 打扰一下，您是乘务员吗？可以给我一杯水吗？
messages.en: Excuse me, are you the steward? Could I have a glass of water?

messages.speaker: Mark (乘务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żgur. Inġiblek waħda issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żgur. Inġiblek waħda issa.
messages.zh: 是的，当然可以。我现在就给您拿一杯。
messages.en: Yes, of course. I'll bring you one now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 stjuward 和机舱里讲解安全带、递水的工作人员联系起来，就能记住乘务员这一常见用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Calculated or judged an approximate amount, value, size, or extent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对数量、价值、大小或程度作了大致计算或判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikkalkula jew qies b'mod approssimattiv l-ammont, il-valur, id-daqs jew il-firxa ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 估算或估计了，即根据已有信息对数值或程度作出近似判断。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wasal għal kalkolu jew ġudizzju approssimattiv dwar xi ħaġa abbażi tal-informazzjoni disponibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an amount or value was estimated, it was calculated approximately using the information available.

formal.mt: Il-valur tal-bini ġie stmat għal mitejn elf ewro abbażi tal-kundizzjoni tiegħu u tal-prezzijiet fiż-żona.
formal.en: The building's value was estimated at two hundred thousand euros based on its condition and local prices.
formal.zh: 根据建筑的状况和当地价格，该建筑的价值被估算为二十万欧元。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm se jdum ix-xogħol? Toni: Ġie stmat li jieħu ġimgħa, imma għadna rridu nikkonfermaw.
colloquial.en: Sara: How long will the work take? Toni: It was estimated to take a week, but we still need to confirm.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这项工作要花多久？托尼：估计需要一周，不过我们还得确认。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm se jdum ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm se jdum ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 这项工作要花多久？
messages.en: How long will the work take?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġie stmat li jieħu ġimgħa, imma għadna rridu nikkonfermaw.
messages.mt_standard: Ġie stmat li jieħu ġimgħa, imma għadna rridu nikkonfermaw.
messages.zh: 估计需要一周，不过我们还得确认。
messages.en: It was estimated to take a week, but we still need to confirm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 stmat 就联想预算表上标着约数的金额；连同 ġie stmat li 一起记，表示据估计。

gloss_zh: 受重视的；受尊敬的（复数）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Regarded as important or worthy of respect and appreciation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到重视、尊敬或珍视的，用于描述多个对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meqjusa importanti jew denji ta' rispett u apprezzament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到重视或珍视的；受尊敬的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jingħataw importanza u jitqiesu b'rispett jew apprezzament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People or things that are valued are considered important and are treated with respect or appreciation.

formal.mt: Dawn l-għalliema huma stmati għall-paċenzja tagħhom u għall-għajnuna li jagħtu lill-istudenti.
formal.en: These teachers are valued for their patience and the help they give students.
formal.zh: 这些教师因耐心以及对学生的帮助而备受重视。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd jitkellem tajjeb dwar dawn l-għalliema? Lara: Għax huma stmati ħafna u dejjem jgħinuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does everyone speak well of these teachers? Lara: Because they are highly valued and always help us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么大家都称赞这些老师？拉拉：因为他们很受重视，而且总是帮助我们。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd jitkellem tajjeb dwar dawn l-għalliema?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd jitkellem tajjeb dwar dawn l-għalliema?
messages.zh: 为什么大家都称赞这些老师？
messages.en: Why does everyone speak well of these teachers?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huma stmati ħafna u dejjem jgħinuna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huma stmati ħafna u dejjem jgħinuna.
messages.zh: 因为他们很受重视，而且总是帮助我们。
messages.en: Because they are highly valued and always help us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群老师收到学生的感谢卡：他们都是受重视的。把 stmati 与复数短语 għalliema stmati 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel dislike for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事产生不喜欢、反感或厌恶的感受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħass li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa ma jogħġbux u qanqallu sentiment ta' stmerrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不喜欢某人或某物；对其感到反感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħass nuqqas ta' simpatija jew stmerrija lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone dislikes a person or thing, they find that person or thing unpleasant or unappealing.

formal.mt: Il-kittieb stmerra l-imġiba tal-karattru prinċipali u wera dan b'mod ċar fir-rumanz.
formal.en: The writer disliked the main character's behaviour and made this clear in the novel.
formal.zh: 作家厌恶主人公的行为，并在小说中明确表达了这一点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark għoġbitu l-idea tal-festa? Maja: Le, stmerra l-idea ta' festa kbira u pprefera ikla mal-ħbieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark like the idea of the party? Maja: No, he disliked the idea of a big party and preferred a meal with friends.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克喜欢办派对这个想法吗？玛雅：不，他不喜欢办大型派对，宁愿和朋友吃顿饭。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark għoġbitu l-idea tal-festa?
messages.mt_standard: Mark għoġbitu l-idea tal-festa?
messages.zh: 马克喜欢办派对这个想法吗？
messages.en: Did Mark like the idea of the party?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, stmerra l-idea ta' festa kbira u pprefera ikla mal-ħbieb.
messages.mt_standard: Le, stmerra l-idea ta' festa kbira u pprefera ikla mal-ħbieb.
messages.zh: 不，他不喜欢办大型派对，宁愿和朋友吃顿饭。
messages.en: No, he disliked the idea of a big party and preferred a meal with friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到一个不喜欢的主意时皱起眉头，把这个反感表情与 stmerra l-idea 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Material used for making clothes, curtains, and other textile items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于制作衣服、窗帘及其他纺织用品的布料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal tessili li jintuża biex isiru ħwejjeġ, purtieri u oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布；用于缝制衣物或其他用品的纺织材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal magħmul minn ħjut minsuġa jew maħduma flimkien, li jista' jinqata' u jinħiet biex isiru diversi oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cloth is textile material that is used to make clothing, curtains, and other household items.

formal.mt: Għal dan il-proġett, l-istudenti għandhom jagħżlu biċċa stoffa tal-qoton u jiddeskrivu l-kulur u n-nisġa tagħha.
formal.en: For this project, students should choose a piece of cotton fabric and describe its colour and texture.
formal.zh: 在这个项目中，学生应选择一块棉布，并描述它的颜色和质地。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek stoffa blu għall-purtieri? Rita: Iva, għandi din. Trid tmissha biex tara jekk togħġbokx?
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have blue fabric for curtains? Rita: Yes, I have this one. Would you like to feel it to see whether you like it?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有做窗帘用的蓝色布料吗？丽塔：有，我有这一款。你想摸摸看喜不喜欢吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek stoffa blu għall-purtieri?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek stoffa blu għall-purtieri?
messages.zh: 你有做窗帘用的蓝色布料吗？
messages.en: Do you have blue fabric for curtains?

messages.speaker: Rita (布店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi din. Trid tmissha biex tara jekk togħġbokx?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi din. Trid tmissha biex tara jekk togħġbokx?
messages.zh: 有，我有这一款。你想摸摸看喜不喜欢吗？
messages.en: Yes, I have this one. Would you like to feel it to see whether you like it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在布店摸一块柔软的布，用 biċċa stoffa 对应一块布，再把 stoffa 与布料的触感联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft material used to fill gaps or secure glass, or a supply of goods kept for use or sale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可用于填补缝隙或固定玻璃的油灰；也指储备供使用或出售的货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal artab li jintuża biex jimla xquq jew iżomm il-ħġieġ f'postu; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll kwantità ta' oġġetti miżmuma għall-użu jew għall-bejgħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于填缝或固定窗玻璃的油灰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal artab li jista' jingħata forma u li jintuża biex jimla xquq jew iżomm il-ħġieġ fit-twieqi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Putty is a soft material used to fill small gaps or hold window glass in place.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储备供销售或使用的货物；存货，库存。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwantità ta' prodotti jew materjali li ħanut, negozju jew persuna jżommu biex ibigħu jew jużaw.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shop's stock consists of the goods it keeps available for customers to buy.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jinbeda x-xogħol fuq it-twieqi, għandu jiġi ċċekkjat jekk hemmx biżżejjed stokk fil-maħżen.
formal.en: Before work on the windows begins, a check should be made to ensure that there is enough putty in the storeroom.
formal.zh: 开始修理窗户之前，应检查库房里是否有足够的油灰。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom stokk għat-twieqi? Rita: Iva, għandna biżżejjed fl-istokk. Kemm għandek bżonn?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have putty for windows? Rita: Yes, we have plenty in stock. How much do you need?
colloquial.zh: Mark：你们有窗用油灰吗？Rita：有，我们库存充足。你需要多少？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom stokk għat-twieqi?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom stokk għat-twieqi?
messages.zh: 你们有窗用油灰吗？
messages.en: Do you have putty for windows?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna biżżejjed fl-istokk. Kemm għandek bżonn?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna biżżejjed fl-istokk. Kemm għandek bżonn?
messages.zh: 有，我们库存充足。你需要多少？
messages.en: Yes, we have plenty in stock. How much do you need?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项放进同一家五金店：修窗时拿的是油灰 stokk，盘点货架时查的是库存 stokk；用使用场景区分词义。

gloss_zh: 唱走调；音不准；显得不协调

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing or sound out of tune, or to clash with the surrounding sound, style, or mood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 唱歌或发声时音调不准；也可指与周围的声音、风格或气氛不协调。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikanta jew idoqq b'noti li mhumiex tajbin; jista' jfisser ukoll li ma jaqbilx mal-ħoss, mal-istil jew mal-atmosfera ta' madwaru.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing tunelessly, to be out of tune, to strike the wrong chord
sense_translations.zh_definition: 唱歌走调，声音不合调；也可比喻言行或事物与场合不协调。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikanta jew jagħmel ħoss li ma jaqbilx man-noti meħtieġa, jew b'mod figurattiv ma jkunx jaqbel mas-sitwazzjoni jew mal-atmosfera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone stona, they sing out of tune; figuratively, something can also clash with the mood or setting.

collocations.en: sang the final note out of tune
sang out of tune with the rest of the choir
collocations.zh: 唱得与合唱团其他人不合调

formal.mt: Għalkemm il-kantant stona fl-aħħar nota, il-prestazzjoni tiegħu ntlaqgħet tajjeb mill-udjenza.
formal.en: Although the singer sang the final note out of tune, the audience received his performance well.
formal.zh: 虽然歌手最后一个音唱走调了，观众仍对他的表演反应良好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kantant stona f'dik il-parti, hux? Pawlu: Iva, imma malajr reġa' sab in-nota t-tajba.
colloquial.en: Maja: The singer went out of tune in that part, didn't he? Pawlu: Yes, but he quickly found the right note again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：歌手那一段唱走调了，对吧？Pawlu：是啊，不过他很快又找准了音。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kantant stona f'dik il-parti, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kantant stona f'dik il-parti, hux?
messages.zh: 歌手那一段唱走调了，对吧？
messages.en: The singer went out of tune in that part, didn't he?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma malajr reġa' sab in-nota t-tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma malajr reġa' sab in-nota t-tajba.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过他很快又找准了音。
messages.en: Yes, but he quickly found the right note again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象合唱时突然冒出一个不合调的音，把 stona 和“走调”绑在一起；再联想到一句话破坏气氛，也是不协调。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition in which the stomach feels uncomfortable, sometimes with nausea or digestive disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胃里感到不舒服的状态，有时伴随恶心、反胃或消化不适。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' skumdità fl-istonku li jista' jkun akkumpanjat minn dardir jew problemi fid-diġestjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胃部不适，可能伴随恶心、反胃或消化紊乱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha persuna tħoss skumdità fl-istonku, xi drabi flimkien ma' dardir jew diffikultà fid-diġestjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have an upset stomach, your stomach feels uncomfortable and you may feel sick.

collocations.en: to feel stomach discomfort after eating
to wake up with an upset stomach

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant ma attendiex il-laqgħa għax kellu l-istonku mqalleb u ma kienx iħossu tajjeb.
formal.en: The participant did not attend the meeting because he had an upset stomach and was feeling unwell.
formal.zh: 该参与者因胃部不适、身体不舒服而没有出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi l-istonku mqalleb u ma tantx għandi aptit niekol. Nina: Trid tistrieħ ftit qabel noħorġu?
colloquial.en: Lara: I have an upset stomach and don't really feel like eating. Nina: Would you like to rest a little before we go out?
colloquial.zh: Lara：我胃不舒服，不太想吃东西。Nina：出门前你想先休息一会儿吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi l-istonku mqalleb u ma tantx għandi aptit niekol.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi l-istonku mqalleb u ma tantx għandi aptit niekol.
messages.zh: 我胃不舒服，不太想吃东西。
messages.en: I have an upset stomach and don't really feel like eating.

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tistrieħ ftit qabel noħorġu?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tistrieħ ftit qabel noħorġu?
messages.zh: 出门前你想先休息一会儿吗？
messages.en: Would you like to rest a little before we go out?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手轻按胃部，配合整句 Għandi l-istonku mqalleb 记忆“我胃不舒服”；把短语与身体感受相连，不必只记成胃痛。

gloss_zh: 吵闹的；喧闹失序的；骚动的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Making much noise, behaving loudly and disruptively, or characterized by agitation and disorder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出很多噪声的；行为喧闹、扰人的；也可形容充满骚动或混乱的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel ħafna storbju, li jġib ruħu b'mod għajjat u jfixkel lil ħaddieħor, jew li jkun mimli aġitazzjoni u diżordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声音很大的；充满噪声的，吵闹的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħmel ħafna ħoss jew li jkun hemm fih ħafna storbju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A noisy person, place, or activity produces a lot of sound, often enough to disturb others.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为喧闹、失序并干扰他人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'mod storbjuż u bla ordni, b'tali mod li jfixkel lil ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Rowdy people behave in a loud and disorderly way that can disturb those around them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 充满骚动、动荡或混乱的；不平静的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ikkaratterizzat minn taqlib, aġitazzjoni jew moviment qawwi u bla ordni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something turbulent is marked by agitation, disorder, or strong and irregular movement.

formal.mt: Il-grupp storbjuż fixkel il-laqgħa, u l-organizzaturi talbu lill-membri tiegħu biex jitkellmu b'leħen aktar baxx.
formal.en: The rowdy group disrupted the meeting, and the organizers asked its members to speak more quietly.
formal.zh: 那群喧闹的人干扰了会议，组织者请他们降低说话的音量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-post huwa storbjuż wisq; immorru x'imkien aktar kwiet? Ben: Iva, ejja noqogħdu barra, 'il bogħod mill-mużika.
colloquial.en: Sara: This place is too noisy; shall we go somewhere quieter? Ben: Yes, let's sit outside, away from the music.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里太吵了，我们去个安静一点的地方好吗？Ben：好，我们坐到外面去，离音乐远一点。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-post huwa storbjuż wisq; immorru x'imkien aktar kwiet?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-post huwa storbjuż wisq; immorru x'imkien aktar kwiet?
messages.zh: 这里太吵了，我们去个安静一点的地方好吗？
messages.en: This place is too noisy; shall we go somewhere quieter?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja noqogħdu barra, 'il bogħod mill-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja noqogħdu barra, 'il bogħod mill-mużika.
messages.zh: 好，我们坐到外面去，离音乐远一点。
messages.en: Yes, let's sit outside, away from the music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三个画面记 storbjuż：机器声音大是“吵”，人群大声失序是“闹”，场面充满骚动是“乱”；根据所修饰的对象选中文。

gloss_zh: 使震懵；使眩晕；感到眩晕

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stun someone, to make someone feel dizzy, or to become dizzy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人一时震懵或感到眩晕，也可指自己感到眩晕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħalli lil xi ħadd għal ftit bla ħila jirreaġixxi, iġiegħlu jħoss sturdament, jew jibda jħoss sturdament hu stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人一时震懵，暂时无法正常反应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iħalli lil xi ħadd għal ftit bla ħila jaħseb jew jirreaġixxi b'mod normali minħabba daqqa jew ħoss qawwi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something stuns you, it temporarily prevents you from thinking or reacting normally.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人头晕，产生身体或周围事物在旋转的感觉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss rasu ddur jew jitlef is-sens tal-bilanċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something makes you dizzy, it causes a spinning sensation or difficulty keeping your balance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始感到头晕或失去平衡。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibda jħoss rasu ddur jew iħoss li ma jistax iżomm il-bilanċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you get dizzy, you begin to feel that you or your surroundings are spinning.

collocations.en: he became dizzy when he stood up quickly
collocations.zh: 他猛然起身时感到头晕

formal.mt: Il-ħoss qawwi storda lill-ħaddiema għal ftit sekondi.
formal.en: The loud noise stunned the workers for a few seconds.
formal.zh: 巨大的响声使工人们一时震懵，持续了几秒钟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil Mark? Lara: Qam malajr wisq u storda. Issa qiegħed bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to Mark? Lara: He stood up too quickly and got dizzy. He's sitting down now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么了？拉拉：他起身太快，头晕了。他现在坐着。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lil Mark?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lil Mark?
messages.zh: 马克怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Mark?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qam malajr wisq u storda. Issa qiegħed bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Qam malajr wisq u storda. Issa qiegħed bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 他起身太快，头晕了。他现在坐着。
messages.en: He stood up too quickly and got dizzy. He's sitting down now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记住：巨响把人震懵，猛然起身自己头晕；留意句中是谁造成眩晕、谁感到眩晕。

gloss_zh: 头晕的；晕眩的；迟钝乏力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling dizzy or unsteady, or being unusually sluggish and slow to react.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到头晕、站立不稳的；也可形容精神不振、行动或反应迟缓的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss rasu ddur jew ma jżommx il-bilanċ sew, jew li jkun bla ħeġġa u kajman fir-reazzjonijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头晕的，感觉自己或周围事物在旋转的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħoss rasu ddur jew li l-affarijiet ta' madwaru qegħdin iduru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are dizzy, you feel that you or the things around you are spinning.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晕眩而身体不稳的，难以保持平衡的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jħoss sturdament u ma jkunx jista' jżomm il-bilanċ sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you feel giddy, you feel unsteady and may have difficulty keeping your balance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迟钝乏力的，缺少活力且行动或反应缓慢的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun bla ħeġġa, ftit attiv u kajman ħafna fil-movimenti jew fir-reazzjonijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is torpid lacks energy and moves or reacts very slowly.

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, l-impjegat qal li kien stordut u talab li joqgħod bilqiegħda.
formal.en: During the meeting, the employee said that he felt dizzy and asked to sit down.
formal.zh: 会议期间，那名员工说自己感到头晕，并请求坐下。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid toħroġ magħna? Mark: Għadni stordut bin-ngħas. Ħallini nqum sew l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to come out with us? Mark: I'm still groggy with sleepiness. Let me wake up properly first.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想跟我们出去吗？马克：我还困得昏昏沉沉。先让我彻底清醒一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid toħroġ magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Trid toħroġ magħna?
messages.zh: 你想跟我们出去吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come out with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni stordut bin-ngħas. Ħallini nqum sew l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni stordut bin-ngħas. Ħallini nqum sew l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 我还困得昏昏沉沉。先让我彻底清醒一下。
messages.en: I'm still groggy with sleepiness. Let me wake up properly first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成描述人的状态：头在转是晕眩，困得反应慢是昏沉；结合上下文选择中文意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the past, or when considered from the perspective of history.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在过去的历史中，或从历史发展的角度来看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-passat, jew meta wieħed iqis xi ħaġa mill-perspettiva tal-istorja u tal-iżvilupp tagħha matul iż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在历史上；从历史事实或历史发展的角度来看。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'referenza għal dak li ġara fil-passat jew għall-mod kif xi ħaġa żviluppat matul l-istorja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use historically to discuss past conditions or to consider something from the perspective of history.

collocations.zh: 在历史上具有重要意义的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina kif l-użu tal-art inbidel storikament.
formal.en: The report examines how land use has changed historically.
formal.zh: 该报告考察了土地用途在历史上的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex trid iżżur dan il-bini? Pawlu: Għax hu storikament importanti, u nixtieq nitgħallem aktar dwaru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you want to visit this building? Pawlu: Because it's historically important, and I'd like to learn more about it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么想参观这座建筑？保罗：因为它在历史上很重要，我想多了解一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid iżżur dan il-bini?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid iżżur dan il-bini?
messages.zh: 你为什么想参观这座建筑？
messages.en: Why do you want to visit this building?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu storikament importanti, u nixtieq nitgħallem aktar dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu storikament importanti, u nixtieq nitgħallem aktar dwaru.
messages.zh: 因为它在历史上很重要，我想多了解一下。
messages.en: Because it's historically important, and I'd like to learn more about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到这个副词，先在心里加上“从历史上看”；它可以说明整句话的观察角度，也能修饰“重要”等形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to history, past events, or the study and representation of the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与历史、过去的事件，或对过去的研究和描写有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-istorja, mal-ġrajjiet tal-passat, jew mal-istudju u r-rakkont tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 历史的，涉及过去的事件或历史研究、记述的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-istorja jew li jittratta ġrajjiet, nies u kundizzjonijiet tal-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is historical relates to past events or to the study and description of history.

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza dokument storiku biex jifhem aħjar il-ħajja ta' kuljum fil-passat.
formal.en: The study analyses a historical document to better understand everyday life in the past.
formal.zh: 该研究通过分析一份历史文献，更深入地了解过去的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed taqra bħalissa? Mark: Rumanz storiku. L-istorja sseħħ fil-passat, u l-karattri huma interessanti ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you reading at the moment? Mark: A historical novel. The story takes place in the past, and the characters are very interesting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你最近在读什么？马克：一本历史小说。故事发生在过去，人物都很有意思。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed taqra bħalissa?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed taqra bħalissa?
messages.zh: 你最近在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading at the moment?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rumanz storiku. L-istorja sseħħ fil-passat, u l-karattri huma interessanti ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Rumanz storiku. L-istorja sseħħ fil-passat, u l-karattri huma interessanti ħafna.
messages.zh: 一本历史小说。故事发生在过去，人物都很有意思。
messages.en: A historical novel. The story takes place in the past, and the characters are very interesting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“历史的”贴在名词旁边记忆：文献是 dokument storiku，小说是 rumanz storiku；这里的词负责说明名词与历史有关。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cartridge containing ammunition for a firearm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供枪械使用的弹药筒，是装有发射所需材料的弹药单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità ta' munizzjon għal arma tan-nar, magħmula minn qoxra li żżomm il-materjal meħtieġ għall-isparatura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 枪械使用的弹药筒；一发装在筒壳内的弹药。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontenitur li jiġbor fih il-komponenti ta' tir u jintuża bħala unità ta' munizzjon f'arma tan-nar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cartridge is a unit of ammunition containing the components needed for a firearm to discharge a shot.

formal.mt: Fil-vetrina tal-mużew hemm stoċċ vojt ħdejn deskrizzjoni tal-użu tiegħu fil-kaċċa.
formal.en: In the museum display case, there is an empty cartridge beside a description of its use in hunting.
formal.zh: 博物馆的展柜里有一个空弹药筒，旁边介绍了它在狩猎中的用途。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak fil-vetrina? Pawlu: Dak stoċċ vojt; it-tikketta tgħid li kien jintuża għall-kaċċa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is that in the display case? Pawlu: That is an empty cartridge; the label says it was used for hunting.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：展柜里的那个是什么？保罗：那是一个空弹药筒；标签说它过去用于狩猎。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak fil-vetrina?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak fil-vetrina?
messages.zh: 展柜里的那个是什么？
messages.en: What is that in the display case?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak stoċċ vojt; it-tikketta tgħid li kien jintuża għall-kaċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Dak stoċċ vojt; it-tikketta tgħid li kien jintuża għall-kaċċa.
messages.zh: 那是一个空弹药筒；标签说它过去用于狩猎。
messages.en: That is an empty cartridge; the label says it was used for hunting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象博物馆展柜中标着 stoċċ 的弹药筒，再用 stoċċ vojt 记住空弹药筒这一具体搭配。

gloss_zh: 健康声称；关于健康功效的宣称

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement claiming that a product, food, or substance has a particular benefit for health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声称某种产品、食品或物质具有特定健康益处的表述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li ssostni li prodott, ikel jew sustanza għandhom benefiċċju partikolari għas-saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关于某种产品、食品或物质有益于健康的声称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stqarrija li tgħid li prodott, ikel jew sustanza għandhom effett ta' ġid fuq is-saħħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A health claim is a statement that says a product, food, or substance provides a particular health benefit.

collocations.en: a health claim on the label

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jevalwa l-evidenza li ssostni l-istqarrija dwar is-saħħa fuq it-tikketta tal-prodott.
formal.en: The report evaluates the evidence supporting the health claim on the product label.
formal.zh: 该报告评估了支持产品标签上健康声称的证据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq il-kaxxa hemm stqarrija dwar is-saħħa. Taħseb li hija vera? Pawlu: Ejja naraw x'evidenza hemm qabel nixtruh.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a health claim on the box. Do you think it's true? Pawlu: Let's see what evidence there is before we buy it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：盒子上有一项健康声称。你觉得是真的吗？Pawlu：我们买之前先看看有什么证据吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-kaxxa hemm stqarrija dwar is-saħħa. Taħseb li hija vera?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-kaxxa hemm stqarrija dwar is-saħħa. Taħseb li hija vera?
messages.zh: 盒子上有一项健康声称。你觉得是真的吗？
messages.en: There's a health claim on the box. Do you think it's true?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naraw x'evidenza hemm qabel nixtruh.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naraw x'evidenza hemm qabel nixtruh.
messages.zh: 我们买之前先看看有什么证据吧。
messages.en: Let's see what evidence there is before we buy it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词与食品包装上“有益健康”的文字一起记：这里指健康功效声称，阅读时联想“声称了什么、证据是什么”。

gloss_zh: 隐私告知；隐私政策声明；隐私声明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A notice or statement explaining how an organization collects, uses, and protects personal information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说明某个组织如何收集、使用和保护个人信息的告知或声明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avviż jew dikjarazzjoni li jispjegaw kif organizzazzjoni tiġbor, tuża u tipproteġi l-informazzjoni personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向个人告知其个人信息将如何被收集和使用的隐私告知。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avviż li jinforma lill-persuni dwar kif tinġabar u tintuża l-informazzjoni personali tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A privacy notice tells people how an organization collects and uses their personal information.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阐明某个组织处理和保护个人信息所遵循政策的隐私政策声明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li tispjega l-politika ta' organizzazzjoni dwar l-użu u l-protezzjoni tal-informazzjoni personali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A privacy policy statement sets out an organization's policy for handling and protecting personal information.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说明个人信息处理方式及隐私保护做法的隐私声明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni li tiddeskrivi kif tiġi ttrattata l-informazzjoni personali u kif titħares il-privatezza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A privacy statement explains how personal information is handled and what measures are taken to protect privacy.

formal.mt: L-istqarrija ta' privatezza tispjega għaliex il-kumpanija tiġbor id-dettalji tal-klijenti u kif tużahom.
formal.en: The privacy statement explains why the company collects customers' details and how it uses them.
formal.zh: 隐私声明说明了公司为何收集客户资料，以及如何使用这些资料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn nista' naqra kif jużaw id-dettalji tiegħi? Mark: Iftaħ l-istqarrija ta' privatezza fil-qiegħ tal-paġna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I read how they use my details? Mark: Open the privacy statement at the bottom of the page.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我在哪里能看到他们如何使用我的资料？Mark：打开页面底部的隐私声明。

messages.speaker: Lara (网站用户)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' naqra kif jużaw id-dettalji tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' naqra kif jużaw id-dettalji tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我在哪里能看到他们如何使用我的资料？
messages.en: Where can I read how they use my details?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iftaħ l-istqarrija ta' privatezza fil-qiegħ tal-paġna.
messages.mt_standard: Iftaħ l-istqarrija ta' privatezza fil-qiegħ tal-paġna.
messages.zh: 打开页面底部的隐私声明。
messages.en: Open the privacy statement at the bottom of the page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想注册网站时页面底部的“隐私声明”：把整个词组与“收集哪些资料、如何使用资料”绑定记忆，三个英语义项都围绕这一用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period when workers collectively stop working to press for changes in pay, conditions, or other workplace matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 劳动者为争取薪酬、工作条件或其他工作事项的改变而集体停止工作的行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni kollettiva li fiha l-ħaddiema jieqfu jaħdmu biex jitolbu tibdil fil-pagi, fil-kundizzjonijiet jew fi kwistjonijiet oħra tax-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罢工，指劳动者为表达诉求或争取改变而集体停止工作的行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waqfien kollettiv mix-xogħol li jagħmlu l-ħaddiema biex jesprimu talbiet jew jitolbu tibdil marbut max-xogħol tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A strike is an action in which workers stop working together to press their employer or another authority to meet their demands.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema ħabbru strajk ta' ġurnata biex jitolbu kundizzjonijiet aħjar tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The workers announced a one-day strike to demand better working conditions.
formal.zh: 工人宣布将举行为期一天的罢工，要求改善工作条件。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-fabbrika magħluqa llum? Toni: Il-ħaddiema qed jagħmlu strajk għax iridu pagi aħjar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is the factory closed today? Toni: The workers are on strike because they want better pay.
colloquial.zh: Nina：工厂今天为什么关门了？Toni：工人正在罢工，因为他们要求提高工资。

messages.speaker: Nina (附近居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-fabbrika magħluqa llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-fabbrika magħluqa llum?
messages.zh: 工厂今天为什么关门了？
messages.en: Why is the factory closed today?

messages.speaker: Toni (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħaddiema qed jagħmlu strajk għax iridu pagi aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħaddiema qed jagħmlu strajk għax iridu pagi aħjar.
messages.zh: 工人正在罢工，因为他们要求提高工资。
messages.en: The workers are on strike because they want better pay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 可以借英语 strike 的相近读音辅助记住 strajk，再配上“工人集体停工”的画面；把 jagħmlu strajk 整组记成“他们举行罢工”。

gloss_zh: 勒颈；扼颈；勒颈或扼颈造成的窒息

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of squeezing someone's neck so that breathing is restricted or stopped.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 压迫或勒紧某人的颈部，使其呼吸受阻或停止的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għafis jew l-issikkar tal-għonq ta' persuna b'mod li jfixkel jew iwaqqaf in-nifs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勒颈或扼颈，使呼吸受阻或停止；亦指由此造成的窒息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għafis jew l-issikkar tal-għonq li jfixkel jew iwaqqaf in-nifs ta' persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Strangulation occurs when someone's neck is squeezed or tightened around, restricting or stopping their breathing.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi sinjali ta' strangulazzjoni fuq l-għonq tal-vittma.
formal.en: The report describes signs of strangulation on the victim's neck.
formal.zh: 报告描述了受害者颈部的勒颈或扼颈迹象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'strangulazzjoni' f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Tfisser li xi ħadd jagħfas jew jissikka għonq persuna u jfixklilha n-nifs.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'strangulazzjoni' mean in this text? Pawlu: It means someone squeezes or tightens something around a person's neck and restricts their breathing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章里的 strangulazzjoni 是什么意思？保罗：指有人压迫或勒紧一个人的颈部，使其呼吸受阻。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'strangulazzjoni' f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'strangulazzjoni' f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 strangulazzjoni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'strangulazzjoni' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li xi ħadd jagħfas jew jissikka għonq persuna u jfixklilha n-nifs.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li xi ħadd jagħfas jew jissikka għonq persuna u jfixklilha n-nifs.
messages.zh: 指有人压迫或勒紧一个人的颈部，使其呼吸受阻。
messages.en: It means someone squeezes or tightens something around a person's neck and restricts their breathing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“颈部受到压迫、呼吸受阻”的场景绑定记忆，再搭配 sinjali ta' strangulazzjoni 复习“勒颈或扼颈的迹象”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who comes from a country other than the country being referred to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自所谈论国家以外的其他国家的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġejja minn pajjiż differenti minn dak li jkun qed jissemma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外国人，指相对于所谈论国家而言来自其他国家的人；此处按名词理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna minn pajjiż ieħor, meqjusa bħala tali b'rabta mal-pajjiż li jkun qed jissemma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this noun sense, a stranġier is a person from a country other than the one being referred to.

collocations.zh: 居住在马耳他的外国人
正在学习马耳他语的外国人

formal.mt: L-artiklu jirrakkonta l-esperjenza ta' stranġier li mar jgħix Malta u beda jitgħallem il-Malti.
formal.en: The article recounts the experience of a foreigner who moved to Malta and began learning Maltese.
formal.zh: 这篇文章讲述了一名移居马耳他并开始学习马耳他语的外国人的经历。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif sejjer bil-Malti, Leo? Leo: Għadni nitgħallem. Jien stranġier, imma nipprova nitkellem bil-Malti kuljum.
colloquial.en: Anna: How is your Maltese coming along, Leo? Leo: I'm still learning. I'm a foreigner, but I try to speak Maltese every day.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Leo，你的马耳他语学得怎么样了？Leo：我还在学。我是外国人，不过我每天都尽量说马耳他语。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer bil-Malti, Leo?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer bil-Malti, Leo?
messages.zh: Leo，你的马耳他语学得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is your Maltese coming along, Leo?

messages.speaker: Leo (外国学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni nitgħallem. Jien stranġier, imma nipprova nitkellem bil-Malti kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni nitgħallem. Jien stranġier, imma nipprova nitkellem bil-Malti kuljum.
messages.zh: 我还在学。我是外国人，不过我每天都尽量说马耳他语。
messages.en: I'm still learning. I'm a foreigner, but I try to speak Maltese every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用自我介绍 Jien stranġier（我是外国人）记忆：这里整个词指“人”，对应英语名词 foreigner；给定的 foreign 提示要结合名词词性理解。

gloss_zh: 层；层状结构中的一层；地层

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thickness of material covering a surface or forming one level within a larger structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖在表面上或构成某种层状结构的一个厚度单位，可指涂层、材料层或地层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda ta' materjal b'ċerta ħxuna li tgħatti wiċċ jew tifforma livell wieħed fi struttura magħmula minn diversi saffi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 层；覆盖在表面上或叠置在其他材料上、具有一定厚度的一层物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwantità ta' materjal mifruxa fuq wiċċ jew fuq materjal ieħor u li għandha ċerta ħxuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A layer is a thickness of material that covers a surface or lies above or below another thickness.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地层；层状结构中可辨识的一层，尤指岩石或土壤的一层。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saff distint fi struttura magħmula minn diversi saffi, speċjalment saff ta' blat jew ħamrija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stratum is a distinct layer within a layered structure, especially a layer of rock or soil.

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi strat ta' blat li jinsab taħt il-ħamrija.
formal.en: The study describes a stratum of rock beneath the soil.
formal.zh: 该研究描述了土壤下方的一层岩层。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Naħseb li l-ħajt għadu jeħtieġ strat ieħor ta' żebgħa. Mark: Naqbel, għadni nara l-kulur l-antik.
colloquial.en: Lara: I think the wall still needs another layer of paint. Mark: I agree; I can still see the old colour.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我觉得这面墙还需要再刷一层漆。马克：同意，我还能看见原来的颜色。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li l-ħajt għadu jeħtieġ strat ieħor ta' żebgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li l-ħajt għadu jeħtieġ strat ieħor ta' żebgħa.
messages.zh: 我觉得这面墙还需要再刷一层漆。
messages.en: I think the wall still needs another layer of paint.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel, għadni nara l-kulur l-antik.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel, għadni nara l-kulur l-antik.
messages.zh: 同意，我还能看见原来的颜色。
messages.en: I agree; I can still see the old colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蛋糕或墙面的一层，再把画面换成地下岩层：strat 都抓住“整体中的一层”这个核心概念。

gloss_zh: 策略；战略；实现目标的行动计划

teaching_sense.en_definition: A planned approach or set of actions intended to achieve a particular goal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为实现某一目标而制定的总体行动计划或方法，可用于学习、工作、竞争等情境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjan jew sett ta' azzjonijiet maħsuba biex jintlaħaq għan partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 策略；战略；为达到特定目标而规划的一套方法和行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjan ġenerali li jorganizza l-metodi u l-azzjonijiet meħtieġa biex jintlaħaq għan partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A strategy is a planned way of acting that is intended to help you achieve a particular goal.

formal.mt: L-iskola adottat strateġija ġdida biex ittejjeb il-ħiliet tal-qari tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The school adopted a new strategy to improve students' reading skills.
formal.zh: 学校采用了一项新策略，以提高学生的阅读能力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi l-istrateġija tiegħek għall-eżami? David: Se nistudja ftit kuljum u nagħmel eżerċizzji fuq kull suġġett.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's your strategy for the exam? David: I'll study a little every day and do exercises on each topic.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你准备怎样应对考试？戴维：我会每天学一点，并针对每个主题做练习。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-istrateġija tiegħek għall-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-istrateġija tiegħek għall-eżami?
messages.zh: 你准备怎样应对考试？
messages.en: What's your strategy for the exam?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nistudja ftit kuljum u nagħmel eżerċizzji fuq kull suġġett.
messages.mt_standard: Se nistudja ftit kuljum u nagħmel eżerċizzji fuq kull suġġett.
messages.zh: 我会每天学一点，并针对每个主题做练习。
messages.en: I'll study a little every day and do exercises on each topic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“目标是什么、准备怎样做”这两个问题记住 strateġija；它指为目标组织起来的一套策略或计划。

gloss_zh: 战略性的；策略性的；具有战略重要性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to planning how to achieve a goal, or important for the success of such a plan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与实现目标的总体规划有关的，或对某项计划能否成功具有重要作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut ma' pjan biex jintlaħaq għan, jew li għandu importanza kbira għas-suċċess ta' dak il-pjan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 战略性的；与总体行动规划有关的，或对实现某项目标具有关键意义的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-tfassil ta' strateġija jew li huwa importanti biex jintlaħaq għan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something strategic relates to planning how to achieve a goal or has particular importance for the plan's success.

formal.mt: Il-pjan strateġiku tal-organizzazzjoni jistabbilixxi l-prijoritajiet għall-ħames snin li ġejjin.
formal.en: The organisation's strategic plan sets its priorities for the next five years.
formal.zh: 该组织的战略规划确定了未来五年的优先事项。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għażilt dan il-post għall-ħanut? Mark: Għax għandu vantaġġ strateġiku: jinsab ħdejn l-istazzjon u jgħaddu ħafna nies minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you choose this location for the shop? Mark: Because it has a strategic advantage: it's near the station, and lots of people pass by here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么选择在这里开店？马克：因为这里有战略优势：靠近车站，而且经过的人很多。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għażilt dan il-post għall-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għażilt dan il-post għall-ħanut?
messages.zh: 你为什么选择在这里开店？
messages.en: Why did you choose this location for the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu vantaġġ strateġiku: jinsab ħdejn l-istazzjon u jgħaddu ħafna nies minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu vantaġġ strateġiku: jinsab ħdejn l-istazzjon u jgħaddu ħafna nies minn hawn.
messages.zh: 因为这里有战略优势：靠近车站，而且经过的人很多。
messages.en: Because it has a strategic advantage: it's near the station, and lots of people pass by here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 strateġiku 放进 pjan strateġiku“战略规划”中记忆：它是形容词，用来说明某事与整体计划或目标成败有关。

gloss_zh: 奢华铺张的；过于讲究排场的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Spending or involving much more money or resources than is necessary or reasonable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花费或耗用的钱财、资源明显超过必要或合理程度的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi nfiq ta' flus jew użu ta' riżorsi ferm aktar milli jkun meħtieġ jew raġonevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奢侈铺张的；花费或耗用超出合理需要的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jonfoq ħafna aktar milli hemm bżonn, jew li jinvolvi spiża kbira żżejjed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something extravagant spends or requires much more money than is necessary or reasonable.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ċaħad il-proposta għal ċelebrazzjoni stravaganti minħabba l-baġit limitat.
formal.en: The committee rejected the proposal for an extravagant celebration because of the limited budget.
formal.zh: 委员会因预算有限，否决了举办铺张庆典的提议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-rigal mhux stravaganti wisq? Mark: Iva, ejja nagħżlu xi ħaġa aktar sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Isn't this gift a bit too extravagant? Mark: Yes, let's choose something simpler.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份礼物是不是太奢华了？Mark：是啊，我们选个简单些的吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-rigal mhux stravaganti wisq?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-rigal mhux stravaganti wisq?
messages.zh: 这份礼物是不是太奢华了？
messages.en: Isn't this gift a bit too extravagant?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nagħżlu xi ħaġa aktar sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nagħżlu xi ħaġa aktar sempliċi.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们选个简单些的吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's choose something simpler.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 stravaganti 与“礼物豪华到超出预算”的画面绑定记忆，重点记住它常含铺张、花费过度的意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mental or emotional pressure caused by demanding or worrying circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由繁重要求或令人担忧的处境引起的心理压力或情绪紧张。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pressjoni jew tensjoni mentali u emozzjonali li tinħoloq minħabba sitwazzjonijiet diffiċli, inkwiet jew ħafna responsabbiltajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因工作、责任或忧虑等产生的心理压力与紧张状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat ta' pressjoni jew tensjoni mentali u emozzjonali li persuna tħoss meta jkollha ħafna talbiet jew inkwiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Stress is the mental or emotional pressure you feel when circumstances are demanding or worrying.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-ammont kbir ta' xogħol żied l-istress fost l-impjegati.
formal.en: The report shows that the heavy workload increased stress among employees.
formal.zh: 报告显示，繁重的工作量增加了员工的心理压力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi ħafna stress minħabba l-eżamijiet. Pawlu: Trid tieħu pawża u toħroġ timxi miegħi?
colloquial.en: Lara: I'm under a lot of stress because of the exams. Pawlu: Do you want to take a break and go for a walk with me?
colloquial.zh: Lara：考试让我压力很大。Pawlu：你想休息一下，和我出去走走吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħafna stress minħabba l-eżamijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħafna stress minħabba l-eżamijiet.
messages.zh: 考试让我压力很大。
messages.en: I'm under a lot of stress because of the exams.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tieħu pawża u toħroġ timxi miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tieħu pawża u toħroġ timxi miegħi?
messages.zh: 你想休息一下，和我出去走走吗？
messages.en: Do you want to take a break and go for a walk with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 stress 就联想考试前脑中堆满任务的紧张感，再用 inaqqas l-istress“减轻压力”把名词和常见动作一起记住。

gloss_zh: 严格的；刻板不变的；严苛的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Requiring close obedience to rules or allowing very little freedom or flexibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求严格遵守规则，或几乎不允许自由变通的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitlob li r-regoli jiġu osservati bir-reqqa jew li ma jħallix wisq libertà jew flessibbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严格的；要求认真遵守规则、纪律或指示的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsisti fuq l-osservanza tar-regoli, tad-dixxiplina jew tal-istruzzjonijiet u ma jaċċettax faċilment ksur tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A strict person or rule requires people to obey instructions and maintain expected standards.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刻板的；固定而缺乏弹性、不容易随情况调整的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jibqa' fiss u ma jippermettix li jsiru bidliet jew adattamenti skont iċ-ċirkostanzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rigid arrangement remains fixed and allows little adaptation when circumstances or needs change.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严苛的；对标准、条件或限制要求很高且执行严格的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jimponi kundizzjonijiet, standards jew limiti iebsa li jridu jiġu ssodisfati b'mod preċiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stringent requirement sets demanding conditions that must be met very carefully and precisely.

formal.mt: Qabel ma l-prodott jitqiegħed fis-suq, irid jgħaddi minn kontroll strett tal-kwalità.
formal.en: Before the product is placed on the market, it must pass stringent quality control.
formal.zh: 产品投放市场前，必须通过严格的质量控制。

colloquial.mt: Nina: L-għalliem il-ġdid huwa strett? Samwel: Iva, iridna naslu fil-ħin u nlestu x-xogħol kollu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the new teacher strict? Samwel: Yes, he wants us to arrive on time and finish all the work.
colloquial.zh: Nina：新老师严格吗？Samwel：严格，他要求我们准时到，并完成所有作业。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem il-ġdid huwa strett?
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem il-ġdid huwa strett?
messages.zh: 新老师严格吗？
messages.en: Is the new teacher strict?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iridna naslu fil-ħin u nlestu x-xogħol kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iridna naslu fil-ħin u nlestu x-xogħol kollu.
messages.zh: 严格，他要求我们准时到，并完成所有作业。
messages.en: Yes, he wants us to arrive on time and finish all the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面区分 strett：老师要求守规矩是“严格”，框架不能调整是“刻板”，质检条件很高是“严苛”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that follows rules exactly, or considers a statement with complete precision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以完全遵守规则的方式；或从准确、严谨的角度限定一种说法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jsegwi r-regoli eżattament, jew li jqis stqarrija skont it-tifsira preċiża tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严格地；完全按照规定、条件或限制，不容偏离地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod rigoruż li jsegwi r-regoli jew il-kundizzjonijiet eżattament u ma jippermettix devjazzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is controlled strictly, the relevant rules are applied carefully without allowing exceptions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严格说来；按照词义、定义或事实的准确界限来判断。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta nitkellmu skont it-tifsira eżatta tal-kliem jew skont id-definizzjoni preċiża ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use strictly speaking to make a statement more exact by applying a precise definition or distinction.

formal.mt: L-aċċess għal dawn id-dokumenti huwa strettament limitat għall-persunal awtorizzat.
formal.en: Access to these documents is strictly limited to authorized personnel.
formal.zh: 这些文件的查阅权限严格限于获授权的人员。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Mela dan huwa żball? David: Jekk nitkellmu strettament, iva, imma t-tifsira għadha ċara.
colloquial.en: Marija: So this is a mistake? David: Strictly speaking, yes, but the meaning is still clear.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那么这算错误吗？David：严格说来，是的，不过意思仍然清楚。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela dan huwa żball?
messages.mt_standard: Mela dan huwa żball?
messages.zh: 那么这算错误吗？
messages.en: So this is a mistake?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk nitkellmu strettament, iva, imma t-tifsira għadha ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk nitkellmu strettament, iva, imma t-tifsira għadha ċara.
messages.zh: 严格说来，是的，不过意思仍然清楚。
messages.en: Strictly speaking, yes, but the meaning is still clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 strettament 放进两个句框记忆：规定被“严格地”执行，以及评价前先说“严格说来”；前者讲执行方式，后者限定判断角度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whom you do not know or who is not known in a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 你不认识的人，或在某个地方不为人们所认识的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ma tafhiex jew li mhix magħrufa f'post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陌生人；自己不认识或当地人不熟悉的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ma tkunx tafha jew li n-nies ta' post partikolari ma jkunux jafuha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stranger is someone you do not know or someone who is unfamiliar to the people in a particular place.

formal.mt: Meta stringier talab l-għajnuna biex isib l-istazzjon, ir-receptionist tah id-direzzjonijiet.
formal.en: When a stranger asked for help finding the station, the receptionist gave him directions.
formal.zh: 一位陌生人请求帮助寻找车站时，接待员给他指了路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma' min kont qed titkellem? Lara: Ma' stringier li ried ikun jaf fejn hi l-ispiżerija.

gloss_zh: 横幅；横幅广告；网页横幅

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long strip displaying a message, or a wide graphic displayed on a web page, often as an advertisement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 展示文字或图像的长条形横幅，也指网页上常用于广告的横幅图像。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp jew materjal ieħor f'għamla twila li turi messaġġ, jew element grafiku wiesa' fuq paġna tal-web, spiss użat għar-reklamar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 横幅；用于展示标语、通知或其他信息的长条形布幅或展示物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp jew materjal ieħor f'għamla twila li turi kliem jew stampi biex twassal messaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A banner is a long strip of material displaying words or pictures to communicate a message.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 横幅广告；通常以长条形图文形式出现在网页上的广告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reklam fuq paġna tal-web li jidher bħala żona tawwalija bi kliem jew stampi u li spiss jista' jingħafas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A banner ad is an advertisement displayed as a strip of text or images on a web page.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网页横幅；网页上用于显示标题、信息或广告的横向图像或图文区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Element grafiku wiesa' fuq paġna tal-web li juri titlu, informazzjoni jew reklam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A web banner is a wide graphic on a web page that presents a heading, information, or advertising.

collocations.en: a banner on the home page

formal.mt: L-iskola waħħlet strixxun mad-daħla biex tilqa' lill-istudenti l-ġodda.
formal.en: The school put up a banner at the entrance to welcome the new students.
formal.zh: 学校在入口处张贴了一条横幅，欢迎新生。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn se ndendlu l-istrixxun? Sara: Fuq il-bieb, biex kulħadd jarah.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where shall we hang the banner? Sara: Above the door, so everyone can see it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们把横幅挂在哪里？萨拉：挂在门上方，让大家都能看见。

messages.speaker: Mark (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se ndendlu l-istrixxun?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se ndendlu l-istrixxun?
messages.zh: 我们把横幅挂在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we hang the banner?

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-bieb, biex kulħadd jarah.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-bieb, biex kulħadd jarah.
messages.zh: 挂在门上方，让大家都能看见。
messages.en: Above the door, so everyone can see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象门上挂着一条长横幅，再把同样的长条形画面搬到网页上，就能串起实体横幅和网页横幅两个用法。

gloss_zh: 网页横幅；网页横幅广告

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wide graphic on a web page that displays a message, a heading, or an advertisement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 网页上用于展示信息、标题或广告的横向图像或图文区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element grafiku wiesa' fuq paġna tal-web li juri messaġġ, titlu jew reklam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网页中的横幅；以横向图文形式展示信息的页面元素。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona grafika tawwalija fuq paġna tal-web li tintuża biex turi kliem jew stampi u twassal messaġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A banner in this context is a wide visual element that displays a message on a web page.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网页横幅广告；以横幅图文形式展示、用于宣传商品或服务的网络广告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reklam f'għamla ta' strixxun fuq paġna tal-web li jippromwovi prodott jew servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A banner ad is a web advertisement that uses a strip of text or images to promote something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网页横幅；网页上的横向视觉区域，可用于页面标题、通知或广告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Element viżiv wiesa' fuq paġna tal-web li jista' juri titlu, avviż jew reklam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A web banner is a wide visual area on a web page used for headings, notices, or advertisements.

collocations.en: a web banner with a link to the shop
collocations.zh: 带有商店链接的网页横幅

collocations.en: a web banner for the campaign
collocations.zh: 用于宣传活动的网页横幅

formal.mt: Il-mużew ippubblika strixxun fuq il-web biex jinforma lill-viżitaturi dwar il-wirja l-ġdida.
formal.en: The museum published a web banner to inform visitors about the new exhibition.
formal.zh: 博物馆发布了一幅网页横幅，向访客介绍新展览。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt l-istrixxun fuq il-web dwar il-wirja? Mark: Iva, għafast fuqu u sibt il-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the web banner about the exhibition? Mark: Yes, I clicked it and found the opening hours.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到介绍展览的网页横幅了吗？马克：看到了，我点了一下，找到了开放时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt l-istrixxun fuq il-web dwar il-wirja?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt l-istrixxun fuq il-web dwar il-wirja?
messages.zh: 你看到介绍展览的网页横幅了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the web banner about the exhibition?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għafast fuqu u sibt il-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għafast fuqu u sibt il-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ.
messages.zh: 看到了，我点了一下，找到了开放时间。
messages.en: Yes, I clicked it and found the opening hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记忆：strixxun 是横幅，fuq il-web 表示在网上；想象网页顶部的一条展览通知即可。

gloss_zh: 广告横幅；横幅广告；网页广告横幅

teaching_sense.en_definition: A banner used to advertise a product, service, or event, either physically or on a web page.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于宣传商品、服务或活动的横幅，可以是实体广告横幅，也可以是网页广告横幅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxun li jintuża biex jirreklama prodott, servizz jew avveniment, kemm f'post fiżiku kif ukoll fuq paġna tal-web.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 广告横幅；展示宣传文字或图像的长条形广告展示物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strixxun bi kliem jew stampi li jintuża biex jirreklama prodott, servizz jew avveniment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An advertising banner is a long display carrying words or pictures that promote a product, service, or event.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 横幅广告；通常出现在网页上的长条形图文广告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reklam fuq paġna tal-web f'għamla ta' strixxun bi kliem jew stampi li jippromwovi xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A banner ad is a strip of advertising content on a web page that promotes a product or service.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网页广告横幅；在网页上以横向视觉区域展示的宣传内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Element grafiku wiesa' fuq paġna tal-web li jintuża għal skopijiet ta' reklamar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A web banner in this advertising sense is a wide graphic used to promote something on a web page.

collocations.en: an advertising banner on a website
an advertising banner for the new offer
collocations.zh: 宣传新优惠的广告横幅

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija poġġiet strixxun pubbliċitarju fuq is-sit elettroniku tagħha biex tippromwovi s-servizz il-ġdid.
formal.en: The company placed an advertising banner on its website to promote the new service.
formal.zh: 公司在自己的网站上放置了一幅广告横幅，用来推广新服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: L-istrixxun pubbliċitarju lest? Daniel: Kważi. Għad irrid inżid il-prezz u r-rabta għall-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the advertising banner ready? Daniel: Almost. I still need to add the price and the link to the shop.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：广告横幅做好了吗？丹尼尔：快好了。我还要加上价格和商店链接。

messages.speaker: Sara (市场推广同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-istrixxun pubbliċitarju lest?
messages.mt_standard: L-istrixxun pubbliċitarju lest?
messages.zh: 广告横幅做好了吗？
messages.en: Is the advertising banner ready?

messages.speaker: Daniel (设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Għad irrid inżid il-prezz u r-rabta għall-ħanut.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Għad irrid inżid il-prezz u r-rabta għall-ħanut.
messages.zh: 快好了。我还要加上价格和商店链接。
messages.en: Almost. I still need to add the price and the link to the shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 strixxun 想成横幅，把 pubbliċitarju 记作说明广告用途的词；看到价格、优惠和购买链接，就联想到广告横幅。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of lines forming one section of a poem or song.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 诗歌或歌曲中由若干行组成的一个段落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' versi li jifforma taqsima waħda f'poeżija jew f'għanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诗或歌曲中由若干行构成的一节。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqsima ta' poeżija jew ta' għanja magħmula minn grupp ta' versi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A verse is a group of lines that forms a section of a poem or song.

formal.mt: Fl-ewwel strofa tal-poeżija, il-poeta jiddeskrivi l-baħar filgħodu.
formal.en: In the first verse of the poem, the poet describes the sea in the morning.
formal.zh: 在这首诗的第一节中，诗人描写了清晨的大海。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema strofa se naqraw? Pawlu: Ejja naqraw l-ewwel strofa flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which verse are we going to read? Pawlu: Let's read the first verse together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们要读哪一节？保罗：我们一起读第一节吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema strofa se naqraw?
messages.mt_standard: Liema strofa se naqraw?
messages.zh: 我们要读哪一节？
messages.en: Which verse are we going to read?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw l-ewwel strofa flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw l-ewwel strofa flimkien.
messages.zh: 我们一起读第一节吧。
messages.en: Let's read the first verse together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象诗页上用空行隔开的一个小段，把 strofa 和“一组诗行构成的一节”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool or device used for a particular task, including making measurements or producing music.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于特定工作的工具或装置，可指测量仪器，也可指演奏音乐的乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda jew apparat li jintuża għal xogħol partikolari, bħal kejl jew daqq tal-mużika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 执行某种操作的工具或仪器，也可指演奏音乐的乐器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda jew apparat għal għan partikolari, jew oġġett li jindaqq biex tinħoloq il-mużika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular purpose, such as measuring something or making music.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istrument tal-kejl użat biex titkejjel it-temperatura tal-ilma.
formal.en: The report describes the measuring instrument used to measure the water temperature.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了用于测量水温的仪器。

colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你演奏什么乐器？马克：我弹吉他。你呢？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Indoqq il-kitarra. U int?
messages.mt_standard: Indoqq il-kitarra. U int?
messages.zh: 我弹吉他。你呢？
messages.en: I play the guitar. And you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 strument 放进两个画面记忆：实验桌上的仪器和舞台上的乐器，再用后面的修饰语判断具体意思。

gloss_zh: 植入器；用于安装植入物的器械

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument used to place and secure an implant in its intended position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于把植入物放置并固定在预定位置的器械。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li jintuża biex jitqiegħed u jitwaħħal impjant fil-post maħsub għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于放置或安装植入物的专用器械。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda apposta li tintuża biex jitqiegħed jew jitwaħħal impjant fil-pożizzjoni meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An implanter is an instrument used to place an implant in the position intended for it.

il-preparazzjoni ta' strument biex jitwaħħal impjant

formal.zh: 手册介绍了植入器在医疗操作中的作用。

colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个器械是做什么用的？戴维：这是用来安装植入物的器械。

messages.mt_standard: Dan hu strument biex jitwaħħal impjant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按功能拆记整组短语：strument 是器械，后面的部分说明“用来安装植入物”，脑中配上器械定位植入物的画面。

sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument maħsub biex tinjetta sustanza fl-intern ta' bajda.

exact_key: strument għall-amministrazzjoni bi pressjoni gholja biex tgħaddi s-sustanza mill-ġilda

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that uses high pressure to deliver a substance through the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用高压使物质穿过皮肤、实现经皮给药或输送的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li juża pressjoni għolja biex iwassal sustanza minn ġol-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用高压将物质经皮肤输送的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat għall-amministrazzjoni ta' sustanza permezz ta' pressjoni għolja, sabiex is-sustanza tgħaddi minn ġol-ġilda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A high pressure transdermal delivery device uses high pressure to move a substance through the skin.

collocations.mt: użu ta' strument għall-amministrazzjoni bi pressjoni għolja
collocations.en: use of a high pressure delivery device

collocations.mt: manutenzjoni ta' strument għall-amministrazzjoni bi pressjoni għolja
collocations.en: maintenance of a high pressure delivery device

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi strument għall-amministrazzjoni bi pressjoni għolja biex tgħaddi s-sustanza mill-ġilda, u jispjega l-funzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The document describes a high pressure transdermal delivery device and explains its function.
formal.zh: 文件介绍了一种利用高压使物质穿过皮肤的输送装置，并解释其功能。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex jissemma l-użu ta' pressjoni għolja? Mark: Għax dan l-istrument jużaha biex iwassal sustanza minn ġol-ġilda. Lara: Jiġifieri l-isem jiddeskrivi kif taħdem it-twassil? Mark: Iva, jenfasizza l-pressjoni u l-mogħdija minn ġol-ġilda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does it mention the use of high pressure? Mark: Because this device uses it to deliver a substance through the skin. Lara: So the name describes how delivery works? Mark: Yes, it emphasizes the pressure and the passage through the skin.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么这里提到使用高压？Mark：因为这种装置利用高压把物质经皮肤输送进去。Lara：也就是说，名称描述了输送方式？Mark：对，它强调压力和穿过皮肤的输送途径。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex jissemma l-użu ta' pressjoni għolja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex jissemma l-użu ta' pressjoni għolja?
messages.zh: 为什么这里提到使用高压？
messages.en: Why does it mention the use of high pressure?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan l-istrument jużaha biex iwassal sustanza minn ġol-ġilda.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan l-istrument jużaha biex iwassal sustanza minn ġol-ġilda.
messages.zh: 因为这种装置利用高压把物质经皮肤输送进去。
messages.en: Because this device uses it to deliver a substance through the skin.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri l-isem jiddeskrivi kif taħdem it-twassil?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri l-isem jiddeskrivi kif taħdem it-twassil?
messages.zh: 也就是说，名称描述了输送方式？
messages.en: So the name describes how delivery works?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jenfasizza l-pressjoni u l-mogħdija minn ġol-ġilda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jenfasizza l-pressjoni u l-mogħdija minn ġol-ġilda.
messages.zh: 对，它强调压力和穿过皮肤的输送途径。
messages.en: Yes, it emphasizes the pressure and the passage through the skin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长名称记成三个画面：“装置—高压推动—物质穿过皮肤”。抓住 pressjoni għolja 的“高压”和 ġilda 的“皮肤”，再串起整句。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument used to administer a vaccination by puncturing the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过刺破皮肤实施疫苗接种的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument użat biex jingħata tilqim permezz ta' titqib tal-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过皮肤穿刺实施疫苗接种的接种器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża għat-tilqim billi jtaqqab il-ġilda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stab vaccinator is an instrument used to administer a vaccine by puncturing the skin.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi dan l-istrument għat-tilqim bħala apparat li jintuża għat-tilqim permezz ta' titqib tal-ġilda.
formal.en: The catalogue describes this stab vaccinator as a device used for vaccination by puncturing the skin.
formal.zh: 目录将这种穿刺接种器描述为通过刺破皮肤实施疫苗接种的装置。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan l-istrument għal xiex jintuża? David: Huwa strument għat-tilqim. Anna: Kif jingħata t-tilqim bih? David: Permezz ta' titqib tal-ġilda.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is this instrument used for? David: It is a stab vaccinator. Anna: How is vaccination carried out with it? David: By puncturing the skin.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这个器具是做什么用的？David：它是穿刺接种器。Anna：用它怎样进行接种？David：通过刺破皮肤进行接种。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-istrument għal xiex jintuża?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-istrument għal xiex jintuża?
messages.zh: 这个器具是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this instrument used for?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa strument għat-tilqim.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa strument għat-tilqim.
messages.zh: 它是穿刺接种器。
messages.en: It is a stab vaccinator.

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jingħata t-tilqim bih?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jingħata t-tilqim bih?
messages.zh: 用它怎样进行接种？
messages.en: How is vaccination carried out with it?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Permezz ta' titqib tal-ġilda.
messages.mt_standard: Permezz ta' titqib tal-ġilda.
messages.zh: 通过刺破皮肤进行接种。
messages.en: By puncturing the skin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 strument għat-tilqim 记作“用于接种的器具”；本词条指定的是穿刺接种器，再配上“刺破皮肤进行接种”的画面。

exact_key: strument li jagħmel aktar minn toqba waħda

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument designed to make more than one puncture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于形成多个穿刺孔的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument maħsub biex jagħmel aktar minn toqba waħda permezz tat-titqib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于刺出多个孔的多孔穿刺器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex jagħmel diversi toqob permezz tat-titqib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A multipuncturer is an instrument designed to make several punctures.

collocations.mt: użu ta' strument li jagħmel aktar minn toqba waħda
tindif ta' strument li jagħmel aktar minn toqba waħda

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi strument li jagħmel aktar minn toqba waħda u jiddeskrivi l-funzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The catalogue includes a multipuncturer and describes its function.
formal.zh: 目录收录了一种多孔穿刺器，并介绍了它的功能。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan l-istrument jagħmel toqba waħda biss? Karl: Le, huwa strument li jagħmel aktar minn toqba waħda. Rita: Allura jagħmel diversi toqob? Karl: Iva, dik hija l-funzjoni tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does this instrument make only one puncture? Karl: No, it is an instrument that makes more than one puncture. Rita: So it makes several punctures? Karl: Yes, that is its function.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这个器具只刺出一个孔吗？Karl：不，它是能刺出不止一个孔的器具。Rita：所以它能刺出多个孔？Karl：对，这就是它的功能。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-istrument jagħmel toqba waħda biss?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-istrument jagħmel toqba waħda biss?
messages.zh: 这个器具只刺出一个孔吗？
messages.en: Does this instrument make only one puncture?

messages.speaker: Karl (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa strument li jagħmel aktar minn toqba waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa strument li jagħmel aktar minn toqba waħda.
messages.zh: 不，它是能刺出不止一个孔的器具。
messages.en: No, it is an instrument that makes more than one puncture.

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura jagħmel diversi toqob?
messages.mt_standard: Allura jagħmel diversi toqob?
messages.zh: 所以它能刺出多个孔？
messages.en: So it makes several punctures?

messages.speaker: Karl (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik hija l-funzjoni tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik hija l-funzjoni tiegħu.
messages.zh: 对，这就是它的功能。
messages.en: Yes, that is its function.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“器具＋能做出＋不止一个孔”逐块理解：toqba waħda 是“一个孔”，aktar minn 表示“多于”，合起来记住多孔穿刺功能。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medical instrument used to scratch or abrade the surface of the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于在皮肤表面造成划痕或进行浅表刮擦的医疗器械。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mediku li jintuża biex jobrox il-wiċċ tal-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮肤划痕器；用于划擦皮肤表面的医疗器械。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument mediku maħsub biex jagħmel grif fuq il-wiċċ tal-ġilda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A scarifier is a medical instrument that scratches or abrades the surface of the skin.

collocations.mt: użu ta' strument li jobrox il-ġilda

formal.mt: Il-manwal jiddeskrivi l-funzjoni ta' strument li jobrox il-ġilda u jinkludi stampa tiegħu.
formal.en: The manual describes the function of a scarifier and includes a picture of it.
formal.zh: 手册介绍了皮肤划痕器的功能，并附有该器械的图片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan l-istrument fl-istampa? Pawlu: Huwa strument li jobrox il-ġilda; il-ktieb jispjega għal xiex jintuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this instrument in the picture? Pawlu: It is a scarifier; the book explains what it is used for.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图片里的这个器械是什么？保罗：这是皮肤划痕器；书里解释了它的用途。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan l-istrument fl-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan l-istrument fl-istampa?
messages.zh: 图片里的这个器械是什么？
messages.en: What is this instrument in the picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa strument li jobrox il-ġilda; il-ktieb jispjega għal xiex jintuża.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa strument li jobrox il-ġilda; il-ktieb jispjega għal xiex jintuża.
messages.zh: 这是皮肤划痕器；书里解释了它的用途。
messages.en: It is a scarifier; the book explains what it is used for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语画面记忆：strument 是器械，li jobrox 表示会刮擦，il-ġilda 是皮肤，合起来想象“刮擦皮肤的器械”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A financial instrument representing an ownership interest in an entity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代表对某个实体拥有所有者权益的金融工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument finanzjarju li jirrappreżenta sehem fis-sjieda ta' entità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 权益工具；代表持有人对某个实体拥有所有者权益的金融工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument finanzjarju li jagħti lid-detentur interess fis-sjieda ta' entità, bħal sehem f'kumpanija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An equity instrument is a financial instrument that represents an ownership interest in an entity, such as a share in a company.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega li dan l-istrument ta' ekwità jirrappreżenta sehem fis-sjieda tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: The report explains that this equity instrument represents an ownership interest in the company.
formal.zh: 报告解释说，这项权益工具代表对该公司的所有者权益。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser strument ta' ekwità? Mark: Ifisser strument finanzjarju li jirrappreżenta sehem fis-sjieda, bħal sehem f'kumpanija.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does equity instrument mean? Mark: It means a financial instrument representing an ownership interest, such as a share in a company.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：权益工具是什么意思？马克：它指代表所有者权益的金融工具，比如公司的股份。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser strument ta' ekwità?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser strument ta' ekwità?
messages.zh: 权益工具是什么意思？
messages.en: What does equity instrument mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser strument finanzjarju li jirrappreżenta sehem fis-sjieda, bħal sehem f'kumpanija.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser strument finanzjarju li jirrappreżenta sehem fis-sjieda, bħal sehem f'kumpanija.
messages.zh: 它指代表所有者权益的金融工具，比如公司的股份。
messages.en: It means a financial instrument representing an ownership interest, such as a share in a company.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“持有公司股份”的画面联系起来：这里的 strument 指金融工具，ekwità 对应所有者权益。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to determine the value of a quantity, such as length, mass, or temperature.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于测定长度、质量或温度等量的数值的仪器或装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex jitkejjel xi ħaġa, bħat-tul, il-massa jew it-temperatura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 测量仪器；用于测定某个量的数值的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument jew apparat li bih jiġi ddeterminat il-valur ta' kwantità, bħat-tul jew it-temperatura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A measuring device is an instrument used to find the value of a quantity, such as length or temperature.

formal.mt: Qabel l-esperiment, it-tekniku ċċekkja l-istrument tal-kejl u rreġistra l-qari tiegħu.
formal.en: Before the experiment, the technician checked the measuring device and recorded its reading.
formal.zh: 实验开始前，技术员检查了测量仪器，并记录了它的读数。

colloquial.mt: Lara: B'liema strument tal-kejl nista' nkejjel it-tul ta' din il-mejda? Toni: Tista' tuża tejp tal-kejl.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which measuring device can I use to measure the length of this table? Toni: You can use a tape measure.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以用哪种测量工具量这张桌子的长度？托尼：你可以用卷尺。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: B'liema strument tal-kejl nista' nkejjel it-tul ta' din il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: B'liema strument tal-kejl nista' nkejjel it-tul ta' din il-mejda?
messages.zh: 我可以用哪种测量工具量这张桌子的长度？
messages.en: Which measuring device can I use to measure the length of this table?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tuża tejp tal-kejl.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tuża tejp tal-kejl.
messages.zh: 你可以用卷尺。
messages.en: You can use a tape measure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 kejl 就联想到“测量”，再把 strument 想成带刻度或显示读数的工具，整句便是“用于测量的仪器”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A musical instrument that produces sound when struck, shaken, or scraped.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过敲击、摇动或刮擦等方式发声的乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali li jipproduċi ħoss meta jintlaqat, jitħawwad jew jingħorok.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打击乐器；以敲击、摇动或刮擦等方式使其发声的乐器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument mużikali, bħal tanbur, li jindaqq billi jintlaqat, jitħawwad jew jingħorok biex jipproduċi ħoss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A percussion instrument is a musical instrument that makes sound when someone strikes, shakes, or scrapes it.

collocations.en: a percussion instrument in the orchestra
collocations.zh: 管弦乐队中的打击乐器

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-mużika, l-għalliema ppreżentat it-tanbur bħala eżempju ta' strument tal-perkusjoni.
formal.en: In the music lesson, the teacher presented the drum as an example of a percussion instrument.
formal.zh: 音乐课上，老师以鼓为例介绍了打击乐器。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema strument tal-perkusjoni se ddoqq illum? Adam: Se ndoqq it-tanbur waqt il-prova.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which percussion instrument are you going to play today? Adam: I am going to play the drum during rehearsal.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你今天要演奏哪种打击乐器？亚当：排练时我要打鼓。

messages.speaker: Nina (乐队同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema strument tal-perkusjoni se ddoqq illum?
messages.mt_standard: Liema strument tal-perkusjoni se ddoqq illum?
messages.zh: 你今天要演奏哪种打击乐器？
messages.en: Which percussion instrument are you going to play today?

messages.speaker: Adam (鼓手)
messages.mt_spoken: Se ndoqq it-tanbur waqt il-prova.
messages.mt_standard: Se ndoqq it-tanbur waqt il-prova.
messages.zh: 排练时我要打鼓。
messages.en: I am going to play the drum during rehearsal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作帮助记忆：一边想象敲鼓、摇沙锤，一边读 strument tal-perkusjoni，把整个短语与打击乐器的声音联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A musical instrument that produces sound through air passing through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过使空气流经乐器而产生声音的乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali li jipproduċi l-ħoss permezz ta' arja li tgħaddi minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用气流产生声音的管乐器或吹奏乐器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument mużikali li jindaqq billi tgħaddi l-arja minnu biex jinħoloq il-ħoss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wind instrument is a musical instrument that produces sound when air passes through it.

collocations.en: to learn to play a wind instrument

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jagħżel strument tan-nifs u jispjega kif dan jipproduċi l-ħoss.
formal.en: Each student should choose a wind instrument and explain how it produces sound.
formal.zh: 每位学生应选择一种管乐器，并解释它如何发声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tixtieq titgħallem iddoqq strument tan-nifs? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nitgħallem indoqq il-flawt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to learn to play a wind instrument? Mark: Yes, I'd like to learn to play the flute.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想学一种管乐器吗？马克：想，我想学吹长笛。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tixtieq titgħallem iddoqq strument tan-nifs?
messages.mt_standard: Tixtieq titgħallem iddoqq strument tan-nifs?
messages.zh: 你想学一种管乐器吗？
messages.en: Would you like to learn to play a wind instrument?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nitgħallem indoqq il-flawt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nitgħallem indoqq il-flawt.
messages.zh: 想，我想学吹长笛。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to learn to play the flute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“吹气让乐器发声”的画面绑定，再用“演奏管乐器”这个搭配反复练习，记住它指一类乐器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The way the parts of something are arranged and connected, or something built from connected parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物各部分的排列和连接方式，也可指由相互连接的部分构成的实体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif il-partijiet ta' ħaġa huma mqassma u marbuta flimkien, jew ħaġa mibnija minn partijiet magħquda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 各组成部分之间的组织、排列和连接关系，或由这些部分组成的构造体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-organizzazzjoni u r-rabta bejn il-partijiet ta' ħaġa, jew kostruzzjoni magħmula minn partijiet marbuta flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The structure of something is the way its parts fit together, and a structure can also be something built from connected parts.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza l-istruttura tal-bini u jiddeskrivi kif il-partijiet ewlenin tiegħu huma marbuta flimkien.
formal.en: The report analyses the structure of the building and describes how its main parts are connected.
formal.zh: 报告分析了建筑物的结构，并描述其主要部分如何相互连接。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'taħseb dwar l-istruttura tar-rapport tiegħi? Mark: Hija ċara, imma poġġi l-konklużjoni wara r-riżultati.
