colloquial.en: Maja: What do you think of the structure of my report? Mark: It's clear, but put the conclusion after the results.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得我的报告结构怎么样？马克：挺清楚的，不过把结论放在结果后面。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'taħseb dwar l-istruttura tar-rapport tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: X'taħseb dwar l-istruttura tar-rapport tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你觉得我的报告结构怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think of the structure of my report?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija ċara, imma poġġi l-konklużjoni wara r-riżultati.
messages.mt_standard: Hija ċara, imma poġġi l-konklużjoni wara r-riżultati.
messages.zh: 挺清楚的，不过把结论放在结果后面。
messages.en: It's clear, but put the conclusion after the results.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象积木搭成建筑，再想象段落组成报告；两幅图都关注“各部分怎样组合”，帮助记住结构这一共同概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement of elements that determines how processes are activated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 决定各个过程如何被激活的组成要素及其组织关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' elementi li jiddetermina kif jiġu attivati l-proċessi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于组织和确定过程激活方式的结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Struttura li torganizza l-elementi u r-rabtiet li permezz tagħhom jiġu attivati l-proċessi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A process activation structure is an arrangement of elements and connections that determines how processes are activated.

collocations.en: design of a process activation structure
analysis of the process activation structure
collocations.zh: 对过程激活结构的分析

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-istruttura tal-attivazzjoni tal-proċessi u r-rabtiet bejn l-elementi tagħha.
formal.en: The diagram shows the process activation structure and the connections between its elements.
formal.zh: 该图展示了过程激活结构及其组成要素之间的连接关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tispjegali l-istruttura tal-attivazzjoni tal-proċessi f'din id-dijagramma? Mark: Iva, ejja nħarsu lejn kif jiġi attivat kull proċess.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you explain the process activation structure in this diagram to me? Mark: Yes, let's look at how each process is activated.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能给我讲讲这张图里的过程激活结构吗？马克：可以，我们来看看每个过程是怎样被激活的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tispjegali l-istruttura tal-attivazzjoni tal-proċessi f'din id-dijagramma?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tispjegali l-istruttura tal-attivazzjoni tal-proċessi f'din id-dijagramma?
messages.zh: 你能给我讲讲这张图里的过程激活结构吗？
messages.en: Can you explain the process activation structure in this diagram to me?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nħarsu lejn kif jiġi attivat kull proċess.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nħarsu lejn kif jiġi attivat kull proċess.
messages.zh: 可以，我们来看看每个过程是怎样被激活的。
messages.en: Yes, let's look at how each process is activated.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“结构—激活—过程”三个意义块记忆，再调整为中文的“过程激活结构”；想象图中的过程逐个被启动，帮助理解整个术语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement of control components used to regulate system frequency as the load changes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在负荷发生变化时，用于调节系统频率的控制组件及其组织关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' komponenti ta' kontroll li jintuża biex jirregola l-frekwenza tas-sistema meta tinbidel it-tagħbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于在负荷变化时调节系统频率的控制结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Struttura li torganizza l-komponenti u r-rabtiet tal-kontroll li jirregola l-frekwenza tas-sistema b'reazzjoni għal bidliet fit-tagħbija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A load-frequency control structure is the arrangement of control components that regulates system frequency in response to changes in load.

collocations.en: design of a load-frequency control structure
collocations.zh: 负荷—频率控制结构的设计

collocations.en: analysis of the load-frequency control structure
collocations.zh: 对负荷—频率控制结构的分析

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istruttura tal-kontroll tagħbija-frekwenza u kif il-komponenti tagħha jaħdmu flimkien.
formal.en: The report describes the load-frequency control structure and how its components work together.
formal.zh: 报告描述了负荷—频率控制结构，以及其中各组件如何协同工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal xiex tintuża l-istruttura tal-kontroll tagħbija-frekwenza? Mark: Biex tirregola l-frekwenza tas-sistema meta tinbidel it-tagħbija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the load-frequency control structure used for? Mark: To regulate the system frequency when the load changes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：负荷—频率控制结构是用来做什么的？马克：在负荷变化时调节系统频率。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex tintuża l-istruttura tal-kontroll tagħbija-frekwenza?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex tintuża l-istruttura tal-kontroll tagħbija-frekwenza?
messages.zh: 负荷—频率控制结构是用来做什么的？
messages.en: What is the load-frequency control structure used for?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex tirregola l-frekwenza tas-sistema meta tinbidel it-tagħbija.
messages.mt_standard: Biex tirregola l-frekwenza tas-sistema meta tinbidel it-tagħbija.
messages.zh: 在负荷变化时调节系统频率。
messages.en: To regulate the system frequency when the load changes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把术语分成“结构、控制、负荷、频率”四块；想象负荷变化后，控制组件配合调节频率，用这个画面串起整个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement that specifies who is responsible for processes and the work involved in them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定各项流程及其相关工作由谁负责、如何分配责任的组织架构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament li jiddetermina min hu responsabbli għall-proċessi u kif jitqassmu r-responsabbiltajiet marbuta magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明确各项流程由谁负责以及相关责任如何分配的架构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Struttura li tidentifika l-persuni jew it-timijiet responsabbli għal kull proċess u tistabbilixxi r-responsabbiltajiet tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A process responsibility structure is an arrangement that identifies who is responsible for each process and its associated tasks.

collocations.en: to define the process responsibility structure

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi struttura tar-responsabilità għall-proċessi li tispeċifika min għandu japprova kull stadju tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The report proposes a process responsibility structure specifying who must approve each stage of the work.
formal.zh: 报告提出一套流程责任架构，明确每个工作阶段应由谁审批。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jkun responsabbli għal kull pass? Pawlu: Ejja nagħmlu struttura tar-responsabilità għall-proċessi, biex kulħadd ikun jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will be responsible for each step? Pawlu: Let's draw up a process responsibility structure so everyone knows what they need to do.
colloquial.zh: Marija：每一步由谁负责？Pawlu：我们制定一套流程责任架构吧，这样大家都知道自己该做什么。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun responsabbli għal kull pass?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun responsabbli għal kull pass?
messages.zh: 每一步由谁负责？
messages.en: Who will be responsible for each step?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nagħmlu struttura tar-responsabilità għall-proċessi, biex kulħadd ikun jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nagħmlu struttura tar-responsabilità għall-proċessi, biex kulħadd ikun jaf x'għandu jagħmel.
messages.zh: 我们制定一套流程责任架构吧，这样大家都知道自己该做什么。
messages.en: Let's draw up a process responsibility structure so everyone knows what they need to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张流程图，每一步旁边都写着负责人的姓名；把整组短语与这张责任分配图一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male person who studies at a school, college, university, or on a course.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在学校、学院、大学或课程中学习的学生；此处为阳性形式，指男学生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ta' sess maskili li titgħallem fi skola, kulleġġ jew università, jew li ssegwi kors ta' studju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接受学校教育或修读课程的学生；阳性形式，可指男学生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifel jew raġel li jattendi skola jew istituzzjoni edukattiva, jew li jkun qed isegwi kors biex jitgħallem suġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A student is someone who studies at an educational institution or takes a course; this Maltese form is masculine.

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jissottometti x-xogħol tiegħu qabel tmiem il-ġimgħa.
formal.en: Each student must submit his work before the end of the week.
formal.zh: 每位男学生都必须在本周结束前提交自己的作业。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int student hawn? Mark: Iva, qed nistudja l-mediċina. Din hija l-ewwel sena tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you a student here? Mark: Yes, I'm studying medicine. This is my first year.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你是这里的学生吗？Mark：是的，我在学医。这是我的第一年。

messages.speaker: Sara (新同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Int student hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Int student hawn?
messages.zh: 你是这里的学生吗？
messages.en: Are you a student here?

messages.speaker: Mark (男学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nistudja l-mediċina. Din hija l-ewwel sena tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nistudja l-mediċina. Din hija l-ewwel sena tiegħi.
messages.zh: 是的，我在学医。这是我的第一年。
messages.en: Yes, I'm studying medicine. This is my first year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借助英语 student 的相同拼写记住“学生”，再配一位男学生的画面，与 studenta 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A female person who studies at a school, college, university, or on a course.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在学校、学院、大学或课程中学习的女性学生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ta' sess femminili li titgħallem fi skola, kulleġġ jew università, jew li ssegwi kors ta' studju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接受学校教育或修读课程的女学生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifla jew mara li tattendi skola jew istituzzjoni edukattiva, jew li tkun qed issegwi kors biex titgħallem suġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A female student is a girl or woman who studies at an educational institution or takes a course.

formal.mt: L-istudenta tal-inġinerija ppreżentat il-proġett tagħha waqt il-konferenza.
formal.en: The female engineering student presented her project at the conference.
formal.zh: 这位工程专业女学生在会议上展示了自己的项目。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int studenta ġdida hawn? Anna: Iva, bdejt il-kors tal-inġinerija din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you a new female student here? Anna: Yes, I started the engineering course this week.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你是这里新来的女学生吗？Anna：是的，我这周开始读工程课程。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Int studenta ġdida hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Int studenta ġdida hawn?
messages.zh: 你是这里新来的女学生吗？
messages.en: Are you a new female student here?

messages.speaker: Anna (女学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bdejt il-kors tal-inġinerija din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bdejt il-kors tal-inġinerija din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，我这周开始读工程课程。
messages.en: Yes, I started the engineering course this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 student 与 studenta 写成一对词卡，后一张配女学生头像，用末尾的 a 提醒自己这个词指女性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spend time learning about a subject by reading, practising, or examining it carefully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过阅读、练习或仔细考察某个主题来学习、研读或研究。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddedika ħin biex jitgħallem dwar suġġett permezz tal-qari, tal-prattika jew ta' eżami bir-reqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学习；通过阅读、练习或认真思考来掌握某个学科或主题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaqra, jipprattika jew jaħseb bir-reqqa dwar suġġett sabiex jitgħallmu u jifhmu aħjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you study a subject, you spend time learning about it through reading, practice, or careful thought.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学习；研读；为获得知识或深入理解而进行的研究活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività tat-tagħlim jew tal-eżami bir-reqqa ta' suġġett sabiex jinkiseb għarfien jew fehim aktar profond.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Study is the activity of learning about a subject or examining it carefully to gain a deeper understanding.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学习；研读；仔细考察某一主题以增进理解。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitgħallem dwar suġġett jew jeżaminah b'attenzjoni sabiex iżid l-għarfien u l-fehim tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you study something, you give it careful attention in order to learn about it or understand it better.

formal.mt: Qabel ma kiteb il-konklużjonijiet tiegħu, ir-riċerkatur studja d-data bir-reqqa.
formal.en: Before writing his conclusions, the researcher studied the data carefully.
formal.zh: 研究人员在撰写结论之前，仔细研究了数据。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi eżami għada. Kif nista' nipprepara? Ġanni: Studja n-noti l-ewwel, imbagħad agħmel ftit eżerċizzji.
colloquial.en: Marija: I have an exam tomorrow. How can I prepare? Ġanni: Study the notes first, then do a few exercises.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我明天有考试，该怎么准备？Ġanni：先复习笔记，然后做几道练习。

messages.speaker: Marija (备考学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi eżami għada. Kif nista' nipprepara?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi eżami għada. Kif nista' nipprepara?
messages.zh: 我明天有考试，该怎么准备？
messages.en: I have an exam tomorrow. How can I prepare?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Studja n-noti l-ewwel, imbagħad agħmel ftit eżerċizzji.
messages.mt_standard: Studja n-noti l-ewwel, imbagħad agħmel ftit eżerċizzji.
messages.zh: 先复习笔记，然后做几道练习。
messages.en: Study the notes first, then do a few exercises.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同学指着笔记说“Studja!”来提醒你学习；动词义记“做学习这件事”，名词义单独记“学习或研究这项活动”。

gloss_zh: 好学的；勤于学习的；学术性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is studious spends considerable time studying and takes learning seriously.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人喜爱学习、认真读书，并愿意投入时间钻研知识。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jħobb jistudja, jieħu t-tagħlim bis-serjetà u jiddedika ħafna ħin għall-istudju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好学的；喜欢读书和钻研知识的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li tħobb it-tagħlim u tqatta' ħafna ħin taqra u tistudja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A studious person enjoys learning and spends a great deal of time studying.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勤学的；学习时认真努力、持续用功的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil min jistudja b'reqqa u b'impenn kontinwu, u jagħmel sforz biex jifhem dak li jkun qed jitgħallem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is diligent in study works carefully and consistently to understand what they are learning.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学术性的；与系统学习、研究或学问探讨有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xogħol jew attività marbuta mal-istudju, mar-riċerka jew mal-eżami sistematiku ta' suġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Academic work is concerned with systematic study, research, or the scholarly examination of a subject.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, l-għalliema ddeskriviet lil Daniel bħala student studjuż li jaqra b'mod indipendenti u jipprepara sew għal kull lezzjoni.
formal.en: In her report, the teacher described Daniel as a studious student who reads independently and prepares thoroughly for every lesson.
formal.zh: 老师在报告中将丹尼尔描述为一名勤奋好学的学生：他能够自主阅读，并认真准备每一堂课。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħuk dejjem bil-ktieb f'idu; kemm hu studjuż! | Mark: Iva, iħobb jitgħallem affarijiet ġodda anki meta ma jkollux eżami.
colloquial.en: Lara: Your brother always has a book in his hand; he is so studious! | Mark: Yes, he enjoys learning new things even when he has no exam.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你弟弟总是手不离书，真好学！ | 马克：是啊，即使没有考试，他也喜欢学新东西。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk dejjem bil-ktieb f'idu; kemm hu studjuż!
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk dejjem bil-ktieb f'idu; kemm hu studjuż!
messages.zh: 你弟弟总是手不离书，真好学！
messages.en: Your brother always has a book in his hand; he is so studious!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iħobb jitgħallem affarijiet ġodda anki meta ma jkollux eżami.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iħobb jitgħallem affarijiet ġodda anki meta ma jkollux eżami.
messages.zh: 是啊，即使没有考试，他也喜欢学新东西。
messages.en: Yes, he enjoys learning new things even when he has no exam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 studjuż 和“主动抱书钻研的人”这幅画面绑定：形容人时记“好学、勤学”，形容工作时结合语境记“学术性的”。这是情境联想，不是词源分析。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stew is a dish of meat, vegetables, or both cooked slowly together in liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把肉、蔬菜或两者放入液体中一起慢炖制成的菜肴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Platt ta' laħam, ħaxix jew it-tnejn flimkien, imsajjar bil-mod f'likwidu sakemm l-ingredjenti jirtabu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炖菜；将肉或蔬菜在汤汁中慢慢炖熟的菜肴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul minn biċċiet tal-laħam jew ħaxix li jissajru flimkien bil-mod f'likwidu u jiġu servuti biz-zalza tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stew is a dish in which pieces of meat or vegetables are slowly cooked together in liquid.

formal.mt: Biex tipprepara l-istuffat taċ-ċanga, sajjar il-laħam u l-ħaxix bil-mod fil-brodu sakemm il-laħam ikun tari.
formal.en: To prepare the beef stew, cook the meat and vegetables slowly in the stock until the meat is tender.
formal.zh: 制作炖牛肉时，将肉和蔬菜放入高汤中慢炖，直到肉质软嫩。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'hemm għall-ikel illum? | Pawlu: Għamilt stuffat tal-ħaxix. Trid ftit ħobż miegħu?
colloquial.en: Nina: What is there to eat today? | Pawlu: I made vegetable stew. Would you like some bread with it?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今天吃什么？ | 保罗：我做了蔬菜炖菜。你想配点面包吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'hemm għall-ikel illum?
messages.mt_standard: X'hemm għall-ikel illum?
messages.zh: 今天吃什么？
messages.en: What is there to eat today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt stuffat tal-ħaxix. Trid ftit ħobż miegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt stuffat tal-ħaxix. Trid ftit ħobż miegħu?
messages.zh: 我做了蔬菜炖菜。你想配点面包吗？
messages.en: I made vegetable stew. Would you like some bread with it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 stuffat，就想象一锅肉和蔬菜在汤汁中慢慢炖软；再用 stuffat taċ-ċanga“炖牛肉”和 stuffat tal-ħaxix“蔬菜炖菜”成组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: If a woman or girl was sexually assaulted, someone subjected her to sexual violence without her consent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示女性遭到未经其同意的性侵犯；该词在具体语境中常明确指被强奸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika li mara jew tifla ġiet soġġetta għal vjolenza sesswali mingħajr il-kunsens tagħha, b'mod partikolari li ġiet imġiegħla tagħmel att sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遭到性侵犯；受到未经本人同意的性暴力，在此词的具体用法中常指被强奸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li mara jew tifla ġiet attakkata sesswalment mingħajr il-kunsens tagħha; il-kelma tintuża b'mod partikolari meta tkun ġiet imġiegħla tagħmel att sesswali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone was sexually assaulted, they were subjected to sexual violence without their consent.

collocations.en: she reported that she had been sexually assaulted
collocations.zh: 她报告称自己遭到了性侵犯

collocations.en: she said that she had been sexually assaulted
collocations.zh: 她说自己此前曾遭到性侵犯

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont tagħha, il-mara qalet li kienet ġiet stuprata u li wara rċeviet appoġġ minn persuna ta' fiduċja.
formal.en: In her account, the woman said that she had been sexually assaulted and had subsequently received support from someone she trusted.
formal.zh: 这名女性在叙述中说，她曾遭到性侵犯，之后得到了一位她信任的人的支持。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sara qaltli li ġiet stuprata u talbitni mmur magħha għaċ-ċentru ta' appoġġ. | Nina: Nista' niġi magħkom ukoll, jekk hi trid.
colloquial.en: Lara: Sara told me she was sexually assaulted and asked me to go with her to the support centre. | Nina: I can come with you both too, if she wants.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：萨拉告诉我，她遭到了性侵犯，还请我陪她去援助中心。 | 妮娜：如果她愿意，我也可以陪你们一起去。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sara qaltli li ġiet stuprata u talbitni mmur magħha għaċ-ċentru ta' appoġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Sara qaltli li ġiet stuprata u talbitni mmur magħha għaċ-ċentru ta' appoġġ.
messages.zh: 萨拉告诉我，她遭到了性侵犯，还请我陪她去援助中心。
messages.en: Sara told me she was sexually assaulted and asked me to go with her to the support centre.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' niġi magħkom ukoll, jekk hi trid.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' niġi magħkom ukoll, jekk hi trid.
messages.zh: 如果她愿意，我也可以陪你们一起去。
messages.en: I can come with you both too, if she wants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 ġiet stuprata 整组记作“她遭到了性侵犯”，留意它表达遭受侵害的经历。用尊重当事人的完整句子练习，避免脱离语境作轻松联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dizziness is a feeling of unsteadiness or a sensation that you or your surroundings are moving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到头晕、身体不稳，或觉得自己及周围环境在移动、旋转的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni li fiha persuna tħossha mhix stabbli, jew tħoss li hi jew l-ambjent ta' madwarha qed iduru jew jiċċaqilqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头晕；感觉身体不稳、头脑发飘或难以保持平衡。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' nuqqas ta' stabbiltà jew bilanċ li fiha persuna tħossha ħafifa f'rasha jew mhix soda fuq saqajha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dizziness is a feeling of being unsteady, light-headed, or unable to keep your balance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眩晕；感觉自己或周围环境在旋转或移动，尽管实际上并未发生这种运动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni li l-persuna nnifisha jew l-affarijiet ta' madwarha qed iduru jew jiċċaqilqu, minkejja li fil-fatt ma jkunx hemm dak il-moviment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Vertigo is a sensation that you or your surroundings are spinning or moving when they are actually still.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-pazjenta ddeskriviet sturdament qawwi, b'sensazzjoni li l-kamra kienet qed iddur minkejja li kienet bilqiegħda.
formal.en: In the report, the patient described severe dizziness, with a sensation that the room was spinning even though she was seated.
formal.zh: 报告中，这名患者描述了强烈的眩晕感：尽管她坐着，却觉得房间在旋转。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed inħoss sturdament; ħa noqgħod bilqiegħda ftit. | Lara: Sewwa, noqgħod hawn miegħek. Tridni nġiblek l-ilma?
colloquial.en: Mark: I feel dizzy; I am going to sit down for a bit. | Lara: All right, I will stay here with you. Would you like me to get you some water?
colloquial.zh: 马克：我有点头晕，先坐一会儿。 | 拉拉：好，我在这里陪你。要我给你拿点水吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss sturdament; ħa noqgħod bilqiegħda ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss sturdament; ħa noqgħod bilqiegħda ftit.
messages.zh: 我有点头晕，先坐一会儿。
messages.en: I feel dizzy; I am going to sit down for a bit.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, noqgħod hawn miegħek. Tridni nġiblek l-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, noqgħod hawn miegħek. Tridni nġiblek l-ilma?
messages.zh: 好，我在这里陪你。要我给你拿点水吗？
messages.en: All right, I will stay here with you. Would you like me to get you some water?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sturdament 配上“站着发飘”和“房间仿佛旋转”两幅画面，分别帮助记住普通头晕与旋转性眩晕；开口时可整句记 Qed inħoss sturdament。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large fish with a long body and rows of hard plates along its sides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鲟鱼，一种身体细长、体表沿纵向排列着硬质骨板的大型鱼类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta kbira b'ġisem twil u b'ringieli ta' pjanċi iebsin tul ġisimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲟鱼，身体细长且有成排硬质骨板的鱼类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sturjun huwa tip ta' ħuta kbira li għandha ġisem twil u ringieli ta' pjanċi iebsin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sturgeon is a large fish with an elongated body and rows of hard plates.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-ġisem twil tal-isturjun waqt iż-żjara fl-akkwarju.
formal.en: The students observed the sturgeon's long body during their visit to the aquarium.
formal.zh: 学生们在参观水族馆时观察了鲟鱼细长的身体。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha dik il-ħuta twila? Mark: Dik sturjun. Ara l-pjanċi iebsin fuq ġisimha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that long fish called? Mark: That's a sturgeon. Look at the hard plates on its body.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那条长长的鱼叫什么？Mark：那是鲟鱼。看它身上的硬质骨板。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jisimha dik il-ħuta twila?
messages.mt_standard: X'jisimha dik il-ħuta twila?
messages.zh: 那条长长的鱼叫什么？
messages.en: What is that long fish called?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik sturjun. Ara l-pjanċi iebsin fuq ġisimha.
messages.mt_standard: Dik sturjun. Ara l-pjanċi iebsin fuq ġisimha.
messages.zh: 那是鲟鱼。看它身上的硬质骨板。
messages.en: That's a sturgeon. Look at the hard plates on its body.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sturjun 配上一张长身、成排骨板的鲟鱼图；看到这些特征就回想这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bird that often gathers with others in large flocks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 椋鸟，一种常与同类聚成大群的小型鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir li spiss jinġabar ma' għasafar oħra tal-istess tip fi qtajja' kbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 椋鸟，常成群活动的一类小型鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sturnell huwa għasfur żgħir li ta' spiss jidher fi qtajja' ma' għasafar oħra tal-istess tip.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A starling is a small bird that often gathers in large flocks with others of its kind.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenta rat sturnell fuq fergħa u semgħet il-kant tiegħu.
formal.en: During her observation in the garden, the student saw a starling on a branch and heard its song.
formal.zh: 在花园观察期间，这名女学生看见一只椋鸟停在树枝上，并听到了它的鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa? Pawlu: Iva, dak sturnell. Ejja nisimgħu l-kant tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see that bird on the branch? Pawlu: Yes, that's a starling. Let's listen to its song.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看见树枝上的那只鸟了吗？Pawlu：看见了，那是一只椋鸟。我们听听它的鸣唱吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa?
messages.zh: 你看见树枝上的那只鸟了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that bird on the branch?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak sturnell. Ejja nisimgħu l-kant tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak sturnell. Ejja nisimgħu l-kant tiegħu.
messages.zh: 看见了，那是一只椋鸟。我们听听它的鸣唱吧。
messages.en: Yes, that's a starling. Let's listen to its song.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sturnell 写在椋鸟图片旁，想象一只停在树枝上、随后飞回鸟群的小鸟来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An idea or mental picture formed by imagining something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过想象在头脑中形成的想法或画面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsieb jew xbieha li persuna tifforma f'moħħha meta timmaġina xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想象所形成的念头、构想或脑海中的画面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Idea jew xbieha fil-moħħ li tinħoloq permezz tal-immaġinazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An imagined idea is a thought or picture that someone forms in their mind.

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, 'stħajjilha' hija ppreżentata bħala nom għal idea jew xbieha li tifforma fil-moħħ.
formal.en: In this lesson, 'stħajjilha' is presented as a noun for an idea or image formed in the mind.
formal.zh: 在本课中，“stħajjilha”作为名词呈现，表示头脑中形成的想法或画面。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'stħajjilha' f'din il-lezzjoni? Pawlu: Idea jew stampa f'moħħok, bħal ġnien li timmaġina.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'stħajjilha' mean in this lesson? Pawlu: An idea or picture in your mind, like a garden you imagine.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这节课里的“stħajjilha”是什么意思？保罗：就是脑中的想法或画面，比如你想象出来的一座花园。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'stħajjilha' f'din il-lezzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'stħajjilha' f'din il-lezzjoni?
messages.zh: 这节课里的“stħajjilha”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'stħajjilha' mean in this lesson?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Idea jew stampa f'moħħok, bħal ġnien li timmaġina.
messages.mt_standard: Idea jew stampa f'moħħok, bħal ġnien li timmaġina.
messages.zh: 就是脑中的想法或画面，比如你想象出来的一座花园。
messages.en: An idea or picture in your mind, like a garden you imagine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条给定的名词义，闭眼想象一座花园，把脑中出现的构想或画面与这个词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be worthy of receiving something because of your actions or qualities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于某人的行为、付出或品质而值得获得某种待遇、评价或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kien jistħoqqlu jirċievi xi ħaġa minħabba l-imġiba, l-isforz jew il-kwalitajiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应得或值得获得某事物，通常基于行为、努力或品质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kien ħaqqu jingħata xi ħaġa minħabba dak li għamel jew minħabba l-kwalitajiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you deserve something, your actions or qualities make it right for you to receive it.

formal.mt: Minħabba x-xogħol siewi tiegħu mal-komunità, dan il-voluntier jistħoqqlu rikonoxximent pubbliku.
formal.en: Because of his valuable work with the community, this volunteer deserves public recognition.
formal.zh: 这位志愿者为社区作出了有益贡献，值得获得公开表彰。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taħseb li Mark għandu jirbaħ il-premju? Toni: Iva, jistħoqqlu. Ħadem ħafna biex jgħin lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you think Mark should win the prize? Toni: Yes, he deserves it. He worked hard to help everyone.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你觉得马克应该获奖吗？托尼：应该，他当之无愧。他为帮助大家付出了很多努力。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Mark għandu jirbaħ il-premju?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Mark għandu jirbaħ il-premju?
messages.zh: 你觉得马克应该获奖吗？
messages.en: Do you think Mark should win the prize?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jistħoqqlu. Ħadem ħafna biex jgħin lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jistħoqqlu. Ħadem ħafna biex jgħin lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 应该，他当之无愧。他为帮助大家付出了很多努力。
messages.en: Yes, he deserves it. He worked hard to help everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象评奖时把“付出的努力”和“应得的奖励”放在天平两端，用公平相称的画面记住“值得、应得”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The separate movable parts of the hand used for touching, holding, and handling things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手指，手上可以分别活动、用于触摸、握持和操作物品的部分；此处为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partijiet tal-id li jistgħu jitħarrku separatament u li jintużaw biex tmiss, taqbad u żżomm l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手指，手上用于触摸、抓握等动作的可活动部分，指多个手指。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-subajja huma l-partijiet tal-id li jitħarrku biex tmiss, taqbad jew iżżomm xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your fingers are the separate movable parts of your hands that you use to touch and hold things.

formal.mt: Qabel l-eżerċizzju tal-kitba, l-għalliema talbet lit-tfal iċċaqilqu s-subajja bil-mod.
formal.en: Before the writing exercise, the teacher asked the children to move their fingers slowly.
formal.zh: 在书写练习之前，老师让孩子们慢慢活动手指。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Is-subajja tiegħi kesħin! Omm: Ilbes l-ingwanti u ċċaqlaqhom ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: My fingers are cold! Mum: Put on your gloves and move them a little.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我的手指好冷！妈妈：戴上手套，再稍微活动一下手指。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-subajja tiegħi kesħin!
messages.mt_standard: Is-subajja tiegħi kesħin!
messages.zh: 我的手指好冷！
messages.en: My fingers are cold!

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilbes l-ingwanti u ċċaqlaqhom ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ilbes l-ingwanti u ċċaqlaqhom ftit.
messages.zh: 戴上手套，再稍微活动一下手指。
messages.en: Put on your gloves and move them a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 念 subajja 时同时活动几根手指，把词义和动作绑定，并记住这里表示复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area on the edge of a city or large town where people live.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 市郊或郊区，位于城市或较大城镇边缘、主要供人居住的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona fit-tarf ta' belt jew ta' raħal kbir fejn jgħixu n-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市郊，位于城市或较大城镇外围的居住区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Subborg huwa żona residenzjali fit-tarf ta' belt jew ta' raħal kbir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A suburb is a residential area on the edge of a city or large town.

formal.mt: Il-familja tgħix f'subborg kwiet u tuża t-trasport pubbliku biex tasal fiċ-ċentru tal-belt.
formal.en: The family lives in a quiet suburb and uses public transport to reach the city centre.
formal.zh: 这家人住在安静的郊区，乘坐公共交通前往市中心。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn toqgħod issa? David: F'subborg kwiet, madwar għoxrin minuta bil-karozza miċ-ċentru.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where do you live now? David: In a quiet suburb, about twenty minutes from the centre by car.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你现在住在哪里？David：住在一个安静的郊区，开车到市中心大约二十分钟。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn toqgħod issa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn toqgħod issa?
messages.zh: 你现在住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live now?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'subborg kwiet, madwar għoxrin minuta bil-karozza miċ-ċentru.
messages.mt_standard: F'subborg kwiet, madwar għoxrin minuta bil-karozza miċ-ċentru.
messages.zh: 住在一个安静的郊区，开车到市中心大约二十分钟。
messages.en: In a quiet suburb, about twenty minutes from the centre by car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在城市地图边缘画一片住宅区并标上 subborg，用“城市外围的居住区”这个画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the movable parts of the hand, used for touching, pointing, and holding things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手上可以活动的指状部分，用于触摸、指示和抓握东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda mill-partijiet li jiċċaqalqu fl-id u li jintużaw biex tmiss, turi jew taqbad xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手指；手上用于触摸、指示或抓握的指状部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saba' huwa parti mill-id li tista' tgħawweġ u tuża biex tmiss jew taqbad xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A finger is one of the movable parts of your hand that you use to touch, point, or hold things.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, it-tabib talab lill-pazjent jgħawweġ is-saba' midrub.
formal.en: During the examination, the doctor asked the patient to bend the injured finger.
formal.zh: 检查时，医生让病人弯曲受伤的手指。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek faxxa ma' subgħajk? Mark: Qtajt saba' waqt li kont inqatta' l-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you have a bandage around your finger? Mark: I cut a finger while I was slicing bread.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的手指为什么缠着绷带？马克：我切面包时割伤了一根手指。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek faxxa ma' subgħajk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek faxxa ma' subgħajk?
messages.zh: 你的手指为什么缠着绷带？
messages.en: Why do you have a bandage around your finger?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qtajt saba' waqt li kont inqatta' l-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Qtajt saba' waqt li kont inqatta' l-ħobż.
messages.zh: 我切面包时割伤了一根手指。
messages.en: I cut a finger while I was slicing bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“手指”与指尖触碰桌面的动作联系起来：边指边说 finger，记住这里关注一根手指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movable parts of the hands that are used together for touching, gripping, and handling things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多根手指，指手上可以共同活动、用于触摸、抓握和操作物品的指状部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partijiet li jiċċaqalqu fl-idejn u li jintużaw flimkien biex tmiss, taqbad u żżomm l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手指的复数，表示多根手指。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-swaba' huma l-partijiet tal-idejn li tista' tgħawweġ u tuża flimkien biex tmiss jew iżżomm xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your fingers are the movable parts of your hands that work together when you grip or handle something.

formal.mt: Qabel l-eżerċizzju, l-għalliema talbet lill-istudenti jiftħu u jagħlqu s-swaba' bil-mod.
formal.en: Before the exercise, the teacher asked the students to spread and close their fingers slowly.
formal.zh: 练习前，老师让学生们缓慢地张开、收拢手指。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed togħrok idejk? Ben: Subgħajja kesħin ħafna; se nilbes l-ingwanti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you rubbing your hands? Ben: My fingers are very cold; I'm going to put on my gloves.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么一直搓手？本：我的手指很冷，我要戴上手套。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed togħrok idejk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed togħrok idejk?
messages.zh: 你为什么一直搓手？
messages.en: Why are you rubbing your hands?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Subgħajja kesħin ħafna; se nilbes l-ingwanti.
messages.mt_standard: Subgħajja kesħin ħafna; se nilbes l-ingwanti.
messages.zh: 我的手指很冷，我要戴上手套。
messages.en: My fingers are very cold; I'm going to put on my gloves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 张开手掌，同时活动几根手指，再联想 fingers：用“多根一起动”的画面记住本条的复数义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A movable part of the hand that can bend and is used to touch or press something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手上能够弯曲、用来触摸或按压物体的指状部分，即手指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti mill-id li tista' titgħawweġ u tintuża biex tmiss xi ħaġa jew tagħfas fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手指；手上可弯曲、用于触碰或按压的指状部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saba' huwa waħda mill-partijiet tal-id li jitgħawġu u jgħinuk tmiss, tagħfas jew taqbad l-affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A finger is a part of your hand that you can bend to touch something or press a small surface.

formal.mt: Biex tixgħel l-apparat, agħfas il-buttuna b'saba' wieħed għal żewġ sekondi.
formal.en: To switch on the device, press the button with one finger for two seconds.
formal.zh: 要启动设备，请用一根手指按住按钮两秒。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif nixgħel din il-lampa? Pawlu: Agħfas hawn b'saba' wieħed.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do I turn on this lamp? Pawlu: Press here with one finger.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这盏灯怎么开？保罗：用一根手指按这里。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nixgħel din il-lampa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nixgħel din il-lampa?
messages.zh: 这盏灯怎么开？
messages.en: How do I turn on this lamp?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħfas hawn b'saba' wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Agħfas hawn b'saba' wieħed.
messages.zh: 用一根手指按这里。
messages.en: Press here with one finger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用一根手指按亮台灯，把“弯曲、触碰、按压”串成动作，帮助记住本条的 finger 义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the movable parts of the hand, used to hold objects or make gestures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手上可活动的指状部分，可用于握住物品或做出手势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda mill-partijiet li jiċċaqalqu fl-id u li jgħinuk iżżomm l-oġġetti jew tagħmel ġesti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手指；手上用于抓握、触摸或做手势的指状部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Saba' huwa parti mill-id li tintuża biex iżżomm l-affarijiet, tmisshom jew tagħmel sinjal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A finger is one of the parts of your hand that helps you hold objects and make gestures.

formal.mt: L-istudent għolla saba' biex juri li xtaq iwieġeb il-mistoqsija.
formal.en: The student raised a finger to show that he wished to answer the question.
formal.zh: 学生举起一根手指，表示自己想回答问题。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan iċ-ċurkett joqgħodli? Rita: Ipprova poġġih fuq saba' ieħor.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this ring fit me? Rita: Try putting it on another finger.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这枚戒指适合我的手指吗？丽塔：试着戴到另一根手指上。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan iċ-ċurkett joqgħodli?
messages.mt_standard: Dan iċ-ċurkett joqgħodli?
messages.zh: 这枚戒指适合我的手指吗？
messages.en: Does this ring fit me?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova poġġih fuq saba' ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova poġġih fuq saba' ieħor.
messages.zh: 试着戴到另一根手指上。
messages.en: Try putting it on another finger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把戒指套在一根手指上，再举起这根手指；用清晰的实物与手势画面记住“手指”这个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A subdivision of a tariff heading used to classify goods more precisely for customs purposes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关税税目下的细分类别，用于在海关申报等事务中更准确地归类货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suddiviżjoni ta' intestatura tariffarja li tintuża biex il-merkanzija tiġi kklassifikata b'mod aktar preċiż għal skopijiet doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关税税目下用于进一步细分货物类别的子目。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kategorija aktar speċifika taħt intestatura tariffarja, użata fil-klassifikazzjoni doganali tal-merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tariff subheading is a more specific category within a tariff heading that identifies goods for customs classification.

formal.mt: Is-subintestatura tariffarja għandha tiġi vverifikata qabel ma tiġi ppreżentata d-dikjarazzjoni doganali.
formal.en: The tariff subheading must be checked before the customs declaration is submitted.
formal.zh: 提交海关申报单之前，必须核实关税子目。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema subintestatura tariffarja nuża għal dawn il-prodotti? Mark: Ejja niċċekkjaw id-deskrizzjoni tagħhom qabel nagħżlu l-kodiċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which tariff subheading should I use for these products? Mark: Let's check their description before choosing the code.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这些产品该用哪个关税子目？Mark：我们先核对产品描述，再选代码。

messages.speaker: Lara (报关员)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema subintestatura tariffarja nuża għal dawn il-prodotti?
messages.mt_standard: Liema subintestatura tariffarja nuża għal dawn il-prodotti?
messages.zh: 这些产品该用哪个关税子目？
messages.en: Which tariff subheading should I use for these products?

messages.speaker: Mark (报关同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw id-deskrizzjoni tagħhom qabel nagħżlu l-kodiċi.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw id-deskrizzjoni tagħhom qabel nagħżlu l-kodiċi.
messages.zh: 我们先核对产品描述，再选代码。
messages.en: Let's check their description before choosing the code.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把海关分类想成逐层展开的目录：先找大税目，再找更细的关税子目，用目录层级帮助记忆这个完整术语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of assigning part of contracted work to another person or business under a separate contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承接合同工作的一方，另行通过合同把其中部分工作交给其他个人或企业完成的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li parti mix-xogħol kopert minn kuntratt tingħata lil persuna jew kumpanija oħra biex twettaqha taħt kuntratt separat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将已承接的合同工作中的一部分，另行签约交由其他个人或企业完成的分包做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament li fih min ikun ħa xogħol b'kuntratt iqabbad persuna jew kumpanija oħra biex tagħmel parti minnu permezz ta' kuntratt separat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Subcontracting is the practice of paying another person or business to carry out part of the work that you have agreed to do.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se tuża s-subkuntrattar biex tagħti x-xogħol tal-elettriku lil ditta speċjalizzata.
formal.en: The company will use subcontracting to assign the electrical work to a specialist firm.
formal.zh: 公司将通过分包方式，把电气工程交给一家专业企业。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se tagħmlu x-xogħol kollu intom? Pawlu: Le, se nużaw is-subkuntrattar għax-xogħol tal-elettriku.
colloquial.en: Nina: Will you do all the work yourselves? Pawlu: No, we'll use subcontracting for the electrical work.
colloquial.zh: Nina：所有工作都由你们自己做吗？Pawlu：不是，电气工程我们会采用分包方式。

messages.speaker: Nina (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tagħmlu x-xogħol kollu intom?
messages.mt_standard: Se tagħmlu x-xogħol kollu intom?
messages.zh: 所有工作都由你们自己做吗？
messages.en: Will you do all the work yourselves?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (承包商)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se nużaw is-subkuntrattar għax-xogħol tal-elettriku.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se nużaw is-subkuntrattar għax-xogħol tal-elettriku.
messages.zh: 不是，电气工程我们会采用分包方式。
messages.en: No, we'll use subcontracting for the electrical work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一家公司接下整项工程，再签合同请专业团队完成其中一部分；用“整项接下、部分分包”的场景记住这个过程名词。

gloss_zh: 崇高的；壮美的；令人赞叹的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to describe something whose exceptional beauty, greatness, or excellence inspires deep admiration or awe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容事物因非凡的美、宏伟气象或卓越品质而令人深深赞叹或敬畏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tqanqal ammirazzjoni profonda jew sens ta' stagħġib minħabba s-sbuħija, il-kobor jew l-eċċellenza tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有非凡的美、宏伟气象或卓越品质，令人赞叹乃至敬畏的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xi ħaġa ta' sbuħija, kobor jew eċċellenza straordinarja li tqanqal ammirazzjoni profonda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe something as sublime, you mean that its extraordinary beauty, greatness, or excellence fills you with admiration.

formal.mt: Fil-poeżija tiegħu, l-awtur jiddeskrivi s-sbuħija sublimi tal-muntanji fid-dawl ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: In his poem, the author describes the sublime beauty of the mountains in the morning light.
formal.zh: 作者在诗中描绘了群山在晨光下令人赞叹的壮美。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-veduta hi sublimi! Luqa: Iva, ejja nieqfu ftit u ngawduha.
colloquial.en: Maja: This view is sublime! Luqa: Yes, let's stop for a while and enjoy it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这景色真是壮美极了！Luqa：是啊，我们停一会儿，好好欣赏吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-veduta hi sublimi!
messages.mt_standard: Din il-veduta hi sublimi!
messages.zh: 这景色真是壮美极了！
messages.en: This view is sublime!

messages.speaker: Luqa (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nieqfu ftit u ngawduha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nieqfu ftit u ngawduha.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们停一会儿，好好欣赏吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's stop for a while and enjoy it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在群山前，壮美得让人屏息赞叹；把 sublimi 与这种强烈的审美震撼相连，记住它比普通“好看”更有力度。

gloss_zh: 下属；部下；小喽啰（轻蔑用法）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who holds a lower position in an organization and works under someone with greater authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在组织中职位较低、接受上级领导或指挥的人，即下属或部下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha pożizzjoni aktar baxxa f'organizzazzjoni u taħdem taħt it-tmexxija jew l-awtorità ta' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在组织或等级关系中隶属于上级、接受其领导的下属。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li, fil-ġerarkija ta' organizzazzjoni, għandha grad aktar baxx u taqa' taħt l-awtorità ta' superjur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A subordinate is someone who has a lower position than another person in an organization and works under that person's authority.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被轻蔑地看作地位低、只能听命行事的下属；小喽啰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna ta' grad baxx li ssegwi l-ordnijiet ta' ħaddieħor, meta tissemma b'ton ta' disprezz jew bħala li għandha ftit importanza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone calls a person an underling, they refer dismissively to that person's low rank and limited authority.

collocations.en: to treat him as a mere underling
collocations.zh: 把他当作一个无足轻重的小喽啰

formal.mt: Il-maniġer għandu jagħti lil kull subordinat struzzjonijiet ċari u jittrattah b'rispett.
formal.en: The manager should give each subordinate clear instructions and treat him with respect.
formal.zh: 经理应向每位下属提供明确的指示，并尊重对方。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark irrabja waqt il-laqgħa? David: Għax il-kap ittrattah bħala sempliċi subordinat u ma semax l-ideat tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark get angry during the meeting? David: Because the boss treated him as a mere underling and didn't listen to his ideas.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 为什么在开会时生气了？David：因为老板把他当作一个无足轻重的小喽啰，根本没听他的想法。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark irrabja waqt il-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark irrabja waqt il-laqgħa?
messages.zh: Mark 为什么在开会时生气了？
messages.en: Why did Mark get angry during the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-kap ittrattah bħala sempliċi subordinat u ma semax l-ideat tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-kap ittrattah bħala sempliċi subordinat u ma semax l-ideat tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为老板把他当作一个无足轻重的小喽啰，根本没听他的想法。
messages.en: Because the boss treated him as a mere underling and didn't listen to his ideas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用组织结构图记忆：上级下面的人是 subordinat；中性语境译“下属”，带轻蔑口气时可译“小喽啰”，注意两种语气的区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A facility in an electricity network where equipment changes voltage or controls the distribution of electricity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电力网络中装有设备、用于变换电压或控制电力分配的设施，即变电站。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Substazzjon huwa post fin-netwerk tal-elettriku b'tagħmir li jibdel il-vultaġġ jew jikkontrolla d-distribuzzjoni tal-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于变换电压或控制电力输送与分配的变电站。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Substazzjon huwa faċilità b'tagħmir elettriku li jibdel il-vultaġġ jew jikkontrolla t-tqassim tal-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electrical substation is a facility where equipment changes voltage or controls the flow of electricity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变电站；此处指电力网络中的一处设备设施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Substazzjon huwa post li jagħmel parti min-netwerk tal-elettriku u fih tagħmir għall-kontroll jew għat-tqassim tal-provvista.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substation is a facility within an electricity network that helps control or distribute the supply.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电力系统中承担电压变换或电力分配控制的变电站。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Substazzjon huwa parti minn sistema tal-enerġija elettrika fejn il-vultaġġ jinbidel jew il-fluss tal-elettriku jiġi kkontrollat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substation of a power system is a facility that manages voltage or electricity flow within that system.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li s-substazzjon jeħtieġ manutenzjoni regolari biex il-provvista tal-elettriku tibqa' affidabbli.
formal.en: The report indicates that the substation requires regular maintenance to keep the electricity supply reliable.
formal.zh: 报告指出，变电站需要定期维护，以保持供电可靠。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-bini ħdejn it-triq? Pawlu: Dak hu substazzjon. Fih tagħmir li jgħin biex jitqassam l-elettriku.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that building beside the road? Pawlu: That is a substation. It contains equipment that helps distribute electricity.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：路边那栋建筑是什么？保罗：那是变电站，里面有帮助分配电力的设备。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-bini ħdejn it-triq?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-bini ħdejn it-triq?
messages.zh: 路边那栋建筑是什么？
messages.en: What is that building beside the road?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu substazzjon. Fih tagħmir li jgħin biex jitqassam l-elettriku.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu substazzjon. Fih tagħmir li jgħin biex jitqassam l-elettriku.
messages.zh: 那是变电站，里面有帮助分配电力的设备。
messages.en: That is a substation. It contains equipment that helps distribute electricity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一张电网节点图：电进入站内，经过设备再分配出去，用“电网中的变电站”这一画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electrical facility that forms part of a network and changes voltage or controls the distribution of electricity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于电力网络、用于变换电压或控制电力分配的设施，即电力变电站。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Substazzjon tal-elettriku huwa faċilità fin-netwerk tal-elettriku fejn tagħmir jibdel il-vultaġġ jew jikkontrolla d-distribuzzjoni tal-provvista.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配有电气设备、用于变换电压或控制电力分配的变电站。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Substazzjon tal-elettriku huwa post b'tagħmir elettriku għall-bidla fil-vultaġġ jew għall-kontroll tad-distribuzzjoni tal-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electrical substation contains equipment used to change voltage or control the distribution of electrical power.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变电站；该短语明确指用于电力供应的设施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Substazzjon tal-elettriku huwa post fin-netwerk tal-provvista fejn l-elettriku jiġi kkontrollat jew jitqassam lejn partijiet oħra tan-netwerk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substation is a network facility where electricity is controlled or distributed to other parts of the network.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电力系统内用于调控电压或电力流向的变电站。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Substazzjon tal-elettriku huwa faċilità li tifforma parti minn sistema tal-enerġija elettrika u tintuża biex jiġi rregolat il-vultaġġ jew il-fluss tal-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substation of a power system is a facility within that system used to regulate voltage or electricity flow.

collocations.en: the door of the electrical substation

formal.mt: L-avviż jgħid li l-ispezzjoni tas-substazzjon tal-elettriku se ssir nhar it-Tlieta filgħodu.
formal.en: The notice states that the inspection of the electrical substation will take place on Tuesday morning.
formal.zh: 通知说明，电力变电站的检查将于星期二上午进行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Mark: Ħdejn il-ħanut, faċċata tas-substazzjon tal-elettriku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Mark: By the shop, opposite the electrical substation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里见面？马克：在商店旁边，就在电力变电站对面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu?
messages.zh: 我们在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-ħanut, faċċata tas-substazzjon tal-elettriku.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-ħanut, faċċata tas-substazzjon tal-elettriku.
messages.zh: 在商店旁边，就在电力变电站对面。
messages.en: By the shop, opposite the electrical substation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成“substazzjon＝变电站”和“tal-elettriku＝电的”两块来记，再合成“电力变电站”；想象门上画着闪电标志。

gloss_zh: 电力变电站；电力系统变电站

teaching_sense.en_definition: A facility in an electrical power system that changes voltage or controls the flow and distribution of electrical energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电力系统中用于变换电压或控制电能输送与分配的设施，即变电站。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Substazzjon tal-enerġija elettrika huwa faċilità f'sistema tal-elettriku fejn jinbidel il-vultaġġ jew jiġi kkontrollat il-fluss u t-tqassim tal-enerġija elettrika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于电压变换或电能分配控制的电力变电站。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Substazzjon tal-enerġija elettrika huwa post b'tagħmir li jibdel il-vultaġġ jew jikkontrolla kif titqassam l-enerġija elettrika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electrical substation is a facility equipped to change voltage or control how electrical energy is distributed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变电站；此处指电能供应网络中的设施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Substazzjon tal-enerġija elettrika huwa faċilità fin-netwerk tal-provvista li tgħin biex l-enerġija elettrika tiġi kkontrollata u mqassma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substation is a facility in the supply network that helps manage and distribute electrical energy.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为电力系统组成部分、用于控制电压或电力输送的变电站。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Substazzjon tal-enerġija elettrika huwa parti minn sistema tal-enerġija li fiha tagħmir għall-kontroll tal-vultaġġ jew tat-trasferiment tal-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A substation of a power system contains equipment that controls voltage or the transfer of electricity within the system.

collocations.en: the construction of an electrical power substation
the capacity of the electrical power substation

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi r-rwol tas-substazzjon tal-enerġija elettrika fid-distribuzzjoni tal-elettriku lejn iż-żona industrijali.
formal.en: The document describes the role of the electrical power substation in distributing electricity to the industrial area.
formal.zh: 该文件介绍了电力变电站在向工业区分配电力方面的作用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jiġifieri substazzjon tal-enerġija elettrika? Ġużi: Huwa post b'tagħmir li jibdel il-vultaġġ jew jikkontrolla kif jitqassam l-elettriku.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does electrical power substation mean? Ġużi: It is a place with equipment that changes voltage or controls how electricity is distributed.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：“电力变电站”是什么意思？朱齐：就是装有设备、用于变换电压或控制电力分配的地方。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri substazzjon tal-enerġija elettrika?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri substazzjon tal-enerġija elettrika?
messages.zh: “电力变电站”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does electrical power substation mean?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa post b'tagħmir li jibdel il-vultaġġ jew jikkontrolla kif jitqassam l-elettriku.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa post b'tagħmir li jibdel il-vultaġġ jew jikkontrolla kif jitqassam l-elettriku.
messages.zh: 就是装有设备、用于变换电压或控制电力分配的地方。
messages.en: It is a place with equipment that changes voltage or controls how electricity is distributed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“substazzjon＝变电站、enerġija＝能量、elettrika＝电的”分块理解，把整串词连成“处理电能的变电站”这一画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to regions just outside the tropics, or to the climate, plants, and other features of those regions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与热带外围的亚热带地区有关的，或具有这些地区气候、植物等特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aġġettiv subtropikali jiddeskrivi reġjun qrib iżda barra t-tropiċi, jew il-klima, il-pjanti u karatteristiċi oħra ta' reġjun bħal dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚热带的；属于热带外围地区的，或与其气候、植被等有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa subtropikali hija marbuta ma' reġjuni qrib iżda barra t-tropiċi, jew għandha karatteristiċi tal-klima jew tal-veġetazzjoni ta' dawk ir-reġjuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A region, climate, or plant described as subtropical is associated with areas just outside the tropics.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif il-klima subtropikali tinfluwenza t-tkabbir tal-pjanti fir-reġjun.
formal.en: The study examines how the subtropical climate influences plant growth in the region.
formal.zh: 该研究考察亚热带气候如何影响该地区的植物生长。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tip ta' pjanti hemm f'din is-serra? Toni: Hemm pjanti subtropikali. Ejja naqraw it-tikketti biex insiru nafu aktar dwarhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: What kind of plants are in this greenhouse? Toni: There are subtropical plants. Let's read the labels to learn more about them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个温室里有什么类型的植物？托尼：有亚热带植物。我们看看标签，多了解一下它们吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tip ta' pjanti hemm f'din is-serra?
messages.mt_standard: X'tip ta' pjanti hemm f'din is-serra?
messages.zh: 这个温室里有什么类型的植物？
messages.en: What kind of plants are in this greenhouse?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm pjanti subtropikali. Ejja naqraw it-tikketti biex insiru nafu aktar dwarhom.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm pjanti subtropikali. Ejja naqraw it-tikketti biex insiru nafu aktar dwarhom.
messages.zh: 有亚热带植物。我们看看标签，多了解一下它们吧。
messages.en: There are subtropical plants. Let's read the labels to learn more about them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上先画出热带，再在它两侧标出亚热带；把 subtropikali 和“亚热带气候、亚热带植物”一起记，掌握它的形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person under the authority of a monarch or ruler, or a subordinate person bound to a lord.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受君主或统治者管辖的人；也可指隶属于某位领主并对其负有效忠义务的附庸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna taħt l-awtorità ta' monarka jew ħakkiem, jew persuna subordinata li għandha dmir ta' lealtà lejn sidha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 臣民，即受某位君主或统治者管辖的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun taħt il-ħakma u l-awtorità ta' monarka jew ta' ħakkiem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A subject is a person who lives under the authority of a monarch or another ruler.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 附庸，即隶属于某位领主并对其承担效忠或服役义务的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna subordinata għal sid jew sinjur, li għandha tagħtih lealtà jew servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vassal is a person who owes loyalty or service to a lord who holds authority over them.

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelma sudditu tirreferi għal persuna taħt l-awtorità tar-re.
formal.en: In the text, the word sudditu refers to a person under the king's authority.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，sudditu 指受国王管辖的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser sudditu f'din l-istorja? Pawlu: Hawn ifisser persuna taħt il-ħakma tar-re.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does sudditu mean in this story? Pawlu: Here it means a person under the king's rule.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的 sudditu 是什么意思？保罗：这里指受国王统治的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser sudditu f'din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser sudditu f'din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 sudditu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does sudditu mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser persuna taħt il-ħakma tar-re.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser persuna taħt il-ħakma tar-re.
messages.zh: 这里指受国王统治的人。
messages.en: Here it means a person under the king's rule.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sudditu 放进“国王与臣民”的画面中记忆；遇到领主语境时，再联系“效忠领主的附庸”。这里的 subject 指人，不是“主题”。

gloss_zh: 手持烟花；仙女棒；信号焰火

teaching_sense.en_definition: A handheld firework, a sparkler that gives off sparks, or a flare that produces a bright signal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指手持烟花、燃烧时迸出火花的仙女棒，或发出强光以传递信号的焰火。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett tan-nar li jinżamm fl-id, li joħroġ xrar meta jinħaraq, jew li jagħti dawl qawwi bħala sinjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手持烟花，即设计为拿在手中燃放的小型烟花。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir tan-nar magħmul biex jinżamm fl-id waqt li jinħaraq u joħroġ dawl jew xrar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A handheld firework is a small firework designed to be held while it produces light or sparks.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仙女棒，即燃烧时不断迸出明亮火花的细棒状烟花。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bastun irqiq tan-nar li joħroġ ħafna xrar żgħir u jleqq waqt li jinħaraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sparkler is a thin firework stick that gives off bright sparks as it burns.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信号焰火，即燃烧时发出强光、用于传递信号的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett li jinħaraq u joħroġ dawl qawwi biex jagħti sinjal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flare is a device that burns with a bright light to give a signal.

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher suffarell li joħroġ xrar qawwi fid-dlam.
formal.en: The photograph shows a sparkler giving off bright sparks in the dark.
formal.zh: 照片中，一支仙女棒在黑暗中迸出明亮的火花。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak li qed jixgħel fir-ritratt? Mark: Dak suffarell. Ara kemm qed joħroġ xrar!
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that glowing in the photograph? Mark: That's a sparkler. Look how many sparks it's giving off!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里那个发亮的东西是什么？马克：那是仙女棒。看，它冒出好多火花！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak li qed jixgħel fir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak li qed jixgħel fir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 照片里那个发亮的东西是什么？
messages.en: What's that glowing in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak suffarell. Ara kemm qed joħroġ xrar!
messages.mt_standard: Dak suffarell. Ara kemm qed joħroġ xrar!
messages.zh: 那是仙女棒。看，它冒出好多火花！
messages.en: That's a sparkler. Look how many sparks it's giving off!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“亮光与火花”串联 suffarell 的三个义项：庆祝时联想到手持烟花和仙女棒，传递信号时联想到信号焰火；这是场景联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A letter or group of letters added to the end of a word or stem to change its meaning or grammatical form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加在词或词干末尾、用来改变词义或语法形式的字母或字母组合，即后缀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ittra jew grupp ta' ittri li jiżdiedu fl-aħħar ta' kelma jew zokk biex ibiddlu t-tifsira jew il-forma grammatikali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 后缀，即附加在词或词干末尾、具有构词或语法作用的成分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Element magħmul minn ittra jew minn grupp ta' ittri li jitqiegħed wara kelma jew zokk biex jagħti tifsira jew forma grammatikali differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A suffix is a letter or group of letters added at the end of a word or stem to change its meaning or grammatical form.

collocations.en: a suffix at the end of the word

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jidentifikaw is-suffiss u jispjegaw kif ibiddel it-tifsira tal-kelma.
formal.en: In the exercise, students must identify the suffix and explain how it changes the meaning of the word.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生需要识别后缀，并解释它如何改变词义。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn insib is-suffiss f'din il-kelma? Għalliema Rita: Fl-aħħar tagħha. Ħares lejn il-parti li żdiedet.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where do I find the suffix in this word? Teacher Rita: At its end. Look at the part that was added.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个词的后缀在哪里？丽塔老师：在词的末尾。看看添加上去的那一部分。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn insib is-suffiss f'din il-kelma?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn insib is-suffiss f'din il-kelma?
messages.zh: 这个词的后缀在哪里？
messages.en: Where do I find the suffix in this word?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-aħħar tagħha. Ħares lejn il-parti li żdiedet.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-aħħar tagħha. Ħares lejn il-parti li żdiedet.
messages.zh: 在词的末尾。看看添加上去的那一部分。
messages.en: At its end. Look at the part that was added.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 suffiss 时，在纸上画“词干＋后缀”，把后缀框在右边；每次看到这个词，就提醒自己先找词末添加的成分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The right to vote in political elections.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在政治选举中依法参加投票、选择代表或公职人员的权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dritt li persuna tivvota f'elezzjonijiet politiċi biex tagħżel rappreżentanti jew persuni għal karigi pubbliċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 选举权或投票权，指参加政治选举并投票作出选择的权利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dritt tal-persuni li jieħdu sehem f'elezzjoni politika billi jagħtu l-vot tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Suffrage is the right that people have to vote in political elections.

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddiskuti l-importanza tas-suffraġju u l-parteċipazzjoni taċ-ċittadini fl-elezzjonijiet.
formal.en: The article discusses the importance of suffrage and citizens' participation in elections.
formal.zh: 这篇文章讨论选举权的重要性以及公民参与选举的问题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser suffraġju f'dan l-artiklu? David: Ifisser id-dritt li tivvota fl-elezzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does suffraġju mean in this article? David: It means the right to vote in elections.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这篇文章里的 suffraġju 是什么意思？戴维：意思是在选举中投票的权利。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser suffraġju f'dan l-artiklu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser suffraġju f'dan l-artiklu?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 suffraġju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does suffraġju mean in this article?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser id-dritt li tivvota fl-elezzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser id-dritt li tivvota fl-elezzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 意思是在选举中投票的权利。
messages.en: It means the right to vote in elections.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 suffraġju 与“有权投下一票”绑定记忆：想象选票旁写着“权利”，提醒自己这个词强调参加选举的资格与权利。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The two soft outer edges of the mouth, which move when you speak, eat, or smile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嘴部上下两片柔软的外缘，说话、进食或微笑时会活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żewġ partijiet rotob ta' barra tal-ħalq, li jiċċaqilqu meta titkellem, tiekol jew titbissem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘴唇；构成嘴部上下边缘的两片柔软组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iż-żewġ partijiet rotob li jiffurmaw ix-xifer ta' fuq u ta' isfel tal-ħalq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your lips are the two soft edges of your mouth that you move when speaking or eating.

formal.mt: F'temp kiesaħ, is-sufftejn jistgħu jinxfu, għalhekk huwa utli li tuża balzmu biex iżżommhom rotob.
formal.en: In cold weather, lips can become dry, so it is useful to apply balm to keep them soft.
formal.zh: 天气寒冷时，嘴唇可能会变干，因此涂润唇膏有助于保持双唇柔软。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi s-sufftejn xotti ħafna llum. Nina: Trid tuża ftit balzmu? Għandi wieħed ġdid.
colloquial.en: Lara: My lips are very dry today. Nina: Would you like to use some lip balm? I have a new one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我今天嘴唇特别干。妮娜：你要涂点润唇膏吗？我有一支新的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi s-sufftejn xotti ħafna llum.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi s-sufftejn xotti ħafna llum.
messages.zh: 我今天嘴唇特别干。
messages.en: My lips are very dry today.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tuża ftit balzmu? Għandi wieħed ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Trid tuża ftit balzmu? Għandi wieħed ġdid.
messages.zh: 你要涂点润唇膏吗？我有一支新的。
messages.en: Would you like to use some lip balm? I have a new one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sufftejn 和双唇干燥、涂润唇膏的画面一起记，开口说话时再联想上下两片嘴唇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light, springy material used to make bottle stoppers, noticeboards, and other objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种轻而有弹性的材料，常用于制作瓶塞、留言板等物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal ħafif u elastiku li jintuża biex isiru tappijiet tal-fliexken, bordijiet għall-avviżi u oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 软木；质地轻、有弹性，常用于制作瓶塞或板材的材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal ħafif u elastiku li jintuża, fost affarijiet oħra, għall-manifattura ta' tappijiet u bordijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Cork is a light, springy material that is often used to make bottle stoppers and noticeboards.

formal.mt: L-avviżi għandhom jitwaħħlu mal-bord tas-sufra ħdejn id-daħla tal-uffiċċju.
formal.en: Notices should be pinned to the cork board beside the office entrance.
formal.zh: 通知应钉在办公室入口旁的软木板上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn inwaħħal dan ir-ritratt? Rita: Mal-bord tas-sufra, ħdejn il-kalendarju.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I pin this photo? Rita: On the cork board, next to the calendar.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张照片钉在哪里？丽塔：钉在软木板上，日历旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inwaħħal dan ir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inwaħħal dan ir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 这张照片钉在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I pin this photo?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mal-bord tas-sufra, ħdejn il-kalendarju.
messages.mt_standard: Mal-bord tas-sufra, ħdejn il-kalendarju.
messages.zh: 钉在软木板上，日历旁边。
messages.en: On the cork board, next to the calendar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 sufra 时想象手指按压轻巧的软木塞，再把同一种材料联系到能钉照片的软木板。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The liquid obtained from tomatoes, which can be drunk or used in cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由番茄榨取的液体，可以饮用，也可以用于烹饪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-likwidu miksub mit-tadam magħsur, li jista' jinxtorob jew jintuża fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 番茄汁；由番茄榨取、可饮用或用于烹饪的汁液。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meraq li jinkiseb billi jingħasar it-tadam u li jintuża bħala xarba jew bħala ingredjent fit-tisjir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tomato juice is the liquid obtained from tomatoes and consumed as a drink or used in cooking.

formal.mt: Waqt il-kolazzjon, il-mistednin jistgħu jagħżlu bejn sugu tad-tadam u meraq tal-larinġ.
formal.en: At breakfast, guests can choose between tomato juice and orange juice.
formal.zh: 早餐时，客人可以选择番茄汁或橙汁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandkom sugu tad-tadam? Mark: Iva. Trid tazza kiesħa? Sara: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, bla silġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have tomato juice? Mark: Yes. Would you like a cold glass? Sara: Yes, please, without ice.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们有番茄汁吗？马克：有。要来一杯冰凉的吗？萨拉：好的，谢谢，不加冰。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom sugu tad-tadam?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom sugu tad-tadam?
messages.zh: 你们有番茄汁吗？
messages.en: Do you have tomato juice?

messages.speaker: Mark (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Trid tazza kiesħa?
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Trid tazza kiesħa?
messages.zh: 有。要来一杯冰凉的吗？
messages.en: Yes. Would you like a cold glass?

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, bla silġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, bla silġ.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢，不加冰。
messages.en: Yes, please, without ice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组与早餐桌上一杯红色番茄汁配对记忆，再用“来一杯、不加冰”的点单情景复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A drink made from the juice extracted from fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从水果中榨取汁液制成的饮品，泛指各种果汁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba magħmula mil-likwidu li joħroġ mill-frott meta jingħasar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从水果中榨取的汁液，也指用这种汁液制成的饮品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-likwidu li jinkiseb meta jingħasar il-frott u li jista' jinxtorob bħala xarba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fruit juice is the liquid extracted from fruit and consumed as a drink.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ġew servuti ilma u sugu tal-frott lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: During the meeting, water and fruit juice were served to the participants.
formal.zh: 会议期间，主办方向与会者提供了水和果汁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tazza sugu tal-frott? Lara: Iva, grazzi. Bil-kesħa, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a glass of fruit juice? Lara: Yes, thanks. Chilled, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想喝杯果汁吗？拉拉：好，谢谢。请给我冰镇的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tazza sugu tal-frott?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tazza sugu tal-frott?
messages.zh: 你想喝杯果汁吗？
messages.en: Would you like a glass of fruit juice?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Bil-kesħa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Bil-kesħa, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。请给我冰镇的。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Chilled, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词和一杯混合果汁的画面绑定：看到 sugu tal-frott，就想到泛指水果榨成的果汁；连着 tazza 一起练习点饮料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A drink made from the juice extracted from oranges.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从橙子中榨取汁液制成的饮品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba magħmula mil-likwidu li joħroġ mil-larinġ meta jingħasar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从橙子中榨取的汁液，也指用这种汁液制成的饮品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-likwidu li jinkiseb meta jingħasar il-larinġ u li jinxtorob bħala xarba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Orange juice is the liquid extracted from oranges and served as a drink.

formal.mt: Il-menu tal-kolazzjon jinkludi ħobż, frott u tazza sugu tal-larinġ.
formal.en: The breakfast menu includes bread, fruit and a glass of orange juice.
formal.zh: 早餐菜单包括面包、水果和一杯橙汁。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandkom sugu tal-larinġ magħsur frisk? Rita: Iva. Trid tazza kbira jew żgħira?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have freshly squeezed orange juice? Rita: Yes. Would you like a large glass or a small one?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有鲜榨橙汁吗？丽塔：有。您要大杯还是小杯？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom sugu tal-larinġ magħsur frisk?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom sugu tal-larinġ magħsur frisk?
messages.zh: 你们有鲜榨橙汁吗？
messages.en: Do you have freshly squeezed orange juice?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Trid tazza kbira jew żgħira?
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Trid tazza kbira jew żgħira?
messages.zh: 有。您要大杯还是小杯？
messages.en: Yes. Would you like a large glass or a small one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象早餐桌上的橙子和橙色果汁，把 sugu tal-larinġ 整体读出来；与泛指果汁的 sugu tal-frott 对照，记住这里明确是橙汁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small stick with a tip that ignites when rubbed against a suitable surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头部涂有可燃物、在合适表面摩擦后能够点燃的小棒，即一根火柴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stikka żgħira b'ras li tieħu n-nar meta tingħorok ma' wiċċ adattat, u li tintuża biex tqabbad xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于引火的小棒，头部在合适表面摩擦后会燃烧；指火柴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stikka żgħira li għandha ras li taqbad bin-nar meta tingħorok ma' wiċċ adattat u li tintuża biex tixgħel xemgħa jew tqabbad nar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A match is a small stick whose treated tip produces a flame when struck against a suitable surface.

formal.mt: Għall-esperiment, l-għalliem xegħel xemgħa b'sulfarina quddiem il-klassi.
formal.en: For the experiment, the teacher lit a candle with a match in front of the class.
formal.zh: 实验时，老师在全班面前用一根火柴点燃了蜡烛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek sulfarina biex nixgħel ix-xemgħa? Maja: Iva, il-kaxxa tas-sulfarini qiegħda fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you got a match so I can light the candle? Maja: Yes, the box of matches is on the table.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有火柴吗？我想点蜡烛。玛雅：有，火柴盒就在桌上。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek sulfarina biex nixgħel ix-xemgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek sulfarina biex nixgħel ix-xemgħa?
messages.zh: 你有火柴吗？我想点蜡烛。
messages.en: Have you got a match so I can light the candle?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kaxxa tas-sulfarini qiegħda fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kaxxa tas-sulfarini qiegħda fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 有，火柴盒就在桌上。
messages.en: Yes, the box of matches is on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“拿出一根、划亮、点蜡烛”的连续画面记 sulfarina；再搭配 kaxxa tas-sulfarini，把一根火柴和一盒火柴一起记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Repeated involuntary interruptions of breathing that produce short hic sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呼吸不由自主地反复短暂停顿，并发出短促“嗝”声的现象，指呃逆式打嗝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' kontrazzjonijiet involontarji tad-dijaframma li jwaqqfu n-nifs għal ftit u joħolqu ħoss qasir ripetut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因膈肌不自主收缩而反复发出短促“嗝”声的现象，即呃逆，不指胃中气体排出的嗳气。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha d-dijaframma tikkuntratta bla kontroll ripetutament, u tikkawża waqfiet qosra fin-nifs flimkien ma' ħoss qasir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have hiccups, your breathing is repeatedly interrupted by involuntary contractions that produce short hic sounds.

formal.mt: Waqt il-preżentazzjoni, il-kelliem kellu jieqaf għal ftit minħabba s-sulluzzu.
formal.en: During the presentation, the speaker had to pause briefly because of hiccups.
formal.zh: 演讲期间，发言人因打嗝而不得不短暂停顿。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi s-sulluzzu u qed insibha diffiċli nitkellem. Rita: Nistennew ftit, imbagħad tkompli tirrakkonta.
colloquial.en: Mark: I've got hiccups and I'm finding it hard to talk. Rita: Let's wait a little, then you can carry on with your story.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我一直打嗝，说话有点困难。丽塔：我们等一会儿，然后你再接着讲。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi s-sulluzzu u qed insibha diffiċli nitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi s-sulluzzu u qed insibha diffiċli nitkellem.
messages.zh: 我一直打嗝，说话有点困难。
messages.en: I've got hiccups and I'm finding it hard to talk.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistennew ftit, imbagħad tkompli tirrakkonta.
messages.mt_standard: Nistennew ftit, imbagħad tkompli tirrakkonta.
messages.zh: 我们等一会儿，然后你再接着讲。
messages.en: Let's wait a little, then you can carry on with your story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象说话时被连续的“嗝、嗝”声打断，把 sulluzzu 和这个场景联系起来；整句练习 għandi s-sulluzzu，记住“我在打嗝”的表达。

gloss_zh: 词义未明，暂不作实义翻译

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个目前无法确定具体含义的名词；教学中宜先识别其词形，不推断其意义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mill-informazzjoni mogħtija; għalissa għandu jiġi ttrattat bħala kelma b'tifsira mhux magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具体词义无法辨认，因此暂不提供确定的中文释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' dan in-nom mhijiex ċara u ma tistax tiġi definita b'ċertezza bl-informazzjoni disponibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this noun remains uncertain because the available definition cannot be read.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'sunetti' tidher fit-test, iżda t-tifsira tagħha għadha mhix ċara u teħtieġ aktar verifika.
formal.en: The word 'sunetti' appears in the text, but its meaning remains unclear and requires further verification.
formal.zh: “sunetti”一词出现在文本中，但其含义尚不清楚，需要进一步核实。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'sunetti'? Pawlu: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nħarsu lejn is-sentenza kollha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'sunetti' mean? Pawlu: I don't know yet. Let's look at the whole sentence.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“sunetti”是什么意思？保罗：我还不知道。我们看看完整的句子吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'sunetti'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'sunetti'?
messages.zh: “sunetti”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'sunetti' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nħarsu lejn is-sentenza kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nħarsu lejn is-sentenza kollha.
messages.zh: 我还不知道。我们看看完整的句子吧。
messages.en: I don't know yet. Let's look at the whole sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“待查词卡”：先记住 sunetti 的完整拼写，再等待可靠释义，不凭外形猜词义。

gloss_zh: 总科；层级中的上位类型

teaching_sense.en_definition: A grouping above the family level in biological classification, or a broader type containing subordinate types in a hierarchy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生物分类中位于科之上的总科；也指层级结构中涵盖若干下位类型的上位类型。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp fil-klassifikazzjoni bijoloġika li jinsab fuq il-livell ta' familja, jew tip usa' f'ġerarkija li jiġbor fih tipi subordinati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 总科，生物分类中位于科之上、归集相关科的分类单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kategorija fil-klassifikazzjoni bijoloġika li tinsab fuq il-livell ta' familja u tiġbor fiha familji relatati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A superfamily is a biological classification group that contains related families.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 层级结构中的上位类型，其范围包含若干较具体的下位类型。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ġenerali f'ġerarkija li jinkludi taħtu tipi oħra aktar speċifiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In a hierarchy, a superfamily is a broader type under which more specific types are grouped.

collocations.zh: 涵盖相关类型的上位类型

formal.mt: Fil-klassifikazzjoni bijoloġika, superfamilja tiġbor flimkien familji relatati u tinsab fuq il-livell ta' familja.
formal.en: In biological classification, a superfamily groups related families together and stands above the family level.
formal.zh: 在生物分类中，总科将相关的科归为一组，其层级高于科。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn it-tipi kollha jidħlu fl-istess grupp? Mark: Iva, f'din il-ġerarkija kollha jaqgħu taħt l-istess superfamilja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do all these types belong to the same group? Mark: Yes, in this hierarchy they all fall under the same superfamily.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些类型都属于同一组吗？马克：是的，在这个层级结构中，它们都归在同一个上位类型之下。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn it-tipi kollha jidħlu fl-istess grupp?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn it-tipi kollha jidħlu fl-istess grupp?
messages.zh: 这些类型都属于同一组吗？
messages.en: Do all these types belong to the same group?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'din il-ġerarkija kollha jaqgħu taħt l-istess superfamilja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'din il-ġerarkija kollha jaqgħu taħt l-istess superfamilja.
messages.zh: 是的，在这个层级结构中，它们都归在同一个上位类型之下。
messages.en: Yes, in this hierarchy they all fall under the same superfamily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一棵分类树：上层框写 superfamilja，下层放几个科或具体类型，用“上层包下层”同时记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: M.U.S.E.U.M. 宗教教育组织的分支主管
