teaching_sense.en_definition: Designating the leader of a branch of the religious instruction organisation M.U.S.E.U.M.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于指称宗教教育组织 M.U.S.E.U.M. 某一分支的主管。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tindika l-persuna li tmexxi fergħa tal-organizzazzjoni għat-tagħlim reliġjuż M.U.S.E.U.M.

sense_translations.en_definition: MUSEUM superior (leader in a branch of the organisation for religious instruction M.U.S.E.U.M)
sense_translations.zh_definition: M.U.S.E.U.M. 宗教教育组织某一分支的主管，即负责领导该分支的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-persuna responsabbli mit-tmexxija ta' fergħa tal-organizzazzjoni għat-tagħlim reliġjuż M.U.S.E.U.M.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In M.U.S.E.U.M., the superior is the person who leads a branch of the religious instruction organisation.

formal.mt: Is-superjur tal-fergħa tal-M.U.S.E.U.M. iltaqa' mal-membri biex jiddiskuti l-programm tat-tagħlim reliġjuż.
formal.en: The superior of the M.U.S.E.U.M. branch met with the members to discuss the religious instruction programme.
formal.zh: M.U.S.E.U.M. 该分支的主管与成员会面，讨论宗教教育课程安排。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ma' min nista' nitkellem dwar il-laqgħa tal-fergħa? Ġużeppi: Tista' titkellem mas-superjur; illum qiegħed hawn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who can I speak to about the branch meeting? Ġużeppi: You can speak to the superior; he is here today.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：关于分支会议，我可以找谁谈？朱塞佩：你可以找主管谈，他今天在这里。

messages.speaker: Anna (新成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min nista' nitkellem dwar il-laqgħa tal-fergħa?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min nista' nitkellem dwar il-laqgħa tal-fergħa?
messages.zh: 关于分支会议，我可以找谁谈？
messages.en: Who can I speak to about the branch meeting?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (分支成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' titkellem mas-superjur; illum qiegħed hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' titkellem mas-superjur; illum qiegħed hawn.
messages.zh: 你可以找主管谈，他今天在这里。
messages.en: You can speak to the superior; he is here today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 M.U.S.E.U.M. 分支会议上负责主持的人，把 superjur 与“分支主管”这一具体角色一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Higher in rank or level, or better in quality, than something being compared.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在等级、层次或质量方面高于比较对象；具体理解取决于上下文。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tindika grad jew livell ogħla, jew kwalità aħjar, meta jsir paragun ma' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在等级或层次上较高的，或在质量上较优的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ta' grad jew livell ogħla, jew ta' kwalità aħjar, minn dak li jkun qed jitqabbel miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as superior has a higher rank or level, or better quality, than what it is compared with.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-materjal il-ġdid bħala ta' kwalità superjuri meta mqabbel ma' dak użat qabel.
formal.en: The report describes the new material as being of superior quality compared with the material used previously.
formal.zh: 报告指出，与先前使用的材料相比，新材料的质量更优。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex dan id-drapp jiswa aktar? David: Għax huwa ta' kwalità superjuri u jdum aktar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why does this fabric cost more? David: Because it is of superior quality and lasts longer.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：为什么这种布料更贵？戴维：因为它质量更好，也更耐用。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan id-drapp jiswa aktar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan id-drapp jiswa aktar?
messages.zh: 为什么这种布料更贵？
messages.en: Why does this fabric cost more?

messages.speaker: David (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa ta' kwalità superjuri u jdum aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa ta' kwalità superjuri u jdum aktar.
messages.zh: 因为它质量更好，也更耐用。
messages.en: Because it is of superior quality and lasts longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个比较画面：等级阶梯上更高一层，布料质量上更好一档；用 superjuri 连接“更高”和“更优”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A class higher in a hierarchy, especially one whose properties and methods can be inherited by other classes in programming.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 类的层级结构中处于上层的类，尤指编程中可供其他类继承其属性和方法的类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Klassi f'livell ogħla ta' ġerarkija, speċjalment fl-ipprogrammar, li klassijiet oħra jistgħu jirtu l-proprjetajiet u l-metodi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 超类；在类的继承关系中，提供属性和方法供其他类继承的上层类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Klassi f'ġerarkija ta' klassijiet li minnha klassijiet oħra jistgħu jirtu proprjetajiet u metodi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A superclass is a class from which other classes can inherit properties and methods.

formal.mt: F'dan il-programm, il-klassi Karozza tiret il-metodu għall-moviment mis-superklassi Vettura.
formal.en: In this program, the Car class inherits the movement method from the Vehicle superclass.
formal.zh: 在这个程序中，汽车类从交通工具超类继承移动方法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-klassi Karozza għandha dan il-metodu? Pawlu: Għax tirtu mis-superklassi Vettura.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the Car class have this method? Pawlu: Because it inherits it from the Vehicle superclass.
colloquial.zh: Lara：汽车类为什么有这个方法？Pawlu：因为它从交通工具超类继承了这个方法。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-klassi Karozza għandha dan il-metodu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-klassi Karozza għandha dan il-metodu?
messages.zh: 汽车类为什么有这个方法？
messages.en: Why does the Car class have this method?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tirtu mis-superklassi Vettura.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tirtu mis-superklassi Vettura.
messages.zh: 因为它从交通工具超类继承了这个方法。
messages.en: Because it inherits it from the Vehicle superclass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把类的继承关系画成家谱：上层的 superklassi 提供共同属性和方法，下层的类继承它们，用图像记住“超类”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a grammatical degree or form that expresses the highest or lowest degree of a quality within a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述语法上的最高级，表示某种性质在一个群体中达到最高或最低程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jindika l-ogħla jew l-inqas grad ta' kwalità fost il-membri ta' grupp, meta jintuża dwar grad jew forma grammatikali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最高级的；用于描述在一定比较范围内表示某种性质达到最高或最低程度的语法等级或形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jesprimi l-ogħla jew l-inqas grad ta' kwalità meta persuna jew ħaġa titqabbel mal-bqija ta' grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A superlative form expresses the highest or lowest degree of a quality within a particular group.

formal.mt: Fis-sentenza 'Din hija l-akbar sala fl-iskola', l-aġġettiv jinsab fil-grad superlativ.
formal.en: In the sentence 'This is the largest hall in the school', the adjective is in the superlative degree.
formal.zh: 在“这是学校里最大的礼堂”这句话中，形容词使用了最高级。

colloquial.mt: Marija: 'L-akbar' hija forma superlativa? Daniel: Iva, bħal meta ngħidu 'l-akbar kamra fid-dar'.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is 'l-akbar' a superlative form? Daniel: Yes, as when we say 'the largest room in the house'.
colloquial.zh: Marija：“l-akbar”是最高级形式吗？Daniel：是的，比如我们说“房子里最大的房间”。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'L-akbar' hija forma superlativa?
messages.mt_standard: 'L-akbar' hija forma superlativa?
messages.zh: “l-akbar”是最高级形式吗？
messages.en: Is 'l-akbar' a superlative form?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bħal meta ngħidu 'l-akbar kamra fid-dar'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bħal meta ngħidu 'l-akbar kamra fid-dar'.
messages.zh: 是的，比如我们说“房子里最大的房间”。
messages.en: Yes, as when we say 'the largest room in the house'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 superlativ 放进 grad superlativ 一起记：它是形容词，给语法等级贴上“最高级的”标签；修饰 forma 时记作 superlativa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The grammatical degree or form used to express the highest or lowest degree of a quality within a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 语法中的最高级或最高级形式，用于表达某种性质在一个群体中达到最高或最低程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grad jew il-forma grammatikali li tesprimi l-ogħla jew l-inqas grad ta' kwalità fost il-membri ta' grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最高级；把某人或某物与同一范围内的其他成员比较，表示某种性质达到最高或最低程度的语法等级或形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grad ta' tqabbil, jew forma li turi dan il-grad, li bih persuna jew ħaġa tingħata l-ogħla jew l-inqas grad ta' kwalità fi grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The superlative is the grammatical degree used to identify the highest or lowest degree of a quality within a group.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jagħtu eżempju tas-superlattiv, bħal 'l-isbaħ', u jużawh f'sentenza sħiħa.
formal.en: Students should give an example of the superlative, such as 'the most beautiful', and use it in a complete sentence.
formal.zh: 学生应举出一个最高级的例子，如“最美的”，并把它用于一个完整的句子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ngħid li dan il-ġnien hu isbaħ mill-oħrajn kollha? Mark: Uża s-superlattiv: 'Dan hu l-isbaħ ġnien'.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do I say that this garden is more beautiful than all the others? Mark: Use the superlative: 'This is the most beautiful garden'.
colloquial.zh: Sara：怎样表达这个花园比其他所有花园都美？Mark：用最高级：“这是最美的花园。”

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ngħid li dan il-ġnien hu isbaħ mill-oħrajn kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ngħid li dan il-ġnien hu isbaħ mill-oħrajn kollha?
messages.zh: 怎样表达这个花园比其他所有花园都美？
messages.en: How do I say that this garden is more beautiful than all the others?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża s-superlattiv: 'Dan hu l-isbaħ ġnien'.
messages.mt_standard: Uża s-superlattiv: 'Dan hu l-isbaħ ġnien'.
messages.zh: 用最高级：“这是最美的花园。”
messages.en: Use the superlative: 'This is the most beautiful garden'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 superlattiv 当作语法课上的一个名词术语来记，意思是“最高级”；本组中双写 tt 的这一项是名词，可搭配“使用最高级”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large self-service shop that sells food, drinks, and everyday household goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 销售食品、饮料和日常家居用品，主要由顾客自行选取商品的大型商店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut kbir li jbigħ ikel, xorb u prodotti ta' kuljum għad-dar, fejn il-klijenti jagħżlu l-prodotti huma stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 超级市场；以顾客自选商品为主要购物方式，出售食品、饮料及日常用品的大型商店。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħanut kbir fejn il-klijenti jieħdu l-ikel, ix-xorb u l-prodotti tad-dar minn fuq l-ixkafef u jħallsu għalihom mal-kaxxier.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supermarket is a large shop where customers select food and household goods from shelves before paying at a checkout.

formal.mt: Is-supermarkit jiftaħ fit-tmienja ta' filgħodu u joffri għażla wiesgħa ta' ikel u prodotti għad-dar.
formal.en: The supermarket opens at eight in the morning and offers a wide selection of food and household products.
formal.zh: 这家超市早上八点开门，提供种类丰富的食品和家居用品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se tmur is-supermarkit illum? Ġanni: Iva, għandi bżonn nixtri l-ħalib u l-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you going to the supermarket today? Ġanni: Yes, I need to buy milk and bread.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你今天去超市吗？Ġanni：去，我需要买牛奶和面包。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tmur is-supermarkit illum?
messages.mt_standard: Se tmur is-supermarkit illum?
messages.zh: 你今天去超市吗？
messages.en: Are you going to the supermarket today?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi bżonn nixtri l-ħalib u l-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi bżonn nixtri l-ħalib u l-ħobż.
messages.zh: 去，我需要买牛奶和面包。
messages.en: Yes, I need to buy milk and bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 supermarkit 和“推购物车买牛奶、面包”的画面绑定记忆，再整句练习 tmur is-supermarkit，记住“去超市”的常用表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Beyond the ordinary laws of nature or attributed to powers outside the natural world.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 超出通常的自然规律，或被认为涉及自然世界之外的力量的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jmur lil hinn mil-liġijiet tan-natura jew li jiġi attribwit lil qawwiet barra mid-dinja naturali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 超自然的；被认为超出自然规律或涉及非自然力量的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jitqiesx bħala parti mill-proċessi ordinarji tan-natura u li jiġi marbut ma' qawwiet lil hinn minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something supernatural is believed to involve powers or events beyond the ordinary laws of nature.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, id-dawl misterjuż huwa deskritt bħala fenomenu supernaturali.
formal.en: In the story, the mysterious light is described as a supernatural phenomenon.
formal.zh: 在这篇故事中，那道神秘的光被描述为一种超自然现象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li dak il-ħoss kien xi ħaġa supernaturali? Leo: Le, naħseb li kienet it-tieqa tiċċaqlaq bir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think that noise was something supernatural? Leo: No, I think it was the window moving in the wind.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你觉得那个声音是什么超自然的东西发出来的吗？Leo：不，我觉得是窗户被风吹动的声音。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dak il-ħoss kien xi ħaġa supernaturali?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dak il-ħoss kien xi ħaġa supernaturali?
messages.zh: 你觉得那个声音是什么超自然的东西发出来的吗？
messages.en: Do you think that noise was something supernatural?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, naħseb li kienet it-tieqa tiċċaqlaq bir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, naħseb li kienet it-tieqa tiċċaqlaq bir-riħ.
messages.zh: 不，我觉得是窗户被风吹动的声音。
messages.en: No, I think it was the window moving in the wind.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事里一盏无风自动的灯，把这个词与“超出自然规律”的画面联系起来；这是语义记忆，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entity or category at a higher level in a hierarchy, under which other entities or categories are grouped.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在层级结构中处于较高一级、其下包含其他项目或类别的上位项或类别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entità jew kategorija f'livell ogħla ta' ġerarkija li taħtha jinġabru entitajiet jew kategoriji oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上位项；在层级关系中包含或统辖较低层级项目的实体或类别。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Entità jew kategorija li tinsab fuq oħrajn f'ġerarkija u li tinkludihom jew tiġborhom taħtha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A superordinate is an entity or category that occupies a higher level in a hierarchy than others grouped beneath it.

collocations.zh: 归于同一个上位类别之下

formal.mt: F'din il-ġerarkija, is-superordni jiġbor taħtu tliet kategoriji iżgħar.
formal.en: In this hierarchy, the superordinate groups three smaller categories beneath it.
formal.zh: 在这一层级结构中，该上位类别之下包含三个较小的类别。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn iż-żewġ kategoriji għandhom l-istess superordni? Pawlu: Iva, ħares lejn il-kaxxa ta' fuqhom fid-dijagramma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do these two categories have the same superordinate? Pawlu: Yes, look at the box above them in the diagram.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这两个类别属于同一个上位类别吗？Pawlu：对，看看图中它们上面的那个方框。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żewġ kategoriji għandhom l-istess superordni?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żewġ kategoriji għandhom l-istess superordni?
messages.zh: 这两个类别属于同一个上位类别吗？
messages.en: Do these two categories have the same superordinate?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħares lejn il-kaxxa ta' fuqhom fid-dijagramma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħares lejn il-kaxxa ta' fuqhom fid-dijagramma.
messages.zh: 对，看看图中它们上面的那个方框。
messages.en: Yes, look at the box above them in the diagram.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张分类树：上方一个大框连接下方几个小框，把上方的大框记作 superordni，帮助记住“上位类别”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The monitoring and oversight of goods or related activities by the customs authorities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海关当局对货物或相关活动实施的监督与管理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sorveljanza u l-kontroll tal-merkanzija jew ta' attivitajiet relatati minn naħa tal-awtoritajiet doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关监管；海关对货物及相关活动实施的监督管理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sorveljanza li ssir mill-awtoritajiet doganali fuq il-merkanzija u l-attivitajiet relatati magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs supervision is the monitoring of goods or related activities carried out by customs authorities.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由海关当局实施的监管；强调监管的执行主体是海关当局。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kontroll jew il-monitoraġġ li jwettqu l-awtoritajiet doganali fuq merkanzija jew attivitajiet li jaqgħu taħt ir-responsabbiltà tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Supervision by the customs authorities means that those authorities oversee the goods or activities concerned.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-merkanzija baqgħet taħt superviżjoni doganali matul il-ħażna.
formal.en: The report indicates that the goods remained under customs supervision during storage.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这批货物在仓储期间一直处于海关监管之下。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-kaxxi għadhom taħt superviżjoni doganali? Rita: Iva, hekk jgħid l-aħħar aġġornament li rċevejna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are the boxes still under customs supervision? Rita: Yes, that's what the latest update we received says.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这些箱子还在海关监管之下吗？Rita：是的，我们收到的最新消息是这样说的。

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kaxxi għadhom taħt superviżjoni doganali?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kaxxi għadhom taħt superviżjoni doganali?
messages.zh: 这些箱子还在海关监管之下吗？
messages.en: Are the boxes still under customs supervision?

messages.speaker: Rita (物流职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk jgħid l-aħħar aġġornament li rċevejna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk jgħid l-aħħar aġġornament li rċevejna.
messages.zh: 是的，我们收到的最新消息是这样说的。
messages.en: Yes, that's what the latest update we received says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条短语放进“货物处于海关监管之下”的场景中记忆，尤其连读 taħt superviżjoni doganali，形成完整表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a high opinion of oneself, often with an attitude of superiority towards others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自视甚高的，常带有认为自己优于他人的高傲或傲慢态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu opinjoni għolja tiegħu nnifsu u li spiss iġib ruħu bħallikieku huwa aħjar minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骄傲的；自负的；对自身价值或能力评价很高的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jqis lilu nnifsu u l-kapaċitajiet tiegħu b'stima għolja u juri kburija bih innifsu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is proud has a high opinion of their own worth or abilities.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 傲慢的；目中无人的；表现得仿佛自己比别人更高一等的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri li jqis lilu nnifsu aħjar minn ħaddieħor u jittratta lill-oħrajn b'arroganza jew b'disprezz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is haughty behaves as though other people are less important or worthy than they are.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-kap huwa ppreżentat bħala raġel supperv li ma jaċċettax il-kritika.
formal.en: In the novel, the leader is presented as a haughty man who does not accept criticism.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，领袖被描写成一个不接受批评的高傲男人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex tgħid li hu supperv? David: Għax jitkellem bħallikieku hu biss jaf kollox u ma jisma' lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you say he's haughty? David: Because he talks as if he's the only one who knows everything and doesn't listen to anyone.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么说他傲慢？David：因为他说起话来，好像只有他什么都懂，而且谁的话都不听。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li hu supperv?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li hu supperv?
messages.zh: 你为什么说他傲慢？
messages.en: Why do you say he's haughty?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jitkellem bħallikieku hu biss jaf kollox u ma jisma' lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jitkellem bħallikieku hu biss jaf kollox u ma jisma' lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他说起话来，好像只有他什么都懂，而且谁的话都不听。
messages.en: Because he talks as if he's the only one who knows everything and doesn't listen to anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个抬着下巴、觉得自己样样胜过别人又听不进意见的人，用这个画面记住 supperv 的“自负、高傲”意味。

gloss_zh: 傲慢；自高自大；高傲疏离

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exaggerated sense of your own importance that makes you treat other people as inferior or keep them at a distance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过分看重自己，因而轻视他人或以高高在上的态度与人保持距离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens eċċessiv tal-importanza tiegħek innifsek li jwasslek biex tqis lil ħaddieħor inferjuri jew iżżommu 'l bogħod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自负；过分看重自己或自己的成就。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stima eċċessiva tiegħek innifsek jew tal-kisbiet tiegħek, li ġġiegħlek tħossok aqwa minn ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pride in this sense is an excessive opinion of your own worth or achievements.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 傲慢；认为自己高人一等并轻视他人的态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attitudni ta' min iħossu superjuri għal ħaddieħor u jittrattah bi stmerrija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Haughtiness is an attitude that shows you consider other people less important than yourself.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高傲冷淡；不愿亲近他人、使人难以接近的态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attitudni kiesħa u distakkata li biha persuna żżomm lil ħaddieħor 'il bogħod u ma turix ħbiberija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Stand-offishness is behaviour that makes you seem distant and unwilling to be friendly.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, is-suppervja tal-protagonist tbiegħdu minn dawk li jixtiequ jgħinuh.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist's arrogance distances him from those who wish to help him.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，主人公的傲慢使他疏远了那些想帮助他的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' titkellem miegħu? Lara: Għax kull darba jkellimni b'suppervja, bħallikieku ma nifhem xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to speak to him again? Lara: Because every time he speaks to me, he is arrogant, as if I don't understand anything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不想再跟他说话？拉拉：因为他每次都傲慢地跟我说话，好像我什么都不懂。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' titkellem miegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' titkellem miegħu?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想再跟他说话？
messages.en: Why don't you want to speak to him again?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba jkellimni b'suppervja, bħallikieku ma nifhem xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba jkellimni b'suppervja, bħallikieku ma nifhem xejn.
messages.zh: 因为他每次都傲慢地跟我说话，好像我什么都不懂。
messages.en: Because every time he speaks to me, he is arrogant, as if I don't understand anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 suppervja 联想成一个人昂着头、看低别人又不愿靠近的画面，串起“自负、傲慢、高傲疏离”三个义项；这里的 pride 偏贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something added to an existing thing to provide extra material, information, or nutrients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 添加到已有事物中的补充部分，可指补充资料、报刊增刊或营养补充剂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tiżdied ma' oħra biex tipprovdi materjal, tagħrif jew nutrijenti addizzjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 补充物或附加部分，如报刊的增刊、补充资料或营养补充剂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żieda ma' xi ħaġa eżistenti li tagħti materjal jew tagħrif ieħor, jew prodott li jipprovdi nutrijenti addizzjonali mad-dieta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supplement is something added to an existing thing to provide additional material, information, or nutrients.

formal.mt: Il-gazzetta ppubblikat suppliment speċjali b'artikli dwar l-istorja tal-belt.
formal.en: The newspaper published a special supplement containing articles about the city's history.
formal.zh: 这家报纸出版了一份特别增刊，刊载有关这座城市历史的文章。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu s-suppliment tal-gazzetta? Nina: Ħallejtu fuq il-mejda; fih artiklu sabiħ dwar il-mużika.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the newspaper supplement? Nina: I left it on the table; it has a lovely article about music.
colloquial.zh: 马克：报纸的增刊在哪里？妮娜：我把它放在桌上了，里面有一篇很不错的音乐文章。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu s-suppliment tal-gazzetta?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu s-suppliment tal-gazzetta?
messages.zh: 报纸的增刊在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the newspaper supplement?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejtu fuq il-mejda; fih artiklu sabiħ dwar il-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejtu fuq il-mejda; fih artiklu sabiħ dwar il-mużika.
messages.zh: 我把它放在桌上了，里面有一篇很不错的音乐文章。
messages.en: I left it on the table; it has a lovely article about music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 suppliment 时想象一份报纸旁边另附一本小册子：主体之外“再补一份”。这个共同画面也能帮助记住补充资料和营养补充剂。

gloss_zh: 应该；预定的；据认为的；据说

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate what is expected, intended, believed, or reported to be true, without necessarily confirming that it is true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示按要求应该如此、按安排预定如此，或按他人的看法与说法如此；具体是否属实需结合语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tindika dak li hu mistenni, maħsub, meqjus jew irrappurtat li hu minnu, mingħajr ma bilfors tikkonfermah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应该；按要求、责任或合理预期应当如此。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika dak li għandu jsir jew iseħħ skont dmir, regola jew aspettattiva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is suppost to do something, they are expected or required to do it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被认为的；被假定的；按计划或安排预定的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika dak li hu meqjus jew maħsub li hu minnu, jew dak li hu ppjanat li jsir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as suppost is believed to be a certain way or intended to happen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 看来；据现有信息似乎如此，但尚未完全确认。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tidher li hi minnha skont it-tagħrif disponibbli, iżda mhix ikkonfermata għalkollox.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use suppost when available information suggests that something is true, although you are not certain.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 据称；据他人的说法如此，说话者不保证其真实性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa qed tingħad minn ħaddieħor, mingħajr ma min jitkellem jikkonferma li hi vera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use suppost to report what others claim without confirming that their claim is true.

formal.mt: Skont il-programm, is-seminar suppost jibda fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: According to the programme, the seminar is supposed to begin at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 根据日程安排，研讨会应于上午九点开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut miftuħ illum? Pawlu: Suppost iva, imma għadni ma ċċekkjajtx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the shop open today? Pawlu: It should be, but I haven't checked yet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：商店今天开门吗？保罗：应该开，不过我还没确认。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħanut miftuħ illum?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħanut miftuħ illum?
messages.zh: 商店今天开门吗？
messages.en: Is the shop open today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Suppost iva, imma għadni ma ċċekkjajtx.
messages.mt_standard: Suppost iva, imma għadni ma ċċekkjajtx.
messages.zh: 应该开，不过我还没确认。
messages.en: It should be, but I haven't checked yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 suppost 放在“预期或说法”这张便签上：按要求是“应该”，按安排是“预定”，按现有消息是“似乎”，转述他人则是“据称”。先判断信息来源，再选中文译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A solid medicinal preparation inserted into the rectum or vagina, where it dissolves or melts to release medicine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放入直肠或阴道后溶解或熔化并释放药物的一种固体药物制剂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Preparat mediċinali solidu li jiddaħħal fir-rektum jew fil-vaġina, fejn jinħall biex jirrilaxxa l-mediċina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 栓剂；置入直肠或阴道后溶解或熔化、释放药物的固体制剂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma solida ta' mediċina maħsuba biex tiddaħħal fir-rektum jew fil-vaġina u tinħall hemmhekk biex tirrilaxxa s-sustanza mediċinali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A suppository is a solid medicinal preparation placed inside the rectum or vagina to release medicine as it dissolves or melts.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega kif għandu jinżamm is-suppożitorju u jagħti struzzjonijiet dwar l-użu tiegħu.
formal.en: The leaflet explains how the suppository should be stored and provides instructions for its use.
formal.zh: 说明书解释了栓剂的储存方法，并提供使用说明。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din il-mediċina hi pillola? Rita: Le, hi suppożitorju. Il-fuljett fil-kaxxa jispjega kif tintuża.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this medicine a tablet? Rita: No, it's a suppository. The leaflet in the box explains how to use it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这种药是药片吗？丽塔：不是，是栓剂。盒子里的说明书解释了怎么使用。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-mediċina hi pillola?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-mediċina hi pillola?
messages.zh: 这种药是药片吗？
messages.en: Is this medicine a tablet?

messages.speaker: Rita (药剂师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hi suppożitorju. Il-fuljett fil-kaxxa jispjega kif tintuża.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hi suppożitorju. Il-fuljett fil-kaxxa jispjega kif tintuża.
messages.zh: 不是，是栓剂。盒子里的说明书解释了怎么使用。
messages.en: No, it's a suppository. The leaflet in the box explains how to use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 suppożitorju 时，把词卡与“栓剂”的药物剂型图配对，再用“固体、置入、溶解释药”三个提示巩固含义，帮助它与药片等其他剂型区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An idea that is accepted as true for the purpose of reasoning, although it has not been fully proved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未得到充分证实，但在思考或推理时暂且视为真实的想法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsieb li jitqies bħala veru waqt ir-raġunament, għalkemm għadu ma ġiex ippruvat għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在缺乏充分证明时暂且接受的假设或推测。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Idea jew fehma li persuna taċċetta bħala vera mingħajr ma jkollha prova sħiħa tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supposition is an idea that you accept as true even though you do not yet have enough evidence to prove it.

formal.mt: L-analiżi hija bbażata fuq is-suppożizzjoni li l-prezzijiet se jibqgħu stabbli.
formal.en: The analysis is based on the supposition that prices will remain stable.
formal.zh: 这项分析以价格将保持稳定这一假设为基础。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qed nassumu li Sara ġejja? Pawlu: Iva, imma din għadha suppożizzjoni; għadna ma kellimnihiex.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are we assuming that Sara is coming? Pawlu: Yes, but that is still a supposition; we have not spoken to her yet.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们现在是假定 Sara 会来吗？Pawlu：是的，但这还只是推测；我们还没跟她说过话。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nassumu li Sara ġejja?
messages.mt_standard: Qed nassumu li Sara ġejja?
messages.zh: 我们现在是假定 Sara 会来吗？
messages.en: Are we assuming that Sara is coming?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma din għadha suppożizzjoni; għadna ma kellimnihiex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma din għadha suppożizzjoni; għadna ma kellimnihiex.
messages.zh: 是的，但这还只是推测；我们还没跟她说过话。
messages.en: Yes, but that is still a supposition; we have not spoken to her yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 suppożizzjoni 想成推理前贴上的“暂且当真”便签：可以据此讨论，但仍需证据确认。

gloss_zh: 与性有关的动作（具体动作未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carry out an action connected with sex; the particular action is unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示进行某种与性有关的动作；具体指哪一种动作尚未明确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li ssir xi azzjoni marbuta mas-sess, iżda l-azzjoni partikolari mhix speċifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示与性有关的动作，但未明确具体动作的动词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika azzjoni li għandha x'taqsam mas-sess, mingħajr ma jkun speċifikat x'inhi eżatt din l-azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This verb concerns an action connected with sex, although its precise meaning cannot be determined from this description alone.

collocations.en: the use of the verb 'supra' in context
collocations.zh: 动词 supra 在语境中的用法

formal.mt: Biex nifhmu t-tifsira preċiża tal-verb 'supra', għandna neżaminaw is-sentenza kollha.
formal.en: To understand the precise meaning of the verb 'supra', we should examine the whole sentence.
formal.zh: 要理解动词 supra 的确切含义，我们应当查看整个句子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser il-verb 'supra' hawn? Mark: Għandu x'jaqsam mas-sess, imma rridu naraw is-sentenza kollha biex nifhmu l-azzjoni eżatta.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the verb 'supra' mean here? Mark: It has to do with sex, but we need to see the whole sentence to understand the exact action.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的动词 supra 是什么意思？Mark：它与性有关，但我们需要看整个句子才能明确具体指什么动作。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser il-verb 'supra' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser il-verb 'supra' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的动词 supra 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the verb 'supra' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu x'jaqsam mas-sess, imma rridu naraw is-sentenza kollha biex nifhmu l-azzjoni eżatta.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu x'jaqsam mas-sess, imma rridu naraw is-sentenza kollha biex nifhmu l-azzjoni eżatta.
messages.zh: 它与性有关，但我们需要看整个句子才能明确具体指什么动作。
messages.en: It has to do with sex, but we need to see the whole sentence to understand the exact action.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 supra 做一张“性相关动作，具体义待核实”的词卡，先记住动词词性，再结合完整语境确认动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the highest rank, authority, or importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在等级、权力或重要性方面处于最高地位的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ogħla grad, l-akbar setgħa jew l-akbar importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 等级最高、权力最大或重要性居首的；至高无上的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab fuq kull ħaġa oħra fil-grad, fis-setgħa jew fl-importanza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is supreme has the highest position or the greatest authority or importance.

formal.mt: L-istatut jagħti lill-kunsill il-poter suprem fuq it-tmexxija tal-għaqda.
formal.en: The statute gives the council supreme power over the management of the association.
formal.zh: 章程赋予理事会对协会管理事务的最高权力。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex dejjem tpoġġi l-familja l-ewwel? David: Għax għalija l-familja għandha valur suprem.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why do you always put family first? David: Because, to me, family has supreme value.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你为什么总把家庭放在第一位？David：因为对我来说，家庭具有至高的价值。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem tpoġġi l-familja l-ewwel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem tpoġġi l-familja l-ewwel?
messages.zh: 你为什么总把家庭放在第一位？
messages.en: Why do you always put family first?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għalija l-familja għandha valur suprem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għalija l-familja għandha valur suprem.
messages.zh: 因为对我来说，家庭具有至高的价值。
messages.en: Because, to me, family has supreme value.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 suprem 放在阶梯最高一级，旁边写“最高权力、至高价值”，用顶端位置记住这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 至高地位；支配地位；绝对优势

teaching_sense.en_definition: The position of having greater power, authority, or ability than others in a particular area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某一领域中，凭借更强的力量、权威或能力而占据的支配或领先地位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pożizzjoni ta' min għandu aktar setgħa, awtorità jew ħila minn oħrajn f'qasam partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高于其他竞争者的支配地位或绝对优势。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-istat ta' min jiddomina jew ikun fuq l-oħrajn bis-setgħa, bl-awtorità jew bil-ħila tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Supremacy is the position of being more powerful, more influential, or more successful than others in a particular field.

collocations.zh: 军事优势；军事支配地位

formal.mt: It-tim żamm is-supremazija tiegħu fil-kampjonat b'sensiela ta' rebħiet.
formal.en: The team maintained its supremacy in the championship through a series of victories.
formal.zh: 这支球队凭借一连串胜利，保持了在锦标赛中的优势地位。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Taħseb li dan it-tim se jerġa' jirbaħ? Ġanni: Naħseb li iva; bħalissa għandu s-supremazija fil-kampjonat.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you think this team will win again? Ġanni: I think so; at the moment, it holds supremacy in the championship.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你觉得这支球队还会再赢吗？Ġanni：我觉得会；目前它在锦标赛中占据优势地位。

messages.speaker: Rita (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan it-tim se jerġa' jirbaħ?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan it-tim se jerġa' jirbaħ?
messages.zh: 你觉得这支球队还会再赢吗？
messages.en: Do you think this team will win again?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li iva; bħalissa għandu s-supremazija fil-kampjonat.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li iva; bħalissa għandu s-supremazija fil-kampjonat.
messages.zh: 我觉得会；目前它在锦标赛中占据优势地位。
messages.en: I think so; at the moment, it holds supremacy in the championship.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 supremazija 记作冠军长期占据的“领先地位”：它是地位这一名词，可与形容词 suprem 配对复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person holding the rank of sergeant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有中士或警佐军衔、警衔的人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha l-grad ta' serġent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中士；警佐，指具有这一军衔或警衔的人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna fil-forzi armati jew fil-pulizija li għandha l-grad ta' serġent.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sergeant is a member of the armed forces or police who holds that rank.

formal.mt: Is-supretendent ippreżenta rapport dwar ix-xogħol tal-għassa matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The sergeant submitted a report on the police station's work during the night.
formal.zh: 警佐提交了一份关于警署夜间工作的报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nkellem lis-supretendent, jekk jogħġbok? Pawlu: Iva, qiegħed fl-uffiċċju. Ngħidlu li qiegħda hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Could I speak to the sergeant, please? Pawlu: Yes, he is in the office. I'll tell him you're here.
colloquial.zh: Lara：请问我可以和警佐谈谈吗？Pawlu：可以，他在办公室。我去告诉他你来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (来访者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nkellem lis-supretendent, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nkellem lis-supretendent, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请问我可以和警佐谈谈吗？
messages.en: Could I speak to the sergeant, please?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (警员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fl-uffiċċju. Ngħidlu li qiegħda hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fl-uffiċċju. Ngħidlu li qiegħda hawn.
messages.zh: 可以，他在办公室。我去告诉他你来了。
messages.en: Yes, he is in the office. I'll tell him you're here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“警署里向警佐递交报告”的画面中，连同人物职级一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A market in which shares representing ownership in companies are bought and sold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 买卖公司股票等股权的市场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suq fejn jinxtraw u jinbiegħu ishma li jirrappreżentaw sjieda f'kumpaniji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 股权市场，供投资者买卖代表公司所有权份额的股票的市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Suq fejn l-investituri jixtru u jbigħu ishma li jagħtuhom sehem fis-sjieda ta' kumpaniji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An equity market is a market where investors buy and sell shares that represent ownership in companies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 股票市场，进行公司股份买卖的市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Suq li fih isir il-bejgħ u x-xiri ta' ishma f'kumpaniji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A share market is a market in which people and institutions trade shares in companies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 股市，供个人和机构买卖公司股票的市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Suq fejn persuni u istituzzjonijiet jixtru u jbigħu l-ishma ta' kumpaniji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The stock market is the market through which individuals and institutions buy and sell company shares.

collocations.en: to invest in the stock market

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza l-andament tas-suq azzjonarju u l-bidliet fil-prezzijiet tal-ishma matul is-sena.
formal.en: The report analyses stock market performance and changes in share prices during the year.
formal.zh: 该报告分析了这一年股票市场的走势及股价变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu eżatt is-suq azzjonarju? Mark: Huwa s-suq fejn jinxtraw u jinbiegħu l-ishma tal-kumpaniji.
colloquial.en: Maja: What exactly is the stock market? Mark: It is the market where company shares are bought and sold.
colloquial.zh: Maja：股票市场到底是什么？Mark：就是买卖公司股票的市场。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu eżatt is-suq azzjonarju?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu eżatt is-suq azzjonarju?
messages.zh: 股票市场到底是什么？
messages.en: What exactly is the stock market?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa s-suq fejn jinxtraw u jinbiegħu l-ishma tal-kumpaniji.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa s-suq fejn jinxtraw u jinbiegħu l-ishma tal-kumpaniji.
messages.zh: 就是买卖公司股票的市场。
messages.en: It is the market where company shares are bought and sold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 suq 记作“市场”，再把整个短语与股票报价屏幕联系起来，记住这里交易的是公司股份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The market for goods and services within a particular country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某一国家境内商品和服务的交易市场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-suq għall-prodotti u s-servizzi fi ħdan pajjiż partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国内市场，指一国境内商品和服务的市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-suq għall-bejgħ u x-xiri ta' prodotti u servizzi ġewwa pajjiż wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A domestic market is the market for goods and services within a particular country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 本国市场，指企业所在国家的市场，相对于其海外市场而言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-suq fil-pajjiż fejn hija bbażata kumpanija, meta jitqabbel mas-swieq tagħha barra mill-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A company's home market is the market in the country where that company is based.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全国市场，指以整个国家为范围的商品和服务市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-suq għall-prodotti u s-servizzi fuq il-livell ta' pajjiż sħiħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A national market is the market for goods and services considered across an entire country.

collocations.en: to focus on the domestic market

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qed iżżid il-produzzjoni biex tissodisfa d-domanda fis-suq domestiku qabel ma tibda tesporta.
formal.en: The company is increasing production to meet demand in the domestic market before it begins exporting.
formal.zh: 该公司正在增加产量，以便在开始出口前满足国内市场的需求。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-prodotti tagħkom jinbiegħu barra minn Malta wkoll? David: Għalissa nbiegħu biss fis-suq domestiku, jiġifieri hawn Malta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are your products sold outside Malta too? David: For now, we sell only in the domestic market, meaning here in Malta.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你们的产品也销往马耳他以外吗？David：目前我们只在本国市场销售，也就是在马耳他这里。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prodotti tagħkom jinbiegħu barra minn Malta wkoll?
messages.mt_standard: Il-prodotti tagħkom jinbiegħu barra minn Malta wkoll?
messages.zh: 你们的产品也销往马耳他以外吗？
messages.en: Are your products sold outside Malta too?

messages.speaker: David (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalissa nbiegħu biss fis-suq domestiku, jiġifieri hawn Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Għalissa nbiegħu biss fis-suq domestiku, jiġifieri hawn Malta.
messages.zh: 目前我们只在本国市场销售，也就是在马耳他这里。
messages.en: For now, we sell only in the domestic market, meaning here in Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在地图上给本国边界画一个圈：圈内的商品与服务交易，就是 suq domestiku。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A market at a later stage of a supply chain that uses products or services supplied at an earlier stage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于供应链较后环节、使用前面环节所提供产品或服务的市场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suq fi stadju aktar tard tal-katina tal-provvista, fejn jintużaw prodotti jew servizzi pprovduti fi stadju preċedenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下游市场，指相对于提供原料、投入品或服务的上游环节而言，位于供应链后续环节的市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Suq li jinsab fi stadju sussegwenti tal-katina tal-provvista u jiddependi fuq materjali, prodotti jew servizzi minn stadju preċedenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A downstream market is a market at a later stage of a supply chain that relies on inputs supplied at an earlier stage.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif żieda fil-prezz tal-materja prima tista' taffettwa l-prezzijiet fis-suq downstream tal-prodotti lesti.
formal.en: The study examines how an increase in raw material prices can affect prices in the downstream market for finished products.
formal.zh: 该研究考察原材料价格上涨如何影响下游成品市场的价格。

colloquial.mt: Nina: F'dan l-eżempju, liema huwa s-suq downstream? Luqa: Is-suq tal-ħobż, għax il-furnara jużaw id-dqiq biex jagħmlu l-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Nina: In this example, which is the downstream market? Luqa: The bread market, because bakers use flour to make bread.
colloquial.zh: Nina：在这个例子里，哪个是下游市场？Luqa：面包市场，因为面包师用面粉制作面包。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan l-eżempju, liema huwa s-suq downstream?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan l-eżempju, liema huwa s-suq downstream?
messages.zh: 在这个例子里，哪个是下游市场？
messages.en: In this example, which is the downstream market?

messages.speaker: Luqa (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-suq tal-ħobż, għax il-furnara jużaw id-dqiq biex jagħmlu l-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Is-suq tal-ħobż, għax il-furnara jużaw id-dqiq biex jagħmlu l-ħobż.
messages.zh: 面包市场，因为面包师用面粉制作面包。
messages.en: The bread market, because bakers use flour to make bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“面粉流向面包”的箭头记忆：沿供应链往后看，使用前一环节投入品的市场就是下游市场。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A market in which buyers and sellers trade under fair conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 买卖双方能够在公平条件下进行交易的市场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suq li fih ix-xerrejja u l-bejjiegħa jinnegozjaw taħt kundizzjonijiet ġusti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交易条件公平、买卖双方受到公正对待的市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Suq fejn il-kundizzjonijiet tal-kummerċ huma ġusti kemm għax-xerrejja kif ukoll għall-bejjiegħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fair market is one in which buyers and sellers can trade under equitable conditions.

collocations.en: the principles of a fair market
the creation of a fair market

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi regoli ċari biex jinħoloq suq ekwu għax-xerrejja u l-bejjiegħa.
formal.en: The report proposes clear rules to create a fair market for buyers and sellers.
formal.zh: 该报告提议制定明确规则，为买卖双方建立公平市场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri suq ekwu? Mark: Suq fejn il-kundizzjonijiet ikunu ġusti kemm għal min jixtri kif ukoll għal min ibigħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does a fair market mean? Mark: A market where conditions are fair both for people buying and for people selling.
colloquial.zh: Maja：公平市场是什么意思？Mark：就是交易条件对买方和卖方都公平的市场。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri suq ekwu?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri suq ekwu?
messages.zh: 公平市场是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a fair market mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Suq fejn il-kundizzjonijiet ikunu ġusti kemm għal min jixtri kif ukoll għal min ibigħ.
messages.mt_standard: Suq fejn il-kundizzjonijiet ikunu ġusti kemm għal min jixtri kif ukoll għal min ibigħ.
messages.zh: 就是交易条件对买方和卖方都公平的市场。
messages.en: A market where conditions are fair both for people buying and for people selling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 suq 想成买卖双方相遇的市场，再用一架平衡的天平记住 ekwu 所强调的公平条件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The group of customers that a business aims to sell its products or services to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 企业计划向其销售产品或服务的特定顾客群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grupp ta' klijenti li negozju għandu l-għan li jbigħlu l-prodotti jew is-servizzi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业选定并着重向其推广和销售产品或服务的顾客群体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-grupp ta' klijenti li negozju jagħżel biex jiffoka fuqu meta jippromwovi u jbigħ il-prodotti jew is-servizzi tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A company's target market is the particular group of customers it intends to reach and sell to.

collocations.en: the needs of the target market

formal.mt: L-istħarriġ se jgħin lill-kumpanija tifhem aħjar il-ħtiġijiet tas-suq fil-mira tagħha.
formal.en: The survey will help the company better understand the needs of its target market.
formal.zh: 这项调查将帮助公司更好地了解其目标市场的需求。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu s-suq fil-mira għal dawn il-basktijiet? Lara: Studenti li jridu basket ħafif u bi prezz tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the target market for these bags? Lara: Students who want a lightweight bag at a good price.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这些包的目标市场是谁？Lara：想买轻便又实惠的包的学生。

messages.speaker: Sara (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu s-suq fil-mira għal dawn il-basktijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu s-suq fil-mira għal dawn il-basktijiet?
messages.zh: 这些包的目标市场是谁？
messages.en: Who is the target market for these bags?

messages.speaker: Lara (营销顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Studenti li jridu basket ħafif u bi prezz tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Studenti li jridu basket ħafif u bi prezz tajjeb.
messages.zh: 想买轻便又实惠的包的学生。
messages.en: Students who want a lightweight bag at a good price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广告箭头指向一群特定顾客，把整组 suq fil-mira 记成企业瞄准的目标市场。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A market in which trading takes place within the same trading day.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 交易活动在同一个交易日内进行的市场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suq li fih l-attività ta' xiri u bejgħ issir matul l-istess jum ta' negozjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供参与者在同一交易日内进行买卖的日内市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Suq fejn il-parteċipanti jagħmlu tranżazzjonijiet ta' xiri u bejgħ fi ħdan l-istess jum ta' negozjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intraday market allows participants to carry out trading within a single trading day.

collocations.mt: il-prezzijiet fis-suq għal negozju fl-istess jum
jipparteċipa fis-suq għal negozju fl-istess jum

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel il-prezzijiet irreġistrati filgħodu ma' dawk irreġistrati wara nofsinhar fis-suq għal negozju fl-istess jum.
formal.en: The report compares prices recorded in the morning with those recorded in the afternoon in the intraday market.
formal.zh: 该报告比较了日内交易市场上午和下午记录的价格。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu suq għal negozju fl-istess jum? David: Huwa suq fejn ix-xiri u l-bejgħ isiru matul l-istess jum ta' negozjar.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is an intraday market? David: It is a market where buying and selling take place within the same trading day.
colloquial.zh: Nina：什么是日内交易市场？David：就是买卖活动在同一个交易日内进行的市场。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu suq għal negozju fl-istess jum?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu suq għal negozju fl-istess jum?
messages.zh: 什么是日内交易市场？
messages.en: What is an intraday market?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa suq fejn ix-xiri u l-bejgħ isiru matul l-istess jum ta' negozjar.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa suq fejn ix-xiri u l-bejgħ isiru matul l-istess jum ta' negozjar.
messages.zh: 就是买卖活动在同一个交易日内进行的市场。
messages.en: It is a market where buying and selling take place within the same trading day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成市场、交易、同一天三个意义块；想象买卖记录都写在日历同一格里，记住日内交易市场。

gloss_zh: 黑市；非法市场；地下市场

teaching_sense.en_definition: A market in which goods or services are traded illegally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 违反法律规定进行商品或服务交易的市场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suq li fih jinbiegħu u jinxtraw oġġetti jew servizzi bi ksur tal-liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑市，指违反法律或交易管制进行买卖的市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Suq li fih isir bejgħ u xiri bi ksur tal-liġi jew tar-regoli li jikkontrollaw il-kummerċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A black market is a system of buying and selling that operates in violation of laws or trading restrictions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非法市场，指交易的商品、服务或交易活动本身违反法律的市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Suq li fih l-oġġetti, is-servizzi jew l-attivitajiet kummerċjali nfushom huma pprojbiti mil-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An illicit market is one in which the goods, services, or trading activities involved are prohibited by law.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地下市场，指为逃避监管或执法而隐蔽运作的非法交易市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Suq illegali li jopera bil-moħbi sabiex jevita s-sorveljanza jew l-infurzar tal-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An underground market is an illegal trading network that operates secretly to avoid official scrutiny or enforcement.

collocations.en: the fight against the illicit market

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-bejgħ ta' prodotti misruqa fis-suq illeċitu jagħmel ħsara lin-negozji leġittimi.
formal.en: The report explains how the sale of stolen products on the illicit market harms legitimate businesses.
formal.zh: 报告说明了在非法市场销售赃物如何损害合法企业的利益。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx tixtri dak it-telefon? Mark: Għax naħseb li ġej mis-suq illeċitu; nippreferi nixtrih minn ħanut li jagħtini rċevuta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to buy that phone? Mark: Because I think it comes from the black market; I'd rather buy it from a shop that gives me a receipt.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么不想买那部手机？Mark：因为我觉得它来自黑市；我宁愿去能开收据的商店买。
