teaching_sense.en_definition: A sequence of things following one another, or the process of taking over a position from someone else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物接连出现所形成的序列，或接替他人担任某一职位的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' affarijiet li jiġu waħda wara l-oħra, jew il-proċess li bih persuna tieħu post oħra f'kariga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事物的接连出现或由此形成的一连串；也指职位的接任。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li affarijiet jiġu waħda wara l-oħra f'sensiela, jew li persuna tieħu l-kariga ta' persuna oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A succession is a series of things following one another, or the process by which someone takes over another person's position.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħejjiet pjan ta' suċċessjoni biex torganizza t-trasferiment tar-responsabbiltajiet meta jirtira d-direttur.
formal.en: The company prepared a succession plan to organize the transfer of responsibilities when the director retires.
formal.zh: 公司制定了接班计划，以安排董事退休时的职责交接。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif kienet il-ġurnata tiegħek? • Mark: Kienet suċċessjoni ta' problemi: l-ewwel tlift ix-xarabank, imbagħad insejt iċ-ċwievet.
colloquial.en: Nina: How was your day? • Mark: It was a succession of problems: first I missed the bus, then I forgot my keys.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你今天过得怎么样？ • Mark：麻烦接二连三：先是错过了公交车，接着又忘了带钥匙。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kienet il-ġurnata tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kienet il-ġurnata tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你今天过得怎么样？
messages.en: How was your day?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet suċċessjoni ta' problemi: l-ewwel tlift ix-xarabank, imbagħad insejt iċ-ċwievet.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet suċċessjoni ta' problemi: l-ewwel tlift ix-xarabank, imbagħad insejt iċ-ċwievet.
messages.zh: 麻烦接二连三：先是错过了公交车，接着又忘了带钥匙。
messages.en: It was a succession of problems: first I missed the bus, then I forgot my keys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成一条接续的队伍：事件排队是一连串，任职者前后接替就是接任。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing the essential information clearly in few words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用少量文字清楚表达必要信息的；言简意赅的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi l-informazzjoni essenzjali b'mod ċar u bi ftit kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表达简短而清楚的；简明扼要的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti l-punti ewlenin bi ftit kliem, mingħajr dettalji żejda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something succinct expresses the essential points clearly in only a few words.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jagħti sommarju suċċint tar-riżultati u jippreżenta l-punti ewlenin b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The report gives a succinct summary of the results and presents the main points clearly.
formal.zh: 该报告简明地概述了结果，并清楚呈现了要点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan is-sommarju twil wisq? • David: Iva, ipprova agħmlu aktar suċċint u żomm biss il-punti ewlenin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this summary too long? • David: Yes, try to make it more succinct and keep only the main points.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这份摘要是不是太长了？ • David：是的，试着写得更简明些，只保留要点。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-sommarju twil wisq?
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-sommarju twil wisq?
messages.zh: 这份摘要是不是太长了？
messages.en: Is this summary too long?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ipprova agħmlu aktar suċċint u żomm biss il-punti ewlenin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ipprova agħmlu aktar suċċint u żomm biss il-punti ewlenin.
messages.zh: 是的，试着写得更简明些，只保留要点。
messages.en: Yes, try to make it more succinct and keep only the main points.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一页笔记缩成三条清楚的要点：suċċint 强调话少而意思完整，可记作言简意赅。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An idea that you offer for someone to consider when deciding what to do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了帮助别人决定如何行动而提出、供其考虑的想法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idea li tipproponi lil xi ħadd biex jikkunsidraha meta jkun qed jiddeċiedi x'għandu jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建议；向他人提出、供其考虑或采纳的想法或做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Idea jew proposta li tingħata lil xi ħadd biex jikkunsidraha jew jaġixxi fuqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A suggestion is an idea that you put forward for another person to consider or act on.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat aċċetta s-suġġeriment li l-laqgħa li jmiss issir filgħodu.
formal.en: The committee accepted the suggestion that the next meeting should take place in the morning.
formal.zh: 委员会采纳了将下次会议安排在上午的建议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi suġġeriment: nitilqu ftit qabel biex nevitaw it-traffiku. Paul: Idea tajba! Nitilqu fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Maja: I have a suggestion: let's leave a little earlier to avoid the traffic. Paul: Good idea! Let's leave at eight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我有个建议：我们早点出发，避开堵车。保罗：好主意！我们八点出发吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi suġġeriment: nitilqu ftit qabel biex nevitaw it-traffiku.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi suġġeriment: nitilqu ftit qabel biex nevitaw it-traffiku.
messages.zh: 我有个建议：我们早点出发，避开堵车。
messages.en: I have a suggestion: let's leave a little earlier to avoid the traffic.

messages.speaker: Paul (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Idea tajba! Nitilqu fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Idea tajba! Nitilqu fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 好主意！我们八点出发吧。
messages.en: Good idea! Let's leave at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Għandi suġġeriment 整句记成“我有个建议”，想象讨论出发时间时举手提出一个办法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The separate movable parts at the end of a hand, used for touching, holding, and handling things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手末端可分别活动的手指，用于触摸、抓握和操作物品；此词为复数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partijiet twal u mobbli fit-tarf tal-id li jintużaw biex tmiss, taqbad u żżomm l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手指，指手末端用于触摸和抓握的可活动部分；复数形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-partijiet mobbli fit-tarf tal-id li bihom persuna tmiss, taqbad u timmaniġġa l-affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your fingers are the separate movable parts of your hand that you use to touch and hold things.

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju, il-parteċipanti għandhom jiftħu idejhom u jċaqalqu s-swaba' bil-mod.
formal.en: During the exercise, participants should open their hands and move their fingers slowly.
formal.zh: 练习时，参与者应张开双手，缓慢活动手指。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għandek is-swaba' kollha blu? • Pawlu: Kont qed inpinġi u messajt iż-żebgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are all your fingers blue? • Pawlu: I was painting and touched the paint.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你的手指怎么全蓝了？ • Pawlu：我刚才在画画，碰到了颜料。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek is-swaba' kollha blu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek is-swaba' kollha blu?
messages.zh: 你的手指怎么全蓝了？
messages.en: Why are all your fingers blue?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont qed inpinġi u messajt iż-żebgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Kont qed inpinġi u messajt iż-żebgħa.
messages.zh: 我刚才在画画，碰到了颜料。
messages.en: I was painting and touched the paint.

cognitive_memory_aid: 伸出一只手，逐个活动手指并说 swaba'，把动作与“多根手指”联系起来，也记住词尾的撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of very wet land where water collects and plants, often including trees, grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 积水或土壤长期十分潮湿、长有植物且常有树木的地带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda art imxarrba ħafna fejn jinġabar l-ilma u jikbru pjanti, spiss ukoll siġar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沼泽地，指地面积水或土壤长期饱含水分、长有湿地植物的区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona ta' art baxxa u mxarrba ħafna, b'ilma wieqaf jew li jiċċaqlaq bil-mod u b'veġetazzjoni li tikber fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A swamp is an area of very wet land where water collects and plants such as trees and bushes grow.

collocations.en: at the edge of the swamp

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi l-veġetazzjoni tas-swamp u l-bidliet fil-livell tal-ilma matul is-sena.
formal.en: The study describes the vegetation of the swamp and changes in water level throughout the year.
formal.zh: 该研究描述了沼泽中的植被以及全年水位的变化。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-mogħdija tgħaddi minn ġos-swamp? • Toni: Le, tgħaddi mat-tarf tiegħu, ħdejn is-siġar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does the path go through the swamp? • Toni: No, it follows its edge, beside the trees.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这条小路穿过沼泽吗？ • Toni：不，它沿着沼泽边缘走，就在树旁。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mogħdija tgħaddi minn ġos-swamp?
messages.mt_standard: Il-mogħdija tgħaddi minn ġos-swamp?
messages.zh: 这条小路穿过沼泽吗？
messages.en: Does the path go through the swamp?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tgħaddi mat-tarf tiegħu, ħdejn is-siġar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tgħaddi mat-tarf tiegħu, ħdejn is-siġar.
messages.zh: 不，它沿着沼泽边缘走，就在树旁。
messages.en: No, it follows its edge, beside the trees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚下泥土浸满水、周围长着湿地植物的画面，把 swamp 和“沼泽地”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A social gathering held in the evening, often with music, conversation, or other entertainment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在晚间举行的社交聚会，常有音乐、交谈或其他娱乐活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqgħa soċjali li ssir filgħaxija, spiss b'mużika, konverżazzjoni jew xi forma oħra ta' divertiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晚间举行的社交聚会或晚会，通常以交谈、音乐或娱乐为活动内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' nies għal okkażjoni soċjali filgħaxija, fejn jistgħu jitkellmu, jisimgħu l-mużika jew jieħdu sehem f'divertiment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A soiree is a social gathering held in the evening, often featuring music, conversation, or entertainment.

formal.mt: L-għaqda kulturali se torganizza swarè mużikali fis-sala prinċipali nhar il-Ġimgħa filgħaxija.
formal.en: The cultural association will organize a musical soiree in the main hall on Friday evening.
formal.zh: 文化协会将于星期五晚上在主厅举办一场音乐晚会。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tiġi għas-swarè għada filgħaxija? • David: Iva, smajt li se jkun hemm il-mużika wkoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you coming to the soiree tomorrow evening? • David: Yes, I heard there will be music too.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你明晚会来参加晚会吗？ • David：会，我听说还会有音乐。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tiġi għas-swarè għada filgħaxija?
messages.mt_standard: Se tiġi għas-swarè għada filgħaxija?
messages.zh: 你明晚会来参加晚会吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to the soiree tomorrow evening?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, smajt li se jkun hemm il-mużika wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, smajt li se jkun hemm il-mużika wkoll.
messages.zh: 会，我听说还会有音乐。
messages.en: Yes, I heard there will be music too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“晚上相聚、聊天听音乐”的场景记住 swarè；读写时同时留意最后带重音符号的 è。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A knitted garment worn on the upper body to keep warm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在上身、用于保暖的针织衣物，通常指毛衣或针织套衫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa lbies maħduma bil-labar li tintlibes fuq il-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem biex iżżomm is-sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛衣；穿在上身保暖的针织衣物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilbies maħdum bil-labar li jgħatti l-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem u jgħin biex iżommha sħuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sweater is a knitted piece of clothing that you wear on your upper body to keep warm.

formal.mt: Minħabba t-temp kiesaħ, l-istudenti għandhom iġibu sweter magħhom għall-ħarġa.
formal.en: Because of the cold weather, students should bring a sweater with them on the outing.
formal.zh: 由于天气寒冷，学生参加此次外出活动时应随身带一件毛衣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed inħoss il-bard. Mark: Għandi sweter ieħor fil-basket. Tridu? Maja: Iva, grazzi!
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm feeling cold. Mark: I have another sweater in my bag. Do you want it? Maja: Yes, thanks!
colloquial.zh: Maja：我觉得冷。Mark：我包里还有一件毛衣，你要吗？Maja：要，谢谢！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss il-bard.
messages.zh: 我觉得冷。
messages.en: I'm feeling cold.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi sweter ieħor fil-basket. Tridu?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi sweter ieħor fil-basket. Tridu?
messages.zh: 我包里还有一件毛衣，你要吗？
messages.en: I have another sweater in my bag. Do you want it?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi!
messages.zh: 要，谢谢！
messages.en: Yes, thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sweter 和英语 sweater 对照记忆：想象天冷时穿上厚毛衣，再连读 sweter oħxon，记住名词与形容词的搭配。

gloss_zh: 创新伙伴关系；创新合作关系

teaching_sense.en_definition: A partnership in which people or organizations work together to develop new ideas, methods, or products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或组织为开发新想法、新方法或新产品而建立的合作关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Relazzjoni ta' kooperazzjoni bejn persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet biex jiżviluppaw ideat, metodi jew prodotti ġodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以开发新想法、新方法或新产品为目的的伙伴关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sħubija li fiha persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet jaħdmu flimkien biex jiżviluppaw ideat, metodi jew prodotti ġodda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An innovation partnership is an arrangement in which people or organizations cooperate to develop new ideas, methods, or products.

collocations.en: the establishment of an innovation partnership
an innovation partnership between two companies
collocations.zh: 两家公司之间的创新合作关系

formal.mt: L-università u l-kumpanija waqqfu sħubija għall-innovazzjoni biex jiżviluppaw metodu ġdid għat-tisfija tal-ilma.
formal.en: The university and the company established an innovation partnership to develop a new method of water purification.
formal.zh: 大学与这家公司建立了创新伙伴关系，以开发一种新的净水方法。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed taħdmu ma' dik il-kumpanija? David: Għandna sħubija għall-innovazzjoni biex niżviluppaw prodott ġdid flimkien.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you working with that company? David: We have an innovation partnership to develop a new product together.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你们为什么和那家公司合作？David：我们建立了创新伙伴关系，要一起开发新产品。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed taħdmu ma' dik il-kumpanija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed taħdmu ma' dik il-kumpanija?
messages.zh: 你们为什么和那家公司合作？
messages.en: Why are you working with that company?

messages.speaker: David (项目成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna sħubija għall-innovazzjoni biex niżviluppaw prodott ġdid flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna sħubija għall-innovazzjoni biex niżviluppaw prodott ġdid flimkien.
messages.zh: 我们建立了创新伙伴关系，要一起开发新产品。
messages.en: We have an innovation partnership to develop a new product together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大学和公司围着同一张设计图合作：把整个短语与“结成伙伴，一起创新”的画面配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike someone or something with the foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用脚踢某人或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jolqot lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa b'siequ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 踢；用脚击打某人或某物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti daqqa b'siequ lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone kicks a person or an object, they hit that person or object with their foot.

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, il-plejer ta bis-sieq lill-ballun lejn il-lasta.
formal.en: During training, the player kicked the ball towards the goal.
formal.zh: 训练时，球员把球踢向球门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ta bis-sieq lill-ballun? Mark: Jien! Mar wisq 'il bogħod? Maja: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who kicked the ball? Mark: I did! Did it go too far? Maja: Yes, it's next to the tree.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁踢了球？Mark：我！是不是踢得太远了？Maja：是啊，球在树旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (球友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ta bis-sieq lill-ballun?
messages.mt_standard: Min ta bis-sieq lill-ballun?
messages.zh: 谁踢了球？
messages.en: Who kicked the ball?

messages.speaker: Mark (球友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Mar wisq 'il bogħod?
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Mar wisq 'il bogħod?
messages.zh: 我！是不是踢得太远了？
messages.en: I did! Did it go too far?

messages.speaker: Maja (球友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn is-siġra.
messages.zh: 是啊，球在树旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's next to the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ta bis-sieq 整体配上“抬脚踢球”的动作记忆，再用 ta bis-sieq lill-ballun 复述“踢了球”，避免只记住孤立单词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rubbish, understood as something worthless or something said without sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指毫无价值的东西，或没有道理、不值得相信的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa bla valur, jew kliem bla sens li ma jistħoqqlux jitwemmen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毫无价值的东西；没有道理或不值得相信的废话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ta cacu jirreferi għal xi ħaġa bla valur jew għal kliem li ma jagħmilx sens.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe something as rubbish, you mean that it is worthless or makes no sense.

formal.mt: Fir-reviżjoni tiegħu, il-kritiku sejjaħ l-argument 'Ta cacu' għax ma kien ibbażat fuq ebda prova.
formal.en: In his review, the critic called the argument rubbish because it was not based on any evidence.
formal.zh: 评论者在评述中把这个论点斥为废话，因为它没有任何证据支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi taħseb dwar dak li qal? | Mark: Ta cacu. Ma ta l-ebda prova.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you think of what he said? | Mark: Rubbish. He didn't give any evidence.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么看他说的那些话？ | Mark：废话。他一点证据都没给。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi taħseb dwar dak li qal?
messages.mt_standard: Xi taħseb dwar dak li qal?
messages.zh: 你怎么看他说的那些话？
messages.en: What do you think of what he said?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta cacu. Ma ta l-ebda prova.
messages.mt_standard: Ta cacu. Ma ta l-ebda prova.
messages.zh: 废话。他一点证据都没给。
messages.en: Rubbish. He didn't give any evidence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ta cacu 整体记成“这都是废话”的评价语块，配合听到无根据说法时摇头的画面记忆。

gloss_zh: 意见一致的；全体赞同的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sharing the same opinion, with every person in a group agreeing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 群体中的每个人都持相同意见、表示赞同的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaqblu lkoll fuq l-istess ħaġa, mingħajr ħadd ma jkollu fehma differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全体意见一致的；没有任何成员持不同意见的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollhom ilkoll l-istess fehma dwar kwistjoni u ma jkun hemm ħadd li ma jaqbilx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a group is unanimous, every member agrees about a particular matter or decision.

collocations.en: be unanimous; be of one mind

formal.mt: Il-membri tal-kumitat kienu ta' fehma waħda li l-proġett għandu jitkompla.
formal.en: The committee members were unanimous that the project should continue.
formal.zh: 委员会成员一致认为，该项目应该继续进行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Aħna lkoll ta' fehma waħda li niltaqgħu fis-sebgħa? Mark: Iva, kulħadd jaqbel. Narawkom fis-sebgħa!
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we all agreed that we should meet at seven? Mark: Yes, everyone agrees. See you at seven!
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们都同意七点见面吗？Mark：是的，大家都同意。七点见！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħna lkoll ta' fehma waħda li niltaqgħu fis-sebgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Aħna lkoll ta' fehma waħda li niltaqgħu fis-sebgħa?
messages.zh: 我们都同意七点见面吗？
messages.en: Are we all agreed that we should meet at seven?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kulħadd jaqbel. Narawkom fis-sebgħa!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kulħadd jaqbel. Narawkom fis-sebgħa!
messages.zh: 是的，大家都同意。七点见！
messages.en: Yes, everyone agrees. See you at seven!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句想成“大家只有一个共同意见”：fehma 联系“看法”，waħda 联系“一个”，再想象所有人同时点头，记住全体一致。

gloss_zh: 形态一致的；式样统一的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the same form or appearance throughout.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各部分或各个成员具有相同形态或外观的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu l-istess forma jew dehra fil-partijiet jew fl-elementi kollha tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形态或外观保持一致的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollu forma jew dehra waħda li tibqa' l-istess fl-elementi kollha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If things are uniform, they have the same form or appearance.

formal.mt: Għall-wirja ntgħażlu kontenituri ta' għamla waħda biex il-preżentazzjoni tkun konsistenti.
formal.en: Containers of a uniform shape were selected for the exhibition to ensure a consistent presentation.
formal.zh: 展览选用了形状一致的容器，以确保展示效果统一。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn il-kaxxi kollha ta' għamla waħda? Mark: Iva, kollha għandhom l-istess forma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are all these boxes the same shape? Mark: Yes, they all have the same shape.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些箱子的形状都一样吗？马克：是的，它们的形状全都一样。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-kaxxi kollha ta' għamla waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-kaxxi kollha ta' għamla waħda?
messages.zh: 这些箱子的形状都一样吗？
messages.en: Are all these boxes the same shape?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kollha għandhom l-istess forma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kollha għandhom l-istess forma.
messages.zh: 是的，它们的形状全都一样。
messages.en: Yes, they all have the same shape.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一排外形相同的箱子作为记忆画面：这里的 waħda 提醒你关注同一种形态，整句记作“式样统一的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening every day, or belonging to ordinary everyday life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示每天发生的，或属于平常生活的，常用来修饰活动、习惯和生活事务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li ssir jew isseħħ kuljum, jew li tagħmel parti mill-ħajja tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 每日的；每天发生或进行的，也可指日常生活中的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-espressjoni ta' kuljum tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li ssir jew isseħħ kull jum, jew li hija parti mill-ħajja tas-soltu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as daily happens every day or forms part of ordinary everyday life.

collocations.zh: 每日的固定安排；日常作息

formal.mt: Dan il-kors jgħin lill-istudenti jużaw il-Malti f'sitwazzjonijiet tal-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: This course helps students use Maltese in everyday situations.
formal.zh: 本课程帮助学生在日常生活情境中使用马耳他语。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-mixi huwa parti mir-rutina ta' kuljum tiegħek? David: Iva, nimxi nofs siegħa kull filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is walking part of your daily routine? David: Yes, I walk for half an hour every morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：散步是你日常作息的一部分吗？戴维：是的，我每天早上散步半小时。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mixi huwa parti mir-rutina ta' kuljum tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Il-mixi huwa parti mir-rutina ta' kuljum tiegħek?
messages.zh: 散步是你日常作息的一部分吗？
messages.en: Is walking part of your daily routine?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nimxi nofs siegħa kull filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nimxi nofs siegħa kull filgħodu.
messages.zh: 是的，我每天早上散步半小时。
messages.en: Yes, I walk for half an hour every morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上每天都画着同一个小记号，把 ta' kuljum 整体记成“每日的、日常的”，再搭配日常作息来练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening, being arranged, or being produced every week.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示每周发生、安排或制作的，常用来修饰会议、活动或报告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li ssir, tiġi organizzata jew titħejja kull ġimgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 每周的；每星期发生、进行或发布一次的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-espressjoni ta' kull ġimgħa tiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li ssir jew isseħħ kull ġimgħa, bħal laqgħa jew rapport.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as weekly happens or is produced once every week.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ta' kull ġimgħa għandu jintbagħat lill-maniġer sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The weekly report must be sent to the manager by Friday.
formal.zh: 每周报告必须在星期五之前提交给经理。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta hi l-laqgħa ta' kull ġimgħa? Luqa: It-Tlieta fl-għaxra, bħas-soltu.
colloquial.en: Nina: When is the weekly meeting? Luqa: On Tuesday at ten, as usual.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：每周例会是什么时候？卢卡：照常，星期二十点。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta hi l-laqgħa ta' kull ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Meta hi l-laqgħa ta' kull ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 每周例会是什么时候？
messages.en: When is the weekly meeting?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-Tlieta fl-għaxra, bħas-soltu.
messages.mt_standard: It-Tlieta fl-għaxra, bħas-soltu.
messages.zh: 照常，星期二十点。
messages.en: On Tuesday at ten, as usual.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在连续几周的日历上圈出同一天，把 ta' kull ġimgħa 和“每周例会”一起记；例句中注意 ġ 的点和 ħ 的横画。

gloss_zh: 弄脏；使沾上污渍；玷污；亵渎

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something dirty or marked, or to violate its purity or dignity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物品变脏或留下污渍；也指玷污某物的纯洁、尊严或神圣性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħammeġ xi ħaġa jew iħalli tebgħa fuqha, jew jonqos mir-rispett lejn il-purità, id-dinjità jew il-qdusija tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使沾上污渍；在物体表面留下脏污的痕迹。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iħalli marka ta' ħmieġ jew ta' kulur fuq wiċċ xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something stains a surface or a piece of cloth, it leaves a dirty or coloured mark on it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玷污；亵渎；以不敬或不洁的行为损害某物的纯洁、尊严或神圣性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa meqjusa pura jew qaddisa maħmuġa jew jonqos gravement mir-rispett lejha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone defiles something regarded as pure or sacred, they damage its purity or treat it with serious disrespect.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif l-att ta' vandaliżmu tabba post meqjus qaddis mill-komunità.
formal.en: The report describes how the act of vandalism defiled a place regarded as sacred by the community.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这起蓄意破坏行为如何亵渎了一个被该社区视为神圣的场所。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, il-meraq tabba t-tvalja! Mark: Ġib ċarruta nadifa biex innaddfuha. Maja: Hawn waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, the juice has stained the tablecloth! Mark: Get a clean cloth so we can clean it. Maja: Here's one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看，果汁把桌布弄脏了！Mark：拿块干净的抹布来，我们把它擦干净。Maja：这里有一块。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, il-meraq tabba t-tvalja!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, il-meraq tabba t-tvalja!
messages.zh: 你看，果汁把桌布弄脏了！
messages.en: Look, the juice has stained the tablecloth!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġib ċarruta nadifa biex innaddfuha.
messages.mt_standard: Ġib ċarruta nadifa biex innaddfuha.
messages.zh: 拿块干净的抹布来，我们把它擦干净。
messages.en: Get a clean cloth so we can clean it.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn waħda.
messages.zh: 这里有一块。
messages.en: Here's one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面区分 tabba：果汁落在桌布上是“弄脏”，不敬行为发生在神圣场所是“亵渎”；这是义项联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A comparative table presenting assessments of how markets perform for consumers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 汇总并比较各消费市场表现的评分表，用于了解市场为消费者提供服务的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tabella li tippreżenta u tqabbel valutazzjonijiet ta' kif jaħdmu swieq differenti għall-konsumaturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费市场评分表；呈现并比较不同消费市场表现的评估表。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tabella ta' valutazzjoni li tiġbor riżultati dwar swieq differenti u tippermetti li jitqabbel kif dawn jaqdu lill-konsumaturi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Consumer Markets Scoreboard presents assessments that allow readers to compare how different markets perform for consumers.

collocations.mt: ir-riżultati tat-tabella ta' valutazzjoni tas-swieq tal-konsumatur
collocations.en: the results of the Consumer Markets Scoreboard
collocations.zh: 消费市场评分表的评估结果

collocations.mt: analiżi tat-tabella ta' valutazzjoni tas-swieq tal-konsumatur
collocations.en: an analysis of the Consumer Markets Scoreboard
collocations.zh: 对消费市场评分表的分析

collocations.mt: tikkonsulta t-tabella ta' valutazzjoni tas-swieq tal-konsumatur
collocations.en: to consult the Consumer Markets Scoreboard

formal.mt: It-tabella ta' valutazzjoni tas-swieq tal-konsumatur tintuża f'dan ir-rapport biex jitqabblu r-riżultati ta' swieq differenti.
formal.en: The Consumer Markets Scoreboard is used in this report to compare the results for different markets.
formal.zh: 本报告使用消费市场评分表来比较不同市场的评估结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Mark: It-tabella ta' valutazzjoni tas-swieq tal-konsumatur. Maja: Għal xiex se tużaha? Mark: Biex inqabbel ir-riżultati ta' żewġ swieq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Mark: The Consumer Markets Scoreboard. Maja: What will you use it for? Mark: To compare the results for two markets.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在读什么？Mark：消费市场评分表。Maja：你打算用它做什么？Mark：比较两个市场的评估结果。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tabella ta' valutazzjoni tas-swieq tal-konsumatur.
messages.mt_standard: It-tabella ta' valutazzjoni tas-swieq tal-konsumatur.
messages.zh: 消费市场评分表。
messages.en: The Consumer Markets Scoreboard.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex se tużaha?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex se tużaha?
messages.zh: 你打算用它做什么？
messages.en: What will you use it for?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inqabbel ir-riżultati ta' żewġ swieq.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inqabbel ir-riżultati ta' żewġ swieq.
messages.zh: 比较两个市场的评估结果。
messages.en: To compare the results for two markets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分块朗读：tabella“表格”、ta' valutazzjoni“用于评估”、tas-swieq“市场的”、tal-konsumatur“消费者的”，最后合成“消费市场评分表”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To draw attention to something important by making it stand out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过强调或使某事物更加显眼，引导人们注意其中的重要内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbed l-attenzjoni lejn xi ħaġa importanti billi jagħmilha tispikka jew jagħtiha enfasi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突出或强调某项内容，使人注意到它的重要性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta wieħed taccena xi ħaġa, jagħtiha enfasi biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni lejha u juri l-importanza tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you highlight something, you draw attention to it so that people notice its importance.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, ir-riċerkatur taccena d-differenza bejn iż-żewġ gruppi u spjega għaliex kienet importanti.
formal.en: In his report, the researcher highlighted the difference between the two groups and explained why it was important.
formal.zh: 研究人员在报告中突出了两组之间的差异，并解释了这一差异为何重要。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qal l-għalliem dwar ix-xogħol tagħna? | Mark: Taccena punt importanti: irridu nagħtu aktar eżempji.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the teacher say about our work? | Mark: He highlighted an important point: we need to give more examples.
colloquial.zh: Maja：老师对我们的作业说了什么？ | Mark：他强调了一点：我们需要多举些例子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qal l-għalliem dwar ix-xogħol tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: X'qal l-għalliem dwar ix-xogħol tagħna?
messages.zh: 老师对我们的作业说了什么？
messages.en: What did the teacher say about our work?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Taccena punt importanti: irridu nagħtu aktar eżempji.
messages.mt_standard: Taccena punt importanti: irridu nagħtu aktar eżempji.
messages.zh: 他强调了一点：我们需要多举些例子。
messages.en: He highlighted an important point: we need to give more examples.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 taccena 时想象老师把重点圈出来，并说“请注意这里”；用这个画面连接“突出、强调”的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the home, household activities, or animals kept at home.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与家庭、家务活动或家中饲养的动物有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mad-dar, mal-attivitajiet tagħha jew mal-annimali li jinżammu fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家庭的；与居家生活或家中饲养有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għad-dar jew għandu x'jaqsam mal-ħajja u l-attivitajiet fid-dar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something domestic belongs to the home or concerns the activities and life of a household.

formal.mt: It-tqassim tax-xogħol tad-dar bejn il-membri tal-familja jgħin biex kulħadd jagħti sehmu.
formal.en: Sharing housework among family members helps everyone contribute.
formal.zh: 让家庭成员分担家务，有助于每个人都出一份力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandek ħafna xogħol tad-dar? Mark: Iva, għad irrid naħsel il-platti u nnaddaf il-kċina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still have a lot of housework to do? Mark: Yes, I still need to wash the dishes and clean the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还有很多家务要做吗？Mark：是的，我还得洗碗和打扫厨房。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandek ħafna xogħol tad-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandek ħafna xogħol tad-dar?
messages.zh: 你还有很多家务要做吗？
messages.en: Do you still have a lot of housework to do?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għad irrid naħsel il-platti u nnaddaf il-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għad irrid naħsel il-platti u nnaddaf il-kċina.
messages.zh: 是的，我还得洗碗和打扫厨房。
messages.en: Yes, I still need to wash the dishes and clean the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“家务”和“家养动物”一起联想：xogħol tad-dar 是家务，annimali tad-dar 是家养动物，共同提示“与家有关”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Funny or amusing in a way that makes people laugh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有滑稽、逗趣的特点，能够引人发笑的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lin-nies jidħku għax ikun umoristiku jew divertenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑稽的；具有逗趣效果、使人发笑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tad-daħk tkun umoristika u tqanqal id-daħk f'min jaraha jew jismagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is comic is amusing and makes people laugh.

formal.mt: L-awtur joħloq sitwazzjoni tad-daħk meta żewġ karattri jaħsbu li qed jitkellmu dwar l-istess persuna.
formal.en: The author creates a comic situation when two characters think they are talking about the same person.
formal.zh: 两个人物误以为彼此谈论的是同一个人，作者由此营造出一个滑稽的情境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-film tal-bieraħ? | Mark: Kien tad-daħk ħafna! Dħakt mill-bidu sal-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was yesterday's film? | Mark: It was really funny! I laughed from beginning to end.
colloquial.zh: Maja：昨天那部电影怎么样？ | Mark：特别好笑！我从头笑到尾。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien il-film tal-bieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien il-film tal-bieraħ?
messages.zh: 昨天那部电影怎么样？
messages.en: How was yesterday's film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien tad-daħk ħafna! Dħakt mill-bidu sal-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Kien tad-daħk ħafna! Dħakt mill-bidu sal-aħħar.
messages.zh: 特别好笑！我从头笑到尾。
messages.en: It was really funny! I laughed from beginning to end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tad-daħk 和看喜剧时忍不住发笑的画面绑定，连着 film tad-daħk“一部好笑的电影”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made of gold or having the colour of gold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由黄金制成的，或呈现金色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmul mid-deheb jew li għandu l-kulur tad-deheb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金制的；具有黄金颜色的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa magħmul mid-deheb jew għandu kulur bħal dak tad-deheb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something golden is made of gold or has a colour like gold.

formal.mt: Il-mużew esebixxa ċurkett tad-deheb f'vetrina ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: The museum displayed a gold ring in a showcase near the entrance.
formal.zh: 博物馆在入口附近的展柜里展出了一枚金戒指。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan iċ-ċurkett tad-deheb huwa tiegħek? Marija: Iva, kien rigal mingħand ommi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this gold ring yours? Marija: Yes, it was a gift from my mother.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这枚金戒指是你的吗？Marija：是的，是我母亲送的礼物。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan iċ-ċurkett tad-deheb huwa tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Dan iċ-ċurkett tad-deheb huwa tiegħek?
messages.zh: 这枚金戒指是你的吗？
messages.en: Is this gold ring yours?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien rigal mingħand ommi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien rigal mingħand ommi.
messages.zh: 是的，是我母亲送的礼物。
messages.en: Yes, it was a gift from my mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一枚闪着金光的戒指：ċurkett tad-deheb 提示黄金材质，kulur tad-deheb 提示金色，用同一幅画面记住两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To place a flower bulb in soil so that it can grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把一颗花卉球茎栽入土中，使其能够生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed basla ta' pjanta tal-fjuri fil-ħamrija sabiex tkun tista' tikber.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将一颗花卉球茎栽入土中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tqiegħed basla tal-fjuri fil-ħamrija biex minnha tkun tista' tikber pjanta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you plant a flower bulb, you put it into soil so that a flowering plant can grow from it.

collocations.en: plant a flower bulb in the soil
collocations.zh: 把一颗花卉球茎栽入土中

collocations.en: plant a flower bulb in a pot
collocations.zh: 在花盆里栽种一颗花卉球茎

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar taddas basla tal-fjuri fil-ħamrija u saqqieha wara t-tħawwil.
formal.en: The gardener planted a flower bulb in the soil and watered it after planting.
formal.zh: 园丁把一颗花卉球茎栽入土中，并在栽种后浇了水。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se taddas basla tal-fjuri? Pawlu: Se npoġġiha f'din il-borma, ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going to plant a flower bulb? Pawlu: I'm going to put it in this pot, next to the window.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你打算把一颗花卉球茎种在哪里？Pawlu：我要把它种在这个花盆里，放在窗边。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se taddas basla tal-fjuri?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se taddas basla tal-fjuri?
messages.zh: 你打算把一颗花卉球茎种在哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going to plant a flower bulb?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se npoġġiha f'din il-borma, ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Se npoġġiha f'din il-borma, ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 我要把它种在这个花盆里，放在窗边。
messages.en: I'm going to put it in this pot, next to the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作画面记整句：手拿一颗花卉球茎，把它放进土里，再浇水；让 taddas basla tal-fjuri 对应“栽种花卉球茎”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loading carried out in blocks or grouped units.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以块或成组单元为单位进行的装载或加载。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa titgħabba fi blokok jew fi gruppi ta' unitajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按块或成组单元进行的装载、加载。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħbija li ssir billi jintużaw blokok jew gruppi ta' unitajiet bħala l-unitajiet tat-tagħbija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Block loading is a process in which loading is organized into blocks or grouped units.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċess ta' tagħbija fi blokok u jispjega kif jiġu organizzati l-unitajiet.
formal.en: The report describes the block loading process and explains how the units are organized.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了分块装载流程，并说明了各单元的组织方式。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tfisser tagħbija fi blokok hawn? Pawlu: Tfisser li t-tagħbija ssir fi gruppi ta' unitajiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does block loading mean here? Pawlu: It means that loading is carried out in groups of units.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的分块装载是什么意思？保罗：意思是按成组的单元进行装载。

messages.speaker: Sara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tfisser tagħbija fi blokok hawn?
messages.mt_standard: X'tfisser tagħbija fi blokok hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的分块装载是什么意思？
messages.en: What does block loading mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (培训员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li t-tagħbija ssir fi gruppi ta' unitajiet.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li t-tagħbija ssir fi gruppi ta' unitajiet.
messages.zh: 意思是按成组的单元进行装载。
messages.en: It means that loading is carried out in groups of units.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把待装载的东西先分成几个方块，再逐块装入；用“装载＋按块进行”的画面记住整个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Temporary overloads permitted within specified operating limits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在规定运行条件和限值内，允许短时间出现的超额负载。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħbijiet li jaqbżu l-livell normali għal żmien qasir u li huma permessi fil-limiti operattivi speċifikati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在规定条件下可接受的短时超额负载。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħbijiet ogħla mil-livell normali li jdumu għal żmien qasir u li jitqiesu aċċettabbli skont il-kundizzjonijiet speċifikati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Transitory admissible overloads are temporary loads above the normal level that are permitted under specified conditions.

collocations.en: the limits for transitory admissible overloads
the duration of transitory admissible overloads
collocations.zh: 允许短时过载的持续时间

formal.mt: Il-manwal jispeċifika l-limiti u t-tul tat-tagħbijiet eċċessivi tranżitorji ammissibbli għall-apparat.
formal.en: The manual specifies the limits and duration of the transitory admissible overloads for the equipment.
formal.zh: 手册规定了该设备允许短时过载的限值和持续时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dawn it-tagħbijiet eċċessivi tranżitorji ammissibbli jistgħu jdumu kemm irridu? David: Le, huma permessi biss għal żmien qasir u fil-limiti tal-manwal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can these transitory admissible overloads last as long as we want? David: No, they are permitted only for a short time and within the manual's limits.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这些允许的短时过载可以想持续多久就持续多久吗？戴维：不行，只能短时间出现，而且必须在手册规定的限值内。

messages.speaker: Lara (实习技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn it-tagħbijiet eċċessivi tranżitorji ammissibbli jistgħu jdumu kemm irridu?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn it-tagħbijiet eċċessivi tranżitorji ammissibbli jistgħu jdumu kemm irridu?
messages.zh: 这些允许的短时过载可以想持续多久就持续多久吗？
messages.en: Can these transitory admissible overloads last as long as we want?

messages.speaker: David (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huma permessi biss għal żmien qasir u fil-limiti tal-manwal.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huma permessi biss għal żmien qasir u fil-limiti tal-manwal.
messages.zh: 不行，只能短时间出现，而且必须在手册规定的限值内。
messages.en: No, they are permitted only for a short time and within the manual's limits.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“负载—超额—短时—允许”四步记忆：先想到超过正常负载，再同时加上时间短和条件允许两个限制。

exact_key: tagħmir li jintlibes u li jagħti xokkijiet tal-elettriku
gloss_zh: 可施加电击的穿戴式束缚器具；电击束缚铐

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wearable restraint devices capable of delivering electric shocks to the wearer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 佩戴在被约束者身上、能够向其施加电击的束缚装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmir ta' trażżin li jintlibes fuq il-ġisem u li jista' jagħti xokkijiet tal-elettriku lill-persuna li tkun liebsa fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够向佩戴者施加电击的铐式束缚装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat ta' trażżin f'għamla ta' manetti li jintlibes fuq il-ġisem u li jista' jagħti xokkijiet tal-elettriku lill-persuna li jkun imwaħħal magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Stun cuffs are wearable restraint devices that can deliver electric shocks to the person wearing them.

collocations.mt: l-użu ta' tagħmir li jintlibes u li jagħti xokkijiet tal-elettriku
il-bejgħ ta' tagħmir li jintlibes u li jagħti xokkijiet tal-elettriku

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-użu ta' tagħmir li jintlibes u li jagħti xokkijiet tal-elettriku bħala mezz ta' trażżin.
formal.en: The report examines the use of stun cuffs as a means of restraint.
formal.zh: 报告考察了将电击束缚铐用作约束手段的情况。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser tagħmir li jintlibes u li jagħti xokkijiet tal-elettriku f'dan it-test? Toni: Hawn ifisser manetti li jistgħu jagħtu xokkijiet tal-elettriku lill-persuna li tkun liebsa fihom.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does wearable equipment that delivers electric shocks mean in this text? Toni: Here it means cuffs that can deliver electric shocks to the person wearing them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这篇文章里的“可施加电击的穿戴式器具”是什么意思？托尼：这里指能够向佩戴者施加电击的束缚铐。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tagħmir li jintlibes u li jagħti xokkijiet tal-elettriku f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tagħmir li jintlibes u li jagħti xokkijiet tal-elettriku f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“可施加电击的穿戴式器具”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does wearable equipment that delivers electric shocks mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser manetti li jistgħu jagħtu xokkijiet tal-elettriku lill-persuna li tkun liebsa fihom.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser manetti li jistgħu jagħtu xokkijiet tal-elettriku lill-persuna li tkun liebsa fihom.
messages.zh: 这里指能够向佩戴者施加电击的束缚铐。
messages.en: Here it means cuffs that can deliver electric shocks to the person wearing them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成“器具＋穿戴在身上＋施加电击”三段理解，再联系束缚铐的形象记忆其具体所指。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equipment used by armed forces for military duties, operations, or defence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 武装部队用于执行军事任务、开展军事行动或进行国防活动的装备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-apparat, l-għodod u l-mezzi li jużaw il-forzi armati biex iwettqu dmirijiet militari, operazzjonijiet jew ħidma ta' difiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于国防和军事防卫的设备与装备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat u mezzi użati għall-ħarsien ta' pajjiż u għat-twettiq ta' ħidmiet ta' difiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Defence equipment consists of the devices and other resources used to protect a country against military threats.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 军队用于训练、执行任务和开展军事行动的装备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat, għodod u mezzi li jużaw il-forzi armati waqt it-taħriġ, il-missjonijiet u l-operazzjonijiet tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Military equipment consists of the tools, devices, and other resources that armed forces use in their work.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċeduri għall-manutenzjoni tat-tagħmir militari u għall-ħażna tiegħu f'post sigur.
formal.en: The report describes the procedures for maintaining military equipment and storing it in a secure place.
formal.zh: 该报告说明了军事装备的维护程序及其安全存放程序。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se naraw fil-mużew illum? Mark: Se naraw tagħmir militari li kien jintuża fil-passat.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are we going to see at the museum today? Mark: We are going to see military equipment that was used in the past.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天我们要在博物馆看什么？马克：我们要看过去使用过的军事装备。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se naraw fil-mużew illum?
messages.mt_standard: X'se naraw fil-mużew illum?
messages.zh: 今天我们要在博物馆看什么？
messages.en: What are we going to see at the museum today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se naraw tagħmir militari li kien jintuża fil-passat.
messages.mt_standard: Se naraw tagħmir militari li kien jintuża fil-passat.
messages.zh: 我们要看过去使用过的军事装备。
messages.en: We are going to see military equipment that was used in the past.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上军队装备陈列的画面来记：tagħmir 表示装备，militari 限定其军事用途；短语可统指多件装备。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equipment originally supplied with a product or installed when it was first made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产品最初交付时配备的设备，或制造之初安装的原配装备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-apparat jew l-għodod li kienu fornuti ma' prodott mill-bidu jew installati fih meta ġie magħmul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产品制造或最初交付时配备的原装设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li kien parti mill-prodott meta ġie magħmul jew li ġie fornut miegħu għall-ewwel darba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Original equipment is the equipment fitted to or supplied with a product when it was first made or sold.

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni kkonfermat li t-tagħmir oriġinali tal-vettura għadu installat u jaħdem sew.
formal.en: The inspection confirmed that the vehicle's original equipment is still installed and working properly.
formal.zh: 检查确认，车辆的原配设备仍安装在车上，而且运行正常。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ir-radju kien mal-karozza meta xtrajtha? Pawlu: Iva, huwa parti mit-tagħmir oriġinali.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did this radio come with the car when you bought it? Pawlu: Yes, it is part of the original equipment.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你买车时就配有这台收音机吗？保罗：是的，它是原配设备的一部分。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-radju kien mal-karozza meta xtrajtha?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-radju kien mal-karozza meta xtrajtha?
messages.zh: 你买车时就配有这台收音机吗？
messages.en: Did this radio come with the car when you bought it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa parti mit-tagħmir oriġinali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa parti mit-tagħmir oriġinali.
messages.zh: 是的，它是原配设备的一部分。
messages.en: Yes, it is part of the original equipment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新车交付时自带的收音机，用“最初就配着的设备”记住 tagħmir oriġinali；这里强调原配关系。

gloss_zh: 防御装备；国防装备；军事装备

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equipment used for defence or for carrying out the duties of armed forces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于军事防御、国防活动或执行武装部队任务的装备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-apparat u l-mezzi użati għad-difiża jew biex il-forzi armati jwettqu d-dmirijiet tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于抵御军事威胁、执行防卫任务的装备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat u mezzi maħsuba biex jintużaw kontra theddid militari u fit-twettiq ta' ħidmiet ta' difiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Defence equipment is equipment used to respond to military threats and carry out protective military duties.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 武装部队在军事训练、任务和行动中使用的装备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat, għodod u mezzi użati mill-forzi armati fit-taħriġ u waqt il-missjonijiet u l-operazzjonijiet tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Military equipment includes the devices and other resources used by armed forces during training and operations.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat eżamina l-ispiża tax-xiri ta' tagħmir ta' difiża u r-rekwiżiti għall-manutenzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The committee examined the cost of purchasing defence equipment and the requirements for its maintenance.
formal.zh: 委员会审查了国防装备的采购成本及其维护要求。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dwar xiex inhu dan l-artiklu? David: Dwar tagħmir ta' difiża u kif jinżamm f'kundizzjoni tajba.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this article about? David: It is about defence equipment and how it is kept in good condition.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文章讲什么？戴维：讲国防装备，以及如何让这些装备保持良好状态。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar xiex inhu dan l-artiklu?
messages.mt_standard: Dwar xiex inhu dan l-artiklu?
messages.zh: 这篇文章讲什么？
messages.en: What is this article about?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar tagħmir ta' difiża u kif jinżamm f'kundizzjoni tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar tagħmir ta' difiża u kif jinżamm f'kundizzjoni tajba.
messages.zh: 讲国防装备，以及如何让这些装备保持良好状态。
messages.en: It is about defence equipment and how it is kept in good condition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“装备＋防御用途”分块记忆：tagħmir 是装备，ta' difiża 说明用途；联想国防装备采购清单即可串起整个短语。

exact_key: tagħmir ta' impatt li jinżamm fl-idejn

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device held in the hands that applies force through an impact or repeated impacts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用时握在手中，通过一次或反复撞击施加作用力的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jinżamm fl-idejn waqt l-użu u li jeżerċita forza permezz ta' daqqa jew ta' daqqiet ripetuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由使用者握持，并通过撞击或连续冲击发挥作用的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li l-utent iżomm f'idejh u li jaħdem billi jagħti daqqa jew sensiela ta' daqqiet fuq oġġett jew wiċċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hand-held impact device is held by its user and applies force by striking an object or surface.

collocations.mt: użu sikur ta' tagħmir ta' impatt li jinżamm fl-idejn
collocations.en: safe use of a hand-held impact device
collocations.zh: 手持式冲击装置的安全使用

collocations.mt: spezzjoni ta' tagħmir ta' impatt li jinżamm fl-idejn
collocations.en: inspection of a hand-held impact device
collocations.zh: 手持式冲击装置的检查

formal.mt: Il-manwal jispjega kif għandu jintuża t-tagħmir ta' impatt li jinżamm fl-idejn u liema kontrolli għandhom isiru qabel kull użu.
formal.en: The manual explains how the hand-held impact device should be used and which checks should be carried out before each use.
formal.zh: 手册说明了该手持式冲击装置的使用方法，以及每次使用前应进行的检查。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan it-tagħmir ta' impatt li jinżamm fl-idejn kif jaħdem? Toni: Jaħdem bid-daqqiet; ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet qabel nużawh.
colloquial.en: Nina: How does this hand-held impact device work? Toni: It works by delivering impacts; let's read the instructions before using it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个手持式冲击装置怎么工作？托尼：它通过撞击起作用；我们先读说明书再用吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tagħmir ta' impatt li jinżamm fl-idejn kif jaħdem?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tagħmir ta' impatt li jinżamm fl-idejn kif jaħdem?
messages.zh: 这个手持式冲击装置怎么工作？
messages.en: How does this hand-held impact device work?

messages.speaker: Toni (培训员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jaħdem bid-daqqiet; ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet qabel nużawh.
messages.mt_standard: Jaħdem bid-daqqiet; ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet qabel nużawh.
messages.zh: 它通过撞击起作用；我们先读说明书再用吧。
messages.en: It works by delivering impacts; let's read the instructions before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长短语拆成三段：tagħmir“装置”、ta' impatt“用于冲击”、li jinżamm fl-idejn“握在手中的”；联想手握装置产生撞击的画面。

exact_key: tagħmir tax-xokk elettriku li jista' jinġarr

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equipment that produces an electric shock and can be carried from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够产生电击并可随身携带或搬运的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmir li jipproduċi xokk elettriku u li jista' jinġarr minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够携带或搬运的电击装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jipproduċi xokk elettriku u li jista' jinġarr minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A portable electric shock device is a piece of equipment that produces an electric shock and can be carried.

collocations.mt: il-ħażna ta' tagħmir tax-xokk elettriku li jista' jinġarr
collocations.en: the storage of portable electric shock equipment
collocations.zh: 便携式电击装置的存放

collocations.mt: it-trasport ta' tagħmir tax-xokk elettriku li jista' jinġarr
collocations.en: the transport of portable electric shock equipment
collocations.zh: 便携式电击装置的运输

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi tagħmir tax-xokk elettriku li jista' jinġarr u jispjega kif għandu jinħażen.
formal.en: The report describes portable electric shock equipment and explains how it should be stored.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了便携式电击装置，并说明了其存放方式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan it-tagħmir? Mark: Huwa tagħmir tax-xokk elettriku li jista' jinġarr.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this equipment? Mark: It is portable electric shock equipment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是什么设备？马克：这是便携式电击装置。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-tagħmir?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-tagħmir?
messages.zh: 这是什么设备？
messages.en: What is this equipment?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa tagħmir tax-xokk elettriku li jista' jinġarr.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa tagħmir tax-xokk elettriku li jista' jinġarr.
messages.zh: 这是便携式电击装置。
messages.en: It is portable electric shock equipment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分成三块记忆：tagħmir 是设备，tax-xokk elettriku 指电击，li jista' jinġarr 表示可以携带；连起来就是便携式电击装置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression presented as a noun in this entry, with the meaning of giving something to them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条按名词列示的表达形式，所给含义为把某物给他们。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni ppreżentata hawn bħala nom li tfisser li wieħed jagħti xi ħaġa lilhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物给他们；本义项按名词列示。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni, elenkata hawn bħala nom, tirreferi għall-għoti ta' xi ħaġa lilhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this entry, the expression refers to giving something to them and is listed as a noun.

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, 'tagħthom' hija elenkata bħala nom bit-tifsira li wieħed jagħti xi ħaġa lilhom.
formal.en: In this list, 'tagħthom' is listed as a noun with the meaning of giving something to them.
formal.zh: 在这份词表中，“tagħthom”被列为名词，含义是把某物给他们。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tagħthom' f'din il-lista? Mark: Hawn tfisser li tagħti xi ħaġa lilhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tagħthom' mean in this list? Mark: Here it means giving something to them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这份词表里的“tagħthom”是什么意思？马克：这里的意思是把某物给他们。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'tagħthom' f'din il-lista?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'tagħthom' f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这份词表里的“tagħthom”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tagħthom' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li tagħti xi ħaġa lilhom.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li tagħti xi ħaġa lilhom.
messages.zh: 这里的意思是把某物给他们。
messages.en: Here it means giving something to them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整词与“把东西递给他们”的画面配对记忆。本条保留词表所给的名词标签，不凭这个标签推断其他用法，也不自行拆解词尾。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb form presented in this entry with the meaning of giving something to them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条所列的动词形式，表示把某物给他们。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' verb li f'din l-entrata tfisser li wieħed jagħti xi ħaġa lilhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物给他们。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din il-forma verbali hija ppreżentata hawn bit-tifsira li wieħed jagħti xi ħaġa lilhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this entry, this verb form means that someone gives something to them.

formal.mt: Il-lista tippreżenta 'tagħthomlok' bħala forma verbali bit-tifsira li wieħed jagħti xi ħaġa lilhom.
formal.en: The list presents 'tagħthomlok' as a verb form meaning that someone gives something to them.
formal.zh: 这份词表将“tagħthomlok”列为动词形式，含义是某人把某物给他们。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tagħthomlok' hawn? Mark: Skont il-lista, tfisser li tagħti xi ħaġa lilhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tagħthomlok' mean here? Mark: According to the list, it means giving something to them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的“tagħthomlok”是什么意思？马克：按照词表，它的意思是把某物给他们。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'tagħthomlok' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'tagħthomlok' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的“tagħthomlok”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tagħthomlok' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont il-lista, tfisser li tagħti xi ħaġa lilhom.
messages.mt_standard: Skont il-lista, tfisser li tagħti xi ħaġa lilhom.
messages.zh: 按照词表，它的意思是把某物给他们。
messages.en: According to the list, it means giving something to them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作整词卡片：正面写 tagħthomlok，背面写“给他们”，旁边画递交物品的箭头。按本条给定含义记忆，不自行给各段词尾添加解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something to someone, or to deliver a punch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物给某人，或挥拳击打。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi xi ħaġa lil xi ħadd, jew tolqot lil xi ħadd b'daqqa ta' ponn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予某物，或用拳头击打。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħti tfisser li tgħaddi xi ħaġa lil xi ħadd, jew li tolqot lil xi ħadd b'daqqa ta' ponn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you give something to someone or deliver a punch, you perform an action expressed here by 'tagħti'.

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'tagħti' tintuża kemm f''tagħti rigal' kif ukoll f''tagħti daqqa ta' ponn'; il-kuntest juri t-tifsira.
formal.en: The word 'tagħti' is used in both 'give a gift' and 'throw a punch'; the context indicates the meaning.
formal.zh: “tagħti”既用于“送礼物”，也用于“挥出一拳”；具体含义由语境表明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Tagħti' dejjem tfisser li tagħti xi ħaġa lil xi ħadd? Mark: Le, tista' tgħid ukoll 'tagħti daqqa ta' ponn'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'tagħti' always mean giving something to someone? Mark: No, you can also say 'tagħti daqqa ta' ponn', meaning 'throw a punch'.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“tagħti”总是表示把东西给别人吗？马克：不是，也可以说“tagħti daqqa ta' ponn”，意思是挥出一拳。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Tagħti' dejjem tfisser li tagħti xi ħaġa lil xi ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: 'Tagħti' dejjem tfisser li tagħti xi ħaġa lil xi ħadd?
messages.zh: “tagħti”总是表示把东西给别人吗？
messages.en: Does 'tagħti' always mean giving something to someone?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tista' tgħid ukoll 'tagħti daqqa ta' ponn'.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tista' tgħid ukoll 'tagħti daqqa ta' ponn'.
messages.zh: 不是，也可以说“tagħti daqqa ta' ponn”，意思是挥出一拳。
messages.en: No, you can also say 'tagħti daqqa ta' ponn', meaning 'throw a punch'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画并排记忆：一幅是伸手送出礼物，对应 tagħti rigal；另一幅是挥出拳头，对应 tagħti daqqa ta' ponn。根据后面的搭配判断意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A possessive expression indicating that something belongs to a female person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物属于她，可译为“她的”或“属于她的东西”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħaġa hija ta' persuna femminili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 她的；指属于她的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika xi ħaġa li tappartjeni lil persuna femminili msemmija jew magħrufa mill-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to indicate that something belongs to a female person already mentioned or understood.

formal.mt: Maria identifikat il-borża u kkonfermat li hija tahha.
formal.en: Maria identified the bag and confirmed that it was hers.
formal.zh: 玛丽亚辨认了这个包，并确认它属于自己。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din il-borża ta' Sara? Maja: Iva, hija tahha. Ħalliha hawn għaliha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this Sara's bag? Maja: Yes, it's hers. Leave it here for her.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这是萨拉的包吗？玛雅：对，是她的。给她放在这里吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-borża ta' Sara?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-borża ta' Sara?
messages.zh: 这是萨拉的包吗？
messages.en: Is this Sara's bag?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija tahha. Ħalliha hawn għaliha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija tahha. Ħalliha hawn għaliha.
messages.zh: 对，是她的。给她放在这里吧。
messages.en: Yes, it's hers. Leave it here for her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象认领物品时指着萨拉的包，说“是她的”；把 tahha 与“她的所有物”这一场景联系记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A farm implement used to turn over soil before planting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 播种前用来翻开、耕松土壤的农具，即犁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda agrikola li tintuża biex taqleb il-ħamrija u tħejji l-art għaż-żrigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犁；用于翻耕土壤、为播种整地的农具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda li l-bidwi juża biex jiftaħ u jaqleb il-ħamrija qabel jiżra' l-għalqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plow is a farm implement that turns over the soil to prepare land for planting.

formal.mt: Il-bidwi juża tahrat biex jaqleb il-ħamrija u jħejji l-għalqa għaż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The farmer uses a plow to turn over the soil and prepare the field for sowing.
formal.zh: 农民用犁翻耕土壤，为田地播种做好准备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se tuża biex tħejji l-art? Pawlu: Se nuża tahrat biex naqleb il-ħamrija qabel niżra'.
colloquial.en: Sara: What will you use to prepare the land? Pawlu: I'll use a plow to turn over the soil before I sow.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你准备使用什么来整地？保罗：我会用犁翻土，然后再播种。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se tuża biex tħejji l-art?
messages.mt_standard: X'se tuża biex tħejji l-art?
messages.zh: 你准备使用什么来整地？
messages.en: What will you use to prepare the land?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nuża tahrat biex naqleb il-ħamrija qabel niżra'.
messages.mt_standard: Se nuża tahrat biex naqleb il-ħamrija qabel niżra'.
messages.zh: 我会用犁翻土，然后再播种。
messages.en: I'll use a plow to turn over the soil before I sow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tahrat 放进春耕画面：农民扶着犁，犁刃翻开泥土，随后播种；用“翻土的农具”记住名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plastic covering for an object, or a cartridge used in a device.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于包覆物件的塑料护套，或装在设备中的卡匣；具体所指取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata tal-plastik għal oġġett, jew skartoċċ li jintuża f'apparat, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塑料护套；卡匣，具体含义由所指物件决定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Takka hija għata tal-plastik għal oġġett, jew skartoċċ li jitqiegħed f'apparat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A takka is a plastic covering or a cartridge, depending on the object being described.

formal.mt: Qabel tuża l-apparat, iċċekkja li t-takka tal-plastik tkun f'postha.
formal.en: Before using the device, check that the plastic covering is in place.
formal.zh: 使用设备前，请检查塑料护套是否已安装到位。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din it-takka tal-plastik fejn inpoġġiha? Pawlu: Poġġiha fuq il-mejda ħdejn l-apparat.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put this plastic covering? Pawlu: Put it on the table next to the device.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个塑料护套放在哪里？保罗：放在设备旁边的桌子上。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-takka tal-plastik fejn inpoġġiha?
messages.mt_standard: Din it-takka tal-plastik fejn inpoġġiha?
messages.zh: 这个塑料护套放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this plastic covering?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha fuq il-mejda ħdejn l-apparat.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha fuq il-mejda ħdejn l-apparat.
messages.zh: 放在设备旁边的桌子上。
messages.en: Put it on the table next to the device.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 takka 配上两幅学习图：包住物件的塑料护套，以及装入设备的卡匣；用语境选择对应含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A car with a driver that you pay to take you to a chosen destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由司机驾驶、乘客付费乘坐并前往指定目的地的汽车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karozza b'xufier li twassal lill-passiġġieri fejn jixtiequ jmorru bi ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出租车；由司机提供付费载客服务的汽车。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taksi huwa karozza b'xufier li ġġorr passiġġieri lejn id-destinazzjoni tagħhom bi ħlas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A taxi is a car whose driver you pay to take you to a particular place.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi jistgħu jieħdu taksi mill-ajruport sal-lukanda.
formal.en: Visitors can take a taxi from the airport to the hotel.
formal.zh: 访客可以从机场乘出租车前往酒店。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nieħdu taksi sal-istazzjon? Mark: Iva, għax għandna ħafna bagalji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we take a taxi to the station? Mark: Yes, because we have a lot of luggage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们坐出租车去车站吧？马克：好，因为我们的行李很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nieħdu taksi sal-istazzjon?
messages.mt_standard: Nieħdu taksi sal-istazzjon?
messages.zh: 我们坐出租车去车站吧？
messages.en: Shall we take a taxi to the station?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax għandna ħafna bagalji.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax għandna ħafna bagalji.
messages.zh: 好，因为我们的行李很多。
messages.en: Yes, because we have a lot of luggage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taksi 和熟悉的英语 taxi 对照记忆，再联想提着行李招车的场景，记住它表示出租车。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At or belonging to the beginning of an activity, process, or period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于某项活动、过程或时期开始阶段的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun fil-bidu ta' attività, proċess jew perjodu, jew li jkollu x'jaqsam ma' dak il-bidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最初的；发生于开始阶段的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jseħħ jew ikun jeżisti fl-ewwel parti ta' attività, proċess jew perjodu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something initial happens or exists at the beginning of an activity, process, or period.

formal.mt: L-evalwazzjoni tal-bidu tgħin lill-għalliem jidentifika l-ħtiġijiet tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The initial assessment helps the teacher identify the students' needs.
formal.zh: 初始评估有助于教师了解学生的学习需求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer il-kors? Mark: Il-lezzjonijiet tal-bidu kienu faċli, imma issa saru aktar diffiċli.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the course going? Mark: The initial lessons were easy, but now they have become more difficult.
colloquial.zh: Maja：课程学得怎么样？Mark：开始阶段的课很容易，不过现在变难了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer il-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer il-kors?
messages.zh: 课程学得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the course going?

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lezzjonijiet tal-bidu kienu faċli, imma issa saru aktar diffiċli.
messages.mt_standard: Il-lezzjonijiet tal-bidu kienu faċli, imma issa saru aktar diffiċli.
messages.zh: 开始阶段的课很容易，不过现在变难了。
messages.en: The initial lessons were easy, but now they have become more difficult.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tal-bidu 放在学习时间线的起点旁，联想“初始阶段、初期费用、最初几课”，记住它强调事情刚开始时的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing a strong feeling of fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人产生强烈恐惧感的；令人害怕的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqajjem sens qawwi ta' biża' f'persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人十分害怕的；使人感到强烈恐惧的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jbeżża' ħafna u jġiegħel lil persuna tħoss biża' qawwi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something terrifying makes you feel extremely frightened.

formal.mt: Ix-xhieda ddeskrivew il-maltempata bħala esperjenza tal-biża'.
formal.en: The witnesses described the storm as a terrifying experience.
formal.zh: 目击者将这场暴风雨描述为一次令人恐惧的经历。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għoġbok il-film? Pawlu: Kien tal-biża'! Għalaqt għajnejja waqt xi xeni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you like the film? Pawlu: It was terrifying! I closed my eyes during some scenes.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你喜欢那部电影吗？Pawlu：太吓人了！有些场景我都闭上眼睛了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġbok il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Għoġbok il-film?
messages.zh: 你喜欢那部电影吗？
messages.en: Did you like the film?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien tal-biża'! Għalaqt għajnejja waqt xi xeni.
messages.mt_standard: Kien tal-biża'! Għalaqt għajnejja waqt xi xeni.
messages.zh: 太吓人了！有些场景我都闭上眼睛了。
messages.en: It was terrifying! I closed my eyes during some scenes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看恐怖电影时捂住眼睛，说一句“Kien tal-biża'!”；用“吓得闭眼”的画面记住“令人恐惧的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A natural ability to do a particular kind of activity well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某项活动或某个领域中表现出色的天生能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħila naturali li biha persuna tkun kapaċi tagħmel attività partikolari tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在音乐、艺术等特定领域中具有的天赋或才华。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kapaċità naturali li tgħin lil persuna tispikka f'qasam jew attività partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you have talent for an activity, you have a natural ability to do it well.

formal.mt: L-iskola toffri lezzjonijiet speċjali biex tgħin lill-istudenti jiżviluppaw it-talent tagħhom għall-mużika.
formal.en: The school offers special lessons to help students develop their talent for music.
formal.zh: 学校开设专门课程，帮助学生培养音乐才华。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Smajt lil binti tkanta lbieraħ? David: Iva, għandha talent għall-mużika! Għandha tkompli titgħallem.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you hear my daughter sing yesterday? David: Yes, she has a talent for music! She should keep learning.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你昨天听到我女儿唱歌了吗？David：听到了，她有音乐天赋！她应该继续学下去。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt lil binti tkanta lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt lil binti tkanta lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 你昨天听到我女儿唱歌了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear my daughter sing yesterday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha talent għall-mużika! Għandha tkompli titgħallem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha talent għall-mużika! Għandha tkompli titgħallem.
messages.zh: 听到了，她有音乐天赋！她应该继续学下去。
messages.en: Yes, she has a talent for music! She should keep learning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 可借助同形英语词 talent 联想“天赋”，再把 talent għall-mużika 整块记成“音乐天赋”，配上孩子自然唱准旋律的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of the kind mentioned or understood; also used to refer to a person without giving their name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示前面提到或语境中明确的那一类；也可用于不指明姓名的某个人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun tax-xorta msemmija jew mifhuma mill-kuntest; jintuża wkoll biex issir referenza għal persuna mingħajr ma jingħata isimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 此类的；与已提到的事物属于同一类型的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun tal-istess tip jew xorta bħal dak li jkun diġà ssemma jew li jkun mifhum mill-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to describe things of the kind already mentioned or understood.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某某；指姓名未说明或无需说明的某个人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jintuża biex jissejjaħ xi ħadd mingħajr ma jingħad ismu, għax l-isem ma jkunx magħruf jew ma jkunx meħtieġ li jissemma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to refer to someone whose name you do not give.

formal.mt: F'każijiet tali, l-uffiċċju għandu jitlob aktar informazzjoni qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: In cases of that kind, the office should request further information before making a decision.
formal.zh: 在此类情况下，办事处应先要求提供更多信息，再作决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jekk terġa' tiġri xi ħaġa tali, ċempilli. Mark: Tajjeb, inċempillek mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: If something like that happens again, call me. Mark: All right, I will call you straight away.
colloquial.zh: Maja：如果再发生这样的事，就给我打电话。Mark：好的，我会马上给你打电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk terġa' tiġri xi ħaġa tali, ċempilli.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk terġa' tiġri xi ħaġa tali, ċempilli.
messages.zh: 如果再发生这样的事，就给我打电话。
messages.en: If something like that happens again, call me.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, inċempillek mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, inċempillek mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 好的，我会马上给你打电话。
messages.en: All right, I will call you straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tali 想成一个语境标签：贴在事情上表示“这样的、此类的”，放进 it-tali persuna 则表示不说姓名的“某某人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, short nail used to fasten something to a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于将纸张、布料等固定在表面上的小型短钉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Musmar żgħir u qasir li jintuża biex iwaħħal xi ħaġa ma' wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于固定纸张、布料等的小型短钉或图钉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taċċ huwa musmar żgħir u qasir li jintuża biex iżomm materjal imwaħħal ma' wiċċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tack is a small, short nail used to hold material against a surface.

collocations.en: fasten the paper with a tack
remove the tack from the board

formal.mt: Waħħal l-avviż mal-bord b'taċċ u kun żgur li l-karta tibqa' f'postha.
formal.en: Fasten the notice to the board with a tack and make sure the paper stays in place.
formal.zh: 用图钉将通知固定在板上，并确保纸张不会移位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek taċċ biex inwaħħal din il-karta? | Mark: Iva, hawn wieħed. Oqgħod attenta għall-ponta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you got a tack so I can put up this paper? | Mark: Yes, here's one. Watch out for the point.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有图钉吗？我想把这张纸钉上去。 | Mark：有，这里有一枚。小心尖头。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek taċċ biex inwaħħal din il-karta?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek taċċ biex inwaħħal din il-karta?
messages.zh: 你有图钉吗？我想把这张纸钉上去。
messages.en: Have you got a tack so I can put up this paper?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn wieħed. Oqgħod attenta għall-ponta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn wieħed. Oqgħod attenta għall-ponta.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一枚。小心尖头。
messages.en: Yes, here's one. Watch out for the point.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taċċ 和“用一枚小钉固定纸张”的动作连在一起记；想象尖头穿过纸、钉帽压住纸。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Discussions in which people exchange views about a subject or try to reach agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们围绕某一主题交换意见的讨论或会谈，也可用于寻求共识的场合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skambji ta' fehmiet bejn persuni dwar suġġett, xi drabi bil-għan li jintlaħaq ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讨论；会谈，指参与者就某个问题交换意见的交流活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Konversazzjonijiet li fihom il-parteċipanti jesprimu u jqabblu l-fehmiet tagħhom dwar kwistjoni jew suġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Discussions are conversations in which people exchange ideas or opinions about a particular subject.

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentanti komplew it-taħdidiet dwar il-proġett bil-għan li jilħqu ftehim.
formal.en: The representatives continued the discussions about the project with the aim of reaching an agreement.
formal.zh: 代表们继续就该项目展开讨论，以期达成协议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marru t-taħdidiet dwar il-proġett? Mark: Tajjeb, imma għad irridu niltaqgħu darb'oħra biex naqblu fuq id-dettalji.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the discussions about the project go? Mark: Well, but we still need to meet again to agree on the details.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：关于项目的讨论进行得怎么样？马克：挺好，不过我们还得再开一次会，把细节商定下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif marru t-taħdidiet dwar il-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Kif marru t-taħdidiet dwar il-proġett?
messages.zh: 关于项目的讨论进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the discussions about the project go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, imma għad irridu niltaqgħu darb'oħra biex naqblu fuq id-dettalji.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, imma għad irridu niltaqgħu darb'oħra biex naqblu fuq id-dettalji.
messages.zh: 挺好，不过我们还得再开一次会，把细节商定下来。
messages.en: Well, but we still need to meet again to agree on the details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个人围桌轮流发表意见，把 taħdidiet 记成一轮轮“讨论、会谈”；重点联想交流意见的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression asking someone to stop tormenting or mistreating the speaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 请求或要求对方不要折磨、欺负说话者的表达，意为“别折磨我”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li biha min jitkellem jitlob lil xi ħadd biex ma jaħqrux jew ma jġegħlux ibati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 别折磨我；要求对方停止使自己痛苦或难受。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Talba jew twissija lil persuna oħra biex tieqaf iġġiegħel lil min jitkellem ibati jew iħossu maħqur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You say this when asking someone to stop causing you distress or treating you cruelly.

collocations.en: Do not torment me with these questions.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu kiteb: 'Taħqarnix aktar; nitolbok tittrattani b'rispett.'
formal.en: In his letter he wrote: 'Do not torment me any longer; I ask you to treat me with respect.'
formal.zh: 他在信中写道：“别再折磨我了；我请求你尊重我。”

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għidli x'ġara! Għaliex ma tridx tgħidli? Sara: Taħqarnix b'dawn il-mistoqsijiet. Għandi bżonn ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Mark: Tell me what happened! Why won't you tell me? Sara: Don't torment me with these questions. I need a little time.
colloquial.zh: 马克：告诉我发生了什么！你为什么不肯告诉我？萨拉：别用这些问题折磨我了。我需要一点时间。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għidli x'ġara! Għaliex ma tridx tgħidli?
messages.mt_standard: Għidli x'ġara! Għaliex ma tridx tgħidli?
messages.zh: 告诉我发生了什么！你为什么不肯告诉我？
messages.en: Tell me what happened! Why won't you tell me?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħqarnix b'dawn il-mistoqsijiet. Għandi bżonn ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Taħqarnix b'dawn il-mistoqsijiet. Għandi bżonn ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 别用这些问题折磨我了。我需要一点时间。
messages.en: Don't torment me with these questions. I need a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taħqarnix 整体记成一句求停止的话：被反复追问时举手说“别折磨我”；结合语气和场景记忆。
